sourceTitle: 新品节 2026 年 10 月版 - 媒体预玩

games.name: Mercyrail: Haven Bound
games.description: Britain fell a year ago. You're running the last train out of a dark Waterloo, north across the real UK rail network towards a rumoured survival colony called Haven. Decide who gets a place, send your crew into empty towns for supplies, and keep everyone alive long enough to reach Haven.

games.name: Age After Age
games.description: 《时代更迭》。建设繁荣的定居点，跨越多重时代塑造社会，主宰动态世界经济。选择您的发展路线： 经典历史、蒸汽朋克、哥特风等多种时代分支，在这款深度城市建造策略游戏中体验不断进化的物流系统、市民阶层、外交与科研。

games.name: Aurora: Firebreak
games.description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

games.name: 波波和噩梦之箱
games.description: 在这款带点惊悚氛围的3D平台跳跃游戏中，尽情跳跃、滑翔并智破陷阱吧！粉碎障碍、解开谜题、击退恶灵，并最终打败“梦境大师”。收集隐藏的宝藏，为这个被黑暗笼罩的世界重新带回欢乐！

games.name: Fables of the Kingdom Remastered
games.description: 帮助勇敢的英雄凯文重建被邪恶巫师巴伦摧毁的美丽王国，并拯救被绑架的公主！在这款重制且节奏明快的时间管理策略游戏中，清理道路、收集资源、建造建筑并施展魔法。

games.name: Slip Angle
games.description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

games.name: Platinum Kill
games.description: Dr Sharkface has plunged the world into chaos and stolen all the kittens. Team up with up to 4 friends and shoot your way through 7 levels of retro-inspired run-and-gun action - packed with wild weapons, huge bosses, and one surprisingly adorable cat.

games.name: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
games.description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

games.name: 卡通工艺：莱斯奥夫谬特申
games.description: 一款受经典RTS启发的剧情即时战略游戏。体验包含个任务的战役，结识个性角色，见证意外联盟与幽默故事。建设王国，指挥人类与兽人，创建并分享属于你的战场。

games.name: Code of The Savage
games.description: 被从奴隶船上扔进海里后，你戴着镣铐漂流到一个残酷而精心打造的王国。《野蛮法典》是一款受经典作品启发的黑暗奇幻开放世界 RPG。在这里，探索、生存、NPC 互动以及选择带来的后果将共同塑造你的道路。

games.name: Fallen Sword II
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 《Fallen Sword II》是一款受复古RPG启发的回合制奇幻冒险游戏。成为埃瑞达斯的新任勇者，穿越奇幻国度与危险地下城。对抗黑暗，打破轮回，拯救世界。

games.name: Subtransit Drive
games.description: 在这款拥有精细物理模拟和完整列车系统的高级地铁模拟器中，驾驶真实地铁线路上的列车。独自探索地下交通网络，或通过跨平台多人模式与其他玩家共同运营。

games.name: 最后的鸡堡
games.description: 《最后的鸡堡》是一款非典型动作角色扮演游戏，融合少量生存、策略与解谜要素。化身饱受压迫的鸡人，踏上抗争之路。在人人建造的角斗场艰难求生，由一个普通鸡人一步步成长为鸡王。之后，统领鸡民反抗人人压迫，夺回属于鸡族的家园。

games.name: Tube2K
games.description: 现在是2005年，你即将建立改变世界的视频分享平台。你是要带来人类的黄金时代，还是让它屈膝？

games.name: Football Story
games.description: 《Football Story》是一款温馨的街头足球 RPG 兼生活模拟游戏，讲述成长、友谊与梦想。锻炼技能、探索 Lumen Bay、帮助居民，组建你自己的街头球队。从最初的街坊比赛一路踢到击败职业球员的胜利！

games.name: Matchy Star
games.description: Match stars along your ship’s flight path in a colorful match-3 roguelite. Plan your moves, chain big matches, and collect quirky upgrades as you chart a changing route through space. Guide Zippy, Skippy, and Bob toward Xanadu, one run at a time.

games.name: Zodiac Legion
games.description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

games.name: Diceward
games.description: Roll the dice. Load them into your cards. Strike. DICEWARD is a dice-driven roguelite deckbuilder where every attack, guard, and gambit is fueled by the dice in your hand and the deck you forge descending through four cursed depths.

games.name: In My Name
games.description: The hunger of an eldritch horror such as yourself can only be satisfied by consuming mortal souls. Do you have the deft touch required to turn a handful of barbarian tribes into thriving civilizations whose citizens are willing to sacrifice themselves in the name of a ravenous impostor god?

games.name: Scratch The Cat
games.description: 戴上耳机，走上唱盘，开启《Scratch The Cat》的音乐之旅《Scratch The Cat》是一款充满活力的3D动作冒险平台游戏。玩家将扮演DJ猫咪Scratch，探索广阔的音乐世界，对抗强大的Boss，找回被盗的唱片。调高音量，为完美的回归做好准备。

games.name: 午夜兽群
games.description: 墙跑！穿梭！斩杀！翱翔于午夜废墟之中！穿梭于无形恶魔的滚烫潮群，以飞刀穿断脊柱，以霰弹轰飞残肢；绽放于腐朽如墨的夜色中，如杀戮玫瑰。身形穿梭游走于筑起的高塔，手中的刀锋是夜的利齿，亦是破晓前烁出的第一缕曦光。凝视着你的怪物，都将在寒光中战栗窒息。你不是猎人，而是午夜本身。

games.name: Fragment: A Botanical Adventure
games.description: Collect over 200 unique plants and bring your farms and gardens to life. Plant flowers and watch butterflies fly in to pollinate your crops. Restore barren lands with mushrooms. Build relationships with your crew as you decipher the mysterious creatures that have infested your corner of the galaxy.

games.name: 枪炮哥布林
games.description: 在这款带有数值养成元素的第一人称射击生存游戏中直面怪物狂潮，建设堡垒、提升等级并升级武器库，从见习鸣钟人一步步崛起为屠龙大师。

games.name: Rusty Tank Survival
games.description: Rusty Tank is a single player 2-D top down survival shooter. The game is an open world sandbox game that includes base and factory building.

games.name: Slottoki
games.description: 老虎机 Roguelike。升级你的符号，收集强力道具，打造打破游戏规则的构筑，赢取大奖。

games.name: Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!!
games.description: An area-control real-time strategy game, filled with auto-battling bunnies bent on destroying the human race!  Explore space and uncover hand-painted planets.  Research unique upgrades!  Kill your friends! -er use diplomacy in multiplayer!

games.name: Don't Save the Princess
games.description: An anti-runner in which you control the obstacles instead of the runner. Strike, combo, and upgrade to finally earn the princess some personal time!

games.name: ARCHWIZARD
games.description:
Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World.
Knowledge based progression. Full of secrets.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.description: 成为电视上最刺激的游戏节目的明星！挑选你的骰子，下注，构建连击，尽量不要过多想输掉时会发生什么。

games.name: Backpack Inspector
games.description: 奇幻世界的海关官员模拟游戏。决定那些想进入你所守护王国的英雄命运。检查他们的背包，找出违禁神器、赃物与走私品。保持警觉，为了王冠的荣耀！

games.name: Flea Madness
games.description:
投入快节奏的目标争夺战，体验受经典团队射击游戏启发的玩法。占领据点、支援队友，并利用各种枪械、滑稽的啃咬攻击以及能够载你冲锋陷阵的奇特昆虫伙伴制造彻底的混乱。
每场比赛都充满了不可预测的时刻、荒诞的遭遇，以及无数智胜——或者咬赢——对手的机会。

games.name: 移动城堡
games.description: 轻松休闲的搭建一座移动城堡，带着居民们一起旅行，战胜可怕怪物，种种地，做做饭，一起看日出与日落。

games.name: ProtoDungeon: Episode III
games.description: A bite-sized, 2D top-down exploration adventure in an interconnected world. Fall into a lonely seaside cove, find a magic leaf beneath a shriveled lotus tree, summon sacred fire, and learn to jump, swim, and dash your way toward the chapel. No map or quest markers here; the way through is up to you.

games.name: Blood And Mead
games.description: Carve through a vast, brutal world filled with deadly enemies, loot, and HUGE bosses. Level up to unlock new combat skills, then drink mead to unleash Berserker Mode… you may or may not end up a demi-god.

games.name: CHOICEEEEE
games.description: 一款快节奏动作RPG. 闯入一百层充满怪物与Boss的关卡, 每过一关从三个随机技能中做出抉择, 构建你的独特战斗流派. 击败敌人掉落随机词缀装备, 白蓝紫暗金红五档品质, 数百种词缀自由组合. 战斗爽快, 装备系统深度十足, 每一件掉落都可能颠覆你的打法.

games.name: 终末之月
games.description: 《终末之月》是一款拥抱90年代经典作品风格的动作RPG游戏。探索一个广阔、苍凉而令人着迷的危险世界，直面腐化的魔物，升级各种能力以恢复世界的和平。月亮正在崩坠，你能否将和谐带回这个世界呢？

games.name: Double Down & Out
games.description: The house always wins, so change the rules. Double Down & Out is blackjack where you combine cards and maths to reach your target. Stack buffs, enhance your cards with chips and beat down dealers who play by their own rules.

games.name: The Sea is Our Stage
games.description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

games.name: 曙之羁绊 - 黄昏轮回
games.description: 每到17点，她必定会死。 无论时间倒流多少次，少女的死亡都会再次上演。为了拯救她，不断重复同一天，反抗死亡的命运——一款时间循环心理恐怖ADV。

games.name: Iron Slugs
games.description: Explosive, fast-paced 2-4 player party game. Shoot your friends, lay traps, explode almost everything you see on the screen going for elaborate environmental frags

games.name: Slime Jump
games.description: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

games.name: ESCAPE: The Cabin
games.description: Trapped, alone, and hunted by a captor who knows your past. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover the truth, and escape before the cabin breaks you. With 70+ randomised puzzles and solutions, every nightmare changes as you fight to get back to your family.

games.name: Homeplanet
games.description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

games.name: NARNOK
games.description:
NARNOK并无攻伐争斗。
唯有NAR，乃秩序与善念之化身。
唯有NOK，乃混乱与邪恶之根源。
筑就乾坤，调遣异星骁将。
挑战玩家留下的战意残影，争夺比对手更为丰厚的NARNOK。

games.name: DIY Store Simulator
games.description: 经营属于你的五金店。上货、定价、在收银台招待顾客，再把利润投回店里做大生意。订购工具、补满仓库，一单接一单，打造你梦想中的五金店。

games.name: STARHOME
games.description: 指挥这支承载着文明幸存者的星舰舰队。合理分配每艘飞船的有限空间，在居住区、生产、防御和武器之间找到平衡。探索银河，在压倒性的威胁下寻找避难之地与生存的希望。

games.name: 死亡派对
games.description: 万圣节之夜，UFO 降临宁静的林荫丘小镇，墓园里的邻居们集体爬了出来。四位草根英雄接下这个不可能的任务：用摇滚乐和破铜烂铁，把僵尸统统赶回地底！

games.name: Lonefarm
games.description: Lonefarm is a farming and driving simulation game. Harvest a wide variety of crops, care for and feed your animals, decorate your cabin with furniture and drive your old Van all over the island in the middle of the South Pacific.

games.name: Lifeguard Simulator
games.description: 驾驶四轮摩托车、水上摩托艇、快艇、无人机和直升机，守护海滩，快速反应，拯救生命。巡逻海湾，帮助有需要的人，揭开隐藏在海浪下的犯罪阴谋。🛟⛑️

games.name: Crown Yer King
games.description: A 3-D precision platformer where you, The Crown, must hop and glide your way through challenging levels to reach your bald Kings head! Meet his requirements and don't make him angry!

games.name: VoltHaven
games.description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

games.name: Off-Score: A game of songs
games.description: A surreal point-and-click music puzzle game. Listen, solve and explore the stories of the music and lyrics on your own songwriter’s desk.

games.name: Starlit World
games.description: Help Bo & Kiki save the Starlits from Oli’s evil spell in a cute and chaotic 3D platforming adventure! Discover special suits, fight bosses, and explore magical worlds as you rebuild Starlit Island and complete your sticker album!

games.name: The BridgeMancer
games.description: Harness the power of Bridgemancy in this wholesome puzzle adventure. To rescue the citizens of Dolion, you must salvage materials, build bridges, and create escape routes for the townspeople. Just be sure not to block their path! Can you muster the magic, logic, and wit needed to save the kingdom?

games.name: KNIGHTS OF THE FALL
games.description: KNIGHTS OF THE FALL is a sci-fi 2D/3D hybrid platformer that tells the story of Haru, a combat veteran, and Yoshida, his scientist sidekick, who join forces to uncover how interdimensional travel and the afterlife could be connected, using time and gravity-bending technology.

games.name: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
games.description: Gowf is an arcade style golf game featuring a single player adventure mode and 8 player online multiplayer. Win tournaments, complete side quests, level up, and take on friends in a variety of courses and game modes!

games.name: ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP VR
games.description:
"ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP V.R." is the ultimate toilet experience, more frantic than ever!
The crazy Windows and Mac title released last year on Steam, now has a V.R. version too!
(Thank god the smell is not included... Yet!)

games.name: Necro-Matcher
games.description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

games.name: Call From The Deep
games.description: Call From The Deep is a gripping first-person co-op horror experience. Crew a submarine with up to 8 friends and descend into a haunted abyss. Patch the leaks, fend off nightmares, and hold the hull together as you dive ever deeper — for fortune and glory, or be lost to the tide.

games.name: 歌兽经理
games.description: 在这款摇滚乐队经营类角色扮演游戏中，你将带领一支 90 年代的垃圾摇滚乐队，从车库里的无名之辈一路走向体育馆演出的辉煌巅峰。在由夸张拟人角色构成的世界里，筹备演出、管理自负的队员，还要在这个平行美国音乐圈中闯荡前行。乐坛登顶，初心不泯！

games.name: RADMINTON
games.description: Become a super rad parkour vigilante and fight back against ADCO. Experience over-the-top action and comical gunfights against 'the big corpo' as you traverse through movement-based levels and puzzles. A 3D-action parkour movement shooter where you can customize, style, rebel, and keep it RAD!

games.name: Mater Abyss
games.description: Mater Abyss is a first-person psychological horror experience presented as found footage. You play as Agata, exploring the apartment of a family who disappeared in 1993, where the environment shifts and reality slowly distorts.

games.name: Fakutori
games.description: 《Fakutori》是一款休闲自动化游戏，在它看似平静的表面之下，隐藏着极为丰富的玩法内容。组合元素、搭建庞大的生产线，追寻只有最执着的建造者才能找到的“传奇方块”。一切节奏都由你掌控。

games.name: Pirates Republic
games.description: 白手起家，建立属于你的海盗共和国。在这款开放世界生存沙盒里，闯荡程序生成的加勒比海：求生、烹饪、经商、劫掠。没有奇幻，只有历史、血汗与自由。单人游玩，或与好友联机合作。

games.name: Pit Sluts: Bloodrun
games.description: 深坑渴望鲜血。冲过残酷的陷阱赛道，闪避圆锯，让血肉四溅，并努力在赛道上最肮脏的多人竞技场表演中活下来。

games.name: Project Hypnagogia
games.description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

games.name: Gobutiko
games.description: Use the convincing power of your dice to negotiate prices in your favor and live out your dream of becoming the greatest goblin merchant!

games.name: 城郊主理人从街角小店到区域价格卡特尔实现供应链托拉斯
games.description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

games.name: Undead Development 2
games.description: Your resources are your surroundings. Scavenge, drag, and nail together what you can find to stay alive. Explore randomly connected regions to restock supplies and weapons. Construct creative traps using the open ended nailing system. Survive together with online co-op.

games.name: Void Skirmisher
games.description: VOID SKIRMISHER is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the warp gate, hold off endless waves of hostile fleets far past any front line, and drop in or out whenever you like.

games.name: 人窟日记
games.description: 《人窟日记》是一款以中国本土题材为背景的第一人称中式恐怖游戏。灵感部分取材自鲁迅先生的作品，游戏以剧情为主，包含潜行、追逐、解密等玩法要素。你将扮演少女华晓曦，迷失在梦境与现实之间，体会一个或许还有希望的“现实”故事。游戏将在2026年内上线。

games.name: Andromeda Wars
games.description: Andromeda Wars is a retro styled space RTS. In Andromeda Wars you must gather power, build a fleet, build defences to defend your mothership, and try to survive the onslaught from the opposing factions. Each ship you add to your fleet gives you powers but also reduces your dwindling resources.

games.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
games.description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

games.name: Super Chesslike Adventure
games.description: A chess-inspired tactical RPG where every piece is a character, every battle bends the rules, and every kingdom has something to hide. Explore an open world, upgrade your party, and fight to overthrow tyrants one calculated move at a time.

games.name: TREMEN
games.description: 对抗奴役人类的变种人大军，在这款拥有现代画面与老派玩法的FPS中，穿越由混凝土构成的野蛮主义地狱。

games.name: 隐藏真探
games.description: 《隐藏真探》是一款民国谍战题材的全动态真人互动影游，你将成为特工“胡杨”，亲历20世纪二十年代那段波诡云谲的民国传奇。在这个谎言与真相交织的棋局中，你能否揭开关于你自己身世的谜题，拯救你所珍视的一切？你会为了家国放弃挚爱，还是为了守护背叛信仰？破晓之前，由你拨开历史的隐藏，探寻时代的真理！

games.name: Gladiator Immortal
games.description: Gladiator Immortal is a turn-based fantasy Medieval Gladiator Roguelike game where you manage a team of warriors who fight for the entertainment of the gods. Build up your town, hire and level up warriors, find powerful weapons and armour, learn and develop new skills and win favour with the gods.

games.name: Enthroned
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: An online RPG with skill-based combat and player-run kingdoms. Designed around the idea that different kinds of players make the world work. Competitively playable even from bed.

games.name: Eternal Tombs
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: An MMORPG run by live staff called Tomb Masters who are constantly evolving the world, elevating the story and personalizing your adventure.

games.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
games.description: 坠机后，你独自醒来。通过狩猎、耕种与制作生存，并探索充满秘密的群岛。建造基地、揭开真相、逃离此地——如果你能做到。

games.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings
games.description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

games.name: TimbrianGuard
games.description: TimbrianGuard is a voxel-based sandbox colony management sim. Lead colonists to a new home, guide their survival, expand your colony's influence, establish outposts, and attract new settlers as your community grows.

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.description: 这款动作冒险游戏中，你将化身德米，勇敢深入索莫纳斯这个神奇的世界，听从神秘声音的指引，打倒传说中的诅咒巨兽，拯救这个世界。运用攻击招式和技能消灭敌人，破解谜题，揭开古老历史背后的真相。

games.name: Kingslayers
games.description: Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn based and real time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

games.name: Touching Grass Simulator
games.description: A relaxing and humorous incremental game where you grow, upgrade, and automate a sprawling field of grass. Plant seeds, watch your lawn flourish, and become the ultimate Grass Tycoon in this chill and oddly satisfying simulation!

games.name: 墨卷奇路
games.description: 《墨卷奇路》是一款融合牌组构筑与奇术盘空间管理的单人类爬塔游戏。选择侠客深入画卷，在卡牌、遗物、消耗品与九门格位之间规划构筑，对抗山林精怪、诡异阵列与藏在路途中的志怪奇遇。
games.developer: 杭州执棋者网络科技有限公司

games.name: 兰岛物语2：奇沧的幻海
games.description: 七位骑士远行至兰岛大陆最南端──奇沧的海湾，充满遗迹和南国风情的渔村。接下来几年将展开全新生活，完成骑士生涯中的艰巨任务。

games.name: 侠不义·昙花一线
games.description: 武侠、卡牌、肉鸽、摸金夺宝！ 武侠对抗中的一招一式，我们通过卡牌策略的方式实现了！ 经典的实克虚，虚克架，架克实，考验策略而非反应！ 如果你喜欢武侠、喜欢牌组构筑、还喜欢一点点打造强大的侠客队伍，那必须体验一下！

games.name: VR Cop Simulator
games.description: Dive into a voice-controlled VR cop simulator, where humor meets intense drama. Engage in realistic talks with AI characters, navigate tough situations, and make impactful decisions. Your virtual journey awaits!

games.name: 扳手猴
games.description: 你将化身成为一只机敏的猴子马克，布置陷阱、拆解机械守卫并招募其他动物伙伴，最终从这座日渐破败的动物园中逃脱。邪恶的园长能够阻止马克吗？还是说马克会成为搅乱一切的变数？

games.name: MIRAI #167
games.description: 《MIRAI #167》是一款 2D 像素风格的 跑酷游戏，您将同时操控两名角色，在时空倒流与传送门间穿梭。踏上一场紧张刺激的冒险旅程，在AI超越人类控制的世界中拯救人类 - 升级角色、打破纪录，在为时已晚之前，改写历史！

games.name: The House Before
games.description:
You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. 
The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

games.name: Trivasion
games.description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

games.name: Racketeering
games.description: Start with nothing and build your criminal empire by hand, alone or with friends. Grow, process, package, and sell product as you expand from small-time dealing into a serious operation.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.description: 一款主打硬核战斗与穿行探索的复古奇幻动作RPG。踏上冒险旅程，前往神秘的尼亚希德岛，寻找你失踪的父王。此乃邪恶势力盘踞之地，处处藏有奥秘玄机，而沉睡的女王也已渐渐苏醒……

games.name: Dream Loop
games.description: A first-person music-puzzle adventure. Wander surreal dreamscapes, record the world around you, and mix what you find into original tracks. Turn up your headphones and drop out.
games.developer: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc

games.name: 电兔拉比！
games.description: 跃入被遗忘的奇异世界，与超萌机器人电兔拉比一起开启蹦跳冒险！在这个充满软乎乎生物和呆呆机器人的卡通世界，你可以运用精确的跳跃搭配多样诡计穿行其中，点亮隐秘。只不过别忘了，所有敌人都是你的朋友！

games.name: Knight of the Forgotten Realm
games.description: Knight of the Forgotten Realm is a 2.5D dark fantasy action-adventure soulslike set in Austeria, a war-torn realm. Featuring visceral combat and the ability to overcharge your soul, you and a godlike being known as an Eternal head east to uncover lost knowledge. Will you survive the Eternal's call?

games.name: Apoceus: Winter Wars
games.description: Apoceus is a fantasy real-time strategy game that features big maps and large battles.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.description: 富贵险中求！在《海岛大亨7》中，你将再次套进他那双锃亮的靴子，亲手打造属于自己的群岛王国，并字面意义上的移山填海。作为光荣领袖，带领您忠诚的海岛居民（以及您的瑞士银行账户）穿越时代，走向前所未有的繁荣。

games.name: 巨像要塞
games.description: 《巨像要塞》是一款奇幻策略游戏，你需要在回合制建设玩法中采集程序生成的各类资源。扩张领地、优化城市结构，培养英雄，并在极具战术深度的自动战斗中大显身手！

games.name: 外星来信
games.description: 探索有着超过一千个字的外星象形字系统。从他们的数字系统开始，直到他们的文化和思想。

games.name: Pseudo-Psy Play
games.description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Pseudo-Psy Play is an eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. The time has come – face your fears in this bone-chilling story-driven horror game that feels (and looks) like nothing else in the genre. Are you ready, Joseph?

games.name: Catch The Train
games.description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

games.name: 拳力以赴
games.description: 这是一款连招拉满的像素风角色动作游戏。主角是退役拳手简，以及她的搭档咯咯特——一只……战斗鸡？见人就打，不服就干。跟海盗拜师学连招，把自家鸡肝到满级。再顺路找到绑匪，让他们明白，这回惹错人了！

games.name: Custom Hobo
games.description: Upgrade your hobo with bizarre custom parts and fight your way through physics-driven platforming with up to four players in this meaty co-op brawler. Build and share custom levels using the built-in level editor and Steam Workshop.

games.name: Illusion Fight — Season 1
games.description: 一个战术黑暗奇幻宇宙。在六边形网格上战斗、收集卡牌、培育生物、阅读小说、观看网络漫画,一切免费且相互关联。由一位独立开发者耗时23年打造。免费游玩。第一赛季现已上线。

games.name: Into the Crypt
games.description: 一款第一人称3D Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏。在不断变化的地牢世界中，对抗诡异生物，探索足以改变战局的随机事件，购买升级与稀有遗物，磨炼你的构筑策略，在危机四伏的地穴中挣扎求生。

games.name: Legend of Mythos ~Touhou Winter Heart Cage~
games.description:
Mythos, a man of mystery arrives in the mystical winter town.
He meets a lot of sexy girls that seem to be fantastical even at the first glance.
With the dreams of befriending all the girls in the world. 
Now, he set forth towards his romance saga.

games.name: SeaDogs Of Nassau
games.description: 一位海盗船长改变了世界。下一个继承它。在这款 Roguelike 沙盒游戏中，突袭船只并走私补给，以维持拿骚的生存。拿走拿骚需要的东西，并承担由谁付出代价的后果。

games.name: 诡域深行
games.description: 《诡域深行》是一款支持 1–6 人在线游玩的合作恐怖探索游戏。玩家将与朋友组队深入遗迹，搜刮被诅咒的物品，通过躲藏来逃避怪物追击，并想办法安全撤离。团队必须在避免被诡域吞噬的同时，想尽办法完成公会下达的配额。

games.name: Sucronomicon
games.description: An online co-op PC/VR horror game for up to 4 players. Team up in haunted kitchen arenas to craft enchanted confections and break the witch’s curse while battling relentless baked beasts that storm the kitchen to stop you.

games.name: Eternal Spectre
games.description: In a world where Time is Fractured. Jared Miles navigates a broken reality where every choice reshapes the world, uncovering the truth behind the fracture and deciding what the world ultimately becomes.

games.name: Born64
games.description: You are Slayer, a Hunter dispatched to a village where the townsfolk are transforming into monsters. None of the previous Hunters ever returned. Explore 64-bit dungeons, solve puzzles, and survive what the past tried to bury.

games.name: Galaxy Gang
games.description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected.  Galaxy Gang  gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

games.name: Breaking The Silent Lies
games.description: The man has to relive his trauma from the past to save his idol but the truth is more than meets the eye.

games.name: Topsoil Town
games.description: Face off against friends to see who can live the coziest life! Farm, fish, mine, cook, and craft your way to the highest score in this turn-based life-sim party game for up to 4 players.

games.name: Line Clear
games.description: Line Clear is a mechanical signal box simulation set in 1990s British Rail. Pull levers, exchange bell codes and read the instruments to route trains through your junction, keeping every service running safely and on schedule.

games.name: The Idle Undead
games.description: The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse - Upgrade a base, recruit survivors, play minigames to boost your damage!

games.name: Void Ledger
games.description: 登上废弃飞船，搜刮物资，活着撤离。《Void Ledger》是一款支持单人或合作游玩的太空打捞游戏，以卡牌、骰子和艰难抉择为核心。深入险境，争取更丰厚的战利品，或趁还有机会及时脱身。出售打捞物资、升级飞船，在一切为时已晚之前还清债务。

games.name: Laws of Nadragia
games.description: 成为极权国家Nadragia的一名检察官。定罪罪犯：在法庭案件中使用法律和事实，不惜一切代价获得有罪判决……但你能保持良心吗？

games.name: Pin City
games.description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

games.name: RalphGame
games.description: A handcrafted action-comedy RPG packed with fresh mechanics and surprises. After your friends are mysteriously kidnapped at sea, it's up to you to bring them home.

games.name: Tattie Bogle
games.description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

games.name: Medieval Alchemist
games.description: 中世纪炼金术士是一款以中世纪为背景的炼金术士生存游戏。 在大自然的挑战中生存，收集原料，生产药水，在集市上出售非必需原料，培养你的性格并通过雇佣工人来建立你的生活空间。

games.name: CRETE
games.description:
Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful.
The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

games.name: INCLOSED
games.description: A twisted survival horror set in a broken harvest fair. Hide in cutouts during deadly games, endure cruel punishments, and uncover the truth behind the barn before someone awakens.

games.name: Laser Lightshow
games.description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

games.name: Dark Age Dinos
games.description: A multiplayer tactical roguelike for 1-4 players set in a medieval world of sword wielding dinosaurs. Strategize your way through short adventures where teamwork is the key to success!

games.name: CUMING FEAR
games.description: 这是一款恐怖冒险游戏 + 密室逃脱，带有80年代恐怖电影的浓厚氛围。想象一下，如果 Resident Evil、Silent Hill 和 Granny 生了个孩子... 还带上 Hentai

games.name: Northanda Chronicles
games.description: Master role-based deckbuilding in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build a party around the RPG holy trinity from countless hero combinations, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

games.name: Mike's Software
games.description: Mike’s Business is falling apart, and most of the work has somehow been left to you. Complete short, increasingly difficult microgames, earn revenue to buy Add-Ons, and use those Add-Ons to score higher and earn more revenue!

games.name: Littlelands
games.description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.name: Not Quite A Fairy Tale
games.description: Ironic grim-but-cute roguelike about winning when everything goes to shit. Gather a party of misfits, toss the cards and bet it all: here a shameful fail is the price for a massive crit. Snatch victory from total disaster and laugh in death’s face. You'll die. You'll laugh. Maybe not in that order.

games.name: Troubleshooting
games.description: chaotic FPS roguelite inside your old family computer! Blast corrupt files, grab XP, stack weird upgrades, and place desktop junk to shape the arena as the system falls apart in increasingly stupid ways.

games.name: Astoaria
games.description: 沙盒开放世界生存游戏。位于一个充满活力的浮岛世界中，每个浮岛都拥有自己特定的生态系统和气候。战略性地利用周边环境来探索并发展浮岛。利用能源、战略性耕种、打造飞艇等等，同时揭开这个世界的奥秘。

games.name: Theatre of War: Rearmed
games.description: 在《战区》系列完整作品中，指挥二战实时战斗——该系列现已整合至最新版本的游戏引擎。体验战术战斗、逼真的弹道模拟以及超过100个任务，并针对现代系统进行了优化。

games.name: The Last Trophy
games.description: 一位太空探险家从一个未知星球接收到了一串奇怪的信号。这个地方究竟有什么？在这款复古街机风格的动作平台游戏中，帮助梅尔揭开这片新土地上的奥秘。

games.name: Discharge Pending
games.description:
所有人都以为 Pescadero Medical Center 早已人去楼空，可你还在这里。
你和出口之间隔着十层楼，每到一层，你都得判断这里是否一切如常。
与此同时，MPS 正在学着像你一样行动，像你一样回忆，像你一样说话。
不要相信你所看见的。

games.name: 笠三郎的秘密钓场
games.description: 放置钓鱼 × 像素青蛙 × 疗愈节奏。让笠三郎帮你钓鱼、收集奇妙鱼种、慢慢经营这片秘密钓场。

games.name: Masterstone
games.description: Roguelite action RPG with procedural levels and story. Random skills and loot force improvised builds, making every playthrough unique. Every enemy is a potential danger, resources are scarce, and death is punishing.

games.name: BPM Boy
games.description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack.

games.name: Arcane Survivors
games.description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
games.description: Welcome back, Chef! Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in this new take on a million-selling classic. With new art, a new campaign, and a new local co-op mode, there's never been a better time to get cooking.

games.name: Miramar
games.description: 在一个硬核科技世界中，Miramar 跟随海军陆战队去完成任务，调查与一个遥远殖民地失去联系的原因。游戏将探秘、回合制战斗和 Roguelike 等玩法相结合，为玩家带来身临其境的游戏体验。

games.name: The Tainted Lands
games.description: Tainted Lands is a turn-based tactical RPG in an eldritch fantasy setting. Lead a band of adventurers to traverse a forbidden wilderness where ancient horrors lie in wait. Recruit companions, scavenge relics, and face the Outer Gods.

games.name: Too Many CUBES!
games.description: Shatter overwhelming cube swarms in a fast arena-survival roguelite. Aim your evolving arsenal, conquer five hazardous zones, destroy their Guardians, and climb five Fracture difficulty tiers—solo or in two-player local co-op.

games.name: Stronghold 4 要塞4
games.description: 需要木材！在这款讲述初代“城堡模拟”游戏故事的前传中，重返《要塞》的原始森林。沉浸在电影般的战役中，在遭遇战模式中运用新机制磨练你的攻城技艺，并用琳琅满目的城堡部件和装饰品打造你的专属城堡。

games.name: Police Station Simulator
games.description:
你被委派去重启一个已经破败的警察局。你有能力让它再现昔日的辉煌吗？
备好咖啡和甜甜圈吧，大面积的翻新和不起眼的工作等着你去做！

games.name: 修道院纪事：桌面回廊
games.description: 你的日常生活便是你的信仰与圣所。《修道院纪事：桌面回廊》是一款静驻屏幕底部的宁静放置游戏。装饰房间，唤醒园地，扩展产业，迎接信众——在工作、学习与浏览的同时，书写属于你的修道院纪事。

games.name: The Magic Garden 魔法花园
games.description: 欢迎来到一个新的奇幻世界，在这个世界中开始一个新的生活。探索这个世界中未知、神秘的地方。在这个世界中您可以建造你的农场，认识各色的人物和神秘的生物。通过种植、收集道具，利用这些道具和技能前往地牢打败强大的怪物来收集稀有的道具。

games.name: Loading...
games.description: You are 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games.

games.name: 偏差，谬误与他的独白
games.description: 为了找到一切未知的真相，天才程序员赛耶开发出了能够不断逼近“正确答案”的全知软件。但与此同时，赛耶的生活却陷入了更深的黑暗：曾经最亲近的搭档尼可开始追杀自己、每晚坠入同一个梦境，并在那里遇见了一个现实中同样存在、却拥有另一段记忆的女孩......凭空形成的陨石坑、梦境、被遗忘的过去，以及那个试图回答一切的软件……当答案真的可以被计算，真相究竟带来救赎，还是灾难？

games.name: Project Burnout
games.description: A turn-based management strategy game about leading a traveling fixer crew hired to rescue game studios in crisis. Plan the week, split dependent tasks across five disciplines, beat deadlines, and protect your crew from burnout.

games.name: BOLO and The curse of the Dark Prophecy
games.description: Do you have what it takes to save a princess from Dark Lord who dares to threaten the whole world by consuming her powers and become threat to everyone's existence, then BOLO Legends is for you. Dont forget to have FUN.

games.name: Backdraft
games.description: 构筑卡组，激战交锋。Backdraft 是一款围绕英雄对决与场面控制展开的肉鸽卡牌战斗游戏。选牌构筑卡组，召唤随从，打出逆转战局的连击。独自征服六大界域，或在线向好友发起挑战。

games.name: Shardana
games.description: 🌊 SHARDANA is a survival horror game set in Nuragic Sardinia. Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, you must survive, explore, and find a cure for a terrifying infestation. But beware of the night: that’s when the monsters emerge. 🌙🗿

games.name: 西格洛夫的低语
games.description: 在扭曲诡异的西格洛夫镇展开一场令人心跳加速的冒险。你将扮演一名病人，被困在梦境与现实模糊的世界中。利用光线解谜、揭示隐藏的物品，改变物体的形态，以前所未有的方式进行探索。

games.name: Number Machine: 数学工厂
games.description: 数字工厂是一款开放式工厂与自动化游戏，融合数学机制。设计、建造并优化工厂，实现复杂数值结构的自动组装与交付。灵感源自Opus Magnum与Infinifactory。

games.name: PatchWorld
games.description: Patch sound, visuals, logic and physics together in 3D to build interactive worlds, musical instruments and games. Create alone or together while everything keeps running, then share and remix what you make.

games.name: 小无人机突突突
games.description: 把小无人机武装到离谱，然后射爆一切。至于科学是不是个好主意，研究设施可以之后再想。

games.name: Recovery Syndicate
games.description:
Recovery Syndicate is a prequel to Abeyance, in which you are the leader of one of the factions trying to reconstruct the economy of the galaxy.
You must build and manage your colony's resources carefully, while watching out for rival factions who are also vying for supremacy.

games.name: Handshakes: Hands On
games.description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

games.name: Case 0 - The Witch
games.description: You have been assigned to investigate a disappearance that happened forty years ago. The case file is almost empty. The building is still there. Your name is already on the documents - and you don't remember signing them.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: Into The Garden
games.description: Awaken as a stitched cat doll in an eerie manor trapped in a supernatural limbo where time flows backward. Hunted by a blind toymaker, you must use mirror portals, enter painted pocket worlds, and transfer your soul between abandoned toys to survive.

games.name: 快递员汤姆
games.description: 跟随汤姆——村里新来的女邮差——去结识当地居民，说不定你会对他们了解得有点太透彻了。她的方法虽然颇具争议，却非常有效：那就是那种近乎痴迷的紧追不舍。

games.name: XANNIBAN
games.description: Point & click to survive the complexes of XANNI-CORP - plan, lure and adapt in this action-horror shooter as you seal away rogue machines.

games.name: Wish Upon A Llama
games.description: 《Wish Upon A Llama》是一款为动物爱好者量身打造的温馨生活模拟RPG！作为羊驼镇的新任牧场主，你将培育并照料这些毛茸茸的可爱伙伴，重新找回小镇与动物之间那份快被遗忘的羁绊。和镇上的居民慢慢熟悉起来，交一群知心好友，说不定还能遇上一段心动的恋情。冒险，就在前方等着你！

games.name: Kill King 2D
games.description: 《Kill King 2D》是一款黑暗奇幻风格的1v1策略自走棋。秘密排好命令、消耗行动点，然后看着你的棋子自行执行计划。进化你的军队，比对手预判得更准，斩杀敌方国王。

games.name: Backrooms:Betrayal
games.description: Maintain reality or watch it collapse. Backrooms: Betrayal is a co-op liminal horror game where the environment is the antagonist. Stabilize shifting sectors against a tide of entropy, but watch your team. Every failure has an explanation, but not every explanation is innocent.

games.name: Stars of Icarus
games.description: 终极太空战斗PvP体验：指挥巡防舰、驾驶战斗机、操控大炮。在被人遗忘的太空竞技场中，团队之间的沟通至关重要。要么共同获胜，要么一起赴死！

games.name: Backyard Bedrock
games.description: You and your friends bought a “nice” piece of land... Turns out you accidentally signed up for catastrophic lifelong debt. Now the collectors want their money. Dig down for treasure, ore, and anything shiny enough to pawn off. Unlock ancient relics and buy new tools to help you on your dig!

games.name: 余烬之镇 Emberville
games.description: 丧失记忆的你从维特莫图斯中苏醒，在这座囚禁亡魂的魔法牢笼里，或许真正的死亡才是恩赐。向被遗忘的秘境进发，直面异形魔兽的威胁，营救遇难的幸存者，在破败的余烬镇重建家园——每一步，都将撕开这座永恒监狱真相的一角。

games.name: Zombie Warz
games.description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

games.name: Tongo
games.description: 在这款 Roguelike 卡组构筑游戏中，组建强大的卡牌套组，操控概率，打破宾果的规则。打造疯狂连锁，追逐巨额头奖，并在每一局中发现改变局势的协同效果。

games.name: The Lost Hotel
games.description: Welcome to The Lost Hotel, a story-based pixel art game where you take on the role of a hotelier, saving the hotel from an endless time loop. Explore the hotel and interact with a diverse cast of characters. Uncover secrets and solve puzzles to unravel the mystery of the hotel's past.

games.name: UNSEVERED
games.description: Unsevered is an erotic visual novel set in an urban fantasy world. After a seemingly harmless encounter with a shirtless drunk who claims to possess godhood, you will be propelled head-first into the arcane underworld of Windgate, a city that promises sympathy and desire, as well as endless threats.

games.name: 乐浮岛
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 欢迎来到《乐浮岛》！在这款温馨的多人游戏中，你可以建设一个更美好、更加可持续的未来。带上新老朋友，一起来种植、做手工、四处探索、装饰房屋、为世界创造更多意义吧！

games.name: Swordeye
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons.  Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks.  Master your sword or die trying.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 来自《Cozy Grove》的制作团队：在柔和的云彩中滑翔，帮助迷失的灵魂，并设计高山之巅上你自己的家。在温暖的篝火旁结交陌生朋友，或与朋友一起在天空中悠闲地钓鱼，分享回忆。欢迎来到你这个奇异的新家。🏠🏔️

games.name: 咔哒！机械乱斗派对
games.description: 在《咔哒！机械乱斗派对》中，制造独一无二的武器：大剑、长弓、甚至是一把...超级电锯！与失控的巨型机器人展开混乱又欢乐的战斗！收集材料、建设赛博城镇，利用传送带、机关和自动化装置打造千奇百怪的战斗方式，独自冒险或与好友双人合作，成为这片竞技场的霸主吧！

games.name: WILLOW RIDGE
games.description: In 1995, Detective Richard Moore turned in his badge, abandoning the only case he couldn't solve — A string of disappearances in town, culminating in the loss of his wife. Ten years later, an impossible lead drags him back. After all... Nothing stays buried forever in WILLOW RIDGE.

games.name: Charon - Zhetan Chronicles
games.description: Overcome the chasm ordained by divine fate! Charon - Zhetan Chronicles is a 2D Queer Magitech Fantasy RPG with pixel art visuals. An epic story with diverse characters, strategic battles and handmade artworks awaits you!

games.name: 再试一次 One More Try
games.description: 在这个回合制的Roguelike卡牌构建游戏中，穿越魔法王国的土地奋勇战斗。通过组合强大的扑克组合来对抗敌人，增强它们的效果，赋予它们新的属性，寻找魔法遗物，并为你的英雄选择新的职业。

games.name: Pogona
games.description: 吐出鳞片，开辟道路，征服一切挑战。《Pogona》是一款手绘风格的硬核2D银河恶魔城游戏。扮演一只小小蜥蜴，将自己的鳞片化作平台与武器，解锁远古之力，探索充满秘密的广阔世界。

games.name: Bark & Blade
games.description: Play as a magical dog searching for your missing owner. Bark, dig, sniff, dash, swim, and fight your way through enchanted forests, crystal caverns, scorching deserts, and volcanic depths. A third- or first-person action-adventure about being the very best boy.

games.name: Portabellows
games.description: 探索一座奇幻小岛，寻找……馅饼食谱？！收集或种植多种食材，烘焙出美味的馅饼，这或许是帮助您新结识的古怪朋友们逃离小岛的关键！在这款轻松愉快的 3D 平台收集游戏中，您可以随心所欲地自由探索世界。

games.name: Phantom Chains
games.description: Phantom Chains is a first person action dungeon crawler with an emphasis on exploration and mystery in a dark fantasy world.

games.name: Alpine Lake
games.description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

games.name: 抓娃娃机任务
games.description: 一款再现日本抓娃娃机的模拟游戏。足不出户，也能体验到游戏厅特有的那种绝望感。运用各种技巧赢取奖品。解锁奖品和关卡，成为抓娃娃机高手吧。

games.name: 无尽星域:流浪舰队
games.description:
这是一款全新玩法的回合制战棋肉鸽卡牌游戏
玩家将体验前所未有的爽快的战斗
进行一场惊心动魄的银心冒险,将一切阻碍都碾碎!

games.name: Inpulse
games.description: Ammo is Movement. Do-Re-Mi is your moveset. You are Flute, a shapeshifting creature who plays music to move. Collect Notes to form melodies and fire them outwards to move through the air. A kaizo-inspired platformer that wants you to succeed, from long-time veterans of the genre.

games.name: 13Z: 生肖试炼
games.description: 你的目标是成为第十三位生肖！接受勇气、速度与力量的终极试炼，体验酣畅淋漓的动作Roguelite冒险之旅！

games.name: Lunar Wardens
games.description: Build a team of elemental creatures and fight for the league title with up to 8 friends. Hire, hunt and evolve your creatures between matches, then set your line-up and watch every bout play out live in the moonlit arena.

games.name: 崛起力量: 沃尼米尔
games.description:
异界的降临者，被卷入血与暗的阴谋，开启沃尼米尔之旅，集结你的伙伴、击退黑暗势力，逐步揭开世界的真相！
在精美像素风与动态场景中，畅享爽快的动作战斗与史诗般的冒险故事！

games.name: Black Ocean
games.description:
"Let's play with me, horses of the gods, I'm ready, come to my sea."
This is a deck building card game where the journey to prevent the 'black sea' that warps the world.
Be a reasoner and work with your colleagues through a twisted, dreamy puppet show.

games.name: Lexomancy
games.description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

games.name: Rhythm Realm
games.description: The lizardman mob boss condemned your village to a slow, catchy death. One boy, one sword: do you have what it takes to venture through this magical world of music and save them all?

games.name: 星核幸存者
games.description: 《星核幸存者》是一款俯视角竞技场自动射击 Roguelite。移动、闪避并收集材料，在 20 波战斗、升级选择与波间商店中完成武器合成和进化，组合遗物与核心规则，对抗精英、Boss 和不断提升的危险难度，打造每局不同的构筑。

games.name: Captain Moviestar 3D
games.description: An FPS starring your favorite platformer character Captain Moviestar… now in full three-dimensions. Early 90’s 2.5D-raycaster-style shooter for the proto-boomer set.

games.name: Lurkers
games.description: Lurkers是一款混乱的2D多人沙盒游戏，你可以建造、战斗和生存！与僵尸战斗，征服像Bedwars这样的游戏模式，在一个由你塑造和摧毁的世界中释放你的创造力。

games.name: Ants in Space!
games.description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

games.name: 乱斗骑士 Scramble Knights Online
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 和好友一起踏上这款轻量级 MMO 动作角色扮演游戏的冒险之旅吧！化身见习骑士，探索玩家齐聚的泰拉科特王国。组队征服地下城、讨伐怪物、寻找稀有战利品，再带着满满的收获回家打造强力新装备，为下一次冒险做好准备。

games.name: Cafe Simulator
games.description: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.

games.name: Gnart's Escape
games.description: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

games.name: Moongrave
games.description: Defend a mysterious lunar crystal against relentless hordes in this roguelite tower defense. Build powerful defenses, cast devastating spells, gather resources, and rebuild humanity's underground city between runs.

games.name: Starshapes
games.description: 这是一款宁静而令人满足的益智游戏：连接图形，创造 3D 星座。

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.description: 在这款2D解谜银河恶魔城中，潜入深海一探究竟！操控水位，在各式机器人之间切换，解开亚特兰蒂斯的上古谜题。

games.name: Mind Vessel
games.description: An autobattler roguelite in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

games.name: 荷莱Horae
games.description: 或许，这是你见过最自私的故事。

games.name: Card To Conquer
games.description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

games.name: TeamSpec
games.description: The class-based shooter where you can make your own class, both in terms of gameplay and looks!

games.name: Tribes of the Ridge
games.description: Lead your tribe in this minimalistic 2D side-scrolling strategy and resource management game. Transform a small settlement into a thriving civilization. Build efficient production chains, discover new occupations, and construct advanced buildings!

games.name: Alembix TCG
games.description: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

games.name: Where are you, Cinderella?
games.description:
Where are you, Cinderella? is a visual novel about Vietnamese culture and the world of entertainment.

Will you be able to find the lost shoe’s owner? Or, will you find your shoe?

games.name: Beyond The Plastic Wall
games.description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

games.name: Louloudi Asteri ~Save the Solar System~
games.description: Switch between two fighter aces in this 3D side-scrolling shooter! Roll your ship to rotate the screen, revealing gaps in enemy fire and terrain. Life regenerates over time, and the frontal shield blocks all fire. Lock on, use special weapons, and sidestep through 3D space to save the solar system!

games.name: 禁忌扳机 SacriShot Matrix
games.description: 《禁忌扳机》是一款带轻rouge-like元素的类光枪第一人称射击游戏。这是一个存在名为《公序良俗法》制约、所有色情相关产业全部被禁止的无聊世界，你将扮演一名试图打破禁忌的挑战者，在代表色欲之罪的魔女陪伴下，深入人类内心的『影世界』进行探索与战斗的旅途。

games.name: Emojis vs Zombies
games.description:
Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game!
Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

games.name: Soccer Ball Simulator
games.description: A concussed referee wakes up as a soccer ball. Real physics at soccer ball scale plus one super powered boost. Climb, jump and bash your way through the halls of your subconscious to put an end to the evil referee rigging the sport.

games.name: NovaLight Z
games.description: Novalight Z is a zombie shooter. Shoot and cut your way through an infected colony ship. Survive and explore to find the artifact and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak.

games.name: Megabat
games.description: 一只大蝙蝠的水果被偷走了！帮助蝙蝠夺回被偷走的水果，同时在这款全新的精准平台游戏中躲避陷阱和敌人！蝙蝠能填饱肚子并活着逃出去吗？

games.name: Operator: Observation
games.description: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

games.name: Heir of the Dog
games.description: A hilariously British point & click adventure. After drinking his uncle's secret formula, Cummerbund Bandersnatch undergoes a monstrous transformation. Solve puzzles, manipulate time and uncover the truth behind Victorian London's most secret society as you regain your humanity.

games.name: 维京酒馆
games.description: 这个冒险游戏支持1到4名玩家合作，在手忙脚乱中打造属于你的传奇维京酒馆。白天猎捕神奇的野兽，晚上做菜服务闹哄哄的客人，尽你们所能保证出餐顺利，平息北欧诸神的怒火，平安活到第二天。

games.name: 破浪而行 Surfpunk
games.description: 《破浪而行 Surfpunk》是一款支持 1-4 人合作的动作角色扮演游戏，“搜、打、撤”是它的核心乐趣。你作为这片海域的“破浪高手”，探索随机生成的岛屿，与伙伴肩并肩打怪，搜刮战利品。冲浪、战斗、搜寻、再来一局！

games.name: Massive Collapse
games.description: Massive Collapse is a round-based multiplayer shooter where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.

games.name: Keikaku計画
games.description: Build your dream car and drive through the '90s. Keikaku計画 is a simulation game where you get to experience both authentic car building and life in Japan, and rise to become a '90s street legend.

games.name: GRAVHOUNDS
games.description: GRAVHOUNDS是一款可供1-4名玩家合作游玩的动作建造游戏。你们将共同降落至敌对星球，应对遵循真实物理法则的混乱场面，建造并守护基地，并要在沦为外星人的食物之前，尽可能地带着所有物品撤离！坚守的时间越久，危险就越大……但奖励也越丰厚。

games.name: Diecast
games.description: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

games.name: Pixel Piracy Online
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Pirate MMORPG with zero microtransactions. Set sail alone or with friends, and build your pirate empire using force or trade. In this pirate simulator game, you write your own RPG story.

games.name: Maid In Wonderland
games.description: Your fate, your duty, your suffering / love.

games.name: Geometry TD
games.description: 一款塔防游戏，战场是一艘由你亲手建造并驾驶的星舰。探索开放宇宙，开采小行星，进行贸易，并带领一支由宇航员组成的船员队伍。当海盗登船时，放置几何图形塔，将它们合成为更强的图形，挡住每一波进攻。

games.name: Metalstorm
games.description: 欢迎游玩《Metalstorm》，体验终极多人组队空战！这是一款真正免费畅玩的游戏。与好友组队进行5v5空战，与世界各地的真人玩家一较高下。收集并升级世界上最先进、最具传奇色彩的战机。

games.name: 小拉奇境：漫画历险记
games.description: 横版战斗 Roguelike × 自走棋式装备构筑！进入游戏 → 打败怪物 → 获取金币 → 进入商店 → 购买装备与升级商店 → 凑齐羁绊 → 构筑流派 → 挑战下一关！

games.name: Vaulted
games.description: Vaulted 是一款以柴油朋克异常区探索为主题、融合 Roguelite 元素的快节奏俯视角射击游戏。深入程序化生成的地下城，这里的敌人不会容忍任何失误。

games.name: Wizavior
games.description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the powerful Zavior a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.

games.name: Soar Up The Charts
games.description:
Soar Up The Charts is a fast-paced rhythm game and arcade style rail shooter where music is your weapon! 
🎸With tracks provided by Alden Ave and KeepFlying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots! 🎺

games.name: Cosmos Kitten
games.description: Combat endless waves of spaceships as Cosmos Kitten in this physics-based action roguelite! Unlock combinations of unique characters with powerful weapons to overcome the onslaught of enemies. Compete or cooperate with friends in optional local multiplayer mode.

games.name: Something Something Spaceship
games.description:
探索一艘出故障的太空船，收集修复飞船所需的物品，同时躲避五花八门的敌人。
一款受8位时代游戏启发的等距平台解谜游戏。

games.name: Followers of Krow
games.description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

games.name: Beauties of Blackfall
games.description: A cooking combat deckbuilder where glamorous television beauties battle grotesque monsters using deadly dishes, strange ingredients, and powerful synergies inside a cursed late-night TV broadcast.

games.name: HavenCraft
games.description: 建造安居之所！一场炼金事故摧毁了整片大陆，民众四处寻觅新家园。你将带领众人一砖一瓦重建社会。《HavenCraft》是一款第三人称城镇建造和管理游戏，支持单人和多人模式。

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.description: 这款开放世界游戏可带你领略狩猎的刺激，还有忠实的狗狗陪伴你左右！你可以在官方品牌中挑选狩猎装备，踏上探索荒野的征程，追寻下一个猎物。

games.name: Castillon 卡斯特隆-魔堡守卫
games.description:
卡斯特隆-魔堡守卫 是一款轻量级策略游戏，玩家需凭借魔法与智慧构建并守护自己的城堡领域。  白天收集资源、探索并建造；夜晚则战斗、防御并顽强求生。  
掌握四大魔法流派，打造终极防御！

games.name: 竹泉记
games.description: 《竹泉记》是一款以春秋时期为背景，融合农场经营与策略防守的游戏。从一座荒废庭院开始，开荒种地、畜牧渔猎、制作家具，与乡邻相识，在四季更迭中建起自己的家园。乱世之中，安稳生活也需要亲手守护：打造武器、武装乡勇，布阵迎敌，收复失地，让流离的人们重返家园。

games.name: 哈玛雷特
games.description: 《哈玛雷特》是一款剧情向肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。玩家将在游戏中揭开堕落骑士团的秘密，见证烈火焚城的真相，探寻至亲失踪的谜底。驾驭古老遗物的力量，在湮灭边缘与恶魔对抗，改写末世命运。

games.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior
games.description: 想象一款外星数独，其中的数字变成了元素。你得想办法弄清楚该把哪个元素放在网格的哪个位置，以及何时放置！为了保持平衡，每个元素都必须与其他元素和谐共存。适合成人和儿童。外星人不玩数独——他们玩“COSMIC HOLES”！

games.name: 主星序
games.description: 《Main Sequence》是一款第一人称太空模拟工厂建造游戏。在游戏中，你将设计宇宙飞船、建造空间站，并实现全面自动化。从一艘飞船起步，逐步发展成横跨星际的工业帝国，在银河中留下属于你的印记。

games.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die
games.description: 经营一家为僵尸、吸血鬼、狼人和半机械人服务的超自然超市。补满货架，扩大生意，在酒吧赌博，雇佣打手，破坏竞争对手的店铺。敌人反击时守住自己的店，并揭开街区隐藏的黑暗秘密。要么卖货……要么死。

games.name: Path of Darkness
games.description: Path of Darkness is a dark incremental adventure where every battle brings you one step closer to absolute power. Crush endless waves of enemies, discover the rarest artifacts, experiment with devastating builds, and unlock new layers of gameplay.

games.name: Survival Of Runt
games.description: 这是一款合作与背叛并存的开放世界PvPvE生存射击游戏。在混沌与秩序之间做出选择夺取胜利；一旦阵亡，将作为强大的变异体玩家复活，狩猎其他幸存者！

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.description: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

games.name: Dark Zone
games.description: Face the horror in a visceral action shooter. As a soldier trapped at the heart of the collapse, battle relentless hordes and brutal bosses to uncover the dark truth behind the outbreak. A complete episodic experience where every bullet counts. Will you survive to see the end?

games.name: HOT STREAK
games.description: A dice roguelike. Multipliers stack. Combos chain. Scores explode. Every roll builds on the last. Every choice pushes you closer to the edge. One more roll.

games.name: Archi Vista
games.description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

games.name: Project Lightbringer
games.description: Project Lightbringer is an exploration-focused bullet heaven where light is your only safe ground. Fight endless hordes, collect powerful upgrades, activate lanterns to expand your territory, and venture deeper into the mist to hunt massive creatures.

games.name: horonox
games.description: A puzzle game about time travel—and its consequences. Move through space and time, resolve paradoxes, and close time loops. Actions echo along each timeline, where cause and effect run both ways. Yet your journey moves inexorably onward, revealing what shattered the balance between past and future.

games.name: Net Raiders
games.description:
《Net Raiders》是一款通过合成卡牌进行战斗的策略类 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。
为了在崩塌的虚拟世界中生存下去，请合成卡牌并找出最佳的应对方式，击败面前的敌人！

games.name: Territorial Hissing
games.description: Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Something smells fishy.  Save your home in this comedy adventure!

games.name: SkyMine
games.description: Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience.

games.name: 欠债与恋爱相连
games.description: 《欠债与恋爱相连》是一款多结局恋爱养成游戏，你本来拥有美好的人生、令人羡慕的爱情，但一夕之间你却面临被解雇、被欺骗、甚至负债十万的悲惨命运！为了活下去，你能做的只有打工、打工、还是打工！但是等等，怎么反而是欠债时桃花运这么旺啊！？

games.name: 4:AM
games.description:
躲藏。解谜。奔逃。求生。
在被“黄灾”摧毁的近未来反乌托邦世界中，光线足以致命，艾拉必须依靠观察力与聪明才智逃离这片险境。你可以复制环境中的各类物品，在重压之下灵活应变，在这款充满电影感的黑暗潜行冒险游戏中开辟属于自己的求生之路。

games.name: 苍蓝原型 (ARCHETYPE BLUE)
games.description: 与超过50名伙伴相遇，组建属于自己的4人队伍，挑战危险任务。伙伴会根据各自的能力与站位战斗，而你则能运用卡牌扭转战局。随着一次次任务，你将逐渐卷入伙伴们的故事与秘密之中。

games.name: Sirens
games.description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

games.name: r:STRIKE
games.description: Get ready for a thrilling shooter racing experience. Feel the immense power and speed from your tank as you liberate a stunning city from it's deadly drone invaders.

games.name: RANGER COMMANDO
games.description:
80 年代怀旧风等距视角战术射击游戏。
踏入随机生成的任务世界，刺杀军官、解救人质、爆破目标，一切尽在探索。
不用手把手教，一玩即可上手！

games.name: 追逐末日之光
games.description:
小行星撞击前6个月，以及新的开始。

在荒凉却美丽的后末日首尔展开的叙事解谜冒险游戏。

你，是否能揭开真相？

games.name: Outcast Tales
games.description: 组建一支充满个性和能力的角色小队，观察他们的关系如何展开。在“流浪者传说：第一次旅程”中体验一段宏伟冒险的开始。参与深度战术战斗，做出艰难的决策，选择自己的冒险 - 编写一段属于你的流浪者传说！

games.name: 弹丸棋盘
games.description: 射击的同时会受到反作用力！这是唯一的法则，先活下去才能战胜更多的敌人。步步为营，你的每一次射击都至关重要。能否逃出敌人重重包围追击，就看你的操作了。

games.name: Last Warrior Arena
games.description: 一款节奏快速的 roguelike 自动战斗游戏，让你打造强大战士，发现强力协同效果，并在无尽的竞技场挑战中一路战斗。

games.name: Netherwyn
games.description: Netherwyn 是一款极具挑战性的 Roguelite 动作 RPG。每次冒险都会将你和盟友送入被不断聚集的阴影吞没的土地，面对无情的敌群与致命的首领战。首个版本将聚焦于“死灵法师归来”。

games.name: Apostle of Mustard
games.description: A difficult 3d precision platformer. Hop, skip, and skid your way across an eerie purgatory. Thread though a rage inducing gauntlet of platforms while unraveling a mustard flavored mystery. Will you make it home, or will you be stuck forever?

games.name: Benny's Backrooms
games.description: 这是一款合作恐怖游戏，你和朋友们（要是有的话）将探索一片看似无穷无尽的阈限空间——这里充斥着令人毛骨悚然的生物。你们仅能依靠一台改良型真空设备和各类特制装备，以科学考察的名义定位并提取一种稀有物质。

games.name: Creatures of the Night
games.description: Inspired by classic horror and the VHS generation of movie rentals. Creatures of the Night aims to be an immersive and fun experience putting players inside some horror classics to solve mysteries, lift curses and try to survive either solo or multiplayer

games.name: 休谟指数 / Hume Index
games.description: 作为一名精通于控制不稳定现实的特工，你需要使用你的枪械、刀具和元素反应来消灭废弃宇宙中的突变体，控制源头，并在可能的情况下逃脱。可以单人游玩，或2-4名玩家一起在合作模式中进行游戏。

games.name: ASMBL
games.description:
Build. Program. Pilot. Compete. 
ASMBL is a multiplayer VR sandbox simulator where you easily snap building blocks to build anything imaginable. Build and pilot planes, trains, cars, and mechs. Put your creativity to the test as you and your friends solve problems and compete together.

games.name: 小狗来啦
games.description: 在你的桌面上养一只会带来好运的小狗吧！它就待在屏幕一角，陪你工作、摸鱼、打游戏，让好运悄然融入日常。累了就和它玩一局牌吧，别光顾着看手里的牌，也看看它的小表情，说不定好运就藏在里边。开开盲盒，攒攒装扮，把桌面变成你们独一无二的幸运小窝！

games.name: Planet Arcade
games.description: A light-hearted, casual adventure game in the style of a retro RPG.  Explore an 8-bit land, and check out everything you see!  In place of battles, key plot points are advanced through minigames, some of which are stylistic tributes to classic arcade games, all of which are... somewhat ridiculous.

games.name: Gap Year
games.description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

games.name: Photophore - Chapter 1
games.description: An arcade game that oscillates between shooting, brick-breaking and reflection... with a single projectile!

games.name: Grimrain MMORPG
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Grimrain is an indie MMORPG with a variety of casual and challenging gameplay for solo and groups. Explore the game world, with gathering, crafting, instanced and overworld dungeons, player housing and decoration, hidden locations, and legendary foes.

games.name: Late Amusement
games.description: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

games.name: 引力井
games.description: 在这片浩瀚无垠的宇宙星系里，通过简单操作和真实的物理引擎，合成一个个天体与星球，探索引力井与星系背后的神秘故事。在这里你可以与朋友或整个互联网上的玩家竞速比赛，争夺排名。亦可以放慢节奏享受治愈深邃的太空氛围，观察群星闪烁的静谧时光。

games.name: The Journey Home
games.description:
有些答案只有在自己的内心才能找到。在一个超越时空界限的世界里，你即将展开旅程。
一款无压力、氛围感十足的横版卷轴冒险游戏。

games.name: 寻踪溺亡湖
games.description: 三个素不相识的人来到寻踪溺亡湖，只为寻找失踪的年轻纪录片导演本托。随着湖中黑暗的过去暴露在天光之下，深埋心底的秘密也将一同浮出水面。在这款集合了垂钓、生存和恐怖要素的游戏中探索并调查黑暗水域的真相，成为活到最后的幸存者。

games.name: Shadow Mate
games.description:
《恐怖动作冒险游戏》
少女“辛西亚”在崩塌的秘密研究设施中醒来，她的体内潜藏着凶恶的寄生生命体“贝利亚尔”。面对潜伏于黑暗中的异形怪物与陷入疯狂的研究员，她必须利用贝利亚尔的力量逃离研究所，并揭开隐藏其中的恐怖真相。

games.name: 精灵戏剧：复读机不会获得幸福
games.description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

games.name: Sticker Kittens
games.description: Sticker Kittens 是一款类似数独的游戏，您需要匹配小猫。您还可以学习如何饲养和与小猫玩耍！

games.name: Mimic
games.description:
在这场高风险的社交博弈恐怖游戏中，从注定毁灭的“伊卡洛斯号”飞船上幸存下来。修复飞船、完成秘密的公司议程，或是作为“拟态者”从阴影中进行狩猎 - 那是一个隐藏在众目睽睽之下、能够变换形态的恐怖存在。

谁是人类，而谁又仅仅是戴着一张人皮面具？

games.name: Illegourmet
games.description: 从一间地下厨房起步，建立你的美食帝国。在这座健康饮食至上的城市里，烹制并贩卖违禁美食，扩张地下厨房网络，招募员工，称霸美食黑市。

games.name: 轻拿轻装
games.description: 在《轻拿轻装》这款轻松治愈的店铺经营游戏中，扮演收银员，扫码、打包商品，用心服务每一位顾客。升级店铺、开展促销活动、完成总部指标，并还清加盟店的创业贷款。

games.name: Plague Lords
games.description: 一款以黑死病时期为背景的回合制战术小队RPG，包含基地建设。组建由农民、工匠和战士组成的队伍，调查瘟疫的神秘起源，发展你的聚落，并与感染者战斗。

games.name: Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors
games.description: Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors is an FPS zombie-themed bullet hell game set in the Dead 4 Now universe. Use massive destruction guns to shred hordes of zombies! Improve your character with in-game improvements and skill tree training, and survive against bosses with various abilities.

games.name: Hexrite
games.description: 你是一位巫师，正试图完成一项召唤远古亡神的神秘仪式。在这款风格独特的PS2风格动作平台游戏中，施展神秘穹顶，探索奇幻领域，邂逅形形色色的奇异角色！

games.name: Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen
games.description: Dracula has been resurrected in modern nights Los Angeles. Separated from his home by oceans and time itself, he must come to grips with a new world while his survival hangs in the balance.

games.name: Instar Ecdysis: Protocol Limos
games.description: 《Protocol Limos》是一款令人窒息的心灵心理生存恐怖游戏，而你的猫则是你唯一的异象检测器。你将扮演一名在军管学校中搜寻食物的无家可归女性，必须时刻依靠潜行、资源管理以及绝对的死寂来维持生计。但务必小心，黑暗之中，有某种东西正在死死凝视着你。

games.name: Blood & Chaos
games.description:
《血与混沌》，用类Rogue游戏的形式，向80年代RPG游戏黄金时代致敬。
创建你的6位英雄远征队，踏上史诗般的旅程，在一个丰富多彩的世界中，完成你伟大的任务；探索城市，深入地牢，在回合制的战斗中，通过你精湛的技艺取得胜利！

games.name: Life Blood
games.description: You awaken on the Altar inside the Life Cathedral. Life Blood is a first-person, Kingsfield-like action adventure game with a focus on exploration. Travel the interconnected world with fast-paced, reaction-based combat and discover the secrets within the heart of the mountain.

games.name: 精灵守望
games.description: 为了守护精灵族的未来，也为了替死去的族人报仇，向不死族开战吧！

games.name: Battle of BackYard
games.description: Engage in thrilling household air battles in this wacky game. Choose your role as a skilled pilot or a sharp-shooting gunner, and customize your aircraft to fit your preferred playstyle. Take on daring missions or challenge friends in multiplayer combat. Relive history and dominate the skies!

games.name: Abyssal Survivors
games.description: Dive into the chaos of Abyssal Survivor, a fast-paced 2D anime-style survivor roguelike! Choose from a vast roster of unique characters and build your ultimate four-person team. Strategize, adapt, and unleash powerful combos as you face relentless waves of enemies. No two runs are ever the same.

games.name: The Transference
games.description: 逃离囚禁你的家。但要小心，你并不是这场囚禁中唯一的人。沉浸在这款充满秘密与家庭背叛的第一人称悬疑惊悚游戏中。找出是谁、又为什么把你关了起来。

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.description: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: 999秒！幸存者
games.description:
拒绝无聊的数值堆砌！
《999秒!幸存者》是一款拥有极高构筑深度的类幸存者Roguelike游戏。我们用30+基石型天赋和有限的天赋资源重构了玩法——天赋的搭配将像选取角色一样重要！配合14名角色、200+道具与40+装备，你能完成怎样疯狂的构筑？你是否有资格从999秒的怪物海中幸存，并通过难度全开的至高挑战？
——深度！困难！与高重玩价值！

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.description: You are a yucky long-armed thief.  Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: Wildsite
games.description: Crash-land on a sci-fi planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic AI companion, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons in this survival-craft adventure solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

games.name: Plug: Build your Empire
games.description: Build a drug empire on a real-world map. Grow, cook and deal across actual streets, launder the cash through front businesses, smuggle product between real cities and stay ahead of the cops. From one corner to a transnational cartel.

games.name: 驱邪师
games.description: 《驱邪师》是一款第一人称的恐怖角色扮演游戏，玩家将化身驱邪师，亲临闹鬼现场，跟随线索、完成指定任务，一步步揭开闹鬼背后的真相

games.name: Phasmonauts
games.description: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

games.name: Grimoire
games.description: A dark roguelite where you cast rituals using poker-style ingredient hands to battle monsters through cursed dungeon floors. Build synergies, collect tomes, unlock characters, and face the Eternal Void. Every ritual is a gamble. Every floor, a new curse.

games.name: Spada
games.description: 进入 Spada 的竞技场，这是一款残酷的角斗士战斗游戏，每一次攻击都至关重要。掌握快速反应和基于节奏的按键序列，在逐渐损坏的护甲中生存，并赢得观众的支持以获得自由。任何失误都可能致命。

games.name: 艾尔塔：逆神
games.description: 在这款令人肾上腺素飙升的动作平台游戏中，尽享自由近战、流畅平台跳跃与科幻探索玩法。与龙形伙伴携手闯荡腐化世界，一路鏖战突围。化身堕落之神艾尔塔的神选勇士，踏上对抗诸神的神圣征程。

games.name: MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80
games.description: MS80 is an action-engineering adventure in an abandoned star system. Trapped in a robot body, scavenge your way through the aftermath of a robot rebellion. Your body is a weapon — upgrade it with modular components you take off your enemies, and build yourself a new you!

games.name: Unwell
games.description: Descend into your own broken mind in this psychological survival horror. Survive twisted manifestations of your psyche, defend your shelter, and shape your fate through choices that lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Aster Initiative
games.description: A puzzle-horror experience - navigate a huge mid-90s internet and use a variety of programs on your work computer to take down your pharmaceutical company without getting caught.

games.name: The Soul of Cosmos
games.description: 《灵魂乾坤》是一款关于灵魂的、集卡牌策略，弹幕射击，角色扮演于一体的冒险游戏。但是请记住，游戏中最重要的始终是您的选择！游戏世界中的种种选择与经历最终都会反映出您的灵魂。受异世界灵魂感召的您，将开启一段怎样的灵魂之旅呢？

games.name: 《去月球 传奇RPG》 之最终一小时
games.description:
你喜欢 RPG，但没时间玩完整个游戏……

我们也喜欢 RPG，但也没时间制作完整个游戏……

所以这里只是一个《去月球 传奇RPG》 的最终一小时！！

games.name: Escape from the Collector
games.description: "Escape from the Collector" is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

games.name: Exista!
games.description: 在一场关于发现、恐惧和寻找自己在世界上的位置的冒险中探索神秘的失落岛屿。面对生活的挑战，揭开隐藏的秘密，面对时间和死亡，并选择你留下的遗产。

games.name: Tearoom of Terror
games.description: Tearoom of Terror is a cozy-gothic narrative cooking mystery where you investigate the mysterious death of your estranged aunt in a tearoom filled with sinister patrons, unsettling secrets, and morally questionable requests.

games.name: Trailblazers: Into the March
games.description: 快来游玩这款 Roguelite 迁移模拟策略游戏，开启惊心动魄的冒险之旅。指挥自己的陆行舰，在策略战斗中取得胜利，照顾由各种角色组成的船员，打造自己的家园，管理资源，带领探险队深入“The March”。探索这片未知之地深藏不露的真相……还有你心中的秘密。

games.name: Choppy Waters
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

games.name: Mage's Adventure
games.description: A roguelike auto battler of misfit heroes and warped realms. Recruit your party, defeat monsters for gear, hoard godly artifacts, and put down the colossal evils at the end of every road.

games.name: ForMind
games.description: 款以 ZiroTech 水下设施为背景的恐怖射击游戏，每个舱室都是生死之战。与感染者搏斗，利用环境，黑入终端并从错误中吸取教训。时间异常给了你第二次机会——切勿错失良机。

games.name: LTA: Light-years! Thrusters! Action!
games.description: A space roguelite sandbox about a captain and their crew in a strange, chaotic galaxy. Trade, fight, build bases, mine resources — the journey is yours for as long as anyone in your crew still lives. The freedom of Pirates!, the wild stories of RimWorld, the hard choices of FTL.

games.name: 萊雅的行商蜜事
games.description:
《莱雅的行商密事》是一款轻解谜、快问快答型的轻松小品游戏。
你将扮演女扮男装的「莱雅」，踏上一场一边赚钱还债、一边压抑(处理)欲望的刺激行商之旅！

games.name: Idlescape
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Idlescape is an MMORPG combining idle mechanics with RPG elements. Progress continues offline, allowing mastery of skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. Engage in crafting, gathering, and strategic battles. Perfect for casual and hardcore gamers alike.

games.name: Piece Quest Idle
games.description: 组建一支即使离线也会不断成长的队伍。收集资源、升级据点、打造装备、自定义英雄技能树，并设定他们在自动战斗中的行为，运用策略击败强大的首领。

games.name: Dark And Evil
games.description: Dark & Evil is an Open World Action RPG game where players take on the role of a young and inexperienced Dark Lord. Fresh from a humbling defeat at the hands of humanity, the Dark Lord is fueled by the burning desire to conquer the human world and reclaim his rightful throne.

games.name: 矿工与山神
games.description:
《矿工与山神》是一款融合搜打撤​玩法的像素​风卡牌RPG，这里的一切几乎都是卡牌​（除了材料和装备）。
你需要使用卡牌和敌人战斗，搜刮物资，在矿洞中建立据点，不断向下探索。失败会让你失去一切，食物、零件、队员…所有一切。你会遇到形形色色的人和事，有人会加入你，有人会妨碍你，在冒险中构筑你的探索小队牌组，不要忘记你最初的目标——“山之心”。

games.name: Situation Succ: Inn Elysium
games.description: Situation Succ is a Dark-Fantasy game with a mythos inspired in part by both Asian and Western occult influences. As a detective who finds himself trapped inside an ancient inn by four evil entities, you have to use your wits and investigative abilities to try and escape.

games.name: Mischief Motors
games.description: Mischief Motors is a chaotic couch multiplayer car combat game where cartoony vehicles, over-the-top special weapons, and destructible arenas turn every match into explosive cartoon mayhem. Pick your ride, wreck your friends, and survive the battle.

games.name: 龙骨海盗（原名：三相航记）
games.description: 驾驶自己的海盗船，遨游奇幻世界。精通类魂战斗与强大魔法，猎杀致命首领。探索新岛屿，搜刮隐秘宝藏，为你和你的船打造各种升级。（1-6名玩家）

games.name: 除靈館
games.description:
你在一栋诡异的废宅醒来,身边是心爱的人。你不记得自己怎么进来这里。为了带她离开,你必须一一面对住在这里的六个怨灵——他们不是要打倒的敌人,是需要被理解的悲剧。每个房间都藏着一段没能说出口的爱。

但在你以为终于可以离开的那一刻,你会明白:有些真相,只能在走出大门之后才看得见。

games.name: Vasya Run
games.description: Explore, a courier and graffiti artist caught in an extraterrestrial invasion amidst a society ruled by surveillance. Can speed and infiltration skills be enough?

games.name: 漫长之旅
games.description: Long Trip《漫长之旅》是一个动作角色扮演VR游戏。在这个奇幻世界旅程中你可以骑乘坐骑，招募战士，驯养宠物，狩猎，采集，烹饪，打造武器，获取不同属性的魔法，甚至唤醒古代机甲或者古龙参与战斗。

games.name: One More Tower
games.description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Farmer's Diary
games.description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm, a long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming, orcharding and animal husbandry to the next level with your friends.

games.name: Spirits of Baciu
games.description: 《巴丘之灵》（Spirits of Baciu）讲述了一只形似猫咪的小精灵在巴丘的漆黑林莽中突然醒来的神秘冒险故事。你需要帮助它一路解开重重难题，直面居住在这片诡谲秘境中的精怪，最终离开这片丛丛密林。

games.name: VERY IMPORTANT NEEDS
games.description: 这是一款混乱的抢劫游戏：一群需求过于“重要”的角色反复闯进同一群邻居的建筑，搜刮所有值钱的东西。目标只有一个：最后只留下墙和门。（墙可选）

games.name: Streak of Power
games.description: Streak of Power is a turn-based strategy game featuring tactical duels. Aim your energy beam carefully, use gravitational stations to alter its trajectory, and take control of them. Outsmart your opponent and destroy their base before they hit yours.

games.name: Voiceless
games.description: Voiceless是一款支持1–4人合作的恐怖游戏。从神秘宅邸中开启直播，完成观众挑战并获得更多订阅者。与朋友合作，或故意坑害他们——选择属于你自己的成名之路。

games.name: Annihilation
games.description: Doomed and surrounded, but not yet dead!  Take on the role of Annihilator and purge the endless horde in this arcade survival shooter.  Featuring roguelike elements and minimal resources: manage your loadouts between waves and strategically invest in war supplies to face the unknown threat.

games.name: Dungeon Automata
games.description: 《Dungeon Automata》（原名《Algolemeth》）是一款“逻辑自动化”游戏：它将日式角色扮演游戏中的地下城探险元素与自动战斗玩法结合到了一起。游戏中，你需要通过可视化的节点编程来指挥你的队伍，在不断的试错中摸索破局之道，最终实现全自动征服地下城！

games.name: Da Bridge Troll
games.description: 在这款类Rogue生存模拟中，你将作为一个狡猾——或贪婪——的巨魔统治你的桥。吃掉、收税或放行旅人，在饥饿、贪欲与声望间取得平衡，选择成为令人畏惧的掠食者……还是受人敬仰的桥之守护者。

games.name: Wilderdark
games.description: 荒野中潜伏着危险之物。《Wilderdark》是一款第一人称生存恐怖游戏，玩家必须在一座充满外寄生恐龙和生物体的奇怪岛屿上来往穿梭。你必须始终保持警惕，悄悄地获取证据、样本，并制作物品才能生存下去。

games.name: False Hope
games.description: 《False Hope》是一款生存恐怖游戏，你将扮演斯坦利。他与朋友哈丽特一同被困在废弃商场中。斯坦利穿行于黑暗走廊时，假人突然复活，让逃生变成生存之战。解开谜题、揭露商场的秘密，并躲避穷追不舍的威胁。

games.name: 沧浪行卷
games.description: 《沧浪行卷》是武侠单人沙盒 RPG。你可在城镇、村落、道路与荒野间习武、交易、采集、狩猎、建造与经营；参与受地形、距离、障碍、武器和伤势影响的回合制战斗。人物与市场会记住你的选择。

games.name: L.OD
games.description: 2D exploratory adventure

games.name: Exitus
games.description: 你找到了一直在寻找的工作。你唯一要担心的,是你的配额。不然呢?蛋白质一直是个难题。HFU 解决了它。低头做事。做好你的工作,你来这里是有原因的。《Exitus》是一款终端风格的抉择游戏。调出每个案件,然后决定他们的命运。

games.name: Dome RPG
games.description: Dome RPG is a game about a boy who once woke up in a strange world. Explore a mysterious world with unique visuals, interesting characters and lots of mysteries to uncover!

games.name: EXTANT: Zombie Eradication Co-op Simulation
games.description: The apocalypse was years ago. Those still living are termed the 'Extant'. Millions of walking dead still roam the cities. Extant SOG groups of four operators have been tasked with infiltrating areas with supplies to retrieve for the Extant civilians. You are one of them. A 4-person CO-OP 3D shooter.

games.name: Clash of Adventurers
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 开发中的开放世界独立MMORPG。免费Steam试玩现已开放：人人可加入，自动即时获取权限，无需密钥。一个职业只担任一个定位：攻击、防御或辅助。组队战斗、采集、制作，在无副本的无缝世界中做任务。

games.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
games.description: 组建一支gotchimon队伍，选好它们的招式和出场顺序，然后看它们自动战斗。体验故事战役，在PvP竞技场挑战其他玩家组建的队伍，工作时也能在屏幕角落的小窗口里继续游戏。

games.name: Bagsy
games.description: Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

games.name: Project Jump Scare
games.description: Carry one object at a time through a forest, restore a broken carnival, and run when the Old One rises. Click or throw items to fight back in this single-player survival horror.

games.name: Iron Dawn
games.description: 作为佣兵驾驶员操控强大的战争机器，在这款战术机甲射击游戏中选择合约、定制装备，并部署至可完全摧毁的战场。带着收益成功撤离，升级你的武器库，迎接越来越危险的任务。

games.name: My Paper Plane Is Better
games.description: 把纸飞机掷向城市上空。你的飞行会变成一条赛道，所有人都来追你的航线。驾驶三架像真纸一样会升力、失速、折翼的纸飞机，追着前十名的幻影往前飞。两分钟一局，整座城市的航线等你去打破。

games.name: Skullf!
games.description:
You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf action!

After another hilarious night terrorizing locals it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

games.name: Notoris 2: Warlords
games.description: 一款融合黑暗奇幻与高魔幻想的策略角色扮演游戏。你可以扮演君主、太守或武将，运用“影响力”左右盟友与对手。统率庞大军队，在紧张刺激的战术回合制战斗中决胜沙场。灵感源自《三国演义》。

games.name: 桌面小搭档
games.description: 桌面小搭档是一款与你一起工作与学习的AI桌面搭子！在这里，你可以选择你喜欢的搭子在任何场景里一起工作或学习，也可以找一个喜欢的房间、咖啡厅、卧室等停下来，一边欣赏风景一边和你的小搭档一起共度美好的时光。还可以布置你喜欢的书桌风格，给自己做一个属于自己的电子书桌！让我们在努力工作和学习的过程中，体验各种有趣独特美好的氛围。

games.name: Pinch N Roll
games.description: A chaotic online physics brawler where you flick, buff, and smash your bean across 20+ maps with up to 10 players. Collect balls, unlock hats, tattoos, and hair, and embrace cartoony chaos with a cheeky twist of adult humor.

games.name: Super Sunny World
games.description: Super Sunny World is the ultimate love letter to the platformer greats of the 8-bit era. Jump, bump, and kick your way through 8 worlds of pixel-perfect platforming, cute characters, and exciting power-ups. Built for the NES, and for the first time playable on Steam!

games.name: 银河狩猎官 Iron Hunters
games.description: 操作机甲作战，收集强力武器，跨越多个危险星球追捕罪犯。用赏金堆砌出不断进化的机甲怪兽，碾压你的敌人。

games.name: Chess Twist
games.description: A mind-bending chess game, where straight lines turn and diagonals fork. Millions of different boards with new strategies hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Luz Mala
games.description: 结合 3D 探索与 2.5D 平台动作挑战的冒险游戏。在解决谜题、克服障碍并直面传说威胁的同时，体验受南美民俗启发的世界。你将化身“Luz Mala”，在永恒的安息中寻求解脱。

games.name: Burden of Revenge
games.description:
Step into the shoes of young Finn Goldenhorn, as he sets out on his quest for revenge.
Master dynamic traversal, solve challenging puzzles and fight your way through enemies to uncover the secrets of a mysterious realm in this 3rd-person action-adventure puzzle platformer.

games.name: Limbival
games.description: You went to a carnival for fun, but suddenly realized that you are the real source of entertainment! Luckily, you still have your limbs, so you can escape from here... right?

games.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
games.description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

games.name: 军团塔防
games.description: 战争的号角回荡在风中，氏族的战火再度灼烧世界！在《军团塔防》点燃RTS与塔防的双线烽火，集结钢铁军团于险峻高地，带领部落杀入血色裂谷迎击敌潮。以古老魔法构筑坚不可摧的战争工事，锻造属于你的战争法则。踏入这场荣耀与破晓的血色试炼！

games.name: Mythical Whalers
games.description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

games.name: Helios Horizon
games.description: Annihilate endless hordes of aliens in this action-packed sci-fi rogue-lite. Acquire a variety of firearms and upgrade your equipment to fulfill your mission.

games.name: Foul
games.description: Foul 是一款带有剧情元素的生存游戏。你必须独自面对前进道路上的一切。被污染的动物、饥饿与黑暗，只是其中的一部分危险。

games.name: Jancer
games.description: 在这款节奏超级紧凑、基于音乐的平台跳跃游戏中，帮助乐舞者找寻他的使命！ 结识化身为猫咪Boss的知名古典作曲家，通过独具匠心的故事体验他们曲作的重混演绎，探索由音乐驱动的世界，寻找秘密音符，并发现隐藏挑战！

games.name: 无路可退
games.description: 《无路可退》是一款带有肉鸽和卡牌构筑元素的回合制策略游戏。玩家将扮演一位需要击败成群的敌人的战斗者。在有限的场地上通过灵活地行动存活下来，并在敌人袭击的间隙组建角色的构筑，直到倒下或者击败所有敌人。游戏以装备+行动代替传统的卡牌，以行动冷却代替卡牌循环，加入了有限的战场空间丰富了战斗时的决策，更有超过100种敌人带来了丰富多彩的挑战。

games.name: No Love No Money
games.description:
