games.description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

games.name: 台球勇者
games.description: 《台球勇者》是一款将桌球物理碰撞、Roguelite构筑与奇幻怪物战斗结合的策略动作游戏。瞄准、蓄力、击球，让主球在战斗桌上弹射连击，击败怪物球，收集遗物与技能，打造属于你的冒险流派。

games.name: Galactic Realms: Quest for the Forgotten
games.description: Magic meets forgotten tech in a first-person, 1-4 player co-op PvE-only extraction RPG and dungeon crawler. Descend into handcrafted, ever-changing dungeons, risk what you bring, claim rare loot, and extract to keep what you earn. No pay-to-win. No microtransactions.

games.name: My Slimadatchi
games.description: A cozy desktop companion idle game where you care for your adorable slime as it plays, enjoys treats, and partake in activities with you. Earn slime points to unlock new toys, customize your Slimadatchi shell, and dress up your slime to create a companion that's truly your own!

games.name: Paper War
games.description: Paper War is a roguelite adventure where you play as "Little Blue," a character brought to life from an artist’s dreams. Battle failed sketches, upgrade skills, and weapons, and fight for survival on a living paper sheet filled with chaos and bombs.

games.name: 精准弹道：模拟器
games.description: 一个藏在解密电脑程序里的射击模拟器，细节多到令人发指。几十种枪械、两百多种弹药、上千种配件，绝对没有半点超自然成分。

games.name: Moonbrella
games.description: 一款以深度移动技能和无跳跃按键为特色的2D类银河恶魔城平台跳跃游戏。升级你的雨伞，探索一颗被遗弃的星球，并一路登上月球。

games.name: 曹操的人妻野望
games.description: 东汉末年群雄割据，人人怀揣野心做着一统天下的大梦，或许是为百姓、为苍生、为权力......而我曹某人，自然也有属于自己的野望，那便是——将天底下的人妻纳为己有！

games.name: 8号房间
games.description:
下班回到家时，自己的房间却变得完全陌生……
这是一款成人向的类8号出口风格异变找碴游戏，目标是在神秘空间中找出异变并逃脱出去。
累的时候，可以让坐在沙发上的「玛丽亚」来疗癒你。
随着游戏的进展，她也会开始和你做一些色色的事情……

games.name: 禁忌之书与魅惑迷宫
games.description: 懒惰的魔法使被禁忌之书关进了充满色情造物的迷宫中,这是一个惩罚,也是一场磨炼.一款Roguelike俯视角射击游戏,包含像素动图,高清CG,Live2D三种涩涩方式,让你一次满足

games.name: 牛娘米露菲的淫欲陷阱调教～触手×媚药×拘束 绝顶榨取！～
games.description:
米露菲（CV：伊ヶ崎綾香）将在主题各异的地牢中，挑战并逃脱各种色情陷阱！
拘束、触手、媚药、榨乳、SM…… 在冒险途中，还能体验与主人的亲密H日常，并通过装备不同的色情道具获得特殊效果！

games.name: Fear Hour
games.description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

games.name: Battle-Lines
games.description: Like playing Go with puzzle pieces. Build, recolor and steal lines to dominate the board! Play local, online or against AI.

games.name: Maker Max
games.description: Build devious levels. Share them with the world. Watch others suffer. Maker Max is a free-to-play platformer where you create, upload, and race through community-made levels — then claim the leaderboard before anyone else does.

games.name: 冻堂英霞的隶雄传
games.description:
究竟是奴隶，还是英雄？
肉体、精神、尊严、日常、未来……献上一切，成为英雄吧！
损耗肉体与心灵来持续守护市民的终极隶雄体验RPG！

games.name: Zap Colony
games.description: Zap Colony⚡是一款极简风格的防御模拟游戏。搭建电网，让防御塔的能量与敌人的颜色相匹配。你能守护殖民地多久？

games.name: Simple Sudoku
games.description: Play the classic puzzle game of Sudoku with difficulty levels, achievements, custom colors, and daily puzzles! Use notes to rule out options and undo to backtrack just like on pencil and paper. Play casually or beat your highest score by completing the puzzle in the quickest time.

games.name: Fablery
games.description: 执掌来自世界各地神话、传说与经典故事中的传奇英雄。每位英雄都拥有专属卡组，展现其独特的性格与力量。投身策略卡牌对战，运筹帷幄、料敌先机，让每一场战斗都成为传奇。

games.name: Multi Deck Hero
games.description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

games.name: みんなで間違い探しスタジアム
games.description: Find the one that doesn't belong. A board packed with near-identical characters hides a single odd one out — spot it fast, alone or against up to 8 players online.

games.name: 楼兰王国
games.description: 《楼兰王国》是一款融合城市生存建造与即时策略的游戏。作为楼兰的统治者，你必须在危机四伏的沙漠绿洲中建立城市，利用丝绸之路发展壮大，拼尽全力守护你的王国，直至最后一刻。

games.name: DOSMIC
games.description: 在庞然巨物横行的世界中，少年尼禄踏上寻找失踪少女斯诺亚的旅程。《DOSMIC》是一款电影式解谜平台游戏，你将运用多样的移动能力，解开神秘谜题，有时还要与超乎想象的恐怖抗争。

games.name: 阴霾笼罩
games.description: 《阴霾笼罩》是一款点击式恐怖游戏。步入死寂的古老宅邸，四处搜寻、收集线索，在环环相扣的环境谜题中抽丝剥茧，窥探不为人知的黑暗秘密。你能否彻底揭开这桩谜团……并且逃出生天？

games.name: Rush Your Band
games.description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

games.name: PAYDAY: Aces High
games.description:
Nothing hits like the moment the mask comes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. High stakes, big money, no mercy: PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players.

Revenge has never felt so good.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: Lacey's Flash Games
games.description: These are the REAL girls’ games. In the mid 2000s, Charlie (Charchar887), discovers the Lacey's Flash Games and their disturbing secrets. Step into the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the missing website creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey!

games.name: Soul Tides
games.description: 在这款拉锯战风格的自动战斗游戏中统领黑暗大军。建设基地、召唤单位、定制技能，将战线推进至敌方据点。在每一场对局中灵活调整策略，在 PvP、合作模式或试炼模式中称霸战场。

games.name: Tropic Industry
games.description: 打造你的热带工业。种植、加工并出口资源——从简单的种植园到复杂的生产链。优化物流，提高效率，将你的企业发展为全球出口网络。

games.name: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
games.description: 打造终极微缩模型商店！订购模型套件，绘制精美微缩模型，与收藏家谈判，将你的店铺发展成所有模型爱好者最喜爱的商店。

games.name: Factory Life
games.description: 《工厂生活》是一款以工人视角出发的工厂模拟游戏，你将从一个小车库起步，逐步发展成为一家受真实生产中心启发的现代化制造企业。你需要生产产品、管理团队，并通过智能自动化实现规模化扩张。👨‍🔧🏭

games.name: CitaDrill
games.description: 在这款融合roguelite元素的城市建造游戏中，指挥一座巨型钻探城市。深入挖掘被感染的星球，采集资源，在穹顶之下扩张你的城市，与你那勇敢又厉害的猫咪队友们共同抵御一波波恐怖生物的侵袭。

games.name: 少女机师养成计划：女武神协议
games.description: 如果拯救末世的代价是最依赖你的她，你还会陪在她身边吗？在这款融合了心理恐怖与模拟经营的科幻视觉小说中，你将在日程中照顾少女驾驶员的一切。在同步率、战损与崩坏的内心之间取得微妙平衡，并通过无止境的新世纪轮回，寻找幸福的唯一可能。

games.name: B.E.S.T 2
games.description: 《B.E.S.T 2》是一款带有多项关键抉择和多种可能结局的成人视觉小说。参加各种挑战吧！帮助你的朋友，或是背叛他们！只有一个目标：成为最强者。一切将由你决定，你想成为什么样的人！

games.name: Click Click Chicken
games.description: 一款关于捕捉鸡、猪、牛和羊的短篇增量游戏。

games.name: Octane100
games.description: Combine items, build your own loadout, and break the flow of battle in a war against the oil corporation Octane100. Butterflies, bullets, or an ATOMIC BOMB? The choice is yours!

games.name: 奇塔利亚童话2
games.description: 与全新英雄爱丽丝和达斯蒂组队出发，踏上一场横跨神秘阿卡德拉半岛的史诗冒险！无论是独自探索，还是与好友同行，你都可以培养独特的战斗技能，收集稀有材料，锻造强力装备，打理欣欣向荣的农场！

games.name: 男大学生的日常
games.description:
Our campus life is an AVG set against the backdrop of modern university life.
In an alternate contemporary world, players step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience a story where sports, friendship, and even romance intertwine with multiple characters.

games.name: 鸟雀斗
games.description:
飞进群禽云集的牌组构筑世界，率领鸟类掀起反叛风潮！搭配方牌，解放鸟儿；解锁百搭牌，
打出狂暴的组合效果。打倒心狠手辣的诡叙师，解放众鸟！

games.name: SuperCitycon
games.description: 一款复古风格的城市建造游戏。在创意沙盒中铺设道路和铁路，打造整片街区。使用内置体素编辑器 SCC Studio 自定义建筑、车辆等模型，并通过 Steam 创意工坊分享你的作品。

games.name: Mythfall
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

games.name: Shared RC
games.description: You drive left. They drive right. Straight? Only if you're both on the same page. Shared RC splits control of one car between two players — team up (or don't) across brutal, physics-based courses where every wrong move is somebody else's fault too.

games.name: The Righteous Wrong
games.description: The Righteous Wrong is a psychological horror game set on Kaldr during the Rule of Three. The game is a hybrid of survival horror and JRPG games.  With inspiration from H.R. Giger to Fallout. Can you survive the cruel world of The Righteous Wrong?

games.name: Back on Your Feet
games.description: A boxing action-adventure built on redemption. Fight up a tournament bracket where every opponent has a story of his own, make choices you can't take back, and circle, weave, and throw every punch yourself. Do you have what it takes to get back on your feet?

games.name: AI Clicker
games.description: 一路点击，走向统治世界（或世界末日）！欢迎来到 AI Clicker——唯一一款让无脑点击真的使你变聪明……或创造一个 AI 取代你的未来的游戏！

games.name: The Pogo Witch
games.description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

games.name: Deck & Defense
games.description: A real-time deckbuilder roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

games.name: Project Roy
games.description: 《Project Roy》是一款快节奏FPS Roguelike游戏，你将化身具备“意识入侵”能力的AI，劫持敌方战斗机器人，操控它们的独特技能，在层层机械大军的围攻下杀出重围，逃离苏利文公司的掌控！

games.name: Spin Power
games.description: 一款简短的增量建造游戏，一切都依靠你的“旋转之力”运转。建造建筑、开采资源、解锁新土地，在庞大的技能树中升级自己，自动化资源开采以增加收入，并将神秘的水箱从永恒的沉睡中唤醒！

games.name: Ultakia
games.description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

games.name: The Last Liftboy
games.description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. After thirty years, a letter brings Ted Grady back to the Hôtel Grand Valmont. The hotel is barely breathing. Carry luggage, run the elevator, restore the rooms — and save the place that made him.

games.name: Conformity Cubed
games.description: Welcome to Conformity Cubed! A space-bending puzzle game where players must move cubes simultaneously to complete a solar system filled with puzzles.

games.name: What Lies Within
games.description: What Lies Within is a co-op first person psychological horror. You and your team must work together to complete objectives within abandoned facilities owned by your employer, 'M-E-L'. A bioengineering company conducting top secret biological experimentation on aliens, humans and more...

games.name: 蝼蚁之城
games.description: 神明降下虚假的永生，罪恶与剥削在无法逃脱的重置中循环。《蝼蚁之城》是一款赛博神话背景的动作游戏：你将作为一名被下令销毁的合成人，通过不断组合武器、芯片与业力，对抗机械妖魔，在循环中撕开这座城市的真相。

games.name: MOP'N SPARK：拖把与火花
games.description:
尝试、倒转、再重新编排！
《MOP'N SPARK》是一款注重灵感与思考的2D解谜平台游戏。操控清洁工和电工，组合两人的行动，找出通关答案。

games.name: Dark Trip
games.description: 《暗黑之旅》是一款哥特式恐怖密室逃脱游戏，你将借助邪恶的生物机械、诡异的艺术品以及自身的幻觉，揭开一桩诡异罪案的谜团。探索诡异的房间，勘察神秘地点和实验室设备，通过扭曲的视觉体验揭示隐藏的线索。支持平面模式和VR模式。

games.name: Tetrabonk
games.description: Tetrabonk is a 1–4 player co-op roguelike. Explore procedurally generated locations, fight with swords, bows, or firearms against hordes of enemies and powerful bosses, and build your character through upgrade cards — no run is ever the same.

games.name: Dylio's Adventures
games.description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio’s shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

games.name: 卡牌：英雄纷争
games.description: 在这款独特的策略RPG游戏中，你需要在一个奇幻世界中通过堆叠卡牌来收集资源并招募军队。探索神秘的房间，巧妙地利用有限的空间组合出强大的战斗单位，迎接回合制Boss战的挑战。本游戏融合了卡牌构筑与空间管理的乐趣，每一个堆叠决策都将影响战局的走向。集结不同种族的英雄，攻克一个个地牢，直到最终征服最后一个房间。立即下载体验，展示你的战术才华，在这个充满无限可能的冒险中书写属于你的传奇。

games.name: Bannerlands
games.description: 一张张卡牌，一步步缔造文明。《Bannerlands》是一款Roguelike牌组构筑游戏，战争、文化与经济将共同决定你的帝国命运。九位各具特色的统治者。数百张卡牌。一个帝国，待你缔造。

games.name: Canvas Infernum
games.description: 《Canvas Infernum》是一款策略建造类 Roguelike 游戏，你将用真实的历史艺术一块一块地拼出超现实的地狱。缔结改变规则的契约，在每一次冒险中发现全新的策略，并揭开文艺复兴风格冥界中活墨角色的奇异故事。

games.name: Appulse
games.description: 这是一款融合弹球台玩法机制的 俯视射击游戏。投身激烈的战斗，精准掌控你的每一次射击。你的任务是守护母舰，抵御机器人的轮番入侵。升级装备、征服敌方飞船，赢下这场战争！

games.name: Moon Drop Miners
games.description: Moon Drop Miners is a high-stakes resource management roguelite where you drop structures onto unstable moons to build and balance a fragile mining operation. Balance Energy and Stability while extracting enough Celestium to meet quota... Or watch your entire operation collapse.

games.name: Stick N' Sheep
games.description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

games.name: Hillthorn
games.description: 一桩发生在僻静社区的失踪案。一座埋藏着重重秘密的山。一位和时间赛跑的侦探。这就是《Hillthorn》，一款暗黑风格的调查推理游戏。全程无对白，你只能依靠手中的卡牌、脑中的逻辑与直觉探寻真相。

games.name: Booty Battler
games.description: SinglePlayer Roguelike meets Auto-Battler Card game! Manage a crew of pirates to fight through endless auto-battles while collecting powerful relics, managing cursed loot, upgrading the ship and casting spells.

games.name: Outpost Simulator
games.description: 世界已然崩塌，但你的前哨站仍屹立不倒。为幸存者打造安全的庇护所，满足他们的需求，把基地发展成繁荣的聚落。驾驶房车穿越废土，击退掠夺者的突袭，一步步重建这个世界的残骸。

games.name: 格林堡
games.description: 《格林堡》是一款以噩梦童话为背景的肉鸽骰子构筑游戏。寻找道具、投掷骰子并优化你的构筑，打出巨额伤害。在诅咒之城中杀出一条血路，直抵公主面前。然后，终结她。

games.name: 9999+ Weapons: Idle RPG
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Lead a squad of collectible companions in an open-world idle RPG shared with other players. Summon heroes, forge better equipment, and challenge bosses as your squad grows stronger. Explore new areas, take on quests, or spend some time fishing, mining, and woodcutting.

games.name: Polemista
games.description: Polemista is a tactical action game with stealth elements, set in a cyberpunk Polish coastal city. You are K, an enhanced super-soldier from a defunct corporate program designed to protect Europe. Now abandoned and hunted, you must find a way to clear your name and regain your freedom.

games.name: Crazy Life
games.description: A life simulation game for up to 6 online players.Become a resident of Shishizaka City and aim to become the richest by getting jobs, changing careers, buying properties, getting married, raising children, and using cards.Experience a turbulent life in a vast city!

games.name: Duoshift
games.description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

games.name: 明日英雄：伦敦
games.description: 在1:1复刻还原的伦敦街头，抄起现实世界的武器，驾驭神秘莫测的Flux源力，与队友并肩作战，拯救这座陷入末日危机的城市。

games.name: Frostrail
games.description: 穿越冰霜，死亡如影随形。踏入残酷的生存FPS，独自或组队皆可。探索、搜刮、制作、战斗，在冰冻腐朽的世界中挣扎求生。驾驶并升级你的蒸汽火车，穿越无情的荒原。在这里，你的每个抉择都关乎生死。

games.name: Nemorsys
games.description: 光会暴露你，影会武装你。《Nemorsys》是一款严酷的潜行动作 RPG，环境光照主宰着每一个能力、每一双敌人的眼睛和每一条路线。正面硬闯必死无疑。熄灭灯火，精通 20 种暗影能力，从黑暗中夺走暴君的王座。

games.name: Rami on Watalands
games.description: Rami on Watalands 是一款温馨的农场冒险游戏，玩家可以种植作物并变身为这些作物，在一个由岛屿组成的世界中探索。每种作物都会赋予独特能力：穿过小洞、在水面上行走、召唤雨水以及发现新的地方。

games.name: Wight Butterfly
games.description:
Recover your stolen VAMPIRE MECHA POWER CHASSIS suits from 6 deadly monsters sent by your brother, Dark Moth. 
Toggle through elemental suits and custom Blaster configurations in this punishing retro 8-bit shooter. 
Earn mobility upgrades from the Reaper and collect what was stolen from you. GO!

games.name: Dittung Dittung
games.description: Dittung Dittung is a 2D stealth action game where Pippi, an adorable penguin, sneaks into a seal's hideout to reclaim the fish they stole from her colony. Use Pippi's unique penguin movements, hide using the environment, and outsmart dangerous predators to take back what's yours!

games.name: Rebels of the Realm
games.description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

games.name: Blood Curse Legions
games.description: 这是一款主要控制骑兵兵团作战的动作即时战略游戏,您将使用吸血鬼的能力指挥军团战斗,并根据游戏世界的形势发展培养各具特色的吸血鬼英雄,组成强大的血咒军团横扫世界,最终建立一个吸血鬼国度,称霸一方。

games.name: 天祝我也
games.description: 天命不予，我便自取。《天祝我也》是一款赛璐璐动画风格的3D动作Roguelite游戏。你将扮演人造少女魔法师“莉莉”，孤身闯入一座危机四伏的迷宫。通过掌控水、火、风、地四大元素，收集失落的“加护”，在无尽的变数中磨炼意志。探索、挑战、成长，在这个充满未知与危险的世界中，追寻属于你的命运吧！

games.name: Die Meeple
games.description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

games.name: 乌托邦的钥匙/The key of Utopia
games.description: 这是一款童话风角色扮演类游戏，你将扮演一名幸运得到机会的孩子提温，与他的妹妹提丝共同前往“乌托邦”。而在你到达后，却发现乌托邦的大门却因为失去钥匙而紧闭，最终能够帮助你开启大门的，究竟是乌托邦的仙子，还是其他……？

games.name: Firefighters Code Red
games.description: 当恐惧席卷而来，你的任务便正式开始：《消防员：红色警报》中，你将与烈火、浓烟和时间赛跑——无论是单人作战，还是通过跨平台多人模式与小队并肩作战。

games.name: Hidden Assault
games.description: Top-down hybrid of strategy and stealth action game. Espionage, infiltration, tactical combat, and resource management. Customize loadout, earn experience, and develop your squad's skills.

games.name: TabletKid Activity Book
games.description: A growing collection of animated, interactive pop-up books set in a cozy playroom space filled with hidden minigames. Point-and-click to explore the library: grab books to read, play with the busy board, and find other surprises. Intended for kids ages 3-5.

games.name: Knightstones
games.description:
Lead your troops on your war table in this unique roguelite auto-battler.
Deploy your elite warriors, trigger devastating chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

games.name: Northwick
games.description:
Northwick; The main protagonist Chris uncovers an ancient book contained within are relentless horrors. Each night Chris's understanding of the true evil that has been thrust upon him will deepen. 

Will you have to commit the ultimate sacrifice?

games.name: Fell The Titan
games.description: Summon units to defend and attack in this strategic card game.  PVP and single CPU battles will play like a CCG, while the rogue-lite adventure mode will have powerups and unlocks, some of which can be carried over into the next run.

games.name: DIG
games.description: 一款适合 1-4 位好友的温馨在线合作挖掘游戏。在阳光明媚的后院挖个坑，寻找矿石和失落的图纸，在工坊里打造可爱的物件，再寄给世界各地的顾客，他们会用信件和照片回复你。没有计时器，尽情挖吧。

games.name: The Charity Shop
games.description: The Charity Shop is an atmospheric, surreal puzzle game where you use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered to The Charity Shop, a place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

games.name: Ritual Tides
games.description: Ritual Tides 是一款剧情丰富的第一人称心理恐怖游戏，故事发生在阴暗、与世隔绝的维多利亚时代英国岛屿 Hortus。你在岸边醒来，不记得自己是谁，也不知道自己如何来到这里。探索这座岛屿，揭开它黑暗的过去，搜集食物、弹药和补给，隐藏行踪，躲避 Fallow Parish 邪教的追捕，在克苏鲁式的恐怖中挣扎求生，找出 Hortus 的真相……以及你自己的真实身份。这是一部宏大恐怖系列的开篇之作。

games.name: 无尽地下城
games.description: 一款回合制策略RPG游戏，可以自由构筑技能组合，多种技能机制打造专属自己的build，所有装备都可手工打造，完全定制，超大量可以自由探索的地下城，每个地下城都有单独制作的特殊BOSS，每个BOSS都有单独制作的独特技能，可建设城镇，可自由恋爱，每个可玩角色都有专属任务线和特殊装备，拥有超过100小时的超长流程，可以开心刷刷刷

games.name: Tight Lines
games.description: Fish solo or with friends on lakes that contain deep simulations of real-life fish behavior. Every species has its own habits and hiding spots. Learn what triggers a bite, refine your technique, and test your skill against the lakes' legendary monsters or while you manage your own fishing pond.

games.name: Metal Coffin
games.description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

games.name: Alien's Fridge
games.description:
Fight for control in Alien's Fridge: A physics-based horror roguelike where aliens don't just attack – they physically dominate you. 
One slip sparks fear, one misstep makes it clear.

games.name: Castlebound
games.description: 在这款支持 1-4 名玩家的动作平台游戏中，与成群的邪恶怪物战斗，保卫你的城堡，游戏融合了 Roguelike 元素！

games.name: 喵力矿工队
games.description: 在被诅咒的永夜大陆上，古老魔法与蒸汽火枪交织出残酷的生存之战！与傲娇的魔王喵签订契约，操纵可改造的矿枪挖掘资源、对抗亡灵军团，并指挥一群装备千奇百怪武器的“守护猫灵”军团！每局游戏都是挖掘狂潮与血腥战斗的循环——用战利品换取力量，向着深渊最深处进军！

games.name: Portal way
games.description: Portal way is a spatial puzzle about finding a path through portals.

games.name: AFRA Survivor: Adventure
games.description: 这是一款末日后的游戏，故事背景设定在一个被机器和人工智能革命所占领的世界，而其目标是消灭人类。该游戏包含几种模式，包括经典的打斗/砍杀模式和竞技场风格的生存模式。

games.name: Beekeeper Simulator
games.description: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

games.name: Lich Lords
games.description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

games.name: Dice Tiny Town
games.description: 用骰子建造的温馨村庄拼图。每回合 3 颗骰子决定形状、建筑和自然，把它们巧妙地嵌进速写本上的小村庄——温暖却又烧脑的四格骨牌摆放乐趣。用星星调整骰子点数，满足挑剔的访客和来到村里的动物吧。

games.name: DEEP SIX
games.description:
A post-WW1 stealth action game where equipment is scarce, and time of day, weather, sound, movement, and position can all betray your position.
Avoid, distract, knockout or kill as you traverse unique locations, sabotage war machines, save your comrades, and take down elite soldiers.

games.name: Second Stone
games.description: 《第二块石头》是一款丰富多彩的角色扮演动作游戏，打造了两个可以尽情游玩的平行世界。玩家扮演年轻宝藏猎人希林，穿梭于充满生机的光之界及其阴暗诡谲的镜像蔽之界之间。掌握快节奏战斗技巧，并利用元素魔力石铺就力量之路吧。

games.name: Bad House
games.description:
欢迎来到你的新家。前租客留下了一些东西，你可以把它们拿走，但只有一个条件：不要进入地下室。
在《坏房子》这款地牢探索类自动战斗游戏中，探索神秘地下室的众多房间吧。

games.name: Wandering Within
games.description: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival

games.name: Store Life Simulator
games.description: Store Life Simulator is a management simulator where you start with a small store and build your own retail empire. Manage products and prices, restock shelves, serve customers, hire employees, expand your store, and open new locations.

games.name: Chains of Reality
games.description: 《现实之链》是一款以剧情驱动的单人叙事为核心的生存恐怖游戏，你将在其中穿越众多临界环境和平行维度，试图履行你与某人达成的协议——而这个人，你本就不该信任。

games.name: Izzy's Arcade
games.description: Explore an arcade filled with retro games.

games.name: Band Stage
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 在游戏中，你将置身于色彩斑斓的舞台，使用各种乐器演奏出美妙的音乐。这里收录了经典金曲，涵盖流行、摇滚、古典、电子等多种风格，满足你对音乐的所有想象。

games.name: Reflections in Amber
games.description: 《琥珀之光》是一款带有神秘元素的侦探视觉小说。与深陷长期抑郁的侦探维尔杉卡一起调查一桩离奇死亡案件。利用老旧相机发现隐藏的线索和路径，通过你的选择改变案件的进程！

games.name: 霓夏：在你身边
games.description: 和霓夏打字或语音聊天，让她陪你度过工作、游戏和休息的时光。这位 3D AI 桌宠会记住聊天中的点滴，用富有感情的声音、表情和动作回应你。

games.name: The Julian
games.description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

games.name: THE FATUM
games.description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

games.name: Meltdown
games.description:
Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, the newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to power the surrounding city.
Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank's flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.

games.name: Delving The Depths
games.description: 在这款第一人称网格地牢探索游戏中，深入牢房下方的洞穴，一路探索，直到你们的小队抵达地面，逃离囚禁。

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.description: Dominus Gladiatus 是一款残酷的角斗士管理模拟游戏。你将招募、训练并装备角斗士，在与其他 Dominus 竞争的致命160天锦标赛中不断做出生死抉择。

games.name: SpellChain
games.description: 掌控创造你自己法术的力量，通过将魔法力量连接起来。创造召唤风暴的火球、带毒的闪电或召唤陨石的暴风雪。摧毁、获取战利品、制作法术并到达国王面前与他严肃对话。

games.name: 复兴吧温泉镇!
games.description: 《复兴吧温泉镇！》是一款日系乡村模拟经营游戏。你可以扮演暑假游玩的小女孩，也可化身努力振兴小镇的镇长。捕虫、钓鱼、赶海、兼职、做料理、完成村民委托，自由体验悠闲生活与经营乐趣。每个选择都将带来不同的变化，让小镇在你的经营下重拾繁荣，一起复兴温泉镇！

games.name: The Dark West
games.description: 《The Dark West》是一款黑暗秘术西部 ARPG，故事发生在一片濒临死亡、被腐化吞噬的边疆。使用符合时代背景的武器与黑暗魔法，在致命遭遇中奋力求生，并发掘各具特色的强力物品。

games.name: Life Core
games.description: Life Core 是一款探索未知星球的 Roguelite 动作游戏。战斗吧，消灭你的敌人！当你倒下时，在新躯体中释放“核心”的力量。但请记住……系统时刻在注视着你！

games.name: Build A Bot
games.description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Danmaku Unlimited 4 WYVER ULTRA
games.description: Arise Wyver and fight for humanity's future against overwhelming odds in this modern labour of love tribute to classic shoot'em ups!

games.name: CYBER RONIN: Lust
games.description: CYBER RONIN: Lust is an action-adventure game featuring Snake, a mercenary in a cyberpunk world. Defeat enemies in dynamic combat, win the hearts of beautiful women, and uncover the main cause behind the infection of Lust City.

games.name: Drug Dealer 2049
games.description: Drug Dealer 2049 是关于在2D世界中建造一座完全自动化的工厂，生产越来越纯净的高阶合成物质。设计你的生产线，将植物杂交成新品种或炼制合成化合物，将产品出售给客户，并保护自己免受各种威胁。

games.name: 莉娜清洁物语
games.description: 把垃圾清掉、擦净灰尘，再把乱七八糟的房间一点点整理干净，《莉娜清洁物语》是一款轻松休闲的清洁游戏！在整理房间的过程中，你还会发现各种各样的生活物件，从照片、书信到被遗忘的小东西，慢慢拼出藏在每个房间里的故事。自由收拾、随心摆放，享受整理带来的满足感吧！

games.name: 末日下班特快
games.description: 同事变成僵尸，还要逼我加班！一款随从战斗 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏：招募乘客、打出连携，用独特的双面卡牌冲出加班重围。

games.name: Paresis® II
games.description: Paresis® II 将带你踏入一个扭曲而神秘的超自然世界。你将扮演 FBI 探员大卫，重新面对自己的过去，解开充满神秘色彩的谜题，对抗可怕的变异生物，并挑战强大的首领。 努力活下去……如果你能做到。

games.name: Terrible Life Expectancy
games.description: 《Terrible Life Expectancy》是一款融入了“类幸存者”要素的Roguelite俯视角射击游戏。你将迎战如潮水般涌来的荒诞变种怪物，只为取悦幕后那些嗜血的观众。只要你的家族中尚有一人一息尚存……或者哪怕只是还在抽搐，你就能继承先辈留下的所有强化升级。

games.name: Gank
games.description: WISHLIST NOW! A love letter to all fans out there who enjoy DOTA or LoL - a MOBA card game! Explore the lore-filled Eudoria, and pit mainstream fantasy like trolls, banshees, even hydras in a long-awaited showdown. Though designed for quick online matches, we also squeezed in a roguelite campaign!

games.name: Statto Complete Basketball
games.description: Take control of your own basketball world where you are the head coach, general manager, and commissioner!

games.name: 胜利旗帜
games.description: 化身战场指挥官，亲临硝烟弥漫的东线战场！在即时战略视角下运筹帷幄，规划战壕、碉堡与雷区，构筑钢铁防线；亦可瞬间切换到第三人称视角，提起步枪亲自踏上战场，完成关键狙杀，用战斗书写新的英雄史诗！

games.name: Swarm Slasher
games.description: 数以万计的怪物汇聚成永无止境、翻腾不息的虫群，向你席卷而来。在疯狂的战斗中挡下这股生物质的洪流吧！建立防御、歼灭一切会动的东西，并将你的“死亡搅拌机”升级到疯狂的威力。你能否同时抵挡十万名敌人的猛攻？

games.name: 升格灾变 The Primeval
games.description: 《The Primeval: 本源计划》是一款生存恐怖游戏，玩家将作为初来乍到的转校生润酱，在被失控实验体侵入的学校中寻找逃出生天的办法。

games.name: KAUNA
games.description: KAUNA is a Finnish boomer shooter made with 90's retro style graphics.

games.name: BONEBUILDER
games.description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

games.name: War for Bryndor
games.description: A fast-paced strategy game where cards offer you strategy and dice determine your fate! Conquer provinces in thrilling battles in an attempt to unite the land. Manage your resources and outmaneuver opponents in quick matches filled with tactical decisions and shifting frontlines.

games.name: Alexus 2040
games.description:
Relive that pure arcade thrill that you haven't experienced... in a long time!
Load up on unique power-ups to create deadly combinations, unlock new ships with unique abilities, and defeat numerous bosses along the way.

games.name: Extreme Cleaning Simulator
games.description: Extreme Cleaning Simulator is a realistic game where you must restore order to the most neglected and disgustingly filthy homes. Get rid of mountains of trash, scrub walls stained with who-knows-what, and tackle the nightmare that is the toilet!

games.name: Underpacked!
games.description: Welcome to the galaxy´s biggest delivery company! Dive into a space odyssey as a delivery crew, alone or with your comrades. Dodge threats, survive the harsh realities of labor exploitation and deliver packages. Prove you’re the best employees in the universe!

games.name: Crave New World
games.description: Crave New World is a strategy sim about building an addictive drink. Buy compounds, rebuild the formula, collect Thirst from demand, open routes country by country, and turn consumers into addicts before Heat brings the operation down.

games.name: 织咒师（spellloom）
games.description: 《织咒师》（Spellloom）是一款具有深度咒法构筑系统的roguelike弹幕地牢探索游戏。扮演受雇于玩世不恭的地牢建筑师的地牢质检员，勇闯他打造的混乱世界。准备好在不断变化的虚空世界中，迎接激烈的战斗、富有创意的咒法工艺，以及充满危险的探索吧。

games.name: 海蒂的馈赠：大山在呼唤
games.description:
《Heidi’s Legacy 》是一款温暖的叙事模拟游戏，你将在这里照料山羊、制作山野手作，并帮
助村民们重筑生活。灵感源自经典《海蒂》系列，体验一段宁静的田园牧歌，颂扬自然、
治愈、社区与自我成长。

games.name: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
games.description: 一款设定在崩塌科幻噩梦中的残酷动作游戏。对抗生物机械变种体，穿越不断变化的地貌，找回失落心智的碎片，逐步深入一个扭曲的后末日世界。

games.name: Discard
games.description:
Discard 是一款受老派电影风格平台游戏启发的科幻解谜2D平台游戏。

你必须解决各种难题，才能在这个危险星球上生存下去。

games.name: Trash Party
games.description: Online co-op party game for up to 4 players. Drive a garbage truck through a colorful cartoon city, hang off the back, and sort recyclable, organic and glass into the right compartment. The faster your crew cleans every block, the more stars you earn.

games.name: 骑士盘骑士
games.description: 《骑士盘骑士》是一款节奏紧张的三消型动作Roguelite游戏。在网格状的战场上实时考验你的反应速度与协调能力：闪避攻击、组合地块为武器充能，并寻找最佳时机发起进攻。

games.name: Alchemy Duel
games.description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

games.name: Plush Rangers
games.description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

games.name: Chaos Coin
games.description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Plan your turns to shove, evade, and attack your foes in tactical lane-based combat. Upgrade coins with new faces unique to every character to build complex combos. The forces of Chaos are coming…so use your heads (and tails)!

games.name: 炼金大亨
games.description: 《炼金大亨》是一款以药水酿造与店铺经营为核心的卡牌模拟经营游戏。在这里，你需要培育魔法原料、酿造神奇药水、随时准备承接领主们的庞大订单，并不断升级、扩张你的事业！是时候开工了，掌柜，挽起你的袖子，去为国王建立起更庞大的魔药帝国吧！

games.name: 黑夜灵遇
games.description: 深入宁静的小村庄——菊峰岭，揭开隐藏其中的秘密！原本与网恋对象奔现的浪漫之旅逐渐演变成一场神秘冒险——史诗般的战斗、古怪的同伴，还有黑色幽默交织其中。赢得她的芳心，解开重重谜团，还得保护好你的猫——查理！

games.name: Football Champions
games.description: Create your player, choose your role, and compete in intense 3v3 football matches where unique abilities and teamwork define every victory. Climb the leagues and become a Football Champion.

games.name: 万象之环
games.description: 《万象之环》是一款无限流、多周目、策略角色扮演游戏。组建一支永劫者小队，在不断的轮回冒险中体验风格迥异的世界观中的故事——战斗、交互、选择、解决事件……养成你的队伍，踏入终末的决战，成为不朽的超脱者。

games.name: Clear the Snow
games.description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

games.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
games.description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

games.name: 星神艾西亚
games.description: 「在您的星球化为灰烬之前，请以这柄剑保护自己吧。」星神艾西亚是 2D 横向卷轴平台动作游戏。挥舞星神之剑，在四个地区之间游走。收集卡片和技能，对抗强大的侵略者！

games.name: Prime World Legends
games.description: Prime World Legends is a free online game in RPG / MOBA genre with a unique universe where tactical session battles, castle management, and hero development are mixed together. Gather your collection of talents, build an army of invincible heroes and become the champion!

games.name: Spirit of Diwata
games.description: Sana en lugar de pelear. Un relajante JRPG cooperativo, local o en línea, ambientado en un mundo de fantasía asiática donde tocas instrumentos y esquivas a seres furiosos que te atacan mientras tratas de calmarlos. Cada ser es único y cada amistad crea lazos para traer esperanza al mundo.

games.name: 极私密关系
games.description: 在同一个故事舞台，你的抉择会催生出不一样的羁绊。依托原创剧本，搭配 AI 自由对话与个性化选择，与三位女主角一同，编织独属于你的故事。这是一款恋爱关系模拟游戏。

games.name: Drunkonauts
games.description: Drunkonauts 是一款混乱欢乐的多人派对游戏，特色是爆笑的基于物理的战斗、疯狂的武器以及喷气背包！在本地或在线对战中与好友厮杀，利用不可预测的移动与离谱的攻势把对手打飞，设法留在地图上、避开危险陷阱，夺取胜利！

games.name: Et le grain mourut
games.description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

games.name: The Witch's Spooky Mansion
games.description: The Witch's Spooky Mansion is a unique blend of escape-room, hidden object, and puzzle genres, wrapped in an original hand-drawn art style. Explore every room, find the key items, and give the witch an intellectual challenge!

games.name: Ridiculous Space Battles
games.description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

games.name: Ultimate Lemon Basket
games.description:
🍋 A Speed-Running platformer where you can’t drop any lemons.🍋
Between you and the goal are Ghosts, Cows, Acid Rain Clouds, Monster Trucks, Hopes, Dreams and other things AS WELL!!
There are leaderboards!

games.name: Olympus Rangers
games.description: 欢迎来到终极战斗模拟器，在这里你可以创建、管理并在多种战斗模式中面对数十个对手。你能成为冠军吗？抛弃失去战斗能力的队友？或者成为全球在线对战的最强者？挑战奥林匹斯！

games.name: Hope in the City
games.description: 17 岁的宋希望原本以为高考才是她最大的烦恼……直到她回到家，发现家里一片狼藉，父母也不知所踪。以画家的视角展开调查，将速写转化为关键线索；随着一个个谜团被解开，她家庭背后的秘密也变得愈发离奇与阴暗。

games.name: Gagged Love: My MILF Neighbor
games.description: 在这篇时长20-30分钟的短篇视觉小说中，你的性感熟女邻居尤娅恳求你帮忙修理水槽。这或许是你终于能和这位美丽动人、刚刚离婚的女人发生关系的机会。更棒的是，你终于能看到她嘴巴被胶带封住的样子了……她很容易兴奋……

games.name: Fool's Trigger
games.description: 欢迎来到以生命为赌注的牌桌。Fool’s Trigger 将俄罗斯轮盘与 6 人纸牌游戏融为一体，让你神经紧绷。为左轮手枪装弹、操控手牌、押上性命，冒险看看今天谁的运气最差。

games.name: Increminer
games.description: Drill fast and keep your oxygen topped up while unleashing wild weapons in a frantic arcade bullet heaven! Crush swarms with careful cave-ins, grab gems for upgrades, and fight your way down to The Core.

games.name: Anunnaki & The Kingdom of Goku
games.description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow insanely powerful with spells + guns! Summon armies, fortify bases, level up, dash around enemies effortlessly, unlock characters + upgrade to create unique and wild builds as you fend off swarms of monstrosities in this surreal RTS-TPS hybrid

games.name: SOUL BACON
games.description: SOULBACON is a 3D pig-based bullet heaven game with player guided world generation and snowballing builds. Kill baddies, farm missions and unlock an ever expanding frontier of unique upgrades, enemies, and replayable worlds.

games.name: 喜鹊先生贪心卡牌
games.description: 这是一款超现实企业惊悚风的卡牌构筑游戏。你将为金钱赌上性命，避开能让你丧命的杰瑞牌，靠着“极致的协同效应”在喜鹊先生的职场噩梦中攀登向上的阶梯。

games.name: Cleared For Impact
games.description: An atmospheric side-scrolling flight game about descending into a dead alien world. Thread a drifting ship through twisting caves, toxic rivers and abandoned mechs to rescue your crew.

games.name: Aberrate Inc.
games.description: Guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

games.name: Police Stories 2
games.description:
遵守法律。
保护无辜。
在Police Stories 2 这款俯视角硬核战术射击游戏中，你将指挥城市最危险的辖区。逮捕是核心目标，武力是最后手段，而每个选择都将引发后果。

games.name: Kung Fu Addiction
games.description: 一款以预判为核心的自动战斗 RPG。预测敌人的行动，规划英雄的成长路线，并借助远古战士的灵魂以全新的格斗风格重生，在多种战斗模式中迎接不断升级的挑战。

games.name: Apprentice of Darkness
games.description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

games.name: Midnight Souvenirs
games.description:
Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist!
Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.

games.name: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach
games.description: 利用物理效果和你那辆小面包车，把散落各处的 1,000 多件物品放回它们该在的地方。扔起来！整理好！打扫干净！帮你的阿姨收拾这个烂摊子吧！哦，别忘了你阿姨那只脾气暴躁的鸡，它可没什么心情帮忙。

games.name: Patient Zero: Plague Idle
games.description: Patient Zero: Plague Idle 是一款以自动推进和增量成长为核心的疫情爆发构建游戏，你将通过变异树、全球感染、长期升级和解锁新病原体来创造完美的病原体。把世界变成你的实验室。

games.name: Chesstro
games.description: Enter Chesstro, the digital roguelite chess empire ruled by TRO. Engage in intense duels against the AI and fight in hopes of one day escaping the digital prison.

games.name: Cinderline
games.description: Drive the Cinderline as an anthropomorphic bird, exploring strange towns in an aging system. Gather ingredients to create the last S’MORE and deliver its delight to the Heart that keeps the system alive.

games.name: Tamara
games.description: Tamara is a Dungeon Crawler with elements of Survival Horror in a Cyberpunk-Fantasy Setting focused on combat, exploration and resource management.

games.name: The Mystery of Oak Island
games.description: 一款引人入胜的 point-and-click 冒险游戏，灵感来源于加拿大新斯科舍省奥克岛的真实寻宝事件。揭开一张由谋杀、神秘和被遗忘历史交织而成的网。有些秘密，最好永远尘封。

games.name: Astrocraft
games.description: 在空间站上经营属于你自己的商店：为货架补货，接待太空旅客，从孤身一人的矿工成长为太空大亨。开采小行星，用机器制造商品，雇佣一支机器人团队，建立前哨站，再驾驶自己的飞船飞向星辰，可以独自游玩，也可以最多四人联机合作。

games.name: 渊舟蚀影 | DREADMOOR
games.description: 《DREADMOOR》是一款黑暗风格的第一人称钓鱼冒险游戏，以一个因昔日灾难而被淹没、逐渐腐朽的世界为背景。在浑浊的水域垂钓，升级你的船只，制作生存装备，与潜伏在水下和陆地上的可怖怪物战斗。

games.name: Eye of Khaos
games.description: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

games.name: Starfort
games.description: Defend your empire in a sci-fi tower defense game. Build deadly combinations of railguns, lasers, gravity wells, drones, and cannons across three maps, 50 levels per map, and four difficulty modes.

games.name: Shelf Life 2
games.description: Shelf Life 2 is an action fps set in a world where the global elite are struggling to maintain a united front, after a financiers suspicious death you set out to protect your trillionaire patron from exposure. Traveling to more varied locations and wielding newer weirder weapons, business continues.

games.name: CastleMiner Z : Resurrection
games.description: The cult survival shooter returns. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, CastleMiner Z: Resurrection brings next-gen visuals, brutal combat, and infinite worlds to explore. Mine, craft, build, and survive against the undead, dragons, and the deadly unknown.

games.name: 无相刀
games.description: 《无相刀》是一款以极致操作为核心的国风动作游戏，回归刀锋对决的纯粹本质。手持长刀，于肃杀江湖中迎战尸潮，以精准闪避与轻重连击斩开生路，在刀光血影间淬炼“人刀合一”的凌厉快感。独特的褪色水墨风格将冷冽兵锋与黑血飞溅凝为暴力画卷，辅以逐帧调校的丝滑动画，让每一次斩杀迸发张力。

games.name: 要塞vs要塞
games.description: 歼星巨炮零距离开火，超武装要塞跃迁对撞！孤悬太空，用流水线武装你的要塞，精巧布局每一处武装与组件,静待下一场死斗。敌方要塞骤然跃迁而来，巨炮齐射，激光撕裂星海，装甲层层崩裂。当炮火归于沉寂，两座钢铁堡垒轰然相撞，唯有胜者可以继续这场轮回死斗。

games.name: DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike
games.description:
扮演一位别具一格的“海盗”矮人，驾驶改装过的矿车驶入矿井深处吧！
在融合了弹珠台、柏青哥和泡泡射击元素的独特战斗中击败敌人，收集改变玩法的弹珠和强化道具，每一次冒险都将焕然一新！

games.name: Geritmia
games.description: An incremental game where you mine, fight and grow stronger while the World Eater devours everything behind you faster and faster.

games.name: Am I The Asshole?
games.description: Step into the role of a judge, solve the pettiest online drama packed with quirky characters and offbeat humor. A satirical take on internet culture.

games.name: CivRise
games.description: 在这款战略放置游戏中打造你的文明：发展知识、建造奇观、指挥军队并招募历史伟人，留下永恒遗产。

games.name: 微风牧语
games.description: 在一座荒废的农场开启新生活。结识形形色色的奇幻居民——精灵、兽人、恶魔、人鱼、幽魂，以及更多！重建农场，邂逅爱情，养育魔法生物，探索地牢，并揭开世界树日渐枯萎的秘密。

games.name: 下一站青城
games.description: “下一站青城”是白玉京工作室的第三代单机产品，也是第一款国风神话开放世界游戏！除开传统开放世界玩法内容外，在这个无缝大世界里：上有三门“剑仙出入青冥、儒者齐家治国、佛陀行走人间”，下有偏门九流“问卜、炼尸、驭鬼、养蛊、化妖、机关、寻龙点穴、踏罡布阵、摆坛起符”等等。

games.name: Hunter's Hand
games.description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every clue you uncover wakes the thing hunting you. Build a lethal deck across branching paths, weather corrupting biomes, and raise the Threat - then discover how much of an Ancient's attention you can survive.

games.name: VICIOUS CIRCLE
games.description: Spiral into madness.

games.name: El Paso, Elsewhere 2
games.description: 更多木桩。更多枪火。更多慢动作。在这款人气第三人称射击游戏的续作中，詹姆斯·萨维奇强势回归。逃出虚空。迎战来自神话、历史与想象的怪物。救赎自己。

games.name: 荒野雄心 / Wyldheart
games.description: 在这款以乡村奇幻世界为背景的合作动作角色扮演游戏中，你将开启一场场小规模战役。一切从无到有，自由构建角色，你可以调查传闻，探索奇异废墟，在日渐衰落的凯尔温王国中绝境求生。

games.name: Eden Protocol
games.description: 网络色情：欲望之城是一部令人兴奋的视觉小说，带有 JRPG 战斗系统！在赛博朋克世界中经历错综复杂的侦探故事，组建一支美丽的女孩团队，揭露邪恶的公司并赢得同伴的心。

games.name: Heavy in the Hand
games.description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

games.name: 《星际清理公司》 (Cleaner Company)
games.description: 星际清洁员们，准备好你们的拖把！《星际清理公司》 (Cleaner Company) 是一款支持1-4名玩家的血腥清洁模拟游戏。在银河系中穿梭，清理废弃空间站、外星前哨站以及被怪物占据的餐厅……而第一批清洁对象，就是你列位前辈的尸体。

games.name: Blood Sword
games.description: An ancient evil returns. A sword lost to legend. A party bound by fate. Forge your legacy in a story-rich RPG of turn-based combat and branching choices, inspired by the classic Blood Sword saga.

games.name: HAVKER-MAN X
games.description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

games.name: AFTER 9PM
games.description: 晚上9点后是一个游戏，现实和噩梦合并成一个。 你父母把你一个人留在家里。 太晚了 每次他们离开，你都会做奇怪的噩梦。 他们每次都变得越来越真实。 现在你不确定这是不是一个梦？

games.name: 灵能中介所
games.description: 《灵能中介所》是一款动漫风格的剧情向冒险游戏。玩家将扮演一对自称“灵能中介”的捉鬼专家，接受各类灵异委托。这对吵吵闹闹的鬼马搭档，运用找鬼、招魂、除灵、驱邪全套把式，解决江城中一个个由鬼魂引发的灵异案件。

games.name: Directive: Intercept
games.description: Protect Earth's last cities from an alien fleet in fast-paced aerial combat. Upgrade and customize your aircraft to dominate the skies.

games.name: Tavern Tycoon: Brew & Brawl
games.description: Run and defend your own fantasy tavern in this cozy simulation brawler. Manage staff, serve adventurers, and customize your tavern’s layout, then fight off rowdy goblins and bandits with your companion in chaotic barroom brawls.

games.name: Tiny Shop: make it cozy
games.description: 远离喧嚣，把开一个温馨小店的梦想变为现实！自由打造与装饰，让来访者一见倾心。尽情发挥想象力，营造美丽又充满吸引力的空间，让人们一次次流连忘返。

games.name: 甘党侍
games.description: AMATO SAMURAI is an online multiplayer shooting-style battle action game for up to four players. Sweet treats appear one after another—first come, first served! Slice through them faster than your rivals to create the most luxurious parfait! But watch out for the not-so-sweet surprises!

games.name: Zombie Police ～凛冽盛夏的新年～
games.description: “陋习 VS 僵尸＝？？？”在盛夏却冰封的陋习村，追查VTuber直播中发生的惨剧。通过“僵尸潜入”进入证人的内心，用“调查笔记”串联收集到的证言，跟随不搭调的刑警搭档揭开真相——喜剧推理冒险系列最新作！

games.name: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
games.description: 独自或与最多 6 名玩家合作经营海滨冰淇淋店。制作冰淇淋、服务各种难以预料的顾客、赚钱并解锁新设备。扩建并自定义你的店铺，迎接一天比一天更混乱的经营生活。

games.name: Sombie
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

games.name: 办公室的窥视
games.description: 你被特别招募到一间知名但神秘的大公司“万见”，才发现自己被赋予了不为人知的工作。四处搜集“关键字”，挖掘同事的秘密，利用权力与他们建立“特殊”的关系吧！

games.name: Netherwake
games.description: 全球紧急警报要求所有人留在室内，绝不要进入迷雾。当你的爱犬跑进森林后，你不得不追上去，并逐渐发现山腹深处隐藏着可怕的秘密。探索环境、隐藏行踪、解决谜题，在危险的异常体中生存下来并寻找逃生之路。

games.name: Time Survivor
games.description:
动作竞技场：增量模式，你必须在生命能量不断流失的同时，与时间本身抗争，努力生存下去。躲避并击杀敌人，收集资源并通过庞大的技能树提升自身实力，升级属性并解锁强大技能。
你能坚持多久？

games.name: Battle Birds
games.description: Battle Birds is a chaotic 1–4 player party game where you flap, dash, and blast through wild arenas packed with deadly hazards and explosive power-ups. Outmaneuver friends or CPU opponents in hilarious local matches filled with split-second dodges and  frantic KOs.

games.name: Wildseed
games.description: Wildseed is a relaxing game where you grow plants and build your garden into a haven for cute animals. Keep your animals happy and your plants healthy, find rare variants, and discover the ancient secrets your garden holds - one seed at a time.

games.name: Don't Mind the Robots
games.description: 在这款策略塔防游戏中，建造致命迷宫，智取失控的人工智能。灵活调整防御布局，善用瞄准参数，并激活强力增益效果，以抵御愈发复杂的机器人浪潮。

games.name: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler
games.description: 《Jaden Industries》是一款轻松舒适的工厂建造解谜游戏，玩家将在浮空岛屿上管理精巧的合成产业链。作为探险工程师，你将探索宁静的群岛，配置生产流程，精炼资源，并打造完美的自动化效率。

games.name: 鹈鹕守卫
games.description: 《鹈鹕守卫》是一款治愈系的基地营造塔防策略游戏，暗雾吞噬了这个世界，你是世上最后一个鹈鹕。围绕灯塔建设小镇，保卫小镇，营救失落的动物乡亲，让群星回归宇宙。

games.name: Magus Slayer
games.description: Steal spells from defeated magi and choose the order they fire in. Pull enemies into a black hole, then erupt swords from its centre—or reverse the order for a different build. Return to the tavern to research new spell forms and prepare your next descent.

games.name: Soul Containers
games.description: Your life collapsed in a single day. Your fiancée vanished, and the only clue is a strange game you bought at a flea market. It was the biggest mistake of your life. A glitch-ridden game, yet it holds more than code - whispers, traces of a presence... and a truth you'd rather not have uncovered.

games.name: Neighborhood Watchers
games.description: In Neighborhood Watchers, you fish, farm, and decorate with friends, then raid haunted houses to recover lost memories and rescue the spirit children who once called this sleepy suburb home.

games.name: Biocybernetic Trap
games.description:
Biocybernetic Trap — an interactive cyberpunk detective.
You are given the quantum diary of a long-dead detective, where reality fractures into parallel versions of the investigation.

games.name: High Tide
games.description: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

games.name: Warlocks Nexus
games.description: In Warlocks Nexus, your medieval realm faces an existential threat: an invasion from beyond. This isn't just about survival; it's about adaptation. Explore a fully destructible, voxel world, scavenge for resources, and craft your way through  incursions.

games.name: CONTAMINANT
games.description: 《污染物》是一款设定于另类后苏联现实的第三人称动作恐怖游戏。你将扮演玛丽亚，被困在祖父阴森的工厂中，通过残酷的战斗、诡异的谜题以及充满异形生物的超现实领域，逐步揭开家族的秘密。

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.description: 《Warhammer Survivors》是由《Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun》开发者打造的暗黑风逆弹幕射击幸存者类游戏。游戏中有超过40位来自《战锤40,000》和《战锤：西格玛时代》宇宙的角色供你选择，尽情消灭那些捍卫死亡与毁灭的敌人吧。

games.name: Audiospeed
games.description: 《AudioSpeed》是一款以飞船高速竞速为核心的音频游戏，视障玩家也能完全游玩。在遥远的未来，车手驾驶的不是赛车，而是在轨道赛道上飞驰的星舰。

games.name: Dragon Fields
games.description: 在这款温馨惬意的游戏中享受简单生活：种植作物、钓鱼、演奏音乐、培育并变异巨龙，还能自定义你的角色！

games.name: Gun Garden
games.description: Gun Garden is a dungeon crawler top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Explore rooms, find gear, fight enemies, and level up your stats as you progress through the various floors, attempting to find what lies at the end of the Gun Garden.

games.name: Iona's Island
games.description: 巨大なウミガメの背中に乗って、活気あふれる島の楽園を取り戻そう！「レシェン・アイオナ」となり、古代の魔法を使って大地を癒やし、島民たちと親しくなって彼らのクエストを手助けしよう。自分だけの魅力的なサンドボックススタイルの聖域を作り上げよう。心地よいローファイな雰囲気の中で、秘密を解き明かし、世界を再構築していこう。

games.name: Killing Things With Your Friends
games.description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

games.name: 暗黑符文：禁忌之源
games.description: 《暗黑符文：禁忌之源》一款深度硬核的ARPG，百变的技能符文系统与经典的符文之语，是时候开启你的刷宝传奇了！每一场战斗都可能掉落改变命运的战利品，每一次符文组合都能创造新的传说。你，准备好迎接挑战了吗？

games.name: Temple of Glyphs
games.description: 《符文神庙》（Temple of Glyphs）是一款逻辑解谜游戏，有着一个又一个用未知符号描述规则的谜题，解开这些谜题，探索这座神庙。

games.name: 永泉
games.description: 在夜深人静之时探索一座神秘的温泉山庄，邂逅其他被吸引至此地的迷失灵魂。

games.name: Shrine Protectors
games.description: 卡组构筑塔防与 Rogue-lite RTS 策略相结合。率领你的军队，粉碎一波又一波的敌人，并解锁强力升级和被动法术。在这款残酷激烈的 Bullet Heaven 中，将卡组构筑策略与战术军队管理融为一体。

games.name: Gendo The Gatherer
games.description: 享受惬意的虚拟生活，扮演元渡在充满不同地形的丰富世界中探索、烹饪。搜集充足的食材，返回温馨的家园为村民们准备食物。成为元渡并体验他的乡村生活吧

games.name: Mortuus
games.description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

games.name: Clowntown
games.description: 一款适合2-8人联机的搞怪派对冒险游戏。和朋友一起联手或者相互使绊子，在精心设计的动作解谜与不断变化的小游戏中一路闯关。你准备好一起欢笑、一起尖叫和一起大按喇叭了吗？

games.name: Totally Nutz: An 80s Adventure
games.description: 在这款手绘隐藏物品解谜冒险游戏中重返 80 年代，讲述一家松鼠追逐大梦想的故事。加入 Nutz 一家，跟随他们从宁静的郊区家园前往大城市，寻找传奇的 Acorn Games。

games.name: Kibo and the Cursed Lands
games.description: Kibo and the Cursed Lands is an enchanting, single-player action RPG set in the land of Thalmyra. Play as Kibo the desperate wanderer and traverse obstacles, fight through enemies and wield unique, elemental weapons in order to find a cure for this ever-growing threat.

games.name: DUMMY HOUSE
games.description: 第一人称心理恐怖与生存体验。利用摄像机和声音在完全黑暗中识别并击退模仿人类的敌人，揭开令人不安的秘密，在拥有多重结局和高重玩性的工业设施中直面愈发紧张的夜晚。

games.name: 勇者斗恶龙怪物仙境4 枯木国的碧安卡与芙萝拉
games.description:
本作是一款RPG，玩家可将“勇者斗恶龙”系列中登场的各种怪物纳为伙伴，并进行培育与配种，体验怪物之间魄力十足的对战。
本作中，两位少女──碧安卡与芙萝拉将成为能与怪物心灵相通的“怪物大师”，并展开全新的冒险旅程。

games.name: 水浒：豪杰风云传
games.description:
《水浒：豪杰风云传》

  这是一款以水浒为背景的2d沙盒arpg生存游戏，玩家可以扮演好汉或者选择自建角色，在北宋宣和年间生存冒险，经商，做官，入伙，做个手艺人，自立为山大王，走镖等等。

 深度还原水浒原著，玩家将会体会生存的艰难与面对生存做出的抉择，剧情会随着时间变化，但是也有改变角色命运的机会。游戏的完善方向是尽可能自由，玩法尽可能丰富，三教九流皆有生存之道。

 并会从原著细枝末节完善好汉的生活，以及水浒中的谜题，比如西门庆的药材生意与吕方的剧情，仗义青年史进面对饥荒的抉择，谁射死了晁盖，如果有人暗杀了放走的高俅梁山会走向何方，如何梁山对战金国会有怎样的传奇战斗，等等

games.name: Hop's Awakening!
games.description: Blast through enemy invaders in colorful 2D pixel art!

games.name: Night At The Mall
games.description: 《Night At The Mall》是一款第一人称叙事驱动的心理恐怖游戏。你将在一个拒绝沉寂的废弃购物中心里值夜班。

games.name: Boom Cube
games.description:
🧊 这不是传统俄罗斯方块。
原创 3D 俄罗斯方块，三轴方块切换形态，立体空间内凑满行列触发消除，搭配炫丽爆炸特效与多场景节奏关卡，体验全新方块消除爽感。

games.name: Sugar Sling Showdown
games.description: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

games.name: Mulerun – Retro Bootlegger Simulator
games.description: Build a moonshine empire in the 1980s. Brew, bottle, deliver, and protect your cargo as you grow from a dusty village to Mulerun City. Outsmart your ankle monitor, take risky deals, and smuggle by land, sea, and air while caught between the CIA and the cartel. Solo or 4-player co-op.

games.name: Knight life tavern
games.description: Cook and brew endlessly, desperately trying to serve a never ending stream of customers with a temper. The medieval knight is hard to please and very vocal about his disdain for goblins and the like. Make sure everyone enjoys eachother's company, and kick the trouble makers through the front door!

games.name: Merchant Miles
games.description: 追踪传闻，洞察市场，抢在竞争对手之前行动。低价进货、高价卖出，经营自己的摊位，与顾客讨价还价，适应不断变化的法律，并根据每天的经营结果规划下一条商路。

games.name: Mount Lomyst
games.description: Mount Lomyst is a 2D action game about climbing to the summit of Mount Lomyst, using a grappling hook and wall climbing — without jumping.

games.name: Senior Survival Club
games.description: 在一个僵尸末日降临的世界，一位奶奶为了寻找孙子，拿起了电锯。这是一个生存动作游戏，你将消灭缓慢但顽固的僵尸，收集武器和装备，通过锻炼来强化自己。在日益强大的僵尸群中，你将一路前行，再次找回年轻时的力量。

games.name: FED Chairman
games.description: Lead the U.S. economy: adjust rates, deploy QE/QT, and balance inflation with employment in this macro-strategy sim.

games.name: Precious Feather
games.description: 猎取完美的羽毛。喂饱家中等候之物。能睡就睡吧。房租终将到期。

games.name: Exodus Core
games.description: 《Exodus Core》是一款高难度回合制战术游戏，拥有黑暗科幻末日氛围。操控三台搭载士兵数字化人格的巨型机甲，对抗来自黑暗、拥有思维的怪物虫群。你能在这场绝望的战斗中取胜吗？

games.name: NuTREEnts
games.description: NuTREEnts is a strategic tower defense roguelike about growing and expanding your forest. Plant saplings, fend off bugs, and explore a desolate planet while you grow a mighty colony of trees!

games.name: 梦：迷乱之渊
games.description: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

games.name: 星海自走牌
games.description: 《星海自走牌》是一款近未来幻想风的即时制策略卡牌对战游戏，包含单双人PVP对战、创造模式、多人组队PVE、轮抽模式几大玩法。玩家将构筑30张牌的卡组，合理地打出各种手牌，在即时战斗与反制博弈中，最终击败对手获得游戏胜利！玩家还可以使用独特的AI捏卡功能创造自己的卡牌，用于特定模式中对战。

games.name: 天命对决
games.description: 《天命对决》是一款类怪物火车的肉鸽卡牌游戏，你将操作来自不同国家和时代的英雄人物，构筑你的卡组与英雄队伍，挑战重重魔物关卡，成为最强的天命者！

games.name: The Rift Machine
games.description: The Rift Machine is an incremental game where you extract resources from inter-dimensional anomalies. Build modular defenses, research advanced technology, automate complex systems, and scale your operation into an unstoppable anomaly-harvesting engine.

games.name: Regression
games.description: 在这款第一人称心理恐怖游戏中，你将前往前女友童年的旧居，探望正处于精神崩溃中的她。通过寻找线索、与诡异的人物交谈并解开谜题，一步步揭开这场危机背后的真相。当她的梦魇化为现实，请随时做好逃跑与躲藏的准备。

games.name: ..kill ´em all
games.description: A dark psychological FPS that pulls the protagonist through a hostile industrial maze of close-quarters combat and stalking patrols, guided by an AI whose influence blurs the lines between help, manipulation, and truth.

games.name: INSOMNIC
games.description: Insomnia is a prison built by your own mind. Set in the early 2000s within the walls of a decaying apartment, you struggle to hide from a killer terrorizing the city. But as sleep fades, reality turns into a nightmare, and the line between victim and predator begins to blur.

games.name: Farm & Drive
games.description: Farm trucks race around one fenced farm, cut crops and ram each other to steal the loot. Drive out a gate before the clock runs out to cash in. Up to 4 players in 4 teams, or play Solo against AI rivals. The team that earns the most money wins.

games.name: God Is Not Here
games.description: “我的神，我的神……为什么离弃我？”——诗篇 22:1。耶稣基督临死前在十字架上所说的话。

games.name: Dwarf Boozter
games.description:
Return Dwarven ale legacy 
Brawler-action with roguelite elements about Dwarf adventures through fantasy taverns. Loot, fight and upgrade.

games.name: 来都来了，下去吧你！
games.description: 勇者！前方是百层深渊。这是一款平台动作游戏，不断往下跳，躲避怪物攻击，利用特殊平台的能力反击消灭怪物。纯粹的勇者，纯粹的冒险，纯粹的目的，干掉100层不同的怪物！

games.name: DEAD SPIN
games.description: 在这款黑暗风格的 Roguelite 牌组构筑游戏中，赌上运气，闯过一座致命的废弃赌场。发掘离谱联动，在分数上压过囚禁你的人，为自由转动转轮。

games.name: Multiworlds
games.description: A world torn apart by one mistake, help pull it back into one. A 2D puzzle game where you control multiple player remnants in parallel, jump between dimensions and avoid obstacles to put back the world together.

games.name: Largitas: Fragments of War
games.description: A 2D top-down survival shooter set in a world where most of humanity has disappeared. Explore and scavenge a dangerous planet with the aid of your mechanized Aether Beast. Upgrade and customize your equipment, explore mysterious ruins, and interact with the people and factions on the planet.

games.name: DING DONG PITCH
games.description: Ding Dong Pitch is holiday horror at your doorstep. Sound is deadly, and perfect pitch is your only defense. Unsettling carolers sing while you must match their notes to keep them from breaking in.

games.name: 渔乐圈
games.description:
工作学习时，你的鱼塘正自动运转：鱼竿挂机钓鱼，员工打理渔场，顾客岸边垂钓。
慢慢扩建渔场，从钓台到茶座，雇人管理、研究鱼饵引稀鱼。偶尔点开，或许能撞见锦鲤上钩，员工在换水。
经营越用心，渔场越热闹，成你屏幕里的悠闲小天地 —— 随时来 “摸鱼” 呀。

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
games.description: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

games.name: Spartan One
games.description: Zeus offers you an empire of your own. All you have to do is walk out of his arena alive.

games.name: TCG卡牌收藏：整理卡牌吧!
games.description: 整理并修复一套由 3,200 张 TCG 卡牌组成的特别收藏。逐张清洁卡牌，让它们重现真正的光彩。将卡牌配对并分类到十六个主题系列中。把一间混乱不堪的房间重新变成收藏家的展示馆。

games.name: Apollyon
games.description: 1979. P.L.U.T.O keeps sending your team of researchers back through G.A.T.E into the backrooms for deeper expeditions, but they are never happy with the lengths you go to. Nearest exit gets your team back safe. Only the deepest exit will suffice.

games.name: DRAGUN
games.description: Run-and-gun roguelike about shooting through an army of dragons and their shadowy organization with an array of weapons, upgrades, and characters in randomized stage layouts.

games.name: Neo Tokyo Rush
games.description: Forgive me father, for I have synthed... Buckle up, son! Slam the pedal to the metal and show who is the king of the neon streets in Neo Tokyo Rush, the ultimate synthwave retro arcade racing experience!

games.name: Lost Arsenal
games.description: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

games.name: 炼血魔瓶
games.description: FLASK 是一款自动战斗肉鸽游戏，讲述炼金术士们在新开拓地的贪婪冒险。打造势不可挡的炼金人偶，与变异商人讨价还价，屠戮成群的怪物，收割珍贵的血液。是时候血赚一笔了！

games.name: The Universe of Death
games.description: Hand-drawn isometric Diablo style rogue like with Elden Ring style controls, and it's also a  tower defense. Level up in run to try new skills and builds, level up between runs to increase your stats to begin each run stronger. Acquire loot and give old loot to your towers and mercenaries.

games.name: ROOTKIT://死 (ROOTKIT PROTOCOL DEATH)
games.description: Cyberpunk extraction runner with bhop movement. Speed determines whether enemies can hit you. Race your own ghost through gauntlet levels, slide under barriers, chain crouch-bhops on ramps, and extract before the system catches up.

games.name: PROJECT: Melee Only
games.description: 扮演一名 Android，战斗并挑战尽可能高的关卡。保留你的等级和 EXP，再次开始并变得更强。揭开你存在的秘密，以及你前世的记忆。

games.name: GRINDWORM
games.description: 这是一款短篇恐怖游戏：你被埋在坍塌的地下矿井中，而你唯一的生存希望是一台老旧的采矿机。

games.name: The Bagman
games.description: 《The Bagman》是一款真正的16位复古点击 / 生存恐怖游戏，融入了潜行元素、可操控的NPC机制，还有大量血浆四溅的杀戮场景！随着时间和事件的持续推进，你的任何一个朋友都可能死去。有多条路线可供选择，由此衍生出不同的结局。你能在游戏中幸存下来吗？

games.name: Champions of Sparta
games.description:
《斯巴达侦察兵》是一款动作角色扮演游戏，古代帝国的荣耀等待着你。
扮演传说中的斯巴达侦察兵奥雷利奥斯，面对强大的敌人，揭开隐藏的真相，带领斯巴达走向命中注定的胜利。

games.name: I Made This Game in 1 Year - without AI
games.description:
A fast-paced roguelike with 3 unique classes, 2 gameplay modes, meta progression. 
Harvest resources, fight hordes of monsters, unlock powerful skills, face unique bosses, and survive escalating enemy spawns in an endlessly replayable world.

games.name: 托托的奇幻之旅
games.description: 《托托之旅》是一款受《绿野仙踪》世界启发的温馨冒险游戏。你将扮演勇敢的小狗托托，在一场神秘的龙卷风后迷失于魔法世界。探索被施了魔法的土地，遇见奇特的生物，并在寻找回家之路的过程中解开环境谜题。

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.description: 接手一座破败的英伦酒店，白天修缮，晚上驱鬼。陪伴你的是毒舌的黑猫、话痨的工具，还有盘根错节的诡异谜团。一场你前所未见的悬疑冒险音乐剧，即将开场。当周遭的一切开始分崩离析时，你，还能撑到第几个夜晚？

games.name: 方形斗兽场：B201号牢房
games.description: 一款斗兽场卡牌构筑，策略游戏。角斗士终有一死，但B201号牢房永存。在竞技场中战斗，改善你继承而来的牢房，为后世留下希望。

games.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
games.description: 《蹄印湾的马匹》是一款精心手绘的 2D 点击式游戏，您可以在游戏中建立自己的马厩。照顾您的马匹，训练它们以增强它们的力量和信心，并参加比赛赢取奖金！饲养可爱的马驹，雇佣员工，建立您梦想中的马厩！

games.name: Save Your Crabbies
games.description: A calm and relaxing puzzle game where you use movement cards and interact with the environment to guide lost baby crabs safely back to their home, solving increasingly challenging, thoughtfully designed puzzles!

games.name: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game
games.description: 《说好的英雄》是一款手绘风格的知识型角色扮演游戏。玩家将扮演一名刺客，在她那既脆弱又残酷的世界中穿梭。战争吞噬了她的家园，她必须收集各种神器来增长知识，从而揭开这个世界以及她内心深处更多不为人知的黑暗角落。

games.name: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator
games.description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

games.name: Metal Soldiers 3D
games.description: 在这款横版跑轰射击游戏中，闯过50多个关卡，突破叛军防线。驾驶坦克和机甲，升级武器，击败强大的头目，开启一场2.5D街机动作冒险。

games.name: 匠木
games.description: 国风益智《匠木》曾荣获故宫、IMGA、Indieplay等颁发的多项国内外游戏大奖，现被收藏于吉美博物馆。现在请打开《匠木》，一起走进可以玩的卯博物馆，畅享空间与想象的脑力挑战。

games.name: TEKNOKRAT
games.description: Enter the city of Nu-Vika as a cyborg repairman in TEKNOKRAT, a thriller romance visual novel. There's a conspiracy brewing beneath this techno-metropolis, and you find yourself an unwilling participant. You will meet three clients, cyborgs with secrets and aspirations of their own.

games.name: Annalynn MD
games.description: Annalynn MD is a falling block puzzle game that hearkens back to similar titles of the 16-bit era. Twist, turn, and take out germs in three different game modes as you help Annalynn make the world just a little bit healthier.

games.name: 末世神枪
games.description: 前所未有的类魂FPS游戏，带你步入传奇美术总监维克多·安东诺夫塑造的末日西部：这片血染黄沙的诡秘蛮荒之地。洞悉猎杀你的怪物，精打细算每一发子弹，用火药与祷文锻造独属于你的战斗风格。无论是单枪匹马还是并肩作战，向西而行吧，枪客，与这片沉沦的国度共赴终局。

games.name: Bookie
games.description: The horse racing roguelike, with cards. Bookie is a fast paced deckbuilder game, in which you build your own stable of horses and try to figure out which one will win the race. Manipulate the odds by modifying the cards and buying game-changing charms that will help you get all the trophies!

games.name: IT BEGAN
games.description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

games.name: Dungeon Picnic
games.description:
《Dungeon Picnic》是RPG与Roguelike融合的游戏。只品尝RPG最美味的部分。
活用各种伙伴与技能的协同，构筑属于你的最强队伍。
从像素风角色中选出4人，挑战地下城！

games.name: 夜の名前
games.description:
We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place...
“The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

games.name: Explosiovania
games.description: 在坠入一个破碎的地下世界后，你必须学会穿越撒旦之丘。利用爆炸火球进行火箭跳跃，解锁各种能力，并掌握不断扩展的移动系统。击败恶魔，发现隐藏的秘密，探索地下世界非线性的角落，夺回邪恶之眼。

games.name: Deiity (Under Ice)
games.description: A dungeon crawler about working smart, not hard. As a fallen god, climb a buried antarctic temple to use humanities own weapons to destroy the earth. Use magic abilities to manipulate physics, enemies, and the environment as you fight man-made biological creations. The temple's secrets await.

games.name: Super Kart Blast
games.description: Super Kart Blast allows you to experience a unique way of kart racer with customizable karts, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!

games.name: 火线后勤：伊萨拉战争
games.description:
一款由战场上各种突发事件驱动的可暂停即时战术与资源管理模拟游戏。
不仅聚焦于战斗，也覆盖士兵们的日常生活——设法物资在资源匮乏的前线维持后勤系统，利用一切可以利用的资源，并试图改善士兵们的艰苦日常。

games.name: 我在西游当妖怪
games.description: 《我在西游当妖怪》是一款以西游为背景，含有RPG、卡牌养成的肉鸽游戏。玩家将扮演一只籍籍无名的小妖，在西游世界中成长冒险，改写和诠释各种传说、典故。最终成为威震一方的万妖之王。

games.name: Night Shift: 1999
games.description:
Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. 

Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

games.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs
games.description: 索巴基斯坦——狗的国度，是一个黑暗讽刺性的叙事体验，设定在一个封闭的极权国家中——你的一举一动都可能让你入狱。

games.name: Mimic in the Dungeon
games.description: You are the Tentacle Mimic! Build your dungeon and lure female adventurers inside. Recruit them for your harem to harness their energy and grow stronger.

games.name: 捕捉·契约·波奇梦
games.description: 在栖息着各种魔物的大陆上，一边进行弹幕战斗一边捕捉魔物。拥有养成系统，和这些「波奇梦」培养感情解锁专属剧情，并让他们成为你的战斗伙伴！

games.name: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game
games.description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

games.name: Ezalm : Magic's Memory
games.description: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.

games.name: Rustborn - Outland Threat
games.description: 你是一名被外星人绑架的牛仔，意外与一只生物机械手臂融合。在这款第三人称弹幕射击游戏中，狂奔、攀爬、疯狂开火，在机器人群中杀出一条生路！征服母舰，找到回家的路！

games.name: Space Revolver
games.description:
SPACE REVOLVER是一款讲述主角卷入黑洞事故后而踏上旅程的解谜冒险游戏。
宇宙飞船在黑洞事故中损坏。探索未知行星，破解谜题，修复飞船，踏上回家的路吧。

games.name: 出摊啦！我的寿司餐车
games.description: 这是一款温馨惬意的模拟经营游戏。你将继承奶奶的寿司餐车，在一座唯美小岛经营你的梦想。准备食材、定制餐车，为当地居民制作手工寿司。不断积攒口碑，参与盛大庆典，开一家全伊豆最棒的寿司餐厅吧！

games.name: Sitter
games.description: 为了调查祖母离奇死亡的真相，一名警探闯入她的家。然而，房屋开始戏弄他：空间扭曲，恐惧化为实体，出口无处可寻。每一步、每个房间、每次循环，都让他离疯狂更近一步。

games.name: Aerosurge
games.description: 进行大胆的空中特技，击败敌人并穿梭于危险的环境中，完成节奏紧凑的任务。升级并自定义你的战机，以应对任何情况，并在这款快节奏的街机飞行游戏中展现你的飞行技巧。

games.name: Fragmentosis
games.description:
Fragmentosis (碎片症) 名词 /ˌfræɡ.mɛnˈtoʊ.sɪs/

一种虚构的认知状态，其特征是与来自集体人类和非人类精神的思想、意象和数字噪音的混乱碎片进行强迫性互动。

games.name: Cave Crawler: Volume 2
games.description: 穿梭于这场洞穴探险中，在地下潜行、奔跑并挤过狭窄缝隙，在避开潜伏在暗处的恐怖的同时，揭开究竟是什么驱使一个人深入到地球的腹地。

games.name: Cannon Keep
games.description: 逐块建造你的城市，在这款塔防类 Rogue 游戏中击败一波波机甲敌人！将强力火炮与独特效果相结合，在残酷的荒原中求生，探索地下收集资源，寻找强大的遗物。

games.name: Beaver Creek
games.description: A casual, water-physics puzzle game about building dams as a beaver (2 - 3 hours). Gnaw down trees, and grab and throw objects to organically build dams, back up water, and progress to the next level.

games.name: BloodState
games.description: An elite military team is sent to recover a specimen that could change everything. As the sole survivor, you must restore power, unlock new routes, reactivate critical systems, and uncover why someone wanted the mission buried.

games.name: DeckTerra
games.description: DeckTerra 是一款以卡牌为核心的 4X 战略游戏。探索程序生成的地图、研究新科技、发展你的聚落、招募军队，同时构筑与你战略相辅相成的卡组。

games.name: Rogue Reels
games.description: 输，不是选项：在这款老虎机Roguelite中一路豪赌、直上巅峰！升级并操纵机器，让胜率向你倾斜。强化转轴、赢取大奖，在节节攀升的风险中爆庄！

games.name: 孤城
games.description: 《孤城》是一款融合美女互动、射击战斗与生存探索的末日开放世界游戏。探索废墟、搜刮物资，对抗丧尸与其他变异怪物；驾驶跑车，带着爱犬穿行城市。回到家园，与性格各异的女孩培养感情，经营属于你们的末日生活。

games.name: Fish and Chill
games.description: A cozy idle fishing game where your fisherman catches fish automatically while you relax. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and enjoy the calming sea in a transparent, borderless overlay that floats on any desktop.

games.name: 海上作业：捕蟹季
games.description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

games.name: Send In The Clown
games.description: A bite-sized birthday catastrophe clown comedy role-playing experience – with minigames!

games.name: 魔女与龙：元素的祈望
games.description: 《魔女与龙：元素的祈望》是一款融合元素反应、角色扮演、回合制战棋与高风险高收益“搜打撤”的Roguelike游戏。身负神秘力量的银发女巫伊莉丝，与小龙皮皮一同踏上冒险，运用元素之力击败强敌，收集宝物构筑独特流派，在机遇与危机并存的旅途中逐步揭开云层之后的真相！

games.name: 方寸三国
games.description: 《方寸三国》是一款融合了征战模式的自走棋策略游戏。你将掌控三国时期的一方势力，组建属于你的强力队伍，攻城掠地，逐步实现天下一统的宏图伟业。

games.name: Hill-Z
games.description: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Bull Gone Wild
games.description: 化身狂暴公牛，积累冲势、连击敌人，用猛烈冲撞将周围的一切化为混乱。感受势不可挡的力量，尽情释放狂野本能，让每一场战斗都变成一场疯狂又欢乐的混战。

games.name: Scallywags
games.description: 在这款策略性海盗船员管理类roguelike游戏中，与一群乌合之众扬帆起航。追捕臭名昭著的海盗 船长，掠夺他们的宝藏，并在一次次混乱的航行中谱写属于你自己的故事。每一次航行都是一次 全新的冒险，每一个选择都将塑造你的命运，每一次胜利都将让你离真正的海盗传奇更近一步。

games.name: CryptidCam
games.description: Head into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more fan favorite cryptids in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

games.name: Goldrot
games.description: A tower defense where you command your subjects, man defenses, and manage resources. Keep production running, or your towers become useless.

games.name: Miplet Plaza
games.description: Miplet Plaza is a minimalist social sanctuary for up to 8 players. No chores, no noise—just a bright, interactive world built for the joy of being together. Zip around in bumper cars, jump into minigames, or just hang out. A growing world for you and your friends.

games.name: Rustmourne
games.description: 《Rustmourne》是一款科幻生存恐怖游戏，带来专为VR打造的深度交互体验。穿行于古老破败的建筑长廊，直面其中饱受折磨的异化生物：躲藏、逃跑，或是斩下怪物的肢体以求生还。查明苏醒背后的真相，活着逃离此地。

games.name: Defendrion
games.description: Top-down action RPG. Battle through levels filled with enemies, earn XP, and level up to unlock or evolve powerful spells and boost attributes. Defeat foes, clear each stage, and push forward to more challenging adventures with greater rewards.

games.name: Argot's Laboratory
games.description:
Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! 
Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job...
Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

games.name: 池中物
games.description: 《池中物》是一款微恐叙事解谜游戏。主要讲述自恋的少年沈青衡被卷入献祭仪式后，心灵逐渐麻木、崩溃，又最终被家人们用'爱'拯救的故事

games.name: southbound
games.description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

games.name: Mingle
games.description: 《Mingle》是一款隐藏物件解谜游戏，你将在人群中穿行，寻找自己的双胞胎。每次配对成功，你都会融合成一个全新的角色。游戏中有数百个爱唠叨的小角色，以及意想不到的关卡转折。

games.name: Burakku Jakku Samurai
games.description: 像素风战术肉鸽游戏。将“气”管理在21点的致命极限内。利用特殊卡牌打破决斗规则，操控战局。赌上一切精准凑齐21点，释放“完美聚气”的致命一击。规划生存路线。你的策略，就是你最锋利的武器。

games.name: 电子华佗修理铺
games.description: 扮演电子维修技师，动手修理各种损坏的设备：收音机、电话、音响等等。焊接电路、诊断问题、更换零件，赚取报酬，不断发展你的维修小店！

games.name: Hermit
games.description: Hermit 是一款第三人称开放世界奇幻 RPG，置身于丰富且动态的世界中。与忠实的驴子并肩而行，深入地下城、施放法术、酿造药剂、猎杀怪物，穿越辽阔的中世纪土地，揭开隐士教团的恐怖秘密。

games.name: Gridfire
games.description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

games.name: Moloch Kombinat
games.description: 1–4 人合作恐怖游戏。对接庞大而破败的工厂空间站，守住反应堆，把战利品搬回来——而看守、吸食者和塞壬正在黑暗中追猎你。支持距离语音聊天。别尖叫。指标是神圣的，你不是。

games.name: DungeonBox
games.description: 一款用手机游玩、最多支持8人的派对RPG。输入你最大胆的行动，投票选出最佳点子，掷骰子、靠投票战斗，机智的地下城主会把你们的选择编织成一场不断分支的冒险。

games.name: aSHRIMPFRIEDthisRICE?
games.description: Cooking game in which you play as Shrimp chased by ruthless Octopus mafia while providing the best & most distinguished dishes in the whole ocean!

games.name: Keep Chaos
games.description: 在全3D环境中抵御源源不断的敌潮！《Keep Chaos》是一款快节奏、第三人称视角的“弹幕割草”类Roguelite游戏。你可以独自游玩或与最多4名玩家组队，驾驭8位各具特色的英雄，叠加强力升级，奋力征服战场。

games.name: Rogue's Odyssey
games.description: 探索、刷宝、掠夺、死亡，循环往复！在2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG中对抗怪物潮和BOSS。跨职业组合技能，打造数千种独特Build。无论是炼金战士还是魔法猫咪，一切由你决定！

games.name: 恋爱音游痴
games.description: 《恋爱音游痴》是一款以音游为题材的视觉小说游戏。讲述了男主刘夏哲因家庭矛盾而选择独自来到小县城读书，偶然因为一款街机音游接触到当地音游圈，从而与四位音游痴女生产生关联，并逐渐成长的故事。

games.name: 東方連珠
games.description: 一款将幻想乡少女们如五子棋般排列的在线对战游戏！不过，由于比拼的是她们之间的亲密度，只有当相邻的少女是朋友时才能获胜。请尽情享受由她们的能力与关系交织而成的战略乐趣吧！

games.name: 脉冲驱动
games.description: 《Pulse Drive》 是一款融入了节奏元素的街机赛车游戏。跟随节拍按键以提升速度！你可以在原创的梦幻场景中轻松兜风，也可以挑战自我完成所有赛道，或是通过排行榜与好友一决高下！

games.name: 捉妖物语3:悟空
games.description: 《捉妖物语3：悟空》是一款“对局博弈+沉浸剧情+桌面宠物+卡牌交易”结合的互动剧情游戏，获取各类灵丹进行交易，解锁的女妖角色设置成桌面宠物.

games.name: Echoes of Nothing
games.description: Engage in action packed dogfights, explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver challenging bosses, then retaliate with lasers and artillery.

games.name: Pay Your Space Debt
games.description: 一款增量式生存轻度游戏。你需要采集整个小行星带，升级飞船，并躲避催收员的追捕，从而赚取足够的收益摆脱债务。

games.name: 青蚀
games.description: 《青蚀》是一款以生化泄露危机为背景的类银河恶魔城游戏。其战斗系统融合了传统2D动作游戏与类魂要素。玩家将在游玩过程中探索各式地图区域、获取新技能与武器、提升角色能力，并最终揭开这次危机背后的阴谋。

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.description: 在这款单人剧情向 Roguelite中，你将统治一座被诅咒的岛屿，调查侄女神秘失踪的真相。审问居民、进行交易、升级能力，并踏上卡牌驱动的远征，揭开黑暗秘密——在下一次大灾变降临之前。

games.name: Whale Life Simulator
games.description: 体验“氪金大佬”的人生。走上街头赚钱，然后把巨额资金投入到网络游戏中。用你满级的账号碾压其他玩家吧！

games.name: Baiacool - Tides of Olympus
games.description: 扮演一只只会说“Cool”的河豚，在海底奥林匹斯展开一场俯视角冒险。解开谜题，对抗武装到鳍尖的众神，并揭开波塞冬失踪背后的秘密。

games.name: 地渊珠宝匠
games.description: 《地渊珠宝匠》是一款采用维多利亚复古美术风格的经营模拟游戏。你将继承没落的”朱红馆“在地下城市法顿霍姆接待形形色色的委托人，鉴定原石、切割宝石、设计并打造饰品,重振店铺声誉的同时发掘潜藏在地层深处的可怖隐秘。

games.name: Rabby's Rainbow Farm
games.description: Welcome to Rabby's Rainbow Farm! Rabby the rabbit moves onto your desktop and keeps tending it while you do other things. Give a simple command, and he'll till, plant, and harvest on his own. Chat with visitors who drop by, and watch your farm grow, little by little.

games.name: Rebirth TD
games.description: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

games.name: Splatchinko
games.description: Pachinko 弹珠台 Roguelike —— 为了追寻你的永恒之爱，把你的眼球射向那些神经质的行星。解锁荒谬突变，组合离谱构筑，如果为了她必须炸掉几条银河……嗯，这就是爱情，不是吗

games.name: Pieceful
games.description: Pieceful is a puzzle game where you assemble 3D character models, perfect for a relaxed and casual gaming experience.

games.name: Burdock 2
games.description: Burdock 2 is a single-player action-horror game. Explore a lost place in a post-apocalyptic future, and help the main character's friends, or leave everyone behind and embark on the path of darkness. Find all the clues and open the way to the passage. Solve puzzles and do not lose your composure.

games.name: U.S. 666
games.description: On a road trip through the American Southwest, a car breakdown leads to running for your life, and the search for the truth of a mysterious highway.

games.name: Defiled West
games.description: A top-down Western Action RPG set in a desolate & mutated frontier. Discover and overpower furiously unstable foes that waver the rules of life and death. Collect and upgrade powerful weapons and wield a variety of otherworldly gadgets. Reclaim what was lost, one building at a time.

games.name: 羽之锋 - Feather's Edge
games.description: 在这款创新与动感十足的类银河战士恶魔城游戏内尽情冲刺、斩杀！时光之塔正等着你，因时空崩塌而支离破碎的世界内隐藏着各项丰富多彩、手工打造的挑战。在严苛、凌厉的关卡中秒杀敌人，掌握鸟人战士之道。

games.name: Bonds of the Zodiac
games.description: 玲是一位沉浸在悲痛中的少女，被卷入一个神秘之境。在那里，十二生肖之灵受玉皇大帝所缚。在这场充满神话、冲突与情感的第一人称旅程中，你将调解祂们内心的挣扎，引领祂们走向自由。

games.name: Cherubim: Heaven's Blade
games.description: A holy knight confronts corruption within a necropolis mega-structure in a souls-like dark sci-fi ARPG.

games.name: Echofall
games.description: A high-mobility sci-fi FPS built around full directional gravity control. Rotate gravity at will, transform walls into floors, ceilings into escape routes, and vertical arenas into tactical advantages. Combine precision gunplay with fluid movement to survive relentless, escalating enemy pressure.

games.name: OneMore
games.description:
Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? 
OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

games.name: Prismarch
games.description: 一款色彩斑斓的国际象棋肉鸽游戏！在充满多巴胺刺激与电影感的策略对局中，实现你的棋力幻想。随着阵容逐步成型，你的棋子将获得各种能力，助力你打造一支可以在狂潮攻势中生存下来的强化军团！冲破七位神秘棱彩国王的阻挡，获得唯一的真王冠！

games.name: 不朽之树
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 体验前所未有的生物收集玩法——你能变为你所看到的各种生物！战斗、建造、制作、探索，借助各种奇幻生物在埃达大陆上生存。建立你的神殿，在这个庞大的开放世界生存制作游戏中，成为对抗枯败的最后希望。

games.name: Expendabots
games.description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

games.name: SHOTGUN DREAMS
games.description: SHOTGUNS DREAMS is a first-person 3D platformer with an emphasis on momentum and creativity. Utilize simple parkour abilities like sliding and wall-running to maintain top speed. Leverage shell pickups to gain velocity, teleport, and manipulate gravity. How you reach the goal is up to you.

games.name: DERELIKT
games.description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

games.name: Celestial Decks
games.description: Life is brief... But death? That's another story. Celestial is a competitive card game where experience is worth its weight in gold. Weave your tale with beautifully illustrated cards. Uncover powerful synergies to claim victory. Follow the paths of the Penumbra, or match wits against other players.

games.name: Backyard Bayou
games.description: 当超乎人类理解的恐怖事物突然出现在自家后院，是不是很讨厌？拿起霰弹枪，把它们统统清理掉。一款快节奏、紧张激烈的第三人称Roguelite射击游戏，道具可以叠加组合成各种奇葩物品，而且沼泽里永远不缺少可射击的目标。

games.name: Abby Normalli in Mayhem Mansion
games.description: A jazz-fueled 3D platformer where you bash, bounce, and explore a sprawling cartoon mansion. Play as Abby Normalli, a mischief-loving whirlwind with a giant hammer, and compete to collect family heirlooms in chaotic, character-packed worlds.

games.name: Codex Lost 2
games.description: Magic and intrigue abound in this gripping dark fantasy RPG, with atmospheric exploration that will beguile even the most avid fans of the genre. Wield a diverse array of weapons and spells as you step forth into a world of intoxicating mystery to face the many challenges lurking within.

games.name: Talaka
games.description: 在流畅迅捷的“类Roguelite”战斗中，挥刀、射击并重塑神话与怪兽，穿梭于令人惊叹的手绘水彩世界之中——在这里，传说中的生物甚至奥里沙神灵都因害怕被遗忘而变得叛逆。

games.name: Ashfield Hollow
games.description: 在废墟中重建生活。Ashfield Hollow融合生存、即时战斗、种田、制作和钓鱼，带你进入一个末日后的世界。疫情爆发十年后，阿什菲尔德营地已成为最后的避难所之一。它能否继续存在，取决于你。

games.name: 重生2我独自逆袭
games.description:
真人恋爱+SLG融合的全新互动影游作品：你将扮演底层小人物，亲历逆袭人生巅峰的爽文剧本
打斗、养成、喝酒撩妹，多重玩法一网打尽！100G爆炸多内容！颠覆你的爽感体验！

games.name: Unicycle Gorilla
games.description: 在《独轮车大猩猩》中骑动力独轮车！轻松3D速通，全球排行榜，搞笑摔倒，疯狂关卡。用L1/R1平衡，称霸城市丛林！

games.name: Everlast: Undying Tale
