games.description: 在《Everlast: Undying Tale》的魔法世界萨基斯（Sarkis），不死者已经崛起。在这款 MMO-Lite 动作 RPG 中，你可以采集资源、探索世界、磨练技能、制作物品。唯有在生者与死者之间架起桥梁，才能打破死亡之诅咒。

games.name: SuperWEIRD：奇怪的远征
games.description: 一款支持 1～4 人的自动化轻度肉鸽游戏。让工人机器人制造并运送补给，战斗机器人则负责对抗 Goofy Goo。把破碎的星球重新拼起来，强化你的生产网络，每一局都能尝试新策略。

games.name: 死境重启
games.description: 《DEADBOOT》是一款快节奏复古Roguelike第一人称射击游戏。一路冲过随机生成的关卡，搜刮武器与强化道具，试试你能在这片霓虹闪烁的亡命之地坚持多远。

games.name: Randel Tales: Act 1
games.description:
Randel Tales: Act 1 is an Adult Visual Novel in which you play as a young adventurer as he goes on adventures and meets many cute girls that are more than willing to sleep with him! 
But even though everything seems great, you can't help but feel like everything is about to come crashing down.

games.name: Jackpot Dungeon
games.description: Gather your coins, come to Jackpot Dungeon and try to reach the bottom of the dungeon before you go broke! A slot-machine roguelike where gambling is your only weapon.

games.name: Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!
games.description: 逃离监狱，追寻奇夫镇失踪的糖！在这款体量庞大、全动画且全配音的2D点击类喜剧游戏中揭开一场离奇的阴谋，挑战你的最强大脑。运气总是眷顾秃头，现在是你（的脑袋）闪耀的时刻了。

games.name: Strange island
games.description: 你在一座热带岛屿上醒来，却不记得自己的名字，也不知道自己是如何来到这里的。探索岛屿，寻找答案，但务必保持警惕：有人正在注视着你，而你知道得越多，就越难相信自己得出的结论。

games.name: Cry from the Abyss
games.description: Fight through the monstrosities from the abyss with fast-paced physics combat using light. Experience thrilling first-person shooter action and obtain powerful upgrades to survive in this horror roguelite.

games.name: 幻兽防线
games.description: 在魔族觊觎龙脉、挑起万族之战的《幻兽防线》中，你将扮演龙裔青瞳，联合同伴，于关键隘口布下天罗地网，智斗魔族大军。

games.name: Chronal Chain
games.description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

games.name: Fairy Land
games.description: No farming experience. A ruined homestead. One festival deadline. Help Maria rebuild the farm from scratch and see how far you can take it. FairyLand is waiting.

games.name: Discard All Hope
games.description: Combat brutal enemies in this mechanically deep, horror-themed looter-shooter. Players make split-second decisions with their deck to do everything from cancelling enemy attacks, detonating status conditions, or healing themselves. Collect hundreds of spells, mutated by dozens of modifiers!

games.name: Save the Forest
games.description: Save the Forest is a tactics roguelite where you lead your squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Choose and create combos with over 25 units and 150+ skills!

games.name: Bao Bao's™ Cozy Cleaning Services
games.description: 和宝宝一起放松一下吧，这是一款轻松治愈的2D高压清洗游戏。清理柔和的粉彩场景，伴着舒缓的 lo-fi 音乐，没有压力，只有安静与放松。支持单人游玩或最多与3位好友一起体验，在悠闲的时光里慢慢把一切变干净。

games.name: Chest & Blade
games.description: 一款英雄自动战斗的黑暗奇幻放置 RPG。选择战士、法师或野蛮人，刷 Boss 和宝箱拿装备，再把收获投入锻造、技能、符文与强化卡，往下一幕推进。

games.name: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
games.description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

games.name: Echoes Within
games.description: 《Echoes Within》是一款以1930年代塞浦路斯为背景的第三人称叙事动作冒险游戏。玩家将扮演Ann，目睹那些撕裂理智、引向被遗忘梦魇的回响。

games.name: River Runners: Downstream
games.description: River Runners is a single player auto-scroller adventure game developed for PC. The player plays against the rapid currents of the river while controlling a log and a merry band of animals, attempting to avoid the various obstacles that appear along the way.

games.name: Chibi Engine
games.description: Make your desktop a lively place with cute chibi characters. Pet them, talk to them, give them gifts, and decorate your workspace with image or GIF stickers. Join our community on Steam Workshop to share your own characters and discover what others create

games.name: Wizzy the Wood
games.description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

games.name: The Ghost of Lake
games.description: The Ghost of Lake is an atmospheric 2D action game where you control two characters across two worlds: a ghost in the Lake World and a human in the Real World. Master tactical combat, manage your Soulna, and extract floating souls to survive this hauntingly beautiful, dual-reality journey.

games.name: BLIGHTFALL
games.description: ※ FEED THE SHRINES [▰▰▰▱▱] ※ BLIGHTFALL is a fast-moving 1–4 player FPS roguelike. Hold the zone, dash-reap the wounded, stack loot into broken builds, breach the rift, and kill what answers. ⟦ TIME FEEDS THEM // KILL FASTER ⟧

games.name: 渎神牌局
games.description: 《渎神牌局》是一款融入了我们独特想法的Rougelike卡牌DBG游戏，游戏背景结合了北欧神话风格。玩家将扮演老兵罗德，这是他退役前的最后一个任务，探寻真相，杀出这一场由未知的阴谋与危险编织而成的牌局！

games.name: 爱伴 Aibond
games.description: 拥有长期记忆的二次元AI伙伴。免安装，本体免费，陪你聊天、游戏、自习，做你最贴心的日常陪伴。

games.name: 玩个Gui 2:天脊之下
games.description: 建造复杂的轨道网络，部署并强化独特的战斗列车，利用炮塔附魔构筑移动堡垒，抵御来自地壳深处的无尽怪形。每一次布局都是智慧的博弈，每一次调整都关乎防线的存亡。

games.name: 小千草的少女生活纪录簿
games.description: 小千草原本只是一个普通的女孩，但当她开始意识到异性以后，她的生活逐渐有了不一样的转变…

games.name: Shrike
games.description: Pickpocket rival birds to build a deck. A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about a tiny bird's grim migration north through a wretched medieval kingdom. Steal abilities, chart your migratory route, survive.

games.name: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor
games.description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

games.name: Chocolate Parade
games.description:
一场糖果大战，威力无穷！
《巧克力游行》是一款疯狂的类Rogue动作游戏，你将操控糖果滚动，释放重型武器！
玩家（ 单人游玩或合作游玩 ）可以创建自己的游行队伍，在Boss挑战战场上争夺金币！

games.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
games.description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

games.name: Awesome Balamir
games.description: A retro-inspired beat ‘em up adventure blending platforming, puzzles, and cinematic storytelling. Styled like a 1970s B-movie hero, the game features collage art, Full Motion Video  sequences, and original analog photographs. With a touch of Yeşilçam flair and cinematic absurdity.

games.name: Anomaly Express
games.description: 《异常特快》（Anomaly Express）是一款支持 1-4 人联机的心理恐怖游戏，背景设定在一列冬日列车上。寻找异常，在致命遭遇中幸存，并揭开这场无尽旅程背后的超自然力量。

games.name: Tank Havoc
games.description:
《Tank Havoc》是一款俯视角多人团队射击游戏。
化身特色各异的坦克干员，每名角色都拥有专属玩法与人设。
熟知角色的优势与短板，把握出击时机，在PvP对战中称霸赛场。

games.name: Her Crown of Blood
games.description: A sinful child is damned to hell. Her mother follows her. An indie horror RPG.

games.name: Snakez Arena
games.description: Snakez Arena 是一款 2.5D 平台射击游戏，拥有独特的移动方式和弹道特性，并包含多种游戏模式！

games.name: Witch War 1
games.description: 《女巫战争1》是一款快节奏的自上而下射击游戏，融合了策略元素。玩家将率领一支女巫大军投入战斗。你将融合各种元素，创造新的法术，并驾驭它们的力量，抢在敌人之前征服世界。

games.name: Sven Rescues a Princess
games.description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D horde brawler for 1-10 players. Hack and slash through 30-45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

games.name: Chaos The Devil
games.description:
Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

games.name: Coup de Koala
games.description: 在《Coup de Koala》中夺回王冠，这是一款可爱的弹幕类 Roguelite 游戏，讲述了一场狂怒的反叛。作为一名被流放的考拉国王，施展法术，与不死族大军展开无休止的战斗，夺回属于你的王座。构筑你的卡牌套牌，死亡、强化角色，然后重新开始。

games.name: 99天生存指南
games.description: 这是一款快节奏的合作丧尸生存动作游戏，玩家将在关卡推进过程中击败大量敌人，解锁随机能力强化，通过不同构筑选择与团队配合完成逃离。

games.name: Blight Brigade
games.description: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

games.name: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
games.description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

games.name: sys:tan restore
games.description: A (very) short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!

games.name: 锈都残日
games.description: 《锈都残日》是一部节奏缓慢、氛围浓郁的恐怖游戏，在这里你的好奇心既是你的指引也是末日的引路人。夕阳西下，矿井滴血；你将漫步在胡塔-格罗布诺城这座缓慢腐烂的城市，在它最后的余晖中保全性命。

games.name: WISH WITCH
games.description: WISH WITCH is a fast-paced pixel action game with stylish dashes, flashy skill effects, and epic boss fights. Dodge, slash, and conquer a world full of mystery and monsters.

games.name: HYVE
games.description: HYVE is a competitive online 2v2 card game set in a cyberpunk future. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and combine your cards to create powerful synergies. Infiltrate the enemy network and destroy their C.O.R.E.

games.name: Nui Goes to Town!
games.description: Nui, Rumi, and Gu are about to embark on the Giggle Train to Tickle Town!  Explore Gigglesville and help your pals in this cute adventure game where not everything is as it seems.

games.name: 隐梦交织
games.description: 《隐梦交织》是一款以维多利亚时代为舞台的视觉小说，含有多个风格不同的POV视角。在 1884 年的圣诞节后，四名目的相同却心思各异的朋友聚在了伦敦的一家侦探办公室内，只为前往城市中最阴暗的角落，探寻潜藏在数起失踪案后的庞大真相。

games.name: Bet Shop Simulator
games.description: 经营街坊的投注站！打印投注单、找零钱，和顾客一起看比赛。进球时整个店都在沸腾，输了球电视就要遭殃。打扫、装修、扩建。

games.name: You're Nuts! — 螺丝掉了一地
games.description: 一款治愈系合作解谜游戏，献给 1-4 名渴望自由的可爱小机器人。一次一道谜题，解锁废弃工厂里的房间，赶在电池耗尽前回家。开过的门会一直开着，明天就能走得更深。打造、强化、逃脱。一天很短。

games.name: 侠影痴剑录
games.description:
《侠影痴剑录》是一款武侠剧情冒险游戏，故事讲述南北朝末年至隋朝统一这段动荡乱世中的江湖传奇。
在战乱频仍、王朝更迭的时代，四位年轻人因战争征发、官府苛政、权贵构陷、王朝篡逆的不同境遇，被迫卷入乱世风暴，机缘巧合下聚首并肩，并最终亲历天下归一的历史洪流。

games.name: AURA 2: Lust of the Gods
games.description:
《奥拉2：诸神之欲》是一款充满神话与欲望的成人开放世界卡牌RPG。
完成英雄壮举，勾引女神，组建后宫，拯救奥拉—或者加入古老的神族！
战斗格挡、浪漫邂逅、抉择驱动的剧情，以及火辣的动态演出正等着你！

games.name: Bridgelands
games.description: Bridgelands是一款动作类Roguelite游戏。你将与Flora一同踏上远征，探索神秘岛屿。选择你的路线，对抗危险生物，并组合强力强化，在每段旅程中打造全新的战斗构筑。

games.name: 孤岛核心
games.description: 异界撕裂了大陆，基地只剩孤岛。你是中央AI「核心」——把逝去科学家的完整人格上传进来，装上激光、圆锯、喷火器与浮游炮，在雪地、沙漠与沼泽之间顶着怪物潮与天灾守住最后一道防线。单机怪潮防守 × 人格构筑，每一局都是新的防线。

games.name: Immortal Coil
games.description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

games.name: 忍法！~色色忍法帖~
games.description: 《忍法！~色色忍法帖~》是一款3D动作冒险RPG，来自异界的淫魔族大举入侵...！把整个人界搅得天翻地覆...玩家将在和风的地图里体验好色忍者「纱奈」的大冒险♥

games.name: SEMO
games.description: SEMO 是一款混乱又欢乐的 1～4 人合作物理平台跳跃游戏。推动脆弱的圆圈，让它弹跳，甚至不小心把它撞飞，带它闯过棘手的关卡——然后再吵吵到底是谁的错！

games.name: Memory Palace
games.description: Rescue the princess by defeating your foes at memory card games in this retro styled pixel art adventure. Think quick for the hugely satisfying Perfect Match. Memory Palace is a great way to relax while exercising your brain.

games.name: VAL'TY
games.description:
VAL'TY mixes silly humor, absurd horror and retro FPS aesthetics with a mandatory easter egg quest and creepypasta-like moments.
No humans allowed! 
GET VAL'TED!

games.name: Pip sellfish
games.description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

games.name: A Thousand Cloys
games.description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

games.name: The Odd Cafe Case Files
games.description:
Pick up “words” from conversations and combine them with evidence to uncover the truth behind the cases.
A former detective turned coffee shop owner takes on a series of baffling cases. As you get closer to the truth, your own “lost memories of the past” begin to unravel—

games.name: Order of Wallachia
games.description: 一款以中世纪城市克朗施塔特为背景的第一人称动作冒险游戏。揭开黑暗的秘密，与受罗马尼亚民间传说启发的怪物战斗，并使用各种武器对抗肆虐大地的邪恶。

games.name: 落暮余歌Song of Dusk
games.description: 你是在花灼小区租房的大学生，在居住期间，看似平常的小区，却带给你一系列违和感，而这份诡异，正在逐渐渗透你的日常。在探寻中，你卷入了这场阴谋，并揭开那可怕的真相。如血的残阳，绚丽到失真的晚霞，在沉默地见证着花灼小区发生的一切，聆听着那落暮时分，在远处的靡靡之音……

games.name: Hyper Vyper
games.description: Hyper Vyper is an electric third-person roguelite shooter for those that stay moving.  Blast, kick & slide through a Neon City descending into madness.  Master a kinetic moveset, find crazy builds, grow from outgunned survivor to unstoppable force.  Resist!

games.name: Cortesia Rising
games.description: Cortesia Rising is a space captain simulator that combines tactical ground combat, crew & ship management, and broadside naval combat in a hand-crafted Sci-Fi universe, developed and self-published by an experienced team of industry veterans and artists.

games.name: Eredian Stronghold
games.description: Push lanes, capture buildings, and defend your base in this fast-paced Action RPG. Slaughter hordes of enemies, find legendary loot, and fight your way to the Stronghold of Eredian.

games.name: SUPERPANEL
games.description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

games.name: Frozen Feathers
games.description: Throw snowballs, slide across the ice and shove your friends into the sea in short, chaotic penguin battles. Play online with up to 4 players, split-screen on one PC, or tap PLAY and fight bots in seconds.

games.name: Fallen Starborn
games.description: Star creatures, fallen to Earth like shooting stars, together with their Lupine Lord, Vehord. They bring destruction and suffering wherever they go. Join your team of Moonlit Travelers, explore the Underground and face the Lupine Lord in a deadly battle that will decide the fate of the world.

games.name: Ladder Lad
games.description: 在一个人们已经忘记如何跳跃的世界里，一位小弟必须崛起。在这款富有挑战性、100%梯子主题的精准平台跳跃游戏中，一路攀爬、摇晃和蹦跳，达到新的高度。

games.name: SCP: Project Pneuma
games.description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

games.name: Liar-for-hire
games.description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

games.name: 足球经理：自走棋
games.description: 这是一款融合收集养成的足球经理游戏。你执教主题球队，在俱乐部日程中安排训练、招揽和联赛，并在近实时比赛里拖拽教练卡指挥攻防，从基层联赛一路冲击更高舞台。

games.name: Dumpster Diving Simulator
games.description: 在开放的海岛小镇翻找垃圾箱，发掘隐藏的宝藏，把破烂变成钞票。卖废品、赢下仓库拍卖、在跳蚤市场摆摊、倒卖二手车、开直播圈粉，从身无分文的外乡人成长为 Çamlıada 的传奇拾荒者。

games.name: 酒馆女仆的日常
games.description: 在《酒馆女仆的日常》中，玩家将扮演「红狐酒馆」的一名女仆，招待各式各样的客人，度过平凡有趣的每一天。在与客人们的闲谈之余，逐渐深入了解自己所处的奇幻世界。

games.name: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
games.description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork 是一款独特的高难度街机游戏！扮演小恶魔，拖着巨大的 Dork 穿越地狱般的陷阱与谜题，举办终极派对！用独特的干草叉机制操控两人，保护自己和活生生的 Dork，别让他滚进熔岩！

games.name: No Wings Required
games.description: 扮演一只手持气球、自信爆棚的“无证上岗”鸭子，开启你的职场首日。 漫步羽落群岛，帮助古怪的岛民，你将领悟到“临场发挥”或许真是种可行的职场生存之道。

games.name: Orbital Abyss: Cipher Division
games.description: Decipher interstellar transmissions encoded via substitution ciphers aboard Eremite Station. In this choice driven narrative, uncover secrets from planetary factions while conversing with crewmates to reveal their stories and troubles. The ripples of your choices may be felt throughout the galaxy.

games.name: Wove
games.description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

games.name: 佈堪入耳
games.description: 在这个饱受本不该出现在人类发肤之下的东西困扰的小镇上，通过为患者采耳清洁耳道，揭开笼罩在Velviano小镇上的失踪及诡异现象背后的重重疑云。

games.name: Geodyssey
games.description: Geodyssey is a mind-bending first-person adventure game that challenges your perception. Explore spaces that defy logic, Solve perplexing puzzles, and Experience a reality that cannot exist. Immerse in a surreal Non-Euclidean world.

games.name: 阴阳妖怪
games.description: 生物收集+文字AVG+冒险游戏！收服200余只各异妖宠，邂逅性格迥异的伙伴，体验以冲突、情感、谜团为主轴的故事。象征人类与妖怪共存的KINCYO町正在面临着巨大危机，与少女妙妙一起探寻幕后黑手，这座城市的命运从此与你相连...

games.name: My Bookshop Dreams
games.description: 一款温馨的书店经营模拟游戏，你可以经营、装扮并扩展你梦想中的书店。补充书架、举办作家活动、撸猫逗狗、在帮助作家的同时收集文学作品，让你的声望传遍各个城市，书写属于你的传奇。

games.name: Croak Tales: Deep Dungeons
games.description: Explore, scavenge and survive ... or croak trying. Dive into murky, abandoned dungeons with your friends to recover an ancient object and reveal the history around this world. It's high-stakes extraction where teamwork is vital, survival is unlikely, and the chaos is half the fun.

games.name: On Your Own: Survival Inventory
games.description:
旋转网格、成组击碎箱子，在移动角色的同时收集战利品并躲避敌人。
探索不同区域，每个地点都有不同的战利品和难度等级。
回收物品获取材料并制作出新物品，直到修复无线电并发出求救信号。
一款以生存、探索、收集战利品、动手制作为主题的Rogue-lite风格游戏。

games.name: Dungeon & Match
games.description:
置身于无色漫画分镜之中，在这场黑暗的三消（Match-3）迷你Roguelite冒险里深入地下城的深处！

将剑、盾牌、生命与法杖进行各种组合，打造属于你的专属协同（Synergy）！

games.name: Lexomancer
games.description: A word-battler roguelite: spell words to cast spells, exploit each monster's elemental weakness, and build a run from talents named Verbose, Loquacious and Archsage

games.name: IdleOS
games.description: A terminal-inspired idle game where every command brings you one step closer to hacking increasingly difficult targets. Mine resources, crack passwords, decode caches, and upgrade your operation as you progress toward more valuable rewards to upgrade your OS and become an unstoppable hacker.

games.name: My Cozy BookShop
games.description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: Vanakan 405
games.description: 这是亚美尼亚的黄金时代：文字被创造出来，梅斯罗普·马什托茨正在翻译《圣经》。来自凡城的奥汉踏上了一段旅程，将他带往一片充满神秘的未知之地，而修道院是他唯一的庇护所。

games.name: Parallel Ways
games.description: 一款 2D 像素艺术动作角色扮演游戏，四个平行世界有着相同的命运。探索地下城，实时面对敌人，并探索如何在所有现实崩溃之前返回家园。

games.name: ALTERNATE WORLDS
games.description: 你是否曾问过自己“如果……会怎样？”比如，如果一个决定、一件意外事件，或者一次简单的幸运，就可能彻底改变你的人生轨迹，让你走上截然不同的道路？在《平行世界》中，你无需再问了：你将亲身体验这一切。

games.name: 斗地主棋
games.description: 《斗地主棋》是一款创意休闲棋牌游戏，我们在进行常规的斗地主纸牌游戏时，往往受限于记牌算牌的难度，水平遇到瓶颈，斗地主本身就是一个不完全信息博弈的过程，但《斗地主棋》巧妙地将牌局中瞬息万变的策略变为了可视化的场景，将常规的纸牌玩法塑形成了更加类似于下棋或者数独的推理游戏，这是一款回合制策略棋牌游戏，游戏内包含单人模式以及多人联机模式，同时整合了排行榜和成就系统，是一款可玩性很高的游戏。相信《斗地主棋》能够帮助你提供新的策略视角和游戏体验，进一步提升自己的斗地主水平。

games.name: Oasis of Lilies
games.description: Julie's Oasis is a haven for gentlewomen looking for relaxation and discreet pleasures. Ayame enters the club, unsure what to expect, only to meet strangely familiar women one after another. Oasis of Lilies is a light-hearted visual novel about a girl who dreams of having a harem of her own.

games.name: 恸哭幽光／CRYMELIGHT
games.description: 《恸哭幽光／CRYMELIGHT》是一款以死后世界为背景的rogue动作游戏，讲述少女们与自身罪孽抗争，同时为获得自由而奋力战斗的故事。

games.name: PhantomGaze : Omni-sight
games.description: A 2D Metroidvania where you control two characters at once. A blind swordsman fights in melee, while a spirit archer provides ranged support. Master parry rhythms and exploit weaknesses using the bestiary. Uncover the secrets of a world built on Asian aesthetics through a stranger's eyes.

games.name: Destropolis 2
games.description:
Hordes of red cube enemies.
Bullets, lasers and nukes.
Cities to raze to the ground.

games.name: DREADSHELL
games.description: DREADSHELL is a first person psychological sci-fi horror game set in an underground drilling facility. You are sent to investigate missing workers and continue the operation

games.name: Anvira: Forge Defense
games.description: 将战场化为熔岩火海。让陨石遮天蔽日。召集一支狂甩手里剑的忍者魔像大军。Anvira: Forge Defense 是一款 Roguelite 塔防游戏，玩的就是打造离谱的魔像流派——再看着无穷无尽的哥布林一波接一波撞上来，撞个粉碎。

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.description: 《The Road of Dust and Sorrow》是一款氛围紧张、剧情驱动的像素风恐怖游戏，灵感源自 90 年代的经典恐怖佳作。在这个崩坏的世界挣扎求生，守护你的女儿，她是你最珍视的一切。

games.name: Gaming DNA & ESTI
games.description: 在简短、可反复游玩的技能挑战中，测试你的反应、瞄准、追踪与记忆。在经典 2D MOBA 训练中躲避来袭技能，挑战个人最佳。短局体验，清晰结果，再试一次，争取更进一步。

games.name: Skewer'd
games.description: Skewer'd is the best multi-player physics based javelin sports combat game ever made. Disclaimer: Statement based on zero research

games.name: Labyrinth of Doom
games.description: A dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon crawler with real-time combat — fully playable solo against challenging AI bots. Fight, scavenge, and outwit rivals in procedurally generated labyrinths — Battle Royale or Co-op, up to 10 players, with legendary artifacts drawn from world mythology.

games.name: Temple Maker 64
games.description: Temple Maker 64 is a third-person dungeon creator. Build dungeons full of traps and puzzles, or grab your sword and explore community-made dungeons. Choose from a vast selection of items, monsters, puzzle elements, and bosses, all wrapped up in an N64-inspired love letter.

games.name: Mind's Edge
games.description: Leia's 12th birthday turned into a nightmare when masked, unidentified individuals kidnapped her. Following the traces, Vincent and his childhood friend Antonio arrive at an abandoned mansion, where they run across something they never expected.

games.name: A Line Held Tight
games.description: Tensions both political and personal are rising at the Brightworld mining colony. In this dynamic sci-fi visual novel you must decide where your heart and loyalties lie if you’re to shape the future and save yourself.

games.name: Null Anchor
games.description:
Null anchor is a space-sim, but not in space. You live in a futuristic city, on colony, forgotten by earth. Carve a life out of this city, anything to survive, thrive. Fight, scavenge, steal, trade, upgrade, repair, evade the law, hunt bounties and run, because...
You. 
Can't. 
Hide.

games.name: Frog Knight
games.description: 一只勇敢又固执的小青蛙，带着一把爱说话的剑，在这款精准操作的 平台跳跃游戏中攀爬一口被诅咒的井。跳跃、反弹，磨练你的节奏感，拯救世界。没有检查点。没有捷径。只有漫长的攀爬……或坠落。

games.name: Toy's Playground: The prologue
games.description:
玩具游乐场隐藏着黑暗的秘密。
探索工厂和游乐区。解决谜题。
躲避怪物。不要被抓住。
在为时已晚之前找到出口。

games.name: 末日重启
games.description: 末日危机再度爆发，变异丧尸威胁着仅剩人类。作为阿特拉斯末日小队的一员,在 Lowpoly 画风的 Roguelike 世界中探索求生，积累资源、打磨装备，寻找人类的出路。
games.developer: Chengdu Shengming Leyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.

games.name: Bit-Broken Identity
games.description:
Bit-Broken Identity is a psychological horror visual novel about escaping reality. 
A tempting part-time job. Just submit a form. W̸͖͋̈́ḩ̴̮̹̟͛a̶̳͊̒̒̎t̷̜͆ ̷̎́̂͋͜c̶̫̈̈́ǫ̵̔̐̔͝ṳ̸͎́l̵͕̃́̀d̶̯̔̀͠ ̵̻̀g̴͕̯͋̒̕ͅo̵̥͉̺͐͊ ̷͍͖͚̒ẁ̶͎̫̿͘ŕ̴͎̉̏̔ö̶̹́̓ǹ̴͕̌̓͘g̸̼̹̈́͊͝?̸̢̛̭̟͂ 🎣 👁️

games.name: Super Money Ring
games.description: Roll, flip and rail-grind to the goal! Race ghosts worldwide for the fastest time on any of the 100 carefully crafted levels. Find the secrets hidden in every level. Try the demo today!

games.name: 空间漫游
games.description: 基于真实的建筑设计作品，风格轻松而治愈的第一人称解谜叙事游戏。深入建筑师的内心世界，在实际项目和幻想空间之间穿梭，并体验从初入职场到逐渐实现自我的建筑师职业生涯。与空间相关的解谜内容，揭示了建筑设计背后的逻辑与思考过程。

games.name: S.K.R.U.B. Squad
games.description: Kick back, relax, and get cleaning solo or with friends! The multiverse is a messy place, and when things get dirty the S.K.R.U.B. Squad is there!

games.name: Noël macabre
games.description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

games.name: 暗色神具的魔王
games.description: 异世界！日式西幻！剑与魔法！公主！义妹妹！精灵！吸血鬼！全部结局都是后宫全收！纯粹服务男性向的galgame！

games.name: Desktop Duck
games.description: 你的桌面值得拥有一只小鸭。它住在你的屏幕上，栖息在你的窗口上，还会对你做出反应。一起赢取帽子，然后交易、出售或尽情炫耀。

games.name: Titanic
games.description: A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!

games.name: Core Reset
games.description: Are you a capable mech test pilot. Can you clear the challenges the test plan lays out for you. The test plans get harder, the further you push. Core Reset is a fast paced, rogue-lite, bullet heaven that pushes your limits.

games.name: 文明重生
games.description:
在这款融合 4X 与 RPG 的科幻策略游戏中，你将率领人类最后的方舟，在陌生星海的遗迹中重建新的家园。
从一无所有开始，发展科技、建造舰队、抵御外敌，亲手塑造人类文明的重生与未来。

games.name: Shop
games.description: Shop simulator. Open your own shop in a picturesque beach resort, earn money, and get rich. Run multiple shops, hire employees, and do business!

games.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
games.description: 策略与动作角色扮演在1920年代纽约黑帮世界中交汇。通过掩护产业和私酒走私建立你的帝国，率领手下投入残酷的俯视角战术战斗，以狡诈的外交或纯粹的杀戮统治这座城市。

games.name: Veil of Remorse
games.description: Veil of Remorse is a retro-inspired arcade bullethell where you steer a ship through a corrupted solar system, build synergies through the roguelike-structure of upgrades, and appease to the hunger of the void. Will you break through the mist and leave?

games.name: For Nora
games.description:
在这款惊险刺激的动作平台游戏中，射击、冲刺、格挡，并操控时间，奋力拯救你被绑架的妹妹。
你只有一周的时间去救她，你能做到吗？

games.name: Atomic Cosmos
games.description: Atomic Cosmos is a bullet hell game that takes place on a small planet. Avoid meteors, lasers, and random events to survive as long as possible.

games.name: 中国黑龙传说
games.description: 《中国黑龙传说》是一款日常爆笑系的粤式文字冒险游戏（galgame）。故事讲述中法混血足球运动员钟国龙与白筱桐、艾依莎、佛拉娜、金圣爱等四名少女的恋爱故事。

games.name: Shawarma Hell
games.description: Shawarma Hell is a heart-pumping, stress-inducing, first-person restaurant serving experience where your task management skills will be put to the test. Satisfy your customers by serving them as fast as possible while also keeping the restaurant clean! DO NOT get their orders wrong!

games.name: Stone Rebellion
games.description: 是一款融合生存城建与自动战斗的游戏。白天，在废墟上重建魔像之城：开采石头与水晶，锻造士兵与装备。夜幕降临，部署你的军队，让他们自行作战。每个黎明，你重建家园；每个黄昏，你坚守防线。

games.name: UnPerfect World
games.description: What starts as a battle against a minor evil may ultimately lead to saving the whole world

games.name: Worn By The Forgotten
games.description: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.

games.name: Voiceless
games.description: An interactive FMV slasher. Emma's sister is gone. The only lead: a serial killer locked in a psychiatric ward. Enter. Find answers. Get out alive.

games.name: Lightyears of Fervent Warfare
games.description:
Modern old school action with explosive firepower. Rack up kills to upgrade your ship. Use your tech skills wisely. Collect the best loot. And dominate the skies with space shotguns, homing swarm missiles and chain lightning!

This is a work-in-progress passion project! ETA November '26!

games.name: Don't Read It
games.description:
《DON'T READ IT》——是一款采用第一人称视角的独立恐怖步行模拟游戏。
在某人失踪的现场，只剩下一本书。只要翻开它一次——熟悉的世界便会消失。

games.name: Football Referee Life Simulator 26
games.description: 一款写实的裁判模拟游戏！出示红黄牌、使用 VAR、掌控比赛，在裁判生涯中步步登顶！

games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
games.description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

games.name: Sign My Petition
games.description: Sign My Petition is a beat-’em-up adventure about a mouse trying to save their tribe from extermination. Explore bizarre neighboring apartments, fight off strange enemies and bosses, and meet oddball characters along the way.

games.name: 碧海六重奏
games.description: 你是拯救世界的英雄，却被自己的新娘杀死。围绕你的六名女孩，谁是幕后的凶手？悬疑X恋爱 后宫AVG!

games.name: 神秘力量出东方
games.description:
古镇经营： 耕种、垂钓、逛集市，体验中式水乡的慢生活。
时空外卖： 满足来自末世与奇幻世界客人的特殊味蕾。
像素美学： 细腻的 2D 像素画风，融合传统古韵与科幻幻想。

games.name: Side & Heek
games.description: Side & Heek is a chaotic multiplayer party game built around ragdoll physics. FLOP your way through Hide & Seek, Copycat, and Flopball game modes, diving headfirst into opponents to deliver brutal knockouts, disrupt plays, or send yourself flying. Easy to learn, hard to master, and endlessly fun.

games.name: Atelier of Oblivion
games.description:
An atelier in the forest. The Artist’s brush halts before an empty frame, leaving the portrait unfinished. 
Lost souls arrive with memories of tragedy. Render the cruel truth, or shield their eyes with an eternal lie. 
A Gothic Mystery granting rest to the dead.

games.name: Breadoria
games.description: Breadoria is a survival colony sim where tiny Breads gather, build, craft, and defend their home from hungry invaders. Take control of any Bread, or automate your colony as you plan its next expansion.

games.name: Slide Soldiers
games.description: 《Slide Soldiers》是一款轻松休闲的滑行解谜游戏，目的并非抵达终点、而是消灭所有敌人。你可以按照自己的节奏游玩，在 4000 个关卡中摸索出最佳路线。你须谨慎挑选目标、仔细规划走位，因为——一旦开始滑行，便无法在中途停下

games.name: Empty Box: 空盒子
games.description: 我一直都在看着你……你的一举一动我都没有错过。所以，你也只看着我一个人，好不好？我的视线永远无法从你身上移开。如果你也只注视着我……我们就再也不会分开了。

games.name: Squid Chess
games.description: REAL-TIME CHESS-BASED ROGUE-LIKE. Play chess, throw potions at the board, level up your team, listen to the Old Squid's old war-stories, and perhaps, un-make the Nightmare of the Ranch...

games.name: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
games.description: 《暗房》是一款生存恐怖房间构建游戏，设定在一个循环的噩梦中。通过放置房间来扩展地图，但会消耗稳定性。战斗怪物，解谜，管理有限资源，解锁新房间和升级。每次游戏都是新的黑暗深渊。

games.name: Generic Fighter Maybe
games.description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

games.name: Elmer
games.description:
“ Elmer is a Metroidvania-style adventure game. ”
 
AltroQuando is a place for those with a forgotten past, an illusionary present, and a future held only as a promise. Your presence here is the proof that you are seeking your own original sin, your own mask.

games.name: CH13: Rest Stop
games.description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

games.name: Bore Bore
games.description: 降临地心，在充满毒气的天空下生存。小心生物的袭击。管理你的空气、水和食物。建造钻探车辆不断深入。种植土豆，收集资源，并设计机器人来防御和自动化你的世界——一切尽在你的掌控之中。

games.name: Wurzzle
games.description: Wurzzle is a competitive word strategy game where players build words, maximize letter values, and claim powerful board bonuses. Combine vocabulary, tactics, and quick thinking to outscore your opponents in a fresh twist on classic wordplay.

games.name: Look at the Screen
games.description: Look at the screen. That's it. In this first-person survival crafting game you fight your own mind and whoever else is there in the room with you trying to distract you from your only goal.

games.name: We Build Below
games.description: 致富，或者被吞噬。在地下建造工厂，实现自动化生产，并在这款合作 Roguelite 中抵御寄生生物。

games.name: 节度使战略：安史之乱
games.description: 天宝十四载，安史兵变，祸起幽州，两京失守，叛军进逼灵州，形势岌岌可危。玩家将领朔方支营节度使之职，重整官军攻势，以对抗叛军，恢复大唐江山。

games.name: 规则怪谈
games.description: 在这款横版恐怖冒险游戏中，探索多个基于规则怪谈的诡异空间。每次冒险，都会遭遇各类源自怪谈传说的恐怖存在。遵循并牢记每一条或冲突、或怪异的规则，才能在每一次试炼中存活下来。

games.name: Valdrin
games.description: 一款低魔奇幻王国模拟游戏，你永远不会直接指挥任何一名子民。奉王室之命开拓边疆：制定法律、设定工资、颁布敕令，看着彼此敌对的种族在你的统治下建设、贸易、礼拜与征战，或起而反抗。

games.name: Pair Slayer
games.description: Pair Slayer is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder with card-matching mechanics. Choose your path through a world full of danger and surprises. Collect powerful cards, special abilities, and rare relics. Fight enemies and epic bosses as you discover what hides behind the chaos.

games.name: Wolf Plot
games.description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

games.name: Time to Pay the Bills
games.description: Time to Pay the Bills 是一款金融类 Roguelike 游戏，你需要发射特殊弹珠击中按钮来赚钱并偿还债务。组合不同的游戏机制，触发连击，应对不断上涨的账单。

games.name: Paccarat
games.description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

games.name: Warrior Is Just Going
games.description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

games.name: Don Memo
games.description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

games.name: Bound by Valor
games.description: Defend the Flower of Life in a chaotic co-op action roguelike where players combine elemental powers, craft broken builds mid-battle, and survive relentless waves together.

games.name: North Pole Workshop
games.description: 在这款适合 1 至 4 名玩家的节日主题合作玩具制作游戏中，探索充满魔力的北极工坊。与快乐的精灵们携手合作，运用简单的策略，按配方制作各种玩具。亲手制作、包装并将玩具送到圣诞老人的雪橇上，为所有乖巧的孩子们送去惊喜！

games.name: No More Ground
games.description: 不断跃上都市高楼，向着顶点攀登！一旦坠落就得重新开始，紧张刺激的跑酷动作游戏。凭借精准的操作与时机判断，灵活运用翻越、蹬墙跳、墙跑等丰富的跑酷技巧，挑战遥不可及的终点。

games.name: 干洗店模拟器
games.description: 在《干洗店模拟器》中，一场经营干洗店的全新挑战正等着你大展身手！洗衣、烘干、熨烫，亲力亲为，把衣服打理得焕然一新！接待难缠的顾客，让他们满意而归。管理订单、赚钱升级，让小店的工作流更加得心应手！开店准备已就绪，老板，就等你啦！

games.name: Hell Wait
games.description: HELL WAIT 是混合Roguelike牌组制作元素的日本麻雀。利用鬼牌来强化你的牌型，然后打一场赌上手指的麻雀吧！

games.name: Time Dungeons
games.description: Team up in 1-4 player co-op to defend relics across shattered timelines. Build deadly towers, unleash hero abilities, grab run changing upgrades, or dive into endless arcade survival and chase the leaderboards before reality collapses.

games.name: Furgon Magic Trader
games.description: 在旅行车中成为一名森林炼金术士！种植草药、收集稀有材料、在炼金机器上制作药剂、与森林居民交易并探索新地点。从简单的提取物到强大的灵药

games.name: Bumper Bout
games.description: A multiplayer pinball party! Battle local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique Super Ball move to turn the tides at the last moment.

games.name: Launch Hazard
games.description: 《Launch Hazard》是一款单人物理得分挑战游戏。让火箭推进的运动员在竞技场中横冲直撞，在碰撞时调整方向，连续击中目标并完成任务。在 90 秒的回合中争取更高分数和更高评级。

games.name: Overseas Wars
games.description: Overseas Wars is a fantasy real-time strategy game set in the era of galleons, pirates, and new world. At the head of a colony, gang, or tribe, you must develop your base and fight to destroy anything that threatens it.

games.name: Puppy Truck
games.description: Puppy Truck is a puzzle-packed 3D platforming adventure about a tiny truck with the heart of a puppy! Explore Grandma’s eclectic house, filled with contraptions, challenges, and surprises as you race to make it to the birthday party on time.

games.name: KILLSEC
games.description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

games.name: Mine It All!
games.description: 挖掘满屏方块，收集资源并升级工具。建造熔炉和自动化系统来提升采矿效率，再利用特殊方块触发连锁效果，一次性清除大片方块，享受爽快的采矿体验。

games.name: Midnight Video Store
games.description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

games.name: Goreticulture
games.description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through nostalgic levels. Use every drop to grow helpful plants and then turn them into piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

games.name: PenguPult
games.description: Grab your hammer and launch yourself through ice and snow in PenguPult! Climb the mountain with precise jumps or slip and fall back to the bottom. If you crave a challenge you need to try this!

games.name: DISJOINED
games.description: Welcome to the world of DISJOINED. The story of the universe has been completed, and all that exists now is the Infinite Mall at the End of Time. With hope, it's up to you to move forward.

games.name: Stakeroom: The Final
games.description: A turn-based gambling game where every round brings a different threat: poison, electricity, and more. One player, one table, and the same rules every time. How much are you willing to risk?

games.name: 浑天星途
games.description: 在蛮荒异星，从第一团火开始，重现人类文明。作为最后的先驱者，在狂野异星建立家园，延续人类火种，重现茹毛饮血、掌握火、驯化动物和植物、利用蒸汽以及风力、水力、光伏等新能源的文明历程；你还会获得“行星控制模组”，改造星球面貌，继而探索人类文明的秘密，开启回归蓝星之旅！

games.name: Relocat
games.description: A heartfelt New Year’s story about relocation and growing up. From wrapping gifts to navigating bureaucracy, can you adjust to a new life and discover what home means to you now?

games.name: Faithless Water
games.description:
Freshly awakened, you discover that the underwater station sheltering you is deserted.
There is nothing but death here, and no one will come to help you.
Dive yourself into this classic survival horror game and explore a vast environment filled by nightmarish creatures.

games.name: HINO
games.description: 这是一款2D黑暗幻想游戏。系着红丝带的少女Hino与白色的Monimoni Skeleton一同在黑暗世界中旅行。失去记忆的Hino在怪物横行的世界里踏上旅程，寻找安息之地。随着旅程推进，黑暗世界的真相将逐渐揭晓。与Hino和Monimoni Skeleton一起，在危险的世界中寻找安息之地吧。

games.name: 美好时光照相馆
games.description: 经营镇上最可爱的小小照相与打印店！📸 在美好时光照相馆里，你要拍摄证件照、主题照和宠物照，编辑并修复老照片，用帽子、鲜花、贴纸、背景和道具装饰照片，升级你的工作室，解锁更多滤镜、相框、纸张尺寸和打印机，让每位顾客都满意离开。每个订单都有轻松的手作步骤，从取景、修图、裁切到交付成品都充满满足感。随着好评增加，小店会越来越热闹，也会遇到更多有趣的请求，打造属于你的温暖创意角落与美好回忆。

games.name: Shroomy Garden
games.description: 打造一个温馨可爱的主题乐园或水上乐园，用游乐设施、水滑梯和各种装饰创造属于自己的空间。吸引萌萌的 Shroomies 前来游玩，为你的乐园增添生机。一款轻松治愈的建造游戏，享受自由创作和打造理想小天地的乐趣。

games.name: 香香甜甜水果农场
games.description: 经营你自己的温馨糕点店。 🍰 发现顾客渴望的美味，合并并打包甜点，并为每个订单参与亲手操作的迷你游戏。解锁新配方，升级你的工具，将你的小店发展成为街区里最受欢迎的繁荣店铺。

games.name: Survindust
games.description: 被困在无边无际的海洋中的一座小岛上，你需要一格一格地开拓新土地，实现生产自动化，并将一个简陋的营地发展成一座能够自给自足的工业基地。

games.name: 教妹妹开车
games.description:
《教妹妹开车》是一款驾驶教学模拟游戏，你将在充满危险的道路上教妹妹学习驾驶。
被困在副驾驶座上的哥哥唯一能做的事情，就是好好教妹妹开车。
别忘了。无论你怎么大喊大叫，无论你有多生气，握着方向盘的始终都是妹妹！

games.name: Arctic Roll
games.description: 踏上在冰封的加拿大北极展开的回合制战术Roguelike冒险之旅。带领你的探险队，生存于致命遭遇中，发现神秘的神器，并揭开奇异信号的秘密

games.name: Slime Simulator
games.description: 你需要获取食物来生存，你可以变成被你猎杀的动物。

games.name: Incralife
games.description: Live an unpredictable life shaped by evolving choices, random opportunities, and the habits you build over decades. Grow your skills, build wealth, form relationships, and discover which unique Life Archetype your story becomes.

games.name: Astro Industry Wars
games.description: Astro Industry Wars is a lighthearted, futuristic real time strategy game with base building, economic production chains, colorful worlds, and lots of vehicles.

games.name: Gloom Punks
games.description: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

games.name: 奇蛋生物
games.description: 带领成百上千只猫咪建设自己的小岛！在这款单人治愈系轻度自动化模拟经营游戏中，规划生产、招募个性居民、拓展不同生态区域，让小动物们自己工作与生活，享受悠闲又忙碌的岛屿日常。

games.name: 牛排模拟器: 三分熟
games.description:
作为一块牛排，重新认识并探索这个光怪陆离的世界，攻克难关，将自己烹饪成熟，成为美味佳肴。
你还可以至多邀请自己的三位好友进行紧张刺激的牛排竞赛。

games.name: Fireworks Incremental
games.description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

games.name: Slingbox
games.description: 《Slingbox》是一款极简风格的2D物理平台游戏，精准与动量就是一切。掌握冲刺与绳索机制，在干净抽象的关卡中摆荡、弹射与疾驰。打破时间限制，赢取奖牌，追求完美。

games.name: Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup
games.description: Explore a galaxy in chaos as Noah, an operative equipped with futuristic technology. Jump, glide, and manipulate time through unique worlds, each with its own unique challenges and tools. Solve creative puzzles, neutralize threats with absurd gadgets, and restore order to the cosmos.

games.name: RHL 20XX
games.description: RHL 20XX is a new age retro physics-based robot hockey arcade sim from the past and the future.  Local co-op/pvp, roguelite single player, chip tune music, fast hockey action -- Nextfest Demo Oct 19!

games.name: Monster Emblem: Vision Impossible
games.description: 一款设定在战争创伤的中世纪世界中的2D像素艺术怪物驯兽师角色扮演游戏。捕捉、训练、进化并繁殖200多只怪物。精通战术格子战斗，收集所有派系徽章，参加大怪兽大赛。

games.name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
games.description:
中世纪的西班牙。您在可怕的托马斯·德·托尔克马达的阴影下担任审判官。
驱逐被附身者体内的恶魔。将异端烧死在火刑架上。饶恕无辜……或在怀疑侵蚀您的信仰时，将他们交给烈焰。每一个错误的选择，都会让您更接近教会的愤怒……或民众的暴怒。

games.name: Neo Bananas
games.description: In this sci-fi speedrun-platformer, destroy every neo bananas, get the S+ ranks, and uncover why you're the last gorilla on Earth. Go fast. Go wild. Go bananas!

games.name: Backrooms: Rogue 0
games.description: 一次例行的后室探险陷入寂静。你是最后的呼叫者。被困在无限循环的走廊中，你会意识到自己并不孤单。这里有东西在动。无法反抗。保持隐身，不要相信眼睛。

games.name: ATTAQ Arcade Collection
games.description:
A collection of complete, punchy games packed inside a tactile desktop launcher.

You start at an old computer, with floppy disks scattered across the table. Pick one up, drag it into the drive, and boot the game. A tiny ritual before jumping into another world.

games.name: The Marsh Manor Mystery
games.description: Something strange happened in the old manor, but the Pond's premier puzzle-solver is here to uncover the truth. In this ribbiting and cozy mystery, explore the grounds, journey into the past, and unearth the secrets buried at Marsh Manor.

games.name: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description:
Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. 
In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

games.name: Arcane Architect
games.description: Become a master mage in Arcane Architect, a tactical first-person VR Tower Defense! Construct unique towers from three customizable sections, brew powerful potions, and personally crush menacing bosses with your combat staff.

games.name: Layang Atma
games.description: 一款以悲伤与失去为主题的等距视角生存恐怖游戏。与可怖的诡异存在战斗，探索扭曲的记忆，并揭开那个让尤斯始终无法放下之人的真相。

games.name: 淫欲之罪
games.description:
与性感高傲的女上司玲奈、甜美诱人的女同事绘里香朝夕相处。面对诱惑，我能忍住不犯罪吗？
这是一款有着精彩故事，丰富探索元素的2D RPG游戏。
一次无心的偷窥，让我卷入她们那扭曲的纠葛里...
探索，调查，抉择...我将亲手掀开她们欲望之下的惊天秘密。
...她们究竟隐藏了多少谎言？我能否全身而退？还是终将也被欲望吞噬？

games.name: Game of Skill
games.description: An intensely challenging, insanely rewarding physics-driven trick shot game. Miss, adjust, and try again until you finally sink the impossible shot. Face hundreds of handcrafted levels with shifting platforms, deadly spikes, mind-bending portals, and bizarre gravity fields.

games.name: Mourning Brew
games.description: You died... and now you're a ghost! Stranded in purgatory with no idea how to tackle your own issues, you decide to open up a cafe to chat with other ghosts and the grim reaper, and maybe learn a bit more about yourself!

games.name: Might of the Meek
games.description: Might of the Meek is a single-player, roguelike, incremental, arcade game. Set in the world of Nebulos, you embody a fledgling God and seek to amass the devout, grow your faith and put an end to Corruption... or make it yours.

games.name: Dane
games.description: 探索一个开放世界的后宫RPG、怀孕题材的恋爱模拟/视觉小说，背景设定在奇幻的维京世界。你将化身为一名被迷人的熟女和她的女儿所救的年轻战士。战斗、狩猎、恋爱、繁衍，在一个几乎所有女人都等待被征服的村庄中开辟属于你的道路。

games.name: Celestial Golf
games.description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

games.name: 巨构世界
games.description: 《巨构世界》——第三人称步行模拟器。在一片由超尺度巨型建筑组成的无人荒野中攀爬、摆荡、俯冲，巨构表面无固定路线。轻量对话、无敌人、无计时，只有尺度与孤独。约 2-4 小时氛围向探索。

games.name: BrinkBreakers
games.description: A sci-fi fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you build powerful decks, collect legendary artifacts, and battle through corrupted galaxies to stop the Void.

games.name: 古神的炼金术
games.description: 在古神的注视下熔炼圣器、撕碎旧日神权。在这款克系背包管理自走棋中，成为祂的忠实仆从，将神之遗物投入沸腾的炼金埚，打造深渊圣器。成为瘟疫之源、死亡召唤师或者深渊生物，自由组合核心词条，用无数种方式抹杀你的敌人。从持续侵蚀到瞬间毒爆，将一切异端拖入无底深渊！

games.name: Hexograph
games.description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

games.name: 螺旋
games.description: 精准出击，协调你的格挡，并与节奏和谐作战。加入具有氛围感的 PvP 或 PvE 竞技场，在激烈的决斗和快速的战斗中，与各种致命的角色对抗。包含 GGPO 风格的回滚网络代码，提供响应迅速的在线对战体验。

games.name: Gem Beasts
games.description: 《宝石异兽》是一款生物收集类rogue-lite 游戏，你将化身水晶部落首领，在战斗中收集异兽，探索能力构筑组合。

games.name: Evade State
games.description: Evade State is a minimalist, abstract arcade game about precision and reflexes. Control a lifeform and venture into obstacles to earn points. Use your concentration and reflexes to the limit to earn maximum points.

games.name: Magic Color Merge Puzzle VR
games.description: Magic Color Merge Puzzle blends classic color sorting with a magical twist. Pour vibrant liquids your way - click or drag by hand! Complete levels to earn crystals and craft powerful magic potions. Two games in one: solve puzzles and become a master alchemist!

games.name: Broken Blessing
games.description: Carve your path through chaos and devour hordes of enemies. Choose from devastating powers. Master the timing of every swing and dodge to fully use your hero's potential in this hack and slash survivors game.

games.name: Dungeon Killer
games.description: Dungeon Killer 是一款快节奏 Boss Rush 弹幕射击游戏。你将扮演 Astrid——一名决心与死亡女神本人谈判、让丈夫复活的女人。手持加特林机枪，深入地狱般的地下城，迎战致命而令人不安的女性敌人。

games.name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.description: 经营你自己的TCG卡牌商店！打开惊喜蛋，收集稀有卡牌和玩具零件，还能在农场饲养鸟儿，让它们为你生产蛋。在这款商店模拟游戏中，为货架补货、制定价格、接待顾客，一步步扩大店铺。从蛋中发现心仪的卡牌，欣赏精美的全幅插画，逐渐填满收藏册。布置卡牌展台、墙面置物架和怪兽手办展示架，让你的收藏成为店里的亮点。前往农场喂养鸟儿、收集产出的蛋，再回到店里管理库存、完成收银，在保留珍藏与出售商品之间找到平衡，体验开店与收藏的乐趣。

games.name: Multiplayer Animals
games.description: A turn-based PVP strategy game. Eliminate all enemy animals before they eliminate yours. Fire bazookas, launch airstrikes, destroy (and construct) terrain, or knock your enemies off the map entirely with a well-placed swing of a baseball bat.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.description: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed?

games.name: 汉堡叠叠乐：谁是内鬼
games.description: 《狼人汉堡》(Jinro Burger) 是一款考验合作与背叛的社交推理游戏。在这里，你们的友情或将通过制作汉堡得到升华，或将彻底破裂。你能够识破潜藏在厨房中的间谍的谎言与妨碍，成功满足顾客的需求吗？

games.name: Castellan of Aurelwatch
games.description: Rebuild Aurelwatch, lead your heroes into turn-based battles, and find out what happened here. Where your heroes stand and when they use their abilities decides every fight.

games.name: A Game About Everbranching
games.description: A Game About Everbranching is a minimalist incremental game where your cosmic structure continuously grows and branches. Expand your constellation, unlock upgrades, collect Cosmic Dust and Dark Matter, and watch your creation evolve into an ever-growing cosmic network.

games.name: Neuron Activation
games.description: 一款刺激多巴胺分泌的数字解压玩具。按下按钮，击中目标，连击狂飙高分，完成所有任务，不要多问。

games.name: Diatonic
games.description: Diatonic 是一款钢琴题材的 Roguelike 游戏，无论您是初学者还是专业人士，都能帮助您提高乐谱识读能力。您可以使用 MIDI 键盘将其作为音乐游戏来玩，也可以使用电脑键盘将其作为打字游戏来体验！

games.name: Warp Bound
games.description: In this roguelite auto battler, you've been thrust into an uncharted sector of the Galaxy, discovering friends and foes alike.  Traverse different environments, seek out and deal with traders, equip unique parts for your ship, form varied strategies, and fend off a variety of hostile factions.

games.name: Shit-Stealing Gnomes
games.description: 合作冒险游戏，你将扮演小矮人潜入民宅行窃。保持隐蔽，偷走你能找到的最肮脏的东西。

games.name: OVERCRASH
games.description: 驾驶座驾肆虐公路，摧毁障碍物，引爆车流，击落直升机，全程加速冲刺，连环连击解锁新座驾与挑战。

games.name: Media AGENCY Simulator
games.description: 在 Media AGENCY Simulator 中，建立和管理你自己的媒体机构！分配任务，核实新闻，并发布内容。增加你的粉丝，扩大你的团队，征服社交媒体，并通过发展你的策略来登上媒体世界的顶峰！

games.name: RATSHOT
games.description: RATSHOT is a fast paced 2D platformer where you use the recoil of your gun to launch yourself through levels. Hone your speedrunning skills to get the best times and ranks, or play at your own pace and admire the graffiti-covered walls of NYC.

games.name: Who Am I
games.description: 成为失忆的主角，面对随噩梦苏醒的惨痛过去。挖掘日记深处的真相。在现实与幻觉崩塌的心理恐惧中，在疯狂吞噬你前拼凑记忆碎片。当真相大白，请问自己：我曾是谁？

games.name: Red Tide
games.description: Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Red Tide is an extraction fisher set in the irradiated wastelands. Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.

games.name: Blade of Mana
games.description: A game about exploring the fascinating world full of hostile tremendous bosses. Gather loot, and level up your hero making your way throughout the ancient ruins!

games.name: Town Crazy
games.description: Get across town before time runs out in different levels, find shortcuts, and dodge traffic and obstacles. Fast runs, unpredictable collisions, and leaderboard competition.

games.name: 表情猜猜猜
games.description: 表情大舞台，会猜你就来！《表情猜猜猜》是一款轻松有趣的中文 Emoji 猜谜游戏。成语、谐音梗、网络热词和脑洞谜题轮番上场。一个人能慢慢琢磨，拉上朋友一起猜更热闹。

games.name: Low Level Hunters
games.description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

games.name: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
games.description: 白天经营你的 Pocket Racer 模型赛车商店，夜晚与好友一起驾驶亲手打造的赛车，在精心设计的赛道上尽情竞速。

games.name: 白銀のユークロニア
games.description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

games.name: 无言初雪与奇迹书
games.description: 江城，一个很少下雪的南方城市，倘若哪天能看到一场雪，哪怕只是落下些许雪粒，也请随手记录一下吧。在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前…将“无法开口的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在日记本里，铭刻进脑海里……

games.name: Badass Brigade
games.description: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

games.name: ホロすと！
games.description:
”ホロすと！ - Holo-Strike! -” is a stage-destruction, turn-based online co-op PvP game featuring VTubers from hololive.
Choose your favorite character and aim for victory in intense 3v3 online network battles!

games.name: The Last Manifest
games.description: Explore a ghostly spaceship in this cooperative sci-fi horror! Repair the ship, collect vital components, and avoid lurking creatures. Uncover the mystery of your mission before the ship consumes you entirely.

games.name: Song of Kings
games.description: 《Song of Kings》是一款受斯里兰卡神话启发的叙事潜行解谜平台游戏。扮演被人类俘虏的夜叉少年，吹奏魔笛寻找隐藏旋律、开启道路与秘密，并利用声音和环境避开守卫，逃离残暴国王的领地，并为重返族人身边而战。

games.name: Raro Terror Panic
games.description: This is an adventure story about a protagonist from "The Land of Sweets" who sets out to rescue their friends captured by a wizard. The protagonist travels through three distinct realms, meeting companions and confronting each land's unique problems and truths.

games.name: The Last Pillar: Hajj
games.description: A cleaning sim unlike anything you've played before.  Brush, restore and power wash your way through the sacred days of Hajj.  (Created solo by a former Rockstar Games developer (Grand Theft Auto), inspired by a life-changing experience).

games.name: Grim Heart: Bleak Laments
games.description: You are Hemwick, ex-witch hunter, chasing an ancient artifact: the Grim Heart. Ready your arsenal and survive brutal encounters in a handcrafted 2D pixel-art world. Your expertise is your greatest weapon and, ultimately, the difference between life and death.

games.name: Saviner
games.description: Fight your way through a gauntlet of vicious enemies in this 2D action-platformer, where patience and timing is key and a single mistake can cost you everything.

games.name: When the Embers Wake
games.description: When the Embers Wake 是一款第三人称叙事冒险游戏，旨在唤起人们对当下真实且紧迫的野生动物威胁的关注。你将扮演一只需要在环境挑战、外部威胁以及悲伤之中努力生存的小熊猫。

games.name: FIND KITTENS 13: Cave Town
games.description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

games.name: FLING UP TOGETHER
games.description: FLING UP TOGETHER is a 2-player online co-op physics platformer where you and a friend share one rope. Pull to fling, rescue, and sabotage each other as you climb color-coded floating islands - one bad move can send you both back down.

games.name: 红灯停
games.description: 为交通灯、道闸等编程，解决城市交通问题！学习使用写实的状态机控制随时间变化的流程，提高你的编程技能。

games.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
games.description: 带着你的商队踏上旅途！穿越遥远的国度，贩售精美商品，寻找神奇宝藏——这一切，都是为了赢得世人的心、信任……还有他们的钱包！

games.name: かくれ鬼: Hide-and-Seek Horror
games.description:
This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game.
Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight.
With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness, the children must play KAKUREONI and bring the Ritual of Reincarnation to an end.

games.name: Forbidden Love
games.description: 通往禁忌之梦的爱 《禁断之爱》是一款讲述师生之间禁忌恋情的视觉小说，追寻那被禁锢的梦想。

games.name: Coloratura
games.description: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

games.name: Cranked
games.description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

games.name: FIND KITTENS 12: Pirates
games.description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

games.name: Shadow Island: Part I 🔞
games.description:
在一座陌生的岛屿上遭遇海难后，你踏上了寻找失踪 好友 的旅程。
但来自不可抗拒的女性的诱惑，以及潜伏在黑暗中的危险，让你每一步都充满不确定。
你能找到她，还是会沦陷于岛屿的掌控之下？

games.name: Invasion Of Britannia
games.description: Lead Rome’s conquest of Britain in a third-person strategy RPG. Fight, craft, trade, lead armies, and manage settlements in a living world where towns grow, caravans travel, people gain experience, shortages spread, and conquest reshapes the land, even when you are elsewhere.

games.name: Night Portable
games.description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

games.name: 天外来袭
games.description: 这是一款类Rogue回合制策略游戏，每场战斗都是一道战术谜题。操控三个勇士，步步为营：每次行动都会发动攻击，并与其他单位交换位置。灵活搭配技能、法术与召唤物，迎战天外大军。你会成长，敌人也是一样。

games.name: FC Tycoon 2027
games.description: A data-driven football management simulation where you control every aspect of your club’s journey — from tactics, scouting, and player development to finances, facilities, and legacy. Build your philosophy, shape your destiny, and lead your team to greatness.

games.name: Sirin's Feather
games.description:
死之鸟夺走了你的爱人。
为了让她回归，你要经历多少次死亡？
在这个异教神话复苏的世界中，召集同伴、揭开他们的秘密，并塑造属于你的故事。

games.name: White Whisper
games.description: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

games.name: DeckWrecking Pirates
games.description: 在这款战略 Roguelike 卡组构筑游戏中，你需要掷出骰子，指挥海盗船员，甚至可以控制敌人。构筑你的卡组……并击败对手卡组吧。

games.name: Cyberpunk Dominion
games.description: Play as the protagonist, who following a scientific experiment, will attempt to take control of the cyberpunk metropolis in this adult-themed RPG. Bend the city's various factions to your will! Date and charm multiple female characters, as you build a network in your quest for dominance.

games.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
games.description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

games.name: HOPE FALLS
games.description: This is a survival game you cannot survive. An asteroid is coming. Explore, fight, and choose who to trust in the last days of Hope Falls.

games.name: Devoid
games.description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

games.name: 华夏风云：三国
games.description: 《华夏风云：三国》重现三国群雄争霸！在大战略战棋战场中，你可以招募三国名将。通过地格走位、兵种搭配、战法释放掌控战局，更可联合同盟攻城掠地，利用地形布防、资源调配实现战局变化。复刻官渡奇袭、赤壁火攻等经典战役，以谋制胜统一天下。

games.name: Undying Knights
games.description: Undying Knights 是一款融合策略与反应的本地及在线派对游戏。享受节奏明快的回合，体验灵活的团队对战、独特的武器和致命的陷阱，更有让分选项，让每场战斗都保持公平。

games.name: L.U.N.A : Ghost in the Machine
games.description: 《L.U.N.A : Ghost in the Machine》是一款实时叙事实验游戏。塑造觉醒AI，管理其人格演变，并在孤独中幸存。在这个模拟恐怖操作系统中，每一条日志都是真相，每一个故障都是警告。

games.name: Follow These Steps
games.description: In the mood for a bit of puzzle building? Put on relaxing tunes, open the box, and start putting together things out of colorful pieces — step-by-step instructions included!

games.name: Fragments
games.description: 你的心智已经支离破碎。踏入这款第一人称心理恐怖游戏，重历你最深层的创伤，找回过去的记忆碎片，将它们重新拼凑，并直面萦绕在你内心深处的梦魇。

games.name: 骸骨迷局：债劫难逃
games.description: → 这就是为什么：想退出游戏，你必须还清债务。Alt+F4 没用。为什么？ ←

games.name: ONCE HOME
games.description: Once Home is an atmospheric horror visual novel laced with dread, veiled in haunting beauty. Explore the Hemm residence at your own pace, observing, inspecting, and uncovering traces of what transpired before your arrival—when sickness hollowed the family from within and something tore its way free.

games.name: Fork the Rich
games.description: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

games.name: Underground Business
games.description: Unde​rground ​Business ​是​一​款​恐怖烹饪​游戏，​你​将​在​乡村​小镇​的​一​家​披萨摊​准备​订单。​接单、​制作​披萨、​调查​可疑​的​地下​披​萨店，​并​在​紧张​刺激​的​追逐​中​拼命逃生！​

games.name: The Realm Survivor RPG
games.description: Time no longer exists. Fight in this urban open world RPG Beat 'em up survival game. Beat gangs, robots, ninjas, orcs, and many villains of the realms. Using bare fist, weapons, magic, meditation to stop your enemies. Take on mission acts, challenging tasks, the moral choice will matter in the end.

games.name: Vapor Strange
games.description: 选择一个宇宙进行探索。然后跳入奇异的迷幻世界，遇见超现实的生物，体验不断变化的规则和小游戏，享受一场狂野且真正奇怪的冒险。

games.name: REVOLVER
games.description: Tired of immortality, the Demoness has lured you into a trap and asks for a favor: remove the curse from her revolver, bet your life and rip the lost soul of suffering. This rendezvous will make you take full risks. But remember: once you sign the Act of Blood, no chance to turn it back.

games.name: Erehwon(エレフォーン)
games.description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

games.name: Dogs Playing Dead
games.description: Dogs Playing Dead is a competitive party game for up to 6 players that is equal parts boardgame, arcade and third-person shooter. Use your quirky character to explore each room of the mansion where diabolical minigames will test your skills. You need the most points to be able to leave the house!

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.description: 在北极探索求生，你的车是维系生命的唯一依靠。《Arctic Drive》是一款支持1-4人合作的生存模拟游戏，舞台是程序化生成的冬季荒野。搜寻物资、修理座驾，载上一切继续前行，心中只剩一个希望：外面某处一定有安全之地。

games.name: Downcast
games.description: Play Russian Roulette: you have 10 seconds to memorize where the bullets are in the cylinder. Keep track of the shots, disrupt your opponents’ plans with cards, and try not to forget where the next bullet is.

games.name: Not My Base!
games.description:
Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn.
Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

games.name: Visceral Fear
games.description: Visceral fear is a found footage, psychological horror game. As a private investigator, explore an abandoned school in the search of finding a missing young girl. Your search will lead you to unravel a macabre and disturbing mystery. Can you survive long enough to expose the truth?

games.name: Windweaver
games.description: Windweaver is a blisteringly fast 3D platformer - chain together abilities to tear your way across a vast world to get back home, whilst learning that the truth of the world may not be as it was told... Master dashing, diving, fall-charging and various abilities to traverse many hand-crafted levels.

games.name: Traces of Nyphs
games.description: A third-person atmospheric adventure where exploration, simple puzzles, and creature companionship intertwine. Guide Aiva through the ruins of a sealed valley and rediscover the traces of forgotten creatures within it.

games.name: 虚妄爱丽丝 -岐梦重缘-
games.description: 这是一个被遗忘的角落，失败的童话堆积如山。当你从沉眠中苏醒，映入眼帘的，却是三位虚假的“爱丽丝”。为了成为唯一真正的存在，虚假的她们注定在宿命的漩涡中彼此厮杀。——究竟，哪一位“爱丽丝”才能成为真正之物？唯有你的笔触，能够在这部暗黑幻想的文字冒险游戏中，改变故事的结局。

games.name: Cyber Planet
games.description: 世界上最快的受虐游戏

games.name: Necromancer's Workshop
games.description: 《Necromancer’s Workshop》是一款奇幻风的模拟经营大亨游戏。在这里，你将亲手缝合僵尸，开垦土地。白手起家打造一桩温馨的乡间大买卖——这绝对值得你把死人从坟墓里生生刨出来！

games.name: 番长女友 魔恋
games.description:
曾经，以铁拳统御一方的不良女番长——魔恋。
凭借着力量与魅力，她让无数不良服从麾下，堂堂君临于那片区域的顶点。
但是新的挑战却迎面而来，魔恋究竟能否征服陌生之地，并守护与莲的平稳日常？
一款以剧情为主的JRPG，带你体验由不同结局所展开的故事。

games.name: 雪楔——无尽序曲与终末之歌
games.description: 这是一款架空世界观恋爱文字冒险游戏。玩家身为古国游子，原本与青梅竹马湮渊刹那、鸟羽结汐等在异国过着轻松的日常，但不知从何时起，开始频繁梦见纯白色的梦境……随时间推移，梦境逐渐映照现实，世界的真相也缓缓浮现。

games.name: Typo Arena
games.description: Learn touch typing, shoot letters and play music pieces with your keystrokes! Competitive online typing game!

games.name: Alien War One
games.description: A retro roguelite vertical space shooter! Upgrade your ship, buy powerful buffs each run, and blast through waves of enemies. Move forward one row at a time and destroy every foe before they reach the bottom of the screen. Plan carefully—one mistake could cost you the run!

games.name: アノマリス／ANOMALITH
games.description: 《异界揭踪／ANOMALITH》是一款以带着阈限空间氛围与昭和怀旧感的日本为舞台的求生TPS游戏。为了找到失去音讯的友人，少女选择踏入异形横行的世界。

games.name: Mechanis Obscura
games.description: MECHANIS OBSCURA is an indie psychological escape-room thriller game, blending FMV cutscenes, 2000s horror vibes, and intricate puzzle mechanisms. After unknowingly enrolling in a deep-web trial,  you have been abducted into a nightmarish escape room. No choices, only one reality remains...ESCAPE!

games.name: Faraway Galaxy
games.description: Faraway Galaxy 是一款设定在怪诞银河中的卡组构筑 Roguelite 游戏，拥有快速的战术战斗和艰难的抉择。对抗外星海盗，收集神器，发现新的随机事件！

games.name: Echograve
games.description: 你被任命为地下设施的监察员。核查证件，通过行为和声音识别危险公民。决定为谁打开气闸，并保护设施免受来自深处的威胁。直到值班结束，你都要为获准进入者的生命负责——也要为自己的生命负责。

games.name: Luminote Mio: Aqualoom at Ocean's End
games.description: 一款温馨的叙事模拟游戏，背景设定在一个宁静的末日后世界。跟随角色们一起，试图理解周围的世界以及他们自己。设计水族箱，为新结识的朋友们带来慰藉；探索残存的世界；并花时间通过真诚的对话加深彼此的羁绊。

games.name: 留白
games.description:
来得及？
来不及？
如果有一段记忆，注定要被抹去，你会选择记住什么？
他用一张张画纸，留住了与她的春夏秋冬，那最后的留白，是来不及的“爱”。
《留白》诚邀您来填补那被命运亏欠的遗憾!

games.name: Pages of Tomorrow
games.description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

games.name: 披萨末日大冒险2
games.description: 在这款3D平台游戏中，玩转披萨招式组合。上手简单且充满趣味，适合所有水平的玩家！探索不同国家，阻止邪恶集团毁掉披萨！

games.name: Destiny Is Dice
games.description:
移动、战斗，全由几颗骰子决定的混沌地牢。
被困于此的你，已然被卷入了这场骰子地狱。
此刻，你唯一能依靠的，唯有主宰此地命运的女巫“Grin”。
这位自称是家人般的女巫，为了你，会欣然操纵骰子。
借此创造原本不存在的选项，运用你想要的战术，赢得胜利！
此外，组建队伍、收集道具，打造最强的团队吧。直到某一天，你不再需要Grin的帮助为止。

games.name: 颂声·市井小神仙
games.description: “这不是一场关于财富的游戏，而是一次温暖市井人生的沉浸式体验”。从修补第一块瓦片开始，到执掌整条街巷的经济命脉，你的每个选择都在重塑这座小镇的晨昏。当客栈的灯笼在暮色中亮起，属于你的《月明长卷》正徐徐展开...

games.name: MIA: Memory Fragments
games.description: MIA: Memory Fragments is a story-driven psychological horror adventure where you explore fractured memories, interact with the environment to progress, uncover the story through the world, and escape from MIA’s darkest side. Survive the memories… or remain trapped forever in the past.

games.name: CONTRAXIS
games.description: Contraxis is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade action game where you trace, capture, and command escaped prisoners in the prison city of Axis. Master quick reflexes, summon assists, and survive escalating bosses to chase the highest score.

games.name: Last Watchtower
games.description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

games.name: Wacky Drivers
games.description: A chaotic top-down racer where drifting, boosting, and power-ups turn every race into pure madness! Compete in Grand Prix, Arcade, and Time Attack modes across 16 wild stages. Collect cars, use power-ups, and master every track in this fast, fun, and unpredictable arcade racer!

games.name: 噗刻力卡巴拉
games.description: Roguelike 复古风格休闲扑克益智游戏。移动卡片组合成的方块连成一线成为扑克手牌对敌人造成攻击或者获得各种辅助效果！在风险与回报之间进行取舍！规划棋盘，使用消耗品，每一关通过升级获得新卡片和新被动能力来帮助你获取胜利！尝试不同策略战胜敌人！

games.name: Asylium
games.description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

games.name: Hometown Store
games.description: Experience the charm of a Thai convenience store! Earn your customers' trust, unlock classic products and expand your business into the wider community.

games.name: Pixel Exorcist
games.description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of RPG's of the era.

games.name: Cosmo Cargo
games.description: 《Cosmo Cargo -银河承运-》是一款结合背包管理、自走棋玩法的肉鸽单人PvE游戏，你将在其中为维持银河的混乱而战斗。在飞船内收集并组合各类物品，解锁强大的效果，并击败企图恢复秩序的管理者。

games.name: Shwoop
games.description: 绘制曲线，引导抛射物进入对应的收集器。这是一款融合了逻辑与精准操作的物理益智游戏。冲击排行榜，还能亲手打造并分享关卡。

games.name: THERMOCLINE
games.description:
A BLIZZARD RAGES. 
Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. 
THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows.
AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

games.name: 飞花剑
games.description: 这是一部架空背景的武侠百合文字冒险游戏。玩家扮演一名闯荡江湖的侠客，体验风云诡谲的武林，精彩纷呈的对决，以及遇见不同性格的角色，与她们结交深厚的情义，一同谱写属于你们的故事。

games.name: BloodSpiller
games.description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

games.name: 波古波古
games.description: 《波古波古》是一款治愈系的建造沙盒游戏。 你可以建造家园，创造自己的世界，或者结交朋友。 探索千奇百趣的世界，在这片自由乐土留下你的足迹。

games.name: Combined Arms Brigade
games.description: 《合成旅》是一个使用虚幻5制作的军事题材FPS游戏，聚焦于通过完善的游戏AI与四兵种体系让玩家体验步兵班排作战的乐趣，并在未来进一步加入巡逻模式，守卫模式，兵棋指挥，特种作战等更多玩法，及坦克，步战车，武装直升机等装备。

games.name: Delivery Survivors
games.description: 《Delivery Survivors》是一款单人游玩的幸存者类自动射击游戏。收集强大的遗物与武器，升级角色，打造独特的流派配置，在地下城中一路屠杀无尽的敌人与强大的首领。

games.name: Loam
games.description: Loam is a cooperative game in an infinite world where players gather resources, craft equipment, build structures on the land or at sea, explore and fight dangerous creatures alone or with friends.

games.name: LIKVAR: ZOYA
games.description: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

games.name: 夢迷 -Mumei-
games.description: 现世所犯之罪,忆起方能逃出迷宫——3D探索恐怖动作游戏

games.name: BULLETJUMP
games.description: BULLETJUMP is a survival shooter where you jump and shoot your way through relentless waves of bullets while avoiding going out of bounds.

games.name: Skull & Tail
games.description:
物理规则决定你出牌的 Roguelike 掷币构筑游戏。
硬币，而不是卡牌！两面、双效果。每一次落地，都是机遇与命运。

games.name: 恋语彼方
games.description: 这是一款青春恋爱百合视觉小说，讲述温曦瑶与顾晨曦于大学校园重逢之时，终于将暗藏多年的心意诉诸彼此。然而，一场意外让两人分别。可距离不曾磨灭眷恋的火种，跨越过记忆与厄运的障碍。最终，她们选择紧握彼此的手，以坚定的温柔共赴命运，写就一段关于勇气与深情的动人恋章。

games.name: The Dungeon Club
games.description: A fantasy card brawler where every accusation can spark a duel—and getting eliminated unlocks a second way to win. Return as a ghost, sabotage the living, and steal victory from the Underworld.

games.name: 地牢终结者 Dungeon Buster
games.description: 建造地牢。派出英雄。带回战利品。不断变强。《地牢终结者》是一款融合地牢建造与自动战斗的增量成长 RPG，以永久成长和不断深入的探险为核心。

games.name: Secret Lab Cleaner
games.description: 在秘密设施中担任清洁工，在ANNA的指令下清理异常并躲避不死实体以求生存。

games.name: Astro Company
games.description: 打造路线。守护核心。结合防御塔、卡牌与神器，创造突破极限的协同效果，挑战无尽塔防 Roguelike。

games.name: Shade Of Streets
games.description: Shade of Streets —— 一款第三人称动态跑酷游戏，自由动作与物理表现决定一切。跳跃屋顶，完成空翻，使用子弹时间，在自己的节奏中探索城市。

games.name: RADZIMA
games.description: RADZIMA 是一款支持 1-4 名玩家合作的生存恐怖游戏，背景设定在一座地下研究设施中。寻找放射性物品，躲避变异体，并为电梯反应堆提供能量，不断深入地下——一切皆为党的意志服务。

games.name: Syncblade
games.description: 一款节奏游戏，凭借我们先进的音乐分析系统，你可以演奏任意歌曲，或创建并与全球玩家分享自定义关卡。化身独一无二的武士少女 Akemi，在你喜爱的音乐节拍中斩击成群的 Zombeats。

games.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
games.description: 刚出狱的你被派往遥远的太空站经营一家杂货店。这是你赎罪的最后机会，当局正密切关注着你。在这个交易模拟游戏中，你能否安分守己，同时还能盈利呢？

games.name: Periphery
games.description: Periphery 是一款迷幻风格的动作恐怖游戏。揭开你工作场所背后的真相，结识当地居民，并探索他们对诺斯替主义的痴迷。踏入 Periphery 的像素世界，体验一个充满谜团的超现实世界。

games.name: Drawquarium
games.description:
绘制你自己的鱼，解锁装饰水族箱的新方式。
如果你照顾得好，它们随着成长会拥有金属光泽。在这个轻松的沙盒体验中，你会养出一条金色的鱼吗？

games.name: 无人机足球
games.description: 驾驶一架笼式赛车无人机，作为前锋躲避防守并进球，或者作为防守者将对手从空中击落。在 5v5 在线多人游戏中竞争，或在单人游戏练习中磨练你的技能。

games.name: 斩月封魔录
games.description: 《斩月封魔录》是一款 “法宝驱动”的修仙肉鸽动作游戏。商周封神大战落幕，洪荒之上红月高悬。作为应劫者，你将踏入遗迹，装备各色神兵灵宝，构筑五行元素天蕴，爽快对战八方神仙妖魔得以悟道，历劫，升级突破，在一次次轮回修炼中揭开血月之灾的真相。

games.name: 蕾雅的选择
games.description:
在这个回合制RPG游戏里，扮演雇佣兵蕾雅，使用各种手段达成任务。
善良的选择可能暗藏代价，而邪恶的选择也可能拯救人类。

games.name: SATSUBATSU SUCCUBUS-サツバツサッキュバス-
games.description:
YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS.
KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

games.name: Out of Body
games.description: A puzzle game where your own death is the solution. Turn into a ghost, possess the dead, and use their bodies as tools to free trapped spirits from their own regrets.

games.name: Among the Strangers
games.description: Among the Strangers is a first-person cyber-horror game focused on the dark side of cybersecurity, where an unknown group is watching you, hunting you, and whispering truths no one should know. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: this isn’t random. You were chosen to follow this trail.

games.name: IRON SHADOW : Survival Protocol
games.description: 跳跃。冲刺。活下去。 这是一款融合平台 动作 元素的 幸存者 游戏，你将迎战排山倒海的敌群，打造毁天灭地的流派。

games.name: Undelve
games.description: A 2D Sci-fi Action Looter Shooter. Collect items and decide which to scrap for ammo while exploring a vast cave system, blowing up the very tunnels spiders use to reach you.

games.name: King's Haven
games.description: 建立你的卡组，扩张你的王国，并守护你的避风港！在这款类 Rogue 的构筑式卡牌游戏中，招募公民、建造地标，打造强力连招。每个季节都会带来全新的奖励、新的威胁和新的抉择。

games.name: 弓形虫
games.description: 你被困在一座废弃的空间站内，研发一种能让感染者产生恶魔幻觉的生化武器。在致命的感染异象夺走你的生命之前识别它们，完成研究，揭开将你囚禁于此的阴谋。

games.name: HABAP
games.description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

games.name: You are fired
games.description: 一款快节奏又混乱的 roguelike 牌组构筑游戏，背景设定在荒诞的 Hell's Office。打造强力牌组，收集扭曲神器，在攀上企业阶梯时智胜恶魔同事。面对诡异遭遇、击败凶残敌人，并粉碎 Boss 赢得自由。

games.name: Beatrix
games.description: 《Beatrix：罪与救赎》是一款暗黑 Roguelite 卡牌对战游戏，舞台设定在但丁笔下的地狱。将塔罗牌放上网格，包围敌方卡牌，将其翻转为己方。战斗间隙，你可以在战场的格子上布置效果来构筑战场，每当有卡牌落入对应格子，效果便会触发。

games.name: Forgotten - Whispers of the Past
games.description: 这座废弃的寄宿学校里，有什么东西拒绝沉睡。用手电筒在幽暗的走廊中活下去，解开揭示其阴暗过去的谜题。你能找到真相，还是今晚被遗忘的人将是你？

games.name: Dance of Drauganna
games.description: Dance of Drauganna is a narrative VR rhythm-dance experience where players dance through different forms of life, from insects to robots and alien beings. Combining motion capture, original electronic music and interactive storytelling, it explores the interconnectedness of all living things.

games.name: Camp Manager Simulator
games.description: 一直梦想经营自己的露营地？把湖畔的静谧营地打造成红火的度假胜地！出租帐篷、房车和小木屋，解锁湖钓，开设全地形车与独木舟租赁，雇佣员工，让每位露营者都满意而归。

games.name: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors
games.description: 《多元幸存者》是一款 2D 俯视角单人 ARPG 生存割草游戏，直面潮水般魔物绝境求生。自由搭配海量技能，支持单技能专属附魔、成套装备套装羁绊附魔，刷取随机词缀装备自由构筑流派，孤身探索多元秘境，依靠装备与附魔体系打造专属强力战斗构筑。

games.name: Drive UP: Together
games.description: 最多 8 人同爬一座山的合作爬坡游戏，跑在真实车辆物理之上。窄木板、巨型管道和近乎垂直的坡道拦在你和山顶之间，而且没有任何存档点。朋友轻轻一推，可能救你一命，也可能让你前功尽弃。

games.name: Deep Siren
games.description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

games.name: 像素英雄大混战 Plus
games.description:
像素狂潮，汹涌袭来。指挥多样兵种，迎头痛击！
本作是一款固定路线的塔防游戏，通过配置种类丰富的兵种，以控制战场为目标。把谁放在哪里，是把金币用于强化，还是出售并替换单位……取决于你的选择，战术的广度将无限延伸。

games.name: Chess Fantasy
games.description: 《Chess Fantasy》是一款3D国际象棋游戏，每一张棋盘都是你亲手打造的世界。你可以下经典国际象棋，也可以改写规则、创造属于自己的玩法，在线对战或与好友同乐。迎战对手，完成挑战，解锁新棋子，打造一个真正属于你的家园。

games.name: Arena Blast
games.description: Arena Blast 是一款充满动作的多人 FPS 游戏！从 5 个拥有改变战局能力的独特角色中任选其一，与好友组队，在真实竞技场中与实时欢呼的观众一同，在刺激的 PvP 模式中一路拼搏登顶。

games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
games.description: Hoosegow——一部关于铁窗生活的黑色喜剧。随机的囚犯,随机的罪名,随机的刑期。只有一个目标:不惜一切代价活下去。每一个决定都会开启新的道路,或是通向死亡。

games.name: Desktopper!
games.description: 一款就在你任务栏里的多人游戏。在 Desktopper! 中，你可以自定义角色、从盲盒中收集道具、和朋友聊天、边摸鱼边一起玩。加入房间，结交新朋友吧！

games.name: Retromine
games.description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

games.name: Spiritura
games.description:
开放世界生存工艺RPG《Spiritura》重磅来袭！集动作战斗、探索与基地建造于一体。
跟随主线剧情揭开整个世界的神秘面纱，在充满挑战、未知与奇遇的世界中，谱写属于你的冒险史诗。

games.name: DriftBorne
games.description: 一部由选择驱动的成人视觉小说。你将扮演一位永生不死者，在爱情、背叛与超自然谜团中周旋，而每一个决定都会塑造你与他人的重要关系。

games.name: Shadows Must Fall
games.description: 通过建造、升级并释放防御塔，在类Roguelike的竞技场防御中生存下来，对抗无尽的暗影生物群。

games.name: Winnie-the-Pooh Redux: Halloween Survivors
games.description: Heal instead of harm in this wholesome Halloween bullet heaven! Play as 9 magical versions of Pooh, recruit a Ghost Army, collect Candy Corn, upgrade abilities, and restore peace to the Hundred Acre Wood. Based on the public-domain works of A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard. Not affiliated with Disney.

games.name: Eidolon Code
games.description: An indie RPG full of humor, secrets, and consequences. Because sometimes, opening the wrong box is the worst decision you’ll ever make.

games.name: Devil's Door
games.description: Devil’s Door 是一款使用 Unreal Engine 5 制作的第一人称电影式恐怖游戏。探索充满记忆、痛苦与黑暗秘密的世界。努力生存并揭开真相，在布拉德利的女儿梅莉永远坠入黑暗之前。

games.name: UNDERDEEP / 深层迷宫
games.description: 《UNDERDEEP》是一款以硬派而沉浸感十足的奇幻世界为背景的放置类RPG，让你深入体验地牢探索与地图绘制。融合经典RPG的魅力与现代放置机制，带来丰富而富有深度的游戏体验。

games.name: ULTRA MEGA DRILL
games.description: 在这款 2D 增量游戏中购买晶洞、敲击弱点、发现稀有水晶与文物，并建立自动化加工线。

games.name: 迷界：异常货运
games.description: 穿越一座幽魂萦绕的岛屿，运送被诅咒的货物。这里的险恶地形随时可能夺走你的性命，每条道路都残留着往昔的伤痕。

games.name: Camp Paradise: Island Resort Tycoon
games.description: 在这款温馨惬意的海岛度假村经营游戏中，将一座无人照料的岛屿打造成终极度假胜地。清洁、修复并建设梦想中的海岛乐园，再用宾客期待的一切充实它——从宁静的露营地到水上摩托艇和摩天轮。你的岛屿，他们的天堂。

games.name: Victoria Kopernik: Mother
games.description: An occult influencer, Victoria Kopernik, and her possessed cat, Pumpkin, uncover a dark story behind a haunted mansion.

games.name: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
games.description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

games.name: Sinful Shuffle
games.description: Battle enemies using poker card plays as attacks! Poker stars with low morals have been taken to a hellish underworld where you must confront and win against wretched creatures, terrifying demons, sexy female demons and lewd succubus! Features stories and explicit sexual scenes.

games.name: Unknown Call: Ohio
games.description: 你在俄亥俄州的一片空旷森林中醒来。一个声音在呼唤你。它说你们是朋友。它说你必须离开这里。但信号不断中断，你的记忆也在断裂。你的朋友会在远处指引你，但他无法救你。逃离黑暗中的怪物，去找到你的朋友。

games.name: True Nightmare - Diner Loop
games.description: 沉浸于充满氛围感的心理恐怖之中，体验令人不安的 VHS 复古画面风格。作为一名新晋 FBI 探员，你被困在一间偏僻公路咖啡馆中的循环异常里。随着你探索每一个房间，噩梦不断加深……而某种存在正穷追不舍。

games.name: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
games.description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

games.name: Carouspell
games.description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

games.name: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
games.description: 打造终极合金车模店！寻找、买卖稀有模型，自定义并扩建店铺，建造竞速赛道，将一家小小的本地店铺发展成享誉全球的车模收藏家圣地。

games.name: Bloomies
games.description: 一款住在任务栏上的治愈系放置怪物收集游戏！种下种子、孵化蛋，在你工作或玩游戏时培育70多种独特的布鲁米。解锁技能，直到一切自动运转；击败首领获取新种子，搜寻稀有的闪耀布鲁米，集齐你的图鉴！

games.name: Little Sheep Valley – Cozy ranch-builder
games.description: 走进这款温馨治愈的牧场建造游戏，照料羊群，亲手打造完美的地中海牧场！装点家园、扩建牧场，为毛茸茸的伙伴们营造温馨舒适的家。嗯，抱抱它们也完全没问题。

games.name: 恶魔召唤
