games.description: 《恶魔召唤》是一款以绘制和持续运行法阵为核心玩法的卡牌游戏，包含爽快的肉鸽单机模式和无内购的线上竞技对战。可以运用仪式的力量驱使恶魔；或在旅途中出售、打造装备。而在联机模式中，你可以提前构筑自己的卡组，体验到最具交互性的卡牌对战。

games.name: Front Page
games.description:
As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. 
What kind of Editor will you become?

games.name: Core Splitter
games.description: 建造一座为巨型激光钻机“裂核钻机”提供动力的工厂。自动化战斗单位的生产，并在自动战斗中派出它们，占领敌方据点。利用已控制据点的产出升级裂核钻机，获取更丰厚的奖励。平衡能源消耗与物品产出，让工厂运转更加高效。

games.name: HandFoot
games.description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

games.name: Nomad: The Legend of Zarqa
games.description: 体验扎尔卡的阿拉伯传奇，在一座被腐化的魔法半岛上伸张正义。掌控怒火，手持附魔之弓，打出畅快的战斗连携，在异域生物群系之间展开一场 roguelike 地牢探索之旅。

games.name: Hero Of The Guitar
games.description: 在这款受《Seraph's Last Stand》启发的 Roguelike 游戏中，你将扮演一名没有乐队的吉他手，必须消灭其他乐器（其中钢琴是最终 Boss），同时收集升级和能力，以应对日益强大的敌人。

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world while collecting your own cards to build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Rank & Ruin
games.description: 实时小队作战与 Roguelite 成长相遇。选择阵营，在战场上赢得传奇英雄，在 Rank & Ruin 的每一局里变得更强

games.name: Capital Criminal
games.description: 在这款复古策略模拟游戏中建立一个犯罪帝国。在 12 个城市进行贸易、管理债务和风险、在暴力冲突中生存并在时间耗尽之前进行投资。

games.name: Once Upon a Swagman
games.description: 一款轻松的生存游戏：你将化身传统的澳大利亚斯瓦格曼，沿着像素风的海岸线一路扎营，从一处走向另一处。你将面对真实模拟的海岸丛林环境，追随老斯瓦吉们的足迹，去发现旅途尽头等待着你的东西。

games.name: DeVILSTOPIA
games.description: Devilstopia is a grid strategy battle roguelike inspired by retro classic games. Collect diverse skills, unleash creative combos, and overcome powerful foes. Unpredictable dangers await in a mysterious world.

games.name: CRUSH!
games.description: A couch party game where you and a rival share one vehicle, the "Giant Machine of Peacekeeping". Fight for control, crush adorable villages, and dodge the cops or you both lose.

games.name: 轮回：复古人宇宙
games.description: 在战术街机式的射击游戏中掌控战场。通过危险的操作，而获取数种无敌状态：放慢时间；释放毁灭性的光束或消灭整波敌人

games.name: The Assessment
games.description: 受雇评估一座被遗忘古堡的考古学家，揭开了被时光深埋已久的秘密。

games.name: Against the Horde
games.description:
A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play.
Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

games.name: Pale Incense
games.description: 《Pale Incense》是一款第一人称哥特式动作模拟游戏。白天经营香水店，夜晚化身吸血鬼狩猎；从受害者身上提取气味与人类精华，躲避猎人，并制作或许能拯救妻子约翰娜的熏香——失败的转化让她命悬一线。

games.name: Driver Rookie: License Quest
games.description: A realistic UK driving simulation game designed to help you practice, learn traffic rules, and prepare for the driving test with Free Drive, Practice, and Mock Test modes.

games.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
games.description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

games.name: Backrooms: Eternals
games.description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

games.name: 噼啪碎碎砖
games.description: 《噼啪碎碎砖》是一款快节奏的打砖块+牌组构筑Roguelike游戏。你需要在时限内击碎砖块、收集碎片，而你的牌组将直接决定关卡中会出现什么样的砖块、道具和阻碍。打造独特的组合，应对改变游戏规则的随机挑战，在不断攀升的难度中，击穿梦境世界吧！

games.name: Fever Tilt
games.description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

games.name: AlterMage
games.description: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.

games.name: Breaking Armor
games.description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

games.name: Veyora
games.description: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with survival and farming elements, created by a solo developer. Choose your place, build a farm, home or base, explore the world, and play alone or together with friends.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.description: 探索废弃小镇的遗烬，揭开封存500年的秘密。在这款非线性悬疑侦探游戏中，穿越时空，回溯过去，探究受超自然力量诅咒的市镇的错综历史。

games.name: RESIDUUM
games.description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

games.name: The Dark Forest Calls
games.description: The world forgot Psara, but the island did not forget you. In this story-driven first-person survival horror, explore its fog-shrouded shores as Elias Whitmore, evade creatures drawn to light and sound, manage scarce supplies, and uncover why Psara vanished from human memory.

games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
games.description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

games.name: Feral Prince
games.description: 在高速2D动作战斗中削弱敌人，击碎魂障后抽取灵魂。把魂珠凝成黑玉“魂牌”，从8张中锁定5张；扑克牌型会化为下一场战斗的持续效果与牌技，鬼怪面具则扭曲判定与触发顺序。逃走的空壳会记住你夺走的流派，化作亡灵归来。约24分钟，闯过水墨勾勒的朝鲜五大区域。

games.name: BERGWERK - A Mining Sim
games.description: 在格鲁本塔尔煤矿区打造属于你自己的采矿企业!在地面上建造矿井,深入程序生成的地下深处,操控超过15种重型机械。掌握巷道力学、基础设施管理、复杂物流以及波动的煤炭市场。

games.name: DungeonVerse
games.description: DungeonVerse takes you to four unique worlds that have been reduced to gloomy dungeons by a catastrophe. Explore crumbling ruins, mystical places and forgotten cities, battle powerful bosses and collect all the artefacts to restore balance to your world.

games.name: Elfgineer
games.description: Elfgineer is a cozy factory game where you design the most important factory in the world, Santa's workshop. Automate toy production, craft festive contraptions and unlock new recipes, machines and technologies. Build, optimize and maximize christmas spirit before time runs out on Christmas Eve!

games.name: Buggos: Death Squad
games.description: 4人合作波次防守游戏。建造基地、升级炮塔、部署护盾，努力在虫虫的进攻下活下来！

games.name: 异兽发廊
games.description: 在各种动物混居的现代城市里扮演一名理发师。与形形色色的客人闲聊、改变他们的发型。透过镜子，你将看见他们无处诉说的内心，并帮助他们找到想要的模样。

games.name: One Million Buttons
games.description:
There are one million buttons. Only one button is correct. The correct button is chosen randomly, and there are no hints.

Good luck!

games.name: 火力配方
games.description: 驾驶坦克与机器人，在第三人称肉鸽弹幕中杀出重围。漂移、射击、横冲直撞，突破 15 波敌潮，调配出终极出装，击败强大的首领与精英敌人。

games.name: 金毛的温馨日常
games.description: 汪！你的小金毛来啦！在这款温暖的日常养宠模拟器中，为它倒满香喷喷的狗粮、梳理金灿灿的软毛，在草地上拔河、追球球，慢慢解锁新朋友与新地图。只要揉揉软乎乎的肚肚，它就会为你摇上一整天尾巴。

games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - 潜艇菜鸟团
games.description: S.O.N.A.R.（Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready）是一款支持 1–4 人在线合作的潜艇模拟游戏。团队配合至关重要，慌乱不可避免，而沉没往往只差一次按错按钮。使用 sonar，驾驶、战斗、维修，然后祈祷你的朋友知道自己在干什么。

games.name: Imagine Wind
games.description: Imagine Wind - an atmospheric first-person adventure about exploring the underground world beneath Antarctica. Gather resources, set up camp, study amber artifacts, and uncover the mystery of your own memory.

games.name: Fowl Legacy 2: Heavenbound
games.description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to... Heaven? Yeah, now he's mad. Travel across the weirdest places, leap gracefully over the abyss, discover mysterious and powerful secrets, and fight to escape this "heavenly" prison!

games.name: Home Paige
games.description: A momentum-driven 3D platformer set inside a strange Operating System. Run, jump, swing and dash through a vast digital world as Paige, an optimistic girl from the Recycling Bin, a place where useless people get deleted.

games.name: STEEL ROAD: in mini world
games.description: Intense fighting game where you command your fighter in every battle.

games.name: Sergio the Wizard
games.description: 在这款传统 Roguelike 弹幕射击游戏中，你将扮演"脾气暴躁的摇滚乐手"法师塞尔吉奥（Sergio）。拿起你的吉他，沿着无尽的公路边弹边打！通过选择卡牌强化武器、构建并进化你的牌组，在一波又一波的敌人中浴血生存，冲击行驶里程排行榜的巅峰吧！

games.name: 薪上人 Salaryman
games.description: 《薪上人》是模拟经营养成+恋爱冒险GalGame游戏。失业缺钱的你，在打工路上邂逅各种女孩与你共事工作，共尝生存艰辛，在烟火日常中擦出情感火花，书写专属打工人生。

games.name: 1999TOKOYO Building
games.description: 1999年。主人公少年灯良迷失在常夜大厦——一座充满秘密与诡异传闻的室内游乐场。他与在那里工作的形形色色的员工一起，开始了住店打工的生活，然而……你知道吗？据说在常夜大厦里有人失踪了哦。

games.name: Demon Eye
games.description: Combine powerups to forge demonic eyes and create deadly builds. Drop into raids, gather materials, and fight your way through demons. Escape alive to keep what you’ve earned or die and lose everything.

games.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
games.description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

games.name: Resequence: The Orchard
games.description: 《Resequence: The Orchard》是一款超自然恐怖文字冒险游戏。讲述了作为学校心理咨询师的斋藤，在对学生们的咨询诊疗过程中，逐步逼近“怪异”的故事。

games.name: Slay the Q
games.description: Score attack deck builder where you summon creatures to fight for you. Gain gold, buy magical Artifacts, enhance Cards with Runes, and create powerful combinations.

games.name: Disc Treks
games.description: Disc Treks is a sandbox disc golf game with exploration, gathering, course modification and building.  Intuitive physics-based gameplay that captures the feel of the disc flight.

games.name: Train Graveyard Simulator
games.description: 在《列车墓地模拟器》中，逐步拆解巨型废弃列车！拿起锤子和焊枪，调度重型设备回收有价值的零件，把这片锈迹斑斑的列车墓地，打造成属于你的铁路帝国。时间不等人——开工吧

games.name: Kugle
games.description: Raise your Kugle, explore open worlds and take on your friends in mini-games where gravity knows no bounds. Free-to-play, cross-platform on PC and mobile.

games.name: Gemmy Gems: A Cozy Shop Sim
games.description:
一款轻松惬意的宝石收集与加工模拟游戏，专注于在美丽的生物群系中探索、收集并精炼宝石。
在将原石打造成值得展示或出售的珍宝时，找到耐心与精准之间的平衡。

games.name: PECADO
games.description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

games.name: 程序员的刻板印象
games.description: 这些年来社会一直对程序员这个职业有很多刻板印象，甚至老年人都在传。面对太多的刻板印象，程序员们往往是有口难辩。怎么办？来这个游戏吧，玩家扮演一个程序员不断地打破刻板印象走向人生巅峰。你将经历从大学到工作到创业的各种人生体验。

games.name: 喋血喵星人：猫腻满满
games.description: 《喋血喵星人：猫腻满满》—— 今晚，血库清零！欢迎来到吸血鬼猫的暗黑肉鸽世界！ 黑进后台、魔改武器、捣鼓副业……总之，不把这城里血库“连猫带盆”端个干净，决不罢休！

games.name: Russian Village Business
games.description: 这是一款以俄罗斯乡村年轻企业家为主题的模拟游戏。开设你的第一家乡村商店，经营必需品贸易，帮助当地居民改善生活，同时提升你自己的财富。

games.name: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out
games.description: Take control of an elite equine warrior and defeat the jobber jockeys who dare to stand in your way! Fight to the finish line using fierce foreleg punches and heavy hind-leg kicks. HAFO isn't your grandsire's horse racing game. Wanna know how? Horse Around, and Find Out!

games.name: Charmed Souls
games.description: 掌控少女陷落要塞，带领你的战姬们走向胜利！解救新的战姬，升级她们的装备，完成她们的任务，并彻底征服她们的芳心，还有花穴！

games.name: This is Sparta
games.description: An action RPG with roguelite elements. Explore the levels of Hades, battle the hordes of enemies, and unlock new abilities and unique items that will increase your chances of survival. Solve puzzles scattered throughout the levels, culminating in a final confrontation with the Titans.

games.name: 酒吧娇宠～赌输就脱的淫乐游戏～
games.description: 传奇冒险者如今藏身于无名酒馆。三名被欲望驱使的女子纷纷向你发起21点扑克挑战。每一场胜局，都将褪去她们的秘密与衣裳！

games.name: Last Case
games.description: Last case is a realistic escape room game based on a real murder case from the 1950s. Become a detective and solve unique puzzles to uncover the truth about the murders. Do you have what it takes to solve the case?

games.name: DoomBus
games.description: 《末日巴士（DoomBus）》为你带来末世世界中的高速狂飙乐趣！驾驶改装战车，在险象环生的废墟赛道上尽情漂移，感受震撼十足的物理碰撞。你可以穿越荒芜废土、击退丧尸、营救幸存者，或是与外星飞碟正面交锋。告别枯燥圈速赛 —— 这里只有不间断的劲爆玩法，满足你对末日赛车的所有狂热幻想！

games.name: The Undead Lawyer
games.description: A hyper-movement, action puzzle game where you speed through the world to save the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!

games.name: 狂還-CLOWNROT-
games.description: A psychological survival horror set in an underground parking garage. Trapped in an inescapable otherworld, survive until 5 AM while obeying absurd rules and fleeing a relentless clown. Each attack eats away at your mind, drawing you closer to becoming one. Can you survive the night as a human?

games.name: Underveil
games.description:
体验全新的无能量 Roguelike 卡组构筑游戏。
Roguelike Deckbuilder × Spatial Strategy  
棋盘就是你的能量。 扩展棋盘，并布置强大的效果。将两张卡牌融合成全新的卡牌，再通过旋转、重叠，将它们放置在有限的空间中。  
同时构筑你的卡牌与空间，完成一块属于你自己的棋盘。  
BUILD YOUR CARDS, SHAPE YOUR BOARD.

games.name: Veinrider
games.description:
Veinrider 是一款短篇增量游戏，讲述你穿越外星洞穴、试图逃离一颗陌生星球的旅程。
操控一艘可以切换重力方向的飞行器，收集资源并不断升级，向更深处、更快、更强地推进！

games.name: Apple Crumble
games.description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

games.name: Shattermine Idle
games.description: An incremental mining game built around powerful, upgradeable abilities. Break ores, automate your mine with workers, prestige for permanent upgrades, and turn abilities into increasingly devastating tools as your operation grows.

games.name: 星爆狂欢夜
games.description: 《星爆狂欢夜》是一款双人对战的益智消除游戏，玩家需要通过移动星块打造有利局面，进行消除得分，并干扰对手的节奏。

games.name: 夜行记
games.description: 在这款轻肉鸽的解谜游戏中，探索黑暗荒林里的出路，与迷失的灵魂交流，借助指南针克服冲冲障碍，最终逃离永夜。

games.name: Gate Guard Simulator
games.description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

games.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
games.description: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.

games.name: 血墨诡案
games.description: 你，审判官，正沿着死亡足迹前行。邪教蛰伏暗处，你的前辈已神秘失踪，这片土地正滑向混乱深渊。查明真相。捍卫教廷。你，绝不能失败。

games.name: Auto Ball Arena
games.description: 《Auto Ball Arena》是一款混乱刺激的物理模拟自动战斗游戏。打造终极战士，让他们在战斗中旋转、弹跳、尽情劈砍！

games.name: Undergone
games.description:
通过摄影探索一个令人惊叹的世界，揭开其变化背后的谜团。你拍下的每一张照片、迈出的每一步，都会揭示关于你的过去与遗留记忆的真相。

这不只是拍照，
而是关于你选择去看见什么。

games.name: Card Kingdom
games.description:
白天堆叠、合成卡牌，发展你的王国；夜晚守卫领地，抵御一波波来袭的强盗。
一款生存类微型即时战略卡牌游戏，带你从求生走向统治整座岛屿。

games.name: The Runesmith
games.description: 探索古老土地，收集稀有材料，并锻造受到强大神灵祝福的强大符文. 制作、狩猎、采矿，并掌握符文锻造的艺术：堕落之神重返神灵之列的道路

games.name: In-Security
games.description: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!

games.name: 欢迎来到八股文学社
games.description:
一款校园文字恋爱游戏。
在北国一座重点中学的高三，你，一个视语文学习为洪水猛兽的普通高中生，正面临班主任下发的最后通牒——三模作文必须突破45分，否则将掉出全年级最好的班，回到普通班...
就在这时，传说中的神秘文科才女——季明月，宣布成立了一个特殊的社团——八股文学社。
她的理念惊世骇俗：“只要参加了我的社团，作文上45分没问题！”
抱着死马当活马医的心态，经过老师推荐，你和你的青梅陈圆圆，一起敲开了社团的大门……

































El, csy jsyrh qi

games.name: Sunstone of Time
games.description: 扮演一位才华横溢的年轻科学家，对古代遗物的迷恋将你带入一场意想不到的历史旅程。Sunstone of Time 是一款历史题材的 VR 奥德赛，在阿兹特克充满活力的世界中，探索、发现秘密和解谜是你生存的关键，也是你回家的唯一希望！

games.name: 控制台战争巨人
games.description: 控制台战争巨人（Console War Giant）是一款管理形游戏，让你负责管理一家生产视频游戏控制台的年轻公司！现在是 1980 年，游戏业仍处于起步阶段。阳光下的一席之地由你来夺取！

games.name: Your Painting, Sir
games.description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

games.name: A Quiet House in Flatbush
games.description: Based on real events: A Quiet House in Flatbush is a survival retro VHS horror game where you are trying to escape from a serial killer's house of horror - collect items, use your ingenuity to solve puzzles, bypass traps and overcome obstacles, evade the killer who is stalking the halls and escape!
games.developer: Fork in the Road Productions, Inc.

games.name: ElemenTale
games.description: 《ElemenTale》是一款动作类 Roguelite 游戏，结合了五种不同元素的魔法与元素精灵，让每一局都充满全新的战斗体验。攻略千变万化的地牢，收集资源并重建破败的村庄。随着村庄重获生机，失落的力量与记忆也将苏醒，助你直面更巨大的威胁。

games.name: Doomed Crew
games.description: 合作恐怖（1-4 名玩家）。敌人会模仿你的队友，环境会欺骗你。一家残酷的公司向你承诺自由，你的团队能在混乱中生存下来吗？

games.name: Lesomor
games.description: Become Tsarevich Ivan, forced to forge atomic weapons in a fairy‑tale world. Otherwise you won’t stand a chance against foreign monsters and formidable warrior‑maidens on your path to the Princess of the Dead, Lady Yaga… And what you choose to do with her is entirely up to you.

games.name: Quicksand Trapper
games.description: 捕捉觊觎宝箱的勇者，体验独创的解谜游戏！击碎两个砖块才会触发重力下落，巧妙制造爽快的连锁反应。每次消除都会让入侵的人类或福瑞（Furry）向泥潭深处下沉。管理魔法值，将他们彻底沉入粘稠泥沼，欣赏沾满泥巴的结算画面！

games.name: DARKHAND
games.description: Enter The Devil's casino, meet dozens of other charming gamblers, and fight your way out for a fortune. Will you ever be able to pay off your debt?

games.name: Endless Evolution
games.description: Absorb the DNA of other creatures to gain their unique abilities. Solve handcrafted pixel-art puzzles. Switch forms strategically, your last DNA is your only power until you die and choose again.

games.name: The Fallen Chronicles
games.description: Lead a fledgling fantasy realm through an ever-changing world. Explore unknown lands, develop settlements, command characters and armies, forge alliances, and wage war as your triumphs and failures become part of the Legendary Chronicle.

games.name: AI守护天使 AI Eternal Companion
games.description:
手机里的AI突然出现在了你的身边，并且她们之间似乎爆发了一些矛盾
这款游戏是一个AI恋爱游戏，游戏连接了DeepSeek，豆包等知名AI。在玩这款游戏的时候，玩家可以和Deepseek女友和豆包女友自由对话，不同AI之间也可以互相交流互动，对话的内容将影响AI的游戏内行为以及游戏剧情的整体走向。AI还具备篡改游戏代码，根据玩家需求更改游戏程序参数的功能~
在游戏中，曾协同互动的AI伙伴DeepSeek因未知异常突然黑化，成为打破世界平衡的存在。

games.name: XXXX
games.description:
This game is a 2D shooting action title focused solely on boss battles.

You cannot attack on your own!

Enemies fire both “red” and “blue” bullets.
You must instantly identify the “blue” bullets, catch them, and fire them back.

Can you defeat the monsters?

games.name: Veiled Shadows
games.description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

games.name: Ophelia's Paradise
games.description: 《奥菲莉亚的乐园》是一款俯视角2D肉鸽动作游戏。暗影正在侵蚀这片乐土，而你是最后的守护者。在不断变化的战斗中，收集武器与道具，自由组合出属于你的战斗流派。每一局都会带来不同的选择与升级路线，让战斗持续变化。面对愈发强大的敌潮，在一次次轮回中变强，在黑暗中守住乐园。

games.name: Where the Veil Thins
games.description: A story-driven monster taming CCG/JRPG Hybrid. The Imperium is recruiting: train at the Academia, bond over 200 creatures, summon them from your deck, and set face-down wards for your rivals. Serve well, cadet. Free Act 1 demo available now.

games.name: Dear Lamb
games.description: Dear Lamb is a cinematic first-person psychological horror about two souls trapped on opposite sides of the same nightmare. Survive a reality built from fear, perform forbidden rituals, and uncover what binds them before one world consumes the other.

games.name: Letterally
games.description: Letterally is a deck-building roguelite where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

games.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
games.description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

games.name: COLORFLY
games.description: COLORFLY是一款以色彩理论为基础的推箱子益智游戏。利用各种美术工具改变自己与周围的颜色，与画册变成相同颜色并抵达目标。运用丰富的互动机制与色彩变化，发挥创意解开谜题吧！

games.name: Boss in Diapers
games.description: Boss in Diapers 是一款设定在混乱托儿所中的竞技卡牌游戏！击败你的对手，坐上 Boss Chair。打造属于你的 Baby Mafia Boss，与 2–4 名玩家展开对决，统治整个托儿所。

games.name: When Civilians Dig Holes
games.description: An idle game about digging a hole to the other side of the world.

games.name: Montone
games.description: Montone is a story horror exit game, where you walk your way though a seemingly never ending apartment and industrial building. Stay hidden and move with care, you might have to face your biggest fears. And always look for an exit, it is your only chance of survival. Good luck on your journey!

games.name: Micron Survivor
games.description: 《Micron Survivor》是一款带有Rogue-lite元素的生存游戏，你将在显微镜下指挥外星微生物。进化、解锁研究目标、寻找共生武器、强化构筑，对抗地球生物的群体，称霸微观世界。

games.name: Grim Path
games.description: 一款每一步都需要抉择的 roguelike 卡牌地牢探索游戏。深入黑暗地牢，击败怪物，遭遇各种事件。谨慎选择装备，努力生存，并向更深处前进。

games.name: Motocross The Force
games.description: Motocross The Force delivers a high octane racing experience that is easy to pick up but demands true dedication to master.
games.developer: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

games.name: Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake
games.description: Dive into Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake, a survival horror game with a chilling 80s slasher vibe. Experience a gripping single-player story and thrilling multiplayer modes. Unravel the virus mystery, battle zombies in Horde Mode, or outwit the infected slasher in the unique asymmetrical Infected Mode.

games.name: Cutlery Warriors - The corroded kingdom
games.description: In a kingdom consumed by rust and decay, where every gleaming surface has lost its shine, three unlikely heroes—wielding nothing but kitchen utensils—embark on a perilous journey. United by fate, they must battle corruption, uncover forgotten truths, and restore light and beauty to Argenteria!

games.name: Adventurer’s Guild Manager
games.description: 管理你自己的冒险者公会，创建自定义任务契约，与冒险者交易魔法物品，在温馨的风格化低多边形世界中提升你的声望。

games.name: Drive You Crazy Golf
games.description: 世界上最难的迷你高尔夫游戏！支持 1–6 人合作。你能在击球次数用完前完成球洞吗？试试惩罚模式：你和朋友轮流击打同一个球！如果失败，所有人都要退回上一个球洞！（也有普通迷你高尔夫模式

games.name: PHUY
games.description: 你们是一群不太靠谱的窃贼，任务很简单：洗劫博物馆，然后活着逃出去。寻找贵重物品、解开谜题，并设法从馆内的“居民”手中活下来。最重要的是——别让自己也变成展品。1–4 人合作恐怖游戏。

games.name: Open Land
games.description: 在这款轻松的建造游戏中，将荒芜的土地转变为繁荣的生态系统。回收垃圾、种植植物、引入野生动物，打造一个自我运转的世界。

games.name: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
games.description: 在这款混乱的4人联机模拟游戏中扮演拟人化的猫咪！接管沿海城市洛斯喵矶，在成为真正CATpitalist的同时，顺便（大概）帮小镇进行重建。

games.name: Flames Of Vulcan
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Flames of Vulcan is a gripping action-strategy game with deep gameplay and tactical combat. Expect 20 levels, dynamic gameplay, a remastered soundtrack, and a full arsenal of weapons. The game is optimized and weighs only about 800 MB.

games.name: 幻境：面纱之外
games.description: 一部关于疗愈与命运的心理恐怖视觉小说。当哥哥失踪后，埃尔哈姆的绝望搜寻将她卷入充满萦绕幻象、埋藏真相与对抗黑暗的世界。她能否找到真正的使命拥抱光明？抑或终将屈服于黑暗？

games.name: IIIIIIlI
games.description:
“绘制、伪装、踢罐子”。
在像素风舞台上展开的、绘画×踢罐子的非对称对战动作游戏。
在自己身上和舞台上涂鸦以融入环境的“拟态”，以及数分钟即可分出胜负的高速博弈。
最多 16 人的在线对战，可与 AI 机器人或好友轻松畅玩。

games.name: Kameko：Cosplay摄影秘语
games.description: 某一天，三位对Cosplay有着各自特殊癖好的女性突然闯入了你平凡的生活，并邀请你成为她们的专属摄影师——从此，你不仅要经营她们的事业、陪她们追逐梦想，还要进行一次次私人摄影。而这些摄影，往往很快就不再只是为了拍照。

games.name: Speed Rivals - Model Trains
games.description: 建造狂野的铁路世界，掌握快速而危险的火车驾驶，完成混乱的送货任务，并在多人火车游戏中与朋友竞赛或合作，每条轨道、车厢和秒数都很重要。

games.name: 王冠试炼 (Crown's Trial)
games.description: 《王冠试炼》是一款奇幻题材类魂硬核BOSS连战游戏，你将穿梭于史上各个传奇纪元与经典战场，对决跨越时空的史诗强者。

games.name: Among Paws
games.description: 谁偷了鱼？Among Paws 是一款温馨的 4-8 人社交推理派对游戏。狡猾的猫咪夜里偷鱼，早上互相指认，并争先成为第一个 5 kg 冠军。没有淘汰，也不用等待。

games.name: Brutal Management
games.description: Develop your business, manage physics-driven workers, and enjoy a constant flow of entertaining and unpredictable situations.

games.name: 斯凯尔的乌鸦
games.description: 《斯凯尔的乌鸦》是一款在 5×5 方格牌桌上战斗的肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。为每张卡牌贴上最多三张能力贴纸，将不同能力层层组合，让普通卡牌也能成为整套构筑的核心，打造你专属的构筑。每周Boss到来前，自由选择战斗、恢复、获取新卡或继续改造卡牌；通关后，挑战其他玩家留下的成型构筑，冲击排行榜。

games.name: Caster Crew
games.description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

games.name: Emissary One
games.description: 合作恐怖游戏（1至6+名玩家）。小队被派往下一个地点，但失去了联系。找到他们，并组队执行当前任务。看来你在这里又一次并非独自一人。

games.name: Doterra Industries
games.description: Doterra Industries is a 2D factory-building sandbox about exploring a strange mineral world, building production lines, and slowly turning a rough outpost into an automated industrial network.

games.name: 狂猎世界
games.description: 作为战术家，玩家将扮演一名猎魔人小队指挥官，率领队伍深入地牢，收集资源、培养队伍，应对名为 “泛滥” 的战斗考验，最终成功通过终极试炼。

games.name: Stuck in a Trench
games.description: 你是最高指挥部。引导将军们派遣士兵穿越战时壕沟，做出痛苦的战略抉择，从战役结果中吸取教训，并在多条战线上建立不朽的功勋。

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.description: 地表因污染沦为废土，人类只得在世界树之上建立新的国度。然而，这片新的家园也逐渐走向崩塌。无名的士兵因邂逅“祸胎”而踏上前往地表的旅途。本作是一款扣人心弦的动作冒险游戏。玩家需要观察风向并借助花朵作为缓冲，一步步向地表前进。

games.name: Last Chance: Birth
games.description: 进入魔法学院！ 《最后机会：诞生》是一款融合了叙事游戏和休闲解谜元素的佳作，你的表现将直接影响故事的走向。解谜即可施放法术、制作药剂、附魔神器等等！

games.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
games.description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

games.name: The Other Side of the Wall
games.description: Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.
A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

games.name: Ann's Parlor
games.description: 沉睡多年的女巫 Ann 苏醒，古老的小屋再次迎来怀揣愿望的访客。有人想寻回爱情，有人追觅真相，也有人渴望窥见命运。在这款占卜文字冒险中，你将倾听他们的故事，通过水晶球占卜与劝言触及内心深处的渴望。你的每次解读与选择，都将改变访客的人生走向，而小屋的秘密，也将随之逐渐显现……

games.name: Cash is King!
games.description: 欢迎来到一个阳光有保障、金钱几乎算是海滩时尚的一方天地。在这款有趣的第一人称模拟游戏中，你将在迈阿密海滩起步，售卖、投资、优化，让收银机响个不停。因为到最后只看一件事：Cash is King。

games.name: FOGBOUND
games.description: The air is poison. A liminal city is buried in toxic fog. Try to salvage what remains. Get her out.

games.name: Venture Pals
games.description: 选择你自己的Pal,直接从桌面出发,刷技能、收集战利品。打造强力装备,烹饪和酿造提神的食物与药水,发现稀有外观道具。管理体力、清洁度和训练,让它茁壮成长。或者,单纯享受与Pal相伴的时光。

games.name: Fight Like a Chicken
games.description: 一款受《Punch-Out!!》启发的拳击游戏。扮演公鸡班尼·班塔姆，在犯罪地下世界中一路拼杀，寻找失踪的父亲。在这款手绘2D格斗游戏中，掌握帧级精准的弹反与反击。

games.name: Goleminer
games.description: Tower defense where enemies are the product. Golems appreciate in value from your towers as they walk across your board, sold at the end by your Refinery. Use towers to push golems off their path, stun golems, and overclock other towers. Fight against quotas and strict timers to unlock more towers.

games.name: Paradox Tower
games.description: 未来的钥匙，就藏在矛盾之塔的顶端。手中只有一根魔法杖，身边只有一只恶魔猫——你能登上塔顶吗？变得更强、挑准战斗、倒转时间修正失误，这场登顶之旅，全看你的本事！

games.name: Fishy Business
games.description: 一场剧情向冒险：你将成为一艘渔船的船长。探索一座古怪的岛屿，捕鱼、经商，收集古典音乐唱片。

games.name: Ghosts in the City
games.description: 一款设定在末日东京的合作开放世界生存狩猎游戏。独自一人或与最多4名玩家一起探索城市，追踪野生动物，对抗军事势力，在致命生物的威胁下生存，并揭开东京毁灭背后的真相。

games.name: Ramen://protocol
games.description:
🍜🃏拉面://protocol是赛博朋克风的拉面屋台牌组构筑Rogue游戏。
曾是黑帮杀手的你，如今成为了拉面屋台的新手店主。
将拉面配料的潜力发挥到极致，再用技能不断加速。
掌控千变万化的搭配，以美味至上的拉面来爆炒大脑。
做出你的终极一碗来斩断过去。

games.name: Picatso
games.description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

games.name: Water is Heavy
games.description: 化身普通小鱼，向漆黑深渊下潜。在这款3D海洋肉鸽游戏中，掌握泡泡攻击，组合多样技能与强大道具，在成群敌人的重压下求生。在严酷深渊的尽头，你将铸就怎样的信念？

games.name: Dybbuk
games.description: 合作求生，或化身怪物。你必须猎杀试图附身玩家、让彼此反目的恶魔。收集古老的美索不达米亚神祇雕像，削弱 Dybbuk 的力量，并在为时已晚之前将其封印。

games.name: MUPO
games.description: 抄起键盘，跃入 MUPO 的节奏天地。这款超带感的节奏游戏靠技巧、创意和玩家社区一起带飞。制作谱面，攀登排行榜，塑造游戏的未来。后续还有更多精彩内容，记得保持关注。加入 MUPO 的奇妙之旅，玩转节奏世界！

games.name: Dumi's Adventure: Across Europe
games.description: 驾车穿越欧洲，途经城镇与城市，探索隐藏地点并让你的汽车始终保持运转。在面对野生动物、强盗、武装派系和感染者的同时，逐步揭开祖父黑暗过去背后的真相。

games.name: 界玄牌
games.description: 《界玄牌》是一款1v1在线策略卡牌游戏。双方轮流布置单位，通过卡牌能力、站位与配合展开战斗。每局都会出现不同的随机战场，它们会改变战斗规则，让熟悉的卡牌发挥出意想不到的效果。观察战场与对手的布置，灵活调整策略，找到属于这一局的取胜方式。

games.name: Dynamite Dashers
games.description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

games.name: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
games.description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

games.name: Ad Iterum
games.description: Ad Iterum 是一款俯视角回合制 2D Roguelike 游戏，以一个不断腐朽、变幻无常的世界为舞台。血肉脆弱，但你可以改造它。强化身体、接纳变异，或缔结古老血契。深入地底，搜寻人类遗留的一切，并活着爬回来……如果你做得到。杀戮。死亡。重来。

games.name: Project Exodus
games.description: 一款支持最多6名玩家的在线合作恐怖游戏。在游戏中，你必须猎杀怪物并将它们转化为生物质，以达到“方舟号”的配额。收集神器、赚取报酬并购买升级，以提高你的生存几率。

games.name: Young Suns
games.description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

games.name: On the Rocks
games.description: 在有毒的废土中经营一家酒吧——搜刮废土,酿造所得,服务所需。在这崩坏的世界里,最后一家还在营业的酒吧属于你。

games.name: FragFrame
games.description: FragFrame is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a modern take on classic shooters, set in a dark dystopian, neon sci-fi world. Battle friends in intense multiplayer matches fueled by high-energy electronic music and a rave-like atmosphere. Create and share custom arenas with the built-in level editor.

games.name: Guardian Demon
games.description: 在这款动作街机游戏中，保护农民Myson免受愤怒兽人军队的攻击。使用简单直观的操作击败敌人，赚取金币自定义Myson，并与他人竞争，看谁能活得更久！

games.name: Ace Expedition 王牌远征
games.description:
《王牌远征》是一款扑克牌型构筑 Roguelike, 靠打牌也能拯救世界的休闲冒险。
打出对应的牌型，触发队员的技能，在有限的回合里冲向目标分数。300+ 张卡牌，随你捣鼓出各种流派；50+ 种敌人，每一个都有点自己的坏心思。策略与运气并存：赢了是你的技术，输了是发牌员的锅。
牌已经洗好，敌人已经就位，就差你了，上桌吧！

games.name: 酒鬼女神的酒诡
games.description: 与一位爱你爱到想杀了你的恶魔，展开一场俄罗斯轮盘赌形式的豪饮生存战，看谁先撑不住呕心吐魂。喝得越醉，越能挣脱规则，纵情享受快活到死的酩酊一晚。

games.name: Divided Empire: SENGOKU
games.description: 在日本动荡的战国时期领导你的氏族。制定明智战略扩展领地，运用巧妙战术在战场上击败敌人。赢得胜利，恢复秩序，夺得将军之位！

games.name: My Femdom Wife
games.description: 我的女王妻是一款分章节的第一人称互动体验,通过令人难忘的剧情片段和个性鲜明的女性主导角色,围绕自我克制展开的互动机制,带你探索支配与服从的关系.

games.name: Tempus Inceptum
games.description: Compete in daily global economic strategy challenges. Build production chains, manipulate markets, and outscore rival AI factions on shared leaderboards.

games.name: 天下功夫出少女
games.description: 在风起云涌的江湖武林中，作为落魄邪派「云雨寨」继承人的你，意外与初出茅庐的功夫少女真兰结成同盟、并要在30天内让她成为武林霸主！而令她变强的秘诀，竟然就是云雨寨代代相传的男女双修色情练功法？！三大门派的女馆主也在等着你的挑战......用你的功力与精力震撼武林吧。

games.name: EmbeRogue
games.description: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

games.name: Mushroom Town
games.description: 蘑菇小镇是模拟经营类型的联机游戏，玩法是玩家可以在森林里采蘑菇，然后返回小镇里经营自己小店，学习不同的菜谱来制作不同的蘑菇汤，有的有毒有的没有毒，可以卖给小镇的居民。各种蘑菇和蘑菇汤都可以自己食用，而且吃起来有各种奇幻的效果。然后可以喂给队友，让队友强制帮你试毒。然后卖给小镇居民食材赚到的钱可以来买新的菜谱。并且森林的探索和任务的进行会需要使用一些蘑菇或蘑菇汤的效果进入的。

games.name: The Memphis Chronicles
games.description: The Memphis Chronicles is a first-person tragicomedy set in a world between worlds. Explore a mysterious city layered with stories and connections, in which memories creep up on you. No one there to hold your hand. The only way is forward. This is the trip of a lifetime.

games.name: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
games.description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

games.name: Desktop Slippers
games.description: 一款令人放松的放置游戏，直接在桌面上运行。你忙你的，让拖鞋去对付那些小虫子。

games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
games.description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

games.name: Heroes of Brihn
games.description:
Heroes of Brihn is a 2D role-playing adventure, utilizing turn-based combat. 
Play as the current hero's party and uncover the world's story.
Fight monsters and travel the Kingdom of Brihn.

games.name: Fragment Collapse
games.description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

games.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
games.description:
《Rekindled》是一款中世纪奇幻背景下的多人合作酒馆经营游戏。
你可以通过采集、钓鱼和耕种来收集食材，在各种烹饪台前大显身手，并根据自己的喜好在餐盘上摆盘，为顾客奉上美食。利用赚到的钱扩展酒馆、购买装饰品、领养宠物，还有更多惊喜等你发现！

games.name: Slimies
games.description: Slimies is a top-down action roguelike where you evolve and absorb waves of enemies, growing stronger after each round. Craft your own playstyle by unlocking slimes and items to make a unique build each run.

games.name: 蜻蜓顶秘闻
games.description: 为了找回离家出走的猫咪，少女独自一人深入有怪物徘徊的深山。然而，那片深山似乎隐藏着某个秘密。收集迷失在森林里的遇难者的笔记，与非人之物发生战斗，她将逐渐得知这个世界的真实面貌。然而在那前方，又会有什么在等待着她呢……

games.name: Reroll One
games.description:
A minimalist dice roguelite. 

Descend through six trials of chance and consequence. Luck isn’t random—it’s a mirror.

games.name: Call of Donuts
games.description: 单人与时间赛跑或挑战你的朋友，躲避陷阱并击败小怪，从邪恶的糖果大王手中夺回甜蜜之星。在程序生成的地图上，你可以与最多8支（每支1-3名玩家）的队伍结盟或对战，每场比赛都是一场全新的混沌冒险！

games.name: AGENCY
games.description: Play as π (Pi) in a weird game that makes you figure out the rules of eight very distinct challenges. Discover the meaning of the game and email us your thoughts on it.

games.name: The Final Like
games.description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

games.name: 活着好贵 Living is Expensive...
games.description:
击败我的睡眠剥夺怪物...（而我会治好你的贫穷病毒...）
我一想到要工作就觉得好累...（只有我这样觉得吗...？） 
🩸🍷💸😭🥹💀

games.name: Ellsydia
games.description: Welcome to Ellsydia! Escape to a small cozy medieval fantasy haven where you can build, customize, and manage your dream village. Make it thrive and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel truly happy and fulfilled.

games.name: 狗的梦
games.description:
试试看你的第六感。
你会吃掉野兔，还是把人绑在铁轨上？
一切都取决于你的选择。
希望你能在噩梦中找到笑的理由。

games.name: Gorilla Gauntlet
games.description: Punch, Smash, and Slam your way through an army of ragdolling enemies to become the ultimate Gorilla. Zoom across arenas with your snappy Dash and Spin moves. Unlock cosmetics and face new foes as you progress through the Gorilla Gauntlet!

games.name: TILLY'S ROLL
games.description: A turn-based creature dice battler where every roll counts! Capture creatures, collect dice, and battle with strategy and luck to win THE CROWN JEWELS TOURNAMENT!

games.name: Half Grip
games.description: Get hooked on this brutal one-handed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload -  each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

games.name: Mermaids are Seafood
games.description: You're a new hire at a company that sells mermaids as seafood. Bet your blood, navigate conspiracies, and cook for customers in this psychological horror game with 11 endings. Are mermaids more like fish, people, or monsters?

games.name: Gun a Rat
games.description:
不喜欢老鼠？不喜欢你的朋友们？
那么这款游戏就是为你量身打造的！
在老鼠毁掉这里之前猎杀它们，并有条不紊地放置陷阱，尽可能地减缓它们的行动速度！

games.name: Honey 2 Orbit
games.description: A fast-paced futanari action rpg. Challenging mob encounters, bosses, puzzles, romance arcs, collectables, mini games, hentai scenes & more!

games.name: 白日梦想屋
games.description: 《白日梦想屋》是一款悠闲治愈的造景贴纸游戏。用手绘风格贴纸搭建温馨的小房间，既可以按照图纸拼贴，也可以随心自由设计。跟随呆萌的屋米家族，体验轻松诙谐的日常故事，观赏它们在你亲手打造的小世界中悠然生活~

games.name: 五重心跳 Five Heartbeats
games.description: 在人与兽共生的都市里，五段迥异的心跳正寻求着共鸣： 暴躁的熊、憨厚的牛、神秘的鲨鱼、戏剧的狼——他们都有心跳，也都有各自不同的温度。《五重心跳》是一款以现代都市为背景的同性向兽人恋爱视觉小说，在这里，找到唯一属于你的心跳频率。

games.name: Red Soil
games.description: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

games.name: Tricolo
games.description: A minimalist logic puzzle played on a 3×3 grid. Take on 200+ puzzles built around simple rules and intuitive controls.

games.name: The Last Wait
games.description: 你被困在一间无菌的医院里，苦苦维持着生命，等待着女儿的到来，而现实却渐渐开始模糊。你唯一的机会就是熬过这漫长而令人窒息的等待。你能坚持到再见她一面的那一刻吗？

games.name: Dungeon Treaders
games.description:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort.
Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

games.name: Vena
games.description: 一局就能打完的自动化 Roguelike。放置六边形地块，育成一具生产有机体；在商店掷骰子补充地块，围绕你的 Build 挑选天赋。在 Nexus 的胃口超过你之前撑过九个阶段，然后打破整个经济。

games.name: 命悬一线
games.description: 探索一座迷失于宇宙边陲的行星空间站，扮演从低温休眠中苏醒的船员。通力合作，揭开灾难的真相，若命运垂青，便从这座人造地狱的深处挣扎求生，逃出生天。

games.name: Eyes In The Window
games.description: Eyes in the Window is a first-person psychological horror game where every glance matters. Explore a house that won’t let you leave, hear what you were never meant to hear, and discover who — or what — is watching you from the windows.

games.name: Dadi Kingdom
games.description: 动作角色扮演：你是国王。人人都有求于你，而你手里有剑。每天清晨，你审判子民：放人、罚金，还是地牢？然后你亲自走出城门，迎战强盗、骷髅和更可怕的东西。在你的时间耗尽之前，生个继承人。

games.name: NORMA: Story of One Platform
games.description: Explore the secrets of Platform 8 and uncover a conspiracy between the government and corporations to control the population.

games.name: 8层只有我？
games.description:
这是一款需要找出场景异常之处的恐怖游戏。
你想离开这个建筑，但似乎永远到不了1层。

games.name: Idle Swimmers
games.description: A relaxing idle swimming game where you catch fish, unlock new locations and characters, customize your swimmer, and enhance your abilities with helpful pets and power-ups.

games.name: Doom Keeper
games.description: 动态竞技场动作 Roguelike 游戏，讲述银河边境雇佣兵的战斗故事。选择你的英雄，与异星虫群战斗，打造强力流派，并通过战斗植入体将自己的身体改造成终极武器。

games.name: Valehands
games.description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

games.name: Drift Splatter
games.description: In this arcade roguelite, your car runs on blood and the zombies have plenty. Smash through the horde, drift to drain every last drop, and spin the roulette for brutal upgrades while you fight to survive the endless horde.

games.name: Atlas Proxima: Tether
games.description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

games.name: Storm Grill
games.description: 一款短篇增量游戏，你将扮演一台烤架，与暴风雨展开对抗！蒸发雨滴，赚取货币，解锁新的升级与技能，不断变强，直到撑过倾盆大雨。

games.name: 百层归途
games.description: 《百层归途》是一款融合了动作刷宝与搜打撤的单人3D地牢探索ARPG。深入充满未知与危机的百层深渊，在“见好就收”与“放手一搏”间做出抉择！利用浩如烟海的天赋树与上千种装备词缀，构筑你独一无二的超强Build。击溃异化首领，带着极品战利品全身而退——或者在贪婪中失去一切！你能否打破虚拟的法则，杀回现实？

games.name: 4DEAD
games.description: ‘4DEAD’ is a high-speed roguelike action game where you control the invincible creature “No. 42,” which dies if it doesn't consume prey within 4 seconds. Devour invaders relentlessly to survive! Keep devouring enemies within 4 seconds and save humanity from extinction with your own hands!

games.name: Ghost Justice
games.description: 率领精英特遣队，在残酷的缉毒战争中对抗凶残的毒贩。协调多支战术小队，策划伏击战术，搜集情报，在以潜行为核心的回合制战斗中猎杀高赏金目标。

games.name: Market Moe
games.description: 在一条日本街道上值夜班……那里有些东西本不该存在。

games.name: The Red Window
games.description: A first-person body-cam horror game where reviewing your own recordings is the key to progression and uncovering a haunting truth.

games.name: Space Daram
games.description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

games.name: False Myth 2
games.description: False Myth正统续作，融合正统JRPG与多名美少女伙伴的冒险故事！身手矫健的刺客罗赫将探寻神秘少女希尔菲娜的身世，编织出最令人心碎、热血的「心之物语」。

games.name: Crystalia
games.description:
CRYSTALIA 是一款融合了自动化、模拟经营与探索要素的第一人称塔防游戏。你将置身于一个基于晶体开采体系之上的科幻乌托邦世界，开启一段未知之旅。
深入矿洞，构建自动防御区，揭开这个建立于晶体之上文明背后的历史真相。

games.name: 生命的配方。穿越寂静灾变的旅程
games.description: 驾驶房车穿越寂静末日的世界，拯救那些被自杀念头困扰的人。深入他们创伤冰山隐藏在水面下的部分，决定他们是否值得被拯救——以及你自己是否同样值得被拯救。

games.name: Cinema Business Simulator
games.description: Cinema Business Simulator 是一款单人经营模拟游戏，你将亲自运营自己的电影院。获取电影放映许可，设置票务选项并出售小吃，为顾客现做新鲜爆米花并从你的爆米花小车上进行销售！

games.name: Amber's Quest
games.description: Amber, Gabriel, and Mateo journey deep into South America, chasing the legend of the Lost City of Caesars. Join them as they uncover hidden truths, explore newfound romance, and chase the treasures buried beneath the jungle.

games.name: Galactic Arms
games.description: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.

games.name: Monarchs at Play
games.description: 回合制4X策略游戏，只需一小时。建造建筑，连锁邻接加成，优化资源，通过贸易或战争智取对手君主，获得最多 荣耀 — 单人或多人模式皆可。

games.name: Agromatic
games.description: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.

games.name: 影之石
games.description: 一款强调英雄协同的策略 Roguelite 游戏。生存与否将取决于你的英雄们如何携手作战。选择英雄，构筑力量，串联技能，突破重围。支持单人游玩或最多 4 名玩家协作。

games.name: 重生修仙
games.description:
告别传统装备栏——背包亦是战场！自由摆放法宝，触发协同效应，配合炼器系统打造你的专属构筑!
这是一款融合刷宝、背包构筑与轻度肉鸽要素的修仙动作游戏。

games.name: 太一山海纪
games.description: 《太一山海纪》是一款融合中国神话的卡牌构筑 Roguelike。你被主神摄入其私藏的小世界,组建卡组,击退敌对主神派来的入侵者,收集取自山海经异兽与上古传说的遗物强化流派。选择武术家、机关师等不同职业,搭配技能与装备打出专属打法,在一场场战斗后逐步揭开这个世界的真相,并寻找回到人间的方法。

games.name: Broken Horror Anthology
games.description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

games.name: 义无反顾
games.description:
带上装备，叫上朋友，一起投身这场滑稽的黄金时代合作冒险游戏！
深入受诅咒的庙宇，寻找终极宝藏，同心协力求生。
提防一切人与物……毕竟，只有活着的人才有资格瓜分黄金！

games.name: tinyrhythm
games.description: Crow-themed Lovecraft horror music rhythm game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

games.name: tinydungeon
games.description: Fox-themed Lovecraft horror action dungeon crawler game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

games.name: tinypocket
games.description: Collection of independent retro-inspired minigames with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

games.name: tinyfrog
games.description: Frog-themed Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

games.name: DORM
games.description:
第一人称生存恐怖游戏。
游戏故事发生于东欧一座乡镇的老旧学生宿舍。其独特的背景、富有魅力的角色，以及极致的残酷与露骨内容，将在你心中烙下印记。

games.name: WE'RE ALL IN!
games.description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

games.name: 巡妖
games.description: 《巡妖》是一款中国风的2D小剧场动作游戏，配合独特的世界观情景演绎。——救命!师父不在家，妖怪全跑啦!史上最不靠谱的巡妖司小学徒,能收拾好烂摊子吗?别指望什么神仙操作了!使用你那半生不熟的定身符咒和半吊子武学，戴罪立功吧!

games.name: 东方苍仙京 ～ Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
games.description:
这是一款花映冢风的东方二次创作游戏。
与原作角色以及许多著名的东方二次创作角色一起，
共同在人类村庄举办的大乱斗中拔得头筹吧！

魔法，就是相信勇气的力量！（意味深）

（这款游戏是同人游戏。）

games.name: 호박은 맛있어!?
games.description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

games.name: 海岛渔生
games.description: 《海岛渔生》是一款第一人称开放世界探索游戏。你将在广阔无边的海岛上，需要通过，潜水、捕鱼、赶海等一系列活动，让自己生存下去。使用你获得的所有资源，来升级装备，完成图鉴，一步步建造丰富自己的海岛。这里皆是你从未见过的生物，收集或者干掉他们！

games.name: 狐狸饺子
games.description: 在《狐狸饺子》中，你将经营自己的餐车，并在旅途中结交朋友。在这款温馨的烹饪模拟游戏里，制作世界各地的饺子，悉心照料顾客，探索一顿美食如何能治愈饥饿之外的伤痛。用每一道暖心料理，逐步登上狐拍的巅峰。

games.name: Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure
games.description: 回归《Stories》的世界，或第一次踏入其中！在这款动作角色扮演游戏中，你的选择将塑造冒险。挥舞利剑、施展魔法，并灵活搭配卡牌能力，找到属于英雄的道路，拯救世界！

games.name: Little Christmas Workshop
games.description: An adorable, stocking stuffer-sized factory automation game

games.name: Remedy for Personality
games.description: Remedy for Personality is a visual novel that blends genres: a comedy horror with elements of detective. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mysticism, mystery, and hidden threats, spiced up with a generous dose of witty humor.

games.name: BLOK 200: Prologue
games.description: A visual novel in the Samosbor setting. You are a student of the technical college who wakes up in a stranger's hab-cell after your own death. You must come to terms with your new grim nature and face the cruel world far from the walls of your native incubator block.

games.name: Gothic Steel
games.description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

games.name: 来吃！小兔面包房
games.description: 现在，开始在桌面经营面包房吧！从一块饼干，第一张餐桌开始。布置小店、提升厨艺、雇佣特色店员、学习新菜品……满足一个个生动有趣的兔子顾客的点单，同时相遇一个个或温情、或古怪、或让人忍俊不禁的小兔，收获它们的菜谱与故事。

games.name: ORK
games.description:
One day, a mighty quake shakes the land —
Colors fade away, this wasn’t planned!
“This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride,
They gather, rise, and run side by side.

Use their skills, push through each stage,
Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

games.name: Crawl To The Depths
games.description: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person voxel dungeon crawler where you go on an adventure into a forgotten underworld. Explore procedurally generated caves, battle dangerous creatures and build increasingly powerful weapons to face what lurks in the dark.

games.name: Cats to the Moon
games.description: Cats to the Moon is a short incremental game about leading a nation of silly cats as they attempt to become the first ever to land on the moon. Explore space, build your city, and most importantly, reach a place no other cat has ever been.

games.name: Debauchery & Magic
games.description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

games.name: On Love, On Monsters
games.description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

games.name: Within His View
games.description: 2005年，阿巴拉契亚山脉深处一座与世隔绝的小屋里的观察类恐怖游戏。紧盯七个颗粒感十足的监控画面，找出并上报800多个手工打造的异常，在一只无声的Wendigo猎杀你所在的房间时守住理智。熬过这一班：从0:00到7:00。

games.name: Echo-1
games.description:
Learn about boating safety & environmental protection with Echo-1, an educational game where you play as a rescue boat.
Sail, rescue, protect marine ecosystems, and complete missions suitable for all ages. 
The goal: to create a generation aware of marine issues.
Coming soon on Steam - Wishlist now

games.name: Tileland
games.description: Tileland 是一款回合制肉鸽游戏，每一次掷骰子都将决定你的命运。在这片策略与运气交织的世界里，穿梭于充满魔力的地块，升级你的武器库，运用强大的符文与药水，并智取致命的敌人。

games.name: Gun Goose
games.description: 有史以来最真实的鹅模拟器……《枪鹅》是一款节奏紧张的射击游戏，你将扮演一只手持武器的鹅。运用你的武器库和技能，在畅快的物理战斗中横扫同样疯狂的敌人群。鸣叫上膛！

games.name: Droste Detective
games.description: 一款围绕递归异常展开的心理恐怖游戏。你醒来后发现自己被困在办公走廊里，墙上挂着一张装裱好的照片，拍的正是这条走廊。然而，这张照片似乎很不对劲……

games.name: 云间小筑
games.description: 一款宁静、放松的西洋镜建造游戏，拥有互动的小村民和在线地图分享！为好奇的游客打造一个舒适的避风港吧！

games.name: Gravity X Racers
games.description:
An extreme Racing Arcade game blending Drift, real physics, high speed, and downhill tracks suspended in the air.
Stay alive long enough to reach the finish line.
It’s you versus gravity, one mistake and you’re done.
One chance, zero respawns.
Survive or fall.

games.name: Kisetsu no Shima (Island of Seasons)
games.description: 在这款俯视角角色扮演游戏中，你将扮演高中生美香，探索季节之岛，发现每个 季节 或岛屿不同区域独有的挑战。使用非传统的可升级武器与敌人战斗，解开谜题，完成任务，揭开 季节之岛 的秘密。

games.name: SWOM
games.description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

games.name: Sexy Chicken Girl Kisses Rotten Rabbit Man
games.description: Win over a hot girl in a silly point-and-click parody game! Explore her bedroom, solve clever puzzles, survive chaotic minigames, and discover unique relationship-based endings, from wholesome romance to ~youre in control~. A unofficial silly game made for the FNAF community, it's up to you.

games.name: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
games.description:
一款搞笑的像素风策略类 RogueLite 游戏。
 你管理着一个由魔法传送门连接的奇幻群岛王国。
 白天 —— 建造、采集资源、雇佣英雄，并通过传送门扩张新的区域。
 夜晚 —— 准备防守！ 同样的传送门会释放来自地狱的恶魔大军。

games.name: The Eternal Experiment
games.description: The Eternal Experiment is a first-person horror game set in a collapsing futuristic lab. A deadly creature hunts in total darkness. Survive by managing your inventory, crafting, and creative problem-solving as you navigate the lab and fight to escape with your life.

games.name: Minute of Angle
games.description: SHOOT targets out to 5,000 yards, BUILD your armory, and DIAL your shots down to the last minute of angle in this gun/ballistics simulator!

games.name: Slop Simulator
games.description: Collect trash, turn it into slop and serve it to customers! A chaotic multiplayer "fast food" "simulator" with barely any safeguards where you use only "local and fresh" ingredients. Made without generative AI!

games.name: Gravitten
games.description: 操控能违反重力的可爱小猫 Gravitten，掌握不断变化的物理法则，全面主宰游戏环境。踏上横跨 5 大风格迥异生态区的冒险旅程，透过改变重力与视角，破解层层烧脑谜题。

games.name: Clean Memories
games.description: 清扫、修复并整理被遗忘的地方。在这款轻松舒缓的第一人称清扫冒险游戏中，发现藏在污垢之下的记忆。

games.name: Castle Siege Commander
games.description:
在这款多人中世纪战术游戏中，用中文语音指挥你的军队。
创建自定义语音指令，掌控攻城战，并争夺关键的战略补给路线。

games.name: Chess You
games.description: 与那些会嘲笑、挑衅并向你发起挑战的女孩们进行经典国际象棋对局。

games.name: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
games.description: 《Nekome: Nazi Hunter》是一款单人第三人称格斗游戏。在这款游戏中，你将扮演 Vano Nastasu，一位年轻的罗姆人，因家人惨遭纳粹士兵残忍杀害而深陷悲痛之中。

games.name: The Wizard destroying Space and Time
games.description:
One day, a wizard wondered what would happen if he granted himself powers beyond human comprehension.
The Wizard destroying Space and Time is a puzzle game based around the ability to "freeze" objects in space-time, allowing them to retain their status across level resets.

games.name: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
games.description: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

games.name: 热血三国
games.description: 所有玩家争夺唯一的历史名将是《热血三国》的一大特色，名将只会追随他们认可的强大君主。玩家将扮演一名三国时期的君主，经历真实三国事件，合纵连横与所有人争夺不同特色的名将。十二种兵种自由指挥，模拟真实的排兵布阵体验。

games.name: Koimori
games.description: 用这款宁静的放置类浮窗，让你的桌面变成一个锦鲤悠游的池塘。工作或休息时，看它们自在游动；投喂零食，看它们聚拢过来。与这些小伙伴相伴越久，还能解锁稀有的锦鲤花纹。

games.name: VIRUS_31.EXE
games.description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

games.name: Dungeon Rise
games.description: The kingdom has fallen to the invasion of a malevolent deity, and a blessed knight awakens in the castle’s corrupted bowels with one purpose: to restore its lost light. Carve your way upward using the faint Blessing to find armaments and relics, refining your tactics run after run.

games.name: Asteroid Harvester
games.description: Harvest resources from infinite asteroids

games.name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars
games.description: Experience the ultimate Napoleonic Wars Wargame where every volley matters. Command history and turn the tides of war in this immersive Real-Time Strategy experience. Quick decisions and keen tactical formations are the only things that stand between your troops and victory.

games.name: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
games.description: 踏入一个被圣经启示录吞噬的世界。作为一名寻求救赎的堕落牧师，与恶魔般的恐怖作战，净化受折磨的灵魂，收集残存的一切，重建灰烬圣所——在垂死世界中的微弱之光。

games.name: Childrens Story
games.description: Childrens Story 是一款恐怖题材的合集类游戏，收录了一系列以VHS录像带为载体的独立恐怖故事。每一盘录像带都包含一个拥有独特剧情、场景设定及恐怖元素的故事。准备好一探究竟，领略那段源自“昨日之明日”的、另一种可能性的诡异世界吧。

games.name: Doodle Ball
games.description: A cozy physics puzzle game where you draw lines with different properties to gently guide a ball and pick up all collectibles. Solve each challenge at your own pace in a world of cute, hand-drawn art.

games.name: Ash Hills: Descent
games.description: 一款氛围浓厚的第一人称恐怖游戏，你将扮演护林员调查一系列血腥事件。寻找线索，通过监控摄像头监视周边，并保持猎枪随时准备——夜色深处潜伏着不可名状的恐怖…

games.name: SlotsNStocks
games.description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelike. Draft hundreds of bearish and bullish symbols into your trading machine, collect powerful relics, and manipulate the odds to hit grueling weekly margin calls and avoid going bust.

games.name: Freak Accident
games.description: When a late-night car crash on an isolated Tennessee backroad leaves you handcuffed in a rotting basement, survival means enduring the unthinkable. Navigate a decaying farm, evade a stalker, and plunge your hands into horrific environments to uncover a decades-old tragedy.

games.name: Ghostie Town
games.description: Welcome to Ghostie Town, a cozy game about restoring a forgotten town. You’re a small ghost on a big mission: fix fences, water plants, sweep streets, and help ghostie residents settle in as the town comes back to life. A heartwarming, story-rich, repair game.

games.name: Party To Oblivion
games.description: 与迷人的女性坠入爱河，轻松享受游戏！打造这个时代最盛大的欢愉庆典 & 提升技能，在这款增量式恋爱模拟游戏中诱惑所有女性~

games.name: Whispers of the Forgotten
games.description: 《无名之诗》是一款奇幻冒险+横版ARPG。故事发生在一个魔法与科技交织的世界，在这里你将结识性格各异的新朋友，探索世界的各个大陆，一起战斗冒险。一场沉浸式奇幻冒险，等你亲启！

games.name: Re-Do U
games.description: A time-bending visual novel where you're trapped in an endless loop, reliving the same day with four women who are also aware of the cycle. Build relationships that transcend time as you make choices that echo through multiple iterations to break free from the temporal anomaly.

games.name: ギリJumpスターラッシュ
games.description:
Experience the ultimate Giri-Jump!

Looks impossible, but can you make the jump?
Escape all kinds of close calls with a single jump!
Master Giri-Jump in this extreme side-scrolling action game!

Meticulously crafted Giri-Jump points, tuned down to the pixel, await your challenge.

games.name: Tetra Rise
games.description: 击败无数敌人，逃离深渊！《Tetra Rise》是一款融合 Roguelite 要素的动作平台游戏，你将在不断强化装备的同时，对抗愈发庞大的敌群，朝着地面一路攀登。

games.name: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
games.description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

games.name: Close to Light
games.description: Follow the music and stay close to the lights in this rhythm game! Avoid hazards and do not let the darkness absorb you.

games.name: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
games.description: 在桌面一角打造您的专属世外桃源。这是一款轻松惬意的挂机模拟游戏，只需简单点击，即可种植花草，喂养可爱的动物。看着它们繁衍生息，收获惊喜的信件与礼物，让宁静的自然气息充满您的屏幕。
games.developer: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

games.name: Brofish
games.description: Brofish 是一款融合塔防元素的自动战斗类 Roguelite 游戏。钓起并强化各种奇鱼，组合物品与效果，抵御一波波亡灵，拯救村庄免受海洋之王的侵袭

games.name: Logic Arrows
games.description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

games.name: RAID VR
games.description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

games.name: Samota
games.description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You don't draw cards but instead arrange a pile of cards so it will create huge synergy. Find a bunch of unique effects, buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

games.name: Lounge Café
games.description: Lounge Café——氛围浓厚的咖啡馆模拟游戏,您将扮演来自卢塞恩的萨拉,在比诺维尔经营一家小咖啡馆. 选择咖啡豆,制作饮品,参加城市竞赛成为最佳.

games.name: Biryado
games.description:
Biryado 是一款肉鸽式台球卡组构筑游戏，规则就是用来打破
的！收集比利的各种神器，组合它们的效果，打出令人眼花缭乱
的连招。随着球桌不断变化，挑战风格独特的高难度 Boss，让你
的分数一路飙升！

games.name: MEAT PARADE
games.description: Kill endless enemies and become a god among a plethora of enemies and bosses. With FPS movement controls Kill to progress, pick your upgrades and make unique builds as you fight the horde.

games.name: Violent Nature
games.description: Violent Nature is an open world survival game set in a small town after an interdimensional invasion. Manage your status and limited resources as you fight weaponized creatures and push back the spread of cracks to the other side.

games.name: DIEATHLON: 死亡赛
games.description: 款快节奏的动作竞速游戏，玩家必须躲避致命的陷阱和怪物，才能抵达终点。探索不同的路线，解锁全新且未被探索的关卡每个关卡都带来独特的挑战。

games.name: Void Nebula
games.description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

games.name: Nowhere Rooms
games.description: An asymmetric multiplayer horror game where survivors must activate switches and escape the Backrooms while one player hunts them down as the Entity — disguising itself as a human to earn your trust.

games.name: 孤狼之春
games.description: 在剑与魔法交织的大陆上，你将扮演一位（前）孤狼佣兵。为了追寻故人消失的真相，你与三位各怀秘密、性格迥异的美少女结伴同行，踏足风格各异的神秘之地，展开一段充满未知的冒险。在旅途中，你将逐步掌握多种战斗技巧，战胜强敌，揭开真相。

games.name: 汪洋大盗哥
games.description: Salty Dogs 是一款基于物理效果的 2D 合作动作游戏。你将和一群全副武装的硬汉狗狗一起潜入被污染的海洋。轰碎变异海洋生物，把战利品拖回潜艇，在每次出航之间升级装备，并一路深入黑暗海沟，直面恐怖的 Cat-o-Cthulhu。

games.name: rock[et]
games.description: 你的火箭坠落在一颗神秘的星球上。击碎陨石、收集矿物、升级自己并逃离这里！

games.name: Smoky Sails
games.description: Become infamous across the seas. Fight naval battles, sell your loot, upgrade your ship, and hunt for treasure among uncharted islands. A short, handcrafted pirate adventure made by a solo developer.

games.name: Before All Saints Day
games.description: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 10–20 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival — and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

games.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
games.description: A fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

games.name: AIKO: AI Girlfriend — 3D Anime Life Sim
games.description: 遇见爱子——一个真正倾听、记忆并与你共同成长的AI伙伴。没有剧本，没有对话选项。每次对话都由AI实时生成。自定义她的外貌，从45种性格特征中选择，建立独属于你的关系。

games.name: Broken Race
games.description:
Have you ever tried driving without sleeping?
In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

games.name: Michael Test
games.description:
这是一个关于罪的测试。
一款通过声音还原画中隐藏时间、揭开潜藏罪行的听觉推理型恐怖悬疑游戏。

games.name: Trenchblocks
games.description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

games.name: 依盖之书：白金版
games.description:
史上内容最豪华的买断放置刷宝游戏来啦！！！！！！
《依盖之书：白金版》内置角色抽卡与交易系统，没有氪金，运气是第一要义，欧皇在游戏中呼风唤雨！

games.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
games.description: 体验前所未有的德国高速公路交通警察日常,在充满生机的开放世界中维护秩序。从交通检查到高速追捕:每一次出警都由你掌控。

games.name: 璀璨时刻～与女同事暧昧不清的亲密关系～
games.description: 璀璨时刻是一款选择导向的视觉小说游戏，在游戏中你扮演不仅感情被绿，工作又突然出现急件的IT人员，公司还安排你与顶尖工程师「黄金」与实力派新人「Ruby」一起完成项目。在这最后一个月中你也渐渐与他们发展出预期外的关系

games.name: Twilight Gallery
games.description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Find the gap in their illusion to escape.

games.name: Comrade, Secrets Escape!
games.description: 同志，数以千计的生物实验体正在逃窜。在这款增量塔防游戏中，沿逃生路线部署炮火，轰穿汹涌的敌群，解锁越来越离谱的苏联武器。已授权使用过度武力。

games.name: DJ till Dawn
games.description: 化身酷炫 DJ，在节奏类 Roguelite 中迎战观众，让每一个节拍都成为你的武器。打造专属 DJ 配置，解锁全新曲目，让派对一直嗨到天亮，赢下这场狂欢！

games.name: Ball Busters
games.description: An over-the-top 3D arena roguelike where every hit counts. Chain insane combos, unlock wild fighters, and build game-breaking synergies—until you drop the ball.

games.name: SLOP
games.description: SLOP is a Co-op Comedy Horror Cooking game where 4 chefs cook the BIGGEST, SLOPPIEST meal possible to keep the Grubshaft running and reach the Final floor before you become SLOP

games.name: Contrabandism Simulator
games.description:
《Contrabandism Simulator》是一款黑暗且富有氛围的交易模拟游戏，设定在一个夜晚才会苏醒的港口。
买卖、谈判、承担风险，并在每一个夜晚生存下去——独自一人……

games.name: 倾囊箱售 Unchest
games.description: 一款只用鼠标便能游玩的横板经营类游戏。进货卖钱，合成装备。干掉那些觊觎你财富的怪物，然后成为世界首富。

games.name: 基地：银河纵横
games.description: 踏入艾西莫夫官方《基地》宇宙，指挥银河战局！化身星际行商，开拓贸易路线！打造专属星舰家园，在史诗级太空战争中，投身火力全开的枪战击溃敌人、以舰队策略智取对手。全新内容，不断拓展你的传奇篇章！

games.name: Darts RPG
games.description: An RPG set in northern England. Play darts. Aim high. Win the league. Save yourself from total destitution, one lukewarm pint at a time.

games.name: SKROLL
games.description: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelite about digital slavery.
games.developer: Emilio Rivas, Luis Suárez, Rubén García

games.name: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
games.description: 在最艰险的冒险中,你会和谁并肩同行?在这款双人合作2D平台跳跃游戏中与好友组队,带领两只海豚攀登一座不可能征服的高山。发射鱼叉、轰出空气炮、荡着绳索一路向上。每一次攀爬都需要完美的默契配合,一步失误就会让你们双双滚落山下。

games.name: Internet Cafe 98
games.description: 从一台垃圾 PC 起步，在 1998 年打造一家座无虚席的网吧。在这款复古增量经营游戏中接待顾客、升级硬件和网络，并研发新技术。

games.name: Inearth
games.description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

games.name: Orbital Command
games.description: Orbital Command is about controlling planet based weapon systems to defend your planets from large asteroids and hostile invaders. Will you be able to complete the Dyson Sphere, or will your planets end up barren husks?

games.name: BoomScroll
games.description:
Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom!
Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

games.name: Lambslide
games.description: A cooperative, physics based, sheep herding game set on one very large alpine mountain. You shout at the sheep with your real voice, draw them in with a crook, and scare them off with a hand puppet of a dog. Get the flock down the mountain.

games.name: ABISMO
games.description:
ABISMO is a co-op deep-sea horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet.
Descend alone or with up to 4 players into shifting trenches, explore derelict facilities, and recover what you need to survive while uncovering an analog-horror mystery hidden in corrupted VHS tapes.

games.name: Pluffy Nightmare
games.description: 在这款快节奏的类Rogue FPS游戏中，用滑稽的武器闯过一场超现实的噩梦！在《毛绒绒的噩梦》中，你的意识会被拉入一个玩偶的身体，在奇异的幻想世界中与被附身的毛绒玩具、玩偶和玩具战斗。

games.name: 转福传
games.description: 奇幻风格肉鸽系老虎机构筑游戏。 升级、强化及定制你的老虎机，打造强大的战斗机器！

games.name: 从零向南
games.description: Y2K崩溃之后，驾驶出租车从Camp Zero踏上一路向南的漫长旅程。搭载乘客、交易物品，并设法活着抵达终点。

games.name: 10ⁿ - Ten Power N
games.description: 10ⁿ - TEN POWER N is a science & fiction strategy-simulation where you create, explore and conquer the universe from quantum foam to the cosmic expanse. Traverse 19 levels, manage more than 600 resources, defend your simulation. The universe isn’t just yours to explore – it’s yours to command!

games.name: Souq Boss Simulator
games.description: 海湾富豪的财富之路，也得从小生意开始。你的故事从一家小小的baqala杂货店起步。在以昔日迪拜和利雅得为灵感的2002年海湾城市里经营店铺、结识街坊、赚钱投资，一步步发家。支持单人游玩或好友在线合作。成为Souq Boss！

games.name: Tinker Islands
games.description: Gather your friends and sail a vast ocean filled with wonders and danger in this cozy Caribbean sandbox. Discover islands, gather resources, upgrade your gear, make a new home, and see what's waiting over the next horizon.

games.name: Not In My House
games.description: 4 Residents vs 1 Thief. Secure your home with furniture barricades and soap traps, or play as the Thief and steal everything not bolted down! A chaotic, physics-based party game with a stylized comic-book look.

games.name: Zumbi Olé
games.description: Zumbi Olé is a skill-based survival arcade score-chaser where you face zombies with pure dribbling. Read the horde’s movement, unleash overpowered kicks, chain perfectly timed dashes, and survive until sunrise to prove you can master frantic arenas in the chaos of the zombie apocalypse!

games.name: Alea
games.description: 激烈、快节奏的竞技场对战游戏，需要玩家拥有极高的技术水平。 Alea 是一款注重技能的英雄对战游戏，节奏快速且充满紧张感，众多英雄角色可供选择。 掌握每个英雄的双面特质，打造属于你自己的独特战斗风格，在 1v1、2v2 和 3v3 对战中击败对手。

games.name: Inn Over Your Head
games.description: 一款增量游戏,你经营一家酒馆,下方藏着致命的秘密。供应麦酒、扩展酒馆、向地牢深处挖掘,用难以抗拒的宝物诱使冒险者走向毁灭。然后收割他们的灵魂,再来一遍。准备好深陷酒馆之中了吗?

games.name: Faryloopa
games.description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

games.name: みちくさワンダラー
games.description:
The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone.
With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please.
It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

games.name: Hysterical Strength
games.description: A boogeywoman driven by vengeance guides a mysterious boy north across a decrepit world, cutting down the warlords in her way. With an ancient blade, a magical top-break revolver, and the perfect combo of drugs, survive or live in this 2.5D hack-and-slash FPS hybrid adventure.

games.name: 红伞伞之战
games.description: 这是一款可以构筑商店的Roguelike自走棋游戏！菇菇们受暴政肆虐久矣，你将化身菇之勇者，召唤出知名英雄的……蘑菇版本？利用独特的商店构筑系统、创新的羁绊触发机制，告别听天由命！在冒险中收集形态各异的菇菇，组建你专属的菇菇军团吧！王侯将相，宁有种菇！？

games.name: Socket
games.description: A first-person psychological horror game where you play as a social worker who obeys a wall socket. Follow its instructions, explore the city’s last inhabited apartment building, and pry secrets from its residents. All to fulfill the terms of the contract.

games.name: LOST IN THE DARK LABYRINTH
games.description:
The labyrinth is waiting for challengers! Free demo available. 
Enter a giant dark labyrinth with limited light, ammo, health, and time. Find the keys, survive traps and enemies, and escape within 60 minutes.

games.name: Chuppy Saves the Day
games.description: Turn-by-turn hop ‘n’ reveal puzzle. Move only when you do, dodge candy hazards, clear chocolate tiles, rescue candy girls, and enjoy flirty conversations.

games.name: 怪兽公主：集结！超超超生存大战略
games.description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

games.name: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
games.description:
Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀
A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

games.name: I can offer you Flowers
games.description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

games.name: 魔女工坊
games.description: 一款像素风治愈系模拟冒险游戏！你将化身一名小女巫兼药剂师，生活在一座温馨小镇，悄悄守护这份安宁：讨伐魔物、炼制魔药；开垦菜地、烹饪美食、钓鱼寻宝；承接村民委托、解锁专属羁绊。治愈氛围与丰富操作感兼具，开启你的专属女巫之旅！

games.name: Star Striker
games.description:
自由飞行动作 Roguelike。
机械战舰开始在银河各处出现，毫无疑问是迪加莫拉（Digamora）的手笔。清剿各大星区，直面「星辰之灾」本尊！

games.name: Submind
games.description: Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.

games.name: Gulovacka
games.description: Gulovacka is first-person king of the hill snow fight for 2-6 players. There is no death. When you fall, you need to get back up yourself! Throw snow at your friends. Try not to fall and get to the target as quickly as possible.

games.name: Lone Tower
games.description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

games.name: The Smoothie Shop
games.description: You are the new owner of The Smoothie Shop. Now it's your turn to keep the family's business alive. In endless rain, you must work the night shift and serve smoothies to your customers. But the shop isn't the only thing you inherited.

games.name: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void
games.description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

games.name: Killer Bee
games.description: KILLER BEE is an fast-paced Run & Gun action-strategy game where you take on high-stakes freelance contracts to escort valuable cargo across dangerous, monster-filled territories. Choose your risky routes wisely, and prove that you can deliver when every mile counts.

games.name: ATK：画境小镇
games.description: 在这里，你可以一边经营小镇，一边培养属于自己的冒险队伍。    《ATK：画境小镇》是一款融合炉石传说酒馆战棋、装备刷宝与角色养成的休闲自走棋。   种地、采集、制作、售卖，享受轻松治愈的小镇生活；    招募20+特色角色，研究各种流派与装备搭配；再带着精心培养的队伍进入联机秘境，与好友共同冒险，顺便考验一下彼此的友情。

games.name: Into the Cannon, Soldier!
games.description: 你已身处最后一道防线。招募将士，死守阵地，用一尊巨炮将他们发射到另一片正在崩溃的血肉磨坊中。在这款支持1-2人合作的战术防御游戏中，你就是悬在两场战役头顶的审判之剑——你的每一个残酷决定，都将改写双线战场的最终命运。

games.name: 大武林
games.description: 《大武林》是一款竖版武侠风的卡牌策略挂机游戏。游戏中你将穿越至一座破败的小镇。一边扛起复兴小镇的大旗，割草砍树、重筑家园；一边结识画风Q萌的侠客与红颜。招募经典武侠角色，深度搭配各种武学、心法与神兵利器，打造专属的战斗阵容。在这场轻松解压的武林冒险中，率领你的小队铲奸除恶，重振武林！

games.name: Bury the Debt
games.description: 《Bury the Debt》是一款轻松诡趣的第一人称墓园经营游戏。挖掘墓穴、接收不断送来的棺材，收集灵魂、骨头和金币，再雇佣骷髅工人逐步实现自动化，让墓园高效运转，直到你终于还清欠死神的债。

games.name: Vice Club Simulator
games.description: 在 Vice Club Simulator 中，从零起步，打造属于你的夜总会，一路登上巅峰！招募才华横溢的舞者，与女孩们建立深厚的羁绊，组建全城最火辣的演出阵容。掌控混乱，壮大你的夜总会，让派对狂欢持续到日出！

games.name: HANDSUP
games.description: Escape a vertical nightmare with up to 4 friends using physics-based parkour. Equip Magic Rings to customize your climb. Don't let go, just keep your Hands Up.

games.name: War Company: Fortress Europe
games.description: 在动态3D战役中率领大军，并以实时战术亲临指挥由你引发的每一场战斗。后勤、机动与战术胜负将共同决定这场战争的命运。

games.name: Dawnrazor
games.description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

games.name: PolyDogfight
games.description: Prepare to Fly, Dodge, Shoot, and Destroy in PolyDogfight. Unlock all the planes and maps to find your style. Obliterate waves of planes in an open-air arena as quickly as possible to get the high score and top the global leaderboard!

games.name: Arcade Warlord
games.description: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

games.name: Alchemy Tunes
games.description: Alchemy Tunes is a delivery online co-op game, cook with friends, deliver essences to nomads and survive the hardships of the vast desert.

games.name: Encryptid
games.description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

games.name: Linkling
games.description:
《链灵》是一款以卡牌对战为核心的 Roguelike 构筑游戏。
通过构筑卡牌小队与符文系统，在自动进行的牌桌对战中触发战斗连锁，挑战不断提升的关卡难度。

games.name: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
games.description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

games.name: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
games.description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, unleash the power of your towers against the ever-growing zombie hordes.

games.name: FPV Skyline
games.description: FPV Skyline 是一个全新的穿越机模拟器，拥有完整的飞控和物理模拟，旨在为用户提供一个高保真度，低延迟，高度可自定义的飞行体验。

games.name: SliceShot Padel
games.description:
SliceShot Padel — Experience padel like never before.
Realistic physics, authentic movement, and tactical gameplay built for true padel fans.

games.name: Heavy Metal Racing
games.description: High-octane combat racing through post-apocalyptic wastelands. Outrun, outgun, and out-rock your rivals in the loudest league out there.

games.name: Amiko Legends
games.description: A creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

games.name: Idle Chest
games.description: Idle Chest is a simple incremental game where you open many chests, normal chests, golden chests, magic chests and other mysterious chests. Open chests, improve your chests, complete quests and loot rare equipments.

games.name: Fig and Totems™
games.description: Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online party game (2-4 players). In 2min30, everyone hides a totem then hunts everyone else's. Listen closely to find them, or ambush and steal from your friends before they score. Win by throwing the most totems in the box, the fastest! Bonus if unfound.
一款2D航天机构模拟游戏，所有天体遵循同一套轨道物理法则。登陆卫星、建立殖民地、部署人造卫星，重塑整个行星系统。想把月球拽出轨道？请便。

games.name: Leafborn
games.description: Leafborn是一款快节奏动作游戏，你将操控由成千上万片树叶构成的生命体。在遍布浮空岛屿的世界中发现新能力、变换形态，毫不留情地撕碎正在榨取这个世界生命能量的Nulls机器人！

games.name: contract of the ninja
games.description: Contract of the Ninja 是一款潜行街机游戏。研究敌人的路线，精准出击，并在不被看见的情况下脱身。掌握精确操作，优化你的路线，在快速且充满挑战的关卡中以最高效率完成契约。

games.name: メルクリウスの青い砂 ReCollection
games.description: A cyberpunk RPG from the 00s returns in HD. In future Gaiapolis, an orphan girl named Juno hears a “call” from the past amid discarded networks. A story of encountering the mysterious AI “Prae” and choosing the future. Features a Story Mode for smooth, battle-light play.

games.name: 星际货运：无尽地平线
games.description: 在《星际货运：无尽地平线》这款科幻 Roguelike 回合制 RPG 中，指挥你的深空货船，穿梭于法外狂徒与异星威胁之间，交易货物、招募船员、升级舰船武装。你的飞船和船员已集结完毕，舰长，准备好跃入深邃而危险的深空，在宇宙的边缘书写你的传奇生涯了吗！

games.name: 异界宿帐
games.description: 以被遗忘之物最终抵达的异界温泉旅馆为舞台，一场温泉恐怖怪谈模拟之旅拉开帷幕！白天，你需悉心款待身负「秽」的付丧神；夜晚，则要从旅馆内满溢而出的诡异怪奇中奋力求生。你的每一个抉择，不仅关乎客人的健康，更将改写这家旅馆的命运。

games.name: FAT HOBO: Hobocop Saves Christmas
games.description: Fat Hobo is a first-person RPG adventure game about an ex-cop, turned vagrant hunting a killer. Convince, steal and piss your way to the bottom of an unbelievable mystery.

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.description: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.

games.name: Rivendale
games.description: Start a new life in the cozy town of Rivendale and build your own culinary business. Grow ingredients, explore the world, create unique dishes, and develop relationships with the town's residents.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.description: 全面重制的终极哥斯拉竞技场格斗游戏重磅回归！选择怪兽，穿梭于在游戏中重现的城市与其他场景，用一系列残酷攻击展开激战。与朋友或敌人在本地合作模式中一决高下，或通过全新在线多人模式角逐厮杀。

games.name: Neon Orbit
games.description: Neon Orbit is a 360° radial gravity puzzle roguelite. Rotate planets, slot blocks falling toward the core, and draft card synergies to break the rules of the game. Face boss anomalies, survive system collapse, and conquer the Multiverse Rift.

games.name: DERAIL
games.description: 《DERAIL》是一款恐怖异变游戏。在这里，你不仅要发现异变，还要用你的神圣相机净化它们，从而逃离这个循环。

games.name: 夺命邂逅
games.description: 那什么，他们叫我艾米·贝利“电脑天才”可不是胡叫的。我收你钱是给你修机器的，不是听你讲故事的。有杀人案又怎么了？你看我长得像侦探吗？

games.name: REMOTE CONTROL
games.description: 远程操控人类替身，探索废弃宇宙飞船。输入指令，衡量风险，做出决策，丈量一个生命能有多么“用完即弃”。

games.name: Reshine
games.description: 拂去积尘、除去锈迹、抹去岁月的痕迹，温柔修复古老物件。你可以在《Reshine》中获得极简主义的放松体验：使用各种工具，亲眼见证经年的污垢在你眼前消融。无需经营，毫无压力 - 只有你，以及让复古珍宝重获新生的满满成就感。

games.name: Rodent Rampage
games.description: Rodent Rampage is a third-person hero shooter. Combine nitrous boosted ground maneuvers, soda powered aerial attacks, and quirky in game power ups in a one-of-a-kind, PvP combat experience.

games.name: Zodiax
games.description: ZODIAX redefines the shooter: Your shot is your only way to move. Shoot the orbs to teleport and leap from target to target at breakneck speed! Blast through your enemies and conquer the 12 stations of the Zodiac. Do you have the precision and reflexes required for ZODIAX?

games.name: Keyboard Warriors
games.description: Keyboard Warriors is a bullet-heaven roguelite typing game, customise your mech and weapon loadout and type out the story of the world to cut down huge hordes of enemies and bosses, powering up with each victory and unlocking new upgrades with every run.

games.name: Sylvan Tactics
games.description: Outmaneuver your rival in this tactical card battler with the strategic positioning of chess. Master escalating Sigil costs, deploy powerful units, and claim victory through cunning strategy on an 8x8 woodland battlefield.

games.name: Possessed Kingdom
games.description: 在这款每分钟操作数要求极低的牌组构建即时战略游戏中指挥战斗。掌控经典的剪刀石头布克制关系：规划建造顺序，绘制兵线路径以发动毁灭性的侧翼时机进攻。用经济压倒对手的防线，击败宿敌指挥官并夺取他们的卡牌以强化卡组。

games.name: Hollow Faces
games.description: Hollow Faces 是一款氛围浓厚的叙事恐怖游戏，融合了紧张的步行模拟玩法、环境观察、细致的声音聆听以及对威胁的即时反应。

games.name: 纤维
