games.description: 人与人的联系像一根根纤维线，在反复的拉扯与缠绕中，有些越缠越紧，有些却慢慢松开。成绩、未来，家人的期望缝紧了她的呼吸。而有些原本紧密的羁绊，却像织物上的线，随着时间逐渐起了毛、松垮。关于亲密与距离，期待与逃避，她试着去理解，也试着被理解。

games.name: CONDOMINIUM: NO EXIT
games.description: 一如往常地乘坐列车回家。然而，门外迎接你的却是脱离常识轨道的混沌世界。手机开始疯狂地响起……

games.name: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
games.description:
这是一款非常短的游戏 🥳

我们在一个无声漫画里藏了200只猫，讲的是一只三花猫在屋子里到处追毛线球的故事。你能全部找到吗？🔎🙀

games.name: Interregnum
games.description: 构筑牌组，智取对手——这是一款向《Dominion》等经典牌库构筑游戏致敬的作品。在这场颇具深度的策略对局中，以更高明的战术抢占先机。你既可以在战役模式中击败各具特色的 AI 对手，也可以在线与好友斗智较量！

games.name: No Mercy
games.description: 一款粗粝写实的 Bodycam 风格第一人称射击游戏。一场失败的政变将城市拖入混乱。杀出帮派控制的街区，查明妻子失踪背后的真相，并用一颗颗子弹夺回被抢走的一切。

games.name: Isle of Titans
games.description: Isle of Titans is an idle tower defense game where you defend a small kingdom against giant invaders. Shape your build with long-term progression between runs, and adapt on the fly during each run to hold back endless waves of Titans.

games.name: That's Not My Cat!
games.description: 领养一只住在你桌面上的小猫。它在窗口之间蹦来蹦去，在任务栏上打盹，每一次抚摸都在为它的新帽子攒钱。给它起个名字，好好爱它，永远别关掉它。

games.name: Picker Magnate Simulator
games.description: 收购废品、寻找稀有宝物，在自己的二手店里把一切变成利润。砍价、修理古董、制作手工制品并升级技能，不想扛重物就买车，打造你的转售帝国。

games.name: Quiz Show Simulator
games.description: 通过精心设计问题、挑选参赛选手和制定制作决策，运营您自己的高风险问答节目，以扩大观众群、提高收视率并赚取更多收入！

games.name: Odds At Oddity
games.description: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

games.name: Peak Slayer
games.description: 一款在网格上进行的回合制Roguelike卡组构建游戏。逐层攀登不断变化的高塔，攻击完全依靠手中的卡牌。把敌人击退坠入陷坑，融合六种元素与地形，用遗物和卡牌融合打造属于你的本局构筑。

games.name: Drift Quest
games.description: 一款会自己玩的黑暗奇幻 RPG。创建一位英雄，接下来就由英雄独自踏上旅程：每5秒一个行动，斩杀怨灵、囤积战利品、卖给商人、买些古怪的装备、学会新法术。把它挂在屏幕一角就好。灵感来自《Progress Quest》。

games.name: We Are So Cooked
games.description: 你们惹上大麻烦了。你们不小心杀了人，必须销毁证据。“We Are So Cooked”是一款1-4人合作物理潜行游戏。目标很简单：把尸体运到出口。但实际操作起来？那才是最难的部分。

games.name: Arctic Grave
games.description: Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo outpost's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of the facility, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you.

games.name: The Gardener
games.description: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

games.name: Burn Out
games.description: Burn Out is a frenetic and chaotic 1-4 player online party game set in the ironical world of corporate life. Players battle deadlines and absurd tasks through increasingly stressful levels to climb corporate ladder and take the CEO's place - who stays calm, and who cracks?

games.name: 爬行桌宠
games.description: 《爬行桌宠》是一款运行在 Windows 桌面上的陪伴型生物养成游戏。轻敲蛋壳孵化宠物，通过投喂、互动和升级见证它成长与进化；收集不同伙伴，布置场景和玩具，并使用结晶解锁更多内容。每只宠物都由程序骨骼实时驱动，你可以细致调整身体结构、动作与外观，保存、导入和分享自己的设计。游戏支持完整窗口与透明桌面模式，可隐藏界面或开启鼠标穿透，让宠物在你工作、学习和浏览时安静陪伴，也可以邀请好友联机互动，展示彼此的宠物与个性装扮。

games.name: BECOME LIFE
games.description:
A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. 
Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

games.name: GravityOptional
games.description: A physics-based co-op roguelite about flightless owls, crippling debt, and industrial glue. Pilot a rickety airship through acid storms, harpoon floating garbage, and build makeshift shelters out of stolen bathtubs to protect your cargo. If the package gets wet, you don't get paid.

games.name: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
games.description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

games.name: VoidFire
games.description: A fast-paced horror arena shooter set in unstable zones where darkness, shifting space, and constant pressure shape every fight.

games.name: 面包房里有妖气
games.description: 在这款温馨的整理与经营模拟游戏中，将3600个新鲜出炉的面包与糕点分类摆放到正确的货架上，开启你的面包店营业，赚取金币，升级便捷能力，解锁可爱的食物主题助手与装饰物，打造你的专属面包店。

games.name: Hatchling Scramble
games.description: A cute, wholesome action game where you help baby sea turtles reach the ocean. But you can't control them, only protect them. Turn off bright lights, scare away aggressive crabs, and clear the beach so every hatchling makes it to the sea! 20% of net proceeds support the Sea Turtle Conservancy.

games.name: 远征公会
games.description: 率领公会打团本！招募不同职业的英雄，组建属于你的公会；灵活配队，挑战团本中拥有独特机制的BOSS；提升队伍实力，解锁英雄天赋树、获取毕业装备，打造最强团本阵容。从零开始，一步步成长为最强公会，重拾MMORPG黄金时代的团本开荒乐趣！

games.name: 天津1924
games.description: 1924年的天津波云诡谲，沙皇俄国已经苟延残喘，英法列强还在虎视眈眈，日本殖民者更是蠢蠢欲动。置身于其中，你将感受到这座城市的暗流涌动。在这里，你可以结交豪杰走卒，学习一技之长，选择自己的道路，谱写属于你的传奇！

games.name: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
games.description: 在这款第一人称动作Roguelike中，击退从天而降的感染者，守护霓虹街区。从4种防卫者职业中选择你的战斗方式，保护人类，用Focus开启子弹时间，强化火力，挺过愈发猛烈的15波攻势。

games.name: Real or Rep: Sneaker Store Simulator
games.description: 经营一家球鞋店，把假货挡在货架之外。买入每一双鞋之前，对照 Brand Book 检查走线、标签、鞋底和鞋盒标签。与卖家和顾客讨价还价，在拍卖中竞拍稀有鞋款，处理线上订单，收集 110 多款手工打造的球鞋。

games.name: Seasonal Lockdown
games.description:
An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control.
You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

games.name: Rover’s Radventure: The New Millennium
games.description: After a regular day at work transforms into a bizarre trip that turns his life upside down, a washed-up park ranger named Rover needs to step up and go on a journey that will take him far beyond his wildest fantasies and lead him to confronting uncomfortable truths about himself and his past.

games.name: Bryce Canyon
games.description: A 90s CGI-inspired FPS where players battle each other in fast-paced matches combining unique weapons and abilities to synergize and outplay the competition.

games.name: 猎户座之蓝
games.description:
《猎户座之蓝》是一款以美丽的外星行星为背景的治愈系钓鱼冒险游戏。
钓起各式各样的鱼类、收集资源，并与行星上的居民慢慢建立关系。
你既可以亲自操作游玩，也可以开启放置模式，轻松享受游戏节奏。
在这颗宁静的星球上，打造属于你自己的生活吧。

games.name: Town of Tinysville
games.description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

games.name: 拍点剧场 - STEP THEATER
games.description: 欢迎来到拍点剧场！《拍点剧场》是一款令人心情雀跃的节奏游戏。跟着节拍踏步，让故事不断展开，一起让剧目成功上映吧！快来享受这场可爱又缤纷的故事演出！

games.name: 魑魅：离人之歌
games.description: 你相信世间存在长生者吗？魑魅：离人之歌将以独特的悬疑解密、中式可爱风格，带你走进以“仙茶”闻名的神秘古寨——山隐村，在这里，你将扮演一名通晓阴阳的警察，在感受独特的茶文化之余，暗访悬案以及成仙者背后的隐秘故事。

games.name: Isekai Parlor Simulator GOLD
games.description: An erotic management simulator in which you build your very own monster girl parlor from the ground up!

games.name: SteelBlade Shop Simulator
games.description: SteelBlade Shop Simulator lets you run your own SteelBlade shop in the streets of Japan. Open SteelBlade boxes, collect parts with different tiers, build powerful SteelBlades, sell them for profit, or take them into the arena and compete to prove your skill.

games.name: Rent A Car Together
games.description: Rent A Car Simulator。从一辆车开始，通过购买车辆扩展车队并发展租车业务。驾驶车辆并在故障时进行维修，寻找新客户。也可以通过 Co-Op 模式一起发展你的业务。

games.name: Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure
games.description: Set in a whimsical snowy world inhabited by friendly creatures, Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure offers cozy yet strategic ice‑fishing with smooth pacing, rewarding fish fights, and light RPG elements. Manage your gear and pick your bait in a relaxing experience where every catch feels meaningful.

games.name: Power Of The Sun
games.description: 赋能太阳，驱动宇宙诞生的创世引擎。收集宇宙资源，生成能量，在银河级升级体系中不断进化。燃烧得更加耀眼，把光与意志辐射到整个宇宙!

games.name: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
games.description: Help a mighty dragon restore its power in this relaxing incremental game. Gather resources, summon workers, construct buildings, and unlock powerful upgrades as you progress.

games.name: Just A Dice Game
games.description: 一款轻松的掷骰子肉鸽游戏，追逐目标分数并尝试打破游戏。一边购买升级、遗物和其他强化道具来壮大你的骰子收藏，一边打造疯狂的联动效果，对RNG嗤之以鼻。

games.name: ALIGNMENT : An Engineering Odyssey
games.description: 在真实地形上设计、建造并驾驶自己的公路。调整路线与坡度，开挖山体、修筑边坡、布置桥梁和隧道，打造复杂立交。亲自上路测试每个弯道与坡道；在工程挑战或自由建造中，不断改进自己的方案。

games.name: RoboCat Café
games.description: You manage a cat café in the future the 2000s promised you. Serve the cats and customers with delicious treats. Expand your menu with modern machines to grow your business. Create a cozy environment with new decorations and help the cats find their forever home! ☆

games.name: Hero's Guild
games.description: Your heroes are people. They form bonds, take grudges, fall in love, and die permanently. Run a guild of brilliant, emotionally unstable adventurers — and watch their story write itself.

games.name: Incresleeper
games.description:
A short, active incremental game about fighting insomnia.
Go to bed, bust hordes of demons in your dreams and get powerful upgrades to become a master at sleeping.

games.name: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
games.description:
白天是温馨的农场建造模拟，夜晚是屠魔的试炼之路——种植作物、发展小镇，然后深入地狱，迎战成群的恶魔和巨型 Boss。
《毁灭战士》和《吸血鬼幸存者》遇上《星露谷物语》。

games.name: Flipocalypse
games.description: 一个按键，天地颠倒。在一座不断想弄死你的霓虹城市里，与最多 8 名玩家在七种派对模式中竞速、闪避、求生。在墙上狂奔，在天花板上冲刺。坚持到最后者获胜。

games.name: 堆叠洞天
games.description: 堆叠洞天是一款融合了中国古风修仙与深度生物繁育要素的治愈系堆叠卡牌经营游戏。在游戏中，你将扮演洞天管理者，通过简单的拖拽与堆叠卡牌操作，指派性格各异的小妖们进行耕种、挖矿、炼丹与烹饪，一步步修复失落的世外桃源。游戏不仅具备元磁通道构建的自动化生产线玩法，更拥有复杂的遗传变异系统，你可以通过杂交繁育筛选天赋，培养出织梦猫、九尾狐乃至青龙白虎等上古神兽。这里没有残酷的死亡，牺牲的灵兽可在祠堂复活，闲置的小动物则能派往云游，通过书信寄回远方的特产与挂念。积攒动物们的快乐化为功德，在随机的肉鸽强化中，体验一场既硬核又温暖的修仙建设之旅。

games.name: Rally Shift
games.description: Drive with a live bomb on your dashboard while a relentless alien anomaly stalks you at every turn. Rally Shift is an arcade first person rally time attack. Stay on the gas, master sharp turns, and beat your personal record before time runs out

games.name: Furmageddon
games.description:
Haha! I'm in! I hacked the devs' Steam page!🦝
Rizzo here. Get ready for a 1-4 player online co-op roguelite bullet heaven. Pick your Furmate, build crazy loadouts and see how long you can survive solo or team up with friends to take on hordes of monsters. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: The guidelines : Hotel Napoli
games.description:
“高薪保证、工作简单、提供食宿。”
被困在与外界隔绝的狭小房间里，你的任务只有一个。通过隐藏在酒店各处客房中的CCTV，监视“异常现象”。 在不断重复的日子里，过去的记忆与酒店中发生的诡异事件开始逐渐联系起来。面对你来到这里的真正原因。酒店的手册是你唯一的生存指南。

games.name: Coal Duty
games.description: 《Coal Duty》是一款1-5人合作的恐怖喜剧撤离游戏。在程序生成的矿井中完成国家煤炭配额，花掉你的票证，计划你的逃脱。据报道，有些矿工已经逃脱。国家不确认此事。

games.name: BREAKOUT BABY
games.description: 《BREAKOUT BABY》是一款刺激的第一人称Roguelike恐怖游戏，融入了吃豆人要素。你需要帮助一个可怜的婴儿逃往地面。逃避怪物，搜刮小球，并摇晃婴儿以求得生机。

games.name: Pro Football Referee
games.description: Pro Football Referee 是一款足球裁判模拟游戏，从一名籍籍无名的底层裁判做起，全面体验足球裁判生涯。执法比赛、做出判罚，积累声望并不断晋升。经营人脉、利用内幕消息与资本运作，在赛场内外逐步扩大你的影响力。

games.name: Fruit Slicer
games.description: 用鼠标或真实手部动作精准切水果！躲避炸弹，掌握连击，在这款快节奏街机切水果游戏中挑战你的反应极限。

games.name: ApocalypseHQ
games.description: 在这款以日为回合的经营策略游戏中，领导一座在丧尸灾变中幸存的总部。调配稀缺的人力与物资，收复区域、修复基础设施，并通过研究和高风险外部行动拓展生存版图。

games.name: By Justice or Mercy - Season 1
games.description: 《以正义或仁慈之名》（By Justice or Mercy）是一款注重玩家选择的成人视觉小说。邂逅形形色色的恋爱对象，体验浪漫、激情、戏剧冲突与阴谋交织的故事。建立新的羁绊，修复破裂的关系，向那些伤害过你的人，施以你所定义的正义！

games.name: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
games.description: 《Desktop Island》是一款结合主/被动（挂机）玩法的多人生活模拟游戏。单人或与最多5位好友一同重建岛屿，打造专属的社区中心。结识岛民、选择职业、体验深度养成，并收集资源打造属于你的梦想之岛。

games.name: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory
games.description: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory is a story rich, investigative mystery game where your only tools are your contacts and the people you can find and get to talk to you. Read through old internet archives, pick out what is important, and solve the mystery of the 10 year old cold case.

games.name: OMEA
games.description: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

games.name: SaintGuard Survivors
games.description:
In this top-down survival roguelite, protect defenseless saints from relentless demonic hordes. Build powerful loadouts, unlock new warriors, weapons, and mounts.
Will you be able to protect while surviving?

games.name: 小动物餐吧2：餐后派对
games.description: 最多支持4人的混乱派对游戏——无论是在线跨平台连线，还是同一个沙发上的同屏对战，你都可以与好友随时跳入海量玩法迥异的迷你游戏中展开疯狂角逐。在这个由可爱小动物与美食构成的荒诞世界里，利用效果各异的美食与好友欢乐大闹一场！

games.name: Dice Looter
games.description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Crow Hunts Worms
games.description: 一款动作增量式/轻度肉鸽解谜游戏。瞄准、射击，并运用枪械技能消灭蠕虫！升级枪械，在游玩过程中获得临时强化，清理受侵染的区域，或者进行无尽挑战！

games.name: 沉默大陆
games.description: 《沉默大陆》是一款融合位移策略与棋盘博弈的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。在 5×12 的战场上，每一张出牌，都是生死攸关的抉择。当怪物浪潮如潮水般涌来，唯有精准的站位与巧妙的构筑，才能杀出一条血路。

games.name: Soul Hunter
games.description: 支持 1–4 人联机的心理恐怖游戏，相机的镜头是你唯一的护身符。驱除恶灵，破除幻象，在被诅咒的怨魂夺走你的灵魂之前，将其封印于胶卷之中。

games.name: Magic Cards Duel
games.description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

games.name: Tiny Survivors
games.description: 在庞大的敌群中杀出血路，打造强到离谱的搭配。收集强力战利品，解锁新角色，组合各种升级，成为虽小却势不可挡的力量。面对汹涌攻势，你能生存多久？

games.name: Unburden
games.description: UNBURDEN is a casual, adventure game in which you guide Mark on a journey to shed his heavy burden of precious possessions while helping others he meets along the way. All in an effort to restore the vibrancy and lightness life once held.

games.name: Call The Exterminator
games.description:
When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours.
CTE is classic 90's 2.5D action. Suit up, Light up, its time to Call The Exterminator.

games.name: 无凡仙域
games.description: 《无凡仙域》是一款宇宙尺度的修仙沙盒生存建造游戏，你将从凡人成长为高阶修士，视众生如蝼蚁，用剑气铲平森林，用符箓炸裂矿山；你将以肉身横渡虚空，自由探索群星，甚至穿越黑洞，造访新的星域。山川星海，天地万物，皆为我用。

games.name: InSector
games.description: InSector is a third-person, story-driven RPG with instant strategy and full combat control. Develop your base, recruit troops, upgrade your hero, storm fortresses or infiltrate them secretly, and use weapons, technology, and your mind to uncover the mystery and decide the fate of the colony.

games.name: Midnight Noodle
games.description: Help Ogik pay off his family's crushing debt in 31 days by running a street-side Mie Nyemek stall. Behind the hustle of serving customers, a tragic fate lurks if you fail. Every bowl served is worth a life, and every passing day determines how your story ends.

games.name: Magic Moon
games.description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

games.name: Long Way Gnome
games.description: Long Way Gnome is a chaotic co-op kart road trip where you and your friends must fight your way home. Scavenge powerful items, do some crazy drifts, and mow down hordes of monsters with up to 4 friends. Can you survive the journey?

games.name: Windowed Realms
games.description: 一款温馨的桌面陪伴游戏，把你的电脑变成一座座互动小岛。在工作或休息时，于透明窗口中管理单位、采集资源、制作物品。

games.name: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim
games.description: 从零开始打造属于你的披萨店！擀面团、切配料、用锅熬酱料、把披萨送进烤炉烘烤，再端给顾客。调整食谱、布置餐厅、管理财务，让你的店成为街坊邻里最爱的披萨店！

games.name: Zolana: Girl Galactic
games.description: A dress up game where you must save the Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must challenge the invading Uniforians to a runway competition to save fashion! Dress on theme, battle it out on the runway and maybe convince your rival, Commander Una fashion is a part of what makes Earth special!

games.name: Heart Decay
games.description: 《Heart Decay》是一款像素风格、注重剧情的回合制战术游戏。在敌方回合精准把握时机，发动致命反击，在这片黑暗世界中闯出属于你的道路。

games.name: marblebuilds
games.description: 一款充满创意的弹珠物理沙盒游戏。在无限网格上放置方块，搭建出你想象中的任何东西：弹珠轨道、计算器、精准的平台跳跃关卡、可玩的小游戏、弹珠机、等等。

games.name: A Case of Missing Identity
games.description: A point-and-click horror/tragedy visual novel about melding your perception of the world around you. Walk around, drive people to their death, and shape Perdita's existence. Remember: The flesh-sin is nothing. Before she can become everything, you must make her into something.

games.name: Where is my sword
games.description:
善良的狐娘与邪恶的魔神组成反差搭档，一起踏上收集信徒的旅程！？
游历不同国度，在紧张刺激又充满策略的即时战斗中，从背包里翻出当下最需要的东西！
有时与他们战斗，有时将他们变成信徒……旅途的尽头究竟会有什么结局？

games.name: 妹调教日记
games.description:
Galgame“十二神器”之一的经典作品高清化正式登陆Steam平台！
通过共同生活中调教妹妹，伴妹妹逐渐成长的过程中，解锁妹妹不为人知的一面。
开启游戏，重温高中时期与同学一起打开禁忌宝典的时光吧。

games.name: Recycle Quest
games.description: Recycle Quest 是一款推箱子益智游戏，您可以控制杰克帮助清洁城市

games.name: Seasonaut
games.description: 探索分为四个季节的 2D 世界，帮助其居民，解决每个地区的问题，同时发现这个宇宙背后的故事。

games.name: The Train Arrives at 10 PM
games.description: A psychological visual novel about grief, memory, and time loops shaped by player choice. Experience a story driven by atmosphere and emotion, where each decision reveals hidden truths and leads toward one of several possible endings.

games.name: The Perfect Paradise
games.description: The Perfect Paradise is an adult game where you play as Aiden, a calm and intelligent man guided by reason. As days pass, subtle illusions turn into seductive temptations that test his values, pulling him between pleasure and duty and slowly reshaping who he becomes.

games.name: Bunker Hill
games.description: Bunker Hill is a WW2 rougelite zombie shooter for 1-4 players. Fight through waves of undead that still haven't forgotten how to wield weapons.

games.name: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
games.description: All Those Dungeons in Alva’s Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alva’s mind.

games.name: 3:33 AM
games.description: A stranger calls at 3:33 AM. They know your name. Choose your words carefully in this fully voiced psychological horror game.

games.name: Gag Order
games.description: The Research laboratory's Guardian Unit faced with a hellish mission to exterminate invincible cephalopod creatures in this one-of-a-kind immersive co-operative Horror FPS.

games.name: Blobby Bash
games.description: BOUNCE, BATTLE AND BASH your friends in this fast paced movement party game! Engage in 7 different game modes where winning requires speed, strategy and skill! Customise your Bert with unlockable outfits galore!

games.name: Rise of Chi
games.description: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind to bring them home. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

games.name: NoWay
games.description: 你在黑暗的地下迷宫中醒来。丧尸游荡，猎手潜伏。保持安静、逃离、战斗，或像它们一样生存。没人能保证这里真的有出口。

games.name: Spherelimina
games.description: Roll, bump, boost, and outplay your rivals in Spherelimina, a fast-paced multiplayer arena game featuring Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, and Laser Tag.

games.name: Rhythm Survivors
games.description: Rhythm Survivors is a single player musical survivor-like. Fight off hordes of increasingly numerous monsters while collecting upgrades to compose powerful sequences of attacks. Only with perfect rhythm can you hope to survive the night!

games.name: Flowers to Honey
games.description: 一款温馨的放置增量游戏，让你选择蜜蜂的进化方向、种植花朵、引导蜂巢，并建立繁荣的蜂蜜帝国

games.name: Pharmacy Owner Simulator
games.description:
Start with a small pharmacy in a favela.
Sell medicine… or find more profitable ways to grow your business.

games.name: Revil Bone
games.description: A spooky co-op survival game for up to 5 players. Explore shifting worlds, mix crystals for Statue demands, gather resources, and survive chaotic encounters where heavy hits trigger physics-based bone reactions.

games.name: For Good Measure
games.description: Two measuring tapes stuck together... Why? No time to explain, you have puzzles to solve! Don't let the simple two-button movement controls fool you into thinking it'll be easy. Tackle the puzzles alone or team up with a friend in online or local co-op.

games.name: Tavernia
games.description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

games.name: Aurora Protocol
games.description: 与一位家庭友人同住——这位神秘人物正是科技巨头阿提米斯公司的失踪老板。当机器人行为诡异，梦境逐渐崩解，在这款成人赛博朋克视觉小说中，你的选择将塑造人际关系并发展后宫阵容，逐步揭开过往真相。

games.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy
games.description: 地球能否幸存？从三种视角体验火星入侵。作为人类在恐怖的外星袭击中求生，作为火星人征服地球，或建设并保卫你的城市，对抗高耸的战斗机器与致命热射线。三种游戏体验，一场地球之战。

games.name: s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop
games.description: Shape a cinematic visual novel through conversations with AI characters. Explore 50 built-in stories and create your own. Run AI on your compatible GPU with no usage fees, or choose optional Cloud AI using credits.

games.name: Liminal Backrooms
games.description: A co-op horror game for up to 4 players where you explore Backrooms-inspired levels, solve puzzles, find exits, and survive entities with different rules.

games.name: Death Projection
games.description: Explore every corner of the realms of death in this Metroidvania! Face enemies, platforming challenges, and gain more power as you try to bring balance to this world, as a reaper!

games.name: Depono
games.description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

games.name: SVAKA: Lost Legends
games.description:
Explore the mystical world of Maji in a story-driven action RPG.
Team up with Suaka and his allies to rescue the innocent from the grip of the dark spirit Dzuna. Face powerful enemies, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a dangerous journey to find Suaka’s missing father.

games.name: Yami Mura
games.description: 惠美香在故乡的车站醒来，整个小镇已被扭曲的黑暗所吞噬。解开错综复杂的谜题，在阴影中的潜伏危机下求生，并在为时已晚之前，揭开这场噩梦背后令人不安的真相。

games.name: 幻影叛离
games.description: 「祕宝」催生出了许多谜团与争执的导火线，而主角们在王国的命令之下持续管理着祕宝。 它为何如此重要，究竟又有什麽用途？ 各个角色的故事将围绕着祕宝的祕密发展。

games.name: They Cry
games.description: They Cry is a psychological horror following Luke seeking to find the source of a reoccurring dream taking over his life, only to find the former husk of his hometown.

games.name: Duplexity
games.description: Two paddles, one ball. Hit the targets and keep the game alive. A simple yet difficult game of coordination, patience and dexterity. Think you can reach 0... or lower?

games.name: type:def
games.description: Welcome, user. This [type:def] tower defense training module simulates a network defense scenario. Hostile data is attempting to escape the system. Deploy defensive nodes, type commands to control them, and secure the network - your only weapon is your keyboard!

games.name: Limerencia
games.description: Sho is in his last year of high school. Upon meeting Kazumi and meeting Nara (a friend from the past), his routine changes. Enjoy this visual novel while you discover memories, emotions and hidden secrets, your decisions will mark the end of a stage.

games.name: Demon Fish Dead Ahead
games.description: Sail the seas of hell while you catalog the local fauna in this turn-based classic JRPG, but watch out... SOMETHING LURKS BELOW!

games.name: 死斗卡牌
games.description:
这是一款独特的回合制卡牌游戏，玩家可以发挥天马行空般的想象力，在游戏中自由的构筑出独属于玩家自己的卡组，从而通过打出卡牌来抵抗一波接着一波的怪物！
每存活一关，怪物都将变得更强！谁能活到最后？
每一次战斗都将获得游戏内的货币，通过消耗货币来抽取新的更加强大或者更加奇妙的卡牌，以及强化原来的卡牌。
并且玩家还可以通过独特的圣物系统，为卡牌装备各种各样强大的圣物，从而生成独属于你自己的奇妙流派。或许是一击清场的强大怪物，或许是无限释放，无限连锁的强力技能或法术。（别小看那些不起眼的卡牌，或许它的作用超乎你的想象）

games.name: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
games.description: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.

games.name: MEHEN
games.description: 《MEHEN》是一款以身处永夜的神秘城塞都市“梅亨”为背景的 Boss Rush 游戏。抵御或格挡星辰的猛烈进攻，并在闪避的同时发动反击，将他们彻底击败。

games.name: Catching Breaks
games.description:
Catching Breaks is a darkly comedic office simulator where fixing problems is easy and dealing with people is not.

Repair broken machines while coworkers interrupt you with pointless conversations, fake urgency, and corporate nonsense. Keep the office running long enough to survive another workday.

games.name: Square Force
games.description: Run. Shoot. Swear. Repeat. Square Force is a fast, brutal co-op survival shooter where waves escalate, panic sets in, and surviving too long only makes things worse.

games.name: Capybara Dungeon
games.description: 《水豚地牢》是一款第一人称合作地牢探索游戏，最多支持 4 名玩家控制水豚，在充满危险生物、不可预测的陷阱和突发幽默的混乱任务中生存，需要不断沟通才能生存。

games.name: Undead Apocalypse: The Dawn
games.description: Create powerful builds and survive escalating zombie hordes in a fast-paced top-down roguelite where every run plays differently.

games.name: Meet Mary
games.description: Experience a thrilling and comedic 1-4 player co-op horror story puzzle game. Learn how to move forward while delving deeper and deeper into the unknown. With a compelling story, Voiced cut scenes, and casual progression. This is the perfect way to spend some time with friends.

games.name: Spin Top Idle
games.description: 把陀螺互相弹射，看着金币爆发！打出连击、召唤雷暴、解锁新陀螺，并培养深度声望树——一款温馨的像素风放置游戏。你的目标：传说陀螺。

games.name: Blades & Trades
games.description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

games.name: 魔王一行 (The Demon Party)
games.description:
魔王消失后，魔王城陷入了混乱。
成为魔族少女蕾特，支配被击败的怪物，组建属于你的魔王一行，建立新的魔王军吧！

games.name: Firewall: Defend The Grid
games.description:
FIREWALL: DEFEND THE GRID is a tower defense strategy game 
where you take the role of a hacker tasked with building cyberspace defense systems. Deploy hardware and software defenses and manage your compute resources to build a perfect firewall and protect the Grid from the ever-growing chaos.

games.name: Greedy
games.description: 浣熊合作恐怖撤离（Extraction）游戏。潜入程序生成的遗迹，搜刮一切并带出圣物。贪婪恶魔玛门正在注视……远离他的诅咒！

games.name: 失明恐惧症
games.description: 你失明了，并且被困在了一个无限循环的医院走廊里。你需要利用导盲杖和其他感官来寻找异常，质疑幻觉，找到逃生之路。

games.name: The Order Of Serenity : Cult Simulator
games.description: The Order of Serenity is a psychological horror simulation where you play as an undercover journalist infiltrating a secret cult, carrying out disturbing duties, making unsettling choices, and earning trust to uncover the truth from within.

games.name: Anomaly Corp.
games.description: Run. Hide. Survive. A deep single-player pure horror experience where you have to escape from supernatural creatures using nothing but a flashlight that slows your movement. Learn from your mistakes, uncover secrets, and escape Amusden Corp's complex.

games.name: Empire Water Works
games.description: Empire Water Works is a steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

games.name: Tuanbot
games.description: 《Tuanbot》是一款多模态AI驱动的像素风桌面宠物应用，集陪伴、创作与协作为一体。你可以聊天、语音输入、生成图片与视频，还能在“会议室”让多位AI共同讨论，甚至一起玩狼人杀。

games.name: Blank Slate
games.description: 你失去了一切，于是亲手锻造一条归途。Blank Slate 是一款第一人称犯罪沙盒——制造有评级的假证件、经营见不得光的店铺、洗白脏钱，在一座假装看不见的城市里甩掉通缉热度。

games.name: Catomino
games.description: 你能为每一只猫咪找到最舒心的位置吗?《Catomino》是一款温馨治愈的3D拼图游戏,你要在这里照顾一群软萌可爱、个性十足的猫咪:有的钟爱温暖的阳光角落,有的离不开心爱的玩具,一个都不能将就。清理房间里的重重障碍,拖拽道具拓展格子空间,满足猫咪们千奇百怪的心愿,让家里处处充满满足的呼噜声。

games.name: Bun G Bop
games.description: Bun G Bop is a low-stakes high-chaos co-op platformer about flinging your friend with a bungee cord while tagging a big tower. We built this game to be fun for all duos, even ones who suck at platformers.

games.name: I, Spy
games.description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

games.name: Hook Nook
games.description: A cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Catch fish to unlock different biomes, socialize with shopkeepers, upgrade your gear, and maybe even try wearing a duck for a hat! Study, work or watch shorts while fishing with friends.

games.name: The Bandits of Sierra Fria
games.description: 一款像素风格的俯视角射击游戏，在被土匪统治的土地上展开疯狂枪战、多样武器与高强度动作体验。

games.name: Ashen Swarm
games.description: 在这款哥特式弹幕生存肉鸽中，将罪孽化作武器。杀穿罪民之潮，围绕誓约构筑技能，或拥抱腐化。用抉择赢得永久遗物，抵达审判官面前，阻止判决吞噬最后的土地。

games.name: Priestess’s Delusions
games.description: ﻿She turned my summer into a mystical tale — a delusion that melts away like snow the moment I close my eyes.

games.name: Eye of Syn
games.description: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

games.name: Catch Meow If You Can
games.description: 一款最多支持4名玩家的在线合作生存游戏。扮演一只著名的获奖猫咪。主人外出时，不同类型的窃贼闯入了豪宅。探索黑暗的房间、解开谜题、智胜入侵者、奋起反击，并在不被抓住的情况下成功逃脱。

games.name: Pookie's Otherworld Tavern
games.description: Trapped in a fantasy world with zero gold? Pookie needs a fortune to buy her way home. Manage a tavern, serve drinks, and charm wealthy patrons. Will you run an honest business, or do whatever it takes to get paid?

games.name: 众星入海
games.description:
大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。
陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。
时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
games.developer: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

games.name: 约书亚：梦境之门(Joshua: Door to Dreams)
games.description: 欢迎来到约书亚的世界，这是一款俯视角动作冒险游戏，你将使用超过10种武器，驾驭4种属性，利用战斗技巧，击败各式各样强大的敌人，破解复杂的谜题，解开相互交织的两个世界背后的奥秘。

games.name: Covert Koalas: Phasco
games.description:
一款轻松愉快的游戏，你需要在独特的手绘关卡中寻找隐藏的考拉，关卡难度可调。帮助一群考拉逃离囚禁，跟随它们踏上寻找新家园的旅程。
因为世界足够大，足以容纳所有生命！

games.name: Cursed Gas Station
games.description: 在 20 世纪 90 年代一座偏僻的加油站里，科尔接受了一份附带住处的夜班工作。当你为顾客提供服务时，这款心理恐怖游戏中的无法解释事件开始逐渐发生。

games.name: Solar Sandbox
games.description: Solar Sandbox is a space engine that allow for player to simulate n-body physics in space. Simulate large n-body physics or how would the Earth be effected by you changing it's orbit or how how many Jupiters you need to combine to get a star.

games.name: 少牌麻将
games.description:
还在用13张牌打麻将吗？
少牌麻将 带来全新玩法：开局就少一张牌，而这张“缺少的牌”将变成万能牌！比运气更重要的是策略与判断，体验前所未有的烧脑对局。动漫风格角色、在线对战、特殊规则、团队模式、节奏爽快！免费游玩！

games.name: 与星相伴：最美好的时光
games.description: 《与星相伴：最美好的时光》是一款治愈系桌面伴侣游戏，玩家将会以Yuki的视角感受与姐姐东云星相处的美好时光。你可以通过使用番茄时钟积攒「灵感」，为姐姐解锁更多的服装配饰，桌面背景以及背景音乐。随着灵感等级的提高，你或许可以通过剧情对话更深入地了解她内心深处的秘密……

games.name: So I Mine
games.description: An incremental mining game where you must move quickly to outrun what follows you.

games.name: Voidshift
games.description: A psychological horror game about working the night shift in a store that reacts to your mistakes. Follow procedure. Avoid irregularities.

games.name: Bodzin
games.description: Step into the boots of a forgotten space legend. In this retro top-down shooter, stop a galactic villain from corrupting ancient wisdom into ultimate power. Correct your past mistake, rescue the Keepers, and rewrite destiny.

games.name: SESSION // ZERO
games.description: 一款节奏紧张的合作生存恐怖游戏，最多支持六名玩家，你必须甩开怪物才能活下来。挑选物品，完成目标，帮助或坑害队友，想尽办法活下去。

games.name: Ghost in the Cloud
games.description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

games.name: Siren's Call: Second Wind
games.description: A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

games.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
games.description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

games.name: Melt Down
games.description: 《Melt Down》是一款史莱姆竞速游戏，你必须在融化倒计时结束前冲过终点。你会持续融化：体型越小速度越快，体型越大速度越慢。你必须在融化成一滩黏液之前完成比赛。躲避沿途的各种危险，用道具击退史莱姆对手，赶在消失前冲过终点。

games.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
games.description:
Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.
Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

games.name: The Lubs 2: Straw Hats
games.description: 《草帽海贼团2：草帽海贼团》是一款融合了角色扮演元素的2D动作平台游戏。响应圣议会的号召，对抗克里顿叛乱！草帽海贼团必须偿还债务，云陵根也必须重归和平！

games.name: University of Progress
games.description:
Instead of playing as a boring guy who is designed to be compatible with everyone, what if you played as an abrasive young man who isn't compatible with anyone and usually ends up making things worse?
Meet Millard. He's kind of a dickhead.

games.name: The Box Project
games.description: 一款带有喜剧元素的短篇第一人称实验游戏。广播里的声音认为现代玩家变得更差了，并设计了一项简单的测试来证明这一点。你的任务：看好一个箱子，并证明自己是一名优秀的玩家。

games.name: Pyro Spice
games.description:
Pyro Spice is a fast third-person shooter where chili pepper characters dash, shoot, and survive zombie waves or
compete in Team Deathmatch, Capture the Sauce, and Milk Delivery. Solo, co-op, or in easy to Host listen server matches.

games.name: BURNTCRUST
games.description: Drive across randomly generated galaxies, deliver pizza, upgrade your ship, and plan your route to avoid hostiles. Or get drunk, gamble away your life savings, and crash full speed into an asteroid field. I won't judge.

games.name: Swarmex
games.description: Swarmex is a casual pixel-art tower defense game where you build and upgrade a modular space base. Place turrets, mine resources with automated miners, and optimise adjacency bonuses as your defences run on their own. Play in short, satisfying sessions.

games.name: Jibbers
games.description: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

games.name: Almost Home
games.description: 一款支持 1–4 人合作的生存冒险游戏，你们的目标是一起回到家。探索各具特色的生物群系，揭开其中的秘密，适应各自的规则，并在归途中应对各种意想不到的挑战。

games.name: Despair Beneath the Sunless Sky
games.description: A psychological horror RPG blending dark fantasy and mystery. Explore a relentless open world, alone or with companions, confront grotesque horrors in turnbased combat, and make irreversible choices. Uncover deep lore and mysteries visible only to those with discerning eyes.

games.name: 脚臭战争
games.description: 《脚臭战争》是一款通过脚臭杀人的平台游戏。跑跳积累脚臭，更换鞋袜控制脚臭——然后接近敌人，臭死他们。

games.name: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
games.description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

games.name: BROMS：大逃杀经营模拟器
games.description:
这是一款经营模拟游戏，你将管理一款大逃杀游戏。
举办比赛以增加来自扭蛋请求的收益，扩展地图并摆放物件以改善环境。
游戏的特色之一是，你可以在自己创建的地图上直接进行游玩。

games.name: Stellar Broadcast
games.description: 引导人类最后一艘殖民飞船，穿越程序生成的世界，面对危险抉择、外星遭遇与信号解码谜题。管理日渐衰弱的舰船系统，读懂每颗行星的视觉线索，决定文明将在哪里重新开始，或永远终结。

games.name: 岁巡社 01：最后一个顾客
games.description: 《岁巡社 01：最后一个顾客》是一款以动态文字演出为核心的线性灵异悬疑视觉小说。跟随胆小认真的新人卯兔，探索闭店后的大型商场，救援无法被夜班保安看见的顾客，并察觉悄然运行的异常规则。无分歧、无 BAD END。

games.name: LoHa Adventure Remake
games.description: A charming 2D platformer remake starring LoHa, a brave little cat. Explore colorful worlds, collect fish, and enjoy smooth gameplay with improved visuals in a cozy, classic adventure.

games.name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
games.description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable factions.

games.name: 求择选：伊万篇
games.description:
✦《求择选：伊万篇》是一款选择取向探索式视觉小说。
故事主要讲述一只名为“伊万·维克托罗维奇·贝理亚叶夫”斯拉夫小白鼠在美国的VR回忆影像。

games.name: Rasta Santa
games.description: You’re Rasta Santa, an undercover cop disguised as Santa, waging war on traffickers. Shoot, slash, raid hideouts, rescue children, and defend the orphanage in a high-skill 2D action-platformer.

games.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+ [AB+]
games.description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

games.name: Sweatshop Tycoon
games.description: A dark management tycoon where profit has consequences. Grow from basement to factory and choose profit over workers' rights. Survive on small margins and even smaller morals. Keep the state happy or face brutal inspections.

games.name: Echoes of Aethelgard
games.description: Evolve your arsenal and become the bullet hell. Echoes of Aethelgard is a horde-survival roguelite featuring deep meta-progression, an explosive combo system, and devastating ultimate abilities. Survive the endless hordes and lift the curse of the Void Corruptor.

games.name: TURBO
games.description: Turbo is a top-down 3D pixel art action RPG set in a dark, philosophical multiverse. Master free-flow combat, duel enemies with the Battle of Wits dialogue system, teleport across worlds, solve mysteries with detective gameplay, puzzles, and explore 108 characters branching, morally complex stories.

games.name: City of Hunger
games.description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Kwartikum
games.description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

games.name: The Curator
games.description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game. Upgrade your van, organize artworks for synergies, upgrade your artists, and satisfy picky visitors as you push across a branching map of biomes.

games.name: Telly No Vision
games.description: Telly No Vision is a hybrid first & third person puzzle shooter where YOU can't see. Push back a hacker attack in a virtual world where giant floating TVs are your eyes!

games.name: The Last Opening
games.description:
你已经死了。若想归来，你必须在森林中熬过40个夜晚，白天做出残酷的选择，并在每个夜晚与死亡对弈。
森林冰冷。长夜漫漫。若你获胜，也许还能看见黎明。若你失败……世界将把你遗忘。

games.name: Topdeck Automat
games.description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

games.name: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
games.description: 攀登一座危险的高山，每次攀登都会变得更加凶险……直到它将你彻底击垮。掌握哥布林登山术，包括橡皮筋手臂弹射和放屁推进。还觉得不够有挑战？寻找各种古怪配饰，成为最“咳咳”漂亮的哥布林。

games.name: Coffin Hunter
games.description: You owe the Helix a very specific soul. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and build the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive faction wars, hunt bounty hunters, and find a way to reach the Kingpin in the lawless Marupto Rift.

games.name: Stackade
games.description: 你的防御塔是从天而降的方块。把方块拖到棋盘上，给它装一把枪、一具火焰喷射器或者一颗地雷，然后守住基地周围的防线。每关结束后用赚到的钱去军械商店添置装备，下一波紧接着就来。玩战役一关关摸清这张棋盘，或者挑战无尽模式，看看自己能在 Boss 手里撑到第几关。

games.name: Ship Happens
games.description: A chaotic co-op game for 2-4 players set in space. Think fast and work together to rescue ridiculously designed spaceships from the clutches of a black hole.

games.name: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator
games.description: You're a night clerk at a roadside motel in 1997, working off a court sentence. Check guests in, clean up after them, and once you get a hidden camera, decide what to do with whatever it catches on tape.

games.name: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey
games.description:
Find Bunny 是一款治愈系找物游戏，撕开贴纸、找出藏起来的图案，再把它们收集起来。
和可可、玛尔恰一起出发，解开调皮农作物的秘密吧。
跨过大海、坐上火车，把相册填满，帮朋友们找回农场的平静！

games.name: Room Service
games.description: You are the only maid working a night shift at an old hotel. Your duties are simple, clean the rooms, fill in reports and survive the night.

games.name: ᴛᴜᴍᴏʀ ɴᴇᴄʀᴏꜱɪꜱ ꜰᴀᴄᴛᴏʀ:// αᴍᴇɴ
games.description: Tear through the decaying Earth as a mutant half-worm in this arcade-inspired rail shooter! Branching paths, fast-paced gameplay, and lots of gore: a blood-smeared love letter to the classics of old.

games.name: Corroded
games.description: In this creature filled, horrifying, procedurally generated world, survive by looting ruins, expanding your base, getting better gear, and staying fed. Don't get caught in the flood and survive this nightmare.

games.name: 我们之间的寂静之地
games.description: 一款以选择为核心的动漫恋爱视觉小说，爱情、友情、失去与自尊彼此交织。你的选择将塑造人物关系、改变故事，并带你走向三个独特的结局。

games.name: Catriarch
games.description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

games.name: Sky Defense
games.description: A card-driven tower defense game where one wrong choice ends your run. Place defenses, upgrade your deck between rounds, and protect your floating island from endless waves of enemies.

games.name: The Last Night Train
games.description: A story-driven puzzle adventure about Ovid searching for Thera, his love who vanished aboard a train where the night never ends… but what if she was never the one he needed to find?

games.name: Node Crown
games.description:
Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom.
Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here! Have fun!

games.name: Rolling Stock
games.description: 《Rolling Stock》是一款最多支持4人在线合作的火车装货游戏。搬运各式货物，把它们码得严丝合缝，遇到重货就帮朋友搭把手。这款全新的益智游戏完全基于物理模拟，登陆Windows和Linux，支持跨平台联机！

games.name: Elzypon
games.description: Elyzpon is metaphysical pedagogy disguised as a turn-based JRPG.

games.name: ～调教女鬼～ 净化巨乳地缚灵
games.description:
身处江户时代——作为末代阴阳师的你，因接到新的除灵委托，来到了一座阴森诡异的大宅。
然而，引发灵异骚乱的并非普通恶灵，而是一个超级骚艳的爆乳女鬼！
作为“苦痛绝顶流”的唯一传人，让恶灵彻底高潮并净化成佛，正是你唯一的目标！
……不过，这次的恶灵似乎有些不同寻常，仿佛隐藏着不为人知的真相？

games.name: Discovery Islands
games.description: A cozy 3D hidden-object game where you rotate, explore, and click around tiny handcrafted islands to find what's hidden. No timers, no pressure - just you and a little world to explore.

games.name: 唐宫诗与谋
games.description:
史书记载了她的结局——珠沉圆折，玉碎连城。
你是一缕意识，在她的脑海中苏醒，不发声就会消散。
武曌、太平、韦后、安乐——四个权力之巅的女人，末路亦是悲壮。
趁一切尚未落笔，你要说些什么，改变什么？

games.name: ARCANATI CARD -アルカナティカード-
games.description: Collect Urban Legend cards and fight in this deck-building roguelite! There is no "hand"—cards are randomly placed, making "positioning" the key to combos. Adjacency effects, chain reactions, and a twist of fate. Dominate the chaotic board with synergy and uncover the truth.

games.name: Ghost Receipt - A Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
games.description: 在霓虹闪烁的城市中经营一家赛博朋克杂货店和当铺。购买、出售并协商交易，调查神秘物品，并通过顾客带来的物件、他们隐藏的秘密以及你所承担的风险，逐步揭开属于他们的故事。

games.name: Feeding Gooble
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

games.name: Zone Idle
games.description: An incremental extraction simulator set in a ruthless world inspired by the extraction genre and book Roadside Picnic. Manage your inventory, navigate hazardous events, and upgrade your hideout. Same tension, but with time to think.

games.name: American Made
games.description: Navigate the state of Mississippi in this narrative action game set at the dawn of the Civil War. As Robert, you must travel between plantations, completing dangerous quests and developing your skills to survive a perilous, state-wide journey toward freedom and rebellion.

games.name: Tiny Ramen Shop
games.description: 经营属于你的迷你拉面店！店虽小，却早已有顾客排队等着品尝你的美味拉面。制作料理，补充新鲜食材，升级并装饰店铺。饥肠辘辘的顾客正等待着他们最喜欢的拉面大厨！

games.name: 末日防线
games.description:
欢迎来到《末日防线》，在这里，基因变异的植物和动物联合抵抗僵尸，保卫家园。这是一款结合策略、动作和养成的全新游戏，发挥你的聪明才智与精心布局，由大名鼎鼎的科学家David博士带领你深入植物和动物联盟的战斗前线，与强大的僵尸军团展开一场场激烈的保卫战，揭开在这个世界中每一个珍贵角色背后的故事。
游戏玩法
策略布局：布置你的植物和动物单位，为抵抗僵尸进攻设置最佳防线。
资源管理：通过收集能量和资源，升级你的单位，解锁强力技能。
games.developer: 上海齐格飞网络科技有限公司

games.name: Totally Normal Ramen
games.description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

games.name: Spectral Map
games.description: movement based texture adventure with rpg elements.

games.name: Ethral
games.description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

games.name: Harlequinade
games.description: Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a very death-prone college student. With the aid of 2 clowns, can you escape this timeloop?

games.name: SLENDYJAN
games.description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

games.name: Sin Return
games.description: 在罪化病不断蔓延的沉寂之国，一场史诗般的冒险即将启程。这是一款注重探索的暗黑风格回合制角色扮演游戏。你需要在这片罪孽的土地上重拾失去的记忆，战胜强敌、克服恐惧，并在旅程中逐渐拼凑出这场灾难的真相。

games.name: Cold Rails
games.description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

games.name: Hakuroku Game Collection
games.description:
Hakuroku 的桌游作品数字版登场！
抢先体验版计划收录 《Hakoniwa Kings》 和 《Guild Build》 两款游戏。
《Greedy Hunters!》 计划在近期更新中追加。

games.name: Monty's Idle Mine
games.description: 一款轻松惬意的桌面放置陪伴游戏，讲述一位生活在屏幕底部的小矿工。看着蒙蒂挖矿，升级他的技能和矿物以获得更多金币，收集或购买他的 142 件小宝藏，并在你工作或学习时装点他的小小世界。

games.name: Neuville Survivors
games.description: During the day, explore tile by tile and build your defenses to survive waves of enemies each night. Stay alive as long as possible to discover why humans are unwelcome on Neuville.

games.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
games.description: 一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏，你的性格将塑造整个游戏体验。回答令人不安的问题，经受骇人的考验，做出无法挽回的决定，并在一场会根据真实的你而变化的评估中生存下来。

games.name: Bad Tides
games.description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

games.name: Delete The Hypercube
games.description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

games.name: 枪炮与异世界
games.description: 一款融合搜打撤、卡牌与异世界探索的即时战略游戏。你将率领现代军队穿越传送门，侦察未知土地、建造采矿设施与雷达站，并以现代化部队和战场卡牌抵挡异世界的反扑。随着扩张越深入，这个世界对你的关注就越强——守住据点，在局势失控前启动传送门撤离。

games.name: 卡制工程
games.description: 选择卡牌属性和技能，亲手制作卡牌并组建 30 张牌组，无需购买卡包。先挑战本地 AI，再参加 Steam 在线 PvP 或进入五幕无尽工坊。通过校验的卡牌和牌组还可分享到 Steam 创意工坊。

games.name: TAKTAKTOP
games.description: 逃离天空的垂直跳跃动作游戏！在建造模式中发射飞行物铺路，或在随机平台模式中随机应变。用导弹传递代币支援或复活队友，无代币时免受攻击。收集代币抵达顶层出口即可获胜！（支持最多12人联机）

games.name: Astro Seed
games.description:
硬核物理攀爬，简直是场煎熬
深渊幽暗洞穴，如同地下监牢 
只靠笨拙双臂，拼命向上攀高
小小机器身躯，誓要成功出逃

games.name: The Night We Met
games.description: 与Alex、Anna和Sierra一起度过四个章节的疯狂万圣节之夜。调情、玩一场激烈的真心话大冒险，用有意义的选择塑造故事走向。解锁12个独特结局，体验你所有行为带来的欢乐与后果。

games.name: Deadly Dimensions
games.description: A solo roguelite horror. Traverse multiple procedurally generated  Dimensions of Earth and scavenge all of the Data you can possibly find from them to sell it to a faceless Corporate entity.

games.name: Typing Drag Racer
games.description: A competitive online multiplayer typing racing game where speed comes from skill, build flow, hit boosts, and out type your opponents.

games.name: 墨武天工
games.description: 《墨武天工》是一款以中国古代神话为背景的开放世界动作生存游戏。玩家将踏入一个破碎而瑰丽的东方世界，体验“以墨规划天地，以武开辟生机”的沉浸冒险。游戏中，您需扮演双重角色：既是建造者，需采集资源、构筑家园、经营田猎，在动态天气与资源挑战中艰难求生；亦是武者，需以魂系风格的硬核战斗，直面妖兽与强敌，体验生死一线的武侠对决。世界深处蕴藏着玄妙道法，您可通过探索与修炼，掌握五行法术与奇门遁甲，将魔法之力融入战斗与建造。游戏支持单人潜心探索，如刺客般在阴影中前行；亦可联机合作，与挚友共同建造宏伟据点，或组队挑战盘踞四方的传奇巨兽。每一次建造都是文明的复兴，每一场战斗都是命运的对抗。

games.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
games.description: Ride attractions, play minigames and chase online high scores across three themed islands! Shoot ducks, feed raptors with a crossbow, hunt pterosaurs from a roller coaster or rescue sailors from the kraken. Win teddies at the Claw Machine and collect Dino Cards for your Lodge.

games.name: Warped Point
games.description:
Explore the unknown, master your weapons, and face the corruption and dangers that lurk while you embrace the chaos.

Welcome to Warped Point, a mysterious world on the brink of collapse.

games.name: Void Eaters
games.description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

games.name: Pixelbound
games.description: A cozy idle game where every click creates art. Mine pixels, unlock powerful automation, and evolve your canvas from simple 4x4 blocks to stunning 256x256 masterpieces. No stress, no timers—just satisfying progress.

games.name: VOIDCAST
games.description: Explore an abandoned video store after dark and descend into spaces that defy logic, where warnings and guidance blur into one without escape.

games.name: Disconnected
games.description: Step into the shoes of Robex, a streamer trapped in a deadly Urbex. Use your smartphone to solve puzzles, manage a reactive chat, and escape a relentless presence. Disconnected is a photorealistic horror experience designed to be completed in one sitting. Will you survive the stream?

games.name: Zap & Andy: Go to HELL!
games.description: A fully animated 2D gay NSFW point-and-click adventure inspired by classic genre titles! Help Zap the angel and Andy the demon make up for their lost teenage years as they try to escape from Hell—without succumbing to the many, many horny (and horned) temptations that stand between them and freedom.

games.name: 灵异家园
games.description: 单机或联机4人合作恐怖生存与生物抓捕的搜打撤PVE游戏

games.name: 爱丽丝与花坊：Lo-Fi
games.description: 陪伴爱丽丝，共同经营一家小而精美的花店，从浇水、等待、到开花，每次收获，都可以解锁更多盆栽品种、装饰道具，以及猫咪伙伴！让花店逐渐从空无一物，变成一个充满生活气息的小角落。内置多首 Lo-fi 轻音乐，你也可以通过唱片机选择喜欢的背景音乐，让桌面变得更加安静而专注！

games.name: Just One Bite
games.description: 一款支持 1~4 名玩家的合作恐怖游戏。你的任务是为人类尽可能多地收集食物。但并不是所有食物都正常。你能将这项任务完成到底吗？

games.name: Rock From Home
games.description: Rock From Home is a comedy simulation about life in the early days of remote work. Type your way through emails, handle strange workplace situations, and choose how you respond. Spend your hard-earned money on the things that truly matter: ridiculous accessories for your pet rock.

games.name: Checkpoint '38
games.description: A roguelike narrative simulation of life as a border guard in Nazi Germany. Inspect passports, detect forged documents, and approve or deny entry as restrictions tighten. Every traveler brings a choice that could save a life or condemn it. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.description: 《Bros of Bench》是一款极简风格的双人合作平台动作游戏。两位玩家将化身为由一根可伸缩连杆相连的哑铃两端，轮流举起对方并使用喷气背包。掌握默契配合、物理机制与行动时机，将是通往胜利的关键！

games.name: Drive With Friends
games.description: 一辆车,司机太多。Drive With Friends 是一款1-4人在线合作驾驶游戏:大家分别操控油门、刹车、左转、右转,合力避开电锯、铁锤和地雷,冲向山顶。

games.name: In Vino Veritas
games.description: 在这款心理恐怖冒险游戏中，你将探索一座被亵渎的大教堂，寻找失踪的妻子。揭开埃洛希姆（Elohim）背后的黑暗真相，解开古老的谜题，在信仰与现实碰撞的惊悚之旅中幸存下来。圣经被误译了；真相远比想象中更加阴暗

games.name: DOPROS
games.description: DOPROS is a dark, Orwellian interrogation experience. Will you break and give it all away, or will you try to get free? It's only up to you, but keep in mind, your every word may and will be used against you…

games.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
games.description: 公主与征服:女王俱乐部是一款包含多种小游戏,剧情丰富的酒馆经营模拟类型游戏.游戏采用动态2D角色立绘与精美插画背景,共同构筑出一个色彩缤纷的世界.当然,角色大部分是采用公主与征服世界观下那些可爱又性感的角色.

games.name: Hemlon the Grey
games.description: 《赫姆隆与灰烬》（Hemlon the Grey）是一款以剑尖决定生死的、以弹反银幕动作为核心的2D类魂游戏。跟随半人半魔的战士赫姆隆的故事击碎敌人，揭开莱因茨共和国与折断之翼的秘密。

games.name: 深空当铺：可能是偷得
games.description: 《深空当铺：可能是偷得》是一款设定在反乌托邦空间站内的赛博朋克店铺经营模拟游戏。制造、交易并走私来路不明的货物，在各方派系势力间周旋；看看为了维持生计，你愿意突破多少底线。在不断上涨的租金将你逼入走投无路的绝境之前，赚取足够的利润来彻底买下这间店铺。

games.name: First Fantasy Hentai Studio
games.description: 好了，你的冒險者隊伍遭遇了一場史詩級的慘敗，現在你們既沒有名聲也沒有錢。得想個辦法擺脫這種困境。你們的世界還沒有發明網路攝影機，但總要有人當第一個。而你正好有那些火辣的夥伴們。

games.name: Late Night Manifest
games.description:
你将扮演⻢可，在一片被黑暗笼罩的世界中醒来。为了活下去，你不得不在废弃与绝望中
寻找答案。但你也许并不是唯一的幸存者。你必须通过探索与解谜揭开真相，跨越致命危
险，找到其他人。

games.name: Traveloot
games.description: Traveloot 是一款肉鸽增量动作冒险游戏。你将带领一支不断壮大的冒险者小队探索各大岛屿。收集资源、击退成群的敌人、解锁分支技能树，并招募新伙伴加入队伍。游戏支持单人游玩及本地合作模式。

games.name: Senders - Wide Open Dirtbike Sim
games.description: Senders is a Dirtbike Simulator taking place over a 20km squared plot of roads, tracks, trails and wilderness. Built from the ground up to provide the deepest, dirtiest riding experience available.

games.name: Pre-Warp Age
games.description: 一款节奏舒缓的回合制策略游戏：在人类尚未掌握超光速航行的年代，开拓太空，从第一次太空飞行，到曲速引擎的问世。在随机生成的恒星系中调配工人、研究技术、开采资源，没有敌人，也没有时间限制。

games.name: Only Mining
games.description: A short game about becoming the ultimate town miner. Strip away the farming, the town chores, and all other distractions so you can focus on 'Only Mining'. Every ladder found sends you toward larger rock and more valuable rewards. How deep will you descend before you run out of air?

games.name: KADI：奥斯曼法官
games.description: 在1300年代的奥斯曼帝国，你是一名"卡迪"（法官）。在从盖姆利克到大马士革的十个行省中，审判取材于真实历史的案件。是凭学识修得智慧，还是堕入贿赂的深渊——平衡由你掌握。成婚、养育子女，在良知与永无止境的欲望之间做出抉择。每一次判决都将塑造你的命运。

games.name: GHOSTNOTE
games.description: Learn to drum in a haunted rhythm game built for keyboard and controller. Master real rhythms, read drum notation, practice fills, chase high scores, and uncover the strange machine hiding in your grandfather’s attic.

games.name: Shotgun Jumper Nano™
games.description: High-skill ceiling gun parkour simulator in skatepark environments inside a sandbox setting featuring a map creator, customizable guns, challenge modes and multiplayer; This is a colorful experience with unlimited fun!

games.name: Voxel Playground
games.description: Voxel Playground is a physics-driven voxel sandbox VR game built for VR. In this fully destructible voxel physics world, you can build, craft and shoot against enemies with limitless possibilities.

games.name: 脱毛沙龙模拟器
games.description: 打造属于你的最强脱毛沙龙！本作是一款经营男士专用沙龙的模拟游戏，你需要利用最新的医疗级激光将客人浓密的体毛燃烧殆尽。在客人的痛觉边缘极限微操，看人下菜碟推销天价护理套餐，用赚来的钱升级设备招募员工，一步步将你的小店打造为猛男净身圣地！

games.name: 无比坚硬：荒原骑士
games.description: 骑士来到荒原，开启一场所谓的冒险。他会把一切都搞砸嘛？还是收拾好心情，继续前行呢？

games.name: Tiny Fortress
games.description: [之前名为"Tiny Towers"] 这是一款短小精悍的增量放置游戏，你需要抵御成群小怪物的袭击，保卫你的微型堡垒。建造防御塔，通过击败敌人获取资源，并在技能树中解锁全新升级，从而不断强化你的哥布林要塞。

games.name: BOOMER
games.description: A chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam engine, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

games.name: Camp Cook: Cooking on the frontline
games.description: 在这款烹饪自走棋游戏中，管理战火中的军队厨房。善用获得的补给，烹饪食物并为中世纪战士分配口粮。战斗开始后，你的行动将决定战局。

games.name: Hooky
games.description: A chaotic first-person multiplayer card game where you and your friends play as fish drawing from a deck full of deadly Hooks. Sabotage your friends, set sneaky traps, and avoid getting yanked to the surface. Will you rule the ocean floor, or will you be the catch of the day?

games.name: Dark Alley
games.description: 一名英国侦探在京都失踪了。化身贝内特探长，揭开一个远远超越雅库扎的神秘案件。

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Heritage Flipper
games.description: 温馨治愈的老宅翻新模拟游戏，让你把历史悠久的古老废墟一步步修复成气派的豪华宅邸。清理、修复 & 装饰美式、法式、英式、西班牙式、荷兰式、日式、中式 & 更多风格的住宅，揭开每一栋老宅尘封已久的秘密往事。

games.name: Impurity
games.description: Build and lead a settlement in a ruthless dark fantasy world. Command companions, explore shifting open world lands, and navigate rival settlements - trading, allying, or waging war. Walk the path of light or corruption as you endure relentless seasons and ancient horrors.

games.name: Horny Legends: Harem of Goddesses
games.description:
收集、定制并展示最热门的成人及动漫风格作品。
你的收藏角色外观由你决定。
解锁稀有内容，打造你的完美收藏，与世界各地的玩家一较高下，成为终极收藏家。

games.name: 桌面股神
games.description: 《Screen Stocks》是一款多人在线股票交易游戏。你将在实时模拟的市场中买入、做空或卖出股票，赚取巨额财富。你可以和其他交易者联手，也可以以智取胜，击败所有对手。是时候赚笔大的了！

games.name: SnatchDeck
games.description:
Steal, Adapt, Survive!
SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

games.name: Lilifel
games.description: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

games.name: BannerRush
games.description:
Banner Rush is a tactical real-time duel in which you build up your army and overrun the enemy lines with a massive assault.
Fight for every lane and seal the victory in the final showdown, when every breakthrough counts double or triple.

games.name: Lost Hope
games.description: 《Lost Hope》是一款短篇第一人称氛围步行模拟游戏,故事设定在遥远的未来、深邃的太空中,一名孤独的男子努力求生,并为人类寻找解药。

games.name: The Final Stamp
games.description: 阴间版《请出示文件》。审问亡魂，用古怪的仪器揭穿他们的罪孽，再裁定去向：地狱、天堂，还是炼狱。就连乔尼·戈尔茨坦，也有一套自己清白的说法。盖章之前，先去验证。

games.name: 变废为宝工坊
games.description: 《变废为宝工坊》是一款铁匠铺经营模拟游戏。你将化身变废为宝的匠人，在堆积如山的垃圾中翻找素材，亲手打造出万余种荒诞不经的奇葩兵器——无论是香蕉长剑还是飞盘盾牌，只有想不到，没有造不出。在这里，你可以升级店铺、解锁神兵谱，并将这些稀奇古怪的作品卖给品味独特的顾客，比如西装革履的水獭或是神秘的意面怪。

games.name: REM
games.description: REM is a short atmospheric dream exploration game. Explore surreal spaces and architecture. Collect all of the dream seeds and plant them. Every dream remembers the last one, and every dream is shaped by the garden you tend when you're awake.

games.name: That Cat Game
games.description: Stalk, pounce and climb your way through a handcrafted 2D world as a small cat with sharp instincts. Hunt birds from a crouch, dodge what you can't kill, and earn real cat abilities across 15 levels. Cozy, normal, or feral - three difficulty modes for repeated gameplay.

games.name: Ascended Snake
games.description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

games.name: WordMaxed
games.description: Build words, bend multipliers, and fill every corner in this strategic word game. Play solo, challenge the AI, pass and play, or battle 2-4 friends online across quick 5x5 and classic 10x10 boards, plus Daily Challenges and leaderboards.

games.name: Pinion Tales
games.description: Pinion Tales is a whimsical physics-based puzzle adventure where nature and machines coexist in a relaxing, immersive world brought to life through hand-crafted visuals. You need to guide the Keeper through tricky obstacles, solve playful mini-tasks, and befriend quirky companions along the way.

games.name: Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain
games.description: In Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain, feed into your worst impulses in this action packed high score gambling game. Gain abilities to rig races in your favor! Collect virtual figurines of your favorite horses, like Jovial Merryment...

games.name: 天降灾异：幸存者
games.description: 地球危在旦夕，召集好友，在一切为时已晚之前击败邪恶势力！在这款全新的横版幸存者游戏中，你将在危机四伏的关卡中跳跃、攻击，对抗汹涌而来的敌潮，并打造属于你的终极Build。支持最多8人在线合作，击退入侵者，在《天降灾异：幸存者》中活下去！

games.name: Magma Karta
games.description: Magma Karta is a satisfying strategy card game with roguelite and gambling elements. The rules can switch at any turn, challenging you to adapt your builds and your playstyle.

games.name: The Mire of Miss Audacity
games.description:
After waking up in a world without her sister, Miss Alexandra Audacity believes she's been left out of a conspiracy between her flaky friends and secretive husband. 

Guide her through five timelines mired by false memories while trying to keep her sanity, and yours.

games.name: Dillaball
games.description: Shoot, roll, and break your way through the city in this fast-paced pinball-like arcade action game. Collect money to buy increasingly chaotic abilities to spice up your runs, call your friends and put on the headphones for some pop punk tunes and blast off!

games.name: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
games.description:
Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. 
Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't).
Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session.

games.name: Beneath Paris
games.description: 在这款氛围诡谲的第一人称恐怖游戏中，深入神秘的法国地下墓穴。探索狭窄的隧道，揭开隐藏的秘密，并深入那些被遗忘的通道。越往深处走，你就越会感到冥冥之中有什么东西在与你同在。

games.name: The Debtician
games.description: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

games.name: 城堡漂流记
games.description:
建造独属于你的飞行要塞，打造出想象中的最强堡垒，指挥它在一个手绘王国中穿行战斗。
不过，你的城堡能够成功抵御大恶魔的强势攻击吗？

games.name: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
games.description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

games.name: 9Clock OverPack
games.description: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

games.name: TOP STEED
games.description: 进入高速赛马的世界！翻身上马，在夸张的赛道上漂移驰骋，体验拥有真实骑乘操控的多人竞速游戏。驾驭你的 TOP STEED 赢得胜利！

games.name: Kaiju Defense Project
games.description: 《怪兽防御计划》是一款策略游戏，背景设定在一个人类苦苦挣扎、对抗巨型怪兽入侵的世界。你需要建造、组织并巧妙地指挥你的防御工事，守住人类最后的堡垒之一。人类还能坚持多久？

games.name: Spincremental
games.description: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

games.name: VESSOUL
games.description: Control an animate vessel powered by motes of light; Explore a world laden with shadows, spirits, forgotten graves, and charred ruins to discover the truth of its past. Escape the cycle, and achieve Ascension, or be bound to eternal servitude for all time. The fate of the Innerlands lies with you...

games.name: This is not Chess, It's War!
games.description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

games.name: 沉舟
games.description: 桌面上出现了一个从没见过的聊天软件，刚一打开，就有一个穿着奇怪工装的女孩向你发出求助。经过一段短暂的相处后，另一个世界的样子通过小小的聊天窗向你展开。

games.name: Space Numbers Go Up
games.description: 款关于小行星采矿的短篇增量游戏。你可以在飞船内四处走动，解锁技能，转动老虎机，点击按钮，并观看数字不断增长。

games.name: These Eyes
games.description: 《这些眼睛》是一款无文字冒险游戏，融合了动作、平台跳跃、任务和恐怖元素。探索不同的场景，解开谜题，并与其他角色互动。

games.name: 键盘农场
games.description: 《键盘农场》是一款桌面挂机种田游戏，打开农场放置于桌面上，然后只需专注于你的工作。每一个按键都是一块土地，每一次按键都能帮助植物生长。通过收获植物来收集金币，获取不同种类的键帽，创造属于你的键盘小天地。

games.name: Skyreap
games.description: 探索一片被遗忘的浮空群岛。采集资源，建造并自动化生产线，将岛屿连成繁荣的贸易网络——直到整片天空都属于你。

games.name: 茶王记 (Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?)
games.description: 一夜之间，你父亲的珍珠奶茶帝国连同整个家族被对手一举覆灭。你是七弟... 唯一幸存的悲剧主角。通过调制最好的饮品、重新夺回这座城市来建立你的势力……又或者，你懂的，用破坏、暗算和暴力来废掉竞争对手。

games.name: Tenrei
games.description: 2D战团沙盒——游历地图，组建军队，进行回合制战斗。

games.name: Disqualified
games.description: 在这片混乱之中拿到你的驾照。只跑一圈。活下来，拿到驾照。

games.name: 开了家放置酒吧撩妹子
games.description: Run your own idle bar and click your way to pleasure — earn money, unlock girls, and progress through increasingly explicit rewards.

games.name: Sacred Land
games.description: Sacred Land is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an ancient nature spirit defending your island against invading settlers.

games.name: The Ice is Watching
games.description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: RatSpire
games.description: RatSpire(鼠之尖塔)是一款手下养成与自动战斗为特色的俯视角幸存者肉鸽：你率领鼠族军团，一层层冲上致命尖塔，选择自己的前进路线。招募各路奇葩职业，叠加武器、药剂与遗物，搓出离谱构筑，杀到越高处越爽。放下双手，让军团替你开战。

games.name: 疫区求生
games.description: 《疫区求生》是一款开放世界僵尸末世生存游戏。游戏以第三人称动作射击为主，可搜刮、换装、建造、制作、种植、钓鱼、狩猎、招募NPC、模拟经营等。

games.name: DEMØNS GATE：漆弹对战行动
games.description:
享受角色养成。超过100个角色槽位。自动推进的派遣系统。超过50个关卡。也可全程自动推进。
战术角色扮演游戏（Tactical RPG）
策略角色扮演游戏（SRPG）
基于网格的回合制战术游戏
日式回合制战术RPG系列

games.name: IdleGambler
games.description: Discover how your grandpa's old PC holds the key to unimaginable riches. Explore, upgrade, and most importantly, gamble as your life depends on it in this incremental game.

games.name: Cup Or Die
games.description: Every cup is a gamble. Play deadly beer pong, take your chances, and find a way out.

games.name: Red Siren Protocol
games.description: Red Siren Protocol 是一款近未来谍战18+视觉小说，带沙盒循环：在安全公寓规划下一步，外出城市获取资源与筹码，然后进入“劫案式”剧情任务——先做准备，再执行真正行动。

games.name: 裂脑轮回
games.description:
你和朋友困在了一个身体里！

这是一款合作冒险游戏，你们需要学会同时控制一个角色，勇闯精神世界，揭穿轮回这个巨型建筑的阴谋！沟通将是成功的关键！

games.name: Place it Gently – Cozy Organizing
games.description: 这是一款温馨放松的第一人称房间布置游戏。摆放家具和日常物品，自由选择可涂色表面的颜色，在布置中解锁新的房间，将空房间变成舒适的空间。无需匆忙，按自己的节奏享受布置的乐趣，所有进度都会自动保存。

games.name: March of the Kingdom
games.description: 一款队伍管理类 Roguelite RPG 自动战斗游戏。探索多样的大地，讨伐王国之敌，直面难以预料的遭遇。组建你的团队，提升等级，收集强大的武器、神器与遗物，助你踏上征途。

games.name: Cellular Sorcery
games.description: Explore a chaotic microscopic universe by traveling between strange cell planets and popping deadly infections with your friends or on your own. Combine upgrades in wild ways and evolve your build each run until you become the most infectious cell in the system.

games.name: Decalcomanie
games.description: A dinosaur trapped in a paper world. Use decalcomania to duplicate tiles, build a path, and escape!

games.name: Forgefolk
games.description: 亲手锻造武器与工具，修好别人弄坏的东西，也揭开埋藏在旧钢铁里的故事。在《Forgefolk》中，每一道伤痕都有来历——而你发现的真相，可能会迫使一位老铁匠大师直面那件他始终没能修好的东西：自己的过去。

games.name: All Haul the King
games.description: 这是一款如假包换的合作游戏。在该游戏中，你和朋友们将踏上一段史诗级的受难之旅，横穿整个王国，将哥布林国王的尸体拖回去复活。运用智商、蛮力以及疯狂的哥布林魔法，应付一路上的崎岖地形和奇葩谜题。

games.name: Rogue Tempo
games.description: Rogue Tempo is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilding game. Build your orchestra with musical cards and unleash powerful synergies to defeat each boss in a fast-paced rhythm! What will your victory sound like?

games.name: Slots Up!
games.description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

games.name: GoGeez
games.description: 《GoGeez》是一款心理恐怖放置游戏：你独自烂在房间里，沉迷于可爱的Q版小生物，对屏幕外愈发恐怖的世界视而不见

games.name: MeowMiner
games.description:
沉浸在可爱猫咪矿工的迷人点击器世界！
砸碎岩石，开采黄金，解锁新镐子，挖掘无尽深处！

games.name: Timberworks
games.description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

games.name: Dream Paralysis
games.description: Your childhood bedroom appears different than you remember. Report all of the anomalies around you to survive the night.

games.name: Nidgets: Award Winning Idle Simulator
games.description: A screensaver with a body count. No progression, no ending, and it has won no awards. Spawn Nidgets, grab lightsabers, and walk away while they slaughter each other.

games.name: 奇迹魔法师：元素觉醒
games.description: 《元素觉醒》是一款三消类策略角色扮演游戏，混沌魔王撕裂了屏障，使得世界原本平衡的元素流转紊乱，混沌蔓延，扭曲了野兽、植物和人类的心灵。作为一名刚毕业的魔法师，你肩负着唤醒元素让世界重归秩序的使命，集结签订了契约的精灵伙伴们，勇敢踏上荆棘之路，在黑暗吞噬世界之前恢复秩序。

games.name: 绿洲行迹Way To Oasis
games.description: 《绿洲行迹》是一部多结局废土风视觉小说。在一片荒漠中，原本身为商队副队长的“你”，在队长身亡后，接管六人小队，肩负起生存资源管理与人员协调的重任。面对生存压力与道德困境，亦或是在“谁”的注视下，“你”是否能带领队伍最终走出荒漠？

games.name: Bravebones
games.description:
Bravebones is a stressful anti-stress game.
Shoot arrows. Miss everything. Die. Repeat.
Auto-shoot included (your mouse will thank you).
Short runs, bad decisions, and just one more try.

games.name: Bumpers & Dragons
games.description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

games.name: Colossus
games.description: 在这款合作游戏中，与好友一同执行太空任务，配置飞船上的计算机，完成一项神秘的任务。

games.name: Eternal Angler
games.description: A surreal multiplayer fishing game where you catch strange creatures hidden across fragmented dimensions.

games.name: 万圣夜砰砰砰
games.description: 《Halloween Poppp》是一款以万圣节为主题，轻松上手的休闲益智连线消除游戏。空间不断压缩，你必须精确计算每一步，在压力下做出最优决策。掌握 10 种道具是制胜关键，触发连击获得倍增分数，消除越多宝石奖励越丰厚。升级等级解锁更强奖励，形成正向循环。挑战自己，在Steam 全球排行榜上证明实力。

games.name: HELLO HACKER - Project Daybreak
games.description: A story-rich hacking sim played inside a real Linux desktop. Recon networks, break web apps, crack crypto, and extract hidden data with tools that behave like the real thing, while an autonomous AI watches the network, learns, and hacks back. The commands are real. So are the consequences.

games.name: Buckshot Bunny
games.description: Buckshot Bunny is a single-player, fast-paced 2D action platformer, testing your speed and agility, navigating challenging locations as the cybernetic rabbit, Buck. Run, smash and bullet-jump through hazards and enemies to free your family and find your way back home.

games.name: Endless Dark
games.description: A first-person survival horror game where you uncover the dark trail of a secretive corporation while searching for your missing sister.

games.name: 幸运奶茶店
games.description: 这是一款融合肉鸽元素的时间管理类餐厅模拟游戏。学习多种美味饮品、遇到各种各样的顾客，掌握五花八门的经营技巧。合理搭配各种选项，不论是休闲闯关或是房租挑战，统统搞定！

games.name: 灵劫变
games.description: 《灵劫变》是一款开放世界玄幻修仙角色扮演游戏。你可以使用自己的专属形象在数万格的手工地图中不断探索全新机缘，体验蝴蝶效应般的非线性剧情与红尘情缘。除却驾驭灵兽与法宝进行策略战斗，你还能开辟洞府、经营宗门，甚至与道侣建立家族，亲自培养下一代天骄，开启有温度的修真之路。

games.name: River Drift
games.description: 一款基于物理的合作漂流游戏：协调划桨、规划路线、收集资源修复木筏，在充满危险生物与陷阱的河流中生存。

games.name: Snackrifice
games.description: 在这款类Rogue地牢探索游戏中，你可以选择独狼单刷，也能最多组成4人小队并肩作战。深入瞬息万变的炼狱，在各种让局面彻底失控的致命诅咒里随机应变。四处搜刮硬币，购买珍贵遗物，想方设法克服炼狱中的重重险阻。

games.name: 迷离夜：课
games.description: MALAM：课，一个节奏慢，无法奔跑，必须直视恐惧的慢热类恐怖游戏。极简UI，轻微解谜，靠镜头查看，触发事件。主要以马来西亚独中元素背景制作的场景。观察四周，让视觉镜头开启轻微事件。在某些情况，回头看也许是通关桥梁，或者是作死，不得而知。人生中多多少少都有些校园黑色回忆及恐怖传说吧，在淡忘之前，希望这辈子留下些什么。游戏内容大量AI辅助完成，因此也让我这个外行有机会独立完成原不可能的作品。

games.name: SANASANA
games.description: 为了让死去的姐姐复活，少女踏上旅途，从三位魔女手中夺取金苹果。穿越美丽却毫不留情的弹幕，在这款充满疯狂的黑暗幻想弹幕射击游戏中追寻她的愿望。

games.name: CRASHLAND
games.description: Survive a hostile alien planet in CRASHLAND, a brutal sci-fi arena FPS playable on PC, Steam Deck, or in VR. Face over 100 terrifying creatures in fast, vicious combat. Master your weapons, motion scanner and limited teleports to stay one move ahead.

games.name: CastleOn Scriptum
games.description: 在这款以历史手稿为主题、融合了塔防与经典即时战略元素的游戏中，建造城堡，抵御敌人进攻！建造塔楼、布置陷阱、训练并指挥你的部队。

games.name: 猫咪牌
games.description: 猫咪牌MeowCards是一款以猫咪为主题的策略卡牌游戏。你可以收集拥有奇特能力的猫咪卡牌，打造属于自己的猫咪牌组，并和它们一起勇攀高峰！喵~

games.name: Arrow Hell
games.description: Play as a Magical Arrow and Fight for your Survival in the Space. A fast-paced arcade game packed with relentless and sci-fi enemy waves. Dodge, Attack & Upgrade and stand until the end in this Short & Minimally Designed Action Arena.

games.name: 零点夜巡
games.description:
我是这片老街的夜班保安。
每天的工作枯燥无味：巡逻、打卡、然后等待凌晨6点的交班铃声。
但今晚，时钟似乎在零点停止了走动，今天能准时下班吗？

games.name: Click to Medieval Roguelite
games.description: Don't want to play a massive complex campaign? Grow your medieval province with just a few clicks, sell your meager hamlet/kingdom then unlock auto hire workers with incremental upgrades for a more idle playstyle, watch your kingdom grow wealthy and powerful with ease.

games.name: NEUROBROOD
games.description: «NEUROBROOD» is a visual novel in the cyberpunk‑horror genre. Those touched by the abyss of neurodream never wake up the same.

games.name: BRAVERY
games.description: 在这款第三人称单人冒险游戏中，扮演一个小小的火柴人。点燃你的左臂，开启新的道路，并面对比你更庞大的敌人。探索世界，寻找古老的镜子，并利用途中发现的资源将它们修复。

games.name: Clearance Defence
games.description: Defend the clearance shelf. When the lights go out, the seasonal war begins. Lead your unsold Easter stock against waves of full-price enemies — before morning reveals the secret.

games.name: Concrete Polishing Simulator
games.description: 在这款由真正的混凝土抛光工开发的亲手操作第一人称模拟游戏中，将粗糙混凝土变成抛光地面。操作专业设备，完成从准备到密封的每个阶段，并通过一项项任务建立你的声誉。

games.name: Silent Anomalies 2
games.description: 一款恐怖“找不同”游戏，你需要监控摄像头、发现异常并努力熬过夜晚。关闭惊吓演出，享受轻松的体验；或开启它们，感受十足的恐怖紧张感。

games.name: Star TD
games.description: 在变幻莫测的 Roguelite 塔防游戏中指挥防御。开采矿点资源，探索战争迷雾，击退外星攻势。凭借深度的技术树和永久进度系统，每一次失败都是通往终极力量的一步。建造。阵亡。研究。轮回。

games.name: Green Gas
games.description:
3–5 Cells and One hidden Cancer.
Which one will you become?

Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive
But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

games.name: Deep Breach
games.description: Fight relentless alien swarms in a top-down action roguelike that blends intense shooting with tower defense. Customize weapons, assemble deadly turrets, unlock HELIOS technology, and push through enemy lines to destroy the alien core.

games.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
games.description: 一款残酷的8位复古射击游戏，灵感来自80年代最好的B级恐怖片。你是塞缪尔·阿尔瓦雷斯，一个破碎的人，发现了一间比任何噩梦都更糟的木屋。活过这一夜，并面对温达科尔的力量——否则你将看不到黎明。

games.name: Bottled by Bears
games.description: 加入熊熊一家，一起经营嗡嗡热闹的小小蜂蜜农场！收集并发现稀有蜜蜂，把蜂蜜装进罐中，扩建农场，看花田在这款温馨的放置经营游戏中灿烂盛开。

games.name: Highland Haven
games.description: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

games.name: Backpack of Wishes
games.description: 末日改变了一切：除了你，所有男人都变成了怪物。这个世界的女人正被一种只有你才能满足的欲望折磨得发疯 😏🔥 把女孩们带回你的避难所，从Boss手中救出她们，并决定今晚谁会陪你玩到天亮 🍆💦 完全免费，18+

games.name: Bounty Monster Trucks
games.description: Bounty Monster Truck is the game true fans have been waiting for. Design your own Monster Trucks, Make your own tracks in Arenas or Stadiums, including racing and freestyle modes, and many different truck bodies to choose from!

games.name: Cloud Harvester
games.description:
Restore the ancient network.
Harvest valuable crystals, collect loot, upgrade your ship
and explore a mysterious world of floating islands.
A handcrafted indie game by a solo developer

games.name: 蹦极渔女
games.description: 想体验不一样的钓鱼？在《蹦极渔女》中，你将扮演一名身穿泳衣，腰绑绳索的捕鱼者。她将从高处纵身一跃，冲到深海里把各种鱼类和宝箱捕捞起来。来一起挑战水下的未知生物和寻找那失落的宝藏吧！

games.name: Unbox the Room 2
games.description: 这款主打惬意开箱与室内设计的游戏现已回归——规模更大、更温馨、互动性更强。从居家住宅到商业小店，每一个空间都会对你的选择做出反馈，并展现出主人的个性。

games.name: Stepmom Who Fell on a Hike
games.description: 《Stepmom Who Fell on a Hike》是一款以选择驱动的心理剧情视觉小说，讲述一名性格内向的大学生，与父亲的新妻子桑德拉及同学艾米丽踏上徒步之旅。暧昧、嫉妒与诱惑不断升级，一次意外邂逅打破平衡。迷路后的生存压力迫使众人直面情感背叛与艰难抉择，玩家的选择将影响关系走向并导向多重结局。

games.name: Apothecary Grounds
games.description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

games.name: 喵岛雄心
games.description: 接手一座荒废的浮空岛屿，带领猫猫居民从零开始整合物产、优化产线、开辟航路——在这款轻度模拟经营×跑商游戏中，建造属于你的猫猫商业帝国！

games.name: Plumbo
games.description: A playful desktop companion that reacts to everything you do to him. Pet, toss, or annoy Plumbo... just don't push your luck.

games.name: 枪炮、公主与勇者 Guns, Princess and Braves
games.description: 《枪炮、公主与勇者》是一款背包构筑+策略塔防的快节奏轻度Rogue游戏。扮演与龙相爱的公主，在有限空间内策略布局武器，构筑致命防线。还可亲自上阵战斗，用华丽的弹幕击溃“正义”的勇者，守护爱龙！

games.name: Nightgate Defense
games.description: 轻操作增量 × 守城塔防。夜幕下怪物从召唤门涌出，城墙是最后防线——数百弓箭手齐射，四位英雄助阵，一夜比一夜更艰难。

games.name: Magical Girl ER
games.description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

games.name: SUPER SKILL ISSUE
games.description: A brutal precision platformer where your own superpowers are the biggest threat.

games.name: Outdraft
games.description: 带领一支 MOBA 电竞战队，制定英雄阵容，管理选手，并在一款融合深度经营要素的策略自动战斗游戏中，带领你的俱乐部走向冠军荣耀。

games.name: New Zombie Era
games.description: 一位狂妄的暴君用人造空气传播的病原体摧毁了文明，并带领感染者大军和精锐雇佣兵统治着废墟。作为罕见的“免疫者”之一，你必须在混乱中杀出一条血路，粉碎他的帝国，并释放解药以夺回我们的未来。

games.name: Last convoy
games.description: Speed or firepower? Survive or dominate? Build your armored convoy car by car in this survivors-like auto-shooter. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

games.name: My Little Ranch
games.description: 一座温馨的马匹牧场：工作时，它安静地待在你的桌面上；闲暇时，也可以全屏畅玩。喂养马儿、让它们结伴奔跑、参加比赛赢取金币、雇佣牧场帮手，把你的小牧场经营得越来越兴旺。

games.name: The Flying Feather Shotgun
games.description:
There's tales told about a shootgun that can burst dreams into reality...
Well, no, to be honest, it's just a single succubus that illegally entered MacDude's room that tell that.
Let's believe her! And off we go to a 2d arena shooter with movement bound to the recoil of your weapons!

games.name: Chakab
games.description: 探索热带岛屿，揭开古老玛雅神庙的秘密，并在查卡布的诅咒中求生。解开谜题，做出重要选择，在一个现实与噩梦交织的世界中面对心理恐怖。

games.name: Blastlane Racers
games.description: Explosive top-down arcade combat racing. Boost past your rivals, unleash powerful weapons and master 24 hand-crafted tracks packed with hazards. Race solo or battle friends in chaotic 4-player splitscreen, earn progress and unlock new skins for 10 different cars.

games.name: Broke Wizards
games.description: 这是一款竞技类沙盒派对游戏，可供2至6名玩家一同游玩。你可以与巫师室友一起痛宰怪物、玩躲猫猫和悬浮板竞速，接下各类奇葩任务，抢先将房租交给小恶魔房东！

games.name: 终末执棋者
games.description: 末日终局降临，谁才是最后的救世主？你并非预言中的勇者，而是于废墟之上挣扎求存的“执棋者”。这里没有既定的英雄，只有幸存下来的强者。召集他们，精心布局，运用收集的道具装备与同伴在绝境中扭转战局。真相就藏在世界的残骸深处——而你，是否敢于执棋前行？

games.name: ETCH
games.description: 一款快节奏的俯视角 Roguelike 迷宫疾行游戏。你是“PSI级”跑者，唯一无法被他们俘获的异类。潜入追踪器盘踞的区块，唤醒核心，在他们包围前收复失地。

games.name: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
games.description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

games.name: Bandit Life
