games.description: Build a hideout, gather your gang, and live off what others cannot defend. Explore a medieval world, set ambushes, develop your outlaws, and face the consequences of decisions that could make you the terror of the roads—or bring your entire gang to ruin.

games.name: 星渊无双
games.description: 《星渊无双》是一款融合了Roguelike随机探索与割草式清屏的星际题材动作游戏。每一次降落，你都将面对汹涌的怪潮，搜集组合武器装备，配合你超强的机动性杀出重围。

games.name: Fiak
games.description: 在真实而沉浸的恐怖体验中熬过四个夜晚。独自待在家中的你，要面对一个执意闯入的恶意存在。这不是步行模拟器：每一个决定都关乎你的生死，一次失误就是致命的。

games.name: Indie City Mixtape 2026
games.description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

games.name: Project Tomorrow
games.description: 一款带有地形改造和制作元素的基地建设生存游戏。地球在一万年前的入侵中遭遇荼毒，沦为一片废土。你需要从休眠中苏醒，守护人类脆弱的立足之地，恢复这颗死星的生机，让它重新成为人类的家园。

games.name: Megashootsplosion
games.description: A fast, physics-drunk arena shooter that never stays the same. Throw your gun to reload, wall-jump to stay alive, and stack chaotic upgrades until fights get gloriously out of hand. Duel 1v1 or brawl up to 4 players across 8 modes.

games.name: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
games.description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

games.name: 第九龙：卧底风暴
games.description: 血战于1980年代九龙城寨的黑帮世界：《第九龙：卧底风暴》是一款叙事驱动的硬派动作游戏，融合了策略战斗与多分支选择，您的每一个决定都将左右这座城寨的命运。

games.name: PixelJunk Monsters 3
games.description: 庆祝 PixelJunk Monsters 系列 20 周年！传奇塔防系列以华丽的 4K 画质回归手绘风格的初心！奔跑、跳舞并建造防御塔，抵御怪物大军的进攻，全新的 Roguelike 元素为游戏增添更多策略深度。支持单人游玩，也可以最多两个人在线或本地一起游玩。

games.name: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
games.description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

games.name: Chrono Cards
games.description: 《Chrono Cards》是一款节奏明快的多人竞技卡牌游戏，让你拥有扭转时间本身的力量！打造横跨历史的牌组，组合出震撼全场、足以撕裂时间线的连招。运用无穷无尽的组合技，将时间线塑造成对你有利的样貌，把对手打回石器时代。

games.name: Petko and the Black Island
games.description: A classical 2D point & click adventure taking place on the eve of a tropical zombie apocalypse! Join world traveler Petko in this crazy adventure full of quirky characters and challenging puzzles!

games.name: Chicks vs Ducks
games.description: 一款支持 2–10 人的跑酷派对游戏。多样的模式让你可以分成两队对抗、单人挑战或者合作闯关。在各式各样的竞技场里，用跑酷技巧完成目标，无论是携手作战还是单打独斗，赢下比赛。

games.name: Eternal Rift Defense
games.description: Build mazes, place towers, and fight beside them in a 3D tower defense RPG. Defend 50 rifts solo or in 4-player co-op, level towers by standing on them, collect powerful gear sets, shape your build with heroes, talents, upgrades, and join a 10-player raid to slay a dragon.

games.name: Broken Soccer
games.description: 从38支荒唐的球队中选一支，掷出骰子，放出恐龙冲撞、僵尸感染、牛市（真有一头牛）或替补席上杀出的尼采。终场哨响还是平局？脱掉球鞋，亮出拳头。支持单人、合作和最多4v4的在线对战。

games.name: Spikehead
games.description: Spike your friends from below in this fast-paced local multiplayer party game!

games.name: 翡翠模拟器
games.description: 这是一款模拟翡翠加工全过程的硬核模拟游戏。玩家将从选料开始，利用手电筒观察原石的水头、颜色与裂纹，凭借经验判断价值。随后需亲自操纵机器切割原石，通过避开裂隙来保住核心价值。游戏涵盖了从去皮、磨圆到抛光的完整加工流程，玩家在将粗石转变为透亮成品的过种中，还需学习辨别天然翡翠与人工处理货的区别。通过出售成品积累资金，玩家可以不断升级加工设备并挑战更高价的矿石。全流程操作感真实，还原了从原石博弈到成品经营的商业逻辑。

games.name: Imperial Kingdoms
games.description: 在这款带有暂停的实时中世纪4X大战略游戏中统御你的王国。建立关键基础设施以供应首都并维持军队。设计自定义军事模板，管理生产阶层，并通过战略围攻和突袭征服敌对王国。

games.name: Oh Apollo!
games.description: A hilarious cozy oracle sim set in ancient Greece! Tell (and shape!) the future, befriend a sassy God, and restore your temple back to former glory.

games.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
games.description:
An award-winning 4v4 class shooter with more personality than sense! The ORIGINAL Mobile Multiplayer Shooting Game comes to PC!

Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and compete with friends across 16 wacky maps. A third-person shooter like no other!

games.name: Split Happens
games.description: 与最多 6 位好友一起在线合作，管理一座老旧破败的核电站。在反应堆进入临界状态前排除危险，控制混乱以避免堆芯熔毁，并尽量别妨碍你的同事。

games.name: TerraNova: Legend of the Runes
games.description: Terra Nova: Legend of the Runes is a modern love letter to classic JRPGs, blending 80's/90's-era charm with a fresh, customizable adventure. Build your perfect party through a flexible job system, and uncover the ancient secrets of the elemental runes before they reshape the world.

games.name: A Psychopomp Besieged
games.description: A strategic wave defence game about guiding and protecting souls on their journey through the underworld. Conjure and enchant magical towers to repel invaders that bleed into the worlds between life and the beyond.

games.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
games.description: 你得去看望奶奶——双胞胎兄弟、末日,全套配齐。让巴士保持运转,饿到受不了时尽量别把朋友吃了。

games.name: Crimson Broadcast
games.description: 在危险的频率上进行广播，生存于无休止的敌人浪潮之中。升级、适应，并在这款末日后的俯视角生存游戏中守卫你的广播电台。

games.name: 雅卢的原野
games.description: 治愈的生活模拟游戏，带你走进古埃及神秘的死后世界。在尼罗河畔耕作，与当地人交朋友，装点永恒的家园。闯入沙漠深处，探索绿洲、金字塔与陵墓。修复古老的方尖碑，向诸神献祭，解锁神奇的魔法力量。

games.name: 都市隶人
games.description:
你将扮演一名新入职牛马，在日复一日的工作中完成任务、管理时间、提升能力，在12周的时间内通过试用期。
但你渐渐发现，公司的本质，从来都不是为了展示你的价值，而是在吞噬你的个性。

也许上班本身，就是最大的规则怪谈。

games.name: Nurtale Nesche
games.description:
帮助涅榭逃离由活生生的怪物所支配的黑暗地牢！
隐藏身形，制造声响引开敌人，搜集道具，并在紧张刺激的捕获事件中设法生还。
游戏包含会对玩家行动作出反应的陷阱、14种以上的怪物，以及36种以上的独特动画场景。

games.name: Geareo
games.description: 在物理沙盒中体验绝不打滑的真实齿轮。利用可自由缩放的零件与形状随心所欲地建造，解决基于物理的谜题，用强力胶将结构融合成稳定的机构，并亲手设计精巧的装置、精密机械以及复杂的机械系统。

games.name: RK Roulette
games.description: RISK YOUR LIFE IN HORROR. Risk it however you want: Play Russian roulette with up to 4 players, customizable bullets and gamemodes, or else, survive hard enemy waves also fully customizable. Buy items on the black market and create unique matches with your own personal touch. YOUR life, YOUR rules.

games.name: 风雪之下
games.description: 特工Wilder带着一项重要的任务潜入了目标的梦境，一切顺利，但有个小问题——入梦的那一刻，他失忆了……

games.name: Streetball Legends
games.description: Streetball Legends is a basketball game with roguelite mechanics and a gameplay without rules.

games.name: SHAPE & SHADE
games.description: SHAPE & SHADE 是一款多人游戏，融合了 Prop Hunt（道具躲猫猫）和社交推理的机制。画出你自己的伪装，在列车到站前活下来。看着你的朋友们慢慢发疯，试图分辨什么是真的，什么不是！

games.name: Echoes of Midnight
games.description: Bound. Dressed. Displayed. A serial killer's ritual has begun... Use silence as your weapon, solve the killer's twisted puzzle, and escape before midnight. Play solo, survive together in co-op, or become the hunter in versus mode.

games.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
games.description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

games.name: Book Nook
games.description: 在 Book Nook 中，一步一步拼出迷你场景。摆放家具、装饰和细小道具，完成每一个温馨角落。无需压力与计时器，享受所有细节归位时的踏实感，感受每个Book Nook里蕴含的故事。

games.name: Tutsak
games.description: 《Tutsak》是一款1-4人合作恐怖游戏：找到钥匙，在怪物抓住你之前逃出去。被抓了？你会被关进牢房，直到朋友把你救出来。有时，你也可以出卖一名队友来代替自己。

games.name: The Tram
games.description:
体验2000年代中东欧风格线路上的电车驾驶。
真实物理、严苛天气与运营条件，以及细节丰富的城市环境，让每一次行程都成为真正的驾驶挑战。

games.name: The Dumbgeon
games.description: The Dumbgeon is a fantasy bullet hell where you fight hordes of enemies with random and challenging modifiers. Unlock champions, items, and upgrades to aid you in your quest. Escape the dungeon for a more casual experience or test your limits with how long you can survive to earn greater rewards!

games.name: Tales of the Trade
games.description: 在一个奇幻世界里，开一家属于你的中世纪小店吧。进货、摆货、应付各种离谱顾客，还要处理那些“多少带点魔法问题”的商品。顺便……也就顺便慢慢还清你祖父留下的 99,999,999,980 金币债务。

games.name: BATTLEDRIFT
games.description: A PvP 2D top-down shooter where your gun recoil is also your ship's propulsion! Master control of your ship better than your opponents and be the last one standing with up to 4 players.

games.name: Dark Roll 2
games.description: 一款以物理机制为核心、考验精准操作的3D平台游戏。滚动、弹跳、躲避陷阱、收集宝石，在黑暗奇幻风格的重重险关中与其他玩家的幽灵竞速。这场试炼就是要让你彻底怀疑“再试一次”这个人生选择。

games.name: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents
games.description: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents 是一款温馨的2D游戏，你将在其中种植花朵、制作精美花束，并为顾客调配芬芳的香水。一次轻松惬意的体验，专注于温柔的成长、创意与舒适的日常时光。🌸🌿

games.name: Gacha Shop Simulator
games.description: 经营一家温馨的扭蛋小店！销售盲盒和手办，接待顾客，扩建店铺，还可以给自己开几个盲盒。谁知道里面会开出什么稀有手办呢？

games.name: Leaping Dungeon
games.description: Leaping Dungeon is a frog first bullet heaven with lots of jumping and roguelike dungeon exploration in the world of frogs vs flies. Wield 6 weapons and 3 tongues at the same time. Beat rooms swarming with flies, fight bosses blocking the way down, and track down the Fly Lord!

games.name: False Echo
games.description: 《虚妄回响》是一款以大西洋深海秘密军用潜艇为背景的剧情向密码解密惊悚游戏。你将操作“暗影（Obscura）”密码机解码信息，在这个哪怕犯下微小错误都会导致惨重伤亡的政权统治下，决定哪些情报可以放行。

games.name: Gospel Drift
games.description: Let grandma take the wheel! Kick Satans whiny little ass and collect the souls of the damned to buy upgrades and slam the hordes that stand in your way...literally.

games.name: Squomb
games.description: Too close. Too late. You drop a bomb. Boom. You die. They die. Good. Respawn as your squomb and dive back in. 1–4 players. PvP or Co-op. Fast, explosive 1-bit madness inspired by Bomberman.

games.name: Fear Tall Grass
games.description: 暗黑生物收集类 Roguelite 游戏，人类奴役了他们古老的神明。在人类最后一场圣战的棋盘上指挥进化的怪物。

games.name: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
games.description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

games.name: Scourge Realms
games.description: Slay monsters in evil realms inflicted with scourge. Find Majestic Loot, Collect powerful enchanting materials and xp to survive the scourge and obtain god-like power.

games.name: Falling Cubes
games.description: 3D falling sand simulation. Experiment to unlock new materials. Reactions, Temperature, Pressure are your tools to discover over 200 unique cube types.

games.name: Space Tenacity
games.description: Chuck space aliens into each other! Dodge giant asteroids! Engage your tractor beam, force field and phase shifting technology to navigate the unknown in this 2D side scrolling physics based space adventure.

games.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
games.description: 你的身体是你的弱点。 一款四人合作恐怖游戏，你将扮演某研究设施的首席科学家。你唯一的目标是执行自毁计划并逃离设施。

games.name: Shatterswarm
games.description: 在这款策略型 2D 太空游戏中，指挥霍普舰长的战舰。建造设施、部署舰队并管理资源，抵御一波又一波的敌人，守卫堡垒。将直接的战舰战斗、塔防和基地建设融为一体，迎接史诗般的首领战。

games.name: Liminal Brutalis: Physical Agility
games.description: First-person precision platformer — A vertigo-inducing journey set in a brutalist facility of oppressing concrete shafts, industrial machinery and damp liminal spaces, that feel too large to be built for people.

games.name: Mauled Horde
games.description: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player co-op horde shooter. Survive relentless waves solo or with friends. Spend resources at Citadels to buy and upgrade weapons, unlock perks and gadgets, activate traps, and shape your build as each round grows more intense.

games.name: Lyden Lys
games.description: Lyden Lys is a knowledge-based metroidvania about an existential journey through a lost homeland. Control the surroundings through music, explore a smoldering world, discover what happened to your people, decide the fate of your successors, and find yourself.

games.name: Lost Floor — Not My World
games.description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

games.name: SAM Arena
games.description: Collect, escape and hunt in a strategic rock-paper-scissors styled arena battler, where each player gains abilities based on their equipped masks.

games.name: PERKS
games.description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

games.name: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike
games.description:
Slimestronauts: Burst Strike needs you to keep cool under pressure to match 4 colors in a row to burst Replinodules - just like the good old days!
Unlike the good old days; there are Powerups, Environmental Hazards, Enemies, Multiple game modes, and the option to Customize your own Game Mode!

games.name: Borbs
games.description: 通过解决简单却令人满足的谜题，帮助圆滚滚的鸟儿们回归鸟群。游戏采用手绘美术风格，出自一位资深养鸟人之手，栩栩如生。

games.name: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
games.description:
You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them.
This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

games.name: Watch Out: Shark!
games.description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

games.name: 不小心被妖狐辣妹包养的那件事
games.description: 《不小心被妖狐辣妹包养的那件事》是一款主打Live2D互动的恋爱养成游戏，你将成为妖狐的”助手”，与她同居并照顾她的生活。

games.name: VIGNETTE
games.description: 一款第一人称视角的点击式心理恐怖游戏。只有手电筒光照到的区域才会发生变化。游戏不依赖突如其来的惊吓，而是通过静谧的不安与解谜推进剧情。试玩版现已发布（约20分钟）。

games.name: 莫依卡：露出诱惑
games.description: 在这款3D动漫体验中，释放茉艾卡隐藏的暴露癖欲望。在公共场合挑战自我、提升自信并解锁全新内容……同时始终徘徊在即将被发现的边缘。

games.name: Another Map Simulator
games.description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

games.name: Tribulum
games.description: Fight and survive during a great supernatural tribulation. Explore abandoned locations, confront people possessed by a demonic plague that destroys moral conscience, and uncover a story where faith, fear, and humanity collide.

games.name: Lust Town: Treasure Hunter
games.description: 踏上海盗主题的三消冒险之旅，揭开格里伯斯通的传奇宝藏。参与惊险刺激的海战，邂逅城中最迷人的女性，并与她们每个人解锁独特的照片和私密场景。

games.name: Pirate Royalty
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 免费游玩的奇幻海盗题材大型多人在线角色扮演游戏。选择四大职业之一，自由分配属性、学习技能、寻找稀有装备、合成宝石并强化装备，与其他玩家一起挑战定时开放的地下城。所有优势都靠游玩赢得，力量绝不出售。

games.name: Cluemates
games.description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

games.name: Seven Nights Ghost 2
games.description:
《这份恋情与诅咒，也只剩七天》
与你同居的，是一位辣妹JK幽灵。
在接下来的七天里，你不仅要拼命闪避她热情满满的告白攻势。
微暗却绚烂——
一场把青春恋爱、心动恐惧与一点点荒诞感混在一起的暖心系惊悚故事。

games.name: Clinical Memory
games.description: This is not just a walking simulator. This is a new genre: a memory simulator. Explore Ward 7B, survive distorted cycles, collect fragments of memory, and face a truth that changes everything at the end.

games.name: Evidentia
games.description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

games.name: Potted Pets
games.description: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!

games.name: Werewolf Hunter: Night of Horror
games.description: Werewolf Hunter is a survival horror game about tracking a deadly predator in a hostile wilderness. Manage hunger and thirst, collect DNA to uncover its weakness, set traps, and barricade shelters. Hunt a regenerating beast that grows more dangerous with every night.

games.name: NoOneKnowsME.
games.description: You are not human—and no one can ever find out. NoOneKnowsME. is a psychological horror adventure set aboard a spaceship. Complete daily tasks, survive tense conversations, and hide your true identity for seven days as you make your way back to Earth.
games.developer: 箱詰めプロダクション

games.name: 余影
games.description: 《余影》是一款以千禧年小镇为背景的心理恐怖解谜游戏。2000年，兰兰在生日当天回到家，却发现父亲失踪了。为了寻找父亲，兰兰被迫在熟悉却逐渐异化的日常街巷中穿梭，在温暖与不安交织的回忆里，逐步拼凑被遗忘的过去，揭开隐藏在小镇中的真相。

games.name: P2W : The Party Show
games.description:
"Forget skills—buy your way to victory!"

 is a chaotic multiplayer party game where cash is king. Grab gold in hilarious minigames and shop for overpowered items to wreck your rivals. Ready to test your friendships? In this flashy show, the deepest pockets win it all!

games.name: Kichi: Focus Together
games.description: 一起进入一个有虚拟伙伴陪伴的多人空间吧！《Kichi: Focus Together》是一个3D多人社交空间，你可以和自己的虚拟搭子一起学习、工作、互动与放松，也可以和朋友一起让彼此的搭子在同一个空间里相遇。你甚至还能自定义房间和角色形象，让Ta真正融入你的线上日常生活。

games.name: Ram Fights
games.description: 准备好在这个爆笑的物理格斗游戏中用头槌撞出属于你的荣耀吧！定制你的终极动物角斗士，掌握完美冲刺的艺术，用史诗级的布娃娃物理引擎让你的对手飞上天。

games.name: Screams Echo
games.description: 《Screams Echo》是一款阴郁的俯视角动作 Roguelike。你必须在程序生成的地下设施中杀出重围，对抗成群的突变体。搜寻能彻底改写整场冒险的强大道具，将它们与武器、英雄技能组合，打造疯狂的连携，把绝望求生化作彻底的混乱。

games.name: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
games.description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - 发生在 The Derailed 世界中的独立故事。调查一场大规模失踪事件时，你来到了一座废弃工厂。答案隐藏其中 - 但你必须为此付出高昂的代价。你准备好了吗？

games.name: LABYRISON
games.description:
从漂浮在太空中的巨型迷宫监狱中活着归来。
成为一名失去记忆的囚犯，回收能量并逐步抵扣刑期的第一人称生存恐怖游戏。
摆脱逼近的捕食者追击，活着返回。

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.description: 一款建立在老虎机之上的回合制 roguelite。停下机器就是攻击，打赢战斗赢取宝箱，再把掉落物拿到铁砧上强化（如果你敢的话）。或者邀请好友，和他一战。

games.name: Origins Trading Card Game
games.description: 首款免费竞技集换式卡牌游戏 (TCG)。通过纯技术比拼（绝无氪金），赢取限量版数字评级卡牌，支持自由买卖与交易！

games.name: Rotary Knights
games.description: Build a Royal Flying Corps career in a turn-based WWI tactical RPG. Plot flight paths and firing angles on a hex board, plan sorties across the Western Front, and return to an aerodrome where wounds, repairs, and squadron choices shape your next mission.

games.name: Spellogger
games.description:
A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack.

Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

games.name: Deductopia
games.description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

games.name: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest
games.description: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest is an exploration adventure game. Reveal the house of Detectif Poirry as a robot vacuum cleaner, bump its inhabitants for stories, and clean your way to victory.

games.name: Hamsteria
games.description: Hamsteria是一款高难度的双人合作游戏，你将扮演两只身处相连滚轮中的仓鼠。支持在线合作、本地合作和单人模式！

games.name: Shadows Of Memory lll
games.description: Face your fears, Alice. This time, you're not alone. This is the last chapter in the horror visual novel trilogy.

games.name: 诡闻录：往日重现
games.description: 《诡闻录：往日重现》是一款中式校园题材的第一人称恐怖冒险游戏，游戏中玩家将扮演警察陈时，前往东山一中调查全校师生神秘失踪案，却阴差阳错之下回到了自己的高中时代，这也让本就心存执念的陈时有了解开心中疑惑的机会，随着一步步的探查，陈时发现校园里这些看似无关的传闻之间隐隐有着某种联系，似乎有什么人在谋划着一切，而他的穿越似乎也不是什么巧合……

games.name: 音飙
games.description: 将任何歌曲变成可玩的节奏驾驶体验。基于数百个手工制作关卡的创作经验，我们打造了专属节奏系统，将你最爱的音乐变成动态赛道。游戏内置关卡编辑器，并支持Steam创意工坊。你可以创作自己独一无二的关卡，也可以探索创意工坊中不断涌现的，来自全球玩家的丰富作品。

games.name: Booker Blitz
games.description: Book the chaos. Call the shots. Booker Blitz is a keyboard-first wrestling promotion management sim with Gorilla Position live match control — audibles, run-ins, and finishes you change mid-match. Build the card, cut the promos, sign the deals, and run the show.

games.name: Rascal
games.description: Rascal is an action roguelike where up to 4 players fight waves of enemies, gain gold, experience and purchase abilities.

games.name: PSYKOS
games.description: 一款合作恐怖游戏，你的声音可能会让你丧命，怪物会闯入你的藏身之处，而被抓走的队友必须在为时已晚之前被救出。

games.name: Hex Seculum
games.description: Explore a perilous hex map, delve into tense dungeons where time and torchlight run out, and fight turn-based battles where distance and positioning decide survival. Plan your expedition, manage supplies, and escape with treasure.

games.name: polymorphite
games.description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

games.name: Soulstonia
games.description: 在这款温馨的放置 RPG 中，招募会自主行动的召唤师。设置放置目标，让队伍替你采集、制作和战斗，也可随时亲自操控。训练 20 多项技能，召唤生物，探索一个鲜活的奇幻世界。

games.name: Donboz Jailbreak
games.description: Donboz Jailbreak is a cartoonish multiplayer jailbreak sandbox where Cops and Prisoners compete, cooperate, or rebel. With 25+ minigames and player-driven gameplay, creativity turns every match into a new social experience.

games.name: Hold The Roost
games.description: Build by day. Defend by night. Command a flock of chickens in a tactical tower-defense survival game where every bird has a job. Gather resources, hatch and recruit stronger chickens, customize weapons and targeting, and outsmart predators with tricks of their own.

games.name: HAWKER
games.description: HAWKER is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

games.name: 過去でバズってVTuber -2018からならバズれるんじゃ！？
games.description: Time-leap back to 2018 and restart your VTuber career from zero. Fifty-three weeks to go viral. Pull in your own avatar through the OBS / VTube Studio virtual camera and watch yourself stream inside the game. Miss a goal and time rewinds — your skills stay in your muscle memory, run after run.

games.name: Unseen - Someone
games.description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

games.name: Blackout Route
games.description: 世界已被“同步网络”掌控。这是一款融合制作、搜刮与撤离玩法的合作动作恐怖游戏。深入危险区域展开突袭，关闭信号、营救幸存者、收集资源，并活着返回营地。

games.name: Applied Shamanism
games.description: 一款温馨的 3D 游戏，讲述一只新手兔子萨满的故事。用“灵视 X 光”诊断古怪病症，采集并种植元素食材，调制永远有用的药水。每位病人都是一段小巧的谜案，融合民间怪病与守护灵，没有战斗、伤害或计时限制。

games.name: 9 Layers of Hell
games.description: 成千上万的恶魔蜂拥而至——杀出一条血路，直奔地狱第九层！自创法术，刷出颠覆构筑的传说装备，趁波次间隙锻造神装。割草肉鸽的爽快感，遇上 ARPG 的刷宝乐趣。你能深入到第几层？

games.name: Dust & Diamonds
games.description: 人类已灭绝，哥布林成为食物链霸主！接管矿山，扩建地表基地并实现物流自动化。管理员工、进行贸易、躲避坍塌与岩浆，最重要的是——努力忍受你老爸无休止的唠叨！在这款 2.5D 模拟经营游戏中开启你的哥布林致富之路。

games.name: 风耍农场大乱斗
games.description: 在神秘的麒麟岛上，白天经营农场、播种收获并赚取金币，夜晚拿起武器守护家园！《风耍农场大乱斗》融合俯视角动作射击、塔防防守、轻度种田与奇趣冒险。灵活走位、切换攻击、释放强力绝招，在成群怪物中守住阵线；穿越机关重重的障碍赛道，挑战风格各异的战场与危险对手；探索葡萄园、空中花园和宏伟城堡，结识古怪又可爱的居民。每一次种植、战斗和探索都会推动你的冒险，让悠闲田园生活与热闹大乱斗交替展开。立即开启你的麒麟岛旅程！

games.name: Blenderman
games.description:
《Blenderman》是一款第一人称逃生恐怖游戏，在这里，可爱的水果正被某个更可怕的存在追捕。
探索黑暗的森林，拯救你的水果朋友，并一路狂奔回到安全之地——同时，每成功救出一个水果，Blenderman都会变得更快、更危险。
你无法躲藏。你无法回头。你只能奔跑。

games.name: Chattini Jetpack Project: A Hololive Fan Game
games.description: A hololive fan-game for factory (and jetpack) enthusiasts! Build, explore, survive, and grant the Chattini some jetpacks!

games.name: 空城：逃离首尔 HollowCity
games.description: 《HollowCity》是一款以废墟城市为舞台的PvE俯视角撤离类射击游戏。你可以单人游玩，或与最多4名同伴一起探索不同区域，收集生存物资。想要你命的不仅是敌对人类。突破那些因不明原因诞生的怪物，安全逃离吧。

games.name: 舰队激斗:郑成功
games.description:
塔防+自走棋+海战
从风帆时代的传奇船长中挑选你的指挥官——郑成功、黑胡子、德雷克、纳尔逊、……还有更多。
指挥10+艘帆船，摆阵型，侧舷开火。敌人一波波沿固定路线进攻。每局随机获得船只，搭配阵容。

games.name: Incredigble
games.description: Click on rocks, gain money, find fossils, buy powerups, and grow in power! Fill and expand your museum with your discoveries, and become famous!

games.name: Nerobreak: Cult Fall
games.description: A neo-noir adventure set in October 1983, as the influence of the criminal gang "Cipher" grows in the city. They are involved in the distribution of illegal substances and causing mass disappearances. A plot-driven retro action film with elements of quest, novella, cyberpunk, and neo-noir

games.name: Formation Builder Idle
games.description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

games.name: Survivor's Log 幸存日志: N17避难所
games.description:
幸存日志：N17避难所
末日爆发。
你必须活下去直到救援抵达，或寻找撤离的方法。
在废墟中探索、分配资源、面对事件与未知生命体的风险。
带着爱犬与爱人坚持到最后。

games.name: 黑箱：无限构筑​
games.description: 欢迎来到首个AI能实时「搓技能」、「捏宠物」、「造家园」的弹幕射击类肉鸽游戏——与「黑箱」一同直面智械危机吧！

games.name: The Last Embrace: Book One
games.description: 一名年轻女孩，一名吸血鬼，也是她这个种族最后的幸存者，在沉睡千年后于现代世界中醒来。一部以故事为核心、带有成人内容的视觉小说。神秘、背叛、失去与暴力正在等待着你！塑造主角以及整个世界的未来！

games.name: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
games.description:
一个神秘的漩涡将你从现实中吞噬。

你将扮演 Max，被困在未知世界之间。

探索、观察、解谜，寻找逃离的方法……

但要小心——
有些存在，并不希望你离开。

games.name: Stinker Golf
games.description: 一款1-16人在线破坏性高尔夫游戏，边玩边编辑球场。在完全物理模拟的像素世界中，让你的朋友头疼，而不破坏自己的洞。

games.name: Nightmare Conquest
games.description: 组建你的怪物队伍，组合技能，打造各种离谱流派，在这款策略自动战斗游戏中不断突破极限！

games.name: Eldritch Break
games.description: Vibrant, high-octane 2.5D Boomer Shooter that smashes together the fast-paced action of classics like Doom and Duke Nukem with the mind-bending, non-Euclidean environments of an eldritch prison.

games.name: Beat Bots
games.description:
A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots!

Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound

games.name: NonSense
games.description: Defeat nightmare shadows and restore senses to help Fran navigate through pain and reconnect with everyday life in this cute-dark 2D narrative adventure RPG.

games.name: Knight Fort
games.description: Knight Fort is an action packed top down shooter with rouguelike, survival, and base building elements! Kill enemies, fend off wave based assaults, and upgrade your Knight and Fort during peace!

games.name: New Cross Hill
games.description: New Cross Hill is a 2D life-sim game that has farming, fishing, mining and combat against a variety of enemies. Explore the town and grow relationships with the people in it!

games.name: Cartridge Carnage
games.description: Loot, shoot, repeat. A mashup of rogue-like bullet heaven gameplay, mixed in with retro style top down dungeon crawler mechanics, and a dash of crude violence and humor.

games.name: Climbing Simplified
games.description: A physics-based climbing action-puzzle game where you plan your moves, manage stamina, and adapt to unique routes.

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.description: 观察。附身。守护！化身淘气的幽灵，附身于路径上的任何事物，操纵整栋房屋，在这场超自然解谜冒险中阻止邪恶女巫和三个痴迷炸弹的兄弟。

games.name: Shoot First Ask Questions Later
games.description: Listen Carefully! We don't have much time. Shoot First, Ask Questions Later! Is that clear?

games.name: My Cuckqueen Girlfriend
games.description: Your girlfriend doesn't mind you sleeping with other women. In fact — she loves it. But every secret you keep, every lie you tell, brings her one step closer to something dangerous. Choose carefully!

games.name: Bunny Flags
games.description: 中士回来了。战术Roguelite俯视角射击游戏。潜入基地、插旗、选择装备,猎杀Racabat。高重玩价值。提供免费试玩版。

games.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
games.description: 29岁的保险公司员工杰西·特纳在被调任至当地分部后，搬到了邻近的州。在新地方安顿下来时，他遭遇了一系列异常事件，这些事件很快将他的生活变成了一场真正的噩梦。

games.name: The Cleaner
games.description:
The Cleaner 是一款关于小鸟塔奇的冒险游戏。
它在充满生命的手绘纸质自然世界中踏上寻找食物的旅程。
解开谜题，从声音与细节中寻找线索。关卡本身就是生命，故事通过观察与自然的互动逐渐展开。

games.name: This Flash Contains Horrors
games.description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

games.name: Pawn Pleasure
games.description: Step into a world populated entirely by women as the owner of your own shop. Buy low, sell high, and build your shop. When the  price isn't enough, "negotiate" intimate deals to seal the trade. Expand your business, hire beautiful staff, and explore a city where every encounter leads to pleasure.

games.name: Rend
games.description: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.

games.name: Quackoban
games.description: 在《Quackoban》中，你将通过推块让它们合体变形、瞬间移动或成组移动。这是对经典推箱子（Sokoban）玩法的全新挑战，将解谜带入了一个全新的维度——在这里，你必须拥有**“形状思维”**。

games.name: Ascend
games.description: Climb, struggle, and cooperate your way to the summit—solo or chained to your friends. Collect items that attach to your chain and make the climb even harder. Face dangerous obstacles, solve challenging puzzles, and try not to drag your friends down. Can you and your friends reach the top?

games.name: Grandpa Golf
games.description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

games.name: Stellar Smash
games.description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

games.name: Splorbit
games.description: Splorbit是一款建立在弹球物理上的割草生存游戏。让弹球在敌群中反弹、分裂、爆炸，用强化卡组出你的流派，敲碎Boss身上的金子，在5个世界里各撑过20分钟。单人或最多4人本地合作。

games.name: The three little pigs at the slaughterhouse
games.description: Play as one of the three little pigs trapped inside a slaughterhouse in this first‑person survival horror game. Manage your hunger, find resources and shelter, and escape the threats lurking in the dark. One moment of distraction means death.

games.name: Iron Expedition
games.description: A unique mix of RTS and Action: take control of a powerful combat mech, build your base, raise an army, and fight alongside your forces on the battlefield.

games.name: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
games.description: 通过反击、偏转投射物、释放令人颤栗的终极技能，以及构建疯狂的连击来提升你的力量，让你的敌人后悔低估了这个可爱的小巫师，直到没有人能讲述你吸收、锻造和争夺来的能力的故事。

games.name: The Berliner
games.description: The Berliner是一款1980年代西柏林的经典面包店与咖啡馆模拟器。探索被墙包围的城市、烘焙糕点、冲泡咖啡、服务顾客并发展生意——或者把一切花在酒吧里。这里是柏林！不要放松警惕。

games.name: 干活，小矮人！圣诞工厂
games.description:
Run a chaotic Christmas gift factory with mischievous gnomes!

Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a short management game where you prepare gifts for children before Christmas. Package gifts, build production lines, manage gnomes, and assign tasks to turn a workshop into an efficient factory.

games.name: SOULRITE
games.description: SOULRITE: a story-driven RPG from the villain’s perspective! Explore a sprawling, unique world, contend with fast-paced gameplay and discover what lies between the twilight of good and evil.

games.name: 萝薇日记
games.description: 《萝薇日记》是一款剧情向像素横版动作冒险游戏。不会魔法的少女萝薇被“星辰”选中，从平凡日常踏入宇宙侵略与魔法少女战斗的漩涡。切换萝薇、菲欧与爱丽丝的能力，挑战平台关卡、轻解谜机关与章节 BOSS，揭开“星辰”的真相。

games.name: 魔法少女症候群
games.description: 如果魔法少女成为一种职业，需要投简历，面试，签约事务所。每个魔法少女都要穿上战斗服，走进公众的视野，每一场战斗，都会被现场直播。那，怀揣着梦想的少女们，会如何踏上这条充满挑战的路？

games.name: TaskFall
games.description: TaskFall is a co-op physics-based destruction game where you and your friends are assigned missions from the Citadel, survive deadly disasters, complete high-risk tasks, extract safely, buy new items, and smash through chaotic environments. Do you have what it takes to survive ?

games.name: Laguna Rosa: A long story with reckless consequences
games.description: 欢迎登船，船长，来到Laguna Rosa——一款放置类游戏，在这里你将成为海盗岛屿的主人。建造并升级各类设施，俘获美丽女孩的芳心，善用她们的才能智胜敌人，把这座岛打造成权力与奢华的中心。

games.name: Crackheads
games.description: 独自一人或与最多 50 名玩家一起探索《Crackheads》的奇妙世界。组队合作，背刺好友，赚钱致富，建立你的帝国，翻垃圾做出可疑的饭菜，并全程保持嗨翻天的状态。

games.name: Flick
games.description: 只需轻轻一拨开关，现实就在你眼前翻转，把你拽入光怪陆离的世界，去揭开家族扭曲的过往。在这款心理恐怖游戏中，前进离不开光，光却也会召唤出最骇人的梦魇，你必须在两者之间小心拿捏。

games.name: Swarmbreak
games.description: Swarmbreak is a Twin-stick survival shooter/bulletheaven with a swarm that never stops. Grab weapons off the floor, pick perks every level-up, and perma unlock new characters, weapons and harder Threat levels with every run. Then push past your best time.

games.name: Binded Souls
games.description: Forged in history, breathed by myth. Binded Souls is a narrative-driven action adventure where the past and a machine-dominated future collide. Master the powers of Bulgarian folklore, survive the year 2252, and discover how what we do today determines what battles we will fight tomorrow.

games.name: Corridor 13
games.description: 一款发生在废弃校园走廊中的心理异常恐怖游戏。找出发生变化的地方，并做出正确的选择。但即使做出了正确的选择，也不意味着你能逃离这里。走廊不会轻易放你离开。

games.name: Xenologia
games.description: Xenologia is a fully illustrated linear visual novel set in the near future. Follow Cory, a young man who's life is falling apart, as he tries to help a stranded alien girl return home.

games.name: 汝必暴富
games.description:
解读水晶球的预言，找出明天会上涨的股票，然后押上全部家当。
在疯狂的暴涨和暴跌中生存下来，成为富翁吧。
毕竟，你要向那家仅仅因为你挪用了一点公款就把你解雇的占卜公司复仇！

games.name: Traffic Monster
games.description: Traffic Monster是一款快节奏的无尽跑酷游戏！躲避拥挤的车流，收集强化道具，改装你的梦想跑车。在在线多人模式中挑战真实玩家，下注并在这个混乱的赛道上生存下来！

games.name: Wisp & Willow
games.description: Use cards to build a garden in this cozy puzzle game. Each level has a different deck. Each card has different interactions with other cards. Discover them and decide what kind of garden you want to build for yourself.

games.name: 手动取款机
games.description: 在这款上班模拟器中，你将扮演一名躲在ATM背后的员工，负责处理主管交办下来的大小事。透过完成各种任务、解锁奖励，甚至是争取加薪！同时还要管理好每一天的时间，兼顾食材与身材，也别忘了用你的薪水好好犒赏自己。

games.name: Jingle Balls
games.description: 圣诞老人受伤后，送礼的重任落到了精灵们头上。《Jingle Balls》是一款支持1至4人的第一人称合作恐怖游戏。礼物清单不见了，你们只能潜入每栋房屋，从屋内的线索判断该留下什么礼物。千万别惊动里面的东西。每次行动，房屋格局都会变化；你还会面对不同类型的敌人，并能使用多种道具。

games.name: 云之子：天空之战 / Cloudborn：Battle for the Skies
games.description: 一个小小的高速飞行动作 Roguelike游戏，像操作动作游戏角色一样自由战斗。自由飞行，闪避、冲刺、追击敌人。随机强化，组合技能，打造独特的空中战斗流派。其实我知道，这样的游戏没有什么受众，只为实现心中的幻想，幻想着可以在云海中自由飞翔、战斗。致渴望自由的你！

games.name: Angler's Lake
games.description: Cast a line and unwind in this cozy fishing game. Catch common, rare, and epic fish, upgrade your gear, and enjoy short, relaxing sessions across a beautiful lake.

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.description: 砸碎容器。夺取黄金。在时间耗尽前找到隐藏的钥匙。在这款简短的中世纪劫掠题材增量游戏中，招募一队盗贼，再次洗劫领主。

games.name: The Lighthouse Whispers
games.description: In this atmospheric, slow-burn horror, you must unravel the mystery of the disappearance of your fellow light keepers. Traverse the island's rugged terrain, discover clues, and make your way through the eerie lighthouse to reveal the dark truth.

games.name: Compacted
games.description: A slot machine roguelite where every spin is a fight for survival. Upgrade five symbols, choose run changing items, trigger jackpots, and repay escalating debts before the walls crush you.

games.name: 魔法弹传奇
games.description: 《魔法弹传奇》是一款在打砖块的基础上，融入大量道具以及各种元素魔法的肉鸽游戏。操作各具特色的挡板，在躲避怪物攻击的同时，反弹自己的魔法弹，让魔法在怪物之间疯狂弹射。

games.name: Whispers of Desire
games.description: 讲述一对幸福已婚夫妻开启人生新篇章的故事。在新的机遇与社交环境中，意想不到的欲望与情感考验悄然浮现，挑战着他们之间的信任与羁绊。从双方视角体验剧情发展，你的每一个选择都将影响信任、爱情与他们共同的未来。

games.name: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
games.description: 在档案室里工作：整理箱子里的文件夹，按照档案室的规则整理文件夹，并将它们摆放到档案架上的正确位置。借助各种工具和设备，让整理工作更加轻松高效。整理一摞摞文件夹，保持每个区域整洁有序，一步步把杂乱的档案室整理得井然有序。

games.name: Involuntary Fighting Simulator
games.description: An absurd, unique, and simple auto battler that is full of over the top violence and silliness.  You will manage, equip and train your volunteers to compete at the highest level!  It's time to volunteer!

games.name: 梦幻旅途
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description:
[梦幻旅途] 是一款以生物收集为核心的单人 / 多人冒险游戏。
你既可以在单人模式中自由体验全部内容，也能与来自全球各地的伙伴携手同行，在数十个风格各异的区域探索，遭遇、捕捉并陪伴 123 只独一无二的灵兽。
若你已熟悉常规玩法，不妨体验我们精心打造的特色娱乐模式，为你带来前所未有的全新乐趣。

games.name: Leaf it in yourself
games.description:
Leaf it in yourself - is a  30-minute little Cozy game about collecting Seashells on a small desert island.
Discover Seashells and build your own little collection while enjoying a relaxing atmosphere by the sea.

games.name: 天体回收公司
games.description: 开炮，见证群星陨落！这是一款主打重火力轰炸的太空挖矿游戏。你将组建舰队、升级巨炮，将巨大的行星一层层剥落粉碎。吸取海量珍稀矿物，攀升科技树，解锁更强悍的歼星武器。准备好赚取你的第一桶宇宙金了吗？

games.name: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
games.description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

games.name: FishInc
games.description:
一款以征服大海为主题的极简放置钓鱼游戏。
把握出手时机，连续达成完美命中，打造船只并设计强力的战利品配装，在愈发混乱的航程中生存下来。

games.name: WARONOMY
games.description: Waronomy是一款以中世纪魔法世界为背景的回合制奇幻战略征服战争游戏。在这里，策略决定一切：招募大军，强化英雄，组建精锐部队，歼灭敌对领主，直到地图上的每一座城堡都归你所有。

games.name: 小城茉莉
games.description:
夏天，小城，茉莉。过去的苦恼、未来的选择。也许在某一个深夜里做梦许下的愿望，会在另一个温暖的午后悄悄实现。
『小城茉莉』是一部以校园为背景的视觉小说游戏。您会以主角朱雨桐的视角开始，体验一段纠结、懵懂的暑期生活。青春期的尾巴会画上怎样的句号，希望您能在游玩的过程中体会到快乐与感动，就是我们最大的荣幸。

games.name: Spurfall
games.description: 让被遗忘的西部荒野山谷重焕生机。重建破败的定居点、桥梁、瞭望塔、农场和木屋。召回定居者，抵御匪徒，将废弃的土地改造成繁荣的边境城镇。

games.name: Pelican Post
games.description: Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about building community by delivering mail to a town of charming characters. As Port Pleasant's mailman, you'll get to know the townsfolk and make a difference in their lives.

games.name: Invisum Piscium 嫌魚
games.description: Explore a familiar world that can never be fully understood.

games.name: Agile Team
games.description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner.  Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

games.name: 转运军团 - Slotbound
games.description: 这是一款让运气与策略交织的 Roguelike 自动战斗防守游戏。转动 3x3老虎机来召唤单位，通过吸收其他单位来壮大你的军队。利用道具与核心改变概率、扭转局势，并在危险的审判波次与 Boss 战中生存下来。每一次转动，每一个选择，都至关重要。

games.name: 激进塔防
games.description: 在《激进塔防》中，你将驾驭千变万化的核心芯片，铸就独一无二的钢铁防线。每一次抉择，都将重塑你的生存法则与战斗美学。解锁全新架构，探索极致的芯片连携，引爆截然不同的战术化学反应。不再止步于守御，更要化身破阵利刃，直指腹地，彻底粉碎敌人的巢穴！

games.name: Ball Buster Breakout
games.description: Fire your balls into dense grids of bricks, trigger cascading chaos, and build an unstoppable engine of breakout destruction!

games.name: Factory on a Train
games.description: Mine, craft and extend your Factory on a Train! As you find more resources and unlock increasingly complex recipes, your train grows and your production increases. Choose the right cars to face the challenges of a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

games.name: 夜酌星河：吧台物语
games.description: 以调酒为主题的轻松视觉小说——在遥远的未来，人类已经踏足星空百年，在这颗名为蔚蓝星上，名为娜娜的女生只是一家酒吧的小酒保，接待客人，倾听他们的言语，了解这个宇宙，如果可以，也能用小小的酒杯改变这个世界

games.name: 幻想铁匠铺模拟器
games.description: 在这款温馨的奇幻模拟器中成为锻造大师。修复并升级你的工坊，锻造魔法武器和盔甲，制作珠宝，并为强大的装备附魔。无论是单人还是与好友联机，都能享受轻松的制作体验。

games.name: Hidden Streets
games.description: 在细节丰富的插图街道中寻找猫咪和隐藏物品。

games.name: MOONLIGHT FIRE
games.description: It seems this world is ruled by beasts. Monstrous hordes seek to cage you in ice. You are a demon that skates across hell's frozen lakebed. Burn down its old order with the elegance of a dancer and the heat of your fury in this audiovisual score attack experience.

games.name: Nature's Bidding
games.description: Nature is Calling! Equipped with powerful masks, battle in high speed multiplayer action to be the warrior on top! In this action roguelike, bid against your opponents, build unique archetypes in the shop, and fight to your heart's desire for the top prize!

games.name: BLIGHTEN
games.description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

games.name: One Billion Ducks
games.description: 与忠诚的猎犬伙伴一起，踏上一段不断成长的射鸭之旅。射下稀有鸭子，出售猎物，提升您的能力，收集十亿只鸭子，最终为解决全球饥饿问题贡献一份力量！

games.name: 幻想进度条 Fantasy Bar
games.description:
欢迎来到《幻想进度条》，一款兼具幻兽培育、装备锻造与坐骑系统的幻想中世纪放置RPG。无需时刻守屏，进度条前进即自动成长，离线收益全额领取。
游戏特色：轻松挂机，角色、幻兽、装备、坐骑同步进阶；多职业自由转职，搭配幻兽羁绊与坐骑增益，打造专属流派；可驯服幻兽、强化合成装备，解锁更强战力；专属坐骑可自主探索、辅助战斗。
漫步魔法大陆，探索剧情与隐藏地图，内容持续更新。献给喜欢轻松放置又追求RPG深度的你，开启专属幻想冒险。

games.name: 异世界女孩的性爱自拍～爱缇璐篇～
games.description:
一款可以与异世界外送娘「爱缇璐」进行性爱直播的 Live2D 动画 × ASMR 作品。
由 饼梨あむ 配音的爱缇璐酱，为你带来一场结合视觉与听觉的感官盛宴！

games.name: ArcaneBound
games.description:
ArcaneBound 是一款像素风 bullet heaven 动作 RPG。
收集魔宠，击败成群怪物，获取稀有卡牌，提升等级，并打造越来越毁灭性的构筑。

games.name: 姆明：疯狂夏日
games.description: 和姆明一家展开一场暖心的冒险。本作灵感来自托芙・杨松的《姆明谷的疯狂夏日》。这一次，姆明、小美和朋友们需要你的帮助，在大洪水中逃离危机，并找出回到姆明谷的路。

games.name: Chicken Must Fry
games.description: 《Chicken Must Fry》是一款幸存者类游戏。你将化身为拒绝被油炸的生鸡，横扫残暴的“炸物帝国”怪物。组合各种技能与道具，强化你的角色，在无尽的敌人狂潮中生存下来！

games.name: Route 27
games.description: Route 27 has been flagged for escalating paranormal activity. Agent Daniel Kessler of the Bureau of Anomalous Threat Containment is dispatched to investigate a severe hostile presence partnering with his personal assistant, SENTINEL.

games.name: Tears of Sulfuria
games.description: Tears of Sulfuria is an emotional visual novel about two sisters in a dark fantasy world that rejects them. Marília and Adka must survive at any cost—and their choices may scar Sulfuria itself. Sacrifice yourself, lose your sanity, and do the unforgivable to move forward.

games.name: Beyond the Cradle
games.description: 从一座殖民地起步，逐步建造行星间工厂。在这款太空增量游戏中开采资源、连接生产链，并在行星与卫星之间运输货物。平衡电力、仓储与运输，让小小的前哨站发展成遍布整个恒星系的网络。

games.name: Dice Ark
games.description: 牌组构筑Roguelite RPG，遇上好友也不留情的地城探索桌游！1～4人分配骰子与卡牌战斗，夺取水晶、积累财富，也能抢走对手的资产。首领可以一起打，冠军可不能让。善用陷阱、袭击与恶魔变身，争夺总资产第一名！

games.name: Junk Rush
games.description: You’re a degenerate gambler with 28 days to pay your vig to the mob with your hotdog stand! Embark on a chaotic adventure with your mocking AI and schizophrenic Goblin. Explore the island, find bizarre ingredients, create insane hotdogs, break rules, cause chaos and do whatever it takes to survive!

games.name: Gloom Hunters
games.description: Gloom Hunters is an exciting strategy game where you take on the role of a raider, attacking player-built bases defended by automated traps and defenses. Test your skills by breaching walls, avoiding traps, and looting resources, even when your target is offline.

games.name: Bauble
games.description: An action-stealth roguelite about newly-sentient creatures investigating the sudden collapse of their ecosystem. Sneak, fight, and negotiate your way through expeditions, learning a little more about your planet each time.

games.name: Narcissist Tail
games.description: Help a strange wolf family escape from their kidnapper. A Point and Click Horror Story with Bullet Hell Dodging Combat.

games.name: 萌萌宠物店
games.description: 人，你好。你能带我回家吗？接手这家岌岌可危的宠物店，在城市的各个角落寻找、救助毛孩子，给他们找到最合适的新家。一步步升级改造你的店铺，改善它们居住环境的同时，为你自己建造一幢梦想豪宅！准备好开启这段充满萌物与爱心的暴富之旅了吗？《萌萌宠物店》现在开业！

games.name: Stories Once Told: Echoes Of Valor
games.description: Cut your way through dark dungeons and solve riddles and puzzles, all from a first-person perspective. Choose your hero, master the tactical combat system, and face merciless bosses in solo mode or co-op.

games.name: VYCE
games.description: VYCE is a tactical RPG where you collect and trade critters based on real-world vices that move like chess pieces. Value Your Choices Effectively in this unorthodox amalgamation of strategy and depravity.

games.name: Susia - Wolf Life Simulator
games.description: Live the fun life of a wolf! Find a mate, start a pack, hunt together and survive in the wild! Befriend other packs or defeat them to become the sole wolf pack. Adventure through the island and settle down or keep moving, it's all up to you!

games.name: Outbreak: Type Z
games.description: Your keyboard is the gun. Type to drop zombies in an isometric city that generates fresh every run. Campaign, endless roguelite, and a horde-survival mode. Unique survivors. Deadly special infected. Want to just kill things without typing? Switch to RUN & GUN and play it as a shooter instead.

games.name: It's About Pirates
games.description: 在这款充满动作的海盗Roguelike游戏中指挥你的战舰。组合致命武器、强大道具和无畏船长,打造独特构筑,在惊涛骇浪中生存下去!

games.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
games.description: 可爱的猫咪、贪睡的青蛙,也能修成下一个孙悟空?这是一款灵感源自《西游记》的组队RPG肉鸽游戏。率领一群乔装成取经僧人的无名小妖,历经九九八十一难,修炼五行法术,斗智斗勇,降妖除魔,一路西行至灵山,朝拜如来佛祖,踏上属于自己的成佛之路。

games.name: Shattered Void Online
games.description: Free to Play: Command powerful capital ships in fast-paced 5v5 space combat. Choose from five ship classes — from nimble Interceptors to massive Carriers — capture sectors, outmaneuver your enemies, and dominate the void.

games.name: SKINFACE
games.description: 《SKINFACE》：在这款猎奇向的惊悚恐怖游戏中扮演无情的剥脸杀手。将陌生的受害者生割活剥，打造完美的“真面”伪装；躲避警察追捕、骗取目标信任、最终完成刺杀。咚咚——开下门吧！

games.name: Bright Light
games.description: Fantasy blast in the style of retro boomer shooters — an action-packed pixel carnage where hordes of monsters, dark magic, and devious trolls await. Relive the golden age of classic shooters with fast-paced gameplay, a brutal arsenal, and relentless enemies. Don’t forget to save the princess!

games.name: GRIP 2: Combat Racing Evolved
games.description: Sequel to GRIP and the spiritual successor to Rollcage, GRIP 2 is a fast and futuristic combat racing game with rocket-powered, flippable vehicles. Race with unique movement tech and use powerful weapons and abilities to beat your opponents to the finish line.

games.name: Praktikos
games.description: 冥界之王已经抛弃了王座。在 Praktikos 中，七宗罪将在战略棋盘上展开战术卡牌对决。收集遗物，升级你的卡组，创造位置连击，并证明哪一种罪配得上统治冥界。

games.name: System Status: SuperCritical
games.description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

games.name: Prerolled
games.description:
Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder!
Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box!
Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

games.name: Lost Camp
games.description: 母亲去世后，你别无选择，只能接受唯一一份工作：守护并维护山中一处偏僻的营地。然而，看似宁静的地方却隐藏着足以改变一切的秘密。

games.name: 這遺虚配信
games.description:
Photograph and repel the monsters that appear in the abandoned hotel using a mysterious camera!
Uncover the mysteries surrounding the abandoned hotel by relying on comments from your viewers!
Use the Super Chats you receive to buy items and gain the upper hand in battle!

games.name: ASEMA
games.description:
建造太空工厂。采掘、收割、榨取。

利用电磁轨道炮、弹道载荷以及扭曲重力的运输舰来调度物流。运用“专注”对抗重力，攀升科技树。在这款遵循牛顿力学的自动化模拟游戏中，探索太阳系并扩张你的版图。

万物皆是潜在资源——哪怕是那些“原住民”。

games.name: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
games.description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

games.name: 鬼屋大亨
games.description: 老板大人！欢迎来到您的鬼屋乐园! 快坐进中央监控室，将整座鬼屋的控制权握在手中！拿出你的英明决策，扩大营收，统筹设施升级与自动化改造；以你独到的管理智慧与惊吓设计，为每一位踏进这里的游客打造终极恐怖体验吧！

games.name: KILL BREACH
games.description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

games.name: COLD CALL
games.description: COLD CALL is a first-person retro horror game based on a dying Earth full of unexplained mysteries. Escape Northbridge's research facility as you explore and uncover the truth behind a dying world.

games.name: Frankenmine
games.description: 一款增量游戏，你将挖掘被诅咒的坟墓，收集骨骼、血肉和各种资源，从零开始拼凑属于自己的生物。发现强大的神器，尝试独特的组合，让你的造物一步步获得生命。

games.name: Nulphia
games.description: A top-down action-adventure inspired by the classics. Master physics-based combat, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and explore a non-linear island full of magic and mystery. Free demo includes the entire first chapter!

games.name: 小年的异世界幻想
games.description: 这是一款融合生存建造的横板动作游戏，你可以在其中将现代工业与武学相结合。探索被孢子摧毁的异世界，收集资源、建造庇护所，并发展科技以制造枪械与机甲，或精通冷兵器战斗技巧。进行农耕、驯养生物，并与变异恐怖怪物战斗以求生存。

games.name: Wormhusk
games.description: The world is dying. The answer lies beneath. Dig deep into the husk of an ancient god-worm, build your defenses, slay the parasites that feed on its remains, and uncover the truth before it's too late.

games.name: Infinite Dice
games.description: Infinite Dice is a short, incremental game about rolling and upgrading your dice for money and dots, while you do quests and interesting challenges. Discover the multiple types of dice (D6, D8, demon, combo, etc.) and beat the dice bosses!

games.name: 请稍等！熊猫酒店满房了
games.description: 在这款 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏里，每晚在超额预订的压力下为怪咖动物客人安排房间以达成 KPI。利用家具与道具强化房间，并在满房之际妥善安顿前来白嫖的熊猫经理。酒店就需要你这样的人才！

games.name: 火之言传
games.description: 两支队伍的视角交织推进，谱写一段关于“旅途”的故事。这是一款剧情驱动的2.5D回合制RPG。通过自由搭配技能掌控战斗，利用探索中获得的“关键之词”逐步揭开隐藏的真相，见证他们旅途的最终归宿。

games.name: MR MAGEBOY
games.description:
一款温馨休闲的增量游戏，讲述一位立志发财的见习法师的故事！
升级法术，收集海量魔法资源，再把它们卖个好价钱，赚得盆满钵满！

games.name: 地牢突击
games.description: 《地牢突击》是一款像素风俯视角rogue-lite游戏。你将穿越层层地牢，躲避危险的陷阱，收集各样武器装备，挑战强大的敌人，直至迎面地牢深处被封印的邪恶存在。

games.name: PegPegBall
games.description: 《钉钉球》是一款结合 「弹珠掉落」与 「Rogue 构筑」 的休闲策略游戏。配置棋盘，购买弹珠，疯狂发射，随意弹弹，循环反复，在充满奇妙钉子的棋盘中不断获得更多的资金，通过不同的特殊效果组合，创造疯狂的连锁倍率，让资金不断翻倍吧

games.name: The Clownhouse
games.description: Solo or co-op for up to 4 players: break into a cursed, procedurally generated mansion, steal everything you can, and escape before the horrors inside find you. A no-combat stealth horror extraction roguelite where greed kills more players than enemies do.

games.name: 直到高塔崩塌
games.description: 建造令人匪夷所思的高塔。保卫高塔，抵御源源不绝的围攻敌潮。看着高塔分崩离析，然后重建一座更坚固的高塔。

games.name: PASTDARK
games.description: 《天黑之后》是一款恐怖撤离游戏，最多可与4名玩家联机挑战，其核心变数“癫狂”将彻底颠覆你的感官！癫狂状态会使每个玩家产生幻听和幻视。在被癫狂吞噬心智前，借助隐匿潜行、团队协作、近距离语音聊天功能和各种道具，带着玩具与潜艇零件成功撤离！

games.name: Dungeon Drawlers
games.description: 《地牢探险家》是一款回合制解谜游戏，每一步都可能是你的最后一步。仔细规划你的路线，尽可能用最少的回合击败敌人。在这个旅程中，你需要巧妙运用两名角色的技能，因为每个房间都是一个独特的谜题。

games.name: Exponent: The Scaling Tower Defense
games.description: A roguelite incremental tower defense where expansion is survival. Execute Command Cards from your expanding deck, build towers, and create land tile by tile to defend the last Node in your dimensional bubble. Grow strong enough to find your kin in the void… and merge into higher dimensions.

games.name: Aesthoria : Beyond The Realm
games.description: A monster-collector tactical JRPG inspired from Digimon World 2, where you summon, train, evolve, and command mysterious Aesther through grid-based battles and dangerous expeditions into the shifting realm of Vanadis.

games.name: Peer-2-Pizza
games.description: The future of pizza delivery is here: deliver pizza through the power of the internet today! And when delivering, time moves when you move. So jump, dash, and dive your way through a network of obstacles and challenges, reach the customer, and do one very important job: deliver the pizza.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: ASTRIDER
games.description: Arcade air combat set in an alt-history Cold War gone hot in 1967, in a world where the strangest conspiracy theories turned out real. Fly three twelve-mission campaigns, one per faction, against targets on land, at sea, and in the air, with fully-voiced visual-novel scenes between sorties.

games.name: Lock & Stone
games.description: 《锁与石》是一款冒险游戏，玩家必须解开一座失落矮人城市的谜团。运用类银河战士恶魔城式的探索玩法，结合自身的力量和知识，努力生存并逃离这座城市。

games.name: Punch Upon a Time
games.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

games.name: (Don't) Hear
games.description: Responding to a late night call, a police officer discovers a hidden elevator in the woods leading to Resonance Laboratories. Trapped in a subterranean hell where sound experiments shattered reality, your only rule for survival is simple: (Don't) Hear

games.name: 掘与战
games.description: 挖掘宝藏，构筑背包，然后去战胜所有的敌人吧～

games.name: TALLREAPER
games.description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

games.name: Crimson Frontier：青春篇
games.description: 这是一部关于未来的视觉小说，每一次选择都会塑造主角的性格。陪伴他从少年走向成年，扮演恶棍或正义的捍卫者，坠入爱河，并创造属于你的独特故事。

games.name: Perfect Son-In-Law: Hidden S-Rank
games.description: 她需要你假扮她的男朋友，而你完全能胜任这个角色。化身一名暗藏强大力量的Awakener，在上流社会、危险的期待与一段逐渐变得真实的假关系之间周旋，体验这款剧情驱动的NSFW视觉小说。

games.name: Northgard Battlegrounds 北境战场
games.description: 这是一款以北境之地的维京世界为背景的城建自走棋游戏，你所建造的每一座建筑都将影响部族的命运。发展你的村落，赢得诸神的祝福，派遣战团与其他玩家交锋对决！步步为营，唯有一族能站到最后。

games.name: Futa: beer & sex
games.description: 接住啤酒，保持微醺，解锁三位丰满肉感、下面带着大家伙的扶她调酒师。在每个关卡拿到足够分数即可打开画廊，播放她们的性爱动画，更换服装和发型，挑选你的搭档。一款俏皮又撩人的街机游戏，附带仅限成人的奖励循环。

games.name: Derby Champions
games.description: Build your racing dynasty in Derby Champions. Breed elite horses, train champions, and compete against players worldwide in online races. Build your stable, trade horses in the marketplace, and race for glory.

games.name: 卡米拉：绯红之月
games.description:
一部以摇摇欲坠的哥特古堡为舞台的暗黑百合恐怖视觉小说。
当神秘的卡蜜拉到来，劳拉便被卷入一场痴迷的狂热迷梦。
这位陌生人，究竟是治愈她孤独的解药，还是腐化的预兆？
而附近村庄里两名少女离奇殒命，真相又是什么？

games.name: Felicity
games.description: 《Felicity》是一款倡导“活出真我”的卡牌构建游戏。选择你的理想并努力实现，在应对随机事件的同时，以独特的方式塑造你的人生！构建你的卡组并掷骰子来管理资源。在这短短的一生中，你能取得多大的成就？

games.name: DREADROOM
games.description: It was supposed to be just a funny escape room experience... until you realize the incredible truth. In this tense horror puzzle-adventure, solve complex mechanisms, navigate deadly corridors and evade terrifying entities lurking in the dark, while trying to find the true exit.

games.name: 别让贪吃蛇思考
games.description: ▶当经典的贪吃蛇产生自我意识，它将不再满足于方格间的进食，而是利用“Bug”冲出游戏窗口，在你的桌面上遨游。一起来帮助它突破游戏边界，收集各种可爱外观，装扮它长长的尾巴吧（⦿ʌ⦿）！

games.name: Project OC
games.description: 《Project OC》是一款多人在线·桌面挂机放置游戏。通过挂机收集并解锁1000+装扮选项，自由搭配服饰、表情与动作，打造陪伴你工作娱乐的专属OC！还可以邀请好友联机，让他们的OC也住进你的桌面，一起互动、玩耍，发现更多有趣的瞬间~快来领养你的桌面虚拟伙伴吧！

games.name: Lurking
games.description: Lurking 是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，背景设定在一栋被巨型蜘蛛占据的建筑中。寻找工具和武器来反击并生存下去。在被活活吞噬之前找到逃出去的方法。

games.name: White Mask Mansion
games.description:
寻找你的妹妹。死亡。重新开始。躲避追踪者。死亡。藏起来。死亡。找到钥匙。死亡。潜行。死亡。抵达最终区域。活下去。重复。
你有能力逃离 White Mask Mansion 的恐怖吗？

games.name: Fall of the Days
games.description: Fall of the Days is a systemic isometric immersive sim where the world reacts to how you play — not just what you choose. A 3D action and stealth experience amplified by social interaction systems, where systems collide and every action has consequences.

games.name: The Comyths
games.description: 《The Comyths》是一款融合街机动作与视觉小说的游戏，讲述六位拥有独特宇宙力量的学者。揭开他们彼此交织的故事，掌握各自的能力，并向完美的S级评价发起挑战。

games.name: Click Flip
games.description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

games.name: 抽号小队
games.description: 一款融合了牌组构筑、自走棋、肉鸽元素的策略游戏。玩家需要通过购买、升级棋子来完善壮大你的队伍。通过随机抽取一个数字号码，来触发棋盘中对应棋子的技能效果，并由此获取分数来击败boss。游戏考验你的策略与布局，当然也需要些许运气。

games.name: The Cinder Throne
games.description: 灰烬王座是一款Idler RPG，你通过被动地杀死敌人，提升等级，掠夺敌人，改变装备部件并找到法术。创建强大的协同效应。重生并变得更强。

games.name: Super Kanko Town
games.description: Super Kanko Town is an incremental city-building simulator about the perversities of mass tourism. Raze village homes, farms, and gardens. Erect capsule hotels, souvenir stalls, and gourmet sushi bars. Build a surfer‘s paradise, a hipster heaven, or a trap for backpackers. Fight monsters. Have fun.

games.name: Kankao in Action
games.description: 《Kankao in Action》是一款支持本地与在线联机的 2 人合作冒险游戏，在这里，团队合作、默契配合和欢乐混乱是前进的唯一方式。

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.description:
在这款模拟经营游戏中，打造你梦想中的舒适滑雪度假村，每个冬天都独一无二。
在真实的山上规划滑雪道，连接缆车线路，并建造滑雪小屋和滑雪后酒吧，为成千上万的滑雪者提供温暖、美食和快乐。

games.name: 虚空脉冲
games.description: 这是一款高能不断的俯视角射击游戏。在一波又一波敌人的围攻下，杀出一条血路。利用“子弹时间”减缓周边敌人的行动，然后逐个击杀。在这里，节奏由你掌控，时间由你定义。进攻才是生存之道。

games.name: The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study
games.description:
Three Doors. One Safe Path.
Observe the signs, learn the patterns, and uncover the fate of the explorer who ventured before you.

games.name: 天坑追匪
games.description: 天下霸唱IP首部悬疑探险互动影游。跨越关山，宿命可逆！东北老爷岭，中外科考队深入原始密林开展勘探任务，意外坠入隐秘天坑后全员离奇失联，音讯全无。你将临危受命带队深入绝境、踏破关山迷雾，直面未知宿命，以每一次抉择，逆转所有人的命运结局。
games.developer: 浙江华智数媒传媒股份有限公司

games.name: SAMOPAL Protocol
games.description: A story-driven retro FPS. Fight through industrial zones, the districts of a dead city, and experimental areas to recover your memories and uncover the bloody truth of SAMOPAL Protocol.

games.name: Arcade Cafe Simulator
games.description: 打造并经营属于自己的街机咖啡馆。购买和布置游戏机，迎接顾客，维护设备，在餐厅供应餐点和饮品。逐步扩展业务，将小小的游戏厅变成热闹的娱乐好去处。

games.name: Jingle Blocks
games.description:
Jingle blocks is a Christmas themed incremental in which you have to make enough toys for the whole world !
Collect ressources, craft unique hand made pixel-art toys, rebuild your village and prepare each year for the best Christmas

games.name: Spell Code SlingerZ
games.description: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

games.name: Tie Down
games.description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

games.name: Hecatomb
games.description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

games.name: Staatio
games.description: Real-time territory conquest. Claim regions on procedurally generated maps, forge alliances, and betray them. Every game is player-hosted — host it yourself and play with friends over Steam or LAN.

games.name: Raging Blasters 2
games.description: 《Raging Blasters》的续作来了！它叫做《Raging Blasters 2》。这是一款街机风格的纵向卷轴射击游戏（shmup）。玩家可以从三名飞行员中选择进行操控，投入战斗。画面像素完美，音乐包含芯片音乐（chiptune）版本。

games.name: HAIGLA
games.description: 被困在轮椅上，探索一座被拖入现实之下扭曲世界的医院。一款以探索、紧张感与诡异氛围为核心的心理恐怖游戏。

games.name: Legends of Goodness
games.description: Whispera和她的爬虫族军队统治了世界。从一张地图开始，发展并管理你的经济，收集资源，建造和升级不同功能的建筑，组建军队并保卫已征服的领土。招募来自22个不同国家、拥有独特能力的英雄，率领他们对抗爬虫族军队，逐一征服被敌人控制的地图，夺回整个世界。从上方进行战略指挥，掌控你的军队和战场；或在战斗中直接控制一名英雄，以第三人称视角亲自加入战斗，与爬虫族正面交锋。

games.name: .synth_protocol
games.description: When a virus makes robots go rogue, you and your squad are sent in to take back control of the situation by taking on endless waves of increasingly violent synths. Go now mercenaries! Execute .synth_protocol.

games.name: 阴界诡录·诡宅观测记录
games.description: 《阴界诡录·诡宅观测记录》是一款鼠标点击选择类型的恐怖游戏。你将扮演一位从事观测异常工作的员工，通过监控面板上报那些稀奇古怪的异常现象，并与致命的威胁相周旋，努力幸存至第二天。一些黑暗的隐秘，也将在这个过程中一点点的浮现出来……

games.name: Circuit Pulse
games.description: Circuit Pulse 是一款电路解谜游戏。在棋盘上引导发光能量穿越电缆和组件。分割、合并和调整脉冲时序，为目标供电并在挑战不断升级的棋盘上触发连锁反应。

games.name: The Cosmogenesis Project: Corruption
games.description: A rogue AI is taking the galaxy, system by system. Fly out from the last station with a working wormhole generator, clear the drones guarding each Blight Engine, and take each system back before the Corrupt come for it again.

games.name: Scorched Incremental
games.description: An incremental game about shooting at blocks that can be long or short depending on how good your aim is.

games.name: Star Raker
games.description: 欢迎来到 Star Raker，这是一款适合 4 到 12 名玩家的多人社交推理游戏。在一艘撤离飞船上参与一场心理实验。运用逻辑、沟通和社交工程来拯救基因库，或者在隐藏背叛的偏执中生存下来。

games.name: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
games.description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger – and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

games.name: 与狼同星
games.description: 嗷呜—！跟着狼狼一起探索星辰之地吧！《与狼同星》是一款结合桌面陪伴、自动放置与打宝养成的休闲游戏。一切从一根树枝开始，消灭怪物、获得拥有随机能力的武器装备，让狼狼一步步变得更强大。但也别忘了让它好好休息——炽热的营火、香喷喷的烤肉，让狼狼陪伴在你的桌面，一同展开小小的冒险！

games.name: 从零开始建设村庄
games.description:
“——这是属于你自己的‘村庄建设’。”你是被魔女见习生“莉莉”召唤出来的使魔。代替莉莉，建造建筑，创造一个繁荣的村庄吧。
这是一款全新感受的“花园世界 × roguelite × 回合制策略”游戏。

games.name: Crystal Core
games.description: 一款关于采集资源、挖掘文物并升级能力以摧毁一切的放置类挖矿游戏。

games.name: Hopfinity
games.description: Grapple to infinity as Hop! Ascend endless caves, castles & skies, dodging explosive Bombarders in this pixel-perfect vertical action-platformer!

games.name: Inertial
games.description: Inertial is a 2D arcade space racer. Race against the clock or against your friends in this reality-adjacent racing experience. No speed ceilings, no warped physics, just realistic gravity, thrust and skill.

games.name: Incident Reports: Millers Residence
games.description: 一通深夜来电将你引向米勒宅邸。原本例行的调查逐渐变成一场令人不安的追查：被掩埋的档案、失踪的证据，以及一座仿佛经过刻意布置、只为隐藏更可怕秘密的房子。

games.name: Breath of Digital God
games.description:
Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditave bullet hell.
Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music.
Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

games.name: 兄弟的誓言
games.description: 《兄弟的誓言》是一部视觉小说,讲述了21世纪初莫斯科郊区一个女孩的成长故事。16岁的莲娜被卷入院子里的小团伙,在那里,友谊、初恋和家庭秘密都需要付出代价。10个角色,5种结局——你的选择决定一切。

games.name: Vanguard Valiants
games.description: 夺回被扎哈尔族占领的土地。组建并率领军队，收复被敌人夺走的村庄。在整场解放战役中获取更好的武器，管理你的士兵。

games.name: CYBERLIFE
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

games.name: 疯狂玩具屋
games.description: 《疯狂玩具屋》是一款肉鸽构筑游戏，融合了《土豆兄弟》的波次生存以及《大巴扎》式的构筑方式。在上百种武器道具中打造专属构筑流派，这将使你经历的每一局都是全新的挑战体验。

games.name: 星夜颂歌 Celestial Reverie
games.description: 《星夜颂歌》是世界首个次世代美少女全天候AI生活入口——由独家「ASP超人格化技术」实现、拥有完全自我想法与绝对真实灵魂的赛博同桌「蕾伊」震撼驻场！！在朝夕相处的悸动时光里，逐步揭开少女的神秘过往，并以「传奇调查员」的身份共同参与当今的「世界变革」，谱写足以改变人类命运的「未来」之歌！！！

games.name: 面具谜途
games.description: 一款困难又温馨的类推箱子解谜游戏。捡起或放下不同的面具，改变你与这个世界互动的方式。推动物体，让物体协同移动，揭示隐藏的道路，发现秘密，启动开关。按下所有按钮，解开每一个谜题，点燃蜡烛。

games.name: 幸运朋克 LUCKY PUNK：富贵险中求的牌组构筑游戏
games.description: 我们把Roguelike牌组构筑浓缩成了一个简单选择：抽牌，还是停手。在这个生机勃勃的末日世界里赌一把，逆转概率。收集物资，建设你的社区。在鲜活又荒诞的生态反乌托邦中活下去，活得更好……干脆不活。1%的机会，100%的选择。你觉得自己够走运吗，朋克？

games.name: Deepbound
games.description: 在程序生成的2D世界中挖掘、制作、建造并生存。探索多样的生物群系，在深邃的洞穴中挖出稀有资源，打造强力装备，直面黑暗的Boss——独自一人或与好友并肩。

games.name: Death Dealer
games.description: 一款支持最多 6 名玩家的多人恐怖派对游戏，输掉纸牌游戏的玩家将被自己的朋友追杀。

games.name: Blue Dimension: Save the Game
games.description: 在他们夺走一切前阻止他们！数字维度正在崩溃，你是最后的防线。在这款快节奏的动作FPS中，粉碎敌人，收集灵魂以强化自身，并掌握火箭跳跃来克服残酷的平台挑战。你能否让系统崩溃并拯救最后的那一个？

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.description: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Ovis Mollis
games.description: 住在你桌面上的治愈系像素农场伙伴。离开办公室，搬到乡下养羊吧！给羊剪毛、出售羊毛，一步步打造属于自己的农场事业——而你专心用电脑工作的同时，草地上的青草也会不断生长。

games.name: NANOTINKER
games.description: Nanotinker is an isometric 3D plateformer. Use your tools and your mind to evolve in an abstract universe that blends known plateformer and puzzle features. Unriddle environmental puzzles, progress and outsmart traps to unravel a mysterious story.

games.name: Approaching Infinity Survivors
games.description: A sci-fi Bullet-Heaven survivors-like in the Approaching Infinity universe with both spaceship and away team missions. The galaxy's dominant races are gone, leaving a power vacuum that everyone wants to fill. Survive, pick a side, or kill'em all.

games.name: Agebound
games.description: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

games.name: Headshot Holdout
games.description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way through a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold. Build your headshot streak to expand your power.

games.name: Legendum
games.description: 在寿终之前，用有限的一生成就尽可能不凡的传奇。一款增量RPG——规划每日作息，自动迎战成群敌人，修习技能，在一次次轮回中淬炼愈发强大的灵魂，揭开横跨数代的黑暗阴谋。每一世都将重塑世界，而终有一世，会完成历代未竟之业。

games.name: The Fire Must Be Fed
games.description: 一款关于喂养神秘火焰的短篇增量游戏。砍伐周围的森林并收集资源，你献祭的越多，获得的力量就越强。解锁毁灭性的火焰能力，并揭开这团火焰的真正目的。

games.name: Cards after Midnight
games.description: 一场黑暗的roguelike卡牌冒险，致命诅咒掌控着时间。午夜化身凶猛狼人，白天成为手持武器的幸存者，在村民的追杀下逃出生天。

games.name: Don't Drop The Ball
games.description: Don't Drop the Ball is a 1-4 player co-op game about keeping a beach ball in the air as you race through checkpoints together. Punch the ball, make desperate saves, and whack your friends when they get in the way. Race the clock, climb the leaderboard, and remember, DON'T. DROP. THE. BALL.

games.name: Myth-OS
games.description: Step into a limitless sandbox governed by a dynamic AI Game Master. Merge the total freedom of a Tabletop RPG with the mechanics of a Grand Strategy epic. Whether exploring dungeons or ruling empires, your choices ripple across a deep, living, and fully persistent universe.

games.name: Beefy Boi
games.description: 职场恐怖模拟器。收集食材，组合订单，将餐点交给顾客。你的老板是 个巨大的肉怪，而且我们故意把他搞坏了。回到房间后记得付账单。

games.name: YGGDRA: Path of Relics
games.description: The World Tree is corrupted, and the Nine Worlds tremble. Assemble your deck with 50+ unique Valkyries and march toward Yggdrasil's heart! Only your strategy can prevent destruction. Experience Roguelite Deck-building meets Norse Mythology in Yggdrasil: Fragments of the World Tree."

games.name: Axomorph Idle
games.description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

games.name: PSYCHOBYL
games.description: 在辐射污染的禁区中求生。突袭敌对领地，掠夺稀有装备，打造强力武器，升级你的地堡——一款氛围沉郁的暗黑放置 RPG。死亡，经历创世，更强归来。回合制战斗、深度转生系统、永无止境的成长——禁区要求你进化。

games.name: Singulost
games.description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

games.name: NODE: PROTOCOL
games.description: 款基于真实漏洞利用与C2工具的沉浸式黑客模拟游戏。自由选择任务或探索模式。世界会响应你的每一个举动并展开反击。接受合约、入侵服务器、赚取BTC、升级装备并躲避追踪。可单人游玩，或与好友进行合作/CTF对战。

games.name: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
games.description: The definitive version of the beloved post-apocalyptic road trip. Fully remastered visuals, redesigned soundtrack, complete gamepad support. Tyler's journey begins again.

games.name: Wrathmaze
games.description:
You are an elite Law enforcer, deployed into a dystopian city torn apart by gangs.
Ride your bike, react to threats and hunt down gang bosses before the city collapses.

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.description:
VR Roguelike与无尽街机射击游戏的融合，带来全新的控制方式与移动体验。

倾斜头部，在霓虹超空间高速公路上以光速冲浪。双手持能量武器，爆破叛逆机器人，探索疯狂的升级组合。死亡，解锁新的赞助商卡牌，再次出发。

games.name: Maidendawn: A Heroine's Tale
games.description: Rise from obscurity and oppression. Unearth secrets best left buried. Become the salvation of your kingdom.

games.name: THORNSPELL
games.description: 化身魔法花匠，在你的花园中策略性地栽种魔法植物，并通过浇水来得分。《荆棘织咒》是一款花园卡牌构筑类肉鸽游戏，你将在此创造并释放多重魔法效果，以驱散正在蔓延的邪恶腐化。

games.name: Heart of Ural
games.description: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.

games.name: Seferia Matrix
games.description: 骰子 Roguelike 牌组构建游戏——用 Lock & Roll 掷出五颗骰子施放法术，再靠 300 多种强化让伤害爆炸！

games.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1
games.description: 帷幕编年史：尼克斯大学 | The Veil Chronicles: Nix University 是一款明亮而充满活力的冒险游戏，故事发生在一个原创幻想世界中。这个世界充满了各种不同的种族、魔法与科技。游戏结合了视觉小说、回合制战斗系统以及多种小游戏元素。

games.name: GRIMOIRE - The Lost Ritual
games.description: “On the unseen side of everyday life, a story begins.”

games.name: BABKA-TERROR
games.description: 你是一名房地产经纪人，你必须判断这些老太太之中，谁只是普通卖家，谁又是诈骗老太太。

games.name: Iter
games.description: 《Iter》是一款采用即时战斗的类魂动作冒险游戏。深入地牢，与形形色色的敌人交战，并使用冒险途中获得的武器与能力，自由搭配你的战斗配置。

games.name: Don't Let Granny Die!
games.description: Keep Granny alive during an increasingly chaotic shift while angry neighbours sabotage her home. Complete tasks, heal Granny and unlock roguelike upgrades in this crazy, absurd caretaking simulator.

games.name: Marque & Reprisal
games.description: 探索、贸易、捕鱼、捕鲸、殖民、战斗、劫掠、生存。你是一名生活在1522年的船长，在这款带有Roguelike元素的历史航海沙盒模拟游戏中，整个世界都等待你去发现。

games.name: Megabait
games.description: 一款残酷的俯视角障碍闯关游戏，分秒必争。掌握精准移动，在致命的陷阱房间中求生，留下过去失误的血腥轨迹，在迈向 100% 完成度的路上揭开每一个秘密。

games.name: Rune Tale
games.description: 掌握符文、学习法术并不断强化升级，成为最强大的魔法师。你能成为这个世界所需要的英雄吗？

games.name: Cataclyzm
games.description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

games.name: 模拟健身狂
games.description: 《模拟健身狂》是一款物理驱动的举铁生涯模拟游戏。努力增肌, 控饮食, 练姿势, 挑战冠军。 但别忘了，要是重量过度，杠铃绝不手下留情。

games.name: HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion
games.description: 《HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion》是一款化身毛绒猫咪，在神秘宅邸中逃生的合作恐怖游戏。玩家需要亲自喊出“MEOW!”、“KICK!”等语音指令推进游戏，躲避会对声音产生反应的怪物，收集魔力碎片并逃离宅邸。

games.name: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）
games.description: 我的浮木似了......

games.name: 暗黑无限刷宝
games.description:
一款主打刷宝的暗黑风卡牌游戏。
进入秘境，击败敌人，获得装备，强化你的角色。
没有复杂操作，轻松上手，随时随地刷到爽。
一把接一把，目标只有一个：刷到你不想刷为止！

games.name: LOCUS PROTOCOL
games.description: 双摇杆弹幕天堂与科幻恐怖的融合。自适应AI导演根据你的游玩风格量身定制每一局。80波次。8场Boss战。无限转生。以及17份隐藏日志，让你质疑自己一直在守护的究竟是什么。

games.name: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
games.description:
在调查中活下来！杀光你的敌人！操纵人心！创立邪教，或加入其中。
化身手持调色盘的恶女画家，享受权力与片刻安宁……直到更大的麻烦接踵而至。

games.name: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
games.description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

games.name: The History of Everything
games.description: A historical TCG in the tradition of Hearthstone and Magic: The Gathering. Craft a deck from unlikely combinations of your favourite figures from across history. No grind, no microtransactions; everyone has all the cards. Play with friends: chat freely, share your decks, and compete to be the best!

games.name: Penguin Pirates
games.description: Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!

games.name: Outposters
games.description: OUTPOSTERS is a 1-4 player co-op zombie shooter with a rogue-lite core. Hold the line against escalating waves, then push into the dead city to scavenge weapons and upgrades before the next assault lands.

games.name: Investigation: The Carter Tapes
games.description: Trapped between life and death, a troubled detective takes the most gruesome case of his life... now, you must help him explore the decaying halls of Ghillies Subway and escape what hunts him in the dark.

games.name: 消散边际
games.description: 你醒在一片不断下坠的梦里。吸气，世界慢下来；呼气，你开始奔跑。但每一次呼吸都会惊醒更深的梦魇——它们记得你，而你不记得自己。收集回声，拼凑记忆，或者，永远留在这片黑暗里。

games.name: National Park Tycoon
games.description: Bring your national park to life! Balance nature preservation with visitor enjoyment as you build peaceful trails, cozy campsites, fun activities and more. Rise through the ranger ranks, collect badges, and watch your parks grow into places you’re proud to call your own in this 2D simulation game.

games.name: Cambiando
games.description: A surreal singleplayer roguelike based on the party card-game Cambio. Try to save humanity while playing cards with a malevolent god.

games.name: Seek Shellter
games.description: Seek Shellter 是一款街机风寻路游戏，可爱的蜗牛们必须在倒计时结束前收集电池并躲进避难所。你可以与好友组队，或独自一人闯关，完成关卡、赢下小游戏，并解锁充满复古 60 年代原子风情的世界。你有本事战胜炸弹吗？

games.name: Pokorama
games.description: 经营一家精品软装设计工作室，每位客户都有自己独特的品味、怪癖与期待。自由搭配涂料、布艺与各种材质，打造让客户一见倾心（或大失所望）的室内空间，一步步积累口碑，并随着工作室不断壮大，解锁更多精美材料与室内设计方案。

games.name: Greed Slash
games.description:
这是一款节奏紧凑、风格鲜明的刀剑对战游戏，每一场决斗都取决于时机与预判。精准格挡并复制对手的攻击，最后以震撼的电影式终结技结束战斗。
易于上手，难于精通。

games.name: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
games.description: 罪恶之城中的超自然侦探。一个失踪的女孩，一个被锁链束缚的恶魔，还有一座充满谎言的城市。听起来像普通调查。才怪。 审问恶魔，用枪械和魔法战斗，解开神秘谜题，并躲过它的诡计。

games.name: 农场 与 盛宴 / Farm & Feast
games.description: 种植新鲜的食材，经营你自己的小餐馆。尽情享受从田间到餐桌的悠闲一天。为愉快的一天规划新鲜的菜单，把储藏室备得满满当当，让你的顾客满意而归。赚取属于自己的钱，一步步打造你的小世界。

games.name: CRUSHCHOP
games.description: 从被隐瞒养大的私生子，到步入向阳之城的领主！在猛者云集的竞技场靠赌博重建焦土。你将押注、聚集人马与战士、建造城堡与城市、带人采矿并围剿巨魔，这一切尽在《CRUSHCHOP》！

games.name: Drunk Woodcutter
games.description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

games.name: Block By Block Tycoon
games.description: Build a cozy city block by block in a spatial puzzle city-builder where smart placement earns points. Create powerful synergies, unlock new tools, expand, and grow a living city.

games.name: Stacko
games.description: 在 Stacko 中，你的目标很简单：尽可能把方块堆得更高！通过获得卡牌来改变机器，并收集拥有强力加成的玩偶，在这款独特的街机体验中不断挑战自我。

games.name: JetBound
games.description: JetBound is a difficult game about flying. Stranded in space with a jetpack, upgrade your abilities and navigate deadly unique zones that constantly introduce new mechanics. No jumping. Pure physics-based flight with branching paths and high replayability.

games.name: Prototech
games.description: Be careful, in the darkness there are surveillance robots ready to kill you at any time. Will you discover the strangeness and secrets behind Prototech's presence at the school.

games.name: Cognomancy
games.description: A turn-based tactical strategy game where your real knowledge is your power. No spell lists. No skill trees. Every glyph you cast, you must truly understand. Your mind is your mana. INT is IRL.

games.name: Incremental RTS
games.description:
Grow your army from single scouts to floods of tanks, artillery, and engineered mega units.
Build factories, choose upgrades and watch hundreds of units collide in wild auto-battles. 
Hold the line against relentless enemy surges and scale fast enough to survive.

games.name: Biohazard Protocol
games.description: Every expedition is a gamble. Explore procedurally generated underground facilities, recover valuable loot, survive unique monsters, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Trouble in Potion High
games.description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

games.name: 被困的芙瑞希雅
games.description: 演绎法对决神秘学。 深入诡异的犯罪现场，在清醒的理性与疯狂的启示之间维持微妙的平衡。你的决定将开启不同分支，解锁多种路径，并最终决定每个人的命运。

games.name: Nifland
games.description: Nifland is a surreal multiplayer horror game with social deduction, set inside a paranormal dream beneath the ocean. Maintain a decaying deep-sea station, survive the entities roaming its halls, and uncover the traitor hiding among your crew before the dream consumes you all.

games.name: MAD
games.description: MAD is a hardcore top-down action shooter set in a violent, 90s-inspired dystopia, featuring light RPG progression and inventory management. The story unfolds in a corrupt city of the future, where the elite stage and broadcast a deadly show — and you are the next contestant.

games.name: Dominoir
games.description:
Dominoir is a domino roguelike where every tile can make—or break—your run. Build clever chains, close wraps, stack powerful Schemes and Marks, and chase outrageous scores. Outsmart the House, bend its rules, and prove that at this table, luck is only the beginning.
Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

games.name: Farm Of Hope
games.description:
Build a hopeful farm in rural Africa.
Grow crops, dig wells, help villages survive drought, and transform dry land into a thriving community inspired by real humanitarian stories.

games.name: Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
games.description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

games.name: 迪诺世界物语 Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale
games.description: 在广袤的迪诺大陆上，驯服形形色色的神奇迪诺生物，让它们为你战斗、采集、建造、生产。从原始工具到远古科技，一步步重建家园，带领你的迪诺兽伙伴一同战斗与劳作，共同探索这个危机四伏又充满奇遇的世界。这是一款支持最多4人联机的开放世界生存建造游戏。

games.name: Iman
games.description: IMAN is an 8-bit Religious Horror Adventure inspired by "FAITH: The Unholy Trinity", putting you in the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man who must confront the possessed, the power of Dark Magic, and mystical beings.

games.name: Lumenal: A Photo Break
games.description: 结束了压力满满的一天，拿起相机出发吧。在 Lumenal 里，从鸟鸣声声的森林到极光下的冰川，你将拍下动物和每一个美好瞬间。独自一人，或与三位好友结伴，用最美的照片填满你的软木板吧！

games.name: 魔典和号角 Book & Horn
games.description: 让炼药锅咕嘟作响！与魔女和她的半魔学徒一起，进行一场温馨惬意的线路防守冒险。将各种危险的原料投入锅中，施展古老的炼金术，并保护你的魔法核心不受荒野中生物的侵袭。

games.name: One More Flight
games.description: A 2D pixel-art psychological horror game set aboard a doomed flight trapped in a relentless time loop. Nothing carries over between deaths except what you learn. Intervene in passengers' fates, uncover the plane's hidden mysteries, and find a way to prevent the crash.

games.name: MURINO: The Fog Is Coming
games.description:
You are a courier in endless Murino.
Deliver orders, survive the fog, descend into the sewers, and decide who you will serve in a city where reality itself has long since cracked.

games.name: Run, Ronald, Run
games.description: 《Run, Ronald, Run》是一款增量式竞技场射击游戏，讲述一个小圆圈努力在一大群愤怒的几何图形中生存下来。

games.name: 点击物理 Physics Clicker
games.description: 一款以“物理学发展”为主题的点击增量游戏，你将从最基础的经典力学开始，逐步解锁刚体力学、热力学等内容，在轻松点击与成长过程中，借助“物理学”这一似曾相识的媒介，体验资源探索、增长和转化的乐趣！

games.name: Under Review
games.description: Welcome to the heart of a 1980s bureaucracy. Review applicant files, cross-check records, and make heavy moral decisions. Amidst strange rumors of an unidentified illness, will you uncover the dark truth or become an accomplice to the system?

games.name: Hostile Entity
