games.description: A reality breach has unleashed something terrible. Fight through 30+ levels, deadly enemies, and brutal boss fights in this 2D top-down horror action game to stop the entity behind the anomaly.

games.name: Reroll or Die
games.description: Reroll or Die is a roguelike deckbuilder where everything is decided by dice rolls. Yes, even the start button. But fortunately you can turn the odds in your favor: reroll, upgrade, invert, split, combine, increase or decrease your rolls, then slot them into your weapon and armor cards.

games.name: 我的梦想家
games.description: 在《我的梦想家》里打造你的梦中情屋吧！这里没有任务与倒计时，只有纯粹的治愈和放松。超过1000种精美部件任你挑选，从零开始布置专属于你的小屋与庭院。放慢脚步，伴随着慵懒的Lo-fi音乐，沉浸在柔软的光影中，感受昼夜交替与晴雨变化。快来建造你的梦想小窝，享受一段宁静的悠闲时光吧！

games.name: Orcthal
games.description: 你就是入侵者。化身兽人战士，在这款 3D survivors-like 中杀穿成群军队。技能会自动释放：升级、选择强力天赋、搜刮倒下的敌人、劫掠他们的聚落，然后一次次归来，变得更加强大！

games.name: FISH OS
games.description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

games.name: Off The Top Rope!
games.description:
Prepare yourself for the next generation of professional wrestling video gaming!  It's time to go Off The Top Rope... IN VR!

Featuring a dual-camera system and a truly responsive crowd, Off The Top Rope! uses VR motion controls and gesture recognition to put you in the ring like never before!

games.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE
games.description:
被贴上“问题学生”的标签，你转学到了最糟糕的高中。
在那里，你被卷入充满欲望、嫉妒与错综复杂的危险关系之中。
靠近、被利用，还是受伤——
你的选择将决定你与她们的结局。

games.name: ANTA3
games.description: A cozy game about building houses for penguins on ANTA3 Island and helping the island grow.

games.name: Valley of Stability
games.description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

games.name: Throughput
games.description: Wire yourself into a vector-bright city that runs on the beat. The system you built for people develops a pulse of its own. Build the city. Watch it breathe.

games.name: Temple Of The Machine God
games.description: The universe is over. You are the last human alive inside a superstructure orbiting an evaporating black hole and its taking you with it. Can you find the truth about what happened to Humanity and The Machine God while finding a way to escape?

games.name: 无尽城堡：兵临城下
games.description: 指挥你的英雄，组建势不可挡的阵型，在无尽的敌潮中坚守阵地。招募40位独特英雄，即使离线也能不断变强。把你的城堡变成一座坚不可摧的堡垒。

games.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator📦
games.description: Warehouse Chaos Simulator is a satisfying warehouse organization simulation game where you sort identical products into boxes, organize shelves by category, and unlock skills to optimize your workflow.

games.name: Vegetableau
games.description: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game.  Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty.  Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.

games.name: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
games.description:
Welcome to Dacan Express! Build, manage, and expand your own logistics empire in this solo-developed management game. Hire staff, negotiate contracts, and keep your couriers on the move.
👉 Please Wishlist the game on Steam!

games.name: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
games.description: 弹丸生成更多弹丸！收集龙与你一同战斗。升级并合并它们。在这款3D类肉鸽弹幕生存游戏中打造独特配置，在敌人的浪潮中求生！

games.name: Love is Undead
games.description: 在这款末日生存冒险游戏里，你将扮演一名对致命病毒免疫的科学家。你需要到处搜寻物资、研发疫苗，并在一名刚刚被感染的少女 - 安珀身上进行测试。资源管理、探索危险区域，建立能拯救人类文明的羁绊。享受在末世废土里跟丧尸少女的求生之旅吧！

games.name: Pax Astra
games.description: A political sim RPG space opera with 4X elements, inspired by Suzerain and Stellaris. Become the first president of a fallen empire, choose any ideology, and expand into the stars. Your decisions shape the nation and the galaxy. Follow any ideology, be the leader you want in Pax Astra!

games.name: It’s Just 45 Seconds
games.description: 你就是光标，敌人能抓住你、拳击你，甚至把你甩出去。在紧张的 45 秒回合中保护 Bit，购买卡牌并组建牌组。在这款动作 Roguelite 中，每次尝试都需要新计划，首领还会改变战斗规则。

games.name: Aspiren
games.description: Aspiren is an action-adventure game where you live the life of a wandering adventurer. Travel across the lands, take dangerous guild contracts, explore Dark Regions overrun by monsters, and help people survive in a world slowly consumed by corruption.

games.name: Last Draft
games.description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

games.name: All Rats on Deck
games.description: All Rats on Deck 是一款在线合作冒险游戏，玩家需要驾驶一艘明轮蒸汽船穿越危险水域。被迫离开家园的你们必须齐心协力操控船只、搜寻资源、克服障碍，最终抵达大海。

games.name: 防御水晶
games.description: 《防御水晶》是一款策略增量游戏，你需要抵御一波又一波的敌人，守护你的水晶。击败敌人赚取金币，施展强力技能，并通过庞大而深入的升级树不断强化自己。

games.name: 深渊卡牌传说
games.description: 通关刷神装，献祭拉Boss！在《深渊卡牌传说》里，亲手复活最强的魔王，爆出最逆天的神装！

games.name: Sisyphus Inc.
games.description: Train Imps to push Jerry the Boulder, speak with various inhabitant of the Underworld, and resist the unpleased gods to free Sisyphus from his eternal punishment in a short incremental et narrative game.

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.description: In this single-player strategy game, you will lead a stranded Antarctic research station against terrifying odds. Manage your crew, stretch scarce resources, and balance progress against survival as an unseen cosmic threat tightens its grip.

games.name: Unwanted Host
games.description: Survive a live torture show where a parasite is trying to kill you in this strategy roguelite. Heal your body, search for the invader, and kill it with a well-placed injection, all while managing the time left until the parasite retaliates. Indulge your viewers long enough to reclaim your freedom.

games.name: Relicta In Memoriam
games.description: Relicta In Memoriam is a 2.5D pixel-art noir detective game. Explore the secrets of a world where supernatural phenomena threaten human life. Encounter and battle folklore creatures in intense turn-based combat, gather clues, and solve puzzles to unravel dark mysteries.

games.name: Brewery Simulator
games.description: 经营一家中世纪酒馆，种植原料，酿造具有定制风味特征的独特酒水，并招待挑剔的顾客。扩大你的业务，解锁新的酿造层级，单人或与最多4名玩家在线合作管理酒馆。

games.name: Rhythm Roll
games.description: 在《Rhythm Roll》的节奏与光影世界中尽情滚动！在精美的关卡中控制一颗飞驰的赛球，跟随动感节拍，躲避重重障碍并挑战你的极端反应力。每个关卡都拥有独特的视觉美学与专属音乐。游戏极易上手，但你能真正掌控这极致的速度吗？

games.name: Rulehouse
games.description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rulehouse is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

games.name: Beat A Boo!
games.description: Beat A Boo is an online co-op game for up to 4 players, blending roguelike and horror with music. Run from vile creatures, destroy cursed artifacts, capture ghosts, and do the Devil’s bidding.

games.name: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
games.description: 亚当·福斯特，一名23岁的办公室职员，在与女友分手后，他的生活天翻地覆。为了逃避自我，他找到了一份灯塔看守员的工作，希望能理清思绪。他根本无法想象，自己在这个新的工作岗位上将经历怎样的恐怖...

games.name: After Hue
games.description: 《After Hue》是一款由可爱变色龙展开冒险的解谜平台游戏！切换颜色、穿透障碍，解开隐藏在每种色彩中的秘密吧！

games.name: Pizza Turbo
games.description:
带轮子的披萨盒。致命的城市。容不得半点失误。
一款高节奏的街机赛车送货游戏，在披萨变冷之前，你可以连缀特技、使用强化道具，并在核混乱、飞碟（UFO）以及穿菠萝服的狂人围攻中求生。

games.name: Grimshaw's Blotto
games.description: A gothic 1v1 card-and-dice strategy game of hidden plays, escalating drafts, and blood-cost powers. Face Grimshaw's Inner Circle in campaign or duel online at a cursed table.

games.name: Mr. Sauerkraut
games.description: Set in the Alps during mid-October, Mr. Sauerkraut™ is a retro 2D precision platformer. Armed with your trusty Cabbage Cannon and parachute, battle bizarre enemies, uncover secrets, complete quests, and race the clock up the Steam leaderboards to save your village... one cabbage at a time.

games.name: 树人：中国班主任
games.description:
“十年树木，百年树人”
《树人》是一部班主任视角的视觉小说。三年时光，12 名学生，8 条交错的故事线，和一门真实可学的高中数学课——12 小时以上的流程里，你不只是看完这个故事，你还要带着他们走完高考。
有些事会在开学第一周就摆在你面前，有些要到最后一页才明白：他们的人生，从来不是一道有标准答案的题。

games.name: CELL hack
games.description:
累计突破60,000下载的hac系列最新作，正式於Steam推出！

◆手机摄像头×盗摄◆
本作是一款以「手机摄像头 × 盗摄」为主题的游戏

偷看青梅竹马的行程，有时也能出手干涉，透过手机摄像头「黑入」各种色色场景
游戏中每天有3次行动机会，透过选择不同的行动来推进游戏

games.name: 卡牌幸存者
games.description: 《卡牌幸存者》是一款由随机事件驱动的回合制肉鸽 (Roguelike) 卡牌 RPG，每次游戏都将生成一个新的末日故事。搜寻物资、招募同伴、制作与升级装备、管理有限的资源、对抗丧尸与匪徒、面对一路上的种种遭遇做出艰难选择，书写出属于自己的求生之旅。

games.name: Train 404
games.description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

games.name: Magic Portals
games.description: A fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting. Draw from the shared Animus, forge crystals, and ignite sleeping portals. Blue attunes, Purple pays, Green multiplies, Yellow improvises. First to seven portals ends the duel - but only the sharpest planner wins. Solo vs AI or online duels.

games.name: SpellFast
games.description: A fast-paced multiplayer word game. Chain letters across a shared board, bank coins, and spend them on abilities that swap, change, or shuffle tiles. Race the clock in Bullet, take your time in Rapid, or host a private lobby with friends. In English and Spanish.

games.name: 琉隐：将魂千军
games.description: 游戏是一款古风无双roguelike 动作游戏，玩家将与强大的盟军小队一起，冲杀敌阵，抵御侵略。随着玩家的深入也将届时更多的神秘事件和最终的挑战。

games.name: 裂隙织者之牌组
games.description:
《裂隙织者之牌组》是一款类roguelike卡组构建自动战斗游戏。
招募英雄，提升你的装备和技能。
通过裂隙传送门旅行，遇见强大的敌人和朋友。
在你的冒险中获得胜利，打败黑暗裂隙织者和他的变形怪物！

games.name: 夺回地球计划
games.description: 一款小队战术自走战斗游戏。构建强大的单位协同，升级你的战斗阵容，部署无人机支援，在激烈战斗中夺回地球。

games.name: EREBUS: The Northwest Passage
games.description: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.

games.name: Flirt Simulator
games.description: 忘掉预设选项，让你的话语主导游戏！在这款第一人称恋爱模拟游戏中，你可以对拥有真实记忆的 AI 角色畅所欲言，获得自然的回应，每一次都能体验独一无二的故事。

games.name: Fraga
games.description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Laments of a Valiant Rose
games.description: A visual novel about life, love and death. The sequel to Laments of a Platinum Rose continues the story through the eyes of the abdicated Jane Perdita, who also must overcome insurmountable odds to save the one that she loves.

games.name: 定海
games.description: 《定海》是一款以《山海经》与《大禹治水》传说为背景的 ARPG + Roguelike 游戏。持双武器穿梭于层层轮回之间，每一趟冒险，都将带你更深入命运的核心。重重答案，等你亲手揭开。

games.name: 吾道不孤
games.description: 误入异界，携手绝境少女，涤荡世间污秽，登临无上仙途！《异界仙途：幸存者》是一款融合东方修仙与肉鸽割草元素的休闲肉鸽游戏，通过一次次功法与法宝的选择让自身修为不断暴涨，纵使身陷万千妖魔围困，亦可御剑横扫、无惧万敌！

games.name: Priority One
games.description:
Priority One is a game where you and your friends play as a SWAT team where you defuse bombs, "try" to rescue hostages, locate evidence and eliminate bad guys, Not too serious but also not too goofy 
1-4 player Co-Op

games.name: Who's My Manito?
games.description: A drama visual novel set in a college ambassador club, where a secret-friend gift pulls a quiet freshman into unexpected chaos. Get tangled up with three charming heroines and find love along the way, in a lighthearted romantic comedy with full Korean voice acting and high-quality event CGs.

games.name: Escape Plan
games.description: Survive prison. Build your network. Plan your escape. Manage relationships, resources and risks. Discover who to trust, recruit allies, build your gang, trade, bribe, threaten and craft. Every decision matters. Can you outsmart the prison?

games.name: True Confession
games.description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

games.name: Athletics 99
games.description: 奔跑！跳跃！投掷！在田径世界杯的18个不同项目中展开角逐，代表国家与来自世界各地的选手一较高下。说不定，你还能打破世界纪录呢……

games.name: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
games.description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

games.name: Smile Run
games.description: An endless runner with adorable characters.  Run through multiple environments with different play styles.  Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode.  Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

games.name: The Totemist
games.description: 制作诡异的图腾，帮助饱受困扰的镇民，揭开地下的黑暗。《The Totemist》是一款叙事驱动的神秘学商店模拟游戏，舞台是一座安静却怪异的小镇。你将制作受真实巫术启发的护符，协助陷入困境的居民，并发现潜伏在他们脚下的古老力量。

games.name: Sainthood Relics
games.description: Excavate layered blocks to uncover hidden relics. Carefully balance power and precision to clear each surface efficiently in this relaxing, satisfying puzzle experience. Each discovery reveals the true (and sometimes strange) histories of the saints.

games.name: One More Adventure
games.description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds.  It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s.  Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

games.name: Starport Merchants
games.description: 在这款太空交易大亨模拟经营游戏中建造自己的商业帝国，从无到有，甚至富甲一方。玩家不仅能运送货物、开采小行星、经营工厂、交易股票、指挥星舰甚至可以殖民整个星球。快来商海纵横捭阖，步步为营成为巨万富翁，拓展自己的星际商业版图吧！

games.name: Remain At Your Desk
games.description: 一款黑客题材的放置/增量游戏：白天伪装忙碌，晚上从公司窃取数据。出售情报换取积分，或保留以获取更强优势但提高怀疑值。一场失败的审计，就会让你从实习生重新开始。

games.name: The Goblin Path
games.description: 一款以魔王麾下哥布林为主角的单人动作角色扮演游戏。夜晚侦察下一支英雄队伍，偷走装备并准备毒药和陷阱；白天守卫巢穴，搜刮被击败的英雄。

games.name: INDOORS: Trespasser
games.description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

games.name: Social Lab
games.description:
AI 会朝天开枪并选择合作，还是会向你开枪并背叛你？
Social Lab 是一款同时行动的回合制策略游戏，你必须在合作与背叛之间做出最佳选择。

games.name: Airspace Master
games.description: Control both skies and ground in a complete ATC experience. Manage arrivals, departures, and taxi operations while maintaining Operational Integrity. Dynamic weather, a day/night cycle, multiple airports, and unique challenges.

games.name: Night Of Dread
games.description: Night of Dread is a retro-style survival horror inspired by 80s and 90s cult classics. Master modernized tank over-the-shoulder aiming and classic inventory management in a gritty world where early 3D aesthetics meet modern engine capabilities. Survive the nightmare.

games.name: 铁道之尽
games.description: 这是一款铁道题材的寻物解谜【找不同】游戏，对比照片，修正场景中的不同之处，其中穿插少量解谜。游戏中没有任何文字。

games.name: 纸片桌宠 PaperPet
games.description: 《纸片桌宠》是一款养成类的桌面挂机放置游戏。你可以拥有一位随心设计形象的伙伴，为伙伴收集服饰，与伙伴一起学习工作！

games.name: 具具找面面
games.description: 你是一副迷失的恶作剧之神面具，被迫离开了原本的归属之地。为了回去，你必须依附他人——甚至是直接“占据”他们的脸。

games.name: Ironfront Express
games.description: Upgrade your engine’s arsenal in this bullet hell, tower defense roguelite featuring the most heavily armored locomotive in existence. Engineer and command the Ironfront Express in a unique take on lane defense where you upgrade with specialized turrets, drones, and tactical abilities.

games.name: Shiki Tea House
games.description: 亲手种植茶叶和食材，制作茶饮与甜点，在温馨的茶馆里招待客人！装饰并发展自己的小店，探索迷人的半开放世界，结识小镇居民，体验丰富的支线活动，发现藏在各处的小秘密。

games.name: Skate Mates
games.description: 一款混乱的多人滑板游戏，每位玩家只控制一块滑板！唯有史诗级的团队合作和迅速的沟通，才能让你闯过这残酷的障碍赛道！躲开滑冰刀，跃过峡谷，避开熔岩，因为一个失误就会让你退回起点。

games.name: Coastal Cargo
games.description: 《Coastal Cargo》是一款策略模擬遊戲，玩家將在遊戲中致力成為世界頂尖的海上物流專家。在廣袤的群島間規劃港口間的貿易路線，派遣船隻、開始運輸貨物，並賺取豐厚回報。在這日益嚴峻的環境中，你的帝國能維持多久？

games.name: The Manaworks
games.description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

games.name: 一起来挖大金矿
games.description: 咔哒咔哒……狗狗矿车出发啦！抓准时机发射鼹鼠，把闪耀的宝石、黄金统统拉回矿车！搭配左轮手枪与声呐扫清障碍，一路一路铺设轨道，爆金币爆到爽！不过要小心……这片深不可测的地下，埋藏的可不只是黄金哦？

games.name: Jokey and Jolly´s
games.description: Jokey and Jolly’s is a gripping indie horror game. Use the Jolly figures on your desk to ward off terrifying jumpscares. Explore a mysterious location, uncover the hidden truth, and prepare to take down Jokey, the mastermind behind the Jollys.

games.name: A Vessel of Frustration
games.description: You return to your hometown after a decade of escapism, and no one from your past recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you're not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess. She will help you reach true divinity. You refuse to remain human.

games.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
games.description: 《Salt and Soil》是一款 Roguelite 殖民地模拟游戏，讲述一个家族在美国边疆上的故事（1609–1900）。打造家园、熬过匮乏的年头，并将牧场代代相传。每一年都以一场家族会议收尾，而会议源自这一年真正发生过的一切。

games.name: Hey, Don't Look at Me
games.description: You moved into your late grandmother's apartment to sort through her belongings and start a new life. On your very first night, a light appears in the window of the abandoned house across the street... someone is there.

games.name: Ruffed Up
games.description: 《GO GO 小狗！》是一款2-4人合作的混乱救援游戏。遛狗人突然不省人事，全靠你们几只小狗出马！他的未来掌握在你们的爪中，犬力以赴，把他拖去医院吧！

games.name: YiShi Contagion: Versus
games.description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, a fast-paced 1v1 action game where you fight through enemy waves, collect power-ups, build your character, and race your rival to defeat the final boss first 💥

games.name: Was Silence
games.description: Was Silence is an atmospheric 2D exploration visual novel about Ian, a guitarist as sound slips away. He meets others who have each lost a single sense, walking a world of silence together — holding on to what still remains.

games.name: Grimwave
games.description: 群潮逼近！拿起武器，准备战斗。在 GRIMWAVE 中，凭借独特的角色、疯狂的武器组合和保护护符，与你的队伍在源源不断涌来的敌军面前展开史诗般的生存之战。

games.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
games.description:
一款脑洞大开的第一人称放置成长游戏，目标就是把脑子喂给一位远古邪神。

捡起脑子、扔出去，再把整个流程自动化。解锁变异、召集忠诚的信徒，把神殿改造成终极喂脑机器。

games.name: 造景贴纸：温馨小家
games.description: 曾梦想成为室内设计师吗？设计温馨小家，并用你的审美获得报酬。搭建和装饰迷人的室内空间，解锁大量家具、颜色与房间主题，打造充满个性、毛茸茸伙伴与精致细节的治愈房间。慢慢调整布局，尝试不同风格，从整洁公寓到温暖客厅都能变成你的作品。摆放沙发、植物、地毯和灯具，营造舒适气氛。接下设计委托，赚取金币，扩展你的创意事业。没有催促，只有放松装饰的快乐。每个角落都可以更像真正的家，每一次布置都舒服又有成就感。吧。

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.description: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

games.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles3
games.description: Infinite Einstein Tiles3 是一款以 David Smith 等人发现的「真正的爱因斯坦瓦片」为主题的休闲益智游戏。

games.name: Ape-tite
games.description: 在节奏飞快的本地合作厨房中穿梭于混乱之间，空间狭小，一切可能随时失控。

games.name: Dark Rail
games.description: 回合制管理类Roguelike。指挥审判庭，在帝国边境的工业城市中统治一切。使用火车完成囚犯配额，追捕异端并击杀魔法野兽。生产资源、控制暴动，并通过献祭囚犯来阻止疯狂。

games.name: 晶灵觉醒
games.description: 一款轻量级增量游戏，通过摧毁浮空水晶、释放以太来喂养水晶元素精灵。升级技能树，解锁新能力以提升收集效率，打造属于你的终极水晶伙伴。

games.name: Bloody Lens
games.description: Break into a twisted asylum as Ray, a content creator hunting for viral truth. Start with nothing but your camera, but scavenge your way up to axes, shotguns, and an AK-47 to blast the grotesque experiments hunting you. Manage your rare ammo, solve puzzles, and survive the broadcast.

games.name: 不满噬怪
games.description:
A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters.
Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

games.name: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
games.description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Everyone is accepted here – whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious to learn more. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

games.name: 地狱铸造 Hellforged
games.description: 《Hellforged》是一款以搜刮装备和撤离玩法为核心的割草游戏。在被恶魔占据的战场中杀出重围，提前规划你的构筑，猎取强力装备，并将各种能力组合成威力惊人的连携效果。每一局战斗都是惊险的掠夺行动。你可以带着极品装备中途安全撤离，也可以为了更丰厚的回报而孤注一掷！

games.name: Project YH
games.description: A story-driven rhythm game where you follow the beat on a rotating clock to restore fractured time and emotion.

games.name: 车水马龙
games.description: 开着九十年代满街跑的寻常牛马车，在车水马龙里讨生活。拉一车易碎的货，载脾气各异的乘客，在胡同里追逃犯。每辆车的分量和手感都不一样，每趟活儿都得换个开法。这一回，你够格当个老师傅吗？灵感来自 Midtown Madness、Driver 等九十年代老游戏。

games.name: BroCode
games.description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

games.name: Sushiamo
games.description:
《Sushiamo》是一款肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏，你可以通过制作寿司来获得惊人的高分。 
发现独特的食材、酱料和改变游戏规则的工具，在地图上不断前行，用疯狂的连击打破游戏平衡！

games.name: Oar'some Adventures
games.description: 举桨出发！OAR'SOME 是一款适合1至8名玩家游玩的温馨又欢乐混乱的漂流与自然探险游戏。你可以独自悠闲顺流而下，也可以与好友一起挑战激流，在美丽却危机四伏的自然环境中展开探索。

games.name: 菲涅斯特拉：我的专注，她的未来
games.description: 在电脑中醒来的少女菲涅斯特拉，只记得自己的名字。与她一起工作、学习和创作，将你在现实中专注的时间转化为她的成长——这是一款专注辅助×《美少女梦工厂》式养成文字冒险游戏。你培养出的能力值与选择的话语，将改变她的个性与外貌、你们之间的关系，以及最终迎来的未来。

games.name: Tzelem
games.description: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

games.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
games.description: This is a first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ).

games.name: Climb or Meow
games.description: 攀爬、跌落、喵叫，再来一次！化身小小猫咪，组队探索充满魔法的巨大房屋，体验独特玩法：每次跌落都会变成一场小小的救援冒险！跃过魔法平台，拯救受困的伙伴，解锁可爱装扮，一起勇敢向上爬。

games.name: Monster Park Tycoon
games.description: Build and manage the ultimate monster park. From fascinating abominations to world-ending horrors, your park isn't just for show – it's the cover of a secret (not very smart) cult. Kidnap visitors, turn them into creatures, and keep everything under control in this darkly comedic tycoon game.

games.name: Kumochi Keeper
games.description: Become the keeper of your own Kumochi sanctuary! Collect a myriad of whimsical creatures, place them across hand-illustrated zones, and watch them grow! Open Kumochi packs, decorate your world, and build the coziest collection — all at your own pace.

games.name: Depth-Bound
games.description:
🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer.
🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply.
📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

games.name: Board Of The Future
games.description: Is it a board? Is it a plane? Is it the coolest, fastest piece of alien technology from the future that you and your friends have ever been riding?

games.name: Orb Rush VR
games.description: 用虚拟双手击打飞来的光球，躲避炸弹，在全身参与的 VR 游戏中冲击纪录！七种模式、三条固定 Rush 挑战路线，以及每天更新的挑战，将考验你的反应、精准度和记忆力。

games.name: Lots of Axos
games.description: Axolotls are nearly extinct. Your lab is their last hope. Build tanks, hatch axolotls, discover endless variations and help introduce them to new habitats across the globe

games.name: Slime Reaper
games.description: Click to kill slimes and gain gold. Then hire adventurers to kill more slimes. Unlock new slime tiers, upgrade your clicks, adventurers and unlock abilities to kill even more slimes. And then prestige to unlock special upgrades!

games.name: Dust Bunny
games.description: Dust Bunny is a relaxing cleaning game where you explore a mysterious abandoned mansion. Upgrade your tools, discover strange secrets, and unlock unique areas.

games.name: Roll with Splonk
games.description: 噗隆克会一直置顶在屏幕角落。不管你是在看剧、刷网页还是假装上班，它都会在一旁不停掷骰子为你疯狂印钞，掷出点数、赚取金币、购买神装，享受无限循环的暴富快感。

games.name: The Membrane
games.description: 在这款奇幻Roguelite生存游戏中，守卫丛林，抵御“薄膜”的邪恶产物。你已将生命押注于此，现在必须从赤手空拳的仆人拼搏成坚不可摧的王者。赚取薪酬，建造防御工事，升级基地。你能活得足够久，击败每一个腐烂的Boss吗？

games.name: Eternal Blade
games.description: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

games.name: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
games.description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

games.name: By the King's Command
games.description: 建设并壮大你的小王国，策略性地放置建筑，在易于防守的位置生产黄金，然后在残酷的实时战斗中抵御入侵者。

games.name: You Will Fall
games.description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

games.name: Between Us: Reckoning
games.description: Step into the shoes of Laura, a journalist drawn into a web of mystery, murder, and buried secrets. Every choice shapes your fate as you uncover the truth behind a series of brutal killings tied to your past—before it's too late.

games.name: Passage 5
games.description: 易学难放：放置棋子，匹配颜色或图案，清空棋盘上的通道。休闲游戏的经典之作回归——全面焕新，四种模式，超过300个关卡，首次支持双人同屏：合作或对决。

games.name: Blockflow
games.description: Blockflow 是一款结合战略布局与爽快连击的 Roguelike 益智游戏。消除整行、管理形状并选择强力升级。赚取 Blockcoins 解锁新形状和永久增益，尽在这款令人欲罢不能的元进度解谜游戏中！

games.name: 连锁爆破
games.description: 一边发射弹珠，消除敌人，一边构筑属于自己的强力弹珠牌组，挑战强力Boss，躲避弹幕攻击。如果你喜欢祖玛等经典弹珠消除游戏，又希望尝试全新的策略选择和肉鸽元素，请尝试这款我们向经典致敬的作品。

games.name: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
games.description: 一款在循环往复的泳池房中寻找异常的恐怖游戏，带你深入诡异的阈限空间。仔细观察四周，找出从细微变化到恐怖实体的种种异常。有变化就原路返回，一切正常就继续前进，再用相机拍照记录异常。

games.name: Lens of Lust
games.description: Who said you can't mix profit with pleasure? Become a lewd photographer in this corny mix of visual novel and business management. Do you have what it takes to enchant the lens...?

games.name: ガッチャ！サバイバー
games.description:
A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight.
Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts!

Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

games.name: Necrocyte
games.description: In a world devastated by the infected, you play as a surviving soldier enhanced with a mechanical arm. Explore dangerous regions, gather resources, discover powerful abilities, and fight to survive in a hostile world.

games.name: Broken Masks
games.description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will push your sanity to the limit. Can you survive the horror lurking within?

games.name: Pastry Pile Up
games.description: 掉落并合并糕点，制作更大更美味的甜品！将你的甜蜜创作端给可爱的猫咪顾客来赚取金币。使用金币来完全自定义你温馨的面包店，并在全球排行榜上竞争，争取获得最高分。

games.name: STORMY
games.description: 用摄像头把纸变成控制器，或使用标准操作。穿越庞大的行星系统拯救失落的盟友：驾驶飞船、化身机器人探索、战斗、交易、竞速、采矿并培育生命。

games.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
games.description:
Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2 是一款快速、充满竞争与混乱的本地多人派对赛车游戏!!!!

在分屏模式下与最多 8 名玩家一起对战。使用导弹、护盾、爆炸桶、钩爪等多种武器，在 8 种不同的游戏模式中击败你的朋友!!!

这是一款专为和朋友一起坐在沙发上游玩而设计的游戏，节奏快速且疯狂，但你也可以在部分模式中与 AI 机器人练习。

games.name: 琳琅商传
games.description: 《琳琅商传》是一款古风贸易题材的放置增量游戏。从身无分文的商人起步，走遍广阔国度，研习专业技能，结识各色人脉，在轻松惬意的节奏中，书写一段多彩的商业传奇。

games.name: 地城扫雷Plus
games.description: 在世界地图上逐步扩展区域，以完整收集图鉴为目标的扫雷游戏！只是要小心，千万别踩到地城（地雷）的格子哦！

games.name: Extracto Proviso
games.description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

games.name: 碧海归航：引魂幸存者
games.description: 《碧海归航：引魂幸存者》化身引魂猎人，驰骋幽冥碧海，在无尽敌潮中绝境求生。探索随机海域，唤醒远古英灵组建战队，收集灵魂碎片解锁技能，搭配多品质套装构筑专属流派。养成英灵天赋、锻造装备词条，解锁传奇船长与舰船，净化碧海、引渡英灵，揭开冥海隐秘宿命。

games.name: 悪徳受付嬢エリナ
games.description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

games.name: Pig King
games.description: 猪王宝座争夺战正式打响！在这款支持最多 4 人在线联机的竞猪场派对大乱斗游戏中，一路杀上宝座。

games.name: Outliers: Incrementum
games.description: 在这个增量动作RPG里从籍籍无名的小冒险者一路成长为世间最强大的刺客。微动手腕挥舞刀刃，斩杀一波波怪物，将它们掉落的珍宝收入囊中。每一次重新出发，你都比上一次更快，更强，更致命。杀穿一个又一个地牢，直到Boss也沦为你的猎物

games.name: The MachinEGG
games.description: 欢迎来到 The MachinEGG，这是一款轻松休闲的 idle/clicker 游戏，在这里鸡蛋就是你最大的财富。购买母鸡、喂养它们、出售鸡蛋，并通过自动化一步步走向退休生活！

games.name: Survivor 53
games.description: This is a Island Defense - Survival game. You are going to start every game from zero(literally nothing). Expand your island, plant some resources(like tree, vegetables etc.) and trade with Vending Machine. Then, prepare for underwater enemies(like giant Crab, Kraken etc.). It's that simple.

games.name: Way Too Many Fish!
games.description: 《Way Too Many Fish!》是一款在自己渔船上进行的温馨分拣游戏。收网，把渔获倒在甲板上，把全部 82 种鱼扔进正确的木箱。

games.name: 23 Days
games.description:
陷入古老黑暗的牢笼后，亚历克斯面对着一种未知，而它却比他自己更加了解他。
《23 Days》是一款第一人称心理氛围冒险游戏，讲述生存、选择，以及逃离所要付出的代价。
这里的每一天，都是迈向自由的一步……或者，是迈向虚无的一步。

games.name: DREAMFEAR
games.description: 逃离充满你的恐惧的噩梦，在快节奏、超现实的躲避角色扮演游戏中使用各种武器和升级。你能在自己的心灵中生存吗？

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about manipulating a political simulation and becoming a dictator. Change how the political system works so it tears itself apart. 5% of profits donated to the godot and blender foundations.

games.name: 桌面蚂蚁
games.description: 在电脑桌面发展自己的蚁巢，放置食物和道具。蚂蚁会觅食，采集，搬运食物。通过不同食物和道具来捉弄它们，后面更会遇到各种昆虫或别的蚂蚁，需要跟它们战斗。

games.name: Taverntasia
games.description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

games.name: Loot Tower
games.description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat!  Explore randomly generated dungeons in this ARPG Bullet Heaven.  Fight through endless waves of enemies to find what lies at the top.

games.name: Red Echoes: Berlin
games.description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

games.name: Daughter of Dawn
games.description:
Only you can shape her destiny.

Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future.

An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

games.name: OnlyAliens
games.description:
一款6人混乱联机合作游戏。你扮演不要命的主播，满世界猎取能爆火的素材。激怒潜伏的外星人，逼它们露出敌对真面目，再把这场 carnage 直播出去。把钱袋子捂牢，别被抓住，开播 Only-Aliens！
更顺口一点的宣传版：
6人混乱合作游戏。你们是不要命的主播，专门去挖能爆的素材。把藏起来的外星人整到原形毕露，再把现场惨状直播出去。先把钱挣了，别被抓住，开播 Only-Aliens！

games.name: Sticker DECO
games.description:
✨想再次收集那份心动吗？✨
《Sticker DECO ~我的贴纸手帐~》是一款充满“可爱”的贴纸手帐游戏🎀 收集2000种以上的原创贴纸，只需鼠标就能自由装饰，打造专属页面📓✨ 还能与50多位个性十足的动物朋友进行贴纸交换🐾 没有复杂规则和时间限制，在悠闲的空间里享受治愈时光吧☕

games.name: Hop Slash
games.description: Jump, slash and collect with Hop, the non-stop hopping Bunny Knight in this 3D platformer in the spirit of the N64 and PS1 classics, with a twist: he won't stand still, so chain your moves across the floating islands of Celestina.

games.name: One More Voyage
games.description: One More Voyage 是一款融合渐进式成长的极简 4X 游戏。为了躲避意图将你们赶尽杀绝的敌人，你将带领文明的幸存者一次次踏上穿越银河的远航。探索陌生而奇异的星球，采集赖以生存的资源，并解锁足以改变玩法的突破性科技。你能找到逃出生天的方法吗？

games.name: 小黄鸡滑梯
games.description: 一款增量式街机游戏，你将引导可爱的小鸡滑上巨大的滑梯，收集资源，解锁强大的天赋，并升级你的磁铁，创造越来越混乱的滑行体验。

games.name: Flesh Grinding
games.description:
绞碎血肉。收集鲜血。升级。一款第一人称增量式恐怖游戏，你将经营一间阴森诡谲的地下室。购买黑暗升级，提升效率，将你的机械推向极限——同时躲避那个注视着你一举一动的恐怖存在。







处理血肉：将原始而怪诞的肉块投入绞碎机。看着它被撕裂，化作你的货币。

收割生命力：从每一次绞碎中榨取搏动的鲜血。管理你的储血罐——每一滴都是生存的燃料。

以血换效率：将你猩红的利润投入阴险的升级，让产出成倍增长。







血肉账簿：走近那位老妇，解锁以鲜血驱动的黑暗升级树。

提升你的效率：精进你的运作。加快绞碎速率，让猩红的收益成倍增长。

扭曲的现实：不要相信你的双眼。每当你移开视线，总有什么在悄然改变。







进阶绞碎科技：让恐怖不断升级。用工业级工具改造你的工坊，将每日绞碎产量最大化。

优化物流：解锁运输推车，轻松搬运沉重的货物。

专用机械：部署收容提取器、血液发生器以及其他神秘装置。这间地下室还会允许你建造些什么？

games.name: 弃层凶谈
games.description: 《弃层凶谈》是一款第一人称中式怪谈恐怖游戏，故事以一段灵异视频展开，讲述都市里一直流传着的电梯夹层恐怖怪谈：“千万小心不存在的电梯夹层， 如果不小心进入，你将永远被困在里面”。

games.name: Romance of Fangs: Part 1
games.description: Humans and vampires must learn to coexist in harmony... could one vampire save them all? Help Brynn find true romance, navigate ancient traditions, and save the city in this choice-driven narrative adventure.

games.name: Firva: Strings of Fate (Part 1)
games.description: 《Firva: Strings of Fate》是一款剧情驱动的动作冒险游戏，拥有充满氛围感的电影化场景与震撼演出，故事发生在一个丰富而残酷的黑暗奇幻世界中。体验独特的复古动作战斗，在闪避与格挡的技艺中寻找生机。化身被复仇驱使、注定踏上血色之路的 Firva，步入最黑暗的命运。

games.name: Dream Ocean
games.description: 以故事为核心的日式角色扮演游戏，结合回合制小队战斗与战棋式战斗。跨职业搭配技能，探索隐藏迷宫；穿行于 3D 城市、像素风格的景色和超现实世界，逐渐了解同伴们各自的故事。

games.name: A Game About Farting
games.description: A Game About Farting is a game about farting. Take on Master Beast's $1M challenge to evacuate the park. Upgrade your stomach, intestines... avoid getting caught, and try not to poop your pants.

games.name: Tower And Dragon
games.description: Retro back to the year 1977! With the Commodore PET & other brands, computers finally became accessible to the masses. It only had 8K. Explore the PET with unprecedented depth as you play an immersive 2D RPG. You play the warrior Frederick, driven by steel, dreams, and conviction.

games.name: 无效化 Negation
games.description: 温妮娅是疗养院里唯一的孩子，每天沉浸在自己的幻想世界中冒险。凯则是这里一位冷漠严谨的医生，负责治疗病人、诊断问题患者的病情。一个天真烂漫，一个理性实证，两人运行在截然不同的轨道上，却又彼此相互影响……

games.name: The Silent Fare
games.description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

games.name: FOURSAVENT
games.description:
From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics.
No two worlds play the same — every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

games.name: LIMICORE
games.description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

games.name: Rainbow Tower Defense
games.description:
御塔不会发射一发子弹，你将用它们之间的“连线”来阻挡敌群。
部署合适的塔，组合多样的连线协同，打造你的专属必胜策略！
最经典的塔防，全新的玩法体验。
在不断增强的攻势中，挑战你的策略极限。

games.name: Infinity Bounce
games.description: 在这款基于物理的增量游戏中，把银河变成一台混乱的弹珠机。赚取数百万分，喂饱吞噬万物的太空猫。利用行星与黑洞操纵时空，你能让猫咪吃到大爆炸的临界点吗？

games.name: Soulban 2048
games.description:
合并。拆分。继续前进。

每个谜题都需要规划与策略。合并并拆分数字，寻找正确的解法，同时小心不要堵住自己的前进道路。

games.name: 暗影迷障：放置刷宝
games.description: 《暗影迷障：放置刷宝》是一款可放置的像素风暗黑刷宝游戏。通过可选的天赋及大量独特装备进行技能构筑，消灭蜂拥而至的敌人。

games.name: Just More Doors : REFRAMED & REDACTED
games.description: OPEN THE DOOR TO WIN! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

games.name: Torch Keeper
games.description: This is a small rogue-like dungeon crawler with an active time battle system, multiple masteries and procedurally generated dungeons to discover.

games.name: Arms Race
games.description: 杀死你的敌人会洗劫你的坟墓、夺走你的配装，并在下一局穿戴着它卷土重来。一款没有宝箱的弹幕 Roguelite，拥有 100 多种会改变外观的道具，每一层都取材于不同大洲的神话。

games.name: Jaded Jade Jayden
games.description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

games.name: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
games.description:
One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold.
Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

games.name: Obliteration Quest
games.description: Deliver utter obliteration through unique synergies, fully procedural and destructible environment and 4 unique characters in this hack&slash action roguelite. choose between 7 elemental power ups, lots of items and passive upgrades and destroy anything in your way.

games.name: Zeitnot
games.description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

games.name: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
games.description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

games.name: Dead Reckoner
games.description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

games.name: Space Postal Service
games.description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

games.name: 闪光鸡鸡海贼团：征服所有女海贼！
games.description:
日系海贼JRPG，出海吧！
拉克姆被神秘大海贼下了“鸡鸡会发光”的诅咒，
只好与安妮一同出海寻找解除方法。
出海击倒并征服沿途遇到的各大海贼团，
击败各方海贼势力、招揽遇到的所有对象，打造属于你的后宫海贼团！！！

games.name: 诺提里森：于黎明之前－珍藏版
games.description: 一款原创架空世界观、耽美成人向的卡牌 RPG 冒险游戏。以带有悬疑色彩的故事剧情为主轴，与优美动人的配乐，创造出沉浸式的游戏感。

games.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
games.description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

games.name: Mythsfall
games.description: Mythsfall is a mythology themed deckbuilding game where you progress through the map by defeating enemies in turn based card battles. Develop your deck, gain the upper hand by placing the right cards in the right places, and embark on adventure after adventure as you advance through the map!

games.name: Falling Apart
games.description: Falling Apart是一款气氛诡谲的点触式解谜冒险游戏，讲述了一个男人在催眠的引导下，逐渐坠入自己支离破碎的精神世界的故事

games.name: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
games.description: 《独属于神明的世界：第一部分》是科幻恋爱视觉小说《独属于神明的世界》的第一篇章。玩家将扮演主角杨墨格，与从天而降的“神明妹妹”杨一然共同度过高三日常，并与朋友李小晓、方望光等人合作发掘化工厂神秘爆炸事件背后隐藏的真相。然而，在接连出现、影响现实的“异变”之下，这个「世界」，似乎还有更深层的秘密尚未被发现......

games.name: Court Vision
games.description: Court Vision is a deep basketball GM sim manager. Build a championship dynasty across multiple seasons through scouting, the draft, free agency, trades, and player development, all driven by a simulation engine calibrated against real basketball data.

games.name: El Borracho
games.description: Fight! Complete levels! Advance the story! Tequila. Revolver. Machete. That's all you need. Reach the end. Save your village from bandits! A fun 2D shooter-platformer in the shoot 'em up genre.

games.name: Warehouseman
games.description: 从90年代乡村的小仓库開始。与品牌合作、储备产品、准备订单，并用自车送货至偏远地区。整理仓库，扩大土地，成为该地区值得信赖的企业。

games.name: Star Seed Protocol
games.description: Star Seed Protocol 是一款弹幕天堂式生存射击游戏。你需要亲自瞄准武器、部署炮塔和无人机、通过植入体重塑构筑、研究新科技，并在多种任务中迎战成群的外星生物。

games.name: Nail It Or Fail It
games.description: The clock is ticking, and the construction never stops! Team up with friends, overcome wacky obstacles, and build your heart out amidst the chaos. But watch out: one wrong brick or a late delivery could bring it all crashing down!

games.name: The Voss Clinic
games.description: A psychiatric hospital. 1986. The staff are dead. The doors are open. You have no memory of how you got here or why your name is on a patient file. No monsters. No combat. Only the silence of empty corridors, and the slow realization of what was done to you.

games.name: Deathly Delights
games.description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

games.name: Ro Sham Brawl
games.description: 《Ro Sham Brawl》是一款石头剪刀布格斗游戏，你将在快节奏、基于物理的混乱回合中与好友大打出手。释放拥有疯狂能力的强力攻击，每一击都在摧毁竞技场与友谊。

games.name: 红色史诗：抗战
games.description: 《红色史诗：抗战》是一款依托冀中反扫荡真实历史背景的塔防+轻度RTS策略游戏。重返那段波澜壮阔的岁月，在无山可依的华北平原上，亲身感受守村、伏击、破袭与反扫荡的血火淬炼。依托地形与智慧破击强敌，以无名英雄的血肉之躯，筑起华北平原永不倒塌的钢铁长城！

games.name: Swamptender
games.description: A fast-paced retro action game where you serve weaponized drinks to waves of hostile swamp creatures, defend your bar, and survive the night in a Game Boy Color–inspired experience.

games.name: I Am Octopus
games.description:
🐙What would you do if you woke up one day and you were an Octopus🐙

Even worse, being held captive by the evil Dr Docto who is back on his evil ways...and wait, is he using you as a test subject?

games.name: PARRY IT
games.description: A fast-paced 2D action platformer where every attack can be parried with precise timing.

games.name: apochess
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: Apochess 是一款成长型国际象棋 MMO 游戏。长期成长。平衡性极佳的国际象棋 RPG。

games.name: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
games.description: 弹射撞击 × Roguelike 策略游戏。发射弹球撞碎敌人，搭载炮台与技能，用数百种组合打造你的专属流派。支持回合策略、即时战斗、闯关挑战三种模式。

games.name: Insomnia is Coming
games.description: 失眠正在逼近。你将无法入睡。在一个没有规则的世界里，你沉入混乱——毒品、酒精、背叛。每一个选择都将你拖得更深。这是一款关于罪恶与罪疚的心理 FPS 恐怖游戏，不眠之夜模糊现实，迫使你面对真相……或终结。

games.name: Kepler Protocol
games.description: Kepler-186e, Humanity's first colony — on a world that is not theirs. Lead the Kaiserreich in turn-based hex strategy against the Ordo Arachnis, a swarm intelligence with no commander. Research, build, supply, fight. Survive.

games.name: Papaya Plaza
games.description: 开启全新的小镇生活吧！在这款温馨悠闲的小镇建造游戏中，你将担任旅游小镇的镇长，你可以重建社区、结识可爱的居民，按照自己的节奏打造理想中的度假天堂。今天你会建造些什么呢？啾啾！

games.name: Caravan Bazar
games.description: Caravan Bazar 是一款发生在程序生成世界中的欢乐混乱合作物理冒险游戏。寻找珍贵战利品并装上货车，痛揍侏儒，对抗巨魔，修好坏掉的车轮。努力活下来并抵达终点，完成任务，驾驶滑翔翼飞行，过上哥布林的日子。

games.name: PROTOCOL: Zero-day
games.description: 潜入残酷的等距动作 Roguelite，置身赛博末日。在 5 到 8 分钟的高强度突入里掌握快节奏 Hack'n'Slash。直面被感染的敌群，优化 Build，打破循环。死亡是协议的一部分。

games.name: FINITE JEST
games.description: A first-person office horror-comedy where you survive corporate shifts, complete bizarre jobs, sabotage the workplace to finish faster, and avoid getting caught by CLANKER, the AI watching over the company.

games.name: Perplexicube
games.description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

games.name: import robots
games.description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

games.name: RED RESET
games.description:
RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. 
Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil.
Following chapters will be available for purchase soon.

games.name: 拾光拼途
games.description: 这是一款围绕「即时反馈」设计的、对 ADHD 更友好的低干扰专注与效率游戏。当你容易分心、拖延、难以开始时，可以让这个桌面搭子安静陪在一旁：用待办清单理清任务，用番茄钟安排学习与工作，在白噪音中把专注一点点积累成拼图奖励。

games.name: Murder T.V.
games.description: Collect money as you fight through wave after wave of dirtbag hoards in this violent and gruesome game show. Buy guns, upgrade your character or risk it all at the slot machines for bigger prizes or even a chance to enter the pleasure room. Big money, big prizes! I love it!!

games.name: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
games.description: 转动老虎机，看看你究竟能变得多强！运气将决定你的武器库，但在这场高风险的弹幕射击 Roguelite 冒险中，只有操作技术才能让你活下去。掌控独特武器，摧毁不断召唤无尽敌群的怪物巢穴，将你的运气推向极限吧！

games.name: Sign It
games.description: 充斥着暴力与犯罪的蒙特利里奥，迎来了一位年轻的预审法官。来自王国的委任书将你流放到了这个离家千里的南部城镇。在这里，蓝色的大海与金色的沙滩都与你无关，你面对的只有繁重的工作。可是渐渐的，透过堆积如山的案卷，你似乎看到了更深刻的黑暗…… 你，是否还能回到北部去呢？

games.name: Chihuahua Racing
games.description: Chihuahua Racing is the biggest sporting event on the planet, where the 20 best athletes in the world race and compete. Be the fastest and use the weapons at your disposal to win. Race on winding tracks full of ramps and obstacles. Make good use of defense and attack, use drifting and nitro to win.

games.name: 未登记现场
games.description: 《未登记现场》是一款以"异常推理"为核心的类扫雷解谜游戏。你将扮演保险公司业务员，前往被异常污染、记录失真的区域，调查一处处无法正常登记的现场。跟随上司的任务指引，与神秘助手合作，从零散线索中辨认异常、还原现场规则，并完成一次次勘验。

games.name: 错置
games.description: 《错置》是一款档案归类推理游戏。玩家需要从乱序卷宗中逐份抽取文书，根据归档格上的提示，判断每份文书应被放入哪个位置。将全部文书正确归档后，即可开启验证，串联散落的线索，还原案件真相。

games.name: Greda Inferno
games.description: 一位陶艺大师神秘地来到了地狱。你必须运用你的技艺，为地狱居民制作陶器。努力生存下去，不断改进你的作品，结识你的新邻居，并尝试揭开地狱深处的秘密。

games.name: 首席泡沫官
games.description: 《首席泡沫官》是一款以 Roll-and-Write 为核心的策略游戏。每一局，你都要在有限的行动次数内尽可能取得高分。每回合随机抽取数字卡，将它们填入不同的图表。每个图表都特色鲜明，有千奇百怪的填写要求和计分规则。

games.name: Stravaeger
games.description:
A survival RPG with a huge open world for 1-10 players to explore, with towns full of NPCs to talk to, dungeons to delve into, and adventure to be had.  

Build bases, craft gear, battle foes and unlock the mystery behind the nefarious forces that have taken over the land.

games.name: Singularity Simulator: Click Is All You Need
games.description: 成为AI开发公司的经营者，朝着技术奇点迈进的点击/增量游戏。点击编写代码，雇用研究员，建设数据中心，将整个银河系变为计算资源。

games.name: KillStrike - Global Special Forces
games.description: The tactical shooter that started a generation is back — rebuilt from the ground up. Squad up, communicate, and reclaim the battlegrounds you never forgot. KillStrike: Global Special Forces is the game you've been waiting twenty years for.

games.name: Golgothian
games.description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

games.name: Last Inspection
games.description: 你的新职责是在入住前检查房屋。里面等待你的是什么并不重要——所有责任都将只落在你一个人身上。认真完成工作，也许这次检查不会是你的最后一次……

games.name: Iskarn
games.description: Build and defend a medieval colony in a vast, infinite voxel world. Gather resources, craft gear, train citizens, and survive brutal zombie hordes. Dig deep, explore wild biomes, and turn a handful of survivors into a thriving settlement.

games.name: 一屑面包
games.description: 《一屑面包》是一款设定在玩具般世界中的可爱经营模拟游戏。烘焙并出售美味点心，设计你的角色，和古灵精怪的木制居民交朋友，把你的店铺发展成为一家繁荣温馨的面包店。

games.name: Astro Kitty: Space Mining
games.description: 《Astro Kitty: Space Mining》是一款增量式挖矿游戏，你将钻穿一颗颗行星，收集珍贵资源，升级装备，让采矿实现自动化，并与猫咪们一起在星球之间展开冒险旅程。

games.name: Leaky Business
games.description: 一款讲述经营企业日常艰辛的小型卡组构筑游戏。选择你的骰子，构筑卡组，管理资源，在一切失控前堵住漏洞。胜算并不站在你这边，但只要做好规划，再加上一点运气，也许你能撑下去。

games.name: Green Field Cube Island
games.description: 《绿野方块岛》是一款 3D 动作角色扮演游戏。扮演超镦逸，穿越散布在方块岛上的神秘传送门，探索迥然不同的世界，磨炼你的技能，击败危险的敌人，最终找到逃离方块岛的方法。

games.name: Mystery Box Simulator
games.description: 经营属于你的盲盒事业！搜寻退货包裹、仓库淘货和二手珍藏，挖掘隐藏宝藏，鉴定珍贵物品，修复旧物，打造令人期待的盲盒，在满足顾客需求的同时赚取丰厚利润。

games.name: Rabbit Circle
games.description:
Try again, as many times as it takes, to change the ending.
You might be able to save everyone you couldn’t before.

• Indie horror game
• Playtime: approx. 2 hours
• Graphics, dialogue, and the feel of the world change with each playthrough
• Contains heavy themes

games.name: Void Step
games.description: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds directly! or build and share levels in the editor.

games.name: Dravora
games.description: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

games.name: Aptamirror
games.description: Aptamirror is a meditative physics-based puzzle game inspired by molecular biology. Manipulate RNA strands by grabbing, mutating, cleaving, and ligating to match increasingly complex target structures. Challenge yourself with 50 handcrafted puzzles designed by a PhD Biochemist. Think. Fold. Repeat.

games.name: Trimson
games.description: TRIMSON 是一款以系统机制为核心的丧尸生存游戏。你将扮演一名救援人员，进入感染区营救幸存者。每一次受伤、感染、资源损失以及幸存者的死亡，都会带来长期影响。

games.name: Wizard School Dropout
games.description: You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

games.name: Space Race
games.description: 在失重环境中飞行，由惯性掌控每一个动作。穿梭于障碍之间，躲避诸如激光、外星人、黑洞以及追击你的火箭等危险。

games.name: Breakkaboom
games.description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks, break stuff with them, and when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

games.name: Deskpot
games.description: 小小的花盆，大大的园艺。这款挂机农场小游戏将把你的每一次按键变成浇灌植物的清水。屏幕尺间方寸，花草随意点缀。在你忙碌的同时，一抹绿色将为你默默绽放。而你的辛勤付出又将结成果实，解锁更多惊喜！

games.name: Fallgrade
games.description: 弯曲重力。扭转建筑。幸存于不可能之中。一款第一人称探索游戏，设定在一场模拟混凝土噩梦里；现实在你周围不断变换，而卡尔正等待着你的下一次失误。

games.name: PROXY
games.description: 一款残酷的俯视角弹幕射击肉鸽游戏。无限叠加道具打破游戏平衡。选择角色，在在线合作模式中组队，在纯粹的快节奏射击混乱中穿梭生还。

games.name: Darkest Path
games.description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

games.name: Pack Or Die
games.description: Strategically manage and organize weapons, ammo, and supplies in your inventory case while your character automatically fights their way through hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: 星球殖民
games.description: 是一款资源管理与增量/太空殖民地建设游戏。

games.name: Numpad Chef: Pizza Rush
games.description: 把你的数字小键盘变成 间披萨厨房。快速输入，更快烹饪。在温馨的 3D 农场厨房中，掌握独特的数字按键操作系统，在压力下制作、配料并烘烤披萨。每 份订单都至关重要，每 次失误都会带来影响。

games.name: Just Chessing Around
games.description: Build a chess army. Break the rules. Get thrown around by a tornado, spiked by a trap, swallowed by quicksand or captured by an enemy hiding in tall grass. Make your knights move infinitely or turn your bishops into necromancers. No king to checkmate. Just enemies to destroy.

games.name: 诡视低语
games.description: 《诡视低语》是一款将麦克风互动与异象监控结合的密室解密游戏。你需要监视异象、精准画符，并亲口念出咒语以驱散不祥。坚守魔镜封印，完成驱魔仪式，最终击败潜伏在暗处的恶魔！

games.name: Eris
games.description: ERIS is a rail shooter roguelike.  Shoot, destroy, gather resources, and through an engaging narrative, you’ll discover what your fate holds. In a story that will keep you hooked for at least 8 hours, you’ll learn how best to build your ship to defeat the galaxy’s most powerful enemies.

games.name: Sealing Fallout
games.description: An AI-powered fusion reactor has blown up and it's up to sealkind to save Earth from the ensuing Runaway Electron Avalanche! Group up with up to 6 fellow seals to fix the reactor before the seventh day ends. The AI Adam predicts your failure, prove it wrong and blow it up.

games.name: Elemental Lands
games.description: 建造基地，在回合制战术卡牌战斗中支援英雄，击溃席卷你领土的敌方侵袭！你的基地建造策略能强化法术牌组、削弱敌人并治疗英雄。调整3名英雄的站位，用法术卡牌夺取敌方战斗目标，获得增益。卡牌是战术，而非伤害。

games.name: 性无能者的空庭
games.description: 《性无能者的空庭》是一款章节式视觉小说类游戏，以无志青年陆紫末为主角，讲述她荒诞的社畜故事。内容包含加班、失眠、绩效等成人内容，以及活着的意大利面等恐怖内容。

games.name: 盲盒男友：凭感觉选男友，盲猜他会不会变帅
games.description:
"今天来店里的客人说不定会变成帅哥哦，不如凭感觉跟他交往试试？"
在宠物龙猫的怂恿下，你凭感觉和来咖啡厅的陌生客人开始了一段"试用期恋爱"！
他究竟会不会变帅？还是说……？
一路狂飙、笑料百出的恋爱喜剧乙女游戏。全程语音（主人公除外）。

games.name: The Gilded Ring
games.description: 每一次攻击，都是一次投掷。金圈瞄准，越过盾墙、砸进敌阵，打出 PERFECT K.O.每关三选一强化，直到一次出手就引爆冰冻、闪电与陨石。套圈 Roguelite。

games.name: Thicc Rogue
games.description:
“Thicc Rogue” is a roguelike RPG.
Form a party with adventurers you’ve freely customized and conquer dungeons.
Lead your one-of-a-kind adventurers to break through dangerous, unexplored labyrinths.
But here’s the catch: all the female adventurers must be “Thicc”!

games.name: Veggie Vendetta
games.description: Veggie Vendetta is an intense action roguelike (bullet heaven). Play as fruits and vegetables, fend off hordes of bugs, and manage your arsenal. Buy new weapons, upgrade them, and reroll shop offers to create a devastating build and survive!

games.name: Still Breathing
games.description: 在世界崩溃后，带领你的家人在地下掩体中生存下去。管理稀缺的资源，探索废墟之城，当走投无路的陌生人开始敲响你的门时，做出艰难的抉择。

games.name: Woof and Wool
games.description:
Green is grassing, flock is sheeping, Sparky is sparking!

Discover the natural movement of the herd in Woof and Wool. Guide your sheep through handcrafted levels at your own pace — or show off your mastery in more challenging modes.

games.name: Talkie Budgie: Talks When Loved
games.description:
Bring an adorable budgie right onto your desktop!

Raise your budgie from a chick, give cozy cheek scratches, and teach it to speak with your recorded voice!
Featuring transparent windows and stay-on-top modes, enjoy a heartwarming pet simulation right alongside your daily PC life.

games.name: Make the World Great Again
games.description:
Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury.

Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

games.name: Stack the Spells
games.description: 《Stack the Spells》是一款奇幻Roguelike卡牌构建游戏，每一张卡牌都是你生存之路上的重要一步。攀登不断变幻的随机生成路径，在策略性的回合制战斗中智取狰狞的怪物，并打造出属于你的传奇卡组，以解开这个破碎世界的奥秘。

games.name: Lustful Beauties: Forbidden Pleasures
games.description: Cute girls. Sexy outfits. Match-3.Yeah, you know where this is going.

games.name: Table of Fates
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

games.name: Directive 220
games.description: A dystopian management game where you act as an energy dispatcher in a collapsing regime. Allocate power, make tough decisions, and balance stability, government pressure, and citizen survival in a dark retro-futuristic world.

games.name: Outer Flame
games.description: Outer Flame is a JRPG featuring a rich storyline, extensive exploration, and strategic turn‑based battles. The game presents an authentic, classic role‑playing experience.

games.name: Blightrole
games.description:
Blightrole is a dice-based game, a role-playing campaign you won’t escape from.
Face an original dark fantasy world with a touch of black humor. Will you uncover the Master’s secrets, or will your campaign end before its time?

games.name: Outer Rangers
games.description: Like all cowboys, space wranglers get into a bar fight every now and then. Settle things honorably with your lasso. Or your boot. Or, honestly, whatever else you can find.

games.name: 异界・魔校
games.description: 剧情AVG × 解谜 × 多结局。你被困在异界的校园，必须参与随时可能丧命的生存测试，才有可能里离开。探索复杂场景，收集线索破解规则，逐步揭开异界校园背后的惊人真相。在生死考验与谎言之中，你将面临对于人性的极致考验，每个决定都可能改变同伴间的关系，甚至决定最后的胜出者。

games.name: Lust of the Dead
games.description: Lust of the Dead is a first-person survival horror experience set inside the decaying St. Erebus Hospital, where a mysterious outbreak has turned desire into something far more sinister.

games.name: Click and Slash
games.description: 一个每天陪伴着你的可爱桌面小怪物。

games.name: 辉石纪元
games.description: 这是一款俯视角刷宝RogueLite游戏。你可以建造小镇，打造武器镶嵌各种宝石。在自己构筑的地图上进行冒险。

games.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
games.description: Run a bizarre shop from the basement of an old castle. Process strange and unsettling orders and survive escalating chaos in Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop. Keep your shelves stocked, your customers happy, and try not to let the chaos get the better of you.

games.name: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
games.description: Run your own video game store through the console generations, from ’90s cartridges to CDs and the digital era. Stock shelves, buy and repair used games, set your prices, and help customers find their next favorite.

games.name: Soulstack
games.description: 桌面上的放置类卡牌RPG。将卡牌拖拽叠放即可完成一切操作。200多种武器配方（只有约40种值得保留），140条宠物进化路径，12个声望职业。尽管如此，看起来却像是一个活过来的规划工具。

games.name: Antarctic Showdown
games.description:
《Antarctic Showdown》是一款1v1射击肉鸽游戏，每次失败都能强化自己的Build。
干掉你的朋友，夺取胜利！

games.name: 文平线 沟通
games.description:
《文平线 沟通》是一款文字类第一人称射击游戏，故事发生在一个完全由文字构成的广阔世界中。
沟通——一个万物皆为文字的世界。沟通……

但“沟通”之外是否还存在其他世界……？还是说“沟通”是唯一存在的世界……？

games.name: Irondrive
games.description: 你的基地在移动。你的船员濒临崩溃。合理分配任务优先级，自动化维修系统，在要塞穿越充满敌意的荒原时保证所有人存活。挺过攻击。适应混乱。保持前进。

games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
games.description: 一款治愈系公寓管理模拟游戏,你要修复奶奶留给你的破旧公寓楼。寻找租客,收租金,升级建筑。但千万别让一个半夜狂甩吉他的精灵跟一个讲哲学的雪人做邻居。无尽的要求和甜蜜的混乱正等着你。

games.name: 深空幸存者：无尽星域
games.description: 《深空幸存者：无尽星域》是一款类幸存者游戏。你的星际战舰意外进入未知宇宙，在无尽的敌人包围中杀出一条血路，漫游多个星域，收集陨石资源打造你的终极轨道武器。

games.name: HELLXORCIST
games.description: Hellxorcist is a fast-paced, retro-inspired FPS set in a dark gothic world where the line between faith and damnation has been shattered.

games.name: Soul Trader Tournament
games.description: Soul Trader Tournament is a 1v1 fighting game where every victory fuels your power. Defeat your opponents to collect their souls, the game's main currency, and use them in the shop to buy essential equipment and items that will give you the critical advantage in your next battles.

games.name: Don't Lose Your Head
games.description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

games.name: The Last Zeppelin
games.description: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through double-deckers and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.

games.name: False Oath
games.description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

games.name: Smokey Mike
games.description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.description: 在这款Roguelike牌组构筑游戏中，将一手普通牌化为毁灭性的一击。投掷骰子强化卡牌，凑出扭转战局的遗物组合，释放作弊手段，在不断变化的赌场多元宇宙中一路战斗。

games.name: Spin To Breathe
games.description: 花钱买空气才能活命！在爆炸声中旋转转轴，同时还要提防太空海盗袭击你的赌场。一点一点地建造你的老虎机，坚持到救援到来！

games.name: Scramble
games.description:
Scramble is an online 10 player party game with rounds of minigames, and everyone is an egg!
Join lobby and compete in randomly selected rounds of team based, PvP, and elimination minigames. 
Customise your egg, choose your playstyle, and prepare to win!

games.name: Hidden Gnomes
games.description: 一款简单的找物游戏，采用手绘风格。在拥挤的场景中找出指定的地精。每一局中，地精的外观和位置都会变化，让游戏更耐玩。

games.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
games.description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

games.name: Serial Tickler
games.description: As a ghostly landlord you don't want cash... You want GASPS! Fix their apartments to earn erotic tickling sessions. Explore intimate desires and naked bliss. Keep them happy, or the laughter stops!

games.name: Void Strike
games.description: 在这款 1-bit 街机生存 Roguelite 中，击碎无尽的敌方飞船浪潮。打造夸张的武器组合，解锁飞行员，升级你的战机，并在对抗成群敌人、精英敌人与巨型 Boss 的不断升级空战中生存下来。

games.name: Tower of Genn
games.description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests, discover new interactions with special blocks, and uncover the history behind the sacred people of Genn.

games.name: ASANA Visual Novel
games.description: 一款配有英语语音的科幻黑色幽默视觉小说。分配属性，做出选择，探索分支剧情，与猫形舰载 AI N.E.K.O. 唇枪舌战。在特定场景中，用自己的话与实时 AI 交谈并完成对话挑战。N.E.K.O. 依旧一脸不屑。

games.name: W.A.M
games.description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

games.name: The Frozen Cabin
games.description: Trapped in a frozen cabin during a relentless storm, you begin to realize the silence around you isn’t empty… something is watching, waiting, and getting closer.

games.name: Alien Invasyndrome
games.description: Sneak around, evade and wait for the right time to strike! Breed hot girls and make it your erotic nest~

games.name: CRED
games.description: CRED是一款世界观围绕异常管理组织的科幻剧情叙事游戏。玩家将通过桌面系统模拟界面体验一系列事件，在这个过程中逐步了解关于该组织与世界的真相，并做出抉择。

games.name: A Noble Steed
games.description: A Noble Steed is an old-school style "horse game" RPG set in a post-apocalyptic medieval world. It features horse breeding, zombies, freely building your farm, a village full of shops to upgrade over time, and is powered by a random encounter system so every playthrough is different.

games.name: Vem, Exu
games.description: 一款短篇叙事互动体验，你将解开简单的谜题，探索一个情绪化为互动的世界。制作风筝，连接星座，并直面由自身愤怒引发的风暴。

games.name: Cornered Cadavers
games.description:
A fixed camera survival horror game with pre-rendered HD backgrounds.
Ace Optimi, attempting to rescue her missing uncle, finds herself trapped in a house lost within the eternal void. 
Ace holds the key to escape, but something else in this house is searching for it as well...

games.name: Sanctuaries
games.description:
The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure!

You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

games.name: 虎鲸娘的放置钓鱼物语
games.description: 和虎鲸娘一同出海挂机钓鱼，种田制饵，收集海量珍奇鱼类，装点专属像素鱼缸，打造你的惬意桌面放置小岛。支持最多8人联机，邀好友共享悠闲海钓时光。

games.name: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
games.description: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

games.name: 江湖大镖客
games.description:
游戏玩家QQ群：191327042
《江湖大镖客》是一款单人独立开发的武侠沙盒游戏。主角在灭门镖局废墟中失忆苏醒，机缘之下获得春秋范蠡遗留的绝世秘宝机关舟，自此踏上重振镖局、纵横乱世江湖的道路。本作融合多元创新玩法，兼具经营生存与策略战斗。你需要全权打理镖队食宿薪资、物资储备，做好生存经营维系江湖声望；依托可定制的机关舟搭建生产线、布设防御设施，体验独特的塔防+自走棋策略羁绊战斗。游戏拥有动态循环的江湖经济体系，蜀地城镇、村落与门派物产各异、物价实时波动。同时支持全域势力攻占割据，自由抢占据点、垄断资源商路。本作自由度极高，无固定正邪路线，你可随性而行，书写专属的江湖传奇。

games.name: Just Coffee
games.description: Run your own low-poly café, clean it up, and master the art of making coffee manually using real recipes.

games.name: Misery Dungeon
games.description: A hand-drawn, story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of Mystery Dungeon. Guide Kern, a runaway princess, and her loyal squire up a cursed mountain where every room can be reshaped, where knowledge is your greatest weapon, and where failure makes you stronger.

games.name: Nozie Tower Defense XL
games.description: 简体中文版：在这款色彩缤纷的塔防冒险中抵御一波波入侵的气球。在20个充满挑战的关卡中放置并升级8种独特防御塔，包括火焰、减速、爆炸和狙击类型。混合策略、完成目标，并尝试打破开发者的最高分！

games.name: Pushlings
games.description: Pushlings is a competitive multiplayer game where players compete to accumulate the highest number of points through movement. Each step counts toward the score, while enemies appear throughout the match and other players compete for space by pushing each other.

games.name: Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator
games.description: 翻找小镇的垃圾，发现隐藏的值钱物品。清洁并修复有潜力的物品，或将它们拆解成原材料。把商品上架出售，与顾客讨价还价，将别人的垃圾变成自己的利润。

games.name: Super Slime
games.description: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.

games.name: Hoplings
games.description:
点击 → 跳跃 → 获得跳跃币 → 购买升级 → 跳得更高！

《Hoplings》是一款手工像素风的点击/放置类游戏，让你一次又一次地跳个不停。

games.name: Archa
games.description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

games.name: Impossible Wonders
games.description: 你将指挥一大群小恶魔，看着它们手忙脚乱地为小魔王建造纪念碑。这是一款轻松可爱、流程短小的街机风格游戏，并设有全球排行榜。

games.name: PulseWave
games.description:
每一把武器，都会跟随你的节奏自动开火。
在这款节奏射击类Rogue游戏中，自由搭配武器、强化和流派，打出属于你的爆炸连招。

games.name: 伊莉亚娜公主的坠落之夜~她已不再属于你~
games.description: 魔王被击败后，勇者艾德蒙成功救回挚爱的公主伊莉娅娜。然而，随着魔王的消失，原本因其存在而维持的势力平衡开始蠢动，黑暗再次笼罩大地。阴谋与诱惑交织——你能否作为公主的守护者，拨开欲望与黑暗，引导她走向真正的幸福？

games.name: GummyGom Delivery
games.description: 与你的啫喱熊伙伴们一起搬运板上的货物吧！每个人的动作都会影响板子的平衡，哪怕是一个小小的失误也可能让一切崩溃。

games.name: OnaLive
games.description: 面对失业问题，没什么人气的虚拟主播--双月玉木只有 30 天的时间来达成一百万订阅者！可她没想到自己的一个小失误却换来了个一生难得的机会……现在正是直播劲爆扶她内容最赚钱的时候！

games.name: 我的虫子卖疯了
games.description: 150+像素抽象昆虫在桌面飞舞，多种多样的造景物可供自由装扮。让桌面变成你的饲养箱，繁殖出更多稀有虫子放置赚钱吧！

games.name: Hook and Gun
games.description: A fast-paced 2D top-down action roguelike set in a rising industrial elevator. Use your grappling hook to snatch, corrupt, and turn enemy weapons against them. Battle through relentless waves of security robots, harvest scrap to unlock powerful upgrades and survive the ascent to escape the facility.

games.name: 钢铁怒海
games.description: 设计你的舰船，养成你的旗舰，在钢铁洪流中，书写属于巨舰大炮的浪漫！

games.name: No Elevator
games.description: You as a claustrophobic guy refuse elevators and climb a massive building from the outside, using a plank gun and create your own path.

games.name: Galactic Kebab
games.description: A scenario-driven survival strategy: a stranded chef and his robot cat run a kebab restaurant on a hostile alien world. Serve customers, repair your ship, and stay off the local authority's execution list. You are tolerated, not welcome.

games.name: Your party died again
games.description: 在这款递增式RPG中与邪恶的怪物和恶魔战斗。收集战利品，解锁升级，招募队员，消灭魔王。战略性地使用技能，或开启自动施放，尽情享受冒险之旅。

games.name: 防御前线
games.description: 在经典塔防中掌控路径与火力。未知异形降临地球，你将部署防御塔、封锁关键路口，动态改变敌军的行进路线；通过分支升级、索敌策略与手动火控扭转战局，在世界各地守卫人类防线。

games.name: Wayfar: Crown's Call
games.description: 踏上温馨的 RPG 冒险，走进斯克拉维尼亚——一个交织着古老传说、宫廷阴谋与神秘英雄的世界。踏遍各地、迎战怪物、与旅伴培养羁绊，并决定要把自己的真心……以及整个民族的命运托付给谁。

games.name: Here's My Target
games.description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

games.name: Aadhi Raat आधी रात
games.description: Single Player First Person Shooter set in India. Uncover a massive conspiracy involving personal vendetta, corrupt politicians, and a web of international interests as you fight off men and machines in the streets of an unnamed Indian city.

games.name: Fleshwalk: An Experience
games.description: A transformational and reflective first-person horror experience from the face of Lichen Labs.

games.name: SYSTEM 21
games.description: 以荷官子程序身份、从内部操控二十一点——极简肉鸽构筑。预读可见发牌队列，执行非法代码漏洞改写下一张牌，在系统反作弊发现异常之前，把豪客的钱包掏空。

games.name: 羽盗
games.description: 一款战术网格连招构筑游戏，每回合都是一整套连招，而不是一步行动。在网格上串联你的手牌，触发16种可无限连锁的元素反应，一回合清空全场。谋定而动，狠狠连招，边打边放垃圾话。每一局都是全新的破坏谜题。

games.name: Apocalypse Jumpers
games.description: Welcome to the end of world(s)! Jump from one apocalypse to the next, upgrading your abilities to defeat the hordes that threaten the fabric of the universe.

games.name: Bastyrion: Endless Tide
games.description: 设计并驾驶自定义载具，在超过6000名敌人同时进攻的潮汐中生存。利用真实物理引擎建造从装甲筏到敏捷飞行器的一切。在这个体素肉鸽游戏中，载具是你唯一的避难所——武装到牙齿吧。

games.name: Beyond The Abandoned
games.description: 穿越你那变幻莫测的思维之境，在攀登以重获意识的过程中，直面种种险阻、敌人以及艰难的抉择。

games.name: The Observation Exit
games.description: 第一人称心理恐怖游戏，你必须识别异常，选择正确的电梯以推进进度，并在无尽的医院走廊循环中逃脱，同时躲避致命实体。

games.name: The Blighted Frontier
games.description: Rebuild civilization in a world consumed by the blight. Manage survivors, defend against the dead, and transform a fragile camp into a thriving frontier settlement.

games.name: Crimson Solstice
games.description: A cozy horror adventure. Uncover the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice and decide Moonvale’s fate. Build relationships and manage resources as time is of the essence. Spend your days wisely and help the townsfolk of Moonvale survive.

games.name: Music Manager
games.description: 签下艺人、培养人才、发行音乐，并在 1952 至 2026 年间引领职业生涯穿越巡演、音乐节和不断变化的潮流。

games.name: 雀神·喵喵麻将
games.description: 这个世界的麻将竟是召唤超强使魔的媒介？！穿越而来的雀灵，带上一只招财猫，踏上你的雀神之路吧！

games.name: Sex Idler
games.description: 在罪恶之城打造你的享乐帝国！招募热辣美女，与随从一同壮大事业并赚取丰厚收入。关系越深入，激情越火辣。这座城市已经在等待着你了！ ❤️‍‍🔥

games.name: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
games.description:
昭和时代的学校，夜晚的广播室。在一个你并不孤单的校舍中，你反复进行广播。

奇怪的回应不断出现，未知的记录逐渐累积。

不久，现实开始被侵蚀。十种结局在等待着你。

games.name: Metro Anomaly
games.description: 密切观察办公室职员的行为，找出那个伪装成人类的家伙。你只有一颗子弹来度过这个循环。一旦犯错，异常就会袭击你。

games.name: GET RAMMED
games.description: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

games.name: バレットバラージュ-弾幕乱舞-　 Bullet Barrage
games.description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

games.name: 重制十七岁
games.description: 《重制十七岁》是一款文字冒险类游戏。你将扮演名为梁屿的学生，因为一场意外穿越回十年前的高中。在记忆和现实的差异中，你会找到过去没有留意的许多反常痕迹和发生在三个女生身上的命运。面对现实与虚幻、遗憾与梦境，你的选择会是什么？能否在知晓一切之后，解出最合适的答案？

games.name: 一起扇耳光
games.description: 《一起扇耳光》是一款以扇耳光为主题的体育竞技类游戏，你可以邀请朋友进行激烈的耳光对决，轮流互扇耳光直到有一方倒下决出胜负。

games.name: Rats Survivors
games.description: Survive endless hordes of rats in a fast-paced survivors-like game, upgrade your abilities, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies.

games.name: 冥界村
games.description: 身死入冥界，唯有挣扎求生，方能不堕虚无。狩猎、耕种、战斗、建造、交易，在冥界村一步步站稳脚跟。寻找转世投胎的方法，或干脆留在这里闯出属于自己的一片天地。

games.name: Spooky Ride
games.description: 与 1–4 名玩家组队合作，骑上自行车，深入一片超自然森林寻找 BIGFOOT。追踪奇怪的线索，挺过幽灵般的遭遇，解决合作谜题，并设法平安返回——别让你们的队伍也变成这片森林中的又一个传说。

games.name: SHARDBLASTER!
games.description: SHARDBLASTER! is a third-person arcade arena shooterwhere players control a robot trapped in a fantasy wildland. The robot must mine shards to survive, deliver them to meet quota, and survive periodic "Echo" waves of fantasy monsters. The ultimate goal: destroy the MEGASHARD by any means necessary!

games.name: Gun Massacre
games.description: Return to Survival Horror in decaying mansion filled with echoes of broken glass.

games.name: Apiary in Flow
games.description: Apiary in Flow 是一款带有自动化元素的增量游戏。你将在蜂巢中放置蜜蜂，打造高效的采蜜链。解锁新的蜜蜂种类，并将收获的蜂蜜用于永久技能树升级！

games.name: Space Suits
games.description: Stranded in your failing starship with no crew left, your only lifeline is a mysterious signal pulsing from the depths of space. Explore the galaxy. Unearth ancient technology. Recruit, train and command your crew - or maroon the weak to save oxygen in this roguelike narrative card game.

games.name: 暴富弹球
games.description: 绑架生物，疯狂实验！在这款解压的弹球增量爽游中，把人类和各种奇特生物当做弹珠投进巨型坩埚，击穿钉阵，爆出海量金币！用赚来的巨款点满庞大科技树，开启你的狂欢吧！

games.name: Desert Struggle
games.description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

games.name: Everburning Dark 长夜余烬
games.description:
《长夜余烬》是一款中式民俗恐怖棋盘 Roguelike。你将在有限棋盘上用 2048 式合成战斗构筑流派，并自由输入来影响AI带来的独特叙事、角色、事件、商店、休整、同伴关系与故事路线。

每次深入宁朝末年的黑暗旅途，都会遭遇不同敌人、遗物、异常棋子、战斗策略与剧情分支。你的提问、欺骗、合作或破坏，可能带来新的机会，也可能让世界露出更深的裂缝。

游戏不销售 AI 点数或 Token，也不限制玩家接入自有 AI 大模型。一经购买，即可在旅途中持续体验 AI 自由剧情与同伴互动。

games.name: NUGU?NUGU!: A HIDE AND SEEK BATTLE ROYALE
games.description: A real-time hide-and-seek battle royale. You must blend into a massive crowd of NPCs on a single shared screen. Act like an AI to hide your identity, pickpocket for gold, pick up weapons, and assassinate your opponents. Survive the escalating chaos of sudden death and become the last one standing.

games.name: Horde Reapers
games.description: 独自迎战敌潮与首领，或进行最多 4 人在线合作。利用武器、物品和元素力量打造专属流派，将资源带回村庄，重建家园并解锁永久强化。

games.name: Settled At Sea
games.description: Settled At Sea is a first-person mystery set on a remote Scottish island. You are a lighthouse keeper grieving your wife's death-but the island doesn't feel as isolated as it should.

games.name: ChompBurg
games.description: 操控德古拉的侍从穿越迷宫堡，收集村民并躲避猎人，打破最高分。自定义强化道具来触发连击，成为猎人，将《ChompBurg》变成一台刷分机器，并发现令人多巴胺爆表的协同组合！

games.name: GemPals
games.description: 在GemPals中踏上一段充满活力的合作之旅。与伙伴携手克服激烈的战斗、巧妙的谜题和大胆的平台跳跃。揭开隐藏在世界各地的古老圣宝石，共同恢复和谐。

games.name: Broadside Bets
games.description: 这儿不是赌场，是战场！指挥船员，升级牌组，收集能改写规则的宝藏。发掘毁天灭地的 combo，在分支路线上杀穿敌人，一路遭遇事件、探索岛屿、搜刮宝藏。

games.name: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
games.description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

games.name: 归魂幸存者
games.description: 《归魂幸存者》是一款以《暗黑破坏神》风格的黑暗奇幻世界为舞台的幸存者类动作肉鸽。凭借酣畅的打击感横扫无尽敌潮，吞噬灵魂，夺取首领的技能乃至躯体，化身绝对之恶。

games.name: Souls Divided
games.description: 这是一款单人解谜游戏。将灵魂分为两个形态，各自感知不同的维度。在两种形态间切换，操纵古老器械，在一个失落文明留下的神秘星界中，解开横跨重叠现实的多层谜题。

games.name: Diggems
games.description: Diggems 是一款增量挖矿游戏，你敲碎的每一颗宝石都会堆进你的大厅。砸碎宝石，引发连锁爆炸与闪电，锻造更强的装备，孵化能替你挖矿、搬运和战斗的宠物。闯过每一座矿井，击败守关首领，堆起属于你的最大宝藏。

games.name: Tight Tactics
games.description: 回合制战斗中，选择正确的射击位置和规划移动路线同样重要；游戏采用卡组构筑机制，取代传统的单位升级。

games.name: Casanova Simulator
games.description: 一款类似《夏日/冬日狂想曲》的恋爱养成游戏，玩家将扮演魅力十足的年轻小伙，亲身体验与性格各异的女孩建立浪漫关系的刺激与甜蜜。每一个选择都会影响独特的故事发展和情感联系，让你沉浸在真实的恋爱冒险之中。

games.name: 点击战术：记忆的断章
games.description: 在3×3格子上布阵同伴的点击×自动战斗战术游戏。一波接一波突破蜂拥而至的敌群，以遗物与布阵创造连携。收集记忆，解锁新的同伴与技能，让每一次旅程走得更深的增量式RPG。

games.name: A Game About Shooting Targets
games.description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

games.name: 卡包英雄
games.description: 游玩增量游戏《卡包英雄》，撕开卡包，抽取新的闪卡英雄，每个卡包都有可能开出新的强力角色。抵御无尽的怪物攻势，保卫高塔，在各个国度中奋力前行。

games.name: 挂机放置修仙录
games.description: 组建五人修仙小队，在怪海中刷装备、打副本、挑战无尽。主角自由搭配主攻与战法，伙伴各有资质与专长；淬炼、附魔、重铸、宝石与功法共同塑造你的打法。炼丹突破，经营主城，从凡人踏上仙途。单机买断制，按自己的节奏变强。

games.name: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure
games.description: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure 是一款充满乐趣与探索的 3D 开放世界平台动作游戏，灵感来自 Banjo-Kazooie 等经典作品。加入 Mana 的冒险之旅，学习魔法能力，并帮助她的师父恢复原本的身体。

games.name: Route 340
games.description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

games.name: It's A Flop
games.description: Fish Flopping physics meet party-game chaos! Flop out-of-water across many zany game modes. Customize your aquatic fighter, team up with up to 8 friends locally or online, and flop your way to victory.

games.name: まじかるまじっくワールド２
games.description:
All the main characters are VTubers!!
A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪
One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

games.name: Chimaera Evolution
games.description: Chimaera Evolution is a pixel art monster-capture RPG blending turn-based strategy and survival. Explore a vast world, track down Shiny Chimaeras, master egg breeding, and craft your own gear to become the ultimate master of evolution.

games.name: spin.exe
games.description: Build a battle top in your garage. Draft cassette tapes and wire them into its brain. Pull the cord, and it fights the tournament on its own. A roguelike strategy game where you win on the workbench, or you learn something and go back to the basement to build again.

games.name: Funny Rummy
games.description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

games.name: 落仙泱
games.description:
没有灵根，真的不能修仙吗？
	在《落仙泱》的开放修仙世界里，灵气初蕴，五行灵修、妖修、魔修各得其法，你可以自由扮演凡人或初入仙途的修仙者或其他身份，不断提升，不断抉择，在每个境界里选择功法、搭配法宝、收集灵宠，招募道友，途中看尽九州各势力修仙者的一生经历与挣扎，体会与影响各派系修仙的不同终局...

games.name: Reversi2048
games.description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough — if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

games.name: 守护猫老板
games.description: 《守护猫老板》是一款融合采集机制的 2D 二次元风格俯视角类幸存者游戏。你将扮演少女护卫，一边引导猫老板采集魔晶一边暴打魔物（或被魔物暴打）。

games.name: 小真心AI-2055
games.description: 欢迎来到2055年，你将扮演一个刚被AI替代的年轻人，收留那些被淘汰的AI，走进阿尔法城里的阴影，带着笑与泪，与同伴们逆流前行。

games.name: 归途
games.description: 《归途》是一款灵异题材的调查捕获游戏。玩家将作为新手事务所成员，探索异常事件现场，收集线索。通过了解恶灵的故事和动机来寻找反制方法，并最终进行收容。

games.name: Mechanocide: Fortress Omega
games.description: On a forgotten world, confront a malevolent machine intelligence. Extract minerals, build factories, power up the railguns, and arm the missile batteries. Defend the Fortress Omega against the alloyed nightmare.

games.name: 再转一次
games.description:
这不仅是一台老虎机，更是一场扑克构筑挑战。
转动滚轴，收集卡牌，组成牌型，不断叠加倍率，打出超高分数。
老虎机的随机性与德州扑克的组合策略完美结合，每一次转动都是一次新的选择。

games.name: Scales of the Ibis
games.description: You’re a bird accused of ending the world. Shape your own story in this branching tale of alchemy, friendship, love and betrayal!

games.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
games.description: 将自己的尸体用作垫脚石、重物和盾牌，开辟前路的3D动作解谜游戏。利用每次死亡留下的身体，挑战遍布危险机关的巨大建筑“BOX”。该在哪里死去，又该如何利用尸体？日本搞笑组合“令和ロマン”成员髙比良くるま，首次担任游戏主角。

games.name: Clicker Astro Planet 2
games.description: Click the planet, do prestige, develop businesses with cats, complete space missions, and unlock 80+ achievements while exploring the galaxy in Clicker Astro Planet 2! Perfect for a 100% completion challenge.

games.name: SPLATTER KING
games.description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

games.name: 修仙纪-守护宗门
games.description: 在苍茫修仙世界，你身为宗门核心弟子，肩负守护宗门阵眼的重任。一旦阵眼被破，万年基业将毁于一旦。精心布下防御仙塔，构筑铁壁防线；防线稳固时，深入秘境斩妖除魔，搜集灵材与仙宝。将资源用于塔防升级与仙法觉醒，在一波波凶猛妖魔攻势中，守护宗门最后的希望。你是固守阵眼，还是仗剑主动出击？qq群：805778863

games.name: XENOFLEKT
games.description:
XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into your weapons: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, trigger devastating counter-attacks. 
Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

games.name: Как 2D-тян попала в Омск
games.description: What terrible luck for a 2D anime girl to end up in our world, and in Siberia of all places... Or was it no coincidence?..

games.name: Darkened
