games.description: A 2D dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG with turn-based combat. Fight through dungeons, complete quests, defeat bosses, collect loot, and return to town to prepare for the next run.

games.name: Homestay Queen
games.description:
An intimate visual novel about Edwin, a young man living with his enigmatic host during a year abroad in Japan.
  What begins as cultural wonder slowly unravels into obsession, shame, and desires he can't control.

games.name: Behelade
games.description: Fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up, consisting of 5 stages full of beautiful, intricate patterns and bosses. Wield the magic sword “Behelade” to find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the forest creatures go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

games.name: Onward! Autobattles
games.description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

games.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
games.description: 在充满活力的加勒比风情中经营你自己的冰淇淋店。制作冰淇淋、混合口味、添加配料、为顾客服务、保持店铺整洁、补充食材、雇佣员工，并将小摊发展成一家繁忙的企业。

games.name: 菇菇悠闲汤屋
games.description: 在你的屏幕一角，有着一间专属于菇菇的温泉汤屋。如果待的时间足够长，你可以看到各式各样的菇菇客人争先恐后地前往汤屋之中。菇菇们也许目的地明确，但你要是想和菇菇们亲近一些，他们也不会拒绝和你的互动。

games.name: Leviticus
games.description: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

games.name: Idle Mining Manager
games.description: An idle asteroid mining management simulator.  Earn credits and advance through corporate tiers to expand your range of mining tools, policy upgrades and resource efficiency.  Unlock the history of interstellar mining since the NofVS and, with a little help, uncover the truth behind the propaganda.

games.name: Lost Ball
games.description: 在这款2D物理解谜平台游戏中翻滚、跳跃，让敌人也成为你的帮手。在战役中解锁新能力，用制作游戏本体的同款编辑器设计关卡，通过脚本创建自定义游戏模式，再将作品分享到Steam Workshop。

games.name: Baking With Chocolate
games.description: After losing your university job for impregnating the dean’s wife, you move to a town to open a bakery that specializes in cream pies. Unfortunately for the neighborhood, you quickly become more interested in serving the local women a different kind of creampie. Your typical BBC NTR game in reverse.

games.name: Syntherion
games.description: Syntherion is a top-down space shooter in which each level is built around a single song. The weapons, enemies, environment, and objectives are all derived from that licensed track. The library spans 20+ artists that have signed on, and is still growing.

games.name: Clickomorph
games.description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

games.name: Heavyweight Saint
games.description: Control two bodies bound to one relentless ghost in a dark, dystopian Manhattan. Infiltrate restricted zones using social disguises, vertical stealth, and tactical coordination in an atmospheric third-person stealth game built for VR.

games.name: Lethal Wedding
games.description: Say “I do” to Lethal Wedding, a top-down RPG shooter where the wedding is off, and vengeance is on. When criminal clowns kidnap the groom, the Bride and Mother-in-Law must fight through circus freaks and mafia thugs in this gritty 16-bit experience of bullets and blood.

games.name: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！
games.description: （本作根据真实事件改编）你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

games.name: aeroDays
games.description: An online co-op 3D platformer where you spray water, clean up messy places, and explore a colorful glassy world with your friends. Inspired by the promised 2000s future, where it's full of water and nature.

games.name: Space Gnomes
games.description: Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

games.name: 二阶勇者 Second Phase Hero
games.description:
《二阶勇者》是一款Boss Rush动作游戏
玩家将扮演勇者，在那一晚的20年后踏上为父亲复仇的路，利用武器和技能打败各种强大的Boss，并利用体内的二阶之力让自己变得更加强大!

games.name: Football on Paper
games.description: A simultaneous turn-based football game. You talk big. Draw the next minute. Watch your boys run it. Every tackle, shot and save is a d20 roll. Guess what the other manager will do, because they are guessing you.

games.name: Back to the Pussy - Season 1
games.description:
发明家爷爷去世后，克西终于有机会弥补过去的错误，还有机会和当年没能搞定的所有女孩上床！
这是一个既搞笑又大胆、毫不掩饰的性感故事，讲述了一个彻头彻尾的失败者如何获得一台时光机，并将其潜力发挥到极致。

games.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
games.description: 世界已经崩塌。动物们崛起并进化出了智慧。构筑你的卡组，加固据点，部署军队，然后见证你的动物帮派在末日战争的混乱中展开自动战斗！

games.name: Pile Goes Up
games.description: "Pile Goes Up" is a roguelike deck‑builder where you stack cards in order… but you are in hell, and the devil cheats. As rounds progress, your deck destabilizes, piles grow harsher, and devilish tricks escalate. Use the shop, discover synergies, and cheat your way to salvation.

games.name: INTERNS
games.description: 一款以医学院实习生为背景的生活模拟游戏——结交朋友，树敌，卷入危险的阴谋，并在这个界限模糊的世界里不要迷失自我。魅力四射的角色、紧张又充满喜剧色彩的剧情，以及充满诱惑的真实氛围。

games.name: Penguin Weapons
games.description: Penguin Weapons 是一款动态动作 roguelite，讲述企鹅收集神器，创造荒谬疯狂的武器，对抗怪物和头目，解锁时尚服装，并探索越来越困难的世界，充满独特组合和不可预测性。

games.name: Fixpert
games.description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

games.name: STEEL GULLET
games.description: 在移动的方舟上建造一座宏伟的工厂。利用现实的热力学来熔化、分离和精炼混乱的废料。按质量而非按件数处理材料，根据材料属性进行制造，并在严格受限的空间内优化复杂的生产线。

games.name: 云游VR
games.description: 翻开一本会带你旅行的书，瞬间置身真实重建的高斯空间场景。《云游》是一款以 Gaussian Splatting 技术为核心的 VR 文旅沉浸体验游戏。翻页即可进入高度还原的 3D 景观，自由行走、近距离欣赏风景，并聆听当地历史文化故事。轻松、沉浸、富有诗意，每一次翻页都是一场心灵的远行。

games.name: Untold Memories: Grandma's House
games.description: Rick 被迫在祖母家住上一周，而每一晚都变得更加诡异不安。探索这座充满低语的房子，在超自然事件中努力生存，并揭开隐藏在这一切背后的秘密——同时，一个警告始终在你脑海中回响：永远不要进入地下室。

games.name: Hexboard Driver
games.description: Build the road before the journey begins! Rotate and swap hexagonal tiles to create a valid path and guide your sports car to its destination through colorful arcade-inspired worlds. A relaxing puzzle game with the charm and style of classic 90s arcade games.

games.name: Kinetic Conundrum
games.description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

games.name: RE∀IVE
games.description: RE∀IVE is a 2D action metroidvania set on the war-torn artificial island of Atrificia. Switch between a former soldier and his damaged AI companion, Lily, unlock new abilities, and uncover the city’s hidden truth.

games.name: DOOMFRONT
games.description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

games.name: Don't Step Wrong 2
games.description: A logic puzzle game where the rules are yours to discover. Navigate grids of mysterious blocks, deduce hidden patterns, and use skills and items to forge your own path through each challenge.

games.name: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
games.description: 击打弹球装置来赚取金钱，扩展你的技能树，放置更多弹球装置，在这款放置类弹球游戏中致富吧！

games.name: A Proof Apart
games.description: 《A Proof Apart》是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。踏入一位数学家支离破碎的心智。依靠毁灭性的成瘾机制扭曲现实，探索不断变化的环境，并躲避由你的悲伤幻化而成的恐怖事物。真实与谎言，仅有一口酒的距离。

games.name: What The Dog Doing?
games.description:
一款位于屏幕一角的休闲闲置挖掘游戏。
当你最好的朋友挖掘物品、收集宝藏并解锁新的生物群系和服装时，尽情工作（或摸鱼）吧。

games.name: Fishing Factory
games.description: 一款结合悠闲钓鱼与轻度自动化的治愈系沙盒游戏。钓鱼、养殖、加工渔获，逐步拓展你的海滨事业，升级装备，探索生机盎然的海岸。无论独自游玩，还是与朋友携手经营，都能按照自己的步调，享受悠闲时光，体会事业逐渐壮大的成就感。

games.name: 女英雄战斗竞技场：堕落竞技场
games.description: 《女英雄战斗竞技场：堕落竞技场》登场！这是一款可弱化女英雄，并与她战斗的3D变身H模拟游戏！邪恶组织精心布下的陷阱，正悄然逼近守护城市、战无不胜的女英雄。对被俘的女英雄施加快感以夺取她的魔力，再通过淫靡的改造逐步削弱她吧！安排女英雄在秘密竞技场中迎战魔物，迫使她屈服吧！

games.name: Starherald
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description:
收集
击败星际海盗获取珍贵的材料，在星球表面开采矿石，收集星球上的各类稀缺资源

制造
利用收集到的材料进行制造和逆向工程

扩张
建造基地占领更高等级的星球，解锁更强大的敌人、更稀有的材料、更高级的制造配方

丰富的舰船和装备体系
多个种族、吨位、等级、型号——从灵活的小型侦察舰船到毁天灭地的行星级巨兽，每一台舰船都有独特的定位与用途

开放的星际经济
玩家驱动的全自由市场，跨星球的贸易网络

危险与机遇并存
星际海盗和外星怪物横行于各个星球，当地原住民急需你的支援，舰长、你准备好了吗！

games.name: ERI: Emotive Rhythm Interaction
games.description: ERI: Emotive Rhythm Interaction is a rhythm game that combines numpad and mouse inputs. Discover a new rhythm experience through dynamic controls and interactions with bullet patterns.

games.name: Project ACCIPITER
games.description:
"We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!"
Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

games.name: Dig Out of The Backrooms
games.description: Dive into the Backrooms! Grab your pickaxe and shovel and dig your way to freedom. Gather resources, upgrade your tools, and dig deeper. Explore mysterious corridors, but beware - something dangerous may be lurking in the dark. Dig. Survive. Escape!

games.name: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case
games.description: Spring break at Briarwood College turns lethal when a student is found dead on campus. Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.

games.name: Room Zero
games.description: 一款第一人称心理悬疑游戏，故事发生在一个本不该存在的阈限空间中。

games.name: Saviour & Religion
games.description:
Saviour & Religion　拯救者与信仰
连自己的身分都毫无记忆，在漆黑的地牢中醒来，在寻回自己记忆的过程充斥著行为扭曲怪诞的病人、目的不明的医生、古老建筑中不知为何设置的致命机关，诡异的邪神信仰……
这是一个关于愿望、信仰、真实与虚幻，还有拯救的故事。

games.name: Backrooms: Impending Doom
games.description: 科考队已经消失。轮到你了。一款发生在 Backrooms 中的第一人称心理恐怖游戏 - 探索破败的层级，维持你的同步率稳定，查明是什么摧毁了你的队伍。免费试玩版：Prologue。

games.name: Vroomity Loops
games.description: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

games.name: Dead Hand
games.description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

games.name: Long Rescue
games.description:
Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. 

Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis.

Will you rescue your dog?

games.name: 流明娜：黎明再临
games.description: 中世纪奇幻风格的女儿养成模拟游戏，融合冒险与恋爱元素。你是一位单亲父亲，女儿成长的每一步，都由你来决定。学习、冒险、交友、恋爱……70+种结局，每一次重来都是全新的故事。准备好，把最可爱的她养大成人了吗？

games.name: SU-93 Survivor
games.description: Survive room after room in a tactical survivor-like: rebuild your weapons every fight, keep your passive items, and create stronger synergies with every choice.

games.name: Pump Away!
games.description: A railroad adventure that sits at the bottom of your screen! Click to make the car go brrr or let it idle - this cat and dog duo will pump away and liven up your desktop.

games.name: 窗台世界（Sill World）
games.description: 这是一款桌面壁纸引擎，也是猫娘陪伴和专注工具。养花、养鱼、装修、压花工坊都在，还有上千种收藏。几乎一切都能自定义，你的壁纸，你说了算！

games.name: The Day I Started Harvesting
games.description: 一款放置点击游戏，简单的收获逐渐演变成更加奇怪的东西。扩展你的田地，雇佣工人，在害虫、风暴和各种诡异事件中生存下来，而你的平静日常正慢慢走向混乱。

games.name: Phantom: Hidden Sins
games.description: As an independent police consultant, you're pulled into the hunt for a serial killer leaving cryptographic ciphers. Play as a detective, analyze crime scenes, and master real decryption methods. Your choices determine if you catch the killer and how many lives are saved.

games.name: Dig to Mole Dorado
games.description: Burrow deep into the earth in this short incremental digging game. Hunt for treasure, upgrade your powers and experience the low-key story of a mole and his dad on a grand adventure.

games.name: 紀事盆栽 Potted Archive
games.description: Potted Archive is an idle desktop companion blending sci-fi storytelling with plant cultivation. Grow over 20 exotic plants in a transparent, low-energy window. As they evolve, unlock diary entries to uncover an epic tale of interstellar exile right from your screen.

games.name: KILLWORLD
games.description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

games.name: 나의 별난 스트리머!
games.description: 《我的怪咖主播!》是一部视觉小说,讲述了喜欢看凌晨网络节目的就业准备生主人公与初学者恩菲相遇后发生的故事。 我奇怪的主播是一个基于文本的游戏，可以通过各种选择和交互来接触故事。 通过游戏中的选项来了解各种结局吧。

games.name: NODGE
games.description: Don’t get hit. Everything else gets harder.

games.name: 体素狂飙
games.description: 在这款无速度上限且没有刹车的迷幻风超高速竞速游戏中，在旋转的宇宙圆柱体表面极限擦边并疯狂加速，单局不到30秒且触碰即死，随时准备迎接肾上腺素的狂飙。挑战世界纪录，与幽灵回放竞速，或是叫上7位好友来一场别开生面的竞速对决！

games.name: BIG PARTY
games.description: A fast, chaotic online party brawl with a Wild West twist. Race through quick minigames with up to 12 outlaws: dodge the curse before it turns you into a werewolf, or outrun a collapsing floor. Proximity voice, 10 languages, and full controller support.

games.name: Orb in the Deep Waters
games.description: A dark underwater roguelite built around sound and darkness. Use your sonar to navigate the abyss, hunt fragments, and survive what lurks in the deep. Fail. Learn. Descend again.

games.name: Pizza Boy
games.description: A pizzeria simulator where you can take customers orders, make pizzas, and manage your shop.

games.name: Mercenary Brotherhood
games.description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company,  survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

games.name: Mio·共鸣
games.description: 与会记住你的 AI 角色实时语音交流。自定义人设、外观与声音，创造独一无二的伙伴，并通过桌宠模式让陪伴常驻你的桌面。

games.name: 小组件放置 Widget Idle
games.description:
你的电脑桌面，就是游戏手柄！
每一次点击、每一次按键、每一次鼠标移动，都在让你的小小世界不断成长。Widget Idle会安静地待在桌面的一角，陪你忙活生活中那些更重要的事情，让忙碌的点击多一点点快乐 :)

games.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
games.description: 1-6人合作生存恐怖游戏。录下你真实的尖叫声，当它夺走你时就会播放。探索程序生成的森林，直面恐惧，在森林决定留下你之前逃脱。

games.name: Debts & Jackpots
games.description: 一款放置游戏，在这里你将敲开保险箱，发现奇特的奖励，升级你的业务，在追逐巨额头奖的过程中摆脱沉重的债务。

games.name: 炽火永燃
games.description:
《炽火永燃》是一款动作搜打撤游戏。
玩家将扮演一名“逐花者”为平息尘世灾祸前往彼岸世界。
你需要在彼界中搜索物资，与灾影战斗，并安全撤离。
通过搜索物资逐渐强化自身，迎战更为强大的灾影并揭开尘世降灾的真相。

games.name: 座敷童男友 ILOVE拉面
games.description: 《座敷童男友 ILOVE拉面》是一款体验拉面制作的同时享受温馨剧情的“恋爱喜剧文字冒险游戏”。

games.name: FEED IT
games.description: A co-op game where you are camping in the woods, enjoying the night when you hear a walkie buzzing. A emergency broadcast warns campers in the area: something is in the forest and you are not alone. Feed your campfire or you will become the food.

games.name: Abyss Hunter: Lust Awakening
games.description: 白天，女猎手们与怪物厮杀；到了夜晚，她们会臣服于你，只为你卸下铠甲 🍒🍑 强化你的公会，与性感女猎手拉近关系，解锁火热约会和大胆露骨的动画场景 💦 接下来会发生什么，全由你决定 😈🔥

games.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
games.description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: AdorableCat
games.description:
一款与可爱猫咪相伴的温馨治愈系桌面陪伴游戏。
成为猫咪的铲屎官，把各种各样的猫咪迎接成为家人，照顾它们，享受相伴的日常时光。

games.name: Rowan Needs Shinies!
games.description: A whimsical incremental game with a colorful cast of critters. Help the greedy crow Rowan gather more shinies with the help of the local wildlife. Discover how to craft strange potions and empower your new friends. All so that you can gather EVEN MORE SHINIES!

games.name: Caravanserai Simulator
games.description: 在残酷的丝绸之路上建造、管理和扩张你自己的贸易据点。从井里打水，照料商人的骆驼，进行货物交易，并将你的商队驿站从一个满是灰尘的营地升级为一个繁荣的沙漠帝国。

games.name: Ami's Pearl Dive
games.description: Ami's Pearl Dive is a quaint underwater adventure game developed for the Game Boy Color! Help Ami dive deeper to find her missing mermaid friend, collect pearls and meet interesting faces along the way!

games.name: 择机而行
games.description: 一个简单的见面计划，究竟能变得多复杂？Flight Date 是一款逻辑解谜游戏，你需要把荒唐又错综复杂的旅行计划理顺，找出正确的路线。解开物流混乱，也别错过每次相聚留下的那些小小瞬间。

games.name: increTower
games.description: 一款短小的增量塔防游戏。升级防御塔，升级敌人，循环往复！

games.name: Fishing Fever
games.description: 一款增量式 Roguelike 钓鱼游戏。从一件渔具起步，到五件渔具收场。抽取、升级、叠加，然后在八片海域追猎 70 种鱼，直到整片海同时咬钩。对手会偷走你的卡牌。黑暗里的某个东西，早已知道你的名字。再来一局。永远都是再来一局。

games.name: What Was Lost
games.description: A cooperative narrative puzzle game about what a couple leaves behind. Two players, two timelines - Past and Present - share a house that remembers everything. Solve together. Remember together. Six chapters playable now in Early Access; the finale arrives in a free update.

games.name: Hyperline
games.description: 高速太空竞技场,2–8 名玩家对战。你的飞船会留下永久光迹填满竞技场 —— 碰到任何光迹、墙壁或飞船即被淘汰。与朋友在线对战或单人挑战机器人。20 艘可解锁飞船、房主自定义规则、Steam 成就与排行榜。

games.name: Super Ragdoll Runner Ultimate
games.description: Super Ragdoll Runner Ultimate is a stupid precision platformer with ragdoll physics.

games.name: Tubular Tides
games.description: 带着你可靠的游泳圈在海上漂流！探索丰富多样的岛屿，揭开隐藏的秘密，在这款令人放松的寻宝冒险游戏中尽情享受。

games.name: Index 1391
games.description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

games.name: Binary Proof
games.description: 测试专家 Aaron Blonde 在平凡的工作日中陷入了离奇诡异的事件。在这个超越逻辑的设施里，他必须利用环境中的一切细节并克服障碍，以尽快逃离这里。

games.name: The Sin Of Fabien
games.description: Maybe you didn’t do it… but you watched. The Sin of Fabien is a psychological horror experience woven around guilt, denial, and silence, where every choice reshapes the world and the story. Each decision brings you closer to the truth… or pulls you further away from it forever.

games.name: THE OMEGA REACH
games.description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

games.name: XENOFALL
games.description: 一款设定在沦陷地球上的单人动漫动作肉鸽游戏。在重重敌意关卡中斩杀、射爆外星怪物，堆叠足以打破规则的道具连携，精通 5 大战斗职业。每一局都截然不同，每一次死亡都让你更强大。

games.name: Greedy Getaways
games.description: Greedy Getaways is a game that you play with your friends to have a good laugh! You can choose teamwork or be greedy, stuffing your pockets with gems and gold. There's puzzles, goofy physics and lots of laughs.

games.name: GET HIM!
games.description: 终于可以带着朋友一起揍其中一个朋友了！一人被选中。其他人用拳头、家具或武器把他打趴！但别忘了，下一个可能就是你！

games.name: Gnat Pack
games.description: 这是一款简短的渐进式游戏，游戏内容是喂养一群饥饿的蚋。引导你的小虫子去吃水果，并解锁升级功能，让你的嗡嗡叫伙伴们一口一口地长大。

games.name: Watermellionaire
games.description: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

games.name: Counter Targets Clicker
games.description: 款带有渐进式剧情的轻量放置系打靶游戏。通过射击靶子来赚取金钱、购买升级、解锁并定制你的专属武器。

games.name: Voxel Breakers
games.description: Voxel Breakers - 一款轻松的增量游戏，你可以破坏体素，购买并升级破坏机器人，然后看着它们替你越来越快地破坏体素。

games.name: Smawverse
games.description: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?

games.name: Street Food Restaurant Owner
games.description: 打造属于你的街头美食生意！烹制美味餐点，招待饥肠辘辘的顾客，管理食材，解锁新食谱并维护声誉，将一家小小的街边摊发展成当地的传奇美食地标。

games.name: Idle Golf
games.description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

games.name: Get-Out-Hoomanz
games.description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

games.name: 熬夜与修仙
games.description: 在三层八卦阵盘上摆放功法、法器与材料，搭出自己的修仙流派，与其他修士异步斗法。免费 DEMO 现已开放，包含天河剑宗与泰岳千机门。倒悬远征开发中，计划加入大地图寻宝、秘境探索与带宝归城。

games.name: C.A.G.E.
games.description: 《C.A.G.E.》是一款讽刺性第一人称叙事冒险游戏。在一个道德存疑的实体的引导下，你必须在企业的煤气灯操纵和环境异象中摸索前行以完成任务。你的同理心是一个系统故障，顺从才是你的通行货币。

games.name: Ember's Oath
games.description: Play as Ember, a fire mage with the unique ability to transform herself into a phoenix. In a world where mages have been hunted to extinction, you must master the synergy between your human spells and phoenix powers in order to defeat your foes in this third-person, combat-focused fantasy adventure!

games.name: 蓝琥珀
games.description: 这是一部关于创造与魔法的短篇视觉小说。作为散步社最后的成员时琴，与热爱摄影的少女云夏结伴同行，校外森林、海崖灯塔、倒悬的古船废墟、山顶的禁区迷雾......在毕业列车到来之前，在散步中探寻着传说能实现任何愿望的蓝琥珀。一张不属于任何人的旧照片，悄悄揭开这座永恒夏日海岛的秘密。

games.name: Blokour
games.description: Jump, build and fight through the dungeons of Blokour! In this puzzle platformer, you place and break blocks whilst solving puzzles and dodging dangerous traps. Featuring 125 levels, 4 boss fights and more than 60 different types of blocks, you'll venture through a wide range of exciting challenges.

games.name: A GAME of stacking cardboard boxes AND DROWNING YOUR FRIENDS
games.description: As the title states, A GAME of stacking cardboard boxes AND DROWNING YOUR FRIENDS is a game where you build levels from cardboard boxes and challenge your friends to a race.

games.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
games.description: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

games.name: PANEMA
games.description: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

games.name: 超时空怪盗
games.description:
是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。
千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

games.name: Keeper of The Strait
games.description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

games.name: Tentacle Nurse
games.description: 👻 Tentacle Nurse is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game 😈 where you explore a Haunted Apartment while a seductive, Obsessive-kinky Tentacle Nurse ❤️ constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you. 👻

games.name: Duck Shoot
games.description: Duck shoot is an arcade-simulation game where you play as Ashley, an aspiring photographer and a tourist on a mission to capture the perfect duck shot. Guiding her is Momo, a cheeky yet  adorable monkey as her mentor.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.description: 这是一款支持近距离语音聊天的非对称恐怖躲猫猫游戏。在游戏里你需要躲藏，狩猎，然后逃出生天！在游戏里你可以选择化身成为道具在人类阵营中求生，或者选择扮演东南亚民间传说中的恐怖恶鬼展开狩猎。

games.name: Farm.exe
games.description: 种植、收获、装饰并自定义你的桌面。解锁全新作物，发现隐藏宝藏，创造一个随着时间推移愈发美丽的空间。

games.name: Astromino
games.description: A roguelite battle against cosmic evils - drop customized polyominoes, collect relics, and execute powerful combos to defeat your enemies!

games.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor
games.description: 一款增量式六边形解谜 Roguelite 游戏。在这里，你可以合并原子以合成更高阶的元素，触发大规模的连锁连击，赚取放射性硬币，并管理你的光环容量，尽可能地生存更长时间。

games.name: We Are Rebellion
games.description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

games.name: Neon Arcade
games.description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

games.name: Fearless Crew
games.description: Fearless Crew is a  monster-hunter  co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

games.name: Magnus Onus
games.description: Delve into a dark fantasy 2D/3D world that is cursed with an endless night. Fight and survive each passing night harnessing the power of elemental affinities. Craft cards, build your deck, and combine items in unique ways to fend off the corruption and restore the flow of time.

games.name: Singularity Echoes
games.description: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.

games.name: SpringTale
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 在这款 Roguelike 平台动作类 MMO 中，与他人一同探索、战斗与游玩。在不断变化的世界中冒险，结识其他玩家，并组队挑战强力首领；收集强力装备，打造属于你的独特玩法。

games.name: The Final Days of Olin Earl
games.description: Investigate, trespass, eavesdrop, and platform through a would-be murder mystery as a lovable old grandpa who made a deal with Death for all the right reasons.

games.name: Exipath
games.description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

games.name: BURIED INSIDE ME
games.description: What if you couldn’t wake up from your worst nightmare? BURIED INSIDE ME is a first-person psychological horror experience where you find yourself trapped within your own dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive yourself.

games.name: 方块机
games.description:
方块机是以俄罗斯方块与老虎机为灵感的消除肉鸽游戏。
拉下拉杆，你将一次次的随机与抉择中完成消除，得到更多道具获取更高的分数。

games.name: Just Dying
games.description: 一款以主播为主角的类幸存者肉鸽。拯救你的粉丝以免失业，解锁独特角色，堆叠强力符文，化身纯粹混乱的破坏球。学习。死亡。重来。

games.name: Luna Hop
games.description: Experience Seoul in Luna Hop, a 3D adventure sharing the essence of K-Culture. Explore Gyeongbokgung Palace to the melodies of Arirang, blending tradition with modern charm. We are committed to evolving this journey into a global masterpiece. Join us and experience the heart of K-Gaming!

games.name: Animal Clicking
games.description: 《动物点击》Animal Clicking）是一款画风可爱、氛围舒适的岛屿建设游戏。它巧妙地将种田、自动化和资源管理，与点击类游戏让人欲罢不能的循环机制融合在一起，为你带来前所未有的沙盒体验。

games.name: 面条条：野兽版
games.description: 一款轻松挂机网络建造游戏。铺设连线、建立节点。代币沿着你的网络流动，不断相遇、合并，最终带着更高的价值获得收益——收益用来建造更多节点，节点用来……你已经明白了。

games.name: On Time In Full
games.description:
Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation 
where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

games.name: Tsuchinoko Fishing
games.description:
"Tsuchinoko　Fishing" is a fishing romance adventure game.
In this game, you'll fish in various locations, solve problems, and deepen your relationship with the heroine!

games.name: 面条电缆
games.description: 面条电缆科技公司欢迎你的加入！理顺并接好巨型电缆，破解一个个房间里的谜题，探索颠覆想象的超现实空间。

games.name: CRIKEYMAS
games.description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

games.name: SHADOW LINK～Two Of Me～
games.description: 本作是一款轻度Rogue生存动作游戏。玩家将操控公主，挥舞各种可爱的童话武器击溃如潮水般涌来的敌人。本作最大的特色是与完全再现你过去行动的影子并肩作战的共斗系统！你不仅要拼命逃跑求生，还需为下一次游玩考虑装备构筑和战略走位。击败每5波来袭的巨大BOSS，努力在单局约20分钟、共计40波的战斗中生存下来通关吧！

games.name: 幸福里:生门
games.description: 《幸福里：生门》是一款支持1–4人联机的第一人称恐怖解谜游戏。探索不断变化的研究设施，搜集线索、破解不同的谜题，在随机出现的房间与出口之间寻找正确的道路。你可以和队友认真分析答案，也可以放弃思考，随便推开一扇门赌赌运气——只是下一间房会通向哪里，没人知道。

games.name: 猫猫挖掘公司
games.description:
猫猫挖掘公司是一款挖矿主题的增量游戏.
咪是主角。咪将获得咪神的宝藏。

games.name: Up-Beat!!
games.description: Up-Beat!! is an action-packed boxing game heavily inspired by Punch-Out!! - fight through a colorful cast of characters and take your place in history as the WFBA's new world champion!

games.name: My Friend, the Wickhorn
games.description: 一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。照顾你的猫，维持偏远山间小屋的运转，并逐步揭开父亲隐秘的过去，与侵蚀你朋友的古老诅咒之间的联系。

games.name: CelSector
games.description: 这是一款2D科幻横版动作游戏。在一座被生物梦魇占领的设施中，你必须为了生存而战。用丰富的枪械武器轰碎敌人，深度自定义你的角色外观，并努力避开各种危险、陷阱以及异种突变。

games.name: Virtual Karting
games.description: A ground-up karting simulator built on real racing experience. Authentic chassis flex, VR mimicked body weight shift, and tire dynamics that make a kart feel truly alive.

games.name: Off Course
games.description:
Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself
stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her
roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

games.name: Adventures in tower defence land
games.description: go on an epic tower defence adventure collecting rare parts and craft the ultimate combination of towers while meeting silly characters on your way

games.name: Mortis Loop
games.description: Die. Learn. Repeat. Mortis Loop is a 2D pixel art platformer where every death makes the world more dangerous. Master deadly traps, meet quirky characters, and break the loop — if you can.

games.name: 下海滩–赌博之圣传说 DX
games.description: 被称为新世代「赌圣」的男人，为了打倒传说中的「赌魔」；踏入了由她掌管的海上非法赌场「巨金城」。在那里等待着他的，是千金城麾下的三名美女干部。赌上性命与快乐的胜负，将从这里开始！

games.name: AI Apocalypse
games.description: 赛博朋克 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。用近战、法术或步枪反抗 AI 末日 —— 3 种武器职业、9 条 build 路线、120+ 张卡牌。每一局都是关于站位、距离与卡组协同的全新战术谜题。

games.name: VERteX-1: AINIA
games.description: VERteX-1: AINIA is a game that combines tower defense and first-person shooting with a retrofuturistic vector art style. Analyze the levels to devise defense strategies and prevent attackers from destroying the simulation that keeps humanity alive.

games.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
games.description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

games.name: Citizen Pain II
games.description: Citizen Pain II is a unique old-school first-person action RPG experience featuring insane challenge, fast gameplay intensity and instantly rewarding combat. Begin a dark journey and experience secret dungeons, hidden hazards and terrifyng enemy encounters.

games.name: Waddle Detour
games.description: 帮助超讨人喜欢的企鹅 Waddly 抵达它的钓鱼地点吧！这是一款看似萌趣可爱、实则颇具挑战的益智游戏。组合不同方块，发挥它们独特的能力，找到属于你自己的解法，让 Waddly 不必再饿肚子太久！

games.name: Airlock
games.description: Explore a ruined city, rescue survivors, and build a thriving underground sanctuary. Every survivor unlocks new professions, technologies, and opportunities as you rebuild humanity beneath the surface while surviving the horrors above.

games.name: Vertigo Trials
games.description: Overcome a meteoric storm of obstacles with rhythmic platforming precision. Every run will train your fluidity for the final reward.

games.name: The Back Door: Emergence
games.description: It's 2015. While urban exploring an abandoned building with your friends, you lose sight of them. Suddenly, you end up in a strange place consisting only of abnormal spaces and places that seem... strangely familiar. Is this all there is? Or most importantly... are you truly alone?

games.name: 石中剑
games.description:
你是西幻故事的女主……但你是一把剑！
斯威拉沃是一座历史悠久的城市，而你只是一把在当地图书馆中沉睡的石中剑。一切与你好像都无关紧要，直到你醒来，你被赋予了一次机会，化身成人，生活在这座城市之中。

games.name: Loopfall
games.description: 硬核反应街机。两个按键，三种模式，一条残酷的霓虹隧道。躲避无尽的门、击中限时电门，或穿过胶囊地雷——在为技术而非运气打造的赛道上，攀登全球 Steam 排行榜。

games.name: Anvilia
games.description: 与伙伴合作经营中世纪铁匠铺。收集资源、锻造工具、为货架补货，打造蓬勃发展的事业。

games.name: Red Rising
games.description: 在官方数字版获奖桌游中，与最多 6 名玩家争夺统治权。组建追随者手牌，连锁强大 combo，在 Red Rising 的反乌托邦世界中带领你的家族走向胜利。

games.name: Game Show But Evil
games.description: A quiz show...but different!

games.name: Beyond The Blight
games.description: 《Beyond The Blight》是一款第一人称 2.5D 放置类地下城探索游戏。搜刮战利品、强化自身、不断变强，使命只有一个：找到并击败腐化之源。

games.name: GUN x FARM
games.description:
Start blasting the farm up before you get taken overrun by farm enemies. Get guns, upgrades, abilities and mow down everything you see.
A bullet hell with roguelite and incremental elements.

games.name: SOS！恋爱~操控
games.description: 《SOS！恋爱~操控》是一款主打电影感的真人互动影视恋爱游戏。你将扮演一名普通大学生，在某个夜晚误入名为「SOS」的酒吧，并结识几位性格各异的女性：隐藏二次元身份的大小姐石煦、温柔又危险的酒吧老板娘 Naomi、封闭而敏感的Lolita少女废墟….一次看似随意的结伴出行，逐渐演变为一场无法解释的旅程。

games.name: 元素牌 灵魂之隙
games.description:
《元素牌：灵魂之隙》 是一款深度融合了“属性克制”与“非线性地图探索”的单机 Rogue-lite 卡牌构筑游戏。你将作为迷失在时空乱流中的探索者，深入神秘的“时空裂隙”，在与各种灵魂力量的碰撞中，收集散落的元素碎片，构筑属于你的终极牌组。
不要被表面简单的数值所欺骗。在这里，出牌位置决定了技能的连携，元素的相互克制能让强大的敌人瞬间战力归零。你需要在一场场生死对决与轮流抓牌的博弈中，巧妙规划资源，挑战那些盘踞在隐藏节点深处的深渊主宰。

games.name: Bio-Breaker
games.description: Fight against over 25+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

games.name: Caladrius 2/Dark Element
games.description:
在美丽与黑暗支配的黑暗哥特世界中……
疯狂系统‘羞耻破坏’问世十余年后，禁忌再度回归！
由多位知名插画师亲手绘制的个性十足的角色，将驰骋于暗黑战场！
元素射击、羞耻破坏全面进化！2D射击游戏带来的爽感与性感的视觉表现，直顶游戏巅峰。

games.name: Digi Dice
games.description: A rogue-like dice-building game. Craft your own dice, play them strategically, upgrade your modifiers and discover magnificent combos.

games.name: 盖亚传说：重生
games.description: 《盖亚传说：重生》是一款 2D 横向动作冒险游戏。在神权、盖亚派与罪恶势力相互角力的永恒大陆上，踏上充满未知与危险的旅程。探索各个区域、迎战强大的敌人，收集散落各地的重生圣物碎片。

games.name: 天堂恋爱王
games.description: 找服装，与天使谈恋爱，建立后宫！在天堂恋爱王里开启一场轻松的旅程，并建造一个独一无二的后宫。

games.name: The Park Keeper
games.description: 管理一座国家公园，而某种东西显然正试图从里面逃出去。审查游客、掩盖事故，并让所有人相信一切都在控制之中。

games.name: tinymancer
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: A tiny, eerie online world with Deckbuilding, Creature Collection, Housing, Crafting, Exploration, and Cartridge mini-games.

games.name: To Find A Home
games.description: You're a witch who has just been evicted. Your only option for tonight? A haunted house full of fellow supernaturals. Find love and friendship in this supernatural amare VN with found family feels, 3 love interests and multiple endings.

games.name: Drum Incremental
games.description: 每次点击都充满节奏感的放置/递进游戏。敲击节奏模式，赚取节奏点数，解锁新技巧，打造你的终极装备。无需音乐经验——只需想要继续前进的欲望。

games.name: Last Lawn Standing
games.description: 从拥有不同属性加成的花园侏儒中选择角色，守护神龛，抵御邪恶势力。白天升级防御塔与武器，布置花卉防御塔，改变夜间来袭敌群的行进路线。你能撑过多少个夜晚？每局挑战都独一无二。

games.name: Reunion Fate
games.description:
Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe.
Use the flame to guide you through the darkness.
Explore familiar and unfamiliar places.
Hide from them.
No one will tell you what you want to hear.

games.name: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
games.description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

games.name: Stone Age Assassin
games.description: A first-person horror game set in the Stone Age, where the story explores fear through situations completely different from the conventional. Gather fruits, craft recipes, and venture into unknown places.

games.name: Undershroom
games.description: 深入一场超现实的心理恐怖体验，熟悉的场景开始违背熟悉的规则。探索周围的一切，揭开曾经发生的真相，并判断你是否还能相信自己的双眼。

games.name: The Lifeline
games.description:
想要逃离这座恐怖的医院，你必须抛下心中的恐惧。你能做到吗？

探索未知，直面丧尸，使用武器，躲避陷阱，迅速反应，才能活下去。

games.name: Clickerite
games.description: Clickerite是一款增量游戏，你必须在立方体世界中收集材料、制作强大的工具并与邪恶怪物战斗 !

games.name: 必须装得下！
games.description: 这是一款益智解谜游戏——变形、合成、打破物品，通过各种手段填满网格。无论用什么办法，最后必须装得下！

games.name: House Of Trauma
games.description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

games.name: Chromagami
games.description: Team up with a comrade to fight an interdimensional paper war in this science-fiction, hero shooter.

games.name: Cards of Bellum
games.description: 一款中世纪策略卡牌游戏，幸运的骰子掷出可将必败之局转为辉煌胜利... 带领独特英雄，如巫师或具名骑士。构筑你的牌组。突袭首都。夺取王座。

games.name: Linkominoes
games.description: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game where overlapping squares form connected structures. Unwind with the satisfaction of placing pieces and building patterns, or take on unique challenges that put spatial planning and strategy to the test.

games.name: ALL GAS
games.description: ALL GAS 是一款无尽的车流穿梭类 Roguelike，每一局都截然不同。在程序生成的空中无限高速公路上挑战极限，穿梭密集车流，找准路线，并冲击全球排行榜。

games.name: Silicon Architect
games.description: 一款采用 Windows XP 风格界面的渐进式硬件工程游戏。配置并优化处理器组件，打造专属 CPU，并运行自动化基准测试。收集遥测数据并筹集研究资金，以解锁全新硬件并提升计算能力。

games.name: 命运牌桌
games.description: 《命运牌桌》是一款以德州扑克为内核的单机牌局 Roguelite。观察对手、判断牌力、管理筹码，在 Pre-Flop、Flop、Turn 与 River 之间选择过牌、跟注、加注、弃牌或全押。掷出技能骰，运用角色能力、魔法卡、Joker 与变化规则改写局势；穿越三章牌桌，挑战不同对手与 Boss，升级骰子并解锁长期成长，在 Standard、Extreme、Best of 3 和 Chaos 四种模式中寻找自己的胜法。

games.name: AllWheelDrive
games.description:
Drive a single vehicle together, literally.
In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

games.name: 超自然档案:前厅
games.description: 《超自然档案：前厅》是一款第一人称轻心理恐怖探索游戏。探索未知空间，观察环境异常，寻找隐藏线索，解开谜题，并逐步揭开“前厅”背后的秘密。

games.name: SALMON
games.description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels satisfying and ridiculous. Jump off walls, race against your friends, explore the strange world. Most people don't realise how athletic salmon can be.

games.name: Graveyard Cabin
games.description: 一款FMV异常恐怖游戏。你是一座荒凉墓地的夜间警卫。监控摄像头，找出异常现象，并努力活下去。

games.name: Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator
games.description: 在这款温馨的奇幻铁匠模拟游戏中成为武器锻造大师。自由组合独特部件、珍贵材料与特殊效果，打造数量众多、变化无穷的刀剑和武器。与每一位登门的顾客商议出公平的价格，接受来自王国各地、要求各不相同的委托，并以精湛手艺满足农民、商人、骑士乃至王室成员的需求。建造、扩张并升级梦想中的中世纪武器店，用各式展柜、家具和装饰品精心布置每个角落，让自己的名声传遍整个王国，成为人人敬仰的武器锻造大师，让每件作品都成为独一无二的杰作！

games.name: Oink Splash Party
games.description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

games.name: Poolrooms Museum
games.description: 探索超现实的泳池空间、博物馆与无尽的边缘空间。

games.name: Near Mint
games.description: 创造属于你自己的卡牌，在独特且不断变化的牌组中自由搭配。探索并战斗于荒芜险地，邂逅奇异生物，在这款Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏中制定完美策略。

games.name: Chreynard
games.description: 回溯时间，操控分身，在这款创新的2D动作解谜游戏中破解重重谜题。凭借智慧与技巧，在30个充满怀旧魅力的像素风关卡中尽情驰骋。

games.name: Mr. "Bargain Expert" 捡漏王
games.description: 你将扮演一名古董店老板，在这款古董题材的增量挂机经营游戏中低买高卖、鉴定收购、雇佣员工自动经营，并不断扩张分店，打造属于自己的古董商业帝国，收藏天下稀世珍宝。

games.name: HANDS OVER
games.description: HANDS OVER 是一款 5 人合作恐怖游戏，无害的挑战会变成残酷的运气与胆量考验。虚张声势、坑害朋友、玩点脏招，让自己比所有人都更久留在桌边。

games.name: Inn Kreeper
games.description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

games.name: SableSyn Protocol
games.description: Engage enemy fleets in turn-based tactical battles on an 8 X 5 grid. Command your half of the battlefield as you manage upgrades and limited resources. Success depends on choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment to eliminate a menacing threat. No grinding, just strategy and conspiracy.

games.name: Quantum Properties
games.description: 你相信量子吗？在独特的物理模拟中测试你的选择与运气。探索多维实验，获取资产，并分析你决策的连锁反应。请记住：一个致命的决定，一切就都结束了！

games.name: Memoirs
games.description: In a treacherous place where overflowing emotions are your weapons, descend into the darkness of a broken mind. Fight through twisted memories and survive your deepest fears in this psychological Top-Down arena shooter.

games.name: Unearthly
games.description: 打造强大的外星战斗流派，将敌人互相投掷碰撞，并在高速随机生成的区域中释放混乱而狂暴的能力！

games.name: Rocket.io
games.description: Rocket.io是一款驾驶悬浮汽车争夺地盘的在线多人竞技游戏。留下轨迹，扩张领地，切断对手的路线！加入快速游戏、私人房间和2至8支队伍的混战，或挑战AI。收集超过25款载具，随心改装。

games.name: Goodnight, B
games.description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

games.name: Stress Buddy
games.description: A stress-relief ball that interacts with your desktop. It’s your fidgety friend. Your anti-productivity accomplice. Your little buddy who breaks up the monotony of work, school, games, and streams. Fling it. Switch it. Send it on a mission of chaos. Now with multiplayer!

games.name: Crimson Monarch
games.description: A modern vampire political narrative where every choice reshapes the city. Rule the Crimson Council, navigate faction intrigue, and survive personal stories of hunger, secrecy, and power in a reactive, state‑driven world.

games.name: For God and For Profit
games.description: For God and For Profit is a Renaissance investigation game. Audit the ledgers, question the merchants, and uphold the truth...for God and for profit.

games.name: Project: C.E.L.L.
games.description: 一款街机风格的增量游戏。分解葡萄糖，引爆连锁反应，并将 ATP 转化为强力升级。尝试不同构筑，发掘强大的组合，将复古未来主义风格的细胞模拟推向极限。

games.name: Herding Adventures
games.description: Herding Adventures is a realistic, MMO herding sim where you and your dog control sheep through pressure, not commands. Guide the flock, avoid predators, and keep them together in a skill based experience where every sheep counts.

games.name: Tavern Deep Cauldron
games.description: Become the owners of a mythical tavern where you'll have to brew magic potions together for extraordinary creatures, consulting an ancient book of recipes. It’s a dynamic co-op game where every drink does more than just quench thirst—it holds its own special secret

games.name: 仓鼠时光
games.description: 桌面上的仓鼠会随着你的键盘和鼠标操作，在跑轮上奔跑。和朋友一起在电脑上完成任务，同时收集可爱的仓鼠和精美的跑轮吧！游戏还提供多种联机模式，以及计时器和待办清单功能。

games.name: Seventh Colony
games.description: 建造并管理一座戒备森严的蒸汽朋克殖民地，控制以太提取，生产专业化自动机械，并抵御不断升级的外星虫群袭击。

games.name: Anomaly Inspector Simulator
games.description: SCP 风格设定下的《Papers, Please》。你是秘密异常管控局的特工。分析危险的异常物品，进行实验，决定它们的命运。切勿让世界陷入混乱！

games.name: Motel 51: Papers, Keys & Aliens
games.description: 一款以 51 区附近为背景的汽车旅馆经营模拟游戏。叔叔把旅馆留给了你，还有他欠银行的债。守好夜班前台：核查身份证件和外星通行证，决定谁能拿到钥匙、住哪间房。有的客人会留下小费，有的留下一张维修账单，还有几个会把麻烦带到你门口。

games.name: Burger Smash
games.description: 在这款快节奏的单人烹饪游戏中规划你的厨房、烤制汉堡，让订单源源不断。设计高效布局，在压力下备餐出餐，解锁拥有独特特长的可玩角色，应对挑剔的顾客。

games.name: Dead Awake
games.description: You fell asleep in class. You woke up in The Purgatory. Explore a nightmarish world between life and death, manage limited resources, and fight dreadful creatures in a desperate attempt to make it home safe.

games.name: Sail On
games.description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

games.name: Redline Horde
games.description: Redline Horde is a high-octane vehicular action roguelike. Drive, drift, and survive against relentless swarms of enemy cars. Upgrade your weapons, collect XP gems, and build the ultimate combat machine in this intense bullet heaven on wheels. Can you outrun the horde?

games.name: Fox Two Protocol
games.description: 开启加力，驾驶现代战斗机投入空战。征战战役、展开PvP一对一对决、挑战计时模式，或投入无尽任务。自由搭配升级与装备，打造自己的战斗风格，再找个理由出击一次。

games.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
games.description: 在太空中经营自己的烘焙店，迎接源源不断的订单。让机器持续运转，制作各式甜点，指挥机器人助手，把你的小店打造成银河系最受欢迎的烘焙店——单人游玩，或与好友一起合作。

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.description: 一场意外使一个迷失的太空探测器获得了自我意识。《Apotheosis Engine》是一款故事丰富的增量游戏。从一件工程造物成长为一个银河超神。

games.name: Sheeple
games.description:
The Sheeple are moving, and they won't stop for anything. Not walls, not traps, and definitely not common sense.
In this chaotic puzzle-platformer, you don't control the player, you control the world.

games.name: Crounds
games.description: Crounds is a fast-paced PvP chess roguelike. Choose a powerful King, draft game-breaking upgrades, and bend the traditional rules of chess to destroy your opponent! Synergize your chaotic upgrades to create your winning strategy!

games.name: Signs Of Devourer
games.description: 又是一个在店里值夜班的夜晚,只是这一次,你被困在店里,与一个伪装成商品的怪物共处一室。保持地面整洁,货架充盈,接待好顾客……并想办法在黎明到来之前不被吞食。

games.name: Gobs & Gears
games.description: 哥布林王要他的炸弹,现在就要!侦察迷雾,夺回失落的建筑,铺设摇晃车路线为它们供货。送完货就统统拆掉,奔赴下一处。一款凑合着来的物流解谜游戏,没有什么是永久的。

games.name: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
games.description:
《汪里个狼》的核心概念是“狗狗中藏着狼”。玩家会进入一个由狗狗角色组成的狼人杀对局，在看似可爱的角色关系中，通过发言、怀疑、站边、投票和身份推理，找出隐藏其中的狼人。我们希望给玩家营造一个高智商博弈，且不用组局，没有社交压力的狼人杀游戏

视觉上，项目走原创手绘狗狗角色方向，用可爱狗狗与悬疑推理之间的反差从而降低上手压力，同时保留心理博弈的紧张感。正式版方向上，我们希望继续扩展技能卡、NPC 解锁、特色模式和局外成长，让玩家在多局游玩中逐步认识、解锁并利用不同性格和行为风格的狗狗 NPC。

games.name: ManaBorne
games.description: Defend your campfire in a rogue-like RTS where strategy meets deckbuilding. Earn runes, build a powerful card deck, and adapt your army to survive relentless waves across diverse biomes. Build fast. Defend smarter. Choose your cards carefully.

games.name: Coldline: Disconnect
games.description: 你是谁不重要，做了什么才重要！作为潜伏在敌营的特工，通过解谜修复设备。植入窃听器，在夜晚收听广播并向我们传递关键情报。每个抉择你都孤军奋战，但你的决定将牵连所有人。

games.name: 音序核心
games.description:
《音序核心》是一款节奏弹幕射击 Roguelike 游戏。你将在音序器上构筑弹幕，让你的构筑实时生成音乐。
组合道具，编排节拍，在太空中演奏出绚丽而致命的弹幕。

games.name: hexGame: Hero Path
games.description: 世界在等待英雄——由你来选择。任何 NPC 都可以成为天选之人。探索充满生机的程序生成六边形世界，开辟属于自己的道路，收集独特的武器、道具与遗物组合，在动感十足的战斗中横扫敌阵。每次通关都与众不同。

games.name: Mutation
games.description: 当主角从梦中醒来时，一切都变了，他将独自对抗一整所庄园的行尸走肉，并发掘其背后的惊天秘密。

games.name: 欲焰盆景
games.description: 成人向修仙种田 RPG，你将在荒废山门中重新建立自己的药园。种植灵草、炼制丹药、探索秘境、组建队伍，并与 5 位性格各异的女角色发展专属恋爱线。你的选择，决定与你共度良宵的人。

games.name: Get Stoned
games.description: Get Stoned is an incremental tower defense game where players design their own bullet loadouts. Gather resources, unlock unique boulders, and discover game-breaking synergies while defending your castle. It's time for everything to get stoned!

games.name: Loading Dock Simulator
games.description: 一款第一人称混合模拟游戏，真实还原物流现场的火热节奏。扫描笼车、徒手搬运箱子，并有策略地码放堆叠。体验体力劳动带来的扎实手感，揪出关键的错分货物，证明你的极致效率。

games.name: HexiGo
games.description: HexiGo 是一款多人策略游戏，2-8 名玩家在六边形地图上选择文明并为征服世界而战。击败对手、扩张领土，成为最终统治世界的文明。

games.name: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
games.description: 一款通过所选法术发现自身职业的类幸存者动作肉鸽。变身为470+名法师之一并解锁用于之后的对局，用30+种符文打破规则，唤起其他玩家倒下的法师，并冲击无尽模式排行榜。

games.name: Chroma Jump
games.description: Chroma Jump is a 2D hardcore platformer where you overcome obstacles by changing your character's color in real-time. Push your physical and mental limits through traps that are completely unforgiving... well, mostly. Will you be able to safely reach the goal and escape?

games.name: Speed King
games.description: Chaotic Racing matches for up to 4 players through silly levels, with anything you can imagine: pigs, kaijus, wheelchairs, and so on. Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Bramble Bay
games.description: A cozy mail delivery adventure where you explore a quiet town, gather clues from its people, and deliver letters to their intended recipients.

games.name: Defense Of Legends
games.description: 一款以英雄作为防御塔的塔防游戏。升级英雄，装备强力物品，打造独特流派，探索毁灭性的组合，阻止无尽的敌人浪潮抵达传送门。

games.name: Chancess
games.description: Chancess is a turn-based strategy roguelike where you control a Prince on an 8x8 chessboard using random movement cards to outsmart enemy pieces, survive tactical encounters, and adapt to unpredictable challenges.

games.name: Still With Me
games.description: A psychological horror experience about returning to a place that never forgot you.

games.name: Arx Temporis
games.description: 一款剧情丰富的日式动漫风格动作角色扮演游戏，融合即时战斗、校园生活与社交模拟。探索随机生成的地下城，发展人际关系，并揭开神秘时间危机背后的真相。

games.name: Theorycraft: Raiding Guild Simulator
games.description: Theorycraft is a single-player raiding guild simulator. Recruit raiders, tune gear and spell priorities, and command authentic MMO-style boss fights with encounter replays, win rate prediction, deep strategy, and rich combat data.

games.name: Hookeye
games.description: It's the end of the line. Resist the madness and use questionable bait to just keep fishing. Sacrifice everything for a bigger catch. It has to be worth it.

games.name: PAYRATES
games.description: Embark on an online co-op pirate game with physics-based gameplay, where you can play with up to 4 players. Find different islands and engage the creatures that live there. Fight, plunder and explore the different environments to satisfy the captain's need for treasure.

games.name: Fool
games.description: You're a jester traveling the realm solving people's problems with the power of juggling. You'll save relationships, resolve conflicts like battles, and even make crops grow all with the mystical power of juggling!

games.name: Data Breach Inc.
games.description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

games.name: World of Slime
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

games.name: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传
games.description: 这是一款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

games.name: 道门修行指南 Taoist Way
games.description: 授箓传度、炼丹画符、召神遣将。玩家将扮演初入道门的修士，在星宿分野与酆都幽冥构成的道门世界中修行成长。管理阴阳属性，多种术法资源，在回合制战斗中利用符箓与法术克制妖魔。寿元耗尽时可在继承部分道行的基础上开启新周目，重选修行路线。游戏深度融合典籍内容：上百种符箓与云篆、二十八星宿分野系统、酆都地狱、法箓职阶体系……每一次境界突破、每一道亲手绘制的符箓、每一位召请的星官神将，都带来真实的“修道”成长感。永久性的轮回机制，确保极高的重玩价值。这不是一款简单的挂机修仙游戏这是一本可以玩的《道门修行指南》。

games.name: Eyes Wide Open
games.description: 为一个反乌托邦检查局工作，判断对象是否为人类，揭露秘密，忍受心理恐惧，完成你的工作配额——否则后果自负。

games.name: Malignus
games.description: Malignus is a 2D dungeon colony sim and emergent story generator. Play as a boss monster and their underling minions and creatures, expanding your underground dominion, building traps, and defending your prisoners and treasures from invading adventurers.

games.name: Flippin Broke
games.description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

games.name: 杂鱼清洁工
games.description: 率领你的英雄小队，讨伐杂鱼怪物。部署英雄，战斗中实时换人，在限定时间内消灭每一波敌人。完成任务，习得新技能，不断变强，向世界更深处进发。

games.name: DATAWANDER
games.description: 漫步于超现实的数字天堂。探索静谧的虚拟空间，发现前所未见的变迁瞬间和隐秘路径。

games.name: Phroller: Cross-Platform VTT
games.description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

games.name: Lustbound Cards
games.description: 《Lustbound Cards》是一款黑暗奇幻战术卡牌RPG。率领你的女主角们打回合制战斗、构筑强力连携，在被诅咒的世界杀出一条路。

games.name: 鸡瘟检察官：最后的IKUN
games.description: 病毒肆虐，全世界都被感染鸡瘟的鸡和感染鸡瘟的小黑子占领，只剩下最后的防线顽强抵抗。你作为防线的一员，需要对前来避难的幸存者进行体检，确保他没有感染鸡瘟，从而放行，扩大你的社区。如果放进感染者后果不堪设想，请谨慎辨别。

games.name: Glaring Flaw
games.description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

games.name: Fanos
games.description: The desert was never meant to be explored at night. When a distant light appears beyond your camp, you follow it into shifting sands and buried secrets. What lies behind the glow and why is it calling you?

games.name: Little Writer Desktop Companion
games.description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this idle productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

games.name: Coremine Corp
games.description: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

games.name: Offworlders: Galactic Ventures
games.description: 自上而下的太空贸易和工作前沿的战斗。运送货物、打捞打捞、打击海盗，并建立一家能够在 Cryos Foundation、Frontier Allegiance 和 Sable Syndicate 的二十个循环压力下生存下来的公司。

games.name: TheManSkiesNoLimit!: Escape The Matrix
games.description: The Man: Skies No Limit! An Action-Adventure RPG. Meet Ebu, a naive, arrogant, boastful man who sets sail across a world consumed by corruption—not to save it, but to build his own legacy. As traps, trials, and twisted truths unfold, he'll discover the man he truly is.

games.name: Interzone
games.description: 你被贴上了逃兵的标签，被扔进了中间地带，在那里生存是唯一的法则。技术在这里消亡，命令从天而降，装在炮弹发射的胶囊里，这是来自外界的最后声音。面对异常、辐射、污染、感染者、叛乱分子和残酷的军队。

games.name: The Adventure of Spyke
games.description: Join Spyke where the worst day of his life suddenly takes a turn and becomes an epic adventure. Solve challenging puzzles, use mystical tools, and fight robots, venom-spitting organ harvesters, terrifying creatures, and much more in this low-poly, top-down, action RPG puzzler.

games.name: Convent Of Magical Chambers
games.description: 如果哈利·波特是个魔法少女会怎样？这款3D冒险沉浸式模拟游戏灵感源自2000年代初的关卡设计，探索一座充斥着幽灵和魔法密室的废弃修道院，并尝试解开这些密室诞生背后的谜团。

games.name: Harvestide
games.description:
一款融合卡牌构筑与农场经营的 Roguelike 游戏！
用卡牌种田，在荒月中生存。构筑你的牌组，经营你的农场，迎接丰收——或死于饥饿。

games.name: Skillpoint Warrior
games.description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

games.name: EATY
games.description:
吞噬×Roguelite
在迷宫般的关卡中飞驰，吞噬眼前的一切来不断强化自己
将获得的能力与武器自由组合，打造属于你的独特构筑，征服每一个关卡。

games.name: Throneforged
games.description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists.  Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

games.name: Broke Street
games.description: 1至6人合作交易类Roguelike模拟游戏。和朋友们从一无所有开始，共享同一账户余额，进行高风险交易，利用道具制定制胜策略，每天完成不断提高的目标。失败，就要付出代价。

games.name: Train of Thought
games.description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

games.name: Cinematic Business
games.description: Run your own movie studio in a deep management simulation. Choose stories, negotiate with creative talent, and back the films you believe in. Balance ambition with your budget, face audiences and critics, and build your studio’s legacy in a competitive industry.

games.name: SELF//FORK
games.description:
A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets,
bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the
fragments to break free.

games.name: Sellsword
games.description: 在一个充满魔法的王国里，化身雇佣兵。接受敌对势力的委托，为黄金而战，为强大的领主收复失地。在这个开放世界中，你将经历独一无二的冒险，每一次行动都会被记录在一本不断增长的传奇之书中，尽情挥洒你的才华。

games.name: Deep Frost
games.description: 这是一款单人社交推理恐怖游戏，你辩护的人可能正是欺骗你的人。某种东西正在复制队员。调查濒临崩溃的南极站，追问矛盾的说法，并在投票前决定为谁辩护。

games.name: Vestalborne
games.description: 打碎这个世界，然后建造你自己的。《Vestalborne》是一款合作动作 RPG 沙盒游戏，拥有爽快的战斗、幽深的地牢，以及跨越多重维度的无尽合成。独自一人、与好友并肩，或是彼此为敌，让永恒之焰长明不熄。

games.name: Puck'n Hell
games.description: 一场发生在灵薄狱中的黑暗街机空气曲棍球对决。怪异的对手。没有借口。只有你和球。容易理解。难以精通。欢迎来到地狱。拿起你的球拍。

games.name: 重返校园2：首富上学
games.description: 《重返校园2》是一款使用 UE5 制作的开放世界喜剧游戏。你将扮演一名顶级富二代，在现代都市与中世纪世界之间展开冒险，自由探索、完成任务、与 NPC 互动，也可以开车闲逛、打架惹事，在两个时代中体验荒诞又自由的故事。c

games.name: JEEP HORROR
games.description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

games.name: Hunt in Oddwick
games.description: Investigate a cursed medieval town as an Inquisitor. Hunt twisted manifestations of everyday objects, survive a creeping demonic miasma, and uncover the truth festering within Oddwick.

games.name: Echoes of Broken Realms
games.description:
Action-Adventure - Enter broken realms. Become the hope. Discover the truth.
Every kill, every power, every resource, every choice, shapes your path and transforms the world around you.

games.name: DüRT: Motocross Championship
games.description: 街机风越野摩托，带着初代 PlayStation 的灵魂：油门控制的漂移、刹车甩尾、真实的腾空与空中特技，还有嘶吼的二冲程引擎。横跨越野与超级越野赛道的完整锦标赛，与玩家一起打造。立即加入愿望单。

games.name: Flagship Down
games.description: 战术类 Roguelike 自动战斗游戏。 组建你的舰队，并为旗舰装备模块与武器。招募船员并将其分配到各个舰船。开始回合，见证你的策略在全自动战斗中展开。

games.name: The Spectacular Evermore
games.description: 熟悉剧院中的每个房间，发现异常并拍下它们，让房间恢复原状。时刻留意任何不寻常之处，从活过来的雕像到被附身的画作。

games.name: 情绪劳动研究所
games.description: 和古灵精怪的美女老板一起在虚拟世界中心跳同步，演奏情感吧！融合了甜蜜互动与节奏动作的另类“情绪劳动”即将开始。

games.name: Silly Typing Game
games.description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

games.name: 小小元素精灵 (Little Elementals)
games.description:
想成为人类的小小元素精灵们的欢乐大逃亡！

偷偷前往人类世界旅行的火之精灵和水之精灵，最终还是被发现，并被关进了监牢。

为了救出他们而踏上冒险旅程的，是土之精灵——以及……风之精灵！？

他们究竟能否成功逃脱，并顺利抵达人类世界呢？

快与小小元素精灵们一起踏上冒险之旅吧！

games.name: DRAWN TO RACE
games.description: DRAWN TO RACE is a roguelike arcade racer with hand-drawn pencil sketch aesthetics. Drive, overtake, drift and speed through corners to gain experience. Choose your upgrade cards on level up and build your roguelite deck. Defeat the boss racers in a 1v1 race and unlock new cars to use in the future!

games.name: 包罗万象
games.description:
《包罗万象》是一款以挖掘道具为核心、融合轻度 Rogue 元素的回合制休闲牌组构筑游戏。
背上能够自动回收道具的魔法背包，升级你的装备，探索强力的组合，击败强敌，守护王国的和平。
……等等？连垃圾也会被自动收回？
那看来，只能从垃圾堆里把能用的东西再挖出来继续战斗了。

games.name: Outscratched
games.description: Outscratched is a scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble your deck from a multitude of powerful cards, collect blessed charms to influence your luck, and discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

games.name: ASHER Descent
games.description:
Go down. Get stronger. Come back alive.
Mine the mountain. Defend your shuttle. Adapt or get overrun.

games.name: 再开一亿包
games.description: 一款以收集为核心的增量游戏。购买卡包、拆开卡包、展示收藏、提升声望、解锁自动化，并自由定制游戏体验。你能把所有卡牌都集齐吗？

games.name: Scape
games.description: Scape是一个不断拓展的多人游戏平台，其首发作品为《Gravity》：一款垂直攀爬平台游戏，跌落就意味着前功尽弃。百余名玩家同台竞技，在同一片崩毁的世界中向上攀爬。这里没有检查点，没有生命条，只有硬核的物理规则与残酷的失误代价。登顶也并非终点，而是一段全新旅程的开端。

games.name: Mirrorbane
games.description: 一款以黑暗奇幻世界为背景、拥有氛围感像素美术的战术类 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。雇佣独具特色的英雄，将他们的卡牌合并为一副牌组，并在远征间隙回到城镇培养你的队伍。

games.name: Pirates Dig Deeper
games.description: 与船员一起挖掘，用大炮守住营地。《Pirates Dig Deeper》是一款融合挖掘与塔防的合作游戏。深入岛屿地底，击退来犯的敌对海盗，解开古代神庙的封印，夺走长生不老药。

games.name: B.L.U.E.
games.description: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is a sci-fi shipbuilding and combat simulator where you design customized spacecraft from modular components. Iterate and refine your ship design as you battle other interlopers in explosive, physics-driven PvP battles.

games.name: Leadville
games.description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

games.name: Nobody's Erde
games.description: 父母离世后，一名神学院学生回到化为废墟的故乡村庄。在一位神父的失踪与古老秘密之间，Brendyk调查着当地的悲剧，发现某种隐秘的力量正在这片荒芜之下蠢动。有些恐怖，本就不该被掘出。

games.name: Cat Caffeine
games.description:
一家在您屏幕上运营的温馨闲置猫咪咖啡馆。
在您工作或放松时烹饪美食招待顾客并装饰您的咖啡馆

games.name: Now With More Plunk
games.description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

games.name: Everfront
games.description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front until your enemies fall.

games.name: Voxborn
games.description: Voxborn is a stylized voxel action RPG where destruction, combat, and a loyal dog companion create emergent gameplay in a dark, evolving world.

games.name: Waywardens
games.description: 在这款黑暗奇幻战术肉鸽卡牌游戏中，率领三名英雄共用一副牌组。每张牌既能发动行动，也能用于国际象棋式的移动。看穿敌人的攻击，打乱他们的阵形，将一手险牌化为制胜之计。组建你的队伍，踏上危机四伏的旅途。

games.name: 荒岛时光
games.description: 在这个岛屿上，你可以种植农作物、钓鱼、捕获岛兽、采矿、伐木和制作工具和道具。欢迎探索海岛世界，体验宁静生活。

games.name: Crafty Marbles
games.description: 用你的弹珠建造任何你想要的东西！精彩的比赛、混乱的机器、连锁反应、战斗，或者其他任何东西！

games.name: SwapHeads!
games.description:
A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!?

Control your buddy’s body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,.

Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?
games.developer: うさうさはっぴーげーむず

games.name: 唯我独尊
games.description: 核能玩家是一个经典RPG游戏，你的角色最终要PVP和玩家1VS1对战。绝出真正的核能玩家。

games.name: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
games.description: 《符文洞窟：永恒回响》是一款带有 Roguelite 元素的益智消除游戏。你将扮演考古学家深入失落文明遗迹，通过“符文共鸣”破解祭坛谜阵，并击碎不断干扰你的“守护者残响”。

games.name: Carpet Racers
games.description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

games.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
games.description: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

games.name: The Cloudvale Protocol
games.description: A story-rich, tabletop-inspired game about hope for a better future, the power to shape it, and the hard choices that follow. Save a wounded utopia built to benefit all, while trying to keep a stranded boy alive. As the stakes rise, your choices will decide the fate of more than one world.

games.name: Secret of Circadia
games.description: Secret of Circadia is a unique blend of old school RPGs, Roguelike Deckbuilder mechanics and light City Builder elements where you use the Circadian Rhythm and Time of Day itself to restore a world corrupted by an AI made from humanity's hubris.

games.name: Typenstein: A Symphony of Keys
games.description: You are a Doctor Typenstein, who needs to defend his castle every night against the oncoming villagers. TYPE words to attack enemies, LEVEL UP and unlock new skills, UPGRADE your castle by using killed villagers, and SURVIVE till the end of the night.

games.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
games.description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

games.name: It Was Not a Suicide
games.description: 一款以2005年的雷尼尔瀑布镇为背景的心理恐怖侦探模拟游戏。找出案件档案中的矛盾，揭开阿黛尔死亡背后的真相。你是否足够敏锐，能够一次性识破嫌疑人的谎言？因为你只有一次实施逮捕的机会。

games.name: Tax Empire
games.description: 建立​属于​你​自己​的​税收​帝国！​征收​税款，​扩张​城市，​雇佣​税务​官员，​管理​交通，​制定​新​的​政策，​并​在​通往​财富​的​道路​上​获取尽​可能​多​的​收入。​

games.name: Echo: The dolphin story
games.description: Echo: The Dolphin Story is a single-player game that can also be played with friends in co-op mode (up to five players). Join forces, explore the world, and find your pod!

games.name: Metroidvania Maker
games.description: Create, play, and share custom Metroidvania worlds with a built-in world editor, co-op play, and player-made adventures.

games.name: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom
games.description: 一款怀旧的第一人称地下城探索冒险游戏，灵感来自 80 年代和 90 年代的经典 RPG。与怪物正面对战，收集战利品，作为孤身冒险者不断变强，踏上击败古老邪恶并救出被绑架少女的任务。

games.name: Reduce, Reuse, Raccoon
games.description: Who needs loot boxes when you've got dumpsters? Open trash, discover rare finds, and sell your haul to the animal kingdom in your very own shop. Play minigames, grow your empire, and claim your rightful title: The Trash King.

games.name: Vossarium
games.description:
Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you.
Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

games.name: MEMORY DEALER
games.description: 你是一名记忆贩子。从被囚禁的大脑中抽取记忆，越卖越多。但别迷上自己的货，否则它们将永远消失……一款阴暗又治愈的赛博朋克放置游戏，静静待在你的桌面一角。

games.name: The Kings Last Hand
games.description:
The Kingdom is under siege.

Gather powerful cards, and build unique defensive strategies to withstand increasingly deadly enemy assaults.

Each defeat teaches a lesson. Each victory unlocks new possibilities.

games.name: Zudon
games.description: A high-octane arcade puzzle game with PvP, puzzle and solo play modes. Slide with clear eyes, a full heart and try not to get posted on.

games.name: TeNeBriSM
games.description: TeNeBriSM is a playable album exploring themes of grief and self-acceptance through 3D environments and electronic music.

games.name: Dies Irae:  tactical puzzle
games.description: Dies Irae Tactical Puzzle is a grid-based tactical roguelite where every move changes the board. Create chain merges and matches, evolve pieces, manage resources, and survive the enemy advance while unlocking islands, biomes, and unique abilities.

games.name: Ravenous Greed
games.description: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

games.name: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
games.description:
“好久不见。”
一款心灵叙事rpg。这里是结束了所有纷争后的和平世界，过去没能解明的那些话语，在此处是否还有弥补的机会？

games.name: wocheneinkauf
games.description:
Remember when grocery shopping used to be stress free? Me neither! Well we found a way to make it even more stressful.
In wocheneinkauf, four different dimensions have recently collided. The world might be ending. Everything changed. Except one thing. You still have to go shopping.

games.name: Personal Digital Affliction
games.description: A Kinetic Novel about a girl investigating a video tied to the death of a friend.

games.name: 蚂蚁点倍
games.description: 培育蚁群，征服公园，搬空野餐篮！《增量蚂蚁》是一款以壮大蚁巢为核心的放置养成游戏。派遣各式各样的蚂蚁搜集食物，强化族群能力，解锁全新蚁种，向着未曾有蚂蚁踏足的领域不断扩张。

games.name: Redemption: The Sin Eternal
games.description: Redemption: The Sin Eternal is a supernatural horror action-adventure game where a priest returns to a haunted orphanage filled with demonic forces, missing children, disturbing secrets. Featuring split-screen co-op, and first- or third-person gameplay.

games.name: Under the Carpet
games.description: Under the Carpet is a classic point-and-click adventure set in the high stakes, adrenaline-fuelled world of discount consumer flooring — where the deals are cheap, but the secrets run deep-pile.

games.name: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a
games.description: Alec Orbusier, a none-too-organized university archaeologist, sets off to recover a priceless artifact from a forgotten tomb. Nothing too difficult, really... A 2D puzzle-adventure full of rooms, devious traps, and secrets for the curious.

games.name: 勇者弹珠
games.description: 勇者弹珠是一款街机柜上的回合制弹珠 RPG 肉鸽游戏。英雄与技能都是实体弹珠——装填铁盒、发射出击，由物理定胜负。攀爬分支地图，在游玩中成长构筑，招募同伴，清空战场。

games.name: KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown-
games.description:
An Item-Building 2D Bullet Hell Shooter Has Arrived!
The unique “ENEMY ATTACK SELECT” system can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
To overcome the disadvantages you face, you’ll need to make smart choices and build the best loadout possible from limited resources.

games.name: Super OctoColor
games.description: Super OctoColor is a collection of retro-style games designed for a fictional handheld console. Unlock a diverse library of games across multiple genres, uncover hidden secrets, and explore the interconnected mysteries that tie them all together!

games.name: Ribbit Riot!
games.description: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

games.name: DIG! DIG! DIG!
games.description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

games.name: All 4 Naught
games.description: ALL 4 NAUGHT is a medieval roguelike where you play as one of 7 heroes that can recruit up to 4 followers to battle your way to the seed of the world tree. Gather riches, unlock new characters and try to craft the perfect battalion to crush your enemies and save the world!

games.name: 赛博：梦核少女
games.description: 在这款AI原生游戏中，扮演失忆的记忆诊所老板，通过与AI少女自由对话发展感情、探索世界、选择分支、推进剧情，慢慢找回记忆，并查明世界真相。AI NPC拥有独特的性格、长期记忆、完整的世界观和角色设定。准备好了吗？去另一个世界，遇见那个，满眼都是你的女孩~

games.name: 创意水族馆
games.description: 如果你的每一笔涂鸦，都能在桌面的一角获得生命呢？《创意水族馆》是一款充满想象力的休闲桌面放置游戏，也是一片由玩家共同创造的水下世界。亲手画下想象中的鱼儿，赋予它名字，看它摆动着独一无二的轮廓游入水族馆，在你工作、学习或放松时静静陪伴。这里没有模板，也没有所谓“画得不好”：天马行空的怪鱼、随手勾勒的小家伙，都可能成为令人过目不忘的明星。发现其他玩家的奇妙作品，收藏彼此的灵感，把喜爱的鱼儿汇聚成专属鱼群；自由装扮水下空间，让每座鱼缸都呈现主人的个性。当越来越多创意汇入其中，你面对的不只是一块画布，而是一片奇思妙想、永不重复的玩家海洋。画一条鱼，为这个世界增添一个新生命。

games.name: 栖心一隅 / My Cozy Corner
games.description: 一款温馨的建造装饰玩具，自由设计属于自己的房间。摆放家具、调整细节，按照自己的节奏打造一个独一无二的舒适空间。

games.name: VOID PROFIT
games.description: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

games.name: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades
games.description: Slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

games.name: Desktop Oasis
games.description: 把桌面变成一片会慢慢成长的水上绿洲。日常打字与电脑操作会积累“灵感”，用来解锁生物、船只、装饰与稀有发现。忙时让它安静陪着你，闲时回来布置世界、与漂浮物互动，享受实时水体物理带来的漂流、碰撞与意外小乐趣。

games.name: 猫壳机动队 Cats In The Shell
games.description: 组装机甲，引爆连锁反应，在这场猫咪驾驶的机甲自走棋肉鸽中里找到属于你的破局之道。零件任意搭配，模块自由组合，摸索强力的构筑联动，然后欣赏你亲手拼出来的钢铁怪物在战场上碾压一切。

games.name: Project Exhibitionist
games.description: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

games.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn
games.description: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night

games.name: Purrfect Bliss
games.description: 《Purrfect Bliss》是一家建立在黑暗历史之上的猫咪咖啡馆。你能在夜班中幸存下来吗？在这款心理恐怖游戏中，为顾客提供服务，照顾猫咪，并揭开可怕的真相。

games.name: The Fool King
games.description: The Fool King 是一款动态策略卡牌游戏，完美融合了即时战术战斗与肉鸽（Roguelite）养成机制。构筑你的8卡牌组，合理分配法力，坚守阵地并粉碎宿敌！收集“Tursu Coins”，为下一次的征程解锁全新卡牌与永久强化组件。

games.name: Hex & Vex
games.description: Fast, brutal, and deeply tactical. Hex & Vex turns every step into a combat encounter. Master dice-based combos, weaponize the environment, and slam enemies into hexes. Evolve with biological augmentations, survive dynamic shifting arenas, and conquer bosses in this ruthless grid-based battler.

games.name: Market Manager Simulator
games.description: 建立并管理您自己的市场。填写货架，设定价格，为客户服务，管理在线订单并扩大业务。雇用员工，检查库存，并将您的市场转变为大型企业。

games.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
games.description: 您是一名病人。您应该避免去那家老医院接受治疗。那位古怪医生的怪异做法令人怀疑。治疗效果可能不会如您所愿。

games.name: We Pretend
games.description: A retro inspired psychological horror game about a student pulled into a surreal hub of locked doors and broken memories, where each step deeper reveals the town’s buried secrets and the truth behind what everyone chose to ignore.

games.name: Roll of Chaos
games.description:
Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you...
Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

games.name: 洗钱铺
games.description: 一款为犯罪世界记账的 Roguelite 策略游戏。接下卡特尔与受制裁政权的委托，在数十个司法辖区之间铺设资金路线，在受制裁代币的市场上博弈。还有——别去惹国际刑警。

games.name: CarSim Racing
games.description: CarSim Racing is a racing game where you start from the very bottom with regular cars and work your way up to supercars, competing against the best racers!The game features more than 45 cars across different classes. Each vehicle is unique and has its own strengths and weaknesses.

games.name: 奴隶公主艾尔妮娅
games.description: 在这款RPG中，你将扮演曾经的公主、如今却沦为奴隶的艾尔妮娅。为了复仇，她必须一步一步重新爬回顶点。你可以通过在帝国的市民面前忍受羞辱和深入危险的地下城战斗冒险两种方式来赚钱。你能一直坚守作为公主的尊严吗？

games.name: Astral Industrial Complex
games.description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

games.name: Infusion
games.description: Infusion is a cozy, narrative-focused, coffee-making sim with branching storylines that takes place in a fantasy world full of magic and intrigue. Make different types of coffee, get to know your patrons, help them solve their dilemmas and become the best barista the Cordara has ever seen!

games.name: 背信淫纹
games.description: 在这款NTR题材RPG里，你将扮演莱因，踏上讨伐魔王的冒险之旅。与你同行的有你的妻子以及两位从小一起长大的伙伴。一路上你们会战斗、探索，也会在过程中逐渐变强，并解锁一些带点暧昧和激情的事件。不过获得力量是有代价的，而承担代价的人并不会是你。为了实现目标，你的队伍究竟愿意付出到什么地步？

games.name: Bowl Big
games.description: 一款精致小巧的增量式保龄球游戏。在这里，一个球瓶可以变成上百个球瓶。解锁科技树，升级球瓶和保龄球，避开障碍物，看着分数一路飙升。打破 10 瓶限制，让保龄球在球道上尽情狂飙！

games.name: ONE MAN'S DECEIT
games.description: This is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. In your quest to find him, you realized you were fooled by another friend, and the whole trip is a lie. He is now blackmailing you throughout the journey. Will you follow his words or be on your own?

games.name: Performance Review: Survivor
games.description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

games.name: No One Returns
games.description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

games.name: Lustera: Goddess of Passion
games.description: 探索 Lustera 的迷人世界！你的乙太赋予你独特的吸引力：傲娇的女战士、女祭司和女巫都在你的魅力下融化。赢得战斗，组建忠诚的小队，享受火辣的 18+ 画廊。最精彩的部分现在开始！

games.name: ASWANG HUNTER
games.description: Real-time horror battler meets tense house defense. As a rogue hunter, explore vulnerable homes, watch window silhouettes, and protect families from an Aswang outbreak. Scavenge bolos and spears, manage controls for each arm, and stop folklore monsters from escaping. Will they survive until dawn?

games.name: 降雪的日子
games.description:
2011年，世界在下雪。我们站在无法前进亦无法后退的雪原上。
明天就会是世界末日，关于所有不寻常的叙事与抒情，面对结局与奇观化，一个关于我们的过错，我们的自我与他人的故事。

games.name: Norselings
games.description: 带领你的北欧族群从赫尔海姆到阿斯加德，经历符文石打击和诺瑟林定居点的崛起。

games.name: Rebirth: Denied Protocol
games.description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

games.name: Дорога Жизни
games.description: A free, story-driven game about a truck driver on the Road of Life. Deliver supplies to besieged Leningrad in the iconic “polutorka” truck, brave blizzards, repair your vehicle, and discover the stories of people who need your help.

games.name: Magical Ascent
games.description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

games.name: The Infinite Library
games.description: A narrative incremental where the UI tells the story. Discover rare Words, craft Phrases, fill shelves until reality buckles. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers.

games.name: Still Waters
games.description: Still Waters is a cozy idle aquarium at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.

games.name: Trouble in Our Skies
games.description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

games.name: Survive The Apocalypse
games.description:
A turn-based survival roguelite set in a sun-baked urban wasteland. 
Fight, scavenge, and manage your needs through 11 procedural city districts. 
Every step is a choice with fatal consequences. 
Eat well, sleep well, and try not to die.

games.name: Knock Again
games.description: This is not a normal clicker. It’s a psychological horror game where mechanical progress hides something dark, twisted, and unsettling. Knock on the door to earn money, upgrade your abilities, and keep knocking. It all seems simple… until it isn’t.

games.name: Crazy Bird Hunt
games.description: Crazy Bird Hunt 是一款快节奏增量街机游戏，灵感来自 2000 年代的 Moorhuhn 游戏。猎杀飞鸟，收集材料和勋章，解锁武器，并通过技能树进行永久升级。

games.name: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0
games.description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

games.name: 你好，市长
games.description: 你不只是在建设一座城市，更要真正治理它。规划城区、平衡财政、走访调研、处理居民诉求、主持政府会议、任用干部并与企业谈判，让每一项决定沿着“发现问题—形成议题—推动执行—获得反馈”的路径改变城市。

games.name: 5YN-OS
games.description: 生活在一个可以编程、定制，甚至搞坏的虚构操作系统里。通过内置的 FantasyLang IDE 学习真正的编程，用脚本驱动终端，探索风格化的暗网，并解开藏在桌面本身的喜剧悬疑谜案。

games.name: PLANETOON
games.description: 抓住行星，将它放入轨道，培育属于你的银河。这是一款太空益智游戏，生命与文明的诞生，以及与UFO和黑洞的相遇，都将为银河带来意想不到的变化。体验跨越120亿年的银河创造之旅，探索60种以上的结局。

games.name: TAILS GEAR HD
games.description:
A revamped version of "Tales Gear," originally released in 2007, featuring high-resolution support, new systems, and rearranged background music.
