A full-fledged 2.5D vertical-scrolling shooter characterized by the Tail Pod, an optional weapon that combines offense and defense.

games.name: Censor Me Totally
games.description: An absurd censor simulator in the Committee of Public Happiness. Censor images and texts, wheel and deal, chase the money, solve problems, try not to get caught, spread your wings, and keep your sanity.

games.name: Nodebreak
games.description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

games.name: Operation: Horumus
games.description: 在这款政治讽刺塔防游戏中，用8种模块组合出120套防御配置。熬过7天的剧情战役，征服100关迷宫，阻止每一艘试图穿越 Horumus 海峡的油轮。

games.name: Death by Taxes
games.description:
A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes.
Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

games.name: Arena Bot Manager
games.description: 在月球环形世界，经营一支从废料场起家的机器人格斗战队，在残酷的竞技场上赌上身家、证明实力。用废料打造机器人，招募工程师和程序员，为战队赢得优势。击溃对手，一路冲击更高排名。

games.name: Working95
games.description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

games.name: Hi-Lo: Card Roguelike
games.description: A cozy roguelike deckbuilder where every card flip is a bet. Predict if the next card is Higher, Lower, or Equal, stack jokers, build score combos, survive story-driven events. One deck. Endless decisions. Will you bet it all?

games.name: Body Kounts
games.description:
在这款街机式的生死心智博弈中，复活并召唤已灭绝的奇幻兽类为你而战。
每一次失败都是致命的；你必须运用智慧和一切可用的工具来克服挑战并生存下去。

games.name: Somnesis: The PSX Tapes
games.description: 一款2000年代背景的心理恐怖游戏。小女孩在新家发现了一箱受诅咒的90年代卡带。在CRT显示器上游玩诡异的PSX风复古游戏，同时在昏暗卧室中应对现实威胁。在怀旧玩法与实时生存之间寻找平衡。

games.name: Bumper & Thumper
games.description: 混乱刺激的载具战斗类 Roguelite。选择你的载具，碾过成百上千的机器人，升级并不断叠加武器。组合疯狂的强化，打造完美搭配，迎战 Boss，并甩开致命的机器人。停下来，你就会死。

games.name: Galaxiwilds
games.description: Explore a collapsing multiverse, make first contact with 75 alien civilizations, and uncover the truth behind reality’s unraveling—one discovery at a time.

games.name: Choo Choo Kingdom
games.description: 《嘟嘟列车王国》是一款类幸存者火车防御游戏，你的整个王国都在铁轨上前进。招募奇幻部队，将他们部署到列车上，重新调整阵型，并利用弓箭手、法师、火炮、横扫攻击、风暴与烈焰，抵御无穷无尽的怪物浪潮。

games.name: Dark Sorcery
games.description: Dark Sorcery 是一款暗黑奇幻 Roguelite 游戏，你将在其中对抗无尽敌潮、解锁强力升级并打造毁灭性构筑。精通移动、传送与策略，在愈发危险的敌人浪潮中生存下来。

games.name: The Man Who Bled The Kingdom
games.description: 以手中之剑征服整个王国！The Man Who Bled The Kingdom 是一款高难度的 2D 动作冒险游戏，背景设定在一个融合奇幻元素的中世纪世界。化身佣兵卡米尔·弗雷姆（Kamil Flame），穿越广袤沙漠、阴森城堡与荒废之地。

games.name: Kingfall
games.description:
A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards move like chess pieces.

Build an army, bless your troops, and conquer the kingdom one battle at a time.

games.name: Rock Band Simulator
games.description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

games.name: Who Killed Arthur?
games.description: Who Killed Arthur? is an offbeat, murder-mystery, puzzle game telling a story of heartbreak, loss, body horror, and the fear of growing up. The game is rife with rich storytelling elements, strange, talking animals, curious children, and a killer original soundtrack to boot!

games.name: Super Duper Siege
games.description: Build, defend, and upgrade your kingdom in Super Duper Siege! A tower defense roguelike where you must survive an endless onslaught from the forces of darkness.

games.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
games.description: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

games.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
games.description: 把现实世界的赛马，换成在奇幻世界让怪物互相较量的养成SLG。养育、出战，目标是2000只竞争对手的顶点。赛程表、分级赛制、五代血统都照搬赛马，所以要从零开始学的东西不多。一年576战，最多8只同时上场，全自动进行。怪物自己移动、互相放技能，自己决出胜负。养大的怪物可以上传到创意工坊，和世界各地的主人对战。

games.name: Feedmaster
games.description: 《幕后推手》是一款以内容推荐为核心的策略构筑游戏。观察用户的兴趣与情绪，把创作者、广告和观念包装成他们愿意点赞的内容；在不断上涨的周度目标前，优化用户池、组合标签与特性，让每一次点击都变成更高的转化率。至于这一切最终会把用户和世界推向哪里——那是算法之后的事。

games.name: Heirs of the Moon
games.description: Live, hunt, and lead as an apex predator embarked on a brutal survival adventure where every choice shapes your legacy. Find a mate, raise your pups, establish a pack and survive the dangers of the wild. Death is inevitable, but your journey continues with your bloodline.

games.name: 你的妖精老婆们
games.description: 《你的妖精老婆们》是一款以休闲麻将消消乐玩法为核心的轻松互动游戏。玩家通过不断完成消除关卡获取资源，与美少女角色进行互动，逐步解锁女孩的故事章节。

games.name: One Coffee At A Time
games.description: Make coffee, tea and a reach of different bakegoods like Mud Cake, Lamingtons, Caramel Slice, biscuits, cookies, croissants and other Bakegoods. In your own little Cafe/Bakery.

games.name: Femboy : Rescue Mission
games.description: Take charge as a lifeguard dispatcher! Manage emergencies, guide rescue teams, and build relationships with a charming femboy recruit and a carefree veteran lifeguard in this summer romance story.

games.name: Deep Space Observatory
games.description: 扫描恒星，解锁科技，自动化数据收集，打造效率不断提升的天文台。

games.name: CatchUp Showdown
games.description: A co-op catch game for up to 6 players. You and your friends throw around a ball in increasingly harder stages trying to rack up points in order to get to the top of the tower

games.name: INTUS
games.description:
因为害怕失去工作，你接下了周末的额外工作，并租下一间便宜的公寓，好让自己能在那里工作。

很快，保住工作将成为你最不需要担心的事。

games.name: Astro beasts
games.description: 《星际野兽》是一款合作竞技场生存射击游戏，可爱的动物们将抵御成群的外星怪物。并肩作战，建造城墙，放置地雷和炮塔，组合升级道具，将竞技场变成一座毛茸茸的太空堡垒。

games.name: Mataha
games.description: You are in an ever-shifting maze, with countless enemies who are tasked with keeping you imprisoned. Can you unlock the secrets of Mataha and find your way out? And Remember you lose everything on death, except what you have learned about the maze, it's guards and yourself.

games.name: Lone Lines: RPG
games.description: Roguelite RPG set between a shifting desert and the flipside of a grim dark future. Explore the world in the body of the Pilot, command a living, katana-wielding Rover, and forge your own path through a non-linear story. Fight, level up, and make choices where absolutely everything is on the line.

games.name: Crown Tactics
games.description: 《Crown Tactics》是一款快节奏策略游戏。在受国际象棋启发的无限棋盘上与时间赛跑。向上移动以提高分数，俘获敌方棋子赚取金币，并策略性地部署皇后或骑士等强力单位，在不断的攀升中生存下来。

games.name: Far Away Kingdom
games.description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

games.name: Anomaly Sector
games.description:
你有多相信自己的眼睛——和你的朋友?
Anomaly Sector是1-8人在线合作游戏。齐心协力找出异常、做出正确判断,通关每个区域。
仔细观察。一次失误,立即重置。

games.name: Inertia 2: Definitive Edition
games.description: From the creator of Inertia - a first-person movement platformer built on fluid, refined mechanics. Run, create, and compete in the definitive movement experience.

games.name: Pichhal Peri
games.description: A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room.  "YOUR VOICE IS YOUR ONLY WEAPON"

games.name: Eternal Fracture
games.description: In Eternal Fracture, you play as officer T. A grieving police officer that gets dispatched to the Bayou Mall in Louisiana to reset a known malfunctioning security system. What was supposed to be just another late-night routine sweep turns into dread. You are being watched.

games.name: 钢铁原野
games.description: 在这款复古单人 RTS 中，直接指挥装甲单位，占领战场建筑，进行战术性防御塔部署，并以更慢节奏掌控战场。没有传统基地建造，也不依赖快速反应——只有计划、压力、升级，以及在手工设计的任务中发动关键推进。

games.name: Under the Elm
games.description: Inherit your grandmother's cabin and the woods she quietly guarded. Forage real mushrooms, brew the remedies she perfected, and tend a village that is slowly forgetting her. Something in the woods is taking what they remember, and only the oldest trees - and her cat - can help you bring it back.

games.name: Copy Cats
games.description: 利用神秘克隆机的力量，指挥你手下的复制猫咪大军，解开一个个谜题，帮助一只小猫逃离一个奇异的虚拟维度！

games.name: Worlda
games.description: Worlda is a 2D top down pixel-art sandbox adventure where you play as young grizzly bear Jonas as he sets forth into a charming, infinite world, battling brutal bosses and building beautiful bungalows. Will you make it through the night, or will you bear-ly survive?

games.name: SKEW
games.description: 一款以阈限空间与梦核氛围为核心的第一人称探索游戏，没有怪物、战斗或 jump scare

games.name: Vehicle Game
games.description: 这是一款收集资源、获取食物并建造设施，以求生存至最后的各种游戏。

games.name: Handwalk
games.description: 《Handwalk》是一款高难度物理受苦游戏，你需要分别控制每只手，用双手走路爬上山顶。

games.name: 冬末守护者
games.description: 冬末守护者是一款回合制 4X 生存策略游戏，你将在冰封的六角格世界中，规划建筑园区、迈向宏伟奇观的建设，指挥军队作战，并决定人类最终是坚守、逃离，还是让世界重获温暖。

games.name: Alpha Omega
games.description: A high quality and unique hand-crafted VISUAL NOVEL in the spirit of the "Choose Your Own Adventures" of old, which focusses on character and choices that alter the story. An unusual story about MMA, friendship, love, and hardship, where your choices drive everyone's fate.

games.name: DRIFTERS: Blackout Crew
games.description: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

games.name: Mutacronia: hidden threat
games.description: 一款设定在生物体内的2D平台侦探游戏。Leukocytus调查“咳嗽”事件，与变异体战斗并揭露阴谋。利用危险的突变：变身为怪物获得力量，然后恢复控制以拯救濒死的世界。

games.name: Baby Peak
games.description: Baby Peak 是一款基于物理法则的混乱多人平台游戏。四名婴儿同时竞速，这里是反应力与策略激烈碰撞的舞台。你的目标很简单：跳跃、攀爬、破坏对手的行动，并成为第一个拿到黄金奶嘴的人。快来探索各种派对模式和不同的关卡吧。

games.name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
games.description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

games.name: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
games.description: Imagine the frenetic chaos of Geometry Wars colliding with the addictive progression of Vampire Survivors. That's Geometry Rift — a relentless auto-fire action experience where geometric enemies flood the screen and your only option is to shoot, dodge, and survive.

games.name: Final Life Simulator
games.description: 从街头生存到缔造金融商业帝国的连续实时模拟 ⏱️。分秒必争，拒绝任何挂机与数值虚标：打卡上班 💼，扩张实体商铺 🏢，按揭投资房产 🏠，配置黄金与加密货币 🥇，操盘专业希腊字母期权 📈。深度微观经济管理，每一次决策皆有真实后果！

games.name: Dear President
games.description: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.

games.name: RWR:Renegade
games.description: Hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and an upgradable motorcycle against mimic worms. Play as a biker nomad who crushes everything in his path to the sound of rock-chip tunes.

games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
games.description: 经营属于你的足球卡牌商店！开启卡包，发现稀有球员卡，采购足球周边商品并摆放到货架上，向顾客出售商品，扩展店铺，打造最成功的足球卡牌商店。

games.name: Design my drink!
games.description: Create drinks! Unlock more decorations, flavors and options for your drinks. Restore and manage your little cafe and meet locals.

games.name: Imperium Warbands
games.description: 征服一个每局都鲜活如生的古代世界。指挥 18 个文明，在程序生成、拥有动态生物群系、敌对野兽与昼夜循环的地图上征战。夺取聚落，统领传奇英雄，争夺圣物，围攻要塞，在陆地与海洋上掀起战争。

games.name: Sunder
games.description: Sunder is an orbital-artillery RTS in a living star system. Every world is a gun platform on a moving orbit: bend shots around the sun, shove planets off their rails, and crack rival worlds to the core. Draft your arsenal as you fight — solo skirmishes or online war with up to 8 players.

games.name: Keepers of Kur
games.description: 一款 1-4 人合作恐怖游戏，猎手们利用一面能在两个平行维度之间穿梭的镜子追踪被诅咒的物品。在惊悚的任务中存活，智取被附身的生物，并共同回收超自然神器。

games.name: Heathen
games.description: Enter the keep and hunt down the fallen lord who took everything from you. As you descend, a deeper evil reveals itself—an ancient horror never meant for mortal eyes. Heathen is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by classic ARPGs. One town. One dungeon. A descent into madness.

games.name: 五行：御阵九宫
games.description: 这里的牌型不只是打出来，更是摆出来的。每张牌落在三乘三的祭坛上，五行在相邻格之间相生相克，倍率沿着盘面连锁扩散。一款比拼「位置」而非「顺序」的 roguelike 牌组构筑游戏。

games.name: 蛋糕与巧克力的时光
games.description: 经营一家温馨的海滨巧克力精品店！🍫 为个性十足的顾客称重、融化并制作手工甜点，尝试新配方，结识当地人，壮大你的巧克力品牌，在 Sunset Town 开始新生活。

games.name: Roam
games.description: A fantasy turn based tableau building strategy game

games.name: DRIVE IN THE RAIN
games.description: 《DRIVE IN THE RAIN》是一款带有恐怖色彩的体验型公路电影冒险。你将在暴雨中的高速公路上驶向目的地，故事则随着同乘者的对话逐渐展开。玩家只是在雨夜的高速公路上，一心一意地驶向目的地。

games.name: Orbit Crisis
games.description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

games.name: NOITABIL
games.description: A short, slow psychological horror game. You wake up somewhere and a voice tells you what to do. You can listen or not. Nothing jumps out at you. If you want something to shoot, this isn't it. If you've ever felt like your computer knows a little too much about you, it might be.

games.name: While 1
games.description: 不要碰墙。《While 1》是一款极简风格的纯鼠标动作游戏。在关卡中画出闭环，同时躲避与音乐同步的障碍物。

games.name: Tiles of the Nadirat
games.description: A traditional roguelike experience with many unique twists awaits you. Tiles makes you stronger, collect permanent stats and survive attacks of the mysterious Boss who created the Nadirat. Trigger movement pattern combo of items to get even stronger. Guess in riddles what is this place all about.

games.name: Red Wire
games.description: 《Red Wire》是一款专为 2 至 4 人精心打造的合作解谜游戏，整个团队必须齐心协力，赶在炸弹引爆之前将它们一颗一颗地拆除。你们要在各个关卡里四处奔跑、来回穿梭，找出藏在各个角落的配电箱，然后小心翼翼地剪断里头的电线——但有一个前提：你必须先和队友好好沟通，谈妥究竟该剪哪一条才行，否则后果不堪设想。这里有欢乐又荒唐的混乱场面、不可或缺的语音聊天，以及一条绝对不能违反的铁则：千万别剪断那条红线！

games.name: Grilluminati
games.description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

games.name: 鲨鱼超市
games.description: Shark Mart 是一款疯狂的合作模拟游戏，你是伪装成友好海豚的鲨鱼。经营商店、给鲸鱼刷澡，偷偷绑架毫无防备的鱼类并做成美食！但小心——鱼类警察要揭穿你们满嘴獠牙的秘密...

games.name: Aptacris : Dipolos Anomalia
games.description: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds. Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles. Play as Ai'Lynn, searching for a fragment within her own mind.

games.name: Green Space
games.description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

games.name: runz
games.description: 在RUNZ中，弹匣里的每一颗子弹都很重要。抵御越来越强的敌人波次，掌握独特的升级系统。构建协同、组合子弹、管理经济并强化武器，体验这款融合自走棋元素的双摇杆射击游戏。

games.name: ShredDead
games.description: ShredDead 是一款轻松搞怪的渐进式僵尸绞杀放置游戏，核心在于不断成长，而且没有失败条件。击败无尽尸潮、收集战利品、壮大技能树，并让僵尸不断进化。

games.name: Roll to Riches
games.description: 在《Roll to Riches》中，每一次掷骰都能推动你的定居点成长。开采铁矿、收集木材、切割石料，不断发展生产。每分钟与商人交易，将小小营地逐步发展为富饶强盛的北欧帝国。

games.name: Qwak Reborn
games.description: 外表可爱。玩法残酷。Qwak Reborn 是一款节奏紧张的街机平台游戏，充满动作、道具、秘密、谜题和陷阱。简单易学。欲罢不能。和朋友一起更好玩！

games.name: 偃月之日: 天狗
games.description: 一颗星石，牵动万物。在古色古香的神州大地，感受四大元素与日月神兽交织的唯美解谜体验。

games.name: KILL HIM
games.description:
在杀戮与探索中寻找真相。
KILL HIM 是一款黑白风格的类银河恶魔城游戏，你将穿越充满敌意的世界，挑战强大的敌人，并发现隐藏在一切背后的秘密。

games.name: Necrotel: No Checkout
games.description: Necrotel: No Checkout is a unique management and crafting simulator set within the walls of a grim, gothic hotel. You play as an underground surgeon managing a getaway for eccentric nobles and monsters to fund your forbidden necromantic experiments.

games.name: Miles To Nowhere
games.description: Running out of ammo during a raid, a police officer escapes into a sealed tunnel. But the end leads not to daylight, but to the darkest corners of his mind. Miles to Nowhere is an intense psychological horror where survival instincts collide with crushing trauma.

games.name: She Was King
games.description: A dark, witchy pixel-art RPG dungeon crawler about hexed bonds, curious creatures, and finding your way home. Run, as fast as you can. Can you outfox what's coming, or will you let it consume you?

games.name: Capybara Clash
games.description: 这些水豚全副武装，渴望用种类繁多、既有趣又致命的武器摧毁敌人和环境。无论是在线单人游戏，还是本地多人游戏，都能尽情享受爆炸的乐趣。

games.name: ALL OUT WAR
games.description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

games.name: Single Note
games.description: An atmospheric first-person driving adventure through a strange retro world filled with music, mystery, and psychological tension.

games.name: PRO: Push React Outgun
games.description: PRO: Push React Outgun 是一款拥有逼真画面的次世代战术 FPS。体验近距离战斗带来的原始冲击感，每一发子弹都至关重要。掌握战略站位与敏锐反应，赢得胜利。看见隐藏之处，听见细微之声，在高压下生存。

games.name: Heroic Gambit
games.description: 《英雄之战》是一款设定在奇幻世界尼米亚的动作类Roguelite游戏。玩家将探索随机生成的地下城，挑战难度不断提升的敌人、陷阱以及创始人留下的谜题。唯有敏捷的反应和稳健的策略，才能助你达成最终目标。

games.name: 银心
games.description: 内向阴郁的女高中生"月"寻找朋友"银心"的过程中，突然发现她可能是自己妄想出来的。在暴风骤雨一般的反转之中，她走遍每个世界，想要见到银心……

games.name: Neural Repair
games.description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

games.name: 口袋修仙
games.description:
《口袋修仙》是一款以“储物袋构筑”为核心的策略修仙游戏。你将在广袤的修仙世界中游历闯荡，收集适合自己的道具，在储物袋有限的格子中，让道具之间形成联动与资源循环，从而积累修为、突破瓶颈、应对千奇百怪的敌人，追求大道。

本游戏为单人开发纯AI项目，游戏中大量使用了AI资产，在这里先和介意的道友声明清楚了哈！也正是因为AI的辅助，我可以提供更加丰富和多样的内容给大家。欢迎加入我们的官方QQ群，一同探讨如何将《口袋修仙》做得更好玩，如果有想要探讨使用AI开发游戏的朋友，也可以一起加入哦！

games.name: Rotten Rounds
games.description: 一款基于职业的第三人称合作肉鸽射击游戏，与队友共同对抗不断升级的僵尸浪潮，每轮后选择强力升级，看看在被僵尸群淹没之前你们能坚持多久。

games.name: 全面抗战  War in Asia
games.description: 扮演任意派系，体验1937-1945年二战的东亚战场，通过拟真的游戏系统管理国家的军事、经济与交通，在7km尺度的地图上，通过指挥链掌握你的兵棋单位，遂行作战任务。

games.name: 小小勇士 (Little Warrior)
games.description: 《小小勇士》是一款可爱像素风双摇杆动作肉鸽。选择法杖、大剑、弓箭、剑盾或双剑进入战斗，在六宫格加点与随机成长中组合技能流派。成为园丁、伐木工或厨师，通过装备品质与词条洗练打出每局不同构筑。胜利不只靠运气，更靠你的选择。

games.name: AmaTisMo
games.description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

games.name: WORJONG / 字将
games.description:
《WORJONG / 字将》是一款通过拼出英语单词来胡牌的类麻将游戏。
使用26种字母牌，拼出4个由3个字母组成的英语单词吧！
规则简单易懂！任何人都能轻松上手！
支持在线对战，快来与好友或其他玩家一较高下吧！

games.name: Hamstr Protocol
games.description: 打造由仓鼠驱动的生物挖矿产业。亲手组装矿机、控制温度、喂养仓鼠并维持生产。从车库起步，优化整个生产流程，最终发展成大规模工业设施。

games.name: Keyboard Curse
games.description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

games.name: 山无所念
games.description: 《山无所念》是一款结合平台跳跃、轻度肉鸽、轻度类塔科夫收集的冒险游戏，在这里进入探险，不断提升自己、挑战难关，途中不仅有各式各样的机关，更有强悍的敌人。如何打破双脚的枷锁，山外面的世界究竟发生了什么？不同的角色以不同的动机来到玩家身边，太多的谜团等待揭晓。

games.name: The Red Weight
games.description: 一部剧情厚重的火星悬疑作品，你的每个选择都有分量。你将扮演火星居住区的一名地质学家，调查一个已经耐心等待了一万年的秘密。

games.name: You're Alive, Phil
games.description: Help Phil work out what it means to be alive. Guide our rocky friend through 70 handcrafted grid-based puzzles, where every step changes the path you can take.

games.name: Behind Room 102
games.description: In a dark nation of crime and corruption, you're more than just a hotel worker. Inspect the people in front of you, catch their lies, and make decisions. Your boss expects the best. To survive in this ruthless world, doing what you're told is a MUST! But will you follow every order?

games.name: Final Buzzer : Idle Basketball Manager 🏀
games.description: 篮球像雨一样落在你的街头球场，每记进球都变成现金。把钱投进 196 节点的技能树，把阵容扩充到 30 名射手，再打真正的 5v5 像素篮球赛，一路爬完七级联赛。一款真的值得盯着看的放置篮球游戏。

games.name: Rookie Raiders
games.description: 新秀们，探索地下城，夺取财富与名誉吧！用个性鲜明的角色打造专属构筑，组建你的队伍！一切尽在你的设计之中。全自动战斗Roguelite RPG《Rookie Raiders》！

games.name: Micro Party
games.description: 150+ micro-games, 5 to 15 seconds each. 2-4 players on one keyboard. Most of it built with AI and I am not going to pretend otherwise.

games.name: BRAVERUN
games.description:
惊险刺激的动作与史诗般的Boss战！
在复古动作RPG《BRAVERUN》中，穿梭于90年代风格的像素世界——斩群敌，迎战强敌！

games.name: The UNDA Legacy
games.description: An atmospheric 3D puzzle game based on the principles of wave physics. Explore the mysterious Roursus island and solve over 25 puzzles using reflection, interference, and resonance. Uncover the fate of a vanished research team in a peaceful world where science meets philosophy.

games.name: DEEPWARD
games.description: 从六名英雄中选择三人，每人拥有专属武器、技能与战斗风格。组建合适的小队，随时切换英雄，在这款背景设定于1920年代的快节奏恐怖FPS Roguelite中直面无情的恐怖。深入被上帝遗忘之地的地底深处——在那里，死亡无可挽回。

games.name: HACKING INTO EREBUS
games.description: 《HACKING INTO EREBUS》是， 款终端驱动的赛博朋克黑客惊悚游戏。入侵敌对网络，智胜监控你每， 步行动的 ARIA 系统。突破节点，绕过防御，揭开陷入冷冻睡眠船员隐藏的秘密。

games.name: Minatro
games.description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

games.name: DropCell
games.description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

games.name: Crowned
games.description: Lead legendary medieval armies in a turn-based card strategy game set during the conflicts of the Middle Ages. Choose your King, build your deck, and outmaneuver your enemies on the battlefield. Every card is earned through battle. Every decision matters.

games.name: 机械之心
games.description: 《机械之心》是一款结合俯视角塔防和轻度rogue的游戏。面对数以千计并不断进化的机械虫群敌人，你将针对性地构筑阵地，用芯片配件强化防御塔，在战斗实时中释放支援武器扭转战局，最终建立牢不可破的防线，保护核心不被摧毁。

games.name: Zombie Crawlers
games.description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

games.name: Endless Void: Idle Tower Defence
games.description: 《Endless Void: Idle Tower Defence》是一款极简科幻放置塔防游戏。从单门加农炮起步，解锁 1000+ 节点星系天赋树与宇宙级毁灭传说武装，派遣自动无人机蜂群，在无限膨胀的敌军狂潮中铸就不可撼动的终极深空堡垒！零内购，纯粹享受数值成长爽感。

games.name: 抽陀螺
games.description: 抽陀螺是一款关于抽打陀螺的增量游戏。你被困在一盘神秘录像带中，只能操控电视画面里的陀螺。不断抽打陀螺，赚取金钱、购买升级、学习技能，解锁并购买各种强力物品，摧毁录像带中的一个个世界，寻找逃离的方法。

games.name: Cloud Country
games.description: An action rogue-lite adventure where you battle through random levels, level up and upgrade your weapons while unlocking new items and characters to defeat the witch threatening Cloud Country.

games.name: 流浪猫岛
games.description: 欢迎来到《流浪猫岛》！这是一款轻松治愈的放置挂机游戏，可以位于屏幕上的任意一个角落。岛上生活着一群可爱的流浪猫，照顾并收养它们，让你在繁忙的生活中也能享受温馨的撸猫时光。

games.name: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
games.description:
A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip!
A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese!
Build defenses, jump in as one of 4 cats, and draft a card every wave to save the premium cheese. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

games.name: Atmospheric Labyrinth
games.description:
在普通房间构成的迷城里，寻找不普通的事件。
穿过迷城，重新看见日常生活。

games.name: 请在梦里玩的开心
games.description: 在梦中战斗的卡牌游戏，用头脑和运气赢得有趣的战斗。

games.name: How to Summon a Demon
games.description:
Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? 
Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

games.name: Sectron
games.description: 以随机生成的小行星世界为舞台的科幻回合制策略游戏。扩建基地，部署并升级部队，利用联盟与战术征服一个个风格各异的星球。规则简单易懂，但战术变化极其丰富。易于上手，难于精通。

games.name: Old War
games.description: A cinematic medieval action adventure set during the Mongol invasions. Survive brutal battles, hunt your enemies, and lead your people through a collapsing world.

games.name: Parcel Panic
games.description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

games.name: Rescue Incoming
games.description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

games.name: 呱呱坠地!
games.description: 被遗忘在世界最底层的你，决定要从下而上，通过不断滚动、跳跃与摆荡，穿越各种充满创意的机关与截然不同的奇幻世界，最终找到自己真正的主人，重新回到被珍惜的幸福时刻。

games.name: Clonefall
games.description: 一款将克隆体化为解谜关键的平台解谜游戏。创造克隆体来抵达新的区域、阻挡危险、启动机关，并利用物理机制突破重重挑战。

games.name: Black Hole Surfers
games.description: Trapped after being sucked into a black hole, your only hope is to gather resources from the passing debris, upgrade your ship and survive long enough to find a way to escape. A unique blend of bullet-heaven action and incremental upgrading, will you find your way back home in Black Hole Surfers?

games.name: Cthulhu Round Table 克苏鲁圆桌
games.description:
这一款拥有克苏鲁元素的心理恐怖解密类文字游戏
玩家作为无法被圆桌直接吞噬的“观测者”
每局随机附身十名凡人角色中的一人，
但根本不知道自己的身份。
你需要通过对话、观察破绽、人物关系和圆桌发言，
同时推理两个目标：我附身了谁？
和哪三个人是古神使者？

games.name: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
games.description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters. Chase those online high scores! And if you have a VR headset, play in VR!

games.name: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game
games.description: 掷出骰子，征服魔法棋盘！在这个充满混乱的多人派对游戏中，升级怪物巢穴，释放独特的角色技能，并让你的朋友们破产！

games.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
games.description: CUBOUNCE 是一款高速物理平台游戏。操控方块，利用弹射和钩爪摆荡，以精准操作和极限动量突破重重挑战。

games.name: Escape the Space Hotel
games.description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

games.name: 谋圣
games.description: 这是一场 15 分钟的 11×11 棋盘领土战。核心是落子、控地、切断与时机判断；卡牌只是辅助你打出声东击西、陷阱或节奏交换。16 位历史名将、30 张策略卡、500 关挑战，每一局先看棋盘，再看手牌。

games.name: Project Spooky
games.description: 这款游戏的开发者在完成作品之前失踪了。探索他最后一个项目的重构版本：这是一段第一人称心理恐怖体验，其中的谜题与隐藏秘密将让你重新审视 Casa da Fonte 曾经发生的一切。

games.name: Texas Oil Baron
games.description: Oil tycoon game, where half the action takes place underground. You buy land, prospect for oil, drill, pump, and transport the product. You can sell at local buyer or sign supply contracts at fixed prices. Profitability is dictated by market forces - politics, weather, and collusion.

games.name: Rosebound
games.description: There's love in deathーdeath in eternity. Rosebound is a fully voiced visual novel set in a world of vampires, high-tech mercenaries, magical priests, and man-made horrors.

games.name: ai.ai
games.description: The CEO of   has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley.

games.name: Undercover Love - Where Shadows Meet
games.description: A dark noir visual novel following Alex, a former police officer drawn into the mafia’s world. In a city where trust can get you killed and everyone has something to hide, Alex and a mafia leader with buried secrets are pulled into revenge, power, and slow-burn romance shaped by your choices.

games.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
games.description: 从一块空地开始打造你自己的网咖：一排排游戏电脑、游戏主机与 VR 区、酒吧和厨房。雇佣员工，让玩家们满意，与城中 21 个派系周旋——别忘了摸摸网咖的猫咪露娜。

games.name: The Last Admiral
games.description: 一款没有网格的回合制太空战术Roguelite。你效忠的联盟一枪未发，就断了你的补给，于是你带着四艘舰船分道扬镳。借小行星掩护作战，从击败的舰队手中赢取舰体，混编14个阵营的舰船，逐个区域夺下整个银河。远征可败，舰队长存。

games.name: GloveUp!
games.description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

games.name: 走了GONE
games.description:
这是一个披着“家庭”外衣，寻找自我的故事。你将以顾晦星的第一人称视角，喝下孟婆汤，成为一个阴差。
喝下汤，“我”还是“我”吗？以旁人视角观看自己生平，以上帝视角重审生活琐事，我又会变成什么样子？
生活从来不是死局，是一个选项。
愿你生活中的每一个瞬间，都值得热泪盈眶。

games.name: Castle of Thorns
games.description: A mystery visual novel set in a cursed castle. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the castle's dark past.

games.name: 全金属炼狱
games.description: 《全金属炼狱》是一款融合物理碰撞和主动技能的轻度肉鸽射击游戏。丰富的载具/武器/构筑，于机械狂潮中碾碎一切！

games.name: My Galaxy Buddy
games.description: Pilot a lone UFO in this cozy idle desktop game that lives in the corner of your screen. Discover randomly generated planets, extract rare resources, uncover strange artifacts, and build your collection one world at a time.

games.name: 创世学院
games.description: 《创世学院》是一款 Roguelike 策略构筑游戏，你将扮演一位学生神明，通过推演不同世界与文明的发展，研究商业、生态、勇者与魔王等课题，构筑属于自己的研究体系并积累研究点数完成毕业考核。

games.name: Sausage Escape
games.description: 这是一场关于香肠生存的合作冒险，任何错误都会让你变成肉末。单独或与一群香肠战士一起玩。在危险的房子里生存，完成任务并以不同的模式使用传送器、火焰喷射器和定制枪。

games.name: Tuggin It
games.description: Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can! Unlock and purchase upgrades to make tuggin it go a little smoother, and apply cosmetics so you're always tuggin it with style!

games.name: 超级收割
games.description: 《超级收割》是一款轻松解压的主动增量割草游戏：挥动镰刀收割疯长的作物，出售资源换取金币，解锁技能、天赋、装备与全新的收割方式，将破旧农场逐步建设成高效运转的收割乐园。

games.name: Desert Echo
games.description: You are Echo, an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Deploy turrets, gas barrels, farm energy fragments. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op. The desert doesn't forgive hesitation.

games.name: Sheepscape
games.description: 《Sheepscape》是一款温馨惬意、专注养羊的农场模拟游戏。派出牧羊犬聚拢羊群，在小游戏里亲手剪羊毛，再卖掉羊毛，一季又一季地培育出更好的羊群。从第一片泥泞的草场到辽阔的苏格兰高地，牧羊人的全部手艺尽在其中。

games.name: Meander
games.description: Draw with crochet stitches, draw new brushes to fit any aesthetic, draw little animation paths to bring your art to life! There are no goals or timers. Just a lot of options to let you relax and be creative. Fill your scrapbook with your doodles and decorate them with stickers and text! (No AI)

games.name: Patience Balls
games.description: 倾斜相互连接的棋盘引导小球入洞。在有护墙的禅道模式与无墙的耐心模式中精通 100 个手工关卡，使用关卡编辑器创作自定义谜题，并冲击全球排行榜。

games.name: Juice Board
games.description: Add some juice to your typing with custom carets, satisfying effects, and reactive word combos that work across multiple desktop applications.

games.name: Ruin Blade
games.description:
《遗迹之刃》是一款专注于近战砍杀的俯视角战斗+地牢探索的游戏。
你将以佣兵的身份深入古代遗迹。直面潮水般的怪物，在危机四伏的环境中搏杀出你的道路。

games.name: Starway to Urf
games.description: A poppy, pulpy sci fi comedy. Play as Susie, a plucky young woman who has to escape her job as an intergalactic au-pair before setting off into a broken universe in search of the fabled Starway to Urf. A point and click adventure about living with heart and finding friends in a broken universe.

games.name: Pucked Up
games.description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

games.name: 欢迎继续上班 (Welcome Back to Work)
games.description: 复活，再带一个自己杀回来！在这款单人生存肉鸽中，复活后救回过去的自己，立刻多一整套火力。每个自己最多携带 6 把武器，让越来越多的自己一起开火，在异变办公室里从孤身求生打到整队齐射。探索武器合成配方，打造更强的 build，把下一波怪潮轰回去。

games.name: Birch
games.description: 桌面上有一群小鸟，会安安静静停在你的图标上。你一靠近它们就有反应，不理它们也不会生气。但你在的时间久了，它们会慢慢认得你哦。

games.name: 美偶人 Puppet
games.description: 一款第一人称 3D 生存恐怖游戏，你误入了这个诡异的空间，疯狂的人偶与高挑的魅影对你紧追不放，任何一步都需要小心翼翼，避开它们的视线。探索周围环境，利用道具和笔记上的线索，寻找离开这里的路。不安与恐惧时刻笼罩着你，努力逃离这场噩梦。

games.name: Penguin, but why?
games.description: The story becomes not a tale about death or nihilism, but a reflection on human life itself. About why people leave their «colonies», why they strive toward impossible peaks, and what exactly drives them to continue the journey, even when all that surrounds them is cold and emptiness.

games.name: 中国棋牌博物馆
games.description: 中国棋牌博物馆是一款中国传统棋牌游戏合集，收录多类跑牌、墩牌、麻将与地方特色玩法。以真实牌桌规则为基础，结合国风美术与原创音乐，支持人机对战和 Steam 联机。你可以在跑牌游戏清空手牌、团队策略争夺墩数，以及多样地方麻将的计番规则中，与可调难度的AI练习或通过Steam联机对战。

games.name: Rejoin
games.description: Restore centuries-old Japanese folding screens through relaxing puzzles that bring their panels back into harmony. Unwind in a world of shimmering gold, tranquil soundscapes, and satisfying restoration.

games.name: Degrowth
games.description:
Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living!
Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed!
Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

games.name: Balingo
games.description: Balingo 是一款以宾果为核心的 Roguelike 游戏，每一颗球都至关重要。购买宾果卡、标记数字，并组合票券、印章、记号笔和弹珠，打造独特的连招，在球用完之前不断冲击更高分数。

games.name: Renegades
games.description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles. Deep character development in multiple tracks leads to high customization.

games.name: Pinguino
games.description: Slip & Slide Your Way Through Each Level While Eating as Few Fish as Possible!

games.name: Fantasy to Kill
games.description:
在融合即时机制的回合制战斗 RPG 中招架敌人的攻击。

“深渊”深处遍布等级远超你的怪物与不公平的战斗。想要活下去，你就必须比它们更狠。

组建一支由 3 名角色构成的队伍，升级各自独特的技能，装备持有物品，强化属性，并通过 EXP 提升等级。

games.name: 1daYs
games.description:
原以为会如往常一样度过的早晨。
一封一直想交出去的信，却将民秀的一天引向了意想不到的方向。
1daYs是一款2D像素叙事冒险游戏，讲述隐藏在平凡日常中的小事件与谜团。

games.name: Pathogen
games.description:
幽灵绑架了曾经拿自己做实验的博士们， 命令他们从病原体中提取精华。
你就是其中一名博士。想要在幽灵的致命实验中活下来， 就必须在为时已晚之前提取足够的精华。
你能活着逃出去吗？

games.name: 門 GATE
games.description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

games.name: 形色之战
games.description: 一款有BD构建的波次生存ROGUE游戏。进化并拼接你的形状、购买各式道具、创造独特的构筑并生存下去！

games.name: Strike Wings
games.description: 指挥整支舰队，或亲自驾驶其中一架战斗机杀入战场核心。Strike Wings 是一款从零打造、向经典太空战 DOS 游戏致敬的作品：三部全语音战役、横跨 16 个星系的持续战争、24 人多人对战、战斗编辑器，以及在漆黑星空上绽放的漫天火光。

games.name: 双蚁
games.description: 两只摸鱼的蚂蚁，一颗神秘的球，以及一场极其残忍的爬升之旅。配合彼此的行动，掌握精准的跳跃，在你们的友情彻底破裂之前把这玩意儿拖到顶峰。

games.name: AQUA FALL
games.description: 滑行、飞跃、俯冲！《Aqua Fall》是一款最多 8 人一起冲下水滑梯的欢乐派对竞速游戏。冲出赛道的捷径是胜负关键。在终点纵身跃入泳池，争夺第一名吧！公开匹配与 BOT 对战都能轻松畅玩。

games.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
games.description: 经营一家温馨的二手魔法店：收购来路可疑的破烂，研究荒诞附魔，制作古怪器物，再和愿意为魔法胡闹一掷千金的奇葩顾客讨价还价。

games.name: The 11th Power
games.description: What if 2048 was a deckbuilding roguelike? Fight evil cultists and trans-dimensional horrors by combining tiles!

games.name: Infernal Foundations
games.description: Command Hell's horde in a colony-building sandbox. Reshape a voxel world, gather physical resources, build your infernal stronghold block by block, create production chains, and defend Hell’s newest territory from the forces of mankind.

games.name: 锁定战机
games.description: 《锁定战机》是一款太空环境中的射击游戏。孤身一人的你面对源源不断的敌人，只能通过战机的锁定功能来打击目标杀出一条活路！选择锁定合适的敌人，通过释放连击积攒的技能击败敌人，保全自己，活到最后的才是胜利者！

games.name: 海岸洗船
games.description: 《Seaside Wash》是一款温馨的职业模拟游戏，你将在游戏中清洁、维修并修复船只，让它们从锈迹斑斑、布满藤壶的状态恢复到崭新如初。升级工具、拓展业务、发现稀有物品、打造属于自己的船只，并享受宁静的海滨生活。

games.name: 奔波的绫子小姐
games.description:
这是一款无战斗的休闲探索RPG。
玩家将扮演单亲妈妈，在小镇中与NPC对话、解决烦恼以收集「信仰」，藉此拯救昏迷的儿子。
本作包含超过190个剧情事件与丰富换装CG，并搭载独特的「自言自语」系统，
让您能一键获取主角心声与攻略提示，轻松体验这段奇妙的助人旅程。

games.name: 亵渎圣女
games.description: 《亵渎圣女》是一款多结局角色扮演游戏。失忆少女爱特菈孤身踏入欲望横流的地下都市，只为找回被夺走的记忆。自由养成角色、20种以上结局分歧。你的选择决定她走向救赎还是沉沦。

games.name: Holy Nun's Futanari Cleansing
games.description: A futa x female visual novel about a nun helping various futanari get accustomed to their new urges and alleviating them of stress. Fully voiced main cast!

games.name: Explosive Exchange
games.description: 一款快节奏的多人竞技派对游戏，最多支持 **8 名玩家**。打造离谱的流派，击败你的朋友，让每一场对战都陷入爆炸般的混乱。支持本地同乐或在线联机。

games.name: Sacrificium
games.description: Sacrificium is a dark psychological horror experience blending illustrated storytelling, branching choices, and sanity-driven gameplay. Trapped in a castle controlled by a satanic cult, you must escape before the nightmare consumes you.

games.name: 六艺中文填字
games.description: 经典填字游戏的中文版。《六艺中文填字》是一款以中国古代“君子六艺”为核心框架的纯正中文文字解谜游戏。游戏有丰富的关卡数量、贴心的UI交互和趣味的主题设计，在这里，你可以穿梭于“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗，挑战包罗万象、纵贯古今中外的海量知识点。

games.name: REUNION
games.description:
Can you handle two at once?
A real-time multitasking puzzle that turns your brain into a traffic jam. Control two souls—one with each hand—and guide them back to each other in this simultaneous-control puzzle action game.

games.name: Ore Legacy
games.description: 一款以深空为背景的复古 CRT 风格放置采矿游戏。扩建空间站，自动化资源开采舰队，虹吸恒星燃料，并偿还一笔不可能还清的债务。

games.name: R.O.G.U.E. Waves
games.description: 全宇宙第一的冲浪 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏！抢最好的浪，搓出离谱的连击，在全世界最没人管的冲浪大赛上把对手的分数甩在身后。

games.name: 矮人的无尽矿山
games.description: 这是一款需要轻度操作的增量游戏，你作为挖矿矮人，深入矿洞寻觅矿石，带回各种矿物换取食矿龙的无尽宝藏。不断升级，不断深入，升级矿山，完全征服这座无尽矿山就是你的目标！

games.name: PATRICIDE
games.description:
《PATRICIDE》是一款讲述杀了父亲的少女们的冒险RPG。
本作以爱与恨的故事、融合动作与回合制的战斗，以及动漫风格描绘的可爱的女主角们为特色。
熟练运用通过“共情”削弱敌人的“感情系统”，在无情且充满窒息感的现代社会中生存下去吧。

games.name: The Last Ores
games.description: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

games.name: Vampire Invasion
games.description: 你就是入侵者。指挥不断壮大的吸血鬼部队，在这款像素风反塔防游戏中作战。部署独特的吸血鬼，构建你的阵型，利用他们的能力，撕裂人类的防线和致命陷阱。

games.name: Into the Planet's Flesh
games.description: 在这款增量游戏中孵化寄生虫，侵染大地。随着殖群如疾病般蔓延整颗星球，造就一番骇人景象。看看当寄生虫探索得太深时会发生什么。

games.name: 零回响
games.description: 一款像素风心理恐怖叙事游戏，围绕日常、记忆与对改变的恐惧展开。探索、解读，并揭开深藏于内心的真相。

games.name: Zone Stalkers
games.description:
Insure your gear and save your life. Die anyway. Come back stronger.
First-person PvPvE extraction in a haunted Exclusion Zone. Take Stalker Insurance before the raid, or pay a lot more after you die. Artifacts, mutants, anomalies, rival stalkers. Either way, the Zone's filing a claim.

games.name: Exhibition of the Heart
games.description:
Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? 
Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

games.name: 記憶の残響-AIプロファイラー-
games.description: 《记忆的回响：AI侧写师》是一款与AI搭档ECHO一同重新调查悬案的推理冒险游戏。玩家将化身为搜查官黑岩诚，通过现场照片、社交媒体和警方数据库寻找线索。根据AI指出的异常之处揭露矛盾，揭开隐藏在“官方记录的谎言”背后的真相！

games.name: ぺちぺちハクスラ
games.description:
A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills.
The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes!
Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

games.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
games.description: 一款充满氛围感的 动作 RPG，扮演精灵女猎手穿越魔法传送门探索奇幻世界。战斗、收集稀有装备，并重建古老的 Sunveil 要塞。

games.name: Slice of Fortune
games.description: 切、榨、卖，在这款充满果汁的增量游戏中不断成长。升级你的刀刃，让它变得前所未有的更大、更锋利，切遍世间所有水果，并通过弹珠机商店出售果汁，不断积累财富，通过技能树解锁强力升级。

games.name: 超魔球！ホームランダービー
games.description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

games.name: 孢子风暴：荒星防线
games.description: 手绘风异星生存塔防。没有固定路线——炮台与冰墙实时改写虫群进攻路径。操控工程师木兰下场作战，利用孢子生态连锁守住矿坑防线。完整版将拓展更多英雄、敌人与战场。

games.name: Midnight Scour
games.description: 在这款氛围感十足的第一人称恐怖游戏中，逃离一场乡村噩梦。你正被一个狡猾的杀手追捕。他在房子里生活、睡觉，并会根据你的行动主动展开狩猎。运用潜行技巧在屋内穿梭，解开谜题，并从其中一个出口成功逃脱。

games.name: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving
games.description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving 是一款血肉横飞的第三人称动作游戏，拥有深度的剑斗系统。运用你丰富的武器库，体验扣人心弦的战役。探索关卡，解锁新内容。

games.name: 永眠之匣，雪上之樱
games.description:
《永眠之匣，雪上之樱》是一款以殡仪馆为舞台的剧情向视觉小说！

没错，殡仪馆！

这是一个关于"告别"与"陪伴"的故事，温馨，治愈，偶尔塞你一口刀（

本作25万字全程语音，无分支主线，十余个EX小剧场，全通后还有打破第四面墙的Meta剧情等着你！

没有黑深残，大家都有happy end~请放心游玩(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

games.name: Idle Tides
games.description:
《Idle Tides》是一款增量放置游戏，你的目标很简单：
尽可能多地捕鱼。解锁新船只使钓鱼自动化，升级你的船队，并帮助岛屿解决鱼类数量过剩的问题！

games.name: Stack Out
games.description: A puzzle platformer where little cubes find the way out. Play solo or with friends, build your own maps, and see how your run stacks out.

games.name: DIGSITE ZERO
games.description: Destroy meteorites, collect crystals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools to dig even deeper beneath the surface of the cosmic rock. In DIGSITE ZERO, a simple mining loop leads to a mystery that’s out of this world.

games.name: Direlands: Extraction
games.description: Direlands: Extraction blends looter shooter progression, extraction gameplay, and classic fantasy RPG adventure. Explore dangerous realms through ancient portals, gather powerful loot, and fight your way home—or lose everything you carry.

games.name: 守城录：六阵 — 三国卡牌构筑塔防
games.description: 三国题材的六边形塔防。构筑你的卡组，召唤传奇英雄，在20波永夜攻势中守住最后的城池。

games.name: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
games.description: Explore surreal, fractured spaces, recover traces of someone who disappeared, and piece together a story of disappearance in a first-person psychological horror game. Episode 1 of a planned trilogy, solo-developed in Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: S.I.F: The Missing Rescue
games.description: 《S.I.F: The Missing Rescue》是一款以美国国家公园为背景的1-4人合作恐怖游戏。有人失踪，你的搜救队深入迷宫般的密林。某种未知存在正暗中窥视。失踪者仍在其中，直面危险吧——这就是你们的职责。

games.name: Crowned Sun
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: A 3D isometric MMORPG rooted in Yoruba, Candomblé, and Afro-Brazilian mythology. In the spirit of Ragnarok Online and Tree of Savior — choose from four peoples, master Base and Job levels, and find your place in Aruanda under a sun crowned in legend.

games.name: Abdication
games.description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

games.name: Dyna-Brix
games.description:
Dyna-brix is the new indie brick breaker game.
Destroy bricks on dynamic levels to an original and dynamic soundtrack, with precise controls and physics and minimalistic and readable visuals.

games.name: content moderator.
games.description: 一种会通过照片传播幻觉的怪病——“异影症”。为了筹集母亲的手术费，你应聘了一份负责删除异常照片的可疑工作——“内容审核员”。异影症之谜、公司的黑暗内幕，以及被掩盖的真相……从这间异常的办公室中活着逃出去吧。

games.name: OxVOID
games.description:
OxVOID —— 一款极简风格的解谜游戏，在这里，物理、逻辑与环境作为一个统一系统共同运作。
通过精心设计的挑战掌握规则。
然后打破边界——在内置关卡编辑器中创造属于你自己的关卡。

games.name: The Deepest Shift
games.description: A psychological horror game about working night shifts in a remote underwater facility, maintaining equipment, completing tasks, and making it through another night.

games.name: Sack Investigation
games.description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

games.name: JMT -DUeL-
games.description: 超硬核猜拳游戏《JMT -DUeL-》 猜拳 + 属性加点 + 技能 + 全透明 AI 逻辑。彻底颠覆你的猜拳大脑。来吧，对决！

games.name: Sunnytime Friends: Episode 1
games.description: As a technician working for a local electrical company, you are tasked to restore power to an old animation studio which used to produce the state-wide cartoon Sunnytime Friends. Use your flashlight, Go through obstacles, And, most importantly, Don't. Get. Caught.

games.name: 古咒迷途2渊海 lost curse 2 abyssal
games.description: 在被梦魇吞噬的黑暗大陆，玩家将踏上一场步步惊心的信任博弈之旅。游戏延续前作经典的 JRPG 回合制玩法，融合爽文式高能反转剧情，让你在与拟态魔物的殊死搏斗中，体验层层揭开真相的极致快感。

games.name: 我的女友是杀手
games.description: 高中生秦越有一个愿望——安稳过完高中。然而转校生铃木静的出现打乱了这份计划。沉默寡言、身手利落的她，自称是来“保护”他的。还没等他消化这一切——八卦的百事通、骄纵的大小姐、深不可测的学生会长，以及那位笑容迷人却暗藏锋芒的美女老师……一段交织着谜团、守护与心动的恋爱喜剧，就此开幕！

games.name: 魔王堕落图鉴
games.description: 登上魔王之座。以指令与抉择,驯服那些胆敢闯入你领地的来犯冒险者。由数值与选择驱动的深度堕落养成,5 名独特角色,全阵容皆以完整 CG 呈现。

games.name: 摸鱼火车 Vibe Train
games.description: 这是一款轻松休闲的火车主题桌面放置游戏。装备各式车厢，在铁轨上探索世界。在旅途中栽培作物、运输货物、贸易经营、运送乘客。

games.name: Lil Laundry Lane
games.description: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

games.name: Senti Metrica | 森蒂·梅特里卡
games.description:
“If you are not loved, you won’t survive—”

A girl slowly turning into a monster,
and the “Metrica” who hunt her.

A survival otome game
where you waver between reason and instinct.

games.name: 深渊降临：黑曜城塞
games.description: 《深渊降临：黑曜城塞》是一款融合实时英雄操控，法术系统，以及 d20 命运骰机制的黑暗奇幻塔防游戏。建造防线、亲自操控法师迎战深渊怪物，并在每一次命运抉择中赌上胜利的希望。

games.name: Rogue Reels
games.description: 《Rogue Reels》是一款海盗题材的roguelike游戏,你需要从零开始打造属于自己的老虎机,以躲过飞行荷兰人索取的幽灵通行费。游戏中拥有100多种独特符号与丰富多变的机制,任你自由组合出强力连击效果,一次次挑战极限,想尽办法逃离这来自亡灵船长的无情追讨,并在全球排行榜上与来自世界各地的玩家一较高下,不断刷新属于自己的最佳纪录,体验独一无二的海盗冒险之旅。游戏不含任何真实货币赌博内容,可以放心游玩

games.name: Cardwork
games.description: Destruction becomes creation in this roguelike deckbuilder where you cut, combine and reshape cards to create powerful new cards and build unique strategies every run.

games.name: Cooking Adventure
games.description: 在为 PC 重新打造的快节奏 2D 烹饪时间管理游戏中烹饪、上菜并升级。掌握食谱，管理忙碌厨房，满足顾客，在缤纷餐厅中冲击高分。

games.name: Lizard Slayer
games.description: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.

games.name: Dark Workshop Simulator
games.description: 《Dark Workshop Simulator》是一款第一人称暗黑奇幻商店模拟器。瘟疫、匪帮、价格波动等世界事件让供应商变幻莫测，需求瞬息万变。探索并解锁新房间，酿造药水，锻造武器，为那些总是有点古怪的顾客服务。

games.name: Soliton Burst
games.description: 竞技场会不断折叠成全新形态：环面、莫比乌斯带、螺旋面，以及更多奇异空间。成群敌人持续涌来；你一边自动开火，一边让子弹沿弯曲空间穿行。

games.name: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
games.description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

games.name: Farm Bang
games.description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

games.name: Center Of The Galaxy: Desktop Idle
games.description: An idle pixel-art space game. Your ship travels toward the center of the galaxy on its own asteroids get in the way. Break them, upgrade your ship, unlock new ones. Reach the center, and the next universe begins harder than the last.

games.name: Kron Wars
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description:
一款在浏览器中运行的持久世界太空 MMO。无需下载，无需安装。打开一个标签页，即刻踏入 Frontier。
在 2 个宇宙、12,000 个星区中贸易、采矿、作战，经济体系完全由玩家亲手构建。
还有一项其他 MMO 都不具备的机制：战争会改写星图。

games.name: Etymancy
games.description: Etymancy is a dark fantasy roguelike dungeon crawler where every spell is a word. Craft your pile of magic letter tiles, collect strange grimoires to grow stronger, smite enemies, and descend deeper into the Lexicon.

games.name: Read of Mask
games.description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

games.name: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
games.description: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
games.description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

games.name: Abjure
games.description: 清空手牌即胜。Abjure 是以大二为核心的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏——黑桃2至高无上，抽牌构筑，积累遗物，击败每一位对手。斗地主玩家秒懂。

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.description: 你的防御塔挡不住任何东西。入侵径直从塔上踏过。唯一能让它们转向的只有墙，所以迷宫由你亲手搭建。然后入侵开始反击：相位体滑过你的墙，跳跃者跃过它们，破障者啃食它们。迷宫是你建的。现在守住它。

games.name: NULLHOME
games.description: NULLHOME is a first-person psychological horror experience inspired by liminal spaces and the Backrooms. Investigate mysterious TV-related disappearances, explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and survive encounters with unknown entities.

games.name: AIRSKIPPER
games.description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

games.name: Letterbane
games.description: A dark fantasy roguelite where words are your weapons. Draw magical letter stones, build words to attack, collect powerful items and combine elemental synergies as you fight your way through increasingly dangerous enemies.

games.name: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
games.description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

games.name: Leap Into Life Episode 1
games.description: 《Leap Into Life Episode 1》是一款故事驱动的成人视觉小说。邀请你进入一个充满爱、野心和性爱的世界。在高度社交的戏剧中穿梭，建立亲密关系，在这个浪漫冒险中塑造你的命运。

games.name: Don't Click, Hantavirus
games.description: 你是秘密实验室的首席科学家。将手指悬在按钮上方以防止病毒传播。接电话、签法令、抓间谍、给老鼠打针——并控制手的颤抖。点击一下，游戏结束。

games.name: Crowns & Tiles
games.description: Crowns & Tiles 是一款温馨的六边形地块放置游戏。在游戏中，你将塑造一个宁静的中世纪王国，连接城堡、森林、房屋与乡村，并通过每一次选择不断扩展你的领土。

games.name: Penance
games.description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers,  with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

games.name: (Spell+Fract)
games.description: (Spell+Fract) a Co-Op PVE Rougelike game about using math formulas to create spells of mass destruction and the better you are, the faster you cast, the more devistating the result.

games.name: 邪恶厨师大战
games.description: 《邪恶厨师大战》是背景设定在奇幻现代都市的短流程、卡通风解谜游戏。玩家误入山寨比赛，需要在有限的步数内完成菜肴的制作，在与角色的互动中逐渐揭开比赛背后的真相与阴谋。

games.name: Get Tao Now
games.description: A simple point and click game where you find characters in a static image.

games.name: 别惹二奎
games.description: 《别惹二奎》是一款荒诞喜剧风格的像素横版动作游戏。为了夺回被抢走的拖拉机和大公鸡，二奎踏上了一场越来越离谱的冒险。爽快战斗、趣味解谜、荒诞剧情与特色 BOSS。这一次，他尤其要把那只鸡带回来！
games.developer: Rizhao Youdian Yisi Animation Design Co., Ltd.

games.name: Simulacre
games.description: 《Simulacre》是一款支持 1–4 名玩家的合作心理恐怖游戏，在这里，熟悉的声音未必真的来自你的朋友。探索令人不安的地点，面对各自独特的目标与威胁，与队友一同生存，并永远不要完全确定你能相信的是谁——或是什么。

games.name: Kingdom Isles
games.description: 建立强大的王国，与盟友贸易，并在这款策略生存殖民地建设游戏中对抗凶猛的维京人！探索群岛，管理稀缺资源，在经济发展、居民满意度和防御之间取得平衡。你能带领人民走向胜利吗？

games.name: Plucked
games.description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

games.name: 无限循环
games.description: 《无限循环》是一款非传统的肉鸽弹幕挂机增量游戏。你在一个不停运转的代码世界里打怪、拾取、升级，等级、技能、天赋、芯片全部永久保留。没有单局重来，你玩得越久，就越强。

games.name: 沙海方舟
games.description: 沙海方舟是一款沙漠绿化策略游戏。你将在一颗精灵树的庇护下，从世界地图中央向外建设绿洲，抵御末日沙暴的周期性侵袭。通过种植  拥有独特能力的植物来降低荒芜、获取水源、对抗沙尘暴，最终将黄沙变为绿洲。

games.name: PP Inflation
games.description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

games.name: Another Card Game
games.description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

games.name: 极上人妻在我身边
games.description: 只要受到邀请，就可以进去。合法进入住户家中、掌握监视网络──这是你在「帷寓」大楼里当常驻维护员的特权。众多住户中，那位温婉的寂寞人妻根本就是你的菜，与此同时，这栋大楼的其他女人也纷纷对你展露兴趣……

games.name: KRENDEL
games.description: KRENDEL - is a strange point-and-click adventure without words or dialogue, where curiosity often leads to trouble. Explore, experiment, solve quirky puzzles, and tumble into absurd situations with a dose of dry humor. There’s definitely a story here. Probably.

games.name: 踢爆地下城
games.description: 踢爆地下城 是一款使用SRD 5.1规则的卡牌战棋游戏。组建独有的队伍、搭配自己的BUILD享受战斗的乐趣。使用卡牌释放你熟悉的火球术、魔法飞弹吧，每一局游戏都有着不同的体验。

games.name: Exiled Ark
games.description: 《Exiled Ark》是一款主打俯视射击、科幻生存建造游戏，以人类星际文明兴衰覆灭为宏大背景。太阳系战争覆灭人类文明，受损殖民飞船蓝色星球号沦为星际孤舟，前往临近恒星系进行探索殖民。玩家扮演幸存者需要在飞船上建设临时据点，搜集资源，制造武器，在飞船内外与各种敌人作战，逐步修复各个受损的飞船舱室。游戏融合太空生存探索、高自由建造制作、Rogue特质战斗，六大属性养成+四大科技树随心发展，更有多元结局等你来解锁。在浩瀚死寂的宇宙中，搜集有限能源艰难求生，与智能AI博弈周旋，抉择人类文明最后的命运，开启硬核科幻末日生存之旅。

games.name: Echoes of Aromia
games.description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

games.name: Drone Arena
games.description: 一款生存者like风格的竞技场肉鸽游戏。驾驶无人机，叠加武器与升级，组成荒诞的build，抵御机甲浪潮直到倒计时结束。每一局都会结束，每一局都会教会你一些东西。

games.name: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires
games.description: 同志！肮脏的亿万富翁再次在购买政治影响！在这场快速的阶级斗争中，击落他们从天而降的贿赂。帮助普通人民崛起，保持清白，赢得人民的选票，解锁强大升级，将亿万富翁的权力征税！

games.name: Corrupted Dice
games.description: 《Corrupted Dice》是一款以骰子为核心的 Roguelite 游戏，每颗骰子终将损坏。构建独特的骰子池，挑战不断提高的分数目标，解锁全新内容，参与高风险的赌注小游戏，并将 Heat 与 Corruption 推向极限。

games.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE
games.description: 《VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE》是一款俯视角机甲动作射击游戏。玩家可以即时切换能量剑、步枪、发射器和防御系统，击破敌方机甲。贴近敌人进行斩击，远距离开火，或使用防御系统抵挡来袭攻击。完成任务，挑战更高评价。

games.name: Alcurio
games.description: Alcurio is the first PvP quota game. Battle your friends while you collect and upgrade items, sabotage with spells, and race to be the first to reach your quota before they do.

games.name: 红山
games.description: 《红山》是一款第一人称心理叙事射击游戏。玩家将进入一座与世隔绝的高山疗养院，调查病历、探索禁区、收集遗物。随着深入，疾病与欲望、现实与幻觉的界限开始变得模糊。这里的人们沉溺于无意义的漫长等待任由精神衰败，而你也将在不断地探索中怀疑：究竟是疗养院困住了所有人，还是人类本就无法逃离自身内心的荒原。

games.name: The Divided
games.description: Co-op extraction action-RPG for 1–4 players. Take missions from the hideout, drop into hostile zones, and fight or sneak past the infected. Loot what you can carry and extract — or die and leave it all behind. Melee is the smart play. Guns invite the horde. Craft, trade, gear up. Bring friends.

games.name: OKUREK
games.description: 照料农场、鸡群，以及那些哀泣的罐子。树林在低语，而毒瘤伴随着每一个昼夜不断生长。O.K.U.R.E.K：一场设定在捷克瑞士腐朽群山之中的“温馨-腌菜-恐怖”体验。封存那些你未能拯救的一切。

games.name: Zona Eleitoral
games.description: Zona Eleitoral is a turn-based strategy game that puts you in charge of a mayoral campaign. Choose your candidate, build your strategy, manage your resources to unlock new actions, and navigate unexpected twists in the race for the mayor's office. Do you have what it takes to win the election?

games.name: MachWire
games.description: MachWire is a single-player speedrunning platformer where you use a variety of tools to get the best time!

games.name: Pegs & Sorcery
games.description: 在这款独特的弹珠风格卡牌构筑游戏中，用特殊球体强化你的英雄队伍。击溃敌人，收集灵魂碎片，并战略性地升级你的能力，以击败越来越强大的对手，在令人上瘾的roguelike冒险中取得胜利。

games.name: Littermates
games.description: Grab your mates, steal some litter, and help the denizens of Raccoon-opolis as the newest member of The Duke's crew. Physics Mayhem with up to 8 mates! Drive your stolen Garbage Truck around neighbourhoods, racing to stay ahead of the sunrise as you try to collect everything that isn't nailed down.

games.name: Booya!
games.description: 收集字母 B-O-O-Y-A 即可获胜。《Booya!》是一款混乱的派对卡牌游戏：偷取、虚张声势、转移目标、破坏对手，在朋友抢先拼出这个词之前完成它。

games.name: Inside Job
games.description: Escape prison in co-op with 1–4 players – or survive LAST COUNT with up to 10: no teams, deadly games, only one walks out. Work the inmates, trade, gamble, and pick your moment.

games.name: Birds of Impalatism
games.description: Infiltrate a vaporwave mall run by a capatalist cult as a undercover agent. Trip out and shoot ghosts in puzzle levels. Uncover the truth of the Birds of Impalatism, and take down its leader.

games.name: Dead Sector
games.description: 经营你自己的数据中心。一个元件一个元件地设计服务器主板，把板上空间用到极致。在机房铺设供电与网络，组建专精 cluster，把合同派发给定制硬件。从单个机柜起步，扩张成规模庞大、冗余满配的多 cluster 运营。

games.name: 歌舞伎町物语：深夜少女
games.description: 这是一款融合“水果”合成玩法与互动元素的游戏。通过不断合成水果获得奖励，与多位性格各异、魅力十足的女孩相识，在逐步加深关系的过程中，解锁专属剧情、精美CG以及更加亲密的互动内容，揭开她们隐藏在夜色下的秘密。

games.name: Stigmata
games.description: Stigmata is a classic survival horror experience where you must fight, explore, and manage your resources to survive. A man finds himself alone in a city where reality is beginning to unfold. Does judgement await you or something else? Your decisions directly affect the world and your experience.

games.name: Legion's Hand
games.description: 《Legion's Hand》是一款麻将风格的 Roguelike 卡组构筑自动战斗游戏。凑齐 3 张相同卡牌，合体成巨大士兵；串起连续数字，组成协同作战的连队——手牌的组合，直接决定军队的编成与阵型。收集 190 种以上能改写规则的遗物，让你独有的“必胜手牌”出征战场。

games.name: 方块猎人：L病毒爆发
games.description:
🎴 卡牌构筑 × Roguelike

收集并升级卡牌，打造属于你的狩猎流派。
每次冒险的路线、事件与奖励都不同。

🛡️ 格挡与节奏战斗

防御不是拖时间，而是战术核心。
抓准敌人出手时机格挡，降低伤害并创造反击窗口。

⚔️ 爆发连段与终结技

堆叠状态、强化武器，打出一回合逆转战局的爆发连段。

👾 病毒怪物与系统崩坏世界

低多边形化的森林、沙漠、雪山与岩浆地带逐步崩坏。
击败病毒 Boss，逐层解放游戏世界。

你能否猎杀 L 病毒，修复错误的世界，找回真正的「游戏」？

games.name: 弈统三国：三国五子棋
games.description: 弈统三国是一款融合了三国+技能+五子棋基础玩法的棋牌游戏，保证不肝不氪无内购！玩家可以自由构筑各个势力的卡组，利用将领技能打出各种脑洞大开的配合，感受技能五子棋的快乐！游戏模式包含线上的PVP玩家对弈，单机PVE的肉鸽爬塔，人机对弈及自我对弈等；各种新模式，新将领源源不断持续更新中~

games.name: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
games.description: Manage your spooky potion shop and meet monsters! Solve the tragicomic problems of vampires, werewolves, ifrits and trolls, or pit them against each other. Scavenge ingredients, craft volatile brews, and enjoy this chaotic management simulation!

games.name: 10 Million Pixels
games.description: 挖掘数百万像素，找到那唯一的黄金像素。一款以探索与侵蚀为主题、令人着迷的增量游戏。

games.name: 冷泉-阈限空间
games.description: 没有战斗的 2D 心理恐怖生存游戏。地图每次进入都会重组，墙壁可以被登山镐破坏，不可视实体只能通过脚步声判断距离。在无限循环的阈限走廊中，找到出口是你唯一的生路。

games.name: Rebel Wraith
games.description: Rebel Wraith 是一款快节奏动作游戏。玩家可以在三个不同角色之间即时切换，并使用每个角色独特的能力、跑酷机制和战斗风格，以流畅且令人满足的方式击败敌人。

games.name: Topdeck Duel
games.description: 一款增量式卡牌Roguelike，每次胜利都会扩展你的牌组！摆放卡牌获得强力增益，夺取敌方卡牌，并合并它们来提升稀有度。在挑战之间积累金币，用于永久全局元升级，精通Topdeck Duel！

games.name: Space Annihilator
games.description: Command a powerful space warship and fight your way through relentless waves of enemy ships and bases to achieve the ultimate victory!

games.name: Wall Street Tycoon
games.description: You start as an intern clicking SIGN on paperwork nobody reads. An hour later the SEC is at your door and you are deciding whether to bribe them. An incremental tycoon about how fast a small amount of money turns into a problem.

games.name: Print N Stick
games.description: A cozy sandbox sticker game where you print, recolor, cut, and combine stickers to decorate different spaces. Create freely in Sandbox Mode, or share your creations on in-game social media, earn money, and expand your collection in Career Mode.

games.name: PlanetOrbit
games.description: 把一颗荒芜的岩石行星，变成霓虹闪烁的赌场行星。在扑克、百家乐、21点、掷骰子、轮盘与老虎机的牌桌上赢取筹码，再用它们建造建筑，看着干涸的地表逐渐披上绿意。被灯火吸引，NPC 们开始造访。走遍这颗球形星球，或从高空俯瞰全景——用你自己的方式，养出宇宙中最热闹的行星。

games.name: Snooze Control
games.description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

games.name: Switch Shapes
games.description: 一款高速反应游戏，音乐源自你的表现。变换形态，在混乱中生存，并创作一首受巴西节奏、电子音乐和迷幻风格启发的程序生成配乐。

games.name: Homeless Kiosk Simulator
games.description: You work the night shift inside a small aid booth. People arrive at your window asking for help. Food. Water. Medicine. Sometimes… things that don’t belong in a donation box. Every box you prepare makes the night worse.

games.name: 星海赌王 JOHN GLEEP
games.description: 小小的外星人JOHN GLEEP有个大大的麻烦——他的赌场经营惨淡、同时他还欠了黑帮一整个星系的钱。解决方法是什么？当然是沿着一个个行星飞过去、强行绑架星球上的赌客们来光顾，以此在这款荒诞不经的宇宙背景动作Roguelike混搭游戏中偿还你的债务、挽回你破碎的婚姻了。

games.name: Becoming None
games.description:
Becoming None is an RPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. 
Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

games.name: Abyssalis
games.description: Descend through the ocean layers, purify marine life, and survive the abyss in this bullet hell roguelite. Face colossal bosses, choose powerful upgrades, and uncover the curse's origin. Can you save the ocean before you become fish bait?

games.name: Revive the Moonlight with Stardust
games.description: Destroy stars, collect stardust, and revive the lost moonlight. Lose yourself in Euphoria.

games.name: A Game About Clicking A Rock
games.description: Click on rocks. Dig for ores, smash through boulders and sell precious minerals on a market. Use your hard-earned cash to unlock upgrades, buy better equipment, and expand your operation. Hire workers, customize theirs  uniforms, and automate your growing mining empire.

games.name: Autobus - The Card Game
games.description: 在这款快节奏的 2–4 人多人卡牌游戏中，比谁能最先清空主牌堆。将牌叠到共享的构筑牌堆上，智胜对手，第一个出完所有牌。支持单人或通过 Steam 在线对战。

games.name: Homesider Survivors
games.description: HOMESIDER SURVIVORS 是一款单人“幸存者类”自动射击游戏。你身处异乡，面对着铺天盖地袭来的外星大军……但真正需要为生存挣扎的却是它们，因为它们绑架了不该绑架的人。杀敌、阵亡、升级，不断尝试，直到最终重返家园。

games.name: Fox Idle
games.description: 和可爱的狐耳伙伴一起踏上冒险吧！采集资源、打造装备、讨伐怪物、完成任务，最重要的是，在这款放置增量RPG里和狐娘们一起不断变强。

games.name: 守城英雄传
games.description: 超爽塔防，轻松挂机，战力无限飙升，享受零内购的纯粹单机体验！排兵布阵，防线自动阻击汹涌怪潮，后台挂机也能积累资源。利用摸鱼间隙或碎片时间招募角色、升级塔防，提升你的防线战力，让你的城堡从临时搭建的防线逐步成长为固若金汤的要塞！  P.S. 游戏支持老板键一键隐藏，随时随地安心守城！

games.name: Deadpact
games.description: 被判死刑的你被送入黑暗，只为换取最后一次自由的机会。猎杀你的并不是无脑怪物：它们会学习你的每一个动作，并且永远不会忘记。智取它们，否则就死。你的每一个选择都会改变故事的结局。

games.name: Sketch Kingdom
games.description: 素描王国是一款短小的放置类游戏，拥有手绘笔记本风格。绘制你自己的生物，收集资源并积累金币以解锁升级。完成任务，解锁技能树中的新能力。简单、迷人，令人意外地上瘾。你能填满整本笔记本吗？

games.name: The Son of Stone
games.description: Play as Sosruko, a warrior born from stone, and fight through mythic battles using three distinct combat styles and stone bending abilities.

games.name: 城市派对
games.description: 和朋友组队跑棋盘、抢地盘、赚金币，再把钱用来开餐厅、买房收租，让每一局比赛都推动你的城市慢慢变富。

games.name: Chase
games.description: 这是一个“把梦想收起来很久的人，在梦里追上自己”的故事。

games.name: Cold Contours: Intake
games.description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

games.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
games.description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

games.name: Neon Chaku
games.description: Kara Kowalski is a bounty hunter on a relentless quest to find her brother, who was kidnapped when they were children. Experience classic 8-bit-inspired action as you battle robots, mercenaries, and Norse gods across a stunning cyberpunk world.

games.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
games.description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

games.name: 迷你村庄
games.description: 《Tiny Village》是一款通过鼠标采集资源、利用收集到的资源解锁新建筑并逐步发展村庄的增量式游戏。强化采集能力，逐一解锁各类建筑，让这个小村庄变得富足起来吧！

games.name: Send It!
games.description:
You are mail. The mailbox is waiting.

Dash and jump through deadly levels at absurd speeds to ensure delivery! Perfect your routes, chase medal times, and master 100 bite-sized levels built for speedrunning and replayability.

games.name: God Codex
games.description: 一款具有电影质感的2D像素风动作冒险游戏。在击败魔王后，你将在她的记忆中苏醒，见证两名少女于崩塌的世界中奋力抗争命运。游戏主打硬核战斗与环境叙事，并采用极简UI设计，营造出沉浸式的电影化视听体验。

games.name: Tank Them All
games.description: 一款适合 2–6 名玩家的混乱俯视角坦克乱斗游戏——可本地或在线游玩。收集 16 种狂野强化道具，在尖刺陷阱、龙卷风和空袭中生存下来，并在包含 King of the Hill 和 Golden Shell 的 4 种游戏模式中称霸超过 90 个竞技场。

games.name: Scrap Vanguard
games.description: 你是一名迫降在濒临毁灭的地球上的孤胆飞行员。利用外星残骸坚守基地，击退如潮水般涌来的入侵者，将废料合成为强力武器、尖端升级与战略设施，捍卫人类最后的希望。

games.name: Wondernauts
games.description: Wondernauts is a 1-4 player local co-op action platformer. Run, jump, stomp, shoot, shield allies, and rescue friends across 20+ handcrafted biomes. Defeat formidable Controllers, collect Wonder Badges to customize your loadout, and survive Wonder Rifts that transform everything mid-level.

games.name: Titanhelm
games.description: Titanhelm is a co-op base building game where you and your friends build a settlement, command a Titan and fight back the creatures of a dark and hostile forest. Gather resources, harvest Soul energy from fallen enemies and upgrade your Titan before the forest consumes you.

games.name: Spill The Ink
games.description: Draw one continuous line, then watch gravity turn your ink into the solution. Guide the paper ball through handcrafted chambers, chase three-star clears, and build, test, and share your own puzzles.

games.name: Verdant Requiem
games.description:
“SRPG in Search of Balance"
On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

games.name: 克苏鲁围棋教学
games.description: 围棋从未如此‘触手’可及！有克苏鲁大人教你下棋，对弈不再枯燥。无论你是想入门围棋，还是想提高水平，或者是想刷死活题，克苏鲁大人都会陪你到天荒地老！

games.name: Flightline: Airline Sim
games.description: Flightline is an airline management sim about building an airline that has to make sense. Set routes, choose aircraft, price seats, and shape a network where passengers route themselves through real markets. Growth is not just drawing lines on a map. It is whether the whole system holds together.

games.name: Your Momo
games.description: 矮个丰满、趣味互动、桌面伴侣。《Your Momo》是一款治愈系桌面叙事游戏。通过拍打屁股的亲密触碰与Momo开启对话，逐渐加深彼此的羁绊。在聊天中解锁全新道具，静静欣赏她在桌面上自由画画的惬意日常吧。

games.name: Cherry Picking Bot
games.description: Cherry Picking Bot是一款短小的放置游戏，通过采集、加工、出售果实来强化机器人。

games.name: Hyperspin
games.description: Hyperspin is an experimental rhythm game where you control a circle that spins on a circle, and you tap circles. There are lots of circles.

games.name: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate
games.description: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

games.name: 移形国象
games.description: 这是一款允许玩家将“控制棋盘”作为一种走子行动的国际象棋变体，游戏支持在线对弈、人机对弈以及本地研究。

games.name: Let Rat Be
games.description: 同时按下键盘上的大量按键，帮助小老鼠逃出去吧！

games.name: Feypath
games.description:
Feypath is a single button precision platformer that is suitable for those that like punishing but fair gameplay.

Save the princess and uncover the secrets of the Demon Kingdom by jumping to the top of the world!

games.name: Unrivaled
games.description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with one of ten classes! You can play on the online ladder, join a tournament in tournament mode, or explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

games.name: SolPlex: Dominion
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: From a single colony to a galactic empire, every expansion strengthens your economy, your military and your influence as you battle for dominance in a persistent MMO galaxy.

games.name: Finesse Frenzy
games.description: Finesse Frenzy is a fast-paced arcade game about eating smaller sea creatures while eluding rivals to climb the food chain. Quick consumption temporarily fills the finesse meter, scaling up speed and score. Do you have the finesse to maintain the increased speed, or will you crash and burn trying?

games.name: I Like Trains
games.description: I Like Trains 是一款增量游戏，你将从一条铁路开始，逐步发展成一个遍布列车、升级和奇异异常现象的庞大铁路网络。建设并扩展线路，看着整张地图逐渐活跃起来，同时解读异常现象，揭开隐藏其中的故事。

games.name: PROJECT M.E.D.S.
games.description: The body is under attack. Hordes of infectious germs are spreading rapidly, overwhelming its natural defenses. As the last line of defense, you'll battle through massive waves of pathogens, unlock powerful medical weapons, and fight to keep your host alive.

games.name: MORTU
games.description: 一款关于汤姆（Tom）的心理恐怖游戏。他被内疚感以及决定了其一生的创伤性事件所吞噬。由于无法摆脱过去的阴影，他发现自己陷入了一个愈发令人不安的噩梦之中。

games.name: MatchMaker95 - A Programming Simulator
games.description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit — all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

games.name: Jeremy is Broke
games.description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

games.name: The Current Past
games.description: A fading seaside town, a dark secret lurking beneath the waves, and a plot that will test your powers of deduction... Use logic, observation and your trusty notebook to untangle your way to the truth in this puzzling mystery.

games.name: A Possum's Favorite Game
games.description: Plagued with wrath, Matthew is forced to confront the traumas of his childhood while battling with a Sinister Force.

games.name: REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION
games.description: A desperate ex-soldier accepts deadly contracts from an anonymous employer. Hunt 4 random targets, fight through hostile locations, and reach a random extraction point in this fast-paced PS2-inspired and early 2000s PC Games shooter.

games.name: D.A.M.N!
games.description: A board game for fun get-togethers with friends and family of any age, with the difficulty you choose. Race to the finish: help your teammate, get in your opponents' way, play combos, knock pieces out, freeze them, use ultimates... Solo, in a team, with bots, on one screen, online or offline.

games.name: Melody Flow
games.description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Discover a new musical world every time you play.

games.name: Cube Fold
games.description: Cube Fold is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game where every move unfolds the cube into new shapes. Solve handcrafted levels filled with teleporters, jump tiles, moving platforms, bridges, and clever mechanics. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

games.name: Tipsy Corpse
games.description:
僵尸、怪物和恶魔生物占领了小镇。必须有人解决这个问题。

一款双摇杆Rogue-lite游戏，您的武器、鸡尾酒乃至环境都可以成为您的盟友；还有坐在您旁边不甘心只是旁观的朋友！

games.name: Jack Pottwin: House of Odds
games.description: Fight your way up a 10-story casino tower to wake from a fever dream in this Roguelike Deckbuilder. Craft your deck, modify runs with lucky coins, and control the Odds. Fuse cards to build high value attacks, trigger poker combos to add powerful combat traits to your cards.

games.name: Kings of Oros
games.description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

games.name: ISO/2004
games.description: ISO/2004 is a grounded psychological horror game about guilt, trauma, and disturbing memories rotting inside a decaying provincial home. Step into a suffocating, atmospheric nightmare where raw emotional tension slowly warps reality. Face what you left behind before the shadows consume you.

games.name: Echo Pandemic
games.description: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

games.name: Rat Quest 2: The Quest For Moon Cheese
games.description: Rat Quest Is a difficult Platformer that requires precise movement to insure you dont die! This game is incredibly difficult the prizes along the way make it rewarding.

games.name: Evergreen Clicker
games.description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

games.name: The Flesh Beneath
games.description: A dark-fantasy card-roguelike about giving the cathedral below what it asks for — one piece of yourself at a time. Sever your own flesh for power. Press blood-stones into your cards. Permadeath. Every name is remembered.

games.name: DEGENERATE STAR
games.description: Investigate the S.S Vandermeer and discover the fate of those aboard.

games.name: Tick Pig
games.description: Tick Pig is a multiplayer party game with pig characters who spray and pop their way to victory.

games.name: Legend Dary
games.description:
一款复古平台动作游戏，讲述普通上班族为了赢得公主芳心而展开冒险。探索 3 个主题世界和 70 个关卡，收集钥匙与星星，赚取金币并升级武器、解锁新角色。

日本語

games.name: Ocean Cargo Manager
games.description: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

games.name: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave
games.description: A decades-old family story intertwined with a modern-day road trip. By identifying dashcam photos, you will reconstruct the route, discover who Robert was, and piece together past events. A real trip, real places, real geolocation.

games.name: Black Hole Idle
games.description: 从一个微小的黑洞开始，通过吞噬小行星、行星和恒星系统不断成长。在这款轻松的太空放置增量游戏中自动化你的力量、解锁升级并吞噬整个宇宙。

games.name: Arrownomics
games.description: Arrownomics 是一款关于射箭的简短增量游戏。雇佣弓箭手，建造和升级靶子，解锁新能力，并提高你的收入。

games.name: The Shimoda Rift
games.description: Discover the fate of a Moon Patrol Vehicle and its crew in this top down, off road, outer space, driving simulator horror platform game.

games.name: Demon Rising
games.description: 《Demon Rising》是一款由本地大语言模型驱动的暗黑奇幻肉鸽自走棋。你扮演魔王，指挥一支会开口顶嘴的恶魔军团，迎击一波波闯入城堡的勇者。招募职业、堆叠协同、装备遗物、解锁天赋，挺过三章节不断升级的战斗。每一局都在重写自己的故事，没有两次相同。

games.name: 桌面骰子牧场
games.description: 《桌面骰子牧场》是一款以骰子为核心的电脑桌面放置养成游戏。通过掷骰获取金币，收集形态各异的骰子，在牧场中繁育后代，解锁组合技与天赋技能，远征击败强敌，最终打造属于自己的终极骰子牧场。

games.name: SUPERUSER
games.description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

games.name: Worldkampf '72
games.description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

games.name: Animal Rescue Network
games.description: Animal Rescue Network is a cozy sanctuary life simulation centered entirely around animal care, healing, and compassion. You arrive in the storm-torn town, where the beloved local sanctuary has collapsed, and the community is struggling to recover.

games.name: 奇境扭蛋屋：英雄集结
games.description: 一款具有角色收集和养成系统的轻度弹幕肉鸽。收集可爱手办，搭配装备扭蛋，借助日常用品，迎战强大Boss。没有内购、重复抽取或碎片系统。

games.name: Network Engineer
games.description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

games.name: Ultimate Freaky Night
games.description: Survive the night shift. Watch the cameras. Manage your power. Try not to get caught by horny animatronics — but if you do, well... that's kind of the whole point. A love letter to FNAF with a very adult twist.

games.name: Lost Mind
games.description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

games.name: Mini Gladiators
games.description: Mini Gladiators 是一款极简风格的角斗士 Roguelite，有着爽快的布娃娃物理效果。你的选择能让小小的角斗士变得势不可挡，让观众欢呼，把敌人打飞。

games.name: Cypris
games.description:
Cypris is a dark, erotic kinetic novel centered on corruption, mind control, and forbidden desire.

You are brilliant psychologist carrying a ancient divine power that slowly warps the minds and bodies of women around you, turning them into devoted, lust-filled slaves to your will.

games.name: 白给俱乐部
games.description: 《白给俱乐部》是一款支持跨平台联机的 VR 物理合作攀爬游戏。攀登一座卡通风格的高山，手劲与团队配合是你唯一的依靠。拉好友一把、使用稀奇古怪的道具，在多样的生态群落中求生。你们这支小队能否一同登顶而不一起摔下去？

games.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
games.description: 夜晚偷取贵重物品，白天在自己的商店里出售。将赃物变成利润，升级店铺，扩大你的犯罪生意。挑战规模更大、风险更高的盗窃行动，不断补充货架上的商品，赚取更多利润。但要小心，警察正紧追不舍！

games.name: 罗慕路斯
games.description: ROMUL 是一款以收集战利品为核心的合作恐怖游戏。与一台具备语音控制和萌芽阶段人工智能的机器人一起，探索重力不稳定的废弃空间站，并善用它。于怪物之中存活下来，带出珍贵货物。

games.name: KUTO: The Lock of Time
games.description: A 2.5D metroidvania where death isn’t the end. Slay enemies, collect the Dust of Ages and spend it to rewind time and undo a fatal mistake. Carve through the eras with the Scythe of Kronos and take revenge on the gods who betrayed you. Free demo out now!

games.name: Absolute Dap
games.description: Dap up your friend and fight bizarre bosses together! Absolute Dap is a co-op action boss rush about two best friends trying to stop an alien invasion from ruining their friend's first date. The game is ridiculous. The friendship isn't.

games.name: WizKitty and the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff
games.description: 一款 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏：你的卡组不直接攻击，而是打造替你攻击的武器。攀登高塔，升级、重铸并叠加词缀，逼随机数给你完美装备。

games.name: Dungeon Cooking
games.description: A dark cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients and cook what they bring back. Test the ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens. And keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.

games.name: Fan: The Flame
games.description: Fan: The Flame is an arcade shooter featuring a gusty tabletop fan. Dodge hordes of enemies, shove them into the flames as quickly as possible to get the highest bonus, and upgrade (or downgrade) your fan to take on progressively more difficult waves.

games.name: Touchdown
games.description: A fast-paced, shared screen party game to challenge your friendships! Quick, chaotic gameplay for both casual and skilled competitive players. Pull off wild plays, learn new tricks and unlock new maps!

games.name: ECHORIS
games.description: Every weapon hides a world. A 2D metroidvania of vertical descent — step inside each blade you find, descend its Item World, and reforge it through layers of memory and reactive elemental depths.

games.name: Dark Thoughts
