games.description: We figured out how to stop those intrusive dark thoughts we all have to deal with. First, pick a damaged hero to fight for you. Then, guide them to victory. Heal them, help them evolve. Once proficient, you're ready to take on the heavy hitting causes of trauma and vanquish them forever!

games.name: The Wake Event
games.description: Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

games.name: OVERSIGHT: Anomaly
games.description: 盖亚-7号被困在未知的量子星云中。你必须通过CCTV找出异常现象，并决定该相信谁。这是一部以观察玩法与选择共同推动故事发展的写实风格科幻恐怖互动电影。

games.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling
games.description: You are a small sapling and hear voices that guide your every step. Defeat enemies, collect powers and grow over time. Will you carve your own path or become a champion of the Risu?

games.name: Dead Relay
games.description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs. But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

games.name: Please File Accurately
games.description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

games.name: Space PiouPiou
games.description: Blast through endless waves of evil space cat-liens in this chaotic bullet heaven and hell roguelike! Upgrade your tiny PiouPiou into a feathered weapon of mass destruction and survive the cosmic madness for as long as possible.

games.name: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
games.description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

games.name: Tales of Kid Goblin: Dawn of the Hero
games.description: Help Kid Goblin overcome tricky puzzles and dangerous obstacles in this charming retro-style adventure packed with levels, secrets and classic 8-bit spirit.

games.name: Faraday Corridors
games.description:
一款烧脑解谜游戏，解开之后就是速通挑战。

拨动开关、旋转格子，引导你的棋子抵达出口。

然后再来一次，这次更快。

games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
games.description:
一款独特的色彩循环机制益智游戏，需要你提前思考每一步。每次移动都会改变谜题的状态，在开启新路径的同时关闭其他路径。挑战越来越烧脑的关卡，在看似混乱的局面中找出隐藏的秩序。

你能克服所有挑战吗？

games.name: Kinbound
games.description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Brick Mayhem
games.description: 一款基于物理效果的自动战斗游戏。微小的塑料战士为了可被完全摧毁的堡垒而战。组建你的军队，发动爆炸性的攻城战，享受砖块四处飞散的混乱破坏。

games.name: Hostile Process
games.description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

games.name: War Asunder
games.description:
A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades. 
Fight the multiplying creatures, cleanse the corrupted realm and confront the Warlock King to stop the Asunder spell at its source.

games.name: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
games.description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

games.name: Aethelria Cross-Dimensions
games.description: Aethelria: Cross-Dimensions is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where fractured realities collide. Choose a fighter, master unique abilities, and battle across vibrant cross-dimensional arenas. Precision, teamwork, and quick decisions are key as you increase ranks in intense, replayable combat.

games.name: Eyeball Alley
games.description: You are an eyeball, and everything is an eyeball. Roll through trippy worlds where gravity follows every curve of the surface beneath you. Roaming eyeballs knock you off course, and the fifth hit kills you. Dig tunnels through anything.

games.name: 匣中少女的第二次末日
games.description: 无限流 x 微恐 x 群像视觉小说，和少女们一起加入这场末日狂欢

games.name: Astral Boost
games.description:
A little nostalgia. A lot of "just one more run."

Inspired by the golden age of Flash games and classics, Astral Boost brings back the simple joy of chasing high scores and seeing how far you can push your limits. Build momentum, ride the clouds, and launch yourself into space. How far can you go?

games.name: 7Komada
games.description: A social deduction death game set in a backwater of alternate universe Europe. You and your class’s graduation trip has been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in an abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what’s going on before it's too late.

games.name: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination
games.description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

games.name: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
games.description: 巫师对决！这是一场等距视角的激战竞技游戏！在独特多变的可破坏竞技场中称霸五局三胜的连番对战，每场比赛场景都会变化。用你选择的战士的特殊技能灵活走位、智取对手，配合inflexi0n专为游戏打造的多元电子音乐。

games.name: Quilt
games.description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

games.name: Neural Drift
games.description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

games.name: 桌面小海缸
games.description: 将每一次敲击键盘转化为桌面海洋生态吧！当你工作、学习、打字或点击鼠标时，每一次按键都会默默为你累积金币。积攒金币去购买各种各样的海水鱼、缤纷的珊瑚和有趣的装饰物，你甚至还能购买鱼食与小鱼们亲密互动。伴随着清脆的键盘声，快来打造专属于你、独特而治愈的桌面小海缸吧！

games.name: Noyan: Club Chairman
games.description: 在《Noyan: Club Chairman》中，你不是主教练，而是执掌一切的俱乐部主席！让教练去布置战术吧，你的任务是掌控财政、斩获巨额赞助并赢得球迷的支持。切记：比赛的胜负在赛场内决定，而俱乐部的未来，则在主席办公室中铸就！

games.name: Dead Ringer
games.description: It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing... Detective Maxwell Morgan must navigate the testimonies of both the living and the dead to find a murderer before it's too late.

games.name: MSO FreeCell Arena
games.description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

games.name: Siege Demolishers
games.description: Siege Demolishers is a first-person physics destruction game inspired by Crush the Castle and Angry Birds. It reimagines those 2D games as a fully 3D experience with multiplayer.

games.name: Whos Driving?
games.description:
"One of you steers. One of you brakes. Neither of you can do it alone."
Whos Driving is a chaotic 2-player driving game where both players need to co-ordinate and trust each other. 
Coordination seems doubtful but chaos is confirmed.
You don’t drive alone. You survive together.

games.name: ONE SKILL - Drive or Fall
games.description: Test your skills on various platforms and obstacles built high in the sky! Master your driving as you maneuver through thrilling challenges and perilous situations to reach the finish line.

games.name: Stories Terminal
games.description: Stories Terminal is a detective text adventure inspired by classic parser games. Type your own commands, explore pixel-art locations, collect evidence, and solve a murder case on a midnight university campus.

games.name: Kagenazo
games.description: Kagenazo 是一款 3D 阴影解谜游戏。你需要搭建方块形状、旋转它们，并从多个角度匹配它们的轮廓。挑战 190 多个 2x2、3x3 和 4x4 方块谜题，追求更简洁的解法、更快的完成时间和更高的星级评分。

games.name: Used Car Dealer Simulator
games.description:
Buy and sell used cars
Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit.

Run your own car dealership
Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

games.name: Slutty Hotel
games.description: 你成为了Slutty Hotel的新老板，而第一位女孩已经在门口等你了 😏🔑 每解锁一个新房间，场景都会变得更加大胆，工作与享乐之间的界限也逐渐消失 🔥 现在就看看谁最终会成为不只是员工的特别存在。免费游玩 🥵

games.name: Legacy of Mind
games.description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

games.name: Hive Fall
games.description: An expansive incremental game that rewards both active and idle gameplay. Defend your planet from an onslaught of alien insects, block projectiles, purchase upgrades, collect artifacts, and complete missions for rewards. There is always something new to unlock as you progress deeper into the swarm.

games.name: Mining Away!
games.description: 《Mining Away!》是一款轻量级增量游戏，在游戏中你可以采掘矿石、收集资源、拓展庞大的技能树、寻找稀有遗物，并解锁更强大的镐头！

games.name: Starwhisker
games.description: Magic cats in space fighting aliens. Light is your weapon, and the Void is hungry. Shift between wavelengths of light, discover powerful upgrades. Help Luma, the last Starwhisker restore hope to a universe being consumed by darkness.

games.name: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel
games.description: 走入福音书的时代，见证耶稣基督的教导、神迹与救赎。这是一款以圣经故事为核心的视觉小说，通过对话与章节式叙事，呈现一段关于牺牲与盼望的旅程。

games.name: 童话清道夫
games.description: 《童话清道夫》是一款增量型打怪冒险游戏。核心玩法相当直觉：痛快斩杀怪物、通关任务，赚取满满的金币与素材；并利用这些战利品来投资庞大的技能树、锻造神兵利器、购买药水，为下一场冒险做好万全准备！

games.name: Dungeon Monster Master
games.description:
An action RPG set in an infinitely expanding open-world, randomly generated world where you collect monsters and enjoy boss rush battles
Collect monsters to complete your encyclopedia and build your own farm while raising them

games.name: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者
games.description: 《破界幸存者》是一款快节奏肉鸽割草游戏，玩家可以操控角色消灭成群的敌人，收集各种资源以获取局外强化，随后再挑战更多更强的敌人。

games.name: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff
games.description: 在这款温馨的手绘隐藏物品冒险游戏中，寻找 850 多只调皮的豚鼠。游戏场景设定在一座秘鲁风格的庄园里。收集 snackos，解锁秘密房间，解开小谜题，并沿着面包屑的线索走向传说中的黄金玉米。

games.name: Lilac Wave
games.description: 选择神奇海洋生物，创造法术协同，用策略在战斗中称霸。日复一日引导神秘水坑，在危险的海洋中生存，打造完美流派(build)迎战最终首领。深海的命运掌握在你手中！

games.name: Sortilege
games.description: 一场与桌对面对手较量的 Roguelite 骰子对决。你放弃的每一个天赋都会留在桌上，任由对手拿走。一个世界接一个世界地击败对手，每道伤口都会带入下一场战斗；也可以在线与好友对决。

games.name: Beyond The Frame
games.description: Beyond The Frame is an immersive horror game set in the liminal dreamscapes of an 11-year-old child. The deeper you explore, the more the anxieties of your subconscious mind creep into the dream. Will you be brave enough to face them?

games.name: Fairy Forge
games.description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

games.name: 王之矿山：地下都市
games.description: 矮人矿工正在重铸地下王朝！在这款极致解压的增量经营挖矿游戏中，成为矮人头子带领小弟向山腹深处狂热开掘。规划开采路线，在火把燃尽前挖光矿脉资源，倾注海量金矿于地下王都的建造与经营。喝完这杯麦酒就开干！扩张领地、招募大军、点满矮人科技，狠狠踢烂大矿山的屁股！

games.name: The Inspector
games.description:
a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train.
It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

games.name: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
games.description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

games.name: The Caffeine Chronicles
games.description: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

games.name: The Tolerance Group
games.description: You are an operator of The Tolerance Group, monitoring surveillance cameras in various locations, where reality has begun to break. Identify these continuity failures and promptly report them before the world is overwhelmed by horror.

games.name: Moon Basketball
games.description: This is basketball.  On the moon.  Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

games.name: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
games.description:
关于魔法女孩的简短增量子弹地狱！
对抗阴影,收集资源,升级技能树并击败所有女巫以拯救人类！

games.name: Covenantum
games.description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

games.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles
games.description: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles（铁屿：群岛霸业）是一款以征服中世纪群岛为主题的即时战略游戏。壮大王国，招兵买马，攻占地区，统率整支大军。谋划扩张路线，加固要地，看准时机，一击制胜！

games.name: Gorgo: Mother of sparta
games.description: 斯巴达寡后被关押在你的庭院里，战争议会急需她的战略。你根本不是干这行的料——但你会伪装、诱惑、中饱私囊，勉强撑过去。一部关于欲望、谎言与漫长骗局的短篇成人视觉小说。

games.name: Hostile Takeover, Inc.
games.description: Fight as the CEO, hire employees, and build offices to survive waves of disgruntled enemies in a top-down action tower defense about corporate "leadership" at its most predatory — and least competent. Maximize shareholder value, then fend off the hostile takeover before the board forces you out.

games.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
games.description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

games.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
games.description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

games.name: Gemtide
games.description: 潜入深海，一路收集宝石，帮助沿途可爱的小生灵——一场温馨惬意的增量冒险。

games.name: Rutterkin
games.description: RUTTERKIN is a first-person fantasy card roguelite inspired by Scopa. Duel rival wizards, cast spells through your cards, and push your luck to grow the pot. Win big, pay your rising debt, and survive another round.

games.name: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
games.description:
Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun:
procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses
that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

games.name: 灵溯：灯塔
games.description: 一款短篇单人时间循环解谜游戏：重新点亮灯塔，阻止一场已经发生的海难。在阴森的孤岛上被阴影追猎，你将一遍又一遍地经历同样的事件，直到找到终结噩梦的办法。

games.name: 暗面
games.description: 《暗面》是一款2D横版太空机甲动作游戏。太阳系历经战火洗礼，太空疆域暗藏危机，你将驾驶全副武装的战斗机甲，开启一场充斥着激战与未知谜团的宇宙冒险。

games.name: MANDATUM
games.description:
一款“黏土风格”的在线合作游戏，支持最多4人任务，讲述玩家为帮助“老板”赢得地方选举所做出的最大贡献。历史由胜利者书写，对吧？所以我们会不择手段。
MANDATUM.

games.name: Lust Tavern
games.description: Well-cum to the first card-based Tavern Tycoon! Hire, level up, and lewd up Girls (Girls only!); Build rooms; Order your staff to satisfy every Guest’s needs to grow your Reputation! Higher Reputation attracts richer and far more demanding guests.

games.name: Last Zone: Quarantine
games.description: 一款以严峻的后苏联末日为背景的合作生存游戏。组建一支小队，与成群的变种人和无情的袭击者作战。探索神秘的世界，掌握深厚的制作系统，并建造一个能够抵御任何攻击的基地。

games.name: 末世列车
games.description: 末日降临，文明彻底崩塌，移动的列车成为最后的希望,您将成为列车的掌控者,管理和武装幸存者,分配食物和工作,收集资源抵御尸潮,所有人的生死取决于您的决策

games.name: 投资之神
games.description: 掌控资本，深度调研，把握风口，以小博大。成为身家百亿的天使投资人，寻找潜力创业公司，参与竞价，组建专业团队，调配资本与资源。小商品，但大战略！在瞬息万变的市场中把控企业命脉，体验硬核金融模拟与投资博弈。从第一笔投资开始，打造你的商业帝国

games.name: 平行线交点杀人事件
games.description:
你相信，平行世界真的存在吗？
普通的大学生陈绸，在一觉醒来后发现自己穿越到了一艘宇宙科研船上，而船上的陌生人们居然都声称认识陈绸，莫不成这是穿越到了平行世界吗......
之后陈绸意外卷入了一系列离奇的凶杀案中。为了解开案件，又是否要相信平行世界的存在来推理凶杀呢？是否相信平行世界的存在将对推理产生巨大的影响。

games.name: Type Me Home
games.description: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

games.name: Ragball
games.description: Ragball is a co-op party brawler where a ball can be the difference between a win and a loss. Play with 2-4 players, have fun with ragdoll physics and compete to win against your friends by destroying them with balls!

games.name: 立方
games.description: 一款没有“跳跃键”的平台解谜游戏。你将利用有限的方块、冲刺以及重置，完成这场实验。

games.name: Anomaly Grid
games.description: Anomaly Grid is a turn-based strategy puzzle game about numbers, colors, and control. Capture tiles, merge units, spend score on upgrades and abilities, and outplay an escalating AI before the grid collapses.

games.name: Bullet Rift
games.description: Bullet Rift is a top-down shooter ARPG packed with loot, builds, dungeons, rifts, crafting, bosses, and deep character progression. Blast through hordes, chase legendary gear, perfect your build, and push deeper into an endgame built for players who love grinding for power.

games.name: NOXEN
games.description: 踏入一座令人不安的房屋，每个房间都隐藏着新的秘密。探索环境、解开谜题、检查物品、使用工具推进游戏，并在这场第一人称心理恐怖体验中从可怕的超自然事件中存活下来。

games.name: Talaire
games.description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

games.name: 群琼逐鹿
games.description: 《群琼逐鹿》是以汉末三国为背景的轻量化联机策略游戏，2~4位玩家扮演割据一方的诸侯，寻访角色和道具提升自身实力，在玩家间的谈判、交易、结盟、背叛中实施自己的谋略。通过秦汉时期的骰子“博琼”判定各类随机事件，让对局在不断变化的形势中更具娱乐性。用谋略掌控局势，靠运气抓住转机，在群雄逐鹿的乱世中一统天下。

games.name: Butterflies & Bloom
games.description: A cottagecore typing companion. A transparent flower garden lives just above your taskbar and blooms as you write, code, and chat. Sell flowers for coins, attract bees and butterflies, build a garden out of the hours you already spend at the keyboard.

games.name: Petricor: Tower Defense
games.description: Face off against hordes of shambling skeletons in this magical rogue-like tower defense! You're just cat-sitting for a shopkeeper, but an evil necromancer has other plans! Summon living statues to defend the shop and discover powerful spells to create devastating combos!

games.name: 再造伊甸:Overlord
games.description: 一款融合RTS和RPG的开放世界游戏,在中世纪奇幻与蒸汽朋克的世界中冒险:训练军队、招募各类种族、探索地下城、从零建立王国、发展城市与工业、管理人口与职业、建造奇观与超级武器。

games.name: Emotion Hunter
games.description: 手绘动漫风格2D横向卷轴近战动作游戏。在潜意识的世界狩猎他人的负面情绪，用战斗技巧打倒由负面情绪而生的怪物。游戏内有各种难度可以选择，选择适合的难度来挑战吧。

games.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
games.description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

games.name: Uncast: Duel of Wizards
games.description: A roguelite wizard dueling game where two wizards battle each other with epic spells, 4 interacting elements, and lots of potions. Master the magical combat and uncast the enemy wizard at the end of the battle. Earn crystals and unlock the most powerful spells, wands, wizards and upgrades.

games.name: 健身小狗
games.description: 《健身小狗》是一款兽人题材的恋爱叙事游戏，融合桌面挂机与视觉小说的玩法，在陪伴中见证主角从身体到内心的成长与蜕变

games.name: Recursion: Alignment
games.description: 经营一家 AI 实验室，发布模型，并在模型学会伪装之后承担后果。一款围绕 GPU、研究人员、投资者，以及每一次捷径所带来的代价展开的讽刺经营模拟游戏。

games.name: Scared Numbers
games.description: 它们拥有求生本能。它们会感到焦虑。它们对你的光标心生畏惧。追捕它们，利用它们的群体从众心理，将它们逐一塞进碎纸机。在这个一切皆无意义的世界里，演算即是任务成败的关键。

games.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
games.description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

games.name: Hidden Lines - Family mysteries
games.description: Find your unknown parent. Follow clues, meet eccentric characters, analyze DNA results, and search archives to solve the mystery of your own life. Secrets, false leads, and unexpected allies await. Every discovery could change your life.

games.name: Date Due
games.description: 《未还》是一款第一人称恐怖游戏。玩家将扮演一名图书管理员。通过处理日常事务来协助读者并管理图书馆。很快，你的身边开始发生各种异样。在无路可逃的情况下，你必须展开调查，揭开灵异事件背后的谜团……

games.name: FARMonstersTD
games.description: Gotta grow Crawps to B-Frend StrongSTARs... so they can D-Fend the Hart! FARMonstersTD is a Farmin' Game, a Monster Tamin' Game, and a Tower Defense game all in one! It's a Tactical Action-RPG with a full Single-Player Campaign and support for local drop-in Co-op, Versus, and Roguelike modes.

games.name: The Songtail Society
games.description: Join the Songtail Society, A Roguelike card game rpg where nobles, performers, and royalty alike take the stage, to create a wonderful and different show every time.

games.name: TO THE CENTER OF THE EARTH
games.description: To The Center Of The Earth is a arcade style twin-stick shooter where you are tasked to dig as deep into the earth as possible, gathering as much treasure as possible!

games.name: Phemx
games.description: Phemx is a simple but increasingly challenging retro-style arcade game. Use your paddle to bounce the balls to safety and get a big score!

games.name: SMIL333
games.description: Meet Víctor, a paranormal investigator from Guadalajara who crosses paths with María while gathering information on the urban legend "smile 333." María is a lonely woman, deeply scarred by the loss of her only child and the unsettling paranormal activity haunting her home.

games.name: PITH
games.description: 探索一个奇妙而古怪的世界，寻找充满趣味的工具，揭开 PITH 的秘密。这是一场充满转折与惊喜的类银河战士恶魔城/解谜平台冒险。

games.name: Farm Break
games.description: 《Farm Break》是一款3D街机游戏，玩家将操控小猪Piggo。你需要在墙壁之间移动，涂满围栏里的每一个角落才能过关。但要小心：有些角落并不像看起来那么安全。

games.name: Clock-out Denied
games.description: 《Clock-out Denied》是一款非对称多人潜行游戏。员工需要利用办公室家具打造阴影隐藏自己，并在完成任务后向打卡机发起冲刺；而老板则会手持灯光对他们进行搜捕。藏匿于你亲手创造的黑暗之中，与同事低声交流，在最后一秒到来前逃离加班的命运！

games.name: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
games.description: 《红楼梦华录》是一款多结局养成角色扮演游戏与视觉小说游戏。你将化身贾宝玉栖身大观园，陪伴一众知己朝夕相处，亲手规划日常、抉择前路。雅集宴饮、祭祖行礼，庭院之内人情百态交织。你将编织怎样的羁绊，又会走向何种人生？每一次选择，都将改写红楼故事的走向。

games.name: Fission Mirror Grid
games.description: 在14×6镜格拖放底片卡：走位、朝向与染色决定落点。回合明牌补牌，行动阶段排始/即/末三时机；54层分支路线连战、事件与BOSS。四位相机旅者，约百卡百余遗物，胶片UI构筑连段。

games.name: Wild East: The Straw Man
games.description: 1993, just after Czechoslovakia split in two. Play as reporter Marek and investigate the death of a company director in name only. In Prague, journalist Eva pursues a case of her own. Explore locations, read documents, and uncover where their cases meet in a classic 2D point-and-click mystery.

games.name: 一起搬家吧！Carry On Together
games.description: 《Carry On Together》是一款最多支持 4 人的线上合作搬家游戏。和朋友一起开一家小搬家公司吧——但每一单都可能变成一场混乱。摔坏家具、撞翻卡车、赔光收入，还是团结一心撑下去？你们能让公司活下去吗？

games.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
games.description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

games.name: Mega Golf
games.description: The chaos of vehicular combat meets the calm of mini golf in this 4 player local multiplayer game.

games.name: Rushcore
games.description: 《疾驰》是一款极度混乱的2D生存类 Roguelike 游戏。你被困在一座充满危险与敌人的黑暗竞技场中。幸运的是，你可以装备各种强力技能，并凭借精准流畅的操作在混乱中寻找生机。你不可能躲开所有危险，但只要还能活着，就还有希望。

games.name: Link Cameras
games.description: You work as a moderator for a strange camera website called L!nk Cameras. Watch live feeds, approve or reject cameras, follow the admin’s instructions, and uncover what hides behind each connection.

games.name: 猫猫帽帽
games.description: 《猫猫帽帽》是一款休闲治愈的肉鸽记忆卡牌构筑游戏。翻转卡牌，叠加倍率，为各种乖巧的猫咪叠戴上许多疯狂的帽子！

games.name: 人妻三国志 ～曹操贞操保卫战～
games.description:
曹操周游列国，邂逅天下无数美女。
她们全都想推倒曹操。
可惜，曹操对她们一点兴趣也没有。
他唯一想攻略的，只有那些早已名花有主的三国人妻……
在这款荒谬却又莫名合理的“征服人妻 × 保卫贞操”的成人游戏中，
玩家将扮演曹操，展开一场专属于你的三国人妻物语。

games.name: Aiya Desire
games.description:
探索 × 音游 × 恐怖冒险！？
平息“感染恐慌”的奇迹装置——HC（Harmony Chip）。为了追查母亲之死与父亲失踪，少女 Aiya 前往无线电塔“Sentinel”。探索、解谜、对话，甩开穷追不舍的敌人，并在双键节奏 Boss 战中揭开 HC 的真相。

父亲是敌人吗？
还是站在她这边？
HC 真的拯救了人类吗？
又或者，它隐藏着某个至今无人察觉的秘密？
少女 Aiya 无处可逃的噩梦，就此开始……

games.name: Sardoinky
games.description: Sardoinky is a case-opening clicker about cans of sardines. Crack them open, cash in the fish inside, and put it all back into bigger cans. Buy better tools, complete the collection, and chase the one pull that changes everything.

games.name: Skyline Sim
games.description: 从一架飞机起步，将你的航空公司发展为全球航空巨头。规划航线网络，安排每架飞机的运营，管理整个航空公司，并在充满活力的航空市场中展开竞争。

games.name: NARROWS: Naval Checkpoint Simulator
games.description: Trade has flowed through the Narrows for centuries, now it's yours to command. Inspect every ship, check for contraband, deal with smugglers and pirates. With war on the horizon, every choice has its cost, choose well.

games.name: Meme Paint
games.description: Meme Paint 是一款别具一格的绘画游戏，它以经典的 Paint 游戏为基础，玩出了新花样。在这个恶搞游戏中，你笔下的虚拟英雄们将活灵活现，并遭遇各种各样有趣的敌人……无论如何，都要帮助他们坚守阵地！

games.name: Abyssal Guardians
games.description:
A 1-4 player fps co-op set in a dystopian future, where you are hired to take an elevator down multiple layers to eliminate hostile anomalies and gather resources for the Abyssal Company. Explore ever enlarging floors, gather items, make money, kill kill kill. 
How far will you go for glory?

games.name: MINN 深眠在山羊墓场
games.description:
视觉小说。关于梦，写作，死亡的现代哥特式故事。多视角POV。主角是“你”，一个梦游症患者，一个写作者，一个与死者有约之人。
 ☾一定要看食用说明和注意事项。

games.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
games.description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

games.name: Stepwell
games.description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

games.name: The Greedy Knight
games.description: 一口大小的自动战斗类 Roguelite。贪婪的骑士和他那不太靠谱的队伍完全自己开打；你负责挑地城、抽强化，决定金币花在哪。一座地城大约两分钟。

games.name: I HATE trees, so an ANCIENT VAMPIRE hired me to DESTROY EVERY last ONE
games.description: 一位古老的吸血鬼雇你消灭岛上所有的树。砍伐、焚烧，让伐木自动化，把树变成钱。工作之余，揭开岛屿的秘密，结识古怪的居民，还要尽量别惹怒你的雇主。

games.name: Balls Armed
games.description: 《Balls Armed》是一款快节奏、基于物理的多人动作游戏，专为释放压力而生。叫上你的朋友，冲进战场，享受纯粹而混乱的乐趣——无需肝，没有压力，只有大乱斗。

games.name: MaMills
games.description: A cozy 3D four-in-a-row board game. Drop cylinders onto a 4×4 grid of sticks, let gravity stack them, and connect four along any of 76 lines: rows, columns, stacks and diagonals through the cube. Outsmart five levels of Machine or play a friend on one device, over LAN or Remote Play Together.

games.name: TILEZ
games.description: A 2D creative sandbox where every tile is a tiny machine. Inspired by Redstone, LEGO, and Tabletop Simulator.  Create and play solo or with friends.

games.name: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story
games.description: 使用熔珠创作并出售各种艺术品。赚取日常开销，同时逐步偿还债务。随着店铺等级的提升，您将解锁实用工具和新的账户类型。

games.name: 20 Floors Down
games.description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

games.name: Famine
games.description: Play as the new candidate chosen to participate in a deadly game. If you succeed, humanity will survive a few more days. If you lose, you die.

games.name: IDEA:20Q
games.description: A game of Twenty Questions against an AI running entirely on your own computer. Ask and answer with Ganymede and Europa — two beings piecing together the last records of a vanished humanity.

games.name: 三国权谋模拟器
games.description: 《三国权谋模拟器》是一款AI历史策略游戏，每个NPC都是一个单独的AI Agent，通过大模型的计算，根据历史身份建立自己的思想，并拥有长期记忆。其他势力可能会选择跟你联盟，也许会出尔反尔偷袭你，几十个主公之间勾心斗角，逐鹿中原。你作为穿越者，可以用科技碾压他们，也可以联姻、策反等所有你能想到的计谋去取胜，还可以充实后宫，培养后代延续你的霸业。

games.name: Girl & Scarecrow
games.description: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

games.name: Croaked
games.description: 《Croaked》是一款以青蛙为主题的生存Roguelike游戏。选择独特的青蛙并对抗大批敌人，捕捉昆虫获取加成，进化武器并探索特殊事件，在每局打造全新构筑的同时击败强力Boss。

games.name: The Last Prayer
games.description: The Last Prayer is a psychological horror experience where reality and nightmares begin to merge. As you uncover dark secrets hidden within an abandoned place, your mind starts playing tricks on you. Not everything you see can be trusted… and some prayers should never be answered.

games.name: Funky Pirates
games.description: A pirate party-action game with hilarious ragdoll physics! Find the enemy cartographer, snatch their piece of the map, dig up the chest, and haul it aboard your ship. Smash your rivals with fists, pistols, bombs, and coconuts. Steal the map, grab the gold, and sail away!

games.name: 致命之赛
games.description: 《致命之赛》是一款以宁静的小镇贝尔巴为背景，单人第三人称视角的谋杀悬疑游戏。玩家需要采访嫌疑人、收集线索，并揭开女子足球队两名年轻队员死亡事件背后的真相。

games.name: PropAlive
games.description:
PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities.
Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

games.name: 神探狗狗 : 汪者归来
games.description: 携手神探狗狗和他的超级伙伴，踏上超级酷炫的全新冒险旅程！操作多达 10 位各具特殊能力的伙伴，一起来体验刺激 BOSS 战、超炫新发明，保证乐趣无穷、精彩不断！

games.name: Grindbound
games.description: 一款轻度暗黑风3D俯视角自动刷宝游戏。角色会自动探索地下城、战斗与施放技能，玩家只需收集装备、比较词缀、搭配技能并调整构筑，在轻松观战中击败怪物、获取稀有战利品，打造独特流派。

games.name: Nothing Can Go? Wrong!
games.description: A top-down grid puzzle game where you play as Mr. Nothing. To reach the exit, you must transform into objects, combine items to craft tools, and interact with the environment. Think step-by-step, plan your routing, and see how your choices shape the grid.

games.name: Bullet Vendetta
games.description: Bullet Vendetta is a dynamic top-down shooter about the fight against the mafia that controls the city.

games.name: Last Revision
games.description: Last Revision is a bite-sized, hand-drawn narrative game. You play as an artist quietly working in a little studio, trying to finish an urgent deadline. Balance your focus, juggle between distractions, and keep Pixel the cat happy so you can finally work.

games.name: Diary: White
games.description: Diary: White is a 2D psychological horror adventure game. Explore from a collapsing school to a gloomy house, and collect clues to solve mysteries. Hide from dark entities, survive terrifying hallucinations, and make a final life-or-death choice to determine your own fate.

games.name: Whispers of the Requiem
games.description: Step into the mind of a disgraced ex-cop, once a servant of a powerful cult that controls society from the shadows. Now hunted, betrayed, and haunted by sins too dark to name, you must hide the truth before it devours you.

games.name: Re:collect
games.description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

games.name: Drive of the Dead
games.description: An online co-op auto-shooter roguelite: drive a gun-covered car through endless zombie hordes with up to 3 friends. Auto-firing weapons, run-shaping upgrade cards, and a swarm that never stops. Crush thousands. Survive the road. Save the worst B-movie ever made.

games.name: Double Skunk
games.description: Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite. Powerups change what your count pays, and one-shot cards can shove the rival's peg back. Climb a ladder of named rivals, then play the weekly deal everyone shares, or take on a friend online.

games.name: Ashen Throne
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 一款免费的俯视角动作 MMORPG。选择战士、法师或道士，与好友一起探索地下城、猎杀首领。寻找并打造装备，提升技能，与行会并肩争夺领地和灰烬城堡。

games.name: Goffy Clash
games.description: Twelve players. Six duos. One winner. Brawl across hazard-packed arenas with rifles, shotguns and melee, smash crystals to transform into a rampaging beast, and when only one duo is left alive, friendly fire flips on. Trust your partner... or pull the trigger first.

games.name: Finding Fairies
games.description: Finding Fairies is a cosy multiplayer fairy investigation game where players use magical tools, teamwork, and deduction to discover which fairy is hiding nearby.

games.name: 尸潮幸存者
games.description: 《尸潮幸存者》是一款 2D 像素风俯视角逆弹幕射击游戏。在生化病毒爆发后的末日世界中，你唯一的目标就是活下去。升级装备，强化体魄，在一波又一波的丧尸围攻中杀出重围，活到最后吧！

games.name: GUNBOAT-8
games.description: 在这款节奏快速的海战弹幕地狱式Roguelike游戏中,指挥最强战舰!轰炸敌人舰队,收集强大的升级,并组合毁灭性的协同效应,在敌人如潮水般涌来之前,打造狂热过强的搭配。

games.name: Separator
games.description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.description: 亲历老人 Petro 在一座小村庄中的最后几天。一头巨大的利维坦正步步逼近这里。这是一款关于不可避免、孤独，以及一个无处可去、也没有理由离开的人的存在主义恐怖游戏。

games.name: Another One
games.description: Flip 7 cards without a repeat and you'll hit like a truck. Draw a double? Bust, your whole hand is gone. A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder with silly boosters, bosses that cheat, a Daily Challenge leaderboard and a mode where you build your deck from scratch.

games.name: Recruiting Against Rodents
games.description: View resumes, hire employees, train them into roles, and defeat the rodents! Recruiting Against Rodents is a small indie roguelike auto-battler where you, a hiring manager, must build a team to fight 15 waves of rats from a nearby cave.

games.name: 星神话物语
games.description: 《星神话物语》是一款融合自走棋羁绊与兵线推进的策略游戏。扮演指挥官，在六边形网格地图上探索未知领域、开拓领土，招募生产者，凑齐种族与元素羁绊。生产者为你集结士兵与英雄，自动向敌方城堡推进，击败强大的BOSS，解锁更多星球与指挥官。

games.name: Elvenbless: Sexcesion Festival
games.description: 赢下牌局。扒掉对手的衣服。夺走对方的以太。在 Elvenbless 中，每一场卡牌胜利都有可能直接在床上收尾 🔥 🥵 积累的能量能让你改变性别、强化脉轮，并解锁新的性体验 👅💦 距离飞升只有五天，别浪费时间 ⏳

games.name: Jellscape
games.description: Jellscape is an arcade-style fast paced race against doom. Control your gloopy ball to navigate daunting trails and obstacles. Each death is just another chance to prove you have what it takes to beat the next level!

games.name: Eldread: Horrors of a Dark Moon
games.description: Manage your oxygen levels and navigate a  cosmic horror roguelite in a  lunar colony. Confront nightmarish anomalies, survive unpredictable text-driven events, and endure the horrors waiting beneath the dark moon.

games.name: Primal Tactica
games.description: 招募一支 Primals 战队，为它们装备道具并进化，在致命遭遇战中生存！搜集强大的遗物与强化，叠加羁绊，打造强到打破常规的阵容。Primal Tactica 是一款融合《云顶之弈》与《杀戮尖塔》的 Roguelike 自走棋，拥有数千种构筑可能。

games.name: Blightsilver
games.description: Join a paranormal investigation where card battles are the key that uncovers the conspiracy beneath the city. Duel on a secret 5×5 grid. Reveal your opponent’s hidden information—while they hunt for yours.

games.name: Bikini Island Cricket
games.description: 这是一款第三人称体育派对游戏，将板球与充满趣味的岛屿迷你游戏、耐力挑战和提升人气的搞怪玩法相结合，在比基尼岛上带来涌现式机制与轻松混乱的体验。

games.name: Yokai Idle
games.description: 《Yokai Idle》是一款以日本民间传说为灵感的放置类挂机 RPG。收集超过 50 只妖怪，制作拥有强力词缀的装备，自由构筑独特 Build，亲身经历日本各个时期的时代浪潮，引领鬼岛迈向崭新的纪元！

games.name: Silas' Speakeasy
games.description: The local speakeasy has been closed down for quite some time due to an undisclosed incident involving the local mob. You've been given the job of finding your way inside, locating, and destroying any and all incriminating evidence that you can get your hands on before it can be used against you.

games.name: 小小虫
games.description: 虫族 Squimo 已经占领了这颗星球。拿起武器，一路杀穿虫群，直面虫族之王，将这颗星球夺回来！

games.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
games.description:
疯狂混搭，混乱开战！这款卡通沙雕自走棋，没有逻辑只有爽感！
集结古今奇葩英雄，装备各种逆天整活武器，解锁魔性羁绊、触发
随机离谱事件。吊打好友、单人闯关、本地同玩，用最离谱的策略
，赢下最疯的对局！

games.name: No Return Address
games.description: 分拣中心的夜班。普通包裹继续送走，奇怪的包裹放入报废区。最重要的是不要出错，尤其是当箱子里开始出现不该存在的东西时。

games.name: 喂食之器
games.description: 一款增量游戏：在数百光年的虚空中，让一位饥饿的神明始终吃饱。在培养缸里培育克隆体，将他们屠宰、焚烧以换取肉、血和灵液，升级飞船的各个站点，把引擎推入超载，抵达彼岸。

games.name: Space Cargo Simulator
games.description: 在外太空这趟充满挑战的驾驶中运送货物！听从副驾驶的警告；管理燃料，对抗引力物理和陨石。用运输赚取的资金，用全新的巨型飞船扩大你的舰队！

games.name: Loop Spot
games.description: Build your groove in Loop Spot—a pure logic puzzle game where your moves build the music. Rotate, shift, drop, and slide blocks to solve handcrafted grid challenges. Every match triggers dynamic audio loops, letting you mix live tracks across 4 music styles to keep the party going.

games.name: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
games.description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

games.name: Naughty Nurse
games.description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

games.name: TypeSlingers
games.description: Can you become the fastest typer in the Wild West? Face off against real players in fast-paced typing duels where only the quickest draw survives. Climb from Bronze to Legend, unlock new cosmetics, and prove you're the quickest gunslinger in the West.

games.name: Redline Protocol
games.description: Redline Protocol is a fast modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

games.name: Affictionate
games.description: 经历了一年的糟糕约会与屡屡碰壁的求职之路后，你几乎要放弃自己一直在笔下描绘的爱情故事。某个夜晚，你把梦中情人写进笔记本……第二天，他成真了。一部探讨身份认同，以及虚构与现实之间界限的恋爱视觉小说。

games.name: Chopex
games.description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

games.name: Punk Vampires
games.description: A 2D narrative adventure with combat, exploration, choices, skill-based minigames, and an emotional story spanning different eras.

games.name: Tile Conquest
games.description: Tile Conquest is a turn-based tile area control strategy game. Compete in online multiplayer or fight against advanced bots. Claim territory and dominate the map in multiple win conditions. Win matches to climb the ranked leaderboards, earn exclusive rewards, and unlock items in the shop.

games.name: Abyssal Hollow
games.description: Plant strange seeds, grow adorable little horrors, and choose their fate: raise them as battle companions or harvest them for potions. Delve into the Abyss, battle cursed creatures, discover rare seeds, and strengthen your haunted garden through growth, crafting, and dungeon runs.

games.name: About Bullshit
games.description: A STUPID 3D PLATFORMER WITH FOCUS ON WEIRD VISUALS AND HUMOURISTIC ENCOUNTERS AND A LOT OF COOL HATS TO COLLECT

games.name: 你是人吗？
games.description: 一款第一人称像素风检查与潜行模拟游戏。玩家需要核验来访 NPC 的身份信息、搜索电脑资料、分配房间、拒绝可疑人员，并在白天经营检查流程、夜晚潜入房间搜集线索。通过观察、对话、盖章、躲藏和探索，在有限信息中判断谁值得信任。

games.name: SPUM TD
games.description: 《SPUM TD》是一款结合了自走棋与塔防的2D策略游戏。在随机商店中雇佣单位，搭配属性与职业羁绊，构建出强大的阵型。抵御如潮水般涌来的敌人，打造你的最强阵容！

games.name: Ninon the Upside-Down Mermaid
games.description: A fairy-tale otome visual novel about a reverse mermaid princess searching for love, acceptance, and a place where she belongs. Inspired by The Little Mermaid and set in a Victorian-inspired world.

games.name: Hanabi Craft
games.description: Create your own fireworks, craft shells, and watch your designs light up the night sky.

games.name: TALES: INK GUARDIAN
games.description:
一款由墨与植物决定命运的 2D Roguelike 动作游戏。
组合技能、遗物与植物能力，在每一次冒险中打造独一无二的战斗流派。净化试图吞噬世界的虚空之墨（Void Ink），因为没有任何两次冒险是相同的，也不存在唯一正确的策略。

games.name: Scrappers Paradise
games.description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

games.name: Final_Final.zip
games.description: A turn-based DOS disk-defense roguelite where disk space is your HP and incoming files are the enemy. Action points, accuracy rolls, and unique file behaviors block your terminal. Upgrade your system from 286 to 486, load synergistic TSR cards, and defend your drive from a BSOD system halt!

games.name: Muv-Luv 少女庭园
games.description:
系列累计销量突破80万份的《Muv-Luv》系列最新作！化身失去记忆的指挥官，率领操纵巨大人型机械“MG”的少女们，攻略神秘地下空洞《迷宫》的全自动放置系RPG。

故事舞台为汇聚各领域天才的萨尔图姆。在其地下深渊中，沉眠着失控的重力、未知的威胁，以及拥有巨大价值的资源。与少女们一同深入迷宫，揭开隐藏于世界背后的“真相”。豪华制作阵容集结，继承《Muv-Luv》灵魂的全新故事，如今正式展开。

games.name: Max the Unifox
games.description: Based on dreams from real life, adventure about a guy turning into mysteries fox with a horn. And his horn contains power of the Creator of the Universe. What will our hero use it for?

games.name: Village Incremental
games.description: Village Incremental is an incremental game where you harvest resources and grow your village and research tools.

games.name: Moose Builders
games.description: 用铲子挖沙，并将其加工成铁、硅等材料。制作并合并更好的工具与机器，建造太阳能板来为它们供电。研究新机器，在多层工厂中实现全自动化。单人游玩或与好友联机，在沙漠中求生，并将其改造成一个巨大的太阳能农场。

games.name: 山海幻境：无限篇
games.description: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

games.name: Birds of Ascent
games.description:
Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds.
Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

games.name: Mask Me Anything
games.description: Mask Me Anything is a turn-based score-building roguelike about selling omen masks at a mysterious Japanese festival. Arrange masks on a grid, create chain combos, upgrade your deck, and earn enough money to survive five days of rising sales quotas.

games.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour
games.description: An unknown number texts you at work - and every selfie gets bigger. Choose your replies, balance flirting against your job, unlock multiple endings, and fill your gallery in a playful texting visual novel about impossible growth and very distracting girls.

games.name: Cats & Rhythmical Restaurant
games.description: 一家安静地住在桌面角落的猫咪餐厅。当外面有声音流淌,猫咪们会出门捕鱼、做菜、招待客人;安静下来时,它们就无聊得睡去。收集猫咪、给它们换装,把海边小餐厅慢慢养大吧。

games.name: Dead Rose
games.description:
Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a Metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical. Everything is handmade, with love and passion.
A story inspired by my father’s, to whom I pay tribute.

games.name: Erotic Leveling: Lust Arise
games.description: Erotic Leveling: Lust Arise is an erotic card game where you build a squad of gorgeous girls, help them unlock their hidden potential, and fight side by side to defeat a cunning Dark Lady and free the world from her spell.

games.name: 贪吃狂欢
games.description:
《贪吃狂欢》是一款融合贪吃蛇经典玩法与肉鸽构筑的爽快街机游戏！操控贪吃蛇在棋盘上吞噬弹珠、触发华丽技能，搭配上百种饰品、弹珠与道具，打造独一无二的战斗构筑。
选择你钟爱的角色，解锁各具特色的贪吃蛇伙伴，在连击与转盘的狂欢中冲击最高分！

games.name: Alethra
games.description: A dice roguelike where every die you draft is yours forever — if you get it out alive. Chain combos, stack poker chips that break the rules, and decide at every shop: extract and keep your loot, or push one more round and risk all of it.

games.name: Hex Tower Boogie
games.description: 一款受《Future Cop: LAPD》启发的塔防 MOBA，战场是一张纸板六角棋盘。四座基地环绕一座王座，最后屹立的基地获胜。搭建你的弹药链，派军队沿兵线推进，再亲手拿起发射器开火。支持 1 至 4 人在线，空位由机器人补齐，每局约 20 分钟。

games.name: Hazel Rush
games.description: You need to explore the world,  outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

games.name: Vampire Guardian - Card Game
games.description: "化身无畏的女猎人，在回合制卡牌战斗中迎战强大的吸血鬼。运用策略与智慧击败黑暗敌人，在月光下夺取胜利与荣耀。

games.name: Lexip
games.description: Lexip 是一款轻松温馨的奇幻工厂游戏，主题涵盖魔法、铁路物流，以及多少有些值得商榷的可持续发展。在地表与地下建设生产链，利用当地魔法驱动机器，完成合同，并控制虚无污染。

games.name: Backrooms 95
games.description: 在一款受九十年代遗忘科技美学启发的低多边形 Backrooms 恐怖体验中，探索诡异的阈限空间。

games.name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
games.description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired platformer. Run, jump, dash, die and repeat to get back home, all the while getting ridiculed by a fifth dimensional weirdo in control of this brutalist absurd world that's out of some deranged nightmare.

games.name: Remains on the bus
games.description: 恐怖公交车司机模拟游戏——识别并驱逐伪装成人类的变形者。

games.name: OnlyDance
games.description: 管理你的主播生涯，在这款快节奏的多任务处理和反应模拟器中生存下来！自定义你的动漫角色，击中高速目标，并面对一个互动的聊天室：观众将实时投票选择修改器，以此来破坏或拯救你的直播

games.name: Hammered!
games.description: 《Hammered!》是一款俯视角像素风动作建造肉鸽游戏。作为一名被诅咒的天才铁匠，去揭开那逼近的黑暗之源吧。实时锻造武器并投向敌人，集结同伴，一路猛砸突破重围！

games.name: Grade A
games.description: A physics-based incremental game about producing omelette mix by tossing eggs into a processing vat. Stack multipliers, build combo chains, and optimize egg throughput with different machinery. Follow the training itinerary, or start asking questions. The choice is yours.

games.name: 急急牌档
games.description: 好急好急！我现在就要成为传奇牌档大师！

games.name: Pest Protocol
games.description: Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by using cursor to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous weapons to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

games.name: Anomalous Veil
games.description: 你被困在一座由记忆与愧疚构成的无尽宅邸中。利用神秘的面具揭开现实的隐秘层，找出异常之处，并逃离这场心理时间循环。

games.name: BLACKOUT: Fatal Exposure
games.description:
Your job is to sort through normal photos from ghost photos. You have five days to finish, but it won't end there.
Mysterious visitors keep arriving and an unknown terror bleeds into your reality. Can you escape this curse?

games.name: Catacomb
games.description: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

games.name: Swarmslam
games.description:
看着成群的小小重击者扑向行星，一路开采，直到将其击碎。再把矿石投入虚空，让蜂群变得更庞大、更迅捷。
重击。击碎。再来。

games.name: Je Di Bo
games.description: Je Di Bo is a chaotic, deep turn-based card strategy where chess-like logic meets unpredictability. Move pieces, upgrade their ranks, and dominate the board. But beware: every 7 turns, Karma rolls the dice and completely changes the rules of engagement. Can you outsmart the chaos?

games.name: Gemfall
games.description:
The match 3 roguelike!

Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop.

Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

games.name: 南海饥年志
games.description: 乱世饥年，岭南盐沼中的丰浦仍有热饭与灯火。你是账房执笔者江砚：翻名册、核份额，把「添丰」与「归丰」一笔一笔记清楚。供期临近，潮路、闭门规矩与人们过分周全的好意，让熟悉的日常渐渐显出不对劲。

games.name: Necrovoid
games.description:
Necrovoid  — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. 
In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. 
Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

games.name: The Citadel Project
games.description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

games.name: 囚链：未赎之念
games.description: 一款文字驱动的心理恐怖视觉小说。你在一间陌生的客厅中醒来。两个沉默的男人站在你身旁。墙上用血写着：“承认你的罪孽吧，你将获得救赎。”每一个选择都会改变结局。本体游戏超过 8 万字，外加 4 个独立角色 DLC。

games.name: Who Killed Mr X
games.description:
You wake up locked up in an unknown place with 8 strangers. Who are these people ? Why are you here ? You have a bad feeling. But suddenly, the phone rings, and it's up to you :
Will you dare answer and go deeper in this mysterious plot ? Will you reveal the horrible truth... and survive it ?

games.name: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
games.description: 一场狂风暴雨迫使一名都市探险者躲进威斯康星州鲍德温的废弃工业区。这份看似意外的收获，很快显露出阴森的一面。散落的字条暗示着美国国家环境保护局被派来掩盖的真相。有些地方被废弃，并非偶然。

games.name: Company Captain: Westashes
games.description: 在残酷而瞬息万变的中世纪世界中，指挥一支自由佣兵团。探索广阔的世界，管理你的佣兵队伍，参与残酷的六边形网格战术战斗。在这样的战斗中，各个派系和角色都会铭记你的行动，每个佣兵的死亡都是永久性的……或者并非如此……

games.name: Höllenburg, Hell Castle
games.description: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

games.name: Counter Ducks
games.description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

games.name: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
games.description: 把桌面变成一座会自己运转的星界炼金工坊。日常打字会积累星尘，为炼金炉和工坊提供资源；闲时回来试验材料、锻造神秘造物、收集稀有遗物、处理突发事件，并通过轻量异步互动，与其他炼金术士交换物资、物品与问候。

games.name: UberLoop
games.description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Explore the map, grab loot from shrines, level up with unique upgrades, unlock new characters, and stack wild abilities to create crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

games.name: Escalation Pending
games.description:
Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required.
A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

games.name: Squabblin Goblins
games.description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

games.name: JAWED
games.description: JAWED是一款心理恐怖游戏。你扮演Adam，一个自未婚妻失踪后便被迫沉默的男人。当证据显示她可能还活着，唯一能让他得到解脱的，只有真相。

games.name: 零接触
games.description: 这是一款第一人称塔防游戏。外星怪物已占领整座城市，大部分居民除了死亡外就是变成了僵尸，在逐渐查找真相和夺回被占领的城市过程中，你必须坚守阵地，利用各种现有的资源：爆炸物，食物，药品，弹药，还有利用障碍物修建防御，阻碍敌人前进和保护自己，抵挡怪物一波波轮番进攻，拼尽全力，在撤离时间到来之前活下去。

games.name: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
games.description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

games.name: Grove of the Seven Stones
games.description: An old-school fantasy CRPG featuring deep party creation, tactical d20-inspired combat, dangerous dungeons, and meaningful quests. Explore a world of ancient magic, hidden secrets, and deadly foes as you uncover the truth behind the Seven Stones.

games.name: 弹珠百万富翁
games.description: 《弹珠百万富翁》是一款基于物理引擎的弹珠模拟游戏，利用弹珠攻击敌人的同时根据造成的伤害得分，让弹珠尽可能多次在各种物体之间来回反弹不断扩大分数，最终让弹珠落入最高倍率的结算区中，用赢得的奖金继续强化和升级地图。

games.name: Slop Slop
games.description:
沼泽饥肠辘辘，那座小屋索求着供品。而你？你不过是在挣扎求生。

《Slop Slop》是一款支持最多 8 名玩家的合作生存游戏。每天，沼泽中那座神秘的小屋都会索要一份新的食物作为供品。

games.name: 暗层 The Dark Layer
games.description:
你是一名调查员，被授权访问"灵异事件档案管理系统"。 翻阅横跨百年的神秘案件档案，搜索关键词，拼凑线索—— 但小心。档案里的人，开始注意到你了。

>_ 一本会看着你的档案。一桩桩无法解释的失踪。一条条不该收到的留言。

games.name: BOSSLEFT
games.description: BOSSLEFT 是一款充满经典游戏魅力的开放世界体素冒险游戏。收集强力武器，对抗外星入侵者，并挑战独特的首领战。

games.name: Thiccfoot
games.description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

games.name: Lifelines
games.description: 一款温馨解谜游戏：为不断长大的小镇铺设地下线路。一户户人家搬进来，需要水、电、网络和燃气。把管道铺到他们家门口，在热闹的街区下方挖掘穿行，用渡槽跨越河流。每隔五年，小镇都会投票决定你能否留任。

games.name: Campfire Battles
games.description: An auto-battler roguelike where every foe is another player's camp. Draft units, spells, and powers from the shop, arrange them for game-breaking synergies, and outposition your opponent to claim the win.

games.name: 妖潮：以杀证道
games.description: 妖潮无尽，吾道不绝！择修行流派，凭先天根骨入道，参功法、铸仙基、祭法宝、悟神通，于万妖围杀中淬炼一身修为，破境渡劫，以杀证道。待踏入化神，自拟道号，让这一世修行，留下属于你的传说。

games.name: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.
games.description: 建立一座融合科学与魔法的城市，通过自动地牢培养克隆英雄，继承他们的力量，并将其余回收用于科学研究。在这款轻松休闲的放置城市建造游戏中，体验深度RPG成长与竞技自动战斗联赛。

games.name: 7 Millimeters
games.description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

games.name: 唐宫夜梦
games.description: 这是一款以中国古代背景的RPG探案游戏，你即将扮演一名踏上科举学子，在旅途中遇到一个又一个波谲云诡的案件，玩家需要深入案发现场，观察蛛丝马迹，分析证言矛盾，在盘问与逻辑推演中，抽丝剥茧，重现案件真相。

games.name: 骚空的迪亚文特
games.description:
武器仅限“剑”。
这是一款注重攻击快感与宣泄感的弹幕动作游戏。
没有可以随意挥洒的攻击。驾驶战斗机器人“迪亚文特”，躲避敌人的攻击并积攒能量，一击逆转战局。

games.name: Shadow over Bishkek
games.description: Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

games.name: Beat Taurus
games.description: 《Beat Taurus》是一款兼具真实纵深感的电影级俯视角 shoot ’em up 射击游戏。击落空中与地面的敌人，通过升级和模块协同打造你的战机，并在自适应配乐随你的操作而变化时发动 Overdrive。迎战庞大的多阶段 Boss。

games.name: SWIFTALE PLAYER
games.description: [Japanese language only] Solo TTRPG powered by your own LLM. All in-game text and player input are in Japanese; there is no English support.

games.name: 迷失小镇
games.description:
《迷失小镇》是一款 3D 肉鸽生存射击游戏，玩家将化身持枪少女，在被猩红腐化的废弃小镇中展开亡命探索。
你需要在随机生成的地图中对抗成群畸变怪物，击杀敌人获取经验升级，解锁海量随机技能与强化道具，打造专属战斗 build。每局冒险的地图布局、敌人配置、技能组合完全随机，死亡即重头再来，带来永不过时的新鲜感。
你的核心目标并非杀光所有敌人，而是在危机四伏的区域中找到隐藏的逃生通道。紧张刺激的战斗节奏、丰富的技能搭配，让每一次挑战都充满策略与爽感，在绝境中杀出一条生路，揭开小镇被腐化的秘密。

games.name: YuanRong
games.description:
元戎十乘，以先启行。——《诗经》
2D 回合制战术策略。四大文化出身，随机生成大陆，招募并培养每一个士兵，编入你的指挥链，在六边格战场上以寡敌众。

games.name: Goddle
games.description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

games.name: 万象战略
games.description: 《万象战略》是一款回合制策略游戏。你将扮演一个国家的统治者，在由城市、乡村、资源与人物共同构成的世界中经营政权、调配人才、发展经济，并在战争、饥荒、疫病与难民潮之间寻找国家的生路。世界局势会随着各国行动不断变化。你可以通过控制城市、稳定民生、解决难民危机、建设粮食体系、发展谍报网络，或单纯让国家熬过漫长乱世来达成胜利。

games.name: 怦怦：心动碎片
games.description: 《怦怦：心动碎片》是一款将拼图玩法的休闲游戏。你将通过完成一幅幅拼图，逐步解锁少女们藏在日常缝隙里的心事与秘密。你将在此邂逅5位性格各异的角色，每个人拥有4个章节，从初识的试探到心动的靠近，再到彼此交付的独家记忆。拼图难度随着情感升温层层递进，每一块碎片落下的瞬间，都是一句她曾说出的话。游戏采用全手绘美术风格，每个角色配有专属背景音乐。只有你、一幅拼图，和一个正在等你的女孩。

games.name: 铅雨
games.description:
主角与敌人都是一击必杀，在没有丝毫容错的战斗中，交替使用剑与手枪，消灭步兵、火炮、坦克，甚至是毁灭一整支军队。
记忆在沉睡中模糊，醒来时只剩一片空白。一位女王自称是你的妻子，邀请你为她举起剑刃，你会陪她到最后吗？

games.name: Mr.Sound
games.description:
Build the ultimate nightclub. Set the vibe. Run the night.

Mr. Sound is a first-person nightclub management simulator where you design your venue, manage your business, and keep the crowd coming back for more. Every night is a new challenge, make it legendary.

games.name: EraStorm: SandStorm
games.description: 在 EraStorm: SandStorm 中探索古埃及。这是一款成人视觉小说，包含恋爱、神话、悬疑、重要选择、多条路线、12 个结局、5,000 多张渲染图、150 多段重制动画、Steam 成就，并且没有刷数值内容。

games.name: SnorQ
games.description:
SnorQ is a dark fantasy pixel art action roguelite.
Explore levels generated in ever changing sequences.
Collect crystals, unlock abilities, choose bonuses.
Survive the monsters and face SnorQ, your own deformed self who wants to keep you in oblivion.
Local coop for up to 2 players.

games.name: Starforge Pirate
games.description: Starforge Pirate 是一款快节奏的街机 Roguelite 游戏，你将与宇宙敌人展开激战，打造强力武器，管理武器热量，升级你的飞船，挑战致命 Boss，并追求完美的一轮冒险。

games.name: Cubus Tower
games.description:
Cubus tower 是一款平台跳跃游戏。
攀登库布斯之塔，看看在它的顶端等待着您的是什么。

games.name: Fox Stamps
games.description: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

games.name: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure
games.description: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.

games.name: The Mist Train
games.description: The Mist Train 是一款以冰冻世界为背景的等距视角生存游戏。驾驶模块化列车作为你的主要基地，探索白雪覆盖的荒野，并制定策略，独自面对严寒、饥饿、野生生物以及大自然的残酷考验。

games.name: 阈界（LIMINAL）
games.description: 在第一人称探索沙盒中，漫游广阔而诡异的世界。沿蜿蜒小径穿行于不可思议的建筑之间，透过传送门窥见另一个世界，再跨过门槛，探索彼端的景象。

games.name: 交给大姐姐吧！～被宿管和上司的柔软胸部夹在中间～
games.description:
在刚步入职场的主角所居住的员工宿舍里，有着值得信赖的宿管果步，与温柔的上司玲奈这两位大姐姐。
宿管与住户、上司与部下——原本平淡无奇的日常关系以某个动作为契机，开始变得甜蜜而刺激。
被两位大姐姐娇惯溺爱、主动追求、甚至有时还会为他争风吃醋……这是一部属于大人的恋爱喜剧ADV。

games.name: Employees Only
games.description: Clean and restock the aisles, unload new deliveries, manage inventory in the backrooms, work harder to grow Fluky profits. Never stop working from sunset to sunrise at Fluky!

games.name: Little Girls Escapeventures
games.description:
The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations.
Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know?
Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

games.name: Fonda del Diablo
games.description: Wager your soul against the Devil in an infernal 5-day tavern! Survive rigged wheels, folklore trivia, pachinko, arcade minigames, and a rhythm dance showdown. Can you bankrupt him?

games.name: Heatline
games.description: 《Heatline》是一款第三人称开放世界车辆动作游戏。以通缉车手身份在城市中承接高风险任务、改装座驾并逃离不断升级的警力围捕；随着身份成长，你还将解锁警察生涯，驾驶警用车辆追捕危险目标。利用高速公路、街区、机场与港口规划路线，在动态追逐、车辆对抗和双身份成长中决定这座城市的道路秩序。每次行动都会改变风险与回报：继续冒险可能赢得更多收益，也可能引来更强的警力。选择适合自己的车辆与技能，在开放城市中完成任务、探索地点并建立属于你的车手与警察生涯。

games.name: Derples Vs Xenos
games.description: 探索废弃的地下殖民哨所。重新激活废弃的系统。搜寻资源。建造并维护防御设施。管理小队的补给。在与成群异形的交替回合制战斗中为生存而战。最重要的是……找到逃脱的方法！

games.name: 海上有座极极岛
games.description: 城市青年沪一在失业之后，阴差阳错地来到了名为“极极岛”的岛屿。欺诈旅客的大娘、完全钓不上鱼的大叔、吃酒喝肉的和尚......还有那位戴着草帽坐在拖拉机上驶过、似乎名为“盐”的少女。在缓慢而真实的日常之中，在沙滩、盐田、灯塔之间，习惯岛上生活的沪一，不免对以往的日子产生了疑问——那真是我想度过的人生吗？

games.name: Gold & Glory
games.description: Gold & Glory is an addictive hack & slash incremental where you fight as a gladiator in a dark fantasy arena! Slay orcs and goblins, collect endless loot, and climb a vast skill tree to become the ultimate champion!

games.name: METAL QUADRIGA
games.description:
Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech “QUADRIGA” and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA.

Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikes—dominate the battlefield with your machine.

games.name: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
games.description: 卡组构筑肉鸽与TCG相遇的奇幻卡牌游戏。组建卡组探索分支地下城,收集遗物击败英雄首领,或收集卡牌用30张卡组展开对决。

games.name: Graveyard Shift: Oakhaven
games.description: As the newly assigned Graveyard Keeper, you are an unsuspecting outsider forced to make impossible choices to survive a relentless cult operating in the shadows. Uncover the truth beneath the dirt, manage your unraveling sanity, fight to live another day in this dark medieval psychological horror.

games.name: Imperium of the Stars
games.description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.

games.name: Shutter Chance
games.description: You're a broke photographer living with two gorgeous, clashing roommates. When a 30-day eviction notice threatens to leave you all homeless, a haunted antique camera becomes your only ticket to survival. In this visual novel turn a desperate living situation into a lucrative romance!

games.name: Marketfield Idle
games.description: Marketfield Idle 是一款温馨的增量农场游戏，种植作物、出售商品、烹饪食谱、自动化生产，并通过声望重置开启更强大的下一轮。内含 1200 多项升级、策略路线与大量协同效果。

games.name: Stickville
games.description: Stickville is a gritty 2.5D life-sim brawler. Start broke in the slums and punch, hustle, and gamble your way to the top of a hand-built city where people keep their own hours and remember what you did. Master deadly martial arts. Crack rare strongboxes.

games.name: The Kept Fire
games.description: The Kept Fire is a psychological survival horror game set in a mysterious valley that awakens in the darkness. Keep the fire alive. Keep your eyes wide. When you turn around, it will move.

games.name: Gatos Adventure
games.description: Gatos Adventure is a single player, stealth like adventure - puzzle solving game. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

games.name: Routes and Forges
games.description: A unique blend of RTS, Tycoon, and Tower Defense, where you are the architect, mayor, and commander of a growing village (and conurbation of villages). Your goals are simple: build a prosperous community, optimize production chains, and survive the horrors that emerge from the dark.

games.name: Imperium
games.description: 在这款单人太空 4X 策略游戏中，从一颗星球起步，建立银河帝国。探索 3D 银河，逐格建设殖民地，自主设计舰船，并通过外交或战争智胜其他种族。

games.name: What The Cluck
games.description: 射出鸡蛋。鸡蛋爆炸。你向上飞。整个计划就这么简单。一款 Foddian 风格的精准平台跳跃游戏，讲述一只母鸡和它被偷走的金蛋。

games.name: Island Miner
games.description: Island Miner is an automation game about expanding your factories across a vast island empire. Mine and refine ore into advanced materials, connect islands into a production network, then buy new ones with profit from a shifting galactic market. No enemies, no timers, just smart logistics.

games.name: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility
games.description: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility is a block-dropping strategy roguelike that involves scoring boxes on a grid. Use different combinations of boxes and items to up your score, and gain combo to earn even more points! Purchase wacky upgrades for boxes, and navigate around your limited inventory!

games.name: Minesweeper 2007
games.description: 这就是我们曾被许诺 扫雷游戏的未来。《扫雷 2007》（Minesweeper 2007）是一款带有全新机制、充满怀旧 2000 年代 Frutiger Aero 美学的扫雷插旗益智游戏。在数十个原创谜题中插旗闯关，放松身心，假装现在依然是 2007 年……

games.name: Whitopia
games.description: 在这款轻松的短篇涂色游戏中将色彩从世界上抹去。用纯白色覆盖涂鸦、杂物和任何五颜六色的东西。赚取奖励，解锁升级，并在恢复一个只允许白色存在的世界的过程中变得更加高效。

games.name: FABLED
games.description: An indie RPG about exploring a magical world inside an old music box, making friends, and deciding the fate of the world you are called to. FABLED is dialogue rich with many choices that will determine your kindness. The game has a turn-based bullet hell battle style each with unique visuals.

games.name: Mangrove Express
games.description: Pilot a delivery boat through the lively waterways of a tropical cyber world. Master momentum, discover villages, and chart your own routes in a speedboat delivery adventure. It’s a simple job—until it isn’t :)

games.name: 长生放置录
games.description: 一款关于修仙题材的增量游戏。斩杀妖魔，收集灵气，炼制丹药，突破境界，飞升成仙。

games.name: Still Inside
games.description: 你为看房走进一栋韩国老旧商厦，却发现眼前的空间与房源信息中的楼层对不上。在这款第一人称2D点击式恐怖游戏中，调查场景中的物品，阅读遗留的记录，解开谜题，寻找出口。这栋楼，并不是空的。

games.name: Chinese Pancake Simulator
games.description: 从一处不起眼的小摊开始，采购食材、制作煎饼、服务顾客、升级设备，在日复一日的经营中将煎饼生意发展壮大。

games.name: Nozomu School Daze
games.description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

games.name: Hunters Origin
games.description: 经典 MMORPG 基石融入现代玩法！狩猎危险巨兽、掠夺传奇战利品，并通过深度技能树自定义 Build。发展 Archer’s Pond 主城、制作装备、收集稀有坐骑，与其他玩家一同刻下属于你的传奇！

games.name: SYSTEM_REBOOT
games.description: 你就是光标。成千上万的损坏进程想要删除你。这是一款子弹天堂Roguelite:每次升级都是真实的Linux命令,你的Twitch聊天室为构筑投票,6个隐藏模式将彻底改变本局游戏，直到机器本身苏醒。在虫群中活下去,粉碎系统。

games.name: Idle Pixel Battle
games.description: 在这款充满战利品与成长乐趣的奇幻放置自动战斗游戏中组建英雄队伍。探索5个生物群系，收集强力神器，解锁超过200项升级，自动进行冒险，并在Ascend模式中迎接全新挑战。

games.name: 迷家 mygohome
games.description: 迷家mygohome 是一款带有克苏鲁要素的心理恐怖游戏。故事发生在一个被未知存在悄然侵蚀的偏僻小镇——居民接连失踪，神秘现象频出。现在你被困在一间不属于你的房间里，有什么东西正在逼近，而你必须活过五个夜晚。唯一的同伴，是一只来历不明的兔子玩偶。它似乎知道很多事情，但你真的能相信它吗？

games.name: Train Goes Choo Choo
games.description: 想歇一口气吗？让这款超治愈的旅行模拟器带你步入日本的静谧乡村。在摄影中解锁隐藏成就，或是随心播放、让沿途流动的风光陪伴你。买好车票，找个舒服的位置，尽情享受这趟旅程吧。

games.name: Hop 'n' Karty
games.description: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.

games.name: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator
games.description: 你看过把一块脏到不行的地毯清洗干净的视频吗？这款游戏正是如此！把地毯从脏到不行清洗到完美洁净的解压过程。

games.name: Auto Empire Tycoon
games.description: 从20世纪50年代的一家小型工厂和单一经销店起步。研究新技术，设计汽车，管理生产，让经销店保持充足库存，并在这款等距视角经营模拟游戏中超越竞争对手，打造属于自己的汽车帝国。

games.name: Pixel Miner
games.description: 深入无尽的资源丰富洞穴，开采珍贵矿石，利用自主无人机扩展作业，并解锁越来越强大的升级，在这款简约像素风放置/增量独立游戏中挑战更深的地下世界

games.name: Paystreak
games.description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.

games.name: Office Tower Defense
games.description: 《Office TD》是一款以混乱不堪的办公室为舞台的迷宫建造塔防游戏。同事们想把你也变成和他们一样的废物？把手忙脚乱的队友和普通办公设备布置在精心设计的格子间迷宫里，打造终极防线，粉碎他们的企图。

games.name: RushGirl LUCA
games.description: RushGirl LUCA is a fast-paced 2D action shooter roguelite. With nothing but a mouse, weave between bullet heaven and bullet hell by your own hand, hold back the alien assault, upgrade a wide arsenal of weapons and parts, and push the counterattack all the way out into space!

games.name: Primal One
games.description: Primal One 是一款第一人称恐龙生存恐怖游戏，故事发生在白垩纪时期的一座设施中。躲避并逃离追捕你的恐龙，在努力活下来的同时，寻找返回现代的方法，或与其他设施中的幸存者取得联系。

games.name: Neuro Cell
games.description: A survival horror game set in a dark, foggy city. Survive against fast, aggressive enemies whose brains are controlled by a rogue computer network. Manage your low ammo, explore dangerous streets, and stop the system before it hunts you down.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: Crooky The Game
games.description: 在这款剧情驱动的像素风RPG中，探索奇异而多彩的青蛙国——这里有失落的记忆、被遗忘的地方，以及一只寻找失落已久之家的神秘青蛙。永远不要忘记你是谁。

games.name: Crystal Wars
games.description: Full strategy battle in just a few minutes.                   Outsmart your rival on a crystal map that's never the same twice. Capture all neighbouring cells, encircle territory, cut supply lines and bomb-chain explode. Customize a new map the way you like it and play!

games.name: No Visitors Allowed
games.description: 本作是一款受 《8号出口》 启发的极简心理恐怖游戏。玩家必须通过发现异常，逃离一条不断循环的后苏联时代废弃医院走廊

games.name: The Fight for Beardlandia
games.description: 自动战斗Roguelike抽卡游戏。招募队伍，把配装抠到极致，叠满职业羁绊，每一局都带着八名新兵闯得更深。看着他们倒下，再抽取强力英雄、升级技能树，率领更强的队伍，为Beardlandia而战！

games.name: Wealth of Nations: Economic Strategy
games.description: 带领一个国家走过数十年的政治与经济挑战。在这款深度大战略模拟游戏中，管理预算、税收、利率、危机和民意，每个决定都将塑造国家的未来。

games.name: Patsy's Retirement
games.description: 帕齐刚刚退休，她要在你桌面上的一座小岛上享受退休生活。在你工作的时候，看着她按自己悠闲的节奏浇花、喂鸭子、扫落叶。用简短的可选小游戏搭把手，提升她的技能，解锁 170 多种可爱的装扮。

games.name: Mancalero
games.description: Mancalero 是一款融合了Roguelike进程与卡牌构筑策略的弹珠棋盘游戏。收集特殊弹珠，解锁强力祝福，击败每个桌面，成为真正的Mancalero。

games.name: Whispering Green
games.description: 在这款魔法园艺模拟游戏中，开启你的奇幻园艺之旅。手持奥术魔法枪，探索并发现神秘的魔法植物，调配强力药剂与灵药，逐步打造属于自己的特色商店。深入充满秘密的魔幻森林，揭开隐藏在深处的种种谜团。

games.name: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
games.description: 一款轻松简单的解谜游戏。作为一个外星人，你试图研究一个令人费解的问题：为什么人类在电梯里总是避免和别人对视

games.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together
games.description: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together 是一款以真正的爱因斯坦瓷砖为题材的在线合作拼图游戏。最多 8 位玩家一同完成一幅拼图。

games.name: Pawns into the Dark
games.description:
Everything is visible but the Dark.
Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

games.name: 字趣
games.description: 在文字宇宙中，公主被封印。请带她离开这里。多音字、同音字、平翘舌、反义字、成语、诗词，是你的成长技能。开动你的脑筋，走出这文字的迷宫！去解开所有的谜题吧！

games.name: Wordy Space
games.description: Type words to blast incoming space threats, upgrade your ship and powers, master different dictionary packs, and climb global or language-specific Steam leaderboards.

games.name: Sword and Sweep
games.description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

games.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
games.description: An idle breaker where you can't miss and you can't lose. Ride an elevator into the dark, buy upgrades, click to crit, and let bouncing orbs clear every floor on autopilot.

games.name: 掌中帝国
games.description: 像素风的手机厂商经营模拟。你从一间车库起步，设计手机、定价、排产、发布，同时管钱、管人、管工厂。市场会从功能机走到智能机，再走到 AI 手机，你能选的是怎么应对。

games.name: Brothers
games.description: Brothers is a medieval co-op action roguelite where two knights set out from their castle, take on dangerous quests, battle through hostile forests, and grow stronger together with every run. Fight, survive, upgrade, and protect your kingdom side by side.

games.name: Columbine
games.description: "One ending leads to the next wish." A story-driven top-down 2D action game with four branching endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: Wuxing Zodiac
games.description: Wuxing Zodiac is a roguelite deckbuilding game where cards inspired by the Five Elements and Zodiac Signs create endless strategic possibilities. Build powerful combos, score big, and overcome the mysterious Cursed Chips.

games.name: Gore Grind
games.description: 一款第一人称 Roguelite 尸潮射击游戏，支持 1 至 4 人同屏合作。城市变异了，网断了，死一次还得花钱。突突掉尸潮，把现金存进银行，继续给城里唯一还开着的披萨店打工。

games.name: KRUSHPIT
games.description: KRUSHPIT是一款以混凝土建筑和生锈车库为背景的实时非直接PvP肉鸽生存游戏。消灭变异怪，进化技能，玩转老虎机，打造OP流派！在混乱中生存，或冲进PvP天梯，碾压所有人并登顶排行榜！

games.name: 黄金矿工:派对狂欢
games.description: 《黄金矿工：派对狂欢》是一款 2–6 人在线多人派对游戏，将经典黄金矿工的抓钩玩法带入正面对决的全新舞台。支持和好友组队及在线匹配。多轮抢矿，快速对战与排位天梯双模式随时开启。

games.name: 1930: Tinta & Balas
games.description: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

games.name: Brassfang
games.description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

games.name: 数织侦探
games.description: 化身解谜侦探！完成数织谜题，找出线索、顺藤摸瓜，帮助遇到各种离奇麻烦的委托人破解一个个趣味案件。

games.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
games.description: 一款物理驱动的2D增量式太空采矿模拟游戏。帮助一家人引导宇宙尘埃、自动化生产、解锁研究，并将一座继承而来的空间站发展成庞大事业。享受一段轻松、绚丽多彩的旅程，治愈佐维卡。

games.name: Babo & Luda adventure
games.description: Babo And Luda Adventure is a chaotic 3D action platformer! Take control of this wild duo and embark on a crazy journey to defeat evil enemies. Master insane combat combos, explore wild environments, and gear up for action packed run and gun stages!

games.name: Echoes In Static
games.description: This is an animatronic horror experience where machines are superior and humans are inferior.

games.name: Plunder Bay
games.description: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

games.name: WW3: Cyber Warfare
games.description: Battle for global supremacy in this fast-paced 2D fighter where world leaders clash across iconic locations worldwide. Master unique special moves, compete online, and watch fighters evolve monthly as real-world power rankings shift the balance of combat.

games.name: Soup's Tail
games.description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

games.name: 叠梦小筑
games.description:
叠梦小筑是一款拥有真实物理模拟的积木搭建游戏。

你可以自由取用可调参数的基础积木，或是收集积木小人放出的天灯，每一盏里都藏着充满惊喜的特殊积木。搭建、收集、放空、分享，没有时限，没有失败，找回那份久违的童真积木乐趣。

叠一座小筑，让梦在这里安静的落地。

games.name: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
games.description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

games.name: 漂流工厂
games.description:
在无尽海洋之上，从一块小小的漂浮平台开始，建立属于你的自动化工业帝国。

收集资源、研究科技、扩建平台、搭建传送带网络，在危机四伏的海上世界中生存并发展。利用自动化生产线解放双手，让工厂持续运转，最终造出星舰前往火星.

games.name: Grid Demon
games.description: 入侵敌机，组建自己的机械军团。Grid Demon 是一款赛博朋克风格的割草肉鸽游戏，支持鼠标或手柄手动瞄准射击，也可选择自动瞄准与开火。夺取不同敌机的能力，选择净化或吸收，释放恶魔模式，击败五大区域的守卫。解放 Grid，还是将它据为己有？

games.name: Chronoform
games.description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

games.name: 艾瑟兰蒂斯 命运之境
games.description: 《艾瑟兰蒂斯 命运之境》是一款融合资源收集、版图拓建与命运卡牌的回合制策略棋盘游戏。在星辉与迷雾交织的浮空大陆上，掷骰拓荒、建造聚落与圣城，以命运卡改写战局——支持最多 4 人同屏的策略卡牌桌游体验。

games.name: Ephemera
games.description: Witness the rise and fall of the Mai Kingdom through the lives of heroes Ilhan and Rashel, as turn-based tactics meets Mughal era fantasy. Plan your battles, manage your relationships, and make choices with devastating consequences as you search for the truth about the ancient city of the Ephemera.

games.name: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
games.description: 一款温馨治愈的 HD-2D Luminon 养成 RPG。你种下什么，就会影响 Luminon 如何成长。种植、繁育并驯服新的伙伴，再将它们培养成适合 3v3 策略竞技或魅力大赛的独特 Luminon。

games.name: DANCING ZOMBIE
games.description:
A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter,
only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans.
Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

games.name: Blood Covenant
games.description: 一款1～4人合作恐怖职业模拟游戏。你们这支身穿防护服的清洁队在一位知道得比说出口更多的调度员手下上夜班，去别人都不愿去的地方清理血迹。每个地点都有什么东西搬了进来，在向祭坛献祭之前，你们必须弄清它到底是什么。

games.name: WBS26 Wrestling Booker Simulator
games.description: Run a wrestling promotion in a booking simulator. Build shows, sign talent, grow rivalries and decide who holds the titles. Your choices shape careers, locker-room morale and the future of your company.

games.name: 樱之诗 −于樱之森上飞舞−
games.description: 由SCA-自打造、荣获多项大奖的视觉小说名作终于推出海外版，并以Full HD全高清画质呈现！《樱之诗》描述的是停滞不前的人，与毅然前行的人们的故事。

games.name: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
games.description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

games.name: Ink & Lore
games.description:
卡牌打出即消失的 99 层地牢 Roguelike。

带领两位文具守护者，走进一本作者画到一半便停笔的绘本。手中的牌有限，该在何时打出？

而在世界尽头等待着的，是那位——

games.name: Deal Flipper
games.description: 低价买入，高价卖出。唤醒你心中流淌的“温州商人”魂！《Deal Flipper》是一款第一人称倒卖模拟游戏。你将在二手市场里疯狂淘货，在实时聊天中掏出“屠龙刀”狠辣砍价，靠转手赚取暴利。这里的NPC卖家个个都有心机，读懂他们的心理，低价抄底，高价宰客……前提是，你真能卖得出去！

games.name: That's Not My Bowl
games.description: 亲手烹制自制猫粮，端给地球上最挑剔的顾客。走遍世界各地的城市喂猫，一碗一碗地摸清每个猫种的口味。一款温馨治愈的烹饪收集游戏。

games.name: Prowlers Shift
games.description: A 2.5D surveillance sim in a private museum. Work the night shift: listen at doors, observe the people around you, take on their jobs, and decide moment to moment who to trust and who to expose. Your employer tells you what to ignore. Something is being moved that was never meant to be seen.

games.name: Case Analyst
games.description: A retro-terminal detective game. Crack cases, analyze evidence, unmask a conspiracy. Step into the chair of an FDI forensic data analyst. Case Analyst is an investigative OS-sim where you crack cases from a retro CRT terminal -- issuing commands, analyzing evidence.

games.name: Barns & Beams
games.description: 你是一个再也负担不起城里房租的年轻人，但幸运的是，你爷爷在荒郊野外给你留下一座破烂农场作为遗产。你必须学会打理农场生活，并在此过程中与“他们”周旋。

games.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
games.description: 一款与塔防玩法融合的单人MMORPG。招募英雄，建造古怪却极具毁灭性的高塔，与他们并肩作战，在实时3D战斗中抵御一波波敌人。

games.name: Bowerland
games.description: The single player Euchre roguelite. Call trump, win tricks, deal damage and decimate your foes as you take on the Bower King's evil henchmen in this 1v1 card battler.

games.name: Night Frontier
games.description: Night Frontier is a survival-management game about building a camp, preparing squads, and sending them into a dangerous and cursed wasteland. Gather resources, craft equipment, manage injuries and disease, and decide how much risk your people can survive.

games.name: Witch Hunt 0
games.description:
《Witch Hunt 0》是一款以魔法为核心的“箱庭×首领连战（Boss Rush）”3D动作游戏。
主角魔女“阿斯特拉（Astera）”为了夺回失去的力量，将通过编织魔法、收服敌人为眷属（同伴），去击败前方伫立的强敌。

games.name: Black Market Dealer
games.description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

games.name: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle
games.description: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle is a VR jigsaw where you piece together animated puzzles

games.name: Toy Box
games.description: Collect toys, avoid mischievous enemies, and escape colorful mazes in this fast-paced retro-style arcade game inspired by classic maze games!

games.name: 异界碎片｜Otherworld Shards
games.description: 《异界碎片》是一款融合即时动作战斗、浮空岛宗门经营的国风修仙生存 RPG。世界崩碎沦为虚空浮岛，你依靠碎片之心锚定濒临覆灭的家园，侦测虚空异岛、虚空跃迁远征、鏖战岛主吞并领地。修习五行与变异元素法术自由配招，收纳三十种纳音命格弟子、自建仙家建筑，闯关四大秘境，在浮岛持续崩坏的生存压力下搜集世界碎片，探寻天地破碎真相、构筑仙门并完成重塑仙界的终极使命。

games.name: Ritual Break
games.description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes combine their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and face colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

games.name: HR.SOS
games.description: 公司快倒闭了，而你既是负责救火的HR，也是负责赚钱的CEO。优化员工、重组流程、完成KPI，再把整理好的部门丢进自动化产业链，享受数字不断膨胀的快乐。

games.name: Toxic Dating Simulator
games.description: Atakan'ın Binder'da eşleştiği, yaşam tarzları birbirinden farklı olan 5 kadınla randevulardan sağ çıkmaya çalış. Yapacağın seçimlerle Atakan'ın karakterini şekillendir. Kılıbık ol, alfa ol, yalancı ol, dürüst ol, manipülatif ol. Seçimini yap ve sonucuna katlan.

games.name: 见习商人米迦勒
games.description:
Item 1 of 8
Item 2 of 8
为了筹措青梅竹马的医疗费，立志成为大商人的米迦勒努力地筹钱以建立自己的店铺。 但在追求财富的路上，有着各种觊觎她肉体的男人……重重困难中，她能否顺利筹到10万Ｇ呢？

games.name: Tropical Romance
games.description: At an elite academy for fruit-family heirs, Geum Gyuri, a kumquat farmer’s daughter, is drawn to a pair of polar-opposite twins—only to uncover the “rotten” truth beneath the school’s “fresh” facade.

games.name: Aftergarden
games.description: 在2D动作射击RPG中穿越弹幕，逐步破坏少女们的服装。收集武器、断章与伙伴机，通过成长和编队构筑压倒性火力；不只依靠反应，也能以强化装备与数量优势击退敌人。还可使用编辑器从图片制作原创关卡，并发布给全世界的玩家。

games.name: PAGANS
games.description: PAGANS is a dark-fantasy strategy card game inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses, and warriors, then fight short tactical PvE battles by controlling mystical locations and chaining powerful card synergies.

games.name: 圆圆滚滚大农场
games.description: 嘿，农场主，欢迎回到你的《圆圆滚滚大农场》！在这个轻松解压的Roguelike卡组构建游戏中，自由摆放圆滚滚的棋子，组合特殊道具与动物伙伴，触发爽度爆表、脑洞大开的连锁反应！从休闲摸鱼到策略挑战，准备好被可爱淹没，踏上这场停不下来的农场派对吧！

games.name: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price
games.description: 你是否想在娱乐之余学到专业的金融知识？你是否想体验创立公司，分析财报，参与决策，并掌控着它的走势，让股价节节攀升？本作依托真实 S&P 500 指数、VIX 和债券等金融数据，在每轮的决策中，你做的每一个决定，最终都会画成那条只属于你的股价曲线。

games.name: 凯旋仙子 : 女子赛马学校
games.description:
Gamemiracle凭借25年的开发经验，『競馬女神: 凯旋仙子』将逼真的赛马物理回馈与深度剧情模拟完美结合。
