『競馬女神: 凯旋仙子』是一款以女子骑术学校为舞台的剧情向赛马游戏。在这里，比赛不只是速度的较量，更是名誉、金钱、权力与人心互相碰撞的战场。与性格各异的少女骑手竞争、结盟、对抗，并揭开这所华丽学校背后真正的规则。

games.name: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
games.description: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

games.name: Holoplanet Architect
games.description: Try your hand as holoplanet architect! Place tetris-like pieces on the 3D grid of a planet hologram in a relaxed, lo-fi atmosphere to unlock new biomes and increase your highscore.

games.name: Tiny Conquests
games.description: Build tiny empires with big ambitions. A cozy, bite-sized 4X where every turn counts: grow cities block by block, research three historical ages, and outscore rivals through building, conquest, or exploration. One currency, one score, 25-minute matches.

games.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
games.description: Jump endlessly upward and ride your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Choose from 4 weapons, combine powerful augmentations to craft your build, and survive monsters and hazards as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are the same.

games.name: 摔倒致富
games.description: 点击、撞倒、赚钱！撞翻四处游荡的小人，雇佣动物制造混乱，收集成堆金币，打造属于你的疯狂帝国。解锁强大的重生升级，击败 Boss，把平静的棋盘变成一片欢乐又混乱的摔倒乐园。

games.name: Leon&Suharto
games.description: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

games.name: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
games.description: 在第一人称模拟游戏中打造并经营属于你的宠物店。出售宠物、摆放货架、装饰店铺、满足顾客需求、发展你的生意，打造终极宠物店。

games.name: Strato Alto
games.description:
Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. 
Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory!
Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

games.name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
games.description: 刮开奖券，发现隐藏奖励，并在这款轻松休闲的游戏中提升你的能力。探索独特主题，收集宝藏，一次一次刮奖，积累属于你的好运。

games.name: Desert Survival
games.description: 在一片想要你性命的沙漠里坚持 15 分钟。迎战阿拉伯民间传说中的怪物浪潮，锻造元素流派与武器进化，接下每日契约，并在两局之间不断变强。免费游玩，每一局都有不同的故事。

games.name: Meltdown Crew
games.description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

games.name: Merc Commander
games.description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

games.name: Tabernacle
games.description:
Tabernacle is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. Once holy places have been forsaken and corrupted by sin. Do your duties as inquisitors of the church; collect evidence of evil, reclaim sacred sites, and banish the unholy that seek to extinguish faith.
Stand between the innocent and the damned.

games.name: Mining Guild Idle
games.description: Mining Guild Idle is an inventory / resource management based incremental style game featuring 15 to 20 hours of gameplay

games.name: Forteria
games.description: 单人游玩或与最多4名玩家合作，探索原野并收集资源，为夜晚来袭的敌人做好准备。以自己的方式打造更好的工具、强化能力，并守护你的据点。

games.name: 比修斯之环
games.description: 这是一款结合生化科幻风格的2D动作与工厂建造游戏。玩家将透过极具张力的高速对刀与极限跳跃击溃异星怪物，并残酷地夺取牠们的血肉与机械碎片。利用这些战利品，你必须从零开始建造并连结一座高度自动化的暗黑能源工厂。透过无情地榨取生物能源并扩张电力系统，你将解锁并深入未知的凶险地域，体验极限战斗掠夺与战略性自动化生产的双重快感。

games.name: 串出弹珠
games.description: 在肉鸽泡泡龙中打造属于你的终极构筑。收集弹珠、串联念珠、改造核心与涂层，通过无数联动组合创造爆炸性的连锁与得分。

games.name: Grass Cutter 9000: Director's Cut
games.description:
Grass to cut, guys to meet and things to eat.
Get upgrades, increase your currency and explore different locations in this short incremental Video Game.

games.name: Kamiyo
games.description: A dystopian visual novel about Gods, humans and the 'Godkillers'. Pray to your God, and death to the Godkillers.

games.name: Lost in the Fest
games.description: The rhythm RPG where swords are guitars and potions are beers.

games.name: 大脑炸弹
games.description: 概念即炸弹，联想即死亡。这是一款极具邪典色彩的反乌托邦心理恐怖解谜游戏。载体（感染者）脑内被植入了概念炸弹，只要联想到特定的【引信词】，头部便会瞬间炸开。你将作为当局的“认知排爆员”，拆除致命的“大脑炸弹”。

games.name: Lightspire: Cards
games.description: Lightspire Cards is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets board control. Summon units, fuse cards, exploit terrain, complete quests, and battle through Luna’s story-driven campaign of saints, schemers, monsters, exiles, and broken vows.

games.name: The Death... And After?
games.description: You are in a coma. Reality is shattered, and the laws of logic no longer apply. "The Death... And After?" is a psychological horror game where you must navigate eerie hospital labyrinths and dark caverns of a fading mind. Is it a dream, or is it death? And what awaits us after?

games.name: Fairwell
games.description: You've inherited your father's old golf club, long since neglected. Armed with a worn-out mower, a little cash, and a grounds crew who came with the place, you set out to bring it back. Can you restore Fairwell to what it once was?

games.name: Neostalker
games.description: NEOSTALKER 是一款紧张的第一人称回合制解谜游戏，将爪钩移动、致命机械与战术规划结合在一系列危险的空间挑战中，带你深入一座已成为周围一切威胁的工厂核心。

games.name: Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Emperor
games.description: Your generals grow old. Your cities grow restless. Your empire need not end. Lead one of 14 factions in a living fantasy world of grand strategy, where populations migrate, crime festers, and every grain shipment matters. Build, conquer, and rule, without end.

games.name: My Useless Hot MILF in the Party
games.description: 在地下城向世人开放之前，你被迫参与一场危险的远征。深入其深处，体验经典第一人称地下城探索玩法。培养你的成熟女性同伴，解开谜题，击败怪物，揭开隐藏的秘密，并发现最终楼层所埋藏的真相。

games.name: Slope Riders - A Motorbike Escapade
games.description: Live the story of a fallen champion’s comeback in this off-road motorbike game. Balance and hold traction while carving across forest, snow, deserts, and rocky canyons. Beat record times, race ghosts, and explore open areas.

games.name: Desktop Factory
games.description: Drill deep while you work or game in a zero-stress factory builder for the side of your screen or second monitor. Power your drill, unlock alternate building shapes, and master compact layouts as you harvest the galaxy. The. Factory. Must. Grow.

games.name: Plunderfall
games.description: Start betrayed on a raft in this open-seas pirate twin-stick roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock new vessels and weapons, rescue your crew to grow your fleet, defeat traitor captains, loot their relics to unlock new waters, and rebuild your legacy.

games.name: Honey, I'm an Agent
games.description: 2D战术潜行、动作与黑色喜剧。一个人畜无害的普通人阴差阳错成了秘密特工。深夜瞒着妻子溜出家门，利用抓钩在街头荡跃，把雨伞当成降落伞滑翔，并展开一场场令人捧腹的欢快战斗！

games.name: Quarterheart
games.description: 一款治愈系的街机肉鸽游戏。你在阁楼里翻出一台老式投币街机，它居然还能玩。在2–4分钟的对局里瞄准、卡准时机出手。每打败一种新怪物都会打印一张贴纸——贴在机身的哪里，决定它升级或解锁什么。投币开玩？

games.name: K-Duel: The Anti-Cheater
games.description: Face ruthless cheaters who break every rule. To survive this brutal tactical card battler, you must out-think the hackers. Position units down strategic rows and use instant fusion to evolve cards into colossal boss monsters. Fight hard, fuse power, and destroy the rigged system.

games.name: Text Factory: Automation
games.description:
《文字工厂：自动化》是一款文字版工厂模拟游戏。
在游戏中，你可以建立自己的生产线，规划不同地图之间的物流运输，升级科技，制作武器和装备，击败敌人获取更多资源，并不断扩建你的工厂。

games.name: Incremensaw
games.description: Incremensaw is a relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Collect fragments, sell them, buy upgrades, and become even stronger.

games.name: Business Rivals
games.description: 在这场残酷的多人商业战争中与竞争对手展开较量。建立你的商业帝国，雇佣员工，投资合法与非法业务，破坏竞争对手的计划，躲避监管审查，并成为全城最富有的企业家。

games.name: Fall, Fall, Fall for you
games.description: 《Fall, Fall, Fall for you》 是一款高难度的球体物理平台游戏。为了向黛西证明你的爱意，你必须一次又一次地坠落。每当你摔下去，黛西都会笑着骂你一句：“笨蛋！” 可、可是……也许她并不是真心这么想？谁知道呢。

games.name: Incremaze
games.description: 一个弹窗之后，机器里有什么东西挣脱了。将 INCREMAZE 杀毒程序部署到受损的硬盘中，让它去干活。Incremaze 是一款放置游戏，讲述自动化、层层升级，以及一种你可能会后悔的解药。

games.name: Dance With Time
games.description: SUPER-WEIRD time manipulation puzzle game. Change the map with your movements, see mind-boggling effects, and reach the exit. Even if you fail, try again. AFTER ALL, TIME IS ALL YOU HAVE.

games.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
games.description:
这款游戏没有教程。

以后也不会有教程。

我相信你能做到。

我没能从 Grid 中逃出去。也许你可以完成这次逃脱。

你是一条会吃苹果、继续向前的蛇。

j/k

你想逃离这个 Grid 循环。

但是，这个循环想把你留在里面，不让你离开。

games.name: Shanking Simulator
games.description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked multiplayer combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

games.name: 爱丽丝桌面冒险
games.description: 《爱丽丝桌面冒险》是一款单机挂机 RPG，支持联机与自由换装。爱丽丝会在桌面一角自动战斗、收集战利品；挂机有机会掉落时装，时装可以在市场上与其他玩家相互交易。

games.name: 合成深渊
games.description: 《Abyss Forge》是一款太空科幻主题的匹配合成 Roguelike 游戏。移动棋子、完成三消与合成，积累燃料、效率、科研等资源，并通过随机强化打造不同构筑路线，在有限步数内让飞船不断深入未知星域。

games.name: KYC: K Stands for Killing
games.description: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

games.name: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die
games.description: Create thousands of night creatures and ensure the Hero does not survive until dawn. Play as death in a reverse survivor-like where both sides level up as you raise armies of monsters, unlock dark powers and stop a lone Hero from becoming a legend.

games.name: Tunnelborn
games.description: Dig for fossils under a volcano, one tile at a time. Nothing moves until you do — but then the lava creeps closer, your lamp burns lower, and something in the dark takes another step towards you…

games.name: Chop Loop
games.description: 一款3D增量式伐木游戏，每棵树都会改变你的玩法。解锁独特的树木机制，用符文控制哪些树木出现，并升级海狸来实现伐木自动化

games.name: Kinghold
games.description: You are the king and the spawn point in this frantic real-time tower defense roguelite. Play cards to summon autonomous troops, construct buildings, and set traps as you scramble to defend your castle against escalating enemy hordes.

games.name: Kick The Wallet
games.description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins.  It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

games.name: VLCNP Story
games.description: Beneath their goofy long-faced looks lies a surprisingly serious action-adventure. Awaken as Akim and Very Long Leelee after 10,000 years of slumber, recover your lost memories, rouse your fallen comrades, and rise to defeat a great evil!

games.name: 颅骨战争：测试场
games.description: 《颅骨战争：测试场》是一款冷调科幻策略战棋游戏。玩家操控名为“颅骨”的人形战争机械，在六边形网格上进行回合制远程射击对抗。每次可执行2种行动（移动、攻击、机能），且敌方数据完全透明。胜负取决于资源规划与协作联动。

games.name: 开拓物语
games.description: 《开拓物语》是一款融合了战术撤离与领地建设的冒险种田游戏。锻造独特武器，去探索世界，寻找稀有宝物，在这个治愈赛璐璐动画风格打造的奇幻世界里，与个性十足的伙伴们一同开拓继承自先祖的遗落领地。收集资源，建造村庄，链接羁绊，勤劳致富，亲手创造超酷的顶级家园！

games.name: Dank Wizard Saga
games.description: Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, solve puzzles, battle dungeon bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades in this retro-inspired action-adventure with stoner comedy.

games.name: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
games.description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

games.name: Did You See That?
games.description: 一款双人合作游戏，两位玩家看到的现实并不总是相同的。探索一个瞬息万变的嘉年华，发现异常之处，与朋友确认是否看到相同的事物，并在小丑鲍比失去耐心之前做出正确的决定……

games.name: Horny Nights
games.description: Meet Dawn, a girl with basic needs. But what happens if those needs aren't met by the one she loves?

games.name: 珍宝猎人模拟器
games.description: 搜寻世界中具有潜力的珍品，砍价，修复甚至造假以不择手段地赚取利润。升级技能，扩张店面，雇佣员工并在政府与叛军激烈对峙的背景下夹缝求生。

games.name: Order of the Holy Crucible
games.description: In this roguelike adventure, you will take up the roles of warrior nuns to fight invading armies, strange creatures and the forces of pure evil.

games.name: Hedge Knight
games.description: Train your skills, test your might in the Fey Forest, make friends, and fall in love in this lighthearted, sex positive 18+ ero-RPG.

games.name: 桃色陷阱
games.description: 玩家将扮演一位创业者，他因故丧生、死因成谜，却在死亡现场见到了；为事业放弃的异地前女友；无条件帮助自己的神秘美女室友；始终打压贬低自己的势利名媛。她们为何会出现在事发现场？自己又因何而死？也许是执念太深、又或是一场梦境，他竟重生到两年前……随着他的选择，有些谜底将会揭开，而有些谜底却石沉大海。

games.name: CURSOR SLASH
games.description: 一款由鼠标光标自动攻击的像素风增量游戏！消灭史莱姆，赚取金币并收集铜、铁、金等矿石。获取各式技能、武器、遗物和硬币，横扫成群结队的史莱姆！

games.name: I Want to Play the Villain!
games.description: I Want to Play the Villain! 是一款以戏剧为主题的逻辑解谜游戏。为演员分配合适的角色，重新安排阵容，改写故事。每位演员都有自己的抱负、恐惧与愿望。运用你的逻辑，让所有人都心满意足！

games.name: EvoluCell
games.description: 你是一颗不断进化的免疫细胞。射击压制敌人、吞噬虚弱目标换取基因，在负担与炎症风暴之间取舍；用基因碎片填满四轨基因库，从数值强化蜕变为全新形态，最终凝聚终极进化体。俯视生物恐怖风肉鸽，每一局都在回答：你这颗细胞，正在变成什么？

games.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
games.description: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

games.name: 灰冠王座 王国篇
games.description: 全程粤语配音！一个香港普通人死后被阴间电视台 HELL TV 选中，醒来竟成了被控毒害王储、即将处死的私生王子。用读心术、真心值、鉴定术与透视眼把每一句对白读穿，拆穿谎言、拉拢同伴，改写王国的结局。免费试玩 Demo（完整第一章）10 月 7 日推出！

games.name: Whisper of The Witch
games.description: A first-person survival-horror game where you are hunted by a ruthless, deranged witch. Unravel the secrets of a sealed European manor, overcome ancient puzzles using the dark arts, and face the sins of the past.

games.name: 误入了
games.description:
误入了■■■■■■■……
一部复古风格的恐怖视觉小说。你的选择将决定前方等待着你的恐怖。

games.name: Deadline Works
games.description: 从零开始建立一家定制机械公司。赢得合同，雇用工程师，通过验收测试——然后卖掉公司。你的旧公司将成为你最强劲的竞争对手。

games.name: Flipside
games.description: Eat, run, jump, push boxes and switch the rules in this scrumptiously adorable puzzle platformer!

games.name: Kern
games.description: It's a tower defence game with a skill tree. Play as the pilot that crash the spaceship in the unknown white space. Defend the spaceship from a horde of enemies through multiple stages while fixing the ship to escape from this place.

games.name: You Must Die
games.description: You Must Die is a dice-building roguelike. Defeat enemies, take their faces, and graft them to your dice to shift the odds in your favor. Prepare for your expeditions by visiting the merchant, and unlock new purchase options for every collected bounty.

games.name: Rogoz Fishing
games.description: A meditative fishing sim on a quiet river. Find your spot on the depth map, set several rods with different baits, read the bites by the ring of the bells and land your trophies — in the warm stillness of dawn or under a bright moon.

games.name: Ludus Saltuum
games.description: 《Ludus Saltuum》是一款第三人称平台游戏。探索无尽的程序生成关卡！强化你的角色，解锁能在旅途中助你一臂之力的技能！你能走多远？🇧🇷

games.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
games.description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

games.name: Trolley Dilemma
games.description: 直面无解的两难抉择，结识形形色色的怪诞角色，见证每一次道岔切换如何改写故事。电车不断前行，而你的选择将决定你信任谁、背叛谁，以及最终是否会变成自己从未想成为的那种人。

games.name: Royale Smith
games.description: 作为一名初学者铁匠开张营业，将你的声望一路提升至王室级别。刺客、弓箭手、骑士和村民都会光顾你的店铺，向你订购普通、稀有或传说品质的剑、斧、匕首、弓、箭以及各种商品。

games.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
games.description: 固定位置、仅用瞄准镜的狩猎。一个位置，一次呼吸，一发子弹。解读荒野，屏住呼吸，在三种生态群落的 40 场试炼中打出完美一枪。解锁 8 把步枪，升级你的猎人，精通每一颗星。

games.name: 诊余漫录
games.description: 《诊余漫录》是一款受传统中医文化启发的温馨像素风生活模拟游戏。来到一座随四季与二十四节气流转的山中村落，种植、采集并晾晒药草，通过望、闻、问、切寻找症状线索，辨识证候，选择合适的药材调配方剂，照料前来求助的村民。经营药草园、规划果园、制作生活物品，与性格各异的邻居建立友谊，一起庆祝岁时节日。你的选择会影响村庄如何发展；在没有战斗压力的日常里，与这片土地和生活在这里的人们彼此陪伴、共同成长。

games.name: Project: Summer Ice Bowling Online
games.description: A Christian-themed, story driven, anime-styled bowling video game in the Project: Summer Ice franchise!

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.description: 《What the Buck?!》是一款以销毁金钱为主题的解压增量游戏。用碎钞机粉碎成捆钞票，在整张桌面上引发连锁反应，通过声望重置获得永久升级，把你的销毁金钱大业自动化。试玩版进度可继承到正式版。

games.name: My Own Hero Party
games.description: 一款组建队伍的休闲增量游戏，每次远征都是与耐力赛跑。招募伙伴，清理房间制地下城，收集金币，并在被勇者队伍踢出后成长你的自定义升级树。

games.name: Final Commit
games.description: `Final Commit`是一款俯视角 Roguelite 生存动作游戏，你可以在两名角色之间切换作战。组合特性、进行职业转换并释放同步驱动，完成你的构筑，抵达未完成游戏世界的结局。

games.name: 赛博西游
games.description: 《赛博西游》是一款爽快刺激的类肉鸽动作游戏！在这里，仙术即是黑科技，法宝乃是赛博造物。您将进入一个由数据、钢铁与香火构成的扭曲西游世界，构筑独一无二的战斗流派，直面持枪诵经的机械佛陀。

games.name: Chromafall
games.description: Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you drag and drop obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Place your pieces, launch the ball, and watch light cascade across the play field. Endless procedurally generated levels ensure the challenge never stops.

games.name: 天衍劫：乾坤至宝
games.description: 《天衍劫：乾坤至宝》是一款水墨写意风格的武侠动作 Roguelike。选择门派踏入天衍劫局，在随机房间中斩敌夺赏，以秘籍与江湖至宝叠构筑，打出近身连招与一打多的爽快战斗。每局路线与成长皆不同——在雾与墨之间变强破局，闯过天衍之劫。

games.name: 第九次轮回
games.description: 这是一款极度流畅的3D肉鸽游戏。 如果你想体验畅快的肉鸽玩法，那这款游戏非常值得一试。

games.name: TailLifters Club: Night Shift
games.description:
Congratulations, you just got the job for Night Guard at a Femboy Stripclub, now try not to get fucked! Play through 5 nights with increasing difficulty and meet all the femboys! They're very eager to get to know you better~
Will you be able to reach the final night and remain in your job?

games.name: Zero Boundary Line
games.description: 这是一款科幻风格主题的独立塔防游戏，你可以在不同的地图中面对各式各样的敌人，并使用不同风格的单位来构筑属于你的防线。在游戏中，你将扮演未来的一位指挥官，对抗变异体，守护人类文明，在不同的地图中阻击各具特色的变异体们，你将随着游戏关卡的推进不断解锁拥有新特性的新的单位，还可以在游戏内的商店里购买一些有趣的特殊单位。

games.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
games.description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

games.name: Ecstatica
games.description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

games.name: Ecstatica II
games.description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

games.name: 五子破局
games.description: 五子破局 是一款「成五即消除」的五子棋策略肉鸽游戏。不再是先手为王、防守至上的传统五子棋：形成五连，棋子离场；新子落地，增生消除，移动转化，盘面不断重构。收集异能棋子与棋谱，在机缘与棋摊里构筑你的棋库。你每回合两手、敌手一手，与手段各异的敌手对局。五子棋从未如此不可预测。

games.name: SoundRoom
games.description: 猜猜这是哪种乐器。

games.name: 重构人生 Project Refactor
games.description: 选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？这不是逆天改命的爽文，这是一份长达十年的‘做题家’真实账单。带着全家的期望来到大城市，在底气与自尊的拉扯中规划每周时间。直面同辈碾压、现实重压与灰色的阶层锁，在残酷的抉择中，经历一段关于认清现实与自我和解的人生。

games.name: 暮光之潮：幻蓝秩元恋
games.description: 相遇此刻，旅程已启程。你已踏上一场由塔罗牌驱动的冒险。将触碰爱、失去、成长与遗憾。破碎末世地球与尘封二战南洋时空，两个世界彼此交叠。揭示你早已被悄然掠夺的命运。夺回命运漫长，又短如浮生一瞬。女主与六位命运相连的男主，穿梭于双世界时空裂隙。 这段旅程，如人生：没有标准答案，每次抉择，都将镌刻你的命运。

games.name: 时空列车
games.description: 《时空列车》是一款俯视角搜打撤生存射击游戏。驾驶穿梭时空的列车进入文明遗迹与废墟战场，搜刮资源、击破建筑、应对随机事件，并在合适时机撤离，组合枪械词条与魔石附魔，打造属于你的爽刷 BD。

games.name: 香蕉航空
games.description: 喂饱你的乘客，不然他们会互相吃掉。经营一家载满食人鸡、放射性乘客和尖叫婴儿的航空公司，婴儿还能直接扔下飞机。飞行、服务、维修，然后努力降落。单人或最多5位好友同乐。

games.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
games.description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

games.name: Backrooms: Splatter
games.description: You're the night-shift paint crew in an office that never ends. Spray paint to reveal invisible floors, fake doors and hidden signs. But spraying is loud, and four things in the dark are listening. PSX horror for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. PIGMENT CO. is not liable.

games.name: 零余者的春天 Good for nothing ~ Every dog has his day
games.description: 一部融合了心理探索、家庭创伤与存在哲思的视觉小说。正如歌德所言，哈姆雷特是“因思想过度发达而麻痹了活动力”的典型人格。而我，在坎通这座城市的春天里，是否也应当如诗人般感叹鸟儿飞来，又飞走了？

games.name: Taillights
games.description: Join your friends on a physics-based co-op survival road trip! Build, repair, and barely hold together your car as you race into the unknown. Survive the wilderness, uncover strange mysteries, and compete with other teams on a brand-new daily map packed with secrets and shenanigans.

games.name: Teen Hustler
games.description: 从狭窄的房间起步，一路打造你的数字帝国，直至入驻高科技顶层公寓。在这款极具深度的3D经济沙盒模拟游戏中，编写代码、黑客入侵、挖掘加密货币并操纵暗网。始终隐藏在暗处，管理你的硬件设备，千万别被警察抓住！

games.name: Table Of Truth
games.description: 你的朋友到底怎么看你？在这款混乱欢乐的合作派对游戏中，为爆笑的正面和负面评价投票。跟随多数人的选择来获得分数，并迎接终极友情测试。你会成为团队里的智囊，还是那个行走的灾难？

games.name: Brick Busters
games.description: An old-school arcade action game where you defend your base, survive waves of enemies, upgrade your tank, and fight bosses every 4th wave. Features roguelike progression, local 2-player co-op, varied maps, and 20+ abilities.

games.name: 枪火与魔法 - 可联机的桌面搜打撤！
games.description:
这是一款可以和朋友「 联机挂机」的「极简桌面搜打撤」！

在被奇异力量毁灭的都市中，聚集了众多对顶尖科学与魔法技术虎视眈眈的势力，而你也同样闯入这片机遇之地，战斗，搜索，撤离，逐步变强、建立自己的营地，并踏上寻找身世的旅途！

games.name: Aisle of Shadows
games.description: Do not forget. It remembers more than it should. What begins as a simple task slowly unravels into something deeply unsettling. Explore the mall's deepest secrets, uncover fragments of forgotten stories, and question reality itself.

games.name: Portentum
games.description: 神秘生物卡组构筑自走棋。用大脚怪、吉莫西、尼斯湖水怪、卓柏卡布拉等神秘生物，寻找超模连招。只要有谁的叔叔 1973 年在林子里见过它，它多半就是《Portentum》里的一张卡。

games.name: 幻鱼公司
games.description: 《幻鱼公司》 是一款第一人称增量游戏，你将供职于全球最大的渔业公司。催眠鱼类、出售渔获、购买升级，并揭开这家诡异企业背后的谜团！

games.name: Palefrost
games.description: The world has ended, but the storm remains. Experience survival-horror within the ruins of a fractured city. Stay warm. Fight the dead. Find the Fountain. Will you be buried beneath the eternal blizzard? Or will you cheat death itself? Every bullet, every match, and every decision counts.

games.name: 熊猫vs喵
games.description: 操控圆滚滚的熊猫对抗猫群，在这款俯视角 Roguelite 生存游戏中混搭武器与圣物，主动释放技能。在波次之间购买同流派特质，凑齐羁绊，解锁改变战斗方式的额外效果。

games.name: Grand Vista Hotel
games.description: 建造并经营一座不断发展的酒店。赢得星级、升级客房与电梯、增设餐厅、水疗、会议和活动，将一家小型家庭旅馆发展成豪华 Palace。

games.name: Cozy Burg
games.description: A cozy hex city builder with real people and real jobs. You have to earn every resident: they want nature nearby, a job they can get to, and a street worth living on. You build it from a small hand of cards. Make it beautiful, make it work.

games.name: Shin'ai Rewritten
games.description: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

games.name: ZodiacLottery
games.description: 一个彩票 Roguelike 游戏. 移动动物, 打造属于你的中奖彩票, 并结合强力遗物与丰富的协同效果, 赢取惊人的巨额奖金!

games.name: Edge of the Blade
games.description: 在血与钢铁笼罩的战乱之地，指挥你的军团。《刀锋之上》是一款以剧情为核心的自走棋战略游戏，你需要组建部队、谋划大战略。招募随机出现的部队，排兵布阵，决定战斗的胜负。你的每一个选择，都将铸就属于你的军团与故事。

games.name: Almost At Pity
games.description:
Almost At Pity is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your gacha pulls define your run! 
Limit break your characters with limited resources, master powerful synergies, and conquer the final boss

games.name: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride
games.description: You’re Bigfoot. You have a bicycle. And it’s really hot. Ride across the country with your friends, survive the wilderness, and try not to completely destroy your bike (and yourself) along the way!

games.name: What Killed Rachel
games.description:
A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. 
As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy.
Blaming someone is easy.
But answering what truly killed her is not.

games.name: The Cardian - Light the Shrines
games.description: 《The Cardian》是一款以站位为核心的Roguelike牌组卡片塔防游戏。打造强力的卡片组合、洞察怪物的行动轨迹，将世界从黑暗中拯救出来吧。

games.name: Heroll: IF
games.description: 《勇士团团转：IF》是一款Roguelite RPG棋盘游戏，玩家透过两个骰子塑造自己的命运。在不断变化的棋盘上团团转，与敌人战斗，获得装备和祝福，踏上不可预测的冒险之旅。

games.name: Cube Duty
games.description: Cube Duty 是一款基于物理的城市建造游戏。每次投掷都会改变你的经济与战场。每个方块都能化作建筑、资源或单位。将工人方块掷向靶场招募弓箭手，扩展生产链，抵御敌人与强大的 Boss，守护你的王国！

games.name: VIRTUAL ENCORE
games.description: 一款以VTuber业界为舞台的视觉小说。你将扮演事务所经纪人·若叶，在担当艺人·月宫艾莉卡首次个人Live到来前的6天里全力支持她。剧情将随你的选择产生分支。而在这6天的尽头等待着你的是什么——你还一无所知。

games.name: X-救援
games.description: 这是一款将格子地图与搜打撤玩法结合的轻度策略养成游戏。你将扮演救援队的守望者，深入危险区域寻找被困的美少女幸存者。探索未知地图、搜刮资源、与怪物战斗，在危险中寻找撤离路线，并最终护送幸存者安全返回基地，与她们建立更深的关系。

games.name: Altitude Zero
games.description: 一款氛围感十足的恐怖游戏，你将驾驶一架老旧的热气球，穿越荒凉的大地，寻找神秘的废弃站点。

games.name: Yagodki
games.description: 经营一个包裹自提点，在这里，每一个丢失的包裹都是你的错。服务没耐心的顾客，快速找到订单，购买装备，并熬过客服工作中最荒诞的一周。

games.name: Stardust Protocol
games.description: 在弹幕厮杀、黑市交易与星际豪赌之间，亲手规划分支星图航线。自由搭配散射、导弹、追踪与激光四类武器，驾驭百余种道具，应对层出不穷的随机事件——每一场出击都会重塑战机的火力与构筑，每一局航程皆不相同。在未知星域中权衡风险与回报，于火光与星云间刻下你的航迹。

games.name: Cheesty
games.description:
In a world built for humans, you'll have to evade scientists, solve puzzles and use your sense of smell to find your way in this adventure about freedom, belonging and home.

You play as Brie, a daring lab rat in search of the rodent paradise… Cheesty.

games.name: The Unskilled
games.description:
死一次。再试一次。学习陷阱。
一款残酷的精准平台跳跃游戏，每一关都在欺骗你。隐藏陷阱、不可能的意外，以及惩罚自信的恶意机制。

games.name: Fathom Reach
games.description: 一款海底肉鸽卡组构筑游戏，每次潜行都是一场豪赌。打出爆发连招，深入险境搜寻更丰厚的战利品，并在艇体破裂前上浮。带着收获回家升级卡组，再建造一座能在离线时抵御其他玩家突袭的基地。

games.name: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
games.description: 组建小队，在回合制战棋战斗中刷装备，然后撤离保住战利品，或继续深入赌上一切。锻造、制作并在真实的玩家市场上交易你的战利品。一款战利品真正值钱的战术肉鸽游戏。

games.name: Buried Life
games.description: 1997. After a sudden mine collapse, you find yourself trapped inside an abandoned Soviet research complex where classified experiments were once conducted. Explore underground laboratories, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover why the facility was buried along with everything it contained.

games.name: The Unworthy
games.description: 如果地狱也会犯错呢？本作取材自一名临床死亡后幸存男子的证词。这款极具电影感的心理恐怖游戏，将迫使你直面恐惧、奋力重返人间；而潜伏在黑暗中的某种存在，则会不惜一切代价，将你永远困在受诅咒者之中。

games.name: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
games.description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

games.name: THAT BOMB GAME
games.description: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

games.name: The Boo Club
games.description: 一款支持 1–4 人合作的恐怖喜剧游戏，主角是一群满脑子馊主意的业余捉鬼人。完成仪式，掏出荒唐装备，捉弄朋友。获得超能力，飞上天空，与撒旦本人战斗。团队合作能把事情办成，但独揽荣耀实在诱人。

games.name: No Beer Left Behind!
games.description: 一款采用像素艺术风格和 8 位配乐的 2D 推箱子益智游戏。你将扮演一位正在整理酒窖的矮人。目标很简单：把每个木桶推到对应的标记位置即可过关。但有时候，你得先喝上一杯啤酒！

games.name: 三个开关问题
games.description: 在「三开关解谜公园」的九项挑战中，拨动开关并观察结果，找出哪个开关控制相应的装置。一路上，你可以与其他小朋友交流，并参与各种户外活动。

games.name: Vizier
games.description:
The king holds the power — but the words are yours. 
Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

games.name: KnighTD
games.description: Defend an ever-expanding procedural map where towers buff your units and every boss drops game-changing loot. Choose a class, master Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Physical units, and survive.

games.name: St. Nicholas Night
games.description: The Night of St. Nicholas is a night that rekindles the belief in miracles. Brave the snowstorm, wander through snow-covered streets, uncover hidden presents in a city fast asleep, and restore the magic of this heartwarming winter adventure.

games.name: Organ Failure
games.description:
A turn-based surgery in medieval times, against a silly Plague Doctor.

Find the Sick Organ, kill less patients and extract their Hearts for an upper hand.

games.name: Dungebra
games.description: Dungebra 是一款黑暗奇幻 roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。你将一次选择多张卡牌，触发连击、超载和序列，在一局游戏中构筑牌组，并把每个回合变成爆发性的出牌组合。

games.name: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
games.description: 探索 GlowPits 的世界，收集珍贵资源，击败竞争对手探险者，解锁独特角色，并提升强大能力。在这个充满生物、挑战和无尽成长的快节奏竞技场冒险中不断前进。

games.name: Finding Buddies
games.description: Finding Buddies is a romance visual novel where your dialogue choices shape Daniel’s story and relationships. Explore different scenes, meet new characters, and experience a narrative with interactive gameplay moments.

games.name: The Idle Captain
games.description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

games.name: Hephaestus Protocol
games.description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

games.name: Forgery
games.description: Forgery 是一款以黑暗中世纪为背景的肉鸽游戏，你要伪造国王的硬币。用寥寥几次冲压满足每位买家的目标，再排列印模，让它们相互触发、重复发动。一击得手，便可能抵得上赎回国王的天价。

games.name: The Art Keeper
games.description: 修复被遗忘的画廊，创作艺术，布置你的空间，把3D草图变成受物理模拟驱动的作品，在创意与解谜交织的世界中，揭开400多幅画作背后的秘密。

games.name: The Walk of Karl
games.description: The Walk of Karl is a precise rage platformer. Following Karl as he explores this unknown world.

games.name: Boarding House: Night Shift
games.description: Boarding House: Night Shift is a horror game. As a night-shift caretaker of an eerie, old boarding house, you must endure unsettling urban legends, manage your survival resources, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows before the morning comes

games.name: 英雄与召唤
games.description: 在战乱不断的奇幻大陆上，培养英雄，收集各种宝物，召唤多种独特生物，组建多支独一无二的军团，击败各路强敌，对战其他玩家，成为这片大陆的霸主。

games.name: BirdBots
games.description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

games.name: 最后一张
games.description: 《最后一张》是一款紧张刺激的肉鸽卡牌游戏。你将参与到炸弹牌游戏，不断要牌使分数暴涨，获得更多金钱，发掘能够改变局势的卡牌和筹码，运用道具改变局面，翻牌越多，翻到炸弹牌的概率越大，归零的概率越大。在每局获得足够的分数来进入下一关。

games.name: Barnburners
games.description: 像90年代和2000年代那样的街机冰球。大力冲撞、花式晃人、死角进球和火爆打架,24支原创球队任你选。在特许经营模式里冲击克莱文杰杯,或拉上朋友本地、线上随便开一局。

games.name: Bogosort
games.description: Bogosort.exe 是一款以混沌与排序为主题的增量式放置类游戏。混合各种元素、获取资源、升级系统，将混沌转化为高效的成长。探索新机制，优化你的游戏进程。

games.name: 煮弟弟
games.description: 把弟弟做成牛排或肉包的文字游戏卡组构筑Roguelite。做菜要用的魔力，就靠魔法卡改写弟弟的台词吸出来。注射器、菜刀、腌菜石……做着做着，弟弟还会只剩一颗头，或者变成一头牛。不过吸到荤段子的话，厨具会……爆炸！！

games.name: Aethyr Idle
games.description: 一款拥有MMO级构筑深度的放置RPG。从四大职业中选择其一，沿天赋树走向十二种专精之一，并亲手编写英雄的技能循环。制作装备、驾驭元素、挑战神话+地下城与无尽深渊。即使你离线，冒险也不会停下。

games.name: 근손실 올까 봐 파멸엔딩은 거절합니다
games.description: A 530,000 combat SHSL personal trainer is reincarnated as a villainess?! “Guillotine in a year? I’ll tank it with my traps.”A chaotic gain-seeking survival comedy romance fantasy visual novel about a character who fears muscle loss more than death.

games.name: OrderlyWorld
games.description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

games.name: Suits of Fantasia
games.description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

games.name: Twin Hooks
games.description: 两位英雄，一场战斗。与好友组队，在这款双人合作动作游戏中一同把敌人挑上天，打出合体终结技，靠采买与战利品换来更强的装备。白日温情，长夜不休。

games.name: Just Press Keys
games.description:
TETЯIS and a Keyboard got a BABY. Type letters and words at different levels, get combo and the highest score you can. This is the ultimate typing game. JUST PRESS KEYS



(*/0*)

games.name: Dead March: Dark Lord Rising
games.description: 黑暗之王！“亡灵大军”已然启程。组建地狱大军，进攻并掠夺定居点以获取资源。增强你的黑暗力量，解锁新能力，并升级你的部队，以征服人类王国的首都。撒旦将审判你每一场战斗。

games.name: Anomagram
games.description: 《Anomagram》是一款以深夜审核值班为舞台的找异变恐怖游戏。午夜零点。今晚，别人的日常照常送达。你要逐条审核推送到公司配发的终端上的短视频，将其标记为“通过”或“上报”。本该只是这样一份工作。但其中混有异常的视频。异常不会只停留在视频里，它会蔓延到终端，也会蔓延到你身上。合同为期8天。

games.name: Keep Shearing
games.description: A cozy incremental game about shearing sheep, collecting wool, earning gold, and unlocking upgrades to grow your flock.

games.name: 湖畔小憩
games.description: 《湖畔小憩》是一款轻松治愈的桌面挂机钓鱼游戏。静待鱼儿上钩，搭配鱼竿、浮漂、饵料与宝石，打造自己的钓鱼流派。探索随四季与昼夜变化的森林湖泊，捕获普通、稀有和传说鱼类，记录星级、长度与重量，逐步完善图鉴。

games.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
games.description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

games.name: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl
games.description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

games.name: VECTORHYTHM
games.description: 在霓虹弹幕天堂中将节奏化为火力。踩准节拍发动攻击，积蓄能量，强化武器；在生存模式中构筑毁灭性的组合，或在快节奏街机对局中冲击高分，让每首乐曲主宰战斗。

games.name: 身千亿·叶榆逆旅客杂俎
games.description: 《身千亿·叶榆逆旅客杂俎》是一款以五代十国时期的中国西南为背景的叙事经营游戏。你是一间山中客栈的掌柜，经营生意、接待旅客，见证和参与各色旅人的故事。

games.name: SwipSwap
games.description: 《SwipSwap》是一款一击即死的快节奏3D游戏。与延迟2秒复制你动作的影子并肩作战，瞬间互换位置，逐个房间肃清德拉库鲁斯的城堡。极限反应与完美时机是你唯一的生存之道。

games.name: STICKBIT
games.description: Escape from the Tower of Madness! STICKBIT is a fast-paced 2D Action Tower-Defense Rogue-lite where you build defenses, collect powerups, and blow up lots of barrels! Do you have what it takes before the computer deletes you forever?

games.name: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love
games.description: Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love is a first-person gothic mystery about memory, loss, and a love the Ashrose family tried to erase. Explore a forgotten manor, uncover hidden clues, restore a damaged portrait, and reveal the truth behind Julian Vale’s disappearance from history.

games.name: Mothman: Shadows of Point Pleasant
games.description: A former military investigator travels to Point Pleasant, West Virginia, to solve a series of murders and child disappearances. Follow the legend of the Mothman into secret underground facilities, government conspiracies, and unimaginable horrors hidden beneath America.

games.name: Rainfusor
games.description: Each element combination creates its own playstyle. Reclaim the lost parts of yourself in rooms in a side-scroller physics rogue-arcade without any boring stat boosts or platforming. Rip apart segmented bugs, uncover new runes and synergies and find crazy emergent mechanics

games.name: Hellmachina Railbane
games.description: Hellmachina Railbane puts you in the role of a sealed war machine reborn through a pact with humanity. Together, you’ll rise against towering futuristic races armed with advanced sci‑fi tech & ancient magic.

games.name: Trenite Engineer
games.description: You don't pilot the ship-you run it. Manage power, fuel, gravity, life support and other systems, repair failures and engineer your way through a hostile solar system.

games.name: 赛博霓虹：核心协议
games.description: 在霓虹永不熄灭的赛博朋克都市中，失控的人工智能正逐步吞噬城市网络。化身身怀绝技的赏金猎人，从四名战斗风格迥异的佣兵中选择一人，沿程序生成的入侵路线深入系统核心。收集并升级卡牌，安装改变战术的强力义体，在攻击、格挡、病毒、弹药与同步协议之间构筑独特流派；洞察敌人的行动意图，把握时机启动超频，突破五个危机四伏的区域与多阶段首领。每次失败都会留下经验与数据，每次选择都将改写下一场行动。接下委托，在机器军团与企业防线清除你之前，成为最后仍在运行的程序。

games.name: PixelRift
games.description: A 2D side-scroller platformer game with level creation features.

games.name: Wizalign
games.description: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

games.name: Dogfight Era: Origins
games.description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 32 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

games.name: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes
games.description: Descend as a gnomish knight into the ancient dungeons of a grim fairy tale, where your courage changes what you see.  Mark the walls, link Ley spells, brew potions, and uncover the lost human world before your Heart Light fades.

games.name: Halls of the Deep
games.description: 探索怪诞的水池和超现实空间，寻找隐藏的拼图碎片与硬币，使用弓箭无声地消灭漂浮在这些被遗忘大厅深处的敌人。

games.name: Astro Boost
games.description: Through a space journey, explore multiple asteroids in search of rare resources! Play as Mineos, an astronaut equipped with a jetpack that will allow him to easily explore the asteroids and thus retrieve rare materials even in the most difficult-to-reach corners.

games.name: Resort Architect
games.description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

games.name: NULLVECTOR
games.description: NULLVECTOR is a fast top-down action roguelike where you pilot a neon ship, equip up to four weapons, stack stat upgrades, and dodge dense bullet hell patterns in short replayable runs.

games.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner
games.description: 来认识一下洛菲莉亚吧，这位梦幻般的桌面伙伴会在你工作、学习或玩游戏时为你创作故事。在这款温馨的点击类游戏中，每当你按下一个键，洛菲莉亚就会继续写她的故事。你会如何装饰洛菲莉亚的温馨小天地呢？

games.name: Iron Skies
games.description: Retro style, propeller plane centred shoot 'em up inspired by the arcade classics of a fondly remembered bygone era.

games.name: The Greatest Sect Master
games.description: Recruit disciples, manage growing sect and fight strategic turn-based battles in this Cultivation fantasy to become the greatest sect master under heaven.

games.name: Heliconia: Evil Prevails
games.description: The humans have ruled for far too long. Unify the undead, monsters, and outcasts and take over human territories.

games.name: REQ/S
games.description: Welcome, New Hire. It's your job to keep the Company's website alive. Build the infrastructure, route the traffic, handle faults, and survive eight connected levels in a single run. Beat the campaign, then keep going in Endless Mode and chase a higher score.

games.name: Duel: The Game Show
games.description: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 varied mini-games testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?

games.name: Rollamech
games.description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

games.name: LOOPY
games.description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

games.name: Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion
games.description: Rug first or table first? Sticky Rooms is a room decorating game where the furniture is stickers, the order of placement is a puzzle, and mistakes can't be undone. Follow Clara's adventures: from uninspired office worker to renowned interior designer. At least at first.

games.name: Pickie Grappy
games.description: 一款让每一次点击都举足轻重的畅快抓娃娃街机模拟游戏。把握时机抓取，追逐稀有奖品，靠抓取每一件令人满足的物品发家致富。

games.name: Idle Resistance
games.description: 机械军团永不停歇地发动攻击，所以你也必须不断开火。招募枪手，解锁致命武器，并在庞大的技能树中规划升级路线，突破下一波敌人。

games.name: Capy Farm
games.description: 一款轻量增量游戏，你将打造一座完全由水豚经营的农场。扩建田地、实现生产自动化、赚取丰厚利润，并击败对手农场，赢得"丰收大赛"的胜利。

games.name: Catacrypt
games.description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

games.name: Snack Attack
games.description:
Something's wrong on aisle 5. The products have woken up. The expiry date is close. Nobody's getting out clean.
Snack Attack is a fast, chaotic party game for you and your friends, grab what you can, before someone grabs you.

games.name: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl
games.description: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.

games.name: 骰途地牢
games.description: 《骰途地牢》是一款融合骰子构筑、回合制战斗与地牢探索的 Roguelike 游戏。规划路线，投掷、重掷并分配骰面，组合元素释放职业技能。收集新骰、遗物与刻印，挑战探索中的骰子考验，在风险与回报之间抉择，打造每一局的独特构筑。

games.name: STATO
games.description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

games.name: King Alone
games.description: Tower Defense与动作策略相结合。化身国王，率领满载农作物的马车前进。保护你仅剩的一切，以及被敌人弄瞎双眼的女王。

games.name: Valley of Rains
games.description: Join Aerin on a journey to find her missing mother and uncover the truth behind the legendary Valley of Rains. Explore ancient ruins, gather companions, discover forgotten magic, and face the dangers hidden beyond the ancient Gates in this classic turn-based JRPG.

games.name: MirrorBullet
games.description: An unreflected shot cannot kill anything. Place a handful of mirrors, fire once, and let the enemy's own volley solve the board. 144 hand-built stages across a dozen worlds — rotating flip mirrors, portals, half-silvered panes and relay sentries — every par proven minimal by a solver.

games.name: Royal Flush
games.description: 《Royal Flush》是一款回合制卡牌对战游戏，每回合只出一张牌，释放强大效果，削减对手生命值，智胜你的对手。读懂牌局、把握时机，迎战狡猾的 AI 或在线真人玩家。

games.name: A Roguelike Tower Defense
games.description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

games.name: SoloGami
games.description:
Fight tactical card duels across three rows and three rounds. Infect enemy
cards with parasites, turn the weather into a weapon, and master the art of
the well-timed pass. Every card hand-crafted, every duel a puzzle.
Just you, the board, and one more match.

games.name: Pinkybites
games.description: 一位四百岁的吸血鬼在某个乐团的地下室醒来，胸口留着木桩刺穿的痕迹，无处可去。她达成了一项交易：担任乐团主唱、赢得乐团对决、搞清楚一块美元到底是什么。一部关于音乐、命运羁绊，以及一颗遗忘了感受能力的心的剧情向视觉小说。

games.name: 码了鸽币
games.description: 一群萌到犯规的鸽子，一座坐满路人的公园，接下来会发生什么，你大概也猜到了。《Pidgeon Pocket》是一款 kawaii 风格的悠闲偷窃放置游戏：顺走亮闪闪的小玩意儿，升级你的鸽群，看着战利品越堆越高。偷东西，升级，再来一遍。

games.name: Boltz
games.description: Boltz 是一款极简主义的逻辑谜题游戏，在游戏中你需要尝试拆除屏幕上的所有目标螺栓和螺母。每隔约 10 关就会加入全新的机制，为你带来丰富的解谜体验。

games.name: Slums: Hauler 2
games.description: 白手起家，接下越来越赚钱的配送工作，购买武器、载具和房产，在一个高回报伴随高风险的世界中努力生存并不断发展。

games.name: Dark Spawn: Infestation
games.description:
Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. 
The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

games.name: Ski Lines：滑雪道地图
games.description: Ski Lines 是一款极简风格的策略模拟游戏，你将亲手设计并管理一座不断扩张的滑雪场地图。绘制不同难度的雪道，建造缆车，把车站、山顶、观景点、餐厅、山间小屋和救援点连接起来。随着每天都有新的地点开放、更多滑雪者抵达，交通压力也会持续增加。合理分配有限资源，升级设施，使用造雪机扩展可滑区域，清理树林开辟新路线，并不断重新规划网络、解决拥堵。你能让整座滑雪场顺畅运行多久？每一次新的连接都会改变山上的流动方式，也可能带来意想不到的新瓶颈与挑战。

games.name: Haunted Echoes
games.description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

games.name: Stick Crisis
games.description: A stickman roguelite shooter where every run reshuffles combat. Fight from cover across rain-soaked city streets, a hidden jungle base and a desert pursuit, build a powerful loadout, and uncover Project Obelisk’s connection to an impossible artifact.

games.name: Sluice That Goose!
games.description: An incremental game where you sluice huge flocks of gooses and farm their loot to further enhance your goose sluicing behaviors. Unlock powerful upgrades, discover hidden events, and SLUICE. MORE. GOOSE.

games.name: Cat Eats Sushi
games.description: 放置寿司，引导爱吃寿司的猫咪的益智游戏。

games.name: FEED HIM
games.description: Trapped as a prisoner‑chef, you must cook and serve dishes to a hungry eldritch beast lurking unseen in the pit below. A retro horror game about obedience,  and survival through feeding. Cook to survive... because if he isn’t fed, you will be next on the menu.

games.name: Shadows of Beginnings
games.description: The free demo for Shadows of Beginnings. Play as the Warrior or the Mage, rescue the people who can help rebuild Novum, then take one of two routes through the Verdant Rot Swamp to reach the Thorn Matriarch. The further you push, the harder the hive pushes back.

games.name: 栀子与荆棘
games.description:
上一份工作逝去后，普通少女陈栀子莫名其妙被娱乐公司招走，本以为是好运降临，但很快她就发现，这几个天赋异禀的队友......成分有点复杂！她该怎样帮助团队成功出道？还是顺其自然，成为其中某位的“专属猎物” ？
在游戏中，您将跟随陈栀子的视角，展开一段惊喜与惊吓并存的旅程，而您的选择，将决定这场梦幻喜剧的结局。

games.name: Towers to Be
games.description: Platform and zoom around a dream-like world to discover what happened to the mind of this patient.

games.name: 放置事务所
games.description: 战斗全自动，阵容你来配。收集英雄，在 4×4 棋盘上搭配站位、职业羁绊与士气；打造装备、研究科技、培养守护灵，让边境事务所按你的节奏成长。

games.name: Conquest of Empires 3
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 《帝国文明3》构建了一个策略至上的多文明战争世界，在这里，谋略是唯一的通行证，每一位玩家都能凭借智慧，在史诗沙盘中开创属于自己的霸业。

games.name: Solo Chudding
games.description:
社会已经崩塌。数十亿人必须死去。
你是否有能力从“豆末日”中拯救世界，还是从此再无任何改变？

games.name: Just Rats
games.description: Co-op survival against relentless waves of pigs for up to 6 players.

games.name: Proper Football Boss
games.description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

games.name: Convoluted
games.description: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

games.name: Rust & Shine
games.description: 《Rust & Shine》是一款温馨的放置型修复游戏。布满铁锈的神秘古董接踵而至——清理、鉴定、出售它们，将一个单人工作台发展成全自动化的工坊。

games.name: Пятизвёздочный курьер и туман, воняющий мертвечиной
games.description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

games.name: Elsewhere
games.description: Activate every shape in abstract logic puzzles built from gems, signals, and shifting paths. Learn each gem's rule, solve the campaign, then build and share your own levels through the editor and Steam Workshop.

games.name: Total Club Manager
games.description: A love letter to the football management games that stole your nights. Sign players, build tactics, run the youth academy and the finances, and live every match minute by minute. Take a club from nothing to the top of Europe.

games.name: Next Acre
games.description: 轻松治愈的农场卡牌合成游戏。种植作物、饲养动物、完成订单，打造高效生产链，逐步扩建属于你的乡村农场。

games.name: 股咚咕咚
games.description: 这里有一只住在你桌面上的卡通水母。它漂浮在你的窗口之上，你打字它赚钱，然后炒炒海底股票、解锁更多皮肤。不会打扰你工作，只负责可爱，就是这样。

games.name: Who's Calling?
games.description: 这是一个以手机为主要威胁的家庭入侵惊悚故事。当神秘人开始追踪你的一举一动时，日常琐事、办公室工作和家务都会变成陷阱。锁好门，报警，并努力在与跟踪者的终极捉迷藏游戏中活下来。

games.name: 情欲失控：午后的秘密关系
games.description: 化身为浩（Hau），一个重情重义却在情感上极度迟钝的大一男生，你平静的校园生活正悄然崩塌。性格文弱、不懂拒绝的温柔人妻；占有欲极强、随时为你吃醋的强势大姐；在暴力阴影下苦苦支撑、依然心怀幻想的可爱青梅竹马——命运将你们死死相扣。然而危机远不止于此。知性大方却执着掘地三尺的闷骚图书管理员向你步步逼近；身怀未来科技与绝伦身手的孤僻女刺客在暗中将你锁定；甚至连性格暴虐的黑道暴君也盯上了你。欲望、宿命与黑道血雨腥风在方寸之间引爆。浩，你究竟能成为谁的救世主？又会坠入谁的温柔乡？

games.name: Manage Town Together
games.description: 独自一人或与好友一起经营属于自己的超市，为小镇居民提供服务，配送订单，管理车辆，共同让一座沉寂的小镇重新焕发生机。在这款轻松愉快的合作生活模拟游戏中，打造属于你们的社区！

games.name: The Rifted Skies
games.description: 《The Rifted Skies》是一款以久被遗弃的世界为背景的动态 VR 跑酷游戏。你将扮演一位回到故乡的孤独战士。奔跑、战斗并施展跑酷技巧，逃离吞噬一切的致命“裂隙”。死亡、重生，并在一次次尝试中变得更强。解锁新能力，揭开真相——你的家园还能被拯救吗？

games.name: Crops & Coops
games.description: 独自经营一座小岛农场，或与最多三位好友在线合作。种植作物、钓鱼并逐步实现农场自动化，在轻松的像素风增量游戏中不断发展。

games.name: Lorentz Factor
games.description: 一款需要动手的增量游戏。把飞船推到物理允许的最接近光速之处：从流过的等离子体中收集燃料，喂给反应堆，看着你的两个时钟不再一致。对你是几分钟，对其他所有人是几个世纪。

games.name: Fembot Vending Machine
games.description: An idle management game where you assign beautiful femboy robots to work and earn gold! Upgrade your facility, research new technologies, and use the vending machine to gacha for rare internal and external parts. Customize their statistics for maximum work efficiency, and unwind in the bedroom.

games.name: JANJARA: Automatic Mahjong Table Simulator
games.description: Gather four players around an automatic mahjong table. Watch it raise the walls and shuffle, then handle the tiles, point sticks, and chips yourselves. JANJARA simulates the table—not the referee—so your group brings the rules.

games.name: IRONWAKE
games.description: Horreur psychologique linéaire en une seule session. Votre esprit est téléversé dans un vieux robot soviétique enfermé dans un bunker mort. Infiltration dans le noir, énigmes à l’intérieur de machines mourantes, et une seule voix à la radio pour vous guider. Trouvez les indices et changez la fin.

games.name: Cubersum
games.description: 一艘立方体飞船坠毁在一颗遥远的星球上。收集周围的方块，用它们建造新的船体，一路攀升，重返太空。

games.name: MiniCook
games.description: 在游戏中你将扮演一名烧烤摊摊主，负责在夜市烤串售卖，当积累了足够的资金后，可以购买一个炒饭车在夜市进行炒饭售卖，当积累了足够的资金后，将开一个奶茶店属于自己的奶茶店。游戏偏向于体验，经营为辅。

games.name: The Veiled Atlas: A Cycle of Falls
games.description: A turn-based 4X of rival governments contesting the dim Atlas through economy, war and an Influence-weighted Council. At the edge of sensor range, the Shadow does not lose - it only rises.

games.name: Crown Cribbage
games.description: The cribbage night you remember. Two, three and four-hand play: online at tables, passed around one screen at home, or against distinct opponents who never peek at your cards. Watch them play each other while you chat, or train in The Study — your first fifteen to muggins.

games.name: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage
games.description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

games.name: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定
games.description: 『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲーム！個性豊かなキャラクターのスキルを駆使し、チンチロの役によって変化する攻撃力を味方につけて勝利を目指そう。知略と豪運が交差するバトルを楽しもう！

games.name: 皮肤起舞
games.description: 这是一个混合中国童话和超现实风格的推理解谜游戏。探索这个令人不安而绚丽夺目的世界，在这里度过美丽的一天，揭开珍盐湖疗养院里的秘密吧！

games.name: 中国式青训
games.description: 扮演一名12岁的足球少年，或接手一家青训俱乐部，在球场、课堂、家庭与合同之间，为梦想争取一个真正上场的机会，各种离奇荒诞的故事会在此上演！

games.name: OAN
games.description: A Vietnamese folk horror in pixel art. Return alone to the abandoned family house for your grandfather's death-anniversary vigil. Light three sticks of incense before dawn, and keep the oil lamp burning. Something folded from paper is already in the house, and it does not want the rite finished.

games.name: 谎言：替身千金
games.description: 你以为自己是唯一，其实只是替身。真人实拍+测谎玩法，撕开三位男主的面具。多种结局、百种分支，每一个选择都在拷问：你究竟是谁的替身？谁的谎言？

games.name: The Cake Mistake
games.description: After being shipped the wrong form of 'YellowCake', a pastry chef bakes his creations, to find himself surrounded by nuclear cakes, ice cream sandwiches and other delicious desserts. Survive and navigate your way out of this Sugary Factory.

games.name: Unburied
games.description: 不葬之王的送葬队伍沿路唤醒每一座坟。独自或与朋友一起守夜——撑到黎明，尸身就地成灰。免费试玩版现已推出。

games.name: DIMAZE
games.description: Devour every enemy spell, then fire it back. Wield elemental ores and your weapons, and keep climbing an ever-changing labyrinth in this 3D action roguelite.

games.name: CrystalCanvas
games.description: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!

games.name: Pluck Em!
games.description: 在这款令人上瘾的街机射击游戏中，对抗那些烦人的羽毛害虫。本作灵感来自 8 位和 16 位时代的经典游戏。探索奇特的生态区，发现怪异的鸟类物种，赢得奖牌，升级你的装备，并揭开一些也许最好永远不要被发现的秘密。

games.name: DiceBeasts
games.description: DiceBeast is a tactical dice-based autobattler with short roguelite runs. Build a team of creatures, assign elemental dice to their abilities, and upgrade them after each victory.

games.name: Medieval Ascendant
games.description: 从被束缚于土地的农奴，到一家贵族的家主。耕作土地、经营贸易，在五大行省建立经济帝国，以战争、权谋或财富夺取土地——并缔造一个长存于你身后的王朝。

games.name: Paper Tower: Idle Overlay
games.description: 款等距3D桌面伴侣放置类自动战斗游戏,静静地待在屏幕一角,陪你处理其他事情。收集战利品,升级你的塔,击退无穷无尽的敌人浪潮。

games.name: TowerBound
games.description: 这座塔里没有运气可言。每一只怪物、每一件道具、每一扇上锁的门都是完全确定的。原作的 50 层构成一整道巨大的逻辑谜题。生命、金币与钥匙必须按正确的顺序花掉，否则你会亲手断绝自己的去路。一款魔塔传统的像素解谜 RPG。

games.name: Mafia: Night falls
games.description: 一款支持多达 16 名玩家的黑手党社交推理游戏，舞台是一座月夜村庄。白天在广场上指控并投票，夜晚隐藏身份们或杀戮、或复活、或囚禁、或调查，而狼人四处狩猎，Mafia 暗中谋划。人人皆有秘密，总有人在说谎。撑到天亮为止。

games.name: Deep Rise
games.description: Colony management roguelite. After every combat, draft one of three cards to build your run. The surface world ended a thousand years ago. Now the road up is open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

games.name: Obscuroid
games.description:
Obscuroid is a psychological horror puzzle game where you use a changing non-Euclidean environment to solve puzzles. Venture through a mind-bending liminal realm, use Polaroids to manipulate your surroundings,
conjure your escape, or be consumed by whatever might wander the realm's vacant halls.

games.name: Summer Like a Dream
games.description: 你将在汉娜家度过一个难忘的夏天，身边有老朋友，也有新面孔。与他们建立更深的联系，探索这个季节带来的一切，并跟随每段关系的发展方向。你能充分利用这个夏天吗？

games.name: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl
games.description:
这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。
被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 
杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。
直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 
从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

games.name: Sweep Protocol
games.description: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

games.name: Dice Breakers
games.description: 在这款令人上瘾的放置增量游戏中粉碎骰子、获取奖励、解锁升级，并通过自动化系统打造属于你的破坏帝国。

games.name: DevilCompany
games.description: 运用时间能力与多种武器战斗的2D动作类银河战士恶魔城。成为地狱的恶魔职员，探索扭曲的人类时代。

games.name: Ambrosia ~Dice Spam Dungeon~ PC
games.description: Dive into the Dungeon where monsters spam dice (attacks), your barrier magic are able to convert those dice into your own dice (mana) for storage. By combining adjacent dice, you reflect the damage back to the monsters.

games.name: Evil Moon: Unspoken
games.description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

games.name: LLM Tycoon
games.description: It's late 2022 and the AI race just started. Train models with real personalities, fill the map with datacenters, survive the scandals, and get to superintelligence before the rival CEOs who trash-talk you on social media.

games.name: 定价人
games.description: 扮演一位从战场上退下来的商人，和拥有运输车队业务的合伙人一起开辟新的小镇商路。但在一系列与当地旧贵族的谈判中，合伙人被毒杀。在几天的思索后，他决定就用自己依旧是车队管理人的优势，通过操纵小镇经济，将当地势力全部连根拔起。

games.name: The Clearing : The Habit Building Game
games.description: You have found a small clearing in the forest. Face the challenges in your real life, and turn the clearing into a beautiful garden as you grow.

games.name: Treasure Chest Master
games.description: Have you ever thought about who collects chests for heroes? No, they don't appear on their own, each of the chests has its own Master! Immerse yourself in the story of the Chest Master, in which your job is to fill chests with loot!

games.name: Check-In Anomaly
games.description: You work the night shift at a hotel. Survive your shift, detect anomalies, patrol the hallways, and unravel the hidden mysteries that await each night.

games.name: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol
games.description: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol is a single-player third-person zombie arena shooter with wave survival, cash drops, bullet-time combat, and over 90 upgrades.

games.name: Pin-Finite
games.description:
Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game.
Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!

games.name: COLONY 2
games.description: 为了找回丢失的板球，吉里推开了一个恐怖的世界。那天他逃了出来，但有一部分永远留在了里面。八年后，调查这座击垮他的英殖民时期疯人院。可他为什么一次次回来？揭开那些本不该被揭开的真相。

games.name: Exit Club: Last Night Again
games.description: A mystery visual novel where you relive the same night in a nightclub, uncover secrets through dialogue, and use knowledge from previous loops to unlock new paths.

games.name: Spearfish
games.description: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.

games.name: Mythia Wild Bonds
games.description: A monster-collector roguelite. Pick a Mythia. Fight the horde. When creatures fall, escort their Exposed Souls to forge permanent Bonds in your Grimoire. Bond the same creature enough times and it reaches its Ascended Form.

games.name: 尚武誌
games.description: 《尚武誌》是以民国初年为背景的格斗游戏，设计灵感源自经典功夫影片。操控招式风格各异、武学正统的武者；复古扁平美术还原老式武馆与街头擂台，游戏包含单人剧情与本地双人对战，拥有扎实流畅的拳脚打击手感。

games.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
games.description: 一款温馨的圣诞主题推箱子解谜游戏，圣诞老人需要把礼物推到正确的位置。挑战50个手绘像素艺术关卡，感受浓浓节日氛围。

games.name: Slim Flamingo Vs The 1%
games.description: Platform infinity in a loop while shooting inwards at the boss in the center!  With one health and only bosses inspired by the greatest boss fights for the 2000s, every moment is on edge, electric, do or die action!

games.name: CPU: Computing Potatoes Unlimited
games.description: Program potato workers to process numbers with simple punch-in instructions at a factory that mimics a processor. Optimize solutions to solve challenging open-ended puzzles. Punch, observe, learn, repeat.

games.name: The Arrow
games.description: The Arrow is a retro wave-based horror shooter set in a world reshaped by a religious military sect. Fight alone or with friends as you push through war‑torn ruins in a crusade to spread the one true god.

games.name: Bravemech: The Century War
games.description: 一款机甲题材的动作 RPG 轻度 Rogue 游戏。这场战争将持续一百年，每一轮就是其中的一年。在横版实时战斗中驾驶你自己的机甲，强化你的飞行员、机甲、小队、舰长和战舰，并从巨型头目手中收集勇者核心（Bravecore）。飞行员会永久阵亡。支持单人或 4 人本地合作。

games.name: Numb Digger
games.description: Dig through a frozen labor camp built to bury you under debt, paperwork, and somebody else’s name. Bring back what it took. Keep your people alive. Reclaim your identity from the cold, indifferent world. The ice is not just ice.

games.name: TeaKnights
games.description: TeaKnights is a Y2K-inspired musical rail shooter set across seven tea-powered biodomes. As apprentice Camellia Jetsworth, blast enemies with TeaSetter REGALIAS, build chain combos to drive the dynamic soundtrack, face bosses, aid fellow knights, explore the overworld, and customize your look.

games.name: Defend The HexCore
games.description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior  |  Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board  |  Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

games.name: Progress98
games.description: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

games.name: Digital Twin: Harmonix
games.description: Enter colorful complex biological simulations, play intense 12-button rhythm charts, collect data and DNA, then assemble that DNA into strange new creatures.

games.name: Paperclash Tactics
games.description: Paperclash Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in a fantasy world. Assemble your team and harness the power of the elements on your quest to save the world!

games.name: Shine on Savior
games.description: Shine On Savior is an action platformer that takes you through the city of New Delmarr and kill hundreds of dregs. Anything in this city can be used as a weapon. A ritual has been set in New Delmarr in which all of the humans and dregs resurrect upon death.

games.name: LOCKOUT
games.description: Your wife and daughter vanished a year ago. Now you wake on a quarantined island with no memory, a stranger's voice on the radio, and things in the dark that hunt. Stay quiet, hide, solve what the dead left behind, and find out why you were brought here.

games.name: 螺丝钉
games.description:
科幻x女同x视觉小说！
你将扮演一名31xx年的公司实习生。在项目组解散的当下，是接受上司递来的橄榄枝、还是接受同事的转组邀请、或者接受人工智能的稳妥安排？又或者……尝试新的公司、新的机会？
在短暂的一周时间内决定未来。

games.name: High Typer
games.description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

games.name: OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery
games.description: 把推车装到极限，征服这座巨大的高层公寓！《OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery》是一款混乱的物理驱动快递模拟游戏。像玩俄罗斯方块一样平衡易碎包裹，与无情的时间赛跑，逃避公司万恶的罚款。单人或在线合作，在打工人的日常折磨中活下来吧！

games.name: Wild Hive
games.description: 在这款肉鸽蜂群模拟经营游戏中筑起蜂巢，活下去。孵化工蜂、采集花蜜，在高度拟真的市场上为你的蜂蜜卖出最好的价钱。控制好巢内气候，击退黄蜂突袭——否则只能眼看蜂群覆灭。驾驭蜂巢，铸就你的蜂蜜帝国。

games.name: memu is space cat
games.description:
宇宙猫 memu，在目眩神迷的景色与音乐中随意漂流。
每一次都全新生成的音乐与空间，放空看着就好。
可以当 BGM 挂着的「Drift」模式。
倾斜星球、让 memu 滚动的「Journey」模式。
用喜欢的宇宙、喜欢的模式，把自己埋进未知的空间里。
——工作时的背景，熬夜时的陪伴。

games.name: 戴森球：桌面工厂
games.description:
自动化产线 + 肉鸽词条 + 塔防战斗 + 桌面壁纸
在遥远的泰普勒星球，点燃基地火种，开启戴森球工业奇迹！
在桌面搭建自动化产线，组装无人机运输，将单元发射升空。抽取科技词条，构筑发展流派，让生产效率飙升。

games.name: Mark My Spell
games.description:
《Mark My Spell》是一款手势施法动作类 Rogue 游戏。绘制符文、输入指令，组合出千奇百怪的法术联动，
  对抗源源不断的幽灵大军

games.name: MAUS TRAP
games.description:
抓老鼠。拆鼠窝。晒太阳。

一款温馨又充满混乱乐趣的平台冒险游戏。

你是一只小猫。任务很大。但没有压力。

games.name: Roguelette
games.description: The roulette roguelike. Roguelette is a tactical, satisfying deckbuilder where you load a cursed wheel with strange balls, bend the odds with powerful effects, and trigger outrageous chain-reaction combos.

games.name: Novalex Project Zero
games.description: 回合制车企经营游戏。从底盘起亲手设计每一款型号，运营工厂、精准定价，在长达百年的汽车工业史中，用技术压过一路增至 30 家的 AI 对手车企。打造一家基业长青的车企，或者在半路上破产收场。

games.name: 怪物碎碎机
games.description: 《怪物碎碎机》是一款短小精悍的主动式增量游戏，以击杀更多怪物为目标，收集材料并投入粉碎机，通过庞大天赋树和局外升级获得永久强化！

games.name: House of Tides
games.description: 在这款以悲伤、愧疚与执念为主题的第一人称心理科幻恐怖游戏中，深入淹没世界之下的一座遗忘剧院，踏入由记忆、想象中的人生与破碎身份构成的不断变幻的迷宫。

games.name: Project R Tactical
games.description: Build and customize an army of robots, equip them with a wide variety of weapons and gear, and complete tactical turn-based missions across different planets. Earn resources to upgrade your units, unlock new equipment, and adapt your strategy to overcome increasingly powerful enemy forces.

games.name: Iliad
games.description: Iliad is an adventure Metroidvania that borrows new powers and area unlocks from it's retro origins and weave classic map design mechanic in the gameplay. Travel through two worlds tightly linked together each growing as you discover new secrets and defeat bosses towards one of the two endings.

games.name: MineCash
games.description: MineCash is a simple incremental game about mining cash.

games.name: ALASH
games.description: ALASH is a brutal 2D action-survival game in the Kazakh steppes. Defend your yurt, craft defenses, eat besbarmak to heal, and swing between structures with web-slinging mechanics to fight off endless hordes of enemies under the hype commentary of a legendary voiceover!

games.name: 推彈小子
games.description: 《推彈小子》是一款益智解謎遊戲，你要靠炸毀障礙物來開路前進。

games.name: Pluricubus
games.description: A puzzle game about using rotation to move.  Pass through complex levels, making use of special tiles along the way.  Teleport, change shape, move along walls and ceilings, and sometimes control multiple shapes at once to reach the end.

games.name: Disaster Scenario
games.description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

games.name: Into The Lumberwoods
games.description: An interdimensional rift just ruined Mothman's peaceful shack life! Into the Lumberwoods is a bullet hell roguelite where your next weapon might be a proper artifact or pulled straight from humanity's worst ideas. Venture into the woods and blast weird monsters back to where they belong.

games.name: Purrfect Beats
games.description: 一只猫、電子復古音乐（Synthwave）和仅需一个按键来考验你的节奏感。能有多难呢？

games.name: A Cube's Choice
games.description: A Cube’s Choice is a 3D platformer where you bob, weave, and use movement abilities to reach the end before the music stops. Explore abstract, song-shaped worlds and face the Wall through soft, symbolic storytelling.

games.name: Terraformer Wars
games.description:
未来，各大跨国企业将“泰拉福默”巨型机器派往遥远的星球，争夺霸权。
一款你前所未见的自动对战游戏。

games.name: All Hands
games.description: Build walls, blast the terrain, and reroute thousands of furious customers through your own killboxes. All Hands is an incremental tower defence game about defending HQ, engineering excessive solutions, and turning corporate catastrophe into career advancement.

games.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
games.description: 《Beastopia: Raiders》是一款PvPvE逃脱动作冒险游戏。化身为动物，探索已成废墟的世界，对抗怪物与其他掠夺者，并带着战利品平安撤离吧。

games.name: Red Lake
games.description: A psychological horror with no interface to guide you. Only you, the forest, and your notebook. Use it to document static-covered objects and go deeper into the Red Lake — and your past.

games.name: Rally King
games.description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.description: 这是一款以奇幻方式重新诠释1592年壬辰倭乱（万历朝鲜战争）的架空历史3D战术角色扮演游戏。在具有高低差的网格战场上指挥部队，利用属性克制与地形扭转战局。沿三阶段职业树培养角色，深入搭配装备，打造独一无二的作战单位。

games.name: 角色屋 桌面伙伴
games.description: 《角色屋：桌面伙伴》是一款捏脸与桌宠玩法结合的休闲放置收集游戏。数百种部件任你自由组合，捏出独一无二的桌面伙伴，看它在你工作学习时排排坐、同步敲击互动，或偷偷躲进墙角安静陪伴。放置即可持续获得收益：抽取并合成配饰，收集设定卡片，不断丰富角色的个性与形象。你还可以与好友联机互访，分享彼此精心打造的伙伴，让陪伴加倍。

games.name: Slimy Dude
games.description: Slimy Dude is a hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a soldier, running from kingdom to kingdom against forces greater simply to escape his past. You will meet new allies, become stronger, uncover secrets and explore new environments.

games.name: ATC: Tower & Ground
games.description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

games.name: Super Hole
games.description: 收集、升级、生产并盈利！ 从一个小小的 Hole 开始，收集资源，解锁强力卡牌，通过独特升级强化你的 Hole，加快生产速度，并通过与顾客交易建立繁荣的事业。

games.name: Defender of Darkness
games.description: 一款放置类塔防游戏：建造防御工事，管理有限资源，施放法术，并决定在与光明势力展开最终决战前，要拯救哪些黑暗领主。别忘了培养属于你的克拉肯！

games.name: Yokai Mart
games.description: 《Yokai Mart》是一款充满神秘故事的温馨商店经营模拟游戏。奶奶把便利店交给你打理了。夜里到访的妖怪，还有村里的常客，都需要你的帮助。一点一点地，你会熟悉这个地方，也会让每位来客的生活变得更好一些。

games.name: Stick Picker Simulator
games.description: Pick up sticks to feed a fire that never stops dying. The better the fuel, the deeper into the freezing dark it lies — and the longer you're gone, the closer your fire gets to going out. A cozy-looking survival game with real teeth.

games.name: Ragnarok Roads
games.description:
Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle
  battles on frozen roads. A moddable roguelike where every run writes a different story across a real map of Sweden.

games.name: Rest In Space
games.description: Space funeral bureau simulator. Find the forgotten dead among the stars, uncover their stories through wreckage and belongings. Choose burial methods and select grave adornments in accordance with the deceased's culture or final wishes.

games.name: AFTER THE SILENCE
games.description: Alone at a remote observatory, you must manage equipment, investigate mysterious transmissions, and survive the unsettling events that follow every signal. Maintain satellites, process incoming data, explore the station, and uncover secrets hidden beyond the univers.

games.name: Protocell
games.description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

games.name: Egg It!
games.description: Someone's holding the egg. That's about to be your problem. Dash, combo, and shove it into someone else's hands before the fuse blows — one hazard-packed arena, 4 players plus bots, local or online. Welcome to Egg It.

games.name: The Hope Incident
games.description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

games.name: SHARDS
games.description: SHARDS 是一款 2–4 人非对称合作解谜游戏，最适合双人游玩。一人操作盘面，其余人只掌握规则。你们看不到彼此的屏幕，唯一的联系是声音。而你要传达的，是没有名字、难以言说的异形符号。中央的“囚笼之核”不断跳动，每一次失误都让它更红、更接近崩溃。沟通失误等同死亡——只凭声音，阻止崩溃。

games.name: Nostos
games.description: 科幻生存恐怖Roguelike——骰子与意志的较量。率领一支可牺牲的打捞火力小队，穿越被猎食异形母体潜伏的废弃船舰。每一次掷骰都是豪赌，搜刮资源以求生存，在她将你逼入死角前抵达撤离点——因为永久死亡不留退路。

games.name: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
games.description: 从一名单打独斗的网漫作者起步，打造你的工作室帝国。画出读者喜爱的章节，培育热门连载，聘请专业人才，并在长达25年的职业生涯中谈判出版协议。一段惬意的创作之旅，兼具经营大亨游戏的深度。

games.name: Yathsel
games.description: 《Yathsel》是一款以狂野西部为背景的骰子类Roguelite游戏：在单人战役、快速决斗以及最多支持8名玩家参与的在线酒馆排名1v1对战中，玩家可以打出诡计多端的“Yahtzee”式牌局，从走私商人那里偷偷拿走桌下的作弊神器骰子，并通过各种作弊手段击败持枪的对手。

games.name: Bestricken Part 1
games.description: Bestricken Part 1 is an erotic fantasy visual novel where you have been cursed! And the only cure seems to be in the hands of 3 VERY lovely ladies! (along with a few extras) Explore the multiple paths and possible girls you come across in this fully voiced, colorful, and animated adventure!

games.name: PSYCHO CASKET
games.description: PSYCHO CASKET is the definitive emo RPG. Play as a vampire and make the ultimate decision- the lives of your friends, or those of the entire world? It's been waiting for you. Yes, YOU.

games.name: Nutshot Simulator
games.description: 扔东西，砸中别人的蛋蛋。

games.name: Demon Baby
games.description: 在这款迷人的3D平台游戏中，从地下世界救回露米。穿越七个独特世界，掌握强大的维京头盔，并揭开一个早于维京人和恶魔存在的古代文明。

games.name: APARTMENT 001
games.description: You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

games.name: Short Fuse!
games.description: 一款支持1至4名玩家的汽车合作挑战游戏。在危险道路上运输不稳定的货物，完成配额目标，并尽量避免在抵达前就互相撞毁。

games.name: Cozy Airways
games.description: An airline tycoon with the stress taken out. Open routes across a storybook world, look after passengers who each have a story of their own, decorate a lounge worth waiting in, and grow one little plane into a global airline — at whatever pace feels good.

games.name: CROAKDOWN
games.description: 亲吻青蛙的日子，结束了。现在，换你把它们打回去。这是一款养成向塔防游戏：收集资源、升级技能、部署防御，挡下这场蛙群入侵。击败头目，它不会消失，而是变成你的下一位盟友。变成什么？你还没准备好。全部收服吧！

games.name: Pressure Points
games.description: Read the body. Strike the vitals. A razor-sharp duel of nerve and reaction: spot the glowing kill-point, draw faster than your rival, and climb the global boards. Solo gauntlets, daily challenges, and online 1v1 standoffs.

games.name: Lucky Pocket
games.description: 根据每轮游戏中都会变化的商店清单调整策略，组合装备以产生强大的协同效应，并利用多种手段击败怪物与首领！

games.name: God of Stock
games.description: 股神肉鸽是一款牌组建造类肉鸽游戏。你作为交易员，利用神明赐福的卡牌交易股票，操纵价格，在混乱的交易市场赢取千万利润。为你的角色打造专属卡组，收集强力道具以及颠覆性宝藏，最终成为股票之神。

games.name: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
games.description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

games.name: MMOS: MMO Simulator
games.description: 在这款单人经营模拟游戏中打造并运营你自己的奇幻 MMO。设计世界、职业、战利品和团队副本，然后看着模拟冒险者游玩、组建公会、追逐稀有掉落。让他们玩得开心、持续订阅，并决定你的 MMO 接下来需要什么。

games.name: 东方蘑菇塔防
games.description:
《东方蘑菇防御》是东方Project的二次创作游戏。
这是一款由Marisa将蘑菇变成塔楼来击败敌人的防御游戏。
在游戏内，你需要采集建造塔楼所需的材料，并建造塔楼来限制敌人的路径。

games.name: Pachinko Overdrive
games.description: 一款混乱的弹珠台 Roguelike 游戏，你可以打造各种荒诞的弹珠升级效果，看着物理驱动的连锁反应在整个棋盘上爆发。每次游戏都会演变成一台独特的机器，充满弹跳、分裂以及不断连锁的得分混乱。

games.name: Ultima Cenere
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a Mediterranean Italy after the end. Every run reshapes you: flesh mutates, body parts are traded for implants. You don't heal — you trade. Four classes, one journey to the last enclave. No loot boxes, no pay-to-win.

games.name: BudMageddon
games.description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth!  Humanity's last hope is You & weed.  a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

games.name: My Dorm - Season 3
games.description: 《我的宿舍》是一款选择至关重要的情色视觉小说。在体验充满情感且健康温馨的情节以及性感的动画成人场景的同时，探索如何组建一种别具一格的“自选家庭”。你的选择将决定你的旅程。

games.name: Outlanders VR
games.description: Outlanders is a town-building strategy game, populated by hard-working, charming folk in search of a simpler life. Some just want to survive off the land, others want to create amazing things.

games.name: Arcadia Unbound
games.description: Embark on a character-driven tactical JRPG adventure through a mysterious world fractured by unseen forces. Build bonds with your companions, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your journey through meaningful choices and dynamic interactions.

games.name: Stash Mayhem
games.description: 一款中世纪仓库 Roguelike，支持 1 到 4 人在线合作。趁店里还清闲，用你自己的方式收纳物品；然后争分夺秒，赶在耐心用完前招呼好每位顾客。这款游戏没有地图，地图只在你脑子里。记住每样东西放在哪，或者干脆拥抱这场混乱。

games.name: Oreship Stellar Frontier
games.description: Start with a small mining ship and build an interplanetary space enterprise. Mine resources, refine goods, automate trade routes, expand your fleet, and take direct control of your freighter as you explore the Solar System.

games.name: 营地·远征
games.description: 奇幻放置挂机 RPG。经营营地、招募英雄、全自动战斗，刷取装备与材料，再强化、附魔、定制词条，打造专属强力装备，逐关征服这片土地！

games.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
games.description: 一款恐怖RPG/FPS游戏,故事发生在一个被狂热邪教控制的反乌托邦美国,该教派一心想培育出完美的"红母牛",以求带来末日降临。玩家将扮演"纵火者",一个决定不顾一切抵抗邪教的普通人

games.name: Deck Forge
games.description: 锻造牌组，开辟道路。一款黑暗奇幻 roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏：五种职业、375 张以上的原创卡牌、致命的圣物、永不重复的分支征途，以及最多四人的在线合作模式。每一局都是全新的试炼——死亡、学习，构筑更致命的牌组。

games.name: FREEWAVE
games.description: FREEWAVE is an epic spaceship action-adventure. Explore a vast, tattered city in search of answers. Fly between crumbling buildings and become a master pilot. Fight against the oppressive tech regime ULTRASOFT and defend yourself against rotten monsters. All hand drawn with pen and watercolor.

games.name: Dice in Wonderland
games.description: 掷骰成牌的肉鸽构筑游戏。亲手锻造每一颗骰子，叠加筹码×倍率，让分数爆炸到连女王的记分官都放弃计分。柴郡猫注视下的残酷而奇异的仙境——再来一局。兔子洞深不见底。

games.name: 逃离末日镇
games.description: 《逃离末日镇》是一款末日生存游戏。你将带领幸存者小队深入危机四伏的城镇，搜寻物资，打败强敌，在丧尸围攻前及时撤离。建设基地、招募伙伴、强化队伍…在一次次出征中积蓄力量，最终逃离这座末日孤城！

games.name: Oops, No Floor!
games.description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

games.name: 仙路烟尘
games.description: 这是一款修仙模拟养成游戏。你将扮演一名初入仙门的凡人修士，通过回合制修炼、功法突破、历练事件与战斗，在宗门中步步成长。每一次行动都消耗时间，每一次选择都可能导向不同的结局。修凡成仙，一念之间。

games.name: 三国志:进击
games.description: 《三国志：进击》是一款以三国乱世为舞台的战术策略模拟游戏。拖拽部队下达命令，在实时大规模战斗中攻击侧翼与后方，运用火计、包围与突破扭转战局。任命武将、处理政务、研究技术，为统一天下奠定基础。

games.name: 永不按颜色分拣
games.description: 在那座积木山的下面某处，埋着你的地板。用磁力手套、筛盘和追踪零件的视觉，分拣这座不可能的「大堆」。装满贴好标签的抽屉，取出零件，看着 MOC 一砖一瓦地咬合成型。惬意、满足，只受一条规则支配：永远不要按颜色分拣。

games.name: Joint Venture: 监狱小卖部模拟器
games.description: 在窗口经营监狱小卖部：核对证件与囚号，遵守狱警每日下发的规矩，完成订单赚取利润。再用毒品、自制刀和走私品做大黑市帝国，躲过巡逻、摄像头和搜身。老实服刑，还是夹带越狱，由你决定。

games.name: The Gastarbeiters
games.description: The Gastarbeiters —— 一款 1-5 人合作游戏，以建筑工地为主题，而周围的一切都在与你们作对。在爆炸、袭击和恶劣天气中建造一座房子。你们能否活着完成建设？

games.name: AJ's Anomaly
games.description: 短篇叙事驱动型恐怖游戏。扮演被困在公寓里的时装设计师Amelia Jalisco，与你想象中的男朋友相处，使用异常治疗装置，探索如梦似幻的周遭环境。

games.name: Rec Room: A New Semester
games.description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

games.name: Conglomerate
games.description: You’re the CEO. Build your company into a thriving conglomerate, managing the cash flow, product launches, funding and hiring decisions. Build a conglomerate or go bankrupt trying.

games.name: Spellworks
games.description: Spellworks is a single-player dark fantasy tower defense game where tactical real-time decisions shape every battle. Build and upgrade powerful elemental towers, defend the realms from relentless enemy waves, and defeat epic bosses.

games.name: IT Outage Desk
games.description: Start as a help desk technician and build your way to the top. Resolve tickets, hire staff, automate your department, and survive the increasingly absurd chaos of corporate IT in this humorous incremental clicker.

games.name: Arcana Rift: Tactics
games.description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

games.name: Heroswarm
games.description: 《御潮英雄》是一款英雄坚守要道的肉鸽塔防游戏。混合火焰、冰霜、闪电与神圣伤害对抗五大护甲，通过局内构筑改变战局规则，迎击适应你防线的敌潮。在地图编辑器中打造专属地图，单人或与好友联机共守阵地。

games.name: Wild Crazy 8s
games.description: 疯狂8点的 Roguelike。每张8都是百搭：指定花色、延续连锁、把怪物级 Combo 兑现成分数。构筑能扭曲规则的牌库，叠加彼此相乘的 House Rules，一层一层打穿整座赌场。

games.name: DashBreaker
games.description: 越破坏，越强大。冲刺贯穿小行星与敌舰，用收集的 Gold 永久强化飞船。这是一款结合快速成长与爽快冲刺战斗的主动增量游戏。从逐个击碎目标到一举扫荡敌群，感受战斗与采集方式的变化。

games.name: GloomDelve
