games.description: 叫上朋友坐到沙发前：一款 100 层的 Roguelite 地牢探索游戏，支持真正的本地分屏合作（也支持联机）。抽取打破平衡的能力卡，死去，再次下潜。每一面墙、每个怪物、每把剑都由代码生成——连烤面包机都能跑。

games.name: The Tower of Seven
games.description: 《The Tower of Seven》是一款以卡牌、骰子与规则改写为核心的类桌游爬塔游戏。每一层中，你将从五张手牌中选择三张组成构筑链，利用一骰、二骰、决胜骰与牌效骰触发不同方向的牌效。正向、逆向、中立与空白面共同决定局势，而恶魔牌会不断改写本层规则，迫使你在风险与收益之间做出选择。每张牌既是力量，也是未来恶魔卡组的一部分。你需要移动、翻转、重掷、复制、禁用和改写桌面上的对象，在七层塔中寻找属于自己的命运。

games.name: Gateshock
games.description: 每张地图都有一串代码。建好自己的地图，把代码发给朋友，再打破他的纪录。六边形格子塔防：14 座防御塔、每座四个升级层级，16 关手工设计的战役，以及由 40 件遗物决定你能走多远的 Run 模式。

games.name: To Type a Tale
games.description: To Type a Tale is a fantasy choose-your-own-adventure story where the only method of interaction is typing. Story progress, choices, and menus are all achieved through typing highlighted words.

games.name: 知夏
games.description: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

games.name: Dust Vein
games.description:
一款支持1-4名玩家的合作恐怖游戏，背景设定在地球死寂的地下掩体中。
收集战利品，完成配额，喂养活体反应堆，并不断深入矿井。

games.name: Anomaly Cafe
games.description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

games.name: Bancet
games.description: Survive alone or with friends in a chaotic frog survival adventure. Fish, loot, steal, throw, poop, and somehow earn enough coins before another ridiculous day begins.

games.name: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
games.description: 高难度物理类 Roguelite 体育游戏，主题是轮椅跳台滑雪。前往 18 个国家参赛，征服评委，打破跳台纪录，并赢得“快乐友谊杯”冠军！

games.name: 进厂模拟器
games.description: 《进厂模拟器》是一款第一人称流水线工厂模拟游戏，支持 1–4 名玩家，赶订单、修故障、对付变异物，一起面对状况层出不穷的流水线，也要收拾彼此制造的烂摊子。

games.name: 百万负翁 Net Worthless
games.description: 讽刺风格的人生理财模拟器。一回合就是一个月：分配时间，上班挣钱，进出股市，在通胀和自己的决定里活下来。选一个角色，帮他圆梦。至少，别死在半路上。

games.name: Xenomire
games.description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

games.name: Not Monsters
games.description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

games.name: 微光旅人 : 细语
games.description:
轻松休闲放置RPG。
透过采集﹑战斗获得素材来打造你的装备，挑战更强的魔物，创造自己的冒险故事。

games.name: Critical Ward
games.description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

games.name: KUKULBAN
games.description: 这是一款关于推动自己的推箱子解谜游戏。在传统的推箱子游戏中，你需要把箱子推到目标点；而在这里，真正需要抵达目标的，是你自己的身体。化身古老传说中的羽蛇神，推动石块、改变身体，在有限的空间中寻找通往终点的道路，体验层层递进、不断带来新发现的空间解谜。

games.name: TOX-17
games.description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

games.name: Escape Them
games.description: Navigate a locked environment to find an escape while avoiding an intelligent, adaptive hunter that reacts to player noise and hiding patterns. Survival hinges on silence, environmental awareness, and outsmarting.

games.name: Hauntasy
games.description:
你相信鬼魂吗？
你和你选择的搭档都是顶尖网红，受邀进入一座闹鬼的祖传庄园，熬过七个夜晚即可赢得100万美元。监视各个房间，管理蜡烛，并在凌晨4点前揭开男爵与男爵夫人隐藏的秘密。体验这场心理奇幻恐怖。

games.name: Party Executable
games.description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

games.name: Smashteroids
games.description: 一款Asteroids式双摇杆肉鸽射击游戏：叠加190+件荒唐强化，让一艘脆弱的小飞船用火力填满整个屏幕。22艘各具专属体系的飞船、22名手工打造的首领、闯入关卡的小头目小队、100+套可解锁涂装，以及通向垂死恒星的分支战役。免费试玩版现已推出。

games.name: Knights & Nonsense
games.description: Knights of Nonsense is a social game with a mini RPG element to it. Run around with your friends using voice chat in a castle playing minigames, throwing tomatoes at who you hate most, role play, PVP and more.

games.name: Hammered Heroes
games.description: 《Hammered Heroes》是一款融合自动战斗与 Roguelite 元素的奇幻冒险游戏。招募一群醉醺醺的英雄，搭配阵容，向地牢深处进发。职业、强化、路线由你来选，打架交给英雄们自己。倒下，变强，再闯一回！

games.name: Black Hollow
games.description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Battle infected hordes solo or in up to four-player online co-op in this first-person dark fantasy roguelite. Harvest ichor, unleash volatile alchemy, and forge monstrous builds across four haunted hunting grounds.

games.name: 死线轮回
games.description: 《死线轮回》是一款末日题材放置防守游戏。在这个世界里，丧尸危机早已取得胜利。被困在不断重启的时间循环中，你需要坚守防线、招募幸存者、升级武器、部署无人机、研究敌人，并在每次战败后重启时间线，以更强的姿态归来，最终打破轮回。

games.name: 纷争之地
games.description: 《纷争之地》是一款经营冒险类卡牌游戏。玩家需要招募人口，经营城镇，搭配队伍，外出探索，挑战敌人，探寻世界真相。

games.name: Tenebrarium
games.description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

games.name: Unclaimed
games.description: 现在是1991年。你独自一人在一处偏远的货运设施里上夜班。随着你不断分拣货物、完成工作，走廊里传来的无法解释的声响、监控摄像头中出现的诡异画面，以及逐渐加剧的不安感，开始将这场夜班变成一场噩梦。

games.name: 沙滩之子
games.description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

games.name: Wooberts
games.description: Grow cute creatures, decorate a floating island, and collect unique companions in the corner of your screen while you work or study.

games.name: 疾风群侠传
games.description: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。

games.name: Debtbound
games.description: Debtbound is an incremental game in which you must try to get a handle on numbers that keeps growing day by day, all set against a relaxing visual and audio atmosphere. The goal is to turn the tide. You have a large skill tree at your disposal, it’s up to you to decide how to break from this cycle.

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.description: 《异星考古学家》是一款轻松悠闲的增量挖掘游戏。使用各式各样可以升级的工具开采矿石、破土掘进、清扫古怪文物，一路向下深入，逐步接近藏在行星核心的秘密。

games.name: 赢麻了 Mahjong Rush
games.description: 《赢麻了 Mahjong Rush》是一款水墨风格的休闲 Roguelike。用麻将牌凑出组合来得分,规则一学就会——没接触过麻将也能玩得转,交互式指引带你从零上手。一路收集花牌、符牌与宝物,把小分滚成大分、一击收割。每一局的路线、Boss 与卡池都随机,局局新鲜。一砚浓墨,一桌好牌。这一局,看看你能不能真正——赢麻了。

games.name: ECHO
games.description: 在身后留下自己的实体分身——然后从上面跃出。Echo 是一款精确解谜平台跳跃游戏：放置回声来铺就道路，冲刺穿过激光，智取每一个房间。没有剧情，没有注水——只有你、你的回声，和下一个挑战。

games.name: Perfectly Fair
games.description: A precision platformer where spikes, lava, Portals, and Switches turn every jump into a puzzle you can only blame yourself for missing. Build your own devious levels in the full in-game Level Builder, then publish them for the whole community to play.

games.name: Rift Raiders
games.description: 撕开裂隙，将里面的一切洗劫一空，扛着战利品撤回家园重建。格子战棋，越贪越险的远征。你每倒下一次，王国就强大一分。

games.name: En Garde Gambit
games.description: 同步心智的决斗：回合制战术 Roguelite。你与敌人各自暗中排兵布阵，随后每一记剑击、每一发火枪弹、每一场爆炸同时揭晓。智取暗藏杀机的六角竞技场，一局一局打造你的怪奇剑士，再到线上合作与对战中一较高下。

games.name: HueTrix
games.description: HueTrix 是一款融合 Roguelike 元素的彩色方块堆叠益智游戏：消除行来赚取金币，再到商店购买强力神话遗物。在七种颜色间连锁连击，叠加永久强化，打造游戏破坏级的强力流派。易于上手，深度无限，完整支持手柄。

games.name: 告白完就逃跑
games.description: 《告白完就逃跑》是一款悬疑冒险 AVG 游戏。学生杜羽的告白受阻，居住的小镇接连出现异象，身边的一切逐渐失控。玩家将从杜羽的视角出发，通过不同的抉择与对话技巧，揭开笼罩在他身边的谜团。

games.name: Lovecraft Locker: Tentacle Office
games.description: Take the role of an otherworldly tentacle entity lurking within a high-rise skyscraper! Infect office lockers, stalk the corridors, and ambush unsuspecting workers from the lockers.

games.name: The Hollowing
games.description: 你接下了一份维修工作，驾驶飞机往返于这座巨构中的聚居地通信塔之间。降落、维修，然后前往下一个任务。能出什么岔子？《The Hollowing》是一款第一人称叙事恐怖飞行模拟游戏，出自《Lorn's Lure》创作者之手。

games.name: The Library Assistant
games.description:
The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections.
Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

games.name: A Dark Cave
games.description: 在残酷的世界中求生，建造并扩展你的村庄，深入下方的黑暗。在这款黑暗文字增量游戏中收集资源、做出艰难抉择，并揭开隐藏于洞穴深处那难以言说的真相。

games.name: 白宫异闻录
games.description: 你是个来参加白宫记者会的记者。散会后，你“不小心”刷开了通往椭圆办公室的侧门，这里空无一人。

games.name: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator
games.description: 在一个饱受战争与瘟疫摧残的王国中经营一家中世纪信鸽邮站。培育并照料信鸽，协商配送委托，建设农场和邮政网络，传递能够重塑贸易、价格、人们生活与梅尔索利亚未来的信息。

games.name: BoxParty!
games.description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

games.name: 主角不想攻略
games.description: 《主角不想攻略》是一部短篇视觉小说，故事主要描述身为校园恋爱游戏主角的童仁，发现自己能看到“攻略对象”对自己的“好感度”。但身为同人女的她只想磕cp，不想谈恋爱！面对“攻略对象”的示好......选择坚定本心，或者是......陷入一场恋爱？

games.name: Nanoquarium
games.description: 一座静谧无声的水族箱，安然栖息在你的屏幕一角。横跨热带、冷水与珊瑚礁三类水缸，收集 200+ 种现实中真实存在的鱼类，繁育出稀有品系，经营属于你的整间鱼房，工作之余让水缸自顾自地运转。没有压力，没有失败——只有你的鱼，悠悠游弋。

games.name: Kitchen of Gods
games.description: Greece is starving! Build and manage your god-run tavérna along the road before Hades lures your people into the Underworld with promises of a full belly.

games.name: Expedition Bonk
games.description: 三个 F 级少女出发讨伐哥布林王的小体量回合制 RPG。攻击和格挡要卡准时机，每个技能都得用在刀刃上，还要在全队共享的技能树上一点点加点，把队伍练强。大约 4 小时就能通关。

games.name: CATHODE
games.description: Build sprawling defensive networks of high-tech turrets and logistics systems to repel massive enemy swarms! Take direct control of your turrets and utilize powerful support powers to repel the invasion!

games.name: The Sin of Ritter
games.description: The Sin of Ritter 是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，在追寻正义的过程中，旅程逐渐演变为一场关于罪恶感、执念与后果的探索。探索阴暗而诡异的环境，在恐惧中求生，并揭开妻子遇害背后的真相。

games.name: Wend
games.description: A tower defense game with a heavy focus on mazing. Includes a campaign, ranked PVP, and an endless PVE mode you can play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. New maps are generated daily, weekly and monthly so you will never run out of content!

games.name: SimPoker
games.description: Build the card room of your dreams. SimPoker is a pixel-art poker-room tycoon: lay out tables, hire dealers, run the cage, manage waitlists and staff, and host nightly tournaments. Every hand is really dealt, so sit down and play yourself or run the floor and rake it in.

games.name: Grave Profits
games.description: Build the most game breaking party you can in this dungeon crawling roguelike auto-battler. Recruit, level up, arrange devastating card synergies, and descend into cursed dungeons alone or with a friend in online co-op

games.name: Vermin God
games.description: A grotesque body horror visual novel inspired by SCP-027, play as the young host of the Vermin God. Wake up in a hidden lab with no memories and experience the terror of a mysterious disease turning your body into a living hive for swarms of pests. Make choices to escape the crawling chaos.

games.name: 最强仙门
games.description: 这是一款宗门经营模拟的游戏。游戏有200多种典籍用于学习技能，有600多个NPC可以进行互动探索，有1200多个法宝用于战斗，至于随机生成的装备那数量则是无穷尽的。同时，你要根据每个弟子的根骨(独有特质)和属性分配不同的工作和任务，带领他们冲破各种劫数和阻碍，最后成就横扫三界的最强仙门！

games.name: Neural Descent
games.description: A 2D platformer with a twist. Jump, dash, and wall cling your way through the decaying program you have called home. You must go through rigorous courses and massive challenges to fully understand the mastermind behind your programming.

games.name: Saturn Rising
games.description: Saturn Rising is a base-building game about constructing a space station to withstand the relentless onslaught of asteroids. Gather resources from asteroids to grow your station. Upgrade your station with powerful technology and design the ultimate station capable of surviving Saturn.

games.name: StarCinder
games.description: Fast-paced multiplayer space combat where three factions battle across arenas, ore runs, and sector conquest with customizable ships, gunships, squadrons, NPC fleets, and progression.

games.name: Ashes of the Crown
games.description: Build a survivor camp, gather resources, craft defenses, and fight as a hero in this singleplayer of an action-RPG RTS hybrid. Survive enemy waves while growing your bases.

games.name: 菌菌岛
games.description: 《菌菌岛》是一款轻松的桌面塔防挂机游戏。小动物们会自动采集、制作、建造和巡逻，帮助它们经营村庄抵御邪恶蘑菇怪物的进攻。慢慢扩建并装饰村庄，收集不同的小动物陪伴你工作学习！与小动物一起夺回小岛吧！

games.name: Ruler of Empires
games.description: 在由钢铁、火药与帝国铸就的时代中引航你的国家。《Ruler of Empires》是一款回合制大战略游戏。改写世纪篇章，逐一征服每一片行省；挽救濒临倾覆的衰落帝国，或是将整个全世界统一在同一面战旗之下。

games.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
games.description: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

games.name: 海鸥灯塔Seagull Lighthouse
games.description: 在一座灯塔里读信、回信、等信。没有倒计时，没有排名，没有任务。只有一片海，一群会送信的海鸥，和一些不知道什么时候漂来的瓶子。瓶子里装着陌生人的人生。你的回信可能会影响他们的故事。在这个焦虑快节奏的年代里，让自己慢下来。

games.name: 男题成双
games.description: Raise Chris over four years, shape his future, and pursue romance with seven unique men in this BL life and dating simulation. Your choices determine his career, relationships, and ending.

games.name: Killer Kevin
games.description: Killer Kevin is a fast paced first person boomer shooter. you play as Kevin, an Australian man who is the apprentice to the wizard Stewart.

games.name: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
games.description: 关于埃及黑社会中的阿努比斯的动作RPG俯视图：快速近距离战斗，抽搐，遗物和与成群的死者和古代神灵的战斗。

games.name: 觅食者
games.description:
《觅食者》是一款融合角色扮演、开放世界探索与模拟经营的游戏。
在这片被各种异化属性影响的大陆上，光影、季节、天气与随时降临的异象，共同塑造着一个不断变化的世界。
你将化身一名觅食者，在光怪陆离的土地间探索、耕种、建造属于自己的据点，与形形色色的伙伴和强敌相遇——
他们外表之下，藏着属于自己的异变形态，读懂他们，你便能借用甚至化身那股力量。
男主或女主，两条独立剧情线，不同的羁绊与选择，将带你走向截然不同的结局，揭开这片大陆背后不止一段的真相。

games.name: Akira's Deep Sea Ventures
games.description: A cozy incremental puzzle game where you solve challenges to gather resources and construct your own infrastructure. Relax at your own pace with zero penalties, upgrade your buildings through an expansion tree, and watch as your business grows deeper into the ocean.

games.name: 疗爆HELAX
games.description: 《疗爆》，独一无二的策略构筑动作射击新作。踏入支离破碎的意识疗界，操控“医疗器具”，猎杀活体病灶。发掘烧蚀症的末日真相，找出并救治”真正”的病人。

games.name: 海陆空四国大战
games.description: 看懂棋盘，也看懂对手。结合暗棋情报、虚实判断与海陆空战术的军事棋类游戏：四人 2v2 协同作战，六人 3v3 抽取身份、推测敌友，或在双人陆战中正面较量。

games.name: Hexzen 六角禅
games.description: 一款六边形逻辑解谜，在缓缓流转的天空下展开。只凭推理解读线索，一步步解开每一个盘面。玩透一段手工打造的战役，随时生成无穷无尽的谜题，再用内置的关卡编辑器设计属于你的挑战。

games.name: 樱桃客栈
games.description:
一款轻交互国风剧情 AVG。你接手奶奶留在深山的无名客栈，告别城市喧嚣。
从山林徒步启程，道具解谜与路径选择交织，山野清风抚平俗世浮躁。形形色色的旅人接踵而至，热闹烟火间暗流涌动。
谨记客栈流传已久的规矩：务必午夜前回房。
樱桃客栈，静候你推门而至。

games.name: Into the Cannon, Cure!
games.description:
Co-op zombie shooter (1–2 players) with thriller elements.
Search the factory complex for valuable medical containers and bring them to the roof. Meet survivors, decide their fate, and piece together what really happened at this facility.

games.name: When Pigs Fly
games.description: Build the plane while you're flying it! When Pigs Fly is a physics co-op game for 1–4 players. Grapple scrap, bolt it onto your cart, and transform into a plane mid-flight. Dodge wolves, fall constantly, and reach the destination island before the whole thing comes apart.

games.name: Squarelings
games.description: 一款支持 4–12 名玩家的混乱合作解谜平台游戏，每个关卡都是对沟通、团队协作与友谊的全新考验。

games.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
games.description: 在15世纪末巴黎的圣母桥（Pont Notre-Dame）上经营花店，生活会是怎样一番景象？你可以个性化装饰你的居所与店铺，传承家族事业，并运用真实的园艺原理培育花卉。这本指南的最后一页，或许正是你现实生活中植物探索之旅的起点。

games.name: My Cozy Cube
games.description: My Cozy Cube is a cozy game about scene stickers. Collage stickers according to the reference, or combine  them freely for your own cube. Have fun with the cozy collage journey with your red panda guide, Chessie!

games.name: Cooking Carnage
games.description: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !

games.name: Digital Romance Memoir
games.description: A total-immersion kinetic novel: boot up a PC running Prisma OS and descend into the psyche of a broken protagonist as 2001 Argentina collapses in the background. Late-night chats, obsession, music, and raw Y2K bleakness.

games.name: Gridiron Grit
games.description: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.

games.name: Axis Flip
games.description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

games.name: KEYKRUNCHER™
games.description:
KEYKRUNCHER™ is the fun and effective treatment for all your keyboard-eating needs!
Look down, follow the monitor, KLICK the correct KEY, and KRUNCH.
Earn enough Compliance Points before IT eats you.

games.name: Waderverse
games.description: Following a large-scale societal collapse, explore a crazy, disturbed world of confrontational sickos and clashing ideologies.

games.name: ORU IN THE VOID
games.description: 这是一款充满氛围感的平台游戏，讲述关于孤独、回忆与内心挣扎的深刻故事。引导奥鲁穿越神秘的虚空，在一段充满象征意义与希望的旅程中克服精准的平台挑战。

games.name: Borrowed Flesh
games.description: 一款身体恐怖题材的卡牌构筑 Roguelike：整支队伍共用一副牌组——英雄倒下时，其所有卡牌也随之死去。从 5 个破碎的灵魂中挑选 3 个，熬过永久的肢体残缺与逐渐崩溃的心智，一路向下，直到你的血肉再也撑不住。

games.name: Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite
games.description: Unique playstyles bring each legend to life in the fight against Hordak’s unstoppable horde. Battle your way through a variety of diverse biomes and obstacles with every playthrough and engage in Trials of Eternia, arcade mini games for precious bonuses.

games.name: FAIL GAMES
games.description: FAIL GAMES 是一款极难但规则简单的小游戏合集。通关一个，解锁下一个。失败也能赚取金币，用来购买服装和特效。简单到连你奶奶都能上手，难到让你想把电脑扔出窗外。还有你奶奶。

games.name: Greed for Glory
games.description: In this chaotic board game, take on the roles of creatures straight out of fables. Use your wits and think carefully about every move to become the richest among your friends and claim the throne. Then, watch your plans unfold before your eyes, because in a fable, nothing ever goes quite as planned.

games.name: Curse of the Chronomancer
games.description: Race against the clock in this top down action roguelike. Trade time for upgrades that will either save you time in the long run, or ultimately lead to your destruction.

games.name: Beyond Acrimony
games.description: Beyond Acrimony is a first-person psychological horror set within the fractured spaces of a grieving mind. Explore shifting liminal environments shaped by emotion, solve cryptic puzzles, and confront what your mind refuses to let go of.

games.name: Contract Terminated
games.description: 在这款采用像素画面、充满复古 80 年代风格的 RPG 游戏中，带领你的雇佣兵小队，在危机四伏的星球上寻找生存之道。游戏融合了经典的网格移动、回合制战术战斗和第一人称地牢探索等元素。

games.name: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
games.description: 经营自己的卡牌店，打开卡包，收集荒诞搞怪的 Grombo。补充商品、制定价格，按自己的想法布置店铺。解锁升级、自动化经营任务，让生意越做越大，同时继续寻找收藏中还缺少的那张卡牌。

games.name: The No Jumpscare Show
games.description: In a world where the paranormal is normal and jumpscares are lazy clichés, Illy signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror. The deal? Survive without getting scared and win $10,000! A totally, 100% jumpscare-free experience :)

games.name: 超好撸的猫 - 桌宠
games.description: 让可爱的小猫在你的桌面安家！收养不同品种的猫咪，陪它们吃饭、睡觉、玩玩具，制作料理，再派它们外出冒险。无论工作还是休息，都有猫咪为你的日常增添热闹与陪伴。

games.name: 从零开始的钓鱼人生Lift
games.description: 首款肉鸽×钓鱼×转生模拟器，无需门槛，1分钟体验台钓乐趣。上百种天赋装备随心组合，每局都有新体验。在轮回中解锁丰富剧情，找到属于你的最好结局。

games.name: 救救我，勇者大人！
games.description: 探索诡异世界，搜集战利品，通过吞噬合成卡牌。《救救我，勇者大人》是一款第一人称卡牌 RPG。锻造装备、搭配天赋，打造属于你的战斗流派。在回合制交锋中寻找胜机，在一声声求救中，决定谁能活下来。

games.name: 不出声
games.description: 《不出声》是一款声控恐怖游戏。你在太平间醒来，唯一规则是保持安静。麦克风会检测任何声音——出声即死。但并非所有规则都真实，你需要分辨谎言。在密封罐中寻找钥匙，活下去。

games.name: XX女王计划
games.description: 这款游戏偏向街机动作玩法，融入了适度的Roguelike和RPG元素。透过简单而爽快的战斗体验冒险故事，与同伴们一同净化身陷危险的女王们，与她们建立深厚的友情，一起拯救世界。

games.name: SCP: Darkwater
games.description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

games.name: Void Inc
games.description: 你是快速成长的 SaaS 初创公司 Void Inc. 的技术负责人，每一个决定都会制造新的问题。规划每天的工作，熬过紧张的技术小游戏，管理不稳定的员工与基础设施，并在压力将你吞噬之前完成公司的目标。

games.name: Immune Response
games.description: An exciting twin-stick shooter with a progressively increasing difficulty. Fight waves of pathogenic enemies, face difficult boss fights and survive for as long as you can!

games.name: Potventure
games.description: Open a restaurant on a fantasy continent and build a culinary empire, one dish at a time. Explore, gather, cook, and expand — while six rival empires plot their own rise. Survive crises, seize opportunities, and carve your own path to victory.

games.name: Tank Mates
games.description: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

games.name: Mourning House
games.description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

games.name: Little Jimmy´s Nightmare
games.description: Little Jimmy's Nightmare is an action roguelite where cute hand-drawn 16-bit charm meets brutal combat, flying guts and powerful item synergies. Explore handcrafted worlds, build outrageous combinations and carve your way through cultists, monsters and bizarre bosses.

games.name: 边陲领主
games.description:
《边陲领主》是一款像素风格的经营建造 + 塔防守城策略单机游戏。
你将作为一名领主驻守王国边境，从零放置建筑、采集木材、矿石等资源发展生产，在城墙上修筑弩炮与投石机；训练士兵，搭配多层陷阱，抵御一波又一波边境入侵者。
平衡资源发展与战场防守，规划专属城防布局，守护你的边陲堡垒，在昼夜交替的坚守中铸就属于你的边境传奇。

games.name: The Golden Girl Case
games.description: As a young private investigator trainee in 2006, you dive into the early internet - social profiles, websites, photos, and archived news - to uncover the truth behind Emily Parker’s death, ruled as an accident after a late-night gathering

games.name: Hexborne
games.description: 在六角格战场上一笔画出不间断的路径：途经的格子化为攻击、护甲、治疗与金币，路径触及敌人的方式决定你挥出的招式。踏过被兽人军团焚毁的王都——暗黑奇幻一笔画 Roguelite RPG，第一章试玩版。

games.name: Turnabout Tactics
games.description: 一款你同时操控双方的国际象棋解谜游戏：没有对手，也没有将死。每一关都有各自的目标。有的棋子被吃时会爆炸，有的冻结或守护周围的格子，有的则能穿过其他棋子。随意回溯，直到所有目标同时达成。

games.name: RoguePunk
games.description: A turn-locked cyberpunk roguelike built around high-stakes quick-time duels. Build lethal cyberware synergies, conquer brutal bosses, and reboot the system.

games.name: The Lost City of Gold
games.description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold.

games.name: Epsilon Zero
games.description: "Epsilon Zero" is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike shooter where every mission is an all-out assault. Use devastating weapon combinations, unlock powerful upgrades, adapt your tactics, and exterminate everything standing in your way.

games.name: Fat Chance
games.description: 在豪宅吞掉你之前逃出去。1–5 人合作恐怖游戏。

games.name: Hidden Cat Islands
games.description: 🐱 Hidden Cat Islands 是一款轻松的 3D 探索游戏，在不同主题的岛屿上寻找隐藏的猫咪。自由移动镜头，使用提示，发现可互动的物品，并寻找隐藏的照片！

games.name: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown
games.description: 与狼伙伴一同踏上旅途，探索第三人称视角的Living World RPG。当你前往别处冒险时，村民仍在生活，冒险者仍在追寻各自的目标。邂逅、传闻与羁绊将延续到旅途的下一站——这个奇幻世界，不会只为你停下脚步。

games.name: Orby vs Rects
games.description:
击碎 Rects。收集 Recties。 升级。 循环挑战。
Orby vs Rects 是一款复古风格射击游戏，传承了 Arkanoid 和 Tetris 等经典游戏的精髓，同时带来节奏明快的弹幕射击体验

games.name: Gull's Gang
games.description: 一款色彩缤纷的地中海派对游戏，最多支持 4 人同乐。装扮你的小鸟，把桌子、板条箱、鱼，以及任何能被你翅膀夹起的东西，统统堆到对手身上。不断扩充的小游戏合集，节奏明快，古灵精怪。支持本地同屏、分屏或局域网。

games.name: The Last Call
games.description:
Every run starts the same. Never ends that way.
Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty.
Only your skill matters.

games.name: VoxMancer
games.description: VoxMancer 是一款语音驱动的 3D 魔法 PvP 游戏。玩家在战斗中喊出自创咒语。魔法是想象力的具现：呼唤元素与奥术力量，用语言塑造属于自己的魔法，让中二、荒诞或临场乱喊的想法化为强大法术——或者一次华丽的施法失败。

games.name: IMITATORS
games.description: 6 人合作恐怖游戏，以及最多 20 人的多人模式。在随机生成的地图上寻找物品，并把它们送进管道。但要小心：普通物品之中潜藏着模仿者（拟态怪），只要灯光一灭，它们就会扑上来。

games.name: Gummy Tummy
games.description: A co-op mining game set in a world made of candy. Bite tunnels through gummy terrain, haul loot and a bellyful of sugar back to the hub, then craft sharper teeth, bigger stomachs and soda-bottle jetpacks to dig deeper. Push past your tier and your teeth corrode go see the dentist!

games.name: 零号变种
games.description: 《VOX Zero》是一款高机动3D体素幸存者游戏。驾驭不断变异的活体变异武器，在立体游乐园中高速走位、跳跃、冲刺、撕开怪潮，并将每件武器进化为毁灭性的超武。

games.name: DinoSWORD
games.description: Dinosaurs...with SWORDS!? When dimensional tears rip through time and space, refined weaponry and prehistoric beast collide! Also includes DINO CHESS, a mode that combines the strategy of CHESS with the savage brutality of 3D DINOSAUR COMBAT!

games.name: ALTER
games.description:
An exorcist descends into a forgotten corner of the Paris catacombs in search of two missing priests. 
Prayers do not work down here.

games.name: SideTower
games.description: A side-view tower offense game where you defeat enemy kingdoms to unlock new towers and weapons, reshape the battlefield, and fight alongside your troops to survive increasingly difficult waves.  Chaotic and fast-paced.  Fulfill your destiny.

games.name: She Only Visits at Night
games.description: A quiet, atmospheric slice-of-life narrative inspired by SCP-134. Work the graveyard shift at a lonely convenience store and form a gentle connection with a strange girl who only visits after dark. Fulfill her small requests, watch the store change, and find comfort in the quiet night.

games.name: The Passport
games.description: Burning the passport means taking another person's life.

games.name: 与中草药娘的日常
games.description: 一款以中医药文化为题材的日常写实向视觉小说。玩家将扮演一名中医药大学的新生，在与由中草药化形的少女灵兰朝夕相处的过程中，逐步了解草药的性味归经与中医的治疗理念，同时带领这位来自千年之前的少女融入现代社会，这款游戏将会带你了解中医学生的日常。游戏采用Live2D技术呈现角色演出。

games.name: 男性止步！美女公寓的秘密
games.description:
影游届女神王涵的首部韩国互动影游作品！
※男性止步※ 你意外成为了女性专用公寓唯一的男保安。
可上班第一天，便接连发生离奇事件……
守护五位性格迥异的美女住户，
开启这场心跳加速、危机四伏的保安日记吧！

games.name: Von Neumann Project
games.description: Von Neumann Project is a space based RTS where you build, mine, and expand across the universe in an attempt to find your creator's equals.  Play across 4 different sectors with 28 handcrafted missions, with each sector introducing unique enemies, buildings, and missions.

games.name: Ghostlock
games.description: 每撑过一轮，那一轮就会化作幽灵归来，分毫不差地重演你的每个动作。触碰过去，即刻死亡。《GHOSTLOCK》是一款 1-bit 街机闪避游戏：每轮都会多出一个幽灵，每隔五轮它们会合而为一，化作首领，而唯一的出路，就是穿过你曾做过的一切。

games.name: Muhit
games.description: Muhit is a story-driven adventure set in an alternative 1990s Istanbul. Search for your missing family, explore the city, meet dangerous people, and slowly climb your way into the criminal underworld. Every job, connection, and decision brings you closer to the truth.

games.name: 心流树屋
games.description: 一间贴在桌面角落的小树屋。番茄王子帮你计时专注，兔嘟嘟替你记着待办，铃兰为你放一首轻轻的歌。专注、完成待办、和精灵们玩耍都能攒下许愿值，换来新装扮、新歌单和树屋装饰。树屋一级级长大，住进来的精灵也会越来越多。

games.name: NeoRunners
games.description: 《NeoRunners》是一部可玩的赛博朋克漫画，也是一款轻度肉鸽卡组构筑游戏。组合🔥燃烧、⚡电涌和💧流涌，触发爆炸性反应；建立关系，解锁新卡牌、改造、服务与剧情路线。

games.name: The Atrium
games.description: Mine your way through a vast cave system that watches as you dig deeper each day. Explore diverse biomes, collect valuable resources and craft increasingly powerful tools and upgrades until you are strong enough to reach the end of the tunnel before it collapses on you.

games.name: Rogue Curling
games.description: 一款类似《Balatro》的Roguelike冰壶游戏，其中基于物理原理的操作技巧与稳固的装备配置同样重要。既可发挥协同效应与精准度，也可打破规则！

games.name: Bravest!2
games.description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

games.name: Backrooms Clicker
games.description: NO ONE HEARS SCREAMS THROUGH THE THICK WALLS OF THE LIMINAL SPACE. Backrooms Clicker is an analog horror idler. Click to drain anomalies, level up your hazmat operative, and send them into the deep field where the entities wait. Bank your loot or lose it.

games.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
games.description: 用你的剑以重金属的节奏摧毁黑暗战士，观看史诗般的电影，同时掌握复杂的战斗系统，在线或离线羞辱你的对手，在这里你会发现开发商以前所未有的方式创造和结合的乐趣、讽刺和战争。

games.name: Observer's Mobius
games.description: 在封闭的立方体中生存下去。你的每一个行动都会被 AI 观察者记录，而他们的判断将决定下一次惩罚或祝福。

games.name: Devil's Sanctum
games.description: 在这款俯视角竞技场射击游戏中，挺过魔鬼的试炼，赢得属于你的自由。化身挑战者坠入地狱，在无穷无尽的恶魔浪潮中杀出血路，并借助强大的调谐能力打造属于你的战斗流派。

games.name: Click Bangbang
games.description: Save the growing Wallflowers from waves of invading insects while helping them spread, grow, and flourish.

games.name: Grim & Bear It
games.description: A dark comedy bureaucracy game where you're the Grim Reaper's overworked intern. Read each soul's case file, check the day's ever-changing rulebook, and stamp them to one of six afterlife destinations before the timer runs out. Eternal judgment, run like a soul-crushing office.

games.name: Lofi Drive
games.description: Relax and unwind in an endless procedurally generated cruise. Unlock new lofi songs, vehicles, biomes, and features by simply stopping at intersections and road signs. No timers, no traffic, no pressure. Just you, the road, and the journey. No MTX, No gatcha, just relaxing and soothing game-play.

games.name: Portal Time Traveller
games.description: 作为某神秘实验室的“实验体247号”，你的任务是穿越时空门户，找回指定的文物。你需要猎杀恐龙、在中世纪帝国中求生、在街头收集关键物资，并穿行于霓虹灯照耀的反乌托邦世界。

games.name: 桌面猫咪点击器
games.description: 如果一款舒适的桌面游戏遇上放置点击游戏会怎样？在《桌面猫咪点击器》中，你的猫会在桌面上闲逛，并在你工作、游玩或放松时获得点数。收集新猫，解锁加成，壮大你的猫咪帝国。

games.name: Click Dystopia
games.description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

games.name: Rapid Raccoons
games.description: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, and grabbing crates by hand or lasso to keep your load aboard. Upgrade your raft, find items and cosmetics, all while trying to meet a quota that continuously gets larger and larger.

games.name: Daemon Doors
games.description:
Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. 
Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

games.name: Ashes of Alice
games.description: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

games.name: Legends of Companion
games.description:
《同伴传说》是一款战略自动战斗 ARPG 肉鸽游戏，每个选择都由你掌控。从4个职业中选
择，深度构建技能树，锻造装备，招募战斗宠物，在不断扩展的世界中开辟道路。精通技能、
装备与队伍组合，将一粒火花化为无敌传奇。

games.name: Voxel Gambit
games.description: Classic chess reborn as a 3D tactical RPG. Command unique pieces based on RPG classes across procedurally generated battlefields. Manage your action points, test your units' 'effort' and survive an adaptive AI on dynamic maps. The board has evolved.

games.name: Protocol: Assimilation
games.description: Awaken your inner speedrunner in this challenging 2D platformer. Strategically combine routes, abilities, and artifacts, choose which obstacles to destroy, and execute every action with precision to maximize your wealth and endure until the end. Die, repeat, and evolve in pursuit of the perfect run.

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.description: The swords are fake, the hits don't count and the monster is just a guy in a costume. Manala is a videogame about live-action roleplay (LARP): build a combat deck, fight other players and argue over armor points.

games.name: Vector Noir
games.description: Simple geometry twin-stick shooter. It's hard on purpose. I'm still working out what the rest of the game is, so follow the page if you want in when I open the playtest.

games.name: The Whispering Walls
games.description: Whispering Walls  is a surreal first-person horror escape game filled with strange rooms, hidden clues, watching eyes, and disturbing human forms. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the mystery, and find a way out before the place claims you.

games.name: Erevael
games.description: Erevael是一款在六角格地图上展开的奇幻RPG，每局的地图都不一样。游戏没有职业之分：你做什么，就在什么上越来越强，从贸易、绘制地图到魔法和战斗都是如此。当你的角色引退后，你将以其继承人的身份继续游戏，并接过其法术、配方和地图。

games.name: CodePhantom
games.description: 《CodePhantom》是一款3D动作游戏，玩家将驾驶人形战斗机甲 PHANTOM（幻影） 执行各种任务。流畅爽快的操作带来驾驶机甲的纯粹乐趣，尽情体验硬核而充满魅力的机甲动作战斗。

games.name: Outspin Champions
games.description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

games.name: Hover Raid
games.description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this very short, linear incremental action game.

games.name: HordeFall
games.description: 《HordeFall》融合了《Bullet Haven》与增量式游戏的特色。通过击杀源源不断的敌人浪潮和BOSS来赚取金钱和声望点数。解锁升级项目，并管理你的经济、属性及法术。你可以积极参与游戏，也可以让游戏在桌面角落自动运行。

games.name: 全小将
games.description: 从半岛的贫农之子，到陆军士官学校的风云人物，再到权倾一国的大统领——最终站上历史的审判席。《全小将》是一款历史养成视觉小说：以回合规划主角的一生，读书、锻炼、钻营、博弈，在每一个关键节点接受时代无情的考验。一步踏错，便是另一种人生。近六十年的风云激荡，这条从茅草屋到总统府的路，你能走到第几步？

games.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
games.description:
Steam 上独一无二的桌面伴侣射击游戏。

你的战士就驻守在你的桌面上待命。每一次点击、每一次按键都是一发子弹——在你处理自己的事情时,他会替你顶住一波又一波的敌人,击杀掉落装备,再逐步强化战备。

games.name: Pokremental
games.description: Pokremental 是一款增量扑克卡牌游戏。翻开卡牌赚钱，购买卡牌和升级，或雇用助手自动化流程。在赌场或技能树中下注，更快地推进游戏进度。

games.name: Unorthodox Rules
games.description: A mystery-comedy deduction adventure inspired by Ace Attorney and Liar Game. Investigate clues, expose contradictions, and survive deadly rule-based games by turning unfair rules against your opponents.

games.name: On The Hook
games.description: 你欠了赌场老板一笔还不清的债，利滚利，一夜重过一夜。几个同样上了钩的代理少女，愿意听你调遣。她们会替你盯紧出手阔绰的豪客、走投无路的输家！在被债务埋掉之前，还清本金，走出赌场大门。

games.name: The Evidence Cleaner
games.description: 黑帮制造混乱，你让一切消失。在这款VR犯罪现场清洁模拟游戏中，亲手擦除血迹、收集证据、处理尸体。用UV紫外线灯搜寻痕迹，升级你的工具，别让警察盯上你。每一次清理的背后，都有一个更大的目标：揭开妻子死亡的真相。在Steam新品节（10月19日至26日）期间免费畅玩试玩版。

games.name: Holdline: Last Gate
games.description: 《Holdline: Last Gate》是一款第三人称塔防生存游戏。采集资源，制造并放置防御塔，在一连串风格各异的外星地图上守住大门——敌潮会同时从每一条战线向你压来。

games.name: 三国老虎机
games.description: 一款以《三国》为灵感打造的独特 Roguelite 老虎机 RPG。招募传奇武将，建立你的军队，施展夸张华丽的奇幻技能，在每一次转动中结合策略与运气，征服战场。

games.name: SpinKnight
games.description: A roguelike where your only move is spinning a sword like a confused ceiling fan. Enemies can't kill you. They just shove you off cliffs while maintaining eye contact. No combos. No health bar. No dignity. Works with mouse or gamepad, both of which you will consider throwing.

games.name: PixelFall
games.description:
A living pixel sandbox where every grain simulates - and every world hides its Keepers.
Dig to the abyss, sail past the clouds, tame a horse, farm, brew, and build. Face seven
sim-bosses you defeat by reshaping the world itself, and mend the heart of your world.

games.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
games.description:
在你的桌面上,打造一座专属于你的迷你水族箱。
《方寸水族》是一款极简几何风格的疗愈养成小品。收集数十种可爱的鱼、虾与螺,布置水草、岩石、灯光与底沙,慢慢拼凑出心目中梦幻的水中世界。每一只小生物都有自己的个性与习性,游动、觅食、躲藏、休息,自在地生活着。
用心喂食与照顾,看着鱼儿悠游、长大,并随时间绽放出绚丽的体色;达成条件,还能解锁一只只华丽奇幻的特殊鱼种,让你的收藏更加丰富。
累了的时候,切换成桌宠模式,让小鱼游在你的桌面上,静静陪你度过每一段忙碌与放松的时光。

games.name: どいなかでリバーシ
games.description: A cozy and gentle Reversi game set deep in rural Japan. Enjoy matches and conversations with Japanese-style characters through Free Match, Story Mode, Tutorials, Puzzles, and Endgame Puzzles.

games.name: Dark Inquiry - Profane Soil
games.description: Investigate an abandoned farm where mysterious accidents have brought the construction of a luxury resort to a halt. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets buried beneath decades of silence.

games.name: Dyeversion
games.description: Dyeversion 是一款颜色布线塔防游戏。把软管从颜色源拖到你的塔上，混合颜色锻造强大的 COMBO 塔，并让管线绕开敌人路径。征战数十个关卡，赚取代币，解锁一棵深邃的技能树。

games.name: Galacto
games.description:
A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your 
screen. Run a space gas station, refuel ships, hire bots, 
chain combo for fat payouts, and rebuild an outpost into 
the busiest stop in the galaxy!

games.name: Time, Line
games.description: Limited to moving left and right, every step you take pushes time forward. Thread through minimalist environments and discover how much depth can exist on a single line.

games.name: Stellar Harvest
games.description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

games.name: Grr Grr Gnomes
games.description: 一款关于微小地精在大海中冒险的合作游戏。在岛屿之间航行，搜集物资，对抗怪异生物，在各种绝境中求生，并推动船只朝向唯一的目标前进：找到回家的路……

games.name: Hollow
games.description: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

games.name: Poking Nun
games.description: An adult NTR visual novel set in a fantasy medieval world. Watch helplessly as you lose your pure, devoted nun wife to corruption and lust.

games.name: Digital Druid
games.description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

games.name: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
games.description: Alpha 7: The Last Hope: A frantic one-button bullet hell style space cyberpunk. Survive with Dave across 6 stages, master 12 ships, unlock the Lore, and enjoy the original jukebox. An extreme, fully inclusive challenge.

games.name: Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator
games.description: A game about hanging out with friends as a cute ball and relax. Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator gives you an out of the world experience of the life of a happy ball. Do nothing or do the ball thing.

games.name: Golfcremental
games.description:
BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY!
Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

games.name: Click the Cubes
games.description: 一款没有方块能够幸存的点击游戏。点击破坏，并用内置编辑器创建自己的关卡。

games.name: The Big Suck
games.description: 你就是龙卷风。在这款越拆越强的增量游戏里，从拔草起步，一路横扫农田、卷飞汽车、拆掉建筑。把破坏赚来的钱砸进庞大的技能树，下一局卷得更大、更狠。

games.name: Off Axis
games.description: An action packed sci fi FPS set aboard a massive spaceship, where reversing gravity changes the way you fight and the environment helps you eliminate enemies.

games.name: 崇祯模拟器
games.description: 崇祯十七年，大明风雨飘摇——李自成揭竿西北，后金铁骑叩关辽东，国库空虚、党争不休、天灾连年。你将扮演大明最后一位皇帝崇祯，在这盘注定败局的棋上落子：批阅奏疏、平衡朝堂、调度钱粮、任免文武。每一位大臣都由 AI 驱动，会揣摩圣意、结党营私、阳奉阴违。你的每一道旨意都在改写历史——是重蹈煤山自缢的覆辙，还是力挽狂澜、再造大明？

games.name: Pride City
games.description: You are a superheroine who protects the community while balancing everyday life: paying rent, going to work, and leading a queer neighborhood community. Can you handle it all? Make choices, build relationships, and save the neighborhood.

games.name: AMEN: MAYHEM
games.description:
这是一款玩家之间纯粹互相厮杀的游戏。最多12名格斗者参与其中，在俯视角像素画风下展开血腥激烈的战斗。
击败对手后，对方留下的所有物品均可据为己有。
本作的设计灵感源自《Nox》的死亡竞赛模式。

games.name: The Last Spire 2
games.description: Upgrade, evolve, and mutate powerful spells as you defend the Last Spire in this strategic incremental tower defense with endless progression and customizable spell loadouts.

games.name: Realm Tycoons
games.description: Realm Tycoons is a turn-based fantasy strategy board game where rival rulers claim realms, build economies, grow armies, cast spells, upgrade strongholds, and battle for control of the kingdom.

games.name: Untitled Ghost Game
games.description: You are dead. Now make it everyone else's problem.

games.name: Butaro's Overtime Office
games.description: 一款关于逃离“996”职场生活的轻松放置类游戏。领养“武太郎”（Butaro）——一个身心俱疲的上班族，让他在你的桌面上安家。在你工作或休息的时候，看着他在枯燥乏味的工作中偷懒摸鱼、装饰办公室并提升职场技能。究竟是你先摆脱职场倦怠，还是武太郎先一步逃离呢？

games.name: Last Writes
games.description: Last Writes is a sound-based puzzle game with very sparse and cryptic instructions, reflecting on what remains of religion in a world that has long strived to overcome it. Follow the signal and confront a rogue AI that sees you as its God.

games.name: DIBARO (秘狩困斗)
games.description: 最多 6 人的在线对战。掷骰获得火・水・土・风・无魔素，在六角棋盘上最多 6 个阵营同场争霸。攻守皆由属性相克决定胜负，重新排列魔素就是「卡组构筑」。在运气与战术交错的博弈中，撑到最后的人获胜。以进化与装备培养超过 60 名 Hunter，挑战 Challenge、Survival 与身分隐匿的 Demon & Hero。支持与浏览器版的跨平台对战。

games.name: Time Stop Tower Defense
games.description: 一款以时间操控为核心机制的高速塔防游戏，融合丰富剧情、成长系统与世界观构建。

games.name: Angel Offline
games.description:
A stranger texts your phone by mistake. You could ignore it, the way everyone ignores everything now. 

Instead, you answer.

Angel Offline is a short visual novel about one accidental conversation that becomes something more, told entirely through the messages you choose to send.

games.name: Find Cats 9: 寻宝猫咪
games.description: 三大史诗奇幻战场，藏满萌猫等你发现！宝库王冠争夺战、深海沉船美人鱼斗海盗、矮人金库抢酒壶——一起寻找。

games.name: Roll and Die
games.description: 一款 push-your-luck 骰子 roguelite。贪婪给你力量。贪婪要你的命。留下你满意的点数，其余的 push 出去重掷，然后祈祷别掷出 Skull。爬出深坑，一路杀到坐庄的那位神面前。

games.name: Feastfall
games.description: Feastfall是一款烹饪类Roguelike牌组构筑游戏。将食材牌放入食谱中，堆叠破坏游戏规则的法术协同，并喂饱贪婪的怪物。这不是一个厨房模拟器。这是在餐桌上的生死豪赌——而餐馆已经饥肠辘辘。

games.name: Cute & Dead
games.description: A fast, absurd VR arcade shooter about a nerd, a zombie apocalypse, and thirty girls who need rescuing. Ridiculous weapons, a very good dog, and a dance floor waiting at the end of every run.

games.name: Civitas: World Simulator
games.description: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.

games.name: VANDALISM101
games.description:
VANDALISM101: An Office Simulation Visual Novel!
You’ll become a new employee at the mysterious, top-secret research facility VANDALISM101.
Complete the tasks assigned to you, boost your performance, and survive!

games.name: Inside You
games.description: Inside you are two women. One says you love her. The other also says you love her. You are in danger.

games.name: Vanguard's Descent
games.description: 在这款 3D 动作 Roguelite 中组建三人英雄小队：实时闪避攻击，暂停战斗以指挥技能，并组合角色专属流派，构筑强力协同。招募新的 Vanguard 成员，彻底根除染疫者这一席卷世界的疫病！

games.name: Chako
games.description: 在融合了“弹幕射击”与桌游RPG机制的等距视角动作Roguelite游戏中，在如潮水般的敌人中生存下来。在程序化生成的地下城中自动攻击，在事件节点投掷d20骰子，收集战利品并在基地升级法术与装备。主宰排行榜吧！

games.name: Market Panic
games.description: 《市场恐慌 Market Panic》是一款关于在经济动荡中求生的回合制投资组合 roguelite。在公开市场、私募股权与加密资产之间建起一只基金，并读懂里面的每一家公司。你要面对可能离开的客户、觊觎他们的竞争对手，以及会来找你的投资委员会。

games.name: Pogo to the Moon
games.description: 你是一只装备了弹跳杆的绵羊，你的目标是到达月球！收集金币，升级你的能力，征服各种平台，从你的家一路攀登到月球。

games.name: MR.EXPLORER
games.description: Explore the world, swap your body parts to gain unique abilities, uncover hidden secrets, and recover all 16 lost packages.

games.name: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
games.description: 地狱最深处，一场在国际象棋棋盘上展开的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑对决。七宗罪的罪王，正等着向你发起挑战。召唤棋子，甩出法术，为麾下大军烙上咒印，赶在回合耗尽前打空罪孽之王的血条。七宗罪，七罪王，一副牌。

games.name: Rinha de Waifus
games.description: Be the strategist behind cute waifus in a tactical, chaotic auto battler: set your formations, pick each one's playstyle, then watch it go gloriously right! Or wrong?! Solo campaigns and challenges, online 1v1s against friends, a roguelite Arena and a ranked Ladder for the ambitious.

games.name: Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection
games.description: 一款掠夺宝箱的增量游戏。破坏宝箱、收集独特卡片，获得无穷无尽的强化。解锁更高级的卡包、发现更强大的卡片，并不断扩充你的收藏。

games.name: BONKER LADS
games.description:
A first-person physics party game about chaotic close-range fights.
Knock enemies off the edges of arenas to win.

games.name: ToadPonds
games.description: 建造并装饰宁静的池塘，收集并照料独特的青蛙，打造属于自己的舒适湿地天堂。定制每个栖息地，培育繁荣的生态系统，按照自己的节奏享受轻松惬意的自然模拟体验。

games.name: The Next Room
games.description: The Next Room 是一款3D动作Roguelite游戏，每一间房都是全新挑战。你将战斗怪物、躲避致命陷阱、探索隐藏秘密、收集装备并强化build，在不断变化的地牢中对抗强大Boss，尽可能生存更久。

games.name: 百目ノ花贄
games.description:
A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals — Hyakume no Hananie
Tokyo, 202X.
On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives.
You don't recognize the sender's name, but the return address bears the name of a village that was supposed to have vanished...

games.name: Classroom 3B
games.description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi voice work in this psychological horror investigation.

games.name: 漫画大冒险
games.description: 一款以擦除与绘制为核心的2D平台动作冒险轻肉鸽游戏。可投掷橡皮擦除敌人与障碍，并使用钢笔消耗颜料绘制道路，在随机漫画世界中前进、探索，战斗并收集藏品。

games.name: 鸭鸭贴纸
games.description: 《鸭鸭贴纸》是一款轻松可爱的“贴纸拼图”游戏。打开一包包色彩缤纷的主题贴纸，观察每枚贴纸独特的轮廓、图案与画面线索，将它们拖到正确位置，伴随舒适自然的吸附反馈，逐步拼出一幅幅热闹又充满惊喜的贴纸画面。游戏包含约150个精心设计的关卡，鸭鸭会与众多有趣形象在不同主题中登场。丝滑的关卡体验，没有倒计时，没有失败压力，在舒缓的节奏中享受整理、拼合与完成作品的满足感。

games.name: Picofender
games.description: 《Picofender》是一款增量型防御动作游戏。玩家使用光标控制勇者，与同伴一起守护村庄。击败敌人赚取资源，强化技能树、装备与主动技能。突破汹涌而至的波次（Wave），以击败魔王为目标吧！

games.name: Type the World
games.description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. That’s it, that’s the game. For kids and grownups.

games.name: Can't Escape It
games.description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

games.name: Fall Off Reach
games.description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

games.name: Ravenian Conquerors
games.description: A real-time sandbox strategy game across the vast archipelago of Ravenia, with a new island every play. Lead a faction, raise armies, and seize cities as you evolve through four ages. Prepare for a cosmic crisis that could end everything. Stand against it, or become the crisis itself.

games.name: GrindFall
games.description: 一款惊险刺激的1-4人合作动作 Roguelite游戏！扮演淘气的幽灵，创造疯狂的武器协同效应，捕捉人类并把他们变成南瓜。将收成送回墓穴以扩张地图，在这款弹幕天堂（Bullet Heaven）游戏中掀起色彩斑斓的混乱风暴！

games.name: Pickup Point Simulator
games.description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

games.name: Laboratorio de Videojuegos
games.description: Play, create, and share 3D platformer levels while discovering the secrets of video game design. Learn by creating, overcome challenges, and become the designer of your own adventures.

games.name: Studio zero
games.description: 《Studio Zero》是一款第一人称赛博朋克真人互动（FMV）惊悚游戏。在这个由超级财阀统治的未来，你的每一个选择都将决定你的命运。你是会打破这个系统、沦为财阀的傀儡，还是消失在霓虹交织的黑夜之中？踏入其中——你的选择将塑造最终的结局。

games.name: Yakko Tako
games.description:
Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly,
tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky.
One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

games.name: The City Of Akhetaten
games.description: Fight, gather, build, and explore in a fast-paced top-down Action RPG. Battle ruthless enemies, gather resources, build your own city, craft powerful gear, and explore mysterious realms through ancient portals.

games.name: Love Joy Happiness
games.description: 一款关于人生中重要之事的简短 incremental（渐进/放置）游戏。

games.name: Mingle
games.description: A multiplayer hide and seek game about hiding as a Wolf among a flock of NPC sheep.

games.name: Bloom Busters
games.description: 痛击并轰飞成群的突变生物，修复受感染的花园，守护昔日祥和的Bloomland。这是一款节奏明快的动作街机游戏，可单人游玩或本机合作。收集资源、种植花卉、喂养动物、完成园艺工作，并征服难度会自动调整的手工打造关卡。

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.description: 经营一家混乱的加油站沙盒游戏：给汽车加油，清洗和维修车辆、购买各种奇特工具、抓捕通缉司机、赚取评价、解锁升级内容、登上排行榜，或让每一次停靠都变成一场彻底的混乱。

games.name: Outbreak Z
games.description: 款末日题材的小队制自动战斗RPG。招募三名毫无共同点的幸存者，在死城里搜刮装备，沿着各自的升级树逐个培养，再把他们送进尸潮。每一波战斗，他们都靠自己打。能不能活着回来，全看你。

games.name: The Last Frame
games.description: Step into your late father's abandoned workshop, where unfinished paintings become living memories. Solve environmental puzzles, restore forgotten artwork, and uncover the story hidden within his final masterpiece.

games.name: Project Quickgunner
games.description: Project Quickgunner is a linear, first-person shooter, multi-level game where you go on various missions from cityscapes, hidden laboratories, and more - finding important items and eliminating those who stand in your way.

games.name: THW's Calcudoku
games.description: Fan of Sudoku, logic or puzzles? Try THW's Calcudoku, the most addictive logic game ever according to THW. Unlimited puzzles, no ads, one low price, can it really be true! Yes! Whether you've never heard of Calcudoku, Mathdoku, Kenken or you're an expert, THW's has unlimited puzzles for you.

games.name: Smooch King
games.description: Build your perfect self and win hearts across Paradise City in an anime-style idle dating sim. Train your stats, meet a growing cast of characters, discover their personalities, choose thoughtful gifts, go on dates, and turn new encounters into lasting relationships.

games.name: Crooked Derby
games.description: Secretly bet on one of six horses, publicly claim who you support, then manipulate the race with face-up cards while your opponents decide whether to call your bluff. A turn-based board game for 2–6 players, playable solo or online.

games.name: Box Flow
games.description: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

games.name: VERAKORIA
games.description: Choose your race and class, create a unique build, and battle relentless hordes in VERAKORIA. Collect experience, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat deadly bosses, and survive the escalating onslaught in this pixel-art action roguelite.

games.name: Midnight Moving Crew
games.description: 《午夜搬家队》（Midnight Moving Crew）是一款支持1至4名玩家的合作类恐怖模拟游戏。打卡上班，清空屋子，并熬过这段值班时间。你可以购买电磁场探测器和护身符，驱逐潜伏在屋内的超自然实体——但无论如何，千万别让自己成了这栋房子的下一位“永久住户”。

games.name: Harpoon Crew
games.description: 招募船员：须能经营店铺且熟练使用鱼叉。1-4人 Co-op。报酬丰厚。请无视关于受诅咒水域的传言。建立你的渔业生意，在超自然的海域中乘风破浪，并将你的渔获带回店铺。

games.name: For Her Crown
games.description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, protect its last survivors, and fight to reclaim what was lost. Explore a dangerous dark fantasy world, gather resources, build your stronghold, and fight for her crown.

games.name: Medium Rare
games.description: Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.

games.name: Spirefall
games.description: （目前仅支持英文）一款单人 Roguelite 卡组构筑游戏，你的要塞也会还击。在回合制卡牌对战中部署单位、施放法术、释放要塞武器。操控五大阵营闯过三座酒馆的试炼，每一场试炼的尽头，都有一位身怀绝技的 Boss。

games.name: Counterweight
games.description: 3 至 8 人社交推理堆塔游戏。堆叠方块，盖起高塔，并找出团队中那个故意捣乱的家伙。抢夺随机刷新的道具，投票放逐你最怀疑的人，抢在一切崩塌之前锻造出破坏者探测器。

games.name: Freeze Line
games.description: 时间，正在碎裂。你在钟楼中醒来——没有记忆，只有一块尚有余温的怀表，和师傅交予你的使命：拾回散落各处的时间碎片，让世界重归完整。冻结时间，瞄准冲刺，从一切想要你性命的东西之间穿身而过——然后，回到那个派你出发的人面前，去面对一个足以改写一切的真相。

games.name: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator
games.description: Found a colony, dig a nest, and raise an empire of ants in a giant's back garden. A top-down colony sim of pheromone trails, brood and castes, foraging, and three-way war. Survive a whole backyard food chain of spiders, birds, frogs, and rival ant colonies.

games.name: Annie's DineInn
games.description: 一款白天温馨、夜晚恐怖的烹饪游戏。你和女儿成为一家废弃汽车旅馆和餐馆的主人。开始做饭、出租房间，并通过其他工作偿还贷款。但要小心你的选择，因为它们可能会回来困扰你。（独立开发者作品）

games.name: Ignite the Depths
games.description: 《点燃深渊》是一款氛围感十足的暗黑奇幻风PvE地牢闯关游戏，你将在一座手工构筑的庞大迷宫中开启冒险。你可以选择独闯黑暗世界，或与最多3名玩家联手展开合作冒险。你能否征服深渊？

games.name: 纵横商海
games.description:
从注册公司到上市IPO，体验真实的商业经营。股票板块轮动、房产买卖、数百个随机事件、VC融资、并购、银行理财、多周目继承。每
一步决策，都在书写你的商业传奇。

games.name: Coppers & Thieves
games.description: Coppers & Thieves is a party hide and seek game for 3-8 players that combines strategic stealth gameplay with fast paced party action.

games.name: 星塔游戈
games.description: 这里是梭傩轨道空间站。敌人在地表的进攻很快就会开始。请合理地运用你的资源：大量功能各异的防御塔，强大的空间站支援技能，为防御塔提供附加效果的插件，具有丰富支援功能的基地，来对抗各种各样、具有不同能力的外星生物、无人机械、异星造物，同时探索梭傩不为人知的秘密…
games.developer: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio

games.name: Me, Bitten
games.description:
孤身一人做足生存准备的生存主义者，却意外被僵尸咬伤。虽觉荒谬，
但绝不打算就此等死。探索四周寻找物资，制作疫苗与武器吧。抑制感染，
消灭僵尸。活下去。仅此而已。

games.name: Wandering Squid
games.description: Dive beneath the depths and explore a vast underwater world, hunt for prey and evade predators to survive - or not.

games.name: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
games.description:
来到东京，开始你的留学生活！
上课、备考、打工赚钱，办理各种留学手续；也可以做饭、健身、逛街、刷视频，在陌生的城市里认识形形色色的人。
但别忘了时间、金钱和精力都是有限的。每一天都由你安排，每一个选择都可能改变结局。
在这款像素风留学生生存模拟游戏中，度过属于你的东京生活吧！

games.name: The Christmas Shift
games.description: The Christmas Shift is a cozy horror game where you work the holiday shift at a local café. Prepare hot drinks, serve fresh pastries, and keep your customers happy.

games.name: Gods of the Grid
games.description: 在三消肉鸽游戏中一路奋战，登上奥林匹斯山。匹配符文来攻击和治疗，施放法术并获取遗物，找出每个敌人隐藏的弱点。九大领域、七位半神，每局只有一条命。

games.name: shatAAAAp!
games.description:
呈指数级增长的可爱动物浪潮，需要越来越荒谬的毁灭手段。
射击、焚烧、电击、爆破……并确保没有任何人能帮到你。

games.name: Violence of Action
games.description: 即时指挥小队，暂停以协调复杂攻势，或随时直接操控任意士兵与载具。在受二战启发、程序生成的战术战役中，于可破坏的战场上浴血奋战。

games.name: PSYCHE
games.description: A fast-paced surreal arena shooter where first, second, and third person collide. Pull off backflips, bunnyhops, uncover secrets and unlockables, climb the leaderboards, and master your PSYCHE.

games.name: Jubaku
games.description: 一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏,拥有分支选择和多重结局。调查一栋闹鬼的房屋,记录超自然现象,揭露隐藏的录音,并决定是直面还是逃离潜伏其中的恐怖。

games.name: SLYTHE
games.description: A snake made of heroes. An arena full of things that want it dead. Steer, stack classes, build something broken, and dive past the final boss into endless depths, New Game+, and a global leaderboard. The snake never stops - can you keep up?

games.name: What Was That?!
games.description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

games.name: Mayhem Duck Simulator
games.description: 准备好体验成为一只橡皮鸭的自由了吗？🦆《Mayhem Duck Simulator》是一款既放松又充满混乱的物理沙盒塑料鸭模拟器。控制每一只鸭子，解救特殊伙伴，大闹泳池！无论你渴望宁静还是纯粹的疯狂，整片泳池都听你号令！✨🛸🔥

games.name: Unwanted Guest
games.description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

games.name: 福尔丘利亚：贸易航路的开拓者
games.description: 在《Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers》中扬帆启航吧。掷骰航行于大海，买卖贸易品积累财富，并在每次游玩都会变化的世界中，与竞争对手船长们争夺全球霸权的桌游 × 贸易策略游戏。

games.name: Vanguard Monsters
games.description: Vanguard Monsters is a run-based creature raising roguelike autobattler.  Hatch a team, evolve them to more powerful forms, and collect gear to defeat the endless forces of the encroaching void.

games.name: No Death No Life
games.description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

games.name: Cake & Bake
games.description: 为你那些庆祝生命中珍贵时刻的顾客们，亲手烘焙、装饰并呈上精美的蛋糕。精心定制每一个订单，用全新的食材与装饰不断升级你的点心屋。在属于你自己的舒适节奏中，打造出小镇上最温馨、最治愈的蛋糕店。

games.name: Mr. Zippy is Watching
games.description: You shouldn't be awake. After watching a late-night show about urban legends, paranoia takes hold: has your favorite toy, Mr. Zippy, come to life? Explore the house and survive this tense narrative-driven mascot horror experience featuring puzzle mechanics.

games.name: Cardume
games.description: 一款实时PvP卡牌对战游戏，交战双方是由数千个活细胞组成的蜂群。构筑一套塑造蜂群行为的卡组，再用几张恰到好处的卡牌扭转战局。看得入迷，钻研不尽。

games.name: The Rug Racket
games.description: 继承一家破旧的地毯清洁店，掌握一门令人满足的手艺。一次一个污渍地除尘、清洗、漂洗和恢复地毯。建立声誉，维持运营，并从掌控你债务的黑帮家族中挣脱出来。每块地毯都是一次小小的胜利，而每一次贡金支付都意味着你尚未自由。

games.name: MindGate CornerGet
games.description: 在任务栏里持续战斗的放置刷宝游戏。屏幕下缘的细长窄条中，Q版小英雄们迎击一波波来敌。你要做的，只是想起来时换上捡到的装备、重配技能——其余一切，都在屏幕角落里自行推进。

games.name: The Peg Mines
games.description: 《弹珠矿坑》是一款增量游戏，以弹珠机的玩法为核心，你将用亲手制作的弹珠开采矿石。不仅要开采矿石，还要打造新弹珠，搭配弹珠，向矿井更深处进发！

games.name: The Sixth Sin
games.description: 《第六罪》是一款恐怖遊戲，你將在其中對抗惡魔、超自然生物與各種謎題，並憑藉自己的智慧生存下來。引導你的聲音正是來自它們。管理你的裝備、完成儀式，切勿放手光與魔法道具。

games.name: Still Trails: Camping
games.description:
HIKE & CAMP
Step into the still trails of this stylized nature game. Walk down the pathways until you find the perfect spot to set down your camping. Place the tent, light up the fire and let the relaxation begin! Sounds of nature, the landscapes and the views will guide you to a peace of mind.

games.name: Taxi Shift
games.description: Rent a taxi, cover your 8-hour in-game shift costs, and try to finish with a profit. Navigate without a GPS route line by reading the map, street names and landmarks, then choose the best route for each fare.

games.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
games.description: 一款氛围温馨的营地建造游戏，你可以用迷人的装饰、温暖的灯光和轻松的氛围，打造中世纪奇幻营地。

games.name: Singularity Drift
games.description: Feed a hungry black hole. Haul debris into the void, devour whole biomes, then collapse everything in a Singularity to grow stronger forever. A cosmic idle game about gravity, greed, and infinite prestige.

games.name: Crownfront
games.description: 一款在房间地板上的棋盘上进行的中世纪回合制策略游戏。采集木材和食物，建造农场和兵营，组建军队，攻下敌人的城堡。每个单位每回合都要吃饭，所以你的农场决定了军队能有多大。

games.name: 数织艺术
games.description: 数织解谜 + 知识收集

games.name: Moki x Moki: your business!
games.description:
Get dressed up and put on your best apron, because it's time to get to business!

With the help of a zombie waiter or a fairy manager or even a bunny barista, upgrade your cafe and decorate apartments to help bring life back to the neighborhoods of Moki!

games.name: Debate!
games.description: Defend the indefensible! A chaotic online debate game with proximity voice chat, live approval ratings, and a ravenous audience. Propose absurd topics and influence the room to win votes!

games.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
games.description: 打造属于你自己的酒庄，酿造非凡美酒，让声誉伴随每一季佳酿不断提升。解锁配方、掌握新技术、举办酒庄活动、历经四季轮回——因为卓越的酿酒工艺是一门艺术，每一瓶酒都在讲述自己的故事。

games.name: 只开宝箱
games.description: 《只开宝箱》是一款增量、休闲游戏，在游戏中玩家将使用各种各样的武器去摧毁样式新奇的宝箱，并体会到从开始的缓慢到后面的富有激情的节奏、一步一步变强的成就感。

games.name: マキコマレイド
games.description:
Lure enemy bullets, sweep them in, and send them crashing back! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy!
A boy named Alta stumbles upon a mysterious disc—and sets off into the vast "Sea of Data" that lies within.

games.name: Hatch'n'Wall
games.description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

games.name: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
games.description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

games.name: Tapis
games.description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points.  To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

games.name: Log Drop
games.description: 一款物理沙盒，只有一个崇高的目标：把多到不合物理常理的原木送进地核。砍树、搭装置，再放出一波原木潮，靠连击狂赚金币。可以躺平看它自己流，也可以精心设计完美的原木瀑布。你的沙盒，你说了算。

games.name: Next Station is...
games.description: 你驾驶着今晚的末班地铁。检查每一座站台，观察乘客，并决定是打开车门还是直接驶离。做出错误的选择，某种东西或许会和他们一起上车。

games.name: 鼠鼠的桌面环游
games.description: 欢迎来到小鼠chichi的世界！你的小鼠chichi是一个拥有远大梦想的旅行家，ta唯一的行李就是——一颗小球！你可以在工作与学习的过程中陪伴chichi，让ta的旅途更加多姿多彩。

games.name: Shorted
games.description: Balatro 式计分，在 9×9 网格上展开。你的牌组就是棋盘：将同色 Packet 连成得分形状，安装改写规则的 Patch，并重构填满网格的牌组。六道 Firewall 横亘在你与爆表高分之间。

games.name: GoKaboom!
games.description: Be ready to GO KABOOM! in this chaotic couch party game. Upgrade your mortar with various frantic combinations and blow up your friends to win the game!

games.name: Fractured
games.description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

games.name: Glooky: Cursors in the City
games.description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

games.name: Silent Protocol
games.description:
Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way
through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

games.name: Lost Ball: Homeward Bound
games.description: One lost ball. One epic journey home. Bounce, roll and blast your way through a 3D world of colourful environments from gritty cityscapes to fantastical worlds. Master new abilities, overcome tricky obstacles and solve challenging puzzles along the way. Ready to roll? Then let’s bounce

games.name: Dream Glitcher
games.description: Dream Glitcher is a hand-drawn 2D point-and-click cyberpunk adventure that plays like an interactive graphic novel, blending dark psychological mystery with dark sci-fi atmosphere in a vibrant retro-futuristic world. Enter the memories of an android Luna and help her understand what she has become.

games.name: Path of Damned
games.description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

games.name: 便利店幸存者
games.description: 神秘的连锁便利店“SHIFT24”。夜越深，古怪的顾客就越是没完没了地涌来。泡面、零食、咖啡，便利店里能抓到的一切都能成为武器。击退顾客的过程中，你会逐渐注意到隐藏在世界各地分店里的可疑线索。循着线索，逐步还清债务，SHIFT24的真相也将浮出水面。

games.name: Monto: TB or not TB
games.description: 一款常驻任务栏的放置怪兽 RPG。游戏运行时，你的 Monto 会在选定关卡持续战斗、击败 Boss、收集战利品，并参加异步 PvP。孵化新的 Monto，优化流派，在 Steam 社区市场交易珍贵掉落，并攀登 PvP 与 PvE 排行榜。

games.name: Backstabbers
games.description: Backstabbers 是一款 4 人在线社交策略卡牌游戏。你们以朋友的身份开始，却可能以敌人的身份结束——因为玩的不只是手里的牌，还有彼此之间的友情。建立临时联盟、背叛、复仇，并破坏对手的计划。

games.name: A Simple job 2
games.description: 💼 One simple task. Countless choices. But what if your job was never the real objective? 😏 Experience absurd humor, discover bizarre endings, unlock achievements, and uncover what's really hiding behind it all.

games.name: Medovox
games.description: Medovox is an incredibly atmospheric sandbox farming simulator with realistic stylized graphics. Buy cars, build up your farm, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world with very beautiful nature. Earn your first million!

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: Hungry Hungry Human
games.description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

games.name: Wholesale Tycoon
games.description: Turn an empty warehouse into a members-only empire. Wholesale Tycoon is a top-down management sim where you design the aisles, stock every shelf, hire staff straight off the sales floor, and watch shoppers pack their carts and pile up at checkout.

games.name: Boy with One Eye
games.description: 《Boy with One Eye》是一款采用独特童话绘本风格的心理与哲学视觉小说。

games.name: Blackbriar Crypt
games.description: 带领三名注定失败的佣兵，穿越瘟疫 Roguelite。战利品须逐一放入 4×4 背包，相邻组合触发连携、诅咒、火焰、毒素与生存战术。

games.name: Click&Fix
games.description: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

games.name: Nightmere
games.description: 1991. A detective, a missing girl, and a horrific truth. Nightmere is a psychological horror-mystery about identity, change, and the secrets we keep from ourselves. Investigate the disappearance of a young woman in an isolated town where everyone is hiding something...especially you.

games.name: ERLIK
games.description: 突厥民俗恐怖题材的弹幕天堂（Bullet Heaven）肉鸽游戏。每一局都在两位神明之间飘摇：饲喂 Erlik 的腐化，换取狂暴之力与吸血；或升向 Tengri 之光，获得护盾与新生。堕入黑暗，还是迎向光明，每次抉择都将重塑你的战局。

games.name: Panic Pub
games.description: Run a pub with your friends. Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up. As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, dishes, and tougher nights!

games.name: Sudokiller
games.description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

games.name: Campaign Forge
games.description:
Infinity grows - Your story never ends. Create worlds, heroes, and play your legends chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers you and your Party. Generate it free and fully offline, then change it how you want. 
Campaign Forge - The 2D Infinite Story RPG.

games.name: Alia Domus
games.description: 在这款像素风生存RPG中探索并殖民一颗未知星球。收集资源、完成任务并制造人类不同时代的科技，将Alia Domus变成家园。从基础生存开始，最终达到文明 class的辉煌。

games.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
games.description: 砸烂皮纳塔，收集糖果，掌控全场！这是一款节奏飞快的主动式放置增量游戏，观众替你出手。升级你的竞技场，在赌场里搏一把，让数字疯长，永不停歇！

games.name: Market at Moonfall
games.description: Build and manage a medieval fantasy market by day, then defend it from the monsters your merchants attract at night. Interview strange sellers, shape your town, upgrade your gear, and decide how much danger is worth the profit.

games.name: Pro Wrestling: The Ascent
games.description: Forge your path in professional wrestling as an unknown rookie and climb the ranks through training, matches, bookings, and rivalries in a deep single-player career simulator.

games.name: 绝空炮火
games.description: 一款融合库存管理与空中战舰建造的自走棋游戏。建造并扩充你的战舰，为船体装配强力武器，精心规划后勤、情报与指挥装备的布局，让舰船 DPS 从数百提升至数百万。完成配置后，看着你亲手设计的战舰迎战愈发强劲的敌舰。

games.name: MONSTERGOTCHI
games.description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

games.name: Ember Camp Knight
games.description: 深入一座不知为谁而建的地下城。单局5~10分钟,节奏明快、打击感十足的像素动作 — 一路杀穿风格各异的4层地下城,在神秘的篝火旁稍作休整,遇见守着火堆的少女。这座地下城为何存在?答案就在最深处等你。

games.name: 喵星档案 Meow Star Archives
games.description: 在这款2D拼图游戏中，你需要将受损严重的猫咪记忆档案重新修复，阻止猫咪灵魂消散。修复档案的同时，你也将了解到这些可爱的猫咪在返星前的故事！没有计时器没有压力，享受碎片归位时的满足感，以及和可爱猫咪们一起度过的温馨时光吧。

games.name: Synemancy
games.description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

games.name: Space Lot
games.description: 旋转。配对。扩张宇宙。强化符号、组合规则，不断扩张盘面本身的宇宙老虎机放置游戏。

games.name: Tumbal 1985
games.description: Tumbal 1985 is an atmospheric and psychological horror-mystery game set within the confines of an Indonesian tobacco distributor office. Explore, clean, collect, and solve mysteries as a night janitor to uncover the insidious truth behind the paranormal.

games.name: 麦田幸存者
games.description: 《麦田幸存者》是自动开火的动作 Rogue-like。武器锁定最近敌人,你只需走位闪避、抉择每次升级的武器与被动组合。麦田、雪原、熔岩、沙漠、虚空 —— 五张主题地图节奏各异,还能在商店里画一张自己的地图当战斗地面。单局 5-20 分钟,武器进化、进化体建造与永久属性加成让战死不白死。

games.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙
games.description: 在《威小鼠和猪大常：接龙》这款游戏中，玩家将进入一段奇妙的旅程，在旅途中不断变强、构建自己的卡组，运用自己的聪明才智，外加一点点运气来战胜不同的对手。。。也许这场对局，只以一分之差险胜对手，可能下一句就能打出连续的完美接龙取得碾压式胜利。。。每场对局都能够带来不一样的新体验。

games.name: EpicSelectly
games.description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

games.name: 喵呜风云
games.description: 把战场挂在桌面上，让猫猫狗狗自动打仗、自动成长；你负责点天赋、买装备、配装，顺手用 APM 把他从普通士兵敲成高效战场打工人！你甚至还可以与好友一起组队参加排位战！获取更高KDA和分数之余，还能看看哪个人上班摸鱼最多的！

games.name: Couch Pirates
games.description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

games.name: Bastionveil
games.description: Command your legion in a dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. Raise free-producing barracks, summon 10 unique heroes, gear them up, and smash the enemy base across two lanes. Pure strategy — no unit micro. Outwit the AI. Free to play.

games.name: Drowned Echo
games.description: Drowned Echo is a narrative-driven VR horror experience in which you explore a sunken ship, using your hands to swim, interact with tools, and uncover a Lovecraftian presence that is corrupting the environment.

games.name: Delivery Today
games.description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

games.name: ELEMENTORS
games.description: Merge-autobattler where every unit fights on two synergy fronts at once. Forge your own d12 of elements, roll it every round, and fuse with creatures. 13 types × 13 elements. Every element you apply is permanent — choose wisely.

games.name: Warlapse
games.description: 战争不是英雄主义,而是冷酷的秩序与机动。在从石器时代到现代的7个时代中,包围敌人、切断补给、瓦解士气,将其歼灭于killbox之中。在Campaign中统领老兵,投入快节奏的Skirmish,或设计专属兵种,为未来的战争制作MOD!

games.name: Callejero
games.description: 面向Brotato和Balatro玩家的肉鸽射击游戏。扮演真实的流浪狗，它们成为了传奇。60秒制关卡，150+张卡牌，指数级构筑，无尽模式。9名角色，12种环境。每季度捐出净利润的20%——用于慈善与社区。

games.name: Xenogarden
games.description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

games.name: Napcats Puzzles
games.description: 《Napcats Puzzles》是一款温馨治愈的解谜游戏,每只猫咪都有属于自己的位置——你要做的,就是找到它。在有限的方格内摆放形状各异的猫咪,按照自己的节奏,解开一个个精心设计的谜题。

games.name: Duck Fest
games.description: Claim flags instead of defeating your opponent in this 1v1 trading card game. Use playing cards and placement to take, retake, and defend flags. Even after claiming a flag, you can't relax—the outcome stays uncertain! Buy and sell cards through the Steam Community Market in the full game.

games.name: It Could Be Worse
games.description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

games.name: 小小港湾
games.description: 在这款温馨治愈的放置经营游戏中，打造并自动化经营属于你自己的小小渔港。壮大船队、发现更多鱼类、不断扩建港湾。即使你正忙着其他事情，这片海边的小天地也会按照自己的节奏，慢慢热闹起来

games.name: みんなでティア表！
games.description: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

games.name: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！
games.description: A baseball management simulation set in an alternate Japan where all 47 prefectures have pro teams. Choose one of 48 clubs and manage drafts, development, reinforcements, lineups, finances, and the road to the championship.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.description: Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! This reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

games.name: LUMEN BLACK
games.description: Light is your only weapon. Vesper carries the last lantern into a world swallowed by the dark: flash to reveal invisible platforms, freeze what hunts you, and watch the battery. When the light dies, the dark takes you.

games.name: Wonderjack
games.description: Play the famous Blackjack but with a twist in this Alice in the Wonderland themed game.

games.name: 查无此人
games.description: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。

games.name: Payday Poker
games.description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker with Payday Poker. Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

games.name: 拯救餐厅
games.description: 节奏飞快的肉鸽经营游戏！限时30天内赚到100万，扩建桌椅，升级菜谱，雇佣培训店员，打造属于你的赚钱机器！每局随机获得厨师、菜谱与经营道具，自由搭配不同流派，节日庆典限时开启，寻找让收益暴涨的隐藏组合，不断解锁更强力的赚钱道具，挑战多种经营路线，解锁属于你的隐藏结局。每10天迎来一次大股东考核，能否撑到第30天，完成100万元业绩？

games.name: Neural Defense
games.description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

games.name: Desktop Hero Rush
games.description: An idle RPG at the bottom of your screen. Protect your hero as they automatically battle waves of enemies while you work or play. Collect over 100 unique items, upgrade your gear and skills, and fight alongside your adorable dragon companion. Defeat bosses, explore dungeons, and grow stronger.

games.name: Send Them to Hell
games.description: 恶魔想要地球？想得美。在这款像素与3D交融的混乱肉鸽游戏中，打造荒诞离谱的超模流派，把它们统统打回地狱！神圣骑士、玉米发射机器人、带着凶猛猫咪的魔法少女等英雄任你选择。支持单人或4人在线合作。屠戮开始。Send Them To Hell。

games.name: We Don't Exist
games.description: 激光、尖刺、毒气、滚烫的蒸汽：每个房间都有自己杀死你的方式。一个房间接一个房间地活下去，而有人在注视着你，记下一切。但最可怕的陷阱，是其他实验体：信任他们，背叛他们，还是牺牲自己？在这里，活下去是有代价的。付出哪一种，由你选择。

games.name: Flag Conquest
games.description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

games.name: Riftmoor
games.description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

games.name: The Obsessive Shadow: Former Residents
games.description: The Obsessive Shadow is lurking... In this 2D Horror Narrative, Uncover the story of what happened to the former residents of Old Diamond Drive... A once thriving community later left abandoned and in ruin. Face what's in the shadows and stay alert... You are being watched at every turn, IT IS HERE.

games.name: Puzzlogue
games.description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

games.name: Books & Blood
games.description: 在这款末世书店恐怖游戏中，你需要替顾客取书，做满当天的业绩，在这座废弃的店里活下去，别被书架间游荡的恐怖之物逮到。

games.name: Studs Up!
games.description: 第一人称足球，由你亲自操控双脚，没有预设动画来决定球的去向。支持 1v1 至 5v5 在线对战，可扮演前锋、守门员或裁判。没朋友？在「杯赛征程」肉鸽模式中组建阵容，升级球员、挑选强化，一路杀入淘汰赛杯赛。

games.name: Royal Farm
games.description: 国王已经宣布了下一次集市日——你的摊位准备好了吗？种植作物、照料动物、烹饪并制作合适的商品，在扩建农场、自动处理部分生产环节的同时，与顾客讨价还价。

games.name: Salaryman Simulator
games.description: 穿过拥挤的地铁站，避开迎面而来的路人，在迟到之前冲上列车！

games.name: Uyar Party
games.description: Uyar Party 是一款最多支持 8 名玩家的快节奏多人派对游戏。在充满混乱的小游戏中与好友一较高下，应对难以预测的危险，并在线上对战或与 AI 较量中争夺第一名。

games.name: Elf Girls Dig Bards
games.description: Play your harp - win her heart! An erotic rhythm game where you serenade 15 elf girls across a sprawling fantasy city. 90 songs, 5 districts, and artwork that reveals more the better you play. One summer to go from Stranger to "Soulmate"!

games.name: TEST 5
games.description:
扮演人工智慧体测试者5，在超现实虚拟大楼中使用多种武器与装备，击败敌人收集物品完成无限数量的测试。
特色;体验高机动操作性能，装备多种多样的物品，纯粹的战斗体验，完善狡猾的充满负面效果的技能树。

games.name: Malleus
games.description: 一个 roguelite 嘉年华街机，您可以在这里与一个魔法般的游戏大师和他操控的 Hi-Striker 机器较量实力。策略、讨价还价，让您的灵魂自由。

games.name: 赌你敢开
games.description: 《赌你敢开》是一款剧情驱动的第一人称恐怖游戏。作为被杀手盯上的开箱主播，你会不断收到对方寄来的诡异包裹。检查它们、判断危险、寻找线索，在直播观众的注视下拼凑案件真相——但要小心，有些包裹一旦打开，就没有后悔的机会。

games.name: 무고한 사람
games.description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

games.name: Void Forge
games.description: 虚空熔炉是一款像素风自走棋游戏，核心玩法是策略搭配与自动战斗。你将从猩红信徒、元素法师、虚空生物等阵营中招募勇者，为他们装配能够改写技能机制的圣遗物，然后布阵上场，自动演绎你的战术。猩红暴君的血色帝国、元素盟会的秘法师、虚空教团的静滞哨兵、荣耀战庭的残存骑士——各方势力的恩怨将在你的竞技场上交织上演。世界之心碎裂后，猩红之月升起，你作为召集者，将带领失散的英雄深入探寻真相。加入愿望单，见证故事的终局。

games.name: 末日锚点
games.description: 做一份完全普通的…异常处置工作。只不过就是整个世界的命运都掌握在你手中而已，小事一桩，别焦虑！

games.name: Americaman
games.description: A satirical narrative adventure inspired by classic adventure games and adult animation. Solve absurd puzzles, interrogate eccentric characters, and survive impossible social predicaments as America’s most wildly unqualified hero: Americaman.

games.name: Vesper Hollow
games.description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

games.name: Ashen of Thrones
games.description: When the thrones of men crumble to ash, only Gods and Titans claim the earth. Ashen of Thrones is a visceral 2D RTS featuring intense lane-based combat, mythological evolution, active divine magic, and monumental Titan battles. Command your army and survive the campaign.

games.name: Wake
games.description: A horror adventure for solo play or two-player online co-op. In co-op, one sees through light, the other through sound. Solve puzzles across two different perceptions of the same world. Every sound reveals the world - and reveals you.

games.name: Dealer's Hand
games.description: A gothic blackjack rogue-lite. Manipulate your odds with powerups, special cards and effects to win the souls of the damned and choose to either slay or set them free.

games.name: Wildegrove
games.description:
Wildegrove是一款快节奏的等距视角弹幕肉鸽游戏。
化身被众神选中的侏儒，施展强大的法术。迎战无休无止的敌潮，收集契合玩法的符文，升级你喜爱的法术，释放毁灭性的攻击，拯救Wildegrove！

games.name: Blooming Parasite
games.description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game set in a research facility hiding a classified underground complex overrun by an evolving parasitic organism. Explore abandoned laboratories, uncover buried secrets, and fight to survive a nightmare that's spreading from the inside out.

games.name: Cricket Manager
