games.description: Every other resort builder stops at the blueprint. Powder Park doesn't. Shape the mountain, design your runs, then drop in and ride them yourself in third person. A new experience from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

games.name: Arcane Abyss（奥术深渊）
games.description: 一款通过投掷武器战斗的回合制轻度Rogue游戏。通过武器合成继承能力，搭配被动技能，每次冒险都能打造不同的构筑。只要手牌和MP足够，就能不断投掷武器；让武器相互碰撞，触发“共鸣”，激发双方的能力。利用抽牌与MP恢复持续进攻，将怪物一扫而空吧！

games.name: 鸡从天降
games.description: 感受动作射击与战术策略融合的Roguelike战火洗礼，与鸡老板一起，在各种严酷环境下，部署小鸡们战术，熟练运用各种道具和武器，击败由各类食肉动物组成的林中匪徒。游戏风格轻松诙谐，惊险刺激。

games.name: Wild Boar Digging
games.description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

games.name: HEAVENBREAK
games.description: A fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Hold the line against relentless waves, upgrade your weapons, and create devastating builds with each run.

games.name: Catalyst Core
games.description: 一款基于网格战场的 Roguelike 卡组构筑游戏，每一步行动都在为下一次元素反应做准备。构筑你的卡组，收集元素核心，释放强大的元素连锁组合技，击败你的敌人。

games.name: 兔兔斩星记 Starfall Samurai
games.description: 《兔兔斩星记》是一款融合斩击操作与增量成长的动作游戏。拖动鼠标决定斩击方向，在小行星聚集的瞬间松开，一刀清场、收集萝卜、强化刀法，持续探索宇宙深处。

games.name: Ball-Aqua
games.description: 试玩版现已推出！滚进这场支持单人游玩和在线合作的明快海洋冒险。征服物理驱动的障碍赛道，在Race和King of the Hill中一较高下，收集星星与泡泡，解锁球体皮肤，并为Steam Workshop打造全新赛道。

games.name: Chimpanik
games.description: A chaotic multiplayer game where your voice is your only weapon. Scream into your mic to blast enemies away, steal their fruits and become the loudest ape in the jungle.

games.name: Bat in White
games.description: Help Lilith put all the little bats to sleep without burning them! 🌙🦇Find your path in the shadows and fly to the coffins for safety.

games.name: Lovely Cafe: Lusty Latte
games.description: 💕 Lovely Cafe 是一款带有浪漫氛围的温馨放置游戏。升级你的咖啡馆，供应甜美甜点，解锁迷人的女孩，完成特别订单，把一家小咖啡馆打造成充满温暖、暧昧与甜蜜时刻的可爱之地。

games.name: Fiducia: Own The World
games.description: 率领家族王朝纵横鲜活诸国。耕作、贸易、创办银行、武装战争，并战胜敌对家族——单人或与好友在线。

games.name: Kleromancy
games.description: Awaken as Unit-01 in the Ark of Theseus. In this roguelike, your cards are 3D dice: roll them, spend energy, and conquer 7 corrupted biomes. Overcome narrative events and minigames, survive multi-phase bosses, and expand your generational station with every victory.

games.name: NightClub Manager Simulator
games.description: 作为老板，评估提交给你的各种提议。管理夜店的声誉，痛打小偷并扑灭火灾。

games.name: Brew & Defend
games.description: Brew & Defend is a medieval tavern management game with tower defense mechanics. Build your supply chain, grow crops, brew beverages, and place taverns along the road to satisfy a parade of thirsty customers before they ruin your reputation!

games.name: 残明·末路
games.description: 甲申国变，天下倾覆。一群活不下去的人凑成一支南逃的队伍。回合制战斗、营地经营、永久死亡——在明末的风雪里，把他们活着带到南方。

games.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
games.description: 一款围绕自创球员生涯展开的单人篮球管理模拟游戏。培养球员能力，争取上场时间，做出场内外的关键选择。通过 Live 2D Match Center 观看比赛进程，或使用快速模拟。
games.developer: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

games.name: The Smiling Flesh
games.description: 《The Smiling Flesh》是一款令人窒息的单人生存恐怖游戏。潜入衰败的哥特式庄园，解开谜题，并智斗一个会学习你移动轨迹的恐怖怪物。带上宝藏逃出生天，否则你将成为这座庄园的下一个牺牲品。

games.name: Shadows of Christmas Eve
games.description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

games.name: Farmshore: Out Past the Horizon
games.description: Escape to a sun-drenched tropical paradise in this 1-8 player life simulator. Build your dream island from scratch, cultivate vibrant farms, manage bustling local businesses, and unwind on the beach with friends. Your perfect island getaway awaits!

games.name: Another Black Hole Incremental
games.description: 从一个脆弱的奇点开始：吞噬物质，坍缩后重生，把永久的辐射投入分支式升级星图。掌握短促而高压的每一局，击破宇宙防御，直到强大得足以吞噬星系核心。

games.name: 空间循环圈
games.description: 《空间循环圈》是一款循环圈+肉鸽的塔防游戏，敌人没有终点，你需要在有限的时间内击败所有敌人！

games.name: Vespillo
games.description: 多人撤离式平台跳跃游戏，用钩索下到地牢里捡战利品、升级。真正的硬核模式：点燃蜡烛，死亡就此成真，没有重生，没有第二次机会。你只能躺着等，等别的玩家找到你的头骨，把它背上去

games.name: Trucktris
games.description: The puzzle driven game, literally. Take control of tetromino shaped trucks and carefully navigate them onto the soon departing cargo ship. Then reverse them into position for satisfying shipments!

games.name: The Passing Bell
games.description: You awaken in an ever-shifting manor with no memory of who you are. As you explore its corridors, you encounter a disfigured man, an arrogant scientist, and a faceless doll waiting for someone in a greenhouse. Uncover the tragic link between them.

games.name: Nightbound
games.description: 末日之际，两个陌路旅人栖身于同一栋房子。此刻，他们唯一的希望是：彼此信任，把一辆破旧的厢式货车修好，奔赴一座寒冷的高山——只有在那里，“噬灭”（Bloom）才无法追上他们。在《Nightbound》中，你将与同伴并肩作战，开展回合制战术战斗。白天里相伴度日，夜晚里坚守家宅，在生死之间，结下一段超越“噬灭”的羁绊。

games.name: HeroNet
games.description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

games.name: Tides of Empires
games.description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels with real MMR matchmaking, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

games.name: Gulf Strike
games.description: Gulf Strike is a top-down helicopter shooter from 1991. A rogue nation is threatening the oil industry in the middle east! Complete the 6 sandbox campaigns by destroying enemy units while searching for supplies. It's time for another strike in the desert!

games.name: Beellionaire Idle
games.description: 在《Bee-lionaire》中，你需要收获蜂箱中的蜂蜜，加工蜂蜜，销售产品，并将利润重新投资到农场中。解锁新设备，提升产量，从一个蜂箱起步，打造属于你的蜂蜜帝国。

games.name: Kintsugi Moon
games.description: A small rabbit awakens with no memory in ancient Japan. Guided by moonlight and drawn to shrines, piece together a forgotten past on a hand-painted climb toward Mount Fuji — where a shapeshifting fox, a wandering storyteller, and an old man by a fire wait to help you remember

games.name: Warrior Quest (勇士征途)
games.description: An old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain in your own words. What you say can materially change an encounter: bribe your way through, extract information, turn an enemy into an ally, or scare them into backing down... and whatever you do, roll well!

games.name: Aparadores de Abacaxis Anônimos (AAA)
games.description: Aparadores de Abacaxis Anônimos (AAA) It’s quite a ride! Choose the contacts to include in your schedule and hope they call at the best possible time (or just roll with the unexpected).

games.name: COMETROX!
games.description: Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.

games.name: 黑金－星乐场之情欲KTV
games.description: 经营一家唱到衣服全掉光的成人KTV！装修包厢、招募美女员工、调制美酒，并处理斗殴、外卖及各种“唱到一半突然变成多人运动”的突发事件。包厢越大，加入合唱的人就越多！

games.name: Make the Bus
games.description: Catch the bus or die trying! Dash, dodge, and survive a chaotic suburban neighborhood in this action roguelike about the world's worst morning commute. Buy upgrades, perfect your route, and reach the bus before time runs out.

games.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
games.description: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, seven stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

games.name: Touhou Smash
games.description: 幻想乡的少女们正面碰撞的 2D 平台格斗游戏。没有血条，取而代之的是不断累积的受击百分比，把对手轰出画面外的一方获胜。灵梦、魔理沙、咲夜等角色各自以专属招式作战。从同屏本地对战到与 Steam 好友的在线乱斗，最多 4 人同乐。

games.name: 镇邪井
games.description: 《镇邪井（Wardwell）》是一款中国民俗志怪题材的放置经营游戏。古井鸣响，地水翻涌，旱魃出世的预兆正在逼近。修复井坛、经营香火、接待香客，在逐渐蔓延的异象中揭开深埋井下的秘密。

games.name: Code: Infinity
games.description: 陷入无限世界之后，我被七个男人缠上了？

games.name: 光辐岛
games.description: 《光辐岛》是一款以文明发展、生存与城镇建造为核心的游戏。带领你的人民抵达一片新土地，从第一座城镇起步，采集资源、研究科技、迈入工业化时代，最终完成太空计划。

games.name: Tayke Me With You
games.description: Tayke Me With You is a visual novel about high school seniors and their struggles with each other and the world around them. You play as Gene, a sheltered, socially naive human from the city as he acclimates to living in a rural town filled with dinosaurs, finding friends (and love) along the way.

games.name: Deadroll
games.description: Roll dice to build poker hands, stack powerful combos, and beat crooked dealers in a dark casino roguelike.

games.name: 水果店模拟器
games.description: 开一家自己的水果店，亲手打理生意，让街角的小店成为街坊们最爱光顾的地方

games.name: IMMRAMA: Voyages of the Otherworlds
games.description: A story-driven RPG you play with text or voice. No jargon, use your own words and the game understands. A hand-written world of myth responds. Real dice, factions, and consequences underneath; a complete, cinematic voyage you can actually finish. Every word human-authored. AI only does the telling.

games.name: Chess Army
games.description: 在这款受到国际象棋启发的回合制策略游戏中，组建军队、融合单位，并主宰整片战场！

games.name: Spook'd
games.description:
Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game.
Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them.
Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!

games.name: Click Cafe
games.description: An active incremental serving game where you run your own cafe! Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in. Purchase upgrades to expand your cafe and earn even more money!

games.name: HUEMON
games.description: A creature collector where your whole team fights at once. Field five HUEMON on a grid where one jumps over others, another anchors nearby enemies, and positioning beats raw power. Collect them across a world still learning to be colorful.

games.name: Resettle
games.description: 《Resettle》是一款内容丰富的增量式城市建造游戏，你将在一座座岛屿上发展聚落。合理规划建筑布局，最大化资源产出，探索 10 种不同的升级系统，打造繁荣兴盛的岛屿城市。

games.name: Grimspire
games.description: 厄渊之塔是一款融合刷宝玩法的 2D 像素动作游戏。踏入不断自我衍生的厄渊秘境，刷取海量装备，镶嵌符文激活符文之语，组合羁绊打造专属 Build。是带着战利品安全撤离，还是赌上一切深入下一层——每一次选择都关乎生死。

games.name: Refund Speedrun
games.description:
You're a support agent at DrumWorks, approving or denying game refund requests
by a 16-rule policy. Hit quota. Pay the water bill. Feed grandma's fish. Then
the terminal starts showing you things it shouldn't — and you find out what
else she left you.

games.name: Aurora Core
games.description: 1,000 sleepers, 100 waking hands and 1,500 light years of emptiness. As commander of the Aurora Core you assign your crew, ration oxygen and make decisions no one should survive. Will you bring your colony to Thalassa?

games.name: 少年游踪　书与钥匙的季节
games.description: 放学后的图书室，带来的尽是看似寻常、却暗藏某种“秘密”与“谎言”的微苦谜团。两位担任图书委员的高中少年，带你以双眼捕捉蛛丝马迹、以双耳倾听心声、以指尖如翻阅书页般亲手揭开真相——这是一部能让您动用五感全方位沉浸其中的微苦青春日常推理文字冒险游戏。

games.name: Xydorth
games.description:
In search of your wife, you must descend into the darkness of a vast cave system. But with every step deeper, your descent becomes a journey into your own personal hell.
Xydorth is a dark first-person shooter with survival horror elements.

games.name: Click to Obsolete
games.description: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

games.name: Tanks
games.description: Tanks is a 2D turn-based multiplayer artillery strategy game with projectile physics and fully destructible terrain. Choose ammo, set angle, power, use wind, and rely on smart decisions with a bit of luck to outplay your opponents.

games.name: 九霄
games.description: 《九霄卷仙》是一款修仙黑色幽默搜打撤游戏。进入霓虹闪烁的赛博仙城，在宗门 KPI、功德贷款和飞升焦虑之间搜刮法器、痛快开打、准点撤离。卷不动，就把战利品带走。

games.name: Illegal Mechanic Simulator
games.description: 白天修车，夜里偷来缺少的零件。独自经营，或与伙伴组成最多四人的团队，在这家破旧汽修店里干出一番事业。寻找同款车辆，拆下所需零件，避开警报，再将赚来的钱投入车间升级。顾客只管满意，零件的来路就不用多问了。

games.name: Technologia
games.description: Lead your civilization from the Stone Age into the future in a card-driven strategy game. Gather resources, manage workers, build a settlement, discover technologies, and shape history through trade or conquest.

games.name: Necromancer´s Ruins
games.description: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.

games.name: Dirty Deal
games.description: 充满魅力女英雄的卡牌对战RPG 🔥 征战竞技场、地下城与战役，同时强化你的卡组与实力。然后进一步了解与你并肩作战的女孩们——调情、聊天，在真正的约会中拉近彼此的距离。

games.name: Lively
games.description: Lively is a puzzle-platformer where two rival creatures fight for control of the planet. Use ever-changing powers to make your way through a unique world  !

games.name: Void Descent
games.description: Void Descent is a fast-paced bullet heaven where aggression is mandatory. Weave through swarms and maximize DPS to raise your Combat Rank or release the controls to slow time and plan your next move. Explore over 80 billion loadout combinations with weapons, elemental mods, and unlockable augments!

games.name: SoulForge Legends
games.description: 十二个职业。一个开放世界。无尽传奇。与好友组队，挑战世界首领，按照自己的方式打造角色，并在40人竞技场中展开对决——这里永远是技术胜过装备。

games.name: Rusty Smile
games.description: 化身传说中人人畏惧的无齿耙灵。白昼查明受害者的罪孽，入夜追猎并惩罚他们；构筑骰子袋，在黑暗的意大利民间传说中展开策略棋盘战斗。

games.name: Squircle
games.description: 对号入洞！Squircle 是霓虹弹珠球与疯狂迷你高尔夫的结合，而且超级酷（信我就对了）。发射发光的图形，让它们四处反弹，再把每一个打进匹配的球洞。很简单，对吧？等六个一起上场，可就不一定了。

games.name: 灭世至尊
games.description: 《灭世至尊》是一款即时战略操控模式的 CRPG 刷宝构筑游戏。玩家将陆续解锁并指挥 5 名能力各异的角色组成小队，探索庞大世界并与众多 NPC 交织出命运轨迹。通过击败强敌收集装备、打造专属属性 Build，揭开世界毁灭与苏醒背后的真相。

games.name: Impersonal
games.description: You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

games.name: Spacercise
games.description: An exercise game that blends arcade space shooting action with motion tracking fun!

games.name: Prison Anomaly
games.description: 陷入高安全级别监狱的无限循环中。检查牢房和周围环境以发现异常，躲避怪物，并在走廊尽头按下正确的按钮提交报告，以到达 A10 区域。

games.name: A (tiny) Slime Quest
games.description: A short and cozy top-down adventure. Exiled to a hidden village after one final defeat, explore your surroundings and help fellow banished monsters by solving their unique troubles. Whether you long to return to combat or wish to discover a new path, it's your time to shine!

games.name: PYR
games.description:
《PYR》是一款速度至上的第一人称无尽跑酷游戏。斩杀敌人、招架来袭的攻击、连续利用移动加速，并升级你的能力配置，逃离吞噬世界的黑暗。

每一次奔跑都是突破极限的机会。跑得越快，活得越久！

games.name: Trials of the cabin
games.description: Trials of the Cabin is a Sokoban puzzle game where the robots only act after you.

games.name: Apocalipsis Survivor
games.description: 前几个世界里，感染者只会朝你走来。到了第四个，他们开始向你开火。穿越 10 个世界的动作生存游戏：选择你的英雄，在战斗中即时强化武器，抵挡越来越密集的尸潮，一路追查瘟疫的异星源头。

games.name: Ionic Drive
games.description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

games.name: No ESC
games.description: A first-person survival horror game where movement, combat, and all other actions are performed by typing. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon, evade or fight enemies, solve puzzles, and find what you need to escape. Featuring hand-painted watercolor artwork.

games.name: Castle Crew
games.description: 偌大的魔法城堡里，一切都乱了套！整理书籍、卷轴、符文和药水，为每件物品找到归属。独自一人或与好友一起，看着一个个房间从一片狼藉变得井井有条，享受整理带来的满满成就感。

games.name: The Last Station - Baku
games.description: 一款以废弃的巴库地铁为背景的第一人称心理生存恐怖游戏。探索黑暗隧道，解开谜题，揭开诡异谜团，并在恐怖怪物的追逐下努力生存。

games.name: TEXAS DOMINOES
games.description: Play classic All Fives dominoes with a Texas twist. Score in multiples of five, control the Spinner, draw from the Boneyard, or block the game.  Play against friends or solo.  Relive your best rounds with game replays, stats, and badges.

games.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
games.description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

games.name: Orbisphere
games.description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. Navigate an asteroid belt, slice feral space worms and find your way home.

games.name: MineMergeMatic
games.description: 挖矿、合并、自动化！将矿石合成为更有价值的资源，打造紧凑的生产线，解锁强力机械，并不断扩建你的洞穴，将它发展成一座繁忙的采矿工厂。

games.name: Song of Larithea
games.description: 《娜瑞希亚之歌》（Song of Larithea）是一款可爱的动漫风角色扮演游戏，讲友情、信任、复仇，以及怎么从黑暗里走回来。一队年轻的法师被派往外面的世界，每个人都有自己要走的路。这条路以前有人走过，走回来的很少。

games.name: The Fixer
games.description: Football star on Saturday, match fixer the rest of the week. Rig games for the syndicate, launder dirty money and keep your suspicion gauge under control in this narrative career sim. How far will you go before it all comes crashing down?

games.name: Square Seller!
games.description: 方形卖家！是一个小型增量游戏,您可以在其中管理您的小地方。出售报纸、筹集资金并利用它们来建造新商店,并通过一棵大技能树来改进它们！

games.name: Diseased
games.description: 在严寒中建造你的营地,做出艰难的抉择。占领城墙以扩张领土,派遣部下外出探索。为获取至关重要的资源,你必须孤注一掷——要在源源不断从黑暗中涌现的 Diseased 浪潮中生存下去,远比你想象的更加困难。

games.name: Little Lua & The Lost Six
games.description: Six kids are torn from their world and dropped into Everbloom, a realm poisoned by the Blight. Build your squad, master fire, ice, and lightning magic, and fight your way through shifting seasons to free everyone the Blight has taken — including your own parents.

games.name: 这里不对劲
games.description:
《这里不对劲》—— 脑洞大开的躲猫猫+找茬对战！
轮流扮演“藏匿者”与“真相侦探”。在糖果乐园深埋一罐鲱鱼罐头，在公元10世纪放飞悬停的无人机，甚至让狗狗潜伏在深海泥沙里打盹……
藏就要藏得离谱又刁钻，找就要找出所有时空错乱！这是眼力与恶趣味的双重狂欢。这世界哪儿不对劲？等你来揭秘！

games.name: ROBOTEKA
games.description: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.

games.name: Mercenary Guild Manager
games.description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

games.name: KleptoMagia
games.description: KleptoMagia is a unique real-time deckbuilder with no turns. Prepare your deck, react to enemy attacks, and play every card at the perfect moment.

games.name: Red Timewarp: Beyond Reality
games.description: Blast through enemy hordes, grab powerful upgrades, and become stronger with every run in a challenging Bullet Heaven roguelite. Choose one of 4 red panda heroes with unique abilities, build them your way, and battle through time solo or with friends in online co-op.

games.name: RepCell
games.description:
What if attention became the most valuable thing in society?

And everyone who lost it was sent to a container suspended above the ocean until they became visible again?

games.name: 10 Minutes to Make a Million
games.description:
You have 10 minutes to make $1,000,000. 

Pick a character, draft three businesses, then hustle, invest or gamble your way there before the timer hits zero. A roguelike economy game where the playstyle is yours and the clock is not.

games.name: Distract The Phone Girls
games.description: Distract The Phone Girls 是一款成人休闲恋爱游戏。你将把女孩们的注意力从手机上转移开，选择自己的大胆程度，解锁私人自拍，并重复游玩场景，发现更加火热的路线。

games.name: Bokcuks
games.description: Bokcuks is a farming game in which creatures named Bokcuk live on sky islands. Sell your crops, complete your tasks, unlock new islands, start automating by hiring workers, and reach the end of the game while discovering many new items.

games.name: Cargo Thieves
games.description:
一款合作游戏，码头工人不去老实干活，而是在警卫不注意时悄悄撬开集装箱偷货。
使用撬棍、开锁工具、啤酒、火焰和混乱。
从食物到超级跑车，能偷的全都能卖。

games.name: Voxel Dynasties
games.description: Lead a civilization from the first stone tool to the atomic bomb in one match. A voxel RTS where every block can break, fortresses fall block by block, and you can jump into any unit in third person mid-battle. Real AI, 8-player multiplayer, one developer.

games.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
games.description: 爽到上头的街机增量游戏：鼠标一动，黑洞横扫满屏彩色方块，越吞越大！每颗方块都化作经验和金币：局内猛长，局外狂点永久升级。再吸几本魔法书，让磁吸、复制和方块雨把屏幕搅成一锅彩色乱炖。倒计时结束？再来一局！

games.name: My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair
games.description: 一份临时的后台工作，让你与魅力十足的默剧演员米拉陷入危险的秘密关系。帮助她完成自己的演出，隐藏你们的秘密，做出艰难选择，并在这部成人视觉小说中解锁5种结局。

games.name: WreckZone
games.description: WreckZone is a wild vehicular action game featuring heavy weaponry, arcade physics, and spectacular stunts. Battle across dangerous arenas, use rockets, machine guns, and special abilities, destroy your opponents, and prove who’s in charge!

games.name: Group Commander
games.description: Take command of a World War II heavy bomber group over occupied Europe. Read the field order, weigh the target against the men, and send your forts. A player-paced command sim where every mission is a decision and every empty bunk is one you signed for.

games.name: SHEEP HAPPENS
games.description: This is coop multiplayer for 2 to 4 players, and every match the game decides who's who — one of you holds the ranch together, the rest exist purely to take it apart.

games.name: Core Logistics
games.description: Core Logistics is a management sim about growing a transport company from a single van into a network across the whole map. Choose which contracts to take, match the right trucks and licenses to each load, and chain jobs together so your trucks never drive empty. When you need to think, hit pause.

games.name: Dawnheart Keepers
games.description: Hold the line across a voice-acted 21-mission campaign, or begin a Long Dawn run: a generated board, no gold, and a card draft after every wave. Ten spires, 41 foes, online co-op for up to 9 Keepers, 6v6 Rival Keeps, and a level editor with Workshop. Fully voiced in English and Hebrew.

games.name: PawTop Cats
games.description: PawTop Cats 是一款温馨舒适的应用程序，让可爱的动画猫咪生活在你的窗口上方。选择不同的皮肤，与毛茸茸的小助手互动，为你的桌面增添一点可爱的混乱。

games.name: Scrap ascent
games.description: Ascend without stopping in Scrap Ascent! A fast-paced vertical arcade platformer featuring vibrant pixel art. Jump, dodge, and survive a constant rain of chaos as you climb a mountain of scrap that won't give you a single second to breathe.

games.name: PROTOCOL: VOID
games.description: PROTOCOL: VOID CONTRACT is a cyberpunk top-down action RPG for 1–4 players. Take on dangerous contracts, fight hostile systems, collect randomized weapons and cyberware, shape powerful builds, and upgrade your gear to survive deadlier missions.

games.name: Voltswarm
games.description: A lone robot faces an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D bullet heaven. Weapons fire automatically. Choose your weapons, upgrades, cores, and mods wisely, then survive escalating waves of industrial chaos.

games.name: Build & Bail
games.description: 赛道由你们自己来搭的派对平台游戏：每回合一个新陷阱，每场比赛一波新混乱。到最后，只看谁先冲线。

games.name: Supply Yard Simulator
games.description: 从零开始建立并运营属于你自己的建材供应场。储备园林绿化及建筑材料，操作叉车、起重机、装载机、自卸卡车、船只和平板卡车来搬运货物，并通过及时交付让客户满意。

games.name: Void Walkers X64
games.description: Embark on a classic 2D overhead RPG adventure inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Forge your destiny across five distinct progression paths, master tactical combat, and explore a world where your choices unlock powerful hybrid classes.

games.name: Super Beat 'Em Up World
games.description: Embark on an action-packed co-op adventure through spectacular theme parks, master unique heroes and outrageous power-ups, battle unforgettable bosses, and uncover the sinister conspiracy behind the DUX Corporation while searching for your missing friend, TUU.

games.name: Nuts Pipeline
games.description: 把坚果送到仓鼠等待的终点吧！每个回合切换管道上设置的转换器,组合出正确的坚果。在3分钟的限时内,通关每一关(10回合)。从任何人都能轻松上手的简单难度开始,随着关卡推进逐渐变难,是一款无穷无尽的逻辑解谜游戏。

games.name: 赛博排球
games.description: 《Cyber Volleyball》是一款横版卷轴2D排球对战游戏，融合真实物理模拟与角色养成要素。玩家通过方向键移动、跳跃和多种动作键完成发球、扣杀、拦网与垫球等操作，在严格的三次击球规则下组织攻防。游戏提供十余种拥有独特AI技能的角色类型，并包含闯关模式、在线多人对战以及9种属性自由加点的卡牌养成系统。

games.name: Pinion
games.description: Answer an SOS from a remote island and enter a manor consumed by a spreading nightmare. Fight transformed inhabitants, search for survivors, and uncover the truth in this first-person survival horror mystery.

games.name: Hell Chambers
games.description: Have you ever wondered what Hell looks like? In this adventure escape room, you'll have the chance not only to see it for yourself, but even to escape from it! In Hell Chambers, you'll solve puzzles, meet the inhabitants of Hell, and uncover the secrets of Hell Corp.

games.name: Password Not Valid
games.description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

games.name: It's All Ogre
games.description: A VR Co-op puzzle game where each player inhabits one half of a two headed ogre. Each player is responsible for an arm and a leg. Coordinate together to bring the ogre to life to complete action puzzles and to feed the ogre!

games.name: Little Pocket
games.description: A cozy desktop game where you can decorate a Little Pocket exactly to your liking, unlock new furniture, and share the space with an adorable pet companion. Create a relaxing little corner that keeps you company while you work, study, or play.

games.name: 棋门遁甲
games.description: 象棋走法当牌打的肉鸽卡牌构筑：马踏斜线，炮隔子轰，卒过河不回头。志怪的刀落在哪一格，出手前你就看得见；挪开一步，这一刀就砍空。涿鹿一战没下完，这盘残局等你三千年。破八门，会九星。落子无悔。

games.name: Veggie Stack Battle Royale
games.description: Merge your veggies, sabotage your rivals, and be the last one standing! Compete in online battles with up to 10 players, unlock cosmetics and trophies, and unleash chaotic attacks in this multiplayer twist on our casual merging game Veggie Stack!

games.name: Syncline
games.description: Roll a line of cubes across a grid and line them up with the goal blocks. Simple — until your line stands on end, climbs, splits apart and reconnects. A puzzle game inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, taken to new heights.

games.name: 舷炮乱斗
games.description: Broadside Bash（舷炮乱斗） 是一款第一人称 4V4 多人海战派对游戏！与你的好友一起砍树、搜刮宝箱、购买装备，从零建造属于你们的战船。驾驶战舰展开激烈的舷炮对射、登船肉搏，甚至直接撞碎敌船！但要小心，不断缩小的海域和有限的复活机会，将迫使所有人迎来最后的决战！

games.name: 环路防线：接管协议
games.description: 《环路防线：接管协议》是一款单人科幻塔防。你将在陌生星球上建立基地，自由设计敌人的进攻路线，组合 16 种火力模块抵御反击。沿星图推进战役，研究新装备，迎战破墙部队和首领。战役之外，还可挑战无尽模式与随机远征，或用地图编辑器制作自己的战场。

games.name: 萌芽食堂
games.description:
《萌芽食堂》是一款融合食堂经营、轻量动作战斗与剧情冒险的 2D 生活模拟游戏。
下班前意外得知自己即将升职加薪，店里今后自己说了算？连多抽两张纸都要狂喷唾沫的蕉总，为何突然良心发现？
山小竹从此过上了白天打害虫进货、晚上和伙伴们开食堂赚钱，时不时还要应付各路奇怪来客的忙碌生活。

games.name: Babylonian Twins
games.description: 来自古巴比伦的失落解谜平台游戏——1993年诞生于巴格达，2026年重制归来。将双子之一冻结成石像，另一人穿越五大世界冲刺、钻探、战斗。含1993年Amiga原版，完整可玩——Steam独占。

games.name: Robot Vacuum Simulator
games.description: Take control of a robot vacuum in this first-person cleaning simulator. Slip under furniture, tackle stubborn stains and odd jobs, and upgrade your machine. Clean every home to perfection—and prove that humans can replace AI after all.

games.name: 洪水求生 - Escape the Flood!
games.description: 一款支持 1 到 10 名玩家的第一人称生存制作游戏。海水越涨越高，这座岛正在被吞没。能收集的都收集起来，造一艘船，在最后一座山丘被淹没前让所有人登船。或者，丢下他们直接起航。

games.name: RV Life Sim
games.description: 追逐地平线，并在旅途中谋生。在广阔的天空下露营，与附近的城镇制作并交易商品，在穿越南方广袤野外的长途旅程中让你的房车保持前行。今天就打造属于你的终极移动之家吧！

games.name: 诅咒街机厅：弹珠肉鸽
games.description: 在一台被诅咒的街机中，用弹珠、撞针与卡牌构筑连锁反应。放置并升级特殊撞针，操控物理碰撞，挑战不断改变规则的关卡与 Boss，在逐渐失控的弹射中打出爆炸分数。

games.name: Anti-anti
games.description: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

games.name: Blokkit
games.description: 放下方块，翻转格子，点亮整个棋盘。一款温暖而有手感的逻辑解谜游戏，每次放置都会翻转它覆盖的格子。9 个世界共 81 关精心设计的谜题，与全世界共享同一个每日棋盘，或在禅意与街机模式中畅玩无尽关卡。

games.name: STUFFED: Two Foot Hero
games.description: Become a two-foot-tall teddy bear in this VR wave shooter where you wield homemade weapons, build defences, and protect a little girl from her nightmares. Play solo or online in up to 4 player co-op.

games.name: SummonFall
games.description: Build a summon-powered warband in a single-player fantasy horde-survival action RPG. Dodge while your weapons and summons attack automatically, survive five-minute floors, defeat bosses, collect ranked gear, and grow stronger between attempts.

games.name: UNDERSTAR: Dig Below, Rise Above
games.description: 在持续存在的2D采矿世界中，挖掘、飞行、战斗，一路披荆斩棘。寻找失落的星辰和远古泰坦，将发现转化为新的能力，并决定下一次探险应该深入到什么程度。

games.name: 3 Estrellas
games.description: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!

games.name: The Doi
games.description:
小小机器人，宏大冒险，无尽混乱。这场冒险，才刚刚开始。

与最多 8 名玩家组队，解开谜题，躲避致命陷阱，一起逃出生天，体验充满欢乐的合作解谜平台游戏。

games.name: MUD the BOX
games.description:
一款基于像素物理模拟的 2D 沙盒游戏。你可以自由放置沙子、水、岩浆、植物、生物和各种物理实体，观察它们在重力、流体、燃烧、爆炸与碰撞中的变化。

砍树、搭建、破坏、设计电路、制造连锁爆炸，或者只是制造一个简单的生态圈……

games.name: Captive 3000
games.description: 第一人称即时战斗地牢探索游戏。探索巨型星际基地与空间站，迎战危险敌人。采用网格移动和传统精灵图设计。灵感来自《Dungeon Master》《Eye of the Beholder》《Grimrock》以及 Amiga／Atari 科幻经典《Captive》。

games.name: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
games.description: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.

games.name: Nova Survivors
games.description: 俯视角生存类 roguelite。驾驶 21 艘独特战舰，用卡牌、神器与武器进化打造破格 build，在 4 个世界中抵御无尽敌潮与巨型 Boss。挑战威胁等级递增的 100 关战役，或投身无尽生存模式。每一局都不一样。

games.name: 凡界幸存者
games.description: 革命军战士李安邦意外传送至被熵兽占领的凡界中，联手觉醒智慧的熵兽“罗”，一起逃出生天！《凡界幸存者》是一款融合类幸存者与自走棋合成构筑的游戏，收集各人类势力在凡界遗留的灵器，组合羁绊、升星强化，并在一轮轮自动战斗与休整抉择中不断前进，直面熵兽之王，夺回离开凡界的传送门。

games.name: Would you mine?
games.description: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.

games.name: Chthonic
games.description: Descend through ever-changing levels of a living nightmare, master a weapon that grows with you, and face colossal demons to a soundtrack that will pump you up.

games.name: Repaint
games.description: Repaint is a colorful online FPS featuring objective control, team deathmatch, free-for-all combat, six arenas, AI bots, and customizable Steam lobbies.

games.name: Blackwood Abattoir
games.description: Blackwood Abattoir is a first-person psychological horror game where an unkillable, 100% blind monster hunts you purely by sound. Trapped in a dark slaughterhouse with no weapons, every footstep, flashlight click, and breath could be your last. Stay silent, or become cattle.

games.name: Lurks Beneath
games.description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

games.name: FROG IN THE HOLE!
games.description: 养青蛙，把它们丢进洞里，赚大钱。在这款增量沙盒游戏中，你将建造基于物理的工厂，从徒手扔青蛙发展到操控多达10万只青蛙。精通技能树，打出连击。青蛙们会遭遇什么？证明你配得上。

games.name: The Demon Wins
games.description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

games.name: The Rouge Casino
games.description:
八款被动过手脚的赌场游戏，共用一套Roguelite框架。操纵轮盘、灌铅骰子、标记纸牌；
叠加护符、预兆与镀金版本，直到庄家优势归你所有。八轮底注、八档赌注、80项挑战，
以及无尽模式。不含任何真钱赌博。

games.name: Neon One-Man Army
games.description: High-speed neon action! Swing with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne. Shoot while flying, chain movement and combat, and feel the rush of unstoppable momentum. Choose powerful cards, unlock skill chests, and master your movement to become an unstoppable force.

games.name: Tile Crawl
games.description: Tile Crawl is a tactical roguelite, with spatial puzzle-like battles, free exploration and a catch: you can only hold 6 items and they wear out with each use - so make every hit count!

games.name: BRAWLZERK
games.description: BRAWLZERK 是一款将幸存者类玩法与格斗游戏式攻防相结合的等距视角动作类 Roguelite 游戏。亲自攻击、格挡、闪避并延续连招，再通过主动技能卡和被动奖励，在每一局中打造全新的战斗风格。

games.name: Beyond the First Star
games.description: 《Beyond the First Star》是一款节奏明快的 2D 横版卷轴射击游戏。从风格各异的驾驶员中做出选择，收集并随时切换多样武器，闯过精心打造的关卡，挑战拥有独特攻击模式的 Boss。

games.name: THE 13th Digit
games.description: In a rain-soaked megacity, one law remains: cross one trillion dollars in hidden wealth and you forfeit your right to live. You are K, the executioner who enforces it — until the numbers start to lie. A branching cyberpunk noir with 5 endings, where every choice is remembered.

games.name: Of Dice and Minions
games.description: 掷出五颗骰子，凑出扑克牌型，召唤随从军队，再看它们自动开打。保留骰子、重掷、招募，灵活克制敌人，在这款肉鸽自动战斗游戏中一路深入100层地牢。

games.name: Towers of Babble
games.description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

games.name: Waveguard
games.description: 一款每局游戏都会改变策略的Roguelike塔防游戏。使用各具特色的防御塔组建专属队伍，组合超过80种神器，创造强大的协同效果。探索精美像素艺术描绘的多彩世界，抵御一波又一波愈发危险的敌人。充分发挥每座防御塔的优势，调整攻击目标的优先级，不断强化防线，迎接越来越严峻的挑战与强大的首领。每当你尝试新的阵容与神器组合，都能发现截然不同的战术，体验充满变化的全新对局。在商店中权衡每一次选择，打造足以抵挡下一波攻势的最佳策略。

games.name: Flower Delivery
games.description: Grow flowers and deliver them to cute cartoon animals in a huge cozy open world. Explore a relaxing landscape with zero stress and no way to lose. Chill, vibe, grow beautiful flowers, enjoy the scenery, and complete heartwarming missions at your own pace.

games.name: Star Claw
games.description: 在宇宙哥特风的抓娃娃机轻度肉鸽游戏中，掌握不可思议的技巧射击。看准时机甩出猫爪，让它在不断变化的闹鬼奖品房间里借助弹板反弹，再把新猫咪、奇异宝藏和足以改变下一次旅程的 Pawcraft 带回家。

games.name: Who Stole It !
games.description: Cartoon cops vs robbers. Sneak into the museum, stuff your bag with paintings and gold, and get it to the van — or play police and throw the whole crew in jail. 10 characters with wild tricks: clown decoys, ghost armies, prison breaks. Friends or AI bots — the heist is always on.

games.name: Splendor The Great
games.description: Aim for the stars in Splendor The Great, a 2D vertically scrolling shoot'em up that challenges you to plan your shots creatively and execute them with grace. Discover your own path through waves of enemies. Demonstrate your mastery by chaining each wave to reveal more of the night sky.

games.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
games.description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

games.name: Submundus
games.description: 你在世界深处的囚牢中醒来。战斗、搜寻物资，奋力杀出一条通往地表的路。牌组就是你的身体、背包与时钟，伤口、饥饿和疲惫都会化作卡牌。命运发给你一手烂牌，你也必须打好。

games.name: HamYam
games.description: A fast-paced, competitive 2D platform racing game of hamsters competing through beautiful dream world tracks!

games.name: Symbiosis: Criticality
games.description: Break the core. Collect the bits. Build a machine that does it for you. An incremental reactor-builder where drones swarm, beams fire, and every upgrade turns a simple click into a bigger spectacle. Balance destruction with collection to keep it all running.

games.name: First Light
games.description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

games.name: Goodly Trials
games.description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and develop your company to survive your journey home. (Plays like a: roguelite, turn-based strategy, auto battler)

games.name: 机骸：第九行星
games.description: 《机骸：第九行星》是一款科幻风机甲类幸存者游戏，玩家可操控多台拥有独特技能、完整进化体系、设计风格迥异的机甲，在特色鲜明的不同关卡中不断进化并屠戮敌群，并解锁丰富的局外成长和新玩法。游戏故事发生在距今一个多世纪的太阳系第九行星上，与小队成员和伙伴们跨越史诗般的未来岁月，并成为英雄的机甲驾驶员吧！

games.name: GO or STOP
games.description: GO or STOP将传统游戏“红灯绿灯”重新演绎为一场心理博弈派对游戏。玩家每轮轮换追捕者与跑者身份。跑者可以推挤对手、躲在其他跑者身后并争夺第一名；追捕者则要观察移动中的跑者，阻止他们抵达终点。

games.name: 潜艇日志：番茄钟航海记
games.description: 《潜艇日志：番茄钟航海记》是一款结合番茄钟与放置玩法的潜艇寻宝游戏：你的每一次专注，都会变成一趟深海旅程！沿途收集宝物、升级潜艇，一路探寻深海的秘宝。还能选用专属音乐与白噪音，打造属于自己的专注环境；就连海里的宝物也能亲手设计，分享给整片海域的玩家。

games.name: Wirehawk
games.description: 《Wirehawk》是一款致敬80年代街机经典的霓虹矢量射击游戏。用你喜欢的方式玩：精准锐利的鼠标操控，或为摇杆重新平衡的专属手柄模式。轰碎小行星与外星人潮，躲过弹雨风暴，用静滞减缓时间。全程自动开火。

games.name: Seal Way
games.description: 你是否一直梦想着体验海豹的生活，却因为现实原因无法晒太阳、吃鱼？机会来了！探索水族馆内部，解开谜题，避开危险，并找到回家的路。我们为你带来一个色彩缤纷的世界、迷人的风景，以及更多精彩内容！

games.name: OutGraft
games.description: 一款高速2D恐怖动作跑酷游戏，巨大而诡异的怪物始终在身后追赶。挥剑击退或跳过敌人，装备不同寄生体，组合自动能力。攻击可积蓄过热，蓄满后向前冲刺并同时触发全部寄生体能力。保持领先；一旦被抓住，本次挑战便会结束。

games.name: Network & Cyber Security Simulator
games.description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

games.name: Apparatus Inspector
games.description: Apparatus Inspector 是一款复古 OS 恐怖模拟游戏。你被困地下，负责评估合成 AI 机器人的异常。通过与受感染机器人聊天、输入终端命令、监控摄像头以及躲避物理威胁，在 7 天的班次中生存下来。

games.name: Hop Slasher
games.description: Hop Slasher is an arena battler that combines fruit ninja with the shot accuracy of billiards, but the enemies fight back.

games.name: Untitled Shop Game
games.description: Untitled Shop Game is a shop simulator that lets you unleash your artistic side. There are 200+ decorations and no limits to how, what, or where you place items (well, except for placing stuff on the roads). Oh, and one more thing: the game includes a music player with over 50 songs!

games.name: 请排队吧，魔王大人！：自走棋
games.description:
“一线交锋，无限策略！”
用最强的组合，再次登上魔王军团之巅！

games.name: 尸潮永无止尽
games.description:
《尸潮永无止尽》是一款虚幻引擎开发的横版丧尸动作游戏。拥有扎实流畅、拳拳到肉的近战打击手感。
你可以孤身深入危险区域搜寻物资、收集资源，返回营地提升自身能力；也可以邀请好友开启本地双人合作模式，并肩对抗源源不断的丧尸浪潮。
合理搜集生存物资，持续强化战斗能力，运用多样的格斗方式冲破尸潮，在末日之中活下去！

games.name: TOUHOU IDLE
games.description: 在这款小巧的放置角色扮演游戏中，《东方Project》的3D Q版角色将在幻想乡的无尽长廊中自动战斗。组建最多四人的队伍，安排前后排与职业搭配，收集装备和稀有战利品，再通过分支技能树打造各具特色的角色流派。击败一波又一波的敌人、精英与首领，不断向更高难度前进。无论工作、学习还是浏览网页，都能让游戏在不遮挡屏幕的窄小窗口中持续战斗与成长；偶尔回来调整阵容、分配技能点并更换装备，尝试全新的组合与打法，看看这支队伍究竟能走多远。

games.name: Bottlecappers
games.description: 建造一座瓶盖工厂，实现生产线自动化，挺过投资人的季度审查——他们只用一个数字来评判你。一款讽刺风格的工厂经营 Roguelite：达成他们的 KPI，买回每一份股权，再把他们请出门。

games.name: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
games.description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

games.name: Sabado
games.description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

games.name: Click Clock
games.description: 在这款增量游戏中解开时间的神秘面纱。鲜血是时间所索要的货币。时间在流逝。你还在等什么？

games.name: Second Stage
games.description: 你是热带小岛上一家火箭公司的新晋工程师。组装火箭、运行模拟、做出 GO 的决定——然后回家做饭、种菜、钓鱼、看星星。一款温馨的生活模拟游戏：做世界上最棒的工作，也过一种值得回家的生活。

games.name: Shifty Letters
games.description: Shifty Letters is a puzzle game where you use falling blocks to form words. Use special blocks to shift your letters or the row, rotate the whole row, or remove everything touching your new word. But beware the cursed block.

games.name: Hardground
games.description: 继承祖父留下的荒废农场，将它发展成繁荣的农业帝国。饲养动物、种植作物、生产高价值商品，打造梦想中的农场。探索乡间、钓鱼、狩猎、完成任务，一步步成为百万富翁。

games.name: Cult Crasher
games.description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

games.name: Cats Love Cakes
games.description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

games.name: Billionth Soul
games.description: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder.  The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

games.name: Combo Break
games.description: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

games.name: Desktop Witch
games.description: A simple incremental game where you help your local desktop witch, Zemma, fend off enemies with the power of your clicks.

games.name: 姐姐是我的猫
games.description: 《姐姐是我的猫》是一款日系乙女养成恋爱模拟游戏。你将扮演女主角，在四年的校园生活中平衡学业与社交，提升魅力、气质、时尚等属性，邂逅三位性格各异的可攻略男角色——温柔腹黑的当红偶像、内敛闷骚的学长、嘴甜会撩的自恋少年。通过课程、打工、约会、节日活动推进好感度，解锁多线结局。你的选择，决定谁能成为最后留在你身边的人。 你外表是高冷萝莉，实际是个天然呆。专业是物理 系，专业第一，理工系系花。有严重的厌男症，轻则呕吐，重则晕 厥。为了克服厌男症，加入研究所实习，尝试接触男性。因为父亲再婚，与新的弟弟同居。面对弟弟，妮可竟然不感到恶心，于是你请弟弟帮忙自己克服厌男症。究竟这位弟弟为什么可以成为例外？

games.name: 学園バドる！
games.description: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game where girls from different school clubs battle with unique abilities and special moves. Master six types of shots, unleash SP Shots and SP Skills, and play through Story Mode or face the CPU or a friend in Versus Mode.

games.name: Iron Verdict
games.description: IRON VERDICT is a dark turn-based RPG where guilt is decided by trial by combat. Fight as the Crown's champion. Time your parries and dodges, or turn timing off. The longer you serve a kingdom that kills innocent people without breaking its own laws, the closer you get to finding out why.

games.name: 哈基米卡牌
games.description: 《哈基米卡牌》是一款融合扑克牌型与卡牌构筑玩法的肉鸽（Roguelike）策略游戏。扮演一只会哈气的猫，积攒怒气，收集天赋与附魔，构筑独特的卡组流派，用爆发性哈气迎战机制各异的敌人。每一次选择都会改变你的旅程，而每一次哈气都可能逆转战局。

games.name: Tatomic
games.description: Drop linked atoms, build color chains to critical mass, and ignite spectacular combos in a kinetic falling-block puzzle game with 30 escalating levels. Three gameplay modes: Critical Mass, Radioactive Survival, and Puzzle.

games.name: Guardian Above the Domes
games.description: 《穹顶之上的守护者》是一款基于真实动力学的即时轨道轰炸游戏。你将从寂静的空间站炮击敌人，保卫死寂行星上最后的穹顶城市，并与猫形AI一同探究这个失落世界尘封的过往。

games.name: 咕咕嘎嘎：躲猫猫
games.description:
咕嘎！咕嘎！咕咕嘎嘎！！咕咕嘎嘎嘎！咕咕嘎嘎！！！

接下来我会用最直白、最客观、最不绕弯子的翻译给你：

数独！扫雷！融合玩法！！还能跟朋友！联机对战！！！

games.name: Velvet Signal: Private Messages
games.description: Ten days of private messages with Elizabeth, a mysterious cyberpunk model. Earn her trust, make meaningful choices, unlock explicit scenes, and decide whether you will remain a viewer or become someone real to her.

games.name: Checkmade
games.description: Want an Engineer who can revive pieces back? Or a Rook that can move 1 square diagonally? Maybe a Pawn that can also go backwards? Well you got all of that in Checkmade. Custom puzzles with Workshop. Build an army with a budget in the Lab, take it into a match, and find out if the theory holds.

games.name: TCG Shop Life
games.description: 经营你梦想中的 TCG 卡牌商店！上架商品、拆开卡包、自由装修店铺并招募员工。收集卡牌、构筑强力卡组，甚至还能参加各级赛事，一路向世界冠军发起挑战！

games.name: Pongcremental
games.description: 《Pongcremental》是一款让你化身为Pong中的球的增量游戏。消灭敌人、变得更强，并解锁足以改变战局的能力。击打、摧毁、赚取、精进。然后不断重复。

games.name: Light Source
games.description: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

games.name: Witch's Last Curse
games.description: A fantasy RPG about saving a medieval town from a spreading curse as the Witch's Apprentice. Spend your limited daily actions investigating secrets, earning the trust of townsfolk, discovering the ingredients your ritual actually needs, and holding back the thorns before time runs out.

games.name: Backrooms 99
games.description: More than just running. Backrooms 99 is a story-driven horror thriller offering a completely new Backrooms experience. Play solo or co-op to explore environments handcrafted for this game. Solve puzzles, face terrifying entities, and uncover a deep narrative mystery.  1-6 Player.

games.name: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
games.description: 矮人布洛克把小小的锻造铺开在了你的任务栏上方。你敲键盘，他抡锤子。打出来的多是马蹄铁和水壶，偶尔也有一把传奇之剑。东西都由妻子布丽吉达在两口子的小店里卖掉。你打字，他打铁。两个人一起干活，又快又有意思。

games.name: Do Not Eject
games.description: Do Not Eject is a retro handheld-inspired bullet heaven roguelite set inside corrupted game cartridges. Choose a digital partner, build absurd projectile combinations, defeat corrupted guardians, and turn every run into permanent progress.

games.name: 好整洁有限公司
games.description: 一款轻松治愈、操作感十足的整理分类游戏。扮演街区里的专职整理员妮娜，接待各具魅力的顾客，游玩以物品为主题的小游戏，把乱成一团的东西分进正确的箱子，赚取报酬，经营一家深受街坊喜爱的整理店。

games.name: Grand Opening: The Apothecary
games.description: Prepare a cozy apothecary for opening day by organizing every potion, herb, and book after a disastrous move. Serve customers, earn gold, and expand your shop.

games.name: 不一样的合成：生生不息 Genesis: From Water to Stars
games.description: 《不一样的合成：生生不息》是一款具有卡牌风格的资源管理加自动化meta游戏，你将从水、风、土和石头开始。逐渐创造出一整个文明。探索配方、安排工作、连接产线，或者...与见证者互动，看着亲手创造的世界逐渐热闹起来，创造出“星辰大海”，把一个有生命的画布变成伸向星空的文明。

games.name: Sky Commander: Voice RTS
games.description: Command a whole battlefield with your voice. Bark orders — attack, defend, regroup — to fighters, tanks, and mechs, then drop into the cockpit and fight yourself. Secure supply routes, seize the summit, and out-command three rival alliances in a glowing neon-vector war.

games.name: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
games.description: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64.  The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

games.name: Thorn Beach
games.description: Chill while piecing together jigsaw puzzles that transform into cozy, animated slices of life featuring the characters, creatures, and "monsters" of Thorn Beach.

games.name: Domignomes
games.description: Domignomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

games.name: Red Father
games.description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

games.name: Deckforce
games.description: 《Deckforce》是一款将21点机制与Rogue-lite元素相融合的网格卡牌构建游戏。在4x4的网格上组合卡牌凑齐21点，通过大胆的下注让你的资金翻倍，打造你的终极卡组，并击败无情的敌人！

games.name: Roulettegeddon
games.description: Roulettegeddon 是一款融合了黑色幽默的轮盘游戏，将经典赌场下注、僵尸元素以及混乱的迷你游戏巧妙结合。在 Rotten Bob 的嘲讽声中挑战幸运轮盘，并通过一系列疯狂的僵尸迷你游戏赢取积分吧！

games.name: Split Second Volley
games.description: Turn based anime-style sports battles! Create outrageous combos and last minute saves using teamwork and unique skills. You can even use guns! Outsmart your foes, choreograph larger than life moments, and win PvP battles with STYLE!

games.name: Terminidle
games.description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

games.name: FAKE ME
games.description: 建模、上色并融入环境！《FAKE ME》是一款在线多人捉迷藏游戏，你可以亲手打造自己的伪装。使用简单的3D建模工具设计你要伪装成的物体。为角色建模并制作自己的服装。躲避搜寻者，或在时间结束前找出所有伪装者！

games.name: PC Store Together
games.description: 和朋友一起经营电脑商店！组装和维修电脑，诊断故障，补充货架库存，制定价格，销售硬件和定制电脑，服务顾客，管理订单，升级店铺，解锁新配件，一起发展你们的生意。

games.name: GOBLIN ELECTRIC LTD.
games.description: Your power company is down to its last two goblins. Recruit a crew of up to 20, plan their squads and gear, and watch them swarm giant monsters in semi-auto battles. Crack their armor, knock them down, capture them alive – and plug them into the grid.

games.name: Coilbound
games.description: Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a card of hidden traits. Descend a coiling dungeon, read each foe's abilities, and choose your path one card at a time — strike or slip past. But some traits refuse to end: it doesn't die when it dies.

games.name: 神明游戏
games.description: 《神明游戏》是一款跨题材阵容构筑与对战模拟游戏。历史名将、动漫人物和游戏角色，都可以在不同主题中登场。玩家需要选择角色、安排位置、组合能力与羁绊，并在既定规则下参与对战。你决定谁将上场，而完整的模拟系统将决定他们如何战斗，以及谁能走到最后。

games.name: 荒山诡宿
games.description: 你是一名恐怖栏目Vlogger，为拍摄灵异素材深入山村，却误入一间与世隔绝的古旧旅社。诡异异象接踵而至，邪祟逐渐缠身——但你不在乎。因为这一切，都是你梦寐以求的涨粉素材。直到你发现，镜头里拍到的东西，比肉眼看到的更多。在这款多结局剧情向心理惊悚模拟游戏中，你将举起摄像机，记录、探索、抉择，并在深夜回放时直面一个足以吞噬你的惊天阴谋。

games.name: Tulip Simulator
games.description: A Tulip simulator where you crossbreed tulips, uncover impossible genetics, and discover flowers that have never existed before, from delicate heirlooms to crystalline wonders and blooms kissed with gold. Capture your rarest creations and share them with the world.

games.name: PLINKOJI
games.description: PLINKOJI is a Plinko-roguelike about outsmarting randomness. Build your deck from emoji pins, hunt for absurd synergies, take risks and lose - just to come back stronger and find that one game-breaking combo. Defeat isn't the end - it's the beginning of a new strategy.

games.name: Pickpocket
games.description: 《Pickpocket》是一款关于偷窃的渐进式游戏。向你的受害者学习，获取更好的战利品，并通过庞大的技能树不断进化。建立属于你自己的犯罪帝国！

games.name: Conspiracy Clean Up Crew
games.description: Conspiracy Clean Up Crew is a co-operative game in which you must erase all evidence of your existence before the humans arrive. While most of you are busy covering your tracks, a small group of saboteurs will do everything they can to get caught. Will you manage to clean everything up in time?

games.name: Plink Void
games.description: Plink Void is a pachinko roguelike with dark fantasy aesthetic. Throw blade-balls, crush pegs-skulls, collect game-changing artifacts and find ancient Truth at the bottom of the Void.

games.name: Colorful Boi 2
games.description: Jump, dash and wall-climb through 74 colorful, deadly levels! Colorful Boi 2 is a tight, fast precision platformer stuffed with spikes, saws, conveyors and launchers - with instant retries, brutal-but-fair challenge and leaderboards for the fastest runs.

games.name: Fantasy Siege
games.description: In Fantasy Siege, you take control of one of several unique fantasy races. Each race has its own units, heroes, buildings, spells, technologies, and other upgrades that will allow you to defeat your enemies in matches for up to 4 players. The game is an auto-battler.

games.name: HOTEL10
games.description: 一款以寻找异常×逃脱为主题的恐怖游戏。若未发现异常则继续前进，若发现异常则折返。与龙猫一起，努力从酒店逃脱吧。

games.name: Stack Factory
games.description: Drop pieces, complete lines, and build upward. Shape your blocks into factories, mine zerons to keep your economy running, and hire guardians to fight at your side.

games.name: Colorways
games.description: Manage the Colorways safely and efficiently - control colorful traffic through various intersections and avoid traffic jams and accidents. Compete against the world's best traffic controllers to climb the leaderboards.

games.name: MOLTYN
games.description: MOLTYN：每个像素都经过模拟的超级英雄破坏沙盒。岩石、水、岩浆、冰与金属会真实地熔化、泛滥、冻结和崩塌。掌握大地的全部力量，畅玩 18 个剧情任务、怪兽战、自由沙盒世界，以及支持关卡分享的关卡编辑器 CREATE。2026 年 11 月 12 日开启抢先体验。

games.name: One Gun Army
games.description: 一把枪，征服整个宇宙。每一次扣动扳机、清空弹匣，以及拍下枪机释放钮，都会让你离彻底称霸更近一步。在这款增量放置游戏中，一枪一枪迈向最终统治。

games.name: Elandrake
games.description: Elandrake 是一款增量成长型双摇杆射击游戏。保护一个正从另一个现实中显现的宇宙实体。吞噬物质以获得能力，并用这些力量将敌方舰队轰回它们来时的地方！

games.name: Scawy Game
games.description: 肯古因·斯汀是一名失败的恐怖小说作家，他买下了一栋便宜的素材商店房子，准备写出自己的杰作。他唯一的工作：喂猫。还有让奶奶按时吃药。还有活过 4 天和 4 个夜晚。一款荒诞的恐怖恶搞游戏。

games.name: Gloombo
games.description: Gloombo 是一位陪伴你专注时光的温馨桌面伙伴。把专注的时间化作她可以制作的物品，扩建她的浮空岛，完成订单，发现新图纸，并照顾一位朋友。

games.name: 无限轮回：增量
games.description: 极简纯粹的文字挂机放置游戏！以时间管理与规划策略为核心，在有限时间内精心安排行动优先级。死亡不可避免，但每一次轮回你都会变得更强。构筑你的自动化循环，突破无限轮回！

games.name: Winds of Valor
games.description: Winds of Valor is a loot-focused fantasy RPG, reminiscent of retro computer games from the 1980's. Explore a vast continent, battle a diverse set of foes, complete quests, and find powerful items along the way that define your character.

games.name: 逃离：伪装色
games.description:
一款融合自由绘画、身份欺骗、心理恐怖追逃与跑酷的多人派对游戏。你可以把它理解成一个更搞笑、更自由的 MM2 式玩法——加入了身体绘画、环境伪装和跑酷追逐。

绘制你的伪装，藏进环境之中，欺骗其他玩家，利用跑酷摆脱追杀，并在混乱的追猎中活到最后。

games.name: Stay with me
games.description:
Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia.
Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

games.name: Rogue Belt
games.description: 在这款俯视角太空轻度 Rogue 游戏中，独自作战或在线合作，杀出风暴肆虐的小行星带。自由搭配飞船与武器，每分钟选择一次升级，十分钟后迎战首领。成功突围，解锁新飞船、武器和永久升级。

games.name: Forsaken Trials
games.description: A hard, momentum-driven platformer where every jump is final. Master sprint, vault, and precision timing through cursed ancient ruins. No air control. No checkpoints. One mistake means death. Restart instantly and try again.

games.name: Lone Sprout - Il Germoglio Solitario
games.description: Manage the Lone Sprout outpost as Sylvain. Balance your needs, optimize the cultivation of precious Claritea, and trade with Eve. Use a gramophone to listen to tracks with unique gameplay effects and unravel an ancient mystery in this 3D low-poly rural survival game.

games.name: Palisade
games.description: 在即时战略战场上直接指挥领土，无需微操编队。扩张边界、连通补给道路，并用骑兵突击和海上登陆突破敌阵。包含五段历史战役、遭遇战、内置地图编辑器以及支持最多 8 名玩家的在线多人游戏。

games.name: My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!
games.description: 你的这条弹幕，能被推“接住”吗？《My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!》是一款全新体验的聊天冒险游戏。你将作为一名观众，参加一位明明自称“清楚系”，情绪却怎么也藏不住、全力以赴又有点冒失的新人VTuber直播。只要读懂空气，发出恰到好处的网络黑话，她就会叫出你的名字，并顺着你的话展开话题。而你一路发出的每一条弹幕，也将在即将到来的考验中左右她的命运。要是踩雷，就会当场被BAN。不要害怕，尽管发送弹幕，引导你的推达成百万订阅吧。

games.name: Bad Dead Shift
games.description: When a zombie virus overruns the city, an ordinary security guard becomes the last hope in a fast-paced side-scrolling pixel action game - fighting through dangerous buildings, saving survivors, and staying alive amidst the chaos of an infected city.

games.name: Imperionis
games.description: Imperionis 是一款以罗马指挥官为主角的战术角色扮演游戏。率领百人队征战高卢，通过 D20 检定作出决定，发展营地与军队，并可亲自指挥六角格回合制战斗，或开启自动战斗观看双方交锋。

games.name: Soccer Club Story
games.description: Build a football club from nothing. Start in the seventh division, recruit and develop players, shape your tactics, and watch every match play out in a charming voxel 3D stadium. Turn a small club into champions.

games.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
games.description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

games.name: Desiderium
games.description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

games.name: For Our King
games.description: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

games.name: 像素打工人
games.description: 在像素城市里打工攒钱，鉴定装备、培养宠物、钓鱼挖矿、切割玉石、交易股票，再到赌场碰碰运气。安稳生活，还是搏个大的？这次由你选择。

games.name: Evertrail
games.description: Explore a peaceful first-person photography and exploration adventure. Discover breathtaking forests, villages, mountains, lakes, and cities as you capture unforgettable moments and uncover hidden trails at your own pace.

games.name: Packs To Riches
games.description: 用一把零钱博一场财富：拆开卡包，把里面的东西换成现金。追逐稀有卡，填满卡册，把利润投进更炫的升级和更高级的卡包。把最好的卡送去评级，卖给收藏家，建立属于你的卡牌帝国。

games.name: Tidy Town
games.description: 《Tidy Town》是一款第三人称清洁游戏，你需要组合日常物品来收拾杂乱、改造空间。帮助珀西伸出“援爪”，一次整理一个房间：拯救朋友的咖啡馆、重建城市公园、焕新艺术家的工作室，一路把整个小镇收拾得井井有条，也走进了社区居民的心里。

games.name: Matchinko
games.description: Match glowing crystals to build a pachinko board, then rain your ball loadout through it for an exploding score. A cozy winter roguelite of fairies, tiles, and fate: light every town on the climb to the boss — but miss one target and the run is over.

games.name: Talk Of The Tavern
games.description: 一款合作式自动战斗类流氓般的游戏，敌对公会将踏上前往国王城堡的征程，途中在酒馆停驻，通过竞标争夺雇佣兵，并利用强大的卷轴打造专属阵容。在旅途中生存下来，并征服国王锦标赛。

games.name: Geometry Run
games.description: Geometry Run is a 3D third-person platformer with a retro synthwave style. Control a glowing cube, overcome creative and challenging levels, and perfect every run. Designed for speedrunners, each level features three modes: Normal, Reverse, and Speedrun.

games.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
games.description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Become Blackhole 成为黑洞
games.description: 一款关于「变大」的太空增量游戏。你是一粒尘埃，击碎目标获取质量。从一块碎石一路长成陨石、卫星、行星、恒星，最终成为吞噬一切的黑洞！

games.name: DATUM: Rescue One
games.description: 一款单人直升机搜救游戏。驾驶直升机穿越风暴与黑暗，借助前视红外系统（FLIR）寻找幸存者，用探照灯确认他们的位置，并将他们安全救回。没有武器。只有大海、黑夜，以及争分夺秒的救援。

games.name: Kairos
games.description: Build, expand, and wage dice-driven wars in this medieval 4x strategy game played in under an hour. Adopt unique legacies to progressively define your strategy as you race your rivals to accomplish 5 feats and claim victory.

games.name: The Tally
games.description: A PS2-style life sim about being a small, busy person in a mid-sized city. Get a job, buy a home, pet a dog, make some choices. Every one of them is being counted. You will die in about 90 minutes. Then you get the receipt, and the afterlife sorts you accordingly. A life, itemized.

games.name: Procession Engine
games.description: 不是又一款回合制卡组构建游戏。这是一场实时拉锯战，你指挥一整支军队：建筑生产它，卡牌塑造它，两条兵线决定谁的要塞先倒下。

games.name: GALLERY OF LIES
games.description: 第一人称陷阱逃脱游戏。别相信你看到的一切。闭馆后你在博物馆里睡着了，醒来时已经在墙的另一侧。到出口还有23个房间。指示牌是假的，箭头指向尖刺，上个房间救了你的那个闪避，在下个房间会要你的命。

games.name: 原路弹回
games.description: 狗民们通过几何学来进行决斗：计算角度，让子弹经墙壁反弹，从而击中那些看似不可能命中的目标。在旅途中，你将与一只坚信自己是狗的猫结伴同行。您和一只自认为是狗的猫结伴上路，见识各地的居民，或许会遇到一些麻烦，但您总能通过漂亮的一发子弹解决问题。

games.name: Grave Engine
games.description: Build armies. Break the game with outrageous item combinations. Explore handcrafted races and biomes in a replayable dark fantasy roguelite where every run tells a different story.

games.name: 薪火与扳机
games.description: 以与机械战斗的设施“种植园”为舞台的科幻军事小说。少年兵仁奉上级命令，与少女及女童扮演虚假的家庭。仁通过家庭生活回想起了人与人之间的温暖，但与此同时，“种植园”所隐藏的黑暗也开始蠢蠢欲动——。

games.name: QBLOX
games.description: QBLOX is a fast-paced 3D action puzzle game where you shift the axis between two walls to guide blocks, break lines, and master spatial precision.

games.name: CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜
games.description:
不知自己是谁，你踏入了流光溢彩的名画世界。
漫步于画卷之中，收集“记忆”，填满空空的容器——这是一场沉浸式艺术冒险。
当你走过一段段美好的记忆，最终又将描绘出怎样的“世界”

games.name: Sylvia
games.description:
Sylvia is a beautifully hand‑drawn adult erotic visual novel with a fully voiced cast, where your choices matter and shape every relationship.
Experience an interactive story exploring sensuality, romance, desires, loyalty, emotional dependence, and forgiveness.

games.name: Neural Goblins
games.description: 进入一个由高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）构成的独特奇幻三维世界——这里映照着你混乱、嘈杂、迷雾重重的大脑。选择一个目标，驾驶脑泡水母闯入其中，穿越 11 个脑内洞穴，探索高空巢穴与隐藏捷径，寻找五只代表不同脑功能的神经哥布林。完成古怪的小游戏，收集多巴胺金币，在神经市场购买资源，建设属于自己的巢穴。这里没有自动替你工作的完美大脑：你必须亲自探索、判断并选择下一步，看看那些神经哥布林到底在搞什么鬼。

games.name: Island Raiders
games.description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

games.name: 赛博修仙
games.description: 眼角余光扫过一撮白绒绒的尾巴——狐小满已经住进你的桌面。敲键变功德，便签有回音，心事有回应。接上你自己的AI模型之后，她会真正活了过来：陪你唠嗑、五子棋跟你斗嘴、难事帮你参谋，像个老熟人。相处越久，她越懂你。从此桌面上，一直有人在。

games.name: Dunjin
games.description:
Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. 

Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

games.name: Bone to Pick / 拾骨谜案
games.description: 从一根骨头，找回身份与真相。以法医人类学实验室为舞台的视觉小说式推理冒险。用科学的眼光解读骨头与物证，和个性十足的同事一起搜查现场、反复实验，一步步逼近真凶。七位死者等着找回名字，18 种把法证工作原样做成的玩法，还有一只很乖的狗。

games.name: Woks & Works
games.description: 打造并自动化你的餐饮帝国。管理厨师、顾客、供应链和生产流程，让食品经济系统持续运转。

games.name: BlackHole Collapse
games.description: Take control of a growing singularity in Blackhole Collapse, a fast-paced action rogue-like! Devour cosmic debris, dodge relentless hazards and volatile anomalies, upgrade your gravitational powers, and consume entire celestial bodies as you survive the void.

games.name: SEVEN DAYS 未知的密室生活
games.description: 《SEVEN DAYS 未知的密室生活》是一款密室悬疑解谜游戏。身为记者的你与制药千金意外被囚，被迫参与为期7天的极限监禁游戏。在幕后黑手的高压指令下，你的选择将决定两人是揭开真相成功逃脱，还是彻底崩溃于密室之中。

games.name: Beatlash: Survival
games.description: 一款用你的音乐开打的割草生存游戏。成千上万的敌人踩着节拍涌来，鼓点炸开的那一刻，你也跟着炸开。放上你最爱的那首歌，看整个屏幕跟着它碎成光。

games.name: 毁灭之巢
games.description: 《毁灭之巢》是一款暗黑风格增量塔防游戏。作为仪式的守护者，你需要迎战永无休止的敌潮。通过一次次战斗解锁全新技能、提升属性，在海量变数中探索你的专属构筑。去吧，勇猛的战士，在这场危机四伏的残酷仪式中，寸步不让，筑起守护仪式传送门的最后防线！

games.name: 棋2
games.description:
国际象棋，但是……  

无回合, 

无将军或将死, 

同一棋子不能走两次, 

10×10棋盘, 

额外2个马和兵, 

兵可向任意方向移动

games.name: Love At The Desktop Market
games.description: 一款以手机小组件形式存在于你真实桌面上的生活模拟游戏。在超市轮班打工,给心上人发短信,然后看着TA出现在游戏窗口之外

games.name: MonMusu Breaker
games.description: A classic Brick Breaker with a naughty twist! Smash through challenging stages, unlock new characters and scenes, and put your aim and timing to the test. Can you break your way through them all?

games.name: Mapping Creator
games.description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

games.name: 池畔的记忆
games.description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. Scattered memories, multiple endings — and a world that rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

games.name: Bloody Duke
games.description: Embark as Blaise Vaelthorne, the 35th Duke of Caerwyn and Warden of the White City, on a harrowing journey to reclaim the Phoenix Throne from the daemon host. Endure betrayal, suffering, and impossible odds as you fight to restore your dukedom’s destiny. By Right. By Blood.

games.name: Vital Decisions
games.description:
Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players.
Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. 
Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

games.name: Party Tycoon: Takeover
games.description: Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors, and turn a rough room into the hottest venue in town. But most important: have fun!

games.name: Memory Cyphers
games.description: 1到4人在线合作类幸存者游戏。和朋友一起迎战被抽走记忆的敌潮。记忆芯片升级、武器强化、改变局势的遗物。用 Cypher Shift 冲破包围把队友拉回来！节奏飞快的Roguelite动作。

games.name: ZUNKS
games.description: ZUNKS is a top-down action game where you wipe out swarms of monsters and battle against powerful bosses in a ruined world. Save the world with ZUNKS, with all your might and a cheerful spirit!

games.name: 挖穿地球
games.description: 一款像素挖矿增量游戏，一步步挖穿各式各样的星球。每个星球都有独特的挖掘方式、不同的技能树升级节点与收集物。一次购买，畅玩多颗星球，还能同时开挖三颗星球。

games.name: Takeout Mania
games.description: Build a food-delivery empire in a real city. Sign its restaurants, dispatch couriers down actual streets, and out-market two entrenched rivals — from a lone scooter to a city-spanning operation. Play any city on Earth and watch a living economy boom, franchise, or go bankrupt.

games.name: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort
games.description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic 1-4 player co-op defense game. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

games.name: 迷途森林
games.description: “肉眼所见，皆为牢笼。” 在这片被诅咒的森林中，黑暗是唯一的实体。寻找散落在密林间的古老路灯，利用光影裂隙在现实与回忆间穿梭。唯有改变过去，才能消除现实中的绝路，逃离这场永无止境的心理噩梦。

games.name: Galvanize Simulator
games.description: Manage a hot-dip galvanizing plant. Bid steel contracts, staff the pickle line and kettle, and run overhead cranes—auto or by hand. Upgrade plant equipment, optimize racks, expand your line, and ship coated loads on time without burning zinc or customers.

games.name: One Man Guerrilla
games.description: One Man Guerrilla is a stealth action game where you play as Bento, a rebel agent fighting a brutal dictatorship. Infiltrate diverse Brazilian cities on deadly missions where being seen means practically death, and face powerful bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

games.name: Stellar Orbit
games.description: 挖得比燃料能载你返航的深度更深，同时太阳耀斑扰乱你的仪表。用那些迎击海盗群的武器剥采整条矿带，在燃料耗尽前赶回，并让每一趟都更深入垂死的恒星。俯视视角的采矿生存分数挑战。

games.name: Gnomes Vs Knights
games.description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

games.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
games.description: 在色彩缤纷的 Verdantia 世界中，与好友或 AI 机器人展开最多 4 人的爆炸性本地多人对战。掌握强化道具与难以预测的 Chaos Mutators，征服 Region Tour，证明自己是 MegaBlast Festival 的冠军。

games.name: Plushy's Playground: Into the Slide
games.description:
《Plushy's Playground: Into the Slide》是一款剧情驱动的模拟恐怖游戏。你将在一座诡异的游乐场中探索、解开谜题，并追寻隐藏其中的线索。

据说，滑梯的另一头有一个由孩子们为孩子们建造的地方。在那里，谁都不必长大。

但你已经不是孩子了。

games.name: Gemfire Survival
games.description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

games.name: Facetier
games.description: Match-3 with an automation twist. Every gem you clear is a resource. Store, sort, and route them into machines that extract more gems or match the board for you.

games.name: Train Party
games.description: 两列火车并排飞驰，车上都是拿枪的人。捡起地上的任何武器，隔着车距开火，胆子够大就爬上车顶。铁轨本身也在找你麻烦：山脊、隧道、桥梁。合作波次生存或PvP。尽量别掉下去。

games.name: Fractured Rift: Incremental
games.description: 一款增量 RPG 自动战斗游戏。组建并培养你的队伍，搭配各具特色的队友，征服难度不断提升的楼层。

games.name: What Have I Become?
games.description: Live an entire life through the personality you build. Every choice strengthens, weakens or transforms cards in your deck and that changes which choices become possible. Replay different lives, endings and identities, see what you became in your final Life Report. No correct answer has been filed.

games.name: Climb, Cube, Climb!
games.description: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a cute rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.

games.name: IRREVERENCE
games.description: IRREVERENCE is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this quirky hotline miami like.

games.name: 洞穴大冒险
games.description: 一款支持1–4人游玩的生存恐怖游戏。操控巨型钻探机，探索洞穴，收集贵重物品，并躲避地下生物的追击。返回地表后，卖掉找到的物品，用赚到的钱升级设备、购买装备。支持单人游玩或在线合作。

games.name: JOVA
games.description: A cozy, bright cascade puzzler. Line up three or more Jovials to clear them, chain the cascades, then bank the meter to trigger HYPER for ultra combos! Play cozy solo across two modes and a 50-level ladder, or go head-to-head in local or online versus against a friend or one of your 10 AI rivals.

games.name: The Scarlet Thread
games.description: 《朱线》是一部维多利亚式庄园推理游戏，画面有着细密的 1-bit 版画质感，黑白之间留着一缕猩红。翻阅不同人物的手记，查验衣物与账册，亲手重演那一夜。难的不只是识破谎言，还要知道每句真话究竟能证明到哪一步。

games.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
games.description: 这是一款单人俯视视角撤离射击游戏，你将实时切换指挥迫降于战火沙漠中的灵梦、魔理沙与荷取。确保物资以求生存，借助联军之力修复次元传送装置，返回幻想乡。

games.name: ODDSTABLE
games.description: 在这款单人离线赛马赔率 Roguelite 中研判六马赛局、锁定固定赔率，并撑过十二场巡回。用虚拟金币组合赛票、签下地下合约，让饰品成为你的兑奖引擎。不含真钱投注或游戏内购买。

games.name: Path of the Retired Adventurer
games.description: A semi-idle crafting sim inspired by Path of Exile, for when you still love the loot but not the grind. Forge gear, gamble on affix rolls, and equip the adventurers who quest and delve in your place. Craft their gear, seal their fate.

games.name: White Hound
games.description: 在自由城市阿扎利亚一座活生生的公会办公室里经营 WHITE HOUND。招募英雄、从公告板挑选任务、观看小队在微缩任务地图上行进、发工资、打公会战、在公报上追逐名声……当然，不用离开你的书桌!!!

games.name: 老婆列车
games.description: 女孩们购买欲望列车的车票，只为实现自己最大胆的幻想。结识车上的乘客，了解她们的喜好，并沉浸在互动体验中——你的每一个动作都会引发真实而鲜明的反应。

games.name: When Life Gives You Lemons
games.description: 和至多 3 位好友一起经营或对抗柠檬摊！在合作或互相使坏的同时，混合原料、调配完美配方、榨取新鲜果汁，让你的顾客满意。订购水果和设备，解锁升级，将你的小摊发展成终极商业帝国。

games.name: FatCat Nexus
games.description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

games.name: 僵尸驾到
games.description: 这是一款以“呼吸与声音管理”为核心的 1-4 人合作恐怖游戏。你需要在黑暗中控制呼吸和声音，避免被尸王闻到、听见；奔跑、碰撞、喘息都会暴露自己。队友之间要分工协作：有人搜集资源、推进目标，有人牵引威胁，有人补给与救援，靠判断何时冒险、何时撤退完成封镇与逃生。

games.name: Coverage
games.description: A board game for two players similar to Othello and Ataxx. Cover the board with your pieces--or take over all of your opponent's.

games.name: Gunship Incremental
games.description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

games.name: Shadow Sovereign
games.description: Minion-based tower defense crossed with an incremental, topped with RPG systems and raid-style boss fights. Raise a legion of 29 shadow types, claim the shadows of 20 fallen bosses, and reset for permanent power. Idle when you want, hands-on when it counts.

games.name: Duck Duck Gone
games.description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

games.name: Impact Zero Project
games.description:
Impact Zero Project is the first third person, 3-D platformer obstacle game with many different types of shaped objects, lasers and the danger of falling into outer space! Precision, timing and momentum are the difference between winning or losing. 

The Objective is simple: Don't touch anything!

games.name: 环噬
games.description: 以身体为武库的贪吃蛇类 roguelite。收集武器身节，把相同的邻居融合升阶，不断重排，直到它们彼此产生反应。当构筑成型，咬住自己的尾巴闭合环形——圈内的一切，尽数处决。

games.name: Bach For More Words
games.description: Bach For More Words is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its definition from three related definitions. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words!

games.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
games.description: 建设并发展属于你的农场和路边商店。种植作物、饲养动物、制作高价值商品、制定价格、雇用员工、补充货架、接待顾客，将小小的生意逐步发展成兴旺的事业。

games.name: 魔法少女×幸せ××××バイト
games.description: Even so, you deserve to be happy

games.name: FIRST LINE
games.description: A retro office mystery about tech support, deadlines, and a floor that doesn't exist. It's 2001, and you're the L1 helpdesk tech at a corporation running on an OS from another era. Close tickets against the clock. Mind your tone. Don't ask about Floor 7.

games.name: Arrows Puzzle
games.description: Clear every arrow from calm, increasingly intricate logic puzzles. Find open paths, remove blockers in the right order, solve 1,000 levels and daily challenges, or chase a high score in Arrow Rush—without ads or timer pressure.

games.name: Dreamfend
games.description: Dreamfend 是一款像素风幸存者类肉鸽游戏，你将扮演一只泰迪熊，守护熟睡的孩子不被噩梦侵扰。击退成群的敌人，收集并强化武器，搜寻各种强化，找出所有 BOSS，撑过这一夜。最重要的是——别在战斗中迷失自我，守护好那个孩子。

games.name: Fly&Goal
games.description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

games.name: My Otaku Girlfriend
games.description: 悠一所在的动漫部终于成功参加同人活动「Comiko」，为了庆祝出展成功，成员们来到新开的高级派对包间举行庆功宴。 悠一也决定趁今晚向一直喜欢的真纪告白。 然而，随着「国王游戏」开始，原本欢乐的聚会逐渐变得不再单纯。最近加入动漫部的海斗似乎也在暗中策划着什么，真纪也一步步陷入了危险之中。。。

games.name: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI
games.description:
To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC.
Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago.
Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

games.name: Grave Danger
games.description: A comedic turn-based survival RPG. A pharmaceutical giant sold the apocalypse as self-care. Adventure 24 zones, fight 380+ absurd monsters, craft weapons from garbage, and topple the CEO who ended the world. Days are turn-limited. Currency is Salt. Jokes are not optional.

games.name: Rot & Bloom
games.description: 一个温馨治愈的闲置堆肥箱，专属于你的副屏幕。喂它厨余，看着它们腐烂长成一座会发光的花园，再丢入一份神秘废料（Mystery Scrap），屏息期待一场花园奇迹——那朵大到能吞掉整个屏幕的绽放。雇几个地精，种一棵可以永久保留的季节之树，让一切在你工作时悄悄运转。

games.name: Cage Legacy
games.description: Build a struggling MMA gym into a title-winning empire. Scout fighters, negotiate contracts, run training camps, survive the drama, balance every dollar, and work the corner live during fully simulated fight nights. A single-player pixel-art management sim.

games.name: Wēlandes
games.description: Solve ancient mysteries in the ethereal world of Anglo-Saxon Britain. You are the spel-wefa, use your magical translation devices to help the gods, beasts, and gentlefolk of Old English poetry. Journey the ageless chalk hills surrounding Wayland’s Smithy; unearth the stories that wander within.

games.name: Dreadlight
games.description: Hold back the dark in a horror arena-survival roguelite. Fight inside your lantern's glow, build a six-weapon arsenal, and brave cursed relics. Rising Dread tears scars into the arena that persist between waves. Spend scrap to seal them, or save it for your next upgrade.

games.name: IRON EDEN
games.description: Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

games.name: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
games.description: 君士坦丁堡，1453年。四位见证者——一名耶尼切里、一个面包师的女儿、一位工程师、一名贵族——在城墙的两侧，经历着围城的同样五十三天。你在一个故事里做出的选择会越入另一个故事：一次宽赦改写别人的结局，一笔贿赂变成最后清晨的一条小船，而这座城市记得这一切。张力从来不在于城会不会陷落，而在于城陷之时你会是谁。这是一部区分目击者日记与后世传说的插图历史小说，以你的选择推进——每一个结局，都是某个人的真相。

games.name: 卡组野兽
games.description: 组建一支像素风野兽小队，在这款融合卡组构筑与自走棋的 Roguelike 中杀穿跃迁。招募野兽、装配技能与道具、收集遗物，用离谱的构筑碾碎其他玩家。

games.name: Riddled Together
games.description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

games.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
games.description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

games.name: Darcnia Monster
games.description: 放下一张卡，怪兽就从卡面里走出来，站上决斗场。Darcnia 是一款免费在线的战术卡牌游戏，没有付费获胜：所有卡牌都靠游玩获得，没有抽卡，也没有付费独占；拿到手的卡还能在交换所和拍卖行里与其他玩家自由流通。爬上深渊之上的十层高塔，击败每一层的看守者，把它们封印进自己的卡组，并掌握咒唤、力量、蛰伏、领域、仪式五种符文。每一场决斗都在全 3D 场地上展开，100 多只怪兽评级从 F 到 SSS，每一张卡都是一个活着的像素灵魂，全部由一个人逐格手绘。

games.name: Sumiban
games.description: A Shinto-inspired Sokoban puzzle adventure where you use a magical brush to paint paths, activate mechanisms, and uncover the secrets of forgotten divine ruins.

games.name: 命运星轨
games.description: 《命运星轨》是一款融合物理弹珠战斗、世界棋盘探索与使魔构筑的单人 Roguelite 策略 RPG。瞄准并发射角色，使其在骰阵中连续反弹；每次碰撞都会掷出点数，触发骰中使魔的攻击、治疗、控制与连锁效果。掷行动骰穿行于三个随机排序的骰境，从四枚普通 D6 开始建立只属于本局的使魔队伍，并迎战三位拥有多阶段机制的黄道宫主。

games.name: 佐谷霞巳不能没有你!
games.description:
在为了防止怪病扩散而建起的分隔牆内，你独自在要塞中进行了2年的守卫任务。
但某天，一名待救助者——佐谷霞巳逃到了要塞前。
被分配在你所属要塞居住的霞巳不知为何很在意你的健康，总是动不动就想照料你的生活。
平和中藏着一丝不稳，热闹又温馨的同居生活即将开始！

games.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
games.description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

games.name: Retro Club Manager
games.description:
Manage your club through fast-paced football seasons in a retro-inspired management simulation. 
Build your squad, scout the transfer market, manage finances, shape your tactics and experience procedurally generated stories in every career.

games.name: Fish Them All!
games.description: 目标是累计1亿条鱼！钓鱼赚钱、学习技能，再钓到更多鱼。这是一款渔获数量与钓鱼速度不断飙升的像素风短篇增量钓鱼游戏。找来潜水员、无人机和UFO当伙伴，在4～5小时内钓尽最后一条鱼吧！

games.name: Pro Baseball: Franchise Builder
games.description: Take control of a professional baseball franchise and build a winner through the draft, trades, free agency, and player development. Customize your league, manage your farm system, track history, and lead your club to a Championship Series.

games.name: COG
games.description: HNI Industries is HIRING TODAY! Join a team where productivity is purpose and exhaustion is honor. Your worth will be measured by each word you successfully type. Can you handle the stress?

games.name: Undermoon
games.description: UnderMoon 是一款暗黑奇幻回合制战术 Roguelike。穿过神秘传送门，在方格战场上规划走位，选择种族并搭配武器与技能，利用火焰、冰与闪电改变战局。探索不同主题的区域，挑战首领，寻找离开这片月下世界的线索。

games.name: Risewards
games.description: Solve tons of puzzles using logic, physics and (why not) by tricking the game itself. Sometimes the solution may be obvious to you, other times you'll need to think outside the box to progress, or maybe hack your own way to skip a puzzle. Just don't fall into the void... unless you should? ;)

games.name: 王之将死/Checkmate
games.description: 《王之将死》是一款发生在9×10中国象棋棋盘上的回合制卡牌Roguelite。你将操控一枚持炮的红方孤帅，在敌军重围中移动、装填、架炮与开火；借敌子作为炮架，计算爆炸范围，在高风险的快炮散射与精准的架炮射击之间作出抉择。沿途选择卡牌，强化火力、射程、弹药和特殊战术，但每次成长也会让敌军获得新的兵种、能力与规则。车马炮卒会持续逼近，一步失误便可能陷入将死。构筑属于你的杀局，突破包围，轰开九宫，亲手斩下敌将。

games.name: Castellan
games.description: 由一人开发的实时肉鸽城堡防御游戏。从城堡射箭，把士兵卡牌拖上战场，施放法术守住防线。失败、强化、再来：13章、33种不同的士兵、85种不同的敌人。

games.name: YOU MUST SLEEP: Ravenous Nightmares
games.description: YOU MUST SLEEP is a First-Person Single-Player Survival Horror game in which you play as John, a man tormented by entities that appear whenever he tries to sleep. Manage your personal needs, stay alert for monsters, and hide when necessary to make it through the night.

games.name: Dynamic Breach
games.description: Top-down tactical shooter, military and gothic, necro-technological horror. Requiem: a solo campaign of 33 operations across 6 acts, on hand-made maps. An AI squad to command, 7 classes, 41 weapons. Onslaught: horde mode, a boss every 5 waves. All modes play against bots, offline.

games.name: Nova Protocol
games.description: A neon bullet heaven at absurd scale. Thousands of wireframe enemies, one auto-firing interceptor, and a grid floor that buckles beneath the swarm. Draft augments, evolve your weapons, and survive a boss every five waves — until the Black Hole arrives at wave thirty, then it's the Finale wave!

games.name: ZERO//DECAY
