games.description: ZERO//DECAY is a frantic roguelite action-platformer where you play as an unstable nucleus racing toward stability. Dash through bullet hell, collect epic mutations, build wild synergies — or die fast and try again.

games.name: MUV-LUV 少女庭园 Mellow Days
games.description:
《MUV-LUV 少女庭园 Mellow Days》是一款专注陪伴冒险游戏，让你与桃园梅露共享一段时光，一起完成每天的任务。
按照自己的喜好设置番茄钟、ToDo清单、日历、音乐和环境音。随着共同努力的时间不断累积，你与梅露的故事也会一点点展开。

games.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
games.description: 帮助杰斯整理、修复并还原磁带、游戏卡带、相机等复古老物件；同时破解隐藏在这个充满回忆的阁楼里的重重谜题。在这段温馨治愈却又带着一丝悬疑的故事中，你将一步步揭开麦特背后的秘密，以及蒂斯蒂妮的真实身份。

games.name: Boomimals
games.description: Battle your friends as chaotic animal tanks in fast-paced local or online PvP! Collect game-breaking upgrade cards, bounce bullets around unpredictable arenas, and outsmart your opponents in booming 2–4 player matches.

games.name: シロクアライブ！
games.description: Led by a strange phone call, a woman sneaked into a hospital at night, where she discovered what had become of her roommate, who was supposed to be dead. She secretly brought her back to her room and resumed her life in an attempt to erase her regrets.

games.name: Road Queens
games.description: Road Queens is an 18+ incremental arcade racer. Overtake and smash rivals, earn cash, turn a rusty wreck into a neon beast, and unlock explicit scenes with the queens of the road.

games.name: Oniria Dreamscapes
games.description: Oniria Dreamscapes is a cozy city-builder set on a living dream planet. Build your surreal voxel city, expand your settlement across its globe, explore forgotten landscapes and balance dreams and nightmares, shaping the destiny of Oniria.

games.name: Avalon Jewels 3 Collector's Edition
games.description: 在奇幻 Match-3 冒险中恢复阿瓦隆的魔法！挑战暗影之王的爪牙，完成 250 个精心设计的关卡，探索神秘国度，掌握强大魔法，并在 Relax 或 Puzzle 模式中拯救王国，驱散黑暗。

games.name: Dead Extraction
games.description: 探索被丧尸占领的东京，搜集资源并活着撤离。扩建避难所、管理幸存者，在这款俯视角撤离生存类轻度Rogue游戏中应对不断变化的威胁和致命首领。

games.name: Card&Dungeon
games.description: Build a three-hero party and brave procedurally generated, first-person dungeons in this roguelike deckbuilder. Each hero owns part of your deck, and fallen heroes change how their cards work. Fight turn-based card battles, claim relics, endure curses, and push deeper into the Soulwell.

games.name: Mountainhall
games.description: The dwarves have chosen you. Will you lead them? A new land, a new start, and a mountain waiting to become a home. Dig it out from the inside, lead a colony of dwarves with lives of their own, and stand with them when the goblins come. Build a settlement, a fortress, a Mountainhall.

games.name: Lucky Crafter
games.description: 这是一款肉鸽（Roguelike）建造类游戏，你的魔药店依靠一个旋转盘来运转。转动四个独立的圆环，将液体、草药、物品和瓶子连成一线，在可用旋转次数耗尽前，酿造出足够价值的魔药来完成订单。利用增益（Perks）和巧妙的材料选择来扭转运气。

games.name: Lagan Salvage Run
games.description: A co-op roguelike deckbuilder about salvaging sunken ships. Loot cards from flooding rooms, break into sealed holds for better treasure, and pick your route across open water. Every run comes from a seed you can share. Get out while there's still a way back.

games.name: 魔女之愿
games.description: 你的桌面上，住着一位见习魔女。她会在窗边看书、写日记、趴着打瞌睡，也会在某天下午突然收拾行李，骑扫帚飞出窗外。帮她备好食物和护符吧——旅途中的她会寄回亲手绘制的明信片，每张都是一幅画，一段只写给你的旅行故事。收集 150+ 张明信片，用她带回来的衣服装扮她。每一件，都是她为你带回的纪念。

games.name: CHICKEN MINE
games.description: 一款支持1至4人合作的采矿游戏，玩家需揭开你所效力的“Chicken Mine”公司背后的真相。

games.name: TD VOID
games.description:
Defend humanity against a machine Void that turns Earth's own technology into a weapon.
An alien nanocluster has reached Earth. It doesn't invade with soldiers. It infects factories, military vehicles, etc.
Your mission is simple: Protect the Shield Core. Survive every assault. Stop the spread.

games.name: 旋转勇者: 进化之路
games.description:
旋转！转职！超级进化！

新感觉的动作Rogue RPG游戏，组成你的队伍、选择你的职业，创造最强的组合伤害！
打倒邪恶的最后头目，拯救这个世界吧！

games.name: Jiggle Clicker
games.description: 点击、赚取积分，壮大你的后宫！在这款令人满足的放置​​类点击游戏中，解锁超过 69 位“老婆”，通过约会与互动赢得她们的芳心，并获取强力加成。

games.name: Manus Sors
games.description: A mystical horror-puzzle game. A cozy grandmother's apartment hides dark family secrets. Explore rooms, solve riddles, and pay close attention - every detail matters!

games.name: Froggous Grove
games.description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

games.name: Golf Course Architect Tycoon
games.description: You're the architect. Arrive on raw land and figure out how to turn it into a golf course people love. Sculpt the terrain, shape each hole by hand, then watch real golfers play your course and play it yourself while you run the club and the business growing around it.

games.name: Metro Resonance
games.description: An intense 30-minute first-person survival thriller set in a post-apocalyptic underground. Survive a pitch-black tunnel, gather spare parts to fix your handcar, and reach the sealing station before your gas mask filter runs out.

games.name: Dodgeball Bash
games.description: Dodgeball Bash is a competitive dodgeball game built around timing, movement, and mind games. Throw, dodge, block, and catch your way through solo challenges and online matches, complete missions, train your skills, and customize your player.

games.name: 突突工坊
games.description: 大规模太空战斗，融合基地建造、制造、自动化与可摧毁的环境。组队作战，或在自由混战竞技场中迎战所有对手。在线对战、单人游玩，或与好友合作。

games.name: Bit Footballer: The Career
games.description: You're the player — not the manager. Start on the bench at a fourth-division village ground and play your way up to the title. Every career runs in its own generated world: 74 clubs, four divisions, and a scout who sees everything.

games.name: LimeFlesh
games.description: Humanity has melted into a massive, living mass of flesh. Born from a drop of blood at the bottom of this nightmare, you must push living walls, carve tunnels, and gather resources to escape. A short, tense body horror experience.

games.name: This Floor Is Mine
games.description: An unfolding apocalypse will challenge your decision making as you try to keep the residents of the third floor happy and alive. Will they succumb to infighting? Or will you maintain the humanity of this small community?

games.name: Pokermancer
games.description: 一款 roguelike 构筑游戏：扑克牌型不是从手牌打出，而是在牌面上连出来的。在 4x4 的牌面上连接相邻卡牌，凑出一对、顺子与同花，再用滑动、交换与删除绕开挡住关键路线的各种危险。

games.name: Honest Work
games.description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

games.name: HYPERPIPES
games.description: Race the OUTSIDE of the pipe. Gravity pulls you around the tube, so holding the top is the whole skill. Every track is grown from a seed, so no two are the same. Draft, boost, shoot and climb six leagues in a neon anti-gravity racer built around one more run.

games.name: 远航
games.description: 一场风暴与疾病过后，驶向新大陆的帆船上只剩下九个人。食物和淡水正在耗尽，而疾病也夺走了你此前的一部分记忆。重新认识身边的八名船员，面对接下来发生的疾病、争执与资源危机，并想办法活到这场航行的终点。

games.name: VEKARRA
games.description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss alone or in two-player local co-op, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends.

games.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
games.description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

games.name: Butterfly Project
games.description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

games.name: BOB LOGISTICS
games.description: 欢迎来到鲍勃公司！核对订单、搬运货物，用自动化设备让工作一点点变轻松。在这款悠闲的第一人称仓库模拟游戏中，从实习生晋升为总监。随着职级提升，公司的新区域与背后隐藏的故事也将逐渐展现。

games.name: 极限主播 截稿前一周
games.description:
截止日前的临界状态，会让人觉醒。
"能拖到明天的事，今天绝不做。"——平时奉行这种人生信条的虚拟主播，今天也背水一战，坠入了日程地狱。
重温主播的一周，靠合理分配资源一路冲刺到底的肉鸽养成模拟游戏！

games.name: Keep Hell Open
games.description: Keep Hell Open 是一款快节奏的增量式防御游戏。从地狱中收集能量，建造自动防御系统，将恶魔变异成强大的武器，并在无穷无尽的恶魔大军中生存下来。

games.name: Free Ball: Volleyball
games.description: Free Ball 是一款多人排球游戏。控制一名球员，与队友一起在沉浸式第三人称视角下参与快节奏的4对4比赛。选择拥有独特能力的角色，并与队友协作，统治球场。

games.name: They Are Adorable
games.description: 割草式增量FPS：数以万计的可爱小家伙朝你涌来。亲手操起离谱强力的巨炮，在人潮里轰出肉眼可见的大窟窿；每局都攒下永久升级，变强了再回来，把上次挡住你的那波敌人杀个片甲不留。

games.name: Raid Lead - Echoes of Gaia
games.description:
Raid Lead 是一款围绕队伍站位与治疗展开的策略游戏。
挑战拥有独特机制的首领，收集属性点和天赋点，不断强化你的队伍。

games.name: 弹没弹完？可以来转转吗？
games.description:
一颗球 + 一台老虎机 + 七种元素的疯狂构筑!
发射母球击碎元素球填满转轮盘面,摇老虎机凑中奖线,在倒计时前冲够分!
40+遗物与40+技能任你搭,拼出你自己的流派——但小心,你越贪,盘面就越疯!

games.name: Cozy Banker
games.description: 银行已经被现金淹没了。分拣八种货币，整理超过 30,000 张钞票，装满 34 个银行保管箱，将金融混乱变成治愈又井然有序的世界。

games.name: 浣熊垃圾大作战
games.description: 你将扮演一只身手敏捷的浣熊，踏上搜寻零食之旅。收集能让你更强壮的水果，撞开美味的垃圾桶！在精心制作的画面与配乐相伴下，解锁炫酷外观与强力强化。

games.name: Up & Up: Pinball & Pachinko
games.description: 弹珠台与柏青哥的独特结合！收集柏青哥弹珠，一路过关斩将，最终解锁柏青哥游戏板，赢取海量分数！先玩弹珠台，解锁柏青哥；再玩柏青哥，刷新最高分！

games.name: Pample
games.description:
Play as Pample, a tiny gardener, in a colorful 2D tower defense!
Sow seeds that sprout into living defenses and hold back a horde of sweet-toothed monsters.
Grow your garden and keep it sugar-free!

games.name: Our Favorite Mortal Potter
games.description: Our Favorite Mortal Potter is a job simulation game about being an abducted potter in an infinitely powerful extraterrestrial's loving keep. You are here to make them pots. They love pots. You better love pots too, because creating them is your sole purpose for the next three-hundred years.

games.name: Check Please!
games.description: 在这个奇幻国度经营混乱不堪的中世纪餐馆！为挑剔的魔法生物安排座位，与你的恶魔厨师一起端上100多道独特菜肴，并升级你在王国各地的酒馆！身为困在这个中世纪奇幻国度的唯一人类，你回到地球的唯一方法就是——当好一名服务员。

games.name: Revenggie
games.description:
收获季已过，复仇时刻降临。
在这款快节奏的“弹幕地狱”类Roguelite游戏中，化身为强大的蔬菜战士。构建你的战斗流派，在每一轮挑战中积累永久升级，驾驭紧张刺激的QTE（快速反应事件），证明技巧与力量同样重要。

games.name: 诡秘渔海：垂钓饲养员
games.description: 《诡秘渔海》 是一款合作多人恐怖钓鱼游戏，作为这片恐怖海域的外星饲养员，你或你的朋友必须钓到足够重量的怪鱼来喂饱藏在水下的未知存在，但祂的胃口一天天增大，到最后，你们才是真正的……鱼饵？！

games.name: Fish Restaurant & Farming Simulator
games.description: 在碧蓝海岸垂钓新鲜海鱼，在后院种植蔬菜，亲手烤制闻名的土耳其鱼肉三明治。收获、切配、上菜——雇佣员工，添置生产机器，把海边小烤摊打造成五星级餐厅！

games.name: Buckaroo
games.description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

games.name: Bow & Banner
games.description: Live the campaign of a medieval longbowman. Hunt, scout, survive and fight in brutal battles as Kaden of Bracken, mastering archery and battlefield judgment while choices, wounds and failure shape a branching war story with multiple endings.

games.name: Pill & Chill
games.description: 使用数药板，将铺满桌面的彩色药丸逐一分类。Pill & Chill是一款基于物理效果的轻松整理游戏，没有时间限制和分数，只有许多令人舒适的细微声响。

games.name: Hollow Hours - Cheap House
games.description: Seeking a fresh start, 25-year-old Ethan buys a quiet suburban house with all his savings. But as the sun sets, the heavy silence, a strange neighbor's questions, and the strictly off-limits second floor reveal an unsettling truth: some fresh starts come at a horrifying cost.

games.name: 星际快递员
games.description: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.

games.name: Throneguard: Last Stand
games.description: Become the last guardian of the kingdom and defend the throne! Fight on the front lines with your sword, build barricades and towers between waves, and upgrade your hero. Throneguard: Last Stand is a 3D medieval action tower defense game.

games.name: Pin A Million
games.description: Permanently fuse pegs into monstrous hybrids, let weather and moon phases rewrite your board, and hand your Twitch chat the keys to the chaos. Pin a Million is a pachinko roguelite with arcade neon glow — no run ever plays the same.

games.name: RUIN: 35th Anniversary - Definitive Edition
games.description: RUIN is a Point-&-Click Adventure set in a cyber-fantasy world of kingdoms and ancient relics. Journey through this mysterious land, behold its wonders, and ponder 35 years of mysteries.

games.name: Flock Fight
games.description: Battle your friends or fly solo as a flying flock of health units. Balance offense and defense as you use weapons to survive quick, chaotic local or online match ups in this minimalist couch fighting game.

games.name: ハッ崩し　ハクスラ×ブロック崩し
games.description: It looks ordinary, but it’s crazy! Destroy everything with a bouncing iron ball! Use a variety of items to keep destroying an endless stream of blocks, zombies, UFOs, and even sushi! Aim for a high score!

games.name: Pawnshop Together
games.description: 独自经营你的二手店，或与最多 3 名好友一起合作！购买、砍价、鉴定、维修并出售各种物品，不断发展生意，并在城镇中寻找更多赚钱的方式。

games.name: The Little Stomping Girl
games.description: 趁火柴还没熄灭，踩碎矿石，收集资源！用光标指向想开采的位置，小女孩就会自动踩踏。布置并强化装备，搭配各种技能与独特装备，打造专属流派，挑战更深的地下世界。

games.name: 挂机之王：组队刷宝
games.description: 《挂机之王》是一款暗黑童话风格的多人挂机刷宝 RPG。自动迎战怪物与 Boss，搜集并强化装备，让你的英雄不断变强。独自冒险，或与最多三位好友在线组队，向更高难度发起挑战！

games.name: TIDE OR HIDE
games.description: 白天三分钟，夜晚九十秒。《TIDE OR HIDE》是一款 1-4 人合作生存游戏：守护营地的深水每晚都会逐区域退去，而武装猎人正冲着你囤积的东西赶来。收集，武装，撑到天亮。

games.name: GreeDrill
games.description: 你欠公司200万美元。用矿石还债，一个配额接着一个配额。这是一款挖矿 Roguelike：每钻一格都赚得更多，也离坠毁更近一步。返回地面，还是再钻一格？甩掉执行官，挑战五位守护者。

games.name: 无人归家
games.description: GL，沉浸式第一人称视觉小说，拥有关键剧情分支选项，可解锁12种不同结局。催婚潮流中不同女性的生存现状，彼此之间的情感纠葛。

games.name: Aviator 航空时代
games.description: 从喷气时代初期一路迈向未来，亲手打造全球航空帝国。在回合制策略模拟中连接 120 多座城市，执飞经典机型，智胜竞争对手，应对历史风云。包含单人历史战役、“海阔天空”沙盒模式以及支持 2–4 人的本机轮流（热座）多人游戏。

games.name: Color Factory
games.description: 连接节点，生成、转换并混合颜色，享受轻松惬意的工厂自动化体验。发现全新配方，通过研究解锁强力节点，并随着你的色彩工厂不断壮大，设计越来越高效的生产网络。

games.name: 战术屠戮地牢 Tactical Dungeon Slayers
games.description: 《杀戮尖塔》式肉鸽卡牌构筑，加入高机动战棋走位与地形策略。寻找最佳位置打出卡组 Combo，以强力 AOE 清场，也要小心别落入敌人的杀阵。

games.name: Shell as Hard as Steel
games.description: 一款恐怖游戏。你扮演一名电梯维修技师,在不断上行的过程中,揭开那些再也没能下去的人的下落。

games.name: にゃんこサバイバー
games.description: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

games.name: Perfect Route
games.description: Perfect Route is a billiards puzzle game centered on route planning. Plan the direction and path of each shot, make use of various special mechanisms, overcome carefully designed challenges, and find the Perfect Route through each level.

games.name: Lingering Link: Hours with Her
games.description: "Lingering Link: Hours with Her" 是一款温暖舒适的专注陪伴游戏，适合学习和工作。与一位安静而坚定的伙伴一起开启专注时段：设定计时器，用音乐营造氛围，选择最合心意的视角，与她聊聊天，或只是享受彼此相伴。

games.name: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One
games.description: A first-person investigation inside a rebuilt memory. You are not a man in a room — you are the scan of one. Reconstruct what happened to him object by object, link the evidence, and learn to spot the parts the machine invented to fill its gaps.

games.name: PANCHIGI: Coin Slap Showdown
games.description: The Korean coin-flipping game panchigi reimagined as a physics-based game. Choose where to strike, aim the direction, and control your power to make all the coins land on the same side.

games.name: BoardboundHeroes
games.description: 招募棋子、锻造装备、布阵上场——然后看着英雄们为你而战。这是一款不断深入地下城的Roguelike自动战斗游戏。围绕个性鲜明的职业与特性羁绊组建队伍，通过奖励卡牌轮抽塑造每一次周回。培养的军团与装备都会作为资产留存。可以精心钻研，也可以挂机周回轻松放置。

games.name: 神奇的贝拉宝宝
games.description: 丈夫在外地期间，Liora不得不独自度过每一天。但孤独并没有她想象中那么安静。

games.name: Hearts Extreme
games.description:
把经典卡牌游戏《红心大战》重做成了一个人解的谜题。
每一关的目标都不一样，去精确达成它。
十种构成各异的牌组，可以在四人、五人、六人桌上游玩。
还有排位赛，与全世界的玩家一较高下。

games.name: Twinblocks
games.description: 掌握这款令人上瘾的街机风下落方块益智游戏，体验 Roguelite 成长机制。通过卡牌获得强力强化，释放震撼连击，征服精心打造的世界，并创建属于自己的关卡。

games.name: 巫师猫：无尽突围
games.description: 《巫师猫：无尽突围》是一款2D卡通风格的动作幸存者游戏。操控魔法猫咪击退怪物，灵活走位躲避攻击，并通过策略卡牌与羁绊组合打出爆炸构筑；在主城点亮天赋树、强化洗炼装备，挑战主线章节、深渊模式与无尽模式，追求更高品质的装备与更高极限。

games.name: Death Row
games.description: 你在酷刑室被判处死刑！为了阻止逼近的电锯，你必须解决双人合作或4人2v2竞技的非对称解谜关卡。作为无声的向导和电路破译者，与时间赛跑，逃离死刑！

games.name: Beehive Simulator
games.description: Build and expand the hive of your dreams in this 3D beekeeping and management game. Raise bees, gather pollen, produce honey, upgrade your equipment, explore new environments, and grow your colony into a thriving beekeeping empire.

games.name: AI Lab Tycoon
games.description: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

games.name: Last Contract
games.description: Last Contract is a fast paced 2D action game set in a pixel art cyberpunk world that you need katanas, shurikens and quick reflexes to survive.

games.name: Primal Idle
games.description: An idle RPG of prehistoric survival. Gather, craft, hunt and tame across thirteen interlocking skills and 57 dinosaur species, then break through ten biomes sealed behind apex guardians. It keeps playing while you don't, so you come back to a valley that got on without you.

games.name: Moto Courier Simulator
games.description: Deliver across a living island city on two wheels. Accept orders, pack them right, weave through real traffic and build your own business – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: Wildmark
games.description: 一款温馨的林间放置 RPG。化身守林人：伐木、采摘、狩猎、垂钓、采矿、烹饪、打造装备，慢慢修炼十项温柔的技能；建起家园木屋，驯服动物伙伴，守护这片山林——即使你不在线，一切也在继续。进来待五分钟，或消磨一整晚。森林一直在生长。

games.name: Man vs. Gary
games.description: Row out. Shoot the enormous sea monster. Drown. File the incident report. Do it again, a little angrier each time. A hand-illustrated idle comedy about losing to Gary, a kraken with opinions and a HR complaint, until one day you don't.

games.name: Hambone Alley
games.description: The Last Alley — at the end, below all others — is littered with bowling pins. A disembodied grin invites you to play. Stack your deck: explosive, gold, multiplier, and more. Shop the alley for enhanced balls and charms. Chain their effects to level hundreds of pins per frame.

games.name: COMPARTMENT 666 : ANOMALY EXPRESS
games.description: Inspect every compartment, identify anomalies, and survive a mysterious train where every mistake brings you closer to death. Reach the conductor and uncover the truth behind Compartment 666.

games.name: Warpack
games.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

games.name: ソラの教室 : Classroom in Sora
games.description: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

games.name: Lucky Hell
games.description: 一家只在夜里开门的隐秘赌场——无需邀请函。掷出骰子组成牌型，用幸运符与刻印扭转赔率，闯过36个越发凶险的夜晚。庄家永远面带微笑。

games.name: Desktop Forge
games.description: 一间常驻在桌面角落的小小锻造工坊。个性鲜明的工匠们会自行收集素材、铸造宝剑。把剑交给来访的冒险者，或是献给交战中的国家——你铸的这一把，决定他们的生死，平息魔物的巢穴，推动战线，甚至改变一座城镇归谁统治。世界，因你铸的剑而转动。

games.name: The Last Train: End of the Line
games.description: A dark, story-driven game with elements of visual novel, exploration, and survival. Explore an old train and an infested sector, scavenge for supplies, make decisions, and discover whether you can trust a girl named Mia—and your own memories.

games.name: Castores vs Topos
games.description: A turn-based board game: beavers versus moles. Create or join an online lobby, play on the same PC, or face off against the AI. An easy-to-learn strategy game.

games.name: Shape Shards
games.description: 《碎片几何》是一款休闲、增量游戏，发射子弹消灭几何敌人，获得碎片进行升级，每次升级都会有全新的体验！

games.name: Maker Circuit
games.description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

games.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
games.description: 巨龙的宝山已经彻底失控。安坐下来，一枚一枚扫起金山，装满一只只宝箱，再把埋在金子下的宝物一一放回架上原位。看着混乱一点点变回井井有条。一款温馨的整理游戏。还有猫。

games.name: 不正经的刷宝骑士
games.description: 一款中世纪题材的回合制刷宝角色扮演游戏。你的技能不再是等待冷却的按钮，而是每个回合重新发到手上的卡牌：用 4 点行动点，从随机发到的一手技能里决定出什么、按什么顺序出。你随身携带剑、长矛与猎弓，出牌时自动切换架势，在同一回合里劈砍、突刺、放箭无缝衔接；给下一击附上毒、火或霜，让敌人在自己的回合流血、燃烧、冻结；把手上重复的技能串成连击，抓住只在这一回合成立的机会，一次抹平整队敌人。每次远征都要走一条分岔路线，穿过精英埋伏、宝物密室与神秘商人，尽头是机制各异的首领。路上捡到的遗物会改变你的出牌方式，让每一趟的打法都不一样。掉落的武器与护甲会留下来，带回城中锻造，修好你的剑，再下去一次。

games.name: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
games.description: 在地狱经营一家公司。招聘、装扮并调配魔员，驳回小罪人的申诉，让荒唐惩罚自动运转，在这款搞笑的增量式经营游戏中一路爬上地狱职场的权力顶端。

games.name: Wasteland Collector
games.description:
探索荒原，搜寻资源，营救幸存者，揭开被遗忘的身世之谜。
在自动战斗中与怪物展开激战，管理你的物资，升级装备，打造属于自己的生存之道。

games.name: Duo Control
games.description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

games.name: Cabin Heart
games.description: A PS1-esque survival horror where your heart arrhythmia reveals you. Your parents dying on the same night, the estate frozen, all that's left is a cabin no one ever mentioned. The paperwork insists you spend one night to take possession. Can you survive until dawn?

games.name: LaurEli & the Blood Dipped Manor
games.description: An Ace Attorney/Danganronpa style Murder Mystery-esque Visual Novel where an unlikely duo must find the vampiric killer stalking the halls of a stormy manor.

games.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
games.description: 没有枪，没有剑，武器只有你走过的一条线。脚步画出的轨迹持续切割敌人，线一闭合，圈内的敌群同时爆炸。撑过15分钟，击败BOSS，培养护符卡组，再次出发——走路就是攻击的幸存者类游戏。

games.name: HellRock Diver
games.description: 挖进地狱。杀穿敌群。选择力量。一路深入。这是一款 Roguelike 射击平台游戏，地面就是你的武器，而每次击败首领都让你变得更强。

games.name: Dentist Jams 2000
games.description: Since putting your dreams of becoming a musician aside to get a degree in Dentistry, you find yourself exploring ways to make music in your day to day job as a Dentist.

games.name: YOU IN?
games.description: 独自或与好友一起入侵敌对系统，体验快节奏的俯视角弹幕轻度Rogue游戏。观察攻击规律，切换武器与装备，用特质塑造流派，并从每个Boss手中夺走招牌攻击，反过来对付它。

games.name: BACKROOMS: PRIMAL
games.description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

games.name: Dusky's Nook
games.description: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

games.name: 桌面杀虫
games.description: 以电脑桌面为战场的射击增量游戏。各类机械虫子从屏幕四周不断涌出，摧毁你的电脑本体，你需要手持各式武器射击，抵御虫群一波波猛攻。每局击杀虫子可获取金币，用于局外解锁庞大技能树，持续强化武器、伤害、防御与特殊能力，也可以从美女助手中得到援助，解锁桌宠伴侣，共你出战！

games.name: Epic Seven
games.description:
PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven.
A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations.
Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

games.name: HYPER TITAN
games.description:
科幻舰队射击游戏：拖动即可飞行，建造你的母舰，征服银河系。

组建舰队，排列战斗阵型，发动战争。

games.name: Anatomy of a Dream
games.description: Wake up inside a forgotten dreamscape where reality unravels around you. Explore impossible spaces, uncover the remnants of those who came before, and discover why the dream refuses to let you wake.

games.name: 冒牌英雄
games.description: 独自迎战，或与好友并肩作战，扮演各怀绝活的"英雄"角色，与无尽怪潮战斗，获取道具、学习技能、选择天赋，自由构筑流派，一路击败强敌，杀上月球！

games.name: MAMA DOUGH
games.description: 饥肠辘辘的僵尸正涌向披萨店，在一片混乱中同时掌握两种职责。厨师需要确认订单、挑选正确的配料，并把握烘烤时机完成披萨；猎人则通过攻击与防御制服僵尸，坚持到能够投递的瞬间。只有披萨、订单和目标全部吻合，才能用新鲜披萨净化僵尸。送错订单会让顾客暴怒，拖得太久则会让完美披萨变质。根据线索找出每种僵尸隐藏的招牌配料，并把答案永久记录下来。合作就是最重要的秘密配料。支持单人游戏与本地同屏合作，迎接这场紧张又疯狂的披萨行动吧！

games.name: 自动箱 AutomaticBox
games.description:
这有一堆会自己移动的箱子，除了看着它们动来动去，唯一能做的就是让箱子复位。 
在这款“无主角”的推箱子游戏中，玩家不再控制角色推挤箱子，而是利用箱子自己移动的顺序和方向让它们达到终点。 
希望这款极简解谜游戏，可以带来一场轻松愉悦的脑部按摩。

games.name: White and Tabby
games.description: The United Federation of Bipedal Dogs has invaded your island! Pick up your sword and unleash feline fury on hordes of heavily militarized canines. No retreat and no surrender, only one cat's fateful path of vengeance.

games.name: 有宋将倾
games.description:
绍兴元年，中原陆沉，山河将倾。你将收拢流民、发展生产、积蓄物资、抵御强敌，于风雨飘摇之际守护一方百姓与家园。  
受国之垢，是谓社稷主。

games.name: System Arrival
games.description: 一款俯视角生存动作RPG，可单人游玩，也可与最多4名玩家在线合作。在废墟中寻找物资，用枪械、近战武器和灵能对抗丧尸，将战利品带回地下地堡。招募幸存者、制作装备、建设并保卫共同的家园，揭开“系统”的秘密。

games.name: Digging Clams
games.description: Let's dig out some clams and throw a barbecue party! Keep digging down and you'll find clams of all different species. Gather up different species for various recipes and have your own culinary adventure!

games.name: Goalcrest: Club Management Tycoon
games.description: Build a football club from the amateur leagues to the top. Manage tactics, finances, sponsors, facilities, morale and matchdays. Strengthen your squad, earn promotion, grow your reputation and become the world’s greatest manager.

games.name: Stelvyr: Colony Defense
games.description: 建造并保卫一座太空殖民地，每一单位能源与每一项人员调度都至关重要。扩展生产、研究新技术、利用城墙和武器塑造战场，并在九场战役行动中不断调整策略，对抗异星虫群。

games.name: Forgotten Tavern
games.description: Run a tavern simulation set in a hidden Korean mountain village. Gather ingredients through unpredictable weather, discover traditional Korean recipes, and serve mystical Dokkaebi and villagers. Get to know your guests by discovering their favourite dishes and unique preferences.

games.name: Real Zombie Survivors
games.description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

games.name: Tiny Industry
games.description: A relaxing automation game where building a factory stays simple. Create production lines, connect your buildings, and unlock new technologies without worrying about ratios. Just ask yourself one question: What does this item need?

games.name: Madness in Bloom
games.description: Running from a painful betrayal, you retreat to the quiet countryside, hoping to leave the past behind. Instead, you find unexpected relationships, buried secrets, and a future that depends entirely on the choices you make.

games.name: Fancy's Monster Girl Beach Jigsaw Puzzle
games.description: 一款轻松休闲的18+拼图游戏,拥有精美的美术与音乐,你可以拼出性感魔物娘的图像。完成全部60张拼图,即可解锁图库中的所有图片。

games.name: Slacker Hero - 摸鱼勇者与恶魔之塔
games.description: 一款会自己战斗的常驻型RPG。不过勇者很懒，一旦打腻了就会从游戏窗口里爬出来，在你的桌面上溜达或者睡觉。是领他回来，让他休息，还是让他去探索？一款略带喜剧感、让人会心一笑的 Roguelite RPG。

games.name: A BILLION GOLD DEBT
games.description: 发展你的聚落，实现生产自动化，探索周边地区并与邻居贸易，偿还高达10亿金币的债务！

games.name: RingOut
games.description: 没有血条。每次命中都会让敌人升温，温度以度数（°）显示。越热，被击飞得越远：先加热他们，再把他们轰出竞技场即可获胜。一款快节奏、混乱的在线竞技场射击游戏：23名斗士、13种武器、29个竞技场、6种模式。可单人对战机器人或在线对战。

games.name: Cozy Cottontail Desktop
games.description: Cozy Cottontail Desktop is a low-stress desktop companion game that will boost your productivity. Solve puzzles with every keystroke you make, get rewarded, unlock cosmetics and decorate your house room by room! All without getting in your way while you work.

games.name: Kitchen Tidy
games.description: Kitchen Tidy 是一款轻松惬意的整理模拟游戏，你可以整理 2,000 多件厨房物品，将每样东西放回属于它的位置。按照自己的节奏，将杂乱无章的厨房一点点整理成井然有序的空间，享受整理带来的满满成就感。

games.name: Spellk
games.description: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Find All Things: Vacation
games.description: Find All Things: Vacation is a relaxing collection of puzzle games set in a world of travel and summer adventures. Search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and spot differences across sunny beaches, water parks, and more. Escape the daily routine and enjoy a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Beat Ten
games.description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat.  Your mission: repair the Beat using YOUR music, one track at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten.

games.name: LEG DAY: Four Steps Through Hell
games.description: Control a single leg in a brutal physics-based precision platformer. Balance, jump and master momentum through four increasingly absurd stages. One bad move can send you falling.

games.name: 变异水族箱保卫战 MUTARIUM
games.description: 喂食，它们就变异。喂多了，它们就反噬。搭配MEAT、GLOW、ORE，把你的鱼养成惹人怜爱的小怪物，再让它们迎战闯进水槽的失败实验体。你不能操控任何单位 — 喂什么，就是你的全部战略。

games.name: Loadout Rush
games.description: Build the perfect loadout — before the wave hits. Cram items into a grid backpack, buff them with neighbor synergies, and merge them into something greater. Chicken + Molotov + Heart = Dragon. We had rules. It happened anyway. Monster waves are coming, and your bag IS your weapon.

games.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
games.description: 一款注重深度策略、协同效应与疯狂连招的Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏。在冒险中构筑你的牌库：200多张卡牌、35位各自颠覆规则的英雄——由前《炉石传说》扩展包设计负责人操刀。免费试玩版现已推出！

games.name: Managing Up
games.description: A darkly funny office idle-management game. Play the boss's loyal "scab": recruit workers, pack the desks, arrange your teams, and squeeze your colleagues for every last drop of KPI. Play Managing Up, and claw your way up the corporate ladder!

games.name: 无尽画布
games.description: 在这款游戏中，你将探索一幅可以无限缩放的画布。深入画中世界，破解层层谜题，寻找隐藏在画作深处的秘密。

games.name: Mai Pillow Smash
games.description: A mental puzzle game about insomnia and the fragments that fill your head. Mai can't sleep. Every night, restless thoughts flood her mind. Match them, calm them, and clear the noise before it takes over.

games.name: Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator
games.description: 在这款完全正常的放置点击水族箱模拟游戏中，唤醒你内心的虾……

games.name: CACTBOY
games.description: 戴上你的警长帽，装好你的左轮手枪！《CACTBOY》是一款最多支持4名玩家的爆笑混乱的西部多人派对游戏。从瞬息万变的拔枪决斗到荒诞无厘头的混战，掌握各种小游戏，证明谁才是真正的CACTBOY！

games.name: Quantum Covenant
games.description: Become a ridiculously devastating machine of destruction and overwhelm your enemies in this high-octane co-op horde survival shooter. Discover powerful weapons, abilities, upgrades, and synergies as you free humanity from the clutches of the machine god! Part bullet hell, part roguelike, all action.

games.name: Confidence Man：庞氏骗局
games.description: 承诺不可能的回报，用今天的钱付昨天的利息。在这款 1920 年代背景的卡牌构筑肉鸽中，你每个月都要选：抬高利率把谎撑大，还是拎起手提箱跑路。骗局注定崩盘——唯一的问题是崩的时候你还在不在场。

games.name: Halsey Row
games.description: People come to the shop on Halsey Row to sell the memories they can't carry and buy the ones they can't live without. Appraise what they bring. Decide what it's worth, and who you'll sell it to. Run an honest shop, or a darker one, and piece together what this street is hiding.

games.name: Neon Armada - Solar Storm
games.description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

games.name: Mana Boom
games.description: 魔法遇上物理，整个世界任你折腾！在最多 8 人的实时混战与竞速中，自由搭配抛物线法术的元素与弹体特性，用绳索飞荡、炸毁并创造地形，玩出自己的打法。为了胜利，什么损招都尽管使，只是小心最后别把自己也坑了。

games.name: Group Idlemen
games.description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

games.name: Chess Town
games.description: 一款温馨的国际象棋生涯模拟游戏，每一步都至关重要。通过决策卡塑造你的策略，在本地锦标赛中不断晋级，并完成城镇工作，打造通往冠军之路的生活。

games.name: Green Breach
games.description: 你在死寂的采矿船上迷茫地醒来。探索揭示了潜伏在阴影中的变异恐怖。在解谜的同时，你的手电筒光芒也渐渐微弱。你能逃离这个破口吗？

games.name: Die and Decay
games.description: 把一把骰子，变成一座敢于反击的城。用卡牌建造城市，触发连锁组合，解锁新英雄。在这款黑暗奇幻骰子放置类 Roguelike 中，每颗骰子都意味着取舍：强化英雄、壮大骰子引擎，或让城市免于崩溃。

games.name: Mortal Chess
games.description: 每枚棋子都时日无多。Mortal Chess 是一款单人国际象棋变体游戏，你的棋子都有可见的生命倒计时。寿命耗尽的棋子会留下硬币，收集硬币即可在对局中购买新棋子，为经典玩法带来全新变化。

games.name: The Mannequin Forest
games.description: A story based horror game about the disturbing practices of a serial killer in a haunted forest. A weekend meant to be spent taking care of your friends cat takes a much darker turn as you feel your every move being watching.

games.name: Pump Track
games.description: A difficult game about timing the pump.

games.name: Raiding Season
games.description: 在这款回合制战术RPG中，率领维京劫掠者追寻财富与荣耀。招募战士，定制能力，在致命的六角格地图上作战。焚烧、掠夺并继续深入以赢得更多财富，但不断增强的抵抗也可能让你失去一切。

games.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
games.description:
社交发育不全的丽莎曾在书中寻得慰藉……
直到她的眼睛掉了出来。
你将扮演亨利——受指派引导丽莎走出抑郁的心理咨询师。
只不过有一个问题：她并不抑郁。

games.name: Pixel Chroma
games.description: 最多支持12名玩家的2D像素捉迷藏！逐个像素为身体涂色并藏起来，再找出那些可疑的像素。不会画画也没关系——这可是像素画！融入场景、骗过寻找者并生存下来！

games.name: Extraction Shop Simulator
games.description:
You're the vendor. They go into the Zone. You get rich either way.

A first-person shop/management sim set on the edge of the Chernobyl exclusion zone. Inspired by the tone of Extraction Shooters but from the other side of the counter.

games.name: 三國撞撞樂
games.description: 日系三国卡牌构筑游戏。招募、强化、合成，体验十分钟一局的休闲 Roguelike 策略；组出最强队伍，自动战斗，撞出胜利之路。

games.name: Chronoseum
games.description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

games.name: One Week Left : Last Days at the Office
games.description: Only 5 days until you quit. Plan your daily schedule, chat with coworkers, and make choices as you prepare to resign. Will you hand over your duties perfectly, or slack off in the breakroom and cause chaos? Experience a hyper-realistic K-office drama shaped by your choices!

games.name: PIYO PIYO CHICKEN
games.description: Launch a chicken into the sky and stay airborne with limited Egg Bursts. Choose your angle and power, preserve speed and altitude, and adapt to boosts, random events, and upgrades. Simple controls meet physics-driven timing and resource choices in an arcade challenge about beating your record.

games.name: 桌面史莱姆墓场：指尖收割者
games.description: 史莱姆正在入侵你的桌面，而你的每一次敲击，都会化作有力的还击。解锁各式武器，抽取脑洞大开的神器，收集千奇百怪的史莱姆。独自战斗，或与好友组队，一起痛击史莱姆！

games.name: Farm to Fortune
games.description: 从一小块地起步，一粒种子一粒种子地攒出万贯家财。种植作物、在自家小店出售，再把赚到的钱全部投回农场。更好的工具、更大的土地、更丰厚的收成。从第一粒种子到最后一片田，全程轻松惬意。

games.name: 刀与剑 ~斗牌风云录
games.description: 这是一款中国武侠题材的CCG卡牌竞技游戏！规则摒弃了经典的“随从交互+场面经营”，而是针对武学的内外功特点设计的独特机制！单局的平均时长控制在5-8分钟之间，轻度竞技，爽快连携！独特的牌组构筑方式，降低构筑学习门槛，增加了牌组趣味性！

games.name: OKTORAID
games.description: 本地合作基地防御游戏：你们之间的电缆是一根带电的线——穿过它的机器人会被电击，靠近彼此两人火力都更猛。搜集废料，筑起炮塔堡垒，在OKTO的机器人围攻中活下来。单人游玩？你的电缆连接着核心。

games.name: Throne Of 3Q
games.description: 《问鼎三国》是一款以东汉末年三国乱世为背景的SLG策略手游。玩家扮演一方诸侯，从零开始经营城池、招兵买马、招揽名将，在群雄逐鹿的乱世中开疆拓土，最终一统天下。游戏拥有丰富的武将养成体系，涵盖魏蜀吴群四大阵营60余位三国名将，每位武将拥有独特的天赋技能与主动技能，分为步、骑、弓三大兵种，形成相生相克的策略对抗。同时融入装备打造、科技研究、军师辅佐、计谋部署等多维度成长线，让每位玩家都能打造独一无二的战斗阵容。除了单人战役关卡外，游戏还提供世界进程、围攻皇城、跨服争霸、群雄割据等大型阵营PVP玩法，以及女将游历、宝物争夺、远征扶桑等特色内容，PVE与PVP交织，单人成长与阵营协作并重。

games.name: AXIS FALL
games.description: AXIS FALL是一款非常轻松的俯视角解密游戏，核心在于知识与发现。在极简风格的迷宫中探索，以坠落来到达新的区域，并集齐每一个数字。

games.name: Please Buy My Junk!!
games.description: An Item Shop Tycoon Game!! Hunt critters, collect their junk and sell it off to some very cool customers that come into your little shop! Become rich and powerful and cool in this unique fantasy world!!

games.name: Cable Arrange
games.description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

games.name: Escape Together: Prison Break
games.description: Dig a secret tunnel and escape a heavily guarded prison. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Hide your operation from guards, dispose of dirt, trade valuable finds, upgrade your tools, and plan the escape using proximity voice chat.

games.name: 攀石出井
games.description: Cobble Climber 是一款难度较高的攀岩游戏，每个抓点都有倒计时。若耗时过长，随着水位的上升，溺水的风险将随之增加。

games.name: Twelve Knots
games.description: 《Twelve Knots》是一款以现代韩国学校为背景的2D恐怖冒险游戏，融入祭祀、巫俗仪式与堂山信仰等韩国民俗元素。摇响古老的黄铜铃，揭示隐藏的痕迹，探索过去与现在交织的学校和亡者村庄，揭开其中的秘密。

games.name: Brick Defenders
games.description: A short incremental about defending your bricks from ball throwing creatures. Upgrade your wizard to keep up with increasingly difficult balls and creatures.

games.name: Liminal Angel
games.description: 恶魔之力腐蚀了野生动物，让大自然调头对抗人类。作为化身凡人的天使，你必须为这场致命的远征做好准备。在不暴露身份的前提下与幸存者沟通，收集装备，并在黎明破晓前躲避恶魔异兽。(Roguelike)

games.name: Goblin Island
games.description: 你辞掉工作想过轻松的农场生活，却停不下刷手机。种植、浇水、收获作物，追寻稀有变异，雇佣哥布林伙伴。抵抗看手机的冲动，提升专注力，把一小块田地打造成哥布林农场帝国。

games.name: TOWERMOUTH
games.description: 两名玩家，一张沙发，一座嘴很毒的塔。在分屏合作或单人模式下攀登一座无尽的 roguelite 高塔——武器会自己开火，所以你靠站位战斗。进化 20 种武器，让没有上限的形态不断升级，并在塔的嘲讽声中每五层迎战一名守卫。

games.name: My Snake Likes Apples
games.description: 这是一款流程短小、风格极简的增量游戏。培养一条不太聪明的蛇，帮助它走得更远。

games.name: DDD: Deep Dungeon Descent
games.description: A top-down precision platformer in 1-bit pixel art. Your jump is your everything — weapon, escape, and only tool. Descend 100 floors of spikes, crumbling ground and enemies. Die, restart the floor instantly, race the clock.

games.name: わが子と吹奏楽部の1000日
games.description: Your child joined the school concert band. Somehow, you ended up its director. Scold the ones who skip rehearsal and the band gets better. That evening, your child doesn't say much. Three years. Nine endings.

games.name: BREACHED: Follow Me
games.description: 一款具有 VHS 氛围和东欧背景的第一人称心理恐怖游戏。探索阴暗的场景，寻找隐藏的秘密，并揭开一个现实可能并非表面所见的故事。

games.name: Domino Descent
games.description:
A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is a box of dominoes. Chain them,
paint them, curse them, and build a multiplier that runs away with itself.
Twelve floors down, something is waiting on every third one. The stairs
keep going after that.

games.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
games.description: 编写 Python 风格的代码来操控修复补丁机，逐扇区拯救一张正在腐坏的 1.44MB 软盘。从四条命令起步；每修复一个文件就解锁循环、变量、函数和列表，直到你的程序让全部 1,474,560 字节重获新生。整个游戏就装在一张软盘里。游戏内文字仅支持英语/日语/韩语。

games.name: 月夜流光·赤之花
games.description: 这是一款以剧情推进为主的NTR游戏。某天，来自异世界的人闯入了你的世界，你需要与凛花和美月携手合作，对抗反派、击败敌人，并根据你的选择解锁不同结局。当一个个道德与欲望交织的抉择摆在眼前时，凛花和美月究竟会坚守本心，成功抵挡诱惑，还是会逐渐被内心深处的黑暗欲望吞噬？

games.name: Traffic Architect
games.description: 专业地设计基础设施，成为掌控交通的大师。铺设道路、设计路口、调校红绿灯、规划公共交通网络，然后看着城市焕发生机。城市规模会自行扩大，每一座新建筑都会给你修建的道路带来更多出行。

games.name: Grave Orbit
games.description: Defend a lone Core against waves from every direction. Collect the scrap enemies leave behind, build production chains and automated turrets, then carry your upgrades into the next, harder chapter. A sci-fi base-defense campaign across 4 acts, plus prequel and skirmish modes.

games.name: Diofru: Survivors of the Tower
games.description: 从卑微的学徒觉醒为九位元素大法师之一，攀登高塔。每一层都有倒计时：在归零之前杀死史诗怪物，否则天花板会在你酣战之际开始塌落。不合心意的升级可以重抽，不想再见的卡可以移除。

games.name: The Highest School: Don’t Look Down
games.description: Your school is waiting at the very top - but to reach it, you’ll have to climb through history itself. Ascend from the Ancient World to the distant future, overcome obstacles, and whatever you do… don’t look down.

games.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
games.description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

games.name: Murder Your Friends
games.description: A party horror game for you and your friends, except one of you is a masked killer. Doors are locked, find the key before the killer finds you! Chaos will ensue as you stumble into each other, find whimsical items, and sacrifice your best friends for survival!

games.name: Nordic Lake
games.description: Develop your own Lake! Balance the food chain and make sure the lake remains inhabitable to all of its residents. Unlock over dozen different unique creatures, including fish and invertebrates. Collect codex of all the plants and creatures as you expand your lake, and make it look uniquely yours.

games.name: Bluy Leaves Home
games.description: A turn-based bullet-hell JRPG game.

games.name: Rash Decision
games.description: Co-op medical for 1-2 players. The Nurse examines a very unwell patient and SHOUTS the symptoms through a hatch. The Biochemist brews a cure from a deeply unreliable grimoire. Get it wrong and the patient mutates. Then mutates again.

games.name: Arena of the Forge
games.description:
战斗。掠夺。锻造。循环往复。
《锻造竞技场》是一款像素风的无尽竞技场战斗游戏。
在竞技场中，你将通过一波波敌人和 Boss 的战斗来收集并锻造更强的装备，
或进入 猛袭模式（Onslaught），体验纯粹的 Boss 速战挑战。

games.name: PlayCard Football
games.description: Don't sim the games. Play every snap. You are the coach, build the profile YOU want. Develop your team roster unit by unit, and take both onto the field with a deck of plays you call yourself.  A football coaching career from Friday-night lights to the pro playoffs.

games.name: 齐天大冲刺
games.description: 还原儿时围坐桌前的西游记忆。1–8 人国风水墨竞速：掷骰前行，步步是险阻，局局都心跳！一柄金箍棒扫清妖障，一颗冲刺骰绝境翻盘。无论独自对弈还是好友欢聚，不到最后一格，胜负绝不见分晓！

games.name: RAT TAG!
games.description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

games.name: The Clues
games.description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

games.name: PAY THE HOUSE：开包还债
games.description: 你欠庄家的钱，手上唯一的营生是香烟卡。撕包、集齐套装、凑够每一次上缴——每第三次金额翻倍。该典当就典当，该借高利贷就借，然后接着开包。一款禁酒令时代的开包 roguelike：债务只会在你每次还清之后变得更大。

games.name: Empty House
games.description: 丧尸末日过后,人去楼空。潜入被遗弃的空屋——第一人称、最多4人合作潜行恐怖游戏。与同伴协力收集物资,活着逃出去!从脚步声到麦克风里的说话声,任何声音都会引来丧尸。避开丧尸,或伪装成丧尸摆脱威胁。

games.name: CLICKONAUT
games.description: A clicker roguelike. Clickonaut is a cosmos clicker with deck building progression. Allowing players to destroy planets, stars, and black holes, earn cash, and combine powerful modifiers into absurdly broken builds.

games.name: EmergenHex
games.description: Build your loadout, press Deploy, and watch combat resolve automatically. Solve 60+ deterministic auto-battler RPG encounters with skills, passives, artifacts, gear, damage types, and status effects, then automate conquered nodes for offline loot.

games.name: Aera in the Ink Realm
games.description: Enter cursed books, fight broken stories, and rescue five lost friends in a dark fantasy action RPG.

games.name: HOPIATE
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a simulated market instead of a board. Build a deck of edges, trade a tape that moves in real time, clear the week’s target.

games.name: Stonefall
games.description:
You are a stone, fallen from the cosmic abyss into an unforgiving dark fantasy world. 

Unleash abilities as you jump, roll, slam and air-cannon your way through deadly obstacles, topple four colossal bosses in souls-like combat, and return to the cold void of space where you belong.

games.name: Survival Fund Manager
games.description: 首席基金经理之间的荣誉对决。凭借独有的情报网络抢先洞察市场，公开或隐藏信息，让股价走势按照你的意图发展。在激烈的心理博弈中夺得最高收益，证明你才是最出色的基金经理。

games.name: JapaneseDialect
games.description: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

games.name: Torque Trails: Beyond Limits
games.description: Drive a variety of vehicles through challenging platforming tracks across diverse environments. Master precision driving, overcome dynamic obstacles, and conquer unique levels in this single-player driving adventure.

games.name: Knock Twice
games.description: Garland Court, 1974. The building has one rule: if someone knocks twice — only twice — do not answer, do not speak. Four apartments, fourteen nights, twelve endings. You never see the thing in the hall. You only decide whether to open the door. Headphones required.

games.name: 椿家的第七天 - 凶手由你指认
games.description: 四个人，谁都可能是凶手的和风推理冒险游戏。旧家的家主猝然离世，你作为送遗嘱来的人，在这个家里住到头七法事那天。宅子和镇上共十三处，走访、追问、收集证据——可自由行动只有十次，走不完。最后在上香的席上，从四名嫌疑人里指认一人。动机、机会、物证攒得够不够，会让同样的指认走向不同的结局：是真相大白，还是没有把握的指认。揭开一个真相，下一周目就换成你还没见过的那桩案子。

games.name: Wordgrow
games.description:
Discover the pleasure of writing and watch your story come to life before your eyes...
Write an essay that's due, your future bestseller, a love letter... whatever the text, it's what grows the landscape.

games.name: GIGASTRIKER
games.description: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

games.name: Last Rituel
games.description: 一款以13世纪被诅咒修道院为背景的第一人称心理恐怖游戏。挥动一面古老的手镜，揭示隐藏的现实，发掘禁忌仪式，并揭开埋藏于数百年信仰之下的骇人真相。

games.name: Blu's Time Machine
games.description: A retro-style 2D platformer where you flutter jump, propel and throw wrenches to defeat enemies and save the day!

games.name: Super Froppings
games.description:
《Super Froppings》是一款最多支持8人同场竞技的青蛙跳跃生存派对游戏。
只用两个按键，看准时机操控青蛙，向更高的楼层进发吧！

games.name: NyanDrop
games.description: NyanDrop是一款物理益智游戏：将4个以上相同图案的积木连在一起，就能消除它们。巧妙旋转、堆叠，让坍落的积木带来连锁。收集Cats购买道具，为陷入困境的棋盘找到转机。和猫咪一起，再来一次！

games.name: Arcanum Solitarius
games.description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

games.name: 深渊机器：AbyssMachine
games.description: 《AbyssMachine》是一款充满混沌连锁的动作肉鸽游戏。每一次按下按钮，都会推动局势向未知发展。没有两次构筑完全相同：在收益、风险与路线之间作出选择，让一个简单的按键最终化为席卷全场的破坏力。

games.name: The Dawn Forge
games.description: Keep the last forge burning. Buy iron, hammer blades, sell to the travellers who walk in — and every spark you throw makes the dark see you further. Arm your neighbours, direct turn-based battles, and cut ten expeditions into the Long Night. Nothing advances while you are away.

games.name: Slammer Soccer: Football Management
games.description: Manage a prison football team, trade inmates, develop your squad, survive prison politics, and lead your team from the yard to glory.

games.name: Run Puppet Run
games.description: Chaos arrives at the cardboard & felt island! Run Puppet Run is a 4-player multiplayer party game. Choose your puppet, dodge crazy traps, and survive fast-paced minigames. Compete with friends and be the last one standing!

games.name: Carry Bros: Find It Together
games.description: Hide objects, search industrial locations, and outsmart the opposing team in a fast-paced online party game. Play as Hiders or Seekers, use special abilities and power-ups, and complete your objective before time runs out!

games.name: Warehouse Catastrophe
games.description: Warehouse: Catastrophe is a cozy warehouse organizing simulator where you clean, sort, and repack over 4,170 products into 1,415 delivery boxes. Restore a disaster-filled warehouse alongside your orange cat companion, unlock new abilities, and bring order back at your own relaxing pace.

games.name: PAWN SHIFT
games.description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

games.name: Diaper Wars
games.description: 这是一款混乱的多人派对游戏，调皮的宝宝们在这里战斗、竞争，并通过荒谬的武器、爆炸性的战斗和狂野的障碍赛释放混乱。

games.name: Dribble Basket
games.description: 在这款基于物理效果的篮球挑战中，一路弹跳着前往篮筐。掌握运球技巧，克服重重障碍，仅凭精准的时机和操作控制篮球走向胜利。

games.name: Cat Over Here!
games.description: 在这座充满隐藏猫咪的黑白工厂中，开启惬意的3D寻物之旅！放慢脚步，检查机器背后，按自己的节奏探索每个角落。没有计时器，没有惩罚，尽享无压力的捉迷藏体验。你能找出工厂里所有的猫咪吗？

games.name: Rise of the Merchants
games.description: RISE OF THE MERCHANTS 是一款以持久在线世界为背景的中世纪城市建设、经济、政治与贸易模拟游戏。从你所在郡县的一个小聚落起步，将其发展成一座有影响力的城市，并建立一个远超其疆界的贸易网络

games.name: Fizzburg
games.description: 在一个物理规则会传染的小镇上,4-8 位朋友争分夺秒完成共同工程——而隐藏的捣乱者正悄悄让一切脱轨。一部没有会议、没有投票、没有死亡的物理社交推理喜剧。

games.name: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
games.description: 在万圣节之夜，变成一颗南瓜！ 绝对的禅意，深夜的忧郁，还有零焦虑。完美的夜晚计划！

games.name: Arborrosa Insidia
games.description: A retro-inspired horror game where you, as a scientist, will explore the local flora, desperately trying to find a semi-mythical plant that promises a better life. In these hazy landscapes your loneliness is only an illusion.

games.name: I Buried Steve
games.description: 八名玩家在沙滩上搭出一条致命障碍赛道，然后八个人都得跑完它。《超级鸡马》遇上《糖豆人》，外加利斧、舰炮和鲨卷风。抽取陷阱，布置沙地，然后在水位淹上来之前拼命跑。

games.name: 充满异常的神社
games.description: 操作博丽灵梦、魂魄妖梦、藤原妹红和雾雨魔理沙，在神社、庭园、竹林和图书馆中寻找异变的东方Project二次创作观察冒险游戏。发现异变时就返回，没有异变时则采取正确行动，并设法逃离异常空间。

games.name: The Hostel Project
games.description: Run your own backpacker hostel in this cozy management sim. Start from humble beginnings and grow your hostel to be the most legendary, or infamous, spot in town. Host influencers, pub crawls, and complete local-themed sponsorships to build your fame and achieve that prestigious 10/10 rating.

games.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
games.description: 一款温馨的第一人称整理模拟游戏，设定在一条熙熙攘攘的小巷：5家魔法店铺和6,666件需要分拣的物品。这条街上的每家店铺都是混乱，每个货架都有规则，每根放错位置的魔杖现在都是你的问题。

games.name: Poordle
games.description: A little homeless poodle just wants a home. Every key you press and every click you make helps him build one, bucket by bucket, tent by tent. No random loot, no microtransactions. Just type, click, and watch your poodle build a life.

games.name: Life Containment Unit
games.description:
Life Containment Unit is a time and resource management survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker.

Struggle to survive against the creatures invading your L.C.U. and the rogue corporate AI that designed this accursed vault system.

games.name: Eternal Dungeon 2
games.description: A fantasy old-school action platformer. Use different attacks, timed blocks and quick reflexes to survive as health is a finite resource. Fight your way through hordes of enemies into the depths of the Eternal Dungeon. Who knows what you will encounter as you descend deeper!

games.name: Zombie Cropse
games.description: 《尸田》是一款温馨哥特风格的放置经营游戏。种下亡灵种子培育亡灵，自动化你的墓园，突袭生者。壮大尸群，征服分支战役，飞升之后带着永久的实力重新开始。

games.name: Dronerush
games.description: Dronerush is an idle, incremental strategy game about discovering drone synergies and mining ore.

games.name: No Brakes Club
games.description: 一款复古多人平台游戏，每局最多支持10名玩家。在节奏飞快的小游戏里冲刺、使坏、背后捅刀：每一局几秒就能上手，一个失误就会出局。

games.name: Masc, Mask & Masked
games.description: Masc, Mask & Masked is a game that combines mini-games with a visual novel in a terrifyingly cute 2D style. Search through your mobile, chat to your potential dates and recover the powerful mask of Niarlatoted.

games.name: We Become Legion
games.description: 这是一款策略型增量自动战斗游戏。你将不断壮大自己的军队，收集装备来打造强力流派，并通过主动技能影响战局。招募单位、解锁升级，并迎战越来越危险的敌人浪潮。

games.name: Myriad
games.description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Every other round, enter a shop and strengthen your build. Gaze the stars in the night sky and score incredibly powerful line clears or just plain destroy the board as you see fit. Watch out for the constellations though...

games.name: Menthal
games.description: Menthal是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，你将成为一名人体实验对象。服用实验药物，承受其副作用，并努力在接下来发生的一切中存活下来。

games.name: Pencil Pursuit
games.description: Outrun the eraser. A hand-drawn runner across 26 notebook pages: flee five stationery villains, topple the WAR MACHINE they bolt together, then turn the chase around in PENCIL REVENGE and claim the page in REDRAW.

games.name: Dying Patience
games.description: 多年来，你一直照顾着母亲，直到她的疾病开始摧毁你的生活。她微弱的声音、憔悴的模样、逐渐消逝的意识……你愿意继续忍受这一切吗？

games.name: Five Signals
games.description: 你的妻子已经死了，但你能在电话中听见她的声音。跟随坐标，探索废弃地点，接听来自电话亭的电话，一步步深入深渊。每通新电话都让你更接近真相……但你可能还没准备好听见它。

games.name: Marrowlight
games.description: Seven women are chained beneath the world, holding an apocalypse down. You are the Warden sworn to execute them when they fail. Free them instead. A horde-survival roguelite where every character you unlock is someone you were sent to kill.

games.name: Necromancer Incremental Graveyard
games.description: Make undead, sell them for souls. An active incremental game where you make as much soul as possible to pay debt. Upgrade multiple different undead gravestones, use contracts, fill up soul jar and unlock perks to make even more souls

games.name: Arkney: The Bone Road
games.description: A handcrafted pixel action RPG. Fight living-world hordes, hunt roaming golden beasts, gather and forge your gear, and walk the Bone Road across three chapters, solo or in 2-player online co-op with a friend. Every hit counts, and death always costs you.

games.name: The Crown
games.description: From humble beginnings, rise up to take your place in the city's underworld!  Your choices will decide how the story plays out in this Visual Novel about crime in the 2000s East Coast.  Choose-Your-Own-Adventure, Stat-driven, Deep Meta-progression.

games.name: Swarmdle
games.description: 一款割草肉鸽。一路向下打穿三层区域，在两波之间补给，把永久强化带进下一局。另有一局十二分钟的每日挑战，全球玩家玩到的完全一样。

games.name: PRINCESS VANGUARD
games.description: 操控拥有五种元素之力的公主，在这款15分钟一局的2D俯视角动作RPG中，以爽快的战斗和华丽的连携必杀技横扫成群敌人。强化武器与装备，挑战强大的Boss，并迎战来袭的魔王军！

games.name: WoundWake
games.description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption

games.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
games.description: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

games.name: Apple Catcher
games.description: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid logs, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

games.name: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology
games.description: The authentic AI industry experience. Answer stupid user questions, make ethical company decisions, and uh... cause nobody any harm! An apocaloptimist game about technology!

games.name: Patchy
games.description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

games.name: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
games.description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

games.name: Arcostate
games.description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

games.name: Blockmosis
games.description: Blockmosis is a puzzle game exploring the intersection of problem solving and music making. The board is an instrument. Aim, rotate, and drop your blocks to create a unique song per level. Different game modes let you explore the intersection in different ways.

games.name: Four Lives
games.description:
Four players. Four lives. One way out.

Four Lives is a 1–4 player online co-op survival horror game where you and your team awaken trapped inside a sprawling nightmare built to test more than your ability to survive.

games.name: 扫平
games.description: 用一根手指托住扫帚、芦苇、鸡毛掸子，或者一根根本不想配合的撬棍。追赶重心，躲过横风和鹦鹉，在万物倒下之前赚取金币、解锁技能，并思考一个重要问题：站得稳，真的比接得住更重要吗？

games.name: LAUNDRO
games.description: A co-op laundromat game about washing strangers' clothes, hitting quota, and surviving whatever walks through the door.

games.name: DISTRAIL
games.description:
[Distrail] features a protagonist who suddenly becomes the 'director' of the final escape vessel project,
and This is a visual novel game that tells the story of the 80 days the project takes place.

games.name: Card Slay
games.description: 庄府会反击的扑克类 Rogue 游戏。放手一搏，把扑克牌型化为武器：红色出击，黑色护身。锻造你的牌组，释放毁灭性的符文连招，智取那些诅咒你的卡牌、扭曲规则的怪物。觉得自己能击败庄府？那就入局吧。

games.name: Lunar Crypt
games.description: 踏入中国神话中的灵界，为十二生肖驱邪，拯救春节！在这款零重力精准平台动作游戏中，以精妙的操作穿梭于重重险境。

games.name: AscendiA
games.description: 你是否也曾梦想成为少年漫画的主角？《Ascendia》是一款像素风动作Roguelike游戏。寻找隐藏彩蛋，获得名为“阿斯特拉”的特殊力量，探索隐藏职业。发现的秘密将助你成长，积累的选择与行动将导向不同结局。属于你的觉醒，就此开始。

games.name: Sia Desktop Pet
games.description: 住在你桌面上的Q版AI虚拟主播「希雅」。她不待在窗口里，而是直接叠在你正在做的事情上面：你工作时她打盹，被拖动时会有反应，你熬得太久了她还会先开口。摸摸她、喂喂她，关系变好之后玩法会一个一个解锁 —— 怪物战斗、桌面足球、24种鱼类图鉴、每天一次的塔罗、天气播报、11套服装、40个成就，存档还能通过Steam云在你的多台电脑之间同步。

games.name: Minus Sixty
games.description: 《Minus Sixty》是一款极寒背景下的单人第一人称剧情生存冒险游戏。你将扮演工程师维克多，前往村庄修理故障的锅炉。通过收集资源、制作物资、生火取暖、管理背包并克服环境中的重重障碍来生存下去。

games.name: PIGMENT LAB
games.description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

games.name: City and War
games.description: 《City And War》是一款融合城市建设、生产经营与即时战争的单人策略游戏。管理不同阶层的人口，建立完整产业链，生产物资与武器，并率领军队在战场和远征地图上争夺资源、击退敌人。

games.name: The Day It Rained Blood
games.description: The Day It Rained Blood is an adult dark-romance visual novel where you choose between a girl cursed to die each day and a childhood friend blessed by fate. Enter the tragedy beneath the blood rain to save her—or turn from the curse and protect your peaceful life.

games.name: Tank of the Fittest
games.description: 《开缸大吉》是一款暗黑水族箱 Roguelite 模拟游戏。调节水温、pH、溶氧与污染，把鱼群推入极限环境；淘汰弱者，催生词条、演化与吞噬连锁，炼出一条足以反噬整个鱼缸的蛊王。
games.developer: Wuhan Wind Tunnel Network Technology Co., Ltd.

games.name: Essence Harvest
games.description: 经典增量玩法与动作性更强的弹幕割草玩法的独特结合。一棵拥有约200个永久升级的巨大升级树，还有遗物、祝福等丰富内容。快加入愿望单，看看你能变得多强。

games.name: Evilos
games.description: 《Evilos》是一款动作塔防游戏，你将扮演一位远古的邪恶巫师，抵御卫道士无穷无尽的进攻浪潮。用海量可进化的魔法武器与法术夷平整个王国，并在 10 个章节中以精英仆从巩固你的防线。这一次，你就是最终BOSS！

games.name: You'll never find it!
games.description: A cozy hiding game for two! Hide everyday objects, then watch your friend search for them and laugh as they walk right past.

games.name: Barkyard Blitz
games.description: 赶拢羊群、抢走分数，用武器化犬吠轰飞对手！获取独特能力，保卫基地，在混乱事件中生存，并扮演不同角色，投身终极农场大战。

games.name: Two Years Later
games.description: 世界一直在运转, 只是我们看到的角度不同

games.name: Tandem Together
games.description: 一款双人合作"友尽"游戏：你和好友骑着双人自行车，穿越危机四伏的地形，运送来路不明的"货物"——还得忍住别亲自"品尝"一口！

games.name: Fallen Hunter Ashen Crown
games.description: 一款充满挑战的动作角色扮演游戏，你将在一个饱受腐化蹂躏的世界中追猎堕落者。掌握快节奏的战斗，击败强大的敌人。

games.name: Dig Thy Hole
games.description: Dig ever deeper through a mysterious underground world, uncover hidden treasures, upgrade your tools, survive deadly hazards, and discover what lies at the bottom.

games.name: 여우 퇴마사는 존중받고 싶었다.
games.description:
"This tiny, four-pyeong room with you is far warmer than the human world that tried to break me."

※ This is a wholesome, heartwarming romance visual novel with no sexually explicit content.

games.name: Kreabordis
games.description: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

games.name: Dak Quest: Year 7108
games.description: Dak Quest is a cozy, stylized top-down action runner where players race through diverse timelines as an interdimensional postal courier. A fast-paced arcade game play with precise mail deliveries, obstacle dodging, and long-term headquarters building, it offers a relaxing yet skill-based experience.

games.name: Pixel Coloring World
games.description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

games.name: Railhold
games.description: Build an armored train and defend it against relentless mutant hordes. Mount turrets, recruit crew and make every stop count in a top-down roguelite tower defense where your base never stops moving.

games.name: Project Turbo Combat
games.description: 《Project Turbo Combat》是一款火爆刺激的载具战斗竞速游戏，同时支持单人战役与在线多人对战。驾驶经典肌肉车、现代运动轿跑与电动超级跑车，在生机勃勃的开放世界街道、宏伟地标与璀璨夜景之间风驰电掣。比赛途中抢夺强化道具：发射追踪导弹、抛洒机油与滑油陷阱、启动氮气加速，将对手狠狠撞出赛道。在这里，每一辆车都是武器，每一圈都是一场激战。你可以选择沉浸式座舱视角或电影感追尾视角，不断扩充你的专属车库，用尽一切手段冲上第一名。

games.name: Steel Company
games.description: Steel Company is a tactical-scale wargame covering all major theaters and powers of WWII, with hundreds of units and detailed modeling of weapons and equipment. It features advanced tactical AI for single player, online multiplayer (PvP and co-op), a powerful scenario editor, and mod support.

games.name: See the sky
games.description: Sometimes the only way to rewrite the past is to relive it. A visual novel in the genre of detective and psychological thriller, where you do not investigate crimes but the psyche and memories of the main characters.

games.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
games.description: 一款发生在停尸房夜间接收台的心理恐怖游戏。遗体随文书一同送达，文书必须与遗体相符。称重、量身、测体温——再听一听胸腔。有些还有脉搏。规程每晚增加一页，而你签收过的东西，有一些不会一直留在签收状态。

games.name: GO, STOP
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder built on hwatu, Korea's flower cards. It's 1999 and you owe a Busan loan shark ₩200,000,000. Match cards, stack charms, blow up the multiplier, and call "Go" to double the pot. Interest comes due every third night.

games.name: AFKTower
games.description: A pixel-art idle RPG docked to the edge of your screen. Your hero climbs a 10,000-floor tower while you work: 12-rarity loot, 4 classes, key-gated bosses, a deep forge and a Paragon Constellation. And it keeps earning while it's closed.

games.name: The Day I Became a Werewolf
games.description: Your latest scientific research has gone horribly wrong. Fix it before it catches up to you, or face the consequences.

games.name: Ombre
games.description: A VR narrative sci-fi horror game. Trapped in an alien prison, you explore, investigate objects, and talk your way through an escape with Isaak, a survivor stranded in orbit who can only reach you by radio. Every conversation choice shapes what he tells you and what he keeps to himself.

games.name: Timberline Factory
games.description: A realistic sawmill simulation made by a real sawmill worker: logs are physics objects that roll, collide and jam your conveyors. Automate production lines, fight dirt and wear, master the market and turn waste into energy.

games.name: just volleyball
games.description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

games.name: CASE: Animatronics Redux
games.description: CASE: Animatronics Redux is a truly scary and challenging first-person stealth horror on PC. The police department's security system has been breached by an anonymous hacker. All exits are locked. Metallic thumps are getting closer. Are you ready to face your nightmares again, Detective Bishop?

games.name: Buzzoria
games.description: 一款轻松温馨的蜜蜂考古与蜂群建设游戏。挖掘消失文明留下的遗迹，寻找深埋地下的珍贵物品，与神秘的“观察者”交易。发展你的蜂群，在一次次发现中收集线索，逐渐揭开旧世界隐藏的真相。

games.name: Great Town Business: Life, Living & Luxuries
games.description: Conquer the ultimate 3D sandbox life! Run a thriving supermarket, restaurant, and furniture empire with deep micro-management. Drive cars, build your dream home, and flirt with NPCs in a living town where every item is interactive and neighbors actually visit you. From cashier to tycoon!

games.name: BALLRENA
games.description: 《BALLRENA》是一款以物理碰撞为核心的构筑型自动战斗 Roguelite。选择决定基础打法的核心，在商店中购买、旋转、合并形状各异的配件，并把它们装进仅有 5×5 格的装配盘。有限的金钱与空间迫使你不断取舍：追逐高阶组件、补足弱点，或围绕关键配件打造连锁。完成装配后，将亲手改造的战斗球送进竞技场，让每次冲撞、反弹、武器启动与能力触发检验你的选择。应对逐渐强大的敌人，领取赏金、调整构筑，并把一块拥挤的网格变成真正能运转的战斗机器。

games.name: Spell Unbound
games.description: 一款像素肉鸽：你唯一的法术，就是你画出的圈。一笔圈住整群怪物，画出形状施放法术，把 Boss 一块块拆掉。四条道路、30 个 Boss、隐藏之地，以及 45 位各自打破一条规则的抄写人。

games.name: Playrooms
games.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

games.name: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs
games.description:
You're gonna need a bigger tower. Then thirty of them. A million bugs are
coming down tunnels the size of a city, and the only correct answer is more
fire. Burn them, rot them, feed them to hungry trees - whatever you do,
don't stop casting.

games.name: Linked Wheels
games.description: 驾驶一辆受物理系统影响的小车，挑战充满危险的障碍赛道。你可以独自控制两侧，也可以与好友在线合作，各自负责一侧。保持配合，跳过危险，蹲下躲避障碍，并在友谊破裂之前逃出致命陷阱。

games.name: Get Outta My Gut
games.description: 一款守护身体、抵御细菌入侵的轻度肉鸽塔防游戏。轮抽炮塔卡牌，搭建防线，为炮塔供血，守住心脏。在10个器官中迎战细菌，每局结束后，还能进化免疫系统。

games.name: Frog Frog Parkour
games.description: 在节奏明快的街机跑酷游戏中操控青蛙。蓄力跳跃、穿越挑战关卡、收集金币，并与自己的残影竞速，刷新最佳时间。容易上手，精通不易。

games.name: Medieval Bust
games.description: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

games.name: An Unreasonable Number of Zombies
games.description: 在一座被僵尸淹没的城市里赌一把。每个街区都是一场不同的战斗，有各自的规则，也有各自的死法。一局打得越久，能赚的就越多……情况也越糟。

games.name: Guild Forge
games.description: 招募英雄，管理你的公会，并派遣冒险者完成高回报的任务。在这款奇幻公会经营模拟游戏中建立你的声望，将公会发展成为王国最强大的公会。

games.name: Iron Void : Silent Space
games.description: 一名孤独的战机驾驶员对抗寂静虚空。在60个手工打造的任务中穿梭于弹幕之间,管理过热,锁定导弹,击垮5个各具特色的首领。赢取战机,升级你的猎手,精通每一颗星。

games.name: Torchlike
games.description: A tense first-person dungeon crawl where a single dying torch stands between you and the darkness.

games.name: Cartagol: Football Card Career
games.description: A football career sim where every match is a card battle. Build joker combos, chase form, survive the press, sign transfers and fill your trophy cabinet — all from your own room. Deckbuilding meets the beautiful game.

games.name: Salty: Evolution Simulator
games.description:
一星孤独的生命之火——一个脆弱的细胞，漂流在广袤而混沌的世界里。
进食、成长、适应、智胜捕食者、挺过病毒入侵，并组装新的细胞器，重塑你的能力与命运。你一直在学习科学——只是忙于求生，无暇察觉。

games.name: Jester's Dungeon
games.description: 一款风格独特的暗黑地牢爬行游戏。你将化身巫师，潜入危机四伏的地牢中，从邪恶小丑的手中夺回被偷走的玩具。将你的鲜血献给暗黑之眼，借用他的力量挣扎求生。斩杀怪物，主宰这座地牢！

games.name: SubSurvival: SSN-13 "Grendel"
games.description: A deep, detailed combat submarine simulator with a lo-fi aesthetic.  Manage crew, nuclear reactor, radio, sonar, radar and power all while remaining undetected and completing the mission.

games.name: 明治藩阀
games.description: 《明治藩阀》是一款模拟明治时代日本政治、经济与军事体系的历史模拟游戏。游戏涵盖从大久保利通遇刺到桂园时代（1878—1912年）。

games.name: SALTWRATH
games.description: Power is bought from the gods and paid for with their attention. Every gift you take makes you stronger and the shore deadlier. The debt never resets. Stack a broken build, evolve your arsenal, and see how far you get before what you owe comes to collect.

games.name: Sakura Shiren
games.description: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on  weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad.

games.name: The Attending
games.description: Run the night shift in an emergency department. Assign patients to your doctors and review their findings before approving a discharge. If something doesn’t add up, order more tests or take over the case yourself.

games.name: Capicú
games.description: A narrative platformer where you play as a yoyo. It tells a story about growing up, having to leave everything behind and rebuilding your life somewhere new.

games.name: 你推的她，真的是你了解的那个她吗？
games.description:
为了守护自己的推，你成为了她所属事务所的安保人员。
入馆证、日程表、许可书、X光检查、声纹认证——这是一款像素风的文件审查冒险游戏。
在规则与“对推的爱”之间不断做出抉择的过程中，光鲜亮丽的VTuber事务所背后那不为人知的一面，也将逐渐浮出水面。

games.name: HoloCozy
games.description: HoloCozy 是一款温馨治愈的放置型桌面陪伴游戏，让你与 hololive 成员在舒适的房间里共度悠闲时光。聆听音乐与环境音，在工作、学习或休息时让喜爱的角色陪伴在旁，并按照自己的节奏见证她们成长。

games.name: Orbion Online
games.description: Orbion Online is a real-time multiplayer space action game where you start as a tiny stone and grow by absorbing asteroids, planets, and rival pilots. Explore a shared cosmos of stars, wormholes, and galaxies and climb from pebble to powerhouse.

games.name: GemSlasher
games.description:
GemSlasher is a fast-paced action roguelite where every attack is built from gems.
Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

games.name: memory cafe
games.description: 在林间深处，有一间只有你能找到的咖啡馆——因为只有你听得懂客人说话。冲煮、种花、布置小店，但真正的功课，是听出他们没说出口的那一句。招待三十位常客，慢慢赢得信任，把他们从未对谁提起的故事，一页页收进故事书里。

games.name: Pocket Studio Desktop Companion
games.description: 设计一款游戏：类型、题材、受众。然后回去做你真正的工作 - 你敲下的每一个键，都会为它多写一行代码。一位迷你开发者在屏幕角落的小窗口里，为你的点子写代码、发售，并接受评分。

games.name: NULL FACTORY Survival Horror
games.description: NULL FACTORY, terk edilmiş bir endüstriyel tesis hayatta kalmanız gereken birinci şahıs bir korku oyunudur. Notlar aracılığıyla fabrikanın karanlık sırlarını açığa çıkarın, zorlu bulmacaları çözün ve sizi avlayan varlıktan saklanın. Gerilim dolu bu tesisten sağ olarak çıkmayı başarabilecek misiniz?

games.name: Moon Swarm
games.description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

games.name: Next Level: Tower Defense
games.description: Race-based tower defense. Build your army, defend your king, and send waves at your rivals. Up to 8-player FFA, 2v2 & 4v4 teams, and singleplayer. Crossplay on Windows, Linux, macOS & Steam Deck.

games.name: 藏好私房钱
games.description: 把私房钱藏进马桶水箱、压在床垫底下、塞到冰箱背后。然后闯进朋友家翻箱倒柜，把他们的钱找出来；房主只能堵门、推你、拼命装无辜。1–4 人物理派对游戏，可以和朋友联机，也可以单人对战机器人。

games.name: Stay in Your Lane
games.description: Stay in Your Lane is a single-lane real-time tug-of-war strategy game. Build your economy, unlock units, spells, and upgrades, then summon an army that fights on its own. Outsmart your rival in campaign, skirmish, or online battles.

games.name: Dungeon Overtime
games.description: Run the cleanup shift after fantasy heroes trash your dungeon. Assign slimes, skeletons, and mimics, turn manual cleanup into automation, and keep the next raid ready—all from a compact desktop window.

games.name: The Final Exhibit
games.description: 探索一座神秘的博物馆，修复被腐化的艺术品，揭开潜伏其中的神秘存在背后的真相——一场心理恐怖之旅就此展开。

games.name: Sketchy Business
games.description: One employee has no idea what the task is. Everyone else does. Draw your clue, bluff your way through, and find the Bludger before they become Employee of the Month.

games.name: 共氧同盟
games.description: O2GETHER 是一款合作生存游戏，全队共用一个氧气罐。离开氧气罐去侦察、捡战利品或救队友，但你的空气会开始倒计时。及时飘回来，否则就会昏迷。拖着氧气罐穿越残骸，躲开混乱，在空气耗尽前抵达空间站。

games.name: Groundwork
games.description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

games.name: Crowns of Medieval Europe
games.description: Lead one of ten medieval kingdoms in this turn-based grand strategy game. Expand your territory, develop your economy, strengthen your army, and shape the future of Europe through diplomacy, war, and strategic decisions.

games.name: 捡起你的玩具来
games.description: 一款温馨的合作整理游戏，把梦想中的玩具店变成井井有条的小世界。整理全部 20,000 件玩具，为每个娃娃、恐龙和小火车找到正确的位置，让货架重新焕发生机——独自游玩，或与最多 4 名好友一起。

games.name: Portal Deep
games.description: 昏迷在自己充满欲望的想象深处。连跳穿越12层罪恶快感地牢，每个Boss都是从你的幻想中活过来的女孩。打败她们，「解放」她们，收集她们的火辣照片——然后决定，现实还值不值得醒来。

games.name: My Furry Goth Girlfriend
games.description: 有一天，你下载了一个交友软件，它承诺帮你找到梦中情人……

games.name: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
games.description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

games.name: Layoff Revenge!
games.description: 被解雇了！但你的门禁卡还能用15分钟。单人挑战或最多4人组队，在时间耗尽前破坏你的经理。用恶作剧填满他的"愤怒"槽，同时把"怀疑"压到最低。一层层往上爬，让整个公司崩塌。

games.name: My Naughty Secretary: Private Overtime
games.description: My Naughty Secretary: Private Overtime 是一款以禁忌办公室恋情为主题的成人视觉小说。与新秘书 Emily 拉近关系，做出选择，揭开公司内部的阴谋，并解锁露骨的 18+ 成人场景。

games.name: Volleyball Sports Game
games.description: A sports game about Volleyball. Experience as a manager as you lead your team towards World Champion.

games.name: Logo Idle
games.description: 一款关于弹跳标志和击碎屏幕的复古放置游戏。点击标志、购买升级，一路把屏幕砸个粉碎！

games.name: My Gym Crush: Private Workout
games.description: 前按摩师亚历克斯成为健身教练后的第一天，遇见了玛丽亚——一位迷人、自信的健身女孩，也是著名拳击手丹尼尔的女友。原本专业的私人训练很快演变成危险的吸引、私密照片、秘密聊天和闭店后的会面。通过对话选择赢得她的信任，完成互动挑战，并决定这段建立在欲望、界限与诚实之上的成人恋情将如何发展。十天剧情中，你将面对诱惑、被发现的风险与真正的感情，解锁大量精美插画、成人场景和Steam成就。所有登场角色均已成年。

games.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
games.description: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

games.name: Desert Survivors
games.description: 横扫沙漠中的无尽怪物，打破诅咒！选择你的角色，搭配各种技能，打造威力惊人的专属组合。面对这片无情的沙漠，你能活下来吗？

games.name: Project September
games.description: Mars is overrun and you're the cleanup crew. A comic book twin stick rogue lite, mow down thousands, stack game breaking perks, roll the enemy's dice, and detonate everything on the map. Die, bank your gold, build a nastier deck, drop again.

games.name: Can It!
games.description: Connect cans before they pile up! "Can It!" is a cute, colorful game where you piece together a variety of cans to survive. Reaction time and strategy are key to getting the highest score possible. Outpace the cans before time runs out!

games.name: SUSHI PARADE
games.description: SUSHI PARADE 是一家开在你桌面上的回转寿司店！传送带铺在窗口外面，寿司就从你开着的文档前面转过去，鼠标只点得到寿司，手上的活一点不耽误。集齐一百多种寿司图鉴，雇师傅站进厨房，招呼自来熟的常客——「いらっしゃいませ」，欢迎光临！

games.name: 巴哈姆特3－龙神之子的堕落
games.description: 《巴哈姆特3－龙神之子的堕落》是一款黑暗奇幻日式角色扮演游戏。玩家将扮演身负龙神血脉的少年克莱昂，在战乱与魔族威胁交织的世界中展开冒险。旅途中，每次对话与抉择都可能增加傲慢、愤怒、贪婪等七宗罪，进而影响角色能力、同伴关系与剧情发展。运用行动点数、技能范围、站位与防御突破击败敌人，招募各自背负欲望与秘密的伙伴，培养八种武器熟练度、强化装备并搭配宠物支持。在有限的时间与资源中，你会成为拯救世界的英雄，还是逐渐堕落成为新的灾厄？

games.name: 企鹅之怒
games.description: 企鹅之怒 是一款Roguelite 自动对战游戏。招募企鹅，将它们合成为更强大的形态，装上武器，再把它们投入永无止境的敌浪。把击杀串联成连击，从 狂热 一路冲到 神级，解锁横跨 6 个时代的 70 款皮肤，并让每一局都多撑过一波。每局阵容与构建都不相同，同样的战斗永远不会重演。每局阵容与构建都不相同，同样的战斗永远不会重演。一局只要几分钟，但你会一直想再来一局，看看自己到底能把氹涌而来的敌浪推回多远。

games.name: Octbuster：录像带租赁店大扫除
games.description: Octbuster 是一款温馨治愈的整理游戏。你将扮演一只章鱼，在打烊后的 80 年代录像带租赁店里进行清理和收拾。在一群小猫咪的帮助下，用你的章鱼触手一把捞起随机散落的 VHS 录像带，并按照你喜欢的方式整理超过 10,000 盘录像带。别担心，你有 8 条手臂、一辆推车，还有一支小猫大军。每一张封面都由程序生成，而不是生成式 AI。

games.name: Bleach & Blood
games.description: Bleach & Blood is a retro slasher horror game about surviving the night shift at a small-town laundromat while a killer stalks the streets.

games.name: Space Squadron Command
games.description: A tactical, dice-based space combat game inspired by tabletop wargames. Plot your maneuvers, activate your squadrons, and fight using an array of ship-to-ship weapons as you build a persistent roster of ships and pilots across a galaxy-spanning campaign.

games.name: Waifu Bubble
games.description: 潜入一场迷人的水下解谜冒险!单人游玩或与好友一起，操控可爱的小螃蟹，带领一位被困的老婆穿过精巧的双层关卡。解开谜题，齐心协力，帮助她抵达水面!

games.name: Deep Digger
games.description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

games.name: Konbini Shift
games.description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

games.name: I Keep Reincarnating as a Rat in the Mad Scientist’s Maze
games.description: Every death turns you back into a rat. Every new life is just another futile attempt to break the loop. Explore the mad scientist’s dystopian maze, learn from your gruesome mistakes, and accept the harsh truth: there might be no way out of this cage.

games.name: DriveGear
games.description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

games.name: Questris
games.description: Questris 是一款奇幻 Roguelite 游戏，你需要放置拼块来完成整行，从而攻击、防御、治疗并触发强力效果。通过新的拼块、遗物、符文和职业能力塑造每次冒险，并根据面对的敌人调整策略。

games.name: Waifu Factory
games.description: This is a factory game where you manage a factory creating waifus to complete requests, buy upgrades and to grow your factory to spread love to the world.

games.name: ScarryLand: The Potion Goes Wrong!
games.description: 一场疯狂的第一人称恐怖冒险，充满谜题、黑色幽默、喜剧元素与混乱。魔法师为夺取王位诅咒了整座小岛，而你祖父的魔药又把人类变成了动物。找到他，收集原料，与会叫你“爸爸”的骷髅伙伴邦奇一起制作解药！

games.name: Tick Walk
games.description: A turn-based puzzle game where you cross a grid of bombs, walls, and traps to reach the door. The board only moves when you move, so there's no rush — take your time and find the safe route. Easy to pick up, tough to solve.

games.name: Scuttled
games.description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

games.name: Court of Hearts: Masquerade Trials
games.description: 将经典红心大战化为策略肉鸽挑战。解锁遗物，塑造每次挑战，掌握全新规则变化。对战 AI 或其他在线玩家。

games.name: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords
games.description: 保卫王国，抵御暴虐的军阀，然后招募他们！指挥史诗般的回合制战斗，将这片土地从压迫中解放出来。当海盗入侵小王国佛雷斯特格罗夫时，唤醒了挺身反抗残暴与奴役的军事领袖。

games.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院
games.description: 这是一款第一人称独立恐怖游戏，在游戏中你将扮演一个探索废弃医院的视频博主，揭开这所废弃医院背后隐藏的秘密。

games.name: WHEN ARMIES WAVER
games.description: Break enemy morale and push the line. Command your whole army in a real-time medieval battle roguelite. Advance, defend, or retreat; choose one of three rewards to build your army; and weigh losses against risky routes to the final battle.

games.name: 海兽奇航
games.description: An incremental action game set across the seas. Lead a party of 5 Heroes, upgrade your heroes and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your skill tree as you fight through 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts for your next adven

games.name: 鼹鼠与矿石
games.description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

games.name: Leeway
games.description: 一款帆船时代的贸易模拟游戏，航行本身就是玩法。真实的风，要逆风而上就得抢风调向；货舱越满，船越笨重，也越早被海水灌满；还有一张借据，不管你靠没靠港，都会照样到期。老实经商，或挂起黑旗。可以单人游玩，也可以凭房间码与好友结伴出海。

games.name: Aqua Factory Simulator
