games.description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

games.name: Evoruption
games.description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

games.name: Card Duel: Black Rite 卡牌决斗：黑暗仪式
games.description: 《卡牌决斗:黑暗仪式》是一款以德州扑克牌型决斗为核心的轻量卡牌 Roguelike，使用多种多样的魔法卡牌改写牌局，强化牌组，在不同的命运中做出选择，最终赢得这场黑暗对决。

games.name: Precinct 2099
games.description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

games.name: Traymon World：任务栏怪物RPG
games.description: 在任务栏上就能玩的最迷你怪物放置RPG。收集并养成各自拥有独特技能与个性的怪物。探索全程自动挂机，在组建出最强队伍之前，千万别停下！

games.name: TerraLounge
games.description: 一个令人放松的史莱姆生态缸，想玩的时候还有三消解谜等着你。这是一个小小的霓虹世界，无论你在工作还是休息，它都能安静地陪在一旁。

games.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
games.description: 操作模块化磁带解码机，挑战互动解谜，修复损坏的数据，揭开医院血腥惨案背后的真相。

games.name: ハルシネーション
games.description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

games.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
games.description: 和风恐怖×规则解谜。阴阳交界处的客栈，每晚都会新增一条守则。垂下目光、捂住耳朵，裁断潜入房间的异变；天亮翻开住宿簿，追查客栈的真相。有些夜晚，来的东西会披着守则所写之物的名字。是遵从，还是怀疑？只用鼠标。

games.name: Across Crime
games.description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

games.name: Brazilian LAN House 2003
games.description: An internet cafe simulator set in 2003 Brazil. Run a LAN house in first person: share one 512 kbps line between every PC, keep the breaker from tripping, chase the tabs in your notebook, and turn six beige machines into the neighborhood hangout.

games.name: 全民对抗外星人
games.description: 外星人给了人类 8 小时，随后便会毁灭地球。使用 Gravity Gun 举起城市中的任何物体，搭建通往巨大 UFO 的道路，单人或最多 4 人在线合作拯救地球。

games.name: Statue Gallery: Back in One Piece
games.description: Explore a messy gallery filled with shattered sculptures inspired by real works from Ancient Greece, Rome, Egypt, and other cultures throughout history. Find where each piece belongs, restore the statues, improve your abilities, and put the gallery back together—one piece at a time.

games.name: Dungeon Sookuma
games.description: 组合14种苏库玛血脉与19种职业，深入每次都会变化的梦境地牢。鉴定未知物品，与19位神祇缔结契约，夺走梦之结晶，再从苏醒的迷宫中杀回地面。这是一款正统回合制类Rogue游戏。

games.name: May No One Be Left Behind
games.description:
Welcome to the Sanatorium!
Here we train the next generation of space pioneers!
We're proud to welcome such an outstanding specialist to our ranks!
A first-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere and storytelling.
Solve puzzles and uncover the conspiracy behind The Global Government.

games.name: KALA
games.description: 钓鱼。进食。呕吐。装饰。入睡。重复。KALA是一款短小的超现实恐怖游戏，讲述一名男子将自己流放到偏远孤岛，却被过往罪孽纠缠的故事。

games.name: Helion Conflict
games.description: 即时战略，凝练至决策本身。你掌控的每座工厂都会不停建造 - 由你决定飞船的去向，并能在飞行途中将其调转。指挥官模式加入了战争经济：铁与金的网络、炮塔、卫星、轨道打击。线上最多八人。分钟计，而非小时。

games.name: BrouHaHa
games.description: 听一个词。在12秒内输入。如果错了，你会在12人排行榜上下滑，直到被淘汰。在单词之间购买优惠券来扭曲对手的音频，打乱他们的输入，并偷他们的美元。

games.name: Hotel 13
games.description: 走廊每次看起来都一模一样。但真的是这样吗？也许有什么东西已经改变了。仔细观察周围的一切。

games.name: Sarukuji
games.description: Global warming has flooded the earth. Only the monke survived. Build your sand castle and fight to the death with random items against your friends!

games.name: BunnyGalSanta-バニーギャルサンタ-
games.description: 「你回来啦～ 我特地为了今天买了兔女郎圣诞装♡」圣诞之夜，与可爱和色气全开的她共度的贴身H向3D模拟。用鼠标拖动的「旋转活塞系统」随心所欲地摆动腰部，提升她的满足度解锁新体位。让她100%满足，就有特别的圣诞礼物…♡

games.name: Gamophobia
games.description: Dating is scary—especially when you’re wooing the physical manifestations of human phobias. Fall in love with a Fear. Try not to flinch.

games.name: Rally Point
games.description: 一款背景设定在“会反击的星系”中的策略肉鸽游戏。从 90+ 张英雄、机甲与支援卡中组建阵容。单人或合作推进战役——在你的任务间隙，敌方势力会增援、反攻，并争夺你的领地。单人模式下可随时暂停，重新部署。

games.name: 留在四月以后
games.description:
《留在四月以后》是一部暗黑系百合悬疑视觉小说。
一次意外死亡，将几名学生共同拖进无法回头的秘密之中。
谎言、沉默、审判与彼此掌握的罪证，逐渐改变着司徒央与苏樱之间原本就并不纯粹的关系。

games.name: TowOrbs
games.description: TowOrbs 是一款增量式塔防游戏，你将面对成群结队的狼群。掌握独特的防御塔发展路线，解锁强大的永久升级，并用旋转的毁灭之球切碎你的敌人！

games.name: Stellar Nursery
games.description: Relight a dead sun and tend the worlds that circle it. Earth comes back to life, builds a city you name, and keeps a written record of all that follows. P.O.R.T.I.A., the caretaker who waited a hundred thousand years, keeps the watch with you. A quiet idle game that works while you are away.

games.name: Path of Broken Builds
games.description: 你不操控英雄，你操控技能树。英雄独自在地牢中厮杀，而你要在实时战斗中培育一棵无尽的、程序生成的被动技能树——每投入一点，都会立刻化作一记打击。串联基石与终极节点，拼出一套崩坏到足以打破游戏本身的构筑。

games.name: Mewtations: Dogma
games.description: 在一张堆满卡牌的桌面上，为猫咪们建起一个家。采集、制作、种植，为队伍配齐装备，派它们踏上自动战斗的 Roguelite 远征——并赶在下一张欠条到期之前，顶住 Huohuo 老大和他那帮狗狗黑帮。

games.name: B.U.D.D.I - Personal Diagnostic Companion
games.description: A desktop puzzle and psychological-horror game where you install a friendly 2003 diagnostic assistant, let him scan your files, and try to close him before he finds another reason to stay.

games.name: Phantasm Cube
games.description: 自动化生产线以生成方块，管理资源转换，维持 key 增益（Buff），打造属于你的终极生产线！

games.name: 虞州的罪羊
games.description: 一款多结局解谜叙事游戏。当噩梦与幻觉更迭，在众多结局的可能性中，破解唯一的真相。

games.name: Carrot Count Sheep
games.description:
Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into The Dream of 100 Sheep in this cozy rpg puzzle adventure. 
Solve not-too-hard puzzles, meet interesting and unique characters, and uncover the mystery behind nightmares that are appearing across this once cozy dream. 

Whose dream is this, anyway?

games.name: Starwreck Reclaimer
games.description: Pilot a combat salvager into a shifting starship graveyard in this top-down twin-stick action roguelite. Battle hostile machines, manage ammunition and hull integrity, choose risky protocols, recover valuable scrap, and build powerful weapon and module combinations.

games.name: Vault of Eras
games.description: A bullet hell shooter, dungeon crawler about robbing a pyramid that rearranges itself after every run.

games.name: Wardspire
games.description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

games.name: Combustor
games.description: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

games.name: Calcio 98
games.description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

games.name: Myth: Chenxiang
games.description: 《神话：沉香》是一款以中国神话为灵感的第三人称动作角色扮演游戏。扮演凡人与女神之子沉香，一路修行、迎战强敌，提升法力与道行，迈向大罗之境。为救出母亲、让家人团聚，你必须挑战天条律令。

games.name: Blind Route
games.description: Blind 无法看到路线；他们的队友必须通过语音描述路线。扮演 Blind 和 Guide，在危险的 3D 障碍赛道中生存下来，并在单人、合作和竞技在线模式中领先对手到达终点。

games.name: 异界刀锋：战卡
games.description: 融合卡牌构筑与基地防守，加入战棋移动的奇幻风格卡牌塔防。召唤角色、布置陷阱、使用魔法，阻止从传送门涌出的敌人，一起来守护基地水晶吧！

games.name: Fish Go Brrr!
games.description: 在这款养鱼放置类模拟经营游戏中，喂养你的鱼儿，收集金币，抵御外星入侵者对鱼缸的攻击。解锁打破常规的稀奇古怪的帮手生物。如果你敢，就踏上这场危险的水下冒险吧！

games.name: Walk in PENUMBRA
games.description: 本作是一款以「利用阴影」为核心的Roguelite射击游戏。活用「进入阴影后伤害翻倍」这一特性，在随机生成的地图中穿行于阴影之间，有时自行制造阴影，甚至利用敌人的影子。一次走位便能扭转战局——这是一款充满策略性的「影击」射击游戏！

games.name: TBF: Task Bar Fishing
games.description: 在被水淹没的世界里,一个女孩一边钓鱼一边探险的故事。让她在桌面一角自动钓鱼,只在重要事件时提供帮助。通过钓鱼收集金钱和装备,继续你的探险,揭开这个世界的真相!

games.name: Abort Sequence
games.description:
Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience!
Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

games.name: ダイノボックス
games.description:
Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger!
DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

games.name: 墨守
games.description:
東洋ハイファンタジーの世界で、防衛成功まで何度も時を巻き戻す高難易度２Ｄタワーディフェンス。

さらにゲーム内のステージ作成機能により、プレイヤーの数だけ終わりないステージが待っている。

games.name: EXCISA
games.description: 坐到废弃宅邸中的通灵桌前。选择一张塔罗牌。掷下骰子。赌上一切，召唤那个从不说谎的天使。每一次伸手越过桌面，都可能让你更接近真相——也可能让某种别的东西坐到你的对面。五把椅子。亡者也听见了你的呼唤。

games.name: 可以看看你的...植物嘛？
games.description: 如果你家有一面完全由你掌控的植物墙会怎么样？种植、培养各种现实生活中的植物并通过挂机来赚钱！种的越多赚的越多！还能引来更多蝴蝶和昆虫哦，然后去创造闻所未闻的变异植物和杂交植物！并在创造中逐渐DIY出专属于你的植物墙~

games.name: F.I.S.H. 2
games.description: A one-button intense rhythm game where you enforce road safety on neglecting fish (the sequel)

games.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
games.description: 在一片被沙尘暴、重力异常和怪诞生物机械恐怖所吞噬的荒野中，一路开火穿过惨烈的生存恐怖体验，追捕你最凶恶的宿敌——那个疯子博士。

games.name: InFlood
games.description: Raise your sails and set forth across an endless ocean, vast and perilous, filled with submerged mysteries and unexpected adventures. Fight your way through danger, upgrade your ship, recruit a crew, explore the world, and decide which coalitions to support—and what will be built upon the ruins.

games.name: Scopa Sweep
games.description: 意大利传统纸牌游戏 Scopa 变身 roguelike, 以当地餐厅为主题在餐桌上与你的对手进行纸牌对决。抓取桌面上所有的卡牌并尽可能拿下更多的分数。使用「SCOPA」扫空牌面来提高你的倍率，完成不同的目标从而获得永久加成。游戏的目标只有一个：获得最高得分并征服全桌！

games.name: BEAM Inc.
games.description: 在无菌研究设施中无力化未知检体的短篇主动型增量游戏。

games.name: 雪月星霜
games.description: 拥有微弱预知能力的高中生久坂宗丞，在寒假来到流传着幽灵与神隐传说的“雪月町”。在这座白雪覆盖的小镇上，他与梦中见过的神秘少女邂逅……。VODALES呈献的冒险类视觉小说作品。

games.name: Snowed In
games.description: Dig through tons of snow, survive the freezing cold, upgrade your tools, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the avalanche.

games.name: Six is Devil
games.description: 一款不断掷骰子，直到所有骰子都掷出6的增量游戏。提升你的成功概率，腐化你的骰子，并下注挑战极限，只为达成完美投掷。你能让所有骰子都掷出6吗？

games.name: A Magical Honor "The Race to Rescue PFC Whiskers"
games.description: This is an FPS Action-Extraction Game!

games.name: Spark of Tales
games.description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

games.name: Dragon Heist
games.description: Sneak into a castle guarded by a sleeping dragon with 3 other players, grab as much gold and treasure as you can, and flee before the dragon wakes up.

games.name: Adventure Reznara
games.description: 在以文字为主的像素风 RPG 类 Roguelike 游戏中选择你的道路。选择职业，经陆路与海路游历六大地域，用卡牌选择化解每一次遭遇：战斗、逃跑，或夺取所遇之物的灵魂。可选普通模式或永久死亡。

games.name: Packfall Chain Arena
games.description: 把4颗同色宝珠连在一起消除，同色属性的装备就会联动出击——落块拼图×背包构筑的单人自动战斗游戏。在商店购买装备，精心摆进背包、让效果相互联动，在与敌人的对决中占得上风。

games.name: The Varitav
games.description: A top-down pixel art survivor roguelike. Play as a little fox, craft a powerful build against endless enemy waves, and survive across three distinct biomes. No permanent upgrades. You start from scratch every run. As the swarm grows stronger, surviving gets pretty hard.

games.name: Anurak
games.description: Psychological first-person horror about an investigative journalist exploring hidden caves beneath Machu Picchu. Document your findings, and uncover what lies beneath.

games.name: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
games.description: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats es un juego de objetos ocultos en el que compites contra el tiempo para encontrar 100 gatos escondidos en los lugares más emblemáticos del mundo. Descubre los gatos, haz clic con cuidado y escala hasta la cima de la clasificación mundial.

games.name: Speed Goes Up
games.description: Race, earn, upgrade, repeat. Turn faster laps into Bits, build a fleet of income generating Ghosts, master drift powered boost, race other cars, and push your vehicle to its limits

games.name: 咕嘟！魔女与核爆秘药
games.description: Brew, toss, and trigger explosive chain reactions! Gudu! Witch & Meltdown is a chaotic anime-style roguelite where you play as a quirky witch crafting volatile potions. Combine recipe ingredients, build exponential multiplier synergies, and hurl nuclear-level flasks to melt monster HP!

games.name: 星月大陆：放置帝国
games.description: 一款复古像素画风的放置挂机类角色扮演游戏，融合了策略搭配与角色收集养成玩法。您将组建并升级由多位独立天赋与技能体系的英雄构成的战队，所有英雄与资源均可通过探索与离线挂机持续获得。游戏强调轻松护肝的绿色养成体验，支持在线升级刷装、免费十连招募、英雄专属套装及成就特权等机制，兼顾摸鱼休闲与深度策略组合。本作针对 Steam 版本增设了签到、每日福利及等级上限加成等专属内容，适合喜爱慢节奏、单机收集与放置成长玩法的玩家。

games.name: Guns & Gargoyles
games.description: 一款哥特式黑暗奇幻动作RPG。在火把照亮的森林里，你只能看见光所触及之处。投出飞刀，再从尸体上拔回来；用燃烧瓶焚烧狼群；当它们贴近时，拔剑相向。做好准备，尽头的那头野兽不会手下留情。

games.name: Glow Arcade Racer
games.description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

games.name: Mine Mine Mine
games.description: Minesweeper, but the mines fight back. Descend an endless shaft where the numbers lie, monsters burrow, and one wrong dig can end the run. Recruit 28 companions, hoard relics, and outsmart the Mole Queen. Survival is solvable by logic — going deeper is the gamble.

games.name: Gold Seller
games.description:
All that's left in your hands is a single game account. Cover incoming monthly bills and fixed expenses to survive.
Trade gold in group chats, dodge scam risks, overcome negative balances, and hang on until the very end!

games.name: Irish Sport Manager
games.description: A management sim for the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. Take a county, pick your fifteen from the clubs inside it, and answer to a board that remembers everything.

games.name: Cube on a Leash
games.description: Cube on a Leash is a dungeon crawler roguelike about commanding your very volatile pet cube. Use your leash to avoid collateral damage as the cube carries out your sequences of attacks -- both manually and automatically -- and becomes your customizable agent of mass destruction.

games.name: Broken Orbits
games.description: Broken Orbits is a fast-paced 1–4 player co-op space-combat game. Tear through hostile fleets, loot wild weapons and prototype effects, create devastating loadout combinations, and fight through a complete three-chapter campaign against the Ancients.

games.name: The House on Grisewood
games.description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

games.name: Rude Supermarket Simulator
games.description:
Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment.
Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players.

games.name: Seal & Sentence
games.description: 成为一个濒临战争的中世纪王国的边境官。检查证件，审问可疑旅客，并决定谁能入境。你会服从王国的法律，还是听从自己的良知？

games.name: Dwarf Wars
games.description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
games.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

games.name: Neon Horde
games.description: 霓虹动作幸存者：无尽虫群、自动开火的武器，以及15分钟一局中能清屏的进化形态。最妙的是：即使关掉游戏，你依然在赚金币。回来后花在永久商店里，精通7位英雄，每一局都更强。

games.name: Collapse Vector
games.description: 驾驶实验型探测器穿越不断崩塌的天体场域，体验节奏紧张的 rage arcade 太空游戏。深入转移试炼，强化探测器，挑战个人纪录，看看在矢量终结这一轮之前，你究竟能走多远。

games.name: GODBLADE
games.description: Steal the gods' words and write the laws of your own sword. Fight through the courts of Anubis, Inanna, Susanoo and Ògún, chain law into law into law, expand a god's domain to change the rules of the fight, and come back stronger from every death.

games.name: Slowdrift
games.description: An arcade drift game. Slide through a city at night, link corners into a chain, and decide when to bank it — or push one more corner and risk the lot. Drift the city for score, take three lives into a branching run, or drive until the wall catches you.

games.name: Continuum
games.description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

games.name: Dead Bet
games.description: Dead Bet 是一款以致命节目为舞台的卡牌类轻度Rogue游戏。研究斗士、揭开他们的秘密，并用卡牌影响胜算。一次错误预测可能会让家人付出生命代价。由你决定谁来买单。

games.name: RabbitDice
games.description: Build a rabbit civilization from a single campfire. Give rabbits jobs, discover unexpected card combinations, and set the whole camp in motion with one roll of the dice. Help them build a spaceship and return to the Moon!

games.name: Roll Arena
games.description: A brutally hard action-roguelike where physics has it in for you: roll, shoot, bounce and brawl through themed arenas with 250+ items as absurd as they are lethal.

games.name: Good Night
games.description: A good night's sleep is for one person only. Roll, squirm, and shove your friends off the bed in this 2-4 player ragdoll party game.

games.name: Hanafuda
games.description: Discover the traditional Japanese 🎴Hanafuda (花札 - Flower Cards) games, brought to life as a beautiful, modern 3D tabletop game. Match cards to create pairs, complete a set and collect points, or call Koi-Koi to risk it all for more. Play against the computer, or other players online.

games.name: Never Stop Climbing
games.description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

games.name: BrickOps
games.description: Play. Build. Customize. BrickOps 是一款色彩鲜明的多人竞技场射击游戏。在方块世界中争夺目标、创建地图，用服装、配饰和装备打造自己的角色。搭建掩体，将敌方旗帜带回基地，或在 Defuse 中用烟花点亮天空。

games.name: 家园构筑学院
games.description: 用卡牌建设家园，搭配建筑，让居民接连工作、资源成倍产出。升级家园，也强化士兵小队；带队清理废墟、攻克聚落，把新卡牌带回家园，组合出更强的联动。一款融合家园经营、区域探索与实时自动战斗的单人策略游戏。

games.name: Last Shuttle
games.description: A 2-to-4-player online co-op and competitive action-adventure. Battle enemies and gather keys to navigate through perilous ruins. Outpace the opposing team to be the first to board the last shuttle!

games.name: Sexperado
games.description: A story-rich adult Western visual novel where your choices shape relationships, reputation, and key confrontations. Ride into Red Creek as a former bounty hunter, expose the conspiracy behind the Black Vulture gang, and grow closer to six alluring women.

games.name: Crownsink
games.description: 一款快节奏的俯视角动作 Roguelite。每一局都有新的楼层、新的战利品和新的构筑。将数百种武器与升级串联成离谱的组合，在陷阱房与竞技场中闪避穿梭，推翻八位怪物之王。可单人游玩，也可与最多 3 位好友在线合作。

games.name: Kazfall
games.description:
《Kazfall》是一款单人肉鸽地牢探索游戏，每次探索限时 25 分钟。
管理耐力、把握格挡时机，寻找出售强化道具和装备的 NPC，并在时间耗尽前抵达首领面前。
即使这次探索失败，你也会在下次探索时变得更强。

games.name: KNELL
games.description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

games.name: 超级跑车收藏：联机同乐
games.description: 和好友一起经营自己的合金模型车商店！在这款支持1-4名玩家的收藏游戏中，开启惊喜汽车卡包、打造你的收藏、与顾客竞速、在线交换卡片，并携手发展你们的生意。

games.name: The Endless Harvest
games.description: 《The Endless Harvest》是放置类村庄建造与塔防的结合。建造一座自动产出金币的农场,把收益投入防御塔与升级,抵御一波强过一波的掠夺者。关闭游戏后生产不停——看看你能走多远!

games.name: Don't Get Six
games.description: Play a deadly dice game where anomalies reveal what's inside the cup. Reveal the die or shake again, but whatever you do... Don't Get Six.

games.name: From Zero: Idle Factory
games.description: 从一间破旧工坊起步，逐步经营八座更先进的工厂。生产、发货、再投资，并用机器人实现自动化。这是一段专注主动经营的增量管理历程，只有游玩时才会推进。

games.name: Sexception: The Dark Seeds
games.description: Enter unstable dreams, recover a missing past, and choose whether to respect or rewrite the desires of six women in this choice-driven psychological erotic visual novel with uncensored scenes and two radically different routes.

games.name: Hostile Boards
games.description: A chess deckbuilding puzzle roguelike where every board is a shifting lock. Deploy pieces from your hand, chain captures and clear each configuration before turns expire. Pieces used to open one layer become locked within it, leaving fewer tools for the next - can you escape the boards retaliation?

games.name: Zombie Fish Tank
games.description: 化身渴望复仇的不死僵尸鱼，吞噬较小的鱼类，变得更加强大，向食物链顶峰攀登。探索 40 个纯手绘关卡，收集临时能力，与棘手的 Boss 展开对决，在超过 80 种鱼类中一路大快朵颐！

games.name: SAMBIRD
games.description: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

games.name: Mithril
games.description: 在程序生成的洞穴中探索与采矿。熟练运用支柱，赶在岩顶塌落前撑住它，向更深处挖掘。搭建自动化生产链加工矿石。再操控熔岩、触发蛰伏，让新的矿石在熔岩流过之处结晶而生。世界依旧。洞穴已变。危险重生。世界记得一切。

games.name: Pactum
games.description: 在漂浮岛屿上召唤天使与恶魔，融合并进化它们。一款轻松惬意的放置游戏，让你放空身心：无限升级，看着你的生物成长，按自己的节奏享受旅程。

games.name: The Previous Owner
games.description: 在1994年的伦敦经营一家旧书店。你从未见过立遗嘱的那个人，却连同这家店一起继承了他的规矩。这里的每一本书都记得它从前的主人：压干的花、信件、写在页边的字。整批收书，为捡到的好东西定价，找出每位客人真正想要的那一本，让这家店撑过1994年的秋天。而在页边，同一只手反复出现，墨水会陈旧，字迹从不，落款永远只有一个字母。按规矩上架，不要读页边。要读多少，由你自己决定。

games.name: Space Travelers
games.description: 开采小行星，交易矿物，在一款节奏舒缓的 2D 太空模拟游戏中绘制无尽的程序生成星系。还可以把它固定到桌面当作动态壁纸：你在忙工作时，飞船仍在飞行、开采与探索。

games.name: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
games.description: 万象卡域是一款轻松好玩的免费在线收藏游戏。每次抽卡都可能带来新的惊喜：集齐卡牌套组，将它们锻造成独特的圣物，并一步步充实属于你的博物馆。这里没有战斗，也没有竞争压力。每天抽几次卡，按照自己的节奏，享受持续数周、数月乃至数年的收藏旅程。

games.name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
games.description: 一款为刷宝狂人打造的放置 ARPG。自动砍怪，狂刷足以改变流派的装备，搭配出离谱 Build，解锁全新职业，然后转生重来——每一次，都比上一次更强。

games.name: Crystalase
games.description: 解锁新图像，探索不同主题，并享受将散落的水晶转变为耀眼杰作的成就感。

games.name: Free Company
games.description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

games.name: Colsword
games.description: COLSWORD 是一款逻辑益智游戏，你要使用附有魔法的彩色剑，按照正确顺序为方块上色。

games.name: My Naughty Nun: Forbidden Confession
games.description: 这是一款仅限成人的18+视觉小说。一场禁忌的告解，让前来寻求赎罪的阿德里安与红发修女艾拉拉逐渐发展出亲密关系，并被卷入持续十天的秘密调查。通过选择改变两人的信任、对话与感情走向，追查神秘“女神之声”的真正来源；完成10个结合记忆、观察与推理的小游戏，逐步解锁包含成人裸露与露骨性爱场面的201张CG画廊。随着线索、旧手稿、钥匙与秘密信号不断出现，你的决定也将影响艾拉拉如何面对欲望、真相以及由自己选择的未来。

games.name: Hordia
games.description: 砍翻无穷无尽的怪物大军，强到荒谬！捡战利品、升级、把强化叠成疯狂流派。用火炮和地雷守住岛屿，猎杀地图上等着你的 Boss，撑得越久越好。单人或在线合作！

games.name: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
games.description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

games.name: The Libido Enigma 2: Fountain of Youth
games.description: The mystery was only the beginning. Return to a world of science, romance, corporate intrigue and desire as a new discovery raises the stakes. Reunite with familiar faces, forge new relationships, and make choices that could change your life—and the future of medicine.

games.name: LastWitness: Mero
games.description: 在这款黑暗童话风格的2.5D动作冒险游戏中，操控咩洛对抗扭曲的记忆，利用传送门破解谜题，并逐步揭开一段被遗忘的童年真相。

games.name: The Last Lunch
games.description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

games.name: the Cellarer
games.description: 建造一座中世纪修道院，掌控周密的后勤、真实的运输网络与复杂的生产链。随着修道院日渐兴旺，优化每一辆推车、每一条小径与每一座建筑。

games.name: Dugout Dice
games.description:
Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy!

Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

games.name: Agent Sherine: Oil Baron
games.description: 中情局特工雪琳·黑尔继续潜伏于亿万富翁的隐秘庄园：价值难以想象的石油交易、敌对特工与危险欲望在此交汇。引导她的抉择，看她如何周旋于各方之间——是完成任务，还是把这笔财富据为己有。

games.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
games.description: 在这款主打高速破坏、闪避、击杀连段与压倒性火力的双摇杆街机射击游戏中冲击排行榜。迎战不断升级的敌方舰队，融合强化道具，单人或合作挑战20多位风格各异的首领。挑战Roguelike“异变”模式，在每局中叠加有利有弊的变异。

games.name: Clicker Inc.～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～
games.description: Build a business empire across generations! Click to earn, hire employees for passive income, and use stocks, banks, and auctions to survive booms and crashes. Pass the company to the next CEO, unlock 100+ skills, complete achievements, and grow into a world-changing corporation!

games.name: You Must Peg
games.description: A roguelite/incremental peg board builder. Construct your board to sate the void's hunger. Harness the singularity for endless growth, or perish fighting its myriad boss forms. Dozens of balls, pegs, events, 100+ items: engineer the ultimate chaos machine of infinite profit, or die trying.

games.name: Magichess
games.description: Magichess是一款融合经典与创新的棋类策略游戏。游戏适配多种棋类玩法。强劲的对手让每一步都充满挑战，但通过新棋子与新道具的搭配，你依然能逆转战局。支持本地对战、邀请Steam好友以及全球随机匹配，无论是和朋友切磋，还是与世界玩家即时较量，都能体验紧张又好玩的棋盘竞技。

games.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
games.description: 你的师父被一块水晶吸了进去——去把他带回来。一款简单、扎实的幸存者类 Roguelite：骑士会自己挥剑，而剑里装什么由你决定。把火焰、冰霜和闪电调进每一次攻击，打穿五大区域。

games.name: 被甩后，我毁掉前任千亿帝国
games.description: 这是一款互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前的香港，你将扮演李洋，在失恋、追杀与资本争夺中寻找真相，你得先活下来，改变处境，也需要找到愿意与你站在一起的人。最后结局会是怎样的，我想把这个决定留给你。

games.name: Lord of the Grind
games.description: Lord of The Grind 是一款单人 2D 动作 RPG，专注于地下城刷怪、资源收集、战利品、制作以及角色的长期成长。

games.name: Sort the Tapes!
games.description: 整理录像带! 是一款温馨的整理模拟游戏，背景设定在2000年代美国小镇的一家录像带租赁店。按类型整理3030盘VHS录像带，处理顾客归还，用录像机观看录像带，并找到可在手提音响上播放的录音带。

games.name: Verdreamia
games.description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

games.name: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
games.description: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece

games.name: 魔物娘幸存者！
games.description: 在这款生存游戏里，你将探索一个被魅魔所占据的世界，搜集各种资源、升级你的基地，对敌人展开对抗。与被族群放逐的魅魔少女--莉莉建立羁绊，一起踏上这段求生之旅。你最终能逃出生天吗？莉莉又是否会一直陪在你身边？你的每一个选择都会影响最终结局。

games.name: Monster Breeder Battler
games.description: 一款融合了塔防跑道的怪物培育工厂游戏。构建一条生产线来培育、强化并调度怪物，然后将它们送上跑道，坚守围墙抵御裂隙。根据下一波预览调整策略。65种物种、61种配方、永久死亡、45回合封印裂隙。

games.name: Nine Below
games.description: A twin-stick arena shooter set in an arctic wasteland. Fight through a cult swarm, break the guardians, and kill the leader before the ritual completes. One continuous battle. No second chances.

games.name: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader
games.description: 一款模拟游戏，你的地堡将成为幸存者们赖以生存的安全港湾。交易和制作物品，并将它们整理存放。亲自探索地表，并雇佣人员进行探险。在这个末日世界里，成为终极贸易中心。

games.name: Normal Human Jobs
games.description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

games.name: Fantorob
games.description: Fantorob is a futuristic take on classic monster-taming genre. Build robots and fight against your opponents to collect components and upgrade your team in this thrilling turn-based combat RPG with brain-twisting puzzles. Join the journey to become the greatest robot master!

games.name: Dead of the Brain
games.description: 本作致敬80年代美式血浆电影与丧尸B级片，主打血肉横飞的血腥场面与粗粝质感的像素画风。这部重现1992年经典恐怖冒险的重制之作，将带你置身于生者与行尸走肉的生死夹缝之中。你能否在这场噩梦中幸存下来？

games.name: RESET ARENA
games.description: Reset Arena is a fast, text-rendered 1v1 duel game. Attack, block and dash on independent cooldowns, toggle between skill shots like homing darts and ensnaring hooks and outread your opponent across 20+ arenas full of shifting hazards and dynamic environments.

games.name: KISI: The Deja Vu
games.description:
KISI: The Deja Vu (기시: 더 데자뷰)

KISI: The Deja Vu is a 3D spot-the-difference horror adventure game based on the uncanny feeling of familiarity — known as "déjà vu."

Players become Dr. Hoffman, a neuroscientist, who must find an exit within a perfectly symmetrical, mirror-image space.

games.name: 牌武者
games.description: 《牌武者》是一款武侠Roguelike卡牌游戏，融合了武学概念和卡牌游戏的特性，利用卡牌实现攻击，招架，反击和抓住敌人破绽那一瞬的连续输出。在这里你会体验到一名侠客的一生，而你想要成为的，是什么样的人呢？

games.name: Rulebound
games.description: 《Rulebound》是一款超现实恐怖增量游戏，生存取决于你能否分散注意力。被困于虚空，你只能在老式 CRT 电视上玩奇异的圆盘合成游戏来逃脱。弹射并合并圆盘、购买升级、铸造3张黄金圆盘，同时警惕黑暗中逼近的存在。

games.name: Morpho Reverie
games.description: 欢迎来到艺核叙事音乐游戏『Morpho Reverie』的世界。大型企业『AT』举办了一场竞演。在竞演过程中，选手『希羽』突然失踪，『AT』制造了和希羽一模一样的AI复制体『希羽α』。主角黎音将一边协助其他选手，战胜主办方制造的AI复制体，一边寻找希羽失踪的真相。

games.name: 激论激议激辩学生会
games.description: 事情开端是深受敬仰的学生会长之所作表态「要不让我们解禁校服自由化吧？」然而，祈求守住学姐身穿校服之身影的副会长·桧山却别有用心，挖空心思加以强烈反对！另一边，暗恋前者的书记·莲见，眼瞅着他为一己私利上蹿下跳，只觉甚是无语……青春群像荒诞轻喜剧视觉小说。角色设计：藤真拓哉。

games.name: Is This Reversi?
games.description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

games.name: 水族箱时光
games.description: 《水族箱时光》是一款治愈系养鱼收集游戏。游戏中有 60 种可爱的鱼、117 种外观和 18 个鱼缸场景。你可以把鱼缸缩成桌面上的小窗口，也可以把它设为动态壁纸。

games.name: Gloomy Tavern Stories
games.description: 一款奇幻的药水制作游戏，你可以收集材料并制作不同类型的药水。药水可以用作炸弹，或利用其效果来解谜。雇佣英雄去对抗怪物和Boss。

games.name: Overrafted!
games.description: Over rafted! 是一款最多支持 4 人合作游玩的多人游戏。和伙伴们分工掌舵、钓鱼、收集物资和进行修理，在不断变化的风向、洋流和海洋生物所带来的混乱中奋力前行，驾驶着逐渐破败的木筏，在无边无际的未知海洋中尽可能航行得更远！

games.name: Keyarium
games.description: 桌面深处，蚂蚁帝国悄然生长。你的每一次输入，都是洒向它们的甘甜雨露。无需刻意经营，这群小家伙会在屏幕角落静静修筑属于它们的王国，偶尔捕获一只捕获的虫子作为惊喜。而当好友桌面上的美食香气随风飘来，它们也会毫不客气地组团前往，尝一口“异国风味”。让这群勤劳又贪吃的小生命，陪伴你度过每一段专注的屏幕时光。

games.name: StoneEra
games.description: 在可改造的体素世界中建设中世纪聚落。安排居民的工作，研究科技，制作物资，与行商进行以物易物交易，驯养动物，并建设利用流动水的水利设施。挖掘地形、开采资源、种植作物，将原料加工成食物、工具和建筑材料。在建筑编辑器中设计并保存可重复使用的建筑蓝图，再让居民在聚落中施工。随着天气、四季与昼夜变化，把小小的营地逐步发展成你心中的家园。也可在创造模式中尝试不同的建造方案。通过研究逐步解锁新的生产与建设内容，协调居民的饮食、休息和日常需求。

games.name: D4 Defence
games.description:
掷骰子塔防递归游戏。
调整你的骰子，升级你的能力，击退恶魔的猛攻。

games.name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
games.description: A small incremental game about grabbing loot. You control the camera, and your heroes attack whatever slimes are on your screen. Grab the coins, watch your treasure chest burst when time runs out, then spend it all on upgrades and go again.

games.name: Tiny Garden Café
games.description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

games.name: Colosseum Infection
games.description: "无时间限制，按照自己的节奏打造专属策略！通过羁绊、强化和装备的多样组合构建强大阵容，在以单位视角展开的逼真战斗中，通过手动操作移动与投掷药水扭转乾坤，体验全新的策略自走棋游戏。"

games.name: 重锁：救赎之链
games.description: 一个只为钱做事的落魄佣兵比尔，阴差阳错地开始拯救被红色锁链束缚的记忆。这是一款在网格回合制战斗之上叠加牌组构筑的喜剧冒险SRPG：决定站在哪里，选择打出哪张牌，一回合一回合地较量。斩断头目的红色锁链，那名敌人就会作为归者加入。与八位同伴积累的好感度，会改变故事的走向。

games.name: Boiled Bison
games.description: A Psychological Horror where you look for a way out after waking up in an abandoned Bison Slaughterhouse. Find a way to escape and uncover the darkest secrets that dwells within The Sterlington Meat Company.

games.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase
games.description:
《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》是一款由一名蒙眼抓捕者与多名逃跑者展开对决的非对称在线追逐游戏。
隐形的抓捕者，以及一旦发出声音就陷入危险的逃跑者。一场简单的追逐游戏，由此演变为紧张刺激的心理博弈。

games.name: TypePuppy
games.description: 这是一款轻松可爱的桌面养成游戏，一只叫帕比的小狗会一直待在你的桌面上陪你工作学习。你打字、点鼠标就能攒积分，定时开启神秘宝箱，抽到各种装饰打扮帕比。你可以收集全部装扮点亮图鉴，多余的装饰还能合成更稀有的道具。它会一直静静地待在你身边，陪伴你度过工作和学习的每一天，像一个真正陪着你的贴心小伙伴！

games.name: Grazed - Incremental Arcade
games.description: 靠得越近，你就越强。《Grazed》是一款递增式街机游戏——想要击杀，就必须踏入濒死的范围。把连杀连击推得足够高，点燃荒唐的力量，冲击最高分。每一局无论输赢都能换来升级，让你一次比一次更致命。

games.name: 苟在魔门求长生
games.description: 这是一款完全由AI制作的互动影游。拜仙道，得长生，这是每一个修仙者的梦想。然而修仙天才荀乘却误入了魔门“天刹宗”，在魔门众多长老的眼里，他俨然成了不可或缺的“人材”。荀乘必须想方设法地活下去，苟到最后，或拨乱反正，或一条道走到黑成为盖世魔君。陷阱机关，阴谋诡计，侠女柔情，一切尽看你的选择。

games.name: Lanebound
games.description: Push one lane with up to 3 players in this co-op PvE MOBA. Pick a hero, clear waves, take towers, and crack the enemy core—no PvP, just teamwork. Steam lobbies, friend invites, and classic mouse-driven controls.

games.name: Draftfall
games.description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

games.name: Pixel Ping Pong
games.description: 一款轻松的放置增量游戏：打碎方块、赚取金币，并升级你不断壮大的弹球群。亲自瞄准发射来加快进度，或者放松身心，让游戏自动运行。

games.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
games.description:
The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience.

You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

games.name: Circuit Brakers
games.description: Circuit Brakers is a kart racing game about robots, physics and a lot of customisation. Build a robot, choose your items, and race with up to 8 players across a variety of bizarre tracks! With mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master, can you become the champion robot racer?

games.name: CountryClicker
games.description: 在 Country Clicker 中点击国家: 最棒的点击游戏,关于点击国家! 攀登、升级,再次去做。

games.name: Towerburst
games.description: 一款增量式塔防游戏，使用独特的防御塔组合迎战敌人。从被击败的敌人身上收集资源，解锁并强化防御塔，发现全新的塔之间协同效果，并在所有防御塔耗尽弹药前击败所有敌人。

games.name: Rewind Together
games.description: Join your brother on an epic time-travel adventure! Solve puzzles together across Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West to find your way back home. Don't forget to take photos!

games.name: 今天还要加班吗？
games.description: 《今天还要加班吗？》是一款让你下班后继续体验上班生活的 Roguelike 撤离类游戏。准备好工具与专业技能，通过自动战斗系统，与没那么讨人厌的同事、有点讨人厌的同事和超级讨人厌的同事对峙，一步步击败强敌，直到站到老板面前，讨回属于你的一切。

games.name: Dungeons of Destiny
games.description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Loot! Dungeons of Destiny is an action-packed anime 3D dungeon crawler. Explore perilous dungeons, defeat formidable fantasy creatures, master powerful skills, and gather valuable loot to strengthen your character.

games.name: Hush Piñata
games.description: 她受够了挨打，于是自己蒙上眼睛，回来复仇。这是一款最多 9 人的恐怖喜剧派对游戏：其中一名玩家扮演蒙眼的皮纳塔，屏幕全黑，只能靠声音狩猎——你的脚步、掉落的物品，甚至麦克风里的说话声，都会在她的黑暗中点亮一道发光的轮廓。其余玩家是派对客，必须完成那些注定会发出噪音的任务来换取票券与道具，然后绕到她背后扯下她的尾巴，并一路守住它，直到她爆开。安静地做事，大声地送命。三种模式可选：偷走尾巴、生存到最后、团队对战。

games.name: 1秒钟英雄
games.description: 《1秒钟英雄》是一款第一人称超高速解谜游戏。对别人来说只有一秒，对你来说却足够漫长。观察瞬息之间发生的一切，利用环境、操纵物体、化解危机——在这一秒结束之前，成为英雄。

games.name: Iron Frame
games.description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.description: Survive 20 escalating stages of meteor chaos in a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter. Master unlockable weapons, face unique meteor threats and powerful bosses, customize your ship, then push your limits in Endless Mode.

games.name: Spike Force
games.description: Spike Force is a roguelite deckbuilder soaked in 90's action anime. Build your volleyball team, draft your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity. Every match is a fight for survival, and every card is a move in the game.

games.name: Glowing Static
games.description: Play a series of retro games and learn about what's really going on in your bedroom.

games.name: Rogue Links
games.description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

games.name: Super Frog Ninja
games.description: Become the ultimate Super Frog Ninja in this retro-inspired pixel platformer packed with challenging trials, hidden secrets, and lightning-fast gameplay.

games.name: Doodle Figure
games.description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

games.name: Weed Inc.
games.description: Weed Inc. is a global strategy simulation. Build a cannabis strain from fragments, introduce it to legal markets, and spread it country by country. Turn Consumers into Addicts, contain the Side Effects, and stay ahead of an escalating Global Response.

games.name: 断线
games.description: 一台老旧的加密终端，一段被刻意抹去的过去。你循着引导，一点点破解谜题，逼近被掩埋的真相。谁曾经用过这台电脑？他们的身上，究竟发生了什么？而现在，这台电脑轮到了你。

games.name: Table of War
games.description:
A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their
own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a
rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

games.name: Laurus
games.description: Rig the machine until it pays out wrong. Draw symbols from your bag across five reels, chain paylines, and slot circuit-board artifacts into combos the house never accounted for. A roguelike deckbuilder about the arithmetic of very bad odds.

games.name: 金瓶梅：清河绮梦
games.description: 在北宋清河县，经营生意、维系家宅、结交人物、打探风闻、搜集证据并布置谋局。你将以西门庆的身份周旋于市井、商路与官场，在有限的时间、金钱、名声、人情和身体状态之间不断取舍。清河众人各有日程、欲望、秘密与利益，会在你看不见的地方继续生活；一次交好、一次错判或一场谋划，都可能改变关系、家业、案件走向与人物命运。经营产业，建立人脉，应对疾病、衰老、生育与死亡，在多条剧情和多种结局之间，走出属于自己的清河一生。

games.name: Ribbit Robber
games.description: A challenging stealth game where every move matters. Sneak, trick, and outsmart enemy guards using creative abilities in a medieval world of frog people.

games.name: Shady Contractor
games.description: You're the least trustworthy contractor in town. Eyeball the blueprints, cut every corner you can, and pocket the difference. A physics-based construction puzzler where greed pays, right up until the building falls over.

games.name: Protocol: Best of Luck
games.description: One of your crew members has gone crazy and killed everyone except you. Escape the station and catch up with him before he leaves you behind forever on Naxos-4. Explore, solve puzzles, decide the murderer's fate, and remember that none of this is real.

games.name: ISKRA
games.description: 你将扮演爱丽丝，她在黑暗的森林中徘徊，寻找出路。在旅途中，她会遇到许多人物——每一个都是她自身个性的映照、恐惧的回响，以及潜意识的显现。

games.name: Twin-stick Japanese
games.description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

games.name: Cosmo Corgis
games.description: 一颗迷你 3D 星球停在你的桌面边缘。你工作时,宇航员和柯基会砍树、挖矿、修复坠毁的火箭——偶尔瞟一眼,花掉他们攒下的资源,看着飞船一点点拼回原样,然后发射,飞向下一个世界。

games.name: Equilibrium Co
games.description: Manage offices, stores, hubs, imports/exports and complex supply chains to keep entire cities thriving in Equilibrium Co. Expand industry networks, research upgrades and balance ever-changing and evolving markets using a modern, professional Saas-style dashboard.

games.name: Abarya
games.description: Defend your core, gather resources, and build a deadly domain in Abarya. Use cards to construct defenses, power your economy, and unleash devastating abilities as relentless enemy waves push your strategy to its limit.

games.name: Quartermark
games.description: 你的队伍会自己战斗。谁在队伍里、他们带着什么，由你决定——这就是整个游戏。12 名英雄、9 个可串联成金色连携的关键词、100 张地图、440 只怪诞的 3D 怪物、100 个首领，以及可能毁掉你最强装备的强化阶梯。

games.name: Plum
games.description: Plum是一款温馨疗愈的3D收集平台冒险游戏，舞台设定在一片绿意盎然的山谷。玩家将化身为一颗李子，一边滚动跳跃，一边寻找回家的路。旅途中会遇见各式各样的幽灵李子，聆听它们各自的故事。这是一段约1小时的短篇冒险，色彩缤纷、风格独具，无论是想放松游玩，还是挑战极速通关，都很适合。

games.name: One Line Wonder
games.description: 一笔画，熟悉的规则玩出新巧思。在错综的路径中找到自己的走法，享受将复杂局面逐渐理顺的满足感。

games.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
games.description: 一款温馨的第一人称整理游戏，背景设在杂乱的80年代地下室。寻找散落的数千颗骰子，识别它们所属的套组，并放回正确的展示柜。单人或合作游玩，选择奇幻职业，解锁魔法能力，让整理变得更轻松。

games.name: TOKYO WANTED
games.description: 舞台是TOKYO，登场的是100人的人群。是混入其中、悄然穿过，直奔终点？还是凭通缉令找出他们，阻止逃亡？逃亡者与追捕者的3v3团队对战。捉迷藏 + 抓人游戏。在线最多6人同时参加，人数不足时由CPU补位，1人也能开始。

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.description: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

games.name: Ms Morisson
games.description: A sheltered young man falls for the woman next door - older, married, and haunted by a past she can't escape. As friendship blurs into forbidden desire, every stolen moment draws them deeper. A mature visual novel about temptation, guilt, and the danger of feeling truly alive.

games.name: Trade or Threat
games.description: Trade or Threat 是一款第一人称商店经营与地牢探索模拟游戏。白天出售商品，夜晚进入地牢寻找战利品，在利润、危险与老板制定的规则之间做出取舍，并赚取足够的金币偿还债务。

games.name: Casino Dealer Simulator
games.description: 你不是赌客，你是荷官。掌管赌场的21点和德州扑克牌桌：亲手发牌、算清赔付、读懂牌型，在赌场主管抓到你的失误之前先抓出老千。实时轮班、从学徒到赌场主管的职业生涯，以及一间要靠本事赢来的贵宾厅。

games.name: Last Man Running
games.description: Outrun the zombies. Betray your friends. A chaotic parkour party game across deadly rooftops. Tackle, grab and toss your rivals in free-for-all or team elimination, or stick together in co-op survival. Play locally or online, with solo score chasing when your friends stop answering your invites.

games.name: Dwarven Outpost Incremental
games.description: The world's first 3D open-world survival cookie clicker. Mine, chop, and hunt across a living landscape. Teach your dwarf to auto-harvest nearby resources. Research, build, and cook to grow a thriving outpost.

games.name: House of the Lost: Revived
games.description: House of the Lost: Revived is a top-down action roguelike built for players who grew up clearing rooms, dodging traps, and learning from every death. Each run is a new house, a new build, and a new chance to craft absurd weapons and get a little further before the House gets you.

games.name: Ballwark: Pinball Siege
games.description: Pinball meets Vampire Survivors in this dopamine-packed arcade roguelite! Launch enchanted balls, build deadly machines, and forge powerful synergies to crush relentless hordes.

games.name: Epoch Forge
games.description: A 2D colony simulator and sandbox where you make a name for yourself in a dying world. You can type freely to anyone, and they remember what you did. Mine, build, wire logic circuits, appease five silent gods, and push the limits of reality. No ending, no win screen. Pace yourself.

games.name: Sort My Comics !
games.description: 漫画散落得到处都是。现在，该由你来整理这套收藏了！分类、归位、补全系列，并解锁各种能力，让这片巨大的混乱一点点变得井然有序、令人无比放松.

games.name: 艾莉丝的放置日志
games.description: 《艾莉丝的放置日志》是一款放置类RPG，让你在屏幕一角慢慢见证艾莉丝的漫长冒险。探索各个区域并投入战斗，收集装备与资源，同时提升采矿、伐木、钓鱼、烹饪、耕作、写作、绘画、商业等多种生活技能。无论是按自己设定的目标游玩，还是暂时离开去忙别的事，艾莉丝的一天都会继续。

games.name: Starwake
games.description: 在这款快节奏的类肉鸽游戏游戏中，指挥一艘星际飞船穿越危险的、程序生成的银河系——每一次弹珠般的弹射都可能决定胜负与毁灭。

games.name: Pathos
games.description: 《Pathos》是一款致敬复古地牢探索类游戏的回合制奇幻冒险作品。你可以体验深度十足、充满动态变数的玩法，搭配现代风格的画面、音效与触控优先的操作界面。你还能对角色进行高度自定义，开启一场由程序随机生成的史诗级冒险旅程。

games.name: 좀비 프린세스
games.description: Raise a daughter infected with a zombie virus in this dark fantasy raising simulation. Over 5 years, balance your daily care in secret with dangerous expeditions. Will you cure her humanity, or help her rise as an immortal zombie queen? Discover over 60 unique endings!

games.name: Roll Value
games.description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

games.name: Re:Draw
games.description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

games.name: Lilith's Curse
games.description:
Welcome to Lilith's Curse. In this game, you're trapped in an asylum: your goal is to find items, solve puzzles, and escape.
Watch out for the enemy: Lilith. Lilith will do everything she can to stop you. If she succeeds, there will be very serious consequences.

games.name: 弹珠洪流
games.description: OrbFlow is a relaxing yet challenging 3D physics puzzle game. Launch streams of marbles down vibrant Low-Poly valleys, guide them through obstacles using physics devices, and fill the target pit using as FEW balls as possible. Compete on global leaderboards for ultimate efficiency!

games.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
games.description: 宝箱、战斗、矿石、材料——冒险者会追寻什么，取决于各自的性情。选定目的地，引导自动前进的冒险者，权衡抄近路与绕行的风险，并选择兼具能力与坏习惯的技能来成长。这是一款地下城Roguelite RPG。

games.name: Guild of the Tower
games.description: 一款组队制RPG：建立公会，用策略系统（Gambit System）编写英雄的战斗战术，率队攀登一座神秘高塔——永久死亡是真实的，并非所有人都能活着回来。

games.name: Voidrunners
games.description: 《Voidrunners》 是一款太空 Bullet Heaven 游戏，你可以组合独特的武器、装备和强化，打造属于自己的强力流派。探索充满秘密的地图，解锁全新飞船，在无尽的敌人浪潮中生存下来。

games.name: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
games.description:
发射弹珠！强化盘面！赚取堆成山的奖牌，不断还清一笔又一笔债务！
一款流程紧凑的柏青哥增量游戏，技能树会不断带来新的赚钱方式！

games.name: 灯守
games.description: When the lamps go out, the world turns to ash. Follow Hina, an apprentice Lampkeeper, as she searches for her vanished master. A dark-fantasy adventure RPG of command-based exploration, escape-room puzzles, and tactical turn-based battles — 10 chapters, 5 to 8 hours.

games.name: Lust & Ledgers: A Vaygren Tale
games.description: Vaygren Tales: Lust & Ledgers is a visual novel that follows Teela, the receptionist at the local Outreach Guild.  In the course of her day to day job, she gets to know the women around her. Intimately. With her dick.

games.name: Deadwood Contingency
games.description: Command a covert military unit tasked with containing and researching a mysterious threat lurking deep within the forest. Face unnatural creatures, uncover the source of the outbreak, and prevent the calamity from spreading to the world.

games.name: Black Roots
games.description: 《Black Roots》是一款富有氛围感的 2.5D 恐怖冒险游戏。玩家将扮演年轻男孩霍希姆忠（Hoshimjon），踏上一段穿过被诅咒且已被石化村庄的危险旅程，去营救他的妹妹。

games.name: 骰战异世界
games.description:
这是一款在桌游风格棋盘上争夺土地的肉鸽卡牌类游戏。 
通过策略和运气组建强大的小队，挑战领主取得胜利。 
二次元穿越者的力量化为卡牌，不断构筑卡组、搭配法宝，做出高明的策略取舍。
 *没有两局冒险会完全相同。*

games.name: 无界工业
games.description: 一款以无限画布为核心的自动化工厂策略游戏。开采资源、规划物流、平衡电力、保障聚居地供给并研究新科技，建设自给自足的星球工业体系。

games.name: 三天
games.description: 由真实经历改编的叙事视觉小说。宝宝出生前三天，一位新手爸爸在产房外学着成为父亲。日常之下，每一个选择都在改写他与妻子、家人之间的关系。单次流程约一小时。

games.name: 魔法蛋蛋牧场
games.description: 在牧场里点击孵蛋、合成、挂机战斗——养一群可爱的魔法蛋蛋，看着它们慢慢变强、挑战魔王。

games.name: Dimenshaper
games.description: 《Dimenshaper》是一款精心打造的精准平台跳跃游戏，围绕动量、时机与技艺展开。切换维度以改变世界的规则，在精心设计的关卡中挑战更干净、更快速的通关。这是完整游戏的免费试玩版。

games.name: Go Next!
games.description: 在 9 个不同的世界中存活下来，抵挡怪物大军，实力指数级增长。采集资源、升级、构建你的技能树，用跑酷杀出混乱！

games.name: Schedule: Rehab Business
games.description: 以合作模式在全城最糟糕的戒瘾中心游玩。管理患者，应对各种灾难，并在不失控的情况下尽力帮助所有人康复。

games.name: Super Friendly Crosswords
games.description:
Crosswords, but with friends.
Pan and zoom across a massive shared board in real time. Grab up to 5 friends and split up to attack different sections, or huddle over the same clue and hash it out together. Turn the crossword from a solitary Sunday ritual into something you actually play with people.

games.name: Vauren's BeastBorn
games.description: 一款PvP卡组构筑游戏，叠加的效果可以进化。构筑你的卡组，叠加连招，并把握卡牌进化的最佳时机，击败对手。

games.name: One More Volley
games.description: Survive the horde, get greedy, and decide: extract with your gold or stay for one more volley. A dark-fantasy survivors-like where leaving rich is harder than dying — and the portal only opens one way.

games.name: Lord of the Tiles
games.description: Gradually uncover the world, discover new cities, connect them with roads, and turn a humble settlement into a prosperous kingdom. Develop your economy, unlock new mechanics, and explore the map at your own pace — with no combat and no unnecessary stress.

games.name: YEETFEST
games.description: YEETFEST is a fast-paced online party game built around one-hit projectile combat and hilarious active ragdoll physics. Outplay your friends across chaotic arenas, fight for the MVP trophy, customize your character, and create unforgettable moments in every match.

games.name: DABANGGU
games.description: 走进1970～80年代的韩国小巷，体验团队追逐游戏《DABANGGU》！躲开追捕者、变身成街边物件，并冲向基地救出队友。支持与机器人一起单人游玩与最多15人的在线对战。

games.name: Stranding Echoes
games.description: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

games.name: World of Kadal: Protector of Hammerdale
games.description: Save Hammerdale from the Orcs, then build your strength before the town is attacked 4 weeks later. Explore the world of Kadal, battle enemies, gain new cards and Actions, and create powerful synergies with your deck, talents, and equipment.

games.name: 子里日记 以巫婆为对手的逃生日记
games.description: 《子里日记》是一款心理恐怖视觉小说。探索一座被诅咒的商场，做出关乎生死的抉择，为了生存而战。你的每一个行动都会消耗你的一部分灵魂。

games.name: Here Comes the Horde
games.description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where you send huge armies to defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Survive their attacks, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

games.name: Backpack Cat
games.description: 让一只住在背包里的超可爱桌面猫咪，为你的生活增添一抹亮色！把日常任务变成奖励，赚取猫咪服装、配饰或可爱的背包装饰。收集、交换并悉心照料你的Backpack Cat。无论是居家、办公还是在校学习，它都能陪伴你度过每一天。

games.name: Pointless Climb
games.description: 在硬核跑酷攀登游戏中扮演 Ilia Movahed，逃离一座不可能的深渊。执行精准翻越、攀墙和高风险跳跃以登顶顶峰。游戏中没有检查点：一个简单的失误就会让你摔回起点。

games.name: Desktop Halfpipe
games.description: 可滑行的半 pipe 住在你的桌面上。做招式、选骑手，从系统托盘自定义不断变化的滑板场景。

games.name: Roguestorm Beats
games.description: 你的节拍就是武器。驯服狂野音符，把它们变成专属于你的炸裂节拍，击退想把你静音的休止符。在这款 Roguelite 数值成长弹幕地狱中，一路炸上世界舞台，成为传奇巨星

games.name: Skysunder
games.description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

games.name: Law Firm Simulator
games.description: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
games.description: 《奥林匹亚象棋》将传统国际象棋升华为了真正的 4v4 团队电子竞技。依托贯穿全场的中央“枢纽”，棋子可直接跨越至相邻棋盘，在高度同步的战队轮次中发起侧翼突袭并驰援盟友。这是全球首款真正的多棋盘竞技型团队国际象棋。

games.name: IJIN: 历史幸存者
games.description: 史上最强，究竟是谁？化身拿破仑、宫本武藏、克利奥帕特拉等在历史上留名的伟人，在这款幸存者类动作游戏中横扫涌来的大军。操作只需移动，攻击全自动。将每位伟人的专属武器培养成映照其传说的进化武器。冰封的奥斯特里茨、迷雾的关原——史实会改变战场规则。支持最多4人在线／本地合作游玩。

games.name: DEAD RECALL
games.description: A 2D side-scrolling roguelite where you command an armored vehicle fitted with an artificial brain through a battlefield overrun by Aberrants. Aim your machine gun, choose upgrades with biomass, and fight your way through the war zone.

games.name: Dungeon Explorers 2
games.description: 探索致命的第一人称地下城，在战术战斗中指挥盟友，建立强大的势力，缔结长久的关系，并决定一个被混沌吞噬的黑暗奇幻世界的命运。

games.name: Hack You
games.description: 桌面入侵与社会工程学，交织于道德惊悚之中。编写病毒，藏入游戏包体，黑入他人电脑——只为逼近那个窃取你人生、并借此攀上新高峰的昔日挚友。

games.name: Deep Trouble
games.description: Dive into Deep Trouble with a crew of up to 6 and your mostly trusty submarine, slipping past massive leviathans into the mysterious depths. Pilot, swim, and salvage together to reach the bottom before your oxygen runs out, a friend blows you up, or you become a tasty treat.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.description: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Yorick: Worlds in Bloom
games.description: A cozy third-person exploration game where you recycle death into new life. Reap spent matter, reshape the land, and bloom colorful ecosystems as you uncover strange landmarks, awaken spirits, and bring faded little worlds back to life.

games.name: Shiver Slopes
games.description: A fast-paced action game where you ski through dangerous slopes, dodge obstacles, and shoot enemies (in bullet time) while navigating procedurally generated mountains. Race for high scores or beat your best times.

games.name: Hury
games.description: Run a cozy drink workshop as Hury, a tiny ferret far from home. Take custom orders, buy ingredients, mix recipes, color labels, fill bottles, upgrade your workshop, and earn enough money to repair your ship and continue the journey.

games.name: Minefield: Rupture
games.description: 这是进化版的《扫雷》。不规则地图、每局变化的几何结构，还有出其不意移动的地雷。保持冷静，制定策略，看看在雷区让你猝不及防之前，你的逻辑能支撑多久。

games.name: Rogue Space Convoy
games.description: 驾驶护航战机，组建民用船队。在由航线选择推动的战役中迎战掠袭者、太空雷与主力舰——护送每一名乘客活着抵达跃迁门。

games.name: DEATHMATE
games.description:
DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. 

Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the depths of the Underworld.

games.name: Quarter Mile
games.description: A quarter mile, two buttons, and a tenth of a second. Stage on the tree, launch clean, shift in the green — then spend the winnings making the car faster. Six classes, twenty-three cars, ten strips. No online, no in-game store, nothing asking for your attention tomorrow.

games.name: 鸡飞蛋打
games.description: 鸡飞蛋打是一款3D卡通横版Rogue-Lite游戏。探寻丰富宝物道具强化自己，需要面对各种特殊事件，并灵活使用他们的技能，完成挑战！

games.name: Grumpy Dungeon
games.description: The dungeon is dying. It would rather die than say thank you. Fight through its halls with wisps living in your weapons and fighting at your side. Rescue every last spirit, grow them, evolve them, regrow its garden. It remembers everything. Collect all the wisps.

games.name: Ricochet Witch
games.description: 你无法自由瞄准。准星会不停地左右摆动，场上同时只能有一发弹。等到想要的角度出现的瞬间射出，用一发在墙壁间不断反弹的子弹把魔物成片扫倒——一款读跳弹的单键计分射击游戏。约5～7分钟分出胜负的 Normal，以及没有终点的 Endless。

games.name: 暗黑收割者
games.description:
暗黑哥特风・幸存者割草游戏・刷宝成长・自由掉落・暗金装备

孤身踏深渊，一斧碎万敌。经典3职业，5系技能自由进化，百件传奇装备构筑专属流派，在尸潮中从零成长，从幸存者蜕变为黑暗收割者。

games.name: 从前有座山
games.description: 一座小小的浮空仙山，您可以种田，种花，养殖，钓鱼，养鱼，捉虫，养蜂，酿蜜，修行，可以全屏游玩，也可以位于屏幕底部的休闲种田挂机模拟游戏，不会影响您的正常工作。

games.name: 余烬之轨
games.description: 列车是你的家，下一站却未必欢迎活人。深入丧尸盘踞的废墟，在有限的弹药和背包空间之中取舍。把物资和幸存者带回列车，扩建你的移动避难所。在毁灭的世界余烬中，沿着铁轨驶向未知。

games.name: Swirl Together
games.description: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.

games.name: Touhou: Your Reimu
games.description: 博丽灵梦来到你的桌面。戳一戳或把她拎起来，她都会像灵梦那样回应你，还会帮你记着待办和闹钟。虽然嘴上冷淡，却总是默默陪在你身边。

games.name: 异界出差
games.description: 二次元异世界背景的动作角色扮演游戏。扮演从现实世界穿越而来的冒险者，在异世界接取委托讨伐哥布林，中后期解锁世界穿梭，前往西部、后末世、精灵领地等多个异世界。

games.name: Portrise Idle
games.description: 在这款氛围感十足的放置策略游戏中，打造一座宁静的渔港。派遣舰队出海，出售渔获，扩建仓库与建筑，收集船长和船只卡牌，从平静的海湾驶向危险的深海。

games.name: Rusty Rampage
games.description: A hack and slash parkour game set in a sci-fi world. Launch, is a young, agile delivery boy who finds himself battling this mega corporation. The game features fast parkour mechanics focusing on jumping and running your way through the world, often using the environment to your advantage.

games.name: The Offering
games.description: 《The Offering》是一款增量游戏：抓取生物收集供奉，购买升级，并在夜晚守护你的神龛。叠加恩赐、锻造武器、捕捉哥布林，飞升穿越多个世界！

games.name: Spray to Grail
games.description: 逐层喷涂球鞋，在限时订单中迅速完成干净利落的配色，把简陋的地下工作室升级成稀有鞋款生产线。解锁拥有动态特效和特殊登场动画的传奇球鞋，升级喷漆罐与生产设备，自动化制作与装箱流程，完成轮班赚取现金，扩充你的收藏墙，并在游戏内动态中展示最抢眼的定制作品。从一双空白球鞋开始，调配颜色、追逐稀有款式，让混乱的工作间逐渐成为高效运转的潮鞋工坊。每一次喷涂、每一个订单和每一项升级，都让你离收藏中的完美鞋款更近一步。

games.name: Chop chop! JUICE SHOP
games.description: Chop fruit, earn money, unlock powerful upgrades, and create the Ultimate Juice in this colorful incremental action game.

games.name: Stickup Willie
games.description: Stickup Willie is a stylized 2.5D Western platformer set in a vintage 1930s cartoon world. Run, jump, and ride through high-speed mine cart tracks and wild frontier showdowns as you outsmart outlaws in a classic side-scrolling adventure.

games.name: Keycap Co
games.description: 经营自己的键盘店。挑选进货商品、制定价格、雇用员工、布置货架。从一家小店起步，逐步创立自己的键盘品牌。设计新款键盘，在店内销售，并承接批发订单。

games.name: Desktop Plinko
games.description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Metabolis
games.description: 打造一座因水而生的城市。将清水送上高地，收集污水，并在排入河流前进行处理。扩建街区，沿着管线寻找问题的根源，让你的低多边形城市蓬勃发展。

games.name: Pedal Pedal Pedal
games.description: 一款混乱的物理竞速游戏，两名小小骑手共骑一辆超大BMX。每人都能蹬踏、转向和刹车，而车只会朝你们意见一致的方向前进。在同一键盘上或在线双人游玩，或在单人模式中同时操控两名骑手。

games.name: 古今東西ダービー
games.description:
古今東西ゲーム！お題はー？
出されたお題に沿って自分の競走馬に名前を付けろ！名前によって馬のステータスが決まります。
お題に沿った強い馬を探し出し、勝利を掴み取れ！
レースは各馬の名前も呼んでくれる実況つきのシミュレーション！
的中馬券で稼いだお金で新たな馬スキンを手に入れ、着飾ったあなただけの馬でさらに勝利を重ねよう！
1人から最大8人まででさくっと遊べる、競馬風パーティーゲームです。

games.name: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
games.description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

games.name: わがママ
games.description:
――My curfew is 8 PM.
Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

games.name: Per My Last Email
games.description: 你是新来的。你接手的账号并不新——它属于 E. Vale，而他已经不在公司了。十个工作日的邮件，你先选择说什么，再选择让谁看见。收件方式一旦发出就无法撤回。有人仍在读。

games.name: Calc and Beat
games.description: “Calc and Beat” is a roguelike puzzle game where you must anticipate future developments—much like the “lethal calculation” mechanic in card games—to determine the best move. Use items strategically to protect the golem and conquer randomly generated dungeons!

games.name: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
games.description: 将一片宁静的土地变成温馨农场。种植并出售作物，饲养动物，让实用宠物进化，升级设备，并在轻松惬意的第一人称农场体验中按照自己的节奏拓展农场。

games.name: Carom Crashers
games.description: Bank shots beat direct hits — x1.5 off one wall, x2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

games.name: The pilot always survives
games.description: 控制直升机，抵御源源不断的敌军。

games.name: SaboTour
games.description:
A chaotic asymmetric racing party game for up to 6 players. Racers
fight for the finish line while one Saboteur, watching from a tower,
sets traps to stop them. Race, drift, and survive the sabotage.

games.name: Main Street Operator
games.description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

games.name: The Studio - Indie Grind
games.description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run the launch, clean up the post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Turn based strategy.

games.name: 安平 An-pêng
games.description: After the air raid, everyone in Anping evacuated inland. You didn't. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

games.name: Town Hall
games.description: 小镇空了一半，但市政厅仍在九点开门。你是办事员，凡是你的印章批准的，就成了事实——许可、执照、名字、死亡。每个走到你桌前的人都带着理由，多数人还带着钱。地下室里有一份档案，解释了小镇为何人去楼空。

games.name: Go! Dot.
games.description: Go! Dot. is a minimalist logic puzzle game featuring sandbox-style decryption gameplay. Place blocks or alter the terrain in each level to help the ball reach its destination.

games.name: 王冕之弈
games.description:
够级（Gouji） 是20世纪60年代诞生于中国山东青岛的一种扑克牌玩法，2008年被列入青岛市非物质文化遗产名录。六名玩家分成两队（联邦/ Federal），交错落座，三人一组对抗。你的联邦队友坐在你的“隔家”，而你的直接对手——“对头”（Rival），坐在你的正对面。

这不是普通的扑克游戏。够级的核心在于 “联邦配合” ——你的胜负不只取决于自己的牌，更取决于你与队友的默契。

games.name: Rigged
games.description: Rigged is a online co-op game with 1-6 players. You Fight off monsters whilst trying to extract oil from an abandoned rig for Kenneth. Rigged includes physics based gameplay such as the boat and oil barrels.

games.name: Punch Rock
games.description: A casual idle survival game in a small window beside your work. A lone climber wanders a mountain in real time, a dog at her heel. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or camp. Then get back to whatever you were doing. You cannot lose. She's further up every time you look.

games.name: Infall 坠入：黑洞增量游戏
games.description: 一款流程不长、节奏轻松的增量游戏，你要让一个黑洞不断长大。一开始比尘埃还小，最后吞下整个星系。

games.name: INCREMINER
games.description: 在广阔的程序生成世界中，建设不断壮大的自主矮人殖民地。深入采矿、管理资源、解锁爆炸武器和工业载具，把小小定居点发展为铺满屏幕的采矿帝国。

games.name: Prevail
games.description: A turn-based tactics roguelike on a hex board. Command a group of miniatures, outmaneuver enemies, and spend your gold between fights on weapons, gear and potions. Lose your party and the run is over. Every run is completely different than the last.

games.name: FreshSheets
games.description: Clean hotel rooms, satisfy guests, earn money, and work your way up to owning and managing your dream hotel.

games.name: Futa Paradise Resort
games.description: Inherit a crumbling island resort — and the five gorgeous staff who refuse to let it die. Rebuild the business, outplay a corporate shark, and fall for one of them in this fully voiced adult visual novel with animated scenes. One resort. Five hearts. You can only choose one.

games.name: Xenobiome Command
games.description: 在长满真菌的异星世界上建立殖民地并维持其生存。探索迷雾，扩张全图，开发土地，并在异星兽群到达你的人民之前将其消灭。Xenobiome Command绝不手软：从降落行星到最后一战。

games.name: PEEMAN
games.description:
当外星人降临地球的时候，你是什么，英雄？自保者？不管你是什么，你都将会有一个被世人熟知的名字——PEEMAN！
升级你的水管，培养可以和外星人作战的植物，然后可以坐下来喝一瓶酒好好思考一下如何拯救世界。

games.name: DaiDee 大弟
games.description: DaiDee 大弟把香港锄大地变成一场单人求生赛——把 13 张牌拆成无敌的牌组，连环出牌点燃 Flow，轰出炸弹接管牌桌。回合之间，堆叠 Style 牌改写规则。错过目标，本局就此结束。打得聪明，打得响亮。

games.name: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up
games.description: 在 Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up 中，你需要整理超过 4000 个童年游戏，并将它们放回正确的货架。沉浸在充满怀旧气息的氛围中，看看你还能认出多少熟悉的游戏。捡起来、分类、整理。再来一遍！

games.name: Click Bait
games.description: 整个互联网都想弄死你。那就点回去。 CLICK BAIT是一款节奏肉鸽游戏,让网络上的每一只怪物都终于遭到报应。一个旋转的转轮。一根扫描指针。只有一条规则:卡点点击——否则就被信息流刷进坟墓。 指针扫过节点的瞬间点击——每种颜色规则各不相同。 WHITE节点是攻击(命中金色的PERFECT细缝可造成双倍伤害)。 RED节点必须格挡才能保住现金。 GOLD节点直接发钱。 PINK是你必须打断的联动直播。

games.name: Craftaway: Tactics
games.description: Knock enemies around like they owe you money in this position based, tactical roguelite. Craft cards and take on over 9 adventures!

games.name: Cozy Plates
games.description: 使用从寿司到甜点的各种美味食材，装饰属于你自己的优雅餐盘。通过简单的控制布置每一个细节，营造温馨的氛围，呈现完美的摆盘。放松身心，按照自己的节奏学习，并沉浸其中。

games.name: Milk Homestead
games.description: 继承一座神秘庄园，以及它暗中运转的高利润谷仓生意。管理采奶流水线，升级设备，搞定七位各有作息、各有脾气的女人。实时探索庄园，解锁数十段全动画 3D 露骨场景！

games.name: Souterrain
games.description: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

games.name: HolEvade
games.description: HolEvade 是一款极具挑战性、基于物理效果的3D平台游戏，在游戏中精确定位至关重要。在云端之上倾斜并控制平台以引导小球，穿过狭窄的通道，在这个充满活力的风格化世界中测试你的反应能力！

games.name: Your Horny Streamer
games.description: Your Horny Streamer is a cozy idle clicker about running a streaming agency. Farm likes, upgrade your three girls, and find out how far they'll go for their viewers' attention.

games.name: Cricket Manager 27
games.description: A deep cricket management simulation where you take charge of a club or national side, build squads, set tactics, handle transfers and board pressure, and chase glory across Test, ODI, and T20 seasons and major ICC events.

games.name: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods
games.description: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

games.name: Fab.exe
games.description: 从 N28 到 A10 经营晶圆厂，配置设备、安排 FOUP 搬运，改善良率与交期。包含 32 个故事任务、自由模式、无尽扩厂与每日／每周挑战；通过循环目标、扩张等级与 A10 后的技术波次持续成长。

games.name: Pigeonhole Principle
games.description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

games.name: Siege of the Isletress
games.description: Siege of the Isletress is a tower defence survival game where you defend a lone fortress against hordes of enemies. Make meaningful decisions under pressure, exploit interconnected systems using 120+ distinct weapons and upgrades and uncover the secret history of the Isletress.

games.name: Bonehaven
games.description: You only have one life. Don't die! Build your own strategy against incoming enemy groups, upgrade your stats between waves, and craft unstoppable builds with cards. As each wave gets tougher, how long can you survive the chaos?

games.name: Vlad Voievod Dracula The Crusaders Tomb
games.description: A Classicvania action-horror game where you play as Vlad Tepes Dracula, the medieval Voievod (Warlord) of Wallachia. Fight your way through the Cesme Castele to recruit a great warrior held by the Genovese in the place called The Crusaders Tomb

games.name: Build the Hole
games.description: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: Worm Capitalist
games.description: Worm Capitalist 是一款增量游戏：饲养饥饿的蠕虫，看它们一像素一像素地啃光一切，再把便便变成利润。喂养它们、扩张虫群、解锁升级、提升并自动化生产，不断成长，直到整个世界都出现在菜单上。

games.name: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental
games.description: A synthwave neon space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack Power Ups at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

games.name: Bat Flapper
games.description: Fly as a bat through pitch-black caves where Echo-Location reveals danger. Eat glowing bugs to keep your passive sonar alive, dodge deadly obstacles, and chase high scores in a tense 3D arcade runner.

games.name: Pegs of Hell
games.description: 一款亲手搭建柏青哥棋盘的物理肉鸽游戏。摆放并升级球钉，排列强大的奥秘牌，分裂弹球，触发元素连锁。在地狱的租金追上你之前，造出分数高得离谱的弹球机器。

games.name: Inkturn
games.description: 一款小巧的解谜游戏。轮流操控两条墨鱼，收集所有星星。每收集一颗星星，就会切换到另一条墨鱼。提前规划，为另一条墨鱼铺路。

games.name: Horse Race
games.description: 从业余赛开始你的征程，一路向顶尖迈进。赢得比赛获取奖励，开启马匹卡牌包，打造马厩，管理你的马匹，为每场比赛找到最合适的赛马。不断提升排名，成为终极冠军。你准备好了吗？

games.name: Keepwatch: Idle Kingdom RPG
games.description: 一位常驻任务栏之上的英雄。《Keepwatch》是一款在桌面后台静默运行的放置类自动战斗RPG——建立营地，为你的唯一英雄装备好装备，然后让他自动战斗，而你可以继续处理手头的工作。

games.name: 狼人烙印：明日，你将作为狼人被处决。
games.description: 明天，你将作为“狼人”被处以火刑。为了拯救家人，你甘愿背负莫须有的罪名被处决。然而死后，化为灵魂的你却目睹妻儿堕入被蹂躏的人间地狱。在由绝对的绝望所引发的“死亡轮回”中，你必须编织出世界上最温柔的谎言。

games.name: Backrooms Insane
games.description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

games.name: Battleships: FleetForge
games.description: A Roguelite reimagining of classic Battleship. Hunt hidden fleets in the fog of war, equip your ships with scavenged components, and fight through endless, escalating tiers. All while the grid itself crumbles beneath you. How long can your fleet hold the line?

games.name: CHECKBORNE - A CHESS ADVENTURE
games.description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

games.name: Impetuous
games.description: After her home was suddenly erased, Ember the Imp must traverse the corrupted and decaying Painted Realms to uncover the truth. Explore surreal and interconnected worlds, collect upgrades to expand your movement abilities, and fight strange and warped enemies in this Metroidvania 3D Platformer!

games.name: Tale'Switch
games.description: Change a book's keywords and rewrite its ending. Trapped in an unfamiliar study, investigate locations, deduce the properties of objects, and connect clues across different tales. Can you unlock the witch's story?

games.name: Wheat Awn: Line Zero
games.description: 《麦芒零号线》是一款以军官经营与卡牌战术为核心的单人军事策略游戏。你将从一支小队起步，在火线考核里赚取星星币，招募军官、采购物资、扩编部队，在军校取得战术卡，最后登上零号线，挑战 15 个战区首领。

games.name: Cluckopia
games.description: Cluckopia 是一款方块建造游戏。你是一只公鸡：盖起房子——墙、门、屋顶——出发寻找失踪的妹妹。种植、做饭、锻造、装饰村庄，按自己的节奏交朋友；危险来临时，唤醒传奇力量。可单人游玩，也可最多与 3 位好友一起。

games.name: 灰度之星
games.description: 穿越回00年代，一起成为“国民偶像组合”吧！这是一个介于“黑”与“白”之间的“灰度”故事。本作将以五位主角的视角展开，在推进剧情的同时，玩家不仅可以为五位角色安排养成日程，还能浏览有趣的复古论坛和复古博客。

games.name: MURABO
games.description: 纸牌接龙 + ROGUELIKE + 90年代深夜迷幻梦境 = MURABO

games.name: 万象回廊：元素 Wanxiang Corridor: Elements
games.description: 《万象回廊：元素》是一款 2D 俯视角 Roguelike 动作射击游戏。手持弓箭，在程序化生成的冰霜回廊中迎战怪物与强大 Boss。自由切换水与冰两种元素：水箭施加"湿润"，冰箭叠加"冰标记"，组合触发"冻结"反应，眩晕敌人并造成百分比伤害。清空房间后挑选随机增益，构筑专属战斗流派，逐层挑战五大关卡。像素美术、快节奏战斗、每局都独一无二——拿起弓，踏入万象回廊。

games.name: Sunday Fighter Pilot
games.description: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

games.name: Fleshgrinder
games.description:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG.
Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population.
Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

games.name: Memento Resonance
games.description: 与原本是敌人的怪物产生共鸣，将它们迎入队伍。为技能装配遗物，打造自己的战斗方式；追寻失落的记忆，攀登每次冒险都会变化的高塔——这是一款怪物收集类轻度 Rogue 回合制策略游戏。

games.name: 蓝血恋歌
games.description: 一款融合恋爱、科幻与悬疑的多结局视觉小说。一次看似完美的重逢，却渐渐显露出无法解释的异常。随着你与他的关系不断加深，你必须在信任与怀疑之间作出选择——而每一次判断，都可能改变彼此的关系与最终结局。

games.name: 龙战纪元：转转大冒险
games.description: 每场战斗都从启动转轴开始！这是一款结合了老虎机机制的回合制肉鸽角色扮演游戏（Roguelite JRPG）！组合不同元素的英雄，叠加强力遗物羁绊，并从 800 多名可招募角色中拉起一支奇葩又欢乐的船员队伍。扬帆探索奇异岛屿，在逗趣搞笑的随机事件与满载宝藏的冒险中乘风破浪！

games.name: 金色海湾:桌面水族馆
games.description: 《金色海湾：桌面水族馆》是一款海洋主题桌面放置经营游戏。将一片透明海湾安放在屏幕边缘，培育鱼群与珊瑚、接待前来潜水的游客，并在轻松陪伴工作的同时经营不断变化的海底生态。收获经营收益并持续提升海湾效果，让海湾成为工作与日常中的一处静谧风景。

games.name: HorusTD
games.description: HorusTD is a strategy tower defense game where Egyptian mythology meets mechanical civilization. Choose the best tiles to build and upgrade your towers, create powerful defensive combinations, and withstand endless waves of enemies in a battle to protect your final stronghold.

games.name: Vangrid
games.description: 《Vangrid》是一款俯视角战术射击游戏，支持单人闯关，也能与好友通过网络连线并肩作战。组队深入战场，攻占据点、坚守堡垒、护送补给车队或夺回失守营地，运用枪械火力、可驾驶登车的载具，以及背包主动技能（治疗、建造、维修）扭转战局，对抗由行为树驱动、各具战术角色（突击、狙击、医疗、工兵）的智能敌军与强大Boss。地图以拼接式关卡生成，每局的地形布局、敌方增援与威胁皆有变化，让每场战斗都考验你的临场判断与团队合作默契。

games.name: 极上人妻-盛夏派对
games.description: 你筹划了一场海滩旅程，旅伴都是在工作场域认识的人妻和姐姐们。通过游玩简单的落下型合成游戏，解锁与不同角色的爱爱冒险！与人妻们遮遮掩掩的恋情，都将一一摊开在阳光底下！！！

games.name: Bilge Rats
games.description: A 1-4 player co-op sailing game. Crew a ship out of Crook's Haven, take the work nobody sensible takes, and race home before the debt comes due. And when the storm hits, keep an eye on the bilge, rat.

games.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
games.description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria by the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Each cat wants a toy: find it to get the scroll it guards!

games.name: Project TITAN
games.description: 你将从一座小型机甲工厂、一堆废料和一个简单的目标开始：赚钱。制造零件、组装机甲，并接受那些只关心高额利润、不在乎道德问题的客户所提供的可疑合同。扩建工厂，升级科技树，最终打造终极机甲：TITAN。

games.name: In that case...
games.description: Open loot cases, pray for rare drops, and pay off a massive debt before a descending ceiling of spikes crushes you. A first-person gambling roguelike about luck, greed, and survival.

games.name: Crease
games.description: 把纸折成目标形状。一款惬意的网格解谜游戏,反复折叠一张纸,直到它与目标完全吻合。超过100个关卡,搭配趣味机关。

games.name: Definitely Not Poker
games.description: It’s not poker, even though it might look like it. Enjoy a new twist on the classic Texas Hold’Em thanks to DNP. In this game, the standard cards aren’t the only ones that matter. Your hand and the special community cards can change the course of the game in a matter of seconds!

games.name: AI大亨
games.description: 一款深度模拟经营游戏：创立你的 AI 公司，在巨头环伺的淘金热中杀出血路——全球搜罗高质量语料，攻坚前沿架构，迭代训练大语言模型，再把技术变现为商业帝国。在研发投入与现金流间走钢丝，应对市场剧变与对手狙击。没有唯一胜利公式，只有你的 AI 商业传奇。

games.name: Towgether
games.description: Towgether is co-op platformer with chained cars, go solo or invite up to 3 friends to stack on them to reach better heights. explore challenging yet interactable and beautiful environment.

games.name: MagiMine Orchestra
games.description: 开采魔法矿石，收集散落资源，组建各具特色的专家队伍。强化工具与矿脉，触发连击和狂热时刻，再通过转生获得永久能力，在这款主动式增量采矿游戏中不断深入。

games.name: Project Nebula
games.description: An explosive arcade arena shooter inspired by the golden age of Amiga classics. Blast through asteroid fields, destroy alien forces, upgrade your ship, and unleash devastating weapons in a modern reimagining of a timeless genre.

games.name: Every Man for Himself and God Against All or, for a shorter name: TimeLeft
games.description: 一款以监狱为背景的二十一点生存游戏。用你剩余生命中的时间作为赌注，击败监狱长，解开隐藏的谜题，并在这座阴暗的像素风监狱中尽可能长久地生存下去——因为每一局牌，都会消耗你的时间。

games.name: Megachest
games.description: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

games.name: 最后壁垒:尸潮防线
games.description: 在这片沦陷的土地上筑起最后的堡垒。规划防御布局，解锁致命武器，面对不断进化的尸潮——每一次抉择，都决定着城墙内外的生死。

games.name: Carpet Daddy
games.description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

games.name: DOTS VS PIXELS
games.description: 点云入侵了你最爱的像素画软件！多达1,000,000,000,000个圆点如流体般涌来，直扑核心，啃噬你画下的一切。你唯一的武器：铅笔。画墙御敌，扛住围攻，解锁破坏平衡的Build。BUILD. RESIST. OVERFLOW.

games.name: 凶案数独
games.description: 这是一款融合数独与谋杀谜题推理的逻辑解谜游戏。在图示犯罪现场中依据行列规则布置嫌疑人，再解读空间线索与房间边界，推理出谁与受害者独处一室。纯逻辑推理，无需猜测。

games.name: 魔物娘Rush
games.description: 这是一款集结魔物娘们作战的Roguelite卡组构筑战斗游戏。单次游玩15～60分钟。使用周回获得的货币（棱镜软糖）培养角色，就能玩得更加尽兴。

games.name: Sex Drive Isekai
games.description: 进入Sex Drive Isekai的世界——组建你的卡组，唤醒你的性感女英雄，亲自体验她们在胜利后有多“懂得感恩”💦 准备好把牌打好了吗？

games.name: Until I Reclaim It
games.description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

games.name: TinSpring Soccer
games.description:
TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten
authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a
floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person,
full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

games.name: Bang Bang Boom Pow
games.description: 在这款融合 Roguelike 元素的第一人称 Boss Rush 游戏中，成为西部最传奇的神枪手，只有拔枪最快的人才能获胜。挑战数十位风格各异的决斗高手，他们各自拥有独特的能力与秘密；或与好友进行分屏对决，一较高

games.name: Goblin Dodge
games.description: Play as a goblin who was displaced from its village, who must fight its way through a bullet gauntlet to earn freedom!

games.name: 狐隐：笼霭村之谜
games.description: 作家王然为寻找一位失踪的少女，踏入了与世隔绝的笼霭村。在那里，名为「除岁破妄」的古老仪式正在举行——迷雾之中，村民一个接一个死去，而所有人都藏着自己的秘密。你可以相信谁？

games.name: TapRacer
games.description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

games.name: 地牢牌
games.description: 一款一切皆为卡牌的地牢 Roguelike 冒险游戏。带领一名初出茅庐的冒险者踏上旅程，在充满未知的随机地牢中不断探索。通过战斗、事件和各种遭遇获取新的卡牌，招募能力各异的伙伴，收集武器、装备、消耗品和特殊道具，并利用不同卡牌之间的效果与组合构筑属于自己的战斗策略。随着冒险深入，你的队伍将不断成长，同时也会面对越来越危险的敌人与挑战。合理规划资源，在随机事件中做出选择，灵活调整队伍与卡牌组合，突破一层层地牢，最终挑战深处强大的 Boss。游戏采用简洁、独特的纯手绘美术风格，没有 AI 生成素材，所有角色、敌人、武器、道具、事件和卡牌均由手工绘制。

games.name: Dead Man's Clock
games.description: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.

games.name: The Turbo Crown
games.description: Drive cannon-equipped toy cars, jump across giant furniture, and fly with nitro in arcade battles for up to 10 players. Fight online or against bots, master four game modes, and customize every piece with no pay-to-win advantages.

games.name: Blacksite Lazarus
games.description: Sent to investigate a medical facility gone dark, a private military contractor discovers a nightmare of death and mutation. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a cancer cure that created something far worse.

games.name: Ancient Duel
games.description: Ancient Duel is a free-to-play historical turn-based strategy card game. Build 40-card decks, combine ancient factions, position units and commanders, and outplay opponents in tactical 1v1 battles where timing, energy and formation matter.

games.name: Marble Mill
games.description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

games.name: Last Exit Diner: The Last Train
games.description: Defend an armoured diner train through six-minute runs across ten hostile biomes. Aim the Dreadnought cannon, deploy bombs, survive flying monsters, and choose rail upgrades while automatic roof guns keep the Last Train moving.

games.name: Starhand
games.description: 大多数卡牌构筑游戏夺走的是你的生命值，Starhand 夺走的是你的选择。每张卡牌都依赖一个舰船系统，而敌人会直接将这些系统击毁离线，在战斗中把卡牌锁死在你手中。六名驾驶员、295 张卡牌、八大星区。学会驾驶半残的战舰取得胜利。

games.name: Tire Dealer Simulator
