games.description: 接手父亲那家负债累累的轮胎店，并将它发展成一家蓬勃经营的企业。采购并管理库存，与顾客谈判，拆装和动平衡轮胎，雇用技师，升级店铺，承接合同，并做出决定未来发展的关键财务决策。

games.name: 16 Bit Gold
games.description: 从零开始打造一家温馨的淘金事业。尽可能多地寻找黄金，将杂草丛生的土地改造成兴旺的采矿场，一根金条接一根金条地积累财富。

games.name: TIDEBREAK: Salt and Bone
games.description: A horde defense roguelite where thirty thousand enemies flood at once. Build towers, place guns, survive endless waves. The pressure never stops and keeps escalating. Every run is different, every decision matters. How long can you last?

games.name: Uncosy
games.description: 一款关于收集娃娃的、让人不自在的游戏。

games.name: Chronicles of the Six Sages
games.description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

games.name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
games.description: 在这款轻度 Rogue 卡组构筑游戏中，将卡牌组合成强大的法术。围绕四种元素制定策略，在回合制战斗中看透敌人的行动意图，在每次冒险后不断成长，与蕾一同攀登星光之塔，寻找失踪的母亲。

games.name: ROOMS EPISODE 1
games.description: 你的选择真的很重要——字面意义上的重要。一个决定可能让你的故事在五分钟内结束，而另一个决定则可能让它继续三十分钟。这是一部由选择推动的图像小说，每一个决定都可能改变接下来发生的事情。

games.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
games.description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

games.name: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory
games.description: 火箭工厂(Roctket Factory)是一款带有工厂建造要素的增量游戏。玩家将在游戏中建造机器，管理工人，搭建流水线，发展壮大自己的工厂，直到建造出火箭，并向下一个目的地进发。

games.name: Under a Turning Sky
games.description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

games.name: 冒险者公会后勤部
games.description: 在中世纪奇幻世界中，你不是踏上冒险的英雄，而是支撑他们冒险的幕后供应者。以 RTS 式操作直接指挥工人，采集、搬运并加工资源，生产武器、药水与各类冒险物资。从徒手搬运、搬运装备到推车，逐步升级物流能力，将生产链延伸至不同市场，建立横跨各地、供应冒险者公会的生产与贸易网络。

games.name: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
games.description: The demo of The Cup, a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler. Play THE ROAD: five cases against invasive species, back to back. Draft as you go, and a creature knocked out is gone for the road. Learn from the booth in one tutorial match, then take on the House. Plays fully offline.

games.name: Potions Galore
games.description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess with no power-ups!

games.name: 10 Million Bounces / 一千万次反弹
games.description: 从一颗弹球开始，撞开矿石，积累经验，扩张你的球群。解锁六种球并逐级进化，让闪现、分裂、火焰与雷电共同开路；彩虹球还能学习附近球的特性。在巨大的彩色矿区中选择发射位置和方向，看每一次反弹带来新的变化。

games.name: Long Watch
games.description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

games.name: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
games.description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

games.name: Obsessed Mita
games.description: Obsessed Mita is an adult romance visual novel about friendship, jealousy, temptation, and a relationship that slowly becomes something far more intense.

games.name: TV Station Tycoon
games.description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

games.name: Cecilia
games.description: CECILIA是一款类塞尔达动作冒险游戏，采用受Game Boy Color启发的像素画风。身为王室护卫，你将探索遍布谜题的地牢，寻找能开辟新道路的道具，挑战强大的Boss，救回被绑架的埃里克王子。

games.name: Disturbing Mirroring
games.description: Behold the mirroring of another hidden reality: a first‑person mystery and puzzle game where the uncomfortable truth is revealed only through mirrors. Unravel enigmas invisible to the naked eye and cross to the other side of the glass to explore secret rooms that do not exist on this side.

games.name: Burnout Bistro
games.description:
Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. 
How long can you keep everything together?

games.name: Happy Project 12
games.description:
成为小学四年级女儿日向的爸爸，用三年时间挑战初中应试的养成模拟冒险游戏。
每周在"让她学习"和"让她玩"之间做出选择，提升模拟考的偏差值，向志愿学校发起冲击。
但真正被考验的，或许不是成绩，而是父女之间的关系。
你的这三年，将抵达11种结局中的哪一种？

games.name: Midnight Pet Clinic
games.description: 这是一款以深夜宠物诊所为舞台的第一人称恐怖游戏。值守各个病区，面对逐渐异变的动物，揭开诊所被掩埋的过往，并设法让徘徊于此的亡魂得以安息。

games.name: Wall of Symbols
games.description: 在炼金术士的桌上进行的 Roguelite 攻城防守。转动、放置，让符号熟成为牌库里从未有过的形态。相邻的符号彼此滋养，一次转化就能把整个盘面变成伤害。

games.name: The Incredible Monsieur Gourmet
games.description: The game in which you eat everything while being extremely French.

games.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
games.description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

games.name: 末班列车上的诱惑
games.description: 《Last Train Temptation》是一款成人视觉小说。麦克斯与尤娜连续七次在近乎空荡的列车车厢相遇，最初羞涩而克制的目光，逐渐变成坦诚、亲密又充满欲望的关系。通过对话选项影响两人的语气与反应，在手机上互发消息，体验融入剧情的多样迷你游戏，并随着故事推进解锁大量细致的成人CG与画廊内容。跟随两位缺乏经验的成年人，在尴尬、幽默和彼此信任中一步步探索感情与身体的界限。在列车的灯光与轰鸣声中见证他们完整的七日故事。

games.name: Paint The World
games.description: 一款休闲的第一人称绘画模拟游戏，带有多人游戏、延时摄影，以及可解锁的颜色、工具和世界！

games.name: Keep Skeleton Alive!
games.description: Vampires, Necromancer, Skeleton and even a Time Traveler. This Visual Novel has it all. But most important question is, can you actually keep Skeleton alive? I guess we will find out.

games.name: Drill Rover
games.description: 《Drill Rover》是一款在外星钻探岩壁的增量放置游戏。踏下油门，升级装备，深入挖掘以获取地底财富。

games.name: Gambit Gardens
games.description:
Become the ruler of the garden in this cute multiplayer strategy game!
Win blind auctions and grow powerful plants before your opponents grab the best turf.

games.name: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag
games.description: An atmospheric fantasy visual novel set on Lake Zurich. Make meaningful choices, uncover the mystery of the final entry, and guide Liva through a story with multiple endings.

games.name: Rail Spirits
games.description: Rail Spirits is an arcade-inspired on-rails shooter with roguelite elements and progression, in a 80s-futuristic setting with a pinch of corporate satire. Fight off waves of spirits as you try to procure an artifact from ancient ruins, all to make sure your employer profits!

games.name: HEXFORGE
games.description: 武器会自己开火，但构筑由你决定。标记目标、投放技能、及时排热。回合之间开启胶囊、合成模组、重新布置 13 个插槽的网格。六大区域，一场长跑，还有一台会慢慢开始自己玩自己的机器。

games.name: Why V Got AKs?
games.description:
没有投票，没有会议，人人皆有处决权！
在这款4-8人的社交推理游戏中，揪出潜伏的内鬼（Impostor），保护队友并努力存活。用你的多模式AK-47就地正法。自带近距离语音，引爆纯粹混乱！🔊💥

games.name: Ghostward
games.description: Trapped on the graveyard shift, four survivors must band together to banish a relentless spirit, or escape before it hunts them down.

games.name: Six Feet Under: The Mortician’s Last Stand
games.description: Six chambers. They fire in order. You decide what each one does. Engrave the cylinder one chamber at a time, close it with a flick of the wrist, and learn the sequence before it learns you — a hand-drawn Western horde shooter where everything you buried is walking back up the hill.

games.name: Riskline
games.description:
Cut through hostile arenas, close risky trails, and capture territory to reveal anime character art. Master 10
escalating stages..

games.name: Mining Mike
games.description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.

games.name: Keycap Keycap!
games.description: 尽情享受键帽清脆悦耳的敲击声！收集各式各样的键帽，强化技能，获取强力的遗物键帽。《键帽键帽！》是一款短小精悍、畅快解压的增量式 ASMR 游戏。

games.name: Rules for Thee
games.description: You're dead, understaffed, and temporarily in charge of the Kingdom's admissions desk. Read lives, question souls, follow an incomplete rulebook, and stamp ASCEND, HOLD, DESCEND, or REFER—then live with the Kingdom your paperwork creates.

games.name: Guttering Light
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

games.name: Kito: Lost Trail
games.description: Kito: Lost Trail 是一款温馨的 3D 平台冒险游戏，你将扮演年轻的豹子 Kito，踏上寻找失踪母亲的旅程。探索野外环境，挑战平台跳跃，发现隐藏的收集品，并在旅途中不断提升 Kito 的能力。

games.name: Tai Chi Tarot
games.description: 每天三分钟，通过原创八卦排盘抽取塔罗，获得一段专属于今天的占卜文字——这是一场融合中国八卦与西方塔罗的每日仪式，而非一次随机的算命游戏。分三轮凭直觉选牌，结果由原创三层解读系统推演而成。九个主题任你选择，二十八张牌——20张经典塔罗与8张原创东方主题牌——落于乾兑离震巽坎艮坤八个宫位之中。深色基调、水墨雾气、极简冥想配乐，在这一处安静的世界里，停下来听一听内心的声音。完整历史记录可随时回顾，15个成就静静记录你的占卜足迹。

games.name: Nova Match
games.description:
Nova Match is a next-gen, Scifi match & merge game!
Blast lines with cosmic strikes, match Nova Cats for board-cleaning explosions.
Nova Match is the puzzle game with the soul of an arcade shooter!

games.name: Siege of Incrementalia
games.description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

games.name: Neighbor Craft
games.description: Neighbor Craft 是一款生存卡牌游戏，你需要通过将卡牌相邻摆放来建立自己的文明。游戏的策略关键在于思考哪些卡牌应该相邻，以及应该放在哪里。采集资源、制作物品、进行战斗、与他人交易，并不断发现新的卡牌，让你的文明逐步发展壮大。

games.name: Grand Snow Rider
games.description: Grand Snow Rider is an open-world action-adventure simulator. Clear snow-covered roads, find abandoned vehicles and their missing keys, fight off troublemakers in snowball battles, and bring the cars back to safety. Use snow-clearing machinery and unusual gadgets as the storm grows stronger.

games.name: TavernMan
games.description:
You wake up on an island where nights never end. Your new job? Running the tavern. Serve
drinks, clean up, fix things, and take on jobs off the books. But why are you here — and
what will it take to leave?

games.name: Griefborn
games.description: Brace yourself for relentless, bloody retro-style action! Slaughter hordes of evil with firearms and magical abilities. All set in a grim medieval world!

games.name: Solarise
games.description: A short and sweet game that aims to be a love letter to solar panel production and the crisis of the modern century for Europe as it grapples with reindustrialisation. Manage your factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people, in order to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals.

games.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong
games.description: A bisexual singer goes viral after being caught kissing a man, shattering the image her fans built around her. Navigate fame, social media, biphobia, and messy romance in this otome/yuri visual novel.

games.name: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
games.description: 你在一座空寂的机器人物流厂上夜班。备货、打包、发运。流程看似简单，但每一夜都有什么东西偏离得更远一点。十个夜晚。两种结局。免费试玩版：前 3 个夜晚。

games.name: Tensio
games.description: A physics climber where the level is an instrument. Every string you pull sings and every string you overpull snaps for good. One life, no checkpoints, and a very long way down.

games.name: Ciao Pizza: Cooking Chaos
games.description: Run a chaotic pizza shop alone or with up to three friends. Make every pizza by hand, deal with impatient customers, keep the kitchen running, and race deliveries across town before everything gets cold, burnt, or completely out of control.

games.name: Task Bar Cube
games.description: Task Bar Cube 是一款放置类 RPG，可以全屏游玩，也可以直接通过任务栏进行游戏。培养你的角色和宠物，收集稀有装备，并探索数十种不同的成长系统。

games.name: Bathroom Please!
games.description: You have to go. RIGHT NOW. Every step is one you never get back. Cross a park, an office and a public pool on a shrinking step limit, talk your way past strangers, and reach a toilet before your luck runs out.

games.name: System32
games.description:
TAKE OVER THE SYSTEM WITH ONLY ONE BULLET!

System32 is a top-down action game with focus on flow. You are a virus with the goal of destruction. Fight through different levels with satisfying gunplay and do what you were made for.

PLAY OUR DEMO SOON!

games.name: 女神机器猎人 (K-God Robot Hunters)
games.description: 一款韩式奇幻扑克肉鸽游戏：用五行花色组成牌型，借助神话女神的力量。打磨牌组，发掘强力组合，一手接一手地对抗机器人叛乱。

games.name: 星夜茶会
games.description: 《星夜茶会》是一款以非对称对抗为核心的游戏。扮演来宾，搜索线索、调和道具并逃离梦境；或扮演魔族，抽取效果各异的卡牌追猎来宾、收集恐惧。多人模式正在制作中。

games.name: Sails of Salt
games.description: Take the helm in this atmospheric pirate roguelite. Explore uncharted seas, shape your crew's destiny and chase fortune through roaring broadsides. Capture ships for your fleet and build a lasting legacy. Will you risk it all for greed?

games.name: Marisa! Cook It!
games.description: "下次宴会的菜就由我来做！"灵梦把咲夜的手艺夸了一次太多，魔理沙终于说出了收不回去的话。组好食材卡组倒进魔法大锅，食材相撞、弹幕炸开，连锁停不下来。一款物理驱动的卡组构筑Roguelike。

games.name: HEX: You Are It
games.description: 奔跑、躲藏、传递诅咒，在混乱又欢乐的多人追逐中逃出生天。撞破可破坏的场景物件，驾驶载具，在五张地图上与好友斗智斗勇，也可以先与机器人练习。回合结束时，可别让自己成为赫克斯！

games.name: Calibration Sequence
games.description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

games.name: Swap Attack
games.description: 一次输入，两个战场，一把枪。你的克隆体在分屏两侧完全同步移动，任意一侧的墙都会同时拦下两人，而只有持枪的那一个能开火。把枪扔过分割线，挡住蜂拥而至的敌群。

games.name: 刑事以外、全员名侦探
games.description: 一款以日本冈山市为舞台的剧情推理游戏。所有人都有答案，而你需要的是证据。调查六起谋杀案，检查证据与记录，核对证言，重建时间线，并分辨合情合理的推论与能够被证据证明的事实。

games.name: IncrementalOS
games.description: 写给90年代桌面的一封渐进式情书。从空白桌面和一个图标开始，解锁程序、系统和小游戏，赚取更多的钱，逐步打造一个值得炫耀的系统。

games.name: Chroma Miners
games.description: Guide Chrobits as they mine, refine, and collect over 16 million unique colors while automating their work in this relaxing incremental game.

games.name: F Of X
games.description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

games.name: Tiny Tycoons
games.description: 为一群仓鼠打造并装饰温馨可爱的小店。自由规划布局、挑选家具和风格，雇用员工帮你维持店铺运转，并随着发展解锁更多店铺类型。

games.name: Bot Survivors
games.description: Bot Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite where you fight off relentless waves of killer robots. Choose your upgrades, build devastating synergies, and survive the mechanical apocalypse!

games.name: Innkeeping
games.description: 一款温馨奇幻的旅店经营模拟游戏。建造你的旅店，酿造你的啤酒，设定价格，照顾你的客人。在平衡老板满意度和不断上涨的成本的同时，提升你的声誉和业务，将一个安静的路边小店打造成传奇地标。

games.name: Idle Necronomics
games.description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

games.name: Bouncemetry
games.description: 一款由七个物理模拟组成的增量游戏。向圆环中投放小球直至其碎裂，在无重力晶格上抢夺连接，用光束扫过反应堆。升级会改变物理本身，而且在你推进下一个模拟时，已自动化的模拟会持续产生收入。

games.name: Pupmancer
games.description: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.

games.name: UNKNOWN EGG
games.description: 一个神秘的操作系统突然抢占了你的工作电脑。里面有个自称是“蛋”的东西正在等你。和它交谈，探索诡异的终端，揭开隐藏的秘密，并查明为什么有些记忆从一开始就不该被发现。

games.name: 罐头成长计划
games.description:
一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系
　　9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式

·养成游戏
·自由选择多结局

罐头：一种体表覆盖有高度拟态中世纪全身板甲的生物。其壳内无实体器官，由黑色触手群构成核心。

games.name: Drawmi: Card Shop
games.description: A card shop simulator where you draw all the cards that you sell. Crack open packs, sell cards, host tournaments, and invite your friends to help grow the store.

games.name: PeeVPee
games.description: 一款混乱的多人派对游戏,你需要喝饮料、灌满膀胱,并与朋友们竞争,看谁能尿到最多地方。喝饮料、瞄准目标,占领最多地盘就能获胜!

games.name: PUCKVPUCK
games.description: Arcade sports with pucks — SOCCER, DODGEBALL and a top-down SHOOTER in one game. Boost, slam and charge your shots, or grab a gun off a pad and chase a kill streak. Up to 8 players, online with friends or all on one PC — or solo against bots. A minute to learn, and the skill ceiling keeps climbing.

games.name: Where the Redwood Ends
games.description: A group of friends looking for a weekend getaway are met with terror as one of them is mysteriously murdered. Trapped in an abandoned mansion deep in the Redwood Forest, they have no one to suspect but each other.

games.name: Item TD
games.description: In this tower defense game, you play as a fighter, fighting alongside towers and a mage partner. Arrange items in the inventories of your fighter and towers to maximize their power. Develop your skill tree to strengthen your fighter and towers. Survive waves of enemies across challenging stages.

games.name: 修仙，然后攻略魔法少女
games.description: 《修仙，然后攻略魔法少女》是一款融合视觉小说与养成 RPG 的单机游戏：你是被命运选定的转生者，在异世界重新开始：白天分配有限的行动力去修行、打工、探索街区，经营与各位美少女之间的羁绊；夜晚踏进黑雾深处，以回合制战斗迎击潜伏的魔物与敌人——每一次行动都要抉择，是成为唯我独尊的绝世强者，还是变成浪迹花丛的潇洒情圣，一切由你决定。

games.name: BACK TOGETHER
games.description: 《BACK TOGETHER》是一款混乱的合作平台游戏，四名玩家需要齐心协力克服重重难关。用绳索互相拉拽，融合为一体，克服重重障碍，考验真正的友谊（以及愤怒）！

games.name: Hotel Carnivalia
games.description: Hotel Carnivalia是一款支持4至15人游玩的FPS社交推理游戏。以第一人称走进哥特风酒店，化身捕食者猎杀猎物，或循着蛛丝马迹，揪出藏在人群中的捕食者。

games.name: Rich PaPa
games.description: Rich PaPa 是一款真正把钱当子弹射出去的第三人称动作射击游戏。消灭成群的僵尸，利用环境打出跳弹，转动轮盘获取高风险升级，并在生存与剩余现金之间不断权衡。

games.name: 百炼仙丹
games.description: 这是一款主打“炼丹求生”的修仙增量游戏。凡人修仙，与天争命，你要在阳寿耗尽前寻找真正延寿的仙家丹方。在这过程中招募药童打理草药，钻研丹炉火候。当大限将至，便会坐化轮回，将毕生修为化作“道痕”遗泽来生。踏上不断转生的修道之旅，最终得道飞升。

games.name: Firework Store Simulator
games.description: Manage your own fireworks store in Tokyo! Buy, sell, and ignite dazzling fireworks, organize spectacular night shows, and craft custom pyrotechnics in this cozy simulation game. Build your small shop into the city's ultimate fireworks empire!

games.name: Colony on the Run
games.description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

games.name: LIDVN
games.description:
Dreamlike point-and-click adventure meets animated visual novel. 
Come along on a journey through surreal experiences, meeting colorful characters and having delightful conversations.

games.name: Under the dead sun
games.description: The Sun is dead. Humanity survives in eternal darkness. Awaken among the corpses as Nameless, guided by a living heart. Explore a dying world, master forbidden magic, and decide what future humanity deserves.

games.name: Watch My Step!
games.description: 看不见的陷阱、不同的视角，以及唯一的出口！在这款支持2–4人在线合作的平台游戏中，每位玩家看到的陷阱都不同。互相提醒危险，携手闯过关卡，并用最快成绩冲上排行榜榜首！

games.name: 汉字工厂
games.description: 《汉字工厂》是一款在立体世界里拆解、重组汉字的自动化工厂游戏。“木”和“几”左右并排是“机”；把“几”移到“木”上，却成了“朵”。造好的字还能再次拆开，接进更深的生产链。一个字所需的部件，未必来自同一个地方。想造一个“晴”，你要的“青”也许藏在山巅，“日”却落在湖的另一岸。你的工厂也得沿着世界铺开，爬上山脊，穿入地下，把远隔山水的部件送到一起。从最初的一次拆分、一次组合开始，让一条条产线彼此接通，汇成一座不断拆字、造字的工厂。当字典里的答案已经不够，你还可以造出一个从未存在过的新字——它的第一个名字，由你决定。

games.name: Shitford Cop Simulator
games.description: 在只有 67 名居民的 Shitford 当警察。这里的人醉酒驾驶、乱停车、行为怪异。收养一只警犬，找出是谁弄脏了草坪，追查大麻种植者、洗钱者和喜欢裸露的当地居民，并逐步扩建你的警局。

games.name: 最后的星垒
games.description:
—— 抵御来自星空的无尽虫潮

沿着环形星球表面建造布防，角度的选择将至关重要。

开拓宇宙，扩大建造空间，也可能引来未知灾害。

三选一获取卡牌，自由组合卡组；前行途中遭遇诸多事件，在一次次抉择中调整你的最终策略。

games.name: 猫法洗衣房
games.description: 经营一间即将失控的魔法洗衣房！把一次性魔法洗涤剂精准投进滚筒，让它们在衣物间碰撞、繁殖并触发连锁计分；购买零件、签订合同、应对臭衣服，在九个回合中把一台日常机器构筑成疯狂的得分引擎。

games.name: DuskLand
games.description:
Poker Roguelike RPG.
DuskLand is a unique roguelike RPG where you deal heavy damage using poker hands and optimize character-specific inventories.
Discover explosive synergies, find the best layout, and unleash powerful combos!

games.name: The Sounding Dark
games.description: 世界漆黑一片。你每走一步，都会发出一道声脉冲，用霓虹勾勒出地穴，也把你的位置准确无误地告诉下方的盲目之物。潜行、倾听、把猎手引开。救出失踪的村民，唤醒大共鸣，彻底走出黑暗。

games.name: Under the Rust
games.description: Under the Rust is a tactical UI-based bunker simulation. Take control of the C.O.R.E. system, manage life support resources, assign personnel, and survive the post-apocalyptic decay.

games.name: 再拆亿包！
games.description: 一款单人放置游戏，让你撕开卡包，收集卡牌，完成究极收藏。卖掉重复卡牌，升级装备，然后继续抽卡，并且抽得更快、更多！享受撕开包装，填满卡册，逐渐集齐一切所带来的巨大满足感。该集卡了！

games.name: Reborn
games.description: Reborn - 一款氛围感十足的第一人称生存恐怖游戏。探索阴暗的宅邸，揭开它的秘密，在感染者之中生存下来。使用武器、潜行和有限的资源，找到通往真相的道路。

games.name: 地牢矿工
games.description: 下到矿道里挖矿石、再运回飞船的1～4人在线合作采矿游戏。小型装备可以随身携带，但巨大的水晶只能用自己的双手抱着搬运。拔出地牢核心后，矿道就会开始崩塌。请在3分钟内拖着矿车回到飞船。

games.name: Books Hate You
games.description: Escape a library where every book wants you dead. Dodge charging tomes, books that drop from above, and ledges that crumble the second you land on them across 29 levels of precision 3D platforming. Die once and you restart the level. Again. And again.

games.name: Who Pressed It?!
games.description: 一款充满混乱与欢乐的 2–4 人合作解谜游戏。和队友一起挑战测试房间，与巨大的按钮互动，并尽量别按错！每一次失误，都会让整个测试设施变得更加混乱！

games.name: DISK-Y
games.description:
带领有着心理问题的转学生〈优〉参观学校，成为她的心灵支柱吧！
本作为含有心理恐怖要素的微型复古视觉小说。

games.name: Soul Finders
games.description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

games.name: Maid?Hero!
games.description: 与女仆一同踏上跨越世界的挑战之旅。收集卡牌，为卡牌赋予独特附魔，发掘每张卡牌的无限潜力。通过不同组合构筑专属于你的战斗流派。探索未知区域，收集强力遗物，挑战各类敌人，在不断变化的战斗中寻找属于你的胜利方式。

games.name: The Night Kitchen
games.description: The Night Kitchen 是一款心理恐怖游戏。你刚开始一份新工作——在厨房里上夜班。烤炉、烤箱、炸锅。接单、备餐、与客人交谈。简单的工作。七个夜晚。一晚比一晚更诡异。

games.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
games.description:
You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball!
A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects.
Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

games.name: Shadow Bridge
games.description: A trading game about arming a war. Five kingdoms, one neutral village, one shop — yours. Sell good steel to a friend, cursed steel to an enemy, and let thirty years of war end the way you decide. You never draw a sword.

games.name: The Last Match
games.description: 她的个人资料看起来完美无瑕，但坐在你对面的女人却完全不是那么回事。一场普通的约会很快变成了可怕的生存之战。观察她的行为，谨慎选择你的话语，并揭开这场最后配对背后的恐怖真相。

games.name: Dungeon of the Forgotten
games.description:
A turn-based roguelike where time is your health. Every hit costs seconds, and the clock never stops.
Descend, get stronger, and find out how deep you can go before it runs out.

games.name: Price War
games.description: Price War is a low-poly retail management game. Build your stores, arrange shelves to boost sales, hire and manage your staff, then grow your empire district by district across an entire city waiting to be conquered.

games.name: Kritsana
games.description: 一款来自泰国的找异常类恐怖游戏。1997年，一个男人坚称他家里有东西，他的精神科医生却说没有。如今这桩案子交到了你手上。翻看他留下的旧监控录像带，报告每一处异常，查明这起案件为何始终说不通。

games.name: Anomaly Center
games.description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

games.name: ONE LAST BEAM
games.description: 独立操控手电筒，让武器自动开火。在这款以目标任务为核心的幸存者类动作肉鸽游戏中，对抗愈发汹涌的僵尸潮。重启电网、进化武器，活到黎明——但光越亮，吸引的危险也越多。

games.name: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches
games.description: A long-form farming and business management RPG where you transform raw land into a thriving farm. Grow crops, raise livestock, sell at markets, hire employees, expand your operation, manage finances, and survive the unpredictable realities of farming.

games.name: 2027 毕业生工作
games.description: 跑外卖，跑外卖，毕业后给我跑外卖。等你好久了，赶紧来入职吧！！！！！

games.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
games.description: 一款通过组合羁绊强化队伍的 Roguelike 自走棋。升级你的单位，击败越来越强大的敌人。

games.name: KRIS: The Last Good Summer
games.description: 克里斯将在30天后被报废。扮演在阁楼发现他的萨姆，和他一起探索雪松瀑布镇。解开点击式谜题，用旧软盘为他增添新能力，并决定愿意冒着失去哪些记忆的风险，为他争取未来。

games.name: Slot Crawler
games.description: 探索。杀戮。搜刮。死亡。把辛苦赚来的代币交给一台动机可疑的老虎机，再为下一轮冒险解锁更多糟糕决策。Slot Crawler 是一款俯视角动作 Roguelike 游戏，拥有程序生成的地图、混乱的构筑，以及那些怎么看都不该奏效的组合。

games.name: Genuine Article
games.description: 维也纳，1901。你接手一家替老物件辨真假的事务所：没有你的证明，东西就一文不值。银器、画、表、纸张——每件都有一段真话和一句谎话。前任的债让贿赂格外诱人。而你不可能次次都对——出错总有代价。

games.name: Space Catnips
games.description: 《太空猫薄荷》是一款增量式游戏，你需要在外星球上采摘猫薄荷，并在自己的酒吧里展示这些猫薄荷，以此吸引形形色色的太空猫！

games.name: CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece
games.description: 在倒计时中塑造缤纷黏土，与好友一较高下！所有人都将面对相同的挑战，看看谁的作品最接近目标。速度模式中，享受匆忙创作带来的滑稽变形作品；大师模式中，精雕细琢，打造属于你的完美杰作。

games.name: NICO DRAW
games.description:
和朋友一起玩，一定会让你笑出来。
画出的角色会直接动起来！组合人类、猫、鸟、乌龟和史莱姆的独特能力，投掷、抓取、滑翔、吸附！和朋友一起挑战机关重重的关卡——这是一款最多支持4人游玩的手绘风在线合作动作游戏。

games.name: Ball Game
games.description: Ball Game is a game about making weaponified balls face each other using physics. Choose between many powerful cards, go through the rounds and watch slowly as the destruction rises!

games.name: Star Driver Ultra
games.description: year 2050 ULTRA high speed combat racing on the Moon

games.name: 熊猫钓鱼：台钓问道之旅
games.description: 《熊猫钓鱼：台钓问道》是一款基于真实台钓逻辑的 2D 钓鱼模拟游戏。从城市河道出发，逐步探索乡间小河、白洋淀、升钟湖等风格各异的钓场，每个钓场都有独特的鱼种和水情变化，你需要根据目标鱼情灵活搭配鱼竿、浮漂、线组和饵料——调漂、找底、抓口，每一个细节都左右着最终的鱼获。数十种装备自由组合，从入门到精通，在不断尝试中理解鱼与水的关系。清新手绘风，沉浸式钓鱼体验，在垂钓问道中，寻觅自我与自然的本真乐趣。水面下的故事，等你来发现。

games.name: Ghostly Late Night Show
games.description: 比利一生都在追求完美，而你就是要打乱他计划的幽灵！加入一场超自然深夜秀，精心布置恶作剧，把他的日常变成精彩好戏。在欢笑背后，探索一段关于错失良机与意外缘分的暖心故事。

games.name: Dour Tower
games.description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

games.name: Deadship Protocol
games.description: 1 到 4 人合作动作游戏，支持在线或同屏。穿过一艘满是怪物的死船的四个区域。你的枪会自动开火：你负责移动、冲刺和使用技能。每个房间后选择一个强化，并击败每个区域的首领。

games.name: Lanternfall
games.description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

games.name: Game Dev Dynasty
games.description: 在这款游戏工作室模拟经营游戏中，打造你的梦想之作。设计游戏封面、带领团队，在不断变化的市场中竞争。销量超越对手，斩获年度游戏大奖，打造全球最负盛名的游戏工作室。

games.name: MAFIA HOTEL
games.description: 《MAFIA HOTEL》是一款最多支持16名玩家的多人社交推理游戏。白天尽情交谈、撒谎、指控并投票；夜晚则返回各自的酒店房间——黑手党随时可能敲响你的房门。熬过危机四伏的夜晚，找出真正值得信任的人。

games.name: Aquanaut
games.description: Delve into the depths of an accursed ocean in this top-down bullet hell roguelike. Battle impossible odds, amass hoards of treasure, and become incredibly powerful - or drown trying.

games.name: Reveria: Act 1
games.description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

games.name: Tolerance
games.description: Every premium order is hand-drawn. The machine cuts EXACTLY what you drew. That's the problem. Run a same-day CNC shop with 1–4 players online - one till, one bank, shared blame. Rush orders, fight fires, wrench the saboteur, climb from pine to titanium, and ship it anyway. Precision optional.

games.name: Marbled Memories
games.description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events.  Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother.  This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

games.name: Special Delivery
games.description: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

games.name: FlashWords: Wordfall
games.description: FlashWords: Wordfall is a language-learning word game where you guide falling words to their correct translations, clear the board, and unlock new vocabulary as you play.

games.name: Prigod Idle
games.description: 在这款放置自动战斗游戏里打造英雄，派上战场。从大量随机属性的装备和150多个技能里挑选搭配，打不过首领就换个新思路！100个关卡、38位英雄、97件圣遗物、22个小游戏和4棵科技树。一次买断，没有微交易。

games.name: Hell is Neon Colored
games.description: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.

games.name: TRACE
games.description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

games.name: Temple Of Your Mom
games.description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

games.name: Samly's Bookly
games.description: Restore forgotten libraries, sort scattered books, and help lost stories find their way home in a cosy game for 1-4 players.

games.name: American Gold Rush
games.description: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

games.name: Goats and Shrubs: Desktop Topiary
games.description: In this desktop idle game, watch your goats graze on wayward shrubs as you build and personalise your own desktop topiary. Your trusty goats collect leaves for you to spend on upgrades, decorations and new ways to customise your goats and topiary.

games.name: 公司狗
games.description: 部署炮塔、建立防线，并举枪狂扫。通过 Rogue-like 系统解锁能力，成为不可阻挡的存在。“赛博脑腐”已侵蚀新美瑞蒂安城，而你就是唯一的解药。一路浴血奋战，成为名副其实的公司狗。记住，在这个地方，没有什么是免费的。

games.name: NULL VECTOR
games.description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

games.name: Nomenocide
games.description:
The Examiner has a number.

You are not issued a name. You do not require one. Names are an operational measure applied to units, for the reasons set out above, and staff are not units.

You do have a name. You are simply not using it here.

Nobody has asked for it in some time.

games.name: 沦为萌犬-被姐姐们温柔偏爱
games.description: AI互动影游，全程狗狗第一视角！化身萌犬，以嗅觉、听觉、撒娇互动与高颜值的美女们朝夕相伴，每一次摇尾、蹭手、撒娇都触发专属影像分支。多线情感结局，治愈甜系互动，解锁人与小狗双向治愈的温柔故事。

games.name: 星空轨迹
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: 《星空轨迹》是一款承袭经典王道精髓的日式角色扮演游戏。故事发生在星力流转的里斯特大陆，古老的星神传说与日渐苏醒的黑暗势力相互交织。玩家以星选者的身份踏上冒险旅途，结识性格各异的可靠伙伴，穿越魔龙岛、妖精之森等风格迥异的秘境，在战斗与探索中不断成长，共同揭开大陆尘封的阴谋，挺身封印邪恶魔王，书写属于你的羁绊史诗。

games.name: Sticky Sword
games.description:
The greatest epic by the weakest creature!

Zip across mountains in Sticky Sword, a fast-paced, super-exciting warp-action Metroidvania.

Guide a timid slime to save the mountain. Make your slime stronger by collecting legendary swords, and slash the ultimate apex creature—a colossal dragon

games.name: Harvest Story
games.description: Merge ingredients on a tiny platform, cook up dishes, and sell your way to survival. The landlord shows up every week like clockwork, and rent only gets steeper—so merging isn't enough, you need a plan. Hire robots to automate production, unlock a tech tree to expand your farm.

games.name: Nine Thrones
games.description: A party-based fantasy RPG combining classic adventuring, tactical turn-based combat, exploration and meaningful choices with an open world of rival kingdoms, political intrigue and war. Build your party, choose your path, and find your place in a changing world.

games.name: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
games.description: 收割源源不断的僵尸狂潮，将屠杀转化为金钱，并将你的战车升级为不可阻挡的杀戮机器！在这款充满动作感的递增式 Roguelite 游戏中，每一次冲锋都让你离面对巨型怪兽（Kaiju）Boss 更近一步。装备完毕，冲破一切，主宰战场！

games.name: Forgotten Garden
games.description: 建造你自己的小农场，种植作物，收集资源，探索周围神秘的世界。去钓鱼，不断成长，逐渐揭开这个奇异之地隐藏的秘密。了解你的土地，因为有时，土地也了解你。

games.name: Literally A Flying Brick
games.description:
"Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game.
The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

games.name: 圣女纪元
games.description: 一款英雄+圣女双重搭配的Rogue卡牌游戏。你将扮演一位英雄，与圣女并肩作战，收集卡牌、构筑流派，体验自动战斗的策略爽感。击败敌人，缴获卡牌收为己用。每局20分钟，轻松上手，策略无穷！

games.name: 开工啦！幻想乡的少女们
games.description: 一款以幻想乡为舞台的像素放置同人游戏。眼看香霖堂生意火爆、自己却穷得叮当响，平日里懒散的博丽灵梦终于下定决心要改变现状！！干脆就地取材、利用神社空地摆摊开店搞钱。这波临时营业意外打乱了幻想乡的平静作息，引得一众妖怪与少女集结到场，一场轻松欢乐的幻想少女大作战就此开启！

games.name: Gravefire Tavern
games.description: Gravefire Tavern is a dark-fantasy roguelite backpack auto-battler. Recruit adventurers, arrange formations, and create builds through item shape, placement, and adjacency. Brave shifting expeditions where every victory, wound, death, and legacy shapes your tavern and the party that follows.

games.name: 浮块防线
games.description: 守护脆弱基地，抵御一波波随波漂来的敌人。将击败来敌的浮岛拼入主岛，让防线越守越大。战前在有限卡组槽位中搭配士兵与建筑，战中用金币购买并部署部队。各地图拥有独特环境效果，为防守增添更多变数。

games.name: Elroy Goes Bugzerk
games.description: The 90s point-and-click classic returns! Help Elroy and Blue find the legendary Technoloptera to win the 10th Annual Insectathon. Outsmart arch-rival Gordon Smugs, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and learn real science in this fully animated interactive adventure story.

games.name: Illusion Remix
games.description: Design optical illusions, animate them, and decide exactly how your music controls them. Start instantly with handcrafted presets or deeply customize your visuals, then play them full-screen, export videos, create live wallpapers, and display them in your own museum.

games.name: Alchemist's Books: Sorting the Old Alchemist's Storage
games.description: Discover 2,532 unique potions, learn their recipes, and organize the old alchemist's shelves. Restore order to the forgotten storage, one potion at a time.

games.name: Digsum
games.description: A relaxed incremental mining game about digging deeper, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering ancient artifacts.

games.name: Four Busted Buttons
games.description: Smash enemies by unlocking and upgrading four unique attack buttons in this short, minimalist incremental game.

games.name: Beneath Europa
games.description: Dive into the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life. Are you ready to take the next step?

games.name: 鬼屋：地狱班
games.description: 在一座布满怪物和陷阱的鬼屋中杀出一条生路，电视观众正在收看现场直播。收集眼球打开受诅咒的门，找到出口并设法活着逃出去。支持单人游玩或本地双人合作。

games.name: Warchaic
games.description: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

games.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
games.description: 用四边的球拍射出魔法弹，把涌进墓地的怪物一扫而空！由打砖块进化而来的怪物射击游戏。用弱点属性击杀，爆炸会无视墙壁连锁引爆，整群一起炸飞。乱打也挺爽，还有计分和计时挑战。攻下全部7座墓地吧。逃走的怪物会涌向别的墓地，把那里变强。去哪里，由你决定。

games.name: Deliwhere?
games.description: 这是一款支持1-4人本地/在线联机的欢乐混乱合作游戏！为了早日还清天文数字般的银行贷款，你和好友必须在奇幻浮空岛间硬核送快递！自由选择4大特色职业，搭乘飞行平台冲破险境，躲避致命火箭与空中水雷，升级机库设施，把每一件包裹安全送达！

games.name: INNER EKO
games.description:
A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of.  

Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

games.name: 投籠 TohKago
games.description:
Throw it, aim it. Watermelon?—BOOM!
A fresh take on a staple of Japanese school sports days. The rules are simple: Pick up fruits and throw them into your team's basket. In a chaotic free-for-all, a single watermelon can make all your steadily collected fruits go BOOM. Who will have the last laugh?

games.name: 武装国度 Armory Keeper
games.description: AK论斤称，沙鹰满地扔，和好兄弟打造真男人的梦想枪房！收集散落的武器装备，沉浸式扮演军火巨头，打造专业武装国度！以军规级标准，将满屋的RPG、加特林等1500多种枪械与弹药物资逐一核对归位。解锁强力技能倍增整理效率，亲手打造让硬核枪迷血脉偾张的满配战术枪墙！

games.name: Cardsharp
games.description: 黑暗房间里的二十一点。可以独自玩，也可以和朋友一起。赢下这手牌就拿钱；输了，荷官就取走一根手指。抢劫其他玩家，烧掉他们留着的那张牌，把诅咒道具塞给他们。

games.name: Picronix 2
games.description: 通过这些轻松的逻辑谜题放松身心、活跃思维。锻炼你的大脑，寻找内心的平静。

games.name: Colorizing: Sunrise
games.description: 一款让人放松的数字填色游戏，包含各种风格的图片，满足不同喜好。

games.name: AsterMaster
games.description: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

games.name: 守雾人
games.description: 《守雾人》是一款塔防生存游戏。你将在迷雾笼罩的异星上建立防线，收集资源，研究科技，在每晚涌来的怪潮中守住能量塔，探寻真正秘密。

games.name: beautiful freaks of the desert
games.description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

games.name: A cointoss roguelike
games.description:
来掷硬币试试运气吧。
概率应该是二分之一。

games.name: Ship Busters
games.description: 用最硬核的方式击沉战舰——一块船板接一块船板。抛射炮弹、撕裂船帆、点燃甲板，再让侧舷所有火炮蓄势齐发。免费游玩。

games.name: Rail Capital
games.description: 在这款即时铁路经营策略游戏中创办公司，铺设轨道，连接城镇，为客运与货运寻找赚钱的线路。购置列车、安排运输，为工厂建设出资，让整片地区的经济随路网一同发展。你还可以买入其他铁路公司的股票，赚取分红，甚至夺取总裁之位。但要留意：AI对手和其他玩家也能入股你的公司。是把利润留给铁路扩张，还是分红充实自己的钱包？一边经营路网，一边守住控制权，在沙盒、剧本、战役或多人对局中，打造属于你的铁路帝国。免费试玩现已推出。

games.name: Click & Loot
games.description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

games.name: Unedited Footage: The Abandoned Factory
games.description: YouTuber俊浩为拍摄下一条视频，于夜里走进一座废弃工厂。那晚拍摄的影像最终未能上传。探索笼罩在黑暗中的三层工厂，完成拍摄并揭开隐藏在废墟中的秘密。这是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。

games.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
games.description: Collect charismatic heroes, build your ultimate team, battle other players in real-time PvP, and make new allies in a vibrant casual RPG.

games.name: Siegecrawler
games.description: 将7种兵种编入自行攻城车，冲向由物理演算构筑的城墙！战斗全自动进行，你以法术、3种号令与破城锤的「会心」扭转战局。指挥官与誓约让每一局都构筑出不同流派的Roguelike攻城战。共30关，通关后开启无尽模式。

games.name: Unread...
games.description: Will you be able to fix things, or will you fail and push that special person even further away? Your actions (and texts) will decide that. A fully-voiced, interactive visual novel!

games.name: For My Kingdom
games.description: 你是一位中世纪国王。每一个决定都要在国库、军队、粮仓与教会之间取得平衡。在战争地图上击退来犯之敌，将王座传给继承人，让王朝延续世代

games.name: Midnight Heat: Retro Racing
games.description: 成为私人司机赚钱，在健身房锻炼，称霸地下街头竞速，积累名气参加正式锦标赛，并在这款复古成人赛车游戏中邂逅美丽女性。

games.name: Highways & Co.
games.description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

games.name: Dyneria
games.description: Dyneria is a god game on a living world, shape deserts or lush jungles, plot wars or bring prosperity. A rich simulation responding to every change. Choose your godly powers from 5 domains, containing over 50 spells. Each playthrough is unique.

games.name: War.exe
games.description: An incremental game where you click territories to gather intel, slowly increase your troops and resources, build a fleet of ships, unlock upgrades and new attacks, then launch invasions and conquer enemy territories.

games.name: Tailor Hotel
games.description: Tailor Hotel 是一款经营模拟游戏，你可以建造并运营属于自己、独一无二的酒店。

games.name: PactSworn
games.description: 在这款逆弹幕Rougelike生存游戏中对抗无尽的野兽和敌人！赚取金币、购买武器并升级角色，打造独特又疯狂的 build，迎战一波波永无止境的敌人。解锁各式各样的英雄与武器，打造专属于你的战斗方式！

games.name: Endless Bounce
games.description: Roguelite pinball: build your own table, one run at a time. Place bumpers, combine them into stronger ones, collect perks and fight through five worlds and their bosses. Every run chases a new highscore — and a place on the leaderboard.

games.name: Femboy Hot Springs
games.description: Burned out by city life, Kazuki inherits a debt-ridden hot spring inn in a snowy mountain village. Save the inn, grow close to four adult femboys, and choose your ending in a heartfelt 18+ visual novel of warm water, cold nights, and melting hearts.

games.name: PUSH MID
games.description: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.

games.name: Sexy Vacation
games.description: A story-rich adult visual novel where your choices shape your summer. Choose your name, escape to a beautiful seaside town, and build intimate connections with Aria and Maya. Every decision matters—from sunlit adventures to private moments after dark.

games.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
games.description:
按你组建的方式行动，按你组建的方式取胜。只凭你的设计来战斗的机体对战。

组装全高18cm的自律型模型机体「希格诺斯」，以流程图式的「思考图块」构建行动逻辑。战斗中无需任何操作。希格诺斯只依循你所设计的逻辑，自动进行战斗。

games.name: Kristi Sky Islands
games.description: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

games.name: Trust The System
games.description: 全体员工须知。不得擅离工位。不得提出无谓的问题。务必信任系统。一款剧情向增量游戏：您机械地在文件上盖章，直到有一天，您潜入禁区走廊，发现您的工作背后究竟隐藏着什么。

games.name: Wager of Banners
games.description: Your village is one of several on a small island, and none of the others intend to stay small. Build it out of what it already makes, sharpen a deck that reshuffles every night, and pick your fights carefully. Beaten villagers here are not killed. They are taken, and they do not come back.

games.name: Raid Leader Simulator
games.description: Lead a fantasy raid guild in this management strategy game. Recruit and develop raiders, build lineups, negotiate contracts, manage morale and loot, and direct your team through tactical boss encounters.

games.name: BotForge
games.description: 《BotForge》是一款紧张刺激的 Roguelite 自动战斗游戏。在这里，策略配装、自定义电路以及精准的过热管理将决定你每一次尝试的命运。打造你的终极机甲，优化核心系统，并灵活调整战术，在越来越残酷且致命的外星入侵者攻势中求生。

games.name: Cute Kitty WAR
games.description: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

games.name: Fast Food Fortune
games.description: 如果你受不了热,就离开厨房吧！Fast Food Fortune 是一款休闲餐厅模拟游戏,您可以带领餐厅从财务崩溃的边缘走向快餐财富。购买升级产品、更新您的餐厅、雇用员工并管理您登上快餐连锁店的顶峰。

games.name: Three Kingdoms Story
games.description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

games.name: Five to Fire
games.description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

games.name: One Night Liar
games.description:
【仅此一夜互相欺骗的ADV】
你将伪装成已遭杀害的女性，潜入在豪华客船中举办的同学会，以“谎言”为武器，解决这一系列的案件。

games.name: 随侯珠
games.description: 一个关于秘密与相遇的故事。失踪的灵蛇、将至的蛇会与排外隐秘的南方山镇，搅动了外来者侯觉原本短暂的旅程。

games.name: Cargo Tempo
games.description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

games.name: 桃园幸存者：匡扶汉室
games.description: 《桃园幸存者：匡扶汉室》是一款以汉末三国为背景的幸存者类动作游戏。操控刘备集团的英杰，在万军围攻中移动、成长、收集武器与装备，锻造神兵、召唤义盟，在一次次战斗中踏上匡扶汉室的征途。

games.name: Chocoletters
games.description: Chocoletters is a cozy roguelike deckbuilding word game with a milky-smooth twist. Fill your Collection with tasty chocolate treats, spell the best words you can, and combine sweet bonuses to whip up deliciously absurd scores.

games.name: PROBATION: EXTENDED COVERAGE
games.description: 你在一套靠沉默说谎的公司操作系统里分拣请求：盖住一个窗口，它就会一脸笃定地继续显示昨天的数据。每一桩案子都藏在两个窗口之间的缝隙里，而这栋楼里有人正指望你不去看。Meridian 对你的进步深感满意。

games.name: 山海绘卷
games.description:
在山海之间，筑起属于你的城。
从一间草舍、两双闲手开始，伐木、挖掘、营造、立法…… 把无名之地，一步步建成水墨山河间的繁华名城。

games.name: Simple Football League Manager
games.description: 一款献给热爱足球、却不想在每个细节上花费数小时的玩家的足球经理游戏。组建球队，从5909家俱乐部中选择执教对象，征战联赛和杯赛，并听取助手罗布的分析。包含2种难度、本地多人模式，以及可轻松自定义的数据库。

games.name: A Little Faraway
games.description: 有些日子，當你只是需要一个安静待着的地方。来这座远方的小岛，度过一段静谧自在的时光。按照自己的步调漫游，看着天空变幻，发现身边那些小小的奇迹。没有催促，没有期待，也没有非做不可的事情。

games.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
games.description: 在海量僵尸潮中展开塔防战斗。建造炮塔，守卫你的防御塔，并体验 Roguelite 与幸存者类玩法的成长系统。

games.name: 大烟枪
games.description: 大烟枪是一款像素风格，垂直俯视角动作游戏：你将扮演一支香烟，从电子烟手里拯救自己的族人。枪战、近身搏斗、处决——杀死你看到的一切，否则就会被杀死。

games.name: Ghostyard
games.description: Ghostyard is a choose your own adventure puzzle game. Spend 5 days working in a graveyard and find out what happened to the previous graveyard keepers. Talk with ghosts and bury bodies while trying to manage your limited resource - time.

games.name: 绝对音感 花园鳗
games.description:
嗖地一下伸长，你的音感！

越玩越上瘾的音感猜谜游戏！以花园鳗伸长的长度为线索，猜出正确的音高吧。

与可爱伸长的小伙伴们一起享受，只需几分钟就能轻松游玩的疗愈系音感训练。

games.name: Horny Orc Alchemist 🧪🔞
games.description: 一款融合视觉小说元素的性感炼金术与商店经营模拟游戏。经营你的魔法炼金术商店，制作药剂，结识迷人的角色，揭开他们的故事，并在这场充满诱惑的奇幻冒险中面对意想不到的后果。

games.name: Fungus Co.
games.description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

games.name: Heroes of Aetheria: Crystal Siege
games.description:
虚无如潮水般涌过边境，击碎城墙，将城市化为灰烬。传统的防御游戏曾将你贬为被动的旁观者。在这里，规则变了。

无论是历经百战的剑士还是奥术法师，你将亲自踏上战场！

games.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
games.description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

games.name: ManiWheel
games.description:
A mani wheel is a Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheel said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture when spun.

Arrange letters, spin the wheel, accumulate Virtue and Mercy, and reincarnate again and again. Discover powerful interactions and find your own path to enlightenment.

games.name: Deepstrata
games.description: Fly your mining pod into the crust of Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto. Drill deep, haul ore up, and pour the profits into your rig. Fuel always burns, hulls crack, and something old is awake down there. A 2D mining adventure with a story campaign, base building and a living ore market.

games.name: Obolus
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

games.name: At Once, My Lord!
games.description: 科尔瓦尔之战结束了。英雄们已经离开，至少那些活下来的。现在总得有人收拾这场烂摊子……猜猜是谁。收集超过10,000件来历可疑的残骸，把它们扔进次元回收容器。赢得Lord Shellborn的认可，也许他会亲自现身

games.name: E-Files
games.description: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

games.name: REOGUNA
games.description: 整理碎片化的文件，力争以最少的操作通关吧。《REOGUNA》是一款受传统磁盘碎片整理启发的极简风格优化解谜游戏。

games.name: Projekt Gartenzwerg
games.description: 《Projekt Gartenzwerg》是一款支持 1 到 4 人的合作型兽潮防守 FPS。夜幕降临,成千上万只陶瓷花园地精朝你的阵地涌来。拿起二战武器库,修筑防御工事,独自或与好友一起死守到天亮。

games.name: Castello
games.description: Castello is a third person shooter game centered around a crime story. While progressing through the main story missions, you are also free to explore the open-world city at your own pace. Gunfights, driving, and a variety of unique missions are among the game's core experiences.

games.name: The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier
games.description: 一款纵向太空射击游戏：你将扮演太空战舰驾驶员，冲破敌方舰队并向母星示警。在炮火中穿梭，与指挥官和首领交战，升级你的战舰，并构建强大的装备协同效果。

games.name: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
games.description: Become an adventurer set on restoring order in a shattered voxel world. Explore procedurally generated wilds, build your own playstyle with a class and skill tree, and take on bosses solo or with friends in search of lost altars.

games.name: First-Person Jigsaw
games.description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

games.name: Kaartel
games.description: Hunt a moving thief across Europe. Ask questions, eliminate cities, predict their next move, block escape routes, and intercept them before they get away.

games.name: Chaos & Seek
games.description: 3v3 multiplayer chaos: three invisible ghosts trash a house while three hunters track them by radar and suck them up with vacuums. You can't see the ghosts — only hear the crashing. Catch all three, or wreck the place before the three-minute clock runs out.

games.name: Ramen Haven
games.description: Turn a humble ramen cart into the shop of your dreams in this cozy cooking and management game. Prepare delicious ramen, delight customers, unlock new recipes, upgrade and decorate your space, and grow your small business into a thriving restaurant.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.description: 和朋友一起挖一个洞穴。这里没有重力：把球扔向岩石，它会一直弹跳，直到被岩石挡下。开采矿石，送进机器，撬开箱子，循着四块埋藏的石头，找到藏在黑暗中的唯一金块。

games.name: 地下城公会经理 Dungeons & Dynasties
games.description: 足球经理玩法遇上龙与地下城：英雄会死去，公会王朝永存！每轮赛程，都是一次地下城远征。英雄会成长、受伤、结下友谊与宿怨，也可能永远死在冒险途中。一个赛季接着一个赛季，他们的故事将成为这个世界真正的历史。而你负责创造这部历史！

games.name: CHROMATIC CRISIS
games.description:
CHROMATIC CRISIS is a colorful metroidvania with unique mechanics!

Try to get out of these artificial biomes and save the colors of the real world!

games.name: STARLINERS
games.description: 从地球出发，迈向月球与更远的星球。在这款增量式物流游戏中，建立殖民地，发展工业，规划供应链。调动太阳系的资源，建造方舟，带领人类前往其他恒星系。

games.name: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL
games.description: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL is a paranormal investigation horror game for solo or online co-op. Gather evidence, identify the entity, survive its hunts, and prepare the right ritual to banish it.

games.name: Fish & Chips
games.description: Fish & Chips is a board-game inspired fishing game where you’ll fulfill your dream of becoming a fisherman. By learning the fishes pattern you could master each zone and buy upgrades to unlock new ones. Get hooked by its addictive incremental loop as you uncover mysteries and fill your encyclopedia.

games.name: Champions Of Thaloria
games.description: An online fantasy RPG in a city built on the scar where two gods destroyed each other. Fight in real-time party combat as a Paladin, Wizard, or Fallen outcast, clear dungeons, upgrade your gear at the forge — and step into a PvP Arena where every cosmetic bonus is switched off.

games.name: 猛砸皮纳塔！
games.description: 拿起你信赖的球棒，在这个多彩的增量游戏中砸碎皮纳塔。购买武器、解锁升级、重开，并建造你那奇特的家。一切都很可爱，一切都很美好，皮纳塔绝对没有生命。

games.name: Pawn'd Chess
games.description: Play, study, and improve at your own pace in a chess trainer with human-like, skill-matched AI, full FEN tools, local hotseat, and ranked play or pressure-free practice.

games.name: Late Night Confessions
games.description: Late-night conversations can reveal more than you ever expected. Choose a girl, become the man closest to her, ask the questions that matter, and watch your choices unfold through intimate conversations, animated scenes, and multiple endings.

games.name: Chaos Chess
games.description: Chaos Chess 是一款全新的国际象棋变体，每次吃子都会演变为一场战斗。发动攻击前请三思，并做好承担后果的准备。组建军队，征战四个独特战役，在这款融合战术 RPG 元素的经典国际象棋游戏中挑战全球玩家。

games.name: Nib Unleashed
games.description: 《Nib Unleashed》是一款宇宙题材的增量射击游戏。扮演饥肠辘辘的小外星人 Nib，拿岩石当零食，轰穿无穷无尽的岩石敌群，解锁新武器、更灵巧的动作和更狂野的攻击方式。不过，石头们可不愿乖乖被吃掉，准备迎接猛烈抵抗吧！

games.name: Skewered Up!
games.description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

games.name: Punctual Monsters
games.description: 一款关于瞌睡怪兽和它们闹钟的可爱解谜游戏。每只怪兽都在自己的数字上醒来。摆好你的怪兽，让所有人准时起床。

games.name: Tell me Your Tale
games.description: 扮演 F.T.I.D. 检查员，找出谁真正属于童话世界。审问角色，检查文件与外貌，发现矛盾，并判断他们究竟是原版角色、冒牌货还是异常体。

games.name: Your Desktop Companion - Lumi
games.description: Lumi is a local-first 3D AI companion that lives directly on your Windows desktop. Chat by text or voice, build a relationship over time, react to your music, and keep the core AI experience running locally on your PC.

games.name: Anywhere RPG
games.description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

games.name: Spooky Land Defenders
games.description: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

games.name: Rome Invictus
games.description: A Roman grand strategy game where real-time battles decide the field and Senate politics decide who's still standing to fight them. Conquer, divide, and rule a living Mediterranean.

games.name: Dice Roll Society
games.description: 这是一款每次掷骰都能得分的骰子锻造肉鸽游戏。打造你的得分机器，逐面锻造五颗骰子。在掷骰次数用完前击败首领，夺走他们的骰子。

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.description: 建造一座以色彩为动力的工厂。提取红、绿、蓝三原色，通过传送带网络进行运输和混合，创造不断扩展的色谱。完成Chroma核心的需求，解锁新技术，优化每一条生产线。

games.name: SoulGraft
games.description: The spell-crafting bullet heaven where you earn your god-tier endgame. Graft runic circles to your soul, then unleash your creations on the daemonic hordes. Create 10^30 possible spell combinations and ascend to godhood.

games.name: Magician Alisa
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where elemental spells clash and combine. Fuse Fire, Ice, Lightning and Earth into explosive combos, learn ancient lore for run-wide boosts, reorder rule-breaking relics to bend the math, and craft a game-changing build every run.

games.name: UNSEAM
games.description: 以被缝合的世界为舞台的动作平台游戏。乘上攻击留下的裂缝极速穿行，地形沿刀痕真实切开。踏上旅程，找回棺中苏醒少女的记忆。

games.name: Death Bag
games.description:
A psychopath’s game, for psychopaths, by psychopaths. You’ve been warned.

Death Bag is a unique deckbuilder blending strategy and auto-combat, with buckets of blood, brutal synergies, and a twisted universe ruled by serial killers.

games.name: Augment Mahjong
games.description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

games.name: Radical Centrists
games.description: A deckbuilder where your cards are real politicians with questionably historical abilities. Discover new combos and accumulate wealth and influence. Push your luck with volatile politicians and make sure your party doesn't go off the deep end!

games.name: Historiker
games.description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

games.name: Not Again
games.description: 觉得自己反应很快？再想想吧。《Not Again》是一款极简风格的2D受苦平台游戏，它的唯一目的就是让你输。避开隐形陷阱，识破虚假的UI，在这个每次跳跃都是赌博的世界中生存下来。你能在砸碎键盘前通关吗？

games.name: 扫雷 Online
games.description: 不只是一个人的扫雷！在完全相同的棋盘上与其他玩家实时竞速，或与2–8名队友协力解开同一片雷区。加入由336个持久区域组成的全服远征世界，与整个社区共同开拓巨型棋盘。掌握Chord等进阶技巧，挑战No-Guess与NoFlag玩法，并通过3BV、IOE和3BV/s等详细数据不断刷新纪录。参与排位赛、完成任务、解锁成就与个性外观，还能创建房间、邀请好友，通过聊天与可选语音并肩游玩。无论新手还是扫雷高手，都能找到属于自己的挑战。

games.name: Afterwork Apocalypse
games.description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

games.name: 虧月の夜
games.description: Set in a remote village shrouded in early Showa darkness. Triggered by a gruesome tragedy, a modern-reincarnated protagonist is trapped in a time loop—dying only to relive it. To break the madness and rewrite fate, they must carve out a new future. A time-leap survival horror.

games.name: Eternal Chamber
games.description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

games.name: Fjordal
games.description: 建立一座北欧村庄，加工这片土地的资源。向国王进贡，或者变得强大到足以反击。一款维京殖民模拟游戏，拥有完整的生产链与资源管理。

games.name: Zeno Survivor
games.description: A single-player survival RPG set in a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic world brought to life in 3D and pixel art. Hunt, gather, and build your own home as a lone adventurer. Follow the traces of civilization and uncover the truth behind the catastrophe that brought the world to ruin.

games.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
games.description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

games.name: Punch Claw
games.description: Punch Claw is a fast-paced boxing gladiator game where you fight your way through brutal arenas, take on waves of enemies, and face powerful champions. Punch, dodge and unleash special punches as you battle through 5 arenas and take on the kings who control the fights and collect their crown!

games.name: 《爱，死亡，我的女儿》
games.description: 《爱，死亡，我的女儿》是一款免费的虚拟桌面与叙事结合的游戏。你将在老旧的软件系统中修复记忆程序，一点点找回曾经的记忆，重新理解一位母亲留下的爱。

games.name: 漢字魔導錄
games.description: 以汉字构形为核心的单人推理解谜游戏。从少数本源种子开始，组合二至四张字卡，依字形、部件与失败记录推导未知汉字。运用仪式与调律两种触媒突破八条魔法法则，在同一组材料中寻找不同答案；逐步解锁七大魔法学派、49 枚本源种子、正典试炼、成就，以及超过 2,800 道各具读音与魔法叙述的独特术式。每次成功与失败都会留下研究线索，让你把偶然的尝试化为可重复推理的知识。这不是要你背下合成表，而是一部必须亲手解读的魔导录。

games.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
games.description: 拿起你的工具，开始修剪吧！《A Game About Cutting Grass》是一款轻松惬意的割草模拟游戏，你可以修剪草坪、升级工具、解锁新区域，按自己的节奏游玩。放松身心，或挑战自我打破纪录，成为最快的割草能手！

games.name: 逃离Galgame
games.description: 这个世界就是一个巨大的 Galgame！扮演一名意外穿越进恋爱模拟 AVG 的西格玛男人，与性格各异的机甲少女相遇、对话、做出选择，并试图逃离既定的恋爱路线。贴吧老哥×机甲少女，一场拒绝按 Galgame 剧本谈恋爱的黑暗恋爱喜剧！

games.name: Prospect
games.description: Prospect is a mining roguelike where you carve through the depths of the mines on a perilous journey towards the world above. Vanquish your foes, find mythical artifacts, and forge your own path with your trusty pickaxe. Will you be the first dwarf to ever reach the surface?

games.name: 无尽仙路
games.description: 《无尽仙路》是一款以“洞天＋实战”为核心循环的修仙挂机刷宝游戏。开局选择天命，踏上修行之路；在洞天的打坐台积累修为、修炼心法，并使用炼丹、炼器等设施提升资源与战力。随后前往大地图，进入全自动进度条回合制战斗，在关卡中对抗妖兽、精英与首领，取得材料、装备和功法经验。大量的装备具备品质、词条、套装，可通过制造、强化、重铸和精炼继续成长。用洞天的长期积累支撑实战，以实战掉落反哺角色与洞天，寻找更强的功法搭配，向更高境界与更危险的区域前进。

games.name: 杠杆地产开发商
games.description: 《杠杆地产开发商》是一款房地产题材的点击增量游戏。你将化身一名富有野心、不择手段的地产开发商，通过借钱、购地、建房、卖房的循环，加上一切可能的杠杆倍率来扩张你的资本帝国。

games.name: Feet in Food
games.description: 还有什么能比美食更棒？没错！食物里的脚！好多好多脚！在女孩们周围摆放各种食物，打造独特的美食构图，然后帮她们把脚上的食物和酱料洗干净。你可不想让她们一直脏兮兮的，对吧？

games.name: 她的牛奶，我的咖啡
games.description: 最好喝的咖啡是用牛奶做的。或者更准确地说，是用她的牛奶做的……冲咖啡，加入各种食材，端给猫咪们，然后赚钱。而且你需要赚很多钱，因为你会把这些钱全部花在带牛娘约会的礼物上。

games.name: 我会在禊萩道口等你
games.description: 时隔七年重返乡间小镇，与初恋少女再次相遇。可她早在三年前就已死于一家人的集体自杀——一款追寻停滞夏日真相的日式恐怖悬疑ADV。

games.name: 我想拯救泪花！ ～和败犬女主一起轮回～
games.description: 为了让败犬女主获胜，你将与她一次又一次循环这段故事的短篇恋爱ADV。哭过、生气过、再次输掉——即便如此，泪花酱依然不肯放弃。等待她的，究竟会不会是一个更加光明的未来！？

games.name: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
games.description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

games.name: Keep Swimming
games.description: One or two Divers hunt up to six friends hiding among schools of fish in an underwater game of hide-and-seek. Copy the locals, stay fed and don’t give the hunters a clean shot. Just keep swimming...

games.name: Between the notes
games.description: A mystical psychological thriller set in the quiet village of Klavishne. Talk to the locals, learn stories, enjoy the atmosphere, pick up the pieces. But find out: who is the woman in the portrait and what happened to her?

games.name: Pikapo
games.description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

games.name: Backmarkers: A Racing Management Sim
games.description: Take over the worst team on the grid and run all of it — drivers, sponsors, the garage, every pit call. Climb a living three-tier racing pyramid where rivals rise and fall around you, in a broadcast-style management sim that remembers every result.

games.name: 72 Seconds
games.description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

games.name: Fluxgates
games.description: A roguelike where every run is a factory you wire together on a canvas. Draft nodes, connect them into a production line, then press Run and find out. Each room demands more than the last - build the combo engine that keeps up, or stall three ticks from the target.

games.name: Void Keeper
games.description: A mining and base defense roguelite. Strip the field for salvage, load up turrets and guns, then hold the line as the waves escalate.

games.name: 大英博士物语
games.description: 一款关于在英国熬完博士的像素风生活模拟。安排时间、写论文、去钓鱼、谈恋爱，也可以去赌场碰碰运气。刻薄的审稿人、逼近的截止日、最后那场答辩，全都变成回合制卡牌对局。用你自己的研究攒出一套牌组，看看能走多远。

games.name: Project Legend
games.description: 体验一名足球运动员的生涯，而不是经营整家俱乐部。争取上场时间，理解主教练的要求，谈判每一份合同，在一个只有自己数据完全确定的世界中前进。686家俱乐部、30个足球国家和约23,900名不断成长与流动的球员，共同构成一段从新秀走向传奇的独特生涯。

games.name: VIRSTEX ENDSTRAIN
games.description: 《VIRSTEX ENDSTRAIN》是一款融合军事科幻与生化恐怖元素的2D横版动作游戏。玩家将扮演军校青年“雾岛海”，使用射击、近战、格挡、冲刺和特殊装备，对抗感染者与军方强化士兵。一场突如其来的事故让设施彻底失控，而敌人口中的“FIRST”揭开了海身世的谜团。与伙伴并肩突破七个危机四伏的区域，揭开利用病毒推动人类进化的绝密计划“VIRSTEX”背后的真相。终结感染，与伙伴一起活着回来。

games.name: Herd League
games.description: 在这款农场策略游戏中，将小小畜群发展成繁荣牧场。繁育并兑换动物、管理草地、扩建土地、保护畜群免遭狼群袭击，并与其他牧场主竞速，率先达到目标奶牛数量。支持单人或在线游玩。

games.name: Wild Spirits Era
games.description: Wild Spirits Era is an online multiplayer social survival game for up to 50 players. Explore a newly generated world, gather Vital Energy, build, fight, form alliances, and stay protected by a Relic when the 28-minute Era ends.

games.name: Rogue’s Dark Descent
games.description: Rogue’s Dark Descent is a traditional roguelike about exploring a dangerous, procedurally generated wilderness and the forgotten places beneath it. Fight, explore, meet survivors, uncover lost history, find powerful artifacts, and see how long your story lasts.

games.name: SUMOO
games.description: SUMOO 是一款极简风格的网格解谜游戏，数字会滑动、碰撞并相加。每个关卡都有一个指定目标数字。利用陷阱、传送门和倍增格，将正确的数值送到目标格。

games.name: Border Control Together
games.description: Border Control Together is a first-person border checkpoint simulator for 1-4 players. Check documents, inspect vehicles, uncover contraband, manage your earnings, upgrade the checkpoint, and decide whether to follow the law or profit from corruption.

games.name: Titanic Survival Simulator Together
games.description: 🚢 Titanic Survival Simulator Together is a cooperative survival game aboard the sinking Titanic. Explore the massive ship, find a way to safety, and survive the cold, darkness, rising water, and deteriorating sanity. Play alone or with up to 4 players. 🧊🌊

games.name: Disbond
games.description: PvP 多人僵尸射击游戏。2 种模式，8 个职业。你们当中已经有人被感染了，只是还不知道是谁。堵门、逃生、反击，为了活下去、为了榜首，能做的都得做。可你到底能信谁？一口就能把你变成他们，而拐错一个弯，等着你的就是那一口。

games.name: My Summer Project Together
games.description: Build your first car from scratch in a cheerful summer adventure, solo or with up to 4 players online. Earn money from odd jobs, explore the countryside for hidden parts, buy supplies, assemble every system, and enjoy the freedom and chaos of summer with friends.

games.name: Drellnathor
games.description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

games.name: Maybe... I'll go to the beach
games.description: It's a small spatial programming puzzle game.

games.name: Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites) - Final Cut
games.description: Wishlist and get the Demo! Step into a terrifying world of atmospheric horror completely rebuilt for PC. Investigate dark demonic mysteries, uncover hidden evidence, and wield powerful sacred relics to survive relentless malevolent forces in Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites).

games.name: Sexhelgard: Shadow of Lust
games.description: Enter Sexhelgard, a dark fantasy adult visual novel where you play a charming mercenary hunting a stolen magical artifact. Seduce powerful women, unravel an occult conspiracy, and discover how far desire can lead a hero.

games.name: Please Stop Breeding the Ducks
games.description: Run your very own duck ranch and store! Breed ducks, hatch new generations, set your own prices, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your humble shop into a thriving duck empire.

games.name: C3 Nightfall
games.description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

games.name: Desktop Ball：桌面弹球
games.description: 一个住在你桌面最上层的小物理玩具。手闲的时候捏两下，心里烦的时候发泄一下，拿一堆奇怪的球随便折腾。甩出去、弹起来、扣进篮筐、炸掉，或者干脆在一小片海里胡乱扑腾。

games.name: Swinging Pier Clean Simulator
games.description: 与清洁团队一起在摇摇欲坠的脚手架上于摩天大楼间摆荡,用泡沫和高压水枪冲刷掉多年的污垢,还要小心别把队友甩飞出去。独自悠闲清洁,或是四人共同制造混乱——选择权在你。

games.name: ALL EYES ON ME
games.description: 所有人看见的都一样。你不一样。在这款割草类 Roguelite 中，数千只眼睛追猎着你，而正是它们的凝视为你最强的武器充能。搜集装备，打磨配装，挑战每日与每周任务，双人本地同屏合作，或参与线上征服。

games.name: Dropper
games.description: Dropper is simple. Gather your friends and fall down dynamically spawned towers, filled with Hazards. This game has been done before.. But not like this!

games.name: Brush Rush
games.description: 画出自己的跑酷路线并成功逃脱！Meccha Tag是一款轻松欢乐的多人捉人游戏。逃跑者可以在跑酷地图中画出3D道路，猎人则拥有超强移动能力、油漆霰弹枪和拳击手套。欢迎公开匹配与直播！

games.name: Super Piotr Deluxe
games.description: Jump from platform to platform, survive enemy waves and defeat bizarre bosses as Piotr descends through giant toilet portals into an ever-stranger arcade universe guided, questioned and occasionally mocked by Peypi, his living toiletpaper companion.

games.name: Wanted Drift
games.description: Drift through police swarms and turn your getaway car into a rolling arsenal. WANTED DRIFT is a top-down roguelite car combat game: grab upgrades, smash through street props, and survive a pursuit that gets meaner with every Wanted level.

games.name: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.
games.description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

games.name: Plinko Mining
games.description: 投放镐子，开采资源，发展你的矿业帝国！Plinko Mining 是一款轻松的放置类养成游戏，镐子在岩石间弹跳，每次撞击都能开采珍贵资源。解锁新镐子，提升产量，扩展技能树，成为矿业大师！

games.name: Marry Anyone
games.description: Get married within one month—or lose your job!? Solve puzzles, use items, and change your stats (Intelligence, Age, Cleanliness, Height, and Income) as you work your way toward marriage in this matchmaking puzzle game!

games.name: La Bidouillerie
games.description: 真正的电子电路模拟器：用真实零件（电磁铁、齿轮、连杆、继电器、晶体管）造机器人、七十年代的弹珠台和八十年代的飞镖机。接好电路，通电，找出它为什么不工作：每一路电流都真实计算，每个故障都有原因。

games.name: Ghost Express
games.description: 《Ghost Express》是一款2D收纳整理解谜游戏，主角是一只可爱到吓不了任何人的小幽灵Spooky。把每家商店的货物一件件塞进箱子里，再送到隔壁的公寓。订单越堆越多，空间越来越小，Spooky能顺利完成任务吗？

games.name: リサイクルショップ回向
games.description:
3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel

Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game.

Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

games.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
games.description: 2040 年，你在一座被异世界侵蚀的都市中醒来。地形可以无限挖掘，堆叠方块就能建造房屋、城堡乃至要塞。在荒野中遇到的魔物娘，捕获后就会成为你的伙伴。她们与你并肩作战、一同生活，支撑起你的王国。而每到第 7 天的夜晚，魔物群便会蜂拥而至。筑起城墙、布下陷阱迎击吧。守住的那个清晨，你会更加爱上这个世界。

games.name: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
games.description: 结识满王国的可爱怪咖，独自或与好友一起，在故事、得分挑战、竞速挑战和对战模式中轰爆五颜六色的硬糖球，尽享这款令人上瘾的街机风卡通益智游戏！

games.name: 百鬼骰
games.description: 《百鬼骰》是一款和风妖怪题材的骰子构筑 Roguelite。掷出组合、锁定得分，在“见好就收”与“再赌一次”之间抉择；招募式神、主动使用御贡，结合福佑与灵箓改变骰局，让随机的出目逐渐变成属于你的得分引擎

games.name: VORANEL
games.description: A linear 3D puzzle game. Awaken in mysterious rooms and use the Builder Tool to construct structures, solve puzzles, and overcome obstacles. Think, engineer, execute!

games.name: Fieldmade
games.description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

games.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
games.description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

games.name: MASA
games.description: In a world where magic is born from spirits, you are a mage of the battlefield. MASA is a fantasy turn-based card game. Use four elements and magic to claim the most wins across five battles. Natural disasters twist every game. Learn magic from the spirits and play with friends worldwide.

games.name: Starving Crow
games.description: 一款合作动作游戏，你和你的朋友们都是饥饿的乌鸦。探索大自然，从人类那里偷东西，为了生存和养活你的小乌鸦宝宝不择手段，即使这意味着要从自己的朋友那里偷食物。合作，当然……

games.name: ARCHIVE ZERO
games.description: In Cold War Britain, you will work through lost reports, photographs, letters, and artifacts as they arrive at the archive. Most seem routine. Some don’t. Follow the details, connect the cases, and decide what is worth digging into.

games.name: NO CLEAN, NO EXIT
games.description: 打扫食人虫盘踞的废弃屋的联机合作恐怖游戏。最多6人一起拖地、清垃圾、消灭害虫,把清洁度刷满。房子不干净,卡车就不会开走。

games.name: Unlucky Swordsmith
games.description:
强化你的剑，成功就出售，失败则碎成一地。
不断强化来提升剑的价值，要冒险到什么程度，全由你决定。
即使强化失败，也能收集并回收碎片，用来逐步发展你的锻造工坊。
这是一款轻松休闲的剑强化游戏。

games.name: Rootrients
games.description: Rootrients is a cute yet challenging 2D puzzle game where you build and adapt root networks to feed and grow your plants, overcoming obstacles in a garden that evolves as you progress.

games.name: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist
games.description: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist is a 1–4 player co-op game where small skeletons raid dangerous medieval castles, complete objectives, avoid guards, lose limbs, interact with physics-based objects, and work together to escape. 💀🏰

games.name: Highschool J
games.description: 雪井过着平淡的生活，肩负着债务，身边只有寥寥数位好友，以及从不与任何人分享的诗篇。直到那名转学生走进教室。因为有些存在，你根本无法抗拒。你只能选择臣服。

games.name: Enarian: Orbital Command
games.description: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

games.name: 双修剑仙录
games.description: 《双修剑仙录》是一款男性向仙侠恋爱冒险游戏，玩家将扮演踏入江湖的剑修，在探索各地、结识性格各异的女修与修炼成长的过程中，逐步解锁专属剧情与亲密互动，体验充满仙侠气息的冒险与双修之旅。

games.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
games.description: 一款硬核第一人称生存模拟游戏。探索失事的货运列车，搜刮容器、狩猎并收集资源，制作武器和装备，管理饥饿、口渴、疲劳与体温，在严寒与猛兽环伺中撑过28天。

games.name: Three Kingdoms Reimagined
games.description: 公元196年，独自或与好友一同在中国入主一方。在可暂停的实时战役地图上扩张势力，再亲自指挥千军万马投入野战、攻城与单挑。武将积累功绩、结下宿敌；每一次伤亡、负伤与被俘都会延续到战役之中。

games.name: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat
games.description: A turn-based tactical wargame inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Build your own battlegroup and fight on a modern battlefield where detecting the enemy, choosing the right weapon, and landing the first accurate shot decide the outcome.

games.name: 神谕之窗.exe
games.description: 这是一款基于桌面操作系统交互的文明模拟经营游戏。扮演一名古文明的代行者，通过操控桌面上的窗口与资源，编织出文明的奇观，推演文明的兴衰。

games.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
games.description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

games.name: 霓虹赌途
games.description: 《霓虹赌途》是一款赛博朋克风格肉鸽老虎机游戏。踏入灯影迷离的隐秘酒馆，依靠老虎机摇出的三位 1–9 数字，拼凑各式中奖组合，应对接踵而至的对手。收集数字与代币，不断构筑、强化你的组合，冲击更高分数。冒险途中抉择分支路线，邂逅形形色色的随机事件，迎战实力各异的敌人，也能在补给站点休整积蓄力量。运筹策略，转动转轮，构筑属于你的无敌中奖组合。

games.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
games.description: 你被咬了。距离变异只剩几个小时。你还剩下的只有：不断流逝的时间和一间空无一人的医院实验室。识别病毒，合成你的抗病毒药，然后去试验。但每一次胜利，都在教病毒如何抵抗你。《Before I Turn》融合生存、自走棋与模拟。

games.name: 梦想翻新家：我的小岛
games.description: Cozy Island Cleaner 是一款轻松治愈的游戏，你将在岛上猫咪的帮助下，清理被垃圾覆盖的小岛。捡起海滩上的垃圾，升级你的装备，一步步让小岛恢复往日的美丽。

games.name: Pray & Slay
games.description: 在这款主动操作的增量游戏中，用神圣法术横扫怪物。投掷飞镖，让金币倍增，再腐化法术，释放更强大的黑暗形态。

games.name: 昼颜
games.description: 这是一款悬疑心理惊悚视觉小说，玩家将在女人、男人、刑警等多位人物的视角之间往返，追查发生于 2000 年城市中的连环杀人案。在实景背景与剪影角色构成的经典画面风格之中，故事将随选项分歧，错误的选择会直接导向 Game Over。

games.name: Scherbenmark: The Old Mine
games.description:
You are the Steiger, the foreman responsible for the mine and everyone who works beneath the earth.
Hire and manage miners, expand the tunnels, secure valuable ore, trade your resources and keep the mine running. The deeper you dig, the greater the rewards and the greater the dangers waiting below.

games.name: Secret Favor
games.description: A story-rich adult visual novel where your choices shape everything. Take command of a remote keep, prove yourself through war and diplomacy, and build intimate bonds with the women who serve your court. Every decision matters — from the war council to the private chambers.

games.name: Bookish Buddies: Bookstore Simulator
games.description: 独自一人或与好友联机，经营你梦想中的温馨书店咖啡馆！从邮局签收新书包裹，整理畅销书与珍稀古籍，为顾客调制香浓咖啡，抚摸贪睡的小方猫，并升级扩建你的多层书店。快来体验这款治愈可爱的多人联机模拟经营游戏吧！

games.name: Incident 24
games.description: 穿梭于色彩绚丽却暗藏杀机的手绘科幻世界，你将深入神秘的“24号古代遗迹”。在这座失落的废墟中，致命的机关陷阱与狂暴的变异怪物如影随形。玩家需要掌握极致流畅的位移技巧，在精准的冲刺、攀跃与闪避中穿梭于高危地形。同时，游戏融合了极其考验操作的精准战斗机制，每一次招架、挥砍与技能释放都需要玩家的预判。面对层层深入的未知恐惧，唯有将极速反应与硬核操作发挥到极致，才能撕碎重重包围，在这片残酷的废墟中求得生机。

games.name: BIG FEET: Football Chaos
games.description: 3v3 物理驱动的混乱足球！一个键翻滚移动、射门，把对手轰飞，再用各种荒唐道具把球场搅个天翻地覆。

games.name: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
games.description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

games.name: Blendead
games.description: 找到我。我就站在你面前。一款伪装成人群 NPC 的多人躲猫猫游戏——一个失误，你就死了。

games.name: Everyone Will Die
games.description: 守卫一座中世纪的饥饿之城，决定你愿意为生存走多远：宰杀马匹和狗，武装老人和年轻人，牺牲你的人性。一款黑暗的生存城市建造游戏，在那里，迟早每个人都会死去。

games.name: Echo Mates
games.description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

games.name: Alchemaidens
games.description: A magical-girl roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker hands, stack Charms until the math breaks, then fuse four Awakened maidens of one rank into a Final Form with its own signature power. 81 Charms, 15 Orders, and 28 villainesses between you and Cycle 8.

games.name: 2in1
games.description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

games.name: Ragdoll and Seek
games.description: Play hide and seek in a chaotic toy store! Hide among dozens of toys, but don't stay still too long or you'll start glowing on the Seeker's thermal scanner! Scramble, blend in, and survive with 2–10 players in fast-paced online matches.

games.name: Retro TV Tycoon
games.description: 在《Retro TV Tycoon》中执掌90年代电视台！购买情景喜剧与经典电影版权，编排全天24小时节目单，签署大额赞助合同，升级演播室并扩张发射网络，彻底统治全球电视荧幕！

games.name: Dark Harvest
games.description:
Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. 
Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

games.name: Beta Earth: Sovereignty Next
games.description: Welcome to Beta Earth, a text-driven sci-fi RPG with two journeys. Explore Sprawl 15 in Sovereignty or brave the harsher survival of Second Chances. Choose your class, find your footing, and make the story your own. Includes the Beta Earth Digital Library.

games.name: Apoc Wilds
games.description: A turn-based creature-collector in the ruins under a tear in the sky. Seal what you find, choose whether it evolves, and build a team of six from 100+ creatures. In Early Access while the Barrowlands story and the Crypt beneath it are built out.

games.name: Prism Factory
games.description: "Yellow light, intensity 5." That is how orders arrive at a factory that works in light. Split white with a prism, take exactly what you need, and route it to the port that asked. Every split leaves you with less. Keep it up and the whole factory fills with light. How far can you get?

games.name: Kickflip Kobie
games.description: Endless side-scrolling skateboard seshin' fun! Get technical and try to rack up points, or just enjoy flow state vibing as the steeziest little frenchanese to ever do it.

games.name: Cloudbusters
games.description: A puzzle game of logic and intuition. As an extra-terrestrial Cloudbuster, save the planet earth from its self imposed isolation.

games.name: The Neighborhood Liars
games.description: 一条温馨的死胡同。十二位邻居。人人都在说谎——而整条街都记着账。想吹哪张牌就吹哪张牌，在对的一刻拍下「骗子！」，再去搜一搜被抓之人的院子——趁内鬼还没把炸弹埋进你家。4 到 12 人的社交推理，支持语音聊天、快速匹配和电脑玩家。

games.name: Dead Keys
games.description: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

games.name: Desktop Buddy
games.description: Desktop Buddy 是一款互动沙盒游戏。你可以在桌面上给自己的布娃娃涂色、开枪、痛扁它，还能自由装饰。用熟悉的绘画工具把桌面伙伴完全打造成你喜欢的样子——好好宠它，还是不那么客气，全由你决定。

games.name: 环梦症 - Cycloid oneirism
games.description: 这是一部使用混合像素风格的视觉小说。从主角的视角回忆一段段已经发生过的过去，解开悲剧与沉默的螺旋。当梦境与现实的边界变得模糊而脆弱，你是否会做出和他一样的选择？

games.name: Pack It Up!
