games.description: 在这款需要亲自上手的增量游戏中打包商品，完成客户源源不断的订单。赶在期限前还清欠供应商的债，重获自由。

games.name: emBARK
games.description: 《emBARK》是一款氛围浓厚的叙事冒险游戏，只关乎三件简单的事：一片汪洋、一条小船，还有一群有故事要讲的可爱狗狗。

games.name: Hullstorm
games.description: 在一波波无情攻势中生存，将飞船性能推向极限！提升等级、收集废料、解锁全新舰体，组合武器、强化与进化，打造毁灭性构筑。迎战成群敌人、精英与首领……或进入无尽模式，看看自己究竟能坚持多久。

games.name: Jump Bald
games.description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

games.name: Hypnagogia 催眠術
games.description: Hypnagogia is a short, surreal, and explorative platforming game involving deep dreams, liminal spaces, and sleep paralysis demons. Navigate strange worlds, chat with weird folk, discover secrets, and escape before your nightmares finally take hold.

games.name: Shove Nova
games.description: 《碰撞新星》是一款快节奏的 2D 物理竞技场游戏。壮大你的能量球，释放强力技能，将对手撞出不断缩小的战场！善用传送门、黑洞、弹力墙和各种机关，在混乱中成为最后的胜者。

games.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
games.description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

games.name: DESKTOP CLEANER 98
games.description: A satisfying file-sorting simulator set in a retro computer. A short-circuit scattered thousands of files across the family PC and it's your job to tidy it all up. Drag files to their proper places, relax to atmospheric DnB music, and collect tools to help organize everything to satisfaction.

games.name: JETGRAVE
games.description: JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up for 1-3 players inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Blast through hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, massive war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

games.name: ONE MORE TERM
games.description: Lead a republic through 48 months. Examine documents, manage your cabinet, pass laws, survive crises, and answer for the consequences of every political compromise.

games.name: I hate progress bars
games.description: A short incremental clicker about the progress bar that stops at 99%. Destroy bars by hand, unlock skills that click for you, and fight through installers, updates and a blue screen — one bar at a time, then hundreds at once.

games.name: Dirty Derby
games.description: 《Dirty Derby》是一款支持2~4人同乐的多人派对游戏。看透每一轮阵容都不相同的动物们的特性，按照落到你手上的委托，亲手打造出相应的名次。带上装备亲自冲进赛道，挡路的家伙尽管打倒也无妨。在只会留下结果的这个地方，压过其他玩家，让所有人都认可你的实力。

games.name: Space Couch Command
games.description: One person buys and installs it on the TV. Everyone else scans the QR code and their own phone or laptop becomes a bridge station, no install, no second copy. Nobody aboard sees the whole picture, so the ship only works if you talk. Crews of 1 to 9, and death is permanent.

games.name: Sky Strike Overdrive
games.description: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

games.name: PaintScape
games.description: Ever wanted to jump inside a coloring book? Step into 3D environments where all surfaces are yet uncolored, and paint them as you desire. There are no time limits or rules, your only job is to make the world less gray. Paint whatever you can imagine by yourself, with your friends or with strangers.

games.name: ciaocargo
games.description: 在这款以意大利为背景的极简 2D 俯视物理模拟器中，掌握卡车驾驶的艺术。穿梭于狭窄的地中海街道，完美呈现你的停车几何学。在无压力的 Zen 模式中放松身心，或在 Time Attack 模式中将你的精准驾驶技巧推向极限。

games.name: CartWare
games.description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

games.name: Mind The Quota
games.description: Mind The Quota is an inventory roguelike. Each round, one item comes out of the pool. Place it in your inventory strategically so all your items work together to beat the quota. Discover new items with unique effects, and beat 5 different levels with their own exclusive items.

games.name: Spell Death
games.description: 一款以字母表为牌组的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑。抽字母、拼单词，用来攻击、格挡或施加诅咒；把字母印在改变规则的纸材上，找出每个恶魔的真名，把它从这座不再读书的装饰艺术之城放逐。界面全中文，拼写用英语：你背过的每一个单词，都是伤害。

games.name: Old Man's Sushi
games.description: 别想不劳而获，先证明自己配得上这份遗产！爷爷想把他的寿司店留给唯一的孙子你，但他怀疑你是否准备好了。钓新鲜的鱼、制作美味寿司、收集古董，完成爷爷的待办清单，证明你的价值！

games.name: Farmbound
games.description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

games.name: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
games.description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

games.name: Dude, Trust Me
games.description: 被你最好的两个朋友彻底误解。你们中的一个失明,一个失聪,一个失去声音,而这里没有一道谜题能靠一个人解开。你们三个能想出办法互相理解吗?

games.name: Fart Together
games.description: Fart Together 是一款基于物理效果的合作跑酷游戏，2–4 名玩家需要利用放屁产生的动力共同操控同一艘船，竞技模式最多支持 8 名玩家。与朋友协调方向、时机和气体动力，一起挑战充满难度的障碍关卡。

games.name: The Queens
games.description: The Queens 是一款快节奏的2至4人派对游戏。玩家轮流将卡牌放到中央，发现正确的配对时，争先拍向牌堆！克服挑战，避免错误操作，抢到最后一张牌，成为牌桌上的女王！

games.name: Gamble Hunters
games.description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

games.name: Fragments of Ember
games.description: 在这款充满氛围感的像素风平台游戏中，探索被遗忘王国的废墟。点燃古老的火把，解开环境谜题，发现隐藏的秘密，并掌握精准的平台跳跃技巧，重新点燃逐渐熄灭的火焰。

games.name: Dreadmark
games.description: A top-down gothic action RPG set over one long night, in a parish that raised its own dead. The big enemies show where each blow will land, loot gets better the deeper you go, and every endgame map lays out a new road. On hardcore a death is permanent, and the live ladder remembers it.

games.name: Final Armada
games.description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

games.name: Sudoku Nook
games.description: Sudoku Nook is a cozy, hand-drawn focused game. INFINITE, random generated sudoku boards based on difficulty with global leaderboards!

games.name: Curio by Day, Mafia by Night
games.description: Manage a curiosity shop by day and excavate hidden underground relics for the mob by night in this atmospheric first-person simulation game.

games.name: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
games.description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

games.name: Decontamination Protocol
games.description: 坐进安检终端后方，体验这款紧张压抑的心理恐怖游戏。核查值班指令，扫描出入人员，做出生死抉择。切勿轻信任何人，在疫情攻破设施之前，隔离所有的猜疑。

games.name: RunnersAndCatchers
games.description:
Get ready for a fast-paced, chaotic tag game for up to 8 players! Dash through obstacle courses packed with giant donuts and candy hazards. Evade your friends as a Runner, or hunt them down as a Catcher.

Run. Jump. Catch. Escape.

games.name: Snap Scrap
games.description: Online co-op mech sandbox for 1-4 players. Loot scrap from dwarf planets, snap it onto your mech piece by piece, and survive against waves of scavenger drones.

games.name: Safari-TV
games.description: 和朋友一起开办野生动物观光公司，把每次旅程都拍成一期 Vlog。组装基于物理的观光卡车，载着游客驰骋开放世界，选择悠闲旅行或高回报的危险路线。走私违禁品、拍下每场灾难，并修好你的卡车。

games.name: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
games.description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

games.name: 魔王大人的女仆咖啡厅
games.description: 给我点餐吧，兄弟！《魔王大人的女仆咖啡厅》是一款短篇，以咖啡厅为主题的增量游戏。招待史莱姆客人，购买升级、而让你的女仆咖啡厅成为业界巅峰。

games.name: ARCHSCROLL
games.description: 奇幻世界背景的独立动作RPG。体验精彩深刻的故事剧情，以及精美角色与场景带来的沉浸式动作交锋！

games.name: Summoner's Legacy
games.description: 招募传奇召唤物，击败成群的敌人，挑战强大的 Boss。《Summoner's Legacy》将 RPG 元素与放置/渐进式游戏的爽快感相结合，包含丰富的功能、技能与升级内容。

games.name: TapTrapGrow
games.description: Light up a pest-filled garden and turn a well-placed swat into a chain reaction. Hunt, earn gold, and unlock lasting upgrades as you discover elemental pests and take on bosses in this action-focused incremental game.

games.name: Serial Founder
games.description:
You have an idea and no company. A few signatures later you have a company and no control.

A startup life sim where investors are people, the term sheet is a document you can

actually misread, and failure is the punchline. Every run a new company, 30 minutes to 4 hours.

games.name: Family Business
games.description: Family Business is a horror game where you work in your uncle’s burger shop. Prepare food, serve it to customers, make new friends and uncover the mystery surrounding your family.

games.name: FIND ALL 10: Greece
games.description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

games.name: Junkpot
games.description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

games.name: Bio Party
games.description: Bio Party is a chaotic 2–4 player party game packed with fast-paced minigames, ridiculous physics, and plenty of ways to sabotage your friends. Compete, cooperate, betray, and survive a series of unpredictable biological challenges.

games.name: Your quest, please
games.description: Play as an NPC deciding whether the hero standing in front of you should have its quest approved or rejected using books, spells, and your logic. Make too many mistakes and your boss will happily fire you. Are you up to the challenge?

games.name: Midnight Rogues
games.description: Midnight Rogues 将道具摆放与自动战斗带入 Roguelike 牌组构筑公式。从三位声名扫地的年轻超级英雄中选择一人，购买并重新排布道具，构筑出足以“打破游戏”的组合，猎杀这座城市的堕落英雄。

games.name: Frontier Prospection: Trouble on Asteroid 47
games.description: Mine valuable resources on dangerous asteroids, haul your cargo back to base, upgrade your vehicle, and defend your convoy from pirates and rival miners. Play solo or multiplayer in an arcade-style space mining adventure.

games.name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
games.description: 从自家车库起步，打造赛车工厂的模拟经营游戏。淘旧件、买新件，或自主设计零件，维修赛车，一步步攀登各级赛事。资金紧张，零件不断磨损，艰难的抉择接踵而至：维修、升级，还是偿还债务，让车队继续生存？

games.name: Pending Review
games.description: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.

games.name: Soul of Slime
games.description: 用卡牌强化你的史莱姆，组合六种元素，让策略在自动战斗中发挥威力。存活并完成10个回合后，带着原有构筑挑战Endless无尽模式，只要还有生命，就能继续前进。

games.name: Terraform Co: Factory and City
games.description: One pod, one core, and an unsurveyed plot on a green world. Clear the ground, trap native grazers, mine metal and rock, and belt it all into a factory — then build the city that buys what you make. Fill contracts, climb the S&G-15 index, and keep the raiders off your core.

games.name: 钱生钱：历史投资模拟器
games.description: 重返 2010—2025 年的金融市场，凭借对未来的了解，买卖股票和加密货币。积累财富，应对意外开支，揭开这一切背后的故事。

games.name: 越界
games.description:
这是一款第一人称视角、多结局的日式恐怖冒险游戏。随着一次次轮回，真相也将不断被改写。
主角被拖入了一个仿若20世纪70年代日本某个村庄般的异空间。克服重重困难，揭开隐藏的真相，并设法重返现世。
你最终是否能查明真相，并成功返回现世——？

games.name: 刮刮喵
games.description: 在桌面上养一只会吐出不同『刮刮乐』的吐司猫，不管你在忙什么，吐司猫都会随你蹦跶；攒够了好感，它就会掏出一张『刮刮乐』。不必时刻盯着它，空闲的时候刮一张，解压一下就好。

games.name: Comic Shop Tycoon
games.description: Comic Shop Tycoon is a first person shop management simulator where you order inventory, stock shelves, serve customers, set prices, and grow a small comic shop into a successful business filled with comics, collectibles, RPG books, dice, and more.

games.name: BROODHOUSE：温室育种
games.description: 你的牌组是活的，会自己下崽。打出一张生物牌，伤害算的不是牌面数字，是它整个族群的人口——所以你的力量藏在你抽不到的那些牌里。养过承载力，溢出的部分就在你手上野化。一个关于群落长得比你按得住更快的肉鸽卡牌游戏。

games.name: Wheel Street
games.description: 《Wheel Street》是一款融合轮盘布局与卡牌构筑的肉鸽策略游戏。移动、合并资产，搭配策略牌，把轮盘打造成接连触发的赚钱机器！下跌时培养资产，上涨时巨额收益，让一次精心安排的落点引爆连锁收益，挑战逐周攀升的赚钱目标。

games.name: Everhex
games.description: Build one tower. Hold endless waves. Spend what each wave drops on damage, crit and six weapon mounts firing at once — then bank the run into a 453-node passive tree that carries into the next. A premium incremental tower defence: no ads, no timers, no energy bars.

games.name: National Volley
games.description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

games.name: Faultfinder
games.description: She kept the machine that holds the city up. It ran correctly for eleven years, and last night it killed her. Step through her rune-tape, watch the registers, rewind the trace, and name the line that did it. You never write a program. You read one, and you convict it.

games.name: Wayward Wind
games.description:
A trading simulation traveling between cities to buy, sell, and profit from commodities in an ever-changing market, inspired by real-world commodity movements.
Turn market knowledge, timing, and a little luck into profit as you grow from an ordinary trader into a master of commerce.

games.name: 丝袜轮盘
games.description: 这是一款末日生存挑战游戏，你的目标是需要靠老虎机赚取更多的金钱生存下去并且解救更多难民，每取得连胜将可以多解救一名难民 ，搜寻物资的同时得额外小心城市中的变异丧尸。

games.name: Cheesy Michael Ball
games.description: 在毁掉 Cheesy Michael 的人生之前，你绝不会停下。你需要的只有一颗鸡蛋。一路倾斜穿过混乱的 3D 关卡，抵达门把手，并赢得星星。

games.name: Found
games.description: Found is a narrative adventure about memory, identity, and rebuilding a fragmented world. Explore dreamlike soft-poly landscapes, uncover lost memories, solve environmental puzzles, battle curious creatures, and assemble a map unique to your journey.

games.name: WheelMate
games.description: 一辆遥控车，两名玩家。一人控制前轮，另一人控制后轮。一个人犯错，两个人买单！跨越障碍，穿梭于建筑工地，齐心协力阻止失控的塔吊。因为单凭你一个人，这辆车哪儿也去不了！

games.name: 勒忒之河 (Below Lethe)
games.description:
死者的记忆留存在勒忒河中。
从浮上河面的记忆中揭开事件真相，并在冥界的审判中证明亡者有罪。
他的罪看似无可置疑——直到足以改写判决的真相浮出水面。
即使知晓全部真相，你还能称他为罪人吗？
一款围绕记忆与审判展开、以剧情为核心的心理恐怖游戏。

games.name: Obsessing Mrs. Moore
games.description: 点击她的迷人曲线，解开谜题，享受火辣的动画，看着摩尔夫人变得更加湿润和放荡。

games.name: Dungeon Flow: Vertical Idle
games.description: 《Dungeon Flow》是一款竖屏放置地牢爬行游戏，Blackstep会自动战斗，而你负责打造他的Build。探索Forgotten Crypts，收集并装备战利品，挑战精英与首领，在每次冒险中不断深入地牢。

games.name: Femboy Futa Cafe
games.description: You inherit a cafe with two faces: a third-wave coffee bar by day, and after midnight, the city's quietest sanctuary for its femboy and futa regulars. You have 45 days to save it from the chain that wants it gone — and six people who make it worth saving.

games.name: Nozile
games.description: Nozile 是一款快节奏的砍杀肉鸽游戏，开局即拥有完整构筑。在战斗中实时切换双流派，直接吸取敌人掉落的属性球，在短短5分钟的高能对局中突破数值极限。

games.name: Mine The Core
games.description: 一款拥有整整 1,006,632,960 个方块世界的放置采矿游戏。招募团队、升级装备、挖矿、击败 Boss，然后转生！

games.name: Winnie's Arcade Pizza
games.description:
Run your newly bought old arcade pizza center, restore it back to it's former glory and find out about the strange past behind the walls of this place. fill the place up with arcades and pizzas and keep your customers happy.
See if you can you reach the perfect end, or the worst...

games.name: Gunline
games.description: A tower defence you fight in first person. One road, one base, and thirty kinds of enemies walking down it. You meet them yourself with six guns and and build different kinds of defensive turrets.

games.name: Kasane
games.description: Layer colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, verified by an exhaustive count — 1000 of them, from three pieces on a 4x4 board to twelve on a 5x5.

games.name: Industeria
games.description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

games.name: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
games.description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats挑战你拯救100只幸存的猫咪！它们在僵尸爆发后躲藏于废弃街道。仔细寻找，小心点击，合理使用提示，与时间赛跑，登上全球排行榜之巅！

games.name: Carnival Stand Simulator
games.description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the fair.

games.name: GNAP GNAP
games.description: GNAP GNAP 是一款割草式射击游戏，你需要击破诡异的气球。解锁道具和鱼叉，不断变强。提升属性至极限，击败所有将你困住的实体，夺回自由

games.name: Carnosis
games.description: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler where you steal the bodies, skills, and minds of fallen enemies. Sever limbs to disable deadly attacks, manipulate emotions to gain trust, and forge broken builds through a roguelike reward system.

games.name: The Cozy Tree Co.
games.description: The Cozy Tree Co. is a relaxing game about chopping, decorating and selling Christmas trees. Search the winter wonderland for the perfect tree, get creative with your decorating, and sell your creations to spread holiday cheer!

games.name: Sussy NPC
games.description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

games.name: Aveos
games.description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

games.name: Scrapstorm
games.description: 1-4 人的俯视角弹幕生存肉鸽（roguelite），整座城市都在追杀你。每次升级都抽卡，直到一把手枪变成铺满屏幕的灾难；同时提防车流、第三轨，以及坐镇每个区的东西。

games.name: Decadrive
games.description: 甩开一条永不结束的公路。Decadrive 是一款俯视街机竞速：无穷车流、永远见底的油表，以及每轮循环都更快更狠的十个阶段。闪避、加速、把超车连成连击，再用跑出来的奖励换更快的车和更致命的技能树。躲开卡车、撑过油表、活过下一轮。去车库买新车和新涂装，把技能树点到下一把更狠。这条路不会停，停下来的是你。再来一把，看看还能跑多远，别让油针先把你干掉。十个阶段通关后还有第二循环，高分和连击都在前面等你。

games.name: Detectimental
games.description: A metal detecting incremental game! Use your metal detector to find treasures hidden in the sand. The closer you move towards a treasure, the faster your blinker will beep. Make sure to recruit some crabs to help you out.

games.name: Lust Isles
games.description: Reclaim the Forsaken Isles in this NSFW fantasy adventure blending visual novel storytelling, RPG progression, and strategic match-3 combat. Battle monsters, unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your character, and build spicy relationships with the exotic  and horny characters you meet along the way.

games.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
games.description: 在黏土打造的桌面世界上营造鲜活的栖息地。挑选动物，塑造它们所需的地形，看着生态缸随四季流转充满生机。一款没有压力的策略游戏——足够深度值得钻研，足够平静适合放松。可单人游玩，也可与最多4位好友同乐。

games.name: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets
games.description:
Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter!
Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!

games.name: 鸽子得死!
games.description: 在地铁里大战一波波鸽群——有些鸽子还会抽烟。躲避鸽群，武器会自动开火；收集掉落的羽毛，攒出一套离谱的武器组合。等鸽子头目登场，你就知道这套武器有多重要了。听我的。

games.name: Broken Rift: Dominion
games.description: Lead a fractured human frontier in a 4X strategy game powered by a fully offline, locally embedded LLM. Build colonies, design warships and tanks, command tactical battles, and face rival empires that plan, remember, negotiate, and wage war without relying on the cloud.

games.name: Tide of the Depths
games.description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

games.name: They Keep Rolling: Incremental Ball Roller
games.description: 一款以赚取数万亿代币为目标的增量滚球游戏。滚球、升级、雇佣、循环。这座温馨又透着诡异的街机厅处处暗藏异样，但 2000 年代独有的怀旧氛围（还有各式汽水）实在诱人，让人迟迟不愿离去。

games.name: RESIDUE
games.description: RESIDUE is a fast-paced urban multiplayer extraction FPS where you raid for resources, produce contraband, sell it in the city, and grow your underground operation.

games.name: 方块前线TD
games.description: 《方块前线TD》是一款画风清新的3D低多边形（Low-poly）塔防游戏。在悬浮的方块岛屿上建造特色炮塔，体验经典布阵、自由改造地形与循环无尽生存三大模式！用金币强化防线，击退如潮水般涌来的方块魔物，享受最纯粹的策略与爽快爆杀的完美结合！

games.name: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!
games.description: 清理森林，分类并回收超过10,000件垃圾，让大自然重焕生机。解锁能力和升级来提高效率，按照自己的节奏享受轻松惬意的清理过程，独自游玩或与朋友一起游玩。

games.name: PITCHFORK
games.description: 一款在线合作地牢探索游戏：最多 4 名毫无准备的农民攀登一座不断变化的城堡，去干掉当地的吸血鬼。与怪物战斗、解开谜题、躲避陷阱，并确保有人一直举着火把。

games.name: The Producer
games.description: 让桌面多一个惦记你的人。Nook 是一款 AI 桌面陪伴体验：选择喜欢的角色，聊聊今天、一起听歌，让 TA 用有声音、有表情的动态视频回应你，逐渐记住你的偏好与共同约定。你来决定 TA 能感知什么，也能随时让陪伴安静下来。

games.name: Pack a Plush!
games.description: Pack a Plush! is a cozy collection game where you buy batches of adorable plushies, organize them into displays, and build valuable collections. Discover legendary plushies, fulfill requests, and create a collection that's uniquely yours.

games.name: The Final Departure
games.description: In the 1990s, a bizarre TV show aired once and vanished without a trace. Now, seven lost episodes have been recovered. Step into the shoes of a night-shift station master and perform your routine duties. But whatever you do, beware of the train that arrives on Platform 1 at exactly 2:30 AM.

games.name: Blackbeam
games.description: BLACKBEAM是一款轻快的俯视角科幻动作冒险游戏。驾驶探测车、击碎水晶、对抗外星生物、发展基地，并向更远处探索。白天可以更自由地行动；入夜后，黑暗、能源压力与敌对生物会让风险陡增。

games.name: Egg to Monster
games.description: 在这款轻松的2D增量经营游戏中孵化蛋、培育个性十足的怪物，并通过出货完成批发订单。安排蛋形村民收集鱼、浆果和肉，利用不同食物提升怪物能力，再把收入投入村民、孵化区域和技能，让安静的草原逐渐发展成热闹的怪物牧场。

games.name: 爪爪奶茶店
games.description: Run a cozy boba shop and craft unique drinks. Create your own recipes, unlock new ingredients, records, and decorations as your little shop grows through the seasons.

games.name: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
games.description: 你家的电脑感染了病毒！在这款类《吸血鬼幸存者》（Survivor-like）的 Roguelite 游戏中，你将利用桌面应用程序作为武器，迎战成群结队的病毒。通过恢复受损数据来提升等级，进而升级应用程序与驱动程序，彻底清除感染。

games.name: 少女机兵：背包塔防
games.description: 《少女机兵：背包塔防》是一款以现代战争为背景的网格路径塔防策略游戏。你将指挥最后的龙骑兵少女机兵部队，在城郊抵御异变生物的狂潮，为全球都市防御圈的启动争取时间。每波战斗后获取不同形状的功能地块，在a14×7的战场上拼接扩展防线，部署机兵单位自动迎敌。融合模块化背包管理与塔防策略，带来全新的决策体验

games.name: Too Much Baggage
games.description: Ever wonder where your bags go after check-in? In Too Much Baggage, keeping the airport moving is your problem. Build and expand a network of belts, route bags through security, and adapt as your airport grows. How long can you keep the world’s baggage flowing?

games.name: 熬夜神偷
games.description: 一个融合了偷与睡的派对游戏，你将扮演其中一位神偷，与另外三名对手参加公会的竞赛，亲手争夺桌上的奇珍异宝，比拼总价，决定谁才配拥有“神偷”的名字！

games.name: Ritual Disorder
games.description: Online social deduction in a cosmic-horror castle for 4–8 cultists. Follow the schema and lay out the ritual objects on the pentagram — but one of you is a traitor. Every ruined ritual ends in a vote and a sacrifice. Three successes or three failures decide the cult's fate.

games.name: LifeStock
games.description: You are a god. Mortal lives are stocks. A godlike life-trading strategy game. Draft mortal lives, trade their futures, manipulate fate and wage war against rival gods in a living medieval village.

games.name: Fish World
games.description:
弱肉强食！在无尽的海洋生存竞争中活下去！

在弱肉强食的海洋中求生的生存动作游戏登场！
玩家将扮演最弱小的小鱼。吞食比自己小的猎物不断变大，面对强大的敌人则全力逃跑！
从竹荚鱼起步，到鲨鱼、甚至是传说中的深海鱼……吞噬到极致完成进化，向在线“全世海排行榜”的顶峰发起冲击！

games.name: Slime Glutton
games.description: Defeat enemies, absorb their essence, and steal their abilities for yourself! In this cozy Roguelite, adventure through different biomes, upgrade after each run and become the ultimate slime! Steal abilities from 20+ enemy types and use them to conquer the land of slimes!

games.name: Oddments & Offerings
games.description: A first-person shopkeeper extraction game where you run a mysterious antique store by day and explore dangerous locations by night in search of rare and valuable oddities. Extract with you're loot, grow your shop and decide what is worth selling - and what is worth keeping.

games.name: Closed World～幻世残忆
games.description: 一款以探索与记忆为主题的长篇3D日式RPG。离开地球四百年，六百名沉睡者共享着同一个梦境——而这是最后一场梦。莉蒂莉亚在什么都不记得的情况下踏上旅途。十二座迷宫，380张手工打造的地图，以及一个被埋藏的真相。

games.name: Confined Space - Module Madness
games.description: A bullet-hell roguelite where your weapons wear out. Every module burns through its own durability, and when it breaks, it's gone for good. Loot, trade and rebuild your loadout between waves, adapt to whatever the next arena throws at you, and see how long you will last in the endless battle.

games.name: 轮回小队
games.description: 无限流风格游戏。独自或与你的朋友共同进入不同的世界：丧尸，奇幻，武侠，赛博朋克，修仙……完成任务并回到主神空间。在主神空间兑换多样的道具，武器，能力。可能是传说中的圣剑，吸血鬼血统，气功，枪械，魔法……拥有一切可能的主神空间，会允许你尝试各种你能想象的物品和能力，然后继续新的挑战。

games.name: KOLUN
games.description: KOLUN - 这台机器。你是1331号工人。你的任务就是工作。拿起木桩，劈开它们，把木柴装进推车，并获得代券。

games.name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
games.description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

games.name: TCG Card Chaos
games.description: 整理散落在混乱卡牌店中的 5,000+ 张收藏卡牌。查看它们的类型、稀有度、编号和符号，打开卡包，发现评级卡牌，并为每张卡牌找到正确的位置。

games.name: Gods of Eternity: Sex & Death
games.description: GODS OF ETERNITY: SEX & DEATH is a story-driven adult visual novel about love, mortality, desire, and choice. Follow Cassian through six mythic afterlives filled with divine romance, ancient mysteries, dangerous gods, animated adult scenes, and plenty of sex.

games.name: Drainer
games.description:
使用你的HP作为弹药，击退一波又一波的敌人。强化自己，解锁新的武器和能力。

掌控暴君的心脏。找到他。惩罚他的罪孽。

games.name: Island Farm
games.description: Island Farm is a cozy strategy game where you discover high-scoring plant combinations as you unlock new crops, level up your upgrades and expand your island.

games.name: Night Drive
games.description: Night Drive is a minimalist, ASCII-rendered pseudo-3D night driving simulator. Cruise down endless, quiet highways and illuminate the dark road ahead.

games.name: 涂鸦学院
games.description: 校园奇幻题材的自走棋游戏，收集并融合卡牌，搭配英雄、种族与职业羁绊，组建阵容进行战斗。

games.name: 想要成为 Rap star 吗？
games.description: 没有名气，没有资源，只有一支麦克风和一个梦想。从地下舞台开始，创作你的音乐，挑战对手，积累声望，成为下一位说唱传奇。

games.name: Odd Express
games.description:
Discover the rules of the anomaly and survive the night.

A mystery horror game set aboard a long-distance train. Explore the train and gather clues during the day, then prepare for the night. Deduce the anomaly's behavior, survive seven days, and make it to the final station.

games.name: Clawstral
games.description: A charming claw machine-themed roguelite! Never underestimate the claw!

games.name: You'll Be Mined
games.description: 你在地牢里迷了路。这是一款以扫雷为核心的增量式地牢探索游戏：清理雷区，收集强化，购买倍率加成，让小小的数字带来高得离谱的分数。这里到处都是骷髅，有些还巴不得你永远走不出去……

games.name: BOOMSTICKS
games.description: BOOMSTICKS is a 1v1 to 4v4 aerial bloodsport played on broomsticks with one shell in the chamber. Throw the ball through their hoop, kill riders at close range, redirect the ball with your pellets and hunt the Golden Switch when a tied match goes to overtime.

games.name: Archronica
games.description: Stack Blessings on the board and unleash Resonance. A deliberate, board-focused card battler fought across a 2×3 grid. Build two-element decks, awaken your Legends, and follow the tale of the Awakened as an ancient Demon Lord stirs. Solo battles and story mode. Earn cards by playing.

games.name: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
games.description: 一款短小精悍的增量式塔防游戏，拥有庞大的技能树！招募可爱又致命的动物伙伴，购买强力帽子，建造建筑，分配工人，解锁强力升级，喂饱 Frog King！

games.name: Chick 'n Gun
games.description: Run, Jump and Gun! Platform in this evil nugget factory, by using your GUN in an unconventional way to help the chicks escape.

games.name: MALEDICTION
games.description: MALEDICTION is a first-person psychological horror experience. Explore an eerie, shifting residence where an unspeakable tragedy took place. Search for clues, unlock hidden spaces, and piece together the dark truth behind the curse to reach multiple endings.

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.description: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Drawmi: Twin Stick
games.description: An action-packed twin stick arena shooter where you can draw all of the enemies, players, weapons, and obstacles.

games.name: Runecast
games.description: 掷出符文，布置阵型，见证每个决策如何影响战局。在这款像素风自动战斗游戏中，合成英雄、选择进阶路线、分配装备，为强敌做好准备。

games.name: 听哨：打字塔防
games.description: 最强的英听反射特训「听打」，这款游戏将听打完美融入塔防，让你人在紧凑的战场节奏中，不知不觉进化出英语直觉！　　当你听出面板上缺少的英文单词，完成输入，炮火随即落在最前线的敌人身上！

games.name: Tight Turn
games.description: A challenging driving game where you navigate an oversized vehicle through narrow roads, tight turns, and obstacles that seem to have been placed there to make your life harder. Can you make it through without getting stuck?

games.name: Overdue
games.description: 独自一人，或与最多三位好友一起，在闹鬼的图书馆值夜班。接待古怪的读者，完成工作，并从书架间潜伏的威胁中活下来。挣到薪水，遵守规则，揭开贝尔韦瑟试图埋葬的往事。

games.name: Passion
games.description: A story-driven 16-bit-style JRPG blending noir mystery, comedy, horror, and psychedelic weirdness. Investigate a strange town, explore dangerous dungeons, and master tactical ATB-inspired combat where timing, status effects, and preparation matter.

games.name: Knick
games.description: 折叠、旋转、拆分、重组纸质链条拼块。每颗双脚钉都是一个铰链。把平直的链条弯成硬纸板上恰好缺少的形状。小小纸艺工坊里的120多个关卡。

games.name: The Phantom of the Opera: Sex & Requiem
games.description: A gothic psychological horror visual novel set inside a restored opera house where impossible acoustics, preserved memories and a masked woman beneath the building blur the line between architecture and the supernatural.

games.name: 日本四季百景
games.description: Explore Japanese scenery and culture through spot-the-difference puzzles, jigsaws, and sightseeing quizzes. Take your time with each view. The demo contains the first chapter set in Okayama.

games.name: Stockroom Syndrome
games.description:
Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls.

HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

games.name: Giusto
games.description:
Bidding for tricks in the forest.  Be perfect, or be punished.

Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts.  Players are scored based on the accuracy of their pre-game predictions. Low score wins.

games.name: Dread of the Deep
games.description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

games.name: The Wrong Way Round
games.description: 你们被困在一座诡异的小镇里，无论从哪条路离开，都会从另一边绕回来。和最多5名好友一起探索小镇，揭开隐藏的秘密，在冰冷的迷雾吞噬一切之前找到回家的路。

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.description: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Corposlop
games.description: 《Corposlop》是一款住在你桌面上的自动化游戏。用官僚手段采收资源，再精炼成元件，喂养企业这台机器。建造精密的工厂和高效的管道，把手上有限的土地用到极致。

games.name: White Christmas
games.description: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

games.name: Rally Together
games.description: 你是技师，不是车手。赛车会带着一身伤回到维修区，而计时器不会停：轮胎、钣金、燃油、 轮毂螺母。没做完的部分，会在下一个赛段变成秒数还给你。1-6 人合作维修区。

games.name: Observer Effect
games.description: As an unwilling contestant, take part in a twisted game show, a first-person psychological thriller where you solve puzzles, try your luck, test your aim & face unpredictable games. Uncover the secret objective, outsmart the host & race against the clock to survive the show... if you dare.

games.name: Blue Water Builders
games.description: Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management and shipbuilding game set during the golden age of industry. Design, build, launch and manage your own fleet as you take a small shipyard from its humble beginnings to a major force in the world of shipbuilding. So, how far will you take your shipyard?

games.name: CRAGGFALL
games.description: You are a rock. Craggfall is a physics-driven momentum game where you roll, leap, and crash a living rock through dynamic terrain. Shatter what stands in your way as you explore mysterious worlds. Build up speed into huge air, and relive every glorious wipeout in instant replay.

games.name: TOO MANY CLANKERS
games.description:
一款围绕一个简单问题展开的增量式塔防游戏：TOO MANY CLANKERS。
构筑夸张至极的火力，将CLANKERS轰成废铁。

games.name: Dear Gardener
games.description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

games.name: Nostalgiallo
games.description: A surreal point-and-click with vote-based combat, taking place in a corrupted world based on Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

games.name: BRAINFREEZE
games.description: A first-person ice cream roguelike. Serve the line, hit the quota, and hand every cent to a boss who is very clear about what happens if you come up short. Draft cards between shifts to build a run that survives one more day. The truck is locked. The phone is ringing. Get scooping.

games.name: Little Bettas
games.description: 《Little Bettas》是一款温馨的水族箱模拟与生物收集游戏，你可以繁育、照料、装饰并发现美丽的斗鱼。解锁独特的颜色、花纹与突变，寻找稀有的传说斗鱼，打造属于你的宁静水下收藏。

games.name: MUSTER
games.description: A roguelite autobattler where every dig shapes your next fight. Build, equip, and position a five-digger warband from twenty different characters, then watch your plan play out in automatic real-time hex battles. Read the buried grid to uncover recruits and loot—or wake a pocket of monsters.

games.name: Replay Rumble
games.description: Fight alongside your past in a fast paced multiplayer arena! Every round adds your previous actions back into the battle, turning simple fights between four unique characters into ever growing temporal chaos.

games.name: shlack!
games.description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

games.name: BLOODCAST
games.description: Shoot. Dodge. Climb. Repeat. BLOODCAST is a frenetic fast-paced 2D shooter buried in TV static and carnage

games.name: SIFT
games.description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 85 handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

games.name: Sausage Snap
games.description: Two skewered sausages fill a close-up plate. Aim a fork, jab the meat into theirs, and watch it stretch, spray, and snap. Best of 3. Local 1v1 or vs CPU. Short rounds. Instant rematch.

games.name: Reel Collectibles
games.description: Cast a line, hook a pack of baseball cards, and fight it to the boat without creasing it. Rip your wax, file the cards, and work through fifty years of sets from 1950 to 1999. A 16-bit collecting game about the pull, the binder, and the grade.

games.name: Warharvest RTS
games.description: 一款采用 3D 像素画风的传统即时战略游戏。在中世纪奇幻世界中采集资源、建造基地，并以小队为单位指挥部队。四个阵营拥有各自的兵种，玩法机制大不相同。你可以在手工设计或程序生成的地图上对抗 AI，也可以参加最多 8 人的 PvP 对战。

games.name: JUST SHOVEL IT!
games.description: 雪下了一整夜，而且不会自己化掉。在新年之前把院子清理干净：一把铲子，一台炉子，窗户里的暖光，以及完全不必着急的节奏。

games.name: 잿빛의 행성 별빛편
games.description: 乘坐闪闪发光的宇宙飞船，一起在银河中旅行的冒险游戏。

games.name: Horror Game Creator
games.description: Horror Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiences—from quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

games.name: LumberBoy
games.description:
探索多样的森林，砍伐树木，
加工原木并不断成长，体验独特的伐木放置成长玩法。
从一把斧头开始，突破能力极限，成长为森林里最强的传奇伐木工吧！

games.name: 医院狂想曲
games.description: 打造你的医院，邂逅属于你的特别关系。从日常的医院管理到私下的交流互动，在忙碌的工作中逐渐了解她们的故事。当信任与好感不断加深，你将发现隐藏在白衣之下的另一面……

games.name: A Cat's Little Pond
games.description: A cozy incremental game about a hungry cat and its little pond. Grow your pond, collect fish and curious creatures, unlock new skills, discover rare relics, and watch your tiny ecosystem come to life.

games.name: 三国之北地剑宗
games.description:
游戏玩家QQ群：735848705   欢迎加群交流玩法反馈意见！
中平六年，董卓乱京，天下分崩离析。
你是幽州边境一名普通流民，无权势、无名师传承，手中仅有一把锈迹斑斑的铁剑，在胡骑、乱兵流寇横行的北地挣扎求生。
濒死之际，【北地剑宗开宗系统】与你绑定。你将以一介小人物之身，从零开创属于自己的剑道门派。

games.name: AETHERIA
games.description: 在可360度自由飞行的3D空间中击破大批敌人，体验高速空战Roguelite动作游戏！将自动攻击、技能与随机强化相结合，打造专属于你的构筑，迎战从四面八方涌来的敌人和巨型头目。

games.name: Pig Up
games.description: 《Pig Up》是一款第三人称 3D 平台跳跃冒险游戏，操控小猪攀登悬浮平台、穿梭奇幻异世界，寻找失散伙伴，一步步揭开时空乱流背后隐藏的真相。

games.name: 删牌与无限：地牢牌
games.description:
这是一款策略Rogue-like卡牌构筑游戏。
在酒馆中，体验分数不断累积的快感，以及打牌后收获成堆的金币的喜悦。
在地牢中，通过策略与构筑，组合上百种随从与道具，击败上百种技能各异的怪物。
在有限的回合，如何利用资源获取最多的分数，将会是游戏胜利的关键。
如果你的运营足够出色，你的角色将拥有BOSS级别的属性，或达成一回合无限出牌碾压敌人。

games.name: Block Planet Frontier
games.description:
Move freely in eight directions and hit the blocks with the shots fired from your ship to colonize the planet! Collect resources to power up your ship!
A pixel-art action shooter. Supports online co-op play.

games.name: 逃家少女同居中 ~和阴郁电玩宅JK的甜蜜蜜同居生活~
games.description: 因某个原因离家出走的阴郁JK表妹，光子来到你身边! 陪她一起聊天、让她给你躺膝枕，或是一起睡觉! 请好好享受与阴郁JK光子的「纯爱」同居生活吧♪

games.name: MARSTEAD
games.description: 从3名坠毁事故幸存者起步，在这款殖民地模拟游戏中建设火星定居地。保障氧气、水和电力，种植作物、烹饪饭菜、制造装备。管理各具特质与人际关系的定居者，与外星种族交易，抵御袭击，通过研究不断扩展定居地。

games.name: Rate & State
games.description: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

games.name: The Grand Furnace
games.description: 《天地洪炉》是一款由 AI 实时演绎、世界持续运转的仙侠人生模拟。没有固定剧本：天地自行运转，众生各有营生——你不看它，它也照样活着。修行问道、结交人物、结怨树敌、探寻机缘，在一次次选择中走出自己的道途。不止是你：众生说过的话、做过的事，天地都记着，也都会留下回响。天地为炉，造化为工——过你自己的仙侠人生。

games.name: One More Shift!
games.description: One More Shift! is a strategic match-3 roguelite RPG where you shift entire rows and columns to attack. Master seven elements, build powerful synergies, and carry your evolving board through a branching expedition.

games.name: SumMon
games.description: Capture monsters and shapeshift into them, several at once. Combine their elements in turn-based battles on a hex-grid battlefield. Embark on an adventure to defeat the Summoner Masters and become one.

games.name: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
games.description: 《变废为宝》是一款超级解压、惊喜不断的翻垃圾桶增量游戏。翻找垃圾寻找宝藏，也许下一个垃圾大王就是你。

games.name: Midnight Arcade Orchestra
games.description: Midnight Arcade Orchestra takes you back to the good old days of arcades packed with retro games. Except... every single one of those games is actually a rhythm game. We’re not sure why, either.

games.name: TOWERTOWER
games.description: 堆叠，迷惑，一网打尽。用方块堆砌要塞的高难度塔防游戏。塔既是武器，也是墙，更是迷惑敌人的地形。放过50个敌人，游戏就结束了。

games.name: Chill Rogues
games.description: Chill Rogues is an incremental action game with automatic combat, build crafting, and ongoing prestige.

games.name: Digbound
games.description: Digbound 是一款轻松惬意、流程精简的第一人称采矿游戏。挖掘地下，发现珍贵矿石，出售你的收获，并升级装备以探索更深的区域。

games.name: Toy Battles
games.description: 在这款类肉鸽自走棋中组建你的玩具战队，叠加增益，连锁引爆足以打破平衡的连招组合。每局都能解锁全新内容，无尽羁绊等你发掘——打破游戏规则吧！

games.name: Rotten Keep
games.description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

games.name: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up
games.description: 修复 The Grand Book Archive，将 2,990 本书归置到它们各自应在的书架上。运用你的观察力和魔法咒语，以最快的速度整理这批藏书。探索丰富多样的书籍主题，在 The Grand Book Archive 中发现无限可能。

games.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
games.description: 《Damage Numbers Go Brr!/伤害数字刷屏》是一款轻松的放置养成游戏，战斗全自动。打怪，越变越强，看着伤害从个位数涨到后面拖一长串零，跟着音乐放空，屏幕上全是伤害数字。

games.name: Who Is Wrong
games.description: Co-op psychological horror for 2-4 players. You're all in the same room — but you don't all see the same room. Describe what you see, find the anomalies, seal them before time runs out. When the portal opens, it judges each of you alone.

games.name: BEAR THE BURN: A Stock Market Deckbuilder
games.description: Bear The Burn is a ruthless desktop-overlay stock market deckbuilder. Buy illegal trading cards, manipulate live market charts, and chase massive multipliers. Will you cash out early or risk the ultimate margin call?

games.name: 核子精灵
games.description: 《核子精灵》是一款俯视角的生物收集构筑类游戏，你将扮演一位拥有变身能力的新生生命，收录并变身成为不同的核子精灵，利用多样的基因自由构筑精灵的能力。探索，战斗，收集全新的精灵信息，一路前进，找到世界的真相。

games.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator
games.description: Run a traditional Turkish tea house with up to five friends online. Brew cay, grill toasties and race trays out to the shopkeepers next door. Keep the okey tables from turning into a brawl, take bets on match night, dodge the tea inspector and settle with the tax man - however you have to.

games.name: GRAVENTH
games.description: Descend into dangerous caves, mine valuable resources, fight deadly creatures and escape with your loot. Upgrade your gear, expand your underground safe zone and push deeper each run. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

games.name: Not Alive Enough
games.description: A new wave of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. Inspect every survivor, identify the infected before they turn, and stop the outbreak from spreading to the outside world in this tense zombie apocalypse screening simulator.

games.name: Flame, Cats & Kitchen
games.description: 画出食材，烹饪它们，喂饱饥饿的猫咪！在缤纷纸艺厨房体验温馨烹饪游戏。剪下你的创作，用特制蜡笔增添风味，并用火候和搅拌做出让每位客人满意的餐点。

games.name: Trap Testers
games.description: 《Traps Testers》是一款基于物理效果的合作式死亡跑酷游戏，陷阱由你亲手布置！与好友一较高下，争先冲过终点，并在途中想办法干掉他们。

games.name: 王国英雄：餘音
games.description: 化身为一名朴实的草药学徒，沉浸在一段温馨惬意的治愈系冒险RPG旅程中。当未知的疫病威胁到宁静的家园，你将深入神秘地穴与古老遗迹，借助炼金术的力量救助受难的人们。在逐步拯救与重建整片大地的过程中，享受心灵被慢慢治愈的无尽欣悦。

games.name: Harvest Exit Plan
games.description: Nico's grandparents just gave him the orchard he spent his whole childhood resenting. The plan is to strip it bare, sell it, and never touch an apple again. Six gardens, three tools, and a season system that keeps handing him a reason to start over.

games.name: Dicepot
games.description: 你在酒馆里输掉了一切。如今，一位女巫向你提出交易：用你的灵魂换取一笔财富。掷出会分裂、会自转、会引发连锁反应的骰子，雇佣助手，融合骰子，看着一次投掷变成堆满成百上千枚骰子的赌桌。一款像素风放置游戏。

games.name: The Weigh Station
games.description: 在一座荒凉的称重站,检查卡车,核实货运清单,并合理分配电力。在有东西靠近之前,封锁你的岗亭门。每一点电力都至关重要,因为电池耗尽时,你唯一的选择就是走进外面的黑暗,以及那些和你一起在那里的东西。

games.name: Drain the Galaxy
games.description: 把成千上万的矮人塞进星舰货舱，把整颗行星挖到骨头都不剩。镐子砸，激光切，导弹轰，在岩层深处咬住矿脉——然后把挖来的东西全换成银河币。没战术，只有规模，只有数字，它们飙得比你眨眼睛还快。

games.name: CARKNIGHT
games.description: 驾驶一辆全副武装的重型战车，在这款高速刺激的 Roguelike 生存游戏中摧毁成群敌人。自由搭配武器、底盘与车轮，打造独一无二的配置，创造出最符合你游玩风格的战斗机器。

games.name: Rock Paper Viking
games.description: You are the sole defender of the Cardboard Castle! Pick up new weapons and magic abilities as you progress. Level up your loot to gain the strength of the Norse Gods, and defeat your foes to claim victory for your kin.

games.name: Better World
games.description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

games.name: High Voltage
games.description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

games.name: Hunting Contract
games.description: Take a werewolf contract with 2–4 hunters. Search Blackwood Estate, secure the corpse in a coffin and deliver it to the truck. Spend the crew’s earnings on equipment for the next hunt, and stay alert inside the mansion: the Wendigos are waiting.

games.name: Dominions of War
games.description: Dominions of War is a fantasy strategy game blending Total War and Bannerlord. Conquer a vast campaign map, command huge armies, fight massive battles, cast powerful spells, siege castles, recruit heroes, face deadly monsters, and build a mighty empire in a world shaped by war, magic and conquest.

games.name: Hivekeepers
games.description: A relaxing and strategic beehive roguelike. Collect honey, hatch bees, and unlock powerful upgrades as your bees defend the hive from hungry invaders.

games.name: Shuriken Maestro
games.description: An incremental game where you're a novice with the sword. Lucky for you, shurikens are more your specialty. Defeat enemies using your shurikens, hone your skills, upgrade your arsenal, and progress through increasingly challenging zones.

games.name: RuinsGate Survivors
games.description: 与伙伴一起奔走于广阔地图，带回宝物并培养队伍——这是一款融入RPG要素的类幸存者游戏。除了迎战魔物大军与强敌，还能在据点宅邸内自由走动、与伙伴交谈、完成任务，逐步解锁武器、服装、家具等丰富内容。

games.name: SHERLOCK HOLMES: SEX & SECRETS
games.description: Sherlock Holmes: Sex & Secrets is a story-driven adult visual novel set in Victorian London. Uncover a deadly conspiracy through deduction, romance, hidden societies, dangerous secrets, animated NSFW scenes, branching choices, and an unlockable gallery.

games.name: Pawprints
games.description: In the dead of night as a storm brews Detective Ward finds himself at the scene of a strange murder. With his trusted partner at his side they set out to determine just what happened here, and maybe catch the cat that's tagged along to the crime scene.

games.name: The Cauldron Eats First
games.description: 收集。升级。战斗。挥舞巨刃劈开荒野，建立由工人与士兵组成的大军，并通过庞大的技能树不断升级、变得更强。面对黑暗，你能让光明坚持多久？

games.name: 痴女仙境:暗黑降临
games.description: 《痴女仙境》是一款融合 Roguelite 俯视角射击与丰富剧情的游戏。装备好你的武器，接受女主角们的祝福，然后一头闯进游乐园，与里头无穷无尽、源源不绝、不知道到底从哪里冒出来的痴女们大战♂一场！在每一次冒险中，从各种强化道具中做出选择，组合出属于自己的独特构筑。变得更强，击败痴女；继续前进；击败更多痴女；然后发现前面还有更多痴女……到底为什么会有这么多痴女啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!! 无论如何，你都必须活下去。直到最后一刻。直到游乐园重获和平。直到——将所有痴女驱逐出这个世界！

games.name: Whole in One
games.description: 你接下了一项任务：清走成千上万颗凭空出现的球。拯救大家的周末——全看你了！

games.name: LINER/TRACER
games.description: LINER/TRACER is a stylish 2D action game that combines mouse and keyboard controls. Move your character with the keyboard, then use the mouse to perform high-speed dashes, create platforms, and attack enemies. Dodge a variety of incoming attacks, race freely across stage, and take down your enemies.

games.name: Incremental Bowling
games.description: Incremental Bowling is exactly what it sounds like. Shove bowling pins into the score area, buy upgrades, and automate the whole lane to score more and more points!

games.name: Football, Sex & Glory
games.description: Football, Sex & Glory is a story-driven adult visual novel about fame, ambition, temptation, and the price of becoming a superstar. Follow Nico Vale through elite football, heated rivalries, glamorous nightlife, intense relationships, animated adult scenes, and the pursuit of ultimate glory.

games.name: Kuroi Pen
games.description: A struggling manga artist inherits a mysterious black pen that brings the women he draws to life. Build relationships, uncover buried memories, and decide their fate in a choice-driven adult romantic fantasy visual novel with multiple endings.

games.name: Fire Up Together
games.description: 在这场最多支持四名玩家的冒险中，水是你唯一的武器。利用高压水流的反作用力将自己喷射到空中，扑灭火焰，不断向更高处攀登。

games.name: Straw Path
games.description: Two months alone in a mountain shack. A locked-away gun. A silent man forced back into a world that stopped waiting for him. Straw Path is a slow-burn survival horror shooter about what it costs to go back outside — and what's already found its way in.

games.name: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
games.description:
数值成长割草 FPS，数百万丧尸爬出了坟墓…… 
而它们，个个一肚子石油!!!!!!
收割数百万丧尸。买光变态武器。当上丧尸石油亿万富翁！

games.name: Idle Commander
games.description:
Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear,
experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

games.name: CatstaC
games.description: CatstaC is a puzzle game where the goal is to reunite two cats with symetric movement, in as few moves as possible, while you collect very green (and shiny) stars!

games.name: UNDERSKIN
games.description: Dario works in a warehouse. Tonight his mind gives in. A psychological horror roguelike in pixel art: go down into his head, pay in pills, fuse 19 weapons into 171 hybrids, with a voice that is not on your side.

games.name: LARP With Your Friends
games.description: 一款混乱的 1–4 人在线合作 RPG。用你的声音施放法术，使用基于物理的武器战斗，和朋友一起攀上危险的高山，斩杀公主，拯救巨龙。

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

games.name: DwarVein
games.description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

games.name: Dragons Invasion
games.description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

games.name: Veinward
games.description: Mine, sell, upgrade, mine deeper. A first-person mining incremental game with hundreds of ores, upgradeable pickaxes and different cave systems. Explore and get stronger!

games.name: Tiny Banners
games.description: A charming pixel-art RTS. Gather wood, gold and meat, raise a village, train units, and go to tiny war against rival banners on a fresh procedural island every game — solo against cunning CPU kingdoms, or with friends over Steam. Be the last tiny banner standing.

games.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
games.description: Bouncy Ball Battle 是一款物理与策略结合的混乱回合制在线多人游戏。击碎方块以打开攻击路线，瞄准你的射击，并利用墙壁反弹击败对手，成为最后留在场上的球！

games.name: Timber & Fortune
games.description: Build a woodworking business from a humble camp. Gather timber, craft furniture, fulfill timed contracts, research new techniques, expand your workshop, trade goods, and protect your reputation as you grow from beginner to master carpenter.

games.name: Gladitta
games.description: 成为终极的地牢测试员！在《Gladitta》中，你的工作就是向反派们保证他们的邪恶巢穴能够防住英雄！在这个极具挑战性的精准平台跳跃游戏中，你需要尽快完成关卡以赚取薪水！

games.name: EXAM WATCH!
games.description: 在学术界，每个决定都至关重要。考场上，重要的不只是抓住作弊者，更是做出正确的判断。从师生关系到职业选择，你的每一步都会塑造声誉与未来。书写属于自己的学术生涯，并决定你愿意付出怎样的代价登上顶峰

games.name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！
games.description: 如果修仙不是古代仙侠，而是现代生活里再普通不过的一件事，会是什么样？在这款自动战斗的修仙构筑肉鸽里，你从小活到老：学术法，排好出手顺序，开打后看它们自己打。一世过完，家藏留给下一代，下一代接着往上修。官方玩家群（QQ）1023196497，测试招募群里先发。

games.name: ねこ部屋日和
games.description:
在这款温馨的2D像素风房间布置模拟游戏中，照顾猫咪，用家具打造属于你们的家。游戏收录60首以上的Lo-fi音乐，并配有番茄钟和秒表，适合陪你工作或休息。
还可以切换到迷你模式，让猫咪们在 Windows 任务栏上悠闲漫步，成为陪伴你的桌面小伙伴。

games.name: Aftergrowth
games.description: A top-down survival game for one to five. Wake with nothing, research your way from a stone axe to steel, build and upgrade a camp worth defending, and follow the road east to one of two endings. The other survivors keep a ledger of what you do to them.

games.name: 沣都镇
games.description: 《沣都镇》是一款中式民俗悬疑游戏。你将扮演主角付同，以故乡为起点，逐渐揭开中国最大邪教之谜。

games.name: Nightshift; Nowhere
games.description: 欢迎来到 Nowhere Medical！工资低得可怜，这次夜班可能就是你的最后一班，职场安全规范早已沦为笑话。抓起能找到的任何武器，赶紧逃出这个鬼地方！

games.name: Panic! at the Jigsaw
games.description: “Panic! At the Jigsaw” is a cozy organizing simulator where you piece together jigsaw puzzle pieces scattered across the floor to restore famous paintings. Fill the empty frames with your own hands and enjoy the satisfaction of watching the scattered pieces gradually transform into paintings.

games.name: 格域争锋
games.description: 《格域争锋》是一款融合形状放置与牌组构筑的回合制策略 Rogue。旋转并部署形状各异的协议，争夺格子、限制对手，在有限回合内通过效果联动提高战术评分，将分差转化为伤害。沿随机冒险路线收集协议、部件与补给，围绕不同机甲的能力打造自己的构筑。

games.name: 喵喵保卫战
games.description:
新上任的喵喵包工头，该你上工了！
你搭的这玩意，能撑住鼠鼠的下一炮吗？
搭工事、粘胶水、耍鼠鼠。保护喵喵，冲击高分。鼠鼠视力不好，但炮弹是真的。

games.name: Hunt The Ducks
games.description: Hunt The Ducks is an addictive shooter that combines retro arcade nostalgia with modern incremental progression. Hunt flocks of ducks, earn coins, upgrade your arsenal, unlock auto-fire systems, and build an unstoppable hunting empire!

games.name: 数学的防御协议
games.description: 在破碎的意识世界中部署角色，把数字与运算符拼成算式，让计算结果化为炮火。构筑队伍、触发羁绊，在剧情关卡与无尽挑战中守住最后的记忆。
games.developer: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

games.name: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad
games.description: 一款超迷你桌面挂机RPG，哪怕缩成一个图标也在继续运行。集结过气的怪物老将，顶回入侵的人类，帮他们夺回巅峰岁月！

games.name: Cirno’s Snowball
games.description: 刨冰太小，没人光顾琪露诺的摊子。于是她推着雪球在幻想乡里滚起来，草莓会粘上来，木箱、石头和青蛙也会。来看看你能做出什么样的刨冰吧。

games.name: Spear Dive
games.description: 拿起鱼叉，在这款第一人称自由潜水捕鱼模拟游戏中展开冒险。观察鱼类习性，管理氧气与体温，升级装备，潜入更深的海域。探索水温、浑浊度和海浪每天都在变化的海洋。收集鱼类图鉴，解锁新的渔场。

games.name: Dungeoneers Idle
games.description: An endless idle RPG with no level cap and no finish line. Build a party of heroes, hunt and craft the gear that makes them stronger, then let them fight, loot and level through procedurally generated dungeons on their own, even while you're away.

games.name: 炼妖录：无相之人
games.description: 一款东方志怪题材的卡牌构筑 Roguelite。击败妖怪、炼化妖魂获得它们的妖术，在不断变化的远征中组合卡牌、遗物与妖相，逐步形成属于自己的战斗流派。

games.name: 胡来！文字麻将
games.description: 今天这桌不讲牌理，专讲胡话！老板、前任、皇帝、丧尸……什么字都可能被你摸上手。吃牌、弃牌、凑词、组句，把一手毫不相干的字强行编成一出大戏：前任突然称帝，老板半夜私奔，丧尸开始上班——越离谱，越想胡！别问有没有道理，能把胡说八道说圆了，就是本事。

games.name: The Last Stash
games.description: 经营末世小镇里最后一家还开着门的店铺。亲手上架每件商品，给稀缺物资定价，完成小镇的委托。没卖掉的货，就搬进店铺地下的地堡：熬过夜晚，是这门生意的另一半。

games.name: 一起来开电玩城
games.description: 一起开店，一起玩！和好友合伙，一起经营你们的电玩城！从经典街机到极限体验，从街角小店到大型娱乐城——携手打造属于你们的街机帝国！

games.name: The  Drawratos
games.description: 在最多支持4名玩家的扑克游戏中，通过在牌上作画、虚张声势并智取对手。《The Drawratos》中，你必须将自己画好的牌伪装成真牌，让所有人都相信你手握强牌。

games.name: Pocket Adventurer
games.description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

games.name: Overflow Protocol
games.description: 一款以数字合并为核心的增量游戏：建造实验室，不断获得更大的数字，发现“上帝之数”。生成并合并相同的数字，升级机器并实现自动化，探索数字究竟能达到怎样的极限。

games.name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
games.description: A psychological horror visual novel set in a neon-lit motel. Work the night shift, build relationships with the unusual staff, make choices, and investigate increasingly strange events as the line between memory and reality begins to blur.

games.name: 十万僵尸冲过来啦！
games.description: 《十万僵尸冲过来啦！》是一款自由规划路线的增量塔防游戏，没有固定的路径，自由放置墙壁和火力，为十万僵尸大军规划一条“必死之路”。你可以设计蜿蜒的迷宫，也可以构筑层层防线，每一局的地图都由你亲手创造。准备好了吗？开始消灭十万僵尸组成的尸潮吧！

games.name: MoonLite
games.description: A free social sandbox set in a low-poly night park. Mix your own music stems live for everyone standing nearby, host a cinema screening, race karts, play pinball, or read a book another player wrote. No score, no enemies, no fail state. Best with headphones on.

games.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
games.description:
S.O.S 是一款以二十一点为基础的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。
收集卡牌、构筑牌组，扭转二十一点的概率。
失去一切的你，是时候重返牌桌，清算那一夜的旧账了。

games.name: 打字地牢
games.description: 《打字地牢》是一款以打字驱动战斗的 Roguelite 地牢游戏。输入地面上的单词来移动、攻击和施放技能，在实时行动的敌人之间灵活走位，并通过不同的武器、装备与技能构筑属于你的战斗方式。

games.name: HOPENOTHING
games.description: A tactical RPG in search of hope. You are a traveler who is "no one," and you can wield every weapon type. Burn your foes on the grasslands, call down lightning on rain-soaked battlefields — or simply drop them into a pit. 11 endings await, and what you wish for decides how your story ends.

games.name: Goblin Smasher
games.description: 把鼠标移到哥布林身上，你的锤子就会自动把它们砸扁。从宁静草原上的寥寥几只开始，到满屏成千上万只结束。解放8片哥布林之地，建造他们的地标，挥舞10把传奇之锤，推翻哥布林之王。手感爽快的像素风增量游戏。

games.name: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
games.description: 你和朋友们一起经营一家狗狗托管中心。结果一塌糊涂。喂饭、洗澡、遛狗，还要铲走它们留下的东西——赶在有人把门卡住、十一只狗发现大门之前。和超级好的狗子们一起制造合作混乱。

games.name: The Off-Season
games.description: 这家海边旅馆从十月到三月歇业，冬季看守人就是你。老板娘的规矩钉在柜台上方：不接客，没有例外。可还是有人敲门：搭末班车来的，淋着雨，带着现金，没有预订。给谁钥匙、给哪一间，由你决定。

games.name: Call of The Cur(s)e
games.description: An Interactive Fiction game by Not Disappointment, talk to people, ghosts and animals and convince them summon you to ‘Cure the World’. Be careful to not reveal your true plan for world domination, or they won’t summon you and the world will fall into the hands... or tentacles, of the elders.

games.name: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic
games.description: 《JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic》是一款以美术馆为舞台的单人3D拼图游戏。收集散落各处的2576块拼图，完成色彩缤纷的艺术作品。学习魔法，让收集拼块和完成拼图更加高效。

games.name: Stop Reading the Cards
games.description: 构筑牌组、设定优先级，然后看着你的策略自行执行。在这款充满讽刺意味的单人类 Rogue 游戏中，卡牌不只是手牌，而是自动战斗系统的一部分。制造荒诞的连锁组合，调整你的规则，并在一座把每次冒险都搞得像场管理灾难的高塔中活下去。

games.name: Motor Sport Unbounded
games.description: 《Motor Sport Unbounded》是一款开放世界街机赛车游戏，其灵感源自2000年代初的传奇街头赛车。探索广阔的夜幕下的城市，参加各种赛事，升级你的赛车，挑战街头霸主，并在遭遇毁灭性的背叛后重夺巅峰地位。

games.name: TimeKov
games.description: TimeKov is a third-person survival action game where time is your life. Explore the unknown planet Ananke, fight hostile creatures, recover resources, and grow your base and factory before your core runs out.

games.name: 再入江湖
games.description: 一款武侠人生模拟卡牌游戏。你死了，江湖还记着你。重生，这一世，你是名门子弟，还是乞丐孤儿？拜师、闯荡、结仇、结缘，每一次抉择都改写命运。轮回，带着前世的恩怨，再入江湖！

games.name: Lust Hope
games.description: 困在未知迷雾中，飞船Hope需要动力，唯一剩下的燃料是你的精液。作为船上唯一的男人，与三位绝色同事一起探索船体、打破一切界限、灌满五个燃料单元，保住人类。

games.name: Re:Red
games.description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

games.name: 异能超载
games.description: 带领异能者小队，将那些怪物彻底消灭！这是一款快节奏的自动战斗肉鸽/单角色自走棋游戏。

games.name: 我打魔王真的假的？
games.description: 这是一款正儿八经的自动战斗游戏……对吧？除了角色有点怪、装备有点离谱、技能有点让人摸不着头脑之外……其他方面看起来都挺正常的。

games.name: 完蛋！我被快递包围了：驿站模拟器
games.description: 经营属于你的快递驿站！接收包裹、扫码并按图标分类上架，为取件顾客快速找件，也为寄件顾客检查属性、称重、贴上分类、目的地和重量标签。一次抱起多个箱子虽然更高效，但奔跑和急转可能让它们散落一地。应对快递雨、易碎品和爆炸物，在拥挤的货架与排队的顾客之间完成每天的营业——尽量别把驿站炸了。

games.name: SpacePub
games.description:
Do you like games set in the distant future where robots are the only survivors of humanity's downfall, stuck solving environmental puzzles? Us too!

Have you ever wondered what such a game would look like if those robots were hooked on edgy humor and beer? Us too!

And that's why SpacePub is here!

games.name: TunaSweeper
games.description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

games.name: 古玩掌柜
games.description: 《古玩掌柜》是一款以古玩为题材的策略卡牌游戏。你能在鬼市和官市挑货，再摆摊忽悠顾客赚钱。古玩有真假，真品可能让你大赚，赝品也未必会亏。游戏拥有超600件古玩。伴随着不断变化的客流和行情，以及与其他掌柜的明争暗斗，你的每一次出手，都要在信息、现金和风险之间取舍。最终拥有最多银两的掌柜，才是真正的赢家！

games.name: Chick'n Chip
games.description: 在《Chick'n Chip》中化身勇敢的小鸡 Piou——一款融入大量 Roguelike 元素的动作射击游戏。射击、闪避、收集金色筹码，购买各种能力，打倒暴君公鸡迈达斯！

games.name: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
games.description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

games.name: NO KING IN HELL
games.description: Awaken as the late Demon King's children, a brother and sister with no realm of their own. Explore an HD-2D demon world, recruit monsters, and reclaim a home. Seize weakened enemies mid-battle, raise them through classes, evolution and fusion, and lead squads in a turn-based strategy RPG.

games.name: Unharvest
games.description: 在这款反向种田增量游戏中，吸干你周围一切的生命。感染所有生长之物，升级你的瘟疫，让世界枯萎，直到再无活物。

games.name: 安德里亚
games.description: 安德里亚是一款以锻造为核心的 Roguelike 角色扮演游戏。拥有独特的装备锻造系统以及变化性极高的天赋树设计。你的目标很简单，尽可能让自己变得更强并击败最终头目。想办法活下去吧，因为死亡将一切重来，但每一段精彩历险将会深深烙印在你的脑海中。

games.name: Save the princess : Cards & Chaos
games.description: Build your deck, fight monsters, and survive the chaos in this turn-based roguelike card game! With no mana or energy system, every card can turn the tide of battle. Upgrade your Hero, shape your strategy, and save the Princess!

games.name: Marble Stars
games.description: Marble Stars 是一款平台跳跃游戏，拥有 55 个悬浮于海洋上空的关卡。探索特殊能力与全新游戏机制，以最快速度抵达终点。掌握每条赛道，不断刷新最佳成绩，并在闯关过程中赢得荣耀奖牌。

games.name: Drone Horizon: Force & Effect
games.description: Design, build and configure your own drones. Brace yourself for challenging environments, discover capabilities and limitations of your vehicle, learn how to overcome them. Experiment with different configurations, flight modes, and control techniques to find the right approach for every mission.

games.name: EXORCIST K9
games.description: Breach the door, trust your extrasensory perception, and charge in with your Ghost Hunting Hound! Slain by a ghost? No problem—that's a tragedy you foresaw! Rewind to the door and break that death flag! ...Tired of dying? Take a quiet stroll with your good boy. Well, through a haunted house, anyway.

games.name: Collapsle
games.description: 《Collapsle》是一款以西部淘金热为背景、快节奏的“三消+Roguelike”高分挑战游戏。通过丰富的道具、角色、自定义选项和挑战内容，构建强力组合，冲击高分！

games.name: Hundred Thousand
games.description: One hundred thousand enemies on the field at once. Carve a clearing through the horde, build your character from a deep pool of skills and runes, and push the swarm to its limit — then survive what waits at the end of the run.

games.name: Peeling Feeling: Sticker Galore
games.description:
Peel stickers, earn cash, collect them all. A cozy incremental game about the
most satisfying feeling in the world: lifting a sticker in one clean pull.
250 stickers, holographic pulls, upgrades, workers, and a prestige system
where the numbers get delightfully out of hand.

games.name: Devour & Evolve
games.description: You are born at the bottom of the food chain, in a first-person maze that grows more dangerous the deeper it runs. Weaken your prey, then choose: devour it, or bind it and carry it home. What you carry home lives in your nest, pairs, and lays — and the egg it lays is the body you wake up in next.

games.name: BLACKOUT
games.description: BLACKOUT a 6 player co-op horror game with roguelite elements. Retrieve samples from a planetary anomaly for your creators back on Earth, and try not to perish in the hostile environment.

games.name: Investor Incremental
games.description: 从零到英雄的投资模拟游戏。从一份没有前途的工作起步，一路走向财务自由。既适合极限最优化玩法，也适合休闲放松的节奏。

games.name: Junkyard Astronauts
games.description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online co-op for 1–4 robots, Mac and PC together.

games.name: 超价
games.description: 率领一支由活生生的化学元素组成的队伍，穿越一个支离破碎的世界；每一种化学键都会改变战局。切换各具特色的英雄，组合他们的能力，控制不稳定反应，并恢复世界的稳定。

games.name: Vending Corner
games.description: A relaxing idle vending simulator that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, browse, or play.

games.name: Ducks VS Demons
games.description: Raise a flock of rubber ducks. Watch them grow and evolve! Collect loot, buy upgrades, and defend your pond from demons in this incremental clicker.

games.name: Over The Gnome!
games.description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

games.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
games.description: 一款温馨治愈、剧情引人入胜的合作清理游戏。清理堆满干草的老谷仓，探索各个房间，升级工具，并出售收集到的物品。与好友组队，在寻找一根小小的针的同时，揭开故事背后的秘密。

games.name: Get The Artifact: Violent Incursion
games.description: You have 3 minutes to drop into a hostile space station, steal the Artifact, and escape. Survive the heist then master its routes through precision time attacks, instant retries, and global leaderboards.

games.name: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate
games.description: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate is a story-driven adult visual novel about survival, desire, destiny, and the meaning of home. Guide Odysseus through a seductive reimagining of Greek myth filled with gods, monsters, romance, war, mystery, animated NSFW scenes, and a full gallery.

games.name: Dreadgence
games.description: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

games.name: ESCAPE SHOW
games.description: 一档综艺：八个人被锁进一模一样的房间，只有一个人知道怎么出去 —— 而那个人不许说话。看懂主持人的比划，做完任务，闯进邻居的房间，赶在毒气上来之前逃出去。和朋友边喊边玩最带劲。

games.name: BACKBITE
games.description: 贪吃蛇，但是决斗。两条蛇、一个棋盘，以及五种互相破坏的能力。先死并不等于输：赢的是吃得更多的一方，而不是活下来的一方。

games.name: Expediente Herodes
games.description: En 2010, un virus cósmico obliga a aislar la colonia Asturias. Horas antes de ser sellada, tu hija es secuestrada y arrastrada al interior. Eres policía, pero has abandonado tu placa; en este crudo survival horror, tu única misión es adentrarte en la zona muerta para recuperarla.

games.name: The Haunting
games.description: 与棋盘互动，在黑暗中沟通，并运用你的社交推理能力在《The Haunting》中生存下来。一款多人恐怖派对游戏。

games.name: Loop Loader
games.description: Loop Loader is a game about loading, upgrading, and unlocking loops and technology! LOOP EVERYTHING!!! Don't stop till you've broken the game!

games.name: 全胡麻将 ALL-HU
games.description: 每一手都要胡。全胡麻将 ALL-HU 是单机麻将解谜:所有牌面朝上、牌墙一览无遗 —— 规划每一次摸打与役种,让两家、甚至四家依序胡牌,一步都不能错。1,100+ 关全数经引擎验证必定有解,含 Steam 独占「珍珑」模式。无运气、无内购,纯粹的理牌逻辑。

games.name: The Needle
games.description: The Needle is a SciFi RPG roguelike game like nothing you've ever seen.  In the tradition of FTL, Crying Suns, and others, it's a deep and immersive space combat sim, with the presentation of a movie.......  That you can talk to.   Fight your way to the alien homeworld, by speaking aloud.

games.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite
games.description: 一款科幻题材的第三人称怪潮生存轻度 Rogue 射击游戏。率领四人火力小组、一只战斗犬和一架鹰式无人机，迎战永无止境、不断升级的怪潮。串联改变整局走向的协同，闯过 10 个生物群系，在虚空边缘死守防线。

games.name: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle
games.description: Solve stealth puzzles using chess movement, evade patrols, and tackle the campaign solo or in local co-op. You can also compete in real-time chess, with different maps and configurable rules, against bots, locally or online.

games.name: D.
games.description: Experience a 2D psychological horror about the fragility of the human mind. Communicate with disturbed patients, solve diagnostic puzzles, and discover the correct frequency to cure them. Face your inner doubt as you navigate the dark labyrinth of psychological trauma

games.name: The Moonless Bell - BL
games.description: 所有人都爱着允。唯独盲眼占卜师潭看见了寄宿在他体内的东西，并因此畏惧他。为了追查席卷都城的一连串离奇死亡，潭接近了深受百姓敬爱、被誉为完美无瑕的刑曹参判允，却发现他的身体里栖息着一个饥饿了四百年的古老存在。同一具身体，两道截然不同的声音。它们以不同的方式渴求潭，也将他拖入爱与执念、怜悯与恐惧交织的深渊。越想逃离，三者的命运便纠缠得越紧。以朝鲜王朝为舞台，融合巫俗、悬疑与心理恐怖的黑暗BL视觉小说。

games.name: Clickhold
games.description: Defend your castle, click down invading enemies, and build your defenses as each wave gets harder

games.name: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing
games.description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

games.name: Haeresis
games.description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

games.name: Genius Simulator
games.description: 《天才模拟器》是一款颠覆传统的幽默卡牌神作，前往末日展开降维打击！你将扮演神级天才，享受民众的爱戴，在激烈辩论中彻底击溃专家的逻辑防线！每一次出牌都是智商碾压，每一个眼神都是拯救世界的末日方程式。

games.name: MataOno
games.description: You've never rolled big ones quite like this. MataOno is a chaotic dice roguelike deckbuilder about assembling dice and building combos that massively cascade out of control. Pair item effects to stack your multipliers and turn single-digit rolls into numbers that can't even fit on your screen.

games.name: Foxalot: Steal Together
games.description: 一款最多4人的在线合作盗宝游戏。偷走遵循物理规律的战利品，避开愤怒的人类、专抓狐狸的乌鸦和敌对小队，把它们运回营地。可以单人游玩，也能和好友组队（或互相对抗）！

games.name: Echo Doodle
games.description:
简体中文 — 短描述
在笔记本页面上展开的高速手绘风2D动作轻度Rogue游戏。击败不断出现的涂鸦敌人，突破一个又一个关卡，并在每场战斗后选择新的能力与强化。将彼此契合的效果组合起来，打造属于自己的战斗流派。利用跳跃、冲刺、冲击波与空中攻击灵活穿梭战场，让每一次挑战都拥有不同的战斗方式。随着关卡不断推进，更危险的敌人与强力Boss将陆续登场。不断强化自己的能力，尝试不同的组合与玩法，在充满涂鸦的笔记本世界中一路战斗下去，看看这一次你究竟能走多远。

games.name: SORTALIS
games.description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

games.name: Expiration
games.description: 一款第一人称心理恐怖策略游戏，糖尿病化为致命的桌面对决。用胰岛素控制血糖、管理物资，并击败迪勒医生，夺得治愈之法。

games.name: 掘金鼹鼠
games.description: 挖金子，添置更多铲子，再雇一群可爱的小动物来帮忙。在轻松的挖矿时光里，把一小片空地变成热闹的矿场。

games.name: Paceweaver
games.description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

games.name: Space in the 80s
games.description: Space in the 80s 是一款伴随 Synthwave 音乐展开的无尽飞行游戏。飞船自动前进，你用鼠标或键盘控制方向，在霓虹世界中躲避障碍。选择三种环境之一，搭配六种星空主题，挑战更远的距离，刷新本地个人最佳成绩。

games.name: 一触即发：西部决斗
games.description: 西部快枪对决：等到真正的信号，再拔枪、瞄准、开火。支持双人、三人对峙；好友可担任口令官掌控发令，也可在影子挑战中刷新自己的最快纪录，挑战好友与全球玩家的影子。

games.name: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
games.description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

games.name: IAI // BREAKER
games.description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

games.name: 尸潮竞技场
games.description: 欢迎来到尸潮竞技场，你需要抽取各色武器与强化，不断强化你的武器与角色，在竞技场中生存下去。

games.name: Astella Walker
games.description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

games.name: The Largest Organism
games.description: The largest living thing on Earth is not a whale. It's a fungus — and you're about to beat its record. Grow a living network from a single spore. Every upgrade changes how your organism behaves, not just a number. No ads. No microtransactions. Just growth.

games.name: Meteor Spin
games.description: 转动转轴，指挥你的防御系统！Meteor Spin 是一款融合老虎机构筑与 Roguelike 星球防御的游戏。用炮塔、激光和护盾打造 5×5 阵列，触发疯狂的连锁协同，抵御陨石群与外星战舰，守护你的星球。

games.name: Sharma Ji's Shop
games.description: Desperate for cash, a young graduate named Asha takes the night shift at a quiet suburban Indian Kirana store. Serve late-night customers, verify UPI payments. Something feels wrong about owner. He acts real strange and customers often mentions old employee disappearing.

games.name: 理论成立: 友情破产
games.description: 《理论成立：友情破产》是一款受博弈论启发的3–8人多人派对游戏。玩家要在金币争夺、军备竞赛和拍卖中分配资源、秘密选择、竞价、虚张声势，并用技能打乱朋友的计划。房主可组合和排序游戏模式、调整参数，以跨局积分决出赢家。规则直观，局势却会被隐藏信息、临时结盟与公开互坑不断改写；你需要在贪婪与克制之间判断风险，猜透朋友，再抢先让他们的最优策略破产。支持Steam大厅、局域网联机和机器人陪玩。理论会成立，友情可就不一定了。

games.name: 灵韵牌：清浊之间
games.description: 连击每多接一张，出手就更重一分！《灵韵牌：清浊之间》——东方奇幻 Roguelite 卡组构筑。深入迷雾灵境，与躁动的灵兽斗智斗勇，见招拆招，一路杀穿！

games.name: Broken Drive
games.description: 走进一位在悲惨车祸中失去女儿的悲痛父亲的脑海。被困在由他痴呆的潜意识所创造的废弃医院的循环中，你必须面对最深层的恐惧。Broken Drive 是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。

games.name: Yukinite Depths
games.description: 在这款轻松、带有放置元素的像素风增量策略游戏中，派遣一支能够自主行动的哥布林矿工队深入地下，寻找传说中的 Yukinite 水晶。发现稀有资源，解锁强力升级，扩建矿井，并面对深处等待着你的一切。

games.name: Mountain Egg
games.description: Swing, fall, and rage! You are a lost egg in a harness armed only with a grappling hook. Scale a treacherous mountain to reach your nest at the very top. One mistake means a long fall down. Whatever you do, don't crack! 🥚

games.name: Last Paddle Standing
games.description: Pong 遇上大逃杀。Last Paddle Standing 将最多 10 名玩家扔进一座不断缩小的混乱竞技场。被淘汰的玩家会化身复仇恶灵，继续干扰仍在场上的幸存者。短局对战。混乱拉满。

games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
games.description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

games.name: Roll Brighter
games.description: Tether up and prove your teamwork in Roll Brighter, a physics-based driving game filled with chaotic traps and fun obstacles! Coordinate with friends via a physics rope, or relax in solo mode as you navigate a vibrant, atmospheric world designed for a satisfying casual driving simulation.

games.name: Mafia Wife: Forbidden Affair
games.description: 你本来只是豪华庄园的新园丁，却成了黑帮大佬妻子心中不可告人的秘密。赢得玛丽娜的信任，阅读她深夜发来的消息，决定愿意为这段禁忌关系冒多大的风险。从泳池边的交谈到一杯咖啡的邀约，每次靠近都让两人的未来更加难以预测。这部成人视觉小说包含十个章节、七处场景中的254张插画、三款小游戏与三个不同结局。通过选择改变关系与故事走向，在日渐加深的感情和逐渐增长的怀疑之间作出决定。你会守护秘密、勇敢迈出下一步，还是选择保持距离？

games.name: Terran Chronicles: 4200
games.description: A dice-driven sci-fi RPG where character creation can be the game. Roll a life term by term in the Terran Federation at the dawn of a new era — qualify, serve, survive, earn medals or wash out — then step into the game as the person that life made you. Great adventures or normal life... your choice.

games.name: Set, Bounce, Cheese!
games.description: Guide Squeaky, a courageous little mouse, on a physics-based quest to save his village from tyrannical cats! Instead of controlling Squeaky directly, place an unlimited supply of bouncy gadgets along his path to guide him past traps and collect every last piece of cheese.

games.name: 史莱姆王国
games.description: 化身伟大的史莱姆王，在这款融合了地牢探索与领地防守的动作生存游戏中，你需要吞噬万物以获取强大的元素力量。分裂出不同属性的小史莱姆组建黏液大军，带领它们探索深渊、迎击入侵者，构筑属于你的地下王国！

games.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
games.description: An active incremental about running an AI data center. Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs, drones and more. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

games.name: 散装舰队
games.description: 《散装舰队》是一款快节奏的像素破坏生存 Roguelite。拆解敌舰与地形、暴露关键 Core，将战功投入武器、分身与模块，把临时编队构筑成火力覆盖全场的舰队。

games.name: 梦境亭
games.description: 通过点触式交互，跟随主人公的视角，你将走进这个特殊的空间，在微风拂过的亭子里，解开机关谜题，了解记忆中的故事。

games.name: God Sight Road of Ashes
games.description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

games.name: Chess: Apex
games.description: Classic chess at a 3D table. Play with friends online through Steam, share a screen, or challenge the computer. Choose your board and pieces, save your games, and revisit your moves with Stockfish analysis and PGN tools.

games.name: 幻卡物语：星卡对决
games.description: 《幻卡物语：星卡对决》是一款回合制卡牌构筑 RPG。选择六大学院之一，从168张卡牌中构筑30张牌组，融合重复卡牌并刻下永久星痕，穿越八章60节点战役。与 AI 同伴或好友共斗时，双方各自管理牌组与战场，在首领行动前轮流出牌，以团队连携挑战多阶段 Boss。完整单人内容可离线游玩。

games.name: ProutoPulsion: Fart on your friends!
games.description: Fight your friends with farts and style.

games.name: Cutset
games.description: 在 80 关工业管网谜题中切断管道、关闭阀门，直到从源到汇再无一条通路。每关都有唯一且可证明的最优截断方案，割炬燃料刚好只够完成它，多一格都没有。这里没有部分分——难的不是毫无头绪，而是有思路却算不完：某处看着很值，合计之后却总差一点。一次买断，无内购，无广告，无联网要求。

games.name: Just Fly
games.description: Just Fly是一款兼具轻松治愈与刺激的翼装飞行游戏，没有强制目标。探索布满峡谷、隧道与危险洞穴系统的程序生成空岛。掌握惊险的贴近飞行，躲避风力发电机叶片，在布娃娃碰撞后瞬时重生，享受自在惬意的滑翔。

games.name: Horseball Manager
games.description: Discover the first management game dedicated to horseball. Take charge of a club, recruit riders and horses, manage training, finances, transfers and breeding, prepare your tactics, and build a team capable of challenging for the biggest titles.

games.name: Pot by Pot
games.description: A cozy organizational logic puzzle game about plants, pots, and finding the perfect place for everything. Follow clues, make connections, and enjoy satisfying, bite-sized puzzles as you arrange your little plant shop and watch beautiful plant-and-pot pairings come together.

games.name: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
games.description: 一款增量放置MMO：给会赚金币的皮纳塔涂装、找地方藏好，同时在庞大且持续运行的世界里，搜寻并偷走别人藏得不怎么样的宝藏！积累财富、投资升级，藏好并守住你的被动收入帝国。自定义角色、报仇雪恨、寻找稀有物品，最后再高调炫个富！

games.name: Lock 87
games.description: Work the night shift at Lock 87, a canal checkpoint in a brutalist dystopian 1992. Inspect vessels, authorise passage, and earn enough to escape the district - while strange transmissions and security footage suggest you may not be alone.

games.name: CrashFest
games.description: Build the track, then race it. Everyone adds a piece between rounds — the bots too — so the corner that just wrecked you is somebody's fault. Local arcade racing for up to six, with shotguns, landmines and homing missiles, plus three arena modes for when you want the track gone.

games.name: 命运地牢
games.description: 玩法大胆的暗黑像素 Roguelite：钉在处刑台上，用痛苦换灵魂、转动命运轮盘，构筑自动反击的刑印，在主持者苏醒前完成处决。

games.name: Tales From Outer Space
games.description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

games.name: Attkand
games.description: ÅTTKAND 是一款极简风格的色彩解谜游戏。点击一枚棋子，观看反应波在棋盘上扩散。利用特殊棋子改变波的走向。将所有棋子变成同一种颜色即可获胜。

games.name: Hand Stretched
games.description: Run a wood-fired pizzeria covering three key roles, Chef, Waiter or Manager, over frantic 6 minute shifts! Can you and up to two friends keep the customers fed and the accountants happy? Or see off a rival shop in a head-to-head, best of three/five battle with up to five other players?

games.name: Fall of the Void
