games.description: Fall of the Void is a dark fantasy isometric ARPG merging high-octane hack-and-slash combat with deep build crafting. Descend into perilous dungeons across fractured realms, master evolving abilities, and forge devastating power synergies to shape your destiny.

games.name: Solitaire & Cheats
games.description: Solitaire & Cheats is a classic Klondike solitaire game where you earn points to spend on cheats-special moves that help you win tough deals. Settle into a cozy late-night jazz club atmosphere. Choose your rules, share game codes, and create your own card art.

games.name: Restock Master
games.description: 大门已锁，停车场空无一人，超市货架一片狼藉。Restock Master 是一款第一人称超市整理游戏。捡起散落的商品，分类整理，把每一个空货架填满。没有倒计时，没有顾客，没有压力。

games.name: Rise From Ashes
games.description: 胜负靠构筑，而非运气。这是一款策略生存割草游戏：合成卷轴、装备印记、凑齐羁绊，一路攀登尖塔。每次挑战都是一卷漫画，你的冒险将绘出其中的每一页。

games.name: 三国史记经典版
games.description: 公元660年，统领高句丽、百济或新罗。这是一款可随时暂停与调整速度的即时战略游戏：管理国库与粮草，编组军团经陆路与海路进军，唐与倭国也会按各自的利益行动。亲自指挥野战与攻城，让每一次胜负影响后续战线。

games.name: 天命1600：东方
games.description:
当世界走到命运的转折点，将由你来决定一个国家的未来。《天命1600：东方》是一款全球历史大战略游戏。
治理地方、经营王朝、延续血脉，在贸易中积蓄国力，在战争中克敌制胜。历史不再只有一种结局。
天下已乱，天命未定，未来由你改写。

games.name: 白日梦猫：梦灵放置冒险
games.description: 一款会待在桌面上持续冒险的放置收集 RPG。组建三只梦灵小队，搭配职业、技能、装备与天生词条，在自动战斗、孵化融合和天赋成长中不断突破更高关卡。

games.name: Chroma Keyboard
games.description: 一款不会失败的四键音游：每一局都会弹到最后一个音，不会被中途打断。40 首原创曲目铺开十二个音乐传统 —— 科拉琴、甘美兰、木卡姆、米隆加、Techno —— 另有四部史诗，每部十幕组曲、十五分钟不间断。

games.name: 行动代号：围棋行动
games.description:
《行动代号：围棋行动》是一款回合制战术策略游戏。这款游戏融合了围棋的规则、战棋的玩法，以及桌面策略游戏的视觉表现。在游戏中，玩家不再需要像传统战棋一样，使用移动力将单位从后方转移至前线，而是可以像围棋一样，直接将单位部署到战场上的任意位置，立即投入战斗，并在形成包围时直接“吃”掉敌方单位。

玩家的增援可以出现在任何需要的位置，敌军的部队也会随时威胁到玩家的后方。传统的战术已不再适用，新的战线可能在一个回合内形成，但在下一个回合中崩溃，每一次行动都是空间与时间的战术决策。

games.name: Hood
games.description: England, 1216. Experience the true story behind the Robin Hood legend as you control Williken of the Weald in this 2D pixel art stealth platformer. Explore, sneak, and fight your way through the forests, villages, and fortresses of Kent to take down the ruthless Castellan and save your family.

games.name: 猫咪堡垒:老虎机防御
games.description: 转动老虎机式密码筒，连锁匹配符号，将伤害化为金币。选择战报，购买遗物和补给，追求更强的一击。在这款中世纪老虎机防御轻度肉鸽游戏中，决定是投资强化，还是为下一次缴税存下金币。

games.name: Ages TD
games.description: Spear towers become balistas, balistas become railguns. Defend one world through three ages as it grows around your towers - and find out why the horde keeps returning. A story-driven tower defense about a world worth 800 years of war, and the Reaper who farms it.

games.name: 午夜耀斑
games.description: 《午夜耀斑》是一款分章节推出的点击式解谜冒险游戏。在第一章中，你将探索被诡异红光笼罩的小镇中的一栋房子，翻找物品、解开机关，并与古怪的角色周旋。你能解开这栋怪异房子的谜团吗？

games.name: DESKPOP
games.description: 《DESKPOP》是一款放在桌面上的物理音乐创作游戏。摆放弹球、骨牌、钟摆、雨滴、磁铁等装置，让它们的碰撞变成音符，再通过乐器、音阶和旋钮调整声音，组合出属于自己的循环音乐。

games.name: Daisy's Dead
games.description: Tend a cemetery for the dearly departed in this cozy but macabre decorating game. Fulfill final requests, craft personalized graves, shape the grounds your way, and uncover the mystery of Daisy’s own death.

games.name: Rolling Fortress
games.description: Command a colossal mobile fortress through a 10-sector post-apocalyptic campaign. Aim its cutting laser, manage automated heavy weapons, intercept enemy salvos, salvage scrap, and build a devastating arsenal between escalating waves.

games.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
games.description: 你因为发现了一桩舞弊案，被关进了监狱。囚犯们正在悄无声息地消失，下一个就是你。避开狱警的视线潜行，用香烟换取情报，必要时挥拳相向，在他们来抓你之前拿下这座监狱。

games.name: Cash Only
games.description: 白天经营咖啡店，背地里做毒品生意。招待顾客、种植货物、安排秘密交货点、躲避警察，并与朋友分工合作，在这款合作犯罪模拟游戏中把生意做大。

games.name: Void Sector
games.description:
Void Sector is a 1 to 4 player co-op action-horror game.
Board a secret facility as a spec-ops unit and discover the weapon that escaped the lab.
Solving problems and completing tasks only adds to the atmosphere and the struggle to survive the mutated enemies and your soldier’s mental deterioration.

games.name: Gypt - The Eternal Pharaoh
games.description: Building and management rogue-lite set in ancient Egypt. Assign your artisans, raise your pyramid on a triangular grid, and riddle it with traps. Upon your death, watch your tomb brave 2,000 years of trials against raiders and the wrath of the gods.

games.name: DELIVERX
games.description: 包裹可不会自己送上门！与多达4名好友跳上工作货车，驱车驶向庞大的未知设施，在致命异形的包围中取回高价值货物。每次潜入都截然不同。不惜一切代价完成派送！Have a fearless delivery!

games.name: Heads Up, Chefs!
games.description: Your neighbors throw dinner off their balconies. Catch it midair with a gravity gun and get it into the pot before the order runs out. One pot, two orders, up to six pairs of hands. Rent is due in three days.

games.name: DicePool
games.description: Roll the dice as you travel through the world of Dysepool in DicePool! Set off with a party of adventurers, each with their own role and playstyle. Mix and match to discover your story and make everyone's wish come true!

games.name: No Survivors
games.description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers, battle an escalating police and military response, upgrade nine brutal weapons, and turn a fully destructible lakeside camp into your deadliest weapon. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

games.name: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
games.description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

games.name: Filthy Liars
games.description: 和其他玩具伙伴一起打扫这间脏兮兮的屋子。但不要相信任何人，因为你们当中藏着一个变形叛徒，白天进行破坏，夜晚展开猎杀。擦洗污渍、藏好自己，并在灯光熄灭前投票驱逐这个怪物。

games.name: Tea Party For 4
games.description: Horror Cozy Anomaly Game

games.name: PHILSEQUE DIVISION
games.description: 在这款 3D 太空动作 Roguelite 游戏中驾驶强大的战斗飞船。迎战规模不断扩大的敌潮，收集经验，安装模块，打造毁灭性的战斗流派，并在危险的太空区域中与精英首领和强大首领展开激烈战斗，奋力生存。

games.name: Drums & Steel
games.description: Command formations of 18th-century armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

games.name: Reap & Repeat
games.description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

games.name: Word Link
games.description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

games.name: Echo Harvest
games.description: Build settlements, command the Echoes of former lives, and race against a corruption consuming the world. Echo Harvest is a colony roguelite where every failed timeline becomes part of the history that shapes the next.

games.name: Whispers from Below
games.description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

games.name: Quadrex
games.description: Quadrex is a mass chaos first-person shooter battle sandbox. Drop into instant large-scale combat on modest hardware, flood the map with bots that pack a little too much punch, and unleash your crazy in this arcade mayhem toybox.

games.name: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
games.description: 这是一款舒适的第一人称组织游戏，背景设定在混乱的维多利亚博物馆中。收集分散的彩色立方体，将它们堆叠起来，然后将它们放入匹配的插槽中，以展示像素艺术品并恢复迷人的 3D 体素展品。

games.name: Keep to the Blue
games.description: Explore a flooded post-apocalyptic world, battle your enemies, and upgrade your ship with the loot you find. But watch out for pirates!

games.name: The House Between Times
games.description: 转动怀表，在同一座房屋的两个时代之间往返。改变过去，重塑现在，解开横跨数十年的谜题，并在这场第一人称悬疑冒险中，查明你的家庭为何分崩离析。

games.name: Rallied!
games.description: A chaotic physics-based racing simulator which crams up to 32 players into a map only meant for 4! Ram your friends, customize your car, mix perks and so much more!

games.name: PROTOCOL: NOAH
games.description:
SINEN STUDIO 带来的首部绝望奇幻作品《PROTOCOL: NOAH》。
玩家将化身“调律师”，指挥少女们作战，调整她们的身心状态。本作是以“学园都市 Ark”为中心，描绘少女们与“Phantom”战斗日常的剧情冒险游戏。
“在不断重演的死亡尽头，那份希望究竟是为谁而存在——”

games.name: EREWHON
games.description: Erewhon is a First Person, Turn-Based, Lovecraftian Dungeon Crawler with Visual Novel and Soulslike elements. As the Wandering Psyche, explore the Weatherleigh Hotel and the diverse realities it connects through several investigations into the unthinkable. Death is not the end, but madness might be.

games.name: 第六枚骰子
games.description: 《第六枚骰子》是一款融合扑克牌型的骰子构筑肉鸽爬塔游戏。你将扮演六位掷骰人之一，以五枚不同阶骰子（D4，D6，D8，D12，D20）开局，穿越8章节24场战斗，对抗各种变异怪物。每场战斗投掷全部骰子，通过重掷锁定满意点数，通过改点改造骰面、通过变阶增减面数，凑出对子、葫芦、顺子、五条等牌型打出伤害。每场战斗后有战后商店，购买符文、技能、骰子，构筑专属流派；随机遗物、奖励金币、利息、牌型升级让每局策略无穷无尽。通关终局Boss后解锁"第六枚骰子"，开启无尽爬塔。每一次投掷都是策略与骰运的交锋，深渊等你来征服。

games.name: Last Offer: Car Dealer
games.description: Explore an open world, find cars for sale, inspect them, negotiate, buy, customize, and sell for profit. Build and grow your own dealership, deal with customers, and know when to make your last offer.

games.name: Deal Me In
games.description: Build wild upgrade combinations in a haunted casino. Fuse maxed cards into unstable bonuses, gamble across six games, and pay your growing debt while monsters hunt you. A first-person horror roguelike for solo play, 2–4 player online co-op or VS.

games.name: Paper Arena Battle Simulator
games.description: Paper Arena is a battle simulator with hundreds of customizable AI fighters. Control one or watch the chaos unfold as rivalries, records, and history grow across matches.

games.name: 美职篮篮球世界
games.description: 本作是一款以现实比赛数据为基础，在虚拟世界进行投资+对抗的游戏。本游戏加入现实真实的工资帽以及球员真实工资系统，玩家通过扮演NBA总裁的角色，在工资帽以及球员属性、工资等条件限制下，组建培养心仪的球队。同时在游戏中需要平衡球队各位置球员实力，并根据球员特色技能搭配出合理阵容。

games.name: Fortress Breaker
games.description: Every siege starts simple. Break through fortress levels, topple bosses to unlock new upgrades, equip upgrades for your next run in the Armory, discover powerful combinations, and conquer all boss levels to unlock Endless Mode and Boss Rush.

games.name: 关于我在异世界胖次变成圣遗物这件事
games.description: 当一个普通的内裤小偷竟然是异世界NPC时会发生什么？穿梭于多元宇宙，夺回被盗的"圣物"，把那些异世界的NPC狠狠地踢飞吧！

games.name: Catomi: Suika Roguelike
games.description: Turn cute cat-fruit into huge combos! Collect powerful catalysts that twist the rules, boost your multipliers, and change how you play. Drop or slingshot fruit into place, trigger chain reactions, and build powerful combinations that send your score soaring in this Suika-style roguelike.

games.name: Baitcore
games.description: BAITCORE is a survival fishing horror game. Trapped inside a container after a shipwreck, you are lost somewhere in the open ocean. By day, scavenge for supplies among the wreckage and fish to survive. When night falls, stay hidden—because something is lurking beneath the waves.

games.name: Knead a Break
games.description: Knead 蜷在舒适的猫窝里，默默照看着某个非常爱久坐的人类。当你坐得太久，这只臭脸小猫就会突然现身，捣乱、卖萌，打断你、迷惑你，想方设法把你从工作前引开。它不是故意淘气——它只想把你从椅子上赶起来，动动身体，然后感觉好一点。

games.name: それゆけ！パンジャンドラム
games.description:
Britain's greatest super-weapon rides again! An online two-player co-op action game
where you each take one wheel. Pull together and it runs straight. Fall out of sync
and it charges off at full speed in entirely the wrong direction.
50 stages. Get there in one piece — or several.

games.name: 整理我的小猪
games.description: 《整理我的小猪》《Sort My Pigs》是一款2D整理模拟游戏，你要把5000多只可爱的小猪送进对应的猪圈。挑一只小猪，找到它的猪圈，赚取金币，随着农场不断扩大，解锁各种升级。没有时间限制，没有压力，只有纯粹、治愈的整理乐趣。

games.name: Grow That!
games.description: Grow That! is a relaxing incremental game where every second counts. Grow flowers, gather resources, expand your research tree, and optimize every run to beat your best times. How far will you grow?

games.name: Dream Daughter
games.description: 你是“女儿”，被困于他人书写的世界，沉眠于梦境之中。你也必须亲手构筑这个世界。规则已然等着你。你构筑世界，也眼看着世界锻造你的现实。直面它并彻底醒来；否则，便永远沉溺于它编织的谎言之中。

games.name: Boss Toss
games.description: Deflect the ball launched by the boss, pass it to a friend, then smash it right back into the boss! The more you pass the ball, the faster it gets—and the fight descends into chaos. Hit the boss. Not your friends.

games.name: She'll Be Home Soon
games.description: Your wife will be home soon. Clean the house, feed the dog, finish the chores and keep everything under control before she arrives, while something that looks like her stalks the house and starts undoing your work.

games.name: 翻转岩石 | Rock Flipper
games.description: Rock Flipper is a short incremental idler about throwing rocks to mine and earn cash, completing a huge skill tree, awakening monoliths, feeding the Rift, and becoming enlightened with the truth about the universe.

games.name: Project MAGNUM
games.description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

games.name: Cargo Calling
games.description: 一款第一人称社交推理游戏，每名玩家都有不同的秘密使命。完成各种目标——从操纵经济到召唤远古宇宙实体——获得分数并赢得比赛！

games.name: Cocaine Smuggler
games.description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

games.name: SCOP
games.description: SCOP is a roguelite card game inspired by Italian Scopa. Capture cards, build combos, power up Base and Mult, collect relics, and face Blinds and Bosses across ever-changing RUNS.

games.name: 合并日：办公室女孩
games.description: 《合并之日：职场少女》是一款美少女解谜游戏，通过合并（Merge）物品来突破堆积如山的工作。扮演被抽调到秘密部门的新人，与等待你的4位女主角产生交集。合并物品完成工作，合并羁绊开启刺激的办公室恋情！

games.name: NEBULA BREAK
games.description: 一款全家人都能同乐的正统太空射击游戏，而且它不会一成不变。突破全5关卡与隐藏内容，新模式会接连解锁——不知不觉变成横向卷轴，再进入全程3D的 SPACE DIVE，打破「纵版射击」的常识。辅助模式会增加生命与炸弹并放慢速度，孩子也能安心游玩；11个银河、50种以上的迷你游戏与100首以上的原创配乐则留给老手挑战。支持双人合作，同屏或通过 Remote Play Together 与远方的朋友一起游玩。

games.name: Quadrillion Carrots
games.description: 🥕 收获数量荒唐的胡萝卜！从赤手空拳开始，解锁强力工具和辅助机器人，探索六个农耕区域，抓住活胡萝卜，躲过会爆炸的胡萝卜，把手工劳作变成一场收获狂潮。🤖

games.name: 哭到天荒 (Cry Me a Cosmos)
games.description: 用不同性情的凡人构筑牌组，将他们种进花园。引发连锁反应，收割他们的眼泪。熬过十二次愈发苛刻的贡奉，收集666滴眼泪，引发末日。

games.name: Paint Gang
games.description: 凭感觉调色，在巨幅画布上争分夺秒，还要小心别踩进湿油漆！《Paint Gang》是一款支持 1–4 名玩家的混乱在线合作游戏，每幅杰作都可能变成全队共同制造的灾难。

games.name: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE
games.description: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE is a first-person psychological horror game where your first day at work becomes a nightmare. Explore a distorted office complex, uncover mysterious letters, and find a way out as reality begins to fall apart around you.

games.name: UFO98
games.description: UFO98 是一款基于独立 Win98 桌面环境的怀旧增量模拟游戏。解密加密的外星信号，泄露绝密文件，对抗压迫性政府，唤醒全人类以揭示真相。

games.name: Oh! my Table
games.description: 一款轻松温馨的美食摆盘沙盒游戏。自由摆放和定制食物与餐具，切分牛排、面包和披萨，用酱汁画出花纹，为碗中添入汤汁。保存餐桌作品，选择灯光与氛围，再用拍照模式记录你的美味创意。

games.name: Last Exit Diner: Edge of Known Space
games.description: Keep a battered ship flying at the edge of known space. Take jobs from the Last Exit Diner, escort freighters, hunt rogue Progenitor Tech, and follow ancient gates through a living neon frontier.

games.name: Futa Seas A Pirate's Booty
games.description: Join the colorful crew of the Crimson Mermaid and sail dangerous waters in search of the lost Siren’s Heart. Bond with six characters, master pirate minigames, and shape the ending of this adult adventure through your choices.

games.name: STELLAR WING
games.description: 一款击穿母舰的太空战斗机射击游戏。以四机编队突入敌方母舰，依次摧毁炮塔、护盾发电机与核心。用200种部件重组你的战机，挑战12个战役任务，以及针对10种巨型机械生命体的30场讨伐。

games.name: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower
games.description: A relaxing organization game where you play as a retired mage's apprentice. Tidy up a magical tower, discover hidden secrets, and slowly learn magic along the way.

games.name: Poetry of Pace: Rally
games.description: Every stage has a rhythm — find it. Drift painterly rally cars through Mediterranean harbors, alpine forests and high-desert canyons in a stylized racer where driving beautifully matters as much as driving fast.

games.name: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged
games.description: 你曾是一位王子，却意外变成了青蛙。甩出舌头捕捉昆虫，将猎物投入女巫的大锅，炼成魔法精华。在这款轻松惬意的增量点击游戏中，升级技能，应对凶悍的虫子，努力恢复王子身份。

games.name: Gnome More Work
games.description: A cozy incremental clicker about helping little gnomes grow a giant tree. Gather resources, recruit gnomes to do the work for you, build up their village, and bet it all on a variety of minigames!

games.name: 桌面TD：随机塔防
games.description: 围坐在酒馆桌边、各自守护自己棋盘的随机塔防。敌人沿着棋盘边缘的轨道无休止地绕行，用金币召唤防御塔，亲手放到轨道旁拦住它们。召唤全凭运气，从长矛兵到轨道炮，跨越原始到未来的各个时代。三个同类合成就会变强，绝不失败。棋盘被敌人填满，这个座位就结束了 — 但抽中一个好棋子就能翻盘。独自坚守，或与朋友一起守护同一张桌子。

games.name: Logical Cat Logistics
games.description: 让昨天的自己，为今天的你开路！扮演猫咪邮差，推送奇妙包裹、安排传送带与机关，再录下一段脚步，和自己的分身接力配送。每走一步，整间配送所才动一拍。慢慢想、大胆试，把看似不可能的订单，送成恰到好处的默契。

games.name: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
games.description: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

games.name: Wipe Them Out!
games.description: 《Wipe Them Out》是一款手绘风格的增量式打僵尸游戏。射杀僵尸、收集废料，并升级你的武器和防御设施。随着每次升级变得更加强大，迎战越来越强大的僵尸群。守住你的城墙，尽情享受横扫无数僵尸的畅快感。

games.name: Flash Freeze
games.description: A battle of wits on two boards. Trap wandering blobs in ice, clear the lines they're frozen in, and earn water pieces that pour into nearby crevices. Every line you clear while the water flows lands on your opponent's board.

games.name: FEEDSTOCK
games.description: 战利品不会进背包，而是进塔莉的肚子，她会因此长大。你们四人把房子逐间搬空，把一切都喂给她。喂得太少，她就吃掉队员；喂得太多，她就再也挤不出门。

games.name: KNUCKLEBOUND
games.description: KNUCKLEBOUND 是一款回合制卡组构筑 Roguelite 游戏。选择你的斗士，构筑牌组，组合拳击、踢击、流血和中毒效果，收集装备，在街头一路杀出重围，最终挑战犯罪之王。

games.name: Mise en War
games.description: 《Mise en War》是一款充满厨房混乱的派对游戏。在其他厨师偷走你的食物之前完成你的食谱。或者干脆不去煮饭，直接偷走他们的食物！

games.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
games.description: 打造机器人、配置工厂，在这款自动战斗策略游戏中守卫总部。收集零件，完善军队配置，挑战战役、单人无尽，与好友并肩双人作战，或在决斗中一较高下。

games.name: Requies
games.description: An atmospheric first-person mystery about a guard at a floating checkpoint in a flooded world. By day, question boats over the radio, search cargo for contraband and decide who gets in. By night, walk the quiet drowned village under curfew and check on its residents.

games.name: Not My Dad
games.description: 爸爸的行为很奇怪，也许只有你注意到了。认识一下《Not My Dad》——一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏，而真正的邪恶或许就在你自己的家中。

games.name: 相当木奉王求 Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
games.description: 拥有压倒性打击手感的高节奏挥棒游戏。运用能引发各种现象的"疑问的技术"，向强敌发起挑战吧！你能否击败全20个关卡的投手呢？

games.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
games.description: 《Hidden Raccoons in Winter》是一款温馨的像素风格寻物游戏！在精心制作的雪景中寻找可爱的浣熊。放松心情，随心所欲地找出所有浣熊吧！

games.name: Aer Isles
games.description: Rise, knight. Reclaim the skies you were once promised. alone or with up to four friends. Cross ever-changing floating isles, survive chaotic encounters, gather Power, and strengthen your Bonk. Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock each other back trying.

games.name: Just Dots
games.description: The classic pen-and-paper game of Dots — place dots, close the loop around your opponent's, claim territory — now against a neural network that taught itself from scratch and beats its own creator. Grow from beginner to master. Any board size, local 2-player.

games.name: Empires of Black Powder
games.description: 拿破仑战争时代，亲手构筑你将奋战的战场。派遣工兵收集补给、扩建当地城镇并布置防线。指挥连队列阵作战，让老兵活着归来，把他们的经验与升级带入下一场战斗。

games.name: 第三阵营
games.description: 一款以冷战为背景的文字政治管理沙盒游戏。平衡预算，招募专家，与互相敌对的超级大国谈条件，处理一封封电报，把一个一穷二白的新生共和国硬生生送进太空时代。又或者，让它葬身核时代。一切均以动态 ASCII 呈现。

games.name: Flippy the Spider
games.description: 跳跃、滑行、摆荡，挑战越来越难的关卡，吃掉苍蝇，寻找回家的路。掌握紧凑精准的物理操控，探索5个独特世界，并一路收集奖杯！

games.name: 捞捞大结果
games.description:
《捞捞大结果》是一款画风轻松可爱的类吸血鬼幸存者游戏。
2026，大结果之年！和森森、柳柳一起在度假酒店里疯狂“捞”钱、捞道具、捞队友，用金钱的力量从丧尸堆里捞出一条逃生路!

games.name: Chief? About That File...
games.description: 步入充满沉浸感的90年代复古警局档案室。在这款第一人称侦探收纳模拟游戏中，仔细研读、分类并整理3360份独一无二的犯罪卷宗，破解保险箱，揭开黑帮犯罪集团的惊天内幕。

games.name: Mool: Chroma
games.description: 一款由你扮演怪物的俯视角肉鸽游戏。吸收颜色，将它们混合成不可能的形态，然后推翻那些世代猎杀你族群的"英雄"。

games.name: Zaehbet, Draad
games.description: Translate an unknown language to uncover mysteries and solve puzzles. Use context clues, dictionary notes, and your last two remaining brain cells to understand the plot, make crucial decisions, and build your own dialogue responses. And, hopefully, avoid insulting entire bloodlines in the process.

games.name: Unlisted
games.description: 在你儿子失踪后，你开始收到由寻找失踪孩子的悲伤父母所录制的令人不安的未列出视频。每个人都身处不同的地点，面临着不同的威胁。这些视频会给你带来希望……还是恐惧？

games.name: My Friend's Hot Mom
games.description: 和一个你甚至不该去想的女人共度三天。做出选择，体验充满情欲的场景，解锁成人向插画，看着埋藏已久的禁忌欲望一步步变成无法忽视的现实。仅限成人。

games.name: March and Conquer
games.description: March and Conquer is a short autobattler game. During the battle, use the skill tree to train units to fight against enemies on the battlefield. Gain gold and mana from wins and train different units and upgrade your army. March across multiple lands and fight fearsome foes!

games.name: DUSTBLOOM
games.description: 在这款 1-4 人合作生存游戏中与好友组队。建造并守护你的基地，实现生产自动化，用卡车运输矿石，把死寂的红色沙漠改造成郁郁葱葱的绿色世界。制作武器抵御夜间的骷髅袭击，揭开失踪的第14支小队背后的黑暗谜团。

games.name: Just Make Sense 直觉实验室
games.description: 十几秒一关的直觉实验室：目测距离、抓准时机、预测轨迹、一眼数量。12 种感官直觉、一格一格长大的主线地图、570 多种生活情境——不考知识、不考数学，只考你的第六感。你的直觉，比你以为的准。

games.name: Sala Manager
games.description: Futsal Manager RPG.

games.name: 假球模拟器
games.description: 《假球模拟器》是一款奇幻足球经理游戏。签下兽人、精灵、机器人、僵尸与巨人，自由排兵布阵，掌管俱乐部财务，以智慧与战术率领球队问鼎联赛与杯赛冠军。游戏支持进行球赛投注、股市交易，并涉及假球与贿赂等幕后事件。

games.name: Factory New Idle
games.description: Connect natural resources to production nodes, turn raw materials into valuable goods, and sell them for profit. Purchase new nodes, expand your skill tree, solve bottlenecks, and build an automated factory that keeps growing.

games.name: Echoes of the Succubi
games.description: Travel through various fantasy worlds, meet their inhabitants, and uncover the truth behind the Succubi. Make choices, build relationships, and decide the fate of your journey in this adult visual novel.

games.name: Chinoris: Little Transporters
games.description: Tiny, unseen Chinoris quietly fix the small things humans lose, at a cost few ever question. Alon is new to this life, and he hasn't learned to stop asking why. Venture through fields, forests, cities, and caves to uncover the truth, and decide what a life is really worth.

games.name: SAAM Tactics
games.description: Catch creatures, raise and train them on your ranch, and win turn-based battles to claim a map one hex at a time. An easy-going strategy game with or without a timer as desired.

games.name: Marco, Polo, SHOTGUN!
games.description: Marco Polo Shotgun is a chaotic, four-player arena shooter. You're equipped with the latest and greatest in personal protection: a bucket. Arm yourself with your trusty double-barrel, embrace your severely restricted visibility, and try to figure out where the hell everyone else is.

games.name: Dealer Principal: The Dealership Simulator
games.description: Run a franchised car dealership from the inside. Buy and price inventory, desk deals, manage F&I, service, parts, staff, OEM relationships, cash flow, and customer satisfaction in a realistic first-person dealership management simulation.

games.name: Barn Rush
games.description: Grab food, haul it home, beat the clock. A colorful pixel time-attack roguelite on your own silly farm: draft upgrades until one little sheep has a tornado, a tractor and a snail on the payroll. Every run gets absurdly strong your way. Earn Feed to unlock new animals, themes, and cosmetics.

games.name: Destruction Snake
games.description:
在《破坏蛇》中，从一条基础机械蛇开始战斗，在成群敌人之间穿行、射击、燃烧、冻结并摧毁它们，收集散落的资源，不断强化你的战斗构筑。

给蛇身安装新的武器与模块，改变攻击方式，叠加增幅效果，制造模块之间的联动。随着构筑逐渐成型，让强大的敌群变成片消失的材料。

games.name: Slime Mine Survivor
games.description: A roguelite action game blending 2D block mining with survivor-like combat. Dig deeper while dodging enemies and creeping poison gas, gather ores and treasure, then upgrade and evolve your pickaxe and weapons to build synergies and dominate enemies and the battlefield alike.

games.name: 时间有点急手忙脚乱游戏车轮战
games.description: 一堆普通的经典复古游戏，但如果，每次倒计时结束就强行换一个，你能打出多少分？

games.name: YoYo Blade
games.description: 在这款仅用鼠标操控的增量动作游戏中，驾驭一把由绳索连接的利刃。投掷、加速并强化你的利刃，在腐化吞噬整个世界之前击退一波又一波的敌人。

games.name: Wildmane: Blood Bay
games.description: Your horse lives on your wallpaper. She grazes behind your windows, wanders across every monitor, and comes when you call. Usually. Ignore her long enough and she'll let you know how she feels about it. Pet her, play with her, fence her in. She is not productive and she is not sorry.

games.name: Ear We Go
games.description: 一款支持 1 至 6 人游玩的混乱合作烹饪游戏！订单从服务员传到自助收银员，再交给厨师。制作美食、传递订单，在一切彻底失控之前守住你的餐厅！

games.name: Tessela
games.description: 在《Tessela》这款无时间压力、无倒计时的 2D 像素风解谜游戏中放松身心，整理混乱。在 99 个精心打造的手工关卡中，体验彩色方块、丰富形状以及专为舒缓心情而设计的挑战。

games.name: Mutual Occult Insurance
games.description: Mutual Occult Insurance is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror and corporate satire. You are a field agent for the only insurer that covers supernatural damage. Fraud or not, whatever did this has not left the building. Approve or deny the claim… if you live long enough to file it.

games.name: 仓库满了！
games.description: 将顾客的家当一件件收进迷你仓。《Pack It In!》一半是收纳解谜，一半是仓储经营模拟。在这款轻松悠然的游戏中，你要想办法让各种难摆的物件各得其所，也会透过人们珍藏的东西，渐渐了解他们。

games.name: ODD ODDS
games.description:
一款在一间房间内展开的单人 Roguelike 赌博游戏。
为了偿还巨额债务，你需要在抓娃娃机中赚取本金，通过小游戏下注赚取更多收益，再利用 ATM 将金币兑换成现金。
用赚来的钱强化设备，在打字机上磨练技能。
门铃突然响起。来访者究竟是想趁火打劫，还是准备向恶魔露出獠牙？
接受哪一笔交易，又该如何与对方周旋——你的每一个决定，都将决定你能否逃离这间房间。

games.name: STARZ.PEG
games.description: STARZ.PEG is a Y2K physics roguelike built around chain reactions. Buy blind-box figures called STARZ between rounds, line up your shot, and set off whole rows of abilities to run up the score.

games.name: Desert Shadows
games.description: 在陷入混乱的墨西哥为革命而战。扮演革命者与潘乔·比利亚的追随者，在这款 2D 动作游戏中射击、骑马并努力生存。

games.name: 星斩
games.description: 消除即挥刀。看穿十二宫少女的每一次抬手：在红区内以顺向连消格挡、以 L 形与十字完美弹反，或空换一步闪身。击碎架势，一击终结。塔罗卡牌、星签与秘仪符文，每一局都是新的星图——动作三消 Roguelike。

games.name: Silent Sonata: Dead Air
games.description: Recover 8 corrupted recordings hidden on the dark web. Defend against hackers and the cult that wants to keep them hidden. Solve the puzzles and stay off the radar in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

games.name: Knowlands: Battle of Wits
games.description: Knowlands 是一款问答与即时战略游戏，知识是你最强大的武器。征服领土，指挥军队，回答问题，在节奏明快的策略与智慧对战中击败对手。

games.name: Astral Phase
games.description: Wake in your own home, only to discover your body is still lying in bed. Trapped outside yourself, explore a familiar house shared with beings from other dimensions, uncover the truth, and find a way back before reality collapses.

games.name: DITY: Origins
games.description: Autumn 1974. A cleaner from a forest parish is sent into town to buy soap. He speaks a language in which “don’t worry, I won’t help you” means yes — and the town hears no, every time. Several endings, an open world.

games.name: NOT MY FAULT
games.description: 一款支持1-4人的混乱物理合作游戏：一根原木需要两人同时操控才能前行——而这还只是第一种载具！疾驰于机关重重的赛道，在令人肾上腺素飙升的下坡跑酷中死里逃生，并在PvP迷你游戏中痛快解压。请记住：输了比赛绝不是你的错！

games.name: Fly Chicken Fly
games.description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

games.name: MoonShot
games.description: A local coop space arcade game- Shoot your friends while orbiting a variety of celestial bodies. Balance hunting down your friends and staying in a safe orbit while picking up powerups and picking your friends off to win!

games.name: Find The Needle
games.description: 你有一把铲子，还有一堆由大约六百万根干草组成的草堆。里面某个地方藏着一根针。亲手把它挖出来，卖掉干草，再用赚来的钱购买传送带和机器，直到再也不用自己动手挖。

games.name: One Bard Move
games.description: One Bard Move是一款充满喜剧色彩的3D精准平台跳跃游戏，每一次起跳都可能酿成灾难。掌握越来越有挑战性的移动技巧，跨越荒诞的巨型障碍，还要忍受一位总能对你的失败发表高见的旁白。

games.name: ShirocaTriangle
games.description:
Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game.
Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

games.name: Voxel Wild
games.description: 在这款第三人称开放世界生存建造动作 RPG 中，探索程序生成的体素荒野。收集资源、建造家园，逐体素自定义武器和护甲，体验狩猎与烹饪，并挑战强大的敌人。你可以独自冒险，也可以与好友在线合作，一起探索、建造和战斗。

games.name: 千里铁旅
games.description: 在《千里铁旅》中，经营一列真正属于你的火车，从中国出发，沿铁路在城市之间展开轻松旅程。自由编组机车与车厢，安排客运与货运，在不同城市间运送乘客、承载货物，并买入和卖出商品。每一段路线都需要决定下一程该带上什么，也让你的列车在旅途中逐渐变得更长、更完整。透过横版2D像素画面，看着亲手经营的列车穿过各地风景，从一座城市驶向下一座城市，享受运输、贸易与旅行交织在一起的节奏。让每一次出发都成为下一段旅程的开始。

games.name: Hollow Flesh
games.description: A first-person psychological horror set in a decaying 1950s psychiatric hospital. You came for your daughter. The building came for you. Explore its wards, solve its locks, relive the past it won't let you forget. Run and hide when it remembers too much.

games.name: Draw My Home 我画我家
games.description: 用你的画笔把毛坯房变成梦想之家。亲手画出家具、家电、玩具与宠物，看它们在约 7 秒内如神笔马良般同时“生长”成完整房间。15 个房间、家庭宠物、可爱像素风，完全免费。

games.name: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
games.description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

games.name: Pencil Topped
games.description: Erase your obstacles to clear a path forward, dash through danger, and fight epic bosses in this action-platformer inspired by Cuphead and Yoshi's Island! Chapter 1 is available for free!

games.name: 顶饱汉堡
games.description: 大多数食材都靠相邻的搭配加分：芝士融化在肉饼上，番茄衬托培根，凑齐BLT总分再乘上倍率。堆得越多分数越高——但贪心多放一层，整座汉堡塔就可能倒塌。物理堆叠的汉堡构筑类Roguelike。

games.name: Night Gig
games.description: 老板为了赶在期限前上线产品，高薪招人上夜班。你在工位电脑上处理帖子审核、文件归类、音频修复；与此同时，办公楼的灯光会变暗、设备会断电，女鬼循着声音与视线靠近。一边干完本夜的活，一边躲开这些异常。

games.name: かみひより ～識塗り編～
games.description:
—“Who are you?”

Naoko is branded an impostor by everyone she knows. During a day she cannot remember, the evil spirit “Shikinuri” entered her body and overwrote others’ perception of her. Can she expose the mastermind and reclaim herself in this Spirit Energy × Perception visual novel?

games.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
games.description: 将杂乱的房屋变成温馨又整洁的空间。打扫房间，整理每个角落，把物品放在你喜欢的位置——没有错误的选择。放松心情，发挥创意，让每个家都变得恰到好处。

games.name: LAST WITCH
games.description:
每隔十年，被命运的“魔女刻印”选中的十位魔女便会被引向一座孤岛。能够重返昔日生活的唯一途径，就是成为最后的生还者——。
在随时间逐渐被诅咒侵蚀的6×6网格孤岛上，展开一场单人游玩的 Battle royale Simulation。昼夜交替间做出关键抉择，活用50种武器、多样道具与角色专属技能开辟战局。本作包含描绘10位魔女各自人生与命运的丰富剧情章节（前传、第一夜、后日谈），以及记录每位落败魔女临终瞬间的阵亡记录，为你呈现一部厚重而凄美的暗黑奇幻故事。

games.name: Taptown Funk
games.description: 《放克小镇》（Taptown Funk）是一款动感十足的放置音游。你的目标是把一座放克小镇发展成繁华的大都市。鼠标悬停就能建造，踩点收金币，打出Combo，越玩越带劲。音乐一停，灾难就会爆发。升级、重建，或者干脆全自动！你能找准节奏，还是会被放克放倒？

games.name: LINETAIN
games.description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

games.name: 乐铲小队
games.description: 《乐铲小队（Joy Loader Crew）》是支持1-4人联机的合家欢工程派对游戏。玩家驾驶铲车、推土机组队协作，完成场地搭建、灾后抢险各类趣味关卡。软萌卡通画风搭配简易操作，亲子、好友聚会都适配。真实物理效果催生超多搞笑翻车瞬间，既能分工配合完成施工目标，也能自由互坑整活。游戏内含多款工程载具、救援关卡与休闲小游戏，轻松解压，快叫上好友一起开铲吧！

games.name: Eccentric Wander
games.description: 尽管影片营造了一种恐怖的氛围，但主角们性格轻松愉快，使其成为一部带有喜剧元素的恐怖片！

games.name: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
games.description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! 是一款轻松治愈的贴纸游戏，主题是温馨小屋和可爱猫咪。用镊子夹起贴纸，把它们放进迷你立体场景中，慢慢打造一个个温暖舒适的小空间，让你在喧闹的一天后还想再回来看看。

games.name: NABERON
games.description: Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

games.name: 囤货蚂蚁
games.description: 醒醒！冬天就要来了，把散落四周的食物收集起来吧。这是一款扮演蚂蚁的温馨工作模拟器。蚁群需要能量，而你是它们唯一的希望。

games.name: Live on, Until we can't
games.description: 这是一款回合制部落生存 Rogue-lite：在孩子的第一声啼哭与某人的最后一息之间，部落的历史缓缓积累。安排族人、应对突如其来的事件，用自己的方式带领部落长久延续下去。

games.name: Object 24
games.description: A psychological horror game set in a Soviet apartment. By day, explore your home, search for clues, uncover secrets and perform rituals. At night, it becomes a trap — hide, use the environment and defend yourself with whatever you can find. Survive the night and remember what you tried to forget.

games.name: Odysseus: Homecoming
games.description: 化身特洛伊战争的英雄奥德修斯，率领战友们返回故乡伊萨卡的选择式剧情冒险游戏！在每一个岔路口，你选择的行动将决定战友们的生死。你能平安回到妻儿等候的家中吗？

games.name: Tumble Tavern
games.description: 带有魔法符石的 Farkle 骰子游戏。掷出六枚骰子，选择落袋为安还是继续搏运气，并施放能扭转败局的符石。挑战酒馆里的 12 位常客，闯荡 Roguelite 连战，或在同一屏幕上把骰子交给朋友。

games.name: Last Civilization: Inherited Flame
games.description: 围绕人类最后的灯火建立村庄。白天采集、建造与研究，夜晚抵御暗影，守护居民与火焰。即使村庄覆灭，也能将记录与记忆传承给下一代文明。让每一代积累的经验，帮助新的村庄跨越曾经无法熬过的长夜。

games.name: 呪ショッピング
games.description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

games.name: Clobbo
games.description: 一款物理乱斗游戏，什么都不会消失。你抡翻的每个敌人都倒在原地，到第十波时你就站在第一波的尸堆上打。血积成滩，尸体堆起来，地图记得你挥出的每一棒。死掉，花光战利品，再派下一个机器人进场。

games.name: Bugs & Birdies
games.description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

games.name: Toss Office
games.description:
Play a new hire at the Department of Disposal.
Toss and shred paper your way up the ladder and hire a team to do your work.
An incremental game about procrastinating.

games.name: Sponge Bridges
games.description: 你所在的 G 市已经沦陷。街道被遗弃，幸存者各自躲在城市不同的角落，食物、药品和日用品都成了稀缺品。你靠替人运送货物活下去，也顺便看看这座城市到底发生了什么。总之……先把货送到。以及……尽量别饿死在路上。

games.name: TinyBriks
games.description: TinyBriks 是一款轻松解压、风格极简的塑料积木搭建游戏。没有目标，没有搭建说明书，没有时间限制，更没有什么“股东利益最大化”。想搭什么，全由你做主。用种类繁多的积木样式和颜色，打造梦幻般的微缩场景。唯一的限制，就是你的想象力。

games.name: NO TRACE BY DAWN
games.description:
这是一款第一人称恐怖游戏。你必须在天亮之前掩盖一场谋杀：肢解尸体、清理血迹、处理证据，并在警察敲响房门时，别让自己的说辞露出破绽。
天亮之前，不能留下任何痕迹。

games.name: Ashen Legacy
games.description: 《Ashen Legacy》是一款快节奏的2D动作RPG，故事发生在一个黑暗奇幻的世界中。掌握激烈的战斗，释放强大的技能，击败致命的怪物，并揭开埋藏于灰烬之中的遗产。

games.name: 命烛三国志：乱世归真
games.description: 千军易得，一将难识。赤壁一炬，群雄忘却姓名，化作代号散落世间。你将从一座城池起势，在任用中辨识英才、唤回真名；经营都市、结交将领，发展经世与兵略天赋，于十栏战场布阵施策，在世界崩解之前收束乱世。

games.name: Rookie Rook
games.description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

games.name: Market Simulator
games.description:
从一家空荡荡的小店起步，只有几排货架，手头的钱甚至只够勉强维持照明。
然后，把它做大做强。

games.name: Beltrunner
games.description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

games.name: Horror Doner
games.description: Step into your late brother's van run a donertruck through haunted cities full of disguised monsters and deadly anomalies among humans. Survive from dusk till dawn by meeting your daily quota and carefully deciding which terrifying customers to feed, and which are deadly traps waiting to devour you.

games.name: NOT Home Free
games.description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

games.name: HELL-A
games.description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

games.name: Beneath Solmere
games.description: 深入索尔梅尔城下的黑暗奇幻第一人称动作 RPG。四种职业任你选择，掌握高速技能战斗，搜寻强力装备，挑战致命首领，不断向更深处推进。你可以独自下潜，也可以在完整版推出在线合作后与伙伴并肩作战。唯一的出路，是向下。

games.name: Floating Paradise
games.description: 旋转、缩放并探索这座精心打造的 3D 漂浮岛屿，寻找巧妙隐藏的物品。《漂浮天堂》是一款轻松愉快的免费寻物游戏，拥有流畅的 360° 镜头控制、无时间限制以及舒缓的低保真背景音乐。

games.name: Underpaid
games.description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

games.name: Mind the Clown: Reborn
games.description: 一款第一人称生存恐怖游戏，背景设定在一个由童年记忆塑造的诅咒马戏团。小心移动，躲避追踪你的恶魔小丑。探索危险的游乐设施，焚烧马戏团海报，解除诅咒。

games.name: Parasite Core
games.description: 争取时间采集资源吧!在这款放置类塔防游戏中,你要保护核心,抵御想把你赶出家园的原住民种族!主动出击,释放技能战斗,或挂机让炮塔自动清理敌人。

games.name: Whispers of Orange Island
games.description:
喜欢潜行游戏？来体验一种全新的潜行方式——原创的护送潜行机制、各有来历的工具，障碍物不再是工具人，而是拥有自己的生活、关系与故事的独特角色。
喜欢剧情与世界观？探索海量可选剧情内容，揭开橘子岛一百年的历史、秘密，以及彼此交织的人生。

games.name: Albedo Carta ~白夜奇談~
games.description: 你在一座宅邸中醒来，却已不记得自己是谁。带领忠诚的人偶与傲慢的仆从们，踏入这片充满疯狂的雪国，寻找失去的自我。那些深受无数人喜爱的童话，如今被扭曲成令人着迷的模样…… Märchen Dark Fantasy RPG。

games.name: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm-
games.description:
潜入危险的地下迷宫「裂渊」：思考、战斗、搜集，然后活着回来。
在即时探索与回合制战斗之间无缝切换的生存战术RPG。
借助狼伙伴与元素反应，从绝境中杀出一条生路。

games.name: Dirty Mop
games.description: Your father vanished from this building years ago. Now you're their janitor — and the master key opens every door. Snoop, scheme, and seduce your way to the truth in this isometric adult adventure where every secret you uncover becomes your favorite new toy.

games.name: One Million Skeletons
games.description: The dead are coming, thousands at a time. Build a Gothic fortress of ramparts, ballistae and bombards and hold it for nine nights. Every skeleton you break leaves bones behind: grind them into crowns, load them as ammunition, or watch the pile become a ramp over your walls.

games.name: Oekaki Golf
games.description:
在这款故事书物理高尔夫游戏中，用蜡笔画线来制作平台。 
最多可支持 12 名玩家同时在同一个球洞进行游戏。帮助朋友，阻挡对手，享受难以预料的击球体验——无论是单人游戏还是多人游戏！

games.name: 丧尸请排队
games.description: 建造地下避难所，抵御无尽尸潮，带着晶核卷土重来

games.name: Make The Pool Blue Again: Pool Cleaning Simulator
games.description: Pressure-wash a national eyesore into sparkling blue water. Vacuum the rubbish, deal with meddling geese, and endure a president who takes credit for every clean centimetre. A first-person cleaning comedy with a very dirty job.

games.name: 释魂日志
games.description: 《释魂日志》是一部以职场为背景的悬疑视觉小说。在公司大楼里，只有你能听见死者的声音。白天当牛做马，晚上帮五个鬼找回记忆——14天倒计时已开始，每一个选择，都将由你亲手裁决。

games.name: Deadstate Heroes
games.description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

games.name: MECCHA OCTOPUS
games.description: 雕塑自己，融入环境！Meccha Octopus 是一款多人捉迷藏游戏，躲藏意味着成为周围环境的一部分。找到完美位置，选择一种形状，将自己雕塑成与环境吻合的模样。复制周围的纹理，完成你的伪装。

games.name: Pixel Metropolis
games.description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

games.name: Sort Sneakers & Socks
games.description: Sort over 2,000 sneakers into 1,000 boxes and organize 96 socks in a cozy sneaker outlet. Find matching pairs, pack their boxes, fill the shelves, and enjoy the satisfying transformation from a colorful pile into a perfectly organized store.

games.name: 方块碎裂：变奏
games.description: 「方块碎裂：变奏」让你放空大脑，把一整屏方块碎裂满地。甚至还能用方块下围棋，打扑克。

games.name: Pick a Part
games.description:
Clean dirty items and sell them to the locals, in the post-post-apocalyptic world of Pick a Part!
Join Sprout, the newcomer of a small island, where she has to manage her store and gain the trust of the town.

games.name: Reversed
games.description: Build your defenses using 15 different types of blocks and survive fifteen waves. You'll earn XP for every wave you survive. Then switch sides and try to destroy your own base. The faster you are, the higher the XP multiplier. Use the XP you've earned to unlock new blocks and cards, and try again.

games.name: Form
games.description: 喂养、观察并培育生活在 RÆLOS 桌面中的神秘数字生命 FORM。在这款即使你离开后时间仍会流逝的氛围放置模拟游戏中，探索文件、完成任务、游玩小游戏，并解开每次循环留下的痕迹。

games.name: Fuse Rush
games.description: Fuse Rush is a fast-paced physics action game inspired by the N64 classic Blast Corps! Grab bombs and objects, charge your throw power, and clear obstacles. Earn rewards, unlock cool skins in the shop, and beat the highscore before time runs out!

games.name: Kat Domino: Agent of S.H.E.L.L.
games.description: Kat Dómino 是 SHELL 的特工。SHELL 是控制着整个世界的组织。一次例行任务让她闯入不该去的地方，发现不该知道的秘密，并揭开一场足以颠覆她一切认知的阴谋。运气好的话，她的实习特工还能活下来。

games.name: WHO CHANGED IT?
games.description: 睁大眼睛，找出异常！《WHO CHANGED IT?》是一款面向1-8人的次世代在线异常寻找游戏。但有个陷阱：制造异常的人就在你们之中！房间里的物体可能会移动、消失或被复制。在不同游戏模式下拍下异常的照片，击败你的对手吧！

games.name: MAR: Millions Are Rising
games.description: 数百万只怪物正从洞穴中逃出。在这款增量式塔防游戏中，用独特的防御塔、核弹和深度升级构筑武器库，阻止它们。

games.name: Bug Bus
games.description: 穿越危机四伏的世界，把小昆虫们安全送到学校。自定义你的移动家园“Bug Bus”，照顾乘客、部署防御，并在上课期间探索周围、收集资源，为下一趟校车之旅做好准备。

games.name: Starlight Cove
games.description: Cast your line, catch fish, and watch the numbers go up! Upgrade your gear, reel in bigger catches, and rebuild Starlight Cove in this cozy fishing incremental. Just one more fish, one more upgrade… and maybe you’ll finally help Grandpa catch the four legendary fish that have eluded him for years.

games.name: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead
games.description: 末日仍在继续，幸存者仍需要吃饭。在 Zombie Wrap Simulator 中，你经营一家提供新鲜蔬菜、顺滑酱料和……可疑肉类的烤肉卷店。烤制卷饼、为避难所送餐，并在夜晚抵御愤怒的 Zomboners。

games.name: Defend the Dawn
games.description:
Defend the Dawn is a single-player third-person roguelite where you stand alone against relentless waves. Fight, build
  defenses, and adapt to randomized upgrades as you hold the line through a long night. Every run changes your strategy,
  but only careful planning will carry you to dawn.

games.name: 玩具特工队
games.description: 一款第三人称动作解谜冒险游戏。操控一支由不同玩具角色组成的特工小队，在人类生活娱乐的场景中寻找传送门，执行秘密任务、规避致命的敌人与陷阱，并利用不同角色的独特能力突破重重障碍，找到下一个坐标，直到完成目标特工任务。

games.name: Strip Club Simulator: Nightlife
games.description: 投身夜生活，将一家废弃破败的俱乐部打造成全城最棒的脱衣舞俱乐部——或者至少在这个过程中发家致富。升级并个性化定制场地，管理舞者，经营酒吧，还要保护店面免受闹事顾客的侵扰。

games.name: AXIDENT
games.description: Battle your friends in a series of mini games to win the golden axe. May the BEST jack win!

games.name: I Can't Stop Touching Balls: Clicker
games.description:
Are you an addicted ball toucher? After launching this game, you definitely ARE!
Luckily for you, we have a huge variety of balls, and every one of them can be touched.
Need to touch something else? Don't worry!
Our automatic ball touchers will happily do the job for you while you're away.

games.name: Cycle 8: The Laundromat Anomaly
games.description: Trapped in a 24-hour laundromat, you've waited for a dryer to finish for three weeks. CYCLE 8 is a psychological horror anomaly loop. Room normal? Leave. Spot an anomaly? Snap a photo for the mailbox. Make 8 correct calls to reach morning and uncover the tragedy keeping you stuck.

games.name: Angelfall
games.description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

games.name: TsundereSQL
games.description: An SQL course that likes you back. Learn through an anime visual novel, write real queries, solve 224 problems across 14 modules, and earn story scenes with three instructors - from your first SELECT to production-grade analytics.

games.name: 足球学院模拟器
games.description: 经营你自己的足球学院！制定个性化训练计划，提升球员技能，出租装备，保持设施整洁，并经营体育用品商店。挑选最优秀的学员组建球队，带领学院登上 Fantasy League 的巅峰！

games.name: Sex, Gods & Monsters: The Velvet Apocalypse
games.description: SEX, GODS & MONSTERS: THE VELVET APOCALYPSE is a story-driven adult visual novel about forbidden desire and a world torn between gods and monsters. Enter a seductive dark-fantasy apocalypse filled with immortal women, mystery, cosmic power, animated NSFW scenes, a gallery, and plenty of sex.

games.name: Killer Issues
games.description: Comedic horror game where serial killers become the victims. Share a cabin with other murderers, face the chaos, and try to survive when someone starts hunting you down.

games.name: 摸鱼小队
games.description: 《摸鱼小队》是一款陪你上班的轻量桌面挂机游戏。现实中的键鼠活跃会影响队员的工作效率：你摸鱼，他们也跟着磨洋工；你开始疯狂敲键盘、他们也会立刻效率拉满。划水时还能木材刮刮乐、敲矿石、烤肉恢复体力，解锁不同角色，并在击败怪物后有机会将其捕获为跟随宠物。把它挂在桌面上，该工作工作，该摸鱼摸鱼，陪你一起上班、一起偷懒、一起把仓库塞满。主打一个工作陪伴。

games.name: Keep on Fishing!
games.description: Catch fish in this relaxing incremental fishing game. Upgrade your boats, use multiple rods at once, hire helpers, and unlock even more bonuses!

games.name: 4:12 AM
games.description: 1999年12月，千年虫前夜。你是一座衰落煤矿小镇的911夜班接线员，用你自己的声音应答十二个夜晚的报警——这是一款对话冒险游戏。每一位来电者都由本地AI扮演，全程离线运行。每晚4点12分，电话都会响起：打来的，是一个本该已经死去的女孩。谁能获救、谁会失去，取决于你怎么接这通电话。

games.name: Uga Buga!
games.description: 《Uga Buga!》是一款以石器时代为背景的伪装诈唬聚会游戏，支持4-12名好友同乐。游戏的目标是找出并揭穿正在说谎（BLUFF）的玩家。在此过程中，你们可以通过语音聊天、挑眉和眼神交流传递隐秘线索。

games.name: Historical War：The Animation
games.description: 《Historical War：The Animation》是一部经典战争动画推演馆。以时间轴重现从亚历山大大帝到海湾战争的著名战役：播放、暂停、回放、拖动进度，每部约五分钟。拿破仑为界，此前为古代战争，此后为现代战争。

games.name: Blooby Idle
games.description: BLOOBY Idle is a desktop idle game where BLOOBY fights endless waves of the Tumor to save the one she loves. Collect loot, upgrade your weapons, prestige and grow stronger while BLOOBY battles on your desktop as you work, browse or play.

games.name: Multiverse Survivors
games.description: 游戏特色：解锁全部多元宇宙，把不同多元宇宙的角色和技能放到一起，打出关羽大战秦琼的效果。爱因斯坦大闹天宫，古代将领手搓原子弹，奥丁开枪攻击敌人，孙悟空大战外星人，等等！

games.name: Board Games
games.description: 一个棋盘游戏合集，世界各地几十种不同类型的棋。开房间线上对战、本地双人、挑战 AI——挑一盘，马上开局。

games.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
games.description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

games.name: Debuilders
games.description: Grab a sledgehammer and dive into the chaos! Debuilders is a physics‑based cooperative comedy for 4 players, in which each worker has a funny flaw. Destroy walls, fix fuse boxes, follow the boss’s instructions, and try to finish the repairs without accidentally destroying your friends!

games.name: 私密房间：少女解密计划
games.description: 在人类、改造人、妖怪与神明共存的科幻都市中，作为一名特殊检察官，你需要定期拜访少女们的房间。通过消消乐获取资源，装饰她们的房间，与她们互动，并逐渐揭开隐藏在日常生活背后的秘密。

games.name: 变强吧！自走棋
games.description: 这是一款自走棋游戏。通过棋子的技能，被动技能和羁绊的配合，使棋子无上限的变强。

games.name: Unmess Co.: Rewind the Wreck
games.description: 环顾一片狼藉的房间，弄清楚谁挡着谁，并按正确的顺序把一切恢复原状。启动 Rewind，重新拼好破碎的物品，把每样东西送回原位——最好别再制造新的事故。

games.name: Dungeon: Build Unbound
games.description: 《地牢：构筑失控》是一款支持单人和最多4人本地同屏合作的动作肉鸽。拿起不同武器，在不断涌来的怪潮中收集和升级道具，把一开始简单的攻击逐渐堆成完全失控的构筑：子弹能够分裂、膨胀并在穿透中变强，激光可以被复制并继续触发近战剑痕，移动也能留下斩击、地雷和残影。随着战斗不断推进，敌群越来越密、构筑越来越夸张；完成主线后，还可以继续进入不断强化的无尽模式。

games.name: UNDERFED
games.description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

games.name: Hexwell
games.description: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where you use powerful magic spells to fight off hordes of arcane machines. Choose your path through the dungeon, fuse your spells together, create unique builds, and become the ultimate mage. Play solo or local co-op with up to 4 players!

games.name: Towered
games.description: Defend the Nexus, run after run. Build under population limits, balance gold and mana, draft augments as you level, and spend gems on a permanent power-up tree in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite.

games.name: Witchkeeping
games.description: Witchkeeping is a cozy narrative organizing game about a witch urgently appointed to an academy library. Fly your broom, shelve the books by solving their puzzles, and put the wands away. Open the owl’s letters, sort out the valley’s odd troubles, and find out what happened to Madame Vesper.

games.name: Dialshift
games.description: Dialshift 是一款在单一圆环上追逐高分的高速街机游戏。每次转向，也是在尝试命中目标。观察目标，选择路线，在七种模式不断改写规则时保持冷静。

games.name: BASHDASH
games.description: 一款最多支持8人的混乱派对游戏，充满狂野的物理效果、陷阱和捣乱！不会彻底出局，爬起来继续战斗。推开好友，像布娃娃一样翻滚乱飞，通过游玩获得所有外观道具，每两周挑战一张全新地图。没有内购。只有一人能赢！

games.name: 阵地战场
games.description: 免费试玩版现已开放！《阵地战场》是一款融合肉鸽卡牌成长的自由布阵塔防游戏。用炮塔改变敌人路线，从三张强化卡中选择一张，在战地商店购买强化与补给，打造你的防御流派，在交叉火力中抵御敌军。

games.name: Tainted Tide
games.description: A rogulite where you're stranded on a damaged lifeboat in a corrupted, endless ocean. You have 40 days to survive. Fish, scavenge, and craft by day. Fight what rises from the deep by night in match-3 battles where every tile is a weapon.

games.name: 孤星漫步
games.description: 《孤星漫步》是一款专注于氛围探索与舒缓治愈的开放世界漫步游戏。你将扮演一名迫降异星的小宇航员，为了修好飞船重返家园，在这颗星球上踏上探索之旅。升级喷气背包以飞跃更广阔的地形，收集散落的飞船零件，解开巧妙的环境谜题，并结识可爱的异星生物。随着旅程推进，整个世界的色彩与音乐将发生奇妙的蜕变，带给你一段零压力纯粹的治愈冒险。

games.name: Sea of Sluts ⚓️
games.description: 在这款融合 Roguelite 元素的成人 3D 视觉小说中，扬帆驶入奇幻海盗世界！探索海洋、选择航线、用弹球风格的战斗迎战敌舰、寻找宝藏，并邂逅美丽的海盗女孩。⚓️💋

games.name: Celebria
games.description: From movie star to music icon, you run the show in Celebria. Guide your entertainer through landing roles, releasing music, touring the world, climbing global charts, chasing prestigious awards, and running a celebrity brand, all while navigating the pressures of fame.

games.name: There’s No Way the Dating Sim Heroine I Liked Could Be a Murderer...?!
games.description: Investigate a series of murders at an abandoned school, examine evidence, connect clues, and reconstruct each crime. In this 2D psychological mystery adventure, every answer points to the dating sim heroine you trusted most—but is she truly the killer?

games.name: Critter Rumble
games.description: 组建你的怪物队伍，选择要挑战的敌人，招募被你击败的对手，在拥有永久增益的Roguelite自动战斗游戏中不断进化你的队伍。灵活调整策略，迎战越来越强大的Boss！

games.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
games.description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

games.name: Fishcremental
games.description: 《Fishcremental》是一场超治愈的海底冒险：捕捉超可爱的小鱼，解锁改变玩法的升级，让整片海洋绽放满屏烟花。

games.name: Pawperwork
games.description: An idle game about a cat stamping an absurd amount of paperwork, in a window that lives on top of everything else you are doing. Collect the package, stamp what is inside, send it out. Do it all by hand until you can afford not to, then go find out who keeps sending the work down.

games.name: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch
games.description: 《天灾都市：魔法少女派出中》是一款结合了都市探索、伙伴收集、角色养成与回合制战斗的二次元 RPG。在灾异与欲望交织的高压锅都市「天原府」中，漫游街头邂逅各路少女、收集海量专长、觉醒变身魔法少女轰杀裂隙异形！游戏更内置强大的可视化剧情与角色编辑器，让你随心创造属于自己的都市传奇！

games.name: Retroventory
games.description: Run a second-hand retro game shop. Haggle over every deal, appraise consoles and games, spot counterfeits, and sell to the right customer at the right price. Manage it all from your shop PC: market trends, loans, bills, staff and shady hackers. Earn, upgrade, and build your retro empire.

games.name: Killwright
games.description: 《Killwright》是一款残酷爽快的第一人称近战肉鸽游戏，核心玩法围绕精准操作与战斗节奏展开。选择你的 Killwright，打造凶狠致命的流派，在千钧一发之际完美防御，触发 Tempo，让周围世界陷入慢动作，并抓住一次破绽，将其化作一连串毁灭性的杀戮。

games.name: Broadband Architect
games.description: Britain's broadband is a mess, and you're the small company that says it can do better. Trench real UK streets, wire real homes to fibre, and size your network against the 8pm evening peak — when the whole town logs on at once. Dig up Britain. Sell broadband. Survive the evening peak.

games.name: wishbound
games.description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

games.name: Sugarena
games.description: 《Sugarena》是一款俯视角roguelike竞技场射击游戏，玩家需要击退成群结队的怪物。游戏提供丰富的武器库供玩家选择，玩家可以升级并提升武器等级，最终通关竞技场。

games.name: K-Drama Game 1
games.description: Step into a dramatic K-drama mystery where nothing is quite what it seems. Investigate suspicious behavior, uncover hidden evidence, compare contradictions, and piece together the lies that reveal what really happened.

games.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
games.description: 在 Deadzone Cleanup Crew 中搜寻废料、升级基地、招募幸存者，并清理被丧尸占领的区域！这是一款点击清理式末日增量游戏，迎战不断升级的丧尸浪潮、强力 Boss，并享受数值不断暴涨的爽快成长感！

games.name: DEBTBOUND: Never Unplug
games.description: DEBTBOUND: Never Unplug is a FPS roguelite where you’ll fight waves of enemies while building your upgrade deck, discovering new items, and exploring procedurally generated maps. Your weapon can also mutate into different combat styles.

games.name: 桌面猎人
games.description: 《Desk Hunter》是一款会在小窗口中持续战斗的桌面放置角色扮演游戏。收集战利品，通过装备炼金打磨装备，利用技能与成长节点搭配流派，与使魔并肩作战，挑战更高难度。

games.name: SWARMED
games.description: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in ~15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

games.name: SLIME OVERFLOW
games.description: Produce, pile up, and merge slimes until your container can barely hold them. Withstand the enemy’s advance, then open the gate and flood the battlefield with everything you’ve built. Grow bigger between runs in this physics-based incremental roguelite.

games.name: The Devoltion
games.description: A vengeful ex-cop slices, shoots, and grapples his way through mob-controlled streets to disarm a bomb and save the mayor and city hall before the clock runs out.

games.name: Zombie Motel 96
games.description: 一款让你经营汽车旅馆、亲手设计迷宫的Roguelike防守经营游戏。收留幸存者，将他们部署在自己设计的迷宫中，抵御丧尸袭击。搭配每局不同的奖励与遗物，挑战生存96天。防线失守后，用新的迷宫设计和流派重新开始。

games.name: Incraiders
games.description: 『Incraiders』一款活跃的 Incremental游戏，在游戏中，你从倒下的入侵者身上获得能量，成为宇宙的跨维度守护者。

games.name: Bloody Fighters
games.description: Command a brutal comic-book faction in fast territory wars. Capture relays, mutate your fighters, earn permanent Superweapons, conquer an industrial campaign, battle ruthless AI, or face up to seven players online.

games.name: RENSE
games.description: A fast survivors roguelite FPS with aggressive combat. Fight against waves of enemies and bosses. Level up, find and stack up loot and grow powerful until your attacks fill the screen. Create unique builds with deep customization.

games.name: 火柴人与荒野战车
games.description: 这是一款结合了公路探索、载具改造与 Roguelike射击 的动作生存游戏。在这里，您的战车是唯一的希望，而身后紧追不舍的未知迷雾与前方致命怪兽，正时刻威胁着你的生命。发动引擎，踏上这场永无止境的生存狂飙！！！

games.name: Shuffle Lounge
games.description: Shuffle Lounge汇集世界各地42款纸牌游戏。可与电脑单人对战，也可和好友及其他玩家在线游玩；支持的游戏最多6人同桌。还能自定义规则，并连续游玩多款游戏。

games.name: AnomalyVault
games.description: 在Anomaly Vault中，你将为反乌托邦世界里最后的企业APC工作。调查未知异常体，实现处理流程自动化，并在一场场失控事故中设法生存。

games.name: John Whisk
games.description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

games.name: Chiki Poki: Rush🎉
games.description: 世界上最可爱的清剿行动。快节奏的主动式增量游戏。击败什么都要模仿的“奇皮”，收集星星糖，让必杀技永不停歇！用收集到的材料不断变强，直到打倒“奇皮王”！

games.name: Witch of Oz
games.description: Turn poker hands into magic in this card-puzzle adventure. Form spell patterns on a 3×3 grid, overlap them for powerful combos, and experiment with items and card enchantments. Explore a pixel-art Oz with Dorothy and use your magic to help her companions.

games.name: 小猫钓鱼
games.description:
这是一款轻松治愈的自动钓鱼游戏。
选择角色、准备鱼竿，抛下鱼线，看着鱼儿上钩、收获战利品，并逐步打造属于你的钓鱼旅程。

games.name: 亡灵苏生
games.description: 打倒尸潮，把倒下的尸身拘成骨兵，亲自施法、带着军团赢下一场；夺回归生权柄，把墓里的亡者接回家，唤回居民、修起工坊，让废墟重新有人等你。东方暗黑奇幻动作，免费试玩已开放。

games.name: Bomb Them Ores
games.description: Bomb Them Ores 是一款流程短小的街机增量采矿游戏。炸开洞穴、收集矿物并解锁升级，向更深处进发！

games.name: 敲酒师
games.description: 《敲酒师》是一款常驻桌面角落的轻量挂机收集游戏。你的匿名键盘节奏会在不记录输入内容的前提下酿成不同啤酒，吸引各有所好的客人前来品尝。观察酿造成因，发现隐藏酒款，逐步填满酒谱与客人图鉴，让工作与学习中的每一次敲击都为小酒馆带来新的惊喜。

games.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
games.description: 与《Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure》一起重温经典吧！36 个关卡中的前 9 关可免费游玩。勇者 Ilenor 的魔杖、大锅和钻石被偷走了，他心爱的猫咪 Shadowtongue 也被抓走了！闯过充满敌人和致命陷阱的混乱关卡，把它们夺回来吧！

games.name: ZomBMart
games.description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

games.name: PLATFORM 13
games.description: 一款第一人称恐怖观察游戏，你必须找出异常才能逃脱。每一座站台都是随机生成的，超过 30 种异常正在等待。每一次死亡都会在名单上添上一个新的名字。在抵达 Platform 13 之前，你会牺牲多少人？

games.name: Delverun
games.description: A roguelite mining simulator where inventory is never the problem, time is. Explore a randomly generated mine as a goblin, grab everything you can carry, and race the collapse before it's too late. Get greedy, or get buried, your time management decides.

games.name: 热血挂机
games.description: 战士、法师、道士，熟悉的职业，全新的桌面冒险。自动战斗、离线成长，也可以隐藏在桌面后，陪你慢慢收集心仪的装备。

games.name: Shift Happens: Together
games.description: Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Take warehouse orders, find the required parts, move goods, assemble and pack products, handle unexpected incidents, and deliver everything as quickly as possible to maximize your earnings.

games.name: Night Class
games.description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

games.name: Arclore
games.description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

games.name: Souls Caps
games.description: A rhythm-driven roguelite deckbuilder. Hit the beat to drop your caps, chain throw after throw, and earn your job at Soulbuster!

games.name: Dungeon Ball
games.description: Fight to the beat in a fast-paced action roguelike and break the cursed loop.

games.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
games.description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》是一款实时下落方块与自动战斗结合的轻度Roguelike游戏，你可以通过消除方块来派遣士兵，选择随机强化，突破敌方堡垒。组建方块军团，在不断变化的战场上挑战极限！

games.name: Horny Gnomes 🧙🏻‍♂️🔞
games.description: 一个小小的地精、一栋巨大的房子，还有一大堆麻烦！在与人类身高相匹配的房间中潜行，解决物理谜题，与环境互动，并在这场搞笑的成人潜行冒险中避免被发现。

games.name: E.G.O. Software Suite
games.description: E.G.O. Software Suite is a personal software suite created by Superego Inc.

games.name: Rottenlands
games.description: Rottenlands is a tower defense deckbuilder where you build a deck of units, towers, and abilities to hold back waves of Mold-corrupted enemies and protect the kingdom.

games.name: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
games.description: 敌军正向德林柴城堡进发，而你只有短短几天时间做好迎敌准备。治理你的子民，训练你的士兵，按你自己的方式为即将到来的围城战加固城墙。因为当敌人兵临城下时，你做出的每一个选择都将与你一同站在战场上。

games.name: Pop Blob
games.description: Pop Blob is a casual platformer game where you control the cute little Blob to get over the obstacles and reach to the safe Bubble! Grab the Gem as extra challenge, explore the levels and shape your movement skills!

games.name: Guildfire
games.description: Lead a party of adventurers through branching expeditions in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Learn enemy intentions, build each character with abilities and accessories, manage your upgrades, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

games.name: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
games.description: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush 完美融合三消谜题与弹珠台物理碰撞玩法！消除方块释放弹跳珠，穿过钉阵落入高倍数插槽，打出极其爽快的超高连击得分。触发强力道具，解锁永久升级，勇夺全球排行榜榜首！

games.name: The Turing Choice
games.description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

games.name: Motive Power
games.description: Run British Railways' locomotive fleet from 1955 to 1994. Order the classes history built — or take your own choices. Manage overhauls, depots, budgets and withdrawals across four decades, and answer for it in a graded annual report against the real record. Deterministic, deeply researched.

games.name: ONE STEP WAR
games.description:
《一步战争》是一款现代极简风格的轻量战术棋盘游戏。战斗发生多样的棋盘上，每个回合都围绕一次关键行动展开：选择单个棋子行动，或让整支部队统一移动。  不同的棋子有不同的效果，做成优秀的选择。

游戏包含常规对战、战役谜题与肉鸽远征等模式。

规则并不复杂，但每一步都可能改变整个局面。观察威胁、安排顺序、制造突破口，并用尽可能少的行动完成胜利。

games.name: Trials of Dash
games.description: Stay ahead of a deadly wall, change color with every jump, and land on the right platforms to survive.

games.name: 守城不慌
games.description: 敌人不会停，士兵会自己打。你不操作士兵，只管买兵、花钱、配队。同一种兵买得越多越贵，钱就这么多，这一波扩军还是留给下一波。输了只丢身上的金币，装备、星图和已解锁的东西都留着。一款不需要手速的增量防守游戏。

games.name: Cat and Dog: Princess Guardians
games.description:
黑暗魔物席卷整片大陆，公主踏上逃亡之路。
﻿
一路上，她遇见一只只遭受排挤、被世人抛弃的猫狗生灵。秋田重甲犬、雷电黑猫 它们身负独特力量，却受尽人类的畏惧与伤害。公主给予它们善意与庇护，而这些生灵自愿化作守护之塔，誓死挡在公主身前。

games.name: KittenRush
games.description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

games.name: A Risky Rocky Resort
games.description: Run a luxurious resort during the day and cater to your guests’ needs in order to make the big bucks! But be wary, because at night, pirates and other invaders show up! Entertain, build, and survive, and hopefully, you’ll make it big!

games.name: 我带过的最差一届
games.description: 这是一款支持最多6人联机的非对称派对游戏！1名玩家扮演严厉老师，另外5名玩家扮演调皮捣蛋学生。捣蛋学生们需要躲藏在数十名NPC学生之间，暗中完成偷吃零食、偷玩手机等恶作剧任务。而老师要从人群里揪出全部的捣蛋学生，维护课堂的纪律！

games.name: MIDNIGHT MARKET
games.description: 在这款合作恐怖游戏中与朋友一起度过夜班。分配任务、补充产品、打扫超市、执行老板荒唐的命令，同时共同应对受巴西民间传说启发的异常现象。

games.name: The Extractors
games.description: 一款合作恐怖游戏，你将与队友一起探索危险环境、收集珍贵物品，并为生存而战。齐心协力，敢于冒险，在为时已晚之前成功返回。

games.name: The Seventh Circle
games.description: Retro movement shooter rougelike in which you smash through the hordes of hell in search of a wish, while getting sponsored by patrons of questionable ethics and eldritch origin...

games.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED
games.description:
Blades and scarabs locked in a tango of death. A multi-ending sci-fi seinen visual novel inspired by 90s anime OVAs.
Will you find the truth behind the alien invasion? Or will you bring the world to the brink of destruction again?

games.name: Veil of Time
games.description: Raine's brother is missing, and his uncle has handed him the family sword. Fight in real time on the field, where a perfect parry drops the world to pencil, or let foes close in for turn-based battles with timed strikes. A JRPG with hand-painted maps, a 32-track score and optional voices.

games.name: Tavern: Tidy Up
games.description:
充满中世纪氛围的温馨手工风格环境
木桶、面包、高脚杯、肉、锅等多种物品
从一个房间到另一个房间的轻松玩法
随着清理不断扩大并解锁新区域的客栈
角色升级系统
无压力、无负担的游戏体验

games.name: Bush League Baseball
games.description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

games.name: Deathfall
games.description: 款节奏明快的像素风 Roguelike，每次冒险都会变得更加混乱。对抗无尽的敌人浪潮，强化你的流派，看看你能存活多久。

games.name: SplitOut
games.description:
Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience

Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

games.name: Midnight Motel
games.description: Work the night shift at a remote motel to pay for your sick mother's medicine. Manage rooms, serve guests, and survive the night. But when escaped convicts arrive, you face a deadly choice: hide them from the police, reject them, or pull the trigger. The choice is yours.

games.name: Cyan Moon - The Simulation Program
games.description: An experimental simulation sandbox where you shape procedural growth, adjust rules and parameters, and watch complex visual patterns emerge from simple systems.

games.name: 万形之海：深潜进化
games.description: 从食物链最底端开始，亲手塑造你的身体，在广袤的海底世界中狩猎、成长与进化。穿越阳光充盈的浅海与寂静无光的深渊，在不断变化的环境与愈发危险的猎手间求生，以独一无二的生命形态探索这片海的最深处。

games.name: Down to Floor Zero
games.description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

games.name: Ultracapitalism
games.description: Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where cash is your health and debt is your weapon. Assemble a 10-slot board of corporate assets, customize synergies with buzzwords, and auto-battle rival founders in deterministic asynchronous boardroom combat.

games.name: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King
games.description: A top-down action-adventure on an 8-bit cartridge, now seen in 3D. Cross a sunlit country, brave nine tombs, outwit their guardians and recover eight Sunstones. Walk it in the orbital 3/4 view, and take on a new tomb every day.

games.name: Be a Pirate!
games.description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath.  Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan.  Think, don't just click!

games.name: MassBlox
games.description: 围绕核心构建方形环，在方块继续下落时旋转已锁定的结构，并触发坍缩连锁反应。MassBlox 是一款节奏明快的 2D 益智游戏，包含无限经典模式和 20 个精心设计的益智关卡。

games.name: Wreckroom
games.description: A physics sandbox about taking ragdolls apart. Shoot them, cut them, burn them or blow them up. They bleed, lose limbs and collapse. Make a mess and see what happens.

games.name: Orbacity
games.description: Enjoy building your own solar system in this relaxing idle game!  Gain money over time to buy a variety of upgrades and extract resources from heavenly bodies.  Start over for even more rewards and complete all the achievements!

games.name: Demon Crisis
games.description: A fast, ridiculous On-Rails Arcade Shooter about two government employees fighting through a demon-infested office. Play Solo or in Two-Player Co-Op using a mouse, controller, or any modern USB Lightgun.

games.name: Fallen Nights
games.description: Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. A top-down zombie survival defense game where every piece of scrap buys firepower or escape. Combine turrets, mines, and weapon upgrades, then fight beside your camp across varied locations and escalating night attacks.

games.name: Saddlebow
games.description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

games.name: Something Really Evil Inc.
games.description: 和可爱的角色们一起散播表情包、制造混乱，扳倒一家邪恶公司！每周都有一个新项目，每个项目都是一次拖延、取消并把 CEO 气到跳脚的机会。

games.name: 心跳老虎机
games.description: 拉下拉杆、赚取信用点，并在 12 天分期合约中按时支付每天的账单。选择能够改写概率的技能，提升全息机器人的好感度，把老虎机推入超频，直到你心爱的机器人真正属于你。

games.name: GARITO
games.description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

games.name: Just Weeding
games.description:
把杂草连根拔起！拔草、捡起、卖掉！
简单却让人上瘾的拔草游戏。
齐心协力拔光全部“10万株”杂草，从心底感受畅快吧！

games.name: AI Startup Simulator
games.description: AI Startup Simulator是一款第一人称经营模拟游戏。从狭小的店面起步，亲手组装服务器，通过完成客户委托，逐步发展自己的AI业务。

games.name: Needle in a Million Haystacks
games.description: 在这款混乱的物理破坏游戏中，用霰弹枪、草叉、电锯、火焰喷射器，甚至一只山羊，摧毁成堆的干草。抓起、投掷、粉碎、燃烧或轰飞干草，把整个农场闹得一团糟，只为找到那根小小的针。

games.name: UNDELIVERED
games.description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

games.name: Tilemancer
games.description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

games.name: PixelPainter 95
games.description: 涂满画布，再涂一块更大的。一款1995年桌面上的增量绘画游戏，从一页走向十亿个格子。加粗画笔，雇来在你离开后继续干活的画师，打印每一页，换来更强的开局。

games.name: The Monkey's Paw
games.description:
Hold the monkey's paw and make a wish, but remember: everything comes at a price.
A short horror visual novel where choices matter...painfully.

games.name: Shroom & Blade
games.description: An asymmetric co-op action and base-building game for two players. The Shroom Fighter battles enemies and gathers resources while the Base Builder automates production and fortifies the base. To survive, both roles must work as one.

games.name: 满载开溜
games.description: 《满载开溜》 清新像素坦克 × 肉鸽构筑 × 轻度搜打撤 搜到满载，打到冒烟，然后想办法活着开溜。

games.name: Synapse Grid
games.description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Green trail is rideable terrain; amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

games.name: The Last Helm
games.description: 《The Last Helm》是一款在奇幻世界中建造并运营属于自己的店铺的贸易与管理模拟游戏。从零开始，采购货物，打造武器与药水，招募员工，并通过组织探险来不断扩展你的商铺。

games.name: Auto Squad RPG
games.description: 一款培养并进化英雄与怪物的自走棋RPG。进化你的单位以激发全新潜力，搭配各具特色的英雄与装备来构筑最佳阵型。探索地下城、刷取强力装备，打造属于你自己的精英小队！

games.name: Undersea Post Office Sim
games.description: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

games.name: Goblins Gotta Go
games.description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

games.name: Potato.exe - A Game About Spinning a Wheel to Download Potatoes
games.description: 一款反放置的轮盘点击游戏。转转盘来收获土豆，成功率只有20%。收集土豆、购买升级、扭转概率……你能连续赢下十次吗？留意屏幕上的每个角落：隐藏剧情、额外升级、猫咪，还有超性感的土豆。

games.name: Tick & Tired
games.description: Tick & Tired 是一款关于搞定待办事项的增量游戏。完成整理邮件等桌面任务，雇佣实习生实现工作自动化，在一天结束时获得海量连击，通过技能树升级你的工作流。

games.name: IS THIS FEMBOY TAKEN⁉️
games.description: 一款关于组织专属派对的成人益智模拟游戏。安排古怪的宾客，发现哪些人适合彼此，并在不同地点找到完美布局。简单易学，却难以精通，充满调皮惊喜。😏

games.name: Her Sister Between Us 💦😳
games.description: 探索热闹的公寓楼，结识迷人的住户，完成任务并揭开他们的故事。在这款充满幽默、秘密与意外邂逅的3D成人视觉小说中，尽情调情、说服他人，并运用你的直觉

games.name: Ministry of Time
games.description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

games.name: Arithmeria
games.description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

games.name: Iron Remnant
games.description: Command troops in real-time battles, upgrade the orbital starship Asgard, and fight alongside anime-inspired companions across a war-torn world in this story-driven action strategy RPG.

games.name: Move The Freak Out!
games.description:
In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. 

Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry!

Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

games.name: Blue Collar'd
games.description: A co-op physics-based construction building game. Manage resources, craft materials and build against the clock!

games.name: Oh Shear!
games.description: 拿起剪刀，打造温馨的羊毛帝国！《Oh Shear!》是一款轻松惬意的放置游戏，照料一群色彩缤纷的绵羊。升级工具、让牧场自动运作，再逐步解锁技能树。放松下来，享受数字不断增长的乐趣！

games.name: Ski Survival
games.description: Get down the mountain. When it goes wrong, something absurd comes to get you, and it is never the same thing twice. A one-button endless skiing comedy where every wipeout summons a rescue nobody asked for.

games.name: 1999保密协议
games.description:
《1999保密协议》是一部由 AI 技术打造的互动影游。当外星意识摧毁
2099 年的神经元宇宙，你被抛回 1999 年——必须在比自己出生早一个世纪
的世界里求生。每一个选择都会改写剧情，在 16 种结局中，危机、喜剧
与意料之外的爱情交织碰撞。

games.name: Head Miner
games.description: 从简单的采矿设施起步，将其打造成强大的资源帝国。实现工作自动化，发现珍贵材料，升级你的装备，并做出明智的投资，让你的事业不断壮大。

games.name: Memorology
games.description: A memory roguelike deckbuilder. Rewrite the rules of memory with intuitive combos, defining upgrades, energetic synergies, and endless strategies.

games.name: Meowmunitions Survivor
games.description: Meowmunitions Survivor is a bullet-heaven arena shooter with the unique augmenting system that allows you to design your own gun.

games.name: Lucky Debt
games.description: A roguelike about debt. Eight deadlines, one rigged slot machine, and a simple problem: the money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger. Build a deck of symbols and charms, chain multipliers, and pay what you owe — or don't.

games.name: 猫爪花屋
games.description: 一款轻松可爱的网格拼图游戏。你需要在一间挤满猫猫的小店里摆放各种盆栽。放好所有植物，了解每只猫的行动规则，并利用它们的小特点解开每一关。

games.name: Mycelarium
games.description: An incremental exploration game about growing a living fungal network beneath a peaceful forest. Expand your mycelium, discover hidden resources, evolve strange mushrooms, and turn the underground into your own fungal empire.

games.name: Too Deep To Stop
games.description:
Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way.
Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

games.name: VELOCIDE
games.description: A fast-paced parkour arena shooter set in a living Hell. Grapple, dash, wall-run, and blast through hordes of enemies in brutal high-speed combat. Move fast. Kill faster. Change Hell forever.

games.name: Marinette mm cl
games.description: Marinette mm cl is a game where you find yourself in a dangerous world where you must confront creatures and solve puzzles to continue your journey.

games.name: Count on Chaos
games.description: A calculator roguelite where every correct equation counts. Install passive drivers, chase absurd combos, survive fake system failures, and raise and customize a tiny calculator buddy as the machine breaks around you.

games.name: Prospector's Yield
games.description: Plan tunnels, mine ore, organize workers and transportation, turn mining output into economic progress, and make strategic decisions in the city between seasons.

games.name: Unreported Shift
games.description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1980s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

games.name: ANOMALY CATALOG 1: SCHOOL
games.description: Something is wrong at this school. Strange incidents are spreading, students are hiding secrets, and creatures that should not exist are beginning to appear. Follow the clues, survive the horrors, and discover what is really happening before it is too late.

games.name: Boss After Boss
games.description: Boss After Boss 是一款增量游戏。击碎宝箱，获得强力技能，挑战越来越危险的 Boss。提升属性，解锁更高等级的宝箱，并利用每个 Boss 的弱点将其击败。

games.name: Aubelys
games.description: Play as the leader of a light fantasy town. Your character gather resources, raise a five-tier settlement, recruit and specialize fellow villagers, and defend against nightly raids in solo, online co-op, PvP, or local split-screen as you push back against the dark spreading in the land of Aubelys.

games.name: The Bakery
games.description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recepies, kitchen furniture, Decoration and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

games.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
games.description: 一次失败的抢劫让整座银行陷入一片混乱。现在，作为金库管理员，你必须整理超过 16,000 件散落的物品，将一切放回正确的位置，并揭开银行客户与他们珍贵财物背后的故事。

games.name: Waifu Curator
games.description: 通过寻找、分类和展示收藏级手办，修复这座混乱的 Waifu 博物馆。收集、整理并打造完美的展览！

games.name: Daedalia
games.description: A Greek labyrinth rebuilt every game. Find the key, the Golden Fleece and the ichor before the others do — while the Minotaur hunts the corridors and the Medusa petrifies on sight. Die, and come back as a Shade to possess them

games.name: Decksplorer
games.description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

games.name: Way Too Many Eggs
games.description: 小小的农场，鸡蛋多到装不下！《Way Too Many Eggs》是一款越玩越热闹的增量游戏。收集鸡蛋、壮大鸡群、雇用帮工，再把巨蛋敲个开花！技能树里的永久升级会让下一轮更有奔头。

games.name: Objecipher
games.description: 一款充满巧妙提示、迷之逻辑和离谱解读的团队对抗游戏。赶在对手之前，找出属于你们队伍的物品！

games.name: 人生回放
games.description: 闭上眼的那一刻，一生在眼前闪过。1000 + 段回忆，从出生到死亡，带你重温一个人完整的一生。每一次选择都改写人生轨迹，四段截然不同的人生，数千种可能。欢笑、泪水、遗憾、温暖交织 —— 回首才懂，平凡的每一天都值得珍惜。

games.name: Chronicles of Prozis
games.description: 一款充满谜团、友情和秘密的经典奇幻JRPG。以你喜欢的方式探索普罗齐斯的世界，揭开一个足以改变整个世界结构的威胁背后的真相。

games.name: Kyle Coral
games.description: 一款宁静、手工打造的洞穴潜水冒险游戏。潜入由五个生态区构成的鲜活海洋，你的氧气是唯一的时钟。读懂洞穴，找到气穴，在氧气耗尽前浮出水面。只有你、深海，和下一口呼吸。由一位父亲和他的两个儿子制作。

games.name: Mossu
games.description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

games.name: Pencil Shavings Soup
games.description: Pencil Shaving's Soup is a relaxing incremental game where you start from one vintage sharpener and turn its pencils shavings into a money making soup factory empire!

games.name: Glims
games.description: A battle pet that lives on your desktop. Your glims walk your taskbar, live in a 3D house you decorate and earn gold on their own. When you call, they hold off an invasion on your screen or dive a 20-floor dungeon. Free, light, and it works offline.

games.name: Tidy Arcana
games.description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

games.name: 极限建造
games.description: 灾难来了！你要用有限预算搭结构、做机关、布防线，保护海狸熬过地震、洪水、泥石流、陨石和敌袭。硬扛、卸力、导流、设防都行——没有标准答案，只要灾难过后，它还站着。

games.name: Abductables
games.description: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

games.name: Duckstep
games.description: Catch falling gems to the beat, draft skills mid-run, and chain combos until your stepper's power ignites. A rhythm game with 20 songs, 20 characters, 30 stackable skills and 7 run-defining Ultimates — plus a VS mode where your combo becomes your opponent's problem.

games.name: Plamo Kits
games.description: 从流道上剪下零件，自由涂装、贴花并组装模型。为完成的模型摆出姿势，展示在房间里并拍照——在轻松的模型制作模拟游戏中，按自己的节奏完成每一盒模型。

games.name: Crown and Coup
games.description: Chess is the deck. Draft an army, march it through escalating sieges, and stack stratagems until one rook move scores like an avalanche. A score-chasing roguelike where every capture feeds the combo - and checkmate is the jackpot.

games.name: Just Kill
