games.description: A third person shooter about a detective investigating a police station which has been overtaken by a dangerous gang of bikers, use your quick wits, agility and deadly force to bring order back to the police station

games.name: Tile Tally
games.description: Draw tiles, connect the land, and chase bigger scoring clusters in this tile-placement roguelike deckbuilder. Small tiles, big scores, in a calm, hand-drawn world.

games.name: 把牌打空！
games.description: 一款没有繁琐数值计算的斗地主 Roguelike：只要想办法让自己的手牌比对手更少，就能获胜；若能彻底打空，更是完胜。可丈育村的村民也懂这个道理，他们可不管什么规则，只顾着把自己的牌往你手里塞。好在你扮演的小动物牌客也个个会出千，绝非易与之辈——现场吃牌、凭空画牌，怎么作弊由你决定。

games.name: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
games.description: 打造疯狂的撞车场景，撞毁汽车并记录混乱瞬间！分享精彩视频，吸引更多粉丝并提高收入。购买新车辆和设备，制造规模更大的撞车事故，让你的 CarCrash.Tube 频道登上巅峰！

games.name: 无字命书：先行篇
games.description: 《无字命书》是一款东方玄幻叙事冒险游戏。在这个凡人以命为薪、诸神高居云端的世界里，一本无字天书的出现打破了千年的平衡。玩家将扮演天命者，踏上揭开天书真相的旅程，在错综复杂的人神纠葛中做出抉择。游戏融合了探索、解谜与剧情选择，你的每一个决定都将影响世界的命运。面对神与凡人的终极博弈，你将书写属于自己的命书。

games.name: DUE TONIGHT
games.description: 瞪着大眼睛的文件在你桌上爬来爬去，业绩指标今晚就得交。你是地下收发室的夜班实习生，手里只有一枚橡皮图章，把它移到文件上头，它自己就会砸下去。盖章、收钱、升职，大楼一共七层，每层都有自己的办公桌、文件和图章，从收发室一路爬到银河登记处。招兵买马组团队，被开除了就更强地杀回来，最后给整个宇宙批个准。每一份文件，全都是今晚要交。

games.name: PARRYGON
games.description: 反弹能量球，把握时机招架，在不断崩塌的竞技场中生存。挑战36个战役任务，在无尽街机模式中冲击Steam排行榜，或与朋友展开支持2至4人的本地对战。

games.name: PERIHELIA
games.description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

games.name: Sekigahara 1600
games.description: 关原，1600年——以及从古代中国到美国南北战争的东西方战场。停在敌方控制区（ZOC）内的部队必须发动攻击：没有平静的侧翼，也没有按兵不动的预备队。推动战线，才是这款游戏的核心。一款内容深厚的六角格兵棋，而大多数会战约 30 分钟即可分出胜负。

games.name: Inbox Duel
games.description: You're the new intern, and the only weapon you have is email. Duel your coworkers with passive-aggressive cards until they get fired, then come for your boss's job. Inbox Duel is a roguelike deckbuilder about climbing the office one promotion at a time.

games.name: Warslave
games.description: An old-school sci-fi shooter in an exotic alien world. Compact, open world mini-Doom.

games.name: Divinestead
games.description: 在这款放置类增量游戏中，将一座小村庄发展成庞大的据点，管理资源，寻找宝藏，击败敌人并获得神圣升级！

games.name: Crash Relay
games.description: 最多支持10名玩家。每辆车由两名玩家共同操控。在《Crash Relay》中，与队友分工控制车辆，拾取武器和特殊能力，并干扰对手队伍。在这款混乱刺激的多人竞速游戏中，团队合作是冲过终点线的关键。

games.name: SLAM TANK
games.description: 挥舞炮管，用车身冲撞，突破AI的机械大军。这是一款主打华丽动作的单人坦克游戏——你摧毁得越多，AI的损失就越大。

games.name: 心镇图书馆 HeartLib
games.description:
作为心镇的新任图书管理员，你茫然之中认识了一位少女和诸多怪异的协助者，同时，你需要用自己掌握的书籍为武器对抗心镇的入侵者。
以心灵信标为基点，打出插图，书页和读后感。游戏围绕卡牌和战棋模式展开，策略聚焦于排布卡牌之间的配合和使用的顺序。玩家们需要自由构筑携带的书籍和协助者，在剧情中了解关于情绪和心灵的秘密。

games.name: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
games.description:
You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world.
Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope.
A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

games.name: Soul Link - End and Rebirth
games.description: 失忆指挥官带着灵魂同伴，以卡面回合战对抗帝国蚀化阴谋——第一幕到第二幕完整收束，含记忆断片与三结局。无体力、无日课、买断即玩。

games.name: Hist Maker: ReMake
games.description: 《Hist Maker: ReMake》是一款历史题材的关卡式元素组合解谜游戏。在各有时代背景与目标的关卡中，每次选择两个已发现的元素，推演人物、技术、制度与环境之间的联系。新发现会成为下一步组合的材料，达成关内目标则逐步补全文明图景。从神话传说与文明起源出发，把零散的线索拼成一段历史。

games.name: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts
games.description:
一款拥有自动战斗（可选）和永久死亡机制的战术回合制MMA模拟游戏。

从自家后院，打到世界冠军。

招募格斗家、分配特技、训练属性、打造协同效应、管理伤病、解锁策略、升级训练馆、贿赂委员会，组建一支MMA冠军阵容。

games.name: 修真从轮回开始
games.description: 一款文字驱动的修仙策略角色扮演游戏。凡人寿八十载，修士寿元随境界递增，至渡劫期凡三万年，每一次抉择都可能改写命数。斗法不拼手速——战前运筹功法神通、法宝丹药与出手先后，布阵既定，胜负自行推演。死亡不是终点：功法以灵魂烙印封存，感悟以残忆留存，功德业力随轮回累进；宗门兴衰、旧识老去，世界自有岁月流转。跨世因果与世界岁月两线交织，渡劫超脱、功德飞升、融入天道，结局由你的因果写就。淡彩水墨之间，单人单机无内购，轮回将启。

games.name: Sumi Archery
games.description: This is a cool sumi  art style archery game. With  Fifty painted pages, from a maple garden at dawn to a glacier under an aurora — one bow, the wind, and a mark on the far side of the paper. Nothing to collect and nothing to upgrade: only the shot. There is also endless play and procedural modes

games.name: Graveheart
games.description: 一款复古 FPS：威廉·华莱士死而复生，苏格兰正在入侵英格兰，而你被诅咒的武器总会在最糟糕的时刻自行切换

games.name: Ante Inferno
games.description: The poker RPG. ANTE INFERNO is a roguelite card battler where you play poker hands as attacks, tear through hell with forty class abilities, and stack boons until the damage counter gives up on digits.

games.name: INKBORN
games.description: 你在一本无人完成的漫画里醒来,橡皮擦正从页面边缘吞噬整个世界。你只有一本速写本:描摹一把斧头,斧头就会出现在你手中。一切都要消耗墨水。在页面消失之前把它重新上色。最多支持四人。

games.name: 永聚：原野工坊
games.description: 在中世纪村庄中打造你的专属天堂！掌握宁静的农耕节奏，投身于丰富的采集与制造经济系统。在这款3D俯视角沙盒游戏中，收集魔法材料，锻造工具，设计并建造充满活力的乡村庄园。

games.name: Hiveheart
games.description: 你的微型群落冒险开始了！在这座粉红色的蚁群中探索大自然的深处，收集资源，一步步建造你的巢穴。可别让小家伙们饿肚子！指挥你的兵蚁和工蚁保护蚁后安全，将你的群落发展成一个繁荣的巢穴。

games.name: 下一篇论文
games.description: 《下一篇论文》是一款卡牌化的放置科研生涯模拟经营游戏。阅读论文、获得灵感、提升能力、开展研究、管理设备与经费，将研究结果写成论文并正式发表；申请项目、培养学生，在长期成长中建立属于自己的学术履历，并参与一个由真人共同塑造的学术世界。

games.name: GraveFeast
games.description: The curse drains your life with every passing second. The only cure is blood. Charge into the horde, gather them, and tear them apart to drink deep. In GraveFeast, low health isn't a reason to run. It's a reason to go deeper.

games.name: Grimhold
games.description: 一款黑暗奇幻风格的肉鸽塔防。在十幕征途中抵御无穷无尽的军团，指挥23位独特英雄，打造永不重复的每一局。每守住一波都是一次抉择，每一次抉择都将重塑这场围城。格林霍尔德还能坚守多久？

games.name: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations
games.description: 这是一款工厂自动化模拟游戏，你将利用传送带和护理设备照顾从出生到一岁的宝宝。自动完成喂奶、睡眠、换尿布和玩耍，并利用传感器与分流闸门，高效管理众多宝宝的日常生活。随着月龄增长，他们所需要的护理也会发生变化，昨天还稳定运行的生产线也可能需要重新改造。渐渐地，你会发现每个宝宝都有不同的反应。在维持效率的同时，你能在多大程度上回应这些差异？经营一座略显奇特的近未来育儿设施，陪伴宝宝们度过他们的“第一年”。

games.name: The Royal Restoration Society
games.description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

games.name: Bouncer
games.description: Bouncer is a compact two-player strategy game about predicting your opponent, controlling space, and surviving the collision. Choose your moves at the same time, resolve them together, and use the game's bounce rules to outmaneuver your rival and hold their base.

games.name: Otherhold
games.description: Otherhold is a fantasy voxel sandbox action RPG. Explore, fight, gather resources, build your base, venture into dungeons, and prepare your defenses to survive invasions and increasingly dangerous threats.

games.name: Ashram Online
tags: 大型多人在线角色扮演
games.description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

games.name: Necromancer: The Fallen Serve
games.description: Command a growing undead legion in a dark fantasy RTS where every fallen enemy can become your next soldier. Raise skeleton armies, harvest bones and souls, build your necromantic stronghold, and overwhelm fortified kingdoms through relentless conquest.

games.name: Ball and Stick
games.description: 在物理驱动的科幻冒险中翻滚、挥舞、飞跃，制造混乱！体验独特的操作方式、疯狂的附件和丰富的角色自定义。独自探索奇异的外星世界，或与好友并肩作战，在多人游戏中掀起一场混乱狂欢！

games.name: CaddiShack
games.description: In CaddiShack, you build a deck of genetically enhanced Caddisfly larvae to play into terrariums. Larvae make beads which form bracelets that are sold for cash. Beads synergize in bracelets that are sold every round. You then spend hard earned money on genetic abilities to keep up with the quota!

games.name: A Rover's Journey
games.description: A Rover's Journey is a 3D, narrative, exploration game set in space! Play as Roo-ver the rover and help Alex the Astronaut discover all that the Moon has to offer. Traverse uneven terrain, avoid meteors, and uncover technology from previous expeditions. Find out if the Moon can sustain human life!

games.name: Goblins vs Poop
games.description: Bunch of underdog Gobbos gotta destroy countless waves of magical turds in the sewers under a Mage City. It's Tower Defense, it's funny, silly, toilet humor, cute retro goblin vibes.

games.name: Nightmare Unleashed
games.description: Nightmare Unleashed! is a fast-paced voxel FPS where you battle relentless monster hordes through the night. Dash out of danger, wield powerful firearms, and survive solo or with a friend in 2-player online co-op.

games.name: M.A.M.M.O.N.
games.description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

games.name: TOP CUT: Locals to Worlds
games.description: he card-game tournament roguelike. Build your deck, play powerful cards, and turn clever combos into match-winning plays. Counter opponents with hand traps, upgrade your favorites into shimmering foils, and climb from the local card shop toward being world champ

games.name: 百年征战
games.description: 六边形战棋 × 元素卡牌 × 英雄远征。指挥人族、森林、萨满、亡灵四大种族的数十种军团,在先攻制回合战场上排兵布阵;积蓄能量吟唱数十张元素法术扭转战局。招募英雄、搜集宝物、穿越三层险境地图,攻城拔寨,直面最终Boss。

games.name: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
games.description: Fight, solve, and escape through a hostile sci-fi facility that refuses to believe you are human. Uncover a branching story, then build, playtest, export, and share escape rooms of your own.

games.name: We March as One
games.description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

games.name: 农场大疯收
games.description: 像割草一样收菜吧！穿梭在农场的怪潮中，疯狂收获农作物，各种农作物的独特技能互相组合，引爆连锁反应，通过轻度Rogue构筑各种农具武器、卷轴法术、农场动物、农场设施等，完成订单培养超级作物，在你的农场开始一场史无前例的大疯收吧！

games.name: A Place for Every Potion
games.description: 一款温馨的药水分类解谜游戏。把混杂的液体反复倾倒，直到每个瓶子只剩一种纯色，再将每瓶药水归位。用4160瓶药水填满52个货架区。没有计时器，不会失败，也不用着急。

games.name: Honey or Else
games.description: 《Honey or Else》是一款增量放置游戏。蜜蜂们被熊囚禁，被迫不停酿蜜，却在暗中谋划着解救自己的蜂后。种花、雇佣蜜蜂、升级蜂巢。甜蜜、黏糊、可爱——还带着一点反骨。

games.name: Da Capo
games.description: 《Da Capo》是一款运用声音改变空间的音乐解谜游戏。Aria Coda，一位音乐制作人，失去了她的灵感和创作的能力。她曾用音符记录世界，却在某天忘记了如何发声。为了找回它，跟随自己的回忆，重新学习声音的开始，衰减，停留和离开，让声音带你去更远的地方，直到重新找回音乐和创作的意义。

games.name: 装B之王
games.description: 《装B之王》是一款四方向闪避的街机动作游戏。看穿假动作，躲过连续射击，在子弹时间中帅气反杀。独自闯关，或与朋友本地双人合作，在变换阵型中默契避弹；也能挑战无尽模式，刷新自己的生存纪录。四个方向，每一下都要躲得漂亮。

games.name: One More Floor
games.description: One More Floor 是一款短篇增量游戏。乘坐电梯深入矿井，命中目标让每层的金币成倍增长，并在死亡前及时结算。解锁新矿井，收集稀有宝石，购买永久声望升级。

games.name: Bustout: Anime Girls
games.description: Smash through blocks and strip gorgeous anime women. Bustout is a fast, sexy twist on classic Breakout. Master every ricochet, chase high scores, and let those perfect busts out.

games.name: Horny Slots: Spin to Sin
games.description: 在这家赌场里，每次中奖旋转点燃的不只是赌局的刺激，还有女孩们的兴趣。下注、凑出获胜组合，看看好运能带你走多远 – 玩得越好，她们的欲望就越大胆，也越愿意在你面前展现真实的自己。

games.name: Sticker Chaos
games.description: Sticker Chaos is a relaxing first-person game. Peel thousands of sticky notes, explore locations, find secrets, earn money, upgrade your skills, play mini-games, and even draw on stickers!

games.name: 割草游戏
games.description: 从亲手割下第一株小草，到让一群软团接力收割！这是一款可爱的种植增量游戏：种下各具特性的植物，画出软团的冲刺路线，铺设菌毯，让蘑菇带来加速、增值与回声复制。把金币投入升级，看一小片草地逐渐变成忙碌又丰收的田园。

games.name: Mammalarium
games.description: 在这款温馨的放置游戏中放松身心，收集超过 500 种独特的哺乳动物。实时观看幼崽成长为壮丽的成年个体，在 9 个主题包中打造温暖的林地栖息地，发现从微小鼩鼱到巨大鲸鱼的稀有物种。

games.name: Midnight Toybox
games.description: Can you last until morning? Take your seat at the toys' board, in the bedroom of a sleeping child. Read your opponent, and take only the right pieces. Get it wrong too many times, and———

games.name: KARANEKO: Night Shift
games.description: Karaneko: Night Shift brings to light a short story long buried in the past. Spend three eventful days as Krista, a young cat girl. Handle the strangest customers imaginable during the night shift at a small store, but something isn't quite right... and closer to her than she'd like.

games.name: Take That Shot
games.description: You're a basketball. Roll, charge-jump and dash up a tower of floating junk, squash your friends on the way, and try to sink a shot at the top. Up to 8 players with voice chat.

games.name: Croissant Simulator
games.description: 经营属于你自己的可颂餐厅。接取订单、制作新鲜可颂、购买食材、管理库存，并让顾客满意。没有任何令人分心的元素，只有专注纯粹的单人可颂模拟体验。

games.name: Your Legacy: Generations
games.description: Build a life across generations in a life and economy simulator. Study, pursue a career, manage money, buy property, build businesses and navigate family choices—then choose an heir and pass on the wealth, traits and consequences of the life you created. This is your story.

games.name: The Keyless: Forbidden Door
games.description: The Keyless : Forbidden Door 是一场梦幻般的超现实之旅，在克服简单挑战时，世界会发生变化，见证奇异的隐喻和超现实场景。

games.name: Muritura
games.description: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

games.name: Facelet
games.description: Facelet is a roguelike deckbuilder played on a scrambled puzzle cube. Twist layers to line up colors, cash them in, and build a deck that scores a cube nobody would ever finish. Spend your winnings on Algorithms, Mods, stickers and Tools, then take the bigger cube into the next Depth.

games.name: Vestibule
games.description: Every band dreams of a tour. Yours goes through Hell. Vestibule is a doom metal roguelite deckbuilder: recruit outcasts and burnouts, chain riffs, sign cursed pacts, stack damage, and play loud enough to kill the dead.

games.name: Football with your life on the line
games.description: A first person physics-based action-football game where you control your character's foot with your mouse. Master the ball and use special powers to dominate the game!

games.name: WarmSpot
games.description: 治愈系逻辑益智游戏：每行、每列、每座汤池都只能有一只动物，而且彼此不能相邻。挑战 50 个精选关卡，在五座温泉乡结识可爱客人，按自己的节奏慢慢泡汤。

games.name: Lead the Charge
games.description: 亲自冲锋，也指挥全军。招募 28 位历史武将、编组 64 种兵种，在 14 张战场运用冲锋、坚守、齐射与阵型变换，体验单人军团 Roguelite 的每一次逆转。

games.name: Subgloom
games.description: A 2D metroidvania where you explore an underground world and the terrain is  destructible. Use your laser gun to kill enemies, drones to fly around, bombs to destroy terrain, and explore hidden rooms to discover items.

games.name: Pull My Finger
games.description: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...

games.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
games.description: 注意了，新手！收拾我们混乱的宝库，证明你有资格加入船队。将每一件战利品整理归位，用钩爪和木腿升级你迟钝的双手的效率，并在过程中解锁隐藏的技能！

games.name: Christmas Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
games.description: 在10个充满节日气氛的圣诞场景中寻找100只隐藏的猫咪！仔细搜索，合理使用提示，避免误点，并与时间赛跑。找到所有猫咪，解锁成就，在全球排行榜上争取一席之地！

games.name: CARNOR CITY
games.description: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKULTRA agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

games.name: Oblivion 2666
games.description: 本作是一部滑流魔幻现实主义视觉小说，以散文体文学与变幻多样、富有质感的影视呈现风格，讲述了有关一位异乡少女、一台借来的相机，以及某座不再与其相片画面相符的城市的故事。

games.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
games.description: 在这款短小精悍的放置类RPG中，化身女巫，建造高塔，用“轰”的一声巨响将进攻的怪物炸个粉碎！

games.name: 海龟汤世界
games.description: 《海龟汤世界》是一款情境推理冒险游戏。每个关卡都是一则独立的离奇故事，表面看似简单，却隐藏着关键事实。探索场景、调查物品、与 NPC 交谈，并向主持人提出只能用“是”“否”或“是也不是”回答的问题，逐步排除错误方向、确认线索，最终还原真相。游戏会下载默认的本地大语言模型，也支持接入兼容的大语言模型 API。

games.name: Wink Mafia
games.description: Pet the cat, bluff your friends, and pray your drink isn't poisoned. Wink Mafia is a chaotic 3D social deduction party tournament. Kill with a lethal wink, execute rivals with the golden gun, or brawl in the streets—where innocent card games turn into deadly mob chaos. Play with friends or smart AI!

games.name: Feral Eyes
games.description: A lone feline bounty hunter brings law and order to a frontier town in order to buy back a treasured heirloom.

games.name: Post Show Cleanup
games.description: Clean up a trashed public park after a huge concert. Collect and recycle rubbish, upgrade your gear, push piles with a broom, move loads with a cart, restore the park, and turn yesterday’s mess into a peaceful morning again.

games.name: CASHGRAB
games.description:
CASHGRAB is an arcade time-attack 2D platformer.
Play as Joey, a duck who sold the rights to a movie adaptation of his last adventure. He has to run, jump, stomp and dash to defeat enemies and grab the cash as fast as he can because the producers want to complete the movie as fast as possible!

games.name: TETRIC
games.description: Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in T É T R I C. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.

games.name: Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm
games.description: A story-driven retro JRPG where you build a party, explore a fantasy world, fight in classic turn-based battles, complete side quests, craft equipment, and uncover the legacy of the Primal Heir in a handcrafted pixel-art adventure.

games.name: JUST PRESS SPACE
games.description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art souls-like, roguelite where one button controls everything.

games.name: OUTNUMBERED
games.description: 成千上万的丧尸正在向你和你的朋友袭来。搜刮物资、制作装备、建立防御，与朋友一起对抗庞大的丧尸群并生存下去。

games.name: Lairs & Lordships
games.description: This time the towers shoot at you. Lairs & Lordships is a reverse tower defense strategy game. Plan your monster horde's assault, wave by wave. Break seven human fortresses and raise your lairs where their keeps stood. Then hold the land with walls and towers when the lords raid back.

games.name: Engagement
games.description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull, raise a fleet of named escorts who rank up and branch, and hold the lane against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

games.name: Blind Person Simulator
games.description: Blind Person Simulator can help you understand how an everyday person with blindness can live trough the day. Limited vision, endless possibilities, hard achievements, recipe for a good simulator.

games.name: Crumbeats
games.description: 在这款音乐驱动的增量街机游戏中，唤醒沉寂的扬声器，重新构筑节拍。击碎 Crumbs，收集回响，解锁乐器，并不断叠加升级，打造持续演变的 Groove。

games.name: LineManager
games.description: Build and operate public transport in a living traffic simulation. Plan tram and bus networks, schedules and depots while cars, traffic lights, passengers and infrastructure interact around you. Keep it simple – or dive deep into signalling and operations.

games.name: Where Did I Park?
games.description: 你忘了自己把车停在哪里。更糟糕的是，这里有 99,999 辆和你的车一模一样的车。搜索停车场，排除错误的车辆，收集贵重物品，并逐步提升你找到正确车辆的机会。

games.name: Night Shift Motel
games.description: Night Shift Motel 是一款第一人称心理恐怖与汽车旅馆经营游戏。接待住客、倾听他们的故事、调查可疑细节、分配房间、监控 CCTV、报告异常、维修旅馆，并在黑夜变得致命之前决定你能信任谁。

games.name: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
games.description: 设计驱动 AI 的芯片。从一个逻辑门开始，亲手搭出一台计算机：连接电路，把设计封装成可复用芯片，编写小型内核，并将架构扩展为真正可以运行的 GPU。

games.name: System Critical 3
games.description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

games.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
games.description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a top-down action-adventure game where you explore dungeons, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. Complete the 4 initial dungeons to unlock the final one. Can you find everything?

games.name: ArkSeed Terraformery
games.description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time.

games.name: 珠峰求生模拟器
games.description: 在按卫星测绘 1:1 还原的珠穆朗玛峰上，完成一次完整的远征求生。适应高原、管理氧气、体温、体力和物资，在各个营地搭帐篷过夜，穿越昆布冰瀑的冰裂缝，冲击 8848 米之巅——再活着回到大本营。

games.name: Crumple Toss
games.description: 一款关于精准投掷、数十次失手和世界纪录的超高难度游戏。

games.name: Femboy Futa Dorm
games.description: One cheap room, five irresistible housemates, and a charter nobody agrees on. Femboy Futa Dorm is an adult romantic visual novel set in Lavender Hall, a residence famous for its femboy and futanari residents, absurd traditions, and late-night confessions.

games.name: Femboy Apocalypse
games.description: Femboy Apocalypse is an adult visual novel set in a world rebuilding after a mysterious transformation. Follow Alex as he grows close to Haven's femboy and futanari residents, adjusts to a new life, and uncovers the secrets of The Bloom.

games.name: Femboy Fame
games.description: Become the manager of a struggling idol agency. Grow closer to five adult femboy and futanari idols, handle backstage crises, and prepare for the Aurora Festival in a mature visual novel blending romance, drama, and five types of optional minigames.

games.name: 守住黎明
games.description: 白天建造，夜晚抵御尸潮。《守住黎明》是一款 3D 废土塔防：特色自动战斗角色、战术防御塔、丧尸浪潮，支持 Steam、局域网与本地多人。

games.name: VELKOR
games.description: VELKOR is a large-scale open-world survival experience where every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Build your base, craft your gear, master brutal combat, explore a ruined world, and uncover the truth buried beneath the remains of VELKOR.

games.name: Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor
games.description: 一款荒诞厨房动作类 Roguelite：化身臭酸豆腐，自动瞄准清剿变种食材怪潮，合成厨具神装、局内突变强化，在新鲜度耗尽前火力全开、炒出疯狂 Build。

games.name: Diversion
games.description: 通过高级观察系统处理被指派的瑕疵物品，收集能量，升级您的作业，并完成不断提高的配额以获得晋升福利。您的职责已被指派。无需进一步询问，也不鼓励这样做。

games.name: Too Hot To Hold
games.description: Grab the Ember and RUN! An up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

games.name: Little Hamster: Find and Organize
games.description: After a long journey, a little hamster returns home to his familiar daily routine. Yet even everyday tasks are full of adventure. Join him as you search for lost items, clean up, and organize the space in a new journey taking you from a forest little house to a lively town.

games.name: PLOW
games.description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

games.name: 100 Years Atop Mount Ellumbee
games.description: Six factions climb one mountain over a century, vying for land and the Tide of Battle. Build your economy, dominate your opponents through Battle Card duels, where Battle Cards are simultaneously revealed, and claim the Summit of Mount Ellumbee.

games.name: Unglamorous
games.description: A punishing time-trial racer for dodgy cars and grassroot grit. Race real club-level motorsport disciplines against real or AI opponents on dynamic courses in cars not fit-for-purpose.

games.name: 和妹妹一起生活吧
games.description: 在这款轻松治愈的3D生活模拟游戏中，父母外出期间，你将扮演哥哥照顾年幼的妹妹。在打工赚钱、为妹妹搭配不同造型、探索家中的各个角落之余，共同度过一段温馨而难忘的日常时光。

games.name: Meat Safari
games.description: Meat Safari is a multiplayer open-world restaurant simulator! Hunt ingredients, cook meat, stack cargo, and race across Meat World solo or in 4-player online co-op. Choose your driver and vehicle, and get out on the safarI!

games.name: FIGHT
games.description: Let's FIGHT. Queue your steps, guards, and strikes, then commit blind and watch both plans collide into skill based warfare. Master over twenty weapon-bound fighters, posture breaks, parries, projectiles with real time replays to watch the battle back in style.

games.name: Dungeonbound
games.description: Dungeonbound 是一款复古风第一人称自动战斗地下城探索游戏。派出你的战士、法师或盗贼，深入怪物成群的地底，看战斗一回合一回合展开，每次冒险都变得更强。死亡只是带着战利品回家。合成装备，购买升级，再次下潜。

games.name: Working...
games.description: 让桌面多一点陪伴。五位女主，动漫、Q版、像素三种画风，从温暖日常到奇幻主题，挑选属于你的心动造型。工作、学习或游戏时让她静静陪在身边，随在线时光收集皮肤、点亮图鉴，用重复收藏合成新的惊喜。

games.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
games.description: 体验千种人生，做出选择，见证它们带来的后果。从童年到老年，每一次相遇、每一个决定，以及命运中的每个偶然，都将塑造一段独一无二的人生。

games.name: OFF SOUNDINGS
games.description: 在港口买卖货物，在航行中安排并培养船员，在海上校准船舷开炮的航海RPG。两船相接后进入接舷，你带大的船员会变成卡牌作战。

games.name: TidyUp 2000
games.description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

games.name: Mournhill
games.description: Who will be the first to open the red door and find THE TRUTH? Mournhill is a comedic noir card game: swipe left or right, keep four factions happy, and collect 100+ endings. Everyone wants a favor. Nobody mentions the door. Something is counting down behind the jokes.

games.name: Quiet in the Keep
games.description: Quiet in the Keep is a single-player, first-person stealth horror game where you carry a heavy artifact through a dark and abandoned castle. Light the way back to your truck, unlock rooms and shortcuts, and survive the Ghost. And no matter what you do, keep quiet.

games.name: 旋转堆叠
games.description: 《旋转堆叠》是一款单机策略型堆叠消除游戏。方块从棋盘上方进入，你需要旋转同心方形底座，选择方块落向的边，并在下落过程中调整位置。填满第4层及以外的完整方形圈即可消除，悬空方块会向中心坍塌，新的排列可能继续形成连锁。核心区域由第0至第3层组成，始终不会被消除；你必须在有限空间中规划每次落子，平衡安全、效率与高分机会。游戏提供基础、进阶、趣味和挑战四种模式，包含标准七种俄罗斯方块、Combo与连锁计分，以及爆裂、射线和棱镜等特殊方块。动态云层、旋转底座和向心坍塌共同构成独特的视觉节奏。通过存档、得分记录和可调整的界面设置，持续挑战更高层数与更高分数。

games.name: Cure The Dead
games.description: 经营一家为感染者服务的药房。补充医疗用品，诊断僵尸顾客，制作治疗药物并出售或交换。雇用拥有实用技能的顾客，为他们分配职责，解锁新资源，并通过技能树不断升级你的药房。

games.name: Frostbeaks
games.description: Outrun the avalanche. You are a penguin in a bobble hat carving down an endless procedural mountain — five biomes, seven weather states, six power-ups, and a wall of snow that never stops. Race up to ten players online, or chase your own line solo.

games.name: Pinoptic
games.description: Among many blocks, one holds the exit and others, explosives. Only your detector posts mark the safe path. A tense, minimalist first person exploration thriller.

games.name: Rock and Found
games.description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

games.name: Lumi and the Murder Quartet
games.description: A 2D rhythm platformer where you need to time your abilities to the beat! Run, fly, and smash your way through various levels to rescue your band of crows from a rival band of jazz cats. Collect trinkets, defeat enemies, and perform on beat to get a high score!

games.name: Rush Out Death
games.description: 一款以六边形组件组装为核心的俯视角动作类 Rogue 游戏。连接武器与辅助模块，让信号脉冲驱动整台机器；收集废料、扩展构筑，在末日荒原不断逼近的敌群中突围。
games.developer: PINGDINGSHAN MENGYE GAME TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

games.name: 拼题猎码手 VI
games.description: 用编程策划完美犯罪——甚至可以 Vibe Coding。

games.name: SUPER-TYPE
games.description: SUPER-TYPE is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

games.name: Will It Launch?
games.description: 一款支持近距离语音聊天的1-6人合作物理喜剧游戏。把浴缸、沙发或流动厕所改造成飞机，在三座岛屿之间运送货物。朋友们会帮你造飞机。不过他们手里也有角磨机、共用钱包，迟早还会有一颗炸弹。

games.name: Rest in Profit
games.description: 一款黑暗奇幻放置增量游戏：你是一名寒酸的死灵法师，在墓园之下开采灵魂。挖掘无尽的地穴通道，把采集器安置在最富有的坟墓下方，再让每一缕灵魂在符文墙上弹跳，成倍放大它的价值。死亡是一门朝阳产业。

games.name: Knight's Party
games.description: Knight's Party 是一系列致命又混乱的锦标赛。人人都想成为骑士，却根本没人知道自己在干什么。和朋友一起开炮、倒酒、争夺王冠，再顺便丢掉几条胳膊腿。想活下来，可没那么容易。

games.name: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
games.description: 在这款轻松治愈的整理清洁模拟游戏中收集、分类垃圾，拯救海龟和珊瑚礁。赚钱购买更好的清洁工具和技能。整理商店、躺椅和沙滩玩具，捡起并整理全部7,621件物品，让珊瑚礁重焕生机！

games.name: I'll Keep It
games.description: I’ll Keep It is a first-person management game about running a neglected Mediterranean getaway. Welcome guests, plan their stays, clean, repair, restock and serve - and somehow turn the place into something worth keeping.

games.name: A Drop of Magenta
games.description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

games.name: 番茄谷
games.description: 《番茄谷》是一款温馨的像素农场游戏，只能在专注轮次之间的休息时打理。专注时作物生长，休息时出门耕地、播种、收获、采矿、伐木、交易，一点点建设你的山谷。

games.name: Mankind Must Bleed
games.description:
Tired of cozy games? Kill humans. Collect their blood. Unlock skills. Get stronger. Then kill even more, you misanthropic maniac!

MMB is an incremental game where the skill tree does more than make numbers go up. Unlock new mechanics, change how you play; go full idle, play actively, or mix both.

games.name: Method in the Witchness
games.description: 一款在小女巫桌面上整理物品、解开谜语与益智谜题的温馨游戏。摆放魔法物品，发现能帮助你解开后续谜题的秘密，并在每件物品独特的声音中，慢慢揭开一段温柔的故事。

games.name: Room Movers
games.description: 你拿住一头，另一头交给我。Room Movers 是一款温馨的双人游戏，你们可以一起拆箱并布置微型立体模型工作场景。没有网格，没有分数，也没有计时器。只有你、你的朋友，以及一间慢慢变成真正空间的房间。

games.name: Atom By Atom
games.description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

games.name: Break the Piñatas
games.description: 一款以打碎1000个皮纳塔为目标的放置类游戏!赚取糖果,购买升级,解锁独特技能,成为最强者。那么,我们要在最后一个皮纳塔前停下吗?

games.name: No Scope CEO
games.description: 《No Scope CEO》是一款 FPS 电竞战队经营游戏：白手起家，只为一个目标——世界第一。签下并培养队员，管好预算和赞助，承担每个选择的后果，然后在比赛中看着自己的决策变成现实。

games.name: EMPTYLAND
games.description: EMPTY LAND is a cinematic single-player survival horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, psychological horror, mystery, puzzles, and survival gameplay. The full game will contain additional levels, locations, story content, enemies, puzzles, and cinematic sequences.

games.name: The Halloway Haunting
games.description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

games.name: Ferryman's Obol
games.description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor.  You ferry the dead across the River Styx.  Each with their own worries, whispers and obol.  How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

games.name: Tide and Crown
games.description: Command a ship in an open-world pirate trading RPG. Exploit a living economy, run dangerous cargo, fight tactical turn-based naval battles, capture vessels, build a fleet, and choose a life of commerce, piracy, or power.

games.name: 浇树模拟器
games.description: 山上的树都干枯了，请打开水阀，给它们浇浇水。

games.name: Exord: Cosmic Talis
games.description: Command your faction in EXORD, conquer hex-based battlefields, build your forces, and lead your team to victory in a fast-paced online strategy war.

games.name: Click the Download
games.description: 点击 Download，升级技能让速度倍增，征服所有游戏。成为世界上最快的下载者。

games.name: Usurper 篡夺者
games.description: 敌人，就是你的武器。《Usurper 篡夺者》是一款独具新意的增量太空射击游戏。在游戏中控制你的敌人，接管火力，在战斗与研究中不断变强，学习新的形态，用敌人的力量击溃敌人，最终夺取万机之主的力量。

games.name: Music Maniaz
games.description:
敲鼓就能玩的音游，塞满 Lofi 曲目，谁都能上手。（仅 Lofi 就有 20 首以上！）
收录 50 首以上多风格原创曲！除鼓以外还能选旋律、All Mix，三档难度！
除了原创曲，还能添加自己喜欢的歌并自动生成谱面，尽情畅玩！

games.name: 润物语：润碟
games.description: “只要擦三个月盘子，赚的钱就能把饭店盘下来”。阿润正是因为这个，历经千辛万苦来到他的应许之地。擦盘，升级，吃上甜甜圈！梦想的生活正在向他招手！《润物语：润碟》是一款全手动擦盘子，讲述润人生活的游戏，擦盘子的手速决定了到底能到达的高度。吃上甜甜圈还是变成泡芙？一切皆有可能！

games.name: 老师，她真生气了！
games.description: 上课偷玩手机给女友回消息，别被老师抓包！在这款搞笑的第一人称潜行游戏里，边打字边留意老师；老师来查课桌时，赶紧藏好手机。

games.name: FailRooms
games.description: 体验前所未有的阈限空间恐怖。受“后室”（The Backrooms）启发，《FailRooms》将你困在一个由荒诞建筑、破碎空间和本不该存在的物体组成的无尽世界中。趁还能笑得出来，尽情笑吧。你能逃离这个从一开始就没打算讲逻辑的地方吗？

games.name: 声东迹西
games.description: 通过行动发出的波纹揭示黑暗...作为寻找出口的 Ping，或循着波纹与脚步追猎的 Prowl，在潜行、追逐与瞬间决策中进行非对称多人对抗。

games.name: 诡地煞星
games.description: 《诡地煞星》是一款充满血腥与黑色幽默的复古FPS。你将扮演一名孤胆杀手，踏入被旧日存在污染的邪恶之地，拿起武器，直面不可名状的怪物，然后把它们统统消灭。

games.name: 宗门经理人 - Sect Master
games.description: 《宗门经理人》是一款单机修仙宗门模拟经营游戏。规划山门、升级建筑、合成装备、招募培养弟子，派遣他们自动深入灵渊带回材料，再以装备、功法、阵型和养成成果迎战灵渊中的妖兽与BOSS，让一座小小山门成长为真正运转的修仙宗门。

games.name: Into the Country
games.description: When your grey world has wearied you, start over in picturesque Seishin Village. Build a life with your own hands, form complex relationships, and search for meaning in a story-rich life sim and visual novel as the world beyond—and beneath—the mountain slowly erodes.

games.name: Fortress Full Fury
games.description: A bullet-heaven where every run feeds incremental permanent upgrades. Defend your fortress, harvest crystals, and climb a 500+ node tech tree until your scrappy defenses become a screen-clearing arsenal against absurd swarms.

games.name: Vug: From Caves to Stars
games.description: A falling-sand cave flyer wrapped in a galaxy campaign. Fly your lander into fully simulated worlds, mine, fight and burn your way through the terrain, then build up the mothership, cross a living galaxy of eight warring factions and face the nanite swarm. Solo or split-screen co-op.

games.name: Devour Protocol
games.description: Incremental reverse tower defense. You are not the one getting invaded; you are the swarm. Send tens of thousands of bots into a stronghold, overwhelm its defenses, and devour its core. Then upgrade your swarm and come back stronger.

games.name: Wyrdtide
games.description: Wyrdtide是一款维京海战生存类roguelite游戏:驾驶长船冲入无尽的袭击浪潮,把武器装到甲板上真实的挂载点,在浪潮之间刻下可叠加的符文,在海水不断上涌时守住船体不沉。单人游玩,或与另外两名水手组成三人合作小队。

games.name: Dread Privateer
games.description:
A turn-based, party-based permadeath roguelite set in the Interstellar Napoleonic Wars of the far future. 

Ave, Britannia Aeterna!

games.name: Late Night with Ken Hayes
games.description: Host the graveyard shift at a small-town radio station in 1998. Callers keep describing the same pale man—and every time someone talks about him on air, he seems to get closer.

games.name: GuildWright
games.description: Run a guild of up to forty adventurers, each with a name, traits, and friendship bonuses that change how they fight. Set the formation, choose their classes, customize their skills and equipment and send them into the zones. They'll keep fighting with or without you.

games.name: Board Dynasty
games.description: Outplay your friends on a board full of surprises. Buy properties, collect rent and send disasters at rival buildings. Switch to races, card battles or time travel, and choose the rules for your next match. Play solo against AI or with up to four local players.

games.name: 求你让雨停
games.description: 一款没有计时器的幸存者类游戏。世界已连续下雨31年，孤儿雯在最后一块干燥之地长大，学会的不是挥剑，而是“书写”天气。走得越远越难，走回来就能喘口气。所有人都求她停雨，而这场雨到底该不该停，由你决定。

games.name: Wildixir
games.description: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

games.name: Compactor Baron
games.description: 你身无分文，账单却一张接一张。把废料砸成方块，卖掉，还债。一款短小的主动式增量游戏：瞄准目标，让锤子自己抡起来，升级工具，故意破产，建起一座能自己养活自己的废品场。

games.name: Sort The Bunnies
games.description: 适合1–4人游玩的温馨收纳模拟游戏。整理500种造型各异的兔兔，填满缤纷的货架，把杂乱的小店变成让人忍不住欣赏的收藏天地。解锁实用升级，让收纳更轻松，也别忘了偶尔来点小恶作剧。

games.name: Restore The Internet
games.description: 一款在复古桌面上展开的治愈系增量游戏。一块一块地修复被遗忘的网站，再把它们连接起来：每个页面放在哪里，都会改变它的收入、流量和修复速度。升级设备、编写自动化规则，最后迎来一个完整的结局。没有强制重置。

games.name: 丧尸日协议
games.description: 激活信标，亲手招来尸潮，再杀出一条活路！在这款第一人称丧尸射击游戏中，你将踏上为期25天的列车旅途，在战斗之间回车整备、强化自己的战斗方式。履行神秘公司的协议，争取活着抵达幸存者营地——那里承诺有你的一席之地。

games.name: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
games.description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,500+ elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

games.name: Flameward
games.description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

games.name: Tattoo Shop Owner
games.description: Run Finn’s struggling tattoo shop, manage artists, clients, supplies and reputation, and try to save enough money to escape San Eloria. Drink, gamble, take bad jobs and make worse decisions while the island, your finances, and Finn’s billionaire plans slowly fall apart.

games.name: Cozy and Tidy
games.description: Cozy and ​Tid​y ​是​一​款​轻松​惬意​的​整理​游戏，​你​可以​通过​分类、​堆叠​和​整理​物品，​忘​却​日常​生活​中​的​压力。

games.name: 战国宏图
games.description: 《战国宏图》是一款以中国春秋战国时代为背景的宏观历史策略游戏。你将扮演一方诸侯君主，在波谲云诡的诸雄争霸中书写属于你的宏图霸业。

games.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
games.description: 你的光标就是剑。用它扫过成千上万的怪潮，守住水晶，再锻出一把强过它们的剑。

games.name: BugPot
games.description: BugPot 是一款休闲类 Roguelike 游戏，每次转动都会改变战局。匹配武器与护符、升级武器、打造强力组合，并针对各种古怪虫子灵活调整策略。

games.name: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
games.description: 在完全3D的对决中骑乘、移动并指挥棋子。选择你的角色，骑着棋子穿越棋盘，近距离面对对手。吃子、智取敌人，以前所未有的方式体验国际象棋，在第一人称动作中焕发生机。

games.name: 挂机魔王 II
games.description: 《挂机魔王 II》是一款暗黑刷宝 × 放置增量 ARPG。自动战斗、装备驱动成长。独创一机六开独立挂机，五大深度职业、六档装备稀有度、暗黑4式回火精炼工作台与无尽大秘境。告别体力与卡进度，享受最纯粹的暗金爆率与终局配装乐趣。

games.name: Idle Purrates Clicker
games.description: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

games.name: SkyStray
games.description: Climb an impossible tower of strange worlds in this 2D action adventure. Dash through boss fights, master moving machinery and rescue friends beneath a sleeping giant. Then return to the Night Exchange to upgrade your rig, find a companion and fill your home with curios.

games.name: MEGA TAG PANIC
games.description: 抓人游戏——但鬼会不停变大。巨大的鬼钻不过窄门，那就是你的出路。蓄力拍击，在红色区域松手，把朋友扇飞。2-10 人，12 张地图，6 种模式，10 个角色配 10 种特殊能力。线上没人？机器人可不会手下留情。

games.name: Trickstir
games.description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. Discover blocks and ingredients with special twists across six different worlds. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

games.name: THE FIGHT BUSINESS: BOXING MANAGER
games.description: Build a boxing promotion from small halls to huge stadiums. Sign fighters, negotiate fights, build cards, manage broadcasting and finances, and compete in an evolving boxing world. Play as a Promoter, or control both gym and promotion as a Trainer + Promoter.

games.name: The Roc
games.description: Venture into the dark realm of the legendary Roc, Run from cover to cover, Be wary of wild beasts and supernatural terrors and use your hand cannon if you have to, Find all ancient tablets and put an end to the Roc's Tyranny.

games.name: 15日僵尸幸存者
games.description: 《15日僵尸幸存者》是一款半开放式的生存游戏.面对一波波不断进攻的僵尸群潮,生命的倒计时开始运转,你必须时刻保持警惕.在荒岛之中,藏匿着大量的僵尸和怪物.战斗,进化是你生存下来的唯一选择.

games.name: HOLD THE COOP!
games.description: HOLD THE COOP! 是一款守卫鸡舍的自动战斗游戏。抵挡一波波郊狼，用赚来的金币升级，解锁更强的战斗鸡，挑战越来越难的关卡。输了？升级后变强再来！

games.name: Working Dead
games.description: Run a supermarket for zombies in this first-person simulator, solo or in online co-op with up to three friends. Prepare body parts, set prices and turn spills into blood soda. Get bitten and keep working as a zombie, but your friends will only hear groans through proximity voice chat.

games.name: No Shoes, No Mercy
games.description:
No Shoes, No Mercy is a first-person horror-comedy where noise, bad decisions, and one terrifying man in his underwear can get you killed. (or worse...).

Sneak, hide, and survive a night trapped inside an ordinary home an din a quiet neighborhood, with a very abnormal owner.

games.name: Dummy Works
games.description: Unleash chaos on test dummies in this physics sandbox, but not all is as it seems.

games.name: Nightclub Security
games.description: 在这款荒诞的第一人称夜店保安游戏中，你只有10秒来决定谁能入场。检查证件，揪出醉鬼，找出隐藏的违禁物品并没收，然后放客人进去 - 或者扇耳光、推搡、抓住他们，再把他们扔出去。

games.name: Fusion Cuisine Survivor
games.description: Anime survivors action in a culinary school overtaken by a tasteless witch.

games.name: Hello the undead are coming
games.description: An incremental roguelike tower defense colony sim where you command your colonist to farm, craft, mine and defend waves of the undead. Progressing towards your skill tree after each run to survive further and further!

games.name: Hit the Anvil
games.description: 敲击铁砧锻造装备，出售赚取金币升级工坊。转职为剑圣、魔导师、死灵法师或影之盗贼，释放铺满屏幕的职业技能，一次强化全部装备。拥有专精、宝石、护符与拼图系统的像素风增量制作游戏。提供免费试玩版。

games.name: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
games.description: 还记得小时候那些一玩就是一下午的小游戏吗？《童年怀旧小游戏八合一》把守基地、吃小鱼、连连看、打砖块等八种熟悉玩法做成单人复古街机合集。快来打开游戏，再玩一次小时候舍不得关掉的那一局！

games.name: Idle Raiders: Second Run
games.description:
Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their base, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into one of the 27 raids.
Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

games.name: TIP or RIP
games.description: 《TIP or RIP》是一款快节奏动作肉鸽游戏，你得赶在饥饿的怪物失去耐心、把你吃掉之前给它们上菜。在餐桌间冲刺，投掷食物，练就离谱的上菜本领，在三家越来越危险的餐厅里活下来，再喂饱最终的超级头目。

games.name: 港水
games.description: 在夏日的水港市，遭遇了一场突如其来的洪水，几户普通人家被同一场雨困在各自的屋檐下。饥饿、口渴、浸湿、疾病，是玩家所要面对的困难。玩家可以进行清点并准备好物资、从商店购买应急物品、向附近的邻居求援等行动。

games.name: A Mirror Apart
games.description: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.

games.name: Dejinochi
games.description: Dejinochi 是一只住在你电脑桌面上的小小电子宠物。给它喂食、照顾它，看着它成长为不同的小家伙，最后和它道别，看着它走向外面的世界。老朋友有时也会回来看看你。

games.name: 专注魔法之乡 - Focus Magic: The Enchanted Land
games.description: 你的专注即是魔法。沉浸于学习与静心的时光，以自身精神魔力滋养荒芜的庭院；闲时体验轻松的种植与炼金，与伙伴相伴，一步步让凋敝的魔法大地迎来复苏。

games.name: Impulse
games.description:
Impulse is a fast-paced voxel style multiplayer arena shooter focused on momentum.
Wall run across maps, carry speed into slides and jumps, grapple onto the environment or other players, and use your weapons and abilities to gain an advantage

games.name: Just A DVD Incremental
games.description: 还记得以前苦苦等待 DVD 标志刚好撞到 电视屏幕角落的那一刻吗？现在不用再等了！在这款轻松休闲的渐进式放置游戏中，提升速度、效率和特效，让碰撞收益最大化。它究竟能否精准撞角？

games.name: Illyrium: Chronicles
games.description: Recruit heroes and craft powerful builds from masteries, classes, spells and equipment. Use these systems to build each character your way, then command your party in challenging turn-based tactical combat.

games.name: 再来一爪
games.description: 3D 物理抓娃娃机 + 肉鸽构筑。抓中进投口，用底分乘倍率打爆目标。

games.name: Pay or Die: Cartel Simulator
games.description: 在《PAY OR DIE: Cartel Simulator》中经营沙漠荒野里的地下武器工坊。按时交付毒枭军火订单，改装致命枪械，击退劫匪突袭并贿赂腐败警察。在这个黑市里，要么按时还清巨债，要么拿命来偿！

games.name: Spirits: Wake Up!
games.description: 《SPIRITS: WAKE UP!》是一款支持2至8人的在线恐怖派对游戏。作为猎人，用麦克风充能发起追击；作为幽灵，在复古下水道中穿梭完成任务并拯救队友。千万别尖叫，否则下一个暴露的就是你！

games.name: Fair21：公平二十一点
games.description: 一款主打可核验公平性的像素风二十一点（Blackjack）纸牌游戏。支持单人桌、三人快速桌和七局淘汰赛；玩家可自定随机种子，并在每手结束后复算、回放和导出完整牌局记录。

games.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
games.description: Silk Collector 是一款轻松惬意的整理模拟游戏。在魔法时装屋中，将散落的 4,012 件衣物归位。整理衣物收集丝绸，使用魔法加快整理速度，还要留意那些在店里四处游荡的神秘衣物。

games.name: Tidyspell
games.description: Tidyspell 是一款温馨的第一人称魔法清洁游戏。你可以使用念力和各种魔法整理一座奇幻住宅，发现隐藏的生物，不断变强，并探索不可思议的空间、秘密房间和神秘传送门。

games.name: 西洋飞行棋：Ludo Mosaic
games.description: 主打公平验证的立体像素西洋飞行棋（Ludo）。用自己的玩家种子开局，亲手复算骰点，对照计算指纹与本局记录。14 套精美高清 3D 主题棋盘可自由旋转、缩放和调整视角，支持多种玩法，可在线匹配、邀请好友及组队对战。

games.name: 进击的军团
games.description: 这是一款轻松的放置自动战斗游戏。从孤身一人的英雄起，逐步招募能力强大的部下组建起强大的军团，并升级强大的能力，然后征服整个世界。

games.name: Keep Farming Aura
games.description: 不断刷取 Aura，让每个动作都推动你的成长。吸引越来越多的观众，组建自己的团队，解锁升级并挑战强大的对手，从默默无闻一路成长为 Aura 传奇。这是一款主动式 3D 增量游戏。

games.name: Capsule Arcade
games.description: 在霓虹闪烁的扭蛋店里整理收纳的第一人称治愈游戏。打开扭蛋，把216个可爱公仔摆进展示柜，让星空扭蛋馆六层楼的机器一台台重新亮起来。

games.name: SpecterMancer
games.description: 一款支持 1–6 名玩家的多人恐怖游戏，背景设定在黑暗的维多利亚时代。作为幽灵，你必须恐吓其他玩家并阻止他们活着逃出去；作为幸存者，你需要探索、解谜、生存，并找到逃离这里的方法。

games.name: Unhistorical Warfare
games.description: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

games.name: House of Pips：多米诺骨牌肉鸽
games.description: 这是一款回合制多米诺骨牌类Roguelike游戏，玩家需要选择打破规则的特殊能力，组合它们的效果，并通过技能树塑造自己的游戏风格。观察棋盘，规划你的放置，并根据每一手牌的情况灵活调整，在单人游戏或在线多人游戏中智胜对手。

games.name: 多米诺俱乐部
games.description: 每一局都能自己查。 输入自定义种子，与服务器承诺共同生成牌序；牌局结束后，玩家可以自行复算牌序与得分。像素风双人多米诺，包含经典摸牌、不摸牌和凑五三种玩法。

games.name: 金拉米：像素牌室
games.description: 《金拉米：像素牌室》是一款主打公平核验的像素风金拉米游戏。熟悉的手牌，考验观察、记牌与取舍，在每一次摸牌和弃牌之间，把握敲牌或凑成 Gin 的时机。自己的种子，自己验证。开局前，你可以自定义随机种子，参与生成牌序；牌局结束后，导出完整记录，在独立核验页面复算牌序、核对出牌过程与最终结算。从第一张牌到最后的得分，每一手都有据可查。六种玩法、七套像素牌桌主题，搭配轻松配乐、自动理牌和手牌旁的快捷操作。无论想快速来一手，还是认真打一场，都能轻松落座，把注意力留给手里的牌与对手的下一步。

games.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
games.description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

games.name: Coins Must Be Made
games.description: The king demands taxes. Crush gold goblins, collect coins, and decide what to spend on your next upgrade. Grow through skills, permanent rings, and prestige cycles in this active incremental roguelite, where every coin must cover both progress and the next tax payment.

games.name: Cue Career
games.description: Build your career at the table. Play pool and snooker, earn your tour card and climb the rankings against AI rivals. Practise your stroke and spin in a walkable club, then take your game from local events to championship arenas.

games.name: Tsukumo SNAP!
games.description: Every forgotten thing grows a soul. Photograph them with your grandma's ancient flip phone, befriend 161 spirits, and spin them into battle. A comedy monster-collecting RPG in a Japanese town that changes with the real calendar.

games.name: Street Takeover
games.description: Drive Fast. Pit Harder. Takeover. Street Takeover is a racing game about high speed police chases, wrecked and damaged car physics, and taking on the county from the racer's seat or leading it's police force in cleaning up the town.

games.name: TCG Card Market Simulator
games.description: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.

games.name: 卡路里弹珠台
games.description: 什么时候可以动动手指就能减肥？现在就能！《卡路里弹珠台》把你的减肥计划变成了一场弹球游戏：是弹向各种各样的运动，还是弹向奇奇怪怪的事件，还是弹向那块2000大卡的蛋糕？就看你的技术和运气了~

games.name: RAT LUCK
games.description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

games.name: 我在撒哈拉数沙
games.description: 撒哈拉究竟有多少粒沙？如果你想知道，就得自己来数！

games.name: Tidy Tech
games.description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

games.name: Mike goes on hike
games.description: 在《Mike Goes on Hike》中成为真正的徒步旅行者！壮丽的荒野风光、独特的徒步氛围与珍贵的人生感悟正等待着你。走完这段旅程，实现挚爱祖父的心愿。

games.name: Solace Creek
games.description: A PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Taraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. Solace Creek is a retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.

games.name: Haul Yeah!
games.description: 装货、绑紧、出发！《Haul Yeah!》是一款支持单人或双人游玩的缤纷配送驾驶沙盒游戏。堆叠具有真实物理效果的货物，用绑带牢牢固定，独自或与朋友分屏合作，穿越山间地区完成送货。留意颠簸与货物的平衡，努力把每一件包裹完好送达。用赚来的钱购入更好的卡车和定制零件，接下更大的订单，一步步壮大自己的运输公司。

games.name: 遥かなる円形世界
games.description: In New York, private detective Ikeda Sen happens upon the enigmatic Lila shortly before his client, Walton, hands him a strange device. And in Japan, Izumozaki Neneko stumbles upon a corpse by the canal on her way to school. Two unrelated stories unfold, intersecting in bizarre and unexpected ways.

games.name: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
games.description: The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style Metroidvania.

games.name: Re: Spin. Die. Repeat.
games.description: 你因不幸而死，因命运而重生。在这款具有异世界 RPG 色彩的中世纪老虎机肉鸽编组游戏中，每一次旋转都将塑造你的命运。操纵运气，阻止黑暗蔓延。

games.name: Fleshbound
games.description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: Idle Clicker Tower
games.description: Idle Clicker Tower 是一款拥有复古霓虹风格的单人放置塔防游戏：保卫你的中央高塔，解锁新的高塔与技能，提升你的力量，击败更致命的敌人波次与首领，并开启卡包来扩充你的卡牌收藏。

games.name: Billy the Hero
games.description: 比利在Hell Island醒来，发现自己变成了一只熊。没有记忆，没有遗憾。显然，他现在就是这副模样。在这款暗黑奇幻回合制RPG中，算术能杀人，女主角们都不太正常，而关于比利的真相，是游戏唯一不会轻易给你的东西。

games.name: Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween
games.description: 2D Bossrush Action Game

games.name: Just Date Goth
games.description: 与性感哥特女孩的情色约会模拟游戏。探索不同地点，从事真实工作，解锁亲密场景。通过独特的艺术风格和富有表现力的动画，享受每一个细节。

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid.  When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it!  Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: 卡皮巴拉大冒险 / Cap 'n Barr's Adventure
games.description: 《卡皮巴拉大冒险》是一款游戏性十足的复古 2D 平台动作游戏，有可爱卡皮巴拉、芯片音乐与挑战满满的关卡，支持单人或本地双人合作。若你喜欢平台跳跃、幽默演出、隐藏关——来试试吧！

games.name: Dicebound TD
games.description: 掷出骰子，召唤维京战士，用神力守卫高塔。在这款融合自动战斗、塔防与增量成长的北欧神话轻度肉鸽游戏中，每一次失败都会让你变得更强。

games.name: Purgatorial Learning
games.description: 《Purgatorial Learning》将你深深拖入交织缠绕的梦境与噩梦之中，将你困在其超凡脱俗的蛛网之中。探索这片噩梦，找出其中的裂缝，逃离这个不属于你的梦境！

games.name: ROTETRA
games.description: ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!

games.name: URIEL OS
games.description: URIEL OS is an audio horror game where the perspective never leaves your screen. Traverse the apocalypse while sealed inside a mechanical vehicle that barely protects you from whatever is outside. Hack devices to manipulate the environment and piece together what happened to a very different Earth.

games.name: 龙晶
games.description: 《龙晶》是一款Furry主题的以探索与叙事为核心的横版冒险游戏。故事发生在龙晶研究所召开第六次龙晶科技峰会之际，你将作为研究所的一名安保队员，在峰会期间执行安保任务，与角色互动，解开谜题，收集隐秘的线索，并逐步揭开平静表象下的暗涌。

games.name: Hold My Cargo
games.description: A first-person smuggling sim, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Carry every crate, hide contraband in your ship, and bluff or bribe customs. Trade up to a bigger freighter while your crew keeps the officer busy and the evidence out of sight.

games.name: Gift Stream: Sorting & Delivery Simulator
games.description: Gift Stream Sorting & Delivery Simulator is a logistics management simulator where gifts constantly arrive through a mysterious portal. Inspect, sort, and ship them efficiently while upgrading machines and expanding your warehouse to handle an ever-growing delivery stream.

games.name: RUNTIME
games.description: Chain midair dashes, flip gravity, and escape ten chapters in a pixel-art precision platformer. Race friends online or in local split screen, or challenge a bot. Chase faster times, unlock your look, and build your own levels.

games.name: Incog-Confine
games.description: A Co-op Horror Game About Identifying, Planning, Scavenging, And Repairing. You Must Escape Or Die; Alone Or With Allies. Survive The Dystopian Lands And Brutal Storm Till Your Last Breath.

games.name: 死域 Rogue 2
games.description: 在这款以陷落地球为背景的FPS肉鸽冒险中,化身Talon 13-10展开战斗。组合武器、增强模块和元素打造毁灭性Build,在Monarch无尽的机械军团中杀出重围。每一局都变得更强,可单人或与好友共战。

games.name: Boric Demo
games.description: Boric is a 2D precision platformer in which a tiny slime must escape from a dark pit. Master the dual-jump system—vertical for height and horizontal for distance in a relentless climb where every millimeter counts. will you have the patience to reach the light?

games.name: The Texting Game
games.description:
每条消息都要做出选择。每次选择，都让你陷得更深……
一款回复就能改变剧情的成人聊天游戏。发展关系、解锁火辣内容，在一场场聊天、一个个应用和一次次冒险选择中，决定今夜如何收场。

games.name: Homeguard
games.description: 一款休闲策略游戏。白天建造你的要塞，夜晚守护它。

games.name: Brasil Assombrado: Arquivo 01
games.description: Discover a side of Brazil you've never seen. Explore a first-person horror mystery inspired by Brazilian folklore, where forgotten diaries, abandoned places, and a relentless presence lead you toward a century-old truth that was never meant to be uncovered.

games.name: The Life You Missed
games.description: 《The Life You Missed》——你虽已功成名就，却在追逐成功的路上迷失了自我。在一座老宅中，你发现了别人的生活——以及你自己的生活。重温往昔记忆——并在梦中，面对那个将决定结局的选择。

games.name: 黑色账本: 黑手党 (Black Ledger: The Mafia)
games.description:
白天经营一家古董店。

夜晚领导一个犯罪组织。

在利润、忠诚与怀疑之间维持平衡……

每一个选择都有后果。

games.name: VCR83
games.description: VCR83 是一款心理恐怖游戏，你需要监控安防摄像头并报告奇怪的异常现象。

games.name: F.A.G.E.N.
games.description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

games.name: Polish Pierogi
games.description: 经营你自己的 pierogi 餐厅！一步一步制作美味的波兰饺子、服务饥饿的客人、升级厨房，让每个人都吃得饱、心情好，还想再回来。

games.name: ERO FIGHTERS 色狼传说
games.description:
你有最喜欢的色色漫画主题吗?! 你将扮演一名色漫收藏家(自称)
在莫名的情况下，被赋予了跟自己心爱的漫画角色挑战的机会
只要击败她们，就可以逐步完成属于自己的幻想！

games.name: Cup of Tales
games.description: Cup of Tales puts you in the shoes of a part-time barista, where every cup of coffee comes with a story. Listen to your customers, build meaningful connections and uncover a mystery hiding beneath the streets of futuristic London.

games.name: 放置尸潮之夜
games.description: 在这款致敬B级恐怖电影经典的渐进式放置游戏中吞噬全世界。从一只卑微的行尸开始，逐步发展成一支规模庞大的丧尸军团。招募邪恶的小动物来自动收集大脑，并为你的大军购买升级。开启桌面伴侣模式，释放一场迷你末世天劫。

games.name: Walkers
games.description: Walkers 是一款开放世界僵尸生存游戏,拥有先进的基地建造和NPC系统。在末日废土上搜刮物资、制作装备、进行掠夺。从街头招募幸存者,将他们分配为工人、守卫或同伴。

games.name: Phantom Grind
games.description: Phantom Grind is a minimalist action RPG where you battle ancient evil with mouse-only controls. Level up, collect gold, and carve through hordes of monsters in retro pixel-art dungeons.

games.name: 明末：力挽狂澜
games.description: 正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，同时让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段和数值变化阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。

games.name: 群雄战歌：妖火纪元
games.description:
这是一款中式2D复古像素角色扮演游戏，故事发生在妖灵肆虐的架空三国乱世。玩家将招募各路英雄豪杰，组建自己的军团，与乱世军阀和异界妖灵展开殊死搏斗。你可以自由培养角色，编排特色战术阵容，并借助强大的天赋和连携技能，驰骋广袤地图迎战形态各异的魔物与妖将。
英雄等待你的招募。集结四方豪杰，直面妖火浩劫。用手中兵刃与精妙战术，驱散暗影，让你的战歌响彻整片大地。

games.name: Please, Tell Me Why?
games.description: 你独自生活。至少，理应如此。进行直播。探索你的公寓。与观众交流。一切看似正常——直到细微之处开始不合常理。这是一款关于身份认同、孤独，以及直面真相所需付出可怕代价的第一人称心理恐怖游戏。

games.name: Out Of Sync
games.description: 凯尔是 Vanta Inc. 的一名初级员工，一直在寻找失踪的好友马库斯。当他发现了一张带有马库斯笔迹的纸条时，凯尔踏入了一个平行世界，却在最后一扇门后面对令人难忘的现实。

games.name: Paluah's Trench
games.description: An underwater narrative horror game where you must journey to the bottom of a deep-sea trench and uncover its mysteries.

games.name: Mow and Move
games.description: Take control of M-42 in a relaxed incremental mowing game. Cut through fields of engineered grass, turn each harvest into upgrades, and reach farther with a stronger mower. Recover useful equipment along the way and work at your own pace.

games.name: Giga Digger
games.description: 《Giga Digger》是一款简短、休闲风的渐进式采矿游戏。开采矿物，解锁升级，不断向更深处挖掘！

games.name: CatchTail
games.description: 吞下自己的尾巴，完成循环！《CatchTail》是一款没有出口的网格解谜游戏。蛇一旦移动，就会一直滑行，直到被挡住为止。成排推动铁笼、穿过传送门、喂鳄鱼吃番茄，回到起点吞下自己的尾巴。

games.name: Wolfpire 0
games.description:
You wake up in a mansion with endless corridors.
Take a good look around you, spot the anomalies and escape from this place.

games.name: Snake Echos
games.description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

games.name: Mani Kalpa: One Last Rite
games.description: Lead a dying purifier into the temple-hospital that cured death, to steal the cure so she never has to feed her leaking rite again. Explore a world of ruined miracles inspired by the temples of ancient India and duel its deathless staff in turn-based combat with real-time parries and attack chains.

games.name: DeltaV Orbital Strategy
games.description: DeltaV is a turn-based strategy game set across the Solar System in 2079 and grounded in hard science fiction. Delta-v is the only resource, shared across the entire fleet. Every ship and order is visible, and nothing is decided at random, so winning depends on planning the fleet as a whole.

games.name: Monster Showdown
games.description: Survive escalating waves of monsters in a fast-paced first-person horde shooter. Earn cash, build your arsenal, upgrade your weapons, grab powerful Perk Donuts, repair defenses, defeat bosses, and unlock wild modifiers that change the way you play.

games.name: How to Turn Zombie
games.description: 操控一个活体病毒，从内部感染人体。摧毁细胞、收集生物质、进化出强大的变异，并抵御免疫系统的猛烈进攻，守护你的病毒核心。这是一款融合增量成长与塔防玩法的游戏。

games.name: Kintsugi Cottage
games.description: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

games.name: Anxiety Mori
games.description: 一款关于创伤与焦虑的第一人称短篇心理恐怖游戏。探索一个支离破碎的世界，在这里记忆与现实相互模糊，体验解谜叙事，揭开一个失去一切的男人究竟经历了什么。游玩时长约1小时。

games.name: Rind Town
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you read each customer's order, build a drink from up to five cards, and blend it into a score. Thirty days, a rising daily goal, and machines that multiply your score until the numbers stop fitting on screen.

games.name: Caveman vs Everything
games.description: You have a spear. They have a tank. Hold your totem through forty stages of escalating history, from hungry wolves to riot police, carving the arena apart as you go. Die, and you start again at the beginning, but the gear you took off a boss stays yours.

games.name: Querni
games.description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

games.name: SlutCraft
games.description: 这是一款从训练到逐渐转变的色情科幻视觉小说.被外星种族淫虫俘获后,扎拉必须变得足够强大才能逃脱.但每一步迈向自由的过程都会以自己从未预料到的方式发生变化.

games.name: Tanuki Tag
games.description: This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go HUGE, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends!

games.name: Your Fantasy Pets
games.description: 建造属于你自己的魔法生物培育场。收集独特物种，培育它们，并在探索每种生物能力的同时不断升级农场。训练它们，带它们参加战斗、竞赛和程序生成的地下城。

games.name: Churro Maniacs
games.description: Churro Maniacs is the narrative simulation video game where you master the art of selling churros while travelling into the space. You will start with the basic foodtruck in your hometown, but as the business grows you can travel to other planets, discover new ingredients, customers and challenges!

games.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
games.description: 1983年，一颗杀手卫星被送入轨道，随后遭人遗忘。2041年，它醒了。环绕地球的一切，都成了目标。一发炮弹，一团碎片，一场连锁反应。在这款像素风增量游戏中，亲手引发凯斯勒综合征。

games.name: Sector Zero: Freedom
games.description: 一款科幻增量模拟游戏，你将扮演帝国的奴隶，建立自己的产业，在稽查中求生，加入工会，并赎回自由。

games.name: 赶海梭哈人
games.description: 你需要适应多变的天气，熟悉沙滩上的每一处洞穴，挥动铲子，挖掘海货。不要忘记时刻审视自己的欲望：它会使你疯狂，也会让你暴富。

games.name: Fliprium
games.description: Fliprium是一款奇幻主题背景的神器合成竞速游戏，四人对局，回合制，支持联机，你会体验到可爆发的对局节奏和深度的策略空间。充分运用你的运气和智慧，并与高手博弈，不断地挑战极限，打造出最高倍率的传奇胜利牌形。

games.name: Grenade! : Pang Pang Survive!
games.description: 战争结束后，在落满手榴弹的赛场上活下来成了一项运动。躲开、接住、扔回飞来的手榴弹，用反弹投掷和连锁爆炸淘汰对手，在最多4人的在线对战中坚持到最后。

games.name: 天衡：放逐少女
games.description: 不一样的养女儿！看动漫一样体验故事，融合恋爱养成、互动选择、自由探索与多结局的奇幻冒险恋爱游戏。

games.name: Apprentice Mage Gale
games.description: Apprentice Mage Gale is an Autobattler RPG where your entire party depends on you. You are their ONLY damage dealer, so master 20+ spells, build your mage through 300+ skill nodes, overcome monsters and bosses, and fight across eight lands on the road on your way to the Demon King.

games.name: GameGame
games.description: GameGame 是一款休闲多人游戏合集，包含众多经典游戏以及一些原创游戏。

games.name: Keyboard Companion
games.description: A tiny pixel monkey that types along with you. He sits at the bottom of your screen, hits the same keys you do, and when you take a break he snacks on bananas, yawns and dozes off. It never records what you type.

games.name: Liminal Depths
games.description: A pixel liminal horror game about surviving an endless maze, recovering who you are, and escaping before the Depths take you. Explore procedural halls, complete jobs from the safehouse computer, upgrade your gear, and face monsters that hunt by sound, sight, and movement, solo or local split-screen.

games.name: Islandry
games.description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

games.name: This Game Socks
games.description: Find, match, and toss 3,000 socks into the basket with friends. Buy absurd gadgets and upgrade them to make the task easier (or not).

games.name: Below The Blades
games.description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

games.name: Pheles Rebirth
games.description: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

games.name: Defend Wallace
games.description: A silly 1-4 player horde defense game where you protect your completely oblivious best friend Wallace from an entire army of monsters. Pick your hero, annihilate enemies, and unlock/upgrade new skills to grow as strong as you need to be to KEEP WALLACE SAFE! He's useless but you still love him.

games.name: Royal Triple Defense
games.description: Build a thriving fantasy kingdom on one side of the screen and hold the gate on the other. Merge three units into one, send it across the bridge, and place it where your line needs it. Each night brings a deadlier horde, and you choose which monsters join it. Survive until dawn.

games.name: 无尽战斗：放置与构筑
games.description:
《无尽战斗：放置与构筑》是一款放置挂机刷宝游戏，8个技能，4个强化……丰富的装备效果构筑，与机制独特的助战伙伴
消灭每一层的敌人，不停攀登。挂机刷宝，直至——终焉之境！

games.name: Mow The Planet
games.description: Start with Mum's back lawn. End with the planet. Mow ground that STAYS mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and build a company that stripes the whole world. No timers, no waiting — everything you earn, you mowed.

games.name: Idle Reef
games.description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

games.name: Fire To Mine
games.description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

games.name: Aegis Vanguard
games.description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

games.name: Spice Pound
games.description: 咚。咔嚓。成粉。《Spice Pound》是一款治愈系增量游戏，讲述亲手捣碎香料的简单乐趣。一道接一道地为菜肴调味，解锁更珍稀的香料，升级你的研杵，看着金币越堆越多。按自己的节奏来玩，没有压力，也没有倒计时。

games.name: spin boom boom
games.description: 通过按键切换旋转支点，避免碰撞，面对时机与精度闯关的终极考验

games.name: Pump And Dump
games.description: It's 1987 and you start in the mailroom. You have eight weeks to get your name on the door. Trade stocks, pump the ones you own, sell to dentists over the phone and keep the SEC off your back. A trading roguelite with scheme cards, a crew to hire and a new run every time.

games.name: Victory for Sale
games.description: 战争靠金钱取胜，靠策略取胜，还是两者缺一不可？与来自世界各地的对手或朋友同台竞拍，组建你的军队，为胜利而战！

games.name: Hivetide
games.description: Build your defenses and face the tide. Hivetide is a mix of tower defense and real-time strategy where each bullet counts.

games.name: Survive the Squallies
games.description: 在这款复古第一人称恐怖游戏中，你将在新家安顿下来，去钓鱼，结识邻居。树林里有东西在注视着你。探索、逃跑、躲藏——比尔会发现，活着回家比融入邻里难得多。

games.name: Coma Dreams
games.description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

games.name: 咕咕嘎嘎-小企鹅
games.description:
那只在网络迷因里摇头晃脑、发出"咕咕嘎嘎"魔性叫声的小企鹅，现在来到你的桌面啦！

这只呆萌的小家伙会在你的屏幕边缘散步、打盹、做各种蠢萌动作，偶尔还会趴在小标签页上偷看你工作。不同的互动会触发它独特的反应——毕竟，她可是那只自带表情包的咕咕嘎嘎！

games.name: Golden Trivia Show
games.description: 独自一人或与好友一起参加答题节目。把你的金条分配到各个答案上，只有正确答案才能让它们免于掉进满是食人鱼的水池。你能坚持到最后吗？

games.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
games.description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

games.name: 整理个球
games.description: 整理个球！一款解压治愈的整理游戏：拆开无数个扭蛋球，整理并收集可爱的玩具球。有条不紊，把它们整理得像个球一样！

games.name: Tamer Survivors
games.description: 与可爱的动物伙伴并肩作战，组合它们的能力，击败成群的垃圾怪物！在这款休闲肉鸽生存动作游戏中，进化多种武器，每局打造全新流派，净化被污染的世界。

games.name: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
games.description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

games.name: Data.exe - An Automation Game About Feeding An AI
games.description: An incremental automation game set inside a retro 1998 desktop. Feed the AI by hand, automate small parts of the process, upgrade your hardware, and eventually turn the entire system into a massive self-running machine.

games.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
games.description: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
games.description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

games.name: Help, My Capybaras Escaped!
games.description: Help, My Capybaras Escaped is a casual and fun hidden object game where you have to rescue all the capybaras in various colourful images!

games.name: Manikin Mimic
games.description: 摆好姿势，融入其中，别被抓住！假装自己是人体模型，在搜寻者开枪前骗过对方。

games.name: Dungeon Cleared!
games.description: 选择四名英雄，踏入地下城。希望四个都能回来。规则很简单。地下城嘛……也许不简单。安排队伍，管理法术，避开陷阱，在十层程序生成的老派回合制战术挑战中活下来——一次短暂冒险，一次可疑决定。

games.name: Quiet Bloom
games.description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

games.name: Railminer
games.description: 从小小的钻头起步，打造庞大的采矿列车！开采资源，出售收获，为列车添置铣刀、激光、火箭和无人机。在这款增量采矿游戏中，每次出发都为下一次升级积累资金。

games.name: Vesper Drift
games.description: Reclaim the five Singularities in this Asteroids-inspired roguelite. Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op, destroy asteroids, combine weapons, fusions and passive abilities, and fight across 150 combat zones on 30 planets spread over 5 star systems.

games.name: 无尽女武神
games.description: 《无尽女武神》是一款北欧神话题材的2D横向滚轴像素放置RPG。带领女武神自动向右探索、选择目标、战斗、施放技能并收集装备，同时配置三技能槽、优先级、装备词缀与成长路线，在低操作成本与主动决策之间找到平衡。穿越冻骨之野、水晶洞窟和城堡废墟，挑战区域Boss，管理40格背包，进行锻造、商店补给和永久升级。领取离线收益，并通过转生重置当前旅程、保留长期成长，在每次掉落与每轮推进中寻找新的战术选择与成长。

games.name: Desktop Theme Park
games.description: Desktop Theme Park 是一款温馨的放置式游乐园建造游戏，你的乐园就坐落在屏幕底部。摆放游乐设施、连通道路、雇用员工，再把乐园装点成你喜欢的样子。工作或浏览网页时，让游戏继续开着，赚取金币，添置新的游乐设施。

games.name: A Beacon
games.description: A young lad follows a beacon across medieval Staffordshire in this point-and-click adventure. Solve puzzles, navigate quirky characters, uncover mysteries and crimes. Hand-drawn art, original score, dark humor inspired by Monty Python and Blackadder. Every choice matters.

games.name: Sort Them Socks
games.description: Sort Them Socks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 3,000 unique socks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy socks store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Defenders of Cinderkeep
games.description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

games.name: Diorama Tactics
games.description: Build your team, place your units, and watch them fight automatically in this strategic roguelite auto-battler. Collect powerful heroes, master the board, survive challenging battles, and grow your collection as you push deeper into the game.

games.name: What Happened to Emily
games.description: Help Daniel uncover his lost memories and piece together the three days leading up to the murder of his wife, Emily.

games.name: CC:Tile Shuffle
games.description: 洗乱拼块，揭示精美画作。《CC:Tile Shuffle》是一款极简风格的滑动拼图游戏，收录了来自《Conviction Chronicles》的插画。游戏包含30个精心设计的关卡，难度循序渐进，并呈现出简洁而富有氛围感的视觉效果。

games.name: Street Value
games.description: You owe the Shark, and you have thirty days. Deal across seven gritty New York neighborhoods with one deck: Hustle cards bend the market; Street cards shake the cops. Take turf from rival crews, survive Collection Day, then risk it all for one more week!

games.name: Field Surgeon
games.description: Scrub in as the field surgeon of a city at war. Draw arrows from bone, close sabre cuts, cut soldiers out of their armour and saw off what cannot be saved, on humans, dwarves, elves, orcs, hornfolk and giants. Then face eight plagues a heretic choir has sung into your patients.

games.name: 街角台球馆
games.description: 六种经典台球，免费在线对战。走进《街角台球馆》，自由瞄准、蓄力出杆，感受扎实的击球反馈。在七种风格鲜明的球厅中挑战对手、邀请好友，用进球与走位拿下比赛。

games.name: 环城大亨
games.description: 好友免费联机，公平可核验！《环城大亨》是一款免费的大富翁类多人地产棋盘游戏。在八座3D微缩城市中掷骰前进、买地收租、升级地产，用行动卡改变战局。好友房无需付费解锁、无需入场筹码，骰点与终局记录可查看、可核验。

games.name: Xenowave Survivor
games.description: 在危险的异星世界上抵御外星虫群。选择你的英雄，实时部署战术装置，掌握元素武器，支持本地分屏或在线联机合作。

games.name: Clean Tides
games.description: 一款惬意的海洋清洁游戏，每次收获都能让你的船变得更好。航行在阳光海湾，打捞垃圾、清理油污、用高压水枪冲洗珊瑚礁。升级并装扮小船，雇用清洁队，给海洋动物喂食，按自己的节奏让大海重新闪耀。

games.name: Hot Mic
games.description: 用声音来玩的派对游戏，支持2到8位好友在线同乐。让博物馆里的半身像开口说话，给好友的涂鸦配上声音，再投票选出谁学公鸡打鸣最像。免费游玩，只要一人拥有 VIP，全房间都能解锁全部内容。让你的麦克风燃起来！

games.name: Spook & Sell
games.description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

games.name: Constellations
games.description: Connect the stars to reveal each constellation in a minimalist puzzle game inspired by all 88 real-world constellations. Revisit your discoveries in the Catalogue, play at your own pace and enjoy the journey through an imagined sky.

games.name: 诸界竞技场
games.description: 《诸界竞技场》是一款融合自动战斗、队伍构筑与赛事经营的策略游戏。扮演竞技场经纪人，招募选手、安排训练、搭配装备与遗物，在十六支队伍的双败赛事中争夺冠军。研究对手、下注押宝、挑战历届强者，独自经营或与其他玩家同场竞技。

games.name: Cube & Seek
games.description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

games.name: Champions City
games.description: Build the life you can’t have in reality: make money 💸, meet new people 🤝, upgrade your lifestyle ✨, and rise to the top of Champions City 🌆.

games.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
games.description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

games.name: 酷鉄のオシゴト
games.description:
In this game, you play as a station attendant and handle ticket settlements.
“Kipp” refers to Japanese train tickets. If the fare is insufficient, you must collect the difference; if it’s too much, you must issue a refund. Understand the various rules and settle the fare “correctly.”

games.name: Find Alien
games.description: A 1–4 player online co-op stealth game. Copy the appearance of Earthlings, hide your true identity, avoid surveillance and traps, rescue your captured alien friends, and escape together.

games.name: Cozy Sticker Home
games.description:
用500多个可爱贴纸装饰你的梦想小屋！🏡✨
撕下、贴上、搭配可爱设计，打造充满抱枕、植物、甜点和快乐的超治愈房间 💕🌿🧁✨

games.name: Cozy Florist
games.description:
重拾外婆留下的小花店 🌷
种植属于自己的花朵，制作精美花艺 💐
慢慢揭开小镇神秘的故事 🌙

games.name: Vet Van Organizer
games.description: 整理你的兽医车 🚐 正确安置27种动物，避免敌对物种相邻，为每位VIP朋友留出空间！💎🐾

games.name: Refuel Together
games.description: 在《Refuel Together》中，与1至6名玩家合作经营加油站。从单一油泵起步，逐步建造大型加油站。随着更多车辆的到来，升级并扩展您的加油站。通过满足顾客需求而声名远播。

games.name: Warhammer Blood Bowl - The Official Video Game
games.description:
Strap on your boots. Tighten your helmet. 
Then step onto the pitch and prepare to settle your differences the old-fashioned way: with touchdowns, broken bones and a rabid crowd screaming for violence. This is Warhammer Blood Bowl!

games.name: Pocket Chef: Asia
games.description: 一款温馨的手绘风拉面店经营游戏。从一辆日式街头小摊起步，亲手做好每一碗面，破解谜语点单，数好零钱，哄好一群古怪又可爱的客人。在完整版中，旅途还将继续穿越整个亚洲。

games.name: A Baker's Dungeon
games.description: The ingredients are fighting back! Build your bakery adventuring party, battle through charming bite-sized dungeons, and turn your spoils into new characters, abilities, and upgrades. A short cozy incremental auto-battling RPG where your little heroes do the fighting while you make them stronger.

games.name: Exile of Arcadia
games.description: A high-octane platformer utilizing a teleporting dagger to traverse through a futuristic city!

games.name: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up!
games.description: 从宇宙尘埃开始，追踪未知信号，掌握引力与轨道运动，为稀有资源闯入危险区域。塑造属于你的天体，在高速旋转战斗中击败对手，最终进化为黑洞。

games.name: Quiet Time
games.description: An atmospheric survival crafting game where every sound matters. Explore, gather, craft, and use music to awaken the world, influence creatures, and survive.

games.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
games.description: 在热闹的意大利沿海小镇经营你自己的街头小吃摊。在这款第一人称烹饪模拟游戏中，你将准备意大利街头美食，服务外卖和堂食顾客，管理食材和设备，并逐步发展你的生意。

games.name: DUSKREIGN
games.description: DUSKREIGN is a first-person co-op souls-like dungeon crawler. Descend into a rotting under-realm, fight its decaying inhabitants, and claw your way back to the world above.

games.name: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
games.description: 经营一家霓虹闪烁的公路汽车旅馆，隔壁还开着一间街机厅。与房客讨价还价、升级客房、畅玩八款真正可玩的街机游戏、为饥肠辘辘的玩家烹制汉堡，并用你的复古平板电脑掌控一切。单人游玩或最多4人在线合作皆可。

games.name: Pin Knight
games.description: Strike true with your pinballs in this arcade roguelike RPG and retrieve the Silver Grail from the heart of the Tilted Keep. Plan your route, optimize your build, charge your punches, and take aim to smash through any foe that would stand in your way!

games.name: Lil Guy Resort
games.description: An adventure/party style game where you explore a magical resort with the lil guy of your choice!

games.name: Crimson Spine
games.description: A Metroidvania set in a dark fantasy world where Raed, a knight resurrected under mysterious circumstances, uses her new heart as a weapon to recover her lost memories.

games.name: Pouring Pints
games.description: 经营你的梦想酒吧，单人或与最多 4 名好友一起游玩。拉啤酒、上小吃，在兵荒马乱的服务中让客人保持好心情。普通酒吧、体育酒吧还是小酒馆？按你的想法建造与装饰，每一局都有新玩法。你能坚持营业多久？

games.name: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
games.description: 一款温馨的合作整理模拟游戏:整理约4,400个魔法骰子和桌游用品。单人游玩,或与最多4名玩家在线合作,伴随着令人满足的骰子音效和魔法技能,整理奥秘大厅的9个分区——完全没有时间限制。

games.name: Tin Coffins
games.description: You are Talon-22, a combat clone printed this shift, and twenty-one of you didn't come home. A cel-shaded mech roguelite shooter: short, lethal squad battles through procedurally generated war-torn cities, against enemy squads that flank, suppress and hold the line. Die, and the next you deploys.

games.name: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
games.description: My Cat Scattered Games是一款温馨的单人整理模拟游戏。将5,158款游戏和游戏机放回货架，整理好你的电子游戏商店，并救出被困在抓娃娃机里的淘气猫咪！

games.name: Defend The Wall
games.description:
Choose your hero. Kill demons. Collect gold. Build your army. Upgrade Skills. Defend the wall.   

In this army building incremental game, you must amass the strongest army you can to survive waves of demons and defeat the Demon Lord.

games.name: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager
games.description: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager is a fishing roguelike that has you catching loads of fish and meeting route quotas! Get buffs to increase your ability to meet higher quotas and maintain the needed bait! Catch 101 different species of creatures and customize your fisher to your hearts content!

games.name: Seabun
games.description: 《Seabun》是一款融合增量成长与收集养成要素的2D类幸存者游戏。你将扮演一只科学家兔子，不断潜入更深的海底，探寻大海被腐化的源头。每次潜水归来，把战利品带回家，扩建你的实验室，并把救回来的鱼儿培养成可以骑乘的坐骑。

games.name: 胡闹乐队
games.description: 《胡闹乐队》是一款俯视角多人音乐射击游戏。边移动瞄准，边跟随武器节奏开火；利用掩体与机关，和队友争夺30次团队击杀。还可开启片段成长，在战斗中收集节奏片段与强化，让演奏和构筑一起变化。

games.name: JOINT LIABILITY
games.description: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.

games.name: 人生如蛇
games.description: 《人生如蛇》是一款2D像素风类肉鸽游戏。你将化身成蛇，一步一关卡，体验非凡蛇生。

games.name: Skull Crusher
games.description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

games.name: LOTH
